294552.en: Target must be at war. 100 Political Power to send the attaché.[4] 50 Command power is used to maintain the attaché.[5]
294552.zh: 目标必须处于战争状态。派遣武官需要 100 政治点数。[4] 维持武官需要占用 50 指挥点数。[5]

473360.en: At war. Enemy has an estimated army strength ratio of 70% or more compared to this country. One of the following must be true: More than 70% War support. More than 0% surrender progress. If is Australia: Has completed Citizen Military Forces Has completed Fight Work or Perish If is British Raj: Is fully independent If is Bulgaria: Does not have national spirit Army Restrictions If is Dominion of Canada: One of the following must be true: Has completed Compromise With Quebec Has completed Forced Quebec Conscription If is Hungary: Does not have national spirit Treaty of Trianon If is Spain: Has not completed All Must Bear the Torch
473360.zh: 处于战争状态。敌方相对于本国的估计陆军实力比达到 70% 或以上。必须满足以下条件之一：战争支持度高于 70%。投降进度高于 0%。若为澳大利亚：已完成公民军事力量 已完成战斗、工作或灭亡 若为英属印度：已完全独立 若为保加利亚：未拥有国家精神：军队限制 若为加拿大自治领：必须满足以下条件之一：已完成与魁北克妥协 已完成强制魁北克征兵 若为匈牙利：未拥有国家精神：特里亚农条约 若为西班牙：未完成所有人都必须高举火炬

1036544.en: A battle plan enables automatic management of divisions in a specific role.
1036544.zh: 作战计划可让师按特定角色自动接受管理。

1277015.zh: 否则，如果⟦0⟧拥有⟦1⟧意识形态：⟦2⟧

1345498.en: The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.
1345498.zh: 以下是⟦0⟧玩家为⟦1⟧建议的战略。请记住，由于游戏的动态特性，其他玩家的情况可能会有所不同。

1461824.en: # Medium term goals faction_goal_a_military_base # Long terms faction_goal_defeat_of_communism
1461824.zh: # 中期目标 faction_goal_a_military_base # 长期目标 faction_goal_defeat_of_communism

1898430.en: Has declared war on Germany Has won the war against Germany
1898430.zh: 已对德国宣战 已赢得对德国的战争

1974362.en: This tree improves research speeds, radar technology, and radio technology and unlocks. Electronic engineering is also sometimes referred to as ⟦0⟧.
1974362.zh: 这棵树提升科研速度、雷达科技与无线电科技并解锁。电子工程有时也被称为⟦0⟧。

58ulky.en: This guide is intended as a beginner's tour of the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧. For more detailed information on the mechanics, including some of the detailed math behind some of the computer's calculations, follow the links to the articles dedicated specifically to those concepts.
58ulky.zh: 本指南旨在带领新手了解⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧在《⟦2⟧》中的基础内容。若想了解更详细的机制说明，包括计算机部分计算背后的详细数学原理，请点击专门介绍这些概念的条目链接。

1e8mehv.en: Before Clicking the Game Play Button
1e8mehv.zh: 点击游戏的 Play 按钮之前

hqt5vb.en: It may be a good idea to become familiar with the information displayed, the various button and tab names, and the functions of those buttons and tabs before clicking the game Play button.
hqt5vb.zh: 在点击游戏的 Play 按钮之前，不妨先熟悉界面上显示的信息、各种按钮和标签页的名称，以及它们的功能。

7d5ook.en: Game version - Observe that the graphic shows game version 1.14.3 and checksum 21de. Saved games are set to the game version and ⟦0⟧ that are currently playing. If the saved game version and checksum do not match the game version and checksum, then the saved game will not work. Be aware that the game is normally on automatic updates and once a new version of the game is released, then previous version saved games will not work unless the game is rolled back to the matching version. This rollback procedure can be found on the Paradox Forums. Note that this procedure requires a game code for each owned game branch and that a Paradox Interactive account is needed to view those codes for input into Steam.
7d5ook.zh: 游戏版本——可以看到，图中显示的游戏版本为 1.14.3，校验和为 21de。存档会绑定到当前游玩的游戏版本和⟦0⟧。如果存档的版本和校验和与游戏版本和校验和不一致，该存档将无法使用。请注意，游戏通常处于自动更新状态，一旦新版本发布，旧版本的存档就无法使用，除非将游戏回滚到与之匹配的版本。回滚方法可在 Paradox 论坛上找到。注意，该操作需要为每个已拥有的游戏分支提供游戏代码，并且需要一个 Paradox Interactive 账号才能查看这些代码并将其输入 Steam。

166xcrk.en: Video display button - Clicking the gear icon opens the video display menu. This menu has 3 dropdown menus; Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. The Display Mode allows three choices: Fullscreen, Windowed, and Borderless. Fullscreen is recommended because Windowed and Borderless modes on some systems have been known to cause launch issues such as blackscreens and failure to launch the game (reference ⟦0⟧). The Resolution allows a multitude of choices such as 1600x1024, 1680x1050, etc. Matching the game's resolution to the monitor's native resolution usually gives the optimum viewing experience. The Refresh Rate should also be set to match the monitor, if possible. The 60 Hz selection is recommended because it is quite common and the 50 Hz selection has been known to cause launch issues such as blackscreens and failure to launch the game. This graphic has a vertical arrow pointing to the video display button represented by the gear icon. Clicking the "gear icon" will open the video display menu (see horizontal arrow) revealing 3 dropdown menus; one menu each for Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. Clicking on each small, inverted, green triangle will open a menu for choosing your video preference. The graphic shows that Fullscreen, 1920x1080, and 60 Hz have been selected.
166xcrk.zh: 视频显示按钮——点击齿轮图标会打开视频显示菜单。该菜单包含 3 个下拉菜单：显示模式、分辨率和刷新率。显示模式提供三种选择：全屏、窗口和无边框。推荐使用全屏，因为已知在某些系统上，窗口和无边框模式会导致启动问题，例如黑屏和游戏无法启动（参见⟦0⟧）。分辨率提供多种选择，例如 1600x1024、1680x1050 等。将游戏分辨率与显示器的原生分辨率保持一致通常能获得最佳显示效果。如有可能，刷新率也应设置为与显示器匹配。推荐选择 60 Hz，因为它相当普遍，而已知 50 Hz 会导致启动问题，例如黑屏和游戏无法启动。图中有一个竖直箭头指向齿轮图标所代表的视频显示按钮。点击「齿轮图标」会打开视频显示菜单（见水平箭头），其中显示 3 个下拉菜单，分别对应显示模式、分辨率和刷新率。点击每个小的倒绿色三角形即可打开菜单，选择你偏好的视频设置。图中显示已选择全屏、1920x1080 和 60 Hz。

mn11ua.en: Clear user directory button - Clicking on this button will clear your HOI4 user directory. Only click on this button if you are experiencing game crashes. Reference the Tooltip in the graphic. A graphic with arrows pointing to the "Clear user directory" button and its associated Tooltip.
mn11ua.zh: 清除用户目录按钮——点击此按钮将清除你的 HOI4 用户目录。只有在遇到游戏崩溃时才点击此按钮。参见图中的工具提示。图中箭头指向「Clear user directory」按钮及其对应的工具提示。

1s7ql5.en: Game Play button - Click the game Play button after choosing the video settings, DLC, and mods.
1s7ql5.zh: Play 按钮——在选择好视频设置、DLC 和模组后，点击游戏的 Play 按钮。

h0xicl.en: Create Account button - Click this button to create a Paradox Interactive account. It is recommended that you create an account as it will give you access to technical support in the event that the game becomes problematic. A Paradox Interactive account is also needed to log into the Paradox Plaza website to access the codes for previous branches of each game that is owned. This is due to the enactment of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Other benefits include access to bug reports, game suggestions, etc.
h0xicl.zh: 创建账号按钮——点击此按钮可创建 Paradox Interactive 账号。建议你创建账号，因为一旦游戏出现问题，它可以让你获得技术支持。此外，还需要 Paradox Interactive 账号登录 Paradox Plaza 网站，才能获取所拥有的每款游戏此前各分支的代码。这是由于《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）的实施。其他好处还包括可以提交错误报告、提出游戏建议等。

13l9lk5.en: DLC tab - Clicking on the DLC tab will reveal all of the downloadable content purchased for this game. Clicking an item will place a green check mark next to the item indicating that it has been selected for inclusion in the game. No check mark indicates that the item was not selected for the game. The graphic shows that all purchased items (Anniversary Pack, Historical German Portraits, Poland: United and Ready, Rocket Launcher Unit Pack) have been selected. Note also that such DLC as Together For Victory, Death or Dishonor, and Waking the Tiger are not shown in the graphic as this user did not purchase those items.
13l9lk5.zh: DLC 标签页——点击 DLC 标签页会显示为本游戏购买的所有可下载内容。点击某个项目会在该项目旁显示绿色勾号，表示它已被选中并加入游戏。没有勾号表示该项目未加入游戏。图中显示所有已购买项目（Anniversary Pack、Historical German Portraits、Poland: United and Ready、Rocket Launcher Unit Pack）均已被选中。另请注意，Together For Victory、Death or Dishonor 和 Waking the Tiger 等 DLC 未在图中显示，因为该用户没有购买这些项目。

1g8c8jf.en: Mods tab - Clicking on the Mods tab will show a pulldown menu capable of revealing all of the mods that have been downloaded for the game. Clicking an item will place a green check mark next to the item indicating that it has been selected for inclusion in the game. No check mark indicates that the item was not selected for the game. The graphic shows that the mods "Coloured Buttons" and "More Division Icons" have been selected. Mods can be downloaded from the Steam Workshop. Be aware that some mods will deactivate the ability to get achievements during gameplay and that some mods are not updated for the latest version of the game which can lead to a system crash. Reading the author's information about their mod will usually indicate if the mod is compatible with achievements and what version of HOI4 that their mod has been updated to. A graphic with an arrow pointing to the "Mods" tab. The "Coloured Buttons" and "More Division Icons" mods have been selected.
1g8c8jf.zh: 模组标签页——点击模组标签页会展开一个下拉菜单，可显示为游戏下载的所有模组。点击某个项目会在该项目旁显示绿色勾号，表示它已被选中并加入游戏。没有勾号表示该项目未加入游戏。图中显示已选中「Coloured Buttons」和「More Division Icons」这两个模组。模组可从 Steam 创意工坊下载。请注意，部分模组会关闭游戏中获得成就的能力，还有一些模组没有针对最新游戏版本更新，可能导致系统崩溃。阅读模组作者提供的说明通常能看出该模组是否兼容成就，以及它已更新到哪个 HOI4 版本。图中箭头指向「Mods」标签页。「Coloured Buttons」和「More Division Icons」模组已被选中。

3c25j5.en: Try the solutions listed below if the game fails to launch, freezes, crashes to desktop (CTD), or "blackscreens". The most common causes and solutions are listed first. Contact technical support or visit the forums for additional help. A Paradox Interactive account is required to contact technical support.
3c25j5.zh: 如果游戏无法启动、卡死、崩溃到桌面（CTD）或「黑屏」，请尝试下列解决方法。最常见的原因和解决方法列在最前面。如需更多帮助，请联系技术支持或访问论坛。联系技术支持需要一个 Paradox Interactive 账号。

jfbhl5.en: Some anti-virus programs will automatically block executable files: try adding hoi4.exe and steam.exe to the anti-virus exception list.
jfbhl5.zh: 部分杀毒软件会自动拦截可执行文件：请尝试将 hoi4.exe 和 steam.exe 加入杀毒软件的例外列表。

l8reqy.en: Outdated graphics card drivers: try downloading and installing the latest drivers for the graphics card.
l8reqy.zh: 显卡驱动过时：请尝试下载并安装显卡的最新驱动。

1odgttq.en: Incompatible OS settings: try Windows compatibility settings by navigating to the hoi4.exe file (typical file path C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Hearts of Iron IV), right clicking on the hoi4.exe file, clicking on Properties, clicking on the Compatibility tab, and experimenting with the different settings.
1odgttq.zh: 操作系统设置不兼容：请尝试调整 Windows 兼容性设置，先找到 hoi4.exe 文件（典型路径为 C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Hearts of Iron IV），右键点击 hoi4.exe 文件，点击「属性」，点击「兼容性」标签页，然后尝试不同的设置。

1ra3aqy.en: Incompatible graphics card settings: try running the game on Fullscreen instead of Windowed mode. From the game launch screen, click the gear icon to open the video display menu. This menu has 3 dropdown menus; Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. The Display Mode allows three choices: Fullscreen, Windowed, and Borderless. Choose the ⟦0⟧ option.
1ra3aqy.zh: 显卡设置不兼容：请尝试以全屏模式而非窗口模式运行游戏。在游戏启动界面中，点击齿轮图标打开视频显示菜单。该菜单包含 3 个下拉菜单：显示模式、分辨率和刷新率。显示模式提供三种选择：全屏、窗口和无边框。请选择⟦0⟧选项。

hjacgl.en: Incompatible graphics card settings: try manually editing the settings.txt file by first navigating to the settings.txt file (typical file path C:\Users\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\settings.txt). Then open the settings.txt file and manually change the text to read as follows: fullScreen=yes and borderless=no. ⟦0⟧: Only change the fullScreen and borderless text settings. Do not change or erase the other settings unless you backup your file and know what you are doing.
hjacgl.zh: 显卡设置不兼容：请尝试手动编辑 settings.txt 文件，先找到 settings.txt 文件（典型路径为 C:\Users\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\settings.txt）。然后打开 settings.txt 文件，手动将文本改为：fullScreen=yes 和 borderless=no。⟦0⟧：只修改 fullScreen 和 borderless 这两项文本设置。除非你已备份文件并清楚自己在做什么，否则不要改动或删除其他设置。

3a2967.en: Corrupt user files: Try clearing the user directory. From the game screen, click on the "Clear user directory" button. Then exit the game and relaunch it.
3a2967.zh: 用户文件损坏：尝试清除用户目录。在游戏界面中点击「Clear user directory」按钮。然后退出游戏并重新启动。

166qpjm.en: Corrupt game files: Try a clean reinstallation of the game. Move your important game files to a backup folder. Go to Steam and select the Hearts of Iron IV game from the Steam Library, then right click and select Uninstall... Navigate to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common and manually delete the Hearts of Iron IV folder. Navigate to C:\User\Documents\Paradox Interactive and manually delete the Hearts of Iron IV folder. Go to Steam and select the Hearts of Iron IV game from the Steam Library, then click Install. Do not launch the game yet! Stay on Steam! While still on Steam right click the Hearts of Iron IV game, select Properties, click on the LOCAL FILES tab, then click on the VERIFY INTEGRITY OF GAME FILES button. This will validate the game files just installed. An "All files successfully validated" message should be seen. Start the game with no mods active. Test the game
166qpjm.zh: 游戏文件损坏：尝试干净地重新安装游戏。先将重要的游戏文件移动到备份文件夹。然后打开 Steam，在 Steam 库中选择 Hearts of Iron IV 游戏，右键点击并选择「卸载…」。前往 C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common，手动删除 Hearts of Iron IV 文件夹。前往 C:\User\Documents\Paradox Interactive，手动删除 Hearts of Iron IV 文件夹。回到 Steam，在 Steam 库中选择 Hearts of Iron IV 游戏，然后点击「安装」。此时不要启动游戏！留在 Steam 中！仍在 Steam 界面时，右键点击 Hearts of Iron IV 游戏，选择「属性」，点击「本地文件」标签页，然后点击「验证游戏文件的完整性」按钮。这将校验刚刚安装的游戏文件。应会看到「所有文件均已成功验证」的提示。在未启用任何模组的情况下启动游戏。测试游戏

1gjnmc0.en: Move your important game files to a backup folder.
1gjnmc0.zh: 将重要的游戏文件移动到备份文件夹。

6kph45.en: Go to Steam and select the Hearts of Iron IV game from the Steam Library, then right click and select Uninstall...
6kph45.zh: 打开 Steam，在 Steam 库中选择 Hearts of Iron IV 游戏，然后右键点击并选择「卸载…」

1t9bd9c.en: Navigate to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common and manually delete the Hearts of Iron IV folder.
1t9bd9c.zh: 前往 C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common，手动删除 Hearts of Iron IV 文件夹。

1bvyzyf.en: Navigate to C:\User\Documents\Paradox Interactive and manually delete the Hearts of Iron IV folder.
1bvyzyf.zh: 前往 C:\User\Documents\Paradox Interactive，手动删除 Hearts of Iron IV 文件夹。

gg4iyp.en: Go to Steam and select the Hearts of Iron IV game from the Steam Library, then click Install. Do ⟦0⟧ launch the game yet! Stay on Steam!
gg4iyp.zh: 打开 Steam，在 Steam 库中选择 Hearts of Iron IV 游戏，然后点击「安装」。此时⟦0⟧启动游戏！留在 Steam 中！

1wjc5oy.en: While still on Steam right click the Hearts of Iron IV game, select Properties, click on the LOCAL FILES tab, then click on the VERIFY INTEGRITY OF GAME FILES button. This will validate the game files just installed. An "All files successfully validated" message should be seen.
1wjc5oy.zh: 仍在 Steam 界面时，右键点击 Hearts of Iron IV 游戏，选择「属性」，点击「本地文件」标签页，然后点击「验证游戏文件的完整性」按钮。这将校验刚刚安装的游戏文件。应会看到「所有文件均已成功验证」的提示。

xebug6.en: Start the game with no mods active.
xebug6.zh: 在未启用任何模组的情况下启动游戏。

wqmgdn.en: ⟦0⟧ offers the one-player game of Hearts of Iron IV. All other ⟦1⟧ will be controlled by the computer. The Single Player menu allows for playing the Tutorial or to start a new game as well as to load a previous saved game.
wqmgdn.zh: ⟦0⟧提供《钢铁雄心 IV》的单人游戏。其他所有⟦1⟧均由电脑控制。单人游戏菜单可以游玩教程、开始新游戏，也可以载入此前的存档。

13v8q9f.en: Playing the Tutorial gives a quick run-down of the game and is therefore highly recommended. The Tutorial game may be continued as if it was a standard playthrough after finishing it.
13v8q9f.zh: 游玩教程可以快速了解游戏，因此强烈推荐。教程游戏结束后，可以像标准流程一样继续进行。

1jtcdj9.en: ⟦0⟧ enables Hearts of Iron IV players to play online with other people. Up to 32 players may play (both competitive and cooperative multiplayer) in one game of Hearts of Iron IV at the same time. The host of the game is able to start a fresh game or load a previous session that was not completed.
1jtcdj9.zh: ⟦0⟧让《钢铁雄心 IV》玩家可以与其他人在线游玩。一局《钢铁雄心 IV》最多可容纳 32 名玩家同时游玩（包括对抗与合作两种多人模式）。游戏主机可以开始一局新游戏，或载入此前未完成的对局。

jh7gqb.en: ⟦0⟧ allows for the customization of sound, appearance and gameplay details of Hearts of Iron IV. This includes adjustment of monitor resolution and user preferences for graphics and sound. The first tab includes very important "game settings."
jh7gqb.zh: ⟦0⟧可用于自定义《钢铁雄心 IV》的声音、画面和玩法细节，包括调整显示器分辨率和图形、声音的用户偏好。第一个标签页包含非常重要的「游戏设置」。

1pmdu6l.en: Once through basic setup, the player may choose a scenario and a nation to play for the duration of that play session.
1pmdu6l.zh: 完成基本设置后，玩家可以选择一个剧本和一个在该局游戏中要扮演的国家。

py4dge.en: The 1936 scenario begins on January 1, 1936. The 1936 scenario is the one most likely to lead to alternate versions of World War II, since it starts with fewer alliances or wars to start. 1936 is the place to begin in order to play through the organization and planning of an economy before the war starts. This scenario is about laying the groundwork for the armed forces and war plans, opening with a focus on ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.
py4dge.zh: 1936 年剧本从 1936 年 1 月 1 日开始。1936 年剧本最容易导向不同版本的第二次世界大战，因为开局时的同盟或战争都较少。要从战前就开始组织并规划经济，1936 年正是起点。该剧本的重点是为武装力量和战争计划打下基础，开局时侧重⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧。

1678vqu.en: Each scenario displays a menu with the seven ⟦0⟧ powers ( ⟦1⟧, the ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, and the ⟦7⟧), along with a list of ⟦8⟧ countries with non-generic content. No matter which is selected, a map of the world is then displayed to allow changing the player's choice, including picking countries not previously listed.
1678vqu.zh: 每个剧本都会显示一个菜单，列出七大⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧、⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧），以及一份拥有非通用内容的⟦8⟧国家列表。无论选择哪一个，之后都会显示世界地图，以便更改玩家的选择，包括挑选此前未列出的国家。

h12e4n.en: The starting countries fall into two broad categories:

l3nbu0.en: The majors are the dominant powers of the period, with the largest militaries and economies. Picking a major thus gives the player more things to manage, and a greater role in deciding the outcome of World War II.
l3nbu0.zh: 主要国家是这一时期占主导地位的列强，拥有最庞大的军队和经济。因此选择主要国家意味着玩家需要管理更多事务，并在决定第二次世界大战的结局中扮演更重要的角色。

cgkict.en: Minors have less to manage but can still possess decent military and economic power, allowing them to influence the course of the war in one or more regions of their choice. Some minors like ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ will be largely insulated from the war and able to prepare at their own pace, while others like ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ may find themselves at war with a much stronger power very quickly.
cgkict.zh: 小国需要管理的事务较少，但仍可能拥有可观的军事与经济实力，从而在自选的一个或多个地区影响战争走向。有些小国如⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧基本不会卷入战争，可以从容按自己的节奏备战；而另一些小国如⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧则可能很快就要与远强于自己的列强开战。

mjmf68.en: Ultimately the player may select whatever country they wish, but one should be aware that countries like ⟦0⟧ may not be best suited as the first nation to play as. We recommend any nation you believe you know the most about, or what will be the most fun!
mjmf68.zh: 最终玩家可以选择任何想要的国家，但应当注意，像⟦0⟧这样的国家可能并不最适合作为第一个游玩的国家。我们推荐选择你最了解的国家，或者你认为最好玩的国家！

209vrd.en: In the lower right corner of the map before starting the game are the game settings. Here the player can toggle ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ on or off and use the difficulty settings to make the game harder or easier for the player and also boost the relative power of one or more of the more important nations (this makes them stronger, but not smarter). There is also an icon for showing if steam ⟦2⟧ can be earned in the game or not, they require ironman mode and regular or higher difficulty. When finished press the ⟦3⟧ button in the lower right hand corner to start the game.
209vrd.zh: 开始游戏前，地图右下角是游戏设置。在这里玩家可以开启或关闭⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧，并使用难度设置让游戏对玩家更难或更简单，也可以增强一个或多个较重要国家的相对实力（这会让它们更强，但不会更聪明）。还有一个图标用于显示本局游戏能否获得 Steam⟦2⟧，这需要铁人模式以及普通或更高难度。设置完成后，点击右下角的⟦3⟧按钮开始游戏。

niv20p.en: Players have the option to define a general difficulty which will apply modifiers globally to themselves and/or the AI. In addition, a player may also apply different modifiers to the seven major countries, thereby buffing/debuffing only one entity and the front it plays in.
niv20p.zh: 玩家可以选择一个总体难度，对自己和/或 AI 全局施加修正。此外，玩家还可以对七大主要国家分别施加不同的修正，从而只增强/削弱某一个国家及其所在战线。

bd5mnq.en: The ⟦0⟧ of Hearts of Iron IV will be immediately familiar to veterans of Paradox strategy games. The left hand of the screen will be used to manage large national issues, alert tabs will appear at the top of the screen as a warning of things that need attention, and the right hand side of the screen will be devoted to information about troops. The very top border of the screen will include important summary information about the state of the game and the world.
bd5mnq.zh: 《钢铁雄心 IV》的⟦0⟧对 Paradox 策略游戏的老玩家来说会立刻感到熟悉。屏幕左侧用于管理国家层面的重大事务，屏幕顶部会出现警报标签，提示需要注意的事项，而屏幕右侧则专门显示部队信息。屏幕最上方的边框会包含关于游戏局势和世界局势的重要概要信息。

12vmfzn.en: Across the top left to center of the main play screen, there is a row of numbers running from left to right.
12vmfzn.zh: 在主游戏界面左上方至中部的区域，有一行从左到右排列的数字。

18ne1gv.en: This is the amount of political capital the nation's leadership has accumulated. Political power can be spent on completing ⟦0⟧ ideas, appointing ⟦1⟧ (political advisors, designers, theorists, and military staff), taking ⟦2⟧, changing ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and some ⟦6⟧. Each ⟦7⟧ gains ⟦8⟧⟦9⟧ points of political power per day which can be modified by ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧, ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧, ⟦14⟧ selection, ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧, or player actions.
18ne1gv.zh: 这是该国领导层积累的政治资本数量。政治点数可用于完成⟦0⟧理念、任命⟦1⟧（政治顾问、设计商、理论家和军事参谋）、采取⟦2⟧、更改⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧以及部分⟦6⟧。每个⟦7⟧每天获得⟦8⟧⟦9⟧点政治点数，该数值可受⟦10⟧、⟦11⟧、⟦12⟧、⟦13⟧、⟦14⟧选择、⟦15⟧、⟦16⟧或玩家操作影响。

n6f6ts.en: The measure of the people's support for its ⟦0⟧. A ⟦1⟧ with low stability suffers penalties to ⟦2⟧, political power gain, and ⟦3⟧ while experiencing an increase to occupied territory ⟦4⟧ gain. The ⟦5⟧ stability is 50%. A nation with 50% stability does not gain nor lose anything. Stability ⟦6⟧ 50%⟦7⟧ yields positive modifiers related to factory and dockyard output, political power, and consumer goods while stability ⟦8⟧ 50%⟦9⟧ yields negative modifiers in those categories.
n6f6ts.zh: 衡量民众对其⟦0⟧支持程度的指标。稳定度低的⟦1⟧会在⟦2⟧、政治点数获取和⟦3⟧方面受到惩罚，同时占领区的⟦4⟧获取量会增加。⟦5⟧稳定度为 50%。稳定度为 50% 的国家既不会获得也不会失去任何东西。稳定度⟦6⟧50%⟦7⟧会带来与工厂和船坞产出、政治点数及消费品相关的正面修正，而稳定度⟦8⟧50%⟦9⟧则会在这些方面带来负面修正。

h4zfkw.en: The measure of the people's support for war. War support directly affects mobilization speed, Command Power gain, and attack and defense on ⟦0⟧ territory. Fascist and aggressive nations generally have more initial war support, but they can eventually be surpassed by democracies fighting a defensive war. ⟦1⟧ gain a positive war support buff for being in a defensive war and a negative buff when being in an offensive war. War support is also affected by world tension, ⟦2⟧, enemy bombing, allied interception, enemy convoy raiding, heroes being killed in action, and operative ⟦3⟧. Nations with low war support tend to surrender quicker.
h4zfkw.zh: 衡量民众对战争支持度程度的指标。战争支持度直接影响动员速度、指挥点数获取，以及在⟦0⟧领土上的进攻与防御。法西斯和好战国家通常初始战争支持度更高，但最终可能被进行防御战争的民主国家超越。⟦1⟧在防御战争中会获得战争支持度正面增益，在进攻战争中则获得负面增益。战争支持度还受世界紧张度、⟦2⟧、敌方轰炸、盟军拦截、敌方运输船队袭击、英雄阵亡以及特工⟦3⟧影响。战争支持度低的国家往往投降得更快。

37jne2.en: The number of men available to create and reinforce military units. This is based on the territories under the nation's control (⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ giving different manpower yields) and affected by a number of factors, primarily ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and the number of "units under construction", also known as units under ⟦4⟧.
37jne2.zh: 可用于组建和补充军事单位的人力数量。其数值基于该国控制的领土（⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧提供的人力产出不同），并受多种因素影响，主要有⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧以及“建造中的部队”数量，也称⟦4⟧中的部队。

1ucokz4.en: Three separate numbers, listing the military factories, naval dockyards and civilian factories available for new orders. We will deal with their roles in a future section.
1ucokz4.zh: 三个独立的数字，分别列出可用于新订单的军用工厂、海军船坞和民用工厂。我们将在后续章节中介绍它们的作用。

1gps79l.en: Fuel is generated by the nation's excess oil. Each nation has a maximum capacity for fuel which can be increased by building ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Fuel generation is affected by oil available (domestic and traded), ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧.
1gps79l.zh: 燃料由该国过剩的石油产生。每个国家都有燃料上限，可通过建造⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧来提高。燃料产量受可用石油（本国产出与贸易获得）、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧影响。

1rsv7kx.en: Logistics Capacity (Fulfillment) represents how satisfied your supply lines are. If your country lacks the trains, trucks, or convoy ships for transferring all supply needs, then your units will get reduced supply which can result in supply penalties.
1rsv7kx.zh: 后勤运力（满足度）表示你的补给线得到满足的程度。如果你的国家缺少用于转运全部补给需求的火车、卡车或运输船队，你的单位获得的补给就会减少，从而可能导致补给惩罚。

1sbaxu4.en: The number of ⟦0⟧, also known as transports, that are available. Each trade for overseas strategic resources requires the allocation of ⟦1⟧ units. Moving land units across oceans and seas requires an allocation of ⟦2⟧. The number of available transports can be increased by building new convoys in the unit production menu.
1sbaxu4.zh: 可用⟦0⟧（也称运输船）的数量。每笔海外战略资源贸易都需要分配⟦1⟧单位。跨洋跨海运送陆军单位需要分配⟦2⟧。可在单位生产菜单中建造新的运输船队来增加可用运输船的数量。

na0x3n.en: Command power represents the ability of the ⟦0⟧ to bypass the chain of command and directly influence the military. Command power is used for various military operations and promotion of generals. It is capped at 200⟦1⟧, however, the growth and cap can be increased by ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
na0x3n.zh: 指挥点数代表⟦0⟧绕过指挥链、直接干预军队的能力。指挥点数用于各类军事行动和将领晋升。其上限为 200⟦1⟧，不过增长速度和上限可通过⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧提高。

pxrzr7.en: As units fight or, in the case of armies, ⟦0⟧, they will gain ⟦1⟧. Army experience can be spent in the unit designer to edit or create new land division templates or modify tank and tank variant equipment. Air experience can be spent on modifications for planes, giving them bonuses to speed, firepower, and so on. Naval experience can be spent on modifications for ships or in the ship designer to create new ship patterns or upgrade old ones.
pxrzr7.zh: 当单位作战时，或者就集团军而言⟦0⟧时，它们会获得⟦1⟧。陆军经验可在单位设计商中用于编辑或创建新的陆军师编制，或改装坦克及坦克变型装备。空军经验可用于改装飞机，为其提供速度、火力等方面的加成。海军经验可用于改装舰船，或在舰船设计商中创建新舰船型号或升级旧型号。

15kifm2.en: All three sorts of experience can be spent to gain research speed boosts, at a rate of 100 XP for a 100% research speed bonus for land, air and naval doctrines, respectively. Naval XP may be used to get a 50-150% research speed bonus for certain naval modules.
15kifm2.zh: 三种经验都可用来获得科研速度加成，比例为每 100 点经验换取相应陆军、空军或海军学说 100% 的科研速度加成。海军经验可用于为某些海军模块获得 50-150% 的科研速度加成。

1vcp67f.en: When nuclear weapons are researched, an icon with a number will appear in the top information bar showing the amount of nuclear bombs a country has available.
1vcp67f.zh: 研究出核武器后，顶部信息栏会出现一个带数字的图标，显示该国可用的核弹数量。

1mikzlb.en: World Tension at 100% To the upper right of the screen there is a globe with a percentage below it, indicating the level of world tension. This percentage is the measure of how close the world is to world war. Some diplomatic and military actions, especially for democratic or neutral nations, require world tension to reach a specific level. World tension is increased by historical ⟦0⟧, declarations of war, and other hostile diplomatic actions. The globe can be selected and the Player can access a list of events affecting world tension and a list of ongoing wars.
1mikzlb.zh: 世界紧张度达到 100% 屏幕右上方有一个地球图标，其下方显示百分比，表示世界紧张度水平。这个百分比衡量的是世界距离世界大战有多近。某些外交和军事行动，尤其是对民主或中立国家而言，需要世界紧张度达到特定水平。世界紧张度会因历史⟦0⟧、宣战以及其他敌对外交行动而上升。选中地球图标后，玩家可以查看影响世界紧张度的事件列表和进行中的战争列表。

1s8j44f.en: ⟦0⟧ - Comprises the following three levels of detail and is the mode that will be seen during the majority of game play. Also known as ⟦1⟧.
1s8j44f.zh: ⟦0⟧：包含以下三个细节层级，是游戏大部分时间所见的模式。也称为⟦1⟧。

ar6f4r.en: ⟦0⟧ represent the land borders of countries. Interactions with nations occurs within the scope of diplomacy. Nations have names.
ar6f4r.zh: ⟦0⟧表示国家的陆地边界。与国家的互动在外交范畴内进行。国家都有名称。

1c940hg.en: A nation is comprised of ⟦0⟧. Factories, infrastructure, and most other improvements built using Civilian Factories are done at State level. Each state is limited in how many improvements it can have. States also have names!
1c940hg.zh: 一个国家由⟦0⟧组成。工厂、基础设施以及大多数其他用民用工厂建造的设施都以州为单位进行。每个州可拥有的设施数量有限。州也有名称！

bty30h.en: Within each state are ⟦0⟧. Interaction with provinces is largely done via land units and a set of constructions that generally aid those units - i.e., forts and naval bases. Provinces do not have names unless they are worth a special amount of victory points and their details are visible in the bottom section of the state overview screen.
bty30h.zh: 每个州内部是⟦0⟧。与省份的互动主要通过陆军单位以及一组通常用于支援这些单位的建筑来实现——即要塞和海军基地。省份没有名称，除非其具有特定数量的胜利点价值，其详细信息可在州概览界面的底部查看。

1un48dj.en: There are three other map modes that players use and whose definitions of ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ largely ignore national borders and potentially encompass multiple states.
1un48dj.zh: 还有另外三种玩家常用的地图模式，它们对⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧的定义基本无视国界，并且可能涵盖多个州。

bf8b83.en: ⟦0⟧ - Sea regions of which up to three adjacent ones can be selected when giving orders to naval fleets. Totally independent of the land map mode. Sea regions all have names.
bf8b83.zh: ⟦0⟧：海域。向海军舰队下达命令时，最多可选择三个相邻海域。与陆地地图模式完全独立。所有海域都有名称。

1xo5t4n.en: ⟦0⟧ - Overlays the land and sea map modes. Air bases are assigned operational concern over a given ⟦1⟧ and air wings are given missions. The air base will then have its planes perform their missions within the strategic region. Strategic regions also have names.
1xo5t4n.zh: ⟦0⟧：叠加在陆地和海洋地图模式之上。空军基地被指派负责特定的⟦1⟧，航空队则被赋予任务。随后空军基地会让其飞机在该战略区域内执行任务。战略区域也有名称。

1okrfyj.en: ⟦0⟧ - In the new update, The supply is now reworked to be built around rail systems. There are also supply hubs and a color map to show if it can support your troops on that state.
1okrfyj.zh: ⟦0⟧：在新的更新中，补给系统经过重做，改为围绕铁路系统构建。此外还有补给中心，以及用颜色显示该州能否为你的部队提供补给支持的地图。

5j567e.en: All three of these regions use blue/green/yellow/red border highlighting to indicate neutral/good/moderate/bad conditions in the region relative to either supremacy (land/sea) or sufficiency (supply).
5j567e.zh: 这三种区域都用蓝色/绿色/黄色/红色边框高亮，表示该区域在优势（陆/海）或充足度（补给）方面的中立/良好/中等/恶劣状况。

13bs3ky.en: The Flag and 9 icon buttons (10 with ⟦0⟧ ) to the immediate right of the Flag provide direct access to the primary menus for interaction with your country. The hotkeys for these menu buttons are noted below. They follow, from left to right, across the top row of the keyboard.
13bs3ky.zh: 国旗及其右侧紧邻的 9 个图标按钮（拥有⟦0⟧时为 10 个）可直接打开与国家互动的主要菜单。这些菜单按钮的快捷键列在下方，它们从左到右依次对应键盘最上面一排按键。

t6v6t8.en: To the far left of the screen is the national flag. Click on this flag to open a view of national status. This includes a portrait of the national leader, political system and level of support for each of the four ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧ that currently apply, and three rows of items that can be changed by spending ⟦2⟧. The view includes buttons for managing ⟦3⟧, exiled governments and ⟦4⟧.
t6v6t8.zh: 屏幕最左侧是国旗。点击国旗可打开国家状态视图，其中包括国家领导人肖像、政治制度、四种⟦0⟧各自的支持度、当前生效的⟦1⟧，以及三行可通过花费⟦2⟧更改的项目。该视图还包含管理⟦3⟧、流亡政府和⟦4⟧的按钮。

1kmz03q.en: The player will be prompted to choose a ⟦0⟧ for the country if none is active. Most national focuses take 70 days to complete, at a cost of one political power point per day. National focuses form a tree, like the technology tree, but rather than unlocking technology they are about the country's choice of direction. One may choose to, for the moment, focus on industrial or technological growth, or orient the country's diplomacy towards certain other countries, forming research pacts, starting factions, gaining claims, or threatening war. Some National Focus choices are mutually exclusive; for example, the ⟦1⟧ cannot be friends with both ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
1kmz03q.zh: 如果当前没有生效的国策，玩家会被提示为国家选择一个⟦0⟧。大多数国策需要 70 天完成，每天消耗 1 点政治点数。国策构成一棵树，类似科技树，但它们解锁的不是科技，而是关乎国家发展方向的选择。你可以选择暂时专注于工业或科技发展，或将本国外交转向某些特定国家，缔结科研协定、建立阵营、获取宣称或威胁开战。部分国策选项互斥；例如⟦1⟧不能同时与⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧交好。

11f0u4l.en: This menu also allows political power to be spent in order to change government laws or hire political, military and industrial advisors. These are summarized under the term ⟦0⟧. Most changes will cost a minimum of 150 political power, and very powerful advisers may cost up to 250, with extremely powerful laws and advisers costing up to 300 political power and sometimes even more than that.
11f0u4l.zh: 该菜单还允许花费政治点数来更改政府法令或聘请政治、军事和工业顾问。这些统称为⟦0⟧。大多数更改至少需要 150 政治点数，非常强力的顾问可能高达 250，而极其强力的法令和顾问则可能高达 300 政治点数，有时甚至更多。

1dy803g.en: ⟦0⟧: Affects how much ⟦1⟧ is available to the country for military service, factory output, dockyard output, construction speed, and training time.
1dy803g.zh: ⟦0⟧：影响该国可用于服兵役的⟦1⟧数量，以及工厂产出、船坞产出、建造速度和训练时间。

1005kra.en: ⟦0⟧: Affects resources to market, factory output, dockyard output, construction speed, and research time.
1005kra.zh: ⟦0⟧：影响投放市场的资源、工厂产出、船坞产出、建造速度和科研时间。

1pxadan.en: ⟦0⟧: Affects how many factories are dedicated to consumer goods, manpower availability, civilian and military factory construction speed, and conversion speed for factories.
1pxadan.zh: ⟦0⟧：影响用于消费品的工厂数量、可用人力、民用和军用工厂建造速度，以及工厂转换速度。

dm9bp6.en: Up to three ⟦0⟧ can be hired to give the country bonuses in different fields.
dm9bp6.zh: 最多可聘用三名⟦0⟧，在不同领域为国家提供加成。

1008gt8.en: There are multiple ⟦0⟧ that can be added, such as a tank designer, ship designer, aircraft designer, material designer and industrial concern, to earn reductions and bonuses for the relevant field. These bonuses can include any combination of a reduction in research time, an increase in equipment production, or an increase in equipment combat abilities.
1008gt8.zh: 可添加多个⟦0⟧，例如坦克设计商、舰船设计商、飞机设计商、材料设计商和工业联合体，以在相关领域获得费用减免和加成。这些加成可包括科研时间缩短、装备产量提高或装备战斗能力提升的任意组合。

1jnmd9c.en: It is also possible to add a ⟦0⟧ to reduce doctrine experience costs, to reduce costs for rocket research or nuclear research, or to increase max speed by 10% for armor equipment.
1jnmd9c.zh: 还可以添加一名⟦0⟧，以降低学说经验消耗、降低火箭研究或核研究的成本，或使装甲装备的最大速度提高 10%。

1s1f16u.en: As ⟦0⟧, a Chief of Army, a Chief of Navy and a Chief of Air Force can be hired to improve combat stats in the relevant field. Up to three other members of the high command may be hired.
1s1f16u.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，可以聘请陆军总司令、海军总司令和空军总司令，以提升相关领域的战斗属性。此外最多还可聘请三名最高统帅部成员。

10t9qm2.en: The gray button at the top of the screen marked with a gavel opens the Events and Decisions menu. Decisions allow a nation to do special projects such as switching ideology, conducting border wars, banning political parties, censoring the press, ⟦0⟧, etc. These decisions typically cost anywhere from 25 to 150 political power. Decisions are a middle ground between focus trees and events (allows additional modding and mechanics).
10t9qm2.zh: 屏幕顶部带有法槌图案的灰色按钮可打开事件与决议菜单。决议允许国家执行特殊项目，例如转换意识形态、发动边境战争、取缔政党、审查新闻界、⟦0⟧等。这些决议通常花费 25 到 150 政治点数。决议介于国策树与事件之间（支持更多模组制作和机制）。

xo8yqo.en: The gray button at the top of the screen marked with an eye opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. Establishing an Intelligence Agency allows a nation to recruit operatives (spies), expand intelligence capabilities, and conduct intelligence operations (espionage missions).
xo8yqo.zh: 屏幕顶部带有眼睛图案的灰色按钮可打开⟦0⟧菜单。建立情报机构后，国家可以招募特工（特工）、扩展情报能力并开展情报行动（特工任务）。

31v5lp.en: The gray button at the top of the screen marked with an Erlenmeyer flask opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. There will be two to four slots available to research particular technologies, but pursuing specific national focus ideas may unlock additional research slots.
31v5lp.zh: 屏幕顶部带有锥形瓶图案的灰色按钮可打开⟦0⟧菜单。其中会有两到四个科研槽可用于研究特定科技，但选择特定的国策理念可能解锁额外的科研槽。

1ysxhhe.en: Each nation starts with a historically appropriate level of technology and theory depending on the scenario. All the research trees are marked along a historical timeline. Researching a technology or unit before the historic date will take more days than if it had been researched at, or after, the historic date. This penalty may be modified by pursuing certain National Focus ideas.
1ysxhhe.zh: 根据剧本不同，每个国家开局时拥有符合历史的科技和理论水平。所有科技树都沿历史时间线标注。在历史日期之前研究某项科技或单位，会比在历史日期当天或之后研究花费更多天数。这一惩罚可通过选择特定的国策理念来修正。

18vy4ui.en: There are nine categories of research. Note: ⟦0⟧ are no longer part of the research tree with the release of patch 1.11.0 Barbarossa.
18vy4ui.zh: 科研分为九个类别。注意：随着 1.11.0 Barbarossa 补丁的发布，⟦0⟧不再属于科技树的一部分。

19fhdqe.en: ⟦0⟧: research better infantry weapons and equipment and unlock specialized types of infantry divisions. This is where mobile infantry (motorized infantry and mechanized infantry), paratroopers, marines, mountain troops, trucks, motorized rocket artillery (MRA), amphibious vehicles, and armored cars (requires ⟦1⟧ DLC) will be unlocked. Infantry technology screen - outdated (doctrines removed from research and added to officer corps with patch 1.11.0 Barbarossa).
19fhdqe.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究更好的步兵武器与装备，并解锁专门的步兵师类型。摩托化步兵与机械化步兵、伞兵、陆战队、山地部队、卡车、摩托化火箭炮（MRA）、两栖车辆和装甲车（需要⟦1⟧DLC）都在此解锁。步兵科技界面——已过时（1.11.0 版本补丁“巴巴罗萨”将学说移出科研并加入军官团）。

48prcl.en: ⟦0⟧: research support equipment and improve support companies that can be attached to divisions. This is also where engineers, recon, military police (MP), maintenance, field hospitals, logistics, and signal companies can be unlocked. Train engines and railway guns can be unlocked with the ⟦1⟧ DLC.
48prcl.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究支援装备并改进可配属给师的支援连。工兵、侦察、军事警察（MP）、维修、野战医院、后勤和通信连也在此解锁。列车引擎和铁道炮可通过⟦1⟧ DLC 解锁。

w355ws.en: ⟦0⟧: research that unlocks and improves light (LARM), medium (MARM), heavy (HARM), super heavy (SHARM), and modern battle tanks (MBT), as well as their variants: tank destroyer (TD), self-propelled artillery/gun (SHART or SPG), and self-propelled anti-air (SPAA). With the ⟦1⟧ DLC, the panel consists of various tank chassis technologies as well as individual module technologies ranging from armor plate to engines.
w355ws.zh: ⟦0⟧：解锁并改进轻型（LARM）、中型（MARM）、重型（HARM）、超重型（SHARM）和现代主战坦克（MBT）的研究，以及它们的变型：坦克歼击车（TD）、自行火炮（SHART 或 SPG）和自行防空炮（SPAA）。拥有⟦1⟧DLC 时，该面板由各种坦克底盘科技以及从装甲板到发动机的各个模块科技组成。

k6plyj.en: ⟦0⟧: research that unlocks and improves all types of artillery including anti-tank (AT), anti-air (AA), and rocket artillery (RART). With the ⟦1⟧ DLC, the panel consists of various tank gun module technologies ranging from small cannons to advanced high velocity cannons to auto loaders.
k6plyj.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究可解锁并改进各类火炮，包括反坦克炮（AT）、防空炮（AA）和火箭炮（RART）。拥有⟦1⟧ DLC 后，该面板由各种坦克炮模块科技组成，从小型火炮到先进高速火炮再到自动装弹机。

1dblvv9.en: ⟦0⟧: research that unlocks and improves ships: Destroyer (DD), Cruiser (CL,CA), Heavy Ship (BB,BC), Carrier (CV) and Submarine (SS) hull technologies as well as destroyer ship modules for anti-submarine warfare, smoke generators, improved aircraft catapults and armor for cruisers and heavy ships.
1dblvv9.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究可解锁并改进舰船：驱逐舰（DD）、巡洋舰（CL、CA）、重型舰船（BB、BC）、航空母舰（CV）和潜艇（SS）舰体科技，以及用于反潜作战的驱逐舰模块、发烟器、改进型飞机弹射器，还有巡洋舰和重型舰船的装甲。

idf2ct.en: ⟦0⟧: research that unlocks naval weaponry, naval training, transport ships and mine-warfare technologies.
idf2ct.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究可解锁海军武器、海军训练、运输船和水雷战科技。

n2pz1m.en: ⟦0⟧: research that unlocks and improves aircraft: fighter (FTR), heavy fighter (HFTR), close air support (CAS), naval bomber (NAV), tactical bomber (TAC), and strategic bomber including carrier borne variants and jet propelled versions.
n2pz1m.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究可解锁并改进飞机：战斗机（FTR）、重型战斗机（HFTR）、近距空中支援（CAS）、海军轰炸机（NAV）、战术轰炸机（TAC）和战略轰炸机，包括舰载型和喷气推进型号。

8jrw4j.en: ⟦0⟧: research electrical engineering to improve or unlock radio (for reinforce rate bonuses and signal companies), radars (for detection bonuses), and computers (for encryption and decryption bonuses), research atomic energy to unlock nuclear reactors and nuclear bombs, and research experimental rockets to unlock and improve rocket engines (for rocket interceptors and guided missiles) and jet engines (for jet aircraft).
8jrw4j.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究电气工程以改进或解锁无线电（用于增援率加成和通信连）、雷达（用于探测加成）和计算机（用于加密和解密加成），研究原子能以解锁核反应堆和核弹，研究实验火箭以解锁并改进火箭引擎（用于火箭截击机和导弹）和喷气引擎（用于喷气式飞机）。

1kbrrts.en: ⟦0⟧: research that improves military factories and dockyards (for output, production efficiency and retention, military equipment conversion speed, factory bomb vulnerability and repair speed), construction speed (for faster building), resource extraction (for natural resource gains), and synthetic refineries (for fuel and rubber resource gains).
1kbrrts.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究可改进军用工厂和船坞（提升产出、生产效率及保持率、军事装备转换速度，降低工厂被轰炸的脆弱性并加快修复速度）、建造速度（加快建造）、资源开采（提高自然资源产出）以及合成炼油厂（提高燃料和橡胶资源产出）。

r26nw.en: The gray button with a hand ready to be shaken opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. This menu presents a list of nations and a number of filter buttons to narrow down the list. Note: After an update, the Diplomacy icon was replaced by "International Market." At the bottom of that screen is a button to "Open Diplomacy."
r26nw.zh: 带有握手图案的灰色按钮可打开⟦0⟧菜单。该菜单显示国家列表以及若干用于缩小范围的筛选按钮。注意：某次更新后，外交图标被“国际市场”取代。该界面底部有一个“打开外交”按钮。

1lh5h5d.en: World region Africa Asia Europe Middle East North America Oceania South America
1lh5h5d.zh: 世界区域 非洲 亚洲 欧洲 中东 北美洲 大洋洲 南美洲

4w304g.zh: 意识形态 共产主义 民主主义 法西斯主义 不结盟（中立）

rbvkzq.zh: 阵营 同盟国 轴心国 共产国际

1jfipc7.en: After clicking on a nation to interact with, there will be a portrait of its leader, and a little bit of information about what the nation is up to. In the upper right corner of the menu, there will be a couple of tiny flags with arrows indicating the relationship between the two nations.
1jfipc7.zh: 点击某个国家进行互动后，会显示其领袖肖像，以及一些关于该国动向的信息。菜单右上角会有两面小旗帜和箭头，表示两国之间的关系。

fz81u1.en: There are a number of actions that can be taken in the diplomatic menu, provided the requirements are met. Democracies are especially limited in their abilities to undertake aggressive diplomatic actions unless the world tension meter has climbed to a high enough level.
fz81u1.zh: 只要满足条件，在外交菜单中可以采取多种行动。民主国家在采取侵略性外交行动方面的能力尤其受限，除非世界紧张度已攀升到足够高的水平。

1jghlwe.en: Hover the mouse over each option for a description of the diplomatic action and what conditions must be met.
1jghlwe.zh: 将鼠标悬停在每个选项上，可查看该外交行动的说明以及必须满足的条件。

fovpvi.en: The gray button with box and curved exchange arrows opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. There will be a number of tabs and sortable columns listing the major resources available, what is required such as quantity of convoys, and possible trading partners. These possible trading partners can be further filtered by world region, neighbors, or subjects (puppets).
fovpvi.zh: 带有箱子和弯曲交换箭头图案的灰色按钮可打开⟦0⟧菜单。其中会有若干标签页和可排序的列，列出可交易的主要资源、所需条件（如运输船队数量）以及可能的贸易伙伴。这些潜在贸易伙伴还可按世界区域、邻国或附属国（傀儡国）进一步筛选。

s3dz13.en: There are six major ⟦0⟧ in the game: oil, aluminum, rubber, tungsten, steel, and chromium. These are used to help in the construction of tanks, battleships, planes and so forth. Each new production line of a major weapon system will require a certain amount of resources. Though it is possible to build these units without the necessary resources, production will be much slower and less efficient.
s3dz13.zh: 游戏中有六种主要⟦0⟧：石油、铝、橡胶、钨、钢铁和铬。它们用于协助建造坦克、战列舰、飞机等。每一条新的主要武器系统生产线都需要一定数量的资源。虽然可以在没有所需资源的情况下建造这些单位，但生产会慢得多，效率也低得多。

eq6iho.en: Resources are found in certain locations on the map and are not evenly distributed. Almost always it will be necessary to trade for what is needed.
eq6iho.zh: 资源分布在地图上的特定地点，且分布并不均衡。几乎总是需要通过贸易来获取所需之物。

v418x6.en: To trade for a resource, click on the name of the country and move the slider to determine how much is being trading for. Resources are typically traded in units of 8. Each trade, unless conducted over land, requires a minimum of 1 convoy vessel plus additional convoys depending on naval distance and total quantity of resources.
v418x6.zh: 要进行资源贸易，点击国家名称并拖动滑块来决定贸易数量。资源通常以 8 为单位进行贸易。每次贸易，除非经由陆路进行，都至少需要 1 艘运输船队，并根据海上距离和资源总量需要额外的运输船队。

y5czy7.en: Every eight units of a resource imported will also cost a civilian factory, with that productive power going to the nation that is being traded with. Therefore, exports will make a country's industry stronger as civilian factory "power" is pulled from other nations, but a lot of imports will make a country weaker due to the loss of civilian factory "power". However, it may be necessary to import resources to keep the war machine running at optimal efficiency. Tip: trading with puppets gains considerably more than 8 resources per civilian factory traded.
y5czy7.zh: 每进口八个单位的资源就需要付出一个民用工厂，其生产能力将归属与该国进行贸易的国家。因此，出口会使一个国家的工业更强大，因为民用工厂“产能”从其他国家被抽取过来；但大量进口会使一个国家变弱，因为会损失民用工厂“产能”。不过，为了让战争机器以最优效率运转，进口资源可能是必要的。提示：与傀儡国贸易时，每付出一个民用工厂所获得的资源远多于 8 个。

19w165l.en: The gray button with the excavator opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. This is where tasks will be assigned to the civilian factories - building infrastructure, new factories, defenses, and so on.
19w165l.zh: 带有挖掘机图案的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单。在这里向民用工厂分派任务——建造基础设施、新工厂、防御工事等等。

bohwvv.en: ⟦0⟧ make all the improvements to a State. The number of factories available for construction will depend on the size of the nation, how many factories are being dedicated to providing consumer goods for the country (the Economy Law), and how many factories that are “traded” for strategic resources. The number of civilian factories can be increased by building more, but be careful since each province can only support a certain number of factories. A maximum of fifteen factories can be devoted to a single construction project, and any left over will work on the next item in the queue.
bohwvv.zh: ⟦0⟧负责对州进行所有改造。可用于建造的工厂数量取决于国家规模、有多少工厂被用于为本国提供消费品（经济法令），以及有多少工厂被“用于贸易”换取战略资源。可以通过建造更多民用工厂来增加其数量，但要小心，因为每个省份只能容纳一定数量的工厂。单个建造项目最多可投入十五座工厂，剩余的工厂将投入队列中的下一个项目。

em5jd2.en: There are three categories of structure that can be built with civilian factories.
em5jd2.zh: 可以用民用工厂建造的建筑分为三类。

amhgvg.en: These constructions improve the state without using up one of the shared building slots. Instead, each type of improvement here has its own level and maximum.
amhgvg.zh: 这类建筑会改善该州，但不占用共享建筑槽位。相反，这里的每种改善都有自己的等级和上限。

6sk3tz.en: ⟦0⟧: Each state has an infrastructure rating that determines how easy it is to supply units in the state, how quickly military units can move through the state, how quickly shared buildings can be constructed, and increases resource output.
6sk3tz.zh: ⟦0⟧：每个州都有基础设施等级，它决定在该州补给单位的难易程度、军事单位通过该州的移动速度、共享建筑的建造速度，并提高资源产出。

1dczy8j.en: ⟦0⟧: The larger the air base, the more planes it can effectively field. Air bases house military aircraft.
1dczy8j.zh: ⟦0⟧：空军基地越大，能有效容纳的飞机越多。空军基地用于驻扎军用飞机。

n7ras9.en: ⟦0⟧: Helps defend a state from enemy aircraft attempting to strategic bomb installations such as refineries, factories, infrastructure, etc.
n7ras9.zh: ⟦0⟧：帮助防御一个州，抵御试图对炼油厂、工厂、基础设施等设施进行战略轰炸的敌机。

x9ijjn.en: ⟦0⟧: Helps the air force detect and engage enemy air wings, increases detection of nearby enemy fleets at sea, and gains intel on enemy troops in nearby states.
x9ijjn.zh: ⟦0⟧：帮助空军发现并拦截敌方航空队，提高对附近海域敌方舰队的探测能力，并获取附近各州敌军的情报。

1n41ox7.en: The number of shared structures that can be built is limited by the number of slots available in that State. The number of slots can be increased by researching Industry technologies.
1n41ox7.zh: 可建造的共享建筑数量受该州可用槽位数量限制。槽位数量可通过研究工业科技来增加。

15m784w.en: ⟦0⟧: Used to produce weapons, equipment, planes, and vehicles.
15m784w.zh: ⟦0⟧：用于生产武器、装备、飞机和车辆。

1u7ylhy.en: ⟦0⟧: Used to produce and improve a nation's military/industrial capacity.
1u7ylhy.zh: ⟦0⟧：用于生产和提升一个国家的军事/工业能力。

d92mo5.en: ⟦0⟧: Produce synthetic fuel and rubber, especially useful to nations that lack either.
d92mo5.zh: ⟦0⟧：生产合成燃料和橡胶，对缺乏其中之一的国家的尤其有用。

1n2i3h4.en: ⟦0⟧: Used to produce ships and convoys. Can only be built in coastal states.
1n2i3h4.zh: ⟦0⟧：用于生产舰船和运输船队。只能在沿海州建造。

y2zyzd.en: ⟦0⟧: Locations from which to produce rockets and to launch rocket attacks on nearby nations.
y2zyzd.zh: ⟦0⟧：生产火箭并向附近国家发动火箭袭击的场所。

bomwwi.en: Province buildings are built on the smallest territory size in HoI4, the province.
bomwwi.zh: 省份建筑建造在HoI4中最小的领土单位——省份上。

1p4uz05.en: ⟦0⟧: Stations and repairs ⟦1⟧, and can send and receive supplies and resources via convoys. Each naval base level increases supply capacity and supply throughput.
1p4uz05.zh: ⟦0⟧：停泊和修理⟦1⟧，并可通过运输船队收发补给和资源。每级海军基地都会提高补给容量和补给吞吐量。

oz6s66.en: ⟦0⟧: Inflicts an attack penalty of ⟦1⟧ for each fort level on the attacker in combat. Attacking from multiple directions will reduce fort's effect.
oz6s66.zh: ⟦0⟧：在战斗中每有一级堡垒，就给进攻方施加 ⟦1⟧ 的攻击惩罚。从多个方向进攻会降低堡垒的效果。

1k3fbsn.en: ⟦0⟧: Inflicts an attack penalty of ⟦1⟧ for each fort level on the attacker in naval invasion combat.
1k3fbsn.zh: ⟦0⟧：在海军登陆战斗中对进攻方每级堡垒施加 ⟦1⟧ 的攻击惩罚。

1qq5oa4.en: The gray button with the wrench opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. This is where ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ are assigned to build ⟦3⟧, army vehicles, ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧. The more factories dedicated to building a specific item, the more will be produced. Infantry, armor and artillery units made will then be assigned to the appropriate military divisions, either for new units being constructed or reinforcement and upgrades for units in the field. Excess equipment is left in the national stockpile. Airplanes produced will be deposited into a reserve pool. Naval units will be automatically placed in the highest level naval base, though one can assign a port or fleet if that would be preferable (recommended for the ⟦6⟧ so they don't end up with all new ships stuck in the Black Sea).
1qq5oa4.zh: 带有扳手图案的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单。在这里分配⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧来建造⟦3⟧、陆军车辆、⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧。投入某个特定物品生产的工厂越多，产量就越高。生产出的步兵、装甲和火炮单位随后会被分配给相应的军事师，用于正在组建的新单位，或战场单位的补充与升级。多余的装备会留在国家库存中。生产出的飞机会存入储备池。海军单位会被自动安置在等级最高的海军基地，不过也可以指定港口或舰队（建议对⟦6⟧这样设置，以免新舰船全都被困在黑海）。

1og6zc.en: Factory output is dependent on the availability of strategic resources for higher end units, and on the efficiency cap of the nation's industry. New production lines will take time to be perfectly efficient, and if factories are added to a production line, some efficiency will be lost. Factory productivity and efficiency can be improved in the Industrial research tree.
1og6zc.zh: 工厂产出取决于高端单位所需战略资源的可获得性，以及该国工业的效率上限。新生产线需要一段时间才能达到完美效率，而如果为生产线增加工厂，也会损失一些效率。工厂的生产力和效率可在工业科研树中提升。

ay69hu.en: The gray button with the tank opens the ⟦0⟧ menu to recruit and deploy units. This is where it is decided what types of ⟦1⟧ are to be trained. These divisions will be filled by the equipment and vehicles built in the production menu. What is required to complete a new unit is shown by hovering over the green progress bars.
ay69hu.zh: 带有坦克图案的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单，用于招募和部署单位。在这里决定要训练哪些类型的⟦1⟧。这些师将由生产菜单中建造的装备和车辆补充。将鼠标悬停在绿色进度条上即可查看完成一个新单位所需的内容。

sm4puu.en: The country starts with a few default divisions that can be built. ⟦0⟧ can be spent to design new division templates or edit ones that already exist.
sm4puu.zh: 国家开局时有若干可建造的默认师。可花费⟦0⟧设计新的师模板或编辑已有模板。

1tddrbh.en: The game starts with reinforcement and upgrades given equal weight with the creation of new units. If it is preferable to focus the energy of new tanks or artillery on fresh units, instead of trickling equipment to the field, reinforcement priorities can be set on this screen as well.
1tddrbh.zh: 游戏开始时，补充和升级与组建新单位被赋予相同的权重。如果更希望把新坦克或火炮的力量集中用于全新单位，而不是把装备一点点滴向战场，也可以在此界面设置补充优先级。

ohf6y1.en: The gray button with the paper and pen opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. This menu gives an overall summary of stockpiled equipment, whatever shortages the country might have, as well as a rundown of how many strategic resources the country is missing from the production lines.
ohf6y1.zh: 带有纸和笔图案的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单。该菜单总体汇总库存装备、该国可能存在的短缺，以及各生产线短缺多少战略资源。

10dryu3.en: The logistics screen provides the general overview of the nation's equipment and resource situation. The center of the screen consists of the equipment, and only shows equipment that is being produced, stockpiled, or used in the nation. The following provides a description of all of the various parts of the screen.
10dryu3.zh: 后勤界面提供全国装备和资源状况的总体概览。界面中央是装备部分，只显示该国正在生产、库存或使用的装备。以下对界面各个部分进行说明。

1xeskla.en: ⟦0⟧, which has a above the column, shows the average ⟦1⟧ of all the lines of production producing that type of equipment. The yellow bar inside the area represents the average production efficiency for each equipment type.
1xeskla.zh: ⟦0⟧的列上方有一个图标，显示所有生产该类型装备的生产线的平均⟦1⟧。区域内的黄色条代表每种装备的平均生产效率。

1bstkvp.en: ⟦0⟧, which says 'Equipment Type' above the column, provides the name and a picture of the equipment that is either being produced, stockpiled, or used in the nation.
1bstkvp.zh: ⟦0⟧，其列上方标有「Equipment Type」，提供该国正在生产、库存或使用的装备的名称和图片。

1avx8io.en: ⟦0⟧, which has a wrench being held by a hand above the column, shows how much of that particular equipment is being produced per day.
1avx8io.zh: ⟦0⟧，其列上方有一只手握着扳手，显示每天生产多少该种装备。

14b0k6q.en: ⟦0⟧ is the green bar next to the amount produced showing how much of the equipment need is being produced. There is also a slider button that lays on the left if the nation is running a surplus of that equipment each day, and on the right if the nation is running a deficit of that equipment each day.
14b0k6q.zh: ⟦0⟧是生产量旁边的绿色条，显示装备需求中有多少正在被生产。此外还有一个滑块按钮，如果该国每天该类装备有盈余，它位于左侧；如果每天有赤字，则位于右侧。

lf7aa2.en: ⟦0⟧, with a hand at the top of the column, is how much of that equipment the nation needs each day.
lf7aa2.zh: ⟦0⟧，列顶部有一只手，表示该国每天需要多少该种装备。

i2urmc.en: ⟦0⟧ is the surplus or deficit being ran each day by the country, represented by a scale at the top of the column. If the nation is running a surplus, it will say ⟦1⟧, but if it is running a deficit, ⟦2⟧.
i2urmc.zh: ⟦0⟧是该国每天运行的盈余或赤字，由列顶部的刻度表示。如果该国有盈余，会显示⟦1⟧；如果有赤字，则显示⟦2⟧。

3u1e1q.en: ⟦0⟧ is the stockpile of the nation. It will be in ⟦1⟧ with the stockpiled amount if the nation has extra of that equipment, and will show ⟦2⟧ with the amount missing from the nation, such as the amount needed to reinforce, equip new units, or, for convoys, how much is needed for current trade.
3u1e1q.zh: ⟦0⟧是该国的库存。如果该国该类装备有富余，会以⟦1⟧显示库存数量；如果短缺，则会以⟦2⟧显示缺口数量，例如补充、为新单位配备装备所需的数量，或者对运输船队而言，当前贸易所需的数量。

8be7nj.en: ⟦0⟧ shows the ⟦1⟧ that the production line is currently using to produce that equipment. If none of that equipment is being produced, it will not show the resources.
8be7nj.zh: ⟦0⟧显示该生产线目前生产该装备所使用的⟦1⟧。如果没有在生产该装备，则不会显示资源。

15hbm8c.en: The bottom of the screen includes extra information.
15hbm8c.zh: 界面底部包含额外信息。

1qrlahf.en: ⟦0⟧ has a green bar indicating the percentage of the nation's military factories that are currently in use.
1qrlahf.zh: ⟦0⟧有一条绿色条，表示当前正在使用的军用工厂占全国军用工厂的百分比。

1qccufh.en: ⟦0⟧, like military factories to the left of it, shows the percentage of the country's naval dockyards that are in use.
1qccufh.zh: ⟦0⟧与其左侧的军用工厂类似，显示该国海军船坞正在使用的百分比。

1g6oa0e.en: The six icons to the right hand corner show ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧. Next to each icon will be either a ⟦6⟧ number showing the nation's surplus of that resource, or a ⟦7⟧ negative number showing that nation's deficit of the resource.
1g6oa0e.zh: 右下角的六个图标分别显示⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧。每个图标旁边要么是一个⟦6⟧数字，显示该国该资源的盈余；要么是一个⟦7⟧负数，显示该国该资源的赤字。

1uljc3w.en: The stockpile screen is accessed by clicking on any of the equipment on the logistics screen. The graph in the center of the screen shows the change in the stockpile over the previous ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, or ⟦2⟧, each of which have a corresponding button above the graph. The change is represent by a ⟦3⟧ line, and the X-axis of the graph is the time variable, while the Y-axis is the stockpile variable. Below that is a mini overview of the equipment, which shows the variants of that equipment (i.e. Basic Infantry Equipment vs. Weapons I) and the amount stored of each variant and weekly production of each variant.
1uljc3w.zh: 点击后勤界面上的任意装备即可进入库存界面。界面中央的图表显示库存在过去⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧内的变化，三者各有对应的按钮位于图表上方。变化用⟦3⟧线表示，图表的 X 轴是时间变量，Y 轴是库存变量。图表下方是该装备的微型概览，显示该装备的各种变体（例如基础步兵装备与武器 I）以及每种变体的库存量和每周产量。

12hrypi.en: The gray button at the top of the screen marked with a hat opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. This menu gives an overall summary of your command power allocation and allows management of military leadership in addition to unlocking military spirits, military doctrines, and preferred tactics.
12hrypi.zh: 界面顶部带有帽子图案的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单。该菜单总体汇总指挥点数分配情况，并允许管理军事领导层，此外还可解锁军事精神、军事学说和偏好战术。

3c1j6a.en: Move units by selecting them with the left mouse button and then clicking their destination with the right mouse button. Draw a box around a group of units using left click and drag, to select all units inside the box and issue commands to them. To move troops across the ocean to friendly territory, first send the units to a province with a naval port and then shift-click on the destination port. Click on the Army View icon under the date or press the hotkey "o" to display an overview of all divisions, including indications of their combat status. Right-click on a division's info bar to pan over to it or hold down shift and left click on multiple units to select them all.
3c1j6a.zh: 用鼠标左键选中部队，再用鼠标右键点击目的地即可移动。按住左键拖拽可框选一组部队，向框内所有部队下达命令。要跨海把部队运往友方领土，先将其派往拥有海军港口的省份，再按住 Shift 点击目的港口。点击日期下方的陆军视图图标或按快捷键“o”，可查看所有师的概览，包括其战斗状态。右键点击某个师的信息栏可将视角移到该师，也可按住 Shift 用左键点击多个部队将其全部选中。

1wl0pja.en: Troops are more effective when they are grouped into armies under a ⟦0⟧'s command and given plans to execute.
1wl0pja.zh: 把部队编成集团军，交由⟦0⟧指挥并下达计划执行时，其作战效率更高。

gfdykx.en: You can create ⟦0⟧ of units by selecting a group of them and then clicking on the silhouetted portrait or green plus sign at the bottom of the screen. Then, go to the selected unit profile in the upper left and click on the silhouetted portrait. This will open up the list of generals you can assign to armies. There are two types of military leaders – generals and field marshals, both of whom can normally only effectively command 24 units; but some up to 32. Commanders may also have attributes that give them bonuses in certain types of combat situations. If one promotes a general to field marshal, they lose their attributes (except "old guard") as field marshals have different attributes.
gfdykx.zh: 先选中一组部队，然后点击屏幕底部的剪影头像或绿色加号，即可创建⟦0⟧。接着打开左上角所选部队的档案并点击剪影头像，会弹出可分配给集团军的将领列表。军事领导人有两种——将领和元帅，二者通常最多只能有效指挥 24 个单位，有些可达 32 个。指挥官还可能拥有特质，在特定战斗情形下提供加成。若把将领晋升为元帅，他们会失去原有特质（“老卫队”除外），因为元帅拥有不同的特质。

binsbl.en: Countries will gain ⟦0⟧ mostly through combat, but one can start a trickle of early experience by having soldiers "exercise". To do this, select the army group. A Battle Plans toolbar will appear; click the exercise button in the far left of the toolbar. Be aware that this results in higher equipment attrition, which may not be desirable as a country with limited industrial capacity.
binsbl.zh: 国家主要通过战斗获得⟦0⟧，但也可以让士兵“演习”来获取少量早期经验。方法是选中集团军群，此时会出现作战计划工具栏，点击工具栏最左侧的演习按钮即可。注意这会加重装备损耗，对工业产能有限的国家来说可能并不划算。

l6emk4.en: You can spend experience to promote generals and allowing them to lead more troops, or to create and edit new division types in the unit ⟦0⟧ menu.
l6emk4.zh: 可以消耗经验来晋升将领、让他们指挥更多部队，或在部队的⟦0⟧菜单中创建和编辑新的师类型。

1c0u7ky.en: An army group can be commanded like any other group of units and by giving a right-click move order to a destination. However, they will fight better if they are given "⟦0⟧" – a general order that is coordinated along a front, either to advance or defend.
1c0u7ky.zh: 集团军群可以像其他部队一样指挥，右键点击目的地即可下达移动命令。不过，若为其设置“⟦0⟧”——一种沿前线协调的总体命令，用于进攻或防御——其作战表现会更好。

18a05fp.en: When you select an army group, a row of general orders is displayed at the bottom of their screen - the aforementioned Battle Plans toolbar. Each of these has a popup text that explains in detail how to use the instruction. This guide will focus on the most important ones.
18a05fp.zh: 选中集团军群后，屏幕底部会显示一排总体命令，即前文提到的作战计划工具栏。每个按钮都有弹出说明，详细介绍该指令的用法。本指南只介绍其中最重要的几项。

1q2gtxw.en: ⟦0⟧: Use this for amphibious attacks on enemy territory. (You can move into friendly territory this way, but it is more efficient to simply use port to port movement as described above.)
1q2gtxw.zh: ⟦0⟧：用于对敌方领土发起两栖进攻。（也可以用这种方式进入友方领土，但如上文所述，直接使用港口到港口的移动更高效。）

rzkwni.en: If you select naval invasion, you will be asked to left-click on an origin point. This is where the army will gather for the assault. Right click on the enemy province you want to invade. Note that you will need to have some naval intelligence of every sea lane they will be crossing, so you will have to have warships patrolling or hold naval superiority in those sea areas.
rzkwni.zh: 选择海军登陆后，需要先用左键点击一个出发地点，部队将在此集结准备突击。再用右键点击要入侵的敌方省份。注意，你需要掌握其将要穿越的每条海上航道的一些海军情报，因此必须让军舰在这些海域巡逻，或在该海域掌握制海权。

5y97zy.en: All plans take time, and amphibious invasions take a lot of time to plan. Once the weeks (or months) of preparation are ready, the grey arrow above the army group will turn a faded green. Click that arrow to activate the plan.
5y97zy.zh: 所有计划都需要时间准备，两栖登陆的准备时间尤其长。当数周（或数月）的准备完成后，集团军群上方的灰色箭头会变为淡绿色。点击该箭头即可启动计划。

1l0zrig.en: ⟦0⟧: To make a ⟦1⟧ for offensive land operations, you must first define one's defensive front – this is the point from which the army group will begin their operations. Select the defensive front button and, on the map, draw a line to indicate where an army group will start. (In many cases, this will be a national border or the current line dividing enemy armies). Then, click the offensive front button (a line with an arrow) and draw the front to where the armies should advance.
1l0zrig.zh: ⟦0⟧：要为进攻性陆上作战制定⟦1⟧，必须先划定防御前线——这是集团军群开始行动的位置。选择防御前线按钮，在地图上画一条线标出集团军群的起始位置。（多数情况下，这就是国境线或当前两军的分界线。）然后点击进攻前线按钮（带箭头的线），画出部队应推进到的前线。

x7g4cv.en: The army group units will begin to organize themselves along their defensive front. When they are in place and you are ready to begin, click the green arrow and the units will begin to execute the plan.
x7g4cv.zh: 集团军群的部队会沿防御前线自行展开。待其就位、准备就绪后，点击绿色箭头，部队便会开始执行计划。

1ip74xt.en: You can research ⟦0⟧ and hire advisors that will reduce the time for a military plan to be prepared or add bonuses to units that are operating with a plan.
1ip74xt.zh: 可以研究⟦0⟧并聘请顾问，以缩短军事计划的准备时间，或为按计划行动的部队提供加成。

34f1ti.en: ⟦0⟧ will be automatically grouped into fleets at ports as they are constructed. If you do not like the way fleets are organized, drag-and-drop silhouettes of ships from one fleet to another.
34f1ti.zh: ⟦0⟧建造完成后会自动在港口编成舰队。如果不喜欢舰队的编组方式，可将舰船剪影从一个舰队拖拽到另一个舰队。

1iomt02.en: Assign ⟦0⟧ to your fleets by clicking on the silhouetted portrait and choosing from available naval commanders. You may recruit new admirals for the fleets. Like generals, admirals may have skills that are assets in particular battle situations or while commanding certain types of vessels. Admirals normally have a maximum amount of 10 fleets to lead.
1iomt02.zh: 点击剪影头像并从可用的海军指挥官中选择，即可为舰队指派⟦0⟧。也可以为舰队招募新的海军上将。与将领一样，海军上将可能拥有在特定战斗情形下或指挥特定类型舰船时颇为有用的技能。海军上将通常最多可指挥 10 支舰队。

dtwuh9.en: If a fleet is selected, a row of different orders will appear below in a Missions toolbar. These range from simple patrol missions to convoy escort duty. Choose a mission for the fleet (submarines, for example, are best used to interrupt convoys), and then right-click on up to three contiguous ⟦0⟧, i.e., sea zones that touch each other. This fleet will then carry out that mission over these areas. You can remove these orders by returning the fleet to port and assigning a new mission.
dtwuh9.zh: 选中一支舰队后，下方会出现一排不同的命令，组成任务工具栏。这些命令从简单的巡逻任务到运输船队护航任务不等。为舰队选择一项任务（例如潜艇最适合用来袭击运输船队），然后右键点击最多三个相邻的⟦0⟧，即彼此接壤的海域。该舰队就会在这些区域内执行这项任务。你可以让舰队返回港口并指派新任务来取消这些命令。

1d4divc.en: As long as a fleet is operating in a sea zone, enough intelligence should be gathered about that zone to both route supply overseas through that region or to order an amphibious assault across that space, but if the enemy is active in the region, naval superiority is also required.
1d4divc.zh: 只要一支舰队在某片海域活动，就能收集到关于该海域的足够情报，从而可以经由该区域运送海外补给，或下令跨越该海域发动海军登陆；但如果敌人在该区域活动，则还需要制海权。

14z9kgk.en: Unlike other units, ⟦0⟧ that are constructed are sent to a ⟦1⟧ hangar. You can mobilize them by clicking on an ⟦2⟧, then creating an ⟦3⟧ using the button to the upper right of the resultant menu (it has a plus sign). The larger the airfield, the more planes it can efficiently use.
14z9kgk.zh: 与其他单位不同，建造完成的⟦0⟧会被送往⟦1⟧机库。你可以点击一个⟦2⟧，然后用弹出菜单右上角的按钮（带加号的那个）创建⟦3⟧，从而将其调动出来。机场越大，能高效使用的飞机就越多。

1o4j5xf.en: Like ⟦0⟧, air units operate over regions and are given specific missions relevant to the type of aircraft. Fighters can perform air superiority or interception missions, strategic bombers can target industry or infrastructure, tactical bombers can provide close support for land attacks, and so on. To assign an air wing to a region and a mission, click on an air field. This will open the air information map mode.
1o4j5xf.zh: 与⟦0⟧一样，空军单位在区域上空作战，并根据机型被指派相应的任务。战斗机可以执行争夺制空权或拦截任务，战略轰炸机可以打击工业或基础设施，战术轰炸机可以为陆上进攻提供近距支援，等等。要为一支航空队指派区域和任务，点击一个机场即可，这会打开空军信息地图模式。

1j32cgz.en: Left click on an air wing and then right click on the region where it should operate. You can decide what mission it will perform. Planes have limited range depending on their type (strategic bombers have a much greater range than interceptors) and design (dependent on technology researched or experience spent to edit their abilities).
1j32cgz.zh: 左键点击一支航空队，然后右键点击它应当作战的区域。你可以决定它执行什么任务。飞机的航程有限，取决于其类型（战略轰炸机的航程远大于拦截机）和设计（取决于已研究的科技，或为修改其性能而花费的经验）。

1ds059q.en: Armies in the field will require supplies to remain in fighting shape. An army out of ⟦0⟧ can take no offensive actions at all, including simple movement, even if unopposed. Supply is determined on a territorial basis (i.e., potentially larger than a single State) where each territory is able to support a specific number of troops. However, the final value of this supply to an actual unit is modified by the infrastructure of the State the unit is stationed within. If a territory can support 10 units easily, but if the army is in a province with very low or damaged infrastructure, a supply bottleneck will develop, so not every unit in that army will get what it needs.
1ds059q.zh: 战场上的集团军需要补给才能保持战斗力。一支断绝⟦0⟧的集团军完全无法采取任何进攻行动，连简单的移动都不行，即使没有敌军阻挡也一样。补给按领土（即可能大于单个州）计算，每块领土能够支撑一定数量的部队。不过，这份补给实际到达具体单位时的最终数值，会受到该单位驻扎所在州的基础设施修正。如果一块领土能轻松支撑 10 个单位，但集团军所在的省份基础设施极差或已被破坏，就会出现补给瓶颈，因此该集团军并非每个单位都能得到所需补给。

55eisz.en: Supplies coming over land are also provided by adjacent territories - which forms a supply line back to the capital or an alternate territory if the capital territory is not in one's control. This is why it is particularly important to maintain and defend contiguous States between home and the front lines.
55eisz.zh: 经陆路运送的补给也由相邻领土提供——这形成了一条通往首都的补给线；若首都所在领土不在自己控制之下，则通往另一块领土。正因如此，保持并防守本土与前线之间的各州彼此接壤尤为重要。

o5o5g2.en: When land paths are unavailable supplies will be transported via sea. Overseas supply is done through ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Larger ports can funnel more supply across the ocean, though this will also require more convoy ships. For overseas convoys to be most effective, one will need to assign some of one's naval vessels to Escort duty in the regions that they will cross.
o5o5g2.zh: 当陆路不通时，补给将通过海路运输。海外补给依靠⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧完成。更大的港口能输送更多补给跨越海洋，但这也会需要更多运输船队。要让海外运输船队发挥最大效用，需要把一部分海军舰船在它们途经的区域指派为护航任务。

wq4cs6.en: You can check the supply lines and capacities by clicking on the Supply map mode in the menu to the lower right of the main screen.
wq4cs6.zh: 点击主界面右下角菜单中的补给地图模式，即可查看补给线与补给容量。

q6snsc.en: If all three ⟦0⟧ (Atomic Research , Nuclear Reactor , Nuclear Bombs ) have been unlocked and at least one nuclear reactor has been built, then you will slowly acquire ⟦1⟧.
q6snsc.zh: 如果三项⟦0⟧（原子研究、核反应堆、核弹）均已解锁，并且已建成至少一座核反应堆，你就会缓慢获得⟦1⟧。

rm4zkk.en: To deliver a ⟦0⟧ the you must use a strategic bomber and have at least 75% air superiority over the strategic air region of the target province. Select the province you want to attack and click the nuclear strike icon in the lower left of the province information menu. A nuclear bomb will destroy most of the infrastructure and industry of the target and will damage any units in that area.
rm4zkk.zh: 要投掷⟦0⟧，你必须使用战略轰炸机，并在目标省份所在的战略空域拥有至少 75% 的制空权。选择你想攻击的省份，然后点击省份信息菜单左下角的核打击图标。核弹会摧毁目标的大部分基础设施和工业，并伤害该区域内的任何单位。

1jjkh52.en: If you researches both ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ and also builds a rocket site , then ⟦2⟧ can be launched at distant States to damage their infrastructure. The main advantage of guided missiles is that they cost zero production and zero resources and do not tie up any military factories. Instead, guided missiles are automatically produced at each rocket launch site at the rate of one every 24 hours. Rocket sites have a maximum capacity of 100 guided missiles, which means that the launch site will be totally filled at the end of 101 days assuming no missiles have been launched. Further research into ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ allows rocket sites to manufacture and launch ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ respectively. At present it is not possible to launch nuclear bombs using rockets.
1jjkh52.zh: 如果你同时研究了⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧，并且建造了火箭基地，就可以向远处的州发射⟦2⟧，破坏其基础设施。制导导弹的主要优势在于不消耗任何生产和资源，也不占用任何军用工厂。制导导弹会由每座火箭发射场自动生产，速度为每 24 小时一枚。火箭基地最多可容纳 100 枚制导导弹，这意味着在未发射任何导弹的情况下，发射场会在第 101 天结束时被完全装满。进一步研究⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧，可分别让火箭基地制造并发射⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧。目前尚无法用火箭发射核弹。

1sxrfyd.en: To use your Rockets, hit F3 to bring up the Air Theater Interface. Under the "Ungrouped Air Wings" section, you will see an icon for your Rockets. Click the icon and a window will appear showing each region that has a Rocket Site, and the Rocket Air Wings. Select the Rocket Air Wing, click on the Strategic Bombing role, and select the target.
1sxrfyd.zh: 要使用你的火箭，按 F3 调出空军战区界面。在「未编组航空队」栏目下，你会看到火箭的图标。点击该图标，将出现一个窗口，显示每个拥有火箭基地的区域以及火箭航空队。选择火箭航空队，点击战略轰炸任务，然后选择目标。

byizuw.en: When your Rocket Site begins making ⟦0⟧, they will be limited to the 500km range. As you research ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ your original rockets will be replaced with the new, longer-range rockets, one per day.
byizuw.zh: 当你的火箭基地开始制造⟦0⟧时，它们将被限制在 500km 航程内。随着你研究⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧，你原有的火箭将被新的、航程更远的火箭取代，每天替换一枚。

1a08ovh.en: Once a country has lost owned ⟦0⟧ above a certain threshold that depends on its war support, it will capitulate. All divisions they own in their ⟦1⟧ or occupied territory will be disbanded and their ⟦2⟧ territory will be instantly occupied by the aggressor, but they carry on as a government-in-exile and keep control of their colonies (non-core provinces) - for example, the Netherlands keeps control of the Dutch East Indies. Partisans in occupied territory will continue to be a problem as long as the country's fellow faction members carry on the war - after all, they can still hope for liberation.
1a08ovh.zh: 当一个国家失去的自身⟦0⟧超过某个取决于其战争支持度的门槛时，它就会投降。它拥有的所有位于其⟦1⟧或占领区内的师都会被解散，其⟦2⟧领土会被侵略者立即占领，但它会作为流亡政府继续存在，并保留对其殖民地（非核心省份）的控制——例如，荷兰仍控制着荷属东印度。只要该国的阵营盟友还在继续作战，占领区的游击队就仍会是个麻烦——毕竟他们仍可指望获得解放。

s1rik2.en: If more than one country is fighting on the losing side of the war, the entire faction will surrender when the last ⟦0⟧ country in it surrenders (you can see which countries are considered majors on the world diplomacy screen). When this happens, the game will pause and a ⟦1⟧ will begin. The peace conference proceeds in stages based on the war effort expended by the victorious powers. So, for example, if the Allies defeat ⟦2⟧ and the ⟦3⟧ achieved the most in the war followed by the ⟦4⟧, the United States will have the first chance to make demands on the Germans, followed by the United Kingdom. Then, the next most significant victor(s) will make their demands.
s1rik2.zh: 如果战败一方有不止一个国家在作战，那么当其中最后一个⟦0⟧国家投降时，整个阵营都会投降（你可以在世界外交界面上看到哪些国家被视为主要国家）。发生这种情况时，游戏会暂停，并开始⟦1⟧。和平会议按战胜国付出的战争贡献分阶段进行。举例来说，如果同盟国击败了⟦2⟧，而⟦3⟧在战争中贡献最大，其次是⟦4⟧，那么美国将首先有机会向德国提出要求，然后是英国。接着，贡献次之的战胜国再提出他们的要求。

gtrchw.en: This continues until all the victors are satisfied with the peace, all available demands have been made or no nation can afford to make additional demands on the defeated powers.
gtrchw.zh: 这一过程会一直持续到所有战胜国都对和平条件满意、所有可提出的要求都已提出，或者没有任何国家还有足够的战争贡献向战败国提出更多要求为止。

16v37sn.en: War demands have a cost, and this cost is deducted from the war score of the victorious nation. Some demands, like making a nation a ⟦0⟧, require having that as a war goal unless the rules of the nation allow puppeting without a war goal.
16v37sn.zh: 战争要求是有代价的，这一代价将从战胜国的战争贡献中扣除。某些要求，例如让一个国家成为⟦0⟧，需要将其作为战争目标，除非该国的规则允许在没有战争目标的情况下将其变为傀儡国。

rogmfb.en: As you are learning Hearts of Iron IV, remember these important steps when planning world domination.
rogmfb.zh: 在你学习《钢铁雄心 IV》的过程中，谋划统治世界时请记住以下这些重要步骤。

3r2oqc.en: You start the game with a few ⟦0⟧ of weapons already active. The most important of these is infantry ⟦1⟧, so, until more military factories have been built, put most of your energy here.
3r2oqc.zh: 开局时你已有几条武器⟦0⟧在运转。其中最重要的是步兵⟦1⟧，因此，在建成更多军用工厂之前，把大部分精力放在这里。

10xf997.en: When your country is ⟦0⟧ new ⟦1⟧, have multiple lines of infantry going at once. If you don't, you will fall behind in army size.
10xf997.zh: 当你的国家正在⟦0⟧新⟦1⟧时，要同时开启多条步兵生产线。否则，你的军队规模就会落后。

1pldu9l.en: Plan out ⟦0⟧ early in the game. For instance ⟦1⟧ will want to move quickly along the paths that give it claims on ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. The ⟦4⟧ will need to get itself out of the Great Depression. ⟦5⟧ has to watch its political stability. Have a long term goal in mind. Keep in mind you don't have to research all the National Focuses one after another. Sometimes it is best to wait a bit for the opportune moment, especially with research boosting focuses.
1pldu9l.zh: 在游戏早期就规划好⟦0⟧。例如⟦1⟧会希望迅速走上那些给它⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧宣称权的路线。⟦4⟧需要让自己摆脱大萧条。⟦5⟧则必须留意自身的政治稳定度。心中要有一个长期目标。记住，你不必把所有的国策一个接一个地研究完。有时最好稍等片刻、等候合适的时机，尤其是对那些提供科研加成的焦点而言。

2jd0lf.en: Each nation has access to extra ⟦0⟧ slots if they activate specific national focuses. These are easily identified by the beaker icons on the names (though some focuses with that icon give research bonuses instead - read the tooltips for details). The sooner these are unlocked, the better the army will fight.
2jd0lf.zh: 如果激活特定的国策，每个国家都能获得额外的⟦0⟧槽位。这些焦点很容易通过名称上的烧瓶图标辨认出来（不过有些带该图标的焦点提供的是科研加成——详情请阅读提示框）。这些槽位解锁得越早，军队的战斗力就越好。

qpucay.en: When researching, try not to rush too far ahead since there are significant penalties to pursuing technology too early in the timeline. However, if you research computing in the electrical engineering track, you can reduce their total research time by a significant margin.
qpucay.zh: 研究时尽量不要推进得太超前，因为在时间线上过早追求科技会受到显著惩罚。不过，如果你在电气工程分支中研究计算机，就能大幅缩短它们的总研究时间。

15f8j2p.en: If a powerful ⟦0⟧ is not central to your war plans, you can usually ignore this aspect of the war and research tree. However, convoys are always useful for trade and supply, so it's best to have whatever ⟦1⟧ you own focus on them.
15f8j2p.zh: 如果一支强大的⟦0⟧并非你战争计划的核心，你通常可以忽略战争的这一方面及其科技树。不过，运输船队对贸易和补给总是有用的，所以最好让你拥有的⟦1⟧都专注于生产它们。

objlip.en: If you is at peace, armies should ⟦0⟧ so they can train until they reach regular status and earn ⟦1⟧. Adding an extra regiment, line battalion, or support company to an existing ⟦2⟧ is an easy way to beef up one's forces – unless you don't have the equipment on hand to reinforce what you have.
objlip.zh: 如果处于和平状态，集团军应当⟦0⟧，这样它们就能一直训练，直到达到正规兵状态并赚取⟦1⟧。给现有⟦2⟧增加一个团、一线营或支援连，是增强部队实力的简单办法——除非你手头没有装备来补充现有的编制。

1cw4n4y.en: In wartime, it is often better to let the new equipment fall into the hands of new units instead of reinforcing and upgrading old ones. Adjust the reinforcement and upgrading of troops with an eye to what you need now – more active units in the field now or a stronger punch in a few months time.
1cw4n4y.zh: 战时，通常最好让新装备流入新单位手中，而不是用来补充和升级旧单位。调整部队的补充与升级时，要着眼你当前所需——是现在要更多的前线作战单位，还是几个月后更强的打击力。

gg51gg.en: Democracies should change their economic ⟦0⟧ as soon as they can in order to free up ⟦1⟧ that are otherwise dedicated to producing civilian goods.
gg51gg.zh: 民主国家应尽早更改其经济⟦0⟧，以释放原本用于生产民用消费品的⟦1⟧。

18gzqfj.en: Don't forget to rest armies after they have reached their objectives. A few days of inaction will help with organization, reinforcement and supply.
18gzqfj.zh: 不要忘记在陆军达成目标后让其休整。几天的按兵不动有助于组织度、补充与补给。

j9sjmm.en: Remember infrastructure and fortifications. Should you be attacked, a line of land forts and a ⟦0⟧ for a defensive hold along a strategic line (like mountains or a river) could give you time to hold off an invasion as you wait for help from allies and/or their own reinforcements.
j9sjmm.zh: 记住基础设施与工事。若遭到攻击，沿战略要线（如山地或河流）修建一道陆上要塞和一条⟦0⟧以防守，可以在你等待盟友援助和/或自身增援时为你争取击退入侵的时间。

1upnlvf.en: If you lack a resource, but produce it locally (i.e. steel is produced, but not enough of it), try to avoid trading for it unless absolutely necessary. You can research excavation under the industry tab, which will increase the amount of your produced resources by 10% for each tier, up to 50% bonus if all tiers of excavation are researched. This will free up your civilian factories from trade and allow you to construct more buildings.
1upnlvf.zh: 如果你缺少某种资源，但本地能生产它（即钢铁有产出，但数量不足），除非绝对必要，否则尽量避免通过贸易获取。你可以在工业标签下研究开采科技，每级可将你生产的资源量提高 10%，如果研究完所有等级的开采科技，最高可获得 50% 的加成。这将使你的民用工厂从贸易中解放出来，让你能建造更多建筑。

wday6d.en: When there is a lack of material, remember to check what is being produced. It won't do to have too many different recruits going at once (i.e both motorized and infantry) if what the factories are producing is going toward upgrades. An example would be to trim away motorized infantry for a while and focus on just regular infantry. If you lower the production of motorized and focus that on upgrading an existing unit, the free factories can be moved to infantry equipment and by extension allow for the production of more units.
wday6d.zh: 当物资短缺时，记得检查生产内容。如果工厂的产出正被用于升级，同时培养太多不同类型的兵员（即摩托化与步兵并行）是没有好处的。举个例子，可以暂时削减摩托化步兵，专注于普通步兵。如果你降低摩托化的生产，并把产能集中用于升级现有单位，腾出来的工厂就可以转去生产步兵装备，进而让你能生产更多单位。

1u1tevb.en: When ⟦0⟧ is low, remember to change your conscription law and try attaching Field Hospitals as support companies or disbanding units you don't need, including air wings and ships. If you must maintain a large front and can't afford to reduce the number of divisions you have, you can consider making them smaller. Quite often you can afford to remove one infantry battalion from your default divisions and they will perform almost the same. Keep in mind that the Total Mobilization (Economy Law) gives you -3% recruitable population and generally isn't worth having, unless you can spare the manpower. The Mobile Warfare and Mass Assault Land Doctrines, as well as the Nationalist branch of the general National Focus tech tree give bonuses to your manpower pool. If you have concerns about your manpower in the long run, consider creating high-tech divisions with advanced equipment. Higher production cost is generally linked with manpower preservation - an infantry division will lose a lot more manpower than a mechanized division. Mountaineers and Marines will save you a little bit of manpower, compared to regular infantry, if deployed properly in their respective fields, due to their combat bonuses in mountains/hills and river crossings/naval invasions, as well as their slightly higher breakthrough stat, and they only cost more Infantry Weapons and training time to produce.
1u1tevb.zh: 当⟦0⟧偏低时，记得更改征兵法令，并尝试将野战医院作为支援连编入，或解散你不需要的单位，包括航空队和舰船。如果你必须维持一条漫长的战线，又无力削减师的数目，可以考虑把它们编得更小。你往往可以把默认师中的一个步兵营去掉，而它们表现几乎不变。请记住，「总体战动员」（经济法令）会使你可招募人口减少 3%，通常并不值得采用，除非你有多余的人力。机动战争与大规模突击陆军学说，以及通用国策树中的民族主义分支，都会为你的可用人力池提供加成。如果你对长远的人力有顾虑，可以考虑用先进装备组建高科技师。更高的生产成本通常与保存人力相关——一个步兵师损失的人力会比一个机械化师多得多。与普通步兵相比，山地兵和海军陆战队员若在各自擅长的领域部署得当（山地/丘陵与渡河/海军登陆的战斗加成，以及略高的突破属性），可以为你节省一点人力，而他们只消耗更多的步兵武器和更长的训练时间。

rfko2y.en: Doctrines should be picked carefully and with consideration. It is possible to switch from one doctrine to another, should the need arise, but it takes a lot of respective experience you will lose the old doctrine. The good part about doctrines is, that they don't require production and the bonuses come into play as soon as you unlock them. There are about 10 separate doctrines in Land Doctrines, 12 in Air, and 15 in Naval. The base cost is 100 experience for Land Doctrines/Air/Naval Doctrines, so it will take considerable amounts of experience to change a fully unlocked doctrine.
rfko2y.zh: 学说的选择应当谨慎并经过斟酌。必要时可以从一种学说切换到另一种，但这需要消耗大量相应的经验，而且你会失去旧学说。学说的好处在于它们不需要生产，并且一旦解锁其加成就会立即生效。陆军学说中约有 10 种独立学说，空军 12 种，海军 15 种。陆军/空军/海军学说的基础花费为 100 经验，因此要更换一套完全解锁的学说需要相当可观的经验。

yop19a.en: Remember to update, research and produce the next tier of equipment for units you find lacking in quality. Sometimes an upgraded version of a unit has a lot more hidden bonuses than one might expect.
yop19a.zh: 记得为那些你认为质量不足的单位更新、研究并生产下一级装备。有时单位的升级版会带来远超预期的隐藏加成。

9sc6q4.en: Different Factions have different disadvantages and advantages when it comes to securing resources. The Allies begin with the majority of Rubber production, and anyone going to war with them will have serious troubles with securing rubber without a plan to attack Allied South-east Asia, or without a lot of Refineries. Rubber is needed for all aircraft, as well as motorized/motorized artillery and mechanized. Most of the world's Chromium can be found in the Soviet Union, Turkey, South Africa, France, Cuba and Yugoslavia. Chromium is needed for ships and heavy tanks, as well as modern tanks. The only ships that don't require Chromium are Destroyers I-III, Light Cruisers I-III, Heavy Cruisers I-III, Submarines I-III. If you want to maintain a fleet of capital or modern ships, you will need to secure those places for yourself, or as allies. Aluminium can be found in France, the United States, Hungary, the Soviet Union, and Yugoslavia. Aluminium is needed for all aircraft, as well as support equipment. When planning your strategy you have to plan to either skip mass production of units requiring resources you don't have, or to plan to steal those resources from the enemy to secure your production or deny the enemy production of a particular equipment type. If you are playing as a minor nation, you might want to consider which side to join, if any, depending on the resources you will need to power your economy.
