appvy.en: ⟦0⟧ allow the players (and the AI) to direct the development of their nation. Each country has a ⟦1⟧, representing a number of progression paths (branches) available to that nation. These paths may be based on actual historical situations or on alternative historical possibilities. The individual options can range from political, diplomatic and warfare-related focuses to more economic and research-related focuses.
appvy.zh: ⟦0⟧允许玩家（以及AI）引导本国的发展方向。每个国家都拥有一个⟦1⟧，代表该国可用的若干发展路线（分支）。这些路线可能基于真实历史情况，也可能基于架空历史可能性。各个选项既有与政治、外交和战争相关的焦点，也有更偏经济与科研的焦点。

m0bvqm.en: Due to the semi-random nature of the AI it ensures that no two games will play out in precisely the same way. Players wishing to have a more historical-based campaign can choose to do so by ticking the ⟦0⟧ option on the country selection screen (map) just before the start of a new game. It is important to note, however, that player nations are not bound by this and as such their in-game actions can still force the AI to pick somewhat less than historical choices.
m0bvqm.zh: 由于AI具有半随机性，因此没有两局游戏会以完全相同的方式发展。希望进行更贴近历史的战役的玩家，可以在新游戏开始前于国家选择界面（地图）上勾选⟦0⟧选项来做到这一点。但要注意，玩家所控制的国家并不受此限制，因此玩家在游戏中的行动仍可能迫使AI做出不太符合历史的选择。

1ytpbmu.en: The seven ⟦0⟧ as well as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ have a unique national focus tree in the base game. Additional countries - ⟦3⟧ - received a unique focus tree as part of different DLCs. All other nations use the ⟦4⟧.
1ytpbmu.zh: 基础游戏中的七个⟦0⟧以及⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧拥有独特的国策树。其他国家——⟦3⟧——随着不同DLC的推出获得了独特的国策树。所有其余国家则使用⟦4⟧。

121mc3a.en: Branches in a focus tree revolve around a common theme or goal with the individual focuses within intended to help in achieving that goal. Although branches are mostly isolated from each other, they will be connected (locally) if they happen to coincide over a common point.
121mc3a.zh: 国策树中的分支围绕某个共同主题或目标展开，其中的各个焦点旨在帮助实现该目标。虽然各分支大多彼此独立，但如果它们恰好交汇于同一点，就会（在局部）相互连接。

1te67p7.en: Only a single focus can be taken at a time. A 70 day focus requires ⟦0⟧ Political power to complete at a progress rate of ⟦1⟧ Political power per day, and a 35 day focus requires ⟦2⟧ Political power to complete. When completed, the player may go up to 10 days without picking a new focus and still have those days (and their accumulated Political power) count towards the new focus.
1te67p7.zh: 同一时间只能推进一个焦点。一个70天的焦点需要⟦0⟧政治点数才能完成，进度速率为每天⟦1⟧政治点数；一个35天的焦点需要⟦2⟧政治点数完成。焦点完成后，玩家最多可以空置10天不选择新焦点，这些天数（及其累积的政治点数）仍会计入新焦点。

28j0a9.en: Aside from the branches' top level focuses, most other focuses have additional requirements in need of fulfillment before they can be picked. If a requirement of an on-going focus has become invalidated, the focus will either be paused until the requirement is restored (if possible) or outright be cancelled when such a thing is not easily possible. For cases such as the latter, focuses will have bypass conditions to allow the player to proceed past them - the player will be notified of the bypass within a few days (they will display a golden bracket as if completed regularly). For example, ⟦0⟧ can be bypassed if the Motorized Infantry technology has already been researched beforehand.
28j0a9.zh: 除各分支的顶层焦点外，大多数其他焦点都有额外的前置要求需要满足才能选取。如果正在进行的焦点的某项要求失效，该焦点将暂停，直到要求恢复（如果可能）；若无法轻易恢复，则会被直接取消。对于后者这类情况，焦点会带有跳过条件，让玩家可以越过它们——玩家会在几天内收到跳过通知（它们会像正常完成一样显示金色括号）。例如，如果事先已研究摩托化步兵科技，⟦0⟧就可以被跳过。

a4ust8.en: Once a focus has started, the player can manually stop it, unless explicitly prohibited. If stopped, a maximum of 10 days of focus progress is saved. If, due to circumstances, the focus has been invalidated, the political power already spent are lost. As such, it is recommended to check all requirements and conditions regarding a focus to assess if/how they may be affected within its completion time-frame.
a4ust8.zh: 焦点一旦开始，玩家可以手动停止它，除非被明确禁止。停止后，最多保留10天的焦点进度。如果因情况变化导致焦点失效，已花费的政治点数将会损失。因此建议检查焦点的所有要求与条件，评估它们在完成时限内是否/如何受到影响。

pwx5h2.en: Accessing a focus' expanded details can be achieved by clicking or hovering over the focus. Among the information presented there are: the flavor description, its requirements, bypass conditions (if applicable) and the expected completion effects.
pwx5h2.zh: 点击或悬停在焦点上即可查看其展开的详细信息。其中包含：风味描述、前置要求、跳过条件（如适用）以及预计的完成效果。

ecnhwg.en: ⟦0⟧ - Players can check at a glance a focus' completion status by the background color of its name bracket. Grey bracket means available for picking, brown bracket indicates as of yet unavailability and golden bracket denotes completed focuses. On-going focuses will feature a shining overlay effect over them.
ecnhwg.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 玩家可以通过焦点名称括号的背景颜色一眼看出其完成状态。灰色括号表示可以选取，棕色括号表示尚不可用，金色括号表示已完成。进行中的焦点上会显示闪耀的叠加效果。

8cbz9.en: ⟦0⟧ - Focuses are connected by colored lines. The color indicates whether its preceding focus is completed (green) or not (light-blue). The connection may also appear as a solid or dotted line, with the former indicating a logical ⟦1⟧ and the latter a logical ⟦2⟧. For example, to pick ⟦3⟧ would require all 3 of the focuses preceding it while picking ⟦4⟧ requires only one of the 2 preceding it.
8cbz9.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 焦点之间由彩色线条连接。线条颜色表示其前置焦点是否已完成（绿色为已完成，浅蓝色为未完成）。连接线也可能显示为实线或虚线，前者表示逻辑上的⟦1⟧，后者表示逻辑上的⟦2⟧。例如，选取⟦3⟧需要其前面的全部3个焦点，而选取⟦4⟧只需其前面2个焦点中的任意一个。

5old9x.en: ⟦0⟧ - Some focuses may have the ⟦1⟧ icon appearing in-between them. The icon denotes that only one of two may be selected. Further more, depending on the focuses outgoing connections it may also exclude from picking any of the focuses connected to them further down the line. For example, choosing between ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ will make any of the other side's subsequent connected focuses unavailable for picking up until ⟦4⟧ (linked to both sides by an ⟦5⟧ connection).
5old9x.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 有些焦点之间会出现⟦1⟧图标。该图标表示两者中只能选择其一。此外，根据焦点向外的连接情况，它还可能使与它们相连的后续焦点无法选取。例如，在⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧之间做出选择后，另一侧的后续相连焦点都将无法选取，直到⟦4⟧（通过⟦5⟧连接与两侧相连）。

pjzyhu.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a special type of focus that is unlocked once 10 regular focuses have been completed. There are a total of 9 continuous focuses available.
pjzyhu.zh: ⟦0⟧是一种特殊类型的焦点，在完成10个常规焦点后解锁。游戏中共有9个持续焦点可用。

yrcv8l.en: Having an active continuous focus comes at the expense of pursuing a regular focus as only one focus can be picked at a time regardless of its type.
yrcv8l.zh: 启用持续焦点会以放弃推进常规焦点为代价，因为无论类型如何，同一时间只能选取一个焦点。

sxwwlk.en: As opposed to a regular focus which provides one-time effects, the effects of a continuous focus benefit the nation whilst the chosen focus remains active. An active focus requires a maintenance cost of ⟦0⟧ Political power per day. The focus can, however, be deactivated or switched with another at any time for no additional cost.
sxwwlk.zh: 常规焦点提供一次性效果，而持续焦点在所选焦点保持激活期间持续为国家提供加成。激活的焦点需要每天⟦0⟧政治点数的维持费用。不过，该焦点可以随时停用或切换为另一个，且无需额外费用。

1pp55g3.en: Gives the country choices on which political path they will take.

1nsm9ui.en: ⟦0⟧ The generic focus tree also acts as the default tree for nations which received a unique focus tree in a DLC if said DLC is ⟦1⟧ enabled.

1w7y3h6.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to unlock technologies. These can serve to unlock new units, equipment or structures or to improve the performance of existing units, equipment and structures.
1w7y3h6.zh: ⟦0⟧用于解锁科技。科技可以解锁新的单位、装备或建筑，也可以提升现有单位、装备和建筑的性能。

1m2vdvo.en: ⟦0⟧: Technologies that improve infantry weapons and equipment, unlock or improve motorized and mechanized units as well as special forces (marines, mountaineers and paratroopers).
1m2vdvo.zh: ⟦0⟧：改善步兵武器与装备的科技，可解锁或改进摩托化与机械化单位以及特种部队（海军陆战队、山地兵和伞兵）。

gbkqhl.en: ⟦0⟧: Technologies that unlock and improve all types of artillery, including anti-tank, anti-air and rocket artillery.
gbkqhl.zh: ⟦0⟧：解锁并改进所有类型火炮的科技，包括反坦克炮、防空炮和火箭炮。

1a3wkxk.en: ⟦0⟧: Technologies that unlock and improve all types of support battalions: Engineers, Reconnaissance, Military Police, Maintenance, Field Hospital, Logistics and Signal companies.
1a3wkxk.zh: ⟦0⟧：解锁并改进所有类型支援连的科技：工兵连、侦察连、军事警察连、维修连、野战医院连、后勤连和通信连。

10yhlbu.en: ⟦0⟧ (different ⟦1⟧): Technologies that unlock all types and models of tanks, from light to super heavy chassis, as well as their variants: tank destroyer, self-propelled artillery and self-propelled anti-air.
10yhlbu.zh: ⟦0⟧（不同于⟦1⟧）：解锁所有类型与型号坦克的科技，从轻型到超重型底盘，以及其变体：坦克歼击车、自行火炮和自行防空炮。

8vtnik.en: ⟦0⟧ (different ⟦1⟧): Technologies that unlock or improve all kinds of ship units: destroyers, light and heavy cruisers, battlecruisers, battleships, carriers, and submarines.
8vtnik.zh: ⟦0⟧（不同于⟦1⟧）：解锁或改进所有类型舰船单位的科技：驱逐舰、轻型与重型巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰、战列舰、航空母舰和潜艇。

813f1o.en: ⟦0⟧: With ⟦1⟧, the naval support research tree includes all technologies which are not direct derivatives of ship hulls. These technologies include for the most part new or improved naval weaponry.
813f1o.zh: ⟦0⟧：在⟦1⟧下，海军支援科研树包含所有并非直接衍生自舰体的科技。这些科技大多是新型或改进型的海军武器。

l7g2mn.en: ⟦0⟧ (different ⟦1⟧): Technologies that unlock or improve all types of airframes: light, medium or heavy, as well as their jet propulsion versions.
l7g2mn.zh: ⟦0⟧（不同于⟦1⟧）：解锁或改进所有类型机体的科技：轻型、中型或重型，以及它们的喷气推进版本。

2d8t63.en: ⟦0⟧: Groups all technologies related to electronic engineering (computers, radios, cryptography), rockets, and atomic research.
2d8t63.zh: ⟦0⟧：汇总所有与电子工程（计算机、无线电、密码学）、火箭和原子研究相关的科技。

661k3n.en: ⟦0⟧: Groups all technologies that improve production efficiency and volume of all ⟦1⟧, increase the excavation of resources, and unlock and improve ⟦2⟧.
661k3n.zh: ⟦0⟧：汇总所有可提升全部⟦1⟧的生产效率与产量、增加资源开采量，以及解锁并改进⟦2⟧的科技。

vglh6q.en: Special project: All technologies that are directly unlocked by completing certain special projects.
vglh6q.zh: 特殊项目：通过完成特定特殊项目直接解锁的所有科技。

lpjpiu.en: Technology is unlocked by assigning a research slot to it for the required number of days.
lpjpiu.zh: 将科研槽分配给某项科技并持续所需天数，即可解锁该科技。

fe7k0k.en: Some countries are defined with the base numbers of research slots, while other European countries have 3 and non-European countries have 2 by default. In addition to the base slots, countries can unlock additional research slots via their ⟦0⟧ trees (1~3 depending on the country). For most countries, they can not complete all these focuses in a game because they belong to different branches. Some of these focuses require some conditions, like having a substantial number of factories (usually 50+), and the Commonwealth countries must additionally become fully independent to maximize their available research slots.
fe7k0k.zh: 部分国家有指定的基础科研槽数量，而其他欧洲国家默认为3个，非欧洲国家默认为2个。除基础科研槽外，国家还可以通过其⟦0⟧树解锁额外科研槽（视国家不同为1~3个）。对大多数国家而言，这些焦点分属不同分支，一局游戏中无法全部完成。其中一些焦点需要满足条件，例如拥有足够数量的工厂（通常为50个以上），而英联邦国家还必须完全独立，才能最大化其可用科研槽。

11lpijx.en: Each research slot can store up to 30 points of "Days Saved" without being assigned to a specific tech.⟦0⟧ "Days Saved" functions as days added to research progress once a tech is chosen for the slot. See ⟦1⟧.
11lpijx.zh: 每个科研槽在未指派具体科技时最多可储存 30 点「节省天数」。⟦0⟧ 一旦为该槽选定科技，「节省天数」便作为科研进度增加的天数生效。参见 ⟦1⟧。

16b91v3.en: Each technology has a base time cost. They are multiples of the standard base cost of 110⟦0⟧ days.
16b91v3.zh: 每项科技都有基础时间成本，它们是标准基础成本 110⟦0⟧ 天的倍数。

b0xvgl.en: Base research cost represents the time it takes to research a specific technology. In practice, this cost will likely vary each time due to different research modifiers being applied (for better or for worse).
b0xvgl.zh: 基础科研成本指研究某项特定科技所需的时间。实际上，由于会施加不同的科研修正，该成本每次往往都会变化（或有利或不利）。

af8qbh.en: Research speed modifiers stack additively to research speed (rather than subtractively to research cost). For example, 110 days base cost at 15% research speed bonus will take:
af8qbh.zh: 科研速度修正以加法叠加到科研速度上（而不是从科研成本中扣减）。例如，基础成本 110 天、科研速度加成 15% 时，所需时间为：

16sb19e.en: "Days Saved" are subtracted from the modified expected number of days. Thus, "Days Saved" benefit from (or are penalized by) the same research speed modifiers.
16sb19e.zh: 「节省天数」会从修正后的预计天数中扣除。因此，「节省天数」也受相同科研速度修正的加成（或惩罚）。

h9xhnx.en: The aggregate research bonus is calculated and updated every day. Thus changes in research speed (except limited-use bonuses) apply to all ongoing research.
h9xhnx.zh: 总科研加成每天都会计算并更新。因此，科研速度的变化（有限次加成除外）会作用于所有进行中的科研。

18j0l17.en: Research speed cannot fall below 10% of the default speed.⟦0⟧
18j0l17.zh: 科研速度不能低于默认速度的 10%。⟦0⟧

8ojlr6.zh: 根据游戏难度设置，玩家会获得科研速度加成或惩罚，具体如下：

kn8y4v.en: Trade laws can also increase research speed. The more open the trade the higher the reduction as can be seen below.

1rs65ut.en: Limited-use bonuses are awarded by ⟦0⟧. Once available, a limited-use research bonus is activated when a Research Slot is assigned to an applicable technology. Once activated, the limited-use bonus is tied to the technology even if the slot is re-assigned. However, the game does give a grace period of 3⟦1⟧ days to switch the bonus to a different applicable technology with the same slot.
1rs65ut.zh: 有限次加成由⟦0⟧提供。一旦可用，当某个科研槽被指派研究适用的科技时，有限次科研加成即被激活。激活后，即使重新指派该槽位，有限次加成仍与该科技绑定。不过，游戏给予 3⟦1⟧ 天的宽限期，以便用同一槽位将该加成切换到另一项适用的科技。

10xu0l3.en: A limited-use bonus can additionally act as an ⟦0⟧ bonus, reducing the ahead-of-time penalty by the stated amount.
10xu0l3.zh: 有限次加成还可充当⟦0⟧加成，按标明的数值降低超前惩罚。

dz96yv.en: Some ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ allow the player to spend ⟦2⟧ to acquire a one-time research speed bonus for them. These bonuses apply on top of any existing one-time bonuses that would be expended alongside them.
dz96yv.zh: 部分⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧允许玩家花费⟦2⟧，为其获得一次性科研速度加成。这些加成会叠加在与其一同消耗的既有一次性加成之上。

1pqnsgo.en: When licensing equipment from another country, researching that equipment gets a speed bonus of ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ For equipment that uses designs, such as ⟦2⟧ (with ), ⟦3⟧ (with ), and ⟦4⟧ (with ), the bonus only applies to technologies for the chassis, hulls, and airframes, not to any module technologies for components of the licensed design(s).
1pqnsgo.zh: 当他国许可生产装备时，研究该装备可获得 ⟦0⟧ 的速度加成。⟦1⟧ 对于使用设计的装备，例如⟦2⟧ (带有 )、⟦3⟧ (带有 ) 和⟦4⟧ (带有 )，该加成仅适用于底盘、舰体和机体科技，不适用于被许可设计任何部件的模块科技。

4d0i9o.en: When a country is part of a research group, it gets a research speed bonus for each other country in the group that has already unlocked that technology, up to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ Tech sharing bonus functions in the same way as Limited-use bonus: once applied, the bonus is locked to the tech; changes in the country's tech sharing situation will only reflect in future research. ⟦2⟧ can benefit less from technology sharing, depending on their ⟦3⟧ level.
4d0i9o.zh: 当一国加入科研集团时，集团中每有一个已解锁该科技的其他国家，该国便获得一份科研速度加成，最多为 ⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧ 技术共享加成的运作方式与有限次加成相同：一旦应用，加成即锁定于该科技；该国技术共享状况的变化只会体现在未来的科研中。⟦2⟧从技术共享中获得的收益可能较少，具体取决于其⟦3⟧等级。

3hbaa8.en: Various ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ can continuously improve research speed for applicable technologies while they are active.
3hbaa8.zh: 各种⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧在生效期间可持续提高适用科技的科研速度。

14jdcfs.en: With ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ can be assigned to perform research, providing a research speed bonus at the cost of daily ⟦2⟧.
14jdcfs.zh: 拥有⟦0⟧后，可指派⟦1⟧进行研究，提供科研速度加成，但每天消耗⟦2⟧。

1idmhlj.en: All technologies have a date attached to them when they become current. Researching them earlier comes at the cost of reduced research speed. Each year ahead-of-time adds a ⟦0⟧ ahead-of-time (AOT) penalty.⟦1⟧ Ahead-of-time bonuses from ⟦2⟧ can reduce this penalty modifier. For research ahead of time, the in-game tool-tip displays the estimated time to completion using the formula below.
1idmhlj.zh: 所有科技都附有一个成为当前科技的日期。提前研究它们会以降低科研速度为代价。每提前一年会增加 ⟦0⟧ 的超前（AOT）惩罚。⟦1⟧ 来自⟦2⟧的超前加成可降低该惩罚修正。对于超前研究，游戏内提示框会使用下方公式显示预计完成时间。

rcu46j.en: If part of the research is not under penalty (i.e., ⟦0⟧ in the equation above), the estimated time-to-completion with an AOT of 2 is ⟦1⟧ days.
rcu46j.zh: 如果部分研究不处于惩罚状态（即上方方程中的 ⟦0⟧），则在 AOT 为 2 时的预计完成时间为 ⟦1⟧ 天。

1v5otfl.en: For example, at exactly one year before a tech becomes current, research speed on that tech is modified by multiplicative factor of ⟦0⟧ . As research speed is re-calculated every day, the speed penalty goes down while a technology is being researched. Half a year later, the penalty is down to ⟦1⟧ . Regular research speed modifiers apply linearly. Thus regular country-wide research bonus does not alleviate AOT penalties. If a 50% ahead-of-time bonus is active as shown in in-game tooltip, 0.5 is taken off the AOT penalty. Thus, at 1 year ahead-of-time, the research speed is modified by ⟦2⟧ instead of ⟦3⟧ without the bonus; similarly, at half a year ahead-of-time, the AOT penalty is reduced to ⟦4⟧ from ⟦5⟧ without bonus.
1v5otfl.zh: 例如，在某项科技成为当前科技的整整一年前，该科技的科研速度会乘以 ⟦0⟧ 的系数。由于科研速度每天都会重新计算，研究进行期间速度惩罚会逐渐下降。半年后，惩罚降至 ⟦1⟧。常规科研速度修正为线性叠加，因此全国范围的常规科研加成并不能缓解超前惩罚。如果游戏内提示框显示 50% 的超前加成已生效，则会从超前惩罚中减去 0.5。于是，在提前 1 年时，科研速度会乘以 ⟦2⟧，而不是没有加成时的 ⟦3⟧；同样，在提前半年时，超前惩罚会降至 ⟦4⟧，而没有加成时为 ⟦5⟧。

1q71uet.en: It is possible to deconstruct shared buildings from the state tab by hovering over the building icon and pressing the ⟦0⟧ that appears in the lower right corner of the icon. During wartime, each state can only deconstruct one building per 30⟦1⟧ days.
1q71uet.zh: 可以在州标签页中拆除共享建筑：将鼠标悬停在建筑图标上，按下图标右下角出现的⟦0⟧。战时每个州每 30⟦1⟧天只能拆除一座建筑。

xpl5py.en: Each state has a ⟦0⟧, which then decides the base number of shared slots. Various ⟦1⟧ give percentage bonuses to how many slots a state can have. Various ⟦2⟧ may give additional bonus slots. The total number of slots is capped at 25.⟦3⟧
xpl5py.zh: 每个州都有一个⟦0⟧，它决定共享槽位的基础数量。各种⟦1⟧会按百分比加成提高一个州可拥有的槽位数量。各种⟦2⟧可能提供额外的奖励槽位。槽位总数上限为 25。⟦3⟧

14ge7g0.en: These buildings are built on a province level. Unlike state or shared buildings, these buildings benefit whoever controls the province they are in regardless of overall control of the state.
14ge7g0.zh: 这些建筑在省级建造。与州级或共享建筑不同，这些建筑由控制其所在省份的一方受益，与该州的整体控制权无关。

11xqy44.en: Stations ⟦0⟧, and can send and receive supplies and resources via convoys. Each naval base level increases supply capacity, supply throughput and the number of local ship repairs⟦1⟧. Resource output in states with a connected supply hub or naval base is increased by ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧
11xqy44.zh: 驻扎⟦0⟧，并可通过运输船队收发补给和资源。每级海军基地都会提高补给容量、补给吞吐量以及本地舰船维修数量⟦1⟧。拥有已连接补给中心或海军基地的州，其资源产出提高⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧

1ldxovo.en: Inflicts an attack penalty of ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ for each fort level on the attacker in land-based combat. Attacking from multiple directions will reduce forts' effects.
1ldxovo.zh: 在陆战中每级堡垒使进攻方承受⟦0⟧⟦1⟧的攻击惩罚。从多个方向进攻会削弱堡垒的效果。

azfacn.en: Inflicts an attack penalty of ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ for each coastal fort level on the attacker during naval invasions and 'strait crossing' combat.
azfacn.zh: 在海军登陆和「横渡海峡」作战中，每级海岸堡垒使进攻方承受⟦0⟧⟦1⟧的攻击惩罚。

1ry6aam.en: Transports supplies from the capital to supply sources like cities, ports or supply hubs. Speeds up transport of divisions doing strategic movement.
1ry6aam.zh: 将补给从首都运往城市、港口或补给中心等补给来源。加快进行战略机动的师的运输速度。

186riza.en: Distributes supplies from railways. Resource output in states a connected supply hub or naval base is increased by ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧

h2qwtk.en: Unlike other provincial buildings, the number of experimental facilities is limited to one per state. They also consume ⟦0⟧ supply while active, so the game does not allow them to be placed in locations with insufficient supply.

1audnzl.en: Landmarks refer to iconic, real‑world monuments. Landmark modifiers affect only the actual owners, not the occupiers. Landmarks can't be damaged by regular strategic bombing.
1audnzl.zh: 地标指现实中具有标志性的纪念建筑。地标修正只对实际拥有者生效，对占领者无效。地标不会被常规战略轰炸破坏。

52dwhv.zh: 通过 2 个国策添加：八纮一宇或一亿一心。

1bfb6oi.en: The Great Wall appears as a landmark in multiple locations on the map, but the landmarks themselves don't provide any buffs. The bonuses are actually applied through the province modifier, not the landmark entity. Occupiers also benefit from modifiers.
1bfb6oi.zh: 长城在地图上多处作为地标出现，但地标本身不提供任何加成。加成实际上通过省份修正生效，而非地标实体。占领者也能享受这些修正。

66dcnj.zh: 战略要地可以提高某些省级和州级建筑的最大数量。

zwk7hj.en: ⟦0⟧ make all the improvements to a territory and are necessary to build any of the constructions listed under the Construction tab . All nations start with a certain number of civilian factories and a percentage will be used for ⟦1⟧, depending on the ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ that are currently in place.
zwk7hj.zh: ⟦0⟧负责对领土进行所有改建，也是建造「建造」标签页中列出的任何建筑的必要条件。所有国家开局都有一定数量的民用工厂，其中一部分会被用于⟦1⟧，具体取决于当前生效的⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧。

1yugzkk.en: Civilian factories that are not used to produce consumer goods can be used for ⟦0⟧, to complete or repair the construction queued in the Construction tab, to spend on the ⟦1⟧, or to pursue decisions or ⟦2⟧ investments. It's possible to increase the number of civilian factories by building more, but this is limited by the number of ⟦3⟧ slots available in each ⟦4⟧
1yugzkk.zh: 未用于生产消费品的民用工厂可用于⟦0⟧、完成或修复「建造」标签页中排队的建造项目、在⟦1⟧上花费，或用于执行决议或⟦2⟧投资。可以通过建造更多民用工厂来增加其数量，但这受限于可用⟦3⟧槽位的数量，即每个⟦4⟧中可用的槽位

7c4sh8.en: Depending on ⟦0⟧, national spirits, political advisors, and stability, a number of civilian factories will be occupied by producing consumer goods and are unavailable for construction, ⟦1⟧, or any other use of civilian factories. This number is computed as a percentage of the total number of factories, including ⟦2⟧ and factories received through ⟦3⟧, but not ⟦4⟧. Factories are counted even when they are damaged and can't produce anything. The number of consumer goods factories is always rounded down.
7c4sh8.zh: 根据⟦0⟧、国家精神、政治顾问和稳定度，一定数量的民用工厂会被占用去生产消费品，无法用于建造、⟦1⟧或民用工厂的其他任何用途。该数量按工厂总数的百分比计算，其中包括⟦2⟧以及通过⟦3⟧获得的工厂，但不包括⟦4⟧。即使工厂受损、无法生产任何东西，也仍会被计入。消费品工厂的数量一律向下取整。

135d64d.zh: 中国军阀国家精神战争税（来自焦点「战争税」）

xrn65e.en: ⟦0⟧ can gain -3% consumer goods at ⟦1⟧ with its spirits, but will not gain additional factories by this.
xrn65e.zh: ⟦0⟧凭借其国家精神可在⟦1⟧获得-3%的消费品，但不会因此获得额外工厂。

t66ab3.en: Suppose the ⟦0⟧ is enabled and no other modifiers apply, meaning that the final consumer goods need is 30%. A country has 50 ⟦1⟧, 50 ⟦2⟧, and 20 ⟦3⟧. It will then have to allocate 30 ⟦4⟧ to produce consumer goods, leaving it with 15 that it can use freely.
t66ab3.zh: 假设已启用⟦0⟧且没有其他修正生效，即最终消费品需求为30%。某国拥有50座⟦1⟧、50座⟦2⟧和20座⟦3⟧。这样它就必须分配30座⟦4⟧用于生产消费品，剩余15座可自由使用。

1mpocbu.en: Consumer Goods Factories factor (CGFF) is an additional factor that is available in some countries, most notably ⟦0⟧. It is the additional percentages of consumer goods in porportion to the current consumer goods factories. The number is multiplicative, not additive.
1mpocbu.zh: 消费品工厂系数（CGFF）是某些国家可用的一项额外系数，最典型的是⟦0⟧。它是相对于当前消费品工厂的额外消费品百分比。该数值以乘法计算，而非加法。

1qro8e5.en: The following is the formula regarding CGFF:

1jld3d8.en: Total Consumer Goods = Consumer Goods granted by Economy Law ⋅ ( 1 + CGFF ) {\displaystyle {\text{Total Consumer Goods}}={\text{Consumer Goods granted by Economy Law}}\cdot (1+{\text{CGFF}})}
1jld3d8.zh: 消费品总量 = 经济法令提供的消费品 ⋅ ( 1 + CGFF ) {\displaystyle {\text{消费品总量}}={\text{经济法令提供的消费品}}\cdot (1+{\text{CGFF}})}

17hbntt.en: Suppose a country with ⟦0⟧, meaning a consumer goods need of ⟦1⟧, and has ⟦2⟧ CGFF. It will have a final consumer goods need of 30% x (1+10%) = ⟦3⟧, not 40%. This means if it had 100 total factories, 33 civilian factories will be allocated to producing consumer goods.
17hbntt.zh: 假设某国采用⟦0⟧，即消费品需求为⟦1⟧，且拥有⟦2⟧ CGFF。其最终消费品需求为30% x (1+10%) = ⟦3⟧，而不是40%。这意味着如果它共有100座工厂，将有33座民用工厂被分配去生产消费品。

1gnn6cz.en: In some cases CGFF can go into the negatives. Similar what happens with positive CGFF, this will reduce the current consumer goods need multiplicatively. If the same example country with ⟦0⟧ had ⟦1⟧ CGFF instead, its final consumer goods need would be 30% x (1-10%) = ⟦2⟧, not 20%.
1gnn6cz.zh: 某些情况下CGFF会变成负值。与正CGFF的情形类似，这将以乘法方式降低当前的消费品需求。如果上述示例国家采用的是⟦0⟧但拥有⟦1⟧ CGFF，其最终消费品需求将是30% x (1-10%) = ⟦2⟧，而不是20%。

qi5l8k.en: Multiple sources of CGFF stack multiplicatively with each other. This means that multiple smaller sources of positive CGFF can have a greater effect than a single, larger source of positive CGFF. Inversely, a single large source of negative CGFF will have a greater effect than multiple smaller sources of negative CGFF.
qi5l8k.zh: 多个CGFF来源之间以乘法叠加。这意味着多个较小的正CGFF来源可能比单个较大的正CGFF来源效果更好。反之，单个较大的负CGFF来源会比多个较小的负CGFF来源效果更强。

1y102e6.en: The civilian factory output of each civilian factory employed in construction is 4⟦0⟧ per day. Construction Speed modifies the output for the building of all constructions.
1y102e6.zh: 每座投入建造的民用工厂每天产出4⟦0⟧。建造速度会修正所有建造项目的产出。

w46z0b.en: The return on investment of building an additional Civilian Factory will depend on the ⟦0⟧ bonus as well the Economy Law currently in place, or expected in the future. The higher the Construction Speed bonus is, the more Output will be done by the newly built Civilian Factory and the faster it will accumulate an Output equal to its cost, 10800. This variable is the time, in days, required to recover the cost of building the factory, or payback time.
w46z0b.zh: 增建民用工厂的投资回报取决于⟦0⟧加成，以及当前或未来预期的经济法令。建造速度加成越高，新建民用工厂的产出就越多，其累积到与自身成本10800相等的产出也越快。该变量即收回建厂成本所需的时间（以天计），也就是回本时间。

The payback time of a new civilian factory is given by the following formula:

gtnxb7.en: Construction speed modifiers range between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Except for the lowest two modifiers, they all have multiple combinations to be achieved. In fact, there are 320 possible combinations of variables affecting civilian factory construction speed outside of national spirits and unique laws. The infrastructure bonus ranges from ⟦2⟧ at zero infrastructure to ⟦3⟧⟦4⟧ at max infrastructure.
gtnxb7.zh: 建造速度修正的范围介于⟦0⟧到⟦1⟧之间。除最低的两档修正外，它们都有多种组合可以实现。事实上，除国家精神和独特法令之外，影响民用工厂建造速度的变量共有320种可能组合。基础设施加成从零基础设施时的⟦2⟧到满基础设施时的⟦3⟧⟦4⟧不等。

fyje7v.en: For example, at 3/5 infrastructure in a state, construction speed in that state is multiplied by ⟦0⟧. In the Construction UI, this bonus is displayed for each State as a colored percentage next to an Infrastructure road icon. This bonus is applied after bonuses from tech, advisors, and national spirits, making 1 level of infrastructure a more powerful bonus than, e.g., a War Industrialist.
fyje7v.zh: 例如，某州基础设施为3/5时，该州的建造速度乘以⟦0⟧。在建造界面中，该加成会以带颜色的百分比显示在每个州的基础设施道路图标旁。该加成在科技、顾问和国家精神加成之后生效，因此1级基础设施的加成比「军工实业家」之类的更强。

ghymu.en: It is usually recommended to allocate an infrastructure/civilian factory building phase for your nation before subsequently militarizing by building military factories and naval dockyards. However, the scope of civilian factory building can be reduced substantially if early warfare is planned or expected, and/or if newly built dockyards are meant to produce ships with very long production times.
ghymu.zh: 通常建议先为国家安排一个基础设施／民用工厂建造阶段，然后再通过建造军用工厂和海军船坞实现军事化。不过，如果计划或预期会提前开战，以及／或者新建的船坞打算用于生产生产时间极长的舰船，那么民用工厂的建造规模就可以大幅缩减。

z6u6do.en: Due to the construction boost from infrastructure, the most efficient method involves filling all building slots one state at a time. This can be done by prioritizing states with higher starting infrastructure levels. The mechanics of the game encourages players to concentrate industry in central, high-infrastructure areas, although this must be balanced against the increased vulnerability of having all of one's industry in one place. It is common for all building slots to be filled before the game ends, this represents the in-game factory cap for the respective territory.
z6u6do.zh: 由于基础设施带来的建造加成，最高效的做法是逐个州填满所有建筑槽位。为此可以优先选择初始基础设施等级较高的州。游戏机制鼓励玩家把工业集中在基础设施完善的中心地区，但也必须权衡将所有工业集中于一处的脆弱性。通常情况下，所有建筑槽位会在游戏结束前被填满，这代表着相应领土在游戏内的工厂上限。

15lc1di.en: A higher construction speed, which is always beneficial, also causes the infrastructure construction boost to be less viable.
15lc1di.zh: 更高的建造速度总是有利的，但同时也会使基础设施的建造加成变得不那么划算。

d4op51.en: The total amount of ⟦0⟧ can also be increased by building infrastructure. Each level of infrastructure gives a resource increase of ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ to the total of all extracted resources in a state; this does not include resources produced by ⟦3⟧. There are five (5) levels of infrastructure; building all of them will give a ⟦4⟧ bonus to the total amount of extracted resources.
d4op51.zh: 建造基础设施也可以提高⟦0⟧的总量。每级基础设施会使该州所有开采资源的总量增加⟦1⟧⟦2⟧；这不包括⟦3⟧生产的资源。基础设施共有五（5）级；全部建满将使开采资源总量获得⟦4⟧加成。

1tuxnq8.en: Once a state's Infrastructure reaches maximum (level 5), a building slot can be added to that state using a decision called “Region-wide Industrial Integration” that costs 100 PP. This decision can only be taken once per state.
1tuxnq8.zh: 当某州的基础设施达到满级（5级）后，可通过名为「全州产业整合」的决议为该州增加一个建筑槽位，该决议需要100 PP。此决议每个州只能执行一次。

1tkxfyl.en: ⟦0⟧ can be converted into ⟦1⟧ for base cost of 4000,⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ can be converted into ⟦4⟧ for base cost of 9000.⟦5⟧ The base cost is modified by ⟦6⟧ and can be futher modified by ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧. To convert a factory, simply click on the corresponding state and hover over the factory that is to be converted. Alternatiely, use the convert button in the construction tab, and conversions will appear in the tab, just like any other building project.
1tkxfyl.zh: ⟦0⟧能以4000的基础成本转换为⟦1⟧，⟦2⟧而⟦3⟧能以9000的基础成本转换为⟦4⟧。⟦5⟧基础成本受⟦6⟧修正，还可进一步受⟦7⟧和⟦8⟧修正。要转产工厂，只需点击相应的州，将鼠标悬停在要转产的工厂上。或者，使用建造标签页中的转产按钮，转产项目就会像其他建筑项目一样出现在该标签页中。

98r7gy.en: Each building level has 100⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. They may get damaged by ⟦2⟧ (naval bases), ⟦3⟧ (infrastructure, forts), ⟦4⟧ (factories), ⟦5⟧, or explicit events (like the ⟦6⟧'s ⟦7⟧ to move factories to the Urals). ⟦8⟧ can destroy multiple or all levels of a building at once, for details see ⟦9⟧.
98r7gy.zh: 每个建筑等级拥有100⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧。它们可能因⟦2⟧（海军基地）、⟦3⟧（基础设施、要塞）、⟦4⟧（工厂）、⟦5⟧或明确的事件（例如⟦6⟧将工厂迁往乌拉尔的⟦7⟧）而受损。⟦8⟧可以一次性摧毁一座建筑的多个或全部等级，详情见⟦9⟧。

1ig7m05.en: The damage from land combat (against infrastructure) and strategic bombing gets scaled by the building's damage factor (air base and radar: 0.5, anti-air: 0.1, 1 otherwise) and the squared ratio of the currently undamaged building levels to the maximum level. For example, a level-3 anti-air building (maximum level 5) where one level is already partially damaged only receives ⟦0⟧ of incoming damage from strategic bombing.
1ig7m05.zh: 陆上战斗（针对基础设施）和战略轰炸造成的损坏，会按建筑的受损系数（空军基地和雷达：0.5，防空：0.1，其他为1）以及当前未受损建筑等级与最高等级之比的平方进行缩放。例如，一座3级防空建筑（最高5级）在已有1级部分受损时，只承受战略轰炸来袭伤害的⟦0⟧。

19xsv02.en: A single military factory in a state (or in other words a level-1 military factory) receives ⟦0⟧ while 15 military factories receive ⟦1⟧ . High-level factories and infrastructure will generally get damaged ⟦2⟧ more quickly from these two damage sources than lower levels.
19xsv02.zh: 一个州内的单座军用工厂（换言之，1级军用工厂）承受⟦0⟧，而15座军用工厂承受⟦1⟧。在这两种伤害来源下，高级工厂和基础设施的受损速度通常比低等级快⟦2⟧。

19sw6mp.en: Anti-air provides damage resistance from bomber-type attacks (port strikes and strategic bombing) depending on the level of anti-air in the containing state and researched anti-air technologies. Dispersed Industry provides an alternative source of damage resistance but only for factories and not stacking with anti-air. The maximum of the two is used for factories.
19sw6mp.zh: 防空会根据所在州的防空等级和已研究的防空科技，提供对轰炸机类攻击（港口打击和战略轰炸）的抗损能力。「分散工业」提供另一种抗损来源，但仅对工厂有效，且不与防空叠加。工厂取两者中的最大值。

i22g8h.en: All damaged buildings appear in the construction list. The speed of factories assigned to a repair line gets a bonus of ⟦0⟧ plus any Factory Repair Speed bonuses (e.g., from ⟦1⟧ or the ⟦2⟧, infrastructure levels). Even when no factories are assigned, the speed of the line is 1⟦3⟧⟦4⟧.
i22g8h.zh: 所有受损建筑都会出现在建造列表中。分配给修复线的工厂速度会获得⟦0⟧的加成，外加任何工厂修复速度加成（例如来自⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧、基础设施等级）。即使没有分配工厂，该线的速度也是1⟦3⟧⟦4⟧。

kmodhl.en: The resulting daily repair progress is ⟦0⟧ , rounded to the nearest full percent. So when no factories are assigned, repairs will still progress by 1% per day. Assigning just a few factories to repair an expensive building may also produce just 1% progress per day, effectively wasting the output of those factories.
kmodhl.zh: 由此得到的每日修复进度为⟦0⟧，四舍五入到最接近的整数百分比。因此即使没有分配工厂，修复每天仍会推进1%。给造价高昂的建筑只分配少量工厂，也可能每天只推进1%，实际上浪费了这些工厂的产出。

vz99is.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ can increase this building's production by ⟦3⟧ after completing ⟦4⟧ or by ⟦5⟧ after completing ⟦6⟧. ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ can increase this building's production by ⟦10⟧ after appointing William Rhodes Davis as a political advisor.
vz99is.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 可将此建筑的产量提高⟦3⟧（在完成⟦4⟧后），或提高⟦5⟧（在完成⟦6⟧后）。⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ 在任命威廉·罗兹·戴维斯为政治顾问后可将此建筑的产量提高⟦10⟧。

1jlhjk6.en: ⟦0⟧ refers to the manufacturing of ⟦1⟧ such as tanks, guns, planes and ships used by the military to conduct a country's war. The construction of buildings in states and provinces, including both military installations and economic development, is known as ⟦2⟧.
1jlhjk6.zh: ⟦0⟧指为军方制造坦克、火炮、飞机和舰船等用于进行国家战争的⟦1⟧。在各州与省份中建造建筑（既包括军事设施，也包括经济建设）称为⟦2⟧。

1lp5hyl.en: There are three types of factories:

x0wqo8.en: ⟦0⟧: Used for ⟦1⟧ (including repair), ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, purchasing equipment licenses, the ⟦4⟧ (with ), and ⟦5⟧ and their upgrades (with ). These have a base output of ⟦6⟧ and powered output of ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ per day.
x0wqo8.zh: ⟦0⟧：用于⟦1⟧（含维修）、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、购买装备生产许可、⟦4⟧（需 ），以及⟦5⟧及其升级（需 ）。其基础产出为 ⟦6⟧，电力充足时每日产出 ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧。

13rgryn.en: ⟦0⟧: Produce land and air-based ⟦1⟧, including for infantry, artillery, tanks, air wings, and railways. These have a base output of ⟦2⟧ and powered output of ⟦3⟧ per day. This is multiplied by both ⟦4⟧ modifiers and by ⟦5⟧, both of which are applied independently of one another. For example, a powered factory at 50% Production efficiency with +10% Factory output from having Export Focus and -21.8% Factory output due to low Stability, the production of each Military factory would be 4.5 ⋅ 0.5 ⋅ ( 1 + 0.1 − 0.218 ) = 1.9845 {\displaystyle 4.5\cdot 0.5\cdot {(1+0.1-0.218)}=1.9845} per day.
13rgryn.zh: ⟦0⟧：生产陆基与空基⟦1⟧，包括步兵、火炮、坦克、航空队和铁路所用装备。其基础产出为 ⟦2⟧，电力充足时每日产出 ⟦3⟧。该产出同时受⟦4⟧修正和⟦5⟧影响，两者相互独立生效。例如，一座电力充足的工厂生产效率为 50%，因拥有「出口聚焦」而获得 +10% 工厂产出，又因稳定度偏低受到 -21.8% 工厂产出，则每座军用工厂的日产量为 4.5 ⋅ 0.5 ⋅ ( 1 + 0.1 − 0.218 ) = 1.9845 {\displaystyle 4.5\cdot 0.5\cdot {(1+0.1-0.218)}=1.9845}。

18onqvh.en: For example, a powered factory at ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ with ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ from having ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ due to low ⟦7⟧, the production of each ⟦8⟧ would be ⟦9⟧ per day.
18onqvh.zh: 例如，一座电力充足的工厂在⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧下具有⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧（来自⟦4⟧），同时具有⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧（源自⟦7⟧偏低），则每座⟦8⟧的日产量为⟦9⟧。

139rfm0.en: ⟦0⟧: Produce ships, submarines, convoys, and other naval ⟦1⟧. These have a base output of ⟦2⟧ and powered output of ⟦3⟧ per day. This is multiplied by ⟦4⟧ modifiers; naval dockyards are not affected by production efficiency.
139rfm0.zh: ⟦0⟧：生产舰船、潜艇、运输船队及其他海军⟦1⟧。其基础产出为 ⟦2⟧，电力充足时每日产出 ⟦3⟧。该产出受⟦4⟧修正影响；海军船坞不受生产效率影响。

13bq2la.en: The main output modifiers for ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧, while ⟦4⟧ are mainly affected by ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧.
13bq2la.zh: ⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧的主要产出修正是⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧，而⟦4⟧主要受⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧影响。

1tf30v6.en: Production of military and naval ⟦0⟧ is organized into production lines, each of which produces a single type of equipment at a time using assigned ⟦1⟧ for land- and air-based equipment and ⟦2⟧ for naval equipment. Up to 150⟦3⟧ factories may be assigned to a single production line, but a country can operate multiple lines producing the same item.
1tf30v6.zh: 军用与海军⟦0⟧的生产按生产线组织，每条生产线同一时间只生产一种装备：陆基与空基装备使用分配来的⟦1⟧，海军装备使用⟦2⟧。单条生产线最多可分配 150⟦3⟧座工厂，但一个国家可以运行多条生产同一物品的生产线。

ok2k8r.en: Ship production lines have a maximum number of dockyards that can be assigned. No more than 5⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ can work on producing a capital ship at once; this limit is 10⟦2⟧ for screen ships and submarines, 15⟦3⟧ for convoys, and 5⟦4⟧ for ⟦5⟧.
ok2k8r.zh: 舰船生产线可分配的船坞数量有上限。同一时间最多有 5⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧能参与建造一艘主力舰；屏卫舰与潜艇的上限为 10⟦2⟧，运输船队为 15⟦3⟧，以及 5⟦4⟧（用于⟦5⟧）。

m87f4m.en: Some special land units may also have a limited number of military factories per line: 5⟦0⟧ each for ⟦1⟧ (including super-heavy ones), super-heavy howitzers (including self-propelled ones), and land cruisers.
m87f4m.zh: 某些特殊陆军单位每条生产线也有军用工厂数量上限：各为 5⟦0⟧，适用于⟦1⟧（包括超重型）、超重型榴弹炮（包括自行式）和陆上巡洋舰。

ik1azh.en: Item name and position in queue
ik1azh.zh: 物品名称及在队列中的位置

1yi2gb4.en: Number of factories assigned to the item
1yi2gb4.zh: 分配给该物品的工厂数量

1kazv4h.en: Move the production line up and down the priority queue. It is also possible to drag and drop the top of the box.
1kazv4h.zh: 在生产优先级队列中向上或向下移动生产线。也可以拖动方框顶部进行拖放。

1t75u86.en: Item's specialized role, if applicable (tank destroyer in this case)
1t75u86.zh: 该物品的专精角色（如适用，此处为坦克歼击车）

1ja6694.en: The MIO used to design the variant. Upwards arrow indicates a new version of the MIO can be applied. (Without the Arms against Tyranny DLC, this shows the design company.)
1ja6694.zh: 用于设计该型号的军工组织。向上箭头表示可以应用该军工组织的新版本。（没有 Arms against Tyranny DLC 时，此处显示设计公司。）

1qaajr5.en: Whether production is being used for reinforcements, upgrading fielded units, or sent to stockpile. The number shows how many items of the equipment type are needed or in stock.
1qaajr5.zh: 生产是用于补充兵力、升级现役单位，还是送入库存。数字表示该装备类型所需或库存的数量。

ud9wc.en: ⟦0⟧ consumed by this production line; red indicates a shortage
ud9wc.zh: 此生产线消耗的⟦0⟧；红色表示短缺

hbzvaq.en: Many of the elements on the box have tooltips that can be inspected for further details.
hbzvaq.zh: 方框中的许多元素都带有提示框，可查看详细信息。

1udwp2q.en: Each production line has its own efficiency level which determines how good it is at producing its current ⟦0⟧. The higher the efficiency, the faster the production line produces equipment, up to a maximum value. Running the same production line continuously gradually increases its efficiency.
1udwp2q.zh: 每条生产线都有自己的效率等级，决定其生产当前⟦0⟧的效率高低。效率越高，生产线生产装备越快，直至达到上限。持续运行同一条生产线会逐步提高其效率。

woa7xr.en: Production efficiency starts at a base (10%⟦0⟧ without modifiers) and increases each day up to a production efficiency cap (50%⟦1⟧ without modifiers). All of these can potentially be increased by ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧. The base production efficiency growth per day is:
woa7xr.zh: 生产效率从基础值（无修正时为 10%⟦0⟧）开始，每天增长，直至生产效率上限（无修正时为 50%⟦1⟧）。这些数值都可能通过⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧提高。每日基础生产效率增长为：

14utejm.en: (All quantities can be expressed in terms of percent or as a fraction, as long as they are expressed in the same terms everywhere.)
14utejm.zh: （所有数值都可以用百分比或小数表示，只要各处使用的表示方式一致即可。）

96i1c9.en: The minimum possible base growth per day is thus about 0.05% (near the starting cap of 50%), and the maximum 1% (100% cap & 10% current efficiency).
96i1c9.zh: 因此每日基础增长最低约为 0.05%（接近 50% 的初始上限时），最高为 1%（上限 100%、当前效率 10% 时）。

1rk2jza.en: Alternatively, the relative time in days to reach a particular level of production efficiency is given by
1rk2jza.zh: 或者，达到某一生产效率水平所需的相对时间（天）由下式给出

drp15y.en: For example, going from 25% of the cap to 75% of the cap takes ⟦0⟧ days.
drp15y.zh: 例如，从上限的 25% 提升到上限的 75% 需要⟦0⟧天。

326rus.en: Therefore it takes at most 500 days for a fully-supplied line to reach the cap. (500 days is the theoretical total time to grow from 0% efficiency to the 100% limit (without any adjustments), serving as the basic constant in the formula.)This represents a shortfall of at most 166.6 factory-days of output relative to a factory running at cap for the same period.
326rus.zh: 因此，补给充足的生产线最多需要 500 天达到上限。（500 天是从 0% 效率增长到 100% 极限（无任何调整）的理论总时间，也是公式中的基本常数。）与同期以满上限运行的工厂相比，这最多造成 166.6 工厂日的产出缺口。

1kvy9jk.en: Production efficiency is tracked separately for each factory. Adding one or more new factories to an existing production line reduces production efficiency of the added factories. It is important to know that the ⟦0⟧ - what they are making has not changed. Only the new factory has minimum efficiency.
1kvy9jk.zh: 生产效率按工厂分别计算。向现有生产线添加一座或多座新工厂会降低新增工厂的生产效率。需要注意，⟦0⟧——它们生产的东西并没有变化。只有新工厂的效率为最低值。

q2g4fv.en: factories already in the line do not lose efficiency
q2g4fv.zh: 生产线中已有的工厂不会损失效率

1n0z2hx.en: Caution: When military factories are lost or damaged and total factory count declines, the loss comes off the bottom of the list and those factories lose their efficiency. A wise precaution is to move your high-priority and high-efficiency production lines up in the list.
1n0z2hx.zh: 注意：当军用工厂被摧毁或受损、工厂总数下降时，损失会从列表底部开始扣除，这些工厂会失去其效率。明智的预防措施是把高优先级、高效率的生产线在列表中上移。

nls24p.en: While all ⟦0⟧ are affected by production efficiency, there are some, special equipment types that are unaffected by passive ⟦1⟧, most notably, ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧ The only way to increase the production efficiency of these lines is to increase their base production efficiency.
nls24p.zh: 虽然所有⟦0⟧都受生产效率影响，但某些特殊装备类型不受被动⟦1⟧影响，最典型的是⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧提高这些生产线生产效率的唯一方法是提高其基础生产效率。

1k1ol94.en: Switching a production line to a related type of equipment not only cancels production of the previous unit and the time spent on it, it also reduces the line's production efficiency. The decrease depends on how drastic the change is, with the player getting to keep a greater percentage of the line's previous efficiency based on how drastic the change is:
1k1ol94.zh: 把生产线切换到相关类型的装备，不仅会取消上一件物品的生产及其已投入的时间，还会降低该生产线的生产效率。降幅取决于改动的剧烈程度，玩家能保留的原有效率比例也随之变化：

1cmxbi6.en: Retain ⟦0⟧: Different ⟦1⟧ of the same model (e.g. Panzer III Ausf. F → Panzer III Ausf. G [variants of the German medium tank 1], this also includes switching from license production to own production of the same equipment type, e.g. Italian Fighter II C.202 Folgore to German Fighter II FW190)
1cmxbi6.zh: 保留 ⟦0⟧：同一型号的不同⟦1⟧（例如 Panzer III Ausf. F → Panzer III Ausf. G [德国中型坦克 1 的变体]；这也包括从许可生产转为自行生产同一装备类型，例如意大利战斗机 II C.202 Folgore 转为德国战斗机 II FW190）

44is7v.en: Retain ⟦0⟧: Different model of the same chassis (e.g. Panzer III → StuG III [German medium tank 1 to German medium tank destroyer 1])
44is7v.zh: 保留 ⟦0⟧：同一底盘的不同型号（例如 Panzer III → StuG III [德国中型坦克 1 转为德国中型坦克歼击车 1]）

10v7y31.en: Retain ⟦0⟧: Direct ⟦1⟧ or direct ⟦2⟧ of equipment of the same type (e.g. Panzer III → Panzer IV [German medium tank 1 to German medium tank 2])
10v7y31.zh: 保留 ⟦0⟧：同类型装备的直接⟦1⟧或直接⟦2⟧（例如 Panzer III → Panzer IV [德国中型坦克 1 转为德国中型坦克 2]）

w6asgl.en: Retain ⟦0⟧: Indirect ⟦1⟧ or indirect ⟦2⟧ of equipment of the same type (e.g. Panzer III → Panther [German medium tank 1 to German medium tank 3])
w6asgl.zh: 保留 ⟦0⟧：同类型装备的间接⟦1⟧或间接⟦2⟧（例如 Panzer III → Panther [德国中型坦克 1 转为德国中型坦克 3]）

38o90t.en: Retain ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧: Any other change (e.g. Infantry Equipment 1 to Towed Artillery 1)
38o90t.zh: 保留 ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧：任何其他改动（例如步兵装备 1 转为牵引火炮 1）

o9ris0.en: Except for changing of variant, which always results in a loss of 10%, these effects can be reduced by researching:
o9ris0.zh: 除更换变体（总会造成 10% 的损失）外，这些影响可通过研究以下科技降低：

1aigfjr.en: Each tech provides a production efficiency retention bonus, which serves to limit the production efficiency loss when switching production lines.
1aigfjr.zh: 每项科技都提供生产效率保持加成，用于减少切换生产线时的生产效率损失。

148z4nm.en: Some ⟦0⟧ and unique ⟦1⟧ can also provide additional ⟦2⟧.
148z4nm.zh: 某些⟦0⟧和独特的⟦1⟧也能提供额外的⟦2⟧。

fknuj4.en: Switching a production line back to the old equipment it was producing not only does not undo the production efficiency loss from having switched lines. Production efficiency retention is based purely on the equipment differences between the currently produced equipment and the equipment being switched to.
fknuj4.zh: 把生产线切回原先生产的旧装备，并不能挽回此前切换生产线造成的生产效率损失。生产效率保持完全取决于当前生产的装备与要切换到的装备之间的差异。

pbiwd.en: Calculating production efficiency with retention bonus
pbiwd.zh: 计算含保持加成的生产效率

1irow6x.en: When a production line is switched while having Dispersed Industry unlocked and/or Flexible Line unlocked, the new Production Efficiency is not the result of a simple addition of the efficiency retention (listed in ⟦0⟧ in the previous section) and the Production Efficiency Retention bonus obtained from the technologies. As the in-game modifier describes, the retention bonus is applied as a percentage of the loss in production efficiency (e.g. 10% retention incurs a 90% loss, so a 10% bonus would reduce the loss by 10% of 90% or 9%. This would give you a new retention of 19%.)
1irow6x.zh: 在已解锁分散式工业和/或柔性生产线的情况下切换生产线时，新的生产效率并非效率保持（即上一节中以⟦0⟧标示的数值）与技术提供的生产效率保持加成的简单相加。正如游戏内修正所描述的，保持加成按生产效率损失的一定百分比生效（例如保持 10% 意味着损失 90%，因此 10% 的加成会把损失减少 90% 的 10%，即 9%，从而得到 19% 的新保持率。）

az0liu.en: The new Production Efficiency can be calculated in three steps. First, determine the bonus efficiency by multiplying the retention modifier and the efficiency loss. Second, add that product to the original efficiency retention (listed in ⟦0⟧ in the previous section). This is you new efficiency retention. Finally, multiply your current production efficiency and your new efficiency retention. This is your new production efficiency.
az0liu.zh: 新的生产效率可分三步计算。第一步，用保持修正乘以效率损失，得到加成效率。第二步，把该乘积加到原有效率保持（即上一节中以⟦0⟧标示的数值）上，得到新的效率保持。第三步，用当前生产效率乘以新的效率保持，即得到新的生产效率。

c2tafl.en: Note that a base production efficiency (default 10%⟦0⟧) superior to this result will supersede it.
c2tafl.zh: 注意，若基础生产效率（默认为 10%⟦0⟧）高于该结果，则以基础生产效率为准。

di77wf.en: It is possible to express these three steps into one formula that will compute the new production efficiency:
di77wf.zh: 可以把这三个步骤合并为一个公式来计算新的生产效率：

17epnhj.en: RET: Retention (the values in ⟦0⟧ above, or 10% for any other production switch);
17epnhj.zh: RET：保持率（上表中⟦0⟧的数值，或其他生产切换时的 10%）；

1fb75ue.en: BON: Efficiency retention bonus obtained through Dispersed Industry I to V or Flexible Line.
1fb75ue.zh: BON：通过分散式工业 I 至 V 或柔性生产线获得的效率保持加成。

wp9lux.en: With this formula, we can see that bonus (BON) is more effective with lower retention (RET).
wp9lux.zh: 由该公式可见，保持率（RET）越低，加成（BON）的效果越明显。

o4c2vm.en: To summarize, the real production efficiency will be given by ⟦0⟧
o4c2vm.zh: 综上，实际生产效率由⟦0⟧给出

f88pym.en: Ships, submarines, and convoys are produced in ⟦0⟧, which do not have production efficiency. Instead, every dockyard produces a constant 2⟦1⟧ per day, modified by ⟦2⟧ modifiers. Hence, if a dockyard production line is changed to a different ship, all progress on the incomplete ship is lost, but the dockyards will immediately operate at full efficiency on the new production line.
f88pym.zh: 舰船、潜艇和运输船队都在⟦0⟧中生产，这些生产线没有生产效率。每座船坞每天固定产出 2⟦1⟧，并受⟦2⟧修正影响。因此，若把船坞生产线改为建造另一种舰船，未完工舰船的全部进度都会损失，但船坞会立即以满效率投入新的生产线。

1r8nf4.en: Also unlike land-based equipment, repairing ships requires allocating ⟦0⟧ for the purpose. Each dockyard can repair up to one ship at a time, and the maximum amount of dockyards allowed to repair ships at a time can be modified in the production screen. Dockyards that are currently repairing ships are removed from active production lines until they are done repairing.
1r8nf4.zh: 与陆基装备不同，维修舰船需要为此分配⟦0⟧。每座船坞同一时间最多维修一艘舰船，允许同时维修舰船的船坞数量上限可在生产界面中调整。正在维修舰船的船坞会从活跃生产线中移出，直至维修完成。

aygfkt.en: A production line can be set to produce an item by converting obsolete or foreign (captured, ⟦0⟧, license-built, or ⟦1⟧) equipment of the same chassis. This can be done at any time (assuming input items are available) by clicking the button in the bottom-left of the production line's box, and incurs no loss of production efficiency. When the line runs out of equipment to convert it will automatically revert to production from raw materials.
aygfkt.zh: 可以把生产线设置为通过转换同一底盘的过时或外国（缴获、⟦0⟧、许可生产或⟦1⟧）装备来生产某物品。只要输入物品充足，随时可以点击生产线方框左下角的按钮进行，且不会造成生产效率损失。当可转换的装备用尽时，生产线会自动恢复为用原材料生产。

1miu8su.en: Equipment conversion can be used for things such as converting tanks to tank destroyers, or upgrading old ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ designs with new modules. It is generally faster than production from scratch (depending on the number of changes made to the design), and can be sped up further with the ⟦2⟧. Strategic resources are only consumed to the extent the new design requires them and the old one did not.
1miu8su.zh: 装备转换可用于把坦克转换为坦克歼击车，或用新模块升级旧⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧设计等用途。它通常比从头生产更快（取决于对设计所做的改动数量），并可通过⟦2⟧进一步提速。战略资源仅在旧设计不需要而新设计需要时才会被消耗。

1vqdb3j.en: Ships can also be refitted to a new design from the task force panel in a similar manner. Each ship must be refitted individually, requiring significant dockyard time (particularly for engine and armor replacements). To refit a foreign ship taken in a peace conference, a new design must be created from the design tab of the ship's info panel; however this may sometimes fail to create a valid refit target.⟦0⟧ Once a refit is started, it can be safely canceled until it is at least 20%⟦1⟧ complete, after which cancelling a refit requires scuttling the ship.
1vqdb3j.zh: 舰船也可以在特遣舰队面板中以类似方式改装为新设计。每艘舰船必须单独改装，需要占用大量船坞时间（尤其是更换引擎和装甲时）。要改装在和平会议中获得的外国舰船，必须从舰船信息面板的设计标签页创建新设计；但有时可能无法生成有效的改装目标。⟦0⟧改装一旦开始，在完成度不足 20%⟦1⟧之前都可以安全取消，此后取消改装则必须将舰船凿沉。

151u68q.en: In order to convert existing equipment, the existing design must be:⟦0⟧
151u68q.zh: 要转换现有装备，现有设计必须满足：⟦0⟧

10999od.en: Marked as decommissioned (automatic for foreign equipment).
10999od.zh: 已标记为退役（外国装备自动标记）。

1mf4rnh.en: Has the same chassis as the new target design (e.g. a 1934 light tank can not become a 1936 light tank).
1mf4rnh.zh: 与新目标设计使用相同底盘（例如 1934 年轻型坦克无法转换为 1936 年轻型坦克）。

1cd70vc.en: Foreign equipment has additional quirks outlined by the table below:
1cd70vc.zh: 外国装备还有下表列出的额外限制：

4i38qy.en: Only with tank / ship / aircraft designers⟦0⟧
4i38qy.zh: 仅在使用坦克/舰船/飞机设计器时⟦0⟧

ch9b0m.en: Note that for the equipment designers, the base chassis cost is not shown in the research or production screens (those have modules priced in), but is seen in the tooltip for production cost in the designer itself.
ch9b0m.zh: 注意，对于装备设计器，基础底盘成本不会显示在科研或生产界面中（这些界面已计入模块价格），但可以在设计器内的生产成本提示框中看到。

wzzaok.en: Production modifiers come from armor types and modules.
wzzaok.zh: 生产修正来自装甲类型与模块。

e3aoap.en: The dismantle cost is paid any time a module changes from the old design, including moving slots.
e3aoap.zh: 只要模块相对旧设计发生变化（包括更换槽位），就需要支付拆解成本。

1b5tga2.en: Refit cost formula for ships: ⟦0⟧. This also applies to carrier conversions.
1b5tga2.zh: 舰船改装成本公式：⟦0⟧。这也适用于航空母舰改装。

19ilu81.en: Module upgrade costs usually are only available when upgrading a module to a differently-tiered one in the same category, e.g., upgrading an anti-air 1 module to anti-air 2, 3, or 4. They are usually less than new module costs, but in some cases like for light cruiser batteries, heavy cruiser batteries, and engines, they can be more expensive than a new module, sometimes doubly or triply so. Note: with engines, the upgrade costs only apply when staying within the same engine category. This is relevant for carrier conversions, as the more expensive upgrade costs are not paid when switching from cruiser or heavy ship engines to carrier engines, but they are paid if the design stays within the same engine category type and has a different tier.
19ilu81.zh: 模块升级费用通常仅出现在将模块升级为同一类别中不同等级的模块时，例如将防空 1 模块升级为防空 2、3 或 4。它们通常低于新模块的费用，但在某些情况下，如轻型巡洋舰主炮、重型巡洋舰主炮和引擎，升级费用可能高于新模块，有时甚至是其两倍或三倍。注意：对于引擎，升级费用仅在保持同一引擎类别时才适用。这与航空母舰改装相关：从巡洋舰或重型舰船引擎换为航空母舰引擎时不需要支付更昂贵的升级费用，但如果设计仍属于同一引擎类别类型而只是等级不同，则需要支付。

1mc1ups.en: ⟦0⟧: with engines, the upgrade costs only apply when staying within the same engine category. This is relevant for carrier conversions, as the more expensive upgrade costs are not paid when switching from cruiser or heavy ship engines to carrier engines, but they are paid if the design stays within the same engine category type and has a different tier.
1mc1ups.zh: ⟦0⟧：对于引擎，升级费用仅在保持同一引擎类别时才适用。这与航空母舰改装相关：从巡洋舰或重型舰船引擎换为航空母舰引擎时不需要支付更昂贵的升级费用，但如果设计仍属于同一引擎类别类型而只是等级不同，则需要支付。

1x8cave.en: Production modifiers come from armor types and engines.
1x8cave.zh: 生产修正来自装甲类型和引擎。

1m1szrb.en: Dismantle costs are paid for removing specific modules, mainly armor modules and torpedo launchers (though the dismantle costs for torpedo launchers are fairly small). This includes removing battleship or battlecruiser armor when converting battleships or battlecruiser to carriers, which practically makes these carrier conversions more expensive than just producing a new carrier from scratch.
1m1szrb.zh: 拆除费用用于移除特定模块，主要是装甲模块和鱼雷发射器（不过鱼雷发射器的拆除费用相当低）。这包括在将战列舰或战列巡洋舰改装为航空母舰时移除战列舰或战列巡洋舰装甲，这实际上使这些航空母舰改装比直接从零开始建造一艘新航空母舰更昂贵。

1jk1mxm.en: Equipment conversion speed bonuses from sources like ⟦0⟧, certain focuses like ⟦1⟧, etc. are applied as bonuses on the reduction of the ⟦2⟧ due to conversion. It only applies to equipment that can be converted, such as tanks with ⟦3⟧ and aircraft with ⟦4⟧, not ships, as alterations to ships are considered refits, not conversions. ⟦5⟧: the UI is currently bugged and does highlight conversion speed bonuses when refitting ships, even though their bonuses are not applied.
1jk1mxm.zh: 来自 ⟦0⟧ 等来源、以及 ⟦1⟧ 等特定焦点的装备转换速度加成，会作为转换所带来 ⟦2⟧ 减少量的加成生效。它仅适用于可转换的装备，例如带有 ⟦3⟧ 的坦克和带有 ⟦4⟧ 的飞机，而不适用于舰船，因为对舰船的改动被视为改装而非转换。⟦5⟧：目前 UI 存在错误，在改装舰船时会高亮显示转换速度加成，尽管这些加成并不会生效。

1juh438.en: ⟦0⟧ Consider upgrading an aircraft with a full cost of 30 . If, through conversion, the cost is normally reduced to 20 , the conversion savings amount to 10 , as ⟦1⟧. With one ⟦2⟧ conversion speed bonus, a reduction of 40% is applied to the 10 savings, giving a further 4 reduction. Therefore, if the initial conversion cost is 20 before researching the conversion bonus, it will be reduced to 16 after applying the bonus, as ⟦3⟧. With both conversion bonuses researched, it would be reduced to 12 , as ⟦4⟧.
1juh438.zh: ⟦0⟧ 假设将一架全价为 30 的飞机升级。如果通过转换，成本通常降至 20，则转换节省的量为 10，如 ⟦1⟧ 所示。若拥有一个 ⟦2⟧ 转换速度加成，则对这 10 点节省量应用 40% 的减免，可再减少 4。因此，如果在研究转换加成之前初始转换成本为 20，应用加成后将降至 16，如 ⟦3⟧ 所示。若两项转换加成均已研究，则会降至 12，如 ⟦4⟧ 所示。

11aonfl.en: With the right designs, these bonuses can help massively reduce the ⟦0⟧ cost of producing expensive equipment, like heavy tanks with heavy cannons or aircraft with self-sealing fuel tanks. Producing a barebones design first and then converting it into a full design can be just a few percentages more expensive than producing the full design outright, but have half or even less of the total resource cost. If a country has additional equipment conversion speed bonuses from elsewhere, making equipment in two steps can even be outright cheaper.
11aonfl.zh: 在合适的设计下，这些加成可以大幅降低生产昂贵装备的 ⟦0⟧ 成本，例如装有重型火炮的重型坦克或装有自封油箱的飞机。先生产简配设计再将其转换为完整设计，可能只比直接生产完整设计贵几个百分点，但总资源成本只有其一半甚至更低。如果一国还能从其他途径获得额外的装备转换速度加成，分两步生产装备甚至可能更便宜。

gcnfpn.en: Ship refitting speed bonuses from sources like the ⟦0⟧ officer corps spirit, certain focuses like ⟦1⟧, etc., act as additional ⟦2⟧ bonuses that are only applied when refitting ships. This makes them have a smaller relative effect the more ⟦3⟧ the country already has.
gcnfpn.zh: 来自 ⟦0⟧ 军官团精神、⟦1⟧ 等特定焦点等来源的舰船改装速度加成，属于额外的 ⟦2⟧ 加成，仅在改装舰船时生效。因此，国家已有的 ⟦3⟧ 越多，它们的相对效果就越小。

p43hk6.en: With the right designs, these bonuses can help reduce the ⟦0⟧ costs of producing expensive ships like battleships or carriers, reduce the ⟦1⟧ of ships with final designs that are a lot more expensive than barebones ones as is often the case with carriers, or both.
p43hk6.zh: 在合适的设计下，这些加成有助于降低生产战列舰或航空母舰等昂贵舰船的 ⟦0⟧ 成本，降低最终设计比简配设计昂贵得多的舰船（航空母舰常常如此）的 ⟦1⟧，或两者兼有。

1ry3ho7.en: Each nation can use a percentage of the resources on its territory for military production, with the rest being reserved exclusively for ⟦0⟧. This percentage depends on the ⟦1⟧, with ⟦2⟧ making all resources available for internal production and no resources available for ⟦3⟧.
1ry3ho7.zh: 每个国家可以将本国领土上一定比例的资源用于军事生产，其余部分则专供 ⟦0⟧。该比例取决于 ⟦1⟧，采用 ⟦2⟧ 时所有资源都可用于国内生产，没有任何资源可供 ⟦3⟧。

ey9v80.en: The total amount of resources can be increased by researching the ⟦0⟧. Each level of excavation technology gives a resource gain efficiency increase of ⟦1⟧ to the total of all extracted resources (extracted resources are those that come from the ground via drilling or mining; it does not include resources from ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧). There are five (5) levels of excavation technology; researching all of them will give a ⟦4⟧ bonus to the extracted resources total.
ey9v80.zh: 研究 ⟦0⟧ 可以提高资源总量。每一级开采科技都会使全部开采资源的总量获得 ⟦1⟧ 的资源获取效率提升（开采资源指通过钻探或采矿从地下获取的资源；不包括来自 ⟦2⟧ 或 ⟦3⟧ 的资源）。开采科技共有五（5）级；全部研究完成后，开采资源总量将获得 ⟦4⟧ 的加成。

ibw9cm.en: The total amount of resources can also be increased by building ⟦0⟧. Each level of infrastructure gives a resource increase of ⟦1⟧ to the total of all extracted resources (except those resources produced by a synthetic refinery or resources acquired via trade) in a state. There are five (5) levels of infrastructure; building all of them will give a ⟦2⟧ bonus to the extracted resources total. Additionally, a ⟦3⟧ can be constructed at state level, increasing the resources gained per infrastructure by ⟦4⟧.
ibw9cm.zh: 建造 ⟦0⟧ 也可以提高资源总量。每一级基础设施会使州内全部开采资源的总量获得 ⟦1⟧ 的资源提升（不包括合成炼油厂生产的资源或通过贸易获得的资源）。基础设施共有五（5）级；全部建成后，开采资源总量将获得 ⟦2⟧ 的加成。此外，还可以在州一级建造 ⟦3⟧，使每级基础设施获得的资源提升 ⟦4⟧。

l001mq.en: A ⟦0⟧ modifier is applied to resource extraction in a state if there is a ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ in it connected to the capital via sea or railroad. Most states have this bonus at game start.
l001mq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修正会施加于某州的资源开采，前提是该州内有通过海运或铁路与首都相连的 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧。大多数州在游戏开始时都拥有此加成。

1epfloq.en: Resources cannot be stockpiled. They flow directly to production, with any excess resources being effectively wasted. ⟦0⟧ that is produced directly from ⟦1⟧ can be stockpiled, however.
1epfloq.zh: 资源无法储存。它们直接流入生产，多余的资源实际上被浪费。不过，⟦0⟧ 若直接由 ⟦1⟧ 生产，则可以储存。

1yankjr.en: Different kinds of equipment require different resources to produce. Lacking sufficient resources will apply an increasing efficiency penalty up to ⟦0⟧ to the lowest priority production lines. The penalty increases by ⟦1⟧ per missing unit of resource per type, and the highest applicable penalty is applied to individual factories.
1yankjr.zh: 不同种类的装备生产所需的资源各不相同。资源不足会对优先级最低的生产线施加递增的效率惩罚，最高可达 ⟦0⟧。每缺少一单位某类资源，惩罚就增加 ⟦1⟧，每座工厂适用其中最高的惩罚。

6azyad.en: For example, when having 2 units of ⟦0⟧ and 0 units of ⟦1⟧ available and adding a new production line for Support Equipment (needs 2 1 ) with 11 ⟦2⟧, the first factory receives a penalty of ⟦3⟧ because it misses one unit of ⟦4⟧. The second factory receives a ⟦5⟧ penalty because it is missing both two units of ⟦6⟧ and the one unit of ⟦7⟧. For each of the remaining factories, the penalty increases by ⟦8⟧ because they need two additional ⟦9⟧, the last ones getting a ⟦10⟧ penalty, being unable to produce the equipment at all. The production line shows the average penalty across all factories, ⟦11⟧. This penalty stacks multiplicatively with other modifiers.
6azyad.zh: 例如，当可用资源为 2 单位 ⟦0⟧ 和 0 单位 ⟦1⟧，并为支援装备（需要 2 1 ）新增一条使用 11 ⟦2⟧ 的生产线时，第一座工厂受到 ⟦3⟧ 的惩罚，因为它缺少一单位 ⟦4⟧。第二座工厂受到 ⟦5⟧ 的惩罚，因为它同时缺少两单位 ⟦6⟧ 和一单位 ⟦7⟧。对于其余每座工厂，惩罚增加 ⟦8⟧，因为它们还需要两单位 ⟦9⟧，最后几座工厂受到 ⟦10⟧ 的惩罚，完全无法生产该装备。生产线显示所有工厂的平均惩罚，⟦11⟧。该惩罚与其他修正以乘法叠加。

1ku888p.en: Some countries have access to unique ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and/or ⟦2⟧ that can reduce these penalties.
1ku888p.zh: 部分国家拥有独特的 ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 和/或 ⟦2⟧，可以减轻这些惩罚。

1ahskor.en: When facing a shortage, consider that the cost in ⟦0⟧, hence construction slowdown, to provide sufficient resources might not be worth the benefit of eliminating the penalty inflicted on the production line. Note that production efficiency increase is not affected by availability of resources for a production line, so it can make sense to leave a production line without adequate resources when it is first started and put the civilian factories needed to buy resources to another use, as this is when output loss is lowest. However, consider that countries from which you buy resources gain the construction you spend. Hence, buying resources from a country that's in the same faction, or which will be so later, doesn't result in loss from your faction, though both AI and humans, even allied, may have different ideas about how to put those civilian factories to use.
1ahskor.zh: 面对资源短缺时，要考虑为提供足够资源而付出的 ⟦0⟧ 成本（也就是建造速度的下降）可能并不值得换取消除生产线上所受惩罚的收益。请注意，生产线的生产效率增长不受资源是否充足的影响，因此在生产线刚开工时让其资源不足，并把用于购买资源所需的民用工厂转作他用是合理的，因为此时产量损失最小。不过要考虑，向你出售资源的国家会获得你花费的建造力。因此，从同一阵营、或日后将加入同一阵营的国家购买资源，不会造成本阵营的损失，不过 AI 和人类玩家，即使是盟友，对于如何使用那些民用工厂也可能有不同想法。

14hxpa5.en: Oil is important for making any form of vehicle run.
14hxpa5.zh: 石油对于让任何形式的车辆运转都很重要。

187fvi4.en: Not used in manufacturing, but instead refined into Fuel, which is used by ships, aircraft, and ground vehicles to operate.
187fvi4.zh: 不用于制造，而是精炼为燃料，供舰船、飞机和地面车辆运转使用。

1od1g59.en: Not used in manufacturing, but instead refined into ⟦0⟧, which is used by ships, aircraft, and ground vehicles to operate.
1od1g59.zh: 不用于制造，而是精炼为 ⟦0⟧，供舰船、飞机和地面车辆运转使用。

1iebi0g.en: Aluminum is important for the construction of specialized vehicles and aircraft.
1iebi0g.zh: 铝对于建造特种车辆和飞机很重要。

cie0bd.en: Rubber is important for the construction of most vehicles.
cie0bd.zh: 橡胶对于建造大多数车辆很重要。

1qazr8p.zh: 飞机 摩托化/机械化

1ridzxp.en: Tungsten is a rare hard metal mainly used for anti-tank munitions, but also machine tools and specialized parts.
1ridzxp.zh: 钨是一种稀有的硬质金属，主要用于反坦克弹药，也用于机床和专用部件。

37wgf8.en: Artillery and Anti-Tank Level III and IV Armored Cars Medium, Heavy, and Super-Heavy tank weapons Small anti-tank and anti-air tank weapons Squeeze-Bore Adapter on tanks and tank variants Rocket aircraft Railway guns
37wgf8.zh: 火炮与反坦克 III 级和 IV 级装甲车 中型、重型与超重型坦克武器 小型反坦克与防空坦克武器 坦克及坦克变体上的锥膛适配器 火箭飞机 列车炮

yaex71.en: Level III and IV Armored Cars
yaex71.zh: III 级和 IV 级装甲车

17rhb8s.en: Medium, Heavy, and Super-Heavy tank weapons
17rhb8s.zh: 中型、重型与超重型坦克武器

1u4qnms.en: Small anti-tank and anti-air tank weapons
1u4qnms.zh: 小型反坦克与防空坦克武器

j7ps4m.en: Squeeze-Bore Adapter on tanks and tank variants
j7ps4m.zh: 坦克及坦克变体上的锥膛适配器

ifm9c1.en: Steel is the primary metal for most types of military machinery, whether it be tanks or ships.
ifm9c1.zh: 钢铁是大多数类型军事机械的主要金属，无论是坦克还是舰船。

5l2bxo.en: Infantry Weapons and Support Equipment Artillery, Anti-Air, and Anti-Tank Floating harbors Ships Tanks, Motorized/Mechanized, and Armored Cars Trains Railway guns
5l2bxo.zh: 步兵武器与支援装备 火炮、防空与反坦克 浮动港口 舰船 坦克、摩托化/机械化与装甲车 列车 列车炮

1x1oiag.zh: 坦克、摩托化/机械化与装甲车

2nrhkf.en: Chromium is a metal used for the construction of advanced engines.
2nrhkf.zh: 铬是用于建造高级引擎的金属。

1iici0v.en: Improved Heavy, Advanced Heavy, Super-Heavy, and Modern tank chassis Welded Armor on tanks and tank variants High-tier Medium tank weapons Level II and III Anti-Tank Large ships (Carrier, Battleship, Super-Heavy Battleship, and Battlecruiser) Level IV small ships (Destroyer, Light Cruiser, Heavy Cruiser, Submarine) Level III and IV Cruiser Armor Jet aircraft Railway guns
1iici0v.zh: 改进型重型、先进重型、超重型与现代坦克底盘 坦克及坦克变体上的焊接装甲 高级中型坦克武器 II 级和 III 级反坦克 大型舰船（航空母舰、战列舰、超重型战列舰与战列巡洋舰） IV 级小型舰船（驱逐舰、轻型巡洋舰、重型巡洋舰、潜艇） III 级和 IV 级巡洋舰装甲 喷气式飞机 列车炮

izuvjo.en: Improved Heavy, Advanced Heavy, Super-Heavy, and Modern tank chassis
izuvjo.zh: 改进型重型、先进重型、超重型与现代坦克底盘

1tm88oy.en: Welded Armor on tanks and tank variants
1tm88oy.zh: 坦克及坦克变体上的焊接装甲

fx9iem.zh: II 级和 III 级反坦克

19slqkt.en: Large ships (Carrier, Battleship, Super-Heavy Battleship, and Battlecruiser)
19slqkt.zh: 大型舰船（航空母舰、战列舰、超重型战列舰与战列巡洋舰）

j9a333.en: Level IV small ships (Destroyer, Light Cruiser, Heavy Cruiser, Submarine)
j9a333.zh: IV 级小型舰船（驱逐舰、轻型巡洋舰、重型巡洋舰、潜艇）

1fy2ea8.en: Level III and IV Cruiser Armor
1fy2ea8.zh: III 级和 IV 级巡洋舰装甲

lt87dy.en: Coal is used by factories to keep themselves powered for increased ⟦0⟧.
lt87dy.zh: 工厂使用煤来维持供电，以提高 ⟦0⟧。

5nyczc.en: When powered: Civilian factories have have their base output of 4[29] increased to 5[30]. Military factories have have their base output of 3.5[31] increased to 4.5[32]. Naval dockyards have have their base output of 2[33] increased to 2.5[34].
5nyczc.zh: 通电时：民用工厂的基础产出由 4[29] 提升至 5[30]。军用工厂的基础产出由 3.5[31] 提升至 4.5[32]。海军船坞的基础产出由 2[33] 提升至 2.5[34]。

12uh5s7.en: ⟦0⟧ have have their base output of ⟦1⟧ increased to ⟦2⟧.
12uh5s7.zh: ⟦0⟧ 的基础产出由 ⟦1⟧ 提升至 ⟦2⟧。

3e9s50.en: There are several ways to acquire more resources:
3e9s50.zh: 有几种方法可以获取更多资源：

wx5kyc.zh: 夺取 ⟦0⟧ 或采取特定的 ⟦1⟧。

4wfmys.en: Build a ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ in a resource-producing state that has none, and connect it to the capital.
4wfmys.zh: 在尚无 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 的产资源州建造其中之一，并将其与首都相连。

f3zl5c.en: Change ⟦0⟧ to keep more domestic production.
f3zl5c.zh: 更改 ⟦0⟧ 以保留更多国内生产。

15chgoz.en: Gain rights to resources through ⟦0⟧ or unique ⟦1⟧.
15chgoz.zh: 通过 ⟦0⟧ 或独特的 ⟦1⟧ 获得资源权利。

18hpsiw.en: In addition to acquiring more resources when there is a shortage, there are many ways to reduce how many are consumed by a nation's production lines:
18hpsiw.zh: 除了在短缺时获取更多资源外，还有许多方法可以减少国家生产线所消耗的资源量：

1s1djk6.en: Lower-tier equipment, components, and chassis often have reduced resource costs.
1s1djk6.zh: 较低等级的装备、部件和底盘通常资源成本更低。

1q2fpsf.en: Aircraft designs with Non-Strategic Material Usage have reduced ⟦0⟧ costs.
1q2fpsf.zh: 采用非战略材料使用的飞机设计具有更低的 ⟦0⟧ 成本。

j1495a.en: Omitting resource-costing components from ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ designs like ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, or ⟦5⟧ reduces their resource costs.
j1495a.zh: 在 ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧ 设计中省略消耗资源的部件，例如 ⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧ 或 ⟦5⟧，可以降低其资源成本。

13i57oq.en: Because converting equipment only costs resources if the new design has a different resource cost from the old one, producing tanks and/or aircraft in multiple steps, where a bare-bones design is built first before it is converted to the full design, can reduce overall resource costs for that line of equipment.
13i57oq.zh: 由于只有在新设计与旧设计的资源成本不同时，转换装备才会消耗资源，因此分多步生产坦克和/或飞机——先生产简配设计，再将其转换为完整设计——可以降低该装备系列的总体资源成本。

13yd1qx.en: Refitting ships after they have been produced only consumes the resources of the refitted components. For example, building a cruiser with no armor and the refitting it with ⟦0⟧ only incurs the armor's ⟦1⟧ cost during the refit step, whereas building the same ship without refitting would cost additional ⟦2⟧ during the entire production process instead of just when the armor is being added.
13yd1qx.zh: 舰船建成后进行改装只消耗所改装部件的资源。例如，先建造一艘不带装甲的巡洋舰，再用 ⟦0⟧ 对其进行改装，只在改装阶段产生装甲的 ⟦1⟧ 成本；而建造同一艘舰船若不进行改装，则会在整个生产过程中持续产生额外的 ⟦2⟧ 成本，而不只是在加装装甲时。

u1hewy.en: Some ⟦0⟧ (MIO) bonuses can reduce resource requirements for certain types of equipment. The Vertical Integration and Permanent Industrial Revolution MIO policies also reduce resource requirements for all MIO equipment, though Vertical Integration also increases the production penalty for lacking resources.

1104pul.en: Nations may pay for production licenses from nations that already have researched a technology. The base cost is ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ per license involving 1936 technology or earlier (pre-1936) technology. The civilian factory goes to the nation whose equipment is being licensed. License costs increase by ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ for each technology year beyond 1936. For example, licensing Towed Artillery (1936 equipment) costs ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, licensing Improved Artillery (1939 equipment) costs ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧, and licensing Advanced Artillery (1942 equipment) costs ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧. Once a license is acquired, it cannot be canceled for 30⟦10⟧ days.
1104pul.zh: 国家可以付费获得已研究某项科技的国家提供的生产许可。涉及 1936 年科技或更早（1936 年前）科技的许可，基础费用为 ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧。民用工厂归被许可装备所属的国家。科技年份每超过 1936 年一年，许可费用就增加 ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧。例如，许可牵引火炮（1936 年装备）需要 ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧，许可改进型火炮（1939 年装备）需要 ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧，许可先进火炮（1942 年装备）需要 ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧。许可一旦获得，在 30⟦10⟧ 天内无法取消。

14317da.en: Having a license to some equipment also provides ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ for the technology that unlocks a domestic (non-licensed) version of that equipment. For equipment that uses a designer, such as ⟦2⟧ (with ⟦3⟧), ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧ (with ⟦6⟧), only the technology for the base chassis, hull, or airframe of the licensed design receives this bonus.
14317da.zh: 拥有某种装备的许可，还会为解锁该装备国产（非许可）版本的科技提供 ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧。对于使用设计商的装备，例如 ⟦2⟧（配合 ⟦3⟧）、⟦4⟧ 和 ⟦5⟧（配合 ⟦6⟧），只有许可设计的基础底盘、舰体或机体所对应的科技才能获得该加成。

8pvs8j.en: A nation with good relations with a foreign nation can request a license from them to produce the foreign equipment. The equipment type an AI-controlled nation is willing to license out depends on their relations and how advanced the technology is. ⟦0⟧, for example, may not be willing to license out their latest tank or fighter designs, but would be happy to provide Panzer IIs to friendly or neutral nations. ⟦1⟧ may also provide a way to gain licenses.
8pvs8j.zh: 与他国关系良好的国家可以请求对方许可，以生产外国装备。AI 控制的国家愿意许可出去的装备类型取决于双方关系和科技先进程度。例如，⟦0⟧ 可能不愿许可其最新坦克或战斗机设计，但乐意向友好或中立国家提供二号坦克（Panzer II）。⟦1⟧ 也可能提供获得许可的途径。

fzw37j.en: Producing foreign equipment will not be as efficient as producing the player's own designs. The following production penalties apply multiplicatively to ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧:
fzw37j.zh: 生产外国装备的效率不如生产玩家自己的设计。以下生产惩罚会以乘法方式作用于 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧：

1e5zy6y.zh: 来自其他 ⟦0⟧ 成员的许可装备：⟦1⟧

14dm971.en: Licensed equipment from a non-⟦0⟧ member: ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧
14dm971.zh: 来自非 ⟦0⟧ 成员的许可装备：⟦1⟧⟦2⟧

1soq0i.en: Does not have a license to produce the foreign equipment: ⟦0⟧
1soq0i.zh: 未获得生产该外国装备的许可：⟦0⟧

d7a9s5.en: Foreign equipment is "ahead of time": additional ⟦0⟧ for each year that it is ahead of time, up to a maximum of ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧
d7a9s5.zh: 外国装备“超前时代”：每超前一年额外 ⟦0⟧，最多为 ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧

okv678.en: Some ⟦0⟧ provide bonuses to license production that can offset these penalties, such as ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧. In particular, ⟦3⟧ can allow ⟦4⟧ to produce licensed equipment faster than their own.
okv678.zh: 某些 ⟦0⟧ 会提供许可生产加成，可抵消这些惩罚，例如 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧。尤其是 ⟦3⟧ 可以让 ⟦4⟧ 以比生产自研装备更快的速度生产许可装备。

v58vco.en: Creating a ⟦0⟧ of licensed equipment costs ⟦1⟧ as much ⟦2⟧ compared to doing the same for non-licensed equipment.
v58vco.zh: 与创建非许可装备相比，创建许可装备的 ⟦0⟧ 需要 ⟦1⟧ 的 ⟦2⟧。

g4v2gz.en: When licensing equipment, ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ applied to the original equipment do not transfer their bonuses to the licensed equipment. However, country-wide bonuses from ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and/or ⟦4⟧ that affect the production cost of the original equipment will transfer over with the license.
g4v2gz.zh: 许可装备时，施加于原装备的 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 不会将其加成转移到许可装备上。不过，来自 ⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧ 和/或 ⟦4⟧ 的全国性加成若影响原装备的生产成本，则会随许可一并转移。

1ar6vnc.en: With ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ cannot be directly assigned to production lines of foreign equipment, preventing them from applying their production bonuses to those lines and also preventing them from gathering funds and experience from overseeing those lines.
1ar6vnc.zh: 启用 ⟦0⟧ 时，⟦1⟧ 无法直接分配到外国装备的生产线，因此无法将自身生产加成应用于这些生产线，也无法通过管理这些生产线积累资金和经验。

lla0k0.en: As of game version v1.16.9, there are also a set of bugs in the game where component modules of licensed ⟦0⟧ can be applied and used on domestic, non-licensed hulls without penalties even if the country does not have the appropriate technology for them. This can happen whenever a save game where the license is active is loaded.⟦1⟧ Similar bugs for ⟦2⟧ (with ⟦3⟧) and ⟦4⟧ (with ⟦5⟧) have also been unofficially noted.⟦6⟧
lla0k0.zh: 在游戏版本 v1.16.9 中，游戏还存在一组错误：许可 ⟦0⟧ 的部件模块可以被应用到国产的非许可舰体上并使用而不受惩罚，即使该国并未拥有相应的适当科技。只要加载许可仍然有效的存档，就可能出现这种情况。⟦1⟧ 对于 ⟦2⟧（配合 ⟦3⟧）和 ⟦4⟧（配合 ⟦5⟧）的类似错误也有非正式的报告。⟦6⟧

181qfec.en: The ⟦0⟧ is the primary ⟦1⟧ depicted on the map during gameplay. Divisions operate inside of a ⟦2⟧, may be transported via ⟦3⟧, and may participate in ⟦4⟧.

oimjp5.en: The composition of each division is specified by its division template. Each country starts with one or more division templates that may be used to order recruiting and deployment of new land units. Division templates may be created and modified by spending ⟦0⟧. New templates may be created by either using the Duplicate button to make a duplicate of a template, giving it a name different from existing templates, and then making modifications to a template as described below, or by selecting the name and pressing "Create Empty". Certain technologies that unlock new battalion types, such as mountaineers, also create basic templates for them. Land experience is not charged until the changes are saved using the Save button on which the total cost is also shown, so players can experiment and analyze the results of changes before making a decision.
oimjp5.zh: 每个师的编成由其师编制规定。每个国家开局时都有一个或多个师编制，可用于下令征募和部署新的陆军单位。师编制可以通过花费⟦0⟧来创建和修改。创建新编制的方法有两种：一是使用「复制」按钮复制一个编制，为其取一个与现有编制不同的名称，然后按下文所述对该编制进行修改；二是选中名称后按「创建空白」。某些解锁新营类型的科技（例如山地兵）也会为其创建基础编制。只有在按下「保存」按钮保存改动后才会扣除陆军经验，该按钮上还会显示总花费，因此玩家可以先试验并分析改动结果，再作决定。

1asoqde.en: When a template is changed, all divisions that are based on that template immediately place orders for additional needed manpower and equipment and return any manpower or equipment that is now surplus to the national stockpile. It is wise to have any needed manpower and equipment ready in the national stockpile before changing the template of a division that may be expected to face combat in the near future. It may be prudent to upgrade units one at a time.
1asoqde.zh: 修改编制后，所有基于该编制的师会立即下达补充所需人力和装备的订单，并将现已多余的人力和装备退回国家储备。在修改近期可能参战的师的编制之前，最好先在国家储备中备好所需的人力和装备。逐个升级单位可能更为稳妥。

1b12pua.en: Divisions can not be divided into smaller game units, but it is possible to merge understrength divisions of the same template in the Army window using the ⟦0⟧ button if the selected divisions are independent of any army command. Such consolidation can be extremely useful for a country low on manpower or equipment that needs to field adequately sized divisions.
1b12pua.zh: 师无法再拆分为更小的游戏单位，但如果选中的师不隶属于任何集团军，就可以在陆军窗口中使用⟦0⟧按钮合并同一编制下不满编的师。对于人力或装备紧缺、却需要投入足额规模师的国家来说，这种合并极为有用。

1pyrx97.en: The template a division uses can be changed at any time by selecting the unit helmet, tank or other unit symbol icon in the Unit Details screen when that division's template is open and choosing any of the templates available there.
1pyrx97.zh: 在该师的编制打开时，于单位详情界面中选择头盔、坦克或其他单位符号图标，即可随时更改师所使用的编制，并在其中任选一个可用编制。

1qiw6ex.en: Each division consists of up to ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. In turn, each combat regiment is composed of up to five battalions. It costs 5 XP to add a battalion to a division; regardless if it is the same or new regiment. Adding a battalion of a different unit type (infantry, mobile, or armored) adds a penalty of 20 XP per additional unit type.
1qiw6ex.zh: 每个师最多由⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧组成。每个战斗团又由最多五个营组成。为一个师添加一个营需要花费 5 XP；无论它属于同一个团还是新团都是如此。添加不同单位类型（步兵、机动或装甲）的营时，每多一种单位类型就要额外花费 20 XP。

1hwmyo1.en: A division may have any number of the same unit type for battalions, but only one of each unit type for support companies.
1hwmyo1.zh: 在营的层面上，一个师可以拥有任意数量的同一单位类型，但在支援连的层面上，每种单位类型只能有一个。

kxnvyx.en: A division template may be specified as reserve, regular, or elite. Elite divisions will be prioritized for better equipment, followed by regular divisions and finally reserves.
kxnvyx.zh: 师编制可以指定为预备、常规或精锐。精锐师会优先获得更好的装备，其次是常规师，最后是预备师。

1v50evl.en: Each division template can receive specific types of equipment if multiple types are available. An example would be elite divisions only using the latest weapons and reserve divisions using the oldest.
1v50evl.zh: 当有多种装备类型可用时，每个师编制都可以指定接收特定类型的装备。例如，精锐师只使用最新的武器，而预备师则使用最老旧的武器。

1vo7umk.en: Each combat regiment in a division consists entirely of a mix of battalions within a single battalion type. The three battalion types are:
1vo7umk.zh: 师中的每个战斗团完全由单一营类型下的若干营混合组成。三种营类型分别是：

1hwwgas.zh: ⟦0⟧：步兵、特种部队、一线（牵引式）火炮/防空/反坦克

zzx6o4.en: ⟦0⟧: Cavalry, motorized infantry, mechanized infantry, motorized rocket artillery, motorized artillery/anti-air/anti-tank, armored cars
zzx6o4.zh: ⟦0⟧：骑兵、摩托化步兵、机械化步兵、摩托化火箭炮、摩托化火炮/防空/反坦克、装甲车

1ph14il.en: ⟦0⟧: Tanks, tank destroyers, self-propelled artillery/anti-air, amphibious tanks
1ph14il.zh: ⟦0⟧：坦克、坦克歼击车、自行火炮/防空、两栖坦克

1xkgk2l.en: Increasing the number of battalions in a division modifies the stats of the division: for example new combat battalions increase the HP and combat width of the division, and typically increase at least the different attack and defense statistics. Note that the division's organization is the average of the organization of the included battalions, thus it is possible that the division's (average) organization actually drops when adding new battalions. See ⟦0⟧ for more discussion on this.
1xkgk2l.zh: 增加师中的营数量会改变师的属性：例如新增战斗营会提高师的 HP 和战斗宽度，并且通常至少会提高各项攻击与防御属性。请注意，师的组织度是所含各营组织度的平均值，因此添加新营时师（平均）组织度反而可能下降。更多讨论请参见⟦0⟧。

xp6ceq.en: For the armor, piercing and hardness stats there is a different calculation:
xp6ceq.zh: 装甲、穿甲和硬度属性的计算方式则有所不同：

1evh37a.en: ⟦0⟧ 40% * (Highest Armor of a Battalion) + 60% * (Average Armor for All Battalions and Companies) = Armor of the Division
1evh37a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 40% *（单个营的最高装甲）+ 60% *（所有营与连的平均装甲）= 师的装甲

1ghj0pg.en: ⟦0⟧ If there are 3 Batallions, 2 Infantry (1936), and 1 Light Tank (1934), then the calculation would look like this:
1ghj0pg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 如果有 3 个营：2 个步兵（1936）和 1 个轻型坦克（1934），则计算如下：

fybadd.en: ⟦0⟧ 40% * (Highest Piercing of a Battalion or Support Company) + 60% * (Average Piercing for All Battalions and Companies) = Piercing of the Division
fybadd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 40% *（营或支援连的最高穿甲）+ 60% *（所有营与连的平均穿甲）= 师的穿甲

6kq348.en: ⟦0⟧ Average of Hardness of Line Battalions = Hardness of the Division
6kq348.zh: ⟦0⟧ 一线营硬度的平均值 = 师的硬度

11p3p4e.en: ⟦0⟧ If there are 4 Batallions, 2 Infantry (1936) and 2 Light Tanks (1934), then the calculations would look like this:
11p3p4e.zh: ⟦0⟧ 如果有 4 个营：2 个步兵（1936）和 2 个轻型坦克（1934），则计算如下：

9j154y.en: Combat battalion composition determines how ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ applies to this division. Their bonuses are modified by the target battalion count in the total combat battalions.
9j154y.zh: 战斗营的构成决定了⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧如何作用于该师。它们的加成会根据目标营在战斗营总数中所占的数量进行修正。

mxkdxs.en: A division may have up to five different support companies. These are referred to in doctrines and elsewhere in the game as 'integrated support', distinguished from 'dispersed support' which is an Artillery, Anti-Air or Anti-Tank type regiment included in a combat regiment column. Support company options are:
mxkdxs.zh: 一个师最多可以拥有五个不同的支援连。在学说和游戏的其他部分中，这些被称为“整合支援”，以区别于“分散支援”——后者是指编入战斗团纵列中的火炮、防空或反坦克类团。可选的支援连如下：

m3l4g3.en: ⟦0⟧: Gives a smaller bonus to soft attack than a line regiment's artillery battalion because it has fewer guns. It does not slow the division† or affect paradrops.
m3l4g3.zh: ⟦0⟧：由于火炮较少，其软攻加成低于一线团的火炮营。它不会拖慢师的速度†，也不影响空降。

gaibks.en: ⟦0⟧: Gives a smaller bonus to air attack than a line regiment's anti-air battalion because it has fewer guns. It does not slow the division† or affect paradrops.
gaibks.zh: ⟦0⟧：由于火炮较少，其对空攻击加成低于一线团的防空营。它不会拖慢师的速度†，也不影响空降。

192ootz.en: ⟦0⟧: Gives a smaller bonus to hard attack and piercing than a line regiment's anti-tank battalion because it has fewer guns. It does not slow the division† or affect paradrops.
192ootz.zh: ⟦0⟧：由于火炮较少，其硬攻和穿甲加成低于一线团的反坦克营。它不会拖慢师的速度†，也不影响空降。

1loymbf.en: ⟦0⟧: Similar to regular support artillery but it also gives a bonus to the division's breakthrough stat, used to avoid enemy attacks when attacking.
1loymbf.zh: ⟦0⟧：与普通支援火炮类似，但还会为师的突破属性提供加成，该属性用于在进攻时规避敌军攻击。

l1jfgm.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the Entrenchment stat of the division and helps in attacking forts and river crossings.
l1jfgm.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高师的构筑工事属性，并有助于攻击要塞和渡河。

1rkl6jn.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases speed in difficult terrain† and the division's Reconnaissance stat, making it easier to counter enemy combat tactics in battle.
1rkl6jn.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高在困难地形†中的速度以及师的侦察属性，使战斗中更容易克制敌方的战斗战术。

nbj69x.en: ⟦0⟧: Gives a bonus to the Suppression stat of its division's line battalions, helping to reduce the effects of partisans. Military Police with 2-6 minimally equipped and trained Cavalry battalions makes an efficient and effective rear-area security division.
nbj69x.zh: ⟦0⟧：为其所在师的一线营提供镇压属性加成，有助于减轻游击队的影响。让军事警察连搭配 2-6 个仅配备最低限度装备、训练程度最低的骑兵营，就能组成一支高效的二线治安师。

icy16y.en: ⟦0⟧: Adds an equipment reliability bonus to the division, reducing equipment losses from training and combat. Advised for combat units using expensive equipment (like tanks).
icy16y.zh: ⟦0⟧：为师提供装备可靠性加成，减少训练和战斗中的装备损失。建议配给使用昂贵装备（如坦克）的战斗单位。

sl3tbu.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases Trickleback stat (returns percentage of lost manpower to the pool) and reduces experience loss from taking casualties. Advised for front-line combat divisions.
sl3tbu.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高伤员归队属性（将损失人力的一定比例返还人力池），并减少因伤亡造成的经验损失。建议配给前线战斗师。

3gwspq.en: ⟦0⟧: Reduces the supply usage of the entire division. This is valuable in areas of low supply and for avoiding the need to disperse for supply reasons.
3gwspq.zh: ⟦0⟧：降低整个师的补给消耗。这在补给匮乏的地区很有价值，也能避免因补给原因而被迫分散部署。

1p1vmyr.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the Initiative stat of the division, speeding up planning and increasing the chance of reinforcement in battle from reserves.
1p1vmyr.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高师的主动性属性，加快计划速度，并提高战斗中预备队增援的概率。

fago74.en: † Most (but not all) support companies do not affect a division's speed and do not affect combat width as they are forces that remain behind the fighting front while the "front line" combat battalions engage. Therefore a towed antitank support company does not affect the 12 kph speed of a fast division but adding a towed antitank combat battalion to the regiment lines would slow that same division to the towed anti-tank's base speed of 4 KPH. So support Artillery, Anti-Air or Anti-Tank support units can add valuable capabilities to fast divisions.
fago74.zh: † 大多数（但并非全部）支援连不影响师的速度，也不影响战斗宽度，因为当“前线”战斗营交战时，它们是留在战斗前线后方的部队。因此，牵引式反坦克支援连不会影响一支快速师 12 kph 的速度，但若在团的纵列中加入一个牵引式反坦克战斗营，就会把该师拖慢到牵引式反坦克炮 4 KPH 的基础速度。所以，支援火炮、防空或反坦克支援单位能为快速师提供宝贵的能力。

1hrrem8.en: However, Recon companies do affect the division's speed. Not only do they set the maximum possible speed for the whole division, but (as with line battalions), their speed will be reduced if they are short of essential ⟦0⟧ (infantry and support equipment for Cavalry, those plus motorized for Motorized, armored cars only for Armored Car, and light tanks only for Light Tank). Since Recon companies need only 10 support equipment items or 24 tanks, the absence of a small number of equipment items can have a large affect on the speed of the whole division.
1hrrem8.zh: 不过，侦察连确实会影响师的速度。它们不仅决定整个师的最高可能速度，而且（与一线营一样）如果缺少必需的⟦0⟧，其速度也会下降（骑兵需要步兵装备和支援装备，摩托化侦察需要这些再加上摩托化装备，装甲车侦察只需要装甲车，轻型坦克侦察只需要轻型坦克）。由于侦察连只需要 10 件支援装备或 24 辆坦克，缺少少量装备就可能对整个师的速度造成很大影响。

bzr725.en: An infantry division marching at 4 kph is well-matched by combat battalions marching at 4 kph as well. Additional bonuses and effects of adding a support company to overall division stats can be seen in the tooltip in the division designer. Even though these companies may historically have been much larger than company size, they are referred to as support companies to distinguish them from the battalions in line regiments.
