bzr725.zh: 以 4 kph 行军的步兵师，与同样以 4 kph 行军的战斗营配合得恰到好处。在师编制界面中，添加支援连给师整体属性带来的额外加成与效果可在提示框中查看。尽管这些连在历史上可能远大于连级规模，但为了与一线团中的营区分开，它们仍被称为支援连。

vbg30w.en: Modifying a division template may cost army experience.
vbg30w.zh: 修改师编制可能会花费陆军经验。

1xg2udz.en: Change a template's name or icon
1xg2udz.zh: 更改编制的名称或图标

1u5j0gx.en: Add a combat regiment of an existing type
1u5j0gx.zh: 添加现有类型的战斗团

28fe2e.en: Add a combat regiment of a new type

twtjsk.en: This can remove the last battalion in a regiment, removing the regiment.
twtjsk.zh: 这会移除团中的最后一个营，从而移除该团。

1ypfor.en: Change a combat battalion type to an existing type
1ypfor.zh: 将战斗营改为现有类型

lmj969.en: The existing battalions may be moved between regiments of the same type, or to new regiments, at no additional cost.
lmj969.zh: 现有营可以在同类型的团之间调动，或调入新团，无需额外花费。

1q9t2e9.en: Change a combat regiment type to a new type

619vfj.en: When changing the first (uppermost) battalion in a regiment, you first select the type. If a different type is selected, all of that regiment's battalions are changed to that battalion type.
619vfj.zh: 更改团中第一个（最上方）营时，首先要选择类型。如果选择了不同的类型，该团的所有营都会变为该营类型。

1skn2yl.en: Some countries already have some tank equipment researched in 1936, and these get an armored template at the start of the game. This is usually a historic template that matches the order of battle of one or more of their starting divisions. For example, Italy ("Divisione Celere" template) and the Soviet Union ("Mekhanizirovaniy Korpus" template) are both in this situation. These templates allow you to create new armored divisions with light tanks. If you have any army experience, then you can change the historic template.
1skn2yl.zh: 有些国家在 1936 年就已经研究出一些坦克装备，这些国家在游戏开局时会获得一个装甲编制。这通常是一个与其一个或多个初始师战斗序列相符的历史编制。例如意大利（“Divisione Celere”编制）和苏联（“Mekhanizirovaniy Korpus”编制）都属于这种情况。这些编制让你可以用轻型坦克创建新的装甲师。只要你有陆军经验，就可以修改这个历史编制。

1tmeq4e.en: A few countries have some tank equipment already researched when the game starts, but don't actually start with any historical armoured divisions. For example, Commonwealth countries like Canada who get tank equipment researched in 1936 (shared with them by UK), though they have no armored divisions then. These countries get an armoured template at the start of the game (called "Armored-Division"), so they can create armored divisions later.
1tmeq4e.zh: 少数国家在游戏开始时已经研究出一些坦克装备，但实际上并没有任何历史装甲师。例如加拿大等英联邦国家，它们在 1936 年获得了坦克装备的科研（由英国共享），但当时并没有装甲师。这些国家在游戏开局时会获得一个装甲编制（名为“Armored-Division”），以便日后创建装甲师。

17a5662.en: All other countries get a free template (called "Armored-Division") when they research their first tank equipment.
17a5662.zh: 所有其他国家在研究出第一种坦克装备时，都会免费获得一个编制（名为“Armored-Division”）。

1nev4gx.en: The free "Armored-Division" template, and those templates which some countries start with, are always light tank templates. To modify these, or modify a duplicate, for use with medium or heavy tanks costs some army experience. As soon as you complete the research, the Division Designer will allow you to replace the light tank battalions with medium or heavy. This costs 5 XP for each battalion.
1nev4gx.zh: 免费的“Armored-Division”编制以及某些国家的初始编制始终是轻型坦克编制。要修改这些编制或其副本，以便使用中型或重型坦克，需要花费一些陆军经验。科研一完成，师编制界面就允许你用中型或重型坦克替换轻型坦克营。每个营花费 5 XP。

j7hj6y.en: The Division Designer has a bar just below the stats, which shows the hardness of the divisions created with the template.
j7hj6y.zh: 师编制界面在属性下方有一条横条，显示用该编制创建的师的硬度。

k95l53.en: Hardness represents how much of your division is made up of armored or at least protected vehicles. The free "Armored-Division" template has only 35% hardness, even though it has two light tank and two cavalry battalions. You can increase the hardness by adding more tank battalions, or replacing light with medium, or medium with heavy, or by replacing "soft" battalions (infantry or cavalry) with motorized or mechanized battalions.
k95l53.zh: 硬度表示你的师中有多大比例由装甲车辆或至少具备防护的车辆组成。免费的“Armored-Division”编制尽管有两个轻型坦克营和两个骑兵营，硬度却只有 35%。你可以通过添加更多坦克营，用中型替换轻型、用重型替换中型，或用摩托化或机械化营替换“软”营（步兵或骑兵）来提高硬度。

bam1ek.en: For example, replacing the two light tank battalions in the default "Armored-Division" template with medium tanks, and the two cavalry with mechanized, changes the hardness from 35% to 70%. Divisions with high hardness will suffer few hits in combat from divisions with low hard attack values – such as infantry with 1936 equipment and no anti-tank equipment.
bam1ek.zh: 例如，把默认“Armored-Division”编制中的两个轻型坦克营换成中型坦克、把两个骑兵营换成机械化营，硬度就会从 35% 变为 70%。高硬度的师在战斗中很少被硬攻值低的师命中——例如使用 1936 年装备且没有反坦克装备的步兵。

tdv99c.en: The ⟦0⟧ combine in different ways in divisions, and these values have special implications for deciding whether one should "scale up" a division template, e.g. doubling up the battlions to go from a 20 ⟦1⟧ to a whopping 40. Any modifications must be view in the context of the current ⟦2⟧.
tdv99c.zh: ⟦0⟧在师中以不同方式组合，这些数值对于判断是否应当“扩大”师编制有着特殊意义，例如把营数翻倍，从 20 ⟦1⟧ 增加到惊人的 40。任何修改都必须结合当前的⟦2⟧来看待。

1ymepcm.en: As mentioned previously, soft/hard attack and defense/breakthrough are additive; doubling the width of the template doubles these values. In the current system, only 10% of the attacks are considered for damage if they are covered by the other unit's defense, but 40% is considered when the attack points have exhausted the defense points. In other words, an attack point not held back by the enemy's defense is four times as good as an attack point that is held back. Although units do drain the enemy units' defense together, having a larger division in this case still allows you to more effectively drain the enemy units' defense, compared to having two smaller divisions of the same smaller size, by removing a random element and allowing the draining to be concentrated.
1ymepcm.zh: 如前所述，软/硬攻与防御/突破是累加计算的；编制宽度翻倍，这些数值也随之翻倍。在当前系统中，如果攻击被敌方单位的防御挡下，只有 10% 的攻击会被计入伤害；而当攻击点数耗尽防御点数时，则有 40% 计入。换言之，未被敌方防御挡下的攻击点，其效果是被挡下的攻击点的四倍。尽管各单位会共同消耗敌方单位的防御，但在此情况下，与拥有两个同等较小规模的师相比，拥有一个更大的师仍能更有效地消耗敌方单位的防御，因为它消除了随机因素，并使消耗更为集中。

1sutcrs.en: On the other hand, doubling the division size does not make the divisions two times more resistant to actual damage, since the organization does not scale up. Damage is two times more frequently dealt to organization instead of HP (which is additive), and defense is often easy to stack up for land units anyways. Having small divisions is additionally more versatile due to the sheer number of divisions, allowing one to run encirclements and cover up extending lines when needed; however this also takes up commanding official capabilities. Small divisions also allow more support weaponry companies to be used, many of which are more economical in their stats contribution per equipment than line companies; on the other hand, they increase the cost of non-weapon support companies, since more of them are needed to achieve the same percentage bonus.
1sutcrs.zh: 另一方面，把师规模翻倍并不会让师对实际伤害的抵抗力翻倍，因为组织度并不会随之增加。伤害命中组织度的频率是命中 HP 的两倍（HP 是累加的），而且对陆军单位来说，防御通常很容易堆叠。此外，小规模师由于数量众多而更加灵活，可以在需要时实施包围并填补不断延长的战线；不过这也会占用指挥能力。小规模师还能使用更多支援武器连，其中许多连在每点装备带来的属性贡献上比一线连更划算；但另一方面，它们会增加非武器支援连的花费，因为要达到相同的百分比加成，需要更多的这类连。

s7m6vv.en: Thus, as a general rule, 20-width divisions are better at defense, and 40-width are better at attack. Composition will make or break this, of course, but having a breakthrough army of large divisions and several of standard-size for holding the actual line is a solid general rule.
s7m6vv.zh: 因此，一般而言，20 宽度的师更擅长防御，40 宽度的师更擅长进攻。当然，编成决定成败，但用大规模师组成突破集团军、再用若干标准规模的师守住实际战线，是一条可靠的通则。

102bdse.en: The overall division unit type is indicated by its default division icon. Battalions all have one or more tags that indicate their type. The division type is determined by multiplying an internal "priority" weight by the number of battalions of each type, and taking the type with the highest score as the exemplar unit that defines the division type. If there are multiple unit types with the same weighted priority, the first (top, left) unit in the template is used to determine the exemplar type.
102bdse.zh: 师的总体单位类型由其默认师图标表示。所有营都有一个或多个标明其类型的标签。师类型通过将内部“优先级”权重乘以各类型营的数量来确定，得分最高的类型即作为定义师类型的样本单位。如果有多个单位类型的加权优先级相同，则以编制中第一个（最上方、最左侧）单位确定样本类型。

7eqpl4.en: In the game files, unit type priority weights are found in the unit definition files in the ...\common\units\ directory. Those values are reproduced here for reference.
7eqpl4.zh: 在游戏文件中，单位类型优先级权重位于 ...\common\units\ 目录下的单位定义文件中。这些数值在此列出以供参考。

thmlaf.en: Often it is necessary to optimize a Division for a certain, likely battlefield or role. Doing so requires the mixing of the right Battalions and Companies.
thmlaf.zh: 通常有必要针对特定且可能出现的战场或角色来优化师。这需要搭配正确的营和连。

agwa4e.en: When a division is understrength its stats are reduced in the principle of how many troops are present to operate how much available equipment. When out of combat the overall "Current Fighting Strength" ratio is determined by taking the minimum of the manpower ratio and the cost-weighted equipment ratio. The stats of the division are the stats of all its battalions and companies combined in ways described above, which are calculated differently from the overall strength ratio. For each battalion (company) the equipment stats are scaled by the lower one of the manpower ratio and the unweighted equipment ratio for each type of equipment the battalion uses, and the subunit stats (including terrain modifiers but excluding organization, recovery rate, and combat width) are scaled by the manpower ratio only, unless the battalion (company) uses "essential" equipment, in which case all the stats are further scaled by the cost-weighted ratio of the respective essential equipment. All the equipment of all support companies and the mechanized battalion is essential, except that infantry equipment is not essential to the engineers company.
agwa4e.zh: 当师不满编时，其属性会按照现有兵力能操作多少可用装备的原则而降低。在非战斗状态下，总体的“当前战斗力”比率取人力比率与按花费加权的装备比率中的较低者。师的属性是其所有营与连按上述方式组合后的属性，其计算方式与总体兵力比率不同。对每个营（连）而言，装备属性按该营使用的每种装备的人力比率与未加权装备比率中较低者进行折算，而子单位属性（包括地形修正，但不包括组织度、恢复速度和战斗宽度）只按人力比率折算；除非该营（连）使用“必需”装备，此时所有属性还要再按相应必需装备的按花费加权比率折算。所有支援连以及机械化营的装备都是必需的，但步兵装备对工兵连而言不是必需的。

12aiuav.en: This is perhaps the single most important stat. And there are two groups of battalions that are good at it: foot infantry and all mobile infantry.
12aiuav.zh: 这也许是最重要的单项属性。有两类营擅长此项：徒步步兵和所有机动步兵。

wys9wf.en: Tanks, artillery and support companies are the parts that are lacking, sometimes severely so. So you need to bring just enough manpower into the mix, to have an effective fighting force. However, note that a lot of doctrines actually offset those penalties for some specific elements, allowing you to use them much more freely.
wys9wf.zh: 坦克、火炮和支援连在这方面较为欠缺，有时甚至严重不足。因此你需要加入恰到好处的人力，才能组成有效的战斗力量。不过要注意，许多学说实际上会为某些特定单位抵消这些惩罚，让你能更自由地使用它们。

j745q7.en: If you want anything more than the 4 km/h of an Infantry Batallion, you have to limit yourself to a combination of Tank and Mobile Battalions that suits your needs. Even just a pure mobile infantry. Artillery has to be limited to support companies, and/or provided by motorized/tank variants.
j745q7.zh: 如果你想要超过步兵营 4 km/h 的速度，就必须把选择限制在符合需求的坦克营与机动营组合上，哪怕只是纯粹的摩托化步兵。火炮则必须限制在支援连中，和/或由摩托化/坦克变体提供。

vw4ej2.en: Most infantry provides 1 to 1.5, while tanks provide 2.5 and artillery/Anti-Tanks provide 0.
vw4ej2.zh: 大多数步兵提供 1 到 1.5，坦克提供 2.5，而火炮/反坦克提供 0。

1he012y.en: However, the cavalry and bicycle infantry provides 2 which can be buffed further with a Military Police Support Company. Yes, there is actually something Cavalry is good at - playing police! Do mind that they cost more supply and equipment, however. Considering that losses due to resistance are calculated by manpower factored vs (1-hardness), soft units like infantry and cavalry employed see a nation suffer higher casualties compared to light tanks or armoured cars.
1he012y.zh: 不过，骑兵和自行车步兵提供 2，还可以用军事警察支援连进一步提高。没错，骑兵确实有擅长的事——当警察！但要注意，它们会消耗更多补给和装备。考虑到抵抗度造成的损失是按人力与（1-硬度）的乘积计算的，使用步兵和骑兵这类软单位时，国家遭受的伤亡会比使用轻型坦克或装甲车时更高。

17nbx01.en: This is the average of all equipment. For a lot of cheap equipment (Infantry Gear, Support Gear, Motorized) the 80% default is enough. However mechanized and tank divisions can benefit a lot from it, as they have the most expensive equipment.
17nbx01.zh: 这是所有装备的平均值。对于许多廉价装备（步兵装备、支援装备、摩托化装备）来说，80% 的默认值已经足够。不过机械化师和坦克师能从中获益良多，因为它们拥有最昂贵的装备。

107udzk.en: Aside from investing XP into the reliability, the Maintenance company helps.
107udzk.zh: 除了把 XP 投入到可靠性上，维修连也有帮助。

yd6raw.en: Infantry already provides plenty of soft attack/width. 1 Artillery easily provides 3 Infantry Battalions worth of Soft attack for half their width. Even light tanks and Mechanized lean more towards the Hard Attack side.
yd6raw.zh: 步兵本身就能提供充足的软攻/宽度。1 个火炮营就能以一半的宽度提供相当于 3 个步兵营的软攻。即便是轻型坦克和机械化部队也更偏向硬攻。

1cuhzu0.en: While everything - even the Infantry equipment - has some Hard attack, usually the soft/hard ratio is in favor of killing infantry.
1cuhzu0.zh: 虽然所有东西——甚至步兵装备——都有一定的硬攻，但通常软/硬攻的比例更有利于杀伤步兵。

5rg8sj.en: Tanks shift the balance more onto the side of hard, the heavier the better. Anything with Piercing will also do good Hard Attack. AA can also be somewhat effective at dealing hard attack, being half the damage of a AT Gun.
5rg8sj.zh: 坦克会把天平更多地推向硬攻一侧，越重越好。任何具备穿甲的装备也能提供不错的硬攻。防空炮在造成硬攻方面也还算有效，其伤害是反坦克炮的一半。

sdjise.en: Air might also be an option.
sdjise.zh: 空中力量也可能是一个选择。

1yc80mu.en: Obviously AA is good at this. It seems unlikely that Armor, Hardness, Defense or Breakthrough has any effect.
1yc80mu.zh: 显然防空炮擅长此项。装甲、硬度、防御或突破似乎都不大可能对此有影响。

179mq78.en: Simply put, tanks are the best at this stat. Heavier is generally better, but the Modern beats the superheavy. Artillery also provides a decent bit, but of course mechanized Infantry the most aside from tanks.
179mq78.zh: 简单来说，坦克在这项属性上最强。通常越重越好，但现代坦克胜过超重型坦克。火炮也能提供相当一部分，不过除坦克之外，自然是机械化步兵提供得最多。

1oauwoh.en: Infantry is the top thing here. The need for mobility limits the buffs from support weapons passive research. Mechanized Infantry actually adds its defense to the equipment derived one, easily beating 80 per Battalion.
1oauwoh.zh: 步兵在这方面是最强的。对机动性的需求限制了支援武器被动科研带来的加成。机械化步兵实际上会将其自身防御加到由装备派生的防御上，每个营轻松超过 80。

z5tiyg.en: As history has shown, tanks are not good defensive battalions (unless you can get an armor advantage).
z5tiyg.zh: 正如历史所证明的，坦克并不是好的防御营（除非你能取得装甲优势）。

yi3mov.en: Incorrect. For example one armor battalion with an armor of 70 and one Infantry with an armor of 0 will give you an armor of 49 for the whole division and with 2 infantry battalions you will get 41.9.
yi3mov.zh: 不对。例如，一个装甲值为 70 的装甲营加上一个装甲值为 0 的步兵营，整个师的装甲值为 49；若有 2 个步兵营，则得到 41.9。

85xl2t.en: If your armor can exceed the enemy's piercing, then relevant combat bonuses await. 40% of the armor value is determined by the single highest armor battalion, so throw in a single very high armor battalion for that. The rest depends on the average values; try going for high-level mechanized Infantry to provide a high "baseline".
85xl2t.zh: 如果你的装甲能超过敌方的穿甲，就能获得相应的战斗加成。装甲值的 40% 由单个装甲最高的营决定，因此为此加入一个装甲极高的营。其余部分取决于平均值；尽量使用高级机械化步兵来提供较高的“基准值”。

17kcix0.en: If the enemy fields heavy armor, then you need heavy piercing. Piercing works like Armor in that the highest value matters (40%), so always try to throw in one battalion of something powerful.
17kcix0.zh: 如果敌方投入重型装甲，你就需要高穿甲。穿甲与装甲的机制类似，最高值起作用（40%），所以总要尽量加入一个强力的营。

6prenm.en: AT guns provide the best piercing, up until the T2 Heavy Tank becomes available (1941). The T2 heavy tank actually has better AP than contemporary AT guns, especially on the Tank Destroyer (tank hunter) variant. Still, as you can field 2 AT guns per 2 width, that might still be enough to increase the average to what you need.
6prenm.zh: 在 T2 重型坦克（1941 年）可用之前，反坦克炮提供的穿甲最高。T2 重型坦克的实际穿甲其实比同时代的反坦克炮更好，尤其是在坦克歼击车（坦克猎手）变体上。不过，由于每 2 宽度就可以放 2 门反坦克炮，这也许仍足以把平均值提高到你需要的水准。

1ngryt2.en: The other 60% is provided by the weighted average of all battalions, and will mostly come from Infantry equipment (either Infantry gear or Mechanized). Do get the passive "Infantry Anti-Tank" upgrades, as they apply to both and can double the piercing values.
1ngryt2.zh: 另外 60% 由所有营的加权平均提供，主要来自步兵装备（步兵装备或机械化装备）。务必研究被动的“步兵反坦克”升级，因为它们对两者都生效，并能将穿甲值翻倍。

g7haak.en: Do be careful of mixing any AT gun companies with line battalions of either AT guns or tanks. This is because AT companies have lower piercing which will lower the overall average division piercing and Organization.
g7haak.zh: 要小心不要把反坦克炮连与反坦克炮或坦克的一线营混编。这是因为反坦克连的穿甲较低，会拉低师的整体平均穿甲和组织度。

10es9r6.en: This is entirely based on how mechanized the army is. If you want a high value, then mix heavy tanks with higher mechanized infantry.
10es9r6.zh: 这完全取决于军队的机械化程度。如果你想要高数值，就把重型坦克与更高级的机械化步兵混编。

yzjy78.en: The Heavy Tank, Engineer Company and all Artillery except AA provides some bonuses. Super heavy tanks and to a lesser extent super heavy tank destroyers have by far the highest bonus. However, this uniquely has no penalties (as those are already rolled into the fortification mechanic itself).
yzjy78.zh: 重型坦克、工兵连以及除防空外的所有火炮都能提供一些加成。超重型坦克的加成远高于其他，超重型坦克歼击车次之。不过，这一项特殊之处在于没有惩罚（因为惩罚已经并入要塞机制本身）。

11d73ps.zh: 或者说是“如何打赢 D-Day”。

1c33mpd.en: As their name implies, amphibious tanks and Marines are best for the job,with the amphibious tanks being better, followed by baseline infantry. All artillery Battalions suffer penalties as do Tanks based on heaviness. The engineer Company provides a huge bonus.
1c33mpd.zh: 顾名思义，两栖坦克和海军陆战队最适合这项任务，其中两栖坦克更好，其次是普通步兵。所有火炮营都会受到惩罚，坦克也会根据重量受到惩罚。工兵连提供巨大加成。

gj04q.en: You will be dependent on Support companies for many strategic needs.
gj04q.zh: 在许多战略需求上，你都要依赖支援连。

1qlmn93.en: Every River is a little Amphibious assault. Units suffer half the penalty of Amphibious Assaults, but it is applied to movement as well. The only additional exception here is the Cavalry which actually performs worse than baseline infantry. Still, if an overrun is wanted, then it might be worth it.
1qlmn93.zh: 每条河流都是一次小型两栖登陆。单位承受的惩罚是两栖登陆的一半，但也会作用于移动。这里唯一的额外例外是骑兵，其表现实际上比普通步兵还差。不过，如果想要实现快速击溃，也许还是值得的。

1omelfg.en: The first choice of course are Mountaineers. Of the tanks, the lighter ones have a lower penalty. Mobile Battalions of all kinds also perform with lower penalties. All Infantry battalions only suffer movement penalties at worst.
1omelfg.zh: 首选当然是山地兵。在坦克中，越轻的惩罚越低。各类机动营的惩罚也较低。所有步兵营最坏也只是承受移动惩罚。

k8xw4g.en: Beginner's Guide to Unit Types & Division Design
k8xw4g.zh: 单位类型与师编制新手指南

46x2ht.en: "Why 40 Width Divisions Are Better Than 20 Width" - A discussion on sizing.
46x2ht.zh: “为什么 40 宽度的师比 20 宽度更好”——关于规模的讨论。

13r9wf2.en: A theater is a player-defined high-level group of ⟦0⟧. Alerts such as being in low supply, and a summary of combat progress, are provided for an entire theater, and reinforcement priority can be set for an entire theater.
13r9wf2.zh: 战区是玩家自行定义的⟦0⟧高级编组。补给不足等警报以及战斗进展摘要都以整个战区为单位提供，也可以为整个战区设置增援优先度。

53n3k6.en: Air and sea region names will also appear below the command theaters to provide alerts such as impending invasions, ongoing sea battles, and enemy air superiority.
53n3k6.zh: 空中和海上区域名称也会显示在各战区下方，用于提供即将发生的登陆、正在进行的海战以及敌方掌握制空权等警报。

jjxcbn.en: For example, as Germany, assigning units to Eastern and Western theaters will enable easy evaluation of armies on both fronts. Some players may also wish to use a training theater to exercise Trained units after deployment until they reach the maximum training level with Regular experience and are ready to be reassigned to a combat theater, or a garrison theater for defense of ports and victory points.
jjxcbn.zh: 例如，扮演德国时把部队分配到东部战区和西部战区，就能轻松评估两条战线上的军队。有些玩家可能还想设立训练战区，让部署后的受训部队继续操练，直到以「正规军」经验达到最高训练等级、可以重新分配到作战战区；也可以设立驻防战区，用于防守港口和胜利点。

9dhm9x.en: To create a new theater, if none exist, simply create a new command group (see below). Otherwise, first select a command group. A "New Theater" button will appear. Clicking this creates a new theater and moves the selected group to it. A selected group can be moved to a different theater by right-clicking on the theater.
9dhm9x.zh: 要新建战区：如果当前没有任何战区，只需新建一个集团军（见下文）。否则先选中一个集团军，此时会出现「新建战区」按钮。点击该按钮会创建新战区，并把选中的集团军移入其中。选中的集团军还可以通过右键点击战区，移动到其他战区。

1gukh99.en: Theaters may be named as desired by clicking on the gear icon to the left of the name (clicking on the existing name is not sufficient). Players may add as many theaters as they like.
1gukh99.zh: 点击名称左侧的齿轮图标即可为战区任意命名（只点击现有名称是不够的）。玩家可以按需添加任意数量的战区。

p8bidz.en: You can analyze the performance of each theater through the Combat Log, which is opened by clicking on the document icon to the right of the theater name. This displays the results of recent battles. You can filter the data by time (using the slider on the top left) or command group (by toggling the icons with haloes on the top right). The Combat Log also displays equipment losses and analyses performance by template.
p8bidz.zh: 你可以通过「战斗日志」分析各战区的表现，点击战区名称右侧的文件图标即可打开。它会显示近期战斗的结果。你可以按时间（使用左上角的滑块）或按集团军（切换右上角带光晕的图标）筛选数据。战斗日志还会显示装备损失，并按师编制分析表现。

zk7yuv.en: ⟦0⟧ The theater interface shows only divisions that are assigned to a command group. Unassigned divisions are shown in the armies list.
zk7yuv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 战区界面只显示已分配到集团军的师。未分配的师会显示在军队列表中。

1ipxp6e.en: A command group is a collection of divisions that can be led by a single commander. Each command group is part of a theater and can be moved to a different theater at will.
1ipxp6e.zh: 集团军是由一名指挥官统率的师的集合。每个集团军都属于某个战区，可以随意移动到其他战区。

10g4xly.en: Command groups allow divisions to be given orders through the battle plans interface, such as assigning to a front and giving a plan of attack, specifying an area to garrison, or giving a fallback line. The commander of each group in the currently selected theater (or a vague silhouette if it has no commander) appears at the bottom of the screen. If it has one or more attack plans assigned, this portrait will have a button to activate the plans, a button to halt the execution of the plan, and a bar below it showing the AI's assessment of relative strength.
10g4xly.zh: 集团军可以通过作战计划界面给师下达命令，例如分配到前线并制定进攻计划、指定驻防区域，或划定撤退线。当前选中战区内每个集团军的指挥官都会显示在屏幕底部（若没有指挥官则显示模糊的人影）。如果该集团军已分配一个或多个进攻计划，该头像上会出现用于激活计划的按钮和用于停止执行计划的按钮，头像下方还有一条显示 AI 对双方相对实力评估的进度条。

7giiy7.en: This is enabled by certain events or decisions. In areas where borders are disputed by neighboring rivals, a decision may become available (Requires Waking the Tiger), or an event may fire triggering a border conflict.
7giiy7.zh: 该机制由特定事件或决议启用。在邻国之间存在边界争议的地区，可能会出现相应决议（需要《唤醒猛虎》），也可能触发事件引发边境冲突。

mi5wwa.en: A victorious invader gains the disputed state and some PP (e.g., +100 PP in China). In a stalemate, the border remains unchanged, both sides get some Army Experience, and the defender is rewarded with substantial PP for holding on. A defender that defeats the invader gains additional PP, Army Experience, and Land Doctrine research bonus as a reward. A failed invader must wait for a time before trying again. This version of the conflict is used by warlords in the Waking the Tiger DLC.
mi5wwa.zh: 获胜的入侵方将获得争议州以及一定量的政治点数（例如在中国为 +100 PP）。若陷入僵局，边界维持不变，双方都获得一些陆军经验，防守方则因守住阵地而获得大量政治点数作为奖励。击败入侵方的防守方还能额外获得政治点数、陆军经验和陆军学说科研加成。入侵失败的一方必须等待一段时间才能再次尝试。《唤醒猛虎》DLC 中的军阀使用的正是这种冲突形式。

1uk86yb.en: There are Decisions for the attacker and defender to choose to escalate the scope of fighting one step further to allow adding troops and taking things a step closer to full war. Lend-lease is only available for countries in full war, so is not available based on just a border war. The vanilla game is configured to limit opposing countries to one border conflict at a time between them.
1uk86yb.zh: 攻守双方都有决议可以选择把冲突规模再升级一步，从而允许投入更多部队，使局势更接近全面战争。租借只对处于全面战争状态的国家可用，因此仅凭边境战争无法使用。原版游戏设定为：两个敌对国之间同时只能有一场边境冲突。

1bkus3c.en: Divisions can be moved by Strategic Redeployment . The divisions on strategic redeployment will automatically make use of roads/bridges (infrastructure) and railroads to increase their movement speed at a cost to organization. The divisions will move at a base infrastructure speed of 5 km/h⟦0⟧ with a potential bonus up to ⟦1⟧ km/h⟦2⟧ depending on the state's infrastructure and will travel at a base railroad speed of 15 km/h⟦3⟧ with a potential bonus up to ⟦4⟧ km/h⟦5⟧ depending on the railroad level. Division organization will drop 90%⟦6⟧ while using strategic redeployment. Divisions using strategic redeployment suffer no attrition, use zero fuel, and are not subject to terrain/weather movement penalties.
1bkus3c.zh: 师可以通过战略再部署移动。处于战略再部署状态的师会自动利用公路/桥梁（基础设施）和铁路来提高移动速度，但会损失组织度。师在基础设施上的基础速度为 5 km/h⟦0⟧，根据州的基础设施情况最高可加成至 ⟦1⟧ km/h⟦2⟧；铁路基础速度为 15 km/h⟦3⟧，根据铁路等级最高可加成至 ⟦4⟧ km/h⟦5⟧。使用战略再部署时，师的组织度会下降 90%⟦6⟧。使用战略再部署的师不受损耗，不消耗燃料，也不受地形/天气移动惩罚。

1vnqnlm.en: Troops can be transported across the water and between two friendly ports. When a division is standing at a port, simply right-click another port to have them attempt to transport themselves there. Transporting troops requires ⟦0⟧ equal to the division's weight rounded up, and if the country or its allies do not have naval supremacy over the sea region, they may be intercepted resulting in casualties. If a division is not standing in a port, right-clicking on the port province, then shift-clicking on the destination port symbol will allow it to be transported in a single order.
1vnqnlm.zh: 部队可以跨越水域、在两个友方港口之间运输。当某个师驻扎在港口时，只需右键点击另一个港口，它就会尝试自行运输过去。运输部队所需的⟦0⟧数量等于该师重量向上取整的值；如果该国或其盟友没有该海域的制海权，运输船队可能遭到拦截并造成伤亡。如果师不在港口中，先右键点击港口省份，再按住 Shift 点击目的地港口图标，即可用一条命令将其运输过去。

xv7dps.en: Alternatively, a battle planner command (frontline, fallback line, naval invasion or garrison) will automatically move a unit across an ocean tile if there is no accessible land path to the target and enough convoys are available to transport the unit.
xv7dps.zh: 或者，如果目标没有可通行的陆路，且有足够的运输船队可用于运输该部队，作战计划器命令（前线、撤退线、海军登陆或驻军）会自动让部队跨越海洋格子移动。

lhopkf.en: Naval invasions are launched via the ⟦0⟧ order in the battle planner.
lhopkf.zh: 海军登陆通过作战计划器中的⟦0⟧命令发起。

wuah65.en: There is a limit to the number of divisions that a single country may assign to naval invasions at one time. With the basic Transport Ship technology, only 10 divisions can plan an invasion at once; with ⟦0⟧ this increases to 50. Multiple invasion plans can be set up from a single command group; each plan must start from a friendly port and the total number of divisions must not exceed the level of transport technology.
wuah65.zh: 单个国家同时可以投入到海军登陆中的师数量有上限。使用基础运输船科技时，一次只能有 10 个师制定登陆计划；拥有⟦0⟧后上限提升到 50。同一个集团军可以制定多个登陆计划；每个计划都必须从友方港口出发，且师的总数不能超过运输科技提供的上限。

1vijdky.en: An army can also move into friendly territory using an invasion, but it is more efficient to simply use port-to-port movement as described above.
1vijdky.zh: 部队也可以用登陆的方式进入友方领土，但直接使用上文所述的港口到港口运输更为高效。

si5nub.en: For land unit base stats reference ⟦0⟧.
si5nub.zh: 陆军单位的基础属性参见⟦0⟧。

phg7yo.en: For land unit combat stats reference ⟦0⟧.
phg7yo.zh: 陆军单位的战斗属性参见⟦0⟧。

wic6my.en: When divisions of opposing countries meet, a battle takes place.
wic6my.zh: 当敌对国家的师相遇时，就会爆发战斗。

r221z8.en: ⟦0⟧ is conducted by ships which operate in the world's interconnected seas and oceans. Naval power is key to protection of convoy traffic, or disruption of enemy convoys. Control of the sea can facilitate ⟦1⟧, or prevent the enemy from performing an invasion of their own. Ships can influence land combat by performing shore bombardment, or block straits to impair enemy movement.
r221z8.zh: ⟦0⟧由在世界上相互连通的海域与大洋中活动的舰船实施。海军力量是保护己方运输船队、或破坏敌方运输船队的关键。掌握制海权可以便利⟦1⟧，也能阻止敌人实施自己的登陆。舰船可以通过对岸炮击影响陆战，或封锁海峡以妨碍敌军移动。

10x2hxm.en: As naval warfare is a complex topic, it is divided among multiple articles. This page serves as a hub, providing a list of the articles which are relevant to naval warfare.
10x2hxm.zh: 海战是一个复杂的主题，因此分散在多篇文章中介绍。本页面充当枢纽，列出与海战相关的文章。

c6iw7q.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a country's collective naval force. It is divided among task forces, fleets and theaters.
c6iw7q.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个国家全部海上力量的总和，其下分为特遣舰队、舰队和战区。

1yp3rfs.en: Naval warfare is primarily conducted through ⟦0⟧, which may be assigned to task forces.
1yp3rfs.zh: 海战主要通过⟦0⟧进行，这些任务可以分配给特遣舰队。

1bjm63a.en: When two opposing navies meet, a ⟦0⟧ unfolds.
1bjm63a.zh: 当两支敌对海军相遇时，⟦0⟧便会展开。

ch1cpw.en: Main articles: Naval technology, Naval support technology
ch1cpw.zh: 主条目：海军科技、海军支援科技

siclw3.en: Advances in ⟦0⟧ can unlock more capable ship designs, or improve the performance of existing ships.
siclw3.zh: ⟦0⟧的进步可以解锁性能更强的舰船设计，或提升现有舰船的性能。

3p8g0j.en: ⟦0⟧ provide bonuses for specific forms of naval warfare.
3p8g0j.zh: ⟦0⟧为特定形式的海战提供加成。

nzfkly.en: This section provides naval warfare strategies. These are not limited to instructions; the ⟦0⟧ behind each strategy is also given, with links to articles in which the relevant mechanics are explained.
nzfkly.zh: 本节提供海战策略。这些内容并不局限于操作步骤；每条策略背后的⟦0⟧也会一并给出，并附上解释相关机制的条目链接。

10921o.en: Mines have ⟦0⟧, and the AI pays little attention to mines. They will only perform minimal minesweeping efforts at most, regardless of how many mines there are. It is thereby possible to gain a strong naval advantage over the AI through extensive mining. The resulting ⟦1⟧ can be useful for facilitating naval invasions, as well.
10921o.zh: 水雷拥有⟦0⟧，而 AI 很少关注水雷。无论水雷数量有多少，AI 至多只会进行最低限度的扫雷。因此，通过大规模布雷可以在对 AI 的海战中取得巨大优势。由此获得的⟦1⟧也有助于实施海军登陆。

1ud5pjb.en: Due to their stealth and low cost, ⟦0⟧ are well suited for minelaying. When equipped with minelaying tubes and given an ⟦1⟧ of 'Never engage', they can perform minelaying missions with near impunity. They remain vulnerable to naval bombers and may take some losses this way, but in practice the AI does not perform enough bombing of minelaying submarines to pose a problem for the player.
1ud5pjb.zh: 凭借隐蔽性和低廉的成本，⟦0⟧非常适合布雷。当装备布雷管并将⟦1⟧设为「绝不交战」时，它们几乎可以毫无顾忌地执行布雷任务。它们仍然容易遭到海军轰炸机的攻击，并可能因此受到一些损失，但实际上 AI 对布雷潜艇的轰炸力度不足以对玩家构成问题。

4yde1o.en: Some countries start the game with primitive submarines based upon the 'Early Submarine Hull'. Refitting these submarines as minelayers can be a good way to put them to use, as their low combat performance will not affect their ability to lay mines.
4yde1o.zh: 一些国家在开局时拥有基于「早期潜艇船体」的原始潜艇。把这些潜艇改装为布雷潜艇是让它们发挥作用的好办法，因为它们糟糕的战斗性能不会影响布雷能力。

11hgbts.en: Due to their relatively high fuel requirements, it is generally reasonable to assign ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧ missions so that they are only called to action when required.
11hgbts.zh: 由于燃料需求相对较高，通常适合把⟦0⟧分配给⟦1⟧任务，这样它们只在需要时才会出动。

1jiwpe0.en: To ensure that the capital ships are protected from torpedoes, it is prudent to have sufficient ⟦0⟧ in the strike force to achieve full ⟦1⟧. While a minimum of three screen ships per capital ship are required for 100% efficiency, it can be beneficial to have even more screen ships than this, to ensure that screening efficiency remains high even if positioning is poor or a few screen ships are destroyed in battle.
1jiwpe0.zh: 为确保主力舰免遭鱼雷攻击，明智的做法是在打击舰队中配备足够的⟦0⟧，以达到满值⟦1⟧。虽然每艘主力舰至少需要三艘护卫舰才能达到 100% 效率，但配备更多护卫舰也有好处：即使站位不佳或战斗中损失了几艘护卫舰，屏护效率仍能保持较高水平。

18oba5p.en: It may be advantageous to have more than one strike force per fleet, as this will enable more than one enemy force to be intercepted by strike forces simultaneously.
18oba5p.zh: 一个舰队拥有多个打击舰队可能更有利，因为这样可以让打击舰队同时拦截多支敌方部队。

ux141u.en: When deciding upon the composition of ⟦0⟧ task forces, it may be helpful to consider the following points:
ux141u.zh: 在决定执行⟦0⟧的特遣舰队编成时，可以考虑以下几点：

1nbpayk.en: The AI uses the 'engage at medium risk' engagement rule for all of its ⟦0⟧ task forces. Submarines with this engagement rule will tend to flee from a group of defending destroyers when the battle starts, regardless of how strong or weak the destroyers are.
1nbpayk.zh: AI 为其所有执行⟦0⟧的特遣舰队使用「中等风险交战」交战规则。使用该交战规则的潜艇在战斗开始时往往会躲避前来防守的驱逐舰编队，无论这些驱逐舰是强是弱。

2znddp.en: To minimise convoy losses, it is important for a fleet performing convoy escort to achieve 100% ⟦0⟧. Escort efficiency is a function of ⟦1⟧ of ships rather than quality; the weakest possible destroyer will contribute exactly as much escort efficiency as a battleship would.
2znddp.zh: 为把运输船队损失降到最低，执行运输船队护航的舰队必须达到 100% 的⟦0⟧。护航效率取决于舰船的⟦1⟧而非质量；最弱的驱逐舰与战列舰提供的护航效率完全相同。

50s69t.en: High ⟦0⟧ is helpful for protecting convoys from torpedoes during battle. As with escort efficiency, screening efficiency is a function of ⟦1⟧ of ships rather than quality.
50s69t.zh: 较高的⟦0⟧有助于在战斗中保护运输船队免遭鱼雷攻击。与护航效率一样，屏护效率取决于舰船的⟦1⟧而非质量。

uqyxn9.en: It is difficult for the ⟦0⟧ side to detect submarines during a naval battle, even when the defending ships are equipped with sonar.
uqyxn9.zh: 在海战中，⟦0⟧很难发现潜艇，即使其舰船装备了声呐。

6hzwye.en: Depth charges are ineffective against undetected submarines.
6hzwye.zh: 深水炸弹对未被发现的潜艇无效。

seo9l2.en: Given the above points, it is viable to use extremely cheap destroyers (⟦0⟧) for convoy escort duty. Such destroyers lack sonar and depth charge equipment and are thereby not particularly well suited for anti-submarine warfare, but convoy raiding submarines will flee from them regardless. Such destroyers can be economically produced in high numbers, providing high escort efficiency and screening efficiency to minimize the damage done to convoys.
seo9l2.zh: 综合以上几点，使用极其廉价的驱逐舰（⟦0⟧）执行运输船队护航是可行的。这类驱逐舰没有声呐和深水炸弹装备，因此不太适合反潜作战，但破交潜艇无论如何都会躲避它们。这类驱逐舰可以低成本大量生产，提供高护航效率和高屏护效率，把运输船队所受的损失降到最低。

2yfsh5.en: early hull, level 1 battery, level 1 engine; the weakest destroyer that may be designed
2yfsh5.zh: 早期船体、1 级主炮、1 级引擎；可设计的最弱驱逐舰

ispucl.en: Under this scheme, the destruction of enemy submarines would be left to patrol and/or strike forces configured for anti-submarine warfare. Such forces could be deployed to regions in which convoys had recently been attacked by submarines. The attacking side is at a significant advantage when attacking submarines, as all defending submarines will be revealed for a period of time from the start of the battle (see the ⟦0⟧ article for further details).
ispucl.zh: 在这种方案下，消灭敌方潜艇的任务会交给配置为反潜的巡逻舰队和/或打击舰队。这类部队可以部署到运输船队近期遭到潜艇攻击的海域。进攻方在攻击潜艇时拥有明显优势，因为所有防守方潜艇都会在战斗开始后的一段时间内暴露（详见⟦0⟧条目）。

3och1g.en: If more expensive destroyers with sonar and/or depth charges were used for convoy escort, such destroyers would inflict slightly greater losses upon attacking submarines on average than the cheap convoy escort destroyers described earlier. However, due to their higher cost, it would be more difficult to amass such destroyers in the numbers required to achieve high escort efficiency and (in particular) high screening efficiency for each battle, which could lead to greater convoy losses. The value of expensive sonar and depth charge equipment would also be reduced in this situation, due to the difficulty of detecting submarines while on the defending side of a battle.
3och1g.zh: 如果使用装备声呐和/或深水炸弹的较昂贵驱逐舰执行运输船队护航，这类驱逐舰平均而言对来袭潜艇造成的损失会略大于前面提到的廉价护航驱逐舰。然而，由于其成本更高，很难凑齐足够数量来在每场战斗中取得高护航效率，尤其是高屏护效率，这可能导致运输船队损失更大。在这种情况下，昂贵的声呐和深水炸弹装备的价值也会降低，因为处于战斗防守方时很难发现潜艇。

1f1kj4r.en: ⟦0⟧ consists of the deployment of air wings to ⟦1⟧, where they can undertake ⟦2⟧ targeting enemy air forces, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ or buildings. Given that air warfare is the only type that directly affects all three types of combat (on top of the strategic targeting), the air war is something the player must take into account when devising successful strategies.
1f1kj4r.zh: ⟦0⟧包括把航空队部署到⟦1⟧，在那里它们可以执行⟦2⟧来打击敌方空军、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧或建筑。鉴于空战是唯一能直接影响到全部三种作战（更不用说战略打击）的作战类型，玩家在制定成功战略时必须把空战纳入考量。

1rkcpf7.en: Air warfare is managed in the corresponding ⟦0⟧. Most air operations work on the scale of ⟦1⟧.
1rkcpf7.zh: 空战在对应的⟦0⟧中进行管理。大多数空中行动都以⟦1⟧为规模单位运作。

1iakyl.en: ⟦0⟧ are needed for the operation of aircraft. They are ⟦1⟧ buildings, which may be constructed or repaired at the ⟦2⟧ screen. In contrast to other state-wide buildings, air bases are located in a specific ⟦3⟧ (which is fixed per state) and control of this province determines who can use the air base. When an air base gets captured, planes automatically relocate to other air bases if available and won't be lost.
1iakyl.zh: 飞机的运作需要⟦0⟧。它们是⟦1⟧建筑，可以在⟦2⟧界面中建造或修复。与其他州级建筑不同，空军基地位于特定的⟦3⟧（每个州固定），控制该省份决定了谁能使用这座空军基地。空军基地被占领时，飞机会自动转移到其他可用的空军基地，不会损失。

qbc8w.en: Each land-based ⟦0⟧ can support 200⟦1⟧ planes per base level without any penalties. The maximum air base level is 10⟦2⟧, for a maximum of 2000 aircraft. All types of planes may be located at these air bases, including carrier-capable models.
qbc8w.zh: 每座陆基⟦0⟧每级可无惩罚地容纳200⟦1⟧架飞机。空军基地的最高等级为10⟦2⟧，即最多2000架飞机。所有类型的飞机都可以驻扎在这些空军基地，包括舰载型。

1f8ksix.en: Naval carriers can operate as air bases at sea. The number of planes they can support without penalties is based on their deck space stat. Most carriers can only support carrier-capable aircraft, though ice carriers can support all types of planes.
1f8ksix.zh: 航空母舰可以在海上充当空军基地。它们可无惩罚容纳的飞机数量取决于其甲板空间属性。大多数航空母舰只能搭载舰载型飞机，不过冰上航母可以搭载所有类型的飞机。

11e7byy.en: The capacity of an air base is shared between allies. The tooltip for the air base shows the total number of planes located there (and a list of the countries with air wings and the types of planes). If the total number of stationed planes exceeds the capacity, every additional percent of planes causes a ⟦0⟧ overcrowding penalty. At ⟦1⟧ overcapacity, the penalty reaches ⟦2⟧, preventing any planes from flying from the air base. It is therefore very important to manage available capacity and to quickly rebase planes off of overfilled air bases.
11e7byy.zh: 空军基地的容量由盟友共享。空军基地的提示框会显示驻扎于此的飞机总数（以及拥有航空队的国家和飞机类型列表）。如果驻扎的飞机总数超过容量，每超出1%的飞机都会造成⟦0⟧的超载惩罚。在⟦1⟧超载时，惩罚达到⟦2⟧，使任何飞机都无法从该空军基地起飞。因此，管理可用容量并迅速把飞机从超载的空军基地转移出去非常重要。

1f2v3v.en: Air bases can be damaged by ⟦0⟧ . Damage will reduce the capacity the base can hold until it is repaired.
1f2v3v.zh: 空军基地会被⟦0⟧ 破坏。在修复之前，损伤会降低该基地可容纳的容量。

1e0gadc.en: ⟦0⟧ act as additional, floating air bases. Their capacity is determined by the ⟦1⟧ stat of the ship. Most carriers can only support carrier-capable aircraft, though ice carriers can support all types of planes.
1e0gadc.zh: ⟦0⟧充当额外的浮动空军基地。其容量由舰船的⟦1⟧属性决定。大多数航空母舰只能搭载舰载型飞机，不过冰上航母可以搭载所有类型的飞机。

3vmenz.en: Planes on aircraft carriers automatically participate in naval battles when they are not assigned on missions and/or if the aircraft carrier is assigned to a mission. Air wings on carriers ⟦0⟧ (not on any ⟦1⟧) outside of ports can perform ⟦2⟧, just like any other aircraft. This can be useful to provide close air support for an amphibious invasion when other bases are out of range, to exercise untrained air wings so that they perform better in naval battles, or to hunt unescorted enemy naval patrol bombers from outside their bombing range, among others.
3vmenz.zh: 航空母舰上的飞机在未被指派任务时，和/或航空母舰被指派了任务时，会自动参与海战。航母上的航空队若⟦0⟧（不在任何⟦1⟧上）且位于港口之外，可以像其他飞机一样执行⟦2⟧。这在其他基地射程不足时为两栖登陆提供近距空中支援、让未经训练的航空队进行训练以便在海战中表现更好，或从敌方轰炸航程之外猎杀没有护航的敌方海上巡逻轰炸机等方面都很有用。

1s2bqpz.en: Hosting too many planes on an aircraft carrier applies the same penalty to their ability to operate as for land-based airbases. However, this penalty can be reduced with the ⟦0⟧ naval doctrine. In naval battles, it can also be counteracted by having more than 100% ⟦1⟧.
1s2bqpz.zh: 航空母舰上驻扎过多飞机时，其作战能力所受的惩罚与陆基空军基地相同。不过，这一惩罚可以通过⟦0⟧海军学说来降低。在海战中，还可以通过拥有超过100%的⟦1⟧来抵消。

b9lw1f.en: Air wings are a ⟦0⟧ of ⟦1⟧ forming an air unit attached to an air base. A new air wing is deployed from the air base screen. An air wing may be created only if there are sufficient planes and ⟦2⟧ available.
b9lw1f.zh: 航空队是⟦0⟧，由⟦1⟧组成，作为空军单位隶属于某个空军基地。新的航空队在空军基地界面中部署。只有在有足够的飞机和⟦2⟧时才能创建航空队。

13osah4.en: The size of an air wing is 100 planes for land-based ones and 10⟦0⟧ for carrier-based ones. All planes in an air wing must be of the same type or capable of the same missions; it is not possible to mix fighters with bombers, for example. However, different models of plane within the same type or same missions (e.g. 1936 fighters and 1940 fighters) may be mixed in the same air wing.
13osah4.zh: 陆基航空队的规模为100架飞机，舰载航空队为10⟦0⟧。航空队中的所有飞机必须是同一类型或能够执行相同的任务；例如，不能把战斗机和轰炸机混编。不过，同一类型或相同任务下的不同型号飞机（如1936年战斗机和1940年战斗机）可以混编在同一支航空队中。

og16mp.en: The ⟦0⟧ of an air wing represents the amounts of plane in an air wing compared to full strength. If the current number of planes is lower than the reinforcement level, new planes will be added to it as long as there are sufficient stockpiled planes of that type. If there are none, then reinforcement will take place when new planes of the correct equipment type are produced by ⟦1⟧.
og16mp.zh: 航空队的⟦0⟧表示其飞机数量相对于满编的程度。如果当前飞机数量低于补充水平，只要该类型有足够的库存飞机，就会为其补充新飞机。如果没有库存，那么当⟦1⟧生产出正确装备类型的新飞机时才会进行补充。

qm8mlr.en: Wings can be split into multiple wings of the same type or merged into one in the air base view. There is also a Reorganize option that allows greater control over moving planes between two or more wings of the same type.
qm8mlr.zh: 在空军基地视图中，航空队可以拆分为多支同类型的航空队，也可以合并为一支。还有「重组」选项，可以更精细地控制同类型两支或多支航空队之间飞机的调配。

91e44d.en: Once a new air wing is created, it will take 2⟦0⟧ days for the planes to arrive at the air base. The wing may be assigned to an air region and given missions immediately, but it will not carry out the missions until the planes arrive. When air wings are reassigned to a different air base (rebased), they require time to travel to their new base. The time required to rebase planes depends on how far away their new base is and the speed of the slowest aircraft model in the design. Rebasing planes from land-based air bases to aircraft carriers or vice versa also applies a 48⟦1⟧ hour-long penalty to the air wing preventing it from receiving any reinforcements.
91e44d.zh: 新建航空队后，飞机需要2⟦0⟧天才能抵达空军基地。航空队可以立即被指派到某个空中地区并下达任务，但在飞机抵达之前不会执行任务。航空队被重新指派到另一座空军基地（转场）时，需要时间飞往新基地。转场所需时间取决于新基地的距离以及编制中最慢机型的航速。在陆基空军基地与航空母舰之间转场也会对航空队施加48⟦1⟧小时的惩罚，使其无法获得任何补充。

qybfr1.en: If an air wing is disbanded, all of its planes will return to the equipment stockpile and will be available for deployment to other air wings.
qybfr1.zh: 如果解散一支航空队，其所有飞机都会返回装备库存，可用于部署到其他航空队。

ugk9f1.en: Air wings can be assigned to various ⟦0⟧.
ugk9f1.zh: 航空队可以被指派执行各种⟦0⟧。

lur7ma.en: Air superiority is the degree of dominance of your air force over an opponent's air force in a strategic region. Air superiority is provided by planes actively performing their mission and depends on their type as well. Each type of an air wing has a defined air superiority power value that describes how effective it is in domination of the sky (see table below).
lur7ma.zh: 制空权是指在某个战略地区中你的空军相对敌方空军的支配程度。制空权由正在积极执行任务的飞机提供，也取决于飞机类型。每类航空队都有固定的制空权数值，表示其夺取天空支配权的效率（见下表）。

p0atw3.en: Fighter, Carrier Fighter, Jet Fighter, ⟦0⟧, Carrier ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, Carrier ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, Jet ⟦5⟧
p0atw3.zh: 战斗机、舰载战斗机、喷气式战斗机、⟦0⟧、舰载⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、舰载⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、喷气式⟦5⟧

37f6pg.zh: 战略轰炸机、喷气式战略轰炸机

1rx2ur9.en: Each air wing's air power is its number of planes, multiplied by the superiority power above and its mission efficiency.
1rx2ur9.zh: 每支航空队的空中力量等于其飞机数量乘以上表中的制空权数值，再乘以其任务效率。

uwjpl6.en: A region's air superiority is determined by comparing your air power (plus allies) to the enemy's air power. This ratio is stated as a percentage and results in a color applied to a region (can be viewed using the ⟦0⟧). The colors and interpretation of the colors is listed in the table below. The ratio is non-linear, at high levels of air superiority you need to add substantially more planes to increase air superiority by 1%. At 4000 allied planes versus 500 enemy planes, adding 1000 planes to the allied side only increases allied air superiority by 1.3 percentage points.
uwjpl6.zh: 一个地区的制空权由你的空中力量（加上盟友）与敌方空中力量的对比决定。这一比值以百分比表示，并会为地区涂上相应颜色（可使用⟦0⟧查看）。颜色的含义见下表。这一比值是非线性的，在制空权较高时，你需要增加大量飞机才能把制空权提高1%。当4000架盟军飞机对500架敌机时，为盟军一方增加1000架飞机也只能让盟军制空权提高1.3个百分点。

1yqx7qn.en: ⟦0⟧ can also reduce air superiority in an air region. Each building level (maximum level 5 per state) adds ⟦1⟧ air power to the opposing side, up to a maximum of ⟦2⟧.
1yqx7qn.zh: ⟦0⟧也能降低某个空中地区的制空权。每级建筑（每个州最高5级）为对方增加⟦1⟧空中力量，最多增加⟦2⟧。

g6yw1y.en: With ⟦0⟧, any ⟦1⟧ launching missiles on ⟦2⟧ also adds ⟦3⟧ air power to their side for each missile wing times the air attack of that wing, up to a theoretical maximum of ⟦4⟧ per site. In practice, ⟦5⟧ is the only such equipment available for these missions, and it only has an Air Attack of 0.25, which translates to ⟦6⟧ air superiority per active missile wing, up to a maximum of ⟦7⟧ air superiority per ⟦8⟧, which is also before factoring in their reduced mission efficiency from their low range.
g6yw1y.zh: 拥有⟦0⟧时，⟦1⟧可用于向⟦2⟧发射导弹，这也会为自方增加⟦3⟧空中力量（每支导弹航空队乘以其空中攻击）。每个基地的理论上限是⟦4⟧，但实际可用的此类装备只有⟦5⟧，其空中攻击只有0.25，折算下来每支现役导弹航空队提供⟦6⟧制空权，最多提供⟦7⟧制空权（即每个⟦8⟧的上限），而且这还没有计入其低航程带来的任务效率下降。

1b0rzc.en: Every 1 point of air superiority advantage in a strategic region gives an air support penalty (called enemy air superiority on the combat screen) to enemy land combat defense and breakthrough of ⟦0⟧, up to a maximum of ⟦1⟧ at 100% air superiority. For example, with 60% air superiority, the enemy will suffer a ⟦2⟧ penalty to defense and breakthrough. For this reason, it is advised to hold air superiority as much as possible. Doctrines can increase this penalty by multiplying the final air support penalty by 1 + the bonus from doctrine; e.g., a ⟦3⟧ penalty to enemies combined with ⟦4⟧ air superiority from, e.g., having all ⟦5⟧ air doctrines becomes -10% * (1 + 30%) = ⟦6⟧. Air superiority also inflicts a maximum penalty of ⟦7⟧ to enemy movement speed at 100% air superiority with no modifiers. ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, and other sources of divisional anti-air can reduce the penalties from hostile air superiority to down to ⟦10⟧⟦11⟧ their unmodified values, but the effect is not linear, with the effect tapering off with more and more divisional anti-air.⟦12⟧
1b0rzc.zh: 在战略地区中每拥有1点制空权优势，就会对敌方陆军作战的防御和突破施加空中支援惩罚（在战斗界面中称为敌方制空权），惩罚为⟦0⟧，在100%制空权时最高可达⟦1⟧。例如，拥有60%制空权时，敌方将在防御和突破上承受⟦2⟧惩罚。因此，建议尽可能保持制空权。学说可以放大这一惩罚，把最终空中支援惩罚乘以1 + 学说加成；例如，对敌方的空中支援惩罚⟦3⟧，在拥有⟦4⟧的制空权（例如来自全部⟦5⟧空军学说）时会变成 -10% * (1 + 30%) = ⟦6⟧。在没有修正的情况下，制空权在100%时还会对敌方移动速度施加最多⟦7⟧的惩罚。⟦8⟧、⟦9⟧以及其他师级防空来源可以把敌方制空权带来的惩罚削减到其未修正值的⟦10⟧⟦11⟧，但效果并非线性，随着师级防空越来越多，效果会逐渐递减。⟦12⟧

h0fwiy.en: Having air superiority in a sea region can increase both surface and sub detection by up to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧
h0fwiy.zh: 在海域中拥有制空权可以把水面和水下探测能力提高最多⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧

jx4j73.en: Air superiority can also affect raids and special missions, such as:
jx4j73.zh: 制空权还会影响突袭和特殊任务，例如：

1ebul36.en: paratroopers cannot be dropped unless you have at least 70%⟦0⟧ air superiority.
1ebul36.zh: 除非拥有至少70%⟦0⟧制空权，否则空降兵无法实施空降。

1pwbbbb.en: the success chances of most aerial raids is reduced down to ⟦0⟧ at 0% air superiority and increased up to ⟦1⟧ at 100% air superiority.
1pwbbbb.zh: 大多数空中突袭的成功率在0%制空权时降低至⟦0⟧，在100%制空权时提高至⟦1⟧。

14k4rpm.en: the success chances of lock bombing, dam busting, and oilfield raids is reduced down to ⟦0⟧ at 0% air superiority and increased up to ⟦1⟧ at 100% air superiority.
14k4rpm.zh: 炸锁、炸坝和油田突袭的成功率在0%制空权时降低至⟦0⟧，在100%制空权时提高至⟦1⟧。

kyfny8.en: the success chances of nuclear strike, thermonuclear strike, mine sabotage, and pathfinder raids is reduced down to ⟦0⟧ at 0% air superiority and increased up to ⟦1⟧ at 100% air superiority.
kyfny8.zh: 核打击、热核打击、水雷破坏和导航机突袭的成功率在0%制空权时降低至⟦0⟧，在100%制空权时提高至⟦1⟧。

zx5mgh.en: air superiority contributes to intel on the success chances of a raid by up to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧
zx5mgh.zh: 制空权最多可为突袭成功率的预估情报贡献⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧

pmljp0.en: Air combat has a chance of generating aces. An air wing may be assigned up to one ace only. For a list of aces by ⟦0⟧, see ⟦1⟧.
pmljp0.zh: 空战有几率产生王牌飞行员。每支航空队最多只能分配一名王牌。按⟦0⟧列出的王牌名单见⟦1⟧。

yewrye.zh: 空中攻击：+3% 航速：+3% 机动：+5%

j67yfu.en: Naval Targeting: +5% Ground attack factor: +3% Agility: +5%
j67yfu.zh: 对海瞄准：+5% 对地攻击系数：+3% 机动：+5%

1lcmfeq.en: Naval Targeting: +10% Ground attack factor: +5% Agility: +10%
1lcmfeq.zh: 对海瞄准：+10% 对地攻击系数：+5% 机动：+10%

y0ic3j.en: Naval Targeting: +15% Ground attack factor: +8% Agility: +15%
y0ic3j.zh: 对海瞄准：+15% 对地攻击系数：+8% 机动：+15%

14kbqcb.en: The effects are scaled inversely by the size of the wing relative to 100⟦0⟧ planes, to a maximum of 50x at 2⟦1⟧ planes.
14kbqcb.zh: 这些效果会按航空队规模相对于100⟦0⟧架飞机的大小反向缩放，在2⟦1⟧架飞机时最高可达50倍。

prhznc.en: An ace can generate on a wing after a sortie under two circumstances:
prhznc.zh: 一次出击后，航空队在两种情况下可能产生王牌：

i0jn0u.en: The wing deals damage to enemy wings in ⟦0⟧
i0jn0u.zh: 该航空队在⟦0⟧中对敌方航空队造成伤害

1hot41y.en: The wing deals more points of damage to a ship than they lose in the attack
1hot41y.zh: 该航空队对舰船造成的伤害点数多于自身在攻击中损失的点数

e9ctg5.en: The wing successfully deals damage to an enemy structure
e9ctg5.zh: 该航空队成功对敌方建筑造成伤害

1twy7ip.en: Each time this happens, the chance to generate an ace scales quadratically with the amount of planes in the air wing. The chance is 1%⟦0⟧ plus 0.005%⟦1⟧ per plane in the air wing, rolled twice. For a full, land-based air wing of 100 planes, this comes out to a final overall chance of 2.9775%. For a full, carrier-based air wing of 10 planes, this comes out to a final overall chance of about 2.0890%.
1twy7ip.zh: 每次发生这种情况，产生王牌的几率与航空队中的飞机数量呈二次方关系。几率为1%⟦0⟧加上航空队中每架飞机0.005%⟦1⟧，判定两次。对于满编的100架陆基航空队，最终总几率约为2.9775%。对于满编的10架舰载航空队，最终总几率约为2.0890%。

1rodomu.en: If an ace is generated for an air wing that already has a living ace, the newly generated ace is put in reserve. Otherwise, the newly generated ace is automatically assigned to the air wing.
1rodomu.zh: 如果为已经拥有在世王牌的航空队产生新王牌，新产生的王牌会进入预备状态。否则，新产生的王牌会自动分配到该航空队。

1sh3axd.en: Aces can die whenever an air wing loses at least one airplane in a sortie. The chance for this to happen is 0.5%⟦0⟧ plus 0.001%⟦1⟧ per plane that was lost in the sortie. When an ace dies, they remain nominally assigned to the air wing, but have a coffin displayed over their portrait and do not give any bonuses to their air wing. Dead aces are only automatically unassigned if the same wing generates a new ace; if there are any living aces in reserve that could be assigned to a wing with a dead ace, they must be manually assigned.
1sh3axd.zh: 当航空队在一次出击中损失至少一架飞机时，王牌就可能阵亡。发生这种情况的几率为0.5%⟦0⟧加上出击中每损失一架飞机0.001%⟦1⟧。王牌阵亡后，名义上仍分配在该航空队，但其头像上会显示棺材，且不再为航空队提供任何加成。只有当同一支航空队产生新王牌时，阵亡的王牌才会自动解除分配；如果预备队中有可以分配给这支有阵亡王牌的航空队的在世王牌，则必须手动分配。

v45qkz.en: Deploying more planes can offset reduced mission efficiency to an extent, but basing planes closer to the center of the strategic region or using planes with longer range may be more efficient.
v45qkz.zh: 部署更多飞机可以在一定程度上弥补任务效率的下降，但把飞机驻扎在更靠近战略地区中心的位置，或使用航程更远的飞机，可能效率更高。

r42fgr.en: If the player does not control any bases within a region that they are attacking, then they are at a considerable disadvantage to their enemies, who do have control. The player might:
r42fgr.zh: 如果玩家在正在进攻的地区内不控制任何基地，就会相对控制着基地的敌人处于明显劣势。玩家可以：

1ctu53p.en: Choose tactical bombers to carry out close air support missions, instead of CAS, and use heavy fighters because of their longer range.
1ctu53p.zh: 选择战术轰炸机执行近距空中支援任务，而不是CAS，并使用航程更远的重型战斗机。

13vq6rz.en: Try to capture an enemy air base as quickly as possible, so that the player can redeploy some fighters and CAS there. It might even be worthwhile if the player captures a state without an air base to build their own level 1 base there as quickly as possible. That will allow them to redeploy wings with up to 200 planes to be located within the region.
13vq6rz.zh: 尽快占领敌方空军基地，以便把一些战斗机和CAS重新部署到那里。如果玩家占领了一个没有空军基地的州，尽快在那里建造自己的1级基地甚至也是值得的。这样就能把最多200架飞机的航空队重新部署到该地区内。

3o7x74.en: Use strategic bombers to bomb enemy buildings, including air bases. This might cause enough damage to their air bases to "even the odds" by reducing enemy mission efficiency. But this may only work if their air bases are already close to full capacity.
3o7x74.zh: 使用战略轰炸机轰炸敌方建筑，包括空军基地。这可能对其空军基地造成足够损伤，通过降低敌方任务效率来「扳平局面」。但这只有在敌方空军基地已接近满容量时才可能奏效。

nnh2cr.en: Using carrier fleets might also be very useful if the region has a coast where the player can (safely) anchor the fleet. Especially if the attack on the region is being carried out by a ⟦0⟧. The carrier fleet can carry out the multiple roles of protecting the transport convoys, and providing ⟦1⟧.
nnh2cr.zh: 如果该地区有可供玩家（安全）停泊舰队的海岸，使用航母舰队也可能非常有用，尤其是在对该地区的进攻由⟦0⟧实施时。航母舰队可以承担保护运输船队和提供⟦1⟧等多重角色。

ejmx35.en: Abandon trying to compete for ⟦0⟧ with the player's fighters, and rely only on interception missions. Fighters on interception missions only take off and attack bomber wings if they detect a target. This causes lower losses of the player's fighters. It will give the player's enemy the air superiority bonus in combat however.
ejmx35.zh: 放弃用玩家的战斗机争夺⟦0⟧，只依靠拦截任务。执行拦截任务的战斗机只有在发现目标时才会起飞攻击轰炸机航空队。这能减少玩家战斗机的损失。不过，这会把战斗中的制空权加成让给玩家的敌人。

m8ubnk.en: from game file \Hearts of Iron IV\common\buildings\00_buildings.txt
m8ubnk.zh: 来自游戏文件 \Hearts of Iron IV\common\buildings\00_buildings.txt

lutpz0.en: The terms used in the game (e.g. regiment, brigade) have historically had different meanings in the militaries of different countries. This section explains the significance of these terms as they are defined for this game.
lutpz0.zh: 游戏中使用的术语（例如团、旅）在不同国家的军队中历史上含义各不相同。本节说明这些术语在本游戏中的定义及其意义。

hluq1i.en: Armies are composed of ⟦0⟧, which is the smallest unit a player can directly control.
hluq1i.zh: 集团军由⟦0⟧组成，师是玩家能够直接控制的最小单位。

pipc49.en: Each division consists of 1-25 battalions - also sometimes called line battalions. This is the main fighting force, and the primary source of most statistics. The primary drain of manpower and equipment.
pipc49.zh: 每个师由 1-25 个营组成——这些营有时也称为一线营。它们是主要的战斗力量，也是大多数统计数据的主要来源，同时是人力与装备的最大消耗方。

963iag.en: All battalions belong to a specific classification or group, such as "Infantry Battalion", "Mobile Battalion" and "Armoured Battalion".
963iag.zh: 所有营都属于某个特定分类或组别，例如「步兵营」「机动营」和「装甲营」。

avue8c.en: Regiments are the "columns" in the template designer. Battalions from different groups must be in different regiments (columns). There is no other effect of regiments. And, as there are 5 regiments/columns but only 3 groups, it is never an issue. There are many other reasons not to use all 25 battalion slots and/or mix more than 1-2 battalion Groups anyway.
avue8c.zh: 团是师编制设计器中的「列」。属于不同组别的营必须放在不同的团（列）中。除此之外，团没有其他作用。而且，由于只有 5 个团（列）却有 3 个组别，这从来不会成为问题。无论如何，还有很多其他理由不去用满全部 25 个营位，或者混编超过 1-2 个营的组别。

1bjc333.en: In addition to the battalions, a division may have up to 5 support companies. These often provide bonuses that cannot be otherwise obtained. Support companies can be roughly put into 4 unofficial groups:
1bjc333.zh: 除了营之外，一个师还可以编有最多 5 个支援连。它们往往提供无法通过其他途径获得的加成。支援连大致可分为 4 个非官方类别：

11f1p17.en: Artillery, which provides limited artillery tree capabilities for divisions that cannot afford to bring mainline artillery battalions along.
11f1p17.zh: 火炮，为那些无力编入一线火炮营的师提供有限的火炮科技树能力。

1fgpgzx.en: Basic support, which only needs support equipment
1fgpgzx.zh: 基础支援，只需要支援装备

yfvtdm.en: Motorized support, which needs support Equipment and some motorized
yfvtdm.zh: 摩托化支援，需要支援装备和一定数量的摩托化装备

inrc57.en: Recon, which can be cavalry (infantry weapons, support), motorized (infantry weapons, support, and motorized), armoured car, or light tank
inrc57.zh: 侦察，可以是骑兵（步兵武器、支援装备）、摩托化（步兵武器、支援装备和摩托化装备）、装甲车或轻型坦克

14apeki.en: Based on the Battalions, each division has a number of values. The calculation of the final values ranges from simple Addition (Summation), Averages, and Worst to "it is complicated" (Armour and Piercing).
14apeki.zh: 师的各种数值都基于其下属的营。最终数值的计算方式从简单相加（求和）、取平均值、取最差值，到「相当复杂」（装甲与穿透）不等。

fonhk3.en: Do keep in mind that some values are also defined by the ⟦0⟧ fielded equipment. The Division designer will simply assume the "best" equipment is used. But between equipment loss and capture as well as limited production relative to casualties, often much older gear might be pulled out of storage. While that will result in every soldier having something to fight with, it will drastically reduce the values. And of course for some divisions, intentional limiting of the usable equipment might be advisable, especially off-map garrison divisions where most equipment stats do not matter.
fonhk3.zh: 请记住，某些数值还取决于实际投入使用的⟦0⟧。师编制设计器只会假定使用了「最好」的装备。但考虑到装备的损失与缴获，以及相对于伤亡而言有限的产量，往往会有大量老旧装备被从库存中取出使用。虽然这能让每名士兵都有武器可用，却会大幅拉低数值。当然，对某些师来说，有意限制可用装备或许是明智之举，尤其是那些不在地图上作战的驻军师——对它们而言大多数装备属性都无关紧要。

1yzplfe.en: Most of these stats can be improved through building and using ⟦0⟧ and, with ⟦1⟧, using different ⟦2⟧. However, be aware that increasing one stat can adversely affect a different stat. Researching ⟦3⟧ can also increase stats, as can various ⟦4⟧ and, with ⟦5⟧, certain special forces doctrines. Some ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ can also increase the stats of certain unit types.
1yzplfe.zh: 这些属性大多可以通过建造和使用⟦0⟧来提升，并且在⟦1⟧中还可以使用不同的⟦2⟧。不过要注意，提升某一项属性可能会对另一项属性产生不利影响。研究⟦3⟧同样能提升属性，各种⟦4⟧也能做到，而在⟦5⟧中还有某些特种部队学说。某些⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧也能提升特定类型单位的属性。

9jw6c1.en: ⟦0⟧ The division travels at the speed of its ⟦1⟧ battalion. Support companies such as scouting units are counted for this; if you chose a slow scouting company the entire division will move at that speed. Some other support companies are also counted for this.
9jw6c1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 师的行进速度取决于其速度最慢的⟦1⟧营。侦察部队等支援连也计入其中；如果你选择了速度缓慢的侦察连，整个师都会以该速度移动。某些其他支援连也会计入。

ygeuim.en: ⟦0⟧ "HP" is an abbreviation for "hit points." This is the ability to absorb damage and is largely a function of manpower and role. Also referred to as ⟦1⟧. Division HP represents how many hits or ⟦2⟧ the division can take before it is physically destroyed. The more HP a division has, the fewer losses to its manpower and equipment it will take from the same amount of damage. When a division takes damage to its HP, its combat stats are reduced proportionally; for example, a division at half of its maximum HP can only use half of its maximum possible attacks or defences in combat. Tanks and combat support battalions tend to be relatively fragile when it comes to absorbing damage, and it is usually infantry and mobile battalions, especially ⟦3⟧, that enable divisions to absorb serious damage without losing as much equipment or manpower. Reference ⟦4⟧. The HP for the division is the ⟦5⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
ygeuim.zh: ⟦0⟧ 「HP」是「hit points」（生命值）的缩写。它代表承受伤害的能力，很大程度上取决于人力和单位类型，也称为⟦1⟧。师的生命值代表该师在被物理摧毁之前能承受多少次命中或⟦2⟧。一个师的生命值越高，在承受相同伤害时损失的人力和装备就越少。当师的生命值受到损伤时，其战斗属性会按比例下降；例如，一个处于最大生命值一半的师在战斗中只能发挥其最大可能攻击或防御的一半。就承受伤害而言，坦克和战斗支援营往往相对脆弱，通常是步兵营和机动营（尤其是⟦3⟧）让师能够承受严重伤害而较少损失装备或人力。参见⟦4⟧。师的生命值为所有营和连生命值的⟦5⟧。

1mp9s49.en: ⟦0⟧ Known as "morale" in previous games, organization is the readiness of a division to perform combat, the willingness of a unit to either continue attacking or to continue holding the province that they are defending. Once a unit no longer has any organization remaining, it can no longer fight in battles. Infantry and mobile battalions tend to be the primary source of organization in a division, so it is important to buffer lower-organization battalions like tanks and combat support battalions with enough of them to keep the division combat-capable. Moving a division causes organization loss at the rate of ⟦1⟧ organization per hour, and organization loss also slows down movement to up to ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧ Organization may also be lost through attrition or lack of supply, see ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧). A division without organization cannot operate as it is supposed to; it cannot stay in combat or move properly. The organization for the division is the ⟦6⟧ of those of all battalions and companies. Battles are usually battles of Organization depletion (reference ⟦7⟧) and, depending on who the attacker is, reaching 0 has one of two effects: If it is the attacker, then the division will stop attacking and will either stay in, or return to, the region it came from. Any movement progress is lost. It cannot be ordered to attack again until Organization has recovered a decent amount. If it is the defender, then the division will try to flee: leaving the province to the nearest friendly one. If it cannot leave the province, then it will be destroyed.
1mp9s49.zh: ⟦0⟧ 组织度在以前的游戏中被称为「士气」，它代表一个师进行战斗的准备程度，即单位继续进攻或继续守住所防御省份的意愿。一旦单位不再剩余任何组织度，它就无法继续参加战斗。步兵营和机动营往往是师中组织度的主要来源，因此必须编入足够的这类营，来为坦克和战斗支援营等组织度较低的营提供缓冲，以维持师的战斗能力。移动一个师会按每小时⟦1⟧组织度的速度损失组织度，组织度损失还会使移动速度最多降低至⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧组织度也可能因损耗或补给不足而损失，参见⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧。没有组织度的师无法按预期运作：它既不能留在战斗中，也无法正常移动。师的组织度为所有营和连组织度的⟦6⟧。战斗通常就是组织度消耗战（参见⟦7⟧），并且取决于谁是进攻方，组织度降至 0 会产生两种效果之一：如果它是进攻方，该师将停止进攻，并留在原地或返回出发地区，所有移动进度都会丢失；在组织度恢复到一定程度之前，无法再次命令它进攻。如果它是防御方，该师会试图逃跑：撤出该省份前往最近的友方省份；如果无法撤出，它将被摧毁。

1h1rb9.en: If it is the attacker, then the division will stop attacking and will either stay in, or return to, the region it came from. Any movement progress is lost. It cannot be ordered to attack again until Organization has recovered a decent amount.
1h1rb9.zh: 如果它是进攻方，该师将停止进攻，并留在原地或返回出发地区。所有移动进度都会丢失。在组织度恢复到一定程度之前，无法再次命令它进攻。

jpkga5.en: If it is the defender, then the division will try to flee: leaving the province to the nearest friendly one. If it cannot leave the province, then it will be destroyed.
jpkga5.zh: 如果它是防御方，该师会试图逃跑：撤出该省份前往最近的友方省份。如果无法撤出，它将被摧毁。

1wtrsq7.en: ⟦0⟧ All divisions that are not in combat regenerate Organization at a fixed rate. This stat is ⟦1⟧ regeneration on top of that, allowing a division to be better prepared for more combat. A division can suffer from a recovery rate penalty if it lacks supply. Reference ⟦2⟧. The stat for the division is the ⟦3⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1wtrsq7.zh: ⟦0⟧ 所有未处于战斗中的师都会以固定速率恢复组织度。该属性是在此基础上⟦1⟧恢复量，使师能为更多战斗做好更充分的准备。师若缺乏补给，会遭受恢复速率惩罚。参见⟦2⟧。师的组织度恢复速率为所有营和连该项数值的⟦3⟧。

16ge6ve.en: ⟦0⟧ Contributes to reconnaissance during battle. In any combat the side with a reconnaissance advantage (from divisions and the general) over their enemy has more information about how their adversaries' forces are deployed and are more likely to pick better tactics for the day (reference ⟦1⟧). Adding a recon support company will give an extra reconnaissance points bonus to the ⟦2⟧ in charge of your division during battle. Reference ⟦3⟧. The stat for the division is the ⟦4⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
16ge6ve.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在战斗中提供侦察能力。在任何战斗中，侦察能力优于敌方的一方（来自师和将领）能更好地掌握敌军部署情况，也更有可能在当天选出更好的战术（参见⟦1⟧）。编入侦察支援连会在战斗中为统率该师的⟦2⟧提供额外的侦察点数加成。参见⟦3⟧。师的侦察值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦4⟧。

c7enbv.en: ⟦0⟧ Ability to suppress local resistance (reference ⟦1⟧). How well the division will stop the formation of partisan forces and their activities. The stat for the division is the ⟦2⟧ of those of all battalions and companies, though because ⟦3⟧ does not involve deployed divisions, in practice it behaves more like the ⟦4⟧ of the division (weighted by ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧).
c7enbv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 镇压当地抵抗的能力（参见⟦1⟧）。即该师能在多大程度上阻止游击队力量的形成及其活动。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦2⟧，不过由于⟦3⟧并不涉及已部署的师，实际上它更像是该师的⟦4⟧（按⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧加权）。

gn2ybj.en: ⟦0⟧ How large or "heavy" the unit is. The higher the number, the more convoys are needed when in naval transfer and the more planes are needed to drop paratroopers. The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
gn2ybj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 单位有多大或有多「重」。数值越高，海运时需要的运输船队越多，空降需要的飞机也越多。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦1⟧。

1m2frun.en: ⟦0⟧ How much supply the unit consumes per day. Please read ⟦1⟧ on the significance of this. Adding a Logistics support company will reduce your division's daily supply consumption. Reference ⟦2⟧. The stat for the division is the ⟦3⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1m2frun.zh: ⟦0⟧ 单位每天消耗多少补给。关于其重要性请阅读⟦1⟧。编入后勤支援连可降低师的每日补给消耗。参见⟦2⟧。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦3⟧。

eobqeg.en: ⟦0⟧ Reliability is the resistance to military equipment breakdown and subsequent loss. Higher reliability reduces the chance of equipment breakdown and loss from attrition and increases the chance of recovering lost equipment during combat. Reference ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. Incorporating a ⟦3⟧ support company (reference ⟦4⟧) into your division will grant a bonus to each equipment type's reliability. The stat is tracked ⟦5⟧ for each type of equipment used by the division.
eobqeg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可靠性指军用装备抵抗故障及随之而来的损失的能力。可靠性越高，装备因损耗而发生故障和损失的概率越低，战斗中回收损失装备的概率越高。参见⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧。为师编入⟦3⟧支援连（参见⟦4⟧）会为每种装备类型的可靠性提供加成。该数值是⟦5⟧按师所使用的每种装备类型分别计算的。

14thygx.en: ⟦0⟧ Normally, Manpower that is lost in combat just vanishes. While the Manpower pool does regrow to its maximum, this is very slow. Trickleback is a portion of casualties that can be saved and returned to the Manpower pool, conserving manpower. This is primarily provided by the ⟦1⟧ support company, see ⟦2⟧. The stat for the division is the ⟦3⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
14thygx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 通常情况下，战斗中损失的人力就此消失。虽然人力池会回复到其上限，但速度非常慢。伤员回收是可从伤亡中挽救并送回人力池的那部分人力，能够节省人力。它主要由⟦1⟧支援连提供，参见⟦2⟧。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦3⟧。

1ymol2x.en: ⟦0⟧ How much ⟦1⟧ is lost when a unit suffers casualties. A high negative is better. A Field Hospital support company can reduce experience loss from casualties. Reference ⟦2⟧. Note that there is additional XP loss for bringing in reinforcements. The stat for the division is the ⟦3⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1ymol2x.zh: ⟦0⟧ 单位遭受伤亡时会损失多少⟦1⟧。负值越大越好。野战医院支援连可以减少伤亡造成的经验损失。参见⟦2⟧。注意，补充兵员还会带来额外的经验损失。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦3⟧。

1qswjn8.en: ⟦0⟧ How many attacks made each hour against the soft parts of an enemy division. In combat, this stat gives the number of attacks the unit can make against a target with low hardness (such as infantry or cavalry) instead of high hardness, armoured targets (such as tanks and tank variants). The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1qswjn8.zh: ⟦0⟧ 每小时对敌方师软目标发起的攻击次数。在战斗中，该属性决定单位对低硬度目标（如步兵或骑兵）而非高硬度装甲目标（如坦克和坦克变体）能够发起的攻击次数。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦1⟧。

vq6cr4.en: ⟦0⟧ How many attacks made each hour against the hard parts of an enemy division. In combat, this stat gives the number of attacks the unit can make against a target with high hardness (such as tanks and armor variants). The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
vq6cr4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 每小时对敌方师硬目标发起的攻击次数。在战斗中，该属性决定单位对高硬度目标（如坦克和装甲变体）能够发起的攻击次数。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦1⟧。

1evizh0.en: ⟦0⟧ How much damage a unit can do against enemy airplanes. It can reduce the effectiveness of enemy aircraft attacking your division (capability of shooting down enemy aircraft). High air attack can also help to counter enemy air superiority effects. The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1evizh0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 单位对敌方飞机能造成多少伤害。它可以削弱敌方飞机攻击你所在师的效能（即击落敌机的能力）。高对空攻击也有助于抵消敌方的制空权效果。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦1⟧。

1tqpt8u.en: ⟦0⟧ Known as "defensiveness" in previous games. This stat represents the number of defences the division has when defending a province, that is, how many attacks it can avoid. When a division has no defences left, it is more probable that it is hit when in combat and cannot hold its defensive position as well. Higher defence allows a division to hold the line longer with fewer casualties. The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1tqpt8u.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在以前的游戏中被称为「防御力」。该属性代表师在防御省份时拥有的防御次数，也就是它能规避多少次攻击。当一个师不再剩余防御次数时，它在战斗中更容易被命中，也更难以守住防御阵地。防御越高，师就能以更少的伤亡更久地守住战线。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦1⟧。

sfjvur.en: ⟦0⟧ Known as "toughness" in previous games. This works like defence, except it applies when the division is attacking a province. This stat represents the number of defences the division has when attacking, that is, how many of the defender's attacks it can avoid. When the division has no defences left, it is more probable that the division will be hit when in combat and cannot sustain the offensive as well. Higher breakthrough allows a division to continue attacking the line more effectively. The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
sfjvur.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在以前的游戏中被称为「韧性」。它的作用与防御相同，只是在师进攻省份时生效。该属性代表师在进攻时拥有的防御次数，也就是它能规避防御方多少次攻击。当师不再剩余防御次数时，它在战斗中更容易被命中，也更难以维持攻势。突破越高，师就能更有效地持续进攻战线。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦1⟧。

o1bqlr.en: ⟦0⟧ Decreases the number of soft and hard attacks made against the division if the attacking division's piercing is less than the defending division's armor, by up to ⟦1⟧ at less than ⟦2⟧ piercing.⟦3⟧ Higher armor than the enemy's piercing will also increase the number of unit attacks in combat and change the organization damage dice roll per attack from 1d4 to 1d6⟦4⟧ as the unit can move around the battlefield more freely without getting pinned or damaged. A division's armour is equal to ⟦5⟧ of the ⟦6⟧ armor in the division plus 60% of the ⟦7⟧ armour in the division.⟦8⟧ Armor is not a property of unit type, only of its equipment.
o1bqlr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若进攻方的穿透低于防御方的装甲，则减少对该师发起的软攻和硬攻次数，若穿透低于⟦1⟧则该减益最多可达⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧装甲高于敌方穿透还会增加战斗中单位的攻击次数，并将每次攻击的组织度伤害骰从 1d4 变为 1d6⟦4⟧，因为单位可以更自由地在战场上机动，不易被压制或击伤。师的装甲值等于⟦5⟧的师内⟦6⟧装甲加上 60% 的师内⟦7⟧装甲。⟦8⟧装甲不是单位类型的属性，而只是其装备的属性。

6q7fot.en: ⟦0⟧ Represents the ability of a division to pierce armour and pin down armoured forces, restricting the movement. If the value is higher than the enemy's armor value, then the division suffers no penalty to its damage and suffers no additional organization damage. Otherwise, the division deals ⟦1⟧ damage with at least ⟦2⟧ piercing, the division deals ⟦3⟧ damage with at least ⟦4⟧ piercing, and ⟦5⟧ damage otherwise.⟦6⟧ A division's piercing is equal to ⟦7⟧ of the ⟦8⟧ piercing in the division plus 60% of the ⟦9⟧ piercing of all battalions and companies in the division.⟦10⟧
6q7fot.zh: ⟦0⟧ 代表一个师穿透装甲并压制装甲部队、限制其移动的能力。如果该数值高于敌方的装甲值，则该师的伤害不受惩罚，也不会承受额外的组织度伤害。否则，该师造成⟦1⟧伤害（穿透至少为⟦2⟧时），造成⟦3⟧伤害（穿透至少为⟦4⟧时），其他情况造成⟦5⟧伤害。⟦6⟧师的穿透值等于师内⟦7⟧穿透的⟦8⟧加上师内所有营和连⟦9⟧穿透的 60%。⟦10⟧

hemll6.en: ⟦0⟧ Higher initiative speeds up battle planning, so 20% initiative, as from a level 1 signals company, speeds up 2%/day planning to 2.4%/day. Higher initiative also increases the chance of a division joining a battle from the reserves, with each 1% initiative increasing reinforce rate by 0.25%.⟦1⟧ The stat for the division is the ⟦2⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
hemll6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 主动性越高，作战计划制定得越快，因此 20% 的主动性（例如来自 1 级通信连）会把 2%/天的计划速度提升到 2.4%/天。主动性越高，师从预备队加入战斗的概率也越大，每 1% 主动性会使增援率提高 0.25%。⟦1⟧师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦2⟧。

ufl3as.en: ⟦0⟧ Represents the ability of a unit to build temporary defensive structures like trenches and pick favourable defensive positions like hills, to better defend against an enemy attack. Entrenchment level is mentioned in the army selection. Entrenchment affect both attack and defence stats of divisions. Divisions build up entrenchment daily when not engaged in combat and stationary (not moving). Divisions will lose all their entrenchment if they are attacking, with the exception of using the probing attack ability (Reference: ⟦1⟧). It provides a massive bonus when defending the province, going as far as an outright force multiplier. The stat for the division is the ⟦2⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
ufl3as.zh: ⟦0⟧ 代表单位修筑战壕等临时防御工事、并选择山丘等有利防御阵地的能力，以便更好地抵御敌军进攻。构筑工事等级会在陆军选中时显示。构筑工事会影响师的进攻和防御属性。师在不参与战斗且静止不动（未移动）时，每天都会累积构筑工事。师在进攻时会失去全部构筑工事，使用试探性攻击能力时除外（参见：⟦1⟧）。它在防御省份时提供巨大加成，甚至能成倍提升战力。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦2⟧。

mjxrj4.en: ⟦0⟧ Represents the room that the division takes up while fighting at the front line. In order to fit into battle, the division needs to fit into the combat width provided by the battlefield. The less width that each division takes, the more divisions that can fire upon the enemy at the same time. However, making many thin divisions also has its tradeoffs. Different battalion types increase the combat width of a division by a different amount. For example, infantry and armoured battalions use 2 width, artillery battalions use 3 width, and anti-tank and anti-air battalions use 1 width. Support companies do not increase the combat width of a division (see ⟦1⟧ for details). The Mass Assault ⟦2⟧ tree has options that reduce the combat width of ⟦3⟧ battalions, while the mountaineer special forces doctrine tree with ⟦4⟧ has an option that reduces the combat width of ⟦5⟧ battalions. The combat width for a division is the ⟦6⟧ of the combat width of all Battalions. Combat width notes: The normal maximum combat width provided by the battlefield varies by terrain. If attacking divisions come from more than one province, then extra width is added to the battlefield for each province, based on the type of terrain that is being attacked. Certain combat tactics can increase or decrease a battle's combat width. It is best to use divisions whose combat widths are factors of the combat width of the terrain you intend to fight in, as this allows you to use as many battalions as possible without sustaining a combat width penalty. Only full divisions can join a fight. Fielding more divisions than the battlefield combat width supports will result in penalties. When this happens, the Battle Interface will automatically put these extra divisions into reserve. Frontage Reduction can reduce the amount of width taken up by divisions, thus allowing more to be used or slightly bigger divisions to be fielded.
mjxrj4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 代表师在前线作战时占据的空间。要想加入战斗，师必须放进战场提供的战斗宽度之内。每个师占据的宽度越小，能同时向敌人开火的师就越多。不过，把师编得又多又薄也有代价。不同类型的营为师增加的战斗宽度不同。例如，步兵营和装甲营占用 2 宽度，火炮营占用 3 宽度，反坦克炮营和防空炮营占用 1 宽度。支援连不会增加师的战斗宽度（详见⟦1⟧）。大规模强攻⟦2⟧树中有可减少⟦3⟧营战斗宽度的选项，而山地兵特种部队学说树配合⟦4⟧则有一个可减少⟦5⟧营战斗宽度的选项。师的战斗宽度为所有营战斗宽度的⟦6⟧。关于战斗宽度的说明：战场提供的常规最大战斗宽度因地形而异。如果进攻的师来自多个省份，则每多一个省份都会为战场增加额外宽度，具体取决于被攻击的地形类型。某些战斗战术可以增加或减少一场战斗的战斗宽度。最好使用战斗宽度能整除你所打算作战地形战斗宽度的师，这样才能在不承受战斗宽度惩罚的前提下投入尽可能多的营。只有完整的师才能加入战斗。投入的师超过战场战斗宽度所能容纳的数量会招致惩罚，此时战斗界面会自动把这些多出的师放入预备队。战线缩窄可以减少师所占用的宽度，从而能够投入更多师，或者让略大一些的师上场。

jwitde.en: The normal maximum combat width provided by the battlefield varies by ⟦0⟧.
jwitde.zh: 战场提供的常规最大战斗宽度因⟦0⟧而异。

su196l.en: If attacking divisions come from more than one province, then extra width is added to the battlefield for each province, based on the type of ⟦0⟧ that is being attacked.
su196l.zh: 如果进攻的师来自多个省份，则每多一个省份都会为战场增加额外宽度，具体取决于被攻击的⟦0⟧类型。

33slye.en: Certain ⟦0⟧ can increase or decrease a battle's combat width.
33slye.zh: 某些⟦0⟧可以增加或减少一场战斗的战斗宽度。

1id8bcm.en: It is best to use divisions whose combat widths are factors of the combat width of the ⟦0⟧ you intend to fight in, as this allows you to use as many battalions as possible without sustaining a combat width penalty.
1id8bcm.zh: 最好使用战斗宽度能整除你所打算作战⟦0⟧战斗宽度的师，这样才能在不承受战斗宽度惩罚的前提下投入尽可能多的营。

1r0uq0v.en: Only full divisions can join a fight.
1r0uq0v.zh: 只有完整的师才能加入战斗。

nfa08x.en: Fielding more divisions than the battlefield combat width supports will result in penalties. When this happens, the Battle Interface will automatically put these extra divisions into reserve.
nfa08x.zh: 投入的师超过战场战斗宽度所能容纳的数量会招致惩罚。此时战斗界面会自动把这些多出的师放入预备队。

14r8r10.en: Frontage Reduction can reduce the amount of width taken up by divisions, thus allowing more to be used or slightly bigger divisions to be fielded.
14r8r10.zh: 战线缩窄可以减少师所占用的宽度，从而能够投入更多师，或者让略大一些的师上场。

17i82vt.en: ⟦0⟧ Represents what proportion of the division is made up of battalions which are hardened and protected, that is, how "hard" the division is. It is the proportion of hard attacks to soft attacks that an incoming unit receives. Units with more hardness will take less soft attack and more hard attack, while units with less hardness will take more soft attack and less hard attack. Different battalions have different levels of hardness. For example, ⟦1⟧ are very soft (0%), ⟦2⟧ are slightly harder (20%), ⟦3⟧ are fairly hard (60-75%), ⟦4⟧ are quite hard (90%), and ⟦5⟧ are the hardest (100%). Multiply this with the attacker's hard attack and multiply 1 - Hardness (i.e. softness) with the attacker's soft attack to find out how many attacks are made against the division. Divisions with high hardness will suffer more of the hard attacks and fewer of the soft attacks directed at them. The hardness for the division is the ⟦6⟧ of those of all line battalions, but not support companies.
17i82vt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 代表师中由经过硬化防护的营所占的比例，也就是该师有多「硬」。它决定了来袭单位对该师发起的硬攻与软攻之间的比例。硬度较高的单位承受的软攻更少、硬攻更多，而硬度较低的单位承受的软攻更多、硬攻更少。不同的营硬度不同。例如，⟦1⟧非常软（0%），⟦2⟧稍硬一些（20%），⟦3⟧相当硬（60-75%），⟦4⟧很硬（90%），而⟦5⟧最硬（100%）。将硬度乘以进攻方的硬攻，将 1 - 硬度（即软度）乘以进攻方的软攻，即可得出对该师发起的各类攻击次数。硬度高的师会承受更多指向它的硬攻和更少的软攻。师的硬度为所有一线营该项数值的⟦6⟧，但不包括支援连。

wtph3u.en: ⟦0⟧ capacity: How much ⟦1⟧ a unit can store. Higher fuel capacity means that the unit will be able to operate at full capacity longer when it lacks fuel supply. Most units that consume fuel will add 96⟦2⟧ hours' worth of their fuel usage to the division's fuel capacity, though there are ways to increase this. The stat for the division is the ⟦3⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
wtph3u.zh: ⟦0⟧ 容量：单位能储存多少⟦1⟧。燃料容量越高，单位在燃料补给不足时就能越久地保持全力运作。大多数消耗燃料的单位会将其 96⟦2⟧小时的燃料消耗量加入师的燃料容量，不过也有办法提高这一数值。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦3⟧。

xdfz5t.en: Fuel Usage: How much fuel a unit uses while it is operating. Land units with fuel consumption will consume fuel when moving, in combat, or training. Divisions low on fuel can only be refueled in provinces with enough ⟦0⟧. Using ⟦1⟧ support companies can lower a division's fuel usage. The stat for the division is the ⟦2⟧ of those of all battalions and companies, though some support companies do not increase fuel usage despite requiring equipment that normally requires fuel.
xdfz5t.zh: 燃料消耗：单位运作时消耗多少燃料。有燃料消耗的陆军单位在移动、战斗或训练时都会消耗燃料。燃料不足的师只能在拥有足够⟦0⟧的省份补充燃料。编入⟦1⟧支援连可以降低师的燃料消耗。师的该数值为所有营和连该项数值的⟦2⟧，不过某些支援连虽然需要通常耗油的装备，却不会增加燃料消耗。

10hnfgp.en: Paradrop: A simple true or false check if the division can be ⟦0⟧. For it to be true, all line battalions must be ⟦1⟧. However, most support companies can be mixed in freely.
10hnfgp.zh: 空降：简单地判断该师能否被⟦0⟧。要满足条件，所有一线营都必须是⟦1⟧。不过，大多数支援连都可以自由混编。

tb0nkt.en: Special Forces Cap: The amount of special forces battalions that a country can field is capped based on the total amount of non-special forces battalions it has deployed. Divisions cannot be changed, trained, given a different template or have their template adjusted if that would result in exceeding that cap. See ⟦0⟧.
tb0nkt.zh: 特种部队上限：一个国家能够投入的特种部队营数量，取决于其已部署的非特种部队营总数。如果改动、训练、更换师编制或调整师编制会导致超出该上限，就无法进行。参见⟦0⟧。

snbsc4.en: Each division will require a certain amount of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and training time to produce. Most of these values are simply a ⟦2⟧, except training time, which is based on the ⟦3⟧ training time of any Battalion or Company. Reference ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧.
snbsc4.zh: 每个师都需要一定数量的⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和训练时间来生产。这些数值大多是简单的⟦2⟧，训练时间除外——它取决于该师中任一营或连最长的⟦3⟧训练时间。参见⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧。

k0eoh9.en: ⟦0⟧ can influence the performance of different unit types in offense, defence and even movement. Terrain modifiers are ⟦1⟧ between all Battalions, but those of Support Companies are ⟦2⟧.
k0eoh9.zh: ⟦0⟧会影响不同单位类型在进攻、防御乃至移动方面的表现。地形修正是在所有营之间⟦1⟧的，而支援连的同类修正则是⟦2⟧的。

1bp6l4g.en: NOTE: The table below is not fully accurate. The table below is prepared using first generation equipment. Detailed information for subsequent generations will be found in ⟦0⟧ and for a comparison of equipment of equivalent generation: ⟦1⟧. Generally non-combat statistics are defined per battalion. But combat statistics are a function of equipment and thus not static. Additionally, battalions add modifiers to its equipment. For example, a Marine combat battalion adds +30% Breakthrough to its infantry equipment while an artillery support company has a -40% Soft Attack, -40% Hard Attack, -40% Defence, and -40% Breakthrough to its artillery equipment. If a battalion uses multiple types of equipment, the stats are a sum of all the equipment used. For example, Mechanized battalions use both Weapon and Mechanized equipment (with a 10% bonus to Weapon Soft Attack and 500% bonus to Weapon Hard Attack). Support Equipment adds nothing to combat stats.
1bp6l4g.zh: 注意：下表并不完全准确。下表是按第一代装备编制的。后续世代的详细信息可在⟦0⟧中查到，同代装备之间的对比则见⟦1⟧。一般来说，非战斗统计数值按营定义，而战斗统计数值是装备的函数，因此并非固定不变。此外，营还会为其装备添加修正。例如，海军陆战营为其步兵装备增加 +30% 突破，而火炮支援连则为其火炮装备带来 -40% 软攻、-40% 硬攻、-40% 防御和 -40% 突破。如果一个营使用多种装备，其属性为所用全部装备之和。例如，机械化营同时使用武器和机械化装备（武器软攻获得 10% 加成，武器硬攻获得 500% 加成）。支援装备不提供任何战斗属性。

pj5lq5.en: Most land unit battalions can be placed in brigade columns and are often referred to as ⟦0⟧. Battalions that need to be placed in the support column are instead called ⟦1⟧. See ⟦2⟧ for more details.
pj5lq5.zh: 大多数陆军单位营都可以放在旅列中，通常被称为⟦0⟧。而需要放在支援列的营则称为⟦1⟧。更多细节参见⟦2⟧。
