4vps38.en: ⟦0⟧, sometimes referred to as ⟦1⟧, are different from other units in a lot of ways.
4vps38.zh: ⟦0⟧，有时被称为 ⟦1⟧，在很多方面与其他单位不同。

1ddi5tj.en: Production of railway artillery is similar to the production of ⟦0⟧ in which the equipment and the unit are essentially one and the same. When one railway artillery piece is produced, it automatically gets deployed in the nation's capital.
1ddi5tj.zh: 列车炮的生产与 ⟦0⟧ 的生产类似，装备和单位本质上是同一回事。生产出一门列车炮后，它会自动部署到该国首都。

1i0c0if.en: Railway artillery movement on land is limited to only on railway lines. Railway artillery can be transported over water by first manually moving it to a railway-connected port before embarking it to another port. Embarked railway artillery ignores ⟦0⟧, so care must be taken to move them in ways where they avoid sea zones that the player wishes them to avoid.
1i0c0if.zh: 列车炮在陆地上的移动仅限于铁路线。列车炮可以先手动移动到与铁路相连的港口，再装船运往另一个港口，从而跨海运输。装船后的列车炮会忽略 ⟦0⟧，因此必须谨慎规划运输路线，避开玩家希望其避开的海域。

179tm5i.en: Railway artillery cannot be assigned to any commanders directly, though like air wings, they can be assigned to land units and will follow their assigned units as best as they can. They can also be assigned to control groups, just like other land units.
179tm5i.zh: 列车炮不能直接指派给任何指挥官，但它们和航空队一样，可以配属给陆军单位，并会尽可能跟随所配属的单位。它们也可以像其他陆军单位一样编入控制组。

17mm61.en: Railway artillery doesn't attack other units directly, it instead applies a debuff to nearby enemy units engaged in combat, similar to ⟦0⟧. If a railway artillery unit has been recently moved, its bombardment bonus will decrease for 24 hours⟦1⟧ and take some time to recover. If multiple railway artillery are in range of a single battle, only the one with the greatest bombardment will take part.
17mm61.zh: 列车炮不会直接攻击其他单位，而是对附近参与战斗的敌方单位施加负面修正，效果类似 ⟦0⟧。如果列车炮单位最近移动过，其轰击加成会在 24 小时内下降⟦1⟧，并需要一些时间才能恢复。如果多门列车炮都在同一场战斗的射程内，只有轰击值最高的那门会参与。

j559tv.en: Railway artillery are affected by ⟦0⟧, including both their movement speed (which decreases to up to ⟦1⟧ in low supply) and their bombardment. Unlike other land units, supply for railway artillery cannot be motorized at a unit- or army-level, so supply hubs must be motorized manually.
j559tv.zh: 列车炮受 ⟦0⟧ 影响，包括其移动速度（在补给不足时会下降至多 ⟦1⟧）和轰击效果。与其他陆军单位不同，列车炮的补给无法在单位或集团军层级摩托化，因此必须手动为补给中心摩托化。

157a5f9.en: Railway artillery can be damaged by enemy ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ air missions that target ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ of damage from ⟦4⟧ missions spills over onto railway artillery in the state, while ⟦5⟧ of damage from ⟦6⟧ missions spills over onto railway artillery in the state. Damaged railway guns must be repaired with ⟦7⟧ and will appear in a country's ⟦8⟧ queue.
157a5f9.zh: 列车炮可能被敌方 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 空中任务击伤，这些任务以 ⟦2⟧ 为目标。⟦3⟧ 的伤害来自 ⟦4⟧ 任务，会波及该州的列车炮；而 ⟦5⟧ 的伤害来自 ⟦6⟧ 任务，也会波及该州的列车炮。受损的列车炮必须用 ⟦7⟧ 修复，并会出现在该国的 ⟦8⟧ 队列中。

18v8c3j.en: Railway artillery can be captured when it is overrun or when its controlling country is capitulates or is annexed. When they are overrun, railway artillery have a ⟦0⟧ chance of being captured. This can be increased with higher Equipment Capture Ratio on the overrunning unit. When their controlling country capitulates or is annexed, ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ of their railway artillery pieces are transferred to their new owners.
18v8c3j.zh: 列车炮在其被击溃、其控制国投降或被吞并时可能被缴获。被击溃时，列车炮有 ⟦0⟧ 的概率被缴获。击溃它的单位装备缴获比率越高，该概率越大。当其控制国投降或被吞并时，其 ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ 列车炮会被移交给新的所有者。

2b6k60.en: Equipment is produced by ⟦0⟧ Lines. All units use Equipment of some sort. An Equipment Type is a more abstract grouping, such as Medium Tanks. A Division that has a ⟦1⟧ that uses Medium Tanks can use any type of Medium Tank Equipment to fill its Equipment needs. The statistics of a unit are determined by the statistics of its equipment types. This may be modified by the unit itself; for example, ⟦2⟧ typically get penalties to most combat statistics.
2b6k60.zh: 装备由 ⟦0⟧ 生产线生产。所有单位都会使用某种装备。装备类型是更抽象的归类，例如中型坦克。一个师若拥有使用中型坦克的 ⟦1⟧，就可以使用任何类型的中型坦克装备来满足其装备需求。单位的属性由其装备类型的属性决定。这可能会被单位本身修正；例如 ⟦2⟧ 通常在大多数战斗属性上会受到惩罚。

1mn9tsw.en: Hearts of Iron IV has 293 (191 on Xbox) different ⟦0⟧, all using the Steam or Xbox achievements mechanics. Achievements have no in-game effects; the achievement just pops up in-game, and is then added to the player's Steam or Xbox profile depending on the version of the game. It is possible to see the achievements sorted by the percentage of users that managed to complete each achievement by going to the game's global achievements at Steam or by using the built-in Sort options in the Xbox achievements list.
1mn9tsw.zh: 《钢铁雄心 IV》共有 293 个（Xbox 版为 191 个）不同的⟦0⟧，均使用 Steam 或 Xbox 的成就机制。成就对游戏本身没有任何影响；成就只会在游戏中弹出提示，随后根据游戏版本添加到玩家的 Steam 或 Xbox 个人资料中。在 Steam 上进入游戏的全球成就页面，或使用 Xbox 成就列表内置的排序选项，即可按达成每个成就的用户百分比查看成就排行。

1ti9ueq.en: Achievements can only be gained in single-player ⟦0⟧ games, with the 1936 start, on ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ difficulty. (30 Minutes of Hel and Don’t Die for Your Country can only be completed in the 1939 start date). They can be earned while playing older versions of the game as long as said achievements were present in that version. They can also be earned with ⟦4⟧ set to off. (Note: There is no "end date", the game can be continued indefinitely)
1ti9ueq.zh: 成就只能在单人⟦0⟧游戏中获得，须使用 1936 年开局，难度为⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧。（30 Minutes of Hel 与 Don’t Die for Your Country 只能在 1939 年开局下完成）。只要旧版本中存在相应成就，游玩旧版本时也可以获得。将⟦4⟧设为关闭时同样可以获得。（注意：游戏没有“结束日期”，可以无限期玩下去）

fqg4uj.en: It is not possible to gain achievements if the ⟦0⟧ has been changed - either by tampering with game files, or by running the game using mods that affect gameplay mechanics (graphical mods do not affect checksum), or a corrupted installation.
fqg4uj.zh: 如果⟦0⟧发生变化，就无法获得成就——无论是篡改游戏文件、使用会影响游戏机制的模组运行游戏（图形类模组不会影响校验和），还是安装文件损坏。

sc8jdy.en: Please note that the Xbox version of the game is no longer kept up to parity with Steam since March 1st, 2024⟦0⟧ and as such, the Xbox version does not have achievements for Trial of Allegiance and will not receive any future expansions.
sc8jdy.zh: 请注意，自 2024 年 3 月 1 日⟦0⟧起，Xbox 版游戏已不再与 Steam 版保持同步，因此 Xbox 版没有《效忠审判》的成就，也不会获得任何后续扩展内容。

17fkpvv.en: Although changing custom game rules usually locks a game out of being eligible for achievements, using the tab "AI Behavior" along with unchecking Historical AI Focuses can allow you to haphazardly preset what nations you want to be historical or not.
17fkpvv.zh: 虽然更改自定义游戏规则通常会使游戏失去获得成就的资格，但使用「AI 行为」选项卡并取消勾选历史AI焦点，就能大致预设你希望哪些国家走历史路线、哪些不走。

1egffdb.en: Uncheck ⟦0⟧ Go into Custom Game Rules and into the AI behavior tab. Changing a country's path from ⟦1⟧ to a defined path makes the game non-iron man, but not if you specifically select the historical route, e.g. changing ⟦2⟧'s path from ⟦3⟧ to ⟦4⟧. Now change every country you want to stay historical from ⟦5⟧ to their ironman-compatible set path, with every country you want to possibly go a-historical still set on ⟦6⟧. This way, the game will only have countries with Default set as their path possibly go non-historical, though it is not guaranteed.
1egffdb.zh: 取消勾选⟦0⟧。进入自定义游戏规则，再进入 AI 行为选项卡。把某个国家的路线从⟦1⟧改为指定路线会使游戏不再是铁人模式，但专门选择历史路线则不会，例如把⟦2⟧的路线从⟦3⟧改为⟦4⟧。接着，把所有你想保持历史路线的国家从⟦5⟧改为其铁人兼容的固定路线，而所有你可能希望走非历史路线的国家仍保持⟦6⟧。这样，只有路线设为默认的国家才可能走非历史路线，但这并不保证一定发生。

rn1wdu.en: This allows you to, for example:

1705sqa.en: Only set ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, which will possibly make them go non-historical and not attack the ⟦2⟧, who will, in turn, not join the Allies. This is especially useful for world conquest runs as it allows you to beat the Allies after 1941.
1705sqa.zh: 只把⟦0⟧设为⟦1⟧，这可能会让它走非历史路线，从而不进攻⟦2⟧，而它也就不会加入同盟国。这对世界征服流程尤其有用，因为这样你可以在 1941 年之后击败同盟国。

avm02l.en: Only set ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, which possibly makes the UK disband the Allies. Again, very useful for runs in which you have to beat the Allies.
avm02l.zh: 只把⟦0⟧设为⟦1⟧，这有可能让英国解散同盟国。同样，这在你必须击败同盟国的流程中非常有用。

1wnjck4.en: Note that other countries might still go non-historical although you set them to their historical path, likely due to focuses from a-historical nations influencing these.
1wnjck4.zh: 注意，即使你把其他国家设为历史路线，它们仍可能走非历史路线，这通常是因为非历史国家的焦点影响了它们。

107fg7h.en: The descriptions on this page are taken from the in-game achievement list; the descriptions on Steam (or other platforms) may be different.
107fg7h.zh: 本页描述取自游戏内成就列表；Steam（或其他平台）上的描述可能有所不同。

1y1i7cs.en: The ⟦0⟧ column includes clarifying information regarding the achievement and helpful tips/guides. Please keep this section concise and as short as possible.
1y1i7cs.zh: ⟦0⟧列包含关于该成就的补充说明以及实用技巧/攻略。请尽量保持这一部分简明扼要。

1bzmcdy.en: The column denotes achievements which can't be completed without the use of DLC mechanics (currently 92 out of 249). Multiple expansion icons mean either can be used.
1bzmcdy.zh: 该列标示若不使用 DLC 机制便无法完成的成就（目前 249 个中有 92 个）。出现多个扩展图标表示使用其中任意一个均可。

oyuagx.en: The ⟦0⟧ column indicates in which version a certain achievement was added. Achievements cannot be earned prior to the version they were added in.
oyuagx.zh: ⟦0⟧列标示某个成就加入游戏的版本。在成就加入的版本之前无法获得该成就。

cf0nan.en: The ⟦0⟧ column indicates the achievement's difficulty level. It can be changed according to player consensus.
cf0nan.zh: ⟦0⟧列标示成就的难度等级，可根据玩家共识进行修改。

fgfwjk.en: The difficulty levels are:⟦0⟧ = Very Easy,⟦1⟧ = Easy,⟦2⟧ = Medium,⟦3⟧ = Hard,⟦4⟧ = Very Hard,⟦5⟧ = Insane,⟦6⟧ = Uncategorized.
fgfwjk.zh: 难度等级为：⟦0⟧ = 非常简单，⟦1⟧ = 简单，⟦2⟧ = 中等，⟦3⟧ = 困难，⟦4⟧ = 非常困难，⟦5⟧ = 疯狂，⟦6⟧ = 未分类。

1bupldf.zh: Friend in Need加入一个阵营。

1vggji8.en: Play as ⟦0⟧, right click on the ⟦1⟧, click "Ask to join Faction", and click "Send" on the pop-up. It's that simple.
1vggji8.zh: 扮演⟦0⟧，右键点击⟦1⟧，点击「请求加入阵营」，再在弹出的窗口中点击「发送」。就这么简单。

19fkfax.zh: Time is on our side坚持到 1948 年。

1t6ieeq.en: Can be completed as any country, but play as ⟦0⟧ on historical, for example, if you want to AFK.
1t6ieeq.zh: 任何国家都可以完成，但如果你想挂机，可以例如在历史模式下扮演⟦0⟧。

1jspgba.zh: Canada First以加拿大加入轴心国。

1gs2px2.en: In faction with Germany Germany is a faction leader
1gs2px2.zh: 与德国同属一个阵营 德国是阵营领袖

11wfrpl.en: On historical mode, simply go down the focus path towards ⟦0⟧. Note: The faction does not need be the Axis, but it must be led by Germany.
11wfrpl.zh: 在历史模式下，只需沿着通向⟦0⟧的焦点路线走下去。注意：该阵营不必是轴心国，但必须由德国领导。

66ykd1.en: We'll Build it in a DayResearch Construction V.
66ykd1.zh: We'll Build it in a Day研究建造 V。

xne8nm.en: Stack up as many bonuses to research speed (especially industrial research speed) as possible and rush your way down the industrial branch. Eventually, you will reach Construction V.
xne8nm.zh: 尽可能叠加科研速度加成（尤其是工业科研速度），然后一路速推工业分支。最终你就能研究到建造 V。

grymog.zh: Transport Tycoon拥有至少 1000 艘运输船队。

1h32krv.en: As the United States or United Kingdom, set all of your Naval dockyards to convoy production and stay out of any wars.
1h32krv.zh: 以美国或英国开局，把所有海军船坞都设为生产运输船队，并避免卷入任何战争。

17x6fu5.zh: Destroyer of Worlds部署一枚核弹。

3fau0l.en: This achievement is ideally tackled as a nation that can receive more than just the standard nuclear research bonus in the generic focus tree. Germany is an ideal choice if one goes Democratic, given that on top of a bonus to nuclear weapons, it can get an ahead of time bonus on nukes.
3fau0l.zh: 完成这个成就最好选择能在通用国策树中获得常规核研究加成之外更多加成的国家。如果走民主主义路线，德国是理想选择，因为除了核武器加成之外，它还能获得核武器的超前研发加成。

12eve0z.en: WunderwaffenHas completed the Special Projects Nuclear Fission Bomb, Rocket Interceptor and Jet Engines.
12eve0z.zh: Wunderwaffen已完成特殊项目：核裂变炸弹、火箭截击机与喷气发动机。

1amt3u5.en: Has completed special project Nuclear Fission Bomb Project Has completed special project Me 163 Komet (Rocket Interceptor) Has completed special project Jet Engine
1amt3u5.zh: 已完成特殊项目 核裂变炸弹项目 已完成特殊项目 Me 163 彗星（火箭截击机） 已完成特殊项目 喷气发动机

1sn6rxp.en: Follow the strategy for Poland Can Into Space achievement and simply research additional technologies.
1sn6rxp.zh: 按照 Poland Can Into Space 成就的思路操作，再额外研究一些科技即可。

13gq9hb.en: United NetherlandsConquer Belgium and Luxembourg as Netherlands.
13gq9hb.zh: United Netherlands以荷兰征服比利时与卢森堡。

j15wvj.en: Owns and controls: Vlaanderen (6) Wallonie (34) Antwerpen (977) Ardennes (980) Luxembourg (8) Brabant (35) Holland (7) Friesland (36)
j15wvj.zh: 拥有并控制：弗兰德斯（6） 瓦隆（34） 安特卫普（977） 阿登（980） 卢森堡（8） 布拉班特（35） 荷兰（7） 弗里斯兰（36）

6ua7zp.en: For detailed strategies, see United Netherlands (achievement)
6ua7zp.zh: 详细攻略请见 United Netherlands（成就）

t1x7qn.en: Vive la FranceReach 1948 as France without capitulating or surrendering.
t1x7qn.zh: Vive la France以法国坚持到 1948 年，且未投降或屈服。

1vtbmbu.en: Has surrendered Has capitulated After Dec 31st, 1947
1vtbmbu.zh: 已屈服 已投降 1947 年 12 月 31 日之后

17bsed5.en: Flip to fascism through an advisor or national foci, and join the Axis. Do not join any wars. Just AFK until 1948.
17bsed5.zh: 通过顾问或国策转为法西斯主义，并加入轴心国。不要加入任何战争。直接挂机到 1948 年。

11wjesq.en: Master of WarFully research a land, air and naval doctrine tree.
11wjesq.zh: Master of War完整研究一条陆军、空军和海军学说树。

1x2emfh.en: Has completed doctrine track: Infantry Has completed doctrine track: Artillery & Combat Support Has completed doctrine track: Armor Has completed doctrine track: Operations Has completed doctrine track: Capital Ships Has completed doctrine track: Carriers Has completed doctrine track: Screens Has completed doctrine track: Submarines Has completed doctrine track: Fighter Aircraft Has completed doctrine track: Strike Aircraft Has completed doctrine track: Medium Aircraft Has completed doctrine track: Heavy Aircraft
1x2emfh.zh: 已完成学说路线：步兵 已完成学说路线：火炮与战斗支援 已完成学说路线：装甲 已完成学说路线：作战 已完成学说路线：主力舰 已完成学说路线：航空母舰 已完成学说路线：护航舰 已完成学说路线：潜艇 已完成学说路线：战斗机 已完成学说路线：攻击机 已完成学说路线：中型飞机 已完成学说路线：重型飞机

1s9cm21.en: Mine is bigger than yoursLead a faction with at least 20 members.
1s9cm21.zh: Mine is bigger than yours领导一个有至少 20 个成员的阵营。

d4dicv.en: Is Faction leader Faction has at least 20 members
d4dicv.zh: 是阵营领袖 阵营拥有至少 20 个成员

1phfbuy.en: Just play as the United Kingdom and go down the Revisit Colonial Policy branch to release all occupied land as puppets.
1phfbuy.zh: 只需扮演英国，沿重新审视殖民政策分支走下去，把所有占领的土地作为傀儡国释放。

14k82vd.en: No country for old menReach 0 manpower with Scraping the Barrel as Conscription Law.
14k82vd.zh: No country for old men在征兵法令为搜刮到底时把人力降到 0。

1knsi57.en: Has conscription law Scraping the Barrel Has 0 manpower
1knsi57.zh: 征兵法令为搜刮到底 人力为 0

7rtcr.en: On historical mode, start as Luxembourg and do absolutely nothing. Save up 750+ political power. When Germany declares war on you, make sure to join the Allies. Since you have no divisions, the Germans will capitulate you almost immediately. Once capitulated, change your conscription law to Scraping the Barrel, and the achievement should fire.
7rtcr.zh: 在历史模式下，以卢森堡开局，什么都不做。攒够 750 以上政治点数。当德国向你宣战时，务必加入同盟国。由于你没有师，德国人几乎会立刻让你投降。投降后，把征兵法令改为搜刮到底，成就就会触发。

1todtqg.en: Poland Can Into SpaceHas completed the Special Project Rocket Interceptor.
1todtqg.zh: Poland Can Into Space已完成特殊项目：火箭截击机。

6xutqm.en: Concede territory to avoid wars and just research. Even when you get overrun and conquered by Germany and/or the Soviet Union, you will continue the game as a government-in-exile hosted by the United Kingdom and remain eligible for the achievement. As long as the Allies survive, you can continue doing research to get the achievement.
6xutqm.zh: 割让领土以避免战争，专心科研。即使你被德国和/或苏联攻占并征服，你也会作为由英国收留的流亡政府继续游戏，并依然有资格获得该成就。只要同盟国还存在，你就可以继续科研以拿到成就。

uqa6yp.en: True BlitzkriegAs Germany have both Poland and France surrender before January 1st 1940.
uqa6yp.zh: True Blitzkrieg以德国让波兰和法国在 1940 年 1 月 1 日之前屈服。

1w0zd9h.en: Before Jan 1st, 1940 France either: Does not exist Has capitulated Has surrendered Poland does not exist or has capitulated
1w0zd9h.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日之前 法国满足任一条件： 不存在 已投降 已屈服 波兰不存在或已投降

1d1paco.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧: Does not exist Has capitulated Has surrendered
1d1paco.zh: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧：不存在 已投降 已屈服

5et0pf.en: Both nations need to be either capitulated or annexed. Neither of them can be a puppet. For detailed strategies, see True Blitzkrieg
5et0pf.zh: 这两个国家都必须已投降或被吞并。它们都不能是傀儡国。详细攻略请见 True Blitzkrieg

1uk044w.en: Northern LightAs a Scandinavian country form your own faction, and have Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland in it.
1uk044w.zh: Northern Light以斯堪的纳维亚国家建立自己的阵营，并让丹麦、瑞典、挪威和芬兰加入其中。

1e4w3ey.en: Playing as either: Denmark Finland Norway Sweden
1e4w3ey.zh: 扮演以下任一国家： 丹麦 芬兰 挪威 瑞典

bpwt5j.zh: 丹麦 芬兰 挪威 瑞典

14ldt1o.en: Is a faction leader In faction with: Norway Denmark Sweden Finland
14ldt1o.zh: 是阵营领袖 与以下国家同属一个阵营： 挪威 丹麦 瑞典 芬兰

1gpuj18.zh: 与以下国家同属一个阵营：

7rtvv3.zh: 挪威 丹麦 瑞典 芬兰

1l71fpy.en: On historical mode, play as Finland. Wait for world tension to reach 50% so you can do the Northern Defense Front national focus, which makes a faction and invites the other Scandinavian countries to it. The AI should join if it is not already in a faction.
1l71fpy.zh: 在历史模式下扮演芬兰。等待世界紧张度达到 50%，这样你就能执行北方防线国策，它会建立一个阵营并邀请其他斯堪的纳维亚国家加入。如果 AI 尚未加入其他阵营，通常都会接受。

237swo.en: Nobody expects...As Nationalist Spain in Axis manage to take Paris before the Germans.
237swo.zh: Nobody expects...以轴心国中的国民西班牙赶在德国人之前拿下巴黎。

1ljmk86.en: Ruling party is Fascist In faction with Germany Germany is a faction leader Controls Ile de France (16)
1ljmk86.zh: 执政党为法西斯主义 与德国同属一个阵营 德国是阵营领袖 控制法兰西岛（16）

drakdn.en: Go down the Unify the Nationalist Front path, win the civil war, and head for Join the Axis. Join the war once Germany attacks the Benelux and gain enough war score for Germany to give you control of Ile de France (16).
drakdn.zh: 沿统一民族阵线路线走下去，赢得内战，然后走加入轴心国。等德国进攻比荷卢时加入战争，并积累足够的战争贡献，让德国把法兰西岛（16）的控制权交给你。

vf4xi9.en: The bell tolls for usWin Spanish Civil War as Republican Spain.
vf4xi9.zh: The bell tolls for us（丧钟为我们而鸣）以共和西班牙赢得西班牙内战。

12firbt.en: Ruling party is Fascist Won the Spanish Civil War Ruling party is Communist or Democratic
12firbt.zh: 执政党为法西斯主义 赢得西班牙内战 执政党为共产主义或民主主义

6kvjnl.en: Even if the civil war hasn't ended, capitulating one of the other factions (Anarchists/Fascists/Carlists) in the civil war as the Republicans will trigger the achievement.
6kvjnl.zh: 即使内战尚未结束，以共和派迫使内战中其他派系之一（无政府主义者/法西斯主义者/卡洛斯派）投降也会触发该成就。

1a8ctl2.en: The Revolution TriumphantHave Germany as a puppet of Soviet.
1a8ctl2.zh: The Revolution Triumphant让德国成为苏联的傀儡国。

10607rx.en: Follow the historical route, or immediately declare war on Poland and then Germany.
10607rx.zh: 沿历史路线走，或者立刻向波兰宣战，然后再向德国宣战。

mh53a6.en: Once More MateOccupy Gallipoli as Australia.
mh53a6.zh: Once More Mate以澳大利亚占领加里波利。

1868cf3.en: You need to move your fleet into the Black Sea before Turkey remilitarises the Bosphorus Strait. You can increase its range by basing it in Cyprus. Go down the Empower the Workers path towards Join Comintern. Justify a wargoal on Turkey and attack from the Soviet Union. Turkey will guard Istanbul, but leave Erdine undefended. Call them into the war and naval invade Edirne (341). The achievement only requires control of the state, so it can be gained while at war.
1868cf3.zh: 你需要在土耳其重新武装博斯普鲁斯海峡之前把舰队开进黑海。把舰队基地设在塞浦路斯可以增加其航程。沿赋予工人权力路线走到加入共产国际。对土耳其制造战争目标，并从苏联方向发起进攻。土耳其会防守伊斯坦布尔，但会留下埃迪尔内不设防。把他们拉进战争，然后海军登陆埃迪尔内（341）。该成就只要求控制该州，因此在战争期间即可达成。

1cvfpbl.en: Forge of VictoryHave 50 factories as Belgium.
1cvfpbl.zh: Forge of Victory以比利时拥有 50 座工厂。

12pfedg.en: Naval dockyards count toward total factories. Simply go Fascist and conquer Netherlands and Luxembourg. If you end up at war with the Allies, don't worry. Simply join the Axis. When Germany punches into France through your territory and capitulates them, you will occupy all of France, thus giving you the necessary factories.
12pfedg.zh: 海军船坞也计入工厂总数。直接转法西斯主义，征服荷兰和卢森堡。如果你最终与同盟国开战，也不必担心，直接加入轴心国。当德国借道你的领土突入法国并迫使其投降时，你将占领整个法国，从而获得所需的工厂。

za016o.en: Sunset InvasionOccupy a coastal province in Europe as Mexico, and if in a faction have it contain only South American members or puppets.
za016o.zh: Sunset Invasion以墨西哥占领欧洲的一个沿海省份；若加入阵营，该阵营只能包含南美成员或傀儡国。

31ao48.en: Has joined a faction with non-South American members Controls any coastal state on the European continent
31ao48.zh: 加入了包含非南美成员的阵营 控制欧洲大陆上的任意沿海州

hvzjnr.en: Has joined a faction with non-South American members
hvzjnr.zh: 加入了包含非南美成员的阵营

16qfik8.en: Controls any coastal state on the European continent
16qfik8.zh: 控制欧洲大陆上的任意沿海州

wca6d1.en: You only need to occupy the state. Turn fascist and justify on Denmark. Build ~10 submarines and declare war. Capture a port in Greenland and then invade Iceland. Note that you cannot be in a faction with countries outside South America.
wca6d1.zh: 你只需要占领该州。转法西斯主义并对丹麦制造战争目标。建造约 10 艘潜艇并宣战。夺取格陵兰的一个港口，然后登陆冰岛。注意，你不能与南美以外的国家同处一个阵营。

1rpmd9q.en: Duce Nuked'emNuke Los Angeles as fascist Italy.
1rpmd9q.zh: Duce Nuked'em以法西斯意大利核袭洛杉矶。

3re609.en: Ruling party is Fascist Has dropped a nuclear bomb in California
3re609.zh: 执政党为法西斯主义 已在加利福尼亚投下核弹

spnpl7.en: Has dropped a nuclear bomb in California
spnpl7.zh: 已在加利福尼亚投下核弹

m945lv.en: After securing the Mediterranean, it can easily be done with a small 1944 strategic bomber fleet (without any escort) by taking control of Gibraltar (118), Azores (698), and Bermuda (696).
m945lv.zh: 控制地中海之后，只要拿下直布罗陀（118）、亚速尔群岛（698）和百慕大（696），用一支 1944 年的小型战略轰炸机队（无需任何护航）就能轻松完成。

1dqe1aq.en: Operation Sea LionControl British mainland as Germany.
1dqe1aq.zh: Operation Sea Lion以德国控制英国本土。

440j5i.en: Controls: South-West England (123) Sussex (127) Gloucestershire (338) Greater London Area (126) East Anglia (125) Wales (122) West Midlands (128) East Midlands (129) Lancashire (132) Yorkshire (130) Northumberland (131) Lanark (133) Lothian (121) Aberdeenshire (136) Scottish Highlands (120)
440j5i.zh: 控制： 英格兰西南部（123） 苏塞克斯（127） 格洛斯特郡（338） 大伦敦地区（126） 东盎格利亚（125） 威尔士（122） 西米德兰兹（128） 东米德兰兹（129） 兰开夏（132） 约克郡（130） 诺森伯兰（131） 拉纳克（133） 洛锡安（121） 阿伯丁郡（136） 苏格兰高地（120）

1tu0j4c.en: Simply follow the guide for True Blitzkrieg which will put Western Europe under your control. At this point, it should be easy to launch an invasion on Yorkshire (130) and Northumberland (131). Get intel on the United Kingdom or call Italy into the war to help with gaining naval superiority. The British Isles will be weakly defended, and once you have a stable port beachhead, it should be trivial to conquer them.
1tu0j4c.zh: 只需按 True Blitzkrieg 的攻略操作，就能把西欧纳入掌控。此时，对约克郡（130）和诺森伯兰（131）发动登陆应该很容易。对英国获取情报，或者把意大利拉进战争以协助夺取制海权。不列颠群岛的防御会很薄弱，一旦你建立起稳固的港口登陆场，征服它们就轻而易举。

fe7bit.en: This is achievement requires a lot of grinding. Go Fascist and keep the empire from falling apart. Take out the United States early and give their territory to Canada to form the Dominion of North America. Later forming the Imperial Federation will then also include the US, giving one of the highest core population possible in the game, especially after also integrating Europe by forming the European Federation. Make sure to justify on as many smaller countries as possible while at war with a major power to speed up the process. Pairs well with New World Order.
fe7bit.zh: 这个成就需要大量重复劳动。转法西斯主义，并防止帝国分崩离析。尽早解决美国，把它的领土交给加拿大以组建北美自治领。之后再组建帝国联邦时就会把美国一并纳入，从而获得游戏中最高的核心人口之一，尤其是在进一步组建欧洲联邦整合欧洲之后。记得在与主要国家交战期间尽可能多地对小国制造战争目标，以加快进度。与 New World Order 搭配完成效果很好。

1hol8i7.en: Choose fascist demagogue as your first Political Power spending, turn fascist (skip civil war option), complete Invite German Military Mission and join the Axis. Justify and declare war on the UK. If playing on historical, signing the Tripartite pact will cause a civil war. So just flip via decision and join the axis manually.

ws37zp.en: Choose the fascist demagogue as your first advisor and turn fascist. Avoid civil war if possible. Join the Axis and help them in their wars. Germany has to survive until they research Tiger tank - at least late 1943. Note: Due to a bug, this achievement cannot be obtained with the No Step Back enabled, because Germany never progresses beyond "Basic Heavy Tank", no matter how long you wait.
ws37zp.zh: 把法西斯煽动家作为你的第一位顾问并转为法西斯主义。尽可能避免内战。加入轴心国并在其战争中协助他们。德国必须存续到研究出虎式坦克为止——至少要撑到 1943 年末。注意：由于一个 bug，在启用《绝不后退》时无法获得该成就，因为无论等多久，德国都不会从「基础重型坦克」继续推进。

1swuu1x.zh: Lethal Straight从 7 个主要国家中的至少 5 个获得生产许可。

exkedy.zh: 英国 德国 美国 苏联 日本 法国 意大利

oeehts.en: It is recommended to play as a non-aligned nation to avoid the diplomatic penalty from different ideology which may block the “Request License Production” option. Improve relations with five of the seven major powers then license the basic infantry weapons. (Researching the next level of infantry equipment also works, as even major nations have few problems with licensing outdated equipment). With La Résistance, you can use an agent and assign him to put diplomatic pressure on majors as well.
oeehts.zh: 建议扮演中立主义国家，以避免因意识形态不同而产生的外交惩罚，该惩罚可能会导致「请求许可生产」选项被封锁。从 7 个主要国家中挑出 5 个改善关系，然后许可生产基础步兵武器。（研究下一级步兵装备也可以，因为即使是主要国家通常也不太介意许可过时装备）。启用《抵抗运动》时，你还可以使用一名特工，派他对主要国家施加外交压力。

1llgq9t.zh: Awake and Angry以中国收复整个中国和满洲，并迫使日本屈服。

1vh1yw9.zh: Romance of the Three Kingdoms（三国演义）以中国傀儡并吞并云南和桂系。

2pnzew.zh: 通过将其变为傀儡国整合了云南

1e2nyvm.en: Play on non-historical and ensure Japan goes for Support the Kodoha Faction. Take Subjugate the Warlords. If they do not accept peacefully, use your war goals to puppet them by force. Complete the series of "Integrate the Warlords" decisions which appear after Guangxi Clique and Yunnan are puppetted. Alternatively, defeat them the old-fashioned way (possibly after taking One China Policy focus) and then reduce their autonomy by building stuff (including border-to-border level 5 forts and supply depots) on their territories and/or lend-leasing supplies to them. The achievement can even be done by annexing them in a war, releasing them as puppets, and then reintegrating them (in case "puppet" is not an available option in the peace conference.)
1e2nyvm.zh: 以非历史模式游玩，并确保日本走支持皇道派。执行征服军阀。如果他们不肯和平接受，就用战争目标以武力将其变为傀儡国。完成在桂系和云南成为傀儡国后出现的一系列「整合军阀」决议。或者用老办法击败他们（可以在执行一个中国政策焦点之后），然后通过在他们领土上建造东西（包括边境到边境的 5 级要塞和补给站）和/或向他们租借补给来降低其自治度。该成就甚至可以通过在战争中吞并他们、将其作为傀儡国释放、再重新整合他们来完成（以防「傀儡」在和平会议中不是可选项）。

nsz6iw.en: As Chinese Soviet Republic, play on non-historical in order to prevent the Sino-Japanese war ( Japan going communist is ideal). Make a fallback line on your capital and declare an early war on China while holding your capital with 9-12 divisions. Research infantry equipment and artillery only (at some point some of your divisions may run out of organization and die, so deploy a few extra divisions before it happens). If the AI stops attacking you, bait it to attack by training your divisions. If a General becomes level 9 before your field marshal, you may promote the General to field marshal and you will get the achievement.
nsz6iw.zh: 作为中华苏维埃共和国，选择非历史路线以避免中日战争（日本转为共产主义最佳）。在首都设置撤退线，并用 9-12 个师守住首都，同时尽早对中国宣战。只研究步兵装备和火炮（某个时刻你的一些师可能因组织度耗尽而被歼灭，所以在此之前多部署几个师）。如果 AI 停止进攻你，就通过训练你的师来引诱它进攻。如果某位将领比你的元帅先升到 9 级，你可以把该将领晋升为元帅，这样就能获得该成就。

17coqi3.en: Note: To get the achievement_the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun country flag, you must annex Japan without being in a faction. The "not in a faction" check is done when Japan gets annexed, so theoretically you are free to join factions during the game if you want to, as long as you leave before you annex Japan. Remember that if you call your faction members to war, you will not be able to leave until after the peace conference. For detailed strategies, see The Dragon Swallowed the Sun
17coqi3.zh: 注意：要获得 achievement_the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun 国家标志，你必须在未加入任何阵营的情况下吞并日本。"not in a faction" 的判定是在日本被吞并时进行的，所以理论上只要你吞并日本之前退出阵营，游戏中途加入阵营也没问题。记住，如果你召唤阵营成员参战，在和平会议结束前你无法退出。详细攻略请见 巨龙吞日（The Dragon Swallowed the Sun）

1wkxxhy.en: Has at least ⟦0⟧ manpower in deployment queue
1wkxxhy.zh: 部署队列中至少有 ⟦0⟧ 人力

1tmfaqw.en: Start as Guangxi Clique and get to 5 Army experience, either by training or hiring military advisor. Create a 1 width division and rush train as many as possible (make sure to set it to the highest priority in the recruiting tab so it gets guns first). Deploy them as soon as they reach the minimum training level and just switch them to the normal template. Note: You can only train 75% of the manpower currently on the field with a minimum of 100.00K. So that means you must have at least 1,333,334 manpower on the field to do this achievement.
1tmfaqw.zh: 以桂系开局，通过训练或雇佣军事顾问把陆军经验提升到 5。创建一个宽度为 1 的师，然后尽可能多地快速训练（务必在招募标签页中把它设为最高优先级，以便优先获得枪械）。当它们达到最低训练等级时立即部署，然后直接把它们换成普通模板。注意：你最多只能训练场上现有兵力的 75%，且下限为 100.00K。这意味着你必须在场上拥有至少 1,333,334 人力才能完成这个成就。

17z5xzb.en: Monarchy is Back in FashionAs Germany, Bring back the Kaiser and ensure that Italy is controlled by Victor Emmanuel by killing Mussolini.
17z5xzb.zh: 君主制再度流行（Monarchy is Back in Fashion）作为德国，迎回皇帝，并通过刺杀墨索里尼确保意大利由维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世控制。

1f510qp.en: Wilhelm II is the current country leader Italy has Vittorio Emanuele III as the current country leader
1f510qp.zh: 威廉二世是现任国家领袖 意大利的现任国家领袖为维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世

1growjz.en: ⟦0⟧ has ⟦1⟧ as the current country leader

kqaywi.zh: 维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世

1aln4c4.en: (This guide requires Götterdämmerung disabled.) Follow the Return of the Kaiser and the Focus on the True Enemy path in the Oppose Hitler branch until you get to the Assassinate Mussolini focus (AI will always agree to assassinate Mussolini). Wilhelm II must be your leader and he must not die before the focus is complete. Note that you can get the achievement just by placing Wilhelm II in the German Empire throne if the non-historical AI choses without your intervention to get rid of Mussolini and place Victor Emmanuel as king.
1aln4c4.zh: （本攻略需要禁用诸神黄昏。）沿「反对希特勒」分支中的「皇帝归来」和「聚焦真正的敌人」路线前进，直到点出「刺杀墨索里尼」焦点（AI 总是会同意刺杀墨索里尼）。威廉二世必须是你的领袖，而且在焦点完成前不能死亡。注意，如果非历史 AI 在没有你干预的情况下选择除掉墨索里尼并让维托里奥·埃马努埃莱成为国王，你只需把威廉二世扶上德意志帝国皇位就能获得该成就。

si4ade.en: Our Other Place in the SunAs Imperial Germany, conquer a Caribbean island.
si4ade.zh: 阳光下另一块地盘（Our Other Place in the Sun）作为德意志帝国，征服一个加勒比海岛。

1wc3d4x.en: If Götterdämmerung is enabled: Has completed focus Our Place in the Sun Otherwise: Has completed focus Our Place in the Sun Conquered an island in the Caribbean
1wc3d4x.zh: 如果启用诸神黄昏：已完成焦点「阳光下的地盘」 否则：已完成焦点「阳光下的地盘」 征服了加勒比海的一个岛屿

e413n6.en: If ⟦0⟧ is enabled: Has completed focus Our Place in the Sun
e413n6.zh: 如果启用 ⟦0⟧：已完成焦点「阳光下的地盘」

miqx69.en: Otherwise: Has completed focus Our Place in the Sun
miqx69.zh: 否则：已完成焦点「阳光下的地盘」

jrdkdu.en: Conquered an island in the Caribbean
jrdkdu.zh: 征服了加勒比海的一个岛屿

5tzs2e.en: Requires Germany to follow the Return of the Kaiser branch. Taking Curacao from the Dutch will not earn the achievement, as it is counted as part of South America. For detailed strategies, see Our Other Place in the Sun
5tzs2e.zh: 需要德国走「皇帝归来」分支。从荷兰手中夺取库拉索不会获得该成就，因为它被算作南美洲的一部分。详细攻略请见 阳光下另一块地盘（Our Other Place in the Sun）

1ytvfkv.en: Australia-HungaryAs Australia, own all core territory of Hungary.
1ytvfkv.zh: 澳匈帝国（Australia-Hungary）作为澳大利亚，拥有匈牙利的全部核心领土。

4qzyr1.zh: 拥有 ⟦0⟧ 的全部核心领土

1a7hdvb.en: Note: Only Easy before patch 1.12! For detailed strategies, see Australia-Hungary
1a7hdvb.zh: 注意：1.12 补丁之前仅为简单难度！详细攻略请见 澳匈帝国（Australia-Hungary）

1bxlg0s.en: My Ships Don't LieAs Colombia, form Gran Colombia and have 10 Carriers and 10 Battleships.
1bxlg0s.zh: 我的舰船不说谎（My Ships Don't Lie）作为哥伦比亚，成立大哥伦比亚并拥有 10 艘航空母舰和 10 艘战列舰。

m9j5kg.en: Has taken the decision to form Gran Colombia At least 10 Battleships At least 10 Carriers
m9j5kg.zh: 已采取成立大哥伦比亚的决议 至少 10 艘战列舰 至少 10 艘航空母舰

k2uyg1.en: Has taken the decision to form ⟦0⟧
k2uyg1.zh: 已采取成立 ⟦0⟧ 的决议

1n71ka7.en: Requires the Restore the Bolívar Union decision. For detailed strategies, see My Ships Don't Lie
1n71ka7.zh: 需要「恢复玻利瓦尔联盟」决议。详细攻略请见 我的舰船不说谎（My Ships Don't Lie）

1ingtqn.en: I Swear I'm Not a ByzantophileAs Greece, Form Byzantine Empire.
1ingtqn.zh: 我发誓我不是拜占庭粉（I Swear I'm Not a Byzantophile）作为希腊，成立拜占庭帝国。

1slwg5q.en: Easiest to follow the Byzantine path in the Greek focus tree introduced in Battle for the Bosporus, see Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.
1slwg5q.zh: 最简单的方法是走《博斯普鲁斯之战》中引入的希腊国策树里的拜占庭路线，参见 伊斯坦布尔还是君士坦丁堡。又一次。（Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.）

f4wmg.en: Team AmericaAs the U.S.A., drop a nuclear bomb on Paris.
f4wmg.zh: 美国小队（Team America）作为美国，向巴黎投掷一枚核弹。

1vuh26i.en: Dropped a nuclear bomb on Paris
1vuh26i.zh: 向巴黎投掷了一枚核弹

xk3zyk.en: As a democratic nation, build a lot of planes, namely strategic bombers and fighters, and rush nuclear technology. Germany will control Paris. When in the Allies, move your planes to the airfield on the British Isles and set them on mission to Northern France when the nuclear tech is ready and one nuke is available. Achieve air superiority and nuke Paris when ready.
xk3zyk.zh: 作为民主国家，建造大量飞机，即战略轰炸机和战斗机，并速通核科技。德国会控制巴黎。加入同盟国后，把你的飞机转移到不列颠群岛的机场，当核科技准备就绪且有一枚核弹可用时，将它们设为前往法国北部的任务。取得制空权，并在准备就绪时用核弹轰炸巴黎。

57ldr6.en: History Repeated ItselfAs the U.S.A., Win against the Confederate States. Again.
57ldr6.zh: 历史重演（History Repeated Itself）作为美国，再次战胜美利坚联盟国。

amsim6.en: The Second American Civil War has started Confederacy of American States exists
amsim6.zh: 第二次美国内战已经爆发 美利坚国家联盟存在

1kgj2m.en: The Second American Civil War has started
1kgj2m.zh: 第二次美国内战已经爆发

1yp1tvx.en: Completing either Full Desegregation or Union Representation Act will trigger a civil war with the Confederacy. To help the United States win the war, complete the WPA branch and Guarantee the American Dream beforehand.
1yp1tvx.zh: 完成「全面废除种族隔离」或「工会代表法」中的任意一项都会触发与联盟国的内战。为帮助美国赢得战争，请提前完成 WPA 分支并点出「保障美国梦」。

iesfc4.en: Georgia On My MindAs the U.S.A., own and fully control all three Georgias.
iesfc4.zh: 心系佐治亚（Georgia On My Mind）作为美国，拥有并完全控制全部三个佐治亚。

h3k1fn.en: Collaborating with the Axis is the simplest route to achieving this. Help the Axis capitulate the Allies and the Comintern, and grab South Georgia (720) and Georgia (231). South Georgia (720) can also be obtained via the Reaffirm Monroe Doctrine focus.
h3k1fn.zh: 与轴心国合作是达成该成就最简单的途径。帮助轴心国迫使同盟国和共产国际投降，并夺取南佐治亚 (720) 和佐治亚 (231)。南佐治亚 (720) 也可以通过「重申门罗主义」焦点获得。

15bktcg.en: To Arms in Dixie!As the U.S.A., start a new civil war as the South.
15bktcg.zh: 迪克西武装起来！（To Arms in Dixie!）作为美国，以南方身份发动一场新的内战。

1kbwn4u.en: Complete America First and hire the fascist advisor. When ready and possible, complete Ally With the Silver Shirts to trigger the event chain leading to the civil war. For best results, complete Work With the Bund and Recruit the Free Corps.
1kbwn4u.zh: 完成「美国优先」并雇佣法西斯顾问。在准备就绪且条件允许时，完成「与银衫军结盟」以触发通向内战的事件链。为达到最佳效果，请完成「与德美同盟合作」和「招募自由军团」。

1igcyqv.en: Arsenal of DemocracyAs the U.S.A., have more than 300 military factories.
1igcyqv.zh: 民主兵工厂（Arsenal of Democracy）作为美国，拥有超过 300 座军用工厂。

1o49qir.en: Ruling party is Democratic More than 300 military factories
1o49qir.zh: 执政党为民主主义 超过 300 座军用工厂

1h6b6al.en: The easiest way to earn this achievement is to simply play on historical as the United States and build as many Military factories as possible. The Arsenal of Democracy branch of the focus tree gives Military factories for free, so make sure you complete it, along with the WPA branch to boost your industry.
1h6b6al.zh: 获得这个成就最简单的方法就是以美国走历史路线游玩，并尽可能多地建造军用工厂。国策树中的「民主兵工厂」分支会免费提供军用工厂，所以一定要完成它，同时完成 WPA 分支来提升你的工业。

8c7gfj.en: Underpaid, Undersexed, and Under EisenhowerAs the U.S.A., assume faction leadership of the Allies, and have over 50 expeditionary divisions from the United Kingdom.
8c7gfj.zh: 报酬太低、缺乏异性，还归艾森豪威尔指挥（Underpaid, Undersexed, and Under Eisenhower）作为美国，取得同盟国的阵营领袖地位，并拥有超过 50 个来自英国的远征师。

191406m.en: Is in faction with the United Kingdom Is Faction leader Received at least 50 expeditionary forces from the United Kingdom
191406m.zh: 与英国同属一个阵营 是阵营领袖 从英国获得了至少 50 个远征军

1sisyln.en: Received at least ⟦0⟧ expeditionary forces from the ⟦1⟧
1sisyln.zh: 获得了至少 ⟦0⟧ 个来自 ⟦1⟧ 的远征军

2axf0t.en: Simply play historical and join the Allies. You need 50% more factories and fielded manpower than the United Kingdom, which shouldn't be a problem after a few years of buildup. Once you become faction leader, create an invasion order and press the button below the army to request 51 expeditionary forces and earn the achievement. Note: The UK will accept to send the 51 divisions you need if they have ~160 divisions, you can send them some of your own troops as expeditionary forces to get them past that number.
2axf0t.zh: 只需按历史路线游玩并加入同盟国。你需要比英国多 50% 的工厂和场上人力，经过几年发展后这应该不成问题。当你成为阵营领袖后，创建一个登陆指令并点击集团军下方的按钮，请求 51 个远征军，即可获得成就。注意：如果英国拥有约 160 个师，他们就会同意派出你需要的 51 个师；你可以把自己的一些部队作为远征军派给他们，让他们超过这个数量。

1m1cm09.en: Last for a Thousand YearsAs the United Kingdom, accomplish the federation of the entire British Empire.
1m1cm09.zh: 延续千年（Last for a Thousand Years）作为英国，实现整个大英帝国的联邦化。

7hrxl7.en: Can be done as any ideology. Make sure to improve relations and save up a few hundred Political Power before starting Hold the Imperial Conference. 300-400 political power is a good number to have saved before starting but if you can spare the time and effort, having around 600-700 political power will ensure success.
7hrxl7.zh: 任何意识形态都可以完成。在开始「召开帝国会议」之前，务必改善关系并积攒几百点政治点数。开始前存下 300-400 政治点数是个不错的目标，但如果你有时间和精力，拥有约 600-700 政治点数就能确保成功。

1y848rc.en: BritzkriegAs the United Kingdom, put Edward VIII in power, ally Germany and fully control Paris.
1y848rc.zh: 英式闪击战（Britzkrieg）作为英国，让爱德华八世掌权，与德国结盟并完全控制巴黎。

1b9y5i8.en: Has completed focus The King's Party Is in faction with Germany France has capitulated or does not exist Has full control of Ile de France (16)
1b9y5i8.zh: 已完成焦点「国王党」 与德国同属一个阵营 法国已投降或不存在 完全控制法兰西岛 (16)

uw7f38.en: ⟦0⟧ has capitulated or does not exist

1uri064.en: Follow the focus tree to Alliance with Germany. Justify against France and launch a naval invasion of Normandy. It is not necessary to call Germany into the war. If France is puppeted, the achievement will not fire. Annex all cores, territories, and colonies to be sure.
1uri064.zh: 沿国策树走到「与德国结盟」。对法国制造战争目标，并对诺曼底发动海军登陆。不必把德国拉入战争。如果法国被变成傀儡国，成就不会触发。为确保触发，吞并所有核心州、领土和殖民地。

pgc1mh.en: Nothing Wrong with our Bloody ShipsAs the United Kingdom, have at least 9 battlecruisers.
pgc1mh.zh: 我们的破船没问题（Nothing Wrong with our Bloody Ships）作为英国，拥有至少 9 艘战列巡洋舰。

1es8uv8.zh: 至少拥有 9 艘战列巡洋舰

c1sx5b.en: Battlecruisers are built with "Heavy Ship Hulls" and "Battlecruiser armor". Make the cheapest battlecruisers you can and build 6 at the same time ( United Kingdom start with 3) with all your dockyards assigned, build more dockyards to speed up construction.
c1sx5b.zh: 战列巡洋舰需要使用「重型舰体」和「战列巡洋舰装甲」建造。造出你能造的最便宜的战列巡洋舰，并用全部船坞同时建造 6 艘（英国开局有 3 艘）；建造更多船坞以加快建造速度。

1bm3cel.en: William WallisAs the United Kingdom, put Edward VIII in power, enforce an American monarchy, and have both it and Scotland as subjects.
1bm3cel.zh: 威廉·华莱士（William Wallis）作为英国，让爱德华八世掌权，在美国强制建立君主制，并使美国和苏格兰都成为你的附庸国。

x404vi.en: Has completed focus The King's Party Scotland is a subject of The United Kingdom The United States is a subject of The United Kingdom Installed an American monarchy
x404vi.zh: 已完成焦点「国王党」 苏格兰是英国的附庸国 美国是英国的附庸国 建立了美国君主制

12edwxq.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a subject of The ⟦1⟧

1mb45pb.en: For detailed strategies, see William Wallis
1mb45pb.zh: 详细攻略请见 威廉·华莱士（William Wallis）

1bm78eg.en: Crush the DreamAs a Communist United Kingdom, crush the American Dream by puppeting the U.S.A.
1bm78eg.zh: 粉碎美国梦（Crush the Dream）作为共产主义英国，通过傀儡化美国来粉碎美国梦。

1tka2da.en: Ruling party is Communist Has completed focus Crush the Dream The United States is a subject of the United Kingdom
1tka2da.zh: 执政党为共产主义 已完成焦点「粉碎美国梦」 美国是英国的附庸国

ucifdq.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a subject of the ⟦1⟧

749dqf.en: For detailed strategies, see Crush the Dream
749dqf.zh: 详细攻略请见 粉碎美国梦（Crush the Dream）

1wntwx9.en: Treading the Narrow PathAs the Netherlands, do not cave to the Germans, continue the Zuiderzee works, and do not lose control of any of your continental European states until 1945.
1wntwx9.zh: 走在窄路上（Treading the Narrow Path）作为荷兰，不要向德国屈服，继续须德海工程，并在 1945 年之前不失去任何欧洲大陆州的控制权。

d7akvk.en: Has completed focus Cave to the Germans Has completed focus Continue the Zuiderzee Works Lost one of your starting states After 1st Jan, 1945
d7akvk.zh: 已完成焦点「向德国屈服」 已完成焦点「继续须德海工程」 失去了一个开局拥有的州 1945 年 1 月 1 日之后

17iysct.en: Lost one of your starting states
17iysct.zh: 失去了一个开局拥有的州

uqssxh.en: Note: Losing control of a state means losing control of a majority of its victory points. It is possible to lose a few provinces without invalidating the achievement. For detailed strategies, see Treading the Narrow Path
uqssxh.zh: 注意：失去一个州的控制权意味着失去其多数胜利点的控制权。丢失少数省份不会导致成就失效。详细攻略请见 走在窄路上（Treading the Narrow Path）

vketyg.en: Putting the Raid on the Medway to ShameAs the Netherlands, ensure the United Kingdom has no capital ships (carriers, battleships, battlecruisers, or heavy cruisers).
vketyg.zh: 让梅德韦河突袭相形见绌（Putting the Raid on the Medway to Shame）作为荷兰，确保英国没有任何主力舰（航空母舰、战列舰、战列巡洋舰或重巡洋舰）。

sjripm.en: Probably easier to fully annex the UK instead of trying to hunt down every single capital ship, as this will also count for the achievement to unlock.
sjripm.zh: 直接完全吞并英国可能比追猎每一艘主力舰更容易，这样做同样可以解锁该成就。

sg0k2z.en: BevrijdingAs the Netherlands, liberate the continental Netherlands after relocating the government to the East Indies.
sg0k2z.zh: 解放（Bevrijding）作为荷兰，在把政府迁往东印度群岛后解放荷兰本土。

8lscof.en: Ruling party is Democratic Has completed focus Liberation
8lscof.zh: 执政党为民主主义 已完成焦点「解放」

16xggma.en: Simply play as Netherlands on Historical, and go down the Continue the War in Batavia branch. There is no point in trying to defend your European lands (as Continue the War in Batavia requires you to have capitulated), so build up your Asian possessions. Once Germany is defeated, you will have control of your homeland back, and you can complete Liberation and earn the achievement. Note: You will need to have removed the "Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War" spirit, so make sure you complete War on Pacifism as soon as possible.
16xggma.zh: 只需以荷兰按历史路线游玩，并走「继续在巴达维亚作战」分支。尝试防守你的欧洲领土毫无意义（因为「继续在巴达维亚作战」要求你已经投降），所以专心建设你的亚洲领地。德国被击败后，你将重新控制本土，届时完成「解放」即可获得成就。注意：你需要移除「一战中饱受炮弹惊吓的旁观者」国家精神，所以务必尽快完成「向和平主义宣战」。

s2ui5b.en: Mi Casa es tu CasaAs Mexico, host a government-in-exile.
s2ui5b.zh: 我家就是你家（Mi Casa es tu Casa）作为墨西哥，接纳一个流亡政府。

1skee1l.en: To host a government in exile you need to be the leader of a faction which has the rule "allows hosting exiled governments". This is set by default on only a small handful of base factions, and the easiest ways to get this achievement (one of which is outlined in the next paragraph) require No Compromise, No Surrender to be enabled. Make your way to Realpolitik and create a "Bastion of Liberty" faction. Use your first initiative point to allow your faction to host governments in exile. Guarantee Finland. Wait for the Winter War to start and accept the Call to Arms. Improve relations and send an attache to Finland. You should have enough relations to invite them to your faction despite the distance. It's important to invite them quickly, as they will white peace the Soviets if they aren't in a faction. Once they capitulate you will get the achievement.
1skee1l.zh: 要接纳流亡政府，你必须是某个拥有「允许接纳流亡政府」规则的阵营领袖。默认只有少数几个基础阵营拥有该规则，而获得这个成就最简单的几种方法（其中一种将在下一段说明）都需要启用《不妥协，不投降》。设法走到「现实政治」并创建一个「自由堡垒」阵营。用你的第一个主动权点数允许你的阵营接纳流亡政府。保障芬兰独立。等待冬季战争爆发并接受参战号召。改善关系并向芬兰派遣武官。尽管距离遥远，你的关系值也应该足以邀请他们加入你的阵营。务必尽快邀请，因为如果他们不在任何阵营中，就会与苏联白和。一旦他们投降，你就能获得成就。

jmsis7.en: The New Home of the RevolutionAs Mexico, put Trotsky in power and puppet the Soviet Union
jmsis7.zh: 革命的新家园（The New Home of the Revolution）作为墨西哥，让托洛茨基掌权并傀儡化苏联

1jakwwc.en: Lev Trotsky is the current country leader The Soviet Union is a subject of Mexico
1jakwwc.zh: 列夫·托洛茨基是现任国家领袖 苏联是墨西哥的附庸国

12sscfc.en: Choose to invite Trotsky in the "Trotsky seeks refuge" event. Follow the rightmost side of the focus tree to become communist and put Trotsky in charge. Join Germany's war against the Soviet Union via the Smash the Bureaucrats focus. To gain warscore, ask Germany for military access and put your troops on their front line. Alternatively, try to naval invade the Soviets' far east front and capture a few victory point provinces. During the peace conference, puppet the Soviet Union.
12sscfc.zh: 在「托洛茨基寻求庇护」事件中选择邀请托洛茨基。沿国策树最右侧一路走到底以转为共产主义，并让托洛茨基掌权。通过「粉碎官僚」焦点加入德国对苏联的战争。为获得战争贡献，向德国请求军事通行权并把你的部队部署到他们的前线。或者，尝试海军登陆苏联的远东前线并占领几个胜利点省份。在和平会议期间傀儡化苏联。

bbsxu7.en: Assuming Direct ControlStarting as a minor power, assume faction leadership of the Allies, the Axis, or the Comintern.
bbsxu7.zh: 接管控制权（Assuming Direct Control）以小国开局，取得同盟国、轴心国或共产国际的阵营领袖地位。

1e3ab9c.en: Playing as ⟦0⟧: United States United Kingdom Germany Italy France Soviet Union Japan China
1e3ab9c.zh: 以 ⟦0⟧ 游玩：美国 英国 德国 意大利 法国 苏联 日本 中国

1yjdwm7.en: United States United Kingdom Germany Italy France Soviet Union Japan China
1yjdwm7.zh: 美国 英国 德国 意大利 法国 苏联 日本 中国

1ttzkue.en: Has assumed faction leadership from the United Kingdom, Germany or the Soviet Union Is Faction leader
1ttzkue.zh: 已从英国、德国或苏联手中取得阵营领袖地位 是阵营领袖

1lxk9pp.en: Has assumed faction leadership from the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ or the ⟦2⟧
1lxk9pp.zh: 已从 ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧ 手中取得阵营领袖地位

4ke9y8.en: Play as Romania and go down the Balkan Dominance branch. Increase your power as much as possible, by focusing on army, industry and by taking out Hungary and Bulgaria. Join the Axis, but never join any of their wars. When they are defeated, you will become the leader, earning you the achievement.
4ke9y8.zh: 以罗马尼亚游玩并走「巴尔干霸权」分支。尽可能提升你的实力，专注于陆军、工业，并击败匈牙利和保加利亚。加入轴心国，但绝不加入他们的任何战争。当他们被击败时，你就会成为领袖，从而获得成就。

10fpcht.en: never join any of their wars
10fpcht.zh: 绝不加入他们的任何战争

ip4hso.en: Vive la Jeune EcoleAs France, have at least 150 Destroyers and research the maximum torpedo launcher technology, before 1945.
ip4hso.zh: 青年学派万岁（Vive la Jeune Ecole）作为法国，在 1945 年之前拥有至少 150 艘驱逐舰并研究出最高级鱼雷发射器科技。

d3jvcd.en: After Jan 1st, 1945 Has at least 150 Destroyers Has researched Modern Ship Torpedo Launcher
d3jvcd.zh: 1945 年 1 月 1 日之后 至少拥有 150 艘驱逐舰 已研究「现代舰用鱼雷发射器」

a5hlrw.zh: 至少拥有 ⟦0⟧ 艘驱逐舰

lxbne3.en: Turn fascist by going down the National Regeneration path. Join the Axis 'but not any war, and rush research towards Modern Ship Torpedo Launcher. Make sure to also build as many naval dockyards as possible. Take focuses that help with research, construction speed and dockyard output. Assign all available dockyards to producing destroyers.
lxbne3.zh: 通过走「民族复兴」路线转为法西斯。加入轴心国，但不加入任何战争，并速通「现代舰用鱼雷发射器」的研究。确保也尽可能多地建造海军船坞。选择有助于科研、建造速度和船坞产出的焦点。把所有可用的船坞都分配去生产驱逐舰。

1t806y7.en: 30 Minutes of HelAs Poland in the 1939 “Blitzkrieg” scenario start, inflict over 1,800,000 casualties to Germany to beat the 2018 PDXCON HOI4 challenge. Extra bragging rights if you do it in 30 minutes or less!
1t806y7.zh: 赫尔 30 分钟（30 Minutes of Hel）作为 1939 年「闪电战」剧本开局的波兰，对德国造成超过 1,800,000 的伤亡，以击败 2018 年 PDXCON 的 HOI4 挑战。如果你能在 30 分钟或更短时间内完成，更有吹嘘的资本！

1bhovtn.en: Playing as Poland Start date is Aug 3rd, 1939
1bhovtn.zh: 以波兰游玩 开局日期为 1939 年 8 月 3 日

1oyiu11.zh: 开局日期为 1939 年 8 月 3 日

13j6p8j.en: Has inflicted more than ⟦0⟧ Casualties on ⟦1⟧
13j6p8j.zh: 已造成超过 ⟦0⟧ 的伤亡（针对 ⟦1⟧）

ctc0qu.en: For detailed strategies, see 30 Minutes of Hel
ctc0qu.zh: 详细攻略请见 赫尔 30 分钟（30 Minutes of Hel）

1rht192.en: Pride and Extreme PrejudiceSink the British Pride of the Fleet.
1rht192.zh: 傲慢与极端偏见（Pride and Extreme Prejudice）击沉英国的「舰队荣耀」。

rczddq.en: Sank the British Pride of the Fleet
rczddq.zh: 击沉了英国的「舰队荣耀」

1bmst8g.en: It can be done quickly as Japan. The Japanese fleet is immediately capable of sinking not just the HMS Hood, but the entire Royal Navy if played properly. Choose Purge the Kodoha Faction and justify on the UK (or British Malaya) as soon as possible. Ask Germany for docking rights, and move your entire fleet to their port nearest to the UK. Use the bulk of your fleet as a strike force, with three groups of destroyers patrolling the naval areas around the UK. If possible, you can also use naval bombers as well for added firepower. When the justification has finished, declare war on them. If Germany invites you to the Axis you should accept in order to use their airfields. From there just keep beating the Brits and building new ships and bombers (importing Oil for fuel if needed) until your fleet sinks the Hood and unlocks the achievement.
1bmst8g.zh: 用日本可以很快完成。日本舰队不仅有能力立刻击沉 HMS Hood，如果操作得当，甚至能击沉整个皇家海军。选择「清洗皇道派」并尽快对英国（或英属马来亚）制造战争目标。向德国请求停靠权，把你的整支舰队调到他们最靠近英国的港口。把舰队主力用作打击部队，并派三组驱逐舰在英国周边的海域巡逻。如果可能，你也可以使用海军轰炸机来增加火力。战争目标制造完成后，对他们宣战。如果德国邀请你加入轴心国，你应该接受，以便使用他们的机场。接下来只要不断打击英国人并建造新舰船和轰炸机（如有需要可进口石油以获取燃料），直到你的舰队击沉 Hood 并解锁成就。

bwo30r.en: Do You Mined?Lay at least 1,000 mines on the coastline of an enemy nation.
bwo30r.zh: 你布雷了吗？（Do You Mined?）在敌国海岸线布设至少 1,000 枚水雷。

1q0uqvb.en: Any country at war with player has more than 999 mines on their coastline
1q0uqvb.zh: 任意与玩家交战的国家在其海岸线上拥有超过 999 枚水雷

53r37u.en: As Italy, remove your divisions from Eritrea (550) or Somaliland (559)(keeping your ports for maximum efficiency). Lay mines on the Ethiopian shore with your starting navy until you reach 1000 mines. However, if you lose all your territory you will white peace with Ethiopia.
53r37u.zh: 作为意大利，把你的师从厄立特里亚 (550) 或索马里兰 (559) 撤出（保留港口以获得最高效率）。用你的开局海军在埃塞俄比亚海岸布雷，直到达到 1000 枚水雷。但是，如果你失去全部领土，就会与埃塞俄比亚白和。

7ys607.en: BFFsAs Portugal, join the same faction as Great Britain.
7ys607.zh: 好朋友（BFFs）作为葡萄牙，加入与大不列颠相同的阵营。

v2h2xx.en: Just go democratic and wait for world tension to rise. If La Résistance is enabled, you can rush towards Join the Allies as well.
v2h2xx.zh: 直接转为民主并等待世界紧张度上升。如果启用了《抵抗运动》，你也可以速通「加入同盟国」。

x2d8bi.en: Go Ahead, Macau My DayAs Portugal, create a collaboration government in Macau and have it own all Chinese states.
x2d8bi.zh: 放马过来吧，澳门（Go Ahead, Macau My Day）作为葡萄牙，在澳门建立一个合作政府并让它拥有中国的所有州。

1oemy7w.en: Any of the following countries: China Chinese Soviet Republic Guangxi Clique Yunnan Shanxi Xibei San Ma Sinkiang Is a subject of Portugal Is a collaboration government Macau (729) is a capital state Own all core states of China and Manchukuo
1oemy7w.zh: 以下任意国家：中国 中华苏维埃共和国 桂系 云南 晋系 西北三马 新疆 是葡萄牙的附庸国 是合作政府 澳门 (729) 是首都州 拥有中国和满洲国的所有核心州

1w9gr02.en: China Chinese Soviet Republic Guangxi Clique Yunnan Shanxi Xibei San Ma Sinkiang
1w9gr02.zh: 中国 中华苏维埃共和国 桂系 云南 晋系 西北三马 新疆

6ejb3k.en: Own all core states of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧
6ejb3k.zh: 拥有 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 的所有核心州

1jojj1b.en: Note: This achievement requires Hong Kong (326) and Kouang-Tchéou-Wan (728) to be taken in a peace deal. For detailed strategies, see Go Ahead, Macau My Day
1jojj1b.zh: 注意：该成就要求在和平会议中夺取香港 (326) 和广州湾 (728)。详细攻略请见 放马过来吧，澳门（Go Ahead, Macau My Day）

lq9yb8.en: Play It, SamHave a spy network of at least 50% strength in Casablanca.
lq9yb8.zh: 弹吧，山姆（Play It, Sam）在卡萨布兰卡拥有至少 50% 强度的特工网络。

vf7fc9.en: Intel Network Strength in ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ is more than ⟦2⟧

lhq3fw.en: At game start, establish an agency and set your operatives on "Establish Spy Network" mission in Casablanca (461). The achievement will trigger once the network strength is over 50%. You can do this as soon as you have recruited your first operative but the more operatives you assign to establish a network in the same region, the faster the network will be at full strength.
lhq3fw.zh: 开局时建立一个情报机构，并让你的特工在卡萨布兰卡 (461) 执行「建立特工网络」任务。当网络强度超过 50% 时成就就会触发。你一招募到第一名特工就可以这么做，但你在同一地区指派越多特工去建立网络，网络达到满强度就越快。

dtr832.en: Spies TradeAs India, become the spymaster for the Allies.
dtr832.zh: 特工交易（Spies Trade）作为印度，成为同盟国的特工首脑。

1wuhmf.en: Is Spy Master In a faction with United Kingdom
1wuhmf.zh: 是特工首脑 与英国同属一个阵营

3joaf0.en: Increase your autonomy towards ⟦0⟧. Meanwhile, create an intelligence agency and upgrade it three times with any upgrade. Once you become a ⟦1⟧, the option to Become Spymaster will be available next to the name and icon of your agency at the top of the window. The AI will always accept.
3joaf0.zh: 提高你对 ⟦0⟧ 的自治度。同时建立一个情报机构，并用任意升级将其升级三次。当你成为 ⟦1⟧ 后，窗口顶部你的情报机构名称和图标旁会出现「成为特工首脑」选项。AI 总是会接受。

19mmnkl.en: Why Die For Danzig?As Germany, turn France fascist and occupy Danzig without going to war with France.
19mmnkl.zh: 为什么要为但泽而死？（Why Die For Danzig?）作为德国，让法国转为法西斯并占领但泽，而不与法国开战。

rjva91.en: France: Ruling party is Fascist Is not at war with Germany Controls Danzig (85) Has declared war on France Germany is at war with France
rjva91.zh: 法国：执政党为法西斯主义 未与德国交战 控制但泽 (85) 已对法国宣战 德国与法国处于战争状态

1wcns3h.en: ⟦0⟧: Ruling party is Fascist Is not at war with Germany
1wcns3h.zh: ⟦0⟧：执政党为法西斯主义 未与德国交战

1gyauzb.en: Boost fascism in France from the start of the game, then complete Danzig for Slovakia to gain control of Danzig (85) without going to war with France. If France hasn't flipped by the time you get Danzig (85), start a fascist coup in France. As soon as the coup fires, you'll get the achievement. Note: "invalid_for_danzig_achievement" flag fires when Germany declares war on France. However, you should be able to join a war against them, e.g. if Italy declares war and asks you to join.
1gyauzb.zh: 从游戏开局就提升法国的法西斯主义支持度，然后完成「但泽换斯洛伐克」以在不与法国开战的情况下取得但泽 (85) 的控制权。如果在你拿到但泽 (85) 时法国还没转变，就在法国发动法西斯政变。政变一爆发，你就能获得成就。注意：当德国对法国宣战时，会触发 "invalid_for_danzig_achievement" 标志。不过，你仍然应该可以加入针对他们的战争，例如意大利宣战并邀请你加入时。

16xbwu2.en: I SEE EVERYTHINGGet over 90% intel in each category on a major without using code cracking.
16xbwu2.zh: 我全看见了（I SEE EVERYTHING）在不使用密码破译的情况下，对某个主要国家在各类别都获得超过 90% 的情报。

1mdeqtt.en: Any major country: Cipher is not fully decrypted Civilian intel greater than 89% Army intel greater than 89% Airforce intel greater than 89% Navy Intel greater than 89%
1mdeqtt.zh: 任意主要国家：密码未被完全破译 民用情报高于 89% 陆军情报高于 89% 空军情报高于 89% 海军情报高于 89%

1teh9si.en: Cipher is not fully decrypted Civilian intel greater than 89% Army intel greater than 89% Airforce intel greater than 89% Navy Intel greater than 89%
1teh9si.zh: 密码未被完全破译 民用情报高于 89% 陆军情报高于 89% 空军情报高于 89% 海军情报高于 89%

tnfl8w.en: In order for the achievement to fire, the decryption must not be complete or cracked, but if the player selects it and waits the 30 days, the achievement will fire.
tnfl8w.zh: 为了让成就触发，解密不能已经完成或被破译；但如果玩家选择解密并等待 30 天，成就就会触发。

1rxpkl7.en: Shaken, Not StirredSuccessfully stage a coup in any nation using a spy with the Seducer trait.
1rxpkl7.zh: 摇匀，不要搅拌（Shaken, Not Stirred）使用拥有「诱惑者」特质的特工在任意国家成功发动政变。

cydarm.en: Started a coup in any nation using an Operative with the seducer trait
cydarm.zh: 使用拥有「诱惑者」特质的特工在任意国家发动了政变

9l4k1f.en: Start as any non-aligned country and get a spy with the seducer trait. Dutch East Indies is the easiest target as they have a high non-aligned popularity at the start and won't be building a spy agency until later.
9l4k1f.zh: 以任意中立主义国家开局，并获得一名拥有「诱惑者」特质的特工。荷属东印度是最容易的目标，因为他们开局的中立主义支持度很高，而且要到后期才会建立特工机构。

uc3tcc.en: Listen Very Carefully, I Shall Say This...Have a French and British spy work together on the same Operation.
uc3tcc.zh: 仔细听好，这话我只说一遍...（Listen Very Carefully, I Shall Say This...）让一名法国特工和一名英国特工在同一次行动中合作。

ao7gsi.en: Have British and French Operatives complete an Operation together
ao7gsi.zh: 让英国和法国特工共同完成一次行动

k0pfqr.en: Check happens upon operation completion. At least 1 participating operative requires French, and at least 1 participating operative requires British nationality.
k0pfqr.zh: 检查在行动完成时进行。至少需要 1 名参与行动的特工为法国国籍，且至少 1 名参与行动的特工为英国国籍。

1u68b6a.en: Man of a Thousand Faces, Every One the SameHave the same spy get captured twice.
1u68b6a.zh: 千面之人，张张相同（Man of a Thousand Faces, Every One the Same）让同一名特工被抓获两次。

1af6nfq.en: Have any operative get captured twice
1af6nfq.zh: 让任意特工被抓获两次

15pc3ov.en: The Soviet Union has the highest chance of capturing operatives, so expand your operative slots and send them all to the Soviet Union. After an operative gets captured, rescue them and send them to the Soviet Union again. Once they get captured again, the achievement will fire.
15pc3ov.zh: 苏联抓获特工的概率最高，所以扩充你的特工名额并把他们全部派往苏联。特工被抓获后，营救他们并再次派往苏联。当他们再次被抓获时，成就就会触发。

1wfhwtp.en: Turing Complete!Fully decrypt all nations in the Axis.
1wfhwtp.zh: 图灵完备！（Turing Complete!）完全解密轴心国中的所有国家。

wlbf9s.en: Germany is considered a Major Country Has decrypted all major countries in faction with Germany
wlbf9s.zh: 德国被视为主要国家 已解密与德国同阵营的所有主要国家

118n531.en: Has decrypted all major countries in faction with ⟦0⟧
118n531.zh: 已解密与 ⟦0⟧ 同阵营的所有主要国家

16c3kvl.en: At the start of the game create your spy agency and unlock all cryptology tech, you only need to decrypt Germany as they are the only member of the Axis.
16c3kvl.zh: 游戏开局就建立你的特工机构并解锁所有密码学科技；你只需要解密德国，因为他们是轴心国唯一的成员。

1xuh0aq.en: One King, Two CrownsAs Bourbon Spain, hold all Spanish and French core states.
1xuh0aq.zh: 一王二冠（One King, Two Crowns）作为波旁西班牙，拥有西班牙和法国的所有核心州。

1fswbzo.en: Is Carlist Spain Conquer all of France
1fswbzo.zh: 是卡洛斯西班牙 征服全法国

14ohw0p.en: For detailed strategies, see One King, Two Crowns
14ohw0p.zh: 详细攻略请见 一王二冠（One King, Two Crowns）

iavsuk.en: We Will Rock YouAs Spain, own Gibraltar.
iavsuk.zh: 我们要震撼你（We Will Rock You）作为西班牙，拥有直布罗陀。

lv4xy3.en: Turn historical AI off, since the United Kingdom may take the Revisit Colonial Policy branch of its focus tree containing the focus Withdraw from Contested Territories which will give Gibraltar (118) to Spain for free along with it becoming a core state. If this occurs during the civil war, Gibraltar (118) may not be given to the player's Spain but will be transferred once the civil war is won.
lv4xy3.zh: 关闭历史 AI，因为英国可能会走其国策树中的「重审殖民政策」分支，其中包含「撤出争议领土」焦点，这会把直布罗陀 (118) 免费交给西班牙，并使其成为核心州。如果这发生在内战期间，直布罗陀 (118) 可能不会交给玩家所控制的西班牙，但内战获胜后就会被转移。

xobnv7.en: Well, I Didn’t Vote for YouWin the Spanish Civil War as the Anarchists.
xobnv7.zh: 好吧，我可没投你的票（Well, I Didn't Vote for You）作为无政府主义者赢得西班牙内战。

1nrb3t9.en: Is Regional Defense Council of Aragón No other country with the original tag of Spain exists
1nrb3t9.zh: 是阿拉贡地区防卫委员会 不存在其他拥有西班牙原始 tag 的国家

a6rj9u.en: No other country with the original tag of ⟦0⟧ exists
a6rj9u.zh: 不存在其他拥有 ⟦0⟧ 原始 tag 的国家

1m144kr.en: Anarchist Spain is created from either Masters of Our Own Fate focus or the Government Crackdown event. At the start of the game focus on building military factories in Valencia. As long as you control Valencia when the Anarchist uprising fires, you will be given control of it. Easier if the Nationalists are weakened by the Carlist rebellion. This can be done by keeping control of the northern states (Asturias & Pais Vasco) for as long as possible. On non-historical, they may also simply not take the focuses in the right order to prevent the uprising from happening.
1m144kr.zh: 无政府主义西班牙由「掌握自己的命运」焦点或「政府镇压」事件产生。开局时专注于在瓦伦西亚建造军用工厂。只要无政府主义起义爆发时你控制着瓦伦西亚，你就能获得它的控制权。如果民族主义者被卡洛斯派叛乱削弱，会更容易。要做到这一点，请尽可能长时间地控制北方各州（阿斯图里亚斯和巴斯克地区）。在非历史路线下，他们也可能不按正确顺序点焦点，从而让起义无法发生。

1pbx7zu.en: Our Chief Weapon is Surprise...As Spain, have at least 5 spies and stage 5 coups against other nations.
1pbx7zu.zh: 我们最主要的武器就是出其不意...（Our Chief Weapon is Surprise...）作为西班牙，拥有至少 5 名特工并对其他国家发动 5 次政变。

1uo6typ.zh: 发动了超过 ⟦0⟧ 次政变

11g8wd9.en: Join a major faction with a large number of members to be able to get enough spy slots. Do not join in the faction's wars so you can continue to trade with all countries and focus on spies to build up spy networks faster and stage coups more often.
11g8wd9.zh: 加入一个成员众多的大阵营，以便获得足够的特工名额。不要加入该阵营的战争，这样你就能继续与所有国家贸易，并专注于特工以更快地建立特工网络、更频繁地发动政变。

z5cbgv.en: Die, Perfidious Albion!As Fascist France or Vichy France, occupy all of Great Britain.
z5cbgv.zh: 去死吧，背信弃义的阿尔比恩！（Die, Perfidious Albion!）作为法西斯法国或维希法国，占领整个大不列颠。

sgcv9p.en: Ruling party is Fascist Controls all European cores of the United Kingdom and Ireland
sgcv9p.zh: 执政党为法西斯主义 控制英国和爱尔兰的所有欧洲核心领土

1bgeyk9.en: Controls all European cores of the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧
1bgeyk9.zh: 控制 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 的所有欧洲核心领土

m7gmll.en: Rush the fascist focuses. Upon taking Utilize the Leagues, you will have access to decisions of boosting fascist and non-aligned popularity. Hire the fascist demagogue and spam "Rally the Leagues" decision; never take "Unleash La Cagoule" decision. Once you have 50% of fascist and non-aligned combined popularity, you can continue working on the fascist focuses. Take the Political Unity focus as soon as possible, as it removes the chance of spawning the civil war. After that rush towards Expand to the Suez focus. Immediately declare war on Britain and annex them. Your starting army is strong enough to easily destroy Britain.
m7gmll.zh: 速通法西斯焦点。点出「利用联盟」后，你将可以使用提升法西斯主义和中立主义支持度的决议。雇佣法西斯煽动者并反复使用「召集联盟」决议；绝不要使用「释放卡古勒」决议。当法西斯主义与中立主义支持度合计达到 50% 后，你就可以继续推进法西斯焦点。尽快点出「政治统一」焦点，因为它会消除爆发内战的可能。之后速通「扩张至苏伊士」焦点。立即对英国宣战并吞并他们。你的开局军队足以轻松摧毁英国。

1ac2vde.en: Second Time’s the CharmAs France, occupy Moscow while Napoleon VI is your country leader.
1ac2vde.zh: 第二次就灵了（Second Time’s the Charm）作为法国，在拿破仑六世是你的国家领袖时占领莫斯科。

1tdqeo0.en: Controls Moscow (219) Napoléon VI is the current country leader
1tdqeo0.zh: 控制莫斯科 (219) 拿破仑六世是现任国家领袖

znc44a.en: Rush towards Proclaim the Third Empire focus to get Napoléon VI. Wait until Germany declares war on Poland and then declare war on the United Kingdom. Accept the invitation to join Germany's faction. Your starting army and fleet will be enough to destroy the United Kingdom. Annex them in the peace conference. Guarantee Finland when the USSR starts justifying a war goal on them. Accept the call to arms and invite the rest of the Axis. This will make the war easier as the Soviet Union will not receive the "Great Patriotic War" buff. Earn enough warscore and ask your allies for control of Moscow (219).
znc44a.zh: 速通「宣告第三帝国」焦点以获得拿破仑六世。等到德国对波兰宣战后，再对英国宣战。接受邀请加入德国的阵营。你的开局陆军和舰队足以摧毁英国。在和平会议中吞并他们。当苏联开始对芬兰制造战争目标时，保障芬兰独立。接受参战号召并邀请轴心国其他成员。这会让战争更轻松，因为苏联不会获得「伟大的卫国战争」加成。获得足够的战争贡献，并向你的盟友索要莫斯科 (219) 的控制权。

12cnz0l.en: Don’t Die for Your CountryAs Germany in a 1939 start, occupy all of Poland and France without taking more than 475 casualties.
12cnz0l.zh: 不要为你的国家而死（Don’t Die for Your Country）作为德国以 1939 年开局，占领波兰和法国全境，且伤亡不超过 475。

1de2kc7.en: Playing as Germany Start date is after Jan 1st, 1939
1de2kc7.zh: 以德国游玩 开局日期在 1939 年 1 月 1 日之后

1b5cydu.zh: 开局日期在 1939 年 1 月 1 日之后

1vnr95u.en: Controls all European cores of Poland and France Has suffered fewer than 475 casualties in the current wars Has paradropped
1vnr95u.zh: 控制波兰和法国的所有欧洲核心领土 在当前战争中的伤亡少于 475 已进行过伞降

1v1pj7y.en: Controls all European cores of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧
1v1pj7y.zh: 控制 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 的所有欧洲核心领土

4sy6mc.en: Has suffered fewer than ⟦0⟧ casualties in the current wars
4sy6mc.zh: 在当前战争中的伤亡少于 ⟦0⟧

1xqzebq.en: Note: Paradropping troops sets country flag "has_paradropped_flag" which prevents this achievement. For detailed strategies, see Don’t Die for Your Country
1xqzebq.zh: 注意：伞降部队会设置国家标志 "has_paradropped_flag"，从而阻止获得该成就。详细攻略请见 不要为你的国家而死（Don’t Die for Your Country）

18zwx0x.en: Warszawo, Walcz!Stage the Warsaw uprising and succeed.
18zwx0x.zh: 华沙，战斗！（Warszawo, Walcz!）发动华沙起义并取得成功。

ssatcs.en: Any country is at war with the player and Poland Has succesfully staged the Warsaw uprising
ssatcs.zh: 任意国家与玩家处于战争状态，且波兰已成功发动华沙起义

g0avhq.en: Any country is at war with the player and ⟦0⟧
g0avhq.zh: 任意国家与玩家处于战争状态，且 ⟦0⟧

1xgy4ko.en: Has succesfully staged the Warsaw uprising

po8tup.en: Start the game as the Soviet Union, justify and declare war on Poland and call Tannu Tuva into the war. After capitulating Poland, give them all Polish states. Kick them from your faction and justify a war goal on them. Declare war but DO NOT capitulate them. Since they don't have the means to properly suppress resistance, you can just wait until the resistance in Poland hits 90.
po8tup.zh: 以苏联开局，制造战争目标并向波兰宣战，再把图瓦人民共和国拉入战争。波兰投降后，把全部波兰州都交给它。将其踢出你的阵营，并对它制造战争目标。宣战，但不要让它投降。由于它没有足够手段有效镇压抵抗度，你只需等到波兰的抵抗度达到 90。

1s6rofl.en: Tour de FranceOccupy all of mainland France while having at least 20 fully equipped Bicycle regiments.
1s6rofl.zh: 环法自行车赛占领法国本土全境，同时拥有至少 20 个满编的自行车团。

nkezrh.en: Controls all French states in Europe More than 2200 of infantry equipment in armies More than 220 of support equipment in armies More than 22 bicycle battalions
nkezrh.zh: 控制欧洲境内的全部法国州 军队中拥有超过 2200 件步兵装备 军队中拥有超过 220 件支援装备 拥有超过 22 个自行车营

1bsmao9.en: Controls all French states in Europe
1bsmao9.zh: 控制欧洲境内的全部法国州

iofkn2.en: More than ⟦0⟧ of infantry equipment in armies
iofkn2.zh: 军队中拥有超过 ⟦0⟧ 件步兵装备

emeo8e.en: More than ⟦0⟧ of support equipment in armies
emeo8e.zh: 军队中拥有超过 ⟦0⟧ 件支援装备

5a2rpw.zh: 拥有超过 ⟦0⟧ 个自行车营

1tg79f2.en: Note: Mainland France includes Corsica (1). For detailed strategies, see Tour de France
1tg79f2.zh: 注意：法国本土包含科西嘉（1）。详细攻略请见 环法自行车赛

u11mnk.en: You Will Never Kill Me AliveHave one of your spies take a Suicide Pill.
u11mnk.zh: 你永远杀不死我让你的特工服用一次自杀药丸。

fujhz3.en: Have an operative die with the Suicide Pills agency upgrade active
fujhz3.zh: 在「自杀药丸」情报机构升级处于激活状态时让一名特工死亡

aoc9a4.en: Build an intelligence agency and make sure to get the Suicide Pills upgrade. Keep sending your operatives on missions, or just have them perform various activities like 'Build Intel Network' in other countries (preferably the Soviet Union). Eventually one of them will die and the achievement will trigger.
aoc9a4.zh: 建立情报机构，并确保取得「自杀药丸」升级。不断派特工执行任务，或只让他们在他国（最好是苏联）进行「建立情报网」等各种活动。最终其中一人会死亡，成就随之触发。

1cqm815.en: Finnish Him!As Finland, defeat the Soviet Union without joining a faction.
1cqm815.zh: 芬兰他！作为芬兰，在不加入任何阵营的情况下击败苏联。

27l3vg.en: Has defeated the ⟦0⟧ without joining a faction
27l3vg.zh: 已在不加入任何阵营的情况下击败 ⟦0⟧

j0zjsd.en: I Captured the Bosporus and All I Got Was This Lousy AchievementAs Greece or Bulgaria, own both sides of the Bosporus. As Turkey, subjugate both Greece & Bulgaria.
j0zjsd.zh: 我攻占了博斯普鲁斯，却只得到这个烂成就作为希腊或保加利亚，拥有博斯普鲁斯两岸。作为土耳其，征服希腊与保加利亚两国。

k8mctw.en: Playing as either: Bulgaria Greece Turkey
k8mctw.zh: 以以下任一国进行游戏：保加利亚 希腊 土耳其

1ubxy8j.zh: 若以希腊或保加利亚进行游戏：拥有伊斯坦布尔（797） 若以土耳其进行游戏：拥有保加利亚作为附属国，或拥有全部保加利亚核心州 拥有希腊作为附属国，或拥有全部希腊核心州（多德卡尼斯（164）除外）

1dtmklx.zh: 若以 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 进行游戏：拥有伊斯坦布尔（797）

w28dhv.en: If playing as ⟦0⟧: Has Bulgaria as a subject or owns all Bulgarian cores states Has Greece as a subject or owns all Greek cores states (except Dodecaneso (164))
w28dhv.zh: 若以 ⟦0⟧ 进行游戏：拥有保加利亚作为附属国，或拥有全部保加利亚核心州 拥有希腊作为附属国，或拥有全部希腊核心州（多德卡尼斯（164）除外）

15fdyup.zh: 拥有 ⟦0⟧ 作为 ⟦1⟧，或拥有全部保加利亚核心州

1diwqxp.zh: 拥有 ⟦0⟧ 作为 ⟦1⟧，或拥有全部希腊核心州（⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ 除外）

1kld3at.en: Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.As Greece, capture Istanbul and rename it to Constantinople.
1kld3at.zh: 伊斯坦布尔就是君士坦丁堡。又一次。作为希腊，夺取伊斯坦布尔并将其更名为君士坦丁堡。

1fv3zxc.en: Owns Istanbul (797) Istanbul has been renamed to Constantinople
1fv3zxc.zh: 拥有伊斯坦布尔（797） 伊斯坦布尔已更名为君士坦丁堡

4cdj15.en: Istanbul has been renamed to Constantinople
4cdj15.zh: 伊斯坦布尔已更名为君士坦丁堡

u4r89l.en: For detailed strategies, see Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.
u4r89l.zh: 详细攻略请见 伊斯坦布尔就是君士坦丁堡。又一次。

4tg4xr.en: Peter’s PrideAs Peter II of Yugoslavia, overthrow your uncle and become King.
4tg4xr.zh: 彼得的骄傲作为南斯拉夫的彼得二世，推翻你的叔父并成为国王。

17wk8fu.en: Simply go down and complete a focus which puts Peter in charge, such as End the Regency. With historical AI, you won't be attacked before you can take the focus.
17wk8fu.zh: 只需沿国策树向下完成一个让彼得掌权的焦点，例如「结束摄政」。在历史 AI 下，你在点出该焦点之前不会遭到进攻。

1txm2aq.en: This is Madness!As Greece, fulfil the Megali Idea and then form Greater Greece.
1txm2aq.zh: 这太疯狂了！作为希腊，实现伟大理想，然后建立大希腊。

1nui5l3.en: The Megali Idea involves you, UK, and France agreeing to attack and split up Turkey so you are guaranteed the land required in the peace deal. Do note that the UK and France can individually bail on the war when you complete the focus to attack Turkey even if they agreed at the convention, but it is still easy to beat Turkey with just one of them and is possible to beat them by yourself. (See also notes for "Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.") The decision to form Greater Greece is unlocked either by the focus Nenikikamen while your leader is not Georgios Kosmidis, by completing the focus The Modern Movement and choosing to have Ioannis Metaxas as your country leader, or by completing the focus Prepare for the Great Anti-Fascist War.
1nui5l3.zh: 伟大理想需要你、英国和法国同意进攻并瓜分土耳其，因此你在和平会议中一定能拿到所需的土地。请注意，即使英法在会议上同意了，当你完成进攻土耳其的焦点时，它们仍可能各自退出战争；不过仅靠其中一国击败土耳其依然轻松，独自取胜也是可能的。（另见「伊斯坦布尔就是君士坦丁堡。又一次。」的注释。）建立大希腊的决议可通过以下任一方式解锁：在领导人不是 Georgios Kosmidis 时完成焦点 Nenikikamen，完成焦点「现代主义运动」并选择让 Ioannis Metaxas 担任国家领导人，或完成焦点「筹备伟大的反法西斯战争」。

oqids9.en: Prepare for the Great Anti-Fascist War
oqids9.zh: 筹备伟大的反法西斯战争

1ep7zfh.en: Nobody’s Business but the TurksRestore the Ottoman Sultanate.
1ep7zfh.zh: 与土耳其人无关恢复奥斯曼苏丹国。

141ahfn.en: You just have to win a small civil war to get to the focus.
141ahfn.zh: 你只需赢下一场小规模内战就能点出该焦点。

1t3fdty.en: House of KurdsAs Kurdistan, hold all of your cores.
1t3fdty.zh: 库尔德人之家作为库尔德斯坦，守住你的全部核心州。

n0x6e7.zh: 必须满足以下条件之一：初始国家为库尔德斯坦 已成为库尔德斯坦 控制：哈卡里（352） 迪亚巴克尔（350） 凡城（800） 通杰利（353） 马拉蒂亚（344） 东阿塞拜疆（1000） 西阿塞拜疆（419） 库尔德斯坦（1001） 伊拉姆（421） 代尔祖尔（680）

7nel9e.en: One of the following must be true: Original country is Kurdistan Has become Kurdistan
7nel9e.zh: 必须满足以下条件之一：初始国家为库尔德斯坦 已成为库尔德斯坦

yj7dgh.en: Note: Kurdistan cannot be released by Turkey, Syria, Iran and Iraq if Battle for the Bosporus is enabled. This achievement is now possible (patch 1.16.5) through the Iraq focus tree with Graveyard of Empires enabled if you go down the Promote Kurdish Identity path. As of 1.16.9, likely due to a bug, this achievement calls for the control of Malatya (344), which is only a claim, but not for Mosul (676), which is one of Kurdistan's cores. As such, if you seize all the required states and attempt to release Kurdistan, the achievement won't fire. You'll have to go to war with Turkey and seize control of Malatya to get the achievement. For detailed strategies, see House of Kurds
yj7dgh.zh: 注意：若启用《博斯普鲁斯之战》，土耳其、叙利亚、伊朗和伊拉克都无法释放库尔德斯坦。该成就在 1.16.5 补丁后、启用《帝国坟场》并通过伊拉克国策树走「推动库尔德认同」路线时已可达成。截至 1.16.9，可能由于一个漏洞，该成就要求控制马拉蒂亚（344）——它只是一处宣称地——却不要求摩苏尔（676），而摩苏尔是库尔德斯坦的核心州之一。因此，如果你占领了全部所需州并尝试释放库尔德斯坦，成就不会触发。你必须与土耳其开战并夺取马拉蒂亚的控制权才能获得该成就。详细攻略请见 库尔德人之家

1woubc3.en: Hellenic CivilityWin the Greek Civil War before 1937.
1woubc3.zh: 希腊式文明在 1937 年前赢得希腊内战。

123wdvu.en: Has won the Greek Civil War before January 1st, 1937
123wdvu.zh: 已在 1937 年 1 月 1 日前赢得希腊内战

1s889ee.en: Before the civil war fires delete all land units and make a single cavalry division in training. Deploy it in Athens after the war starts and take all victory points to quickly end the civil war. Naval invade Crete (182) if necessary. With Battle for the Bosporus, civil war can be triggered by not arresting the King and going down the The Right to Rule path. Without Battle for the Bosporus, you have to manually trigger a civil war using party popularity mechanics. Since you have a timer for when the civil war starts, you can time the Reorganize the Royal Guard focus to complete one day after the civil war starts. If you have deleted all units previously, the two units granted by the focus will be enough to immideately win the war.
1s889ee.zh: 在内战爆发前删除全部陆军单位，并在训练中保留一个骑兵师。战争开始后将其部署到雅典，占领全部胜利点以迅速结束内战。必要时海军登陆克里特（182）。启用《博斯普鲁斯之战》时，可通过不逮捕国王并走「统治权」路线来触发内战。未启用《博斯普鲁斯之战》时，你必须利用政党支持度机制手动触发内战。由于内战爆发时间有倒计时，你可以安排在开战一天后完成焦点「整编皇家卫队」。如果你此前已删除全部单位，该焦点提供的两个单位就足以立刻赢得战争。

k7unui.zh: 徒步行军用三十个骆驼骑兵师统一阿拉伯。

1xlsht5.zh: 军队中拥有超过 ⟦0⟧ 件步兵装备

1u0m9xq.zh: 拥有超过 ⟦0⟧ 个骆驼骑兵营

tqb73n.en: You can do this as any nation, as long as you have camel units. Easiest as the United Kingdom since it already controls all the territory needed, except Saudi Arabia, Oman and Yemen. Take The King's Party focus route, justify and annex the 3 independent nations of the peninsula. Make a camel template and train 30 of them. You start the game with camels unlocked, but you have to make the template yourself. NOTE: Territory needs to be owned directly (not through puppets and not merely occupied), you'll need to reduce autonomy and annex Oman (which is easy), and, if the British Raj failed to hand over Aden back in 1936, you'll have to annex the Raj too (which is trickier, since The King's Party sets it on the path for independence and gives it a large daily autonomy boost). ⟦0⟧: Ethiopia: Unlocks with Animal Husbandry (By Blood Alone required) Turkey: Unlocks with Desert Camel Corps and The Tuz Gölü Training Facility (Battle for the Bosporus required) Sultanate of Aussa: At the game start At the game start with Battle for the Bosporus enabled: British Raj France Iraq Italy * Oman United Kingdom Saudi Arabia Spain Yemen
tqb73n.zh: 只要你有骆驼单位，任何国家都能完成该成就。用英国最省事，因为它已经控制了所需的大部分领土，只差沙特阿拉伯、阿曼和也门。走「国王党」焦点路线，制造战争目标并吞并半岛上的这 3 个独立国家。建立一个骆驼模板并训练 30 个。开局时骆驼已解锁，但模板需要你自己制作。注意：领土必须直接拥有（不能通过傀儡国、也不能只是占领），你需要降低自治度并吞并阿曼（这很容易）；如果英属印度在 1936 年没有交还亚丁，你还得吞并英属印度（这更棘手，因为「国王党」会让它走上独立道路并给予其大量每日自治度增长）。⟦0⟧：埃塞俄比亚：通过 Animal Husbandry 解锁（需要《以血盟誓》） 土耳其：通过 Desert Camel Corps 和 The Tuz Gölü Training Facility 解锁（需要《博斯普鲁斯之战》） 奥萨苏丹国：开局即拥有 启用《博斯普鲁斯之战》时开局即拥有：英属印度 法国 伊拉克 意大利 * 阿曼 联合王国 沙特阿拉伯 西班牙 也门

12zowey.en: Before 1.12 / By Blood Alone: Go down the communist focus tree towards Pan-Balkan Initiative and instigate an uprising in Romania. When the communists win the civil war, justify on them and declare war (they will not be guaranteed by anyone). Puppet Transylvania in the peace conference and give them all Romanian territory. Starting with 1.12, this doesn't work because of the rework of the peace conference system. You have two choices. Either go down Western focus branch, release Transylvania as a puppet using Autonomy for Slavic Transylvania, and then defeat Romania; or go Communist and defeat Romania twice (first to create the Transylvania puppet, then to give them the rest of Romanian cores). The second route is extra-hard (on historical, anyway), because you need to do it all before the Soviet Union demands Bessarabia in mid-1940.
12zowey.zh: 1.12 /《以血盟誓》之前：沿共产主义国策树走向「泛巴尔干倡议」，并在罗马尼亚煽动起义。共产党赢得交战后，对其制造战争目标并宣战（不会有人保障它们）。在和平会议中将特兰西瓦尼亚设为傀儡，并把全部罗马尼亚领土交给它。从 1.12 起，由于和平会议系统重做，这招不再有效。你有两个选择：要么走西方焦点分支，通过「斯拉夫特兰西瓦尼亚自治」将特兰西瓦尼亚释放为傀儡，然后击败罗马尼亚；要么转共产主义并两次击败罗马尼亚（第一次创建特兰西瓦尼亚傀儡，第二次把其余罗马尼亚核心州交给它）。第二条路线格外困难（至少在历史线下），因为你必须在苏联于 1940 年中期索要比萨拉比亚之前全部完成。

ibkmkj.en: You only need to occupy the states, not own them. Switch to communist and get as many Balkan countries as possible in your faction. The country will flip above 60% communist support ( Romania and Greece are particularly important to get on your side). Any Balkan country in your faction can be annexed through the The Unification of the Balkans focus. Once you have established the Federation, attack whoever still controls land in the Balkans and capitulate Turkey. Note: Turkey needs to be in a faction when they capitulate to satisfy the "at war" and "has capitulated" requirements. Otherwise when they capitulate, they are no longer at war and the achievement doesn't fire.
ibkmkj.zh: 你只需占领这些州，不必拥有它们。转为共产主义，并尽可能把巴尔干国家拉进你的阵营。共产主义支持度超过 60% 时该国就会转向（争取罗马尼亚和希腊站在你这边尤其重要）。阵营内的任何巴尔干国家都可以通过「巴尔干统一」焦点吞并。联邦建立后，进攻仍控制巴尔干土地的国家，并让土耳其投降。注意：土耳其投降时必须处于某个阵营中，才能满足「处于战争状态」和「已投降」的要求。否则它投降后就不再处于战争状态，成就不会触发。

1ibxlyz.zh: 巴尔干问题已解决作为共产主义保加利亚，建立联合巴尔干联邦并拥有全部巴尔干州作为核心州。

1jp44aa.en: Take the focus Revise the Constitution then take Balkans Dominance. Build an army to at least 500k manpower and take the Align Hungary and Split Czechoslovakia focuses. If Hungary refuses, win the war and puppet them. Germany should also agree to split Czechoslovakia giving Romania a Slovakian puppet. Take the Appoint Pro-Axis Government, take the Fascist Demagogue and flip to fascism. Then head to Force Abdication. Remove the Fascist Demagogue once Romania flips to fascism. Wait until Germany declares war against Poland and Bulgaria joins the Axis. Join the war but do not let Hungary and Slovakia into the war. Place the army on the Bulgarian Border. Take King Michael's Coup to flip to democratic and wait until Poland capitulates and the Soviet Union takes Eastern Poland. Take the "Join the Allies" decision and capitulate Bulgaria.
1jp44aa.zh: 点出焦点「修订宪法」，然后点「巴尔干霸权」。把军队扩充到至少 50 万人力，并点出「拉拢匈牙利」和「瓜分捷克斯洛伐克」焦点。如果匈牙利拒绝，就打赢战争并把它设为傀儡。德国也应同意瓜分捷克斯洛伐克，从而给罗马尼亚一个斯洛伐克傀儡。点出「任命亲轴心政府」，聘请「法西斯煽动家」并转为法西斯主义。然后走向「强制退位」。罗马尼亚转为法西斯主义后解雇法西斯煽动家。等到德国对波兰宣战、保加利亚加入轴心国。加入战争，但不要让匈牙利和斯洛伐克参战。把军队部署在保加利亚边境。点出「米哈伊国王政变」以转为民主主义，并等到波兰投降、苏联占领东波兰。选择「加入同盟国」决议，并让保加利亚投降。

1k9uath.en: Go fascist and justify on Albania once you flip. Since Italy is guaranteeing Albania they will join Albania once you declare war on them. Make sure to rush for the port so that the Italians cannot bring over their troops. Capitulate Albania and take all their land.
1k9uath.zh: 转为法西斯主义，并在转向后立刻对阿尔巴尼亚制造战争目标。由于意大利保障着阿尔巴尼亚，你对阿尔巴尼亚宣战时它们会参战。务必抢先夺下港口，让意大利无法把部队运过来。让阿尔巴尼亚投降并夺取其全部土地。

n857hq.en: The Regency Council is formed through Form a Regency Council focus. Go for Plot Against Boris focus and pick the decisions to kill him, then choose a pro-Axis regent and join the Axis. Going down "The democratic principle" seems easier than "The Tsars regime". Prince Paul will be replaced by Peter II in February 1941, and Germany will attack Yugoslavia soon after. Join the war to get the achievement. Not clear how (or if!) this is doable as Yugoslavia: the problem is that the only possible Yugoslavian underage monarch, Peter II, loses his 'underage monarch' trait in September 1941 when he turns 18, but Tsar Boris III of Bulgaria only dies in 1943 under historical AI, and you have no way to influence that.
n857hq.zh: 摄政会议通过「组建摄政会议」焦点成立。走向「密谋对付鲍里斯」焦点，选择杀死他的决议，然后选一位亲轴心摄政并加入轴心国。走「民主原则」似乎比「沙皇体制」更容易。保罗亲王将在 1941 年 2 月被彼得二世取代，德国随后不久就会进攻南斯拉夫。加入战争即可获得该成就。尚不清楚以南斯拉夫如何（或能否！）完成：问题在于唯一可能的南斯拉夫幼主彼得二世会在 1941 年 9 月年满 18 岁时失去「幼主」特质，而保加利亚的沙皇鲍里斯三世在历史 AI 下要到 1943 年才去世，你无法影响这一点。

1ff2sbr.en: Go the Kemalist route through the Continue the Policy of Etatism and Peace at Home focuses. Take the Silent Workhorse advisor and use the Secularism decision whenever available to block the expansion of your Islamist rivals. Türk Ulusu focus will pacify the Kurdish states, while the Islamist opposition can be dealt with through the Counter-Fundamentalist Operation or compromise decisions (as long as the Kemalist remain loyal). You do not have to go to war and simply need enough political power to repeat the decisions. The achievement will trigger when all Islamic states are Placated, and the Kurdish states are either at Separatist Fatigue or cored. Alternatively, follow the Ottoman route, participate in WW2, and be defeated. Since Kurdistan will be established in the East, the negative Kurdish modifiers will be removed.
1ff2sbr.zh: 走凯末尔主义路线，点出「继续国家主义政策」和「国内和平」焦点。聘请「沉默的苦工」顾问，并在「世俗主义」决议可用时随时使用，以阻止伊斯兰主义对手扩张。「Türk Ulusu」焦点将安抚库尔德各州，而伊斯兰主义反对派可通过「反原教旨行动」或妥协决议处理（只要凯末尔主义者保持忠诚）。你无需开战，只需要足够的政治点数来反复执行决议。当所有伊斯兰州都进入「已安抚」状态、库尔德各州达到「分离主义疲劳」或被设为核心州时，成就就会触发。另一种做法是走奥斯曼路线，参加二战并被击败。由于库尔德斯坦将在东部建立，负面的库尔德修正会被移除。

7ocaci.en: After completing The Fate of the Balkans you get the ability to peacefully puppet any nation with a Balkan capital who is in your faction, as well as the capacity to force them into your faction if they are not already in one. A puppeted Yugoslavia can be integrated with its constituent states released as puppets for this achievement, or you can seize 803 (106) from them via decision. These states can make the puppets Macedonia and Serbia. In order to get states to join your faction via decision it is important to have more manpower deployed to the field, and puppet expeditionary forces contribute to this number.
7ocaci.zh: 完成「巴尔干的命运」后，你将获得和平傀儡任何首都位于巴尔干且处于你阵营中的国家的能力，也能强迫尚未加入任何阵营的此类国家加入你的阵营。被设为傀儡的南斯拉夫可以整合，并释放其组成部分作为傀儡来达成该成就，或者你也可以通过决议夺取它的 803（106）。这些州可以造就马其顿和塞尔维亚两个傀儡。要想通过决议让州加入你的阵营，重要的是在战场上投入更多人力，而傀儡提供的远征军也会计入这一数字。

1lpdo3l.en: The Pope? How many Divisions does he have?As the USSR take Rome.

8ucs8c.en: Note: Do not take the focus Reconcile Japan since North Sakhalin is your core! Turn off historical German focuses, leaving everything else on historical. 1l2gnno.zh: 同时保留自己的核心州

hwqf2w.en: One Step ForwardAs Soviet Union declare a war on Poland and Germany before Germany attacks Poland.

hacxd4.zh: 每个邻国都是你的附属国

37ec35.en: Crusader Kings IIIAs Poland, crown a King (or Queen) and capture Jerusalem.
37ec35.zh: 十字军之王 III作为波兰，加冕一位国王（或女王）并夺取耶路撒冷。

d3b41t.zh: 已选举一位君主 控制巴勒斯坦（454）

11k316k.en: The Romanovs laugh lastRestore the Romanovs to the throne and conquer Germany, Hungary, Austria, Czechoslovakia, Turkey, and Bulgaria.
11k316k.zh: 罗曼诺夫家族笑到最后让罗曼诺夫家族重登皇位，并征服德国、匈牙利、奥地利、捷克斯洛伐克、土耳其和保加利亚。

1ry9wzt.zh: 勃兰登堡（64） 波希米亚（9） 下奥地利（4） 北匈牙利（43） 索菲亚（48） 安卡拉（49）
