1n9dh6n.zh: 详细攻略请见 罗曼诺夫家族笑到最后

1adjjjg.en: We don't really like statisticsAs the Soviet Union under Stalin, conquer Germany while suffering less than 1 million casualties total.
1adjjjg.zh: 我们其实不太喜欢统计数字作为斯大林治下的苏联，在累计伤亡少于 100 万的情况下征服德国。

98mhpw.en: Iosif Stalin is the current country leader Has defeated Germany while taking less than 1 million casualties
98mhpw.zh: 现任国家领导人为 Iosif Stalin 已在伤亡少于 100 万的情况下击败德国

aapbsg.en: Has defeated Germany while taking less than 1 million casualties
aapbsg.zh: 已在伤亡少于 100 万的情况下击败德国

1sdigy7.en: Germany must capitulate to you. If it capitulates to another faction and you don't see the popup, you won't get the achievement. Can be done in a historical playthrough, but it's easiest to achieve when Germany goes for Oppose Hitler. Attack the Monarchist (or both sides) before they can recover from the civil war. Something to note is that this number only applies to casualties taken from Germany; you can take as many casualties as you like from other countries you are at war with.
1sdigy7.zh: 德国必须向你投降。如果它向其他阵营投降而你看到弹窗时，你将得不到该成就。历史线通关也能完成，但当德国选择「反对希特勒」时最容易达成。在君主派（或双方）尚未从内战中恢复时发起进攻。需要注意的一点是，这个数字只计入从德国承受的伤亡；与其它交战国作战时你想承受多少伤亡都可以。

oabbzm.en: Race for GermanyAs the Soviet union, capitulate Germany after the fall of France before the Allies control one German core state.
oabbzm.zh: 德国竞速作为苏联，在法国沦陷后、同盟国控制任何一个德国核心州之前让德国投降。

1ceajs5.en: Conquered Germany after the Fall of France, before any other country took a core state of Germany.
1ceajs5.zh: 在法国沦陷后、任何其他国家夺取德国核心州之前征服了德国。

1dsinjk.en: When Germany capitulates, all their core states have to fall under your control. France must be in the Allies and have capitulated. The earlier the war, the better your odds. Go down the Collective Security branch and pick Eradicate Western Fascism (mid-1939 to optimize the attack bonus). Refuse the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact, and attack the German when they close in on Paris. Collaboration Government in Germany could be helpful. Alternatively help Germany kill the Allies by naval invading the UK after the fall of France then kill Germany. It is safer but harder.
1dsinjk.zh: 德国投降时，其全部核心州都必须落入你的控制之下。法国必须加入同盟国并已投降。开战越早，胜算越大。走「集体安全」分支并选择「铲除西方法西斯主义」（1939 年中期可优化进攻加成）。拒绝《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》，并在德国逼近巴黎时进攻它。在德国建立合作政府会有所帮助。另一种做法是帮助德国消灭同盟国——在法国沦陷后海军登陆英国，然后再消灭德国。这样更稳妥但更难。

h2pytc.zh: 西伯利亚虎作为图瓦人民共和国，建立西伯利亚。

1etaehc.en: For detailed strategies, see Siberian Tiger
1etaehc.zh: 详细攻略请见 西伯利亚虎

117vbc8.en: Just proper ganderAs the Soviet Union, activate 30 propaganda campaigns before 1945.
117vbc8.zh: 只需要好好宣传作为苏联，在 1945 年前激活 30 次宣传运动。

zg26lb.en: Completed at least 30 propaganda Campaigns After Jan 1st, 1945
zg26lb.zh: 已完成至少 30 次宣传运动 在 1945 年 1 月 1 日之后

pcpycp.zh: 已完成至少 ⟦0⟧ 次宣传运动

zpa2qv.en: Complete "The Path of Marxism Leninism", "Addressing Internal Affairs", "Expand the Agitprop", "The Komsomol" and then either "Positive Heroism" or "Collectivist Propaganda" to unlock the Agitprop decisions and expand to three slots. Continually take these decisions as soon as they are available to achieve 30 campaigns around five years after starting so make sure to start by 1939 just to be safe.
zpa2qv.zh: 完成「马克思列宁主义之路」、「处理内部事务」、「扩充宣传鼓动机构」、「共青团」，然后选择「正面英雄主义」或「集体主义宣传」，以解锁宣传鼓动决议并扩展到三个槽位。决议一可用就立刻执行，这样在开局约五年后就能完成 30 次宣传运动；保险起见，务必在 1939 年前就开始。

b7s9ae.en: Around Eurasia in 80 daysMake a railroad from Gibraltar to Singapore.
b7s9ae.zh: 八十天环欧亚修建一条从直布罗陀到新加坡的铁路。

1godjel.en: For railways to connect, the provinces must be owned by members of the same faction. There are multiple possible routes to choose from. The route which passes through the fewest countries is Gibraltar - Spain - France - Germany - Poland - Soviet Union - Iran - British Raj - British Burma - Siam - British Malaya.
1godjel.zh: 铁路若要连通，相关省份必须由同一阵营的成员拥有。可选的路线有多条。经过国家最少的一条是：直布罗陀 - 西班牙 - 法国 - 德国 - 波兰 - 苏联 - 伊朗 - 英属印度 - 英属缅甸 - 暹罗 - 英属马来亚。

15zrwdj.en: Poland Peasant RevolutionAs Poland, have the Peasant’s Strike overthrow the government.
15zrwdj.zh: 波兰农民革命作为波兰，让农民罢工推翻政府。

akwiif.en: Has completed focus Organize the Peasant's Strike Is not in a civil war Ruling party is either Democratic or Communist
akwiif.zh: 已完成焦点「组织农民罢工」 未处于内战中 执政党为民主主义或共产主义

4yw7ht.en: Is not in a civil war

3zej98.en: Simply take the focus Organize the Peasant's Strike and then take the decisions to claim provinces as well as the option to expand the strike to the factories. Having even a few provinces let’s you win the civil war easily.
3zej98.zh: 只需点出焦点「组织农民罢工」，然后执行索取省份的决议，以及把罢工扩展到工厂的选项。哪怕只拿到几个省份，你也能轻松赢下内战。

1sccti7.en: …and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!As Switzerland, have 24 states
1sccti7.zh: ……你得到一个州，每个人都得到一个州！作为瑞士，拥有 24 个州

k583aj.en: For detailed strategies, see …and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
k583aj.zh: 详细攻略请见 ……你得到一个州，每个人都得到一个州！

1osbgid.en: I’m not locked in here with you…As Switzerland, declare war on Germany and win.
1osbgid.zh: 我不是被你关在这里的……作为瑞士，对德国宣战并取胜。

49u01t.en: After the Anschluss, you can justify a quick war goal on Germany using the claim on Vorarlberg. Doing this once the Allies have made a successful landing or two, you can fall back to a defensive line and simply wait.
49u01t.zh: 德奥合并之后，你可以利用对福拉尔贝格的主张，快速对德国制造战争目标。等到同盟国成功登陆一两次后再动手，你就可以退守防线静静等待。

gis12h.en: Follow the guide for ⟦0⟧. The most important thing is that once you unite Scandinavia, you DON'T disband the faction, or join the ⟦1⟧ - instead, just release ⟦2⟧ as a puppet. Yes, Iceland counts, and you're not exactly getting a lot of industry from them. Make sure you don't have anyone else in your faction; some countries will probably ask to join, so you have to fight your impulse to invite them.
gis12h.zh: 按照 ⟦0⟧ 的攻略操作。最重要的一点是：统一斯堪的纳维亚之后，你千万不要解散阵营，也不要加入 ⟦1⟧——而是把 ⟦2⟧ 作为傀儡国释放。没错，冰岛也算数，而且你从他们那里得到的工业本来也不多。确保你的阵营中没有其他人；有些国家很可能会申请加入，所以你必须克制住邀请他们的冲动。

cs2x3t.en: It's required to get a MIO of each category to level 11 at least. Progress towards the next stages (funds) is gained by either researching with the according MIO assigned to the research and/or by producing equipment with the MIO assigned. Best done with the USA as they have a strong economy and research abilities.
cs2x3t.zh: 每一类军事工业组织都必须至少达到 11 级。向下一阶段推进所需的进度（资金）可以通过两种方式获得：将相应的军事工业组织指派给科研项目进行研究，和/或让该军事工业组织负责生产装备。用美国来完成最好，因为他们拥有强大的经济与科研能力。

1nl5hn8.en: If Germany is the last major in its faction then capitulating it will end the war and the achievement will not fire. Capitulating it before Italy is recommended, unless one of the Balkan Axis countries becomes a major. Any faction that includes the United Kingdom counts as 'the Allies'.

utxr7q.en: Easy and quick with Chile or Argentina. Use the research bonuses from the military branch of the focus tree to get nuclear weapons early. As Chile you need some fighters to guarantee air superiority. As Argentina just release Y Wladychfa Gymreig as a free country and then justify a war goal.
utxr7q.zh: 用智利或阿根廷会又快又简单。利用国策树军事分支提供的科研加成尽早获得核武器。作为智利，你需要一些战斗机来确保制空权。作为阿根廷，只需将 Y Wladychfa Gymreig 作为自由国家释放，然后制造战争目标。

1eelbgc.zh: 我回家了！以巴西占领葡萄牙的每一块核心

wy91ar.en: Controls: Porto (180) Guarda (181) Lisbon (112) Santarém (795) Beja (179) Madeira (697) Azores (698)

y05hyz.en: You can start this by either subjugating Portugal with the monarchist path, or by going down communism or fascism, getting a foothold in Iberia by declaring on one (or more) of the Spanish Civil War factions, and taking land when they capitulate that borders Portugal. If you subjugate them, it's easier if you take Spain and give it to your Portugese puppet so you can build on the land and lower their autonomy easier.
y05hyz.zh: 你可以通过两种方式开始：走君主主义路线让葡萄牙臣服，或者走共产主义或法西斯主义路线，对西班牙内战中的一方（或多方）宣战以在伊比利亚取得立足点，并在他们投降时夺取与葡萄牙接壤的土地。如果你选择让葡萄牙臣服，先拿下西班牙并把它交给你的葡萄牙傀儡国会更容易，这样你就能在那片土地上建造，并更轻松地降低他们的自治度。

1etnszr.en: When the civil war fires, chose the option for divisions, rather than territory and do the Mobilize the Veteran Legionaries focus ASAP. When you attack Argentina DO NOT finish the war, but try to push a bit in the south and cause some casualties. When WW2 starts, attack France and join Axis. If Germany doesn't let you join, reload the save and they will let you. Once France capitulates, just ask Germany for control of Paris. (You should have enough war score from the war against Argentina). If it still is not enough, try giving Germany some of the occupied territories in Argentina.

4sq2z5.en: Argentina: Go the fascist path down to "Union Nacional Fascista" and build up your industry and a capable army. Get military access from Italy or even join the Axis via focus. Either way naval invade Spain when their civil war is over and your army is ready. They'll have very few equipment but will try to conquer any bridgehead you establish. This will cause them to have a massive equipment deficit quickly so you can overrun them easily. (Naval invading from countries you only have military access to works when you first set up a naval invasion from your country to the point from where you want to naval invade your actual target. For example set up from Buenos Aires to Sardinia and then you should be able to plan from Sardinia).
4sq2z5.zh: 阿根廷：走法西斯路线，一路点出 “Union Nacional Fascista”，同时发展工业和一支有战斗力的陆军。从意大利取得军事通行权，或者通过焦点直接加入轴心国。无论哪种方式，等西班牙内战结束、你的陆军准备就绪后，海军登陆西班牙。他们的装备会非常匮乏，但会试图消灭你建立的任何滩头阵地。这会让他们迅速出现巨大的装备缺口，于是你就能轻松碾压他们。（从你只有军事通行权的国家发起海军登陆是可行的，办法是先从本国向一个中转点规划海军登陆，再从那里登陆你真正的目标。例如，先规划从布宜诺斯艾利斯到撒丁岛，之后就能从撒丁岛开始规划。）

1egt4ik.en: Rush down the fascist route and take the Hispanic Alliance focus to invite all fascist or non-aligned Hispanic American countries. There is an 80% chance for them to accept your invitation (independent of opinion or diplomatic pressure). In 1936, these countries are Argentina, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela, with Bolivia and Paraguay potentially flipping later. NOTE: make sure to take the focus when as many of them as possible are eligible, because it's a one-time thing; once the focus event fires, short of conquering them, it becomes extremely difficult to add anyone who refused or was ineligible at the time. Unless they are in a war, they'll need 30% fascist support, fascist government, +100 opinion, 100% diplomatic pressure, and some special factor like having a border with you, to make them accept.
1egt4ik.zh: 速点法西斯路线，并点出 西班牙联盟 焦点，邀请所有法西斯或中立主义的西语美洲国家。它们有 80% 的概率接受你的邀请（与好感度或外交压力无关）。1936 年，这些国家是阿根廷、多米尼加共和国、萨尔瓦多、危地马拉、尼加拉瓜、秘鲁、乌拉圭和委内瑞拉，玻利维亚和巴拉圭之后可能也会转投。注意：务必在尽可能多的国家符合条件时再点这个焦点，因为这是一次性的；焦点事件一旦触发，除了征服它们，之后再想把当时拒绝或不符合条件的国家拉进来会极其困难。除非它们处于战争状态，否则需要 30% 法西斯主义支持率、法西斯政府、+100 好感度、100% 外交压力，再加上与你接壤之类的特殊因素，它们才会接受。

Once you reach 60% fascism popularity, continue down the focus tree and either create your own faction (Argentina First) or join the Axis. Near the bottom of the fascist tree you'll find the focus The Old Enemy giving you a war goal on Brazil. Once you declare your war the achievement will unlock.

1mse8mr.en: Build Nuclear Research Facilities and hire scientists to man them. Rush down to Manhattan project, you get there the fastest by choosing ⟦0⟧. Research Atomic Research as well as all computing research ahead of time. You can also go for radar research to increase physics breakthroughs. Assign whatever Scientists to Pile-1 Nuclear Reactor, but you MUST choose Oppenheimer for The Manhattan Project. Make sure to check out iterations and decisions during the research. If an event comes up asking you to decide whether to keep or dismiss Oppenheimer from the project, keep him. Once the project completes, the achievement pops.

1iowkq9.en: After Jan 1st, 1945 Greece has capitulated before Jan 1st, 1945 Any army leader is in Attica (47), Dodecaneso (164), Crete (182), Thrace (184), Epirus (185), Peloponnese (186), Aegean Islands (187) or Central Macedonia (731)

q671fn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在 1945 年 1 月 1 日之前已投降

ibk6bp.en: Best done as Australia on either the Democratic or the Fascist dominion path. Defend Greece from the Axis and keep your HQ there. When the war ends Greece leaves the Allies and will kick your divisions out, but the achievement will fire anyway. In the event that the Axis surrenders well before 1945, you can instead try to annex the Dodecanese from Italy in the peace conference and station the HQ there. If that's not possible, there may be enough world tension that you can immediately justify a war on Greece once they leave the Allies, declare war and get the HQ into a Greek state before they capitulate.
ibk6bp.zh: 最好用澳大利亚走民主或法西斯的自治领路线完成。守住希腊抵御轴心国，并把总部留在那里。战争结束时希腊会退出同盟国并把你的师赶出去，但成就仍会触发。如果轴心国在 1945 年之前很早就投降，你可以改为在和会中从意大利手中吞并佐泽卡尼索斯，并把总部设在那里。如果这也做不到，世界紧张度可能足够高，让你能在希腊退出同盟国后立即对其制造战争目标、宣战，并在其投降前把总部开进某个希腊州。

14lxygk.en: As the Soviets, you can justify and declare on Poland at game start with a fallback line behind Bryansk. From here, you just need to wait until the AI puts a general in or nearby Bryansk, and then encircle and capture it. Can alternatively be done by retreating as the USSR during Barbarossa or while invading as Germany, but this is faster with an easier war.
14lxygk.zh: 作为苏联，你可以在开局就向波兰制造战争目标并宣战，把撤退线设在布良斯克后方。之后你只需等待 AI 把一名将领派到布良斯克或其附近，然后包围并俘获他。另一种做法是在巴巴罗萨行动中作为苏联撤退，或作为德国进攻时完成，但用上面那场更轻松的战争会更快。

Alternatively, after conquering French Indochina, build up and wait for Japan to declare war, submit to and join their faction, and then capitulate Yunnan, Guangxi, Guangdong, and British Burma.

19nnefr.en: This page lists the codes which may be input into the Console Window, a special debugging window which may be accessed on non-ironman games by hitting ⟦0⟧ , ⟦1⟧ or tilde (~) (key varies based on keyboard layout). Press the up or down arrow keys to traverse through previously executed commands. Many codes can be turned off by repeating the command, but sometimes reloading the save or exiting the game is necessary. Please note that many of these commands come in and out with each DLC making some of them not work. Mods may introduce commands and more commonly, tags into the game to enhance their gameplay.
19nnefr.zh: 本页面列出了可输入控制台窗口的指令代码。控制台窗口是一个特殊的调试窗口，在非铁人模式下按 ⟦0⟧ 、⟦1⟧ 或波浪号（~）即可打开（按键因键盘布局而异）。按上、下方向键可翻阅此前执行过的指令。许多指令可通过重复输入来关闭，但有时需要重新加载存档或退出游戏。请注意，许多指令会随每个 DLC 的推出而出现或消失，因此其中一些可能无法使用。模组也可能为游戏引入指令，更常见的是引入标签，以增强其玩法。

psuryr.en: Also of note, commands may not work in ironman games by design.
psuryr.zh: 另需注意，按设计，指令在铁人模式游戏中可能无法使用。

1jk8d60.en: Press Shift+2, §, ~, \, `, ", º, ^ or ALT+2+1, or Shift+3 to access the console (key varies based on keyboard layout)
1jk8d60.zh: 按 Shift+2、§、~、\、`、"、º、^ 或 ALT+2+1，或 Shift+3 可打开控制台（按键因键盘布局而异）

16nh7bz.en: Console commands use internal IDs, which may be obtained in a variety of different ways.
16nh7bz.zh: 控制台指令使用内部 ID，可通过多种不同方式获取。

16cl5hg.en: An easy way to tell internal IDs is debug mode. ⟦0⟧ as a console command will turn on debug mode which can provide information about certain database entries, such as focuses, national spirits (and other ideas such as laws or designers), or technologies when hovering over them, as well as obtaining information when hovering over a province of IDs of the state and the province, as well as the 3-letter country tag of the country it belongs to. ⟦1⟧
16cl5hg.zh: 查看内部 ID 的一个简便方法是调试模式。⟦0⟧ 作为控制台指令可开启调试模式，将鼠标悬停在某些数据库条目上时可提供相关信息，例如国策、国家精神（以及法令、设计商等其他理念）或科技；悬停在一个省份上时，还可获取该州与省份的 ID，以及其所属国家的三字母国家标签。⟦1⟧

15tt0k7.en: Note that while modding, the console command does not do everything that the launch option does and cannot serve as a substitute.
15tt0k7.zh: 请注意，在进行模组制作时，该控制台指令并不能实现启动选项的全部功能，无法作为其替代。

3ghtts.en: If that is impossible, using localisation is an alternative. To do that, navigate to the folder where the game is contained, then to the ⟦0⟧ folder. Each file in there contains localisation keys with values that actually appear in-game assigned to them. Using a non-default text editor can also allow using the 'Search in files' function (Such as in Notepad++, Sublime Text, or Visual Studio Code) in order to search through every single localisation file at the same time to find a specified value.
3ghtts.zh: 如果无法做到，使用本地化文件是另一种方法。为此，请先找到游戏所在文件夹，然后进入 ⟦0⟧ 文件夹。其中的每个文件都包含本地化键，并为其分配了实际在游戏中显示的值。使用非默认的文本编辑器还可以使用“在文件中搜索”功能（例如 Notepad++、Sublime Text 或 Visual Studio Code 中），从而同时搜索每一个本地化文件，以找到指定的值。

1vkxta2.en: In this article, there are 3 types of brackets used within commands:
1vkxta2.zh: 在本文中，指令内使用了 3 种括号：

1rt4zul.en: Regular brackets as in ⟦0⟧ are used to show aliases, alternate names for the console commands. In this case, using ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ has the same effect in-game.
1rt4zul.zh: 像 ⟦0⟧ 这样的圆括号用于表示别名，即控制台指令的替代名称。在此例中，使用 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧ 在游戏中的效果相同。

1pjabc.en: Square brackets as in ⟦0⟧ signify an ⟦1⟧ argument. In this case, both ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ will work, but may have different effects.
1pjabc.zh: 像 ⟦0⟧ 这样的方括号表示 ⟦1⟧ 参数。在此例中，⟦2⟧ 和 ⟦3⟧ 都能生效，但效果可能不同。

10usdgf.en: Square brackets in combination with angle brackets as in ⟦0⟧ signify a ⟦1⟧ argument. In this case, ⟦2⟧ will work, but ⟦3⟧ will not.
10usdgf.zh: 像 ⟦0⟧ 这样方括号与尖括号组合使用，表示 ⟦1⟧ 参数。在此例中，⟦2⟧ 会生效，但 ⟦3⟧ 不会。

1hmrdt4.en: ie: gain_xp seawolf Note To make it work with new, generic created Admirals: 1. Open 'Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\settings.txt' with a text editor and change "save_as_binary=yes" to "save_as_binary=no". 2. Start game, load savegame and save as new file, exit game. 3. Open 'Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of iron IV\Save Games' , open the newly created savegame file, search (CTRL-F) for the name of your generic created Admiral 4. Go a few lines below to max_traits=0.000 and add the following code block behind it in_progress={ seawolf=0.000 superior_tactician=0.000 spotter=0.000 fly_swatter=0.000 ironside=0.000 air_controller=0.000 } 5. Make sure to save the file with ANSI encoding format. 6. Start game, load save game, use gain_xp command, enjoy. (Optional turn back on binarization in settings.txt)
1hmrdt4.zh: 例如：gain_xp seawolf 备注 要使其对新建的通用海军上将生效：1. 用文本编辑器打开 'Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\settings.txt'，将 "save_as_binary=yes" 改为 "save_as_binary=no"。2. 启动游戏，载入存档并另存为新文件，退出游戏。3. 打开 'Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of iron IV\Save Games'，打开新创建的存档文件，搜索（CTRL-F）你新建的通用海军上将的名字。4. 向下几行找到 max_traits=0.000，在其后面添加以下代码块 in_progress={ seawolf=0.000 superior_tactician=0.000 spotter=0.000 fly_swatter=0.000 ironside=0.000 air_controller=0.000 }。5. 确保以 ANSI 编码格式保存文件。6. 启动游戏，载入存档，使用 gain_xp 指令，尽情享受。（可选：在 settings.txt 中重新开启二进制化）

kp1e56.en: Here are some of the common acronyms in the game and in discussions surrounding it:
kp1e56.zh: 以下是游戏中以及相关讨论中常见的一些缩写：

6uevd6.en: Anti-air - Can be used in multiple contexts. Most common are ⟦0⟧ and divisional anti-air (⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ that use anti-air equipment such as ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧).
6uevd6.zh: 防空（Anti-air）——可用于多种语境。最常见的是⟦0⟧，以及师属防空（⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧使用⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧等防空装备）。

1oejd1m.en: ⟦0⟧ - Artillery designed to shoot down enemy ⟦1⟧.

v3st4w.en: Armored Car - wheeled (not tracked) lightly armored military vehicle typically used for reconnaissance and security.
v3st4w.zh: 装甲车（Armored Car）——轮式（而非履带式）的轻装甲军用车辆，通常用于侦察和警戒。

1cbrmaw.en: In multiplayer, more commonly used to refer to a ⟦0⟧'s air controller player (see ⟦1⟧ section).
1cbrmaw.zh: 在多人游戏中，更常用来指⟦0⟧的空军控制手玩家（参见⟦1⟧一节）。

1bzbq23.en: ⟦0⟧ - A player's recounting of their game. For more detail, see the ⟦1⟧.
1bzbq23.zh: ⟦0⟧——玩家对自己一局游戏的记述。更多细节参见⟦1⟧。

5ytx7t.en: Artificial intelligence - What controls all ⟦0⟧ that are not being played by humans. (In the context of Hearts of Iron 4, this term uses a very loose definition of "intelligence".)
5ytx7t.zh: 人工智能（Artificial intelligence）——控制所有非玩家操作⟦0⟧的程序。（在钢铁雄心4的语境中，这个词对「智能」的定义非常宽松。）

hushpo.en: Armored Personnel Carrier - an armored fighting vehicle for carrying infantry soldiers in combat or Armor Piercing Capped - an armor piercing shell type used in anti-tank guns and naval guns.
hushpo.zh: 装甲人员输送车（Armored Personnel Carrier）——在战斗中运送步兵的装甲战斗车辆；或风帽穿甲弹（Armor Piercing Capped）——反坦克炮和舰炮使用的一种穿甲弹类型。

odj9cf.en: ⟦0⟧, including light (LARM), medium (MARM), heavy (HARM), and super-heavy (SHARM) varieties.
odj9cf.zh: ⟦0⟧，包括轻型（LARM）、中型（MARM）、重型（HARM）和超重型（SHARM）。

1udsyxs.en: Anti-submarine warfare - the use of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ to find and destroy enemy ⟦2⟧. This is usually the main task of destroyer escorts in combat.
1udsyxs.zh: 反潜战（Anti-submarine warfare）——使用⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧发现并击毁敌方⟦2⟧。这通常是驱逐舰护航在战斗中的主要任务。

iepfm1.en: ⟦0⟧, including ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, or ⟦3⟧ (see also SPxx). Also "Arty". See also RART.
iepfm1.zh: ⟦0⟧，包括⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧（另见 SPxx）。也写作「Arty」。另见 RART。

1ceqk2k.en: Anti-tank - Designates ⟦0⟧ with a high ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ value, can be ⟦3⟧ or ⟦4⟧.
1ceqk2k.zh: 反坦克（Anti-tank）——指⟦0⟧具有高⟦1⟧和高⟦2⟧数值，可以是⟦3⟧或⟦4⟧。

1szijrt.en: ⟦0⟧ - Most powerful type of ⟦1⟧ equipped with guns.

18fsryi.en: ⟦0⟧ - Heavily armored and gunned battleship, sometimes designated as SHBB.
18fsryi.zh: ⟦0⟧——重装甲重火力的战列舰，有时称为 SHBB。

1kr4xqn.en: ⟦0⟧ - Lightly armored battleship, served as a fast convoy attack ship, but can be used in the same role as a BB in HoI4.
1kr4xqn.zh: ⟦0⟧——轻装甲战列舰，曾用作快速袭击运输船队的军舰，但在钢铁雄心4中也可以承担与 BB 相同的角色。

fhylpy.en: ⟦0⟧ - Mechanic used in HoI4 to simplify defensive or offensive management of ⟦1⟧.
fhylpy.zh: ⟦0⟧——钢铁雄心4中用于简化⟦1⟧的防御或进攻管理的机制。

164d6y8.en: A term used in the names of ⟦0⟧, also informally to refer to a tactical formation of one or more regiments and other assets, a tactical force of comparable size, a collection of varied troops grouped together, or other colloquial meanings. To avoid confusion, it should not be used interchangeably with "regiment" to describe a combat ⟦1⟧ column in a ⟦2⟧. Rectangular infantry divisions, common in World War One, were composed of 2 brigades each of 2 regiments.
164d6y8.zh: 该词用于⟦0⟧的名称中，也非正式地指由⟦1⟧组成、并配有其他力量的战术编队，或规模相当的战术部队，或混编在一起的各类部队；还有其他口语含义。为避免混淆，不应把它与「团」混用来描述⟦2⟧中的一列战斗部队。第一次世界大战中常见的方阵制步兵师由 2 个旅组成，每个旅下辖 2 个团。

1dbyasc.en: ⟦0⟧ - the ⟦1⟧ tree that benefits ⟦2⟧ the most.
1dbyasc.zh: ⟦0⟧——在⟦1⟧中，对⟦2⟧提升最大的那一分支。

ju4icg.en: ⟦0⟧ - Large sized cruiser, can fit multiple roles.
ju4icg.zh: ⟦0⟧——大型巡洋舰，可胜任多种角色。

jufafj.en: Carrier air group - The ⟦0⟧ attached to an ⟦1⟧.
jufafj.zh: 舰载机大队（Carrier air group）——⟦0⟧配属给⟦1⟧。

1pwjpfj.en: More commonly, short for capitulation or surrender.
1pwjpfj.zh: 更常见的用法是「capitulation」或「surrender」（投降）的简称。

qz5ojh.en: Less commonly, Combat Air Patrol, ⟦0⟧ flying overhead to protect their target from enemy ⟦1⟧.
qz5ojh.zh: 较少见的用法是战斗空中巡逻（Combat Air Patrol），即⟦0⟧在目标上空飞行，保护其免受敌方⟦1⟧攻击。

bg1akl.en: Naval bomber ⟦0⟧ that also have a lot of close air support weapons, letting them act as either CAS or NAVs as needed.
bg1akl.zh: 同时装有大量近距空中支援武器的海军轰炸机⟦0⟧，可按需充当 CAS 或 NAV。

98o2ab.en: ⟦0⟧ - Combat ⟦1⟧ mounted on horseback, available in many ⟦2⟧ at the start of the war, and often favored for partisan ⟦3⟧.
98o2ab.zh: ⟦0⟧——乘马机动的战斗⟦1⟧，战争开始时许多⟦2⟧都有，也常用于游击队⟦3⟧。

lhopjv.en: Casus belli - Cause for war, term carried over from other Paradox games with the same meaning as the possibilities for Justifying War Goal (Conquer, Puppet, etc.).
lhopjv.zh: Casus belli（宣战理由）——开战的理由，这一术语沿袭自其他 Paradox 游戏，含义与制造战争目标的各种理由（征服、傀儡等）相同。

1kmo2e9.en: Less commonly, large cruisers, which describe special ship types that use cruiser armor but can equip heavy gun batteries, e.g., Panzerschiffs and Coastal Defense Ships.
1kmo2e9.zh: 较少见的用法是大巡洋舰（large cruisers），指使用巡洋舰装甲但能装备重型主炮的特殊舰种，例如装甲舰和岸防舰。

14i295g.en: Construction industrial capacity - Capacity provided by ⟦0⟧ for the ⟦1⟧ of any structure in HoI4.
14i295g.zh: 建造工业产能（Construction industrial capacity）——由⟦0⟧提供、用于在钢铁雄心4中⟦1⟧任何建筑的产能。

1p282jd.en: Commander-in-chief. The term is never used in HoI4 itself, but players may use it to designate various things such as the ⟦0⟧.
1p282jd.zh: 总司令（Commander-in-chief）。钢铁雄心4本身从不使用这个术语，但玩家可能用它来指代各种事物，例如⟦0⟧。

16x4qh.en: Chief of Naval Operations. The term is never used in HoI4 itself, but players may use it to designate various things such as the ⟦0⟧.
16x4qh.zh: 海军作战部长（Chief of Naval Operations）。钢铁雄心4本身从不使用这个术语，但玩家可能用它来指代各种事物，例如⟦0⟧。

vv9bzt.en: Crash To Desktop - Frequently used in ⟦0⟧ notes.
vv9bzt.zh: 崩溃到桌面（Crash To Desktop）——常用于⟦0⟧说明中。

1rho1qp.zh: ⟦0⟧或航空母舰特遣舰队（Carrier Task Force）。

1kgjqn6.en: Escort Aircraft Carrier - a shorter and slower carrier with fewer ⟦0⟧, but was cheaper and quicker to build. Usually converted from a cruiser when playing with ⟦1⟧. Historically, used to defend ⟦2⟧, but in practice in the game, is bad at that job and so instead is best either for navies that cannot afford full carriers or wish to sidestep issues with ⟦3⟧.
1kgjqn6.zh: 护航航空母舰（Escort Aircraft Carrier）——更短、更慢、⟦0⟧更少的航空母舰，但造价更低、建造更快。在使用⟦1⟧游玩时通常由巡洋舰改装而成。历史上用于护卫⟦2⟧，但在游戏实际表现中并不擅长此职，因此最适合用在不养不起正规航母、或想回避⟦3⟧问题的海军。

pw8qhr.en: Light Aircraft Carrier - a faster version of CVE able to keep up with fast moving, full size aircraft carriers.
pw8qhr.zh: 轻型航空母舰（Light Aircraft Carrier）——CVE 的更快版本，能跟上高速行进的正规航空母舰。

1agh8cb.en: Damage Control, emergency measures to prevent the sinking of a ⟦0⟧ from battle damage or Depth Charge, a weapon launched or dropped into the water that detonates and causes a hydraulic shock wave for the purpose of destroying enemy ⟦1⟧.
1agh8cb.zh: 损管（Damage Control），防止⟦0⟧因战伤沉没的应急措施；或深水炸弹（Depth Charge），一种投入或抛入水中引爆、产生水压冲击波以摧毁敌方⟦1⟧的武器。

hyn0j.en: Destroyer Escort - A ⟦0⟧ designed to escort ocean ⟦1⟧ and merchant ships, usually to protect them from submarines.
hyn0j.zh: 护航驱逐舰（Destroyer Escort）——为⟦0⟧护航、保护⟦1⟧和商船免遭潜艇攻击的舰船。

1mir3rd.en: ⟦0⟧ - A package made available by Paradox that adds more game mechanics, music, and other features to the game. Compare with ⟦1⟧.
1mir3rd.zh: ⟦0⟧——Paradox 发售的资料包，为游戏加入更多游戏机制、音乐和其他内容。可与⟦1⟧相比较。

1qll7kz.en: Demilitarized Zone - An area where a treaty between nations prohibits military forces, military equipment, and military installations.
1qll7kz.zh: 非军事区（Demilitarized Zone）——国家间条约禁止驻扎军队、存放军事装备和修建军事设施的区域。

94crqv.en: ⟦0⟧, an early DLC that has since been integrated into the core game.
94crqv.zh: ⟦0⟧，一个早期 DLC，此后已被整合进游戏本体。

clotdt.en: ⟦0⟧ - A common National Focus choice for Germany. OR ⟦1⟧ - Can be used as a verb ("Japan just DOW'd the USA!").
clotdt.zh: ⟦0⟧——德国常见的一个国策选择。或⟦1⟧——可用作动词（「日本刚刚对美宣战（DOW）了！」）。

pv3h4q.en: Dual Purpose gun - a light caliber naval artillery piece designed to shoot enemy ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
pv3h4q.zh: 两用炮（Dual Purpose gun）——一种小口径舰炮，用于射击敌方⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧。

1rjmdy1.en: European Theater of Operations - a term used by the United States to refer to US operations in Europe.
1rjmdy1.zh: 欧洲战区（European Theater of Operations）——美国用来指其在欧洲作战的术语。

1jarpi9.en: Fire Control - a method for aiming a ship's guns that accounts for gun range, gun elevation, ship's speed, distance to target, etc.
1jarpi9.zh: 火控（Fire Control）——为舰炮瞄准的方法，计算时会考虑火炮射程、火炮仰角、舰船速度、与目标的距离等因素。

11dvfu4.en: Fire Control System - a system that helps aim a ship's guns.
11dvfu4.zh: 火控系统（Fire Control System）——帮助舰炮瞄准的系统。

z286jc.en: Fire Exchange group - a cluster of ships simultaneously engaged in sea battle
z286jc.zh: 交火群（Fire Exchange group）——在海战中同时交战的一群舰船。

10aeb64.en: ⟦0⟧, the highest of the two possible ranks of ⟦1⟧.

1elkjzy.en: Fog of War - Prevents ⟦0⟧ from seeing parts of the ⟦1⟧ they do not either border, or have an ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ adjacent to.
1elkjzy.zh: 战争迷雾（Fog of War）——使⟦0⟧无法看到⟦1⟧中那些既不与之接壤、也没有相邻的⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧的部分。

bss32c.en: ⟦0⟧. Often means only "light fighters", which is to say the types that aren't in the "heavy fighter" research tree.
bss32c.zh: ⟦0⟧。通常仅指「轻型战斗机」，也就是不在「重型战斗机」科技树中的那些类型。

1myw8p3.en: Gross Domestic Product - The value of all goods and services produced in a ⟦0⟧ during a given year.
1myw8p3.zh: 国内生产总值（Gross Domestic Product）——某一⟦0⟧在给定年份内生产的所有商品与服务的价值。

up7akx.en: ⟦0⟧ - a ⟦1⟧, led by ⟦2⟧, of East Asian nations.

2uviel.en: Government In Exile - a temporary government formed by exiles who have fled to a foreign country in the hope of ruling their former country when it becomes liberated.
2uviel.zh: 流亡政府（Government In Exile）——由逃亡到外国的流亡者组成的临时政府，期望在原属国家获得解放后重新统治该国。

1090hbr.en: Game-master - A leader or organizer of a multiplayer game.
1090hbr.zh: 游戏主持（Game-master）——多人游戏的主持者或组织者。

61ahpg.en: ⟦0⟧ - The hard attack value of a ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧.

hsj2cy.en: ⟦0⟧ - Represents how much damage a ⟦1⟧ can take. Maximum HP is increased by adding ⟦2⟧ to a division. HP value drops when a division takes damage (losing men and ⟦3⟧) and is replenished when it receives ⟦4⟧. ⟦5⟧ - Also represents how much damage a ⟦6⟧ can take before sinking. ⟦7⟧ - Also represents how much damage a ⟦8⟧ can take before complete destruction.
hsj2cy.zh: ⟦0⟧——表示一个⟦1⟧能承受多少伤害。最大 HP 可通过给师添加⟦2⟧来提高。师受到伤害（损失人员和⟦3⟧）时 HP 数值下降，获得⟦4⟧时得到补充。⟦5⟧——也表示一艘⟦6⟧在沉没前能承受多少伤害。⟦7⟧——也表示一艘⟦8⟧在被彻底摧毁前能承受多少伤害。

brmfw6.en: Industrial capacity - Term used in previous installments of HoI, is equivalent to Factory Output in HoI4.
brmfw6.zh: 工业产能（Industrial capacity）——前几代钢铁雄心使用的术语，相当于钢铁雄心4中的工厂产出。

umugly.en: Number of days of IC usage - Term used in previous installments of HoI, is similar to Production Cost in HoI4.
umugly.zh: IC 使用天数（Number of days of IC usage）——前几代钢铁雄心使用的术语，类似钢铁雄心4中的生产成本。

60m8r8.en: Infantry - This word standing alone may refer to either the general category of infantry soldiers (those using ⟦0⟧) or specifically to non-specialized combat infantrymen who travel on foot, as distinguished from ⟦1⟧ (⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧) and from mounted infantry (⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧).
60m8r8.zh: 步兵（Infantry）——单用这个词时，既可指使用⟦0⟧的步兵这一大类，也可专指徒步机动的非专业战斗步兵，以区别于⟦1⟧（⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧）以及乘马步兵（⟦5⟧、⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧）。

1efvk7f.en: Software manager used by Paradox for bug reporting.
1efvk7f.zh: Paradox 用于报告 Bug 的软件管理工具。

xj1m9h.en: ⟦0⟧ - the 3rd major expansion by Paradox for Hearts of Iron IV.
xj1m9h.zh: ⟦0⟧——Paradox 为钢铁雄心 IV 推出的第 3 个大型扩展包。

1doqbtp.en: ⟦0⟧ - an agreement between the ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ and the ⟦5⟧ to limit and reduce naval armament.
1doqbtp.zh: ⟦0⟧——⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧之间为限制和削减海军军备而达成的协议。

1lgg69e.en: Military industrial capacity - Capacity provided by ⟦0⟧ for the construction of any ⟦1⟧ in HoI4.
1lgg69e.zh: 军事工业产能（Military industrial capacity）——由⟦0⟧提供、用于在钢铁雄心4中建造任何⟦1⟧的产能。

1qr50e5.en: The Mass Mobilization branch of the ⟦0⟧ land doctrine.
1qr50e5.zh: ⟦0⟧陆军学说中「大规模动员」分支。

1ye3rbm.en: Alternatively, the flood of small infantry divisions used to help hold a frontline made possible thanks to the uniquely strong bonuses given by the Mass Mobilization branch of the ⟦0⟧ land doctrine.
1ye3rbm.zh: 或者指依靠⟦0⟧陆军学说中「大规模动员」分支给予的独特强力加成，用大量小编制步兵师填满前线。

1eiz1ms.en: ⟦0⟧ - The one pact to rule them all.

1jbzane.en: ⟦0⟧ - rocket artillery mounted on a truck chassis.
1jbzane.zh: ⟦0⟧——安装在卡车底盘上的火箭炮。

mctopl.en: Motor Torpedo Boat - a small, fast, lightly armed boat for torpedoing enemy ships.
mctopl.zh: 鱼雷快艇（Motor Torpedo Boat）——小型、快速、轻武装的艇只，用于对敌舰发射鱼雷。

xypksm.en: ⟦0⟧ - The metric used to measure how long, on average, it takes for an ⟦1⟧ to trigger.
xypksm.zh: ⟦0⟧——衡量某个⟦1⟧平均需要多久才会触发的指标。

100mtnf.en: ⟦0⟧. An agreement or formal treaty between countries not to attack one another via a ⟦1⟧ (DOW).
100mtnf.zh: ⟦0⟧。国家之间通过⟦1⟧（DOW，宣战）以外的方式约定互不攻击的协议或正式条约。

1ghw3nv.en: ⟦0⟧, used for anti-shipping missions in ⟦1⟧ and for ⟦2⟧ over land.
1ghw3nv.zh: ⟦0⟧，用于在⟦1⟧中执行反舰任务以及在内陆执行⟦2⟧。

13wccuy.en: ⟦0⟧ - A concept that works similarly to ⟦1⟧, but for political actions.
13wccuy.zh: ⟦0⟧——运作方式与⟦1⟧类似，但用于政治行动。

129q167.en: Naval industrial capacity - Capacity provided by ⟦0⟧ for the construction of any ⟦1⟧ in HoI4.
129q167.zh: 海军工业产能（Naval industrial capacity）——由⟦0⟧提供、用于在钢铁雄心4中建造任何⟦1⟧的产能。

rso0rc.en: Narodnyy Komissariat Vnutrennikh Del or People's Commissariat for Internal Affairs - Secret police during the ⟦0⟧ regime.
rso0rc.zh: Narodnyy Komissariat Vnutrennikh Del（内务人民委员部）——⟦0⟧政权时期的秘密警察。

dz5dd5.en: ⟦0⟧ - a modifier that describes unique advantages or disadvantages of ⟦1⟧.
dz5dd5.zh: ⟦0⟧——描述⟦1⟧独有优势或劣势的修正。

5cb861.en: ⟦0⟧ - the 6th expansion by Paradox for Hearts of Iron IV.
5cb861.zh: ⟦0⟧——Paradox 为钢铁雄心 IV 推出的第 6 个扩展包。

1j8s0mp.en: Order of Battle - the hierarchical organization, command structure, strength, disposition of personnel, formations, and ⟦0⟧ of armed forces.
1j8s0mp.zh: 战斗序列（Order of Battle）——武装力量的层级编制、指挥结构、兵力、人员部署、部队编成以及⟦0⟧。

1p6sev9.en: Out of Sync - A notorious desynchronisation error that occurs in multiplayer, requires the game to be loaded again. ⟦0⟧.
1p6sev9.zh: 不同步（Out of Sync）——多人游戏中臭名昭著的失同步错误，需要重新载入游戏。⟦0⟧。

bpowjb.en: Overpowered or, on the forums, the original poster of a thread.
bpowjb.zh: overpowered（过于强力）的缩写；在论坛上也指帖子的楼主（original poster）。

yxsk7t.en: ⟦0⟧. A phase of the game that occurs when a ⟦1⟧ or all the countries in a ⟦2⟧ have capitulated.
yxsk7t.zh: ⟦0⟧。当某个⟦1⟧投降、或某个⟦2⟧中的所有国家都已投降时游戏进入的阶段。

1sbzuew.en: ⟦0⟧ - a capital ship that is chosen to represent a country and its people at their "best".
1sbzuew.zh: ⟦0⟧——被选来代表一个国家及其人民「最佳」形象的主力舰。

swyzpi.en: ⟦0⟧ - Point acquired over time and required for all political actions in the game.
swyzpi.zh: ⟦0⟧——随时间积累、游戏中所有政治行动都需要的点数。

ee14jh.en: Pacific Theater of Operations - a term used by the United States to refer to US operations in the Pacific.
ee14jh.zh: 太平洋战区（Pacific Theater of Operations）——美国用来指其在太平洋作战的术语。

1uabjt.en: Quick Reaction Force - a military unit that can respond quickly to a military emergency such as a breach in the front line.
1uabjt.zh: 快速反应部队（Quick Reaction Force）——能对前线被突破等军事紧急情况迅速作出反应的军事单位。

b5d589.en: ⟦0⟧ - a basic military formation of 1 or more ⟦1⟧, which is in game represented by a ⟦2⟧ that can have 1 to 5 battalions of compatible types.
b5d589.zh: ⟦0⟧——由 1 个或多个⟦1⟧组成的基本军事编队，在游戏中表现为一个⟦2⟧，可下辖 1 至 5 个类型兼容的营。

1lbhozw.en: Random number generator; a mathematical subsystem that generates a random number. Used to determine chances for ⟦0⟧, battle results, and other game features that use randomization of results to any degree.
1lbhozw.zh: 随机数生成器（Random number generator）；生成随机数的数学子系统。用于决定⟦0⟧的触发概率、战斗结果，以及其他任何程度依赖随机结果判定的游戏机制。

1joymrx.en: Rest of the world - Generally refers to all areas outside Europe.
1joymrx.zh: 世界其他地区（Rest of the world）——一般指欧洲以外的所有地区。

saainr.en: ⟦0⟧ - The Soft attack value of a ⟦1⟧ or other ⟦2⟧.

7r8t4p.en: Surface Action Group - A task force of surface warships that has a primary mission to attack and sink enemy surface ships.
7r8t4p.zh: 水面行动群（Surface Action Group）——以攻击并击沉敌方水面舰船为首要任务的水面战舰特遣舰队。

1k33eir.en: ⟦0⟧ - An ⟦1⟧ that will always happen when starting in the 1936 scenario.
1k33eir.zh: ⟦0⟧——以 1936 年剧本开局时必然发生的⟦1⟧。

1c1y2dv.en: ⟦0⟧, one of the available ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ (⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧) or ⟦6⟧ (a ⟦7⟧).

2ba4um.en: Shaft horsepower - the power delivered to a ⟦0⟧ propeller shaft.
2ba4um.zh: 轴马力（Shaft horsepower）——输出到⟦0⟧螺旋桨轴的功率。

1tuvhw7.en: Super Heavy [something] - Can be used to designate Super Heavy Battleships (SHBB), tanks (SHT), artillery (SHA), tank destroyer (SHTD) or anti-air (SHAA).
1tuvhw7.zh: 超重型［某物］（Super Heavy [something]）——可用来指超重型战列舰（SHBB）、坦克（SHT）、火炮（SHA）、坦克歼击车（SHTD）或防空（SHAA）。

1m1vvai.en: Self-propelled [something] - Weapons mounted on vehicle chassis, including ⟦0⟧ (SPART) aka guns (SPG), ⟦1⟧ (SPTD) and ⟦2⟧ (SPAA).
1m1vvai.zh: 自行［某物］（Self-propelled [something]）——安装在车辆底盘上的武器，包括⟦0⟧（SPART），又称自行火炮（SPG）、⟦1⟧（SPTD）和⟦2⟧（SPAA）。

1goo4fy.en: Two/three province minor - Term borrowed from EU4 to designate small countries in the game, consisting of only two or three ⟦0⟧.
1goo4fy.zh: 两/三省份小国（Two/three province minor）——借自 EU4 的术语，指游戏中只拥有两三个⟦0⟧的小国。

ltxkpg.en: Table of Organization and Equipment - specified organization, staffing, and ⟦0⟧ of ⟦1⟧ in table form.
ltxkpg.zh: 编制与装备表（Table of Organization and Equipment）——以表格形式列明⟦0⟧的编制、人员配备和⟦1⟧。

1l6stwd.en: ⟦0⟧ - Points attributed to some ⟦1⟧, usually ⟦2⟧ and strategic locations, in order to measure how close a ⟦3⟧ is to capitulating.
1l6stwd.zh: ⟦0⟧——分配给某些⟦1⟧（通常是⟦2⟧和战略要地）的点数，用来衡量一个⟦3⟧离投降还有多远。

1qudmlt.en: Works/working as designed; this acronym means that the thing in question is wrongly considered a bug and is actually intentional.
1qudmlt.zh: 按设计运作（Works/working as designed）；这个缩写表示相关现象被误认为是 Bug，实际上是刻意设计。

4n8gyw.en: World conquest - Taking over every inhabitable ⟦0⟧ on the ⟦1⟧; often a goal for players; for others, an ahistorical outcome.
4n8gyw.zh: 世界征服（World conquest）——占领⟦0⟧上每一块可居住的⟦1⟧；这常常是玩家的目标；对另一些人来说则是背离史实的结局。

qi5yyj.en: Washington Naval Treaty - a treaty signed during 1922 among the major nations that had won World War I, which agreed to prevent an arms race by limiting naval construction.
qi5yyj.zh: 华盛顿海军条约（Washington Naval Treaty）——1922 年由赢得第一次世界大战的主要国家签署的条约，约定通过限制海军建造来防止军备竞赛。

1cixhj5.en: ⟦0⟧ - the willingness of the population to endure the privations of war.

55br7d.en: World tension - Variable that serves to limit the involvement of ⟦0⟧ in ongoing ⟦1⟧.
55br7d.zh: 世界紧张度（World tension）——用于限制⟦0⟧介入正在进行中的⟦1⟧的变量。

v0nfz1.en: Waking the Tiger, an early DLC that has since been integrated into the core game.
v0nfz1.zh: 唤醒猛虎，一个早期 DLC，此后已被整合进游戏本体。

1c305up.en: ⟦0⟧ - Points acquired in three categories (Army, Navy, Air) through combat or other means.
1c305up.zh: ⟦0⟧——通过战斗或其他途径获得的三类点数（陆军、海军、空军）。

15jal92.en: Here are some of the common slang terms in the game and in discussions surrounding it:
15jal92.zh: 以下是游戏中以及相关讨论中常见的一些俚语：

1toryl9.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, similar to an air controller, but as a player playing co-operatively for a nation that is not 100% dedicated to managing ⟦1⟧.
1toryl9.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中类似空军控制手，但作为合作玩家协助一个国家，且并非 100% 专注于管理⟦1⟧。

16rata.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: In multiplayer, an Axis strategy that invests a lot into the faction's air force, usually also forcing the Allied faction to invest similarly large amounts into their airforce to match the Axis. Referred to as a "gamble" or "casino" because of its highly variable results, sometimes being very strong (because it can fully prevent any allied naval invasions) and other times being very weak (because it leaves insufficient production for land units, particularly tanks) depending on how the rest of the game progresses.
16rata.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：多人游戏中轴心国的一种策略，向阵营空军投入大量资源，通常也迫使同盟国阵营相应地投入同样庞大的资源发展空军以抗衡轴心国。之所以被称为「赌博」或「赌场」，是因为其结果波动极大：有时非常强（因为能彻底阻止任何盟军海军登陆），有时又非常弱（因为留给陆军单位、尤其是坦克的产能不足），取决于整局游戏的后续走向。

cf6eow.en: ⟦0⟧: A ⟦1⟧ that is meant to have very high armor and that is meant to be used by a single battalion in a tank division that otherwise has more economical tanks that do not focus as much on armor. Related to the Space Marine, but is more effective at its job of providing more armor to a division for as little extra cost and stats reductions as possible.
cf6eow.zh: ⟦0⟧：一种⟦1⟧，其设计目标是拥有极高的装甲，并计划在坦克师中只编入一个营，师内其余坦克则更经济、不那么强调装甲。与「星际战士」相关，但在为师的提供更多装甲、同时尽可能减少额外成本和属性损失方面更为高效。

1lqu5nu.en: ⟦0⟧: A strategy, usually in multiplayer, where the Allies, mainly the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, prioritize fighting ⟦3⟧ in Asia instead of the Axis powers in Europe and Africa.
1lqu5nu.zh: ⟦0⟧：通常出现于多人游戏的一种策略，即同盟国（主要是⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧）优先在亚洲与⟦3⟧作战，而不是在欧洲和非洲对付轴心国。

1x5ceeu.en: ⟦0⟧: A shortening of "Operation Barbarossa", used to describe the German invasion of the USSR/Russia.
1x5ceeu.zh: ⟦0⟧：「巴巴罗萨行动」的简称，用来描述德国对苏联/俄罗斯的入侵。

1i8chws.en: ⟦0⟧: A large nation that tends to get larger over time unless checked. Named after how such large nations' expansions can leave them with irregular borders, resembling blobs of paint.
1i8chws.zh: ⟦0⟧：若不受遏制就会不断扩张的大国。得名于这类大国扩张后边界往往变得不规则，像一滩滩颜料。

198l1on.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: In multiplayer, the practice of deliberately performing actions that provide additional civilian factories to a specific, allied country, such as ⟦2⟧ resources even when they are not needed, purchasing unnecessary ⟦3⟧, or deliberately buying useless equipment from them through the ⟦4⟧.
198l1on.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：多人游戏中，刻意采取某些行动为某个特定的盟国提供额外民用工厂的做法，例如在其并不需要时仍向其⟦2⟧资源、购买不必要的⟦3⟧，或通过⟦4⟧刻意从该国购买无用的装备。

1ijgz98.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: A strategy or part of a strategy that provides some notable advantage and that is unlikely to be intentional by the game's developers. Somewhat related to exploits, but usually considered "softer" and more fair to use. Examples include constant conversion, completely removing an enemy's planning bonus by having every member of a ⟦2⟧ set one of their spies to build a network near their frontline, tying down an enemy's navy by using many tiny ⟦3⟧ task forces to Always Engage, et al.
1ijgz98.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：能提供某些显著优势、且不太可能是游戏开发者有意设计的策略或策略的一部分。与漏洞利用有些相关，但通常被认为「更温和」、使用起来更公平。例子包括持续改装、让⟦2⟧的每个成员国都派一名特工在其前线附近建立情报网从而彻底消除敌人的计划加成、用许多小型⟦3⟧特遣舰队设置为「始终交战」拖住敌方海军等等。

o3uxu8.en: ⟦0⟧: to make a country succeed far beyond expectations. (A takeoff on the polandball meme.)
o3uxu8.zh: ⟦0⟧：让一个国家取得远超预期的成就。（源自波兰球梗。）

wxho6d.en: ⟦0⟧: One's rightful land. Also a takeoff from polandball.
wxho6d.zh: ⟦0⟧：某人理应拥有的土地。同样源自波兰球。

1p75vm2.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: Being able to quickly defeat all enemy forces in a province without any effort besides right-clicking the province to order selected units to move onto it.
1p75vm2.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：除右键点击该省份、命令所选单位开进之外不需任何操作，就能迅速消灭一个省份内所有敌军。

i46xwt.en: ⟦0⟧: Dedicated player who focuses their attention on producing, micromanaging, and maximizing bonuses for ⟦1⟧, preferably the super-heavy variety. Somewhat common in multiplayer games, usually done by minor powers whose land unit bonuses are eclipsed by their teammates', e.g., ⟦2⟧ for the Axis and ⟦3⟧ for the Allies.
i46xwt.zh: ⟦0⟧：专注于生产、微操并最大化⟦1⟧（最好是超重型）加成的玩家。在多人游戏中较为常见，通常由陆战加成被队友压过的小国担任，例如轴心国的⟦2⟧和同盟国的⟦3⟧。

yhywbl.en: ⟦0⟧: Historically, the day of the Allied naval landings in occupied France in Operation Overlord; used to describe any in-game naval invasion of continental Europe from Britain, sometimes as a verb (as in "The Allies are D-Daying!").
yhywbl.zh: ⟦0⟧：历史上指「霸王行动」中盟军对被占法国实施海军登陆的那一天；用来描述游戏中任何从英国对欧洲大陆发动的海军登陆，有时也用作动词（如「盟军正在D日登陆！」）。

orfq8c.en: ⟦0⟧: Division(s), the basic combat unit on the map.

1gf5wqp.en: ⟦0⟧: An extremely large enemy force in a single province; seldom used on land in HoI4, but often for navies.
1gf5wqp.zh: ⟦0⟧：聚集在单个省份内的极其庞大的敌军部队；在钢铁雄心4中陆地上很少见，但海军中常常如此。

15tpg5j.en: ⟦0⟧: Attacking the same enemy province from two different provinces in a way where the attacks are treated as two separate combats instead of a singular one, done by queueing up moves for the divisions in two different provinces in a specific way. This ensures that enemy units get the "in multiple combats" penalty in both combats, which would normally only be applied if they were both attacking and defending at the same time.
15tpg5j.zh: ⟦0⟧：以某种方式从两个不同省份进攻同一个敌方省份，使两次进攻被判定为两场独立战斗而非一场，做法是按特定顺序为两个不同省份的师排队下达移动指令。这样就能确保敌军单位在两场战斗中都会受到「多场战斗」惩罚，而正常情况下只有当他们同时既进攻又防守时才会受到该惩罚。

1bt6qqt.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for El Alamein, the site of a few famous historical battles in World War 2 and a notorious choke point for land armies in Egypt.
1bt6qqt.zh: ⟦0⟧：El Alamein（阿拉曼）的缩写，第二次世界大战中几场著名战役的发生地，也是埃及境内令陆军头疼的著名瓶颈。

z49a6p.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: The practice of rapidly switching ⟦2⟧, usually bombers, between multiple air zones, either to abuse the mechanics behind naval strike and port strike air missions to make attacks happen far more frequently than intended, or simply to overload the micromanagement abilities of enemy air controllers in multiplayer.
z49a6p.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：让⟦2⟧（通常是轰炸机）在多个空中区域之间快速来回切换的做法，目的要么是利用海军打击和港口打击空中任务背后的机制，使攻击发生的频率远高于设计预期，要么只是为了在多人游戏中压垮敌方空军控制手的微操能力。

7kj1c8.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for Gibraltar, a notable choke point controlling access between the Mediterranean Sea and the larger Atlantic Ocean.
7kj1c8.zh: ⟦0⟧：Gibraltar（直布罗陀）的缩写，控制地中海与大西洋之间通道的著名瓶颈。

chwfaw.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: Bastardization of the very annoying ⟦2⟧ combat tactic, usually when unlocked through the Mass Mobilization branch of the ⟦3⟧ land doctrine.
chwfaw.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：对极其烦人的⟦2⟧战斗战术的讹称，通常是在⟦3⟧陆军学说的「大规模动员」分支解锁该战术之后。

17j50sc.en: ⟦0⟧: Deliberately keeping units in battles without capturing provinces to generate XP. Often used in early wars before World War 2 with volunteer divisions to help level up ⟦1⟧ to high levels with good skills and traits, rarely also used with ⟦2⟧ (and more difficult to do with them) for similar reasons. Pre-grinds: Done in many multiplayer-oriented mods and custom save games to avoid people wanting to grind generals manually and therefore speed up the game, as grinding an normally be somewhat micro-intensive.
17j50sc.zh: ⟦0⟧：为获取经验而刻意让部队留在战斗中、不占领省份。常用于二战前的早期战争中，用志愿军师把⟦1⟧刷到高等级并获得优秀技能与特质；出于类似原因偶尔也用于⟦2⟧（用他们这样做难度更高）。预刷：在许多面向多人游戏的模组和自定义存档中进行，以免玩家想手动刷将领，从而加快游戏节奏，因为正常刷经验相当耗费微操。

xj2ys5.en: ⟦0⟧: Done in many multiplayer-oriented mods and custom save games to avoid people wanting to grind ⟦1⟧ manually and therefore speed up the game, as grinding an normally be somewhat micro-intensive.
xj2ys5.zh: ⟦0⟧：在许多面向多人游戏的模组和自定义存档中进行，以免玩家想手动刷⟦1⟧，从而加快游戏节奏，因为正常刷经验相当耗费微操。

hn54hg.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for infantry equipment, the most important ⟦1⟧ in terms of providing a battalion's combat stats for all infantry and mobile battalions. Usually followed by a number to indicate its year: gun 0 is 1918 infantry equipment, gun 1 is 1936 infantry equipment, gun 2 is 1939 infantry equipment, and gun 3 is 1942 infantry equipment.
hn54hg.zh: ⟦0⟧：步兵装备（infantry equipment）的缩写，就为所有步兵和机动营提供战斗属性而言，它是最重要的⟦1⟧。通常后面跟一个数字表示年份：枪 0 是 1918 年步兵装备，枪 1 是 1936 年步兵装备，枪 2 是 1939 年步兵装备，枪 3 是 1942 年步兵装备。

lc26fm.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, a reference to players who actively pay attention to a delicate in-game situation and actively respond to it (or used in insults for players who cannot or do not do this when expected of them), usually in the form of micro.
lc26fm.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，指积极关注游戏中微妙局势并主动做出应对的玩家（也用来讥讽那些在本应如此时做不到或不去做的玩家），通常表现为微操。

18z20x4.en: ⟦0⟧: Deliberately letting an event expire or waiting until right before it does to select an option in it. Because a lot of events only apply their effects after a country has clicked an option in it, holding events like this can delay undesirable effects (e.g., the Allies handing the Sudetenland over to Germany) for a few weeks that can end up being crucial.
18z20x4.zh: ⟦0⟧：刻意让事件过期，或等到临过期前才在其中选择选项。由于许多事件只有在国家点击选项后才会生效，这样压住事件可以把不想要的效果（例如盟国把苏台德地区交给德国）推迟几周，而这几周有时至关重要。

1vgdvyi.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for howitzer tanks, i.e., tank designs that use howitzers for their main armament, giving them a lot of soft attack but very little hard attack.
1vgdvyi.zh: ⟦0⟧：榴弹炮坦克（howitzer tanks）的缩写，即主炮采用榴弹炮的坦克设计，软攻很高但硬攻极低。

uaphlb.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: The practice of leaving a research slot deliberately empty for a month before spending the accrued research progress to help complete a specific, high-priority tech faster. This is done by researching said "juggled" tech with one slot while leaving another empty, and when the empty slot has accrued enough research progress, switching the first slot to research a different technology and then continuing to research the "juggled" tech with the slot that was left empty.
uaphlb.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：刻意让一个科研槽空置一个月，再动用积累的科研进度来帮助更快完成某项特定的高优先级科技。做法是用一个科研槽研究该「被杂耍」的科技并让另一个槽空着，当空置的槽积累了足够的科研进度后，把第一个槽切换到研究另一项科技，然后继续用先前空置的槽研究「被杂耍」的科技。

1ss3ba2.en: ⟦0⟧: The political action of building a propaganda case against a country to justify a declaration of war.
1ss3ba2.zh: ⟦0⟧：为制造宣战理由而对某国开展宣传攻势的政治行动。

bwlmds.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: In multiplayer, spending a lot of time in the game's lobby waiting for the game to start, waiting for players whose game crashed or who went out-of-sync to reconnect to the game, and/or waiting for hot-joins to finish loading in.
bwlmds.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：在多人游戏中，花大量时间待在游戏大厅里等待开局、等待游戏崩溃或不同步的玩家重新连接，以及/或者等待中途加入的玩家加载完成。

5hr64r.en: ⟦0⟧: Slang for numerical ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and other points.
5hr64r.zh: ⟦0⟧：对数值化的⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧及其他点数的俚称。

wgegvh.en: ⟦0⟧: Considered the opposite of "micro", refers to the larger choices made and strategy used outside of controlling individual units, including for ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ expenses, and the order and timing of ⟦5⟧.
wgegvh.zh: ⟦0⟧：被视为「微操」的反面，指在操控单个单位之外所做的更大层面抉择和运用的战略，包括⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧方面的投入，以及⟦5⟧的顺序与时机。

t6m5ko.en: ⟦0⟧: Short for "micromanagement", refers to controlling individual units, as well as the attention and the skill required to do it well under time pressure. Pause-Micro: In multiplayer, queueing up orders for many individual units while a game is paused, taking advantage of there being no time pressure present to do so. Last Stand Micro or Force Attack Micro: The practice of setting of a dummy order-of-battle with lower-quality generals that can then be used to dramatically reduce the command power cost of performing the respectively named commander abilities. This is done by temporarily assigning the specific divisions for which the ability is to be used to one of those dummy generals, activating the commander ability on the dummy general, and only assigning the unit(s) back to their regular generals after the ability is no longer needed.
t6m5ko.zh: ⟦0⟧：「微操管理」（micromanagement）的简称，指操控单个单位，以及在时间压力下做好这件事所需的专注与技巧。暂停微操：在多人游戏中，趁着游戏暂停、没有时间压力时，为许多单个单位排队下达指令。最后一搏微操或强制攻击微操：设置一套由低质量将领组成的傀儡战斗序列，借此大幅降低使用相应名称的指挥官技能所需的指挥点数成本。做法是临时把要使用该技能的具体师划归某位傀儡将领，在该傀儡将领身上激活指挥官技能，等技能不再需要后再把单位划回其常规将领麾下。

16un5a5.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, queueing up orders for many individual units while a game is paused, taking advantage of there being no time pressure present to do so.
16un5a5.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，趁着游戏暂停、没有时间压力时，为许多单个单位排队下达指令。

qahgt9.en: ⟦0⟧: A software package that modifies the game, written by the player community. Compare with DLC.
qahgt9.zh: ⟦0⟧：由玩家社区编写、用于修改游戏的软件包。可与 DLC 相比较。

17lfcqx.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, a player playing co-operatively on a larger nation who is meant to focus on nothing else besides micromanaging that country's navy.
17lfcqx.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，在大国里合作游玩、除微操该国海军之外不负责其他事务的玩家。

1rgvy2j.en: ⟦0⟧: A strategy where a country puts far more emphasis on building up a (surface) navy than is deemed sensible for that country.
1rgvy2j.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个国家把远超其合理程度的资源投入到建设（水面）海军的策略。

151wh5g.en: ⟦0⟧: Nuclear bombs, or the act of using them.

nrcd93.en: ⟦0⟧: Organization, required for any division to continue or engage combat. Deorg: A division running out of organization, forcing it to break off an attack or retreat when defending.
nrcd93.zh: ⟦0⟧：组织度，任何师要继续作战或投入战斗都必需。掉组织度：一个师的组织度耗尽，被迫中断进攻，或在防御时被迫撤退。

450p9k.en: ⟦0⟧: A division running out of organization, forcing it to break off an attack or retreat when defending.
450p9k.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个师的组织度耗尽，被迫中断进攻，或在防御时被迫撤退。

1whenef.en: ⟦0⟧: After having ⟦1⟧ an enemy country's cipher, revealing it for a major temporary bonus at the cost of needing to re-decrypt their cipher after the bonus expires.
1whenef.zh: ⟦0⟧：在⟦1⟧敌方密码后将其公开，以换取一次重大的临时加成，代价是加成到期后必须重新解密其密码。

2o3knd.en: ⟦0⟧: Defeating all divisions currently in combat before ⟦1⟧ divisions in the same province can enter combat, forcing them to retreat without fighting (or causing them to be destroyed if encircled).
2o3knd.zh: ⟦0⟧：在同一省份的⟦1⟧师能投入战斗之前，就消灭当前所有正在战斗的师，迫使它们不战而退（若被包围则会被歼灭）。

1tr0n5n.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, having the game's host save the game, exit the game (thereby disconnecting all other players), then host a new game from the save taken. Often used as an attempted fix for when several players keep crashing and/or going out-of-sync to the point that the game cannot actually be played.
1tr0n5n.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，让游戏主机保存游戏、退出游戏（从而使其他所有玩家断线），然后用所存的档开一局新游戏。当多名玩家不断崩溃和/或不同步到游戏根本无法进行时，常用作一种尝试性的解决办法。

1yv49vr.en: ⟦0⟧: When the Axis captures Egypt and advances south into Africa.
1yv49vr.zh: ⟦0⟧：轴心国占领埃及并向南挺进非洲。

10klqcm.en: ⟦0⟧: Reloading earlier saves when something goes wrong in order to set things right. Often considered a negative trait. Ironman mode prevents savescumming, unless circumvented through manual file copying.
10klqcm.zh: ⟦0⟧：出问题时读取较早的存档来把事情扳回正轨。通常被视为负面行为。铁人模式会阻止读档，除非通过手动复制文件来绕过。

1d8sjji.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, the act of exploiting a certain bug around ⟦1⟧ that allow them to be launched against a player without triggering the visual or audio alert for them for an ongoing naval invasion.
1d8sjji.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，利用与⟦1⟧有关的某个 Bug，使其能在不触发进行中的海军登陆的视觉或音效提示的情况下对玩家发动。

11xp4hc.en: ⟦0⟧: Sending a single division or small group of divisions to race ahead through a breakthrough and capture tiles, VPs, or ports without securing the tiles behind them, in order to disrupt industry or enemy supply, or VP snipe an enemy country and cause it to capitulate. Often results in the division(s) used being encircled and lost.
11xp4hc.zh: ⟦0⟧：派出单个师或一小群师沿突破口抢先进军、占领地块、胜利点或港口，而不去巩固身后的地块，目的是破坏工业或敌军补给，或偷袭胜利点迫使敌国投降。结果往往是所用师被包围并损失掉。

1t9uc5y.en: ⟦0⟧: A division with a single armored battalion, usually a heavy tank destroyer or heavy tank, that otherwise has no other armored battalions. This is meant to provide a lot of armor and/or piercing to the division for little cost by taking advantage of the way armor and piercing are calculated for divisions. Considered overpowered by a lot of people in early versions of the game, they tend to be far less cost-effective in current versions of the game.
1t9uc5y.zh: ⟦0⟧：只编入一个装甲营（通常是重型坦克歼击车或重型坦克）、此外不含其他装甲营的师。其目的是利用师级装甲与穿甲的算法，以很小的代价为该师提供大量装甲和/或穿甲。在游戏的早期版本中被很多人认为过于强力，而在当前版本中其性价比已远不如从前。

1eqevmk.en: ⟦0⟧: Strategic bomber or strategic redeploy or strategy.
1eqevmk.zh: ⟦0⟧：战略轰炸机，或战略再部署，或战略。

1pwaqx9.en: ⟦0⟧: Using paratroopers, snaking fast divisions, and/or naval invasions to capture the victory point tiles of an enemy country and thus cause it to capitulate, bypassing most of its army. When unsuccessful, likely to result in the divisions used being encircled and lost.
1pwaqx9.zh: ⟦0⟧：使用伞兵、蛇形突击的快速师和/或海军登陆占领敌国的胜利点地块，从而绕开其大部分军队迫使其投降。一旦失败，所用师很可能被包围并损失掉。

1x6p547.en: ⟦0⟧: The act of declaring war / being declared war upon.

13rdax3.en: ⟦0⟧: The cheapest, most basic heavy cruiser that can be made whose sole purpose is to be designated a ⟦1⟧ to give its country extra war support.
13rdax3.zh: ⟦0⟧：能造出的最廉价、最基础的重型巡洋舰，其唯一用途是被指定为⟦1⟧，为本国提供额外的战争支持度。

pp961d.en: Abbreviations sometimes used for countries. Often written in all caps despite not being initialisms, many of those are originating from the country tags used by Paradox.
pp961d.zh: 有时用于指代国家的缩写。尽管它们并非首字母缩略词，却常以全大写书写，其中许多源自 Paradox 使用的国家标签。

zz581j.en: ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) are threads posted to the HOI4 forums or a personal web site or blog written by players about their ongoing games. They can be written from the game player's personal point of view, or can be written from a fictitious narrative perspective, like a serialized novel. Some writers also blend the two elements, going from a metagame discussion to a fictitious narrative set in their game's alternate history world.
zz581j.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧）是玩家发布在 HOI4 论坛、个人网站或博客上、讲述自己正在进行中的游戏的帖子。它们可以从玩家的个人视角来写，也可以采用虚构叙事视角，像连载小说一样。有些作者还会把两种元素糅合起来，从元游戏讨论过渡到以游戏架空历史世界为背景的虚构叙事。

greij.en: "I had a rough time as Austria this last session. It started when Ulm, that darned ⟦0⟧, suddenly brought in half the HRE against me when I declared war on it. In all my playthroughs, this was the first time I ever was faced with such a nasty coalition. Before I knew it, not only was I facing the coalition, but the Ottoman Empire decided to make a DOW on me while I was in the thick of it!“
greij.zh: 「上一局我玩奥地利可真是艰难。起因是乌尔姆那个讨厌的⟦0⟧，在我对它宣战之后突然拉来了半个神圣罗马帝国来对付我。在我所有的游玩经历中，这是第一次遇到如此难缠的联盟。还没等我反应过来，我不但要面对这个联盟，奥斯曼帝国还趁我焦头烂额之际对我宣战了！」

5avwfs.en: "Let me tell you a story, a story about how a small and obscure nation, would come and rise to glory and ultimately shape history forever...
5avwfs.zh: 「让我给你讲个故事，一个关于一个渺小无名的小国如何崛起、走向辉煌，并最终永远改变历史的传说……

1jdee8f.en: It is 1938 and the Munich Conference is in to discuss theSudeten crisis. France and the United Kingdom came to decide the fate of little Czechoslovakia's northern front, the Sudetenland. Both of these powerful nations, France and the U.K. decided to fall in to the German Reich's demands for the land, effectively giving it to them. But when the German soldiers went to their "newly aquired lands" they saw forts, bunkers and all sorts of fortifications along the border, with Czechoslovakian flags held high. See, the Czechs had a fear of this crisis since 1936, and they acted on it. They build great land forts, built the army, worked on moving to a full war economy and mass produced weapons. The Czechs were ready to defend their rightful home. 2 months will pass and the German Reich will demand that Czechoslovakia surrender the land or there will be war... The Czech president sent a message to the German aggressors, "Come and take it", at that moment, In 1938, the German Reich decalred war on the Czechs. No help from the U.K. or France made the situation look dire, but the brave Czechs had a plan, they reformed the "Little Enente" of Yugoslovia and Romania. Hungary, bordering the east of Czechslovakia would go onto join the Axis, and try to invade Slovakia, but Romanian troops will crush the Hungarian menace, and absorb their lands. Its now 1939 and Italy has not decided to enter the war, and Romanian and Yugoslavian troops occupied by fighting to defend Yugoslavia from German invasions, was unable to help the Czechs against Germany, Czechoslovakia stood alone. They saw the German army, the Panzers, the Luffwaffe, and decided that they must hold the line. Winter, 1939 German troops are suffering heavy from attrition, the Czechs have been prepared for winter and have plenty of equipment to hold, then, on December 17, 1939, the Field Marshall of the Czecholslovakian Army ordered a push to attack the encamped Germany attackers. The Czechs raided out of their bunkers and attacked the unprepared Germany army. The Germans were rapidly pushed back, Almost no rest for the retreating German army made them weak. January 12, 1940 -- The capital of the former nation Austria, Vienna, has been taken by Czech forces, the same will be with Nuremberg, Munich. March 11, All of former Austria has been taken by Czech forces, and the entire southern half of Germany has been taken. March 13, The Soviet Union will inavde Poland, and begin to justify war against the Czechoslovakian goverment. In March 27, 1940, the capital of the German Reich, Berlin, will fall to Czech forces, Germany is contemplating surrender. A day later, March 28th, Italy will decide it cannont stand idely by while their ally is being demolished, they declare war on Czechoslovakia. Italy will launch a full invasion on Yugoslavia, in April, Yugoslavia will capitulate to the Italians. Every bit of Germany has been taken except the city of Hamburg, the last bastion of the Nazi goverement. In September of 1940, the German Reich will capitulate to Czech troops. Italy stands alone against the Czech might, A massive army pushed down the Italian pennisula and in December of 1940, Rome will fall. In Early 1941, Italy will surrender to Czech forces, and will be left with control only over Sicily and Sardina, effectively kicked off mainland Europe. In March of 1941, Japan will enter the war and attempt to restore the GErman Reich, their invasion will be stopped. In May, 1941, Japan will give up on the war and ask for peace. The Allies are fighting against Comintern forces while the Czechs consolidate their newly aquired land of Germany, Austria and Italy... and remember the day that when their freedom was in danger, they fought, fought valiantly for it, and won.
1jdee8f.zh: 1938 年，慕尼黑会议正在召开，讨论苏台德危机。法国和英国前来决定小国捷克斯洛伐克北部边境——苏台德地区的命运。这两个强国，法国和英国，决定屈从于德意志国对这片土地的要求，实际上等于把它拱手相让。但当德国士兵开进他们“新获得的土地”时，看到的却是边境线上林立的要塞、地堡和各式工事，捷克斯洛伐克国旗高高飘扬。要知道，捷克人从 1936 年起就担心这场危机，并且为此采取了行动。他们修筑了宏伟的陆地要塞，扩充军队，努力转向全面战时经济，并大批量生产武器。捷克人已准备好保卫他们合法的家园。2 个月后，德意志国将要求捷克斯洛伐克交出这片土地，否则就开战……捷克总统向德国侵略者传去一句话：“有本事就来拿。”就在那一刻，1938 年，德意志国对捷克宣战。英国和法国都没有伸出援手，局势看起来十分严峻，但勇敢的捷克人自有打算：他们重建了由南斯拉夫和罗马尼亚组成的“小协约国”。位于捷克斯洛伐克东侧边境的匈牙利随后加入了轴心国，并试图入侵斯洛伐克，但罗马尼亚军队将粉碎匈牙利的威胁，并吞并他们的土地。时间来到 1939 年，意大利尚未决定参战，罗马尼亚和南斯拉夫军队忙于保卫南斯拉夫抵御德国入侵，无法抽身帮助捷克人对抗德国，捷克斯洛伐克只能孤军奋战。他们看到了德国陆军、装甲部队和空军，决定必须守住防线。1939 年冬，德军因损耗而损失惨重，而捷克人早已为寒冬做好准备，拥有充足的装备可以坚守。随后，在 1939 年 12 月 17 日，捷克斯洛伐克陆军元帅下令发起进攻，打击驻扎下来的德国进攻部队。捷克人冲出地堡发动突袭，攻击毫无准备的德国军队。德军被迅速击退，撤退中的德军几乎得不到休整，因而虚弱不堪。1940 年 1 月 12 日——前国家奥地利的首都维也纳已被捷克军队攻占，纽伦堡和慕尼黑也将如此。3 月 11 日，前奥地利全境已被捷克军队攻占，德国整个南半部也已被占领。3 月 13 日，苏联将入侵波兰，并开始对捷克斯洛伐克政府制造战争目标。1940 年 3 月 27 日，德意志国的首都柏林将落入捷克军队之手，德国正在考虑投降。一天后，即 3 月 28 日，意大利认定不能坐视盟友被摧毁，于是对捷克斯洛伐克宣战。意大利将对南斯拉夫发动全面入侵，4 月，南斯拉夫将向意大利投降。德国除汉堡市外已全境被占领，汉堡成了纳粹政府的最后堡垒。1940 年 9 月，德意志国将向捷克军队投降。意大利独自面对捷克的强大力量，一支庞大的军队沿意大利半岛南下，1940 年 12 月，罗马将会陷落。1941 年初，意大利将向捷克军队投降，只剩下西西里和撒丁岛的控制权，实际上被逐出了欧洲大陆。1941 年 3 月，日本将参战并试图恢复德意志国，他们的入侵将被阻止。1941 年 5 月，日本将放弃这场战争并请求和平。同盟国正与共产国际的部队作战，而捷克人则在巩固他们新获得的德国、奥地利和意大利的土地……并铭记那一天：当他们的自由受到威胁时，他们奋起反抗，英勇地为自由而战，并赢得了胜利。

gripe.en: The course of human history was changed that day, WW2 never occured, America and the Allies will fight and destory the Soviet Union in late 1944, the Cold War will never happen, and Czechoslovakia will become one of the most powerful nations in the world. Czechmate."
gripe.zh: 那一天，人类历史的进程被彻底改变：二战从未爆发，美国与同盟国将在 1944 年末与苏联交战并将其摧毁，冷战永远不会发生，而捷克斯洛伐克将成为世界上最强大的国家之一。将死（Czechmate）。"

jfzdmf.en: Players can include screen shots from their games, maps, period art, and other elements to add depth to their reports.
jfzdmf.zh: 玩家可以加入自己游戏中的截图、地图、时代美术素材以及其他元素，让战报内容更加充实。

1h26gdv.en: For music, cosmetic packs or e-books see ⟦0⟧.
1h26gdv.zh: 音乐、外观包或电子书请见⟦0⟧。

1f2q8rf.en: ⟦0⟧ is content built by ⟦1⟧ (PDS) as an extension or add-on to ⟦2⟧. They are modular in nature,⟦3⟧ which means that a player can choose to play with or without a given DLC by checking them out at the launch menu. An expansion DLC is normally accompanied by a free ⟦4⟧ that gives players most of the new content as not to hinder the playability of the game. As such, most DLCs are seen as optional content for players who wish to have a better gaming experience in exchange for some monetary support.
1f2q8rf.zh: ⟦0⟧是由⟦1⟧（PDS）制作的⟦2⟧扩展或附加内容。它们在本质上是模块化的，⟦3⟧这意味着玩家可以在启动菜单中勾选或取消勾选某个 DLC，从而决定是否启用它。扩展包 DLC 通常附带一个免费的⟦4⟧，向玩家提供大部分新内容，以免影响游戏的可玩性。因此，大多数 DLC 被视为可选内容，适合那些愿意以一定金钱支持换取更好游戏体验的玩家。

t7o7dz.en: Multiplayer games also benefit from this compatibility, that is to say, if the host has a gameplay DLC (expansions and flavor packs) the player does not, the game acts as if the player has it.
t7o7dz.zh: 多人游戏同样受益于这种兼容性：也就是说，如果主机拥有某个玩法 DLC（扩展包与风味包）而玩家没有，游戏会视该玩家为已拥有该 DLC。

1kogfof.en: ⟦0⟧ Further details on a specific title may be available by clicking on its banner or icon. A quick ⟦1⟧ of the major DLC is provided at the bottom of this page.
1kogfof.zh: ⟦0⟧ 点击某个具体条目的横幅或图标，或许可以查看其更多详情。本页底部提供了主要 DLC 的快速⟦1⟧。

pv2wsx.zh: 基础游戏版本与捆绑包

16grluo.en: The base game is required for any and all DLC relating to the game. While cosmetic/music DLCs can be used with any game version, content DLCs can't be used prior to the version they were released with.
16grluo.zh: 所有与本游戏相关的 DLC 都必须拥有基础游戏。外观/音乐类 DLC 可用于任何游戏版本，而内容类 DLC 无法在早于其发布时对应版本的游戏中使用。

phez8m.en: Hearts of Iron IV Paradox Steam Released on 2016-06-06. Total strategic war: War is not only won on land, sea and in the air. It’s also achieved in the hearts and minds of men and women. Authentic real-time war simulation: Let the greatest commanders of WW2 fight your war with the tools of the time; tanks, planes, ships, guns and newly discovered weapons of mass destruction. Assume control of any nation: Choose from the greatest powers striving for victory, or the small nations trying to weather the storm. Turn the world into your battlefield: Experience the full WWII timespan in a topographical map complete with seasons, weather and terrain. phez8m.zh: 钢铁雄心 IV Paradox Steam 发行于 2016-06-06。全面战略战争：战争不只在陆上、海上和空中取胜，还要赢得人心。逼真的实时战争模拟：让二战中最伟大的指挥官用当时的工具为你作战——坦克、飞机、舰船、枪炮以及新发现的毁灭性武器。掌控任意国家：选择力争胜利的列强，或选择试图在风暴中求生的小国。把世界变成你的战场：在一张完整呈现季节、天气与地形的地形图上体验二战全程。冰雪、泥泞和风暴既可能是你的强大盟友，也可能是无情的敌人。谈判或强加你的意志：体验深度的政治与外交系统，组建阵营，进行资源贸易，并为你的党派任命部长。激烈的在线战斗：在最多 32 名玩家的竞技与合作多人对战中作战。支持中途加入与跨平台联机。让你的国家独具优势：体验灵活可变的科技系统，每个主要国家都拥有独特的特色。通过科研和陆军经验研发细节丰富的历史坦克与飞机。

1mz9wmq.en: No Compromise, No Surrender Paradox Steam Released on 2025-11-20. Mould new paths in history for Japan, China and the Philippines in No Compromise, No Surrender, an Expansion for Hearts of Iron IV. Seize a greater depth of control over factions, forge new military doctrines and decide the fate of the Pacific and beyond. Japan Focus Tree: Seize control of the Pacific, shatter Western dominance, and usher in a rising sun, red dawn, or other unique paths as you reshape the Pacific in an image of your choosing. Communist China Focus Tree: Drive out the old order, unite the people and lead the nation towards its rightful ascendancy as you balance enemies within and without. Nationalist China Focus Tree: Rally the republic, crush the warlords and bring your nation back from the precipice. Choose one of several paths towards victory against the hostile Empires in your war of resistance. Philippines Focus Tree: Defend the islands, defy the invaders and establish independence for your nation. Explore alternative histories and work with those you once considered foes; leverage your access to abundant natural resources, and lend your support to those who most benefit your situation. New Military Doctrines: Shape, manage, and ultimately reform the armed forces according to your battlefield requirements with unique doctrines that accompany a rework of the core doctrines system. Expanded Factions System: Wield greater control over allied countries with new and expanded faction rules and defined goals of your alliance. Additional supporting features and quality-of-life updates, such as new Naval Special Projects and updates to Naval Combat with improved carrier mechanics.
1mz9wmq.zh: 不妥协，不投降 Paradox Steam 发行于 2025-11-20。在《不妥协，不投降》中为日本、中国和菲律宾开辟新的历史道路——这是《钢铁雄心 IV》的一款扩展包。更深入地掌控阵营，打造新的军事学说，决定太平洋乃至更远地区的命运。日本国策树：夺取太平洋的控制权，粉碎西方的统治，让旭日升起、赤潮涌动，或走上其他独特道路，按你选择的样子重塑太平洋。中国共产党国策树：驱逐旧秩序，团结人民，带领国家走向它应有的崛起，同时平衡内外之敌。国民政府国策树：重振共和国，粉碎军阀，让国家从悬崖边缘回归。在抗敌战争中从数条道路中选择一条，战胜充满敌意的列强。菲律宾国策树：保卫岛屿，抗击入侵者，为你的国家赢得独立。探索架空历史，与曾经的敌人合作；利用你所能获取的丰富自然资源，支持最能改善你处境的一方。新军事学说：用独特的学说按你的战场需求塑造、管理并最终改革武装力量，同时核心学说系统也将一并重做。阵营系统扩展：借助新的、扩展的阵营规则和明确的同盟目标，对盟国施加更强的控制。其他辅助功能与体验优化更新，例如新的海军特殊项目，以及改进航母机制的海战更新。

nn2vze.en: Götterdämmerung Paradox Steam Released on 2024-11-14. Players can write new histories of Germany, Austria, Hungary and Belgium. Build the industrial and research foundation to survive the world's greatest conflict. Pursue exciting new research and military options, opening new paths for devastating new weapons and dramatic raids on strategic targets. German Focus Tree: Revised national focuses and alternate historical paths for one of the most played nations in Hearts of Iron IV. These political paths include new monarchist content, a restored democratic Germany and an alternate communist path. More character driven events add flavour to the war's central player. Austrian Focus Tree: New alternate histories for Austria free of German control, as well as content for surrounding countries that were once part of the Habsburg Empire. There is also a historical path for AI controlled Austria. Hungarian Focus Tree: Rebuild the nation, using technology to overcome manpower shortages. Reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire and forge a powerful, unified faction. Belgian Focus Tree: Resist or welcome German supremacy. Draw on the natural wealth of the Congo and build potential for an African government-in-exile. Congo Focus Tree: Collaborate with Belgium to grow your economy and harness natural resources. Support the Allies or time your independence to follow a Communist, Democratic, or Monarchist path. Special Projects: Build scientific facilities to pursue advanced research in special projects, assigning scientists to further your war effort. Special projects include nuclear physics, advanced aircraft, rocketry, advanced tanks and artillery, naval engineering and electronics. Raids: Attack important enemy targets with carefully planned strikes. Enemy ports, industrial structures, research facilities and special resource collection areas are potential targets for bombing strikes, commando raids or paratroop attacks. And more: Added Landmarks and Dams that are visible on the map. New changes to the use and effectiveness of atomic warfare.
nn2vze.zh: 诸神黄昏 Paradox Steam 发行于 2024-11-14。玩家可以书写德国、奥地利、匈牙利和比利时的新历史。建立工业与科研基础，以熬过世界上最大的冲突。追寻激动人心的新科研与军事选项，为毁灭性的新武器和对战略目标的戏剧性突袭开辟新道路。德国国策树：为《钢铁雄心 IV》中被游玩最多的国家之一重制国策，并提供架空历史路线。这些政治路线包括新的君主主义内容、恢复民主的德国以及一条架空共产主义路线。更多以人物为驱动的事件为这场战争的核心参与者增添风味。奥地利国策树：为摆脱德国控制的奥地利提供新的架空历史，以及曾属于哈布斯堡帝国的周边国家的内容。此外还有一条供 AI 控制的奥地利使用的历史路线。匈牙利国策树：重建国家，用科技克服人力短缺。改革奥匈帝国，打造一个强大而统一的阵营。比利时国策树：抵抗或欢迎德国的霸权。利用刚果的自然财富，为非洲的流亡政府积蓄潜力。刚果国策树：与比利时合作发展经济并利用自然资源。支持同盟国，或把握时机独立，走上共产主义、民主主义或君主主义路线。特殊项目：建造科研设施，在特殊项目中开展前沿研究，指派科学家推进你的战争努力。特殊项目包括核物理、先进飞机、火箭技术、先进坦克与火炮、海军工程和电子学。突袭：以精心策划的打击攻击敌方重要目标。敌方港口、工业设施、科研设施和特殊资源采集区都可能成为轰炸打击、突击队突袭或伞兵攻击的目标。以及更多：新增在地图上可见的地标与水坝。对核战争的使用方式与效果进行了新的改动。

1dnvcd3.en: Arms Against Tyranny Paradox Steam Released on 2023-10-10. Finnish Focus Tree: Relive the defining moment of Finnish history, defying the odds in a war against a much more powerful Soviet adversary. Swedish Focus Tree: The richest of the Nordic nations, Sweden is well-suited to a path of vigorous neutrality and to serve as both an arms designer and arms trader. Norwegian Focus Tree: Relive the historical challenge of a young industrializing nation trying to stay neutral in the face of German aggression or prepare for war by quickly arming to resist the war that is coming to your doorstep. Danish Focus Tree: A long-standing policy of neutrality leaves Denmark unready for a continental war. Pursue the course of domestic harmony through a strong welfare state and agile diplomacy, or throw in with the democratic Allies, rearming for the coming storm. Icelandic Focus Tree: Military Industrial Organizations: Military Industrial Organizations will offer new ways to streamline production lines or develop high-performance weapons systems with advantages on the battlefield. International Market: In the new International Market, you can become an arms exporting powerhouse, selling weapons to other nations in return for civilian factory output, increasing your own industrial production at home while fueling the fires of war abroad.
1dnvcd3.zh: 反抗暴政 Paradox Steam 发行于 2023-10-10。芬兰国策树：重温芬兰历史上决定性的时刻，在一场对抗强大得多的苏联对手的战争中逆势取胜。瑞典国策树：作为北欧最富裕的国家，瑞典非常适合走积极中立的路线，并同时充当武器设计者和武器贸易者。挪威国策树：重温一个年轻工业化国家在德国侵略面前努力保持中立的历史挑战，或者迅速武装起来，抵抗即将来到你家门口的战争。丹麦国策树：长期的中立政策让丹麦对大陆战争毫无准备。通过强大的福利国家和灵活的外交追求国内和谐，或者加入民主的同盟国，为即将到来的风暴重新武装。冰岛国策树：军事工业组织：军事工业组织将提供精简生产线或开发高性能武器系统的新途径，让你在战场上占据优势。国际市场：在新的国际市场中，你可以成为武器出口大国，向他国出售武器以换取民用工厂产出，既提升本国的工业生产，又为海外战火添柴。

1nrixbb.en: ⟦0⟧: The richest of the Nordic nations, Sweden is well-suited to a path of vigorous neutrality and to serve as both an arms designer and arms trader.
1nrixbb.zh: ⟦0⟧：作为北欧最富裕的国家，瑞典非常适合走积极中立的路线，并同时充当武器设计者和武器贸易者。

affv1k.en: ⟦0⟧: Relive the historical challenge of a young industrializing nation trying to stay neutral in the face of German aggression or prepare for war by quickly arming to resist the war that is coming to your doorstep.
affv1k.zh: ⟦0⟧：重温一个年轻工业化国家在德国侵略面前努力保持中立的历史挑战，或者迅速武装起来，抵抗即将来到你家门口的战争。

1ch02dw.en: ⟦0⟧: A long-standing policy of neutrality leaves Denmark unready for a continental war. Pursue the course of domestic harmony through a strong welfare state and agile diplomacy, or throw in with the democratic Allies, rearming for the coming storm.
1ch02dw.zh: ⟦0⟧：长期的中立政策让丹麦对大陆战争毫无准备。通过强大的福利国家和灵活的外交追求国内和谐，或者加入民主的同盟国，为即将到来的风暴重新武装。

1j1acdv.en: ⟦0⟧: Military Industrial Organizations will offer new ways to streamline production lines or develop high-performance weapons systems with advantages on the battlefield.
1j1acdv.zh: ⟦0⟧：军事工业组织将提供精简生产线或开发高性能武器系统的新途径，让你在战场上占据优势。

10kfovm.en: ⟦0⟧: In the new International Market, you can become an arms exporting powerhouse, selling weapons to other nations in return for civilian factory output, increasing your own industrial production at home while fueling the fires of war abroad.
10kfovm.zh: ⟦0⟧：在新的国际市场中，你可以成为军火出口强国，向他国出售武器以换取民用工厂产出，既提升本国的工业生产能力，又为海外的战火添柴加薪。

xk4g6b.en: By Blood Alone Paradox Steam Released on 2022-09-27. Build a new empire, resist foreign aggression or explore the limits of neutrality. The expansion adds new alternate history options and gameplay variety for three nations, as well as other significant changes. Updated Italian Focus Tree: Follow the historical path of Mussolini's Italy or rewrite history by restoring power to the monarchy, leading a Communist revolution or promoting democracy. Ethiopian Focus Tree: Defy the odds to defeat the Italian invader or resist the conqueror from abroad using unique Government in Exile abilities. Swiss Focus Tree: Surrounded by France, Germany and Italy, the mountain nation of Switzerland finds strength in its neutrality, balancing competing factions and overtures from the great powers. New Peace Conference Options: Demilitarize zones of the map or entire nations, bid on the capital ships of defeated powers, or claim control of enemy resources or factories as reparations. Aircraft Designer: Design and build your own planes, from nimble interceptors that prioritize speed to durable bombers crafted to unload tons of destruction from high above. Unit Medals: A log of each division's accomplishments lets you track their performance, and even allows you to award unique medals to division commanders for their actions in the field. Embargo Interaction: Embargo your enemies with a new diplomatic interaction, preventing them from trading with you if they have generated enough world tension. New Unit Models: Over 20 new unit models for Italy, Ethiopia, and Switzerland New Plane Models: 67 new plane models 12 New Music Tracks
xk4g6b.zh: 以血盟誓 Paradox Steam 发布于 2022-09-27。建立新的帝国，抵御外国侵略，或探索中立政策的极限。该扩展包为三个国家增添了新的架空历史选项与玩法变化，并带来其他重大改动。更新后的意大利国策树：沿着墨索里尼统治下的意大利的历史道路前行，或改写历史——将权力归还君主制、领导共产主义革命，或推行民主。埃塞俄比亚国策树：克服重重劣势击败意大利入侵者，或利用独特的流亡政府能力抵抗来自国外的征服者。瑞士国策树：被法国、德国和意大利包围的山地国家瑞士，从其中立政策中汲取力量，在相互竞争的派系与列强的拉拢之间保持平衡。新的和平会议选项：将地图上的某些区域或整个国家非军事化，竞拍战败国的主力舰，或索取敌方资源或工厂作为战争赔偿。飞机设计商：设计并建造你自己的飞机，从优先追求速度的轻型截击机，到为从高空倾泻成吨毁灭而打造的坚固轰炸机。部队勋章：记录每个师的战绩，让你能够追踪其表现，甚至可以因师指挥官在战场上的表现而授予其独特勋章。禁运互动：通过新的外交互动对敌人实施禁运，若对方已制造了足够的世界紧张度，便可阻止其与你进行贸易。新增单位模型：为意大利、埃塞俄比亚和瑞士新增超过 20 个单位模型 新增飞机模型：67 个新飞机模型 12 首新音乐曲目

1l2dvxz.en: No Step Back Paradox Steam Released on 2021-11-23. The Second World War's hardest fighting was on the Eastern Front of Europe. This expansion adds greater detail for many nations in Eastern Europe, unique game systems to reflect Soviet politics, and many improvements to the military aspect of the game. Updated Soviet National Focus Tree. Updated Polish National Focus Tree. New Baltic National Focus Trees: Shared alternate history paths for Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, as well as unique paths for each. Army Officer Corps: Build a general staff, drawing on the talents and expertise of available officers to take advantage of changes in technology and tactics. Army Spirits: Emphasize certain characteristics of your military arms, adding general bonuses to certain units types or even aiding division design. Supply System Updates: Scorched Earth tactics, floating harbors and special supply units added to the logistics system. Tank Designer: Design your own armored force using modules prioritizing speed, gun power, armor or even production cost. Railway Guns: Commission the grandest, most prestigious of artillery pieces, uniquely designed to deal with entrenched foes, and fortified positions.
1l2dvxz.zh: 绝不后退 Paradox Steam 发布于 2021-11-23。第二次世界大战中最惨烈的战斗发生在欧洲东线。该扩展包为东欧的众多国家增添了更多细节，加入了反映苏联政治的独特游戏系统，并对游戏的军事层面作出了大量改进。更新后的苏联国策树。更新后的波兰国策树。新的波罗的海国策树：为爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛提供共享的架空历史路线，并为每国提供独有路线。陆军军官团：建立总参谋部，借助可用军官的才能与专长，把握科技与战术的变化。陆军精神：强调你麾下各军种的特质，为特定单位类型提供通用加成，甚至有助于师的设计。补给系统更新：后勤系统中加入了焦土战术、浮动港口和特种补给单位。坦克设计商：使用优先考虑速度、火力、装甲甚至生产成本的模块，设计你自己的装甲部队。列车炮：委托制造最宏大、最负盛名的火炮，专为对付已构筑工事的敌人和设防阵地而设计。

4i8cso.en: La Résistance Paradox Steam Released on 2020-02-25. Updated Focus Trees for France: New National Focuses for Free France and the Vichy France Regime, as well as an option for conservatives to restore the old French Monarchy. More in Depth Spanish Campaign: New National Focuses for Republican Spain and Nationalist Spain, as well as an expanded Spanish Civil War that can spiral into a wider conflict. Portuguese Focus Tree: Navigate the pressure of the World War, or involve yourself in the Spanish Conflict. Espionage: Use your Intelligence Agency to train spies to specialize in certain types of information warfare and develop passive resistance to enemy espionage, then send them on special operations. Support Resistance: Use your agents to assist allied resistance movements, giving them what they need to damage the enemy. Collaboration Governments: Use your agents to prepare the ground for collaborators to fill the void once you've conquered your target. Code Cracking: Decrypt enemy communications to gain short term battlefield advantages. Recon units: Scout planes can provide useful information on nearby areas while armored cars help in detecting and suppressing resistance activities.
4i8cso.zh: 抵抗运动 Paradox Steam 发布于 2020-02-25。更新后的法国国策树：为自由法国和维希法国政权添加了新的国策，并为保守派提供了恢复旧法国君主制的选项。更深入的西班牙战役：为共和西班牙和国民西班牙添加了新的国策，并扩展了西班牙内战，使其可能升级为更大范围的冲突。葡萄牙国策树：在世界大战的压力中周旋，或让自己卷入西班牙冲突。间谍活动：利用你的情报机构训练特工，使其专精于特定类型的信息战，并发展出对敌方间谍活动的被动抵抗能力，然后派遣他们执行特种行动。支援抵抗：利用你的特工协助盟国抵抗运动，为其提供破坏敌人所需的一切。合作政府：利用你的特工为合作者铺路，以便在你征服目标后填补权力真空。密码破译：解密敌方通信，以获得短期战场优势。侦察单位：侦察机可以提供附近区域的有用情报，而装甲车则有助于发现和镇压抵抗活动。

uwos0o.en: Graveyard of Empires Paradox Steam Released on 2025-03-04. Navigate the difficult channel between nationalist dreams and imperial oppression. Resist the demands of foreign great powers and claim your own place on the world stage, engaging in diplomacy and warfare to lead a great national rebirth in the vast lands between the Euphrates and the Gulf of Bengal. Gain new national focus trees for key actors in West, Central and South Asia, with a focus on regional resistance to European domination in the region: Indian National Focus tree: The Raj is the jewel of the British Empire, rich and strategically vital. However, a growing independence movement threatens to disrupt the war effort and dissolve the empire. A large focus tree focused on the struggle of Indian Independence offers many alternate historical paths, including the revival of the East India Company as a corporate nation, as well as the possible freedom of the Princely States and the formation of Pakistan and Bangladesh. Iranian National Focus tree: Iran is a potential great power, hemmed in by the imperial pressure of the Soviet Union and the British Empire. A significant new Focus Tree allows the player to resist the imperial incursions that historically weakened Iran, as well as offering potential for a new and modern Persian Empire or an Islamic Revolution in the heart of Asia. Iraqi National Focus tree: Take control of this British client state and try to chart your own path, choosing to side against your overlord. Manage the many competing ethnic and religious factions in Iraq and develop the strategically important oil fields. Afghan National Focus tree: The historic Graveyard of Empires, isolated from the wider war, offers many alternate paths. Continue the historical path of neutrality and isolation, or choose the road of rapid industrialization and building a new power in the mountains of Central Asia.
uwos0o.zh: 帝国坟场 Paradox Steam 发布于 2025-03-04。在民族主义梦想与帝国主义压迫之间的狭窄航道中穿行。抵抗外国列强的要求，在世界舞台上争取属于自己的一席之地，通过外交与战争，在幼发拉底河与孟加拉湾之间的广袤土地上领导一场伟大的民族复兴。为西亚、中亚和南亚的关键角色提供新的国策树，重点关注该地区对欧洲统治的区域性抵抗：印度国策树：英属印度是大英帝国皇冠上的明珠，富庶且具有重要战略意义。然而，日益壮大的独立运动威胁着战争努力，并可能瓦解整个帝国。一棵庞大的国策树聚焦于印度独立斗争，提供众多架空历史路线，包括让东印度公司以公司国家的形式复兴，以及土邦可能获得自由、巴基斯坦与孟加拉国的成立。伊朗国策树：伊朗是一个潜在的列强，却被苏联和大英帝国的帝国主义压力所困。一棵重要的新国策树让玩家能够抵抗历史上削弱伊朗的帝国主义入侵，同时也为在亚洲腹地建立新的现代波斯帝国或爆发伊斯兰革命提供了可能。伊拉克国策树：掌控这个英国附庸国，尝试走出自己的道路，选择与你的宗主国为敌。管理伊拉克众多相互竞争的族群与宗教派系，并开发具有重要战略意义的油田。阿富汗国策树：这个历史上的帝国坟场与更广泛的战争相隔绝，提供众多架空路线。延续中立与孤立的历史道路，或选择快速工业化、在中亚山区建立新强权的道路。
