1fjjzj9.zh: ⟦0⟧：英属印度是大英帝国皇冠上的明珠，富庶且具有重要战略意义。然而，日益壮大的独立运动威胁着战争努力，并可能瓦解整个帝国。一棵庞大的国策树聚焦于印度独立斗争，提供众多架空历史路线，包括让东印度公司以公司国家的形式复兴，以及土邦可能获得自由、巴基斯坦与孟加拉国的成立。

1ah722u.en: ⟦0⟧: Iran is a potential great power, hemmed in by the imperial pressure of the Soviet Union and the British Empire. A significant new Focus Tree allows the player to resist the imperial incursions that historically weakened Iran, as well as offering potential for a new and modern Persian Empire or an Islamic Revolution in the heart of Asia.
1ah722u.zh: ⟦0⟧：伊朗是一个潜在的列强，却被苏联和大英帝国的帝国主义压力所困。一棵重要的新国策树让玩家能够抵抗历史上削弱伊朗的帝国主义入侵，同时也为在亚洲腹地建立新的现代波斯帝国或爆发伊斯兰革命提供了可能。

18cbrnd.en: ⟦0⟧: Take control of this British client state and try to chart your own path, choosing to side against your overlord. Manage the many competing ethnic and religious factions in Iraq and develop the strategically important oil fields.
18cbrnd.zh: ⟦0⟧：掌控这个英国附庸国，尝试走出自己的道路，选择与你的宗主国为敌。管理伊拉克众多相互竞争的族群与宗教派系，并开发具有重要战略意义的油田。

ei72js.en: ⟦0⟧: The historic Graveyard of Empires, isolated from the wider war, offers many alternate paths. Continue the historical path of neutrality and isolation, or choose the road of rapid industrialization and building a new power in the mountains of Central Asia.
ei72js.zh: ⟦0⟧：这个历史上的帝国坟场与更广泛的战争相隔绝，提供众多架空路线。延续中立与孤立的历史道路，或选择快速工业化、在中亚山区建立新强权的道路。

voyaby.en: Trial of Allegiance Paradox Steam Released on 2024-03-07. National Focus Tree for Brazil: Challenged by a decade of internal strife and constitutional crises, Brazil can follow the historical path as a late but valuable member of the Allied cause. Alternately, seek continental hegemony under a new government with new priorities. National Focus Tree for Argentina: Rife with corruption, revolts and worker unrest, Argentina presents a difficult political challenge. Once you’ve settled the problems at home, you can contribute more on the world stage and help this nation reach its full potential. National Focus Tree for Chile: Chile is a vigorous republic with a radical tradition that must face domestic fascist parties, the embers of ethnic unrest and the imposing influence of the United States. Chart a course of equality and renewal, rallying under the banner of continental unity. Paraguay and Uruguay: Minor content as well as several new releasable nations. New Art: New 3D unit sprites for the Brazilian army, as well as new unique 2D art for National Focus trees and units New Music: Six new songs, with two each for the major nations in the pack. New Voiceovers: Voiceovers in Brazilian Portuguese, Argentinian Spanish and Chilean Spanish.
voyaby.zh: 效忠审判 Paradox Steam 发布于 2024-03-07。巴西国策树：面对长达十年的内乱与宪政危机，巴西可以走上历史道路，作为盟国事业中虽迟到却宝贵的一员。或者，在新政府与新优先事项下谋求大陆霸权。阿根廷国策树：腐败横行、叛乱频发、工人动荡不安，阿根廷面临着艰难的政治挑战。一旦解决了国内问题，你就能在世界舞台上作出更大贡献，帮助这个国家充分发挥其潜力。智利国策树：智利是一个充满活力、有着激进传统的共和国，必须面对国内的法西斯政党、族群动荡的余烬以及美国强大的影响力。绘制一条平等与革新的道路，在大陆团结的旗帜下集结。巴拉圭与乌拉圭：少量内容以及若干新的可释放国家。新增美术：为巴西陆军新增 3D 单位模型，以及国策树和单位的新独特 2D 美术 新增音乐：6 首新歌曲，其中为包内主要国家各提供 2 首。新增配音：巴西葡萄牙语、阿根廷西班牙语和智利西班牙语配音。

ooioik.en: Battle for the Bosporus Paradox Steam Released on 2020-10-15. New dedicated national focus trees to the minor powers around the Black Sea and the Aegean. Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey can each chart unique historical and alternate history paths as they resist efforts by the major powers to dominate the strategic sea-lanes of the Bosporus and Dardanelles. National Focus Tree for Bulgaria: Balance the factions in a divided land or reclaim territory lost in 1919. Follow the historical alliance with Germany or resist the German pressures on Tsar Boris, standing up for a free Bulgaria. National Focus Tree for Greece: Riven by political division, Greek neutrality is maintained by the controversial Metaxas. Build a strong relationship with the Allies under the guidance of King George II, follow arch-conservatives into fascism or restore the glories of Greek Empire in the east. National Focus Tree for Turkey: Robbed of its empire in the last war, what future is there for Turkey in a new one? Continue or halt the reforms of Kemalism, stand as the protector of the Balkans in a new regional faction, restore the Sultan to the throne or found a new Islamic state. New Music Tracks. New Models: 3D Unit Models for Balkan and Turkish armies. Unique voiceovers for Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey.
ooioik.zh: 博斯普鲁斯之战 Paradox Steam 发布于 2020-10-15。为黑海与爱琴海周边的小国提供全新的专属国策树。保加利亚、希腊和土耳其可以各自走上独特的历史与架空历史路线，抵抗列强试图控制博斯普鲁斯与达达尼尔海峡这些战略航道的企图。保加利亚国策树：在四分五裂的土地上平衡各派系，或夺回 1919 年失去的领土。延续与德国的历史同盟，或顶住德国对沙皇鲍里斯的压力，捍卫自由的保加利亚。希腊国策树：在政治分裂的撕扯下，希腊的中立由颇具争议的梅塔克萨斯维持。在国王乔治二世的引导下与盟国建立牢固关系，追随极端保守派走向法西斯主义，或在东方重振希腊帝国的荣光。土耳其国策树：在上一次战争中失去了帝国，在一场新的战争中，土耳其还有怎样的未来？继续或中止凯末尔主义的改革，在新的地区阵营中充当巴尔干的保护者，让苏丹重登王位，或建立一个新伊斯兰国家。新增音乐曲目。新增模型：巴尔干与土耳其军队的 3D 单位模型。保加利亚、希腊和土耳其的独特配音。

15f5qnv.en: Thunder at Our Gates Paradox Steam Released on 2026-06-11. Step into the heart of command in Thunder at Our Gates, a Theater Pack for Hearts of Iron IV. Expand on the art of organizing a campaign with new features such as military headquarters and navy captains, as well as unique new content for nations caught between rival empires; Australia, Siam and Indonesia: Australia Focus Tree: Support your Allies across the world and hold fast as the last bastion against Japan in the Pacific, or make use of your unstable political climate to change your course entirely. Siam Focus Tree: Turn rival nations into pawns, exploit the great powers and carve out your own empire in Southeast Asia. Indonesia Focus Tree: Steer the course of Indonesia’s future; remain under Dutch rule, or seize the moment to fight for independence alone, or under a new patron. Military HQs: Deploy your generals where they matter. Wield local command and support your troops through synergies with updated command abilities, proximity, and new division design features. Ship Captains: Named captains lead your ships, where they earn skills and can be promoted to admirals to command your fleets.
15f5qnv.zh: 雷霆临门 Paradox Steam 发布于 2026-06-11。在《雷霆临门》中步入指挥的核心——这是《钢铁雄心 IV》的一款战区包。通过军事指挥部和海军舰长等新特性，深化组织战役的艺术，并为夹在敌对帝国之间的国家提供独特的新内容；澳大利亚、暹罗和印度尼西亚：澳大利亚国策树：支援你在世界各地的盟友，坚守阵地，成为太平洋上抵御日本的最后堡垒，或利用你不稳定的政治气候彻底改变你的路线。暹罗国策树：把竞争对手变成棋子，利用列强，在东南亚开辟属于你自己的帝国。印度尼西亚国策树：掌控印度尼西亚未来的走向；继续留在荷兰统治之下，或抓住时机独自争取独立，或在新的幕后靠山支持下为之而战。军事指挥部：把将领部署到真正重要的地方。凭借更新后的指挥能力、邻近度以及新的师设计特性所产生的协同效应，实施局部指挥并支援你的部队。舰长：具名舰长指挥你的舰船，他们可以积累技能，并晋升为海军上将，统领你的舰队。

un7jzr.en: Peace for Our Time Paradox Steam Released on 2026-04-22. The Allied betrayal of Czechoslovakia at Munich and the later German annexation of that country is a key moment in the historical march towards World War II in Europe. But imagine a world where the White Lion of Prague was prepared to face German aggression - bravery in the face of oppression. Explore that scenario in Peace for Our Time, a new Focus Pack for Hearts of Iron IV. Created in collaboration with veteran modders Logan ‘Spicy Alfredo’ Calkins, Abbus Fung and Marijn ‘marijn211’ Vroegh, this Focus Pack offers new options for Czechoslovakia in a desperate fight for survival against overwhelming odds, posing a unique challenge to all Hearts of Iron IV players. Democratic National Focus Path: Surrounded by non-democratic nations, safeguard Czechoslovakia's freedom by forging your own faction, leading a government in exile or pursuing independence. Communist National Focus Path: Spark a socialist revolution to replace the failed middle path, joining the Comintern or uniting the region under your own federation; whether through radical struggle or moderate reform. Monarchist and Fascist National Focus Paths: Rally nationalist forces to establish a new kingdom of Bohemia or embrace military dictatorship, expand your influence through allies or subjects, and decide whether to entrench authoritarianism or return to democracy once the crisis has passed. Manage your arms industry, become an industrial powerhouse, and shape conflicts across the globe by exporting weapons abroad. Engage with the Divided Nation mechanic to solve the challenges of governing a divided democracy. Army Readiness Balance of Power forces you to ensure you have the support of the military. New Art and Music, including two new music tracks, 3D depictions of the historical Prague Castle and Bojnice Castle, new equipment graphics and new focus icons and character portraits.
un7jzr.zh: 我们时代的和平 Paradox Steam 发布于 2026-04-22。盟国在慕尼黑对捷克斯洛伐克的背叛，以及随后德国对该国的吞并，是欧洲迈向第二次世界大战的历史进程中的关键时刻。但请想象一个布拉格的白狮已准备好直面德国侵略的世界——面对压迫时的勇气。在《我们时代的和平》中探索这一情景，这是《钢铁雄心 IV》的一款新焦点包。本焦点包与资深模组作者 Logan ‘Spicy Alfredo’ Calkins、Abbus Fung 和 Marijn ‘marijn211’ Vroegh 合作制作，为捷克斯洛伐克在压倒性劣势下为生存而进行的绝望抗争提供了新选项，为所有《钢铁雄心 IV》玩家带来独特挑战。民主国策路线：在被非民主国家包围的环境下，通过组建自己的阵营、领导流亡政府或追求独立来捍卫捷克斯洛伐克的自由。共产主义国策路线：点燃社会主义革命，取代失败的中间道路，加入共产国际，或在你自己的联邦之下统一该地区；无论是通过激进斗争还是温和改革。君主主义与法西斯主义国策路线：集结民族主义力量，建立新的波希米亚王国，或拥抱军事独裁，通过盟友或属国扩张你的影响力，并决定是巩固威权主义，还是在危机过去后回归民主。管理你的军工产业，成为工业强国，并通过向海外出口武器来影响全球各地的冲突。借助「分裂的国家」机制，解决治理一个分裂的民主国家所面临的挑战。陆军战备权力平衡机制迫使你确保自己获得军方的支持。新增美术与音乐，包括 2 首新音乐曲目、历史建筑布拉格城堡与博伊尼采城堡的 3D 呈现、新的装备图像，以及新的焦点图标和人物肖像。

1rexhf2.en: Man the Guns (A free DLC[2]) Released on 2019-02-28, now part of the base game. Major Alternate Paths: Revive the Old Confederacy as the United States and provoke a new civil war, or hasten decolonization of the British Empire. Ship Design: Research new components and refit older vessels to take advantage of new knowledge. Outfit your submarines with snorkels or improved stealth. Admiral Traits and Skills: Tailor and level up your Admirals with new traits and skills. Governments in Exile: Welcome a government in exile to your democracy, boosting their legitimacy in return for more manpower and elite troops fighting to free their homeland. Other National Focuses: New national focuses for The Netherlands and Mexico. Naval Mines: Protect your coasts from invasion or assault with anti-ship mines, or clear a path through enemy mines before you make the big push. Shipping route controls: plot new routes for your shipping and navies by marking areas you want to avoid. Naval Treaties: Struggle to keep the peace by following internationally agreed upon rules, or creatively defy the world consensus by exceeding your limits. Amphibious Landing Vehicles: Add power to your beach landing by researching and producing specialized combat vehicles for your marines. New Music: Original music composed specifically for the Man the Guns expansion.
1rexhf2.zh: 全民持枪（一款免费的 DLC[2]） 发布于 2019-02-28，现已成为基础游戏的一部分。主要的架空路线：以美国复兴旧邦联并引发一场新的内战，或加速大英帝国的去殖民化。舰船设计：研究新部件并改装旧舰，以利用新知识。为你的潜艇装备通气管或改进的隐蔽性。海军上将特质与技能：用新的特质和技能来定制并提升你的海军上将。流亡政府：欢迎流亡政府来到你的民主国家，提升其合法性，以换取更多人力，以及为解放祖国而战的精锐部队。其他国策：为荷兰和墨西哥添加新的国策。海军水雷：用反舰水雷保护你的海岸免遭入侵或攻击，或在发动总攻前扫清敌方水雷、开辟通路。航运路线控制：通过标记你想要避开的区域，为你的航运和海军规划新路线。海军条约：遵循国际商定的规则，努力维持和平，或富有创意地超额突破你的限制，公然违抗世界共识。两栖登陆载具：为你的海军陆战队研究并生产专用战斗载具，为你的滩头登陆增添力量。新增音乐：专为《全民持枪》扩展包创作的原创音乐。

nyncvx.en: Waking the Tiger (A free DLC[3]) Released on 2018-03-08, now part of the base game. National Focus Trees for China: Guide China or the Communist China through the war, guided by your own vision of the future. Modified Focus Trees: German Reich and Japan, two major Axis powers now have alternate history paths, including the chance to depose Hitler or restore democracy to Japan. General Traits and Abilities: Generals’ traits can now unlock powerful Command Power abilities, allowing great flexibility and creativity. Decisions and Missions: Historical decisions and national missions give new places to spend Political Power, from domestic politics to start special projects. And more: Scavenge equipment from the battlefield, use Volunteer Air Corps, as well as new music and art.
nyncvx.zh: 唤醒猛虎（免费 DLC[3]）于 2018-03-08 发布，现已并入基础游戏。中国的国策树：带领中国或共产主义中国走过战争，以你自己对未来的设想为指引。修改后的国策树：德意志国与日本这两大轴心国列强如今拥有架空历史路线，包括推翻希特勒或让日本恢复民主的机会。将领特质与能力：将领的特质现在可解锁强大的指挥点数能力，带来极大的灵活性与创造性。决议与任务：历史决议与国家任务提供了新的政治点数花费途径，从国内政治到启动特殊项目。以及更多：从战场搜刮装备，使用空军志愿队，还有新的音乐与美术。

17hq67c.en: Death or Dishonor (A free DLC[3]) Released on 2017-06-14, now part of the base game. Four New Focus Trees: Experience the war from the difficult perspectives of Hungary, Romania, Czechoslovakia, and Yugoslavia. Equipment Conversion: Update your arsenal by converting older units - or make use of captured enemy vehicles and gear. New Diplomatic Interactions: License military technology to bring other nations' weapons to the field or sell your advances to the highest bidder. New Puppet Interactions: Fascist countries get new subject levels like Reichskommissariat, with access to licenses, industry and strategic resources. The instated governments are held in an iron grip, making it harder for them to break free. New Music and Art: 3 new thematic musical tracks from composer Andreas Waldetoft, new art content for the four focus nations, and new troop voiceovers.
17hq67c.zh: 死亡或耻辱（免费 DLC[3]）于 2017-06-14 发布，现已并入基础游戏。四个新国策树：从匈牙利、罗马尼亚、捷克斯洛伐克与南斯拉夫的艰难视角体验战争。装备改装：通过改装旧式单位来更新你的军备——或利用缴获的敌方载具与装备。新外交互动：授权军事科技，把别国的武器投入战场，或将你的技术卖给出价最高者。新的傀儡国互动：法西斯国家获得新的附庸等级，如 Reichskommissariat（帝国专员辖区），可使用授权、工业与战略资源。被扶植的政府被牢牢掌控，更难挣脱。新音乐与美术：作曲家 Andreas Waldetoft 创作的 3 首新主题音乐，四个焦点国家的新美术内容，以及新的部队语音。

1ri7bx0.en: Together for Victory (A free DLC[3]) Released on 2016-12-15, now part of the base game. New national focus trees and events: Focus trees for Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the British Raj (India) and South Africa. Alternate historical path: For each of the Dominions, with options to stay loyal to Great Britain, or forge a new, more independent destiny. New autonomy system: Giving subject states degrees of independence from a foreign master. Changes to Lend-Lease: Allows to ask allies to send you your desperately needed equipment. A Spearhead battleplan command: Allowing more control over grand encirclements and punching through enemy lines. Technology sharing: Allows Commonwealth nations to quickly catch up with British assistance.

1873fte.en: Defines are exposed constants used by the game to control almost every aspect of it. They allow modders to influence systems that do not have a direct script component.

1tdkwl6.en: As defines are Lua code rather than a PDXscript-interpreted file, any Lua code can go in there, however modules allowing to go out of this directory are not available. As a consequence of this, ⟦0⟧. Defines, including graphical defines, are merely a Lua-contained array, and it is possible to modify a single member of the array in Lua using, for example, ⟦1⟧. Each of these lines is contained on a separate line and ⟦2⟧, such as the following:
1tdkwl6.zh: 由于 Defines 是 Lua 代码，而不是由 PDXscript 解析的文件，因此其中可以放入任何 Lua 代码，但无法使用能够跳出此目录的模块。因此，⟦0⟧。Defines（包括图形 Defines）只是一个由 Lua 包含的数组，可以用 Lua 修改数组中的单个成员，例如 ⟦1⟧。这些行各自独占一行，且 ⟦2⟧，如下所示：

1ux0xz2.en: there is no need to copy the entire file to edit it
1ux0xz2.zh: 无需复制整个文件即可进行编辑

1ihky5q.en: there are no commas separating them
1ihky5q.zh: 它们之间没有用逗号分隔

1n1bo82.en: -- An unnecessary comma will result in a game crash upon launching.
1n1bo82.zh: -- 多余的逗号会导致游戏在启动时崩溃。

17aw8zf.en: -- They are present in the base game defines file due to the fact that NDefines is one single large array, and when defining an array with members, the members are separated with commas. However, commands are not separated with commas.
17aw8zf.zh: -- 它们之所以出现在基础游戏的 defines 文件中，是因为 NDefines 是一个单一的大数组，而在定义带成员的数组时，成员之间用逗号分隔。但是，命令之间不用逗号分隔。

hac7zw.en: This goes into a separate file set to be evaluated after the base game defines, which is sorted by filenames using the ASCII character IDs. Since 0 is among the earliest characters by ID – placed before letters, other numbers, and underscores – almost any filename can work. In the base game files, the graphical defines are set to be merged into NDefines in the last line of the base game file. However, since Lua does not create copies of tables by default, the base game's NDefines contains pointers to the actual elements, which are contained within NDefines_Graphics regardless. For this reason, modifying either NDefines or NDefines_Graphics works for changing graphical defines. A mod should ⟦0⟧ contain the 00_defines.lua and 00_graphics.lua files within of itself: these files are commonly changed even in minor game updates, and having a define missing from a file results in the mod being unstable, potentially having a crash on startup.
hac7zw.zh: 这些内容放入一个单独的文件，并设置为在基础游戏 defines 之后求值，该文件按文件名使用 ASCII 字符 ID 排序。由于 0 的 ID 属于最早的字符之一——排在字母、其他数字和下划线之前——几乎任何文件名都可以。在基础游戏文件中，图形 defines 被设置为在基础游戏文件的最后一行合并进 NDefines。但是，由于 Lua 默认不会创建表的副本，基础游戏的 NDefines 中存放的是指向实际元素的指针，而这些元素无论如何都包含在 NDefines_Graphics 中。因此，修改 NDefines 或 NDefines_Graphics 都可以更改图形 defines。模组应⟦0⟧自身包含 00_defines.lua 和 00_graphics.lua 文件：这些文件即使在小型游戏更新中也常被改动，而文件中缺失某个 define 会导致模组不稳定，甚至可能在启动时崩溃。

1425d62.en: The Influence cost modifier is basically the inverse of distance. Nearby states are cheaper, and far-away states are more expensive. We basically do a two-segment lerp: if distance is between [0, NEUTRAL_DIST], we lerp the cost modifier between [MIN_DIST_COST_MODIFIER, 1.0] if distance is between [NEUTRAL_DIST, MAX_DIST], we lerp the cost modifier between [1.0, MAX_DIST_COST_MODIFIER] The below values represent (pixel distance / INFLUENCE_DISTANCE_DIVISOR) distance to capital that results in a cost modifier of 1.0
1425d62.zh: 影响力花费修正基本上与距离成反比。附近的州更便宜，偏远的州更昂贵。我们基本上做两段线性插值：如果距离在 [0, NEUTRAL_DIST] 之间，则在 [MIN_DIST_COST_MODIFIER, 1.0] 之间对花费修正做线性插值；如果距离在 [NEUTRAL_DIST, MAX_DIST] 之间，则在 [1.0, MAX_DIST_COST_MODIFIER] 之间对花费修正做线性插值。下面的数值表示（像素距离 / INFLUENCE_DISTANCE_DIVISOR）到首都的距离，其花费修正为 1.0

vvikq7.en: Example: If 2000 score is distributed to winners this turn and this value is set to 0.05, each winner will receive a minimum of 100 score (clamped by the max score they will receive over the cource of the conference). How much of the total peace conference score you get during the first n turns.
vvikq7.zh: 示例：如果本回合向胜方分配 2000 分，且该值设为 0.05，则每个胜方至少获得 100 分（受其在会议期间将获得的最大分数限制）。你在前 n 回合中获得和平会议总分的多少。

x1wm7n.en: More explanation of the peace score distribution above: {1.0} would give you all the score on the first turn. {0.5, 0.5, 0.5} would give you 50 % of the total score on each of the first three turns (in this case resulting in receiving 150 % of the total score). How much of the spent peace conference score that gets refunded in a contest. First element applies for the first round of conflicts, second element for the second round of conflicts, etc. The final element is used for each consecutive turn, so setting that to e.g. 0.7 means you get 70 % of the spent score back for every turn thereafter.
x1wm7n.zh: 对上文和平分数分配的进一步说明：{1.0} 会在第一回合就给你全部分数。{0.5, 0.5, 0.5} 会在前三个回合各给你总分的 50 %（此情况下共获得总分的 150 %）。争夺中已花费的和平会议分数有多少会被退还。第一个元素适用于第一轮冲突，第二个元素适用于第二轮冲突，依此类推。最后一个元素用于其后每一回合，因此将其设为例如 0.7 意味着此后每回合你可拿回已花费分数的 70 %。

vjx7cd.zh: 一国为接任领袖，其工厂相对于现任领袖必须达到的最低比例。

tspa0r.en: Number of days after formation of faction or change in leadership before another country is allowed to assume leadership.
tspa0r.zh: 阵营成立或领袖变更后，其他国家被允许接任领袖所需经过的天数。

vq667u.zh: 在判断阵营成员距接任领袖有多近时，投降状态的权重。

113ehr6.zh: 相同意识形态时增加的接受度数值

7cbt9g.zh: 脚本化意识形态接受度修正的接受度系数

507epk.zh: 贸易影响力的接受度系数（由基础值调整而来）

13fdmsd.zh: 人力补充投送的批量大小，以编制所需总人力的 % 表示。

32pva.zh: 每次更新时装备升级分配的最大批量。

9z3xfd.zh: 处于防御战争中的影响

kgb15e.zh: （旧情报系统）估算敌方工业总量时的最大偏差

1tpy2yb.en: Max total penalty from trade convoy raided
1tpy2yb.zh: 贸易运输船队遭袭带来的最大总惩罚

w5uz81.en: applies as a factor to female unit leader randomization the values needs to be zero if you don't actually have random portraits country leaders army leaders navy leaders air leaders operatives
w5uz81.zh: 作为系数作用于女性部队指挥官随机化，如果你实际上没有随机头像国家领导人陆军将领海军将领空军将领特工，该值需为零

hjcwr3.en: once a trade convoy ship sunk, you will get a larger negative impact on your war support
hjcwr3.zh: 一旦贸易运输船队被击沉，你的战争支持度将受到更大的负面影响

14l76ya.en: resource transfer convoys convoys from our states being raided will give a daily war support penalty depending on how important that resource is and how inefficent convoys are
14l76ya.zh: 资源运输船队中来自我方各州的运输船队遭袭时，将根据该资源的重要程度以及运输船队的低效程度给予每日战争支持度惩罚

180heg5.en: once a resource transfer convoys from our states ship sunk, you will get a larger negative impact on your war support
180heg5.zh: 一旦来自我方各州的资源运输船队被击沉，你的战争支持度将受到更大的负面影响

jehw2k.en: trade convoys being raided will give a daily war support penalty depending on how important that resource is and how inefficent convoys are
jehw2k.zh: 贸易运输船队遭袭时，将根据该资源的重要程度以及运输船队的低效程度给予每日战争支持度惩罚

dp9gki.en: Max total penalty from operative performing the propaganda mission in a country
dp9gki.zh: 特工在他国执行宣传任务造成的最大总惩罚

7jwlki.en: Amount of stability recovered daily from propaganda effort
7jwlki.zh: 宣传行动每天恢复的稳定度

1q70d8m.en: Amount of war support recovered daily from war support effort
1q70d8m.zh: 战争支持度行动每天恢复的战争支持度

pade97.en: time in days to fully delete equipments from stockpile. when you delete an equipment, they go to a temporary hidden pool which still can be seized
pade97.zh: 从库存中完全删除装备所需的天数。当你删除装备时，它们会进入一个临时的隐藏池，该池仍可被缴获

1ikl4a7.en: Conversion scale for planes to air supply
1ikl4a7.zh: 飞机转换为空中补给的换算系数

375exn.en: Air drop length after being dropped
375exn.zh: 空投后补给的持续小时数

1irpkyj.en: starting command power for every country
1irpkyj.zh: 每个国家的初始指挥点数

138aiig.en: base value for maximum command power
138aiig.zh: 指挥点数上限的基础值

xug0ra.en: base value for daily command power gain
xug0ra.zh: 每日指挥点数获取的基础值

1d2qgru.en: Ratio for volunteer planes available for sending in relation to sender air force
1d2qgru.zh: 可派出志愿飞机数量与派出国空军规模之比

tc1fim.en: Ratio for volunteer planes available for sending in relation to receiver air base capacity
tc1fim.zh: 可派出志愿飞机数量与接收国空军基地容量之比

o0nolh.zh: 国家从武官处获得的经验

1bj1ybg.en: Max ammount of special forces battalions is total number of non-special forces battalions multiplied by this and modified by a country modifier
1bj1ybg.zh: 特种部队营的最大数量，等于非特种部队营总数乘以该值，并受国家修正影响

dxlnog.en: You can have a minimum of this many special forces battalions, regardless of the number of non-special forces battalions you have, this can also be modified by a country modifier
dxlnog.zh: 无论你拥有多少非特种部队营，你都至少可以拥有这么多特种部队营，该值同样可受国家修正影响

1mdjqyh.en: Number of days a war has to have existed before anyone can surrender in it
1mdjqyh.zh: 一场战争必须持续多少天后，其中任何一方才能投降

nw5219.en: num convoys needed per fuel land lease
nw5219.zh: 每单位燃料租借所需的运输船队数量

1kgpt3l.en: starting fuel ratio compared to max fuel for countries
1kgpt3l.zh: 各国初始燃料与最大燃料之比

xl3n3u.en: base amount of fuel gained hourly per excess oil
xl3n3u.zh: 每份过剩石油每小时提供的基础燃料量

go91kq.en: base amount of fuel gained hourly, independent of excess oil
go91kq.zh: 每小时获得的基础燃料量，与过剩石油无关

qqymvj.en: pp cost to scorch a state
qqymvj.zh: 焦土化一个州的政治点数花费

eapgto.en: Factor on amount of normal manpower left for an exiled nation with no territory.
eapgto.zh: 无领土的流亡国家所保留的常规人力数量的系数。

1fpjxst.en: Factor on amount of normal manpower gained for the exile nation. From owned states that are controlled by an enemy. State manpower reduced by factor 1000 in code.
1fpjxst.zh: 流亡国家获得的常规人力数量的系数。来自被敌方控制的己方拥有的州。代码中州人力按 1000 的系数缩减。

1fp9ahy.zh: 流亡政府的合法性上限

12xd2a8.en: 0-1 Transfers ratio of stockpile. from 0 to this define depending on starting legitimacy on capitulation.
12xd2a8.zh: 0-1 库存转移比例。投降时根据初始合法性从 0 到该值。

1kc7kot.en: 0-100 Minimum starting legitimacy to transfer any equipment at all.
1kc7kot.zh: 0-100 初始合法性至少达到该值才会转移任何装备。

1cd7ksd.en: Multiplies war contribution percent with this factor for part of starting legitimacy. (0.5 would mean a 50 % war contribution gives 25 more legitimacy)
1cd7ksd.zh: 将战争贡献百分比乘以该系数，作为初始合法性的一部分。（0.5 表示 50 % 的战争贡献可带来 25 点额外合法性）

5pnafa.en: Multiplies war length (nr of weeks) with this factor for part of starting legitimacy. (1.0 would mean a war length of 30 weeks gives 30 more legitimacy)
5pnafa.zh: 将战争持续时间（周数）乘以该系数，作为初始合法性的一部分。（1.0 表示 30 周的战争可带来 30 点额外合法性）

1mp6o0.en: Factor on how much legitimacy is gained from warscore earned by GiE units.
1mp6o0.zh: 流亡政府部队获得的战争贡献转化为合法性的系数。

mm880q.en: Host will receive from 0 to this value in CIC.
mm880q.zh: 东道国将获得 0 到该值之间的 CIC。

c3rrag.en: Host will receive from 0 to this value in MIC.
c3rrag.zh: 东道国将获得 0 到该值之间的 MIC。

17j40gh.en: Host will receive from 0 to this value in dockyards.
17j40gh.zh: 东道国将获得 0 到该值之间的船坞。

oai772.en: Factor on amount of manpower gained from owned states that are controlled by an enemy. State manpower reduced by factor 1000 in code.
oai772.zh: 从被敌方控制的己方拥有的州获得的人力数量的系数。代码中州人力按 1000 的系数缩减。

1nwsda5.en: Factor on max amount of exile manpower that can be gained from owned states. Approaching this will give diminishing returns. Reduced by factor 100 in code.
1nwsda5.zh: 可从己方拥有的州获得的流亡人力上限的系数。接近该上限时收益递减。代码中按 100 的系数缩减。

1si4ba7.en: When this ratio of max manpower has been recruited we start applying the penalty.
1si4ba7.zh: 当已征召人力达到最大人力的这一比例时，开始施加惩罚。

1ex3qk8.en: Max penalty on exile manpower growth.
1ex3qk8.zh: 流亡人力增长的最大惩罚。

74n3bw.en: Legitimacy required to recruit exile airwings
74n3bw.zh: 招募流亡航空队所需的合法性

17nc0zh.zh: 流亡航空队的初始经验

3puskp.en: Legitimacy required to recruit exile troops
3puskp.zh: 招募流亡部队所需的合法性

1vg88co.en: Max XP exile troops can receive from training
1vg88co.zh: 流亡部队可通过训练获得的最大经验

o549at.en: Legitimacy levels where a new army leader is received.
o549at.zh: 获得新陆军将领的合法性等级。

ehvpu.en: days to transfer escaping divisions to host nation
ehvpu.zh: 将逃离的师移交给东道国所需的天数

7i8bkn.en: Escaping divisions gain a boost to experience. Only the toughest motherbadasses will band together and survive to git me one hundred Nazi scalps ... Or die tryin'...
7i8bkn.zh: 逃离的师会获得经验加成。只有最顽强的硬汉才会团结起来活下来，让我割下一百张纳粹头皮……或者死而后已……

1howub7.en: Attack bonus factor against whoever occupies your core territory.
1howub7.zh: 对占领你核心领土者的进攻加成系数。

750qr2.en: Attack bonus factor when fighting on cores.
750qr2.zh: 在核心领土上作战时的进攻加成系数。

1kfszcc.en: Defense bonus factor when fighting on cores.
1kfszcc.zh: 在核心领土上作战时的防御加成系数。

1tsbm00.en: Base equipment ratio on escaped troops.
1tsbm00.zh: 逃离部队的基础装备比例。

1v87tti.en: Ratio on amount of divisions that escapes. Scales with starting legitimacy
1v87tti.zh: 成功逃离的师数量比例。随初始合法性缩放

k5k9iv.en: An uncapitulated exile that is fully liberated will have legitimacy changed with this amount daily. Will be automatically reinstated when it reaches 0.
k5k9iv.zh: 未投降的流亡政府若被完全解放，其合法性将每天按该数值变化。当合法性降至 0 时将自动复国。

9vmdqj.en: Factor on exile manpower kept when a faction leader capitulates and the hosted exiles are transfered.
9vmdqj.zh: 当阵营领袖投降、受庇护的流亡政府被移交时，所保留流亡人力的系数。

loa9rh.en: Number of convoy a GiE will get on creation.
loa9rh.zh: 流亡政府成立时获得的运输船队数量。

81i9s2.en: each percent of collaboration will lower surrender limit by this percentage
81i9s2.zh: 每 1% 的合作度将按该百分比降低投降界限

ogfsjf.en: countries with collaboration will get bonus while game calculates which country the enemy will capitulate
ogfsjf.zh: 在游戏计算敌方向哪一国家投降时，拥有合作度的国家将获得加成

16kc5j0.en: each percent of collaboration will be converted to this compliance at capitulation
16kc5j0.zh: 每 1% 的合作度将在投降时转换为该数量的顺从度

vktvh1.en: taken focuses that has lead to war will still make ai prep for war for this many days after being taken
vktvh1.zh: 已导致战争的已点选焦点在被点选后仍会让 AI 按这么多天进行战争准备

jxsdek.en: the decision thats lead to war will sitll make ai prep for war for this many days after being taken/cooldown/timeout
jxsdek.zh: 已导致战争的决议在被点选/冷却/超时后仍会让 AI 按这么多天进行战争准备

1oi6039.en: number of armies that is used in training xp calculates daily lerps to actual number (if real number is lower)
1oi6039.zh: 训练经验计算中使用的军队数量每日向实际数量插值逼近（若实际数量更低）

1thmcs.en: number of armies that is used in training xp calculates daily linearly approaches this number (if real number is lower)
1thmcs.zh: 训练经验计算中使用的军队数量每日线性逼近该数值（若实际数量更低）

2y6ewb.en: initial resistance percentage of a state once it is captured
2y6ewb.zh: 州被占领后的初始抵抗度百分比

1l9kjxl.en: initial compliance percentage of a state once it is captured
1l9kjxl.zh: 州被占领后的初始顺从度百分比

185pnww.en: compliance factor that applies when the state controller changes (in between allies, compliance is zeroed if it is taken by original country)
185pnww.zh: 当州的控制者变更时适用的顺从度系数（在盟友之间转移时适用；若被原属国夺回，则顺从度归零）

1i4ha7p.en: resistance cooldown when the state is taken back by its original owner (compliance is zeroed in that case)
1i4ha7p.zh: 当州被其原属主夺回时的抵抗度冷却（此时顺从度归零）

52qvmm.zh: 基础抵抗度目标百分比

1qg1tgf.en: resistance target modifier in % for states we have claim
1qg1tgf.zh: 我们拥有宣称的州的抵抗度目标修正，单位为 %

vcrscr.en: resistance target modifier per stability below 100%
vcrscr.zh: 稳定度每低于 100% 时的抵抗度目标修正

16thwoj.zh: 每 1% 顺从度的抵抗度目标修正

150bl9f.en: resistance target modifier when we are at peace
150bl9f.zh: 处于和平状态时的抵抗度目标修正

ynjh1a.en: resistance target modifier pairs for vp. first entry is total vp in state and second entry is amount of target modifier that applies for that threshold 0 - 5 5 - 20 20 - 50 50 - ...
ynjh1a.zh: 胜利点的抵抗度目标修正数值对。第一项为州内胜利点总数，第二项为该阈值所适用的目标修正量 0 - 5 5 - 20 20 - 50 50 - ...

3f0mmj.en: resistance target modifier when the enemy is capitulated
3f0mmj.zh: 敌方已投降时的抵抗度目标修正

1k4iqp2.en: min & max resistance target modifier resistance target modifier for exile countries. interpolated using legitimacy
1k4iqp2.zh: 流亡国家抵抗度目标修正的最小值与最大值。使用合法性进行插值

2vh0mp.en: how much we reduce the resistance target
2vh0mp.zh: 我们将抵抗度目标降低多少

17nugw8.en: min resistance target will be capped to this percentage for non-compliance sources
17nugw8.zh: 对于非顺从度来源，最低抵抗度目标将被限制到该百分比

lm6iyv.en: resistance decay modifier for our claims
lm6iyv.zh: 我方宣称的抵抗度衰减修正

yawxa2.en: resistance decay modifier when resistance hits a certain percentage below 10% it has a -50% modifier on decay below 20% it has a -25% modifier on decay
yawxa2.zh: 抵抗度衰减修正：当抵抗度低于 10% 时衰减获得 -50% 修正，低于 20% 时衰减获得 -25% 修正

aay3f1.en: modifier that applies to losses from resistance attack to garrisons at most can be reduced to this amount
aay3f1.zh: 适用于抵抗度攻击对驻军造成的损失的修正，最多可降低到该数值

1hxs02x.zh: 和平时期的顺从度增长加成

1h5kalz.en: compliance growth buff if state has a claim
1h5kalz.zh: 州拥有宣称时的顺从度增长加成

10xda1r.en: as compliance increases, it gets a decay rate depending on its value. compliance should stabilize at some value until its growth changes
10xda1r.zh: 随着顺从度提高，其衰减速度取决于其数值。顺从度应在某个数值上稳定下来，直到其增长发生变化

nbmukq.en: higher legitimacy will give higher decay to compliance
nbmukq.zh: 合法性越高，顺从度的衰减越大

yc3jvt.en: resistance diff between two neighbour states will spread by this ratio ( from highest resistance states to lower ones and it will only spread once to a state)
yc3jvt.zh: 两个相邻州之间的抵抗度差值将按该比例扩散（从抵抗度最高的州向较低的州扩散，且每个州只会被扩散一次）

1iqolye.en: resistance will be disabled once it reaches zero and will not be reenabled until resistance target reaches above this value
1iqolye.zh: 抵抗度降至零后将被停用，直到抵抗度目标升到该数值以上才会重新启用

yyyq8f.en: at least this ratio of no garrison law should be active in order to no compliance gain to take effect
yyyq8f.zh: 至少要有该比例的无驻军法令处于生效状态，无顺从度增长才会生效

wywshw.en: Minimum base delivery speed if the chunk can't be calculated.
wywshw.zh: 无法计算该批次时的最低基础投送速度。

5btb9r.en: Modifier for garrison manpower reinforcement. This value is the maximum to be delivered which is then modified by distance
5btb9r.zh: 驻军人力补充的修正。该值为可投送的最大值，之后会按距离进行修正

gipb3a.en: Modifier for garrison equipment reinforcement speed
gipb3a.zh: 驻军装备补充速度的修正

1uc6g5f.en: Scales impact of manpower deficiency by raising that deficiency to the number here. Formula: efficiency = 1.0 - manpower_deficiency^GARRISON_STR_POW_MANPOWER
1uc6g5f.zh: 通过将人力缺额提升到该数值的幂来缩放人力缺额的影响。公式：efficiency = 1.0 - manpower_deficiency^GARRISON_STR_POW_MANPOWER

jpfl40.en: Scales impact of euqipment deficiency by raising that deficiency to the number here. Formula: efficiency = 1.0 - equipment_deficiency^GARRISON_STR_POW_EQUIPMENT
jpfl40.zh: 通过将装备缺额提升到该数值的幂来缩放装备缺额的影响。公式：efficiency = 1.0 - equipment_deficiency^GARRISON_STR_POW_EQUIPMENT

p7mn50.en: Number of suppression point we need for each 1% of resistance
p7mn50.zh: 每 1% 抵抗度所需的镇压点数

bil6vi.en: if resistance is lower than this value then we always act as though it is at the define for the purpose of suppresion requirements
bil6vi.zh: 若抵抗度低于该数值，则在计算镇压需求时始终视其处于该 define 值

16d1xdx.en: if resistance is greater than this value then we always act as though it is at the define for the purpose of suppresion requirements
16d1xdx.zh: 若抵抗度高于该数值，则在计算镇压需求时始终视其处于该 define 值

1furcjb.en: Ratio of manpower lost by garrison at each attack on garrison (this number will be reduced by the hardness of garrison template)
1furcjb.zh: 驻军每次遭袭时损失的人力比例（该数值会被驻军编制的硬度降低）

x20x8a.en: Ratio of equipment lost by garrison at each attack on garrison (this number will be reduced by the hardness of garrison template)
x20x8a.zh: 驻军每次遭袭时损失的装备比例（该数值会被驻军编制的硬度降低）

kfqw79.en: Cap to be sure that garrison will suffer lost in attack, even with a almost 100% hardness
kfqw79.zh: 用于确保驻军在遭袭时仍会遭受损失的上限，即使硬度接近 100%

159a4lm.en: The minimum number of Manpower that AI will accept to give at once, in order to avoid many weird little transfer.
159a4lm.zh: AI 一次性愿意提供的最少人力数量，以避免许多奇怪的小额转移。

1qsvqe2.en: To determine how much AI can give as foreign manpower, we calculate how much manpower we use, and add this buffer. The result is what we want to keep, for minor countries. So higher this number is, lower we will give Manpower.
1qsvqe2.zh: 为确定 AI 可以提供多少外国人力，我们计算自身使用的人力并加上该缓冲值。其结果是我们希望保留的人力，适用于小国。因此该数值越高，我们提供的人力越少。

1jx8oym.en: To determine how much AI can give as foreign manpower, we calculate how much manpower we use, and add this buffer. The result is what we want to keep, for major countries. So higher this number is, lower we will give Manpower.
1jx8oym.zh: 为确定 AI 可以提供多少外国人力，我们计算自身使用的人力并加上该缓冲值。其结果是我们希望保留的人力，适用于主要国家。因此该数值越高，我们提供的人力越少。

78o1lt.en: The part of the manpower needed by the foreign garrison, that AI will agree to support with our manpower. If negative number, AI will not take into consideration the need, and just calculate how much they can give.
78o1lt.zh: 外国驻军所需人力中，AI 同意用我们的人力支援的部分。若为负数，AI 将不考虑该需求，只计算自己能提供多少。

12ypf3s.en: Number of days after an AI give us manpower before the AI accept to give more.
12ypf3s.zh: AI 向我们提供人力后，需经过多少天 AI 才会同意提供更多。

16iwenm.en: resistance value for initial colony states
16iwenm.zh: 初始殖民地州的抵抗度数值

q78hns.en: compliance value for initial colony states
q78hns.zh: 初始殖民地州的顺从度数值

zxiuqa.en: garrison value for initial colony states
zxiuqa.zh: 初始殖民地州的驻军数值

13smvn4.en: daily compliance decay for the states you lost control of
13smvn4.zh: 失去控制的州的每日顺从度衰减

1d50pd.en: Max number of different strategic resources an equipment can be dependent on.
1d50pd.zh: 一种装备可以依赖的不同战略资源的最大数量。

mvue53.en: Max number of factories that can be assigned a single production line.
mvue53.zh: 可分配给单条生产线的工厂最大数量。

1npqjde.en: Railway gun strength repair speed per factory
1npqjde.zh: 每个工厂的列车炮兵力修复速度

1f4qch.en: Daily loss of efficiency for unused factory slots ( efficiency is tracked per factory slot in the production line )
1f4qch.zh: 未使用工厂槽位的每日效率损失（效率是按生产线中的每个工厂槽位追踪的）

5d3k6s.en: Switch to red progress bar if penalty is over threshold
5d3k6s.zh: 若惩罚超过阈值，进度条将切换为红色

14f7cuz.en: Base factory speed multiplier (how much hoi3 style IC each factory gives).
14f7cuz.zh: 基础工厂速度倍率（每个工厂提供多少 hoi3 式 IC）。

wbwbkb.en: Base start efficiency for factories expressed in %.
wbwbkb.zh: 工厂的基础初始效率，以 % 表示。

jj0bap.en: Base max efficiency for factories expressed in %.
jj0bap.zh: 工厂的基础最大效率，以 % 表示。

1mkr51y.en: Base factor for changing production variants in %.
1mkr51y.zh: 切换生产改型的基础系数，以 % 表示。

1xn5qek.en: Base factor for changing production parent<->children in %.
1xn5qek.zh: 切换生产父代<->子代的基础系数，以 % 表示。

940xhe.en: Base factor for changing production with same family in %.
940xhe.zh: 切换为同一系列生产的基础系数，以 % 表示。

1wiphep.en: Base factor for changing production with same archetype in %.
1wiphep.zh: 切换为同一原型生产的基础系数，以 % 表示。

mtcyf0.en: Nr of days between lend lease deliveries
mtcyf0.zh: 租借交付之间的间隔天数

jks7kv.en: How much stockpiled equipment will be transferred on annexation
jks7kv.zh: 吞并时将转移多少库存装备

1eti0lv.en: How much equipment from deployed divisions will be transferred on annexation
1eti0lv.zh: 吞并时将从已部署的师转移多少装备

19mil3d.en: How much fuel will be transferred on annexation
19mil3d.zh: 吞并时将转移多少燃料

8k6o64.en: How many convoys will be transferred on annexation
8k6o64.zh: 吞并时将转移多少运输船队

1hq6jgj.en: How many deployment lines minimum can be training
1hq6jgj.zh: 最少可有多少条部署线在进行训练

12a5wo1.en: Ratio which % of army in field can be trained
12a5wo1.zh: 在外陆军可接受训练的比例 %

1ua8bh.en: How much equipment from deployed divisions will be transferred on capitulation
1ua8bh.zh: 投降时将从已部署的师转移多少装备

jt6vav.en: How much fuel will be transferred on capitulation
jt6vav.zh: 投降时将转移多少燃料

17e98v5.en: Building in a state with higher infrastructure will reduce the cost of shared buildings.
17e98v5.zh: 在基础设施更高的州建造将降低共用建筑的花费。

i8ile.en: Penalty decrease while lack of resource per factory
i8ile.zh: 每个工厂缺乏资源时的惩罚降低量

10ek44b.en: The CIC bank can boost production speed with this factor (0.5 means 50 %)
10ek44b.zh: CIC 储备可按该系数提升生产速度（0.5 表示 50 %）

1k128wa.en: Min days for license to be active

crcq21.en: Base IC cost for lended license
crcq21.zh: 租借许可的基础 IC 花费

1iv4o7h.en: IC cost equipment for every year of equipment after 1936
1iv4o7h.zh: 装备年份在 1936 年之后每过一年装备的 IC 花费

1bidguv.en: base MIC speed modifier for licensed equipment
1bidguv.zh: 授权装备的基础 MIC 速度修正

1kc2k8v.en: MIC speed modifier for licensed equipment for each year of difference between actual and latest equipment
1kc2k8v.zh: 实际装备与最新装备每相差一年时，授权装备的 MIC 速度修正

1ufmwnh.en: Maximum years for MIC speed modifier
1ufmwnh.zh: MIC 速度修正适用的最大年数

a9mbk0.en: MIC speed modifier for licensed equipment for not being in faction
a9mbk0.zh: 不处于同一阵营时授权装备的 MIC 速度修正

10l7227.en: XP cost for upgrading licensed equipment
10l7227.zh: 升级授权装备的经验花费

9oxwbe.en: Penalty for producing non licensed equipment
9oxwbe.zh: 生产无授权装备的惩罚

7adbyb.en: Modifier to the production speed when converting equipment
7adbyb.zh: 改装装备时生产速度的修正

ijvnrh.en: XP cost for adding a new equipment module in an empty slot when creating an equipment variant.
ijvnrh.zh: 创建装备改型时，在空槽位中添加新装备模块的经验花费。

10wj0j2.en: XP cost for replacing one equipment module with an unrelated module when creating an equipment variant.
10wj0j2.zh: 创建装备改型时，用一个不相关模块替换某个装备模块的经验花费。

1j1sk12.en: XP cost for converting one equipment module to a related module when creating an equipment variant.
1j1sk12.zh: 创建装备改型时，将某个装备模块转换为相关模块的经验花费。

hb4swv.en: XP cost for removing an equipment module and leaving the slot empty when creating an equipment variant.
hb4swv.zh: 创建装备改型时，移除某个装备模块并让槽位空置的经验花费。

12x0wdg.en: Fraction of the hull industry cost which is always included in the refitting cost.
12x0wdg.zh: 始终计入改装花费的船体工业花费比例。

18zu7kp.en: Fraction of the chassis industry cost which is always included in the conversion cost.
18zu7kp.zh: 始终计入改装花费的底盘工业花费比例。

1iqrrrg.en: Minimum fraction of a naval equipment's strategic resource cost that any conversion will cost.
1iqrrrg.zh: 任何改装都至少需要花费的海军装备战略资源花费的最低比例。

igxq0d.en: Minimum fraction of a land equipment's strategic resource cost that any conversion will cost.
igxq0d.zh: 任何改装都至少需要花费的陆军装备战略资源花费的最低比例。

j933s9.en: Maximum refitting progress % that we still allow to cancel wihtout having to scuttle the ship.
j933s9.zh: 在无需自沉舰船的情况下仍允许取消改装的最大改装进度 %。

1xvb03l.en: When a ship is being damaged (for example port strike) while refitting, the damage is transferred to the production line progress instead. This variable is used to balance it.
1xvb03l.zh: 当舰船在改装期间受损（例如港口打击）时，伤害会转而计入生产线进度。该变量用于平衡这一效果。

b0ywbb.en: The minimum number of factories we have to put on consumer goods, by value.
b0ywbb.zh: 我们必须投入消费品生产的工厂数量下限，按数值计。

55fe3h.en: The minimum number of factories we have to put on consumer goods, in percent.
55fe3h.zh: 我们必须投入消费品生产的工厂数量下限，按百分比计。

5ipbtl.en: max % of factories allowed on autorepairs
5ipbtl.zh: 允许用于自动修复的工厂最大百分比

17e4op9.en: Number of days between purchase contract deliveries
17e4op9.zh: 采购合同交付之间的间隔天数

1ixcftv.en: The factor for mapping IC cost to CIC cost. Should be a positive number.
1ixcftv.zh: 用于将 IC 花费映射为 CIC 花费的系数。应为正数。

14mvhei.en: Max number of factories that can be assigned for paying single contract.
14mvhei.zh: 可用于支付单份合同的工厂最大数量。

ljamqc.en: The factor of base equipment price for low price level. Should be in range (0,1]
ljamqc.zh: 低价位等级的装备基础价格系数。应处于 (0,1] 区间内

6a30qb.en: The factor of base equipment price for high price level. Should be more than 1.
6a30qb.zh: 高价位等级的装备基础价格系数。应大于 1。

1ob602w.en: The delivery percentage under we want to let player know the contract is inefficient. [0,1]
1ob602w.zh: 低于该交付百分比时，我们希望让玩家知道该合同效率低下。[0,1]

lieum1.en: The factor of speed bonus from subsidies
lieum1.zh: 补贴带来的速度加成系数

9lk15n.en: Overrides the default lend leas weight of convoys for international market
9lk15n.zh: 覆盖国际市场中运输船队的默认租借权重

xzl1gr.en: Whether by default should accept market access requests from other countries.
xzl1gr.zh: 默认是否应接受其他国家的市场准入请求。

sbcbri.en: Whether by default should send market access requests to other countries.
sbcbri.zh: 默认是否应向其他国家发送市场准入请求。

f6shqm.en: Whether by default should accept purchase requests from other countries.
f6shqm.zh: 默认是否应接受其他国家的采购请求。

1oh25yz.en: How strong effect should have the daily convoy count on the average (1.0 means it will use only the new number as average)
1oh25yz.zh: 每日运输船队数量对平均值的影响强度（1.0 表示只使用新数值作为平均值）

88ggrt.en: How strong effect should have the daily production on the average (1.0 means it will use only the new number as average)
88ggrt.zh: 每日产量对平均值的影响强度（1.0 表示只使用新数值作为平均值）

1tz5y81.en: If the difference between current and estimated available convoy count is smaller then this value, we will use the current value for calculations.
1tz5y81.zh: 若当前可用运输船队数量与估算值之差小于该数值，我们将使用当前值进行计算。

717qfp.en: If the difference between current and estimated daily production is smaller then this value, we will use the current value for calculations.
717qfp.zh: 若当前每日产量与估算值之差小于该数值，我们将使用当前值进行计算。

14li4uu.en: How strong effect should have the daily sunk efficiency on the average (1.0 means it will use only the new number as average)
14li4uu.zh: 每日被击沉效率对平均值的影响强度（1.0 表示只使用新数值作为平均值）

1vixi70.en: If the difference between current and estimated sunk efficiency convoy count is smaller then this value, we will use the current value for calculations.
1vixi70.zh: 若当前被击沉效率对应的运输船队数量与估算值之差小于该数值，我们将使用当前值进行计算。

7i9xgo.en: The contracts will show sunk convoy message if there was sunk convoy in this amount of days
7i9xgo.zh: 若在这么多天内出现运输船队被击沉，合同将显示运输船队被击沉消息

13i9x02.en: Max number of sub technologies a technology can have.
13i9x02.zh: 一项科技可以拥有的子科技最大数量。

4oafqy.en: Base amount of research points a country can save per slot.
4oafqy.zh: 每个科研槽国家可保存的基础科研点数。

l3srs2.en: Base cost for a tech. multiplied with tech cost and ahead of time penalties
l3srs2.zh: 一项科技的基础花费。会乘以科技花费与超前研究惩罚

ft6nj9.en: Max technology sharing bonus that can be applied instantly
ft6nj9.zh: 可立即应用的最大科技共享加成

hl1s3r.en: default xp cost of a research to unlock directly
hl1s3r.zh: 直接解锁一项科研的默认经验花费

153r7eh.en: default xp cost of a research to speed up the process
153r7eh.zh: 加速科研进程的默认经验花费

1thutoc.en: default boost research bonus gained when xp is used to research an item
1thutoc.zh: 使用经验研究某个项目时获得的默认研究加成

ejjzwq.en: research speed can't go below this value
ejjzwq.zh: 科研速度不能低于该数值

18kngp2.en: Number of days the player has to regret using a limited tech bonus
18kngp2.zh: 玩家在使用了有限科技加成后可以反悔的天数

j947sh.en: Maximum amount random leader to have per party.
j947sh.zh: 每个政党可拥有的随机领导人最大数量。

1vjt759.en: command power cost for recruiting new leaders, 'this value' * number_of_existing_leaders_of_type
1vjt759.zh: 招募新将领的指挥点数花费，即「该数值」 * number_of_existing_leaders_of_type

1dq57t1.en: Amount of XP a trait needs to be shown in tooltips of a leader.
1dq57t1.zh: 特质需要在将领提示框中显示所需的经验值。

s2p3i6.en: Revolter party loses 80% popularity when the civil war breaks out
s2p3i6.zh: 内战爆发时叛军政党失去 80% 支持率

1ouhi3z.en: Min possible support for new government after puppeting the government
1ouhi3z.zh: 傀儡化政府后新政府可获得的最低支持率

12fio4a.en: Min party popularity for instant win in one province state
12fio4a.zh: 在单省份州中立即获胜所需的最低政党支持率

6g4dwn.en: How much air superiority reduction to the enemy does our AA guns? Normally each building level = -1 reduction. With this multiplier.
6g4dwn.zh: 我方防空炮能降低敌方多少制空权？通常每级建筑 = -1 削减。乘以该系数。

1etw5va.en: How much air superiority each SAM mission gives per rocket wing performing SAM missions.
1etw5va.zh: 每支执行 SAM 任务的火箭航空队提供多少制空权。

1jxp3iv.en: Max levels a building can have.
1jxp3iv.zh: 建筑可拥有的最大等级。

1fs08lv.en: Each level of airbase building multiplied by this, gives capacity (max operational value). Value is int. 1 for each airplane.
1fs08lv.zh: 空军基地每级乘以该值即为容量（最大运作值）。值为整数，每架飞机为 1。

wudu2l.en: Each level of rocketsite building multiplied by this, gives capacity (max operational value). Value is int. 1 for each rocket.
wudu2l.zh: 火箭基地每级乘以该值即为容量（最大运作值）。值为整数，每枚火箭为 1。

1n28dzl.en: Each level of navalbase building repairs X strength and can repair as many ships as its level
1n28dzl.zh: 海军基地每级可修复 X 兵力，可修复的舰船数量等于其等级。

kez1g5.en: Radar range base, first level radar will be this + min, best radar will be this + max
kez1g5.zh: 雷达范围基准值：1 级雷达为该值 + 最小值，最高级雷达为该值 + 最大值。

1wpr0vj.en: Radar range (from state center to province center) in measure of map pixels. Exluding techs.
1wpr0vj.zh: 雷达范围（从州中心到省份中心），以地图像素为单位。不含科技加成。

5wbjh2.en: Range is interpolated between building levels 1-15.
5wbjh2.zh: 范围在建筑 1-15 级之间按插值计算。

1fy1azt.en: Province covered by radar increases intel by 10 (where 255 is max). Province may be covered by multiple radars, then the value sums up.
1fy1azt.zh: 被雷达覆盖的省份情报 +10（最大值为 255）。省份可被多部雷达覆盖，此时数值累加。

j8txy7.en: How much damage takes a factory building in sabotage when state is occupied. Damage is mult by (1 + resistance strength), i.e. up to 2 x base value.
j8txy7.zh: 州被占领时，工厂建筑在破坏活动中受到的伤害。伤害乘以 (1 + 抵抗度强度)，即最高为基础值的 2 倍。

o7bg0a.en: Default repair rate in percentage before factories are taken into account (1.0 equals 1%).
o7bg0a.zh: 未计入工厂加成前的默认修复速率（百分比，1.0 等于 1%）。

z11gok.zh: 修复时的工厂速度修正。

pq8wgb.en: supply throughput per level of naval base
pq8wgb.zh: 海军基地每级的补给吞吐量。

1p0fuug.zh: 工厂共享的最大槽位数。

x9kpln.en: Scale factor of extra shared slots when state owner change.
x9kpln.zh: 州所有权变更时额外共享槽位的缩放系数。

1w8yi6a.en: Number of days cooldown between removal of buildings in war times
1w8yi6a.zh: 战时拆除建筑之间的冷却天数。

11j1ow5.en: multiplicative resource bonus for each level of (non damaged) infrastructure
11j1ow5.zh: 每级（未受损）基础设施提供的乘算资源加成。

19avidv.en: multiplicative resource bonus for having a railway/naval connection to the capital
19avidv.zh: 与首都保持铁路/海运连接时提供的乘算资源加成。

16qqk7x.en: multiplicative effect on mud growth for max infra
16qqk7x.zh: 满级基础设施对泥泞增长的乘算影响。

1hra7kx.en: Base training done each day during deployment.
1hra7kx.zh: 部署期间每天完成的基础训练。

xovg4o.en: Multiplier on TotalOrganisation when determining the combat value of a division
xovg4o.zh: 判定师战斗价值时对总组织度的乘数。

1b63u9r.en: Multiplier on TotalStrength when determining the combat value of a division
1b63u9r.zh: 判定师战斗价值时对总兵力的乘数。

1f9waxa.en: How much we care about potential soft attacks when evaluating priority combat target
1f9waxa.zh: 评估优先打击目标时对潜在软攻的重视程度。

1dhil91.en: How much we care about potential hard attacks when evaluating priority combat target
1dhil91.zh: 评估优先打击目标时对潜在硬攻的重视程度。

b0nou7.zh: 伤亡造成的战争支持度惩罚的除数。

7jtw6v.en: Our piercing / their armor must be this value to deal damage fraction equal to the index in the array below [higher number = higher penetration]. If armor is 0, 1.00 will be returned. there isn't much point setting this higher than 0
7jtw6v.zh: 我方穿甲 / 敌方装甲需达到该数值，才能造成与下方数组索引相等的伤害比例[数值越高 = 穿透越强]。若装甲为 0，则返回 1.00。将其设为大于 0 没有太大意义。

s47h6e.en: 0 armor will always receive maximum damage (so add overmatching at your own peril). the system expects at least 2 values, with no upper limit.
s47h6e.zh: 装甲为 0 时始终受到最大伤害（因此加入过度穿透后果自负）。系统至少需要 2 个数值，没有上限。

736xe2.en: Get a trait if any valid options & xp gained >= this
736xe2.zh: 若存在可用选项且获得经验 >= 该值，则获得一个特质。

1i7yg1i.en: Number of days that a unit must have been on a particular active order instance to receive a history entry.
1i7yg1i.zh: 单位必须在某个生效的命令实例上停留的天数，才能获得一条历史记录。

1j8ko82.en: Max officers to show in field officers list, sorted by field EXP. Divisions with awardable entries will potentially supercede this limit
1j8ko82.zh: 野战军官列表中显示的最大军官数，按野战经验排序。拥有可授勋记录的单位可能突破该上限。

1w327l3.en: Chance to receive a female divisonal commander. This is set to zero in the base game, as we do not have generic female portraits for many graphical culture groups. This expects a value between 0 and 1 and is added to by female_divisional_commander_chance. If you don't have female generic portraits defined, you -will- get silhouettes.
1w327l3.zh: 获得女性师级指挥官的几率。原版游戏将其设为 0，因为许多美术文化组没有通用的女性立绘。该值应在 0 到 1 之间，并由 female_divisional_commander_chance 追加。若未定义通用女性立绘，你——会——得到剪影。

gqnvy4.en: XP thresholds for divisional commander ranks. [TAG]_DIVISION_EXPERIENCE_TITLE_ARMY_EXPERIENCE_[array index]
gqnvy4.zh: 师级指挥官军衔的经验阈值。[TAG]_DIVISION_EXPERIENCE_TITLE_ARMY_EXPERIENCE_[数组索引]

jwoe98.en: whether to apply org_loss_when_moving modifiers additively or multiplicatively (hardcoded multiplicative pre-2021)
jwoe98.zh: org_loss_when_moving 修正以加法还是乘法方式应用（2021 年前硬编码为乘法）。

15flb74.en: how much org is lost every hour while moving an army.
15flb74.zh: 集团军移动时每小时损失的组织度。

1ypm1ih.zh: 组织度为 0 时的速度影响。

3zd12y.en: scale factor of infra on org regain.
3zd12y.zh: 基础设施对组织度恢复的缩放系数。

fvqfbe.en: how much enemy combat width we are allowed to engage per width of our own
fvqfbe.zh: 我方每点战斗宽度可交战多少敌方战斗宽度。

1pytt9w.en: speed penalty per infrastucture below maximum.
1pytt9w.zh: 基础设施每低于满级一级的速度惩罚。

1hkvp99.en: Minimum VPs required to receive an entry in divisional history
1hkvp99.zh: 在师历史中获得一条记录所需的最低胜利点。

1u3f8c5.en: VPs required for high-level history entry
1u3f8c5.zh: 获得高级历史记录所需的胜利点。

1qu91bs.en: Max number of history entries to check back to see if we're being awarded the same entry
1qu91bs.zh: 回溯检查是否被授予相同记录的最大历史记录数。

1gbgky8.en: Additional cost factor per active medal
1gbgky8.zh: 每枚生效勋章带来的额外花费系数。

t809ky.en: If we do the same type of thing consecutively, each entry will stack locations up to this number
t809ky.zh: 若连续做同类事情，每条记录最多累积的地点数量。

10m2c19.en: Should we generate history entries for the AI (may cause savegame bloat)
10m2c19.zh: 是否为 AI 生成历史记录（可能导致存档膨胀）。

v4uv3v.en: Multiply field experience gained by this, when applying to divisional commander
v4uv3v.zh: 将获得的野战经验应用于师级指挥官时乘以该值。

bpt75h.en: Max experience that can be gained on divisional commanders
bpt75h.zh: 师级指挥官可获得的经验上限。

hhxhil.en: Multiply officer field experience gain by this * number of division medals on application
hhxhil.zh: 应用时，军官野战经验获取乘以该值 × 师勋章数量。

12smlhz.en: max random int to roll when determining whether to grant an awardable entry for operations. 1/N chances.
12smlhz.zh: 判定是否为作战行动授予可授勋记录时掷出的最大随机整数。几率为 1/N。

15c5ylm.en: number of received casualties to receive a history entry (one only)
15c5ylm.zh: 获得一条历史记录所需的伤亡人数（仅一条）。

7o90sp.en: Amount of division experience lost when promoting a commander (reduced by modifiers)
7o90sp.zh: 晋升指挥官时损失的师经验量（受修正降低）。

urk2pp.en: Play as British Raj. Take the focuses for Mughal rebellion. If done right, it's possible to seize the entirety of the Raj during the civil war. Use focuses to attack and annex Afghanistan, Sinkiang, Iran, and Iraq, in this order. The biggest difficulty is that you only have until late 1940 to get Iraq: any later, and it gets puppeted by the UK. (You can still get the achievement by capitulating British Iraq, but then you'll be stuck in a war against the Allies.) Difficulty: Medium as British Raj, hard to very hard as other three possible countries.
urk2pp.zh: 扮演英属印度。选取与莫卧儿叛乱相关的焦点。若操作得当，可以在内战期间夺取整个英属印度。按此顺序使用焦点进攻并吞并阿富汗、新疆、伊朗与伊拉克。最大的难点在于你必须在 1940 年末之前拿下伊拉克：再晚，它就会被英国变为傀儡国。（你仍可通过使英属伊拉克投降来获得成就，但那样你会陷入与同盟国的战争。）难度：以英属印度游玩为中等，其余三个可选国家为难到极难。

1yjqn6w.en: Beeline for the ⟦0⟧ focus (note that you'll need to immediately use the Pay Small Dividends decision after Incorporation to unlock the ⟦1⟧ focus). Hostile takeover will unlock decisions to buy them from ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. Rush every focus that adds civilian factories while building more; you should have enough factories to buy both before 1938 ends. 1bc1370.en: Note: The Mughal Empire cosmetic tag can only be gained by completing Unite the Subcontinent national focus before completing Expand the Silk Road. This achievement can be combined with I shall either find a way or make one. An easy way to do it is to simply guarantee the independence of Greece and/or Yugoslavia, so that you will find yourself in a defensive war against the Axis on the same side as the Allies. The UK will let you join the allies and you can easily become the spymaster once you are in. For detailed strategies, see Media Mughal

1tngnci.en: Easiest as the East India Company. Here is how to get a state in all continents: Using Just Good Business, you can get Dutch New Guinea (669) (Australia), Curaçao (695) (South America) and any state in the Netherlands (Europe), via a naval invasion from Britain to the Netherlands, using the British navy. Then you can purchase Bermuda (696) (North America), French Somaliland (268) or Madagascar (543) (Africa), and Alexandretta (799) (Middle East). Alternatively, you can purchase Suez (446) and Panamá Canal (685) for the Middle East and South America requirements, if you want to also get the It's Just Good Business achievement.
1tngnci.zh: 以东印度公司游玩最简单。以下是在各大洲都获得一个州的方法：利用「只是生意（Just Good Business）」，你可以通过使用英国海军从英国对荷兰发动海军登陆，获得荷属新几内亚 (669)（澳大利亚）、库拉索 (695)（南美洲）以及荷兰境内的任意州（欧洲）。然后你可以购买百慕大 (696)（北美洲）、法属索马里兰 (268) 或马达加斯加 (543)（非洲），以及亚历山德里塔 (799)（中东）。或者，如果你也想获得「这只是生意（It's Just Good Business）」成就，可以购买苏伊士 (446) 与巴拿马运河 (685) 来满足中东与南美洲的要求。

tnhn92.en: Can be easily accomplished on historical mode, as long as Sinkiang doesn't become a Soviet puppet. Note that this achievement requires ⟦0⟧ of your cores instead of just occupation; Although this could potentially mean a total war with the allies, the PRC actually has a focus to just request these treaty ports from their occupiers. If you use the tree to switch to Democratic and don't cause much world tension by justifying on anything, it seems that they'll give them up easily to you.

7puu2f.en: Very easily obtained by taking the historical Mao path with historical focuses on. Just take as many advisors that give you PP as possible. You need to make sure China does well enough to not die to Japan though - Japanese occupation prevents you from infiltrating states/will reset your infiltration progress. Don't bother infiltrating Warlord states, as both the warlord and China have decisions to remove your infiltration, meaning it gets removed much faster than just infiltrating China's states. You don't even have to actually win against Japan, if you progress far enough down the tree you'll be able to leave the United front and make your own faction, letting you declare war and get the achievement earlier.
7puu2f.zh: 开启历史焦点并走历史上的毛泽东路线即可轻松获得。尽量多选能提供政治点数的顾问。不过你必须确保中国表现足够好，不至于被日本打垮——日本占领会阻止你渗透各州，并会重置你的渗透进度。不必费力渗透军阀的州，因为军阀和中国都有移除你渗透的决议，这意味着它被移除的速度远快于只渗透中国的州。你甚至不必真正战胜日本：只要在国策树上推进得足够远，你就能退出统一战线并建立自己的阵营，从而提前宣战并拿到成就。

18s2lgh.en: Most easily done with historical focuses turned off; Japan can potentially go Hokushin-ron, which leads to them making a non-aggression pact with you and attacking the USSR instead. Can be combined with "It's all coming together" and "A Fullmetal Brotherhood" if played safely. Keep in mind that it's just China's starting coastal states & not all their cores, so you can afford to lose coastal states that you conquer later (be careful with Qingdao though, it's a one province state so it can easily be lost by mistake).
18s2lgh.zh: 关闭历史焦点时最容易完成；日本有可能走北进论，从而与你签订互不侵犯条约，转而进攻苏联。若稳妥游玩，可与「一切正在成形」和「钢铁兄弟会」一同完成。请记住，这里只涉及中国的初始沿海州，而非其全部核心州，因此你可以承受失去后来征服的沿海州（不过要小心青岛，它是只有一个省份的州，很容易因失误而丢失）。

f38lkr.en: As with all capitulation achievements, you need to be careful; Even if you've occupied most of a country's territory, they can capitulate to another country if that country has a greater war contribution score. The Germans will not begin Operation Barbarossa so long as France hasn't capitulated, so France's survival is your best bet to ensure Soviet neutrality. Germany's main strength lies in their air force, so build plenty of high-quality fighters and equip divisions with anti-air guns. You can't get this achievement if Germany isn't fascist anymore, so don't try it on ahistorical.
f38lkr.zh: 与所有需要使对方投降的成就一样，你需要小心：即使你已占领某国的大部分领土，只要另一国的战争贡献更高，它也可能向那一国投降。只要法国没有投降，德国就不会发动巴巴罗萨行动，因此让法国存活是你确保苏联中立的最佳办法。德国的主要优势在于空军，因此要建造大量高质量战斗机，并为各师配备防空炮。如果德国不再是法西斯主义，你就无法获得本成就，所以不要在非历史模式下尝试。

16sdtx1.en: You need to go down the "Election Overturned" Hispanic road. After that, complete the rest of the Hispanic focuses and take decisions with Hispanic countries with the ⟦0⟧ focus. I recommend improving relations and using a diplomatic pressure agent. After completing the "War of Independence", you need to hold the USA for a year to get the white peace event. Then, take the "Reino de Filipinas" focus and unify with the faction member countries, in that specific case, with Spain. Because of the civil war, you need to core half of Spain manually when you reach the necessary compliance level.

Since all events in the chain have a MTTH, it can take a while after taking the assassination focus before you get your achievement.

1f77ncj.en: It's not difficult to do this in a regular historical game by just beating Russia with the Axis after pushing out Japan. However, it can be made incredibly easy in non-historical: if Russia does any of their alt history paths but especially if they go Tsarist, then Mongolia gets spit out of their faction and is easily conquered.

f3flzc.en: The cosmetic tag can only be gained via the "The Fall of the Republic" event chain while being democratic. The event chain starts once Germany gains the Sudetenland via their Demand Sudetenland focus, after Czechoslovakia has been betrayed by their allies. 6 days after the initial event the second event will trigger and immediately change your name. If you select the "We need radical change" option in that event your name will also change to "Czecho-Slovak Republic", which is redundant due to the immediate effect of the event. Furthermore, 14 days after the second event a third event will demand you release Slovakia as a puppet. Releasing Slovakia will again also change your name (which is also redundant). You don't actually have to release Slovakia to gain this achievement, but it could prove useful to use them as a buffer state by not calling them into the war. For detailed strategies, see I didn't hear no bell
f3flzc.zh: 该外观标签只能在民主主义状态下通过「共和国覆灭」事件链获得。当德国通过「索取苏台德」焦点获得苏台德、且捷克斯洛伐克被其盟友背叛后，事件链就会启动。初始事件发生 6 天后，第二个事件会触发并立即更改你的国名。如果你在该事件中选择「我们需要彻底的变革」选项，你的国名也会变为「捷克-斯洛伐克共和国」，但由于该事件的即时效果，这一步是多余的。此外，第二个事件发生 14 天后，第三个事件会要求你释放斯洛伐克作为傀儡国。释放斯洛伐克同样会更改你的国名（这也是多余的）。要获得本成就，你实际上不必释放斯洛伐克，但把它留作缓冲国、不将其召入战争可能会很有用。详细策略参见我没听到铃声（I didn't hear no bell）

123x61.en: Premyslid's DreamAs monarchist Czechoslovakia, integrate both Austria and former Bohemian lands.
123x61.zh: 普热米斯尔之梦（Premyslid's Dream） 扮演君主制捷克斯洛伐克，整合奥地利与前波希米亚领地。

xwzb0f.en: Has completed The Legacy of Ottokar Has completed Proclaim Restoration of the Bohemian Kingdom
xwzb0f.zh: 已完成「奥托卡尔的遗产」 已完成「宣告波希米亚王国复辟」

16n94o6.en: Proclaim Restoration of the Bohemian Kingdom
16n94o6.zh: 宣告波希米亚王国复辟

14mk1gs.en: ⟦0⟧ requires you to conquer Austria, while the Bohemian Kingdom requires you to own Silesia. Rush down the monarchist path. Going ahistorical makes this achievement easier. If you complete Fight for Silesia you get the option for a limit war with Germany after conquering Upper Silesia.
14mk1gs.zh: ⟦0⟧要求你征服奥地利，而波希米亚王国则要求你拥有西里西亚。尽快走完君主制路线。走非历史路线会让本成就更容易。如果你完成「争夺西里西亚」，就能在上西里西亚被征服后获得对德国发动有限战争的选择。

yi7x5b.en: KuťáciAs Czechoslovakia, build every facility type.
yi7x5b.zh: 库塔奇（Kuťáci） 扮演捷克斯洛伐克，建造每一种设施类型。

bcuhvm.en: Owns at least 1 of each facility type
bcuhvm.zh: 拥有每种设施类型各至少 1 个

29ggea.en: You don't actually have to build the facilities yourself. A coastal province must be acquired to build the naval facility.
29ggea.zh: 你实际上不必亲自建造这些设施。要建造海军设施，必须获得一个沿海省份。

f5ktm4.en: First train homeAs Czechoslovakia, own any state of the Trans-Siberian Railway.
f5ktm4.zh: 首班列车回家（First train home） 扮演捷克斯洛伐克，拥有西伯利亚大铁路的任意一个州。

1ewmy0n.en: Owns and controls one of: Moscow (219) Ivanovo (253) Gorky (252) Chuvashia (256) Kazan (249) Udmurtia (399) Perm (398) Zlatoust (573) Sverdlovsk (653) Chelyabinsk (572) Tyumen (403) Omsk (571) Novosibirsk (570) Khakassia (569) Krasnoyarsk (568) Bratsk (567) Irkutsk (566) Chita (563) Amur (561) Birobidzhan (657) Khabarovsk (409) Vladivostok (408)
1ewmy0n.zh: 拥有并控制以下之一：莫斯科 (219) 伊万诺沃 (253) 高尔基 (252) 楚瓦什 (256) 喀山 (249) 乌德穆尔特 (399) 彼尔姆 (398) 兹拉托乌斯特 (573) 斯维尔德洛夫斯克 (653) 车里雅宾斯克 (572) 秋明 (403) 鄂木斯克 (571) 新西伯利亚 (570) 哈卡斯 (569) 克拉斯诺亚尔斯克 (568) 布拉茨克 (567) 伊尔库茨克 (566) 赤塔 (563) 阿穆尔 (561) 比罗比詹 (657) 哈巴罗夫斯克 (409) 符拉迪沃斯托克 (408)

2znqvx.en: An ahistorical Soviet Union is typically much weaker. With some luck, you can even annex a state in a peace deal after joining the 2nd Russian Civil War via Intervene in the Soviet Civil War
2znqvx.zh: 非历史模式下的苏联通常要弱得多。运气好的话，你甚至可以通过「干预苏联内战」加入第 2 次俄罗斯内战后，在和平会议中吞并一个州。

1kwpwya.en: Intervene in the Soviet Civil War

1t7ekc0.en: Ain't like that nowAs fascist Czechoslovakia, complete "Return to Democracy".
1t7ekc0.zh: 今非昔比（Ain't like that now） 扮演法西斯捷克斯洛伐克，完成「回归民主」。

jzwetj.en: For detailed strategies, see Ain't like that now
jzwetj.zh: 详细策略参见今非昔比（Ain't like that now）

ypm2q5.en: Czechoslovaustrohungarian UnionAs communist Czechoslovakia, complete "Expand the Union" and have Austria and Hungary in that union.
ypm2q5.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克-奥地利-匈牙利联盟（Czechoslovaustrohungarian Union） 扮演共产主义捷克斯洛伐克，完成「扩张联盟」，并让奥地利与匈牙利加入该联盟。

1nmwrtd.en: Has completed focus Expand the Union Hungary is a subject of Czechoslovakia and has the "Integration efforts" national spirit Austria is a subject of Czechoslovakia and has the "Integration efforts" national spirit
1nmwrtd.zh: 已完成焦点「扩张联盟」 匈牙利是捷克斯洛伐克的附属国，并拥有「一体化努力」国家精神 奥地利是捷克斯洛伐克的附属国，并拥有「一体化努力」国家精神

18z2e68.en: ⟦0⟧ is a subject of ⟦1⟧ and has the "Integration efforts" national spirit
18z2e68.zh: ⟦0⟧是⟦1⟧的附属国，并拥有「一体化努力」国家精神

1bhohvs.en: If ⟦0⟧/ ⟦1⟧ refuse to become your puppet, simply attack and puppet manually. The national spirit can be given to them via decision once they are your subject.
1bhohvs.zh: 如果⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧拒绝成为你的傀儡国，就直接进攻并手动将其变为傀儡国。一旦它们成为你的附属国，就可以通过决议给予它们该国家精神。

k8tb1m.zh: X 周年更新（X Anniversary Update）

1t3axij.en: SteinerAs Germany, get over 30% surrender progress after 1941.6.22 while being at war with Soviet Union, France and England and controlling Moscow, Paris and London
1t3axij.zh: 施泰纳（Steiner） 扮演德国，在 1941.6.22 之后、与苏联、法国和英国交战且控制莫斯科、巴黎与伦敦的情况下，使投降进度超过 30%

1powter.en: Has had more than 30% surrender progress while after 1941.06.22 Has not capitulated Is at war with Soviet Union, France and United Kingdom Controls Ile de France (16), Greater London Area (126), and Moscow (219)
1powter.zh: 在 1941.06.22 之后曾出现投降进度超过 30% 未投降 与苏联、法国和英国交战 控制法兰西岛 (16)、大伦敦地区 (126) 与莫斯科 (219)

1j3mbcp.en: Has had more than 30% surrender progress while after 1941.06.22
1j3mbcp.zh: 在 1941.06.22 之后曾出现投降进度超过 30%

1kefsk3.en: Win the war without peacing out. Wait till after 1941.06.22. Declare war on Switzerland and let them occupy you to 31%. You only need to have had more than 30% surrender progress after 1941.06.22 once, and not necessarily when at war with the required countries.
1kefsk3.zh: 在不单独媾和的情况下赢得战争。等到 1941.06.22 之后。对瑞士宣战，让他们占领你到 31%。你只需要在 1941.06.22 之后曾有过超过 30% 的投降进度一次即可，而且不必是在与所需国家交战时。

v32e81.en: Et tu, Paulus?Capture a field Marshal.
v32e81.zh: 你也有份吗，保卢斯？（Et tu, Paulus?） 俘获一名元帅。

1mmlkco.en: Has captured an enemy field marshal

1m095wm.en: On historical, Finland deploys their general Aksel Airo in mid '37. The Finnish AI is highly inclined to promote him to field marshal, but once they do this they will un-deploy him as an HQ and deploy someone else. However, if you justify on them as the Soviets at game start and just encircle him immediately, the HQ will be unable to disband. From here, you just have to keep him encircled & make sure the HQ doesn't kill itself before ~1938 - at around this time, Finland should promote Airo despite being encircled, and then you can capture him. There's no way to tell whether he has been promoted or not, but waiting until around mid 1938 will make it more consistent. On historical, Switzerland also at one point deploys their field marshal and will leave him in the field at least till 1945.
1m095wm.zh: 在历史模式下，芬兰会在 37 年中期部署其将领阿克塞尔·艾罗。芬兰 AI 很倾向于将他晋升为元帅，但一旦晋升，他们就会把他作为司令部撤编并部署其他人。不过，如果你在开局时以苏联身份对其制造战争目标并立即将他包围，该司令部就无法解散。此后，你只需保持包围，并确保该司令部在 1938 年前后不会自我消亡——大约在这时，芬兰应该会在被包围的情况下仍晋升艾罗，然后你就能俘获他。没有办法判断他是否已被晋升，但等到 1938 年中期左右会更稳定。在历史模式下，瑞士也会在某一时点部署其元帅，并至少会把他留在战场上直到 1945 年。

1wws1u3.en: Hunt for the Desert FoxCapture Erwin Rommel.
1wws1u3.zh: 猎杀沙漠之狐（Hunt for the Desert Fox） 俘获埃尔温·隆美尔。

8mroam.en: Best done as ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧, as being the single focus of Germany's attention in an early war makes Rommel easier to locate. Another viable strategy is to play as the Soviet Union on historical, immediately justify on Poland then Germany and rush them down.
8mroam.zh: 最好以⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧游玩，因为在早期战争中成为德国唯一的关注目标会让隆美尔更容易被找到。另一个可行的策略是在历史模式下扮演苏联，立即对波兰制造战争目标，接着对德国制造战争目标并迅速击溃他们。

73ut85.en: The 7th StateAs Australia, own and fully control New Zealand.
73ut85.zh: 第七个州（The 7th State） 扮演澳大利亚，拥有并完全控制新西兰。

1b57use.en: Follow the Democratic path and let Labour win elections 3 times. Then take the focus "Reclaim the Lost Territory". This requires the DLC.
1b57use.zh: 走民主主义路线，让工党赢得 3 次选举。然后选取「收复失地」焦点。这需要相应的 DLC。

13enc2f.en: The rightside upAs Australia, own and fully control Jan Mayen.
13enc2f.zh: 正面朝上（The rightside up） 扮演澳大利亚，拥有并完全控制扬马延。

o8l9pf.en: Follow the Fascist path with P.R. Stephensen and join the Axis via "Nauru's Return to German Hands". The focus also makes you independent. Then justify and declare on Norway with Germany's help before WT goes above 25%. If done right it will not have any guarantees and won't join any faction. Take Jan Mayen in the peace deal.
o8l9pf.zh: 随 P.R. 斯蒂芬森走法西斯路线，并通过「瑙鲁回归德国」加入轴心国。该焦点还会让你独立。然后在世界紧张度超过 25% 之前，借助德国的帮助制造战争目标并对挪威宣战。如果操作正确，挪威不会有任何保障独立，也不会加入任何阵营。在和平会议中夺取扬马延。

ccf4vv.en: A succulent Chinese MealAs Australia annex and own one province in China.
ccf4vv.zh: 美味中餐（A succulent Chinese Meal） 扮演澳大利亚，吞并并拥有中国的一个省份。

1ymg7af.en: Owns and controls any core state of ⟦0⟧
1ymg7af.zh: 拥有并控制⟦0⟧的任意核心州

1z0nala.en: The common term in HoI4 for the smallest ⟦0⟧, other than ⟦1⟧, when designing a ⟦2⟧ or an abbreviation for ⟦3⟧.
1z0nala.zh: 钢铁雄心4中，设计⟦0⟧时对最小⟦1⟧（⟦2⟧除外）的常用称呼，也用作⟦3⟧的缩写。

q1mtr5.en: ⟦0⟧ - Airplanes specialized in combat role, inflicts ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ damage to enemy ⟦3⟧ during battle.
q1mtr5.zh: ⟦0⟧——用于执行对地攻击任务的飞机，在战斗中造成⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧伤害，目标为敌方⟦3⟧。

6yonu9.en: ⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ used in ⟦2⟧ role and sometimes ⟦3⟧ role.
6yonu9.zh: ⟦0⟧——在⟦1⟧中承担⟦2⟧任务、有时也承担⟦3⟧任务的巡洋舰。

w9q3qp.en: Constant Conversion, a cheesy strategy that allows certain expensive ⟦0⟧ to be produced at a fraction of its normal ⟦1⟧ costs through the use of equipment conversion (see ⟦2⟧ section).
w9q3qp.zh: 一种取巧策略：借助装备改装（参见⟦0⟧一节），某些昂贵的⟦1⟧能以仅为正常⟦2⟧成本一小部分的花费生产出来，称为持续改装（Constant Conversion）。

1k23k8m.en: ⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ capable of transporting ⟦2⟧ of three types: ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧.

1cfrkxd.en: ⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ used in ⟦2⟧ role and anti-submarine warfare or ⟦3⟧.
1cfrkxd.zh: ⟦0⟧——在⟦1⟧中承担相应角色并执行反潜作战任务的⟦2⟧，或⟦3⟧。

5c8rfe.en: Hunter Killer - ⟦0⟧ that form groups to hunt and kill enemy ⟦1⟧.
5c8rfe.zh: 猎潜（Hunter Killer）——组成编队猎杀敌方⟦0⟧的⟦1⟧。

14vx21m.en: ⟦0⟧ - a program to send free aid (⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, etc.) to another ⟦4⟧.

1kaj692.en: ⟦0⟧ - a temporary grouping of naval assets, such as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, to accomplish a specific ⟦3⟧.
1kaj692.zh: ⟦0⟧——为完成特定⟦1⟧而把⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧等海军力量临时编成的编组。

1ty2rjd.en: ⟦0⟧: Dedicated player who focuses their attention on micromanaging ⟦1⟧ for their ⟦2⟧ and tries to obtain strong bonuses to their air units through ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ choices. Very common in multiplayer games.
1ty2rjd.zh: ⟦0⟧：专注于微操⟦1⟧、为⟦2⟧服务，并试图通过⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧的选择为空军单位取得强力加成的玩家。在多人游戏中非常常见。

1ubjqz6.en: ⟦0⟧: A cheesy strategy where the high ⟦1⟧ costs of expensive tanks and aircraft are bypassed by simultaneously producing basic, bare-bones designs that are marked as outdated and ⟦2⟧ them immediately to their final designs. This can happen because the ⟦3⟧ costs of these equipments is often incurred only by the base chassis/airframe and the main armament, while these are only a minority of the total production costs of the final design. Especially with the help of ⟦4⟧, the amount of production lost to this strategy ends up being negligible, while the ⟦5⟧ savings from not having to ⟦6⟧ for as many resources can be huge.
1ubjqz6.zh: ⟦0⟧：一种取巧策略：先同时生产被标记为过时的基础简配设计，随后立即将其⟦1⟧为最终设计，从而绕开昂贵坦克和飞机的⟦2⟧成本。之所以可行，是因为这些装备的⟦3⟧成本往往只由基础底盘/机体和主武器产生，而它们只占最终设计总生产成本的一小部分。尤其在⟦4⟧的帮助下，这种策略损失的生产量可以忽略不计，而无需为那么多资源花钱所省下的⟦5⟧可能极其可观，相比⟦6⟧开支而言收益巨大。

163ms79.en: ⟦0⟧: A marine division with a few mechanized battalions included, usually to greatly increase the division's HP and therefore make it last longer when performing ⟦1⟧ using the Force Attack ⟦2⟧.
163ms79.zh: ⟦0⟧：编入若干机械化营的海军陆战队师，通常是为了大幅提高该师的 HP，从而使其在执行⟦1⟧、使用「强制攻击」⟦2⟧时能坚持更久。

twbofs.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: The practice of setting of a dummy order-of-battle with lower-quality ⟦2⟧ that can then be used to dramatically reduce the ⟦3⟧ cost of performing the respectively named ⟦4⟧. This is done by temporarily assigning the specific divisions for which the ability is to be used to one of those dummy ⟦5⟧, activating the commander ability on the dummy general, and only assigning the unit(s) back to their regular ⟦6⟧ after the ability is no longer needed.
twbofs.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：设置一套由低质量⟦2⟧组成的傀儡战斗序列，借此大幅降低使用相应名称的⟦3⟧技能所需的⟦4⟧成本。做法是临时把要使用该技能的具体师划归某位傀儡⟦5⟧，在该傀儡将领身上激活指挥官技能，等技能不再需要后再把单位划回其常规⟦6⟧麾下。

1e4qxdx.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for a ⟦1⟧ who increases the country's ⟦2⟧ gain, usually one with the Silent Workhorse trait.
1e4qxdx.zh: ⟦0⟧：能提高国家⟦1⟧增长的⟦2⟧的缩写，通常指拥有「沉默的实干家」特质的那位。

15b50gi.en: ⟦0⟧: Reinforcements in manpower, equipment or both. Reinforce meme: Defeating all divisions currently in combat before reserve divisions in the same province can enter combat, forcing them to retreat without fighting (or causing them to be destroyed if encircled).
15b50gi.zh: ⟦0⟧：人力、装备或两者兼有的补充。增援梗：在同一省份的预备队师能投入战斗之前，就消灭当前所有正在战斗的师，迫使它们不战而退（若被包围则会被歼灭）。

13khhgu.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for a ⟦1⟧ who increases the country's ⟦2⟧, usually one with the Popular Figurehead trait.
13khhgu.zh: ⟦0⟧：能提高国家⟦1⟧的⟦2⟧的缩写，通常指拥有「民众偶像」特质的那位。

10hei7x.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, the practice of one country buying the ⟦1⟧ of an ally to offset said ally using their civilian factories to purchase the first country's resources, even when those resources would go unused. Also often used to offset the ⟦2⟧ cost of obtaining ⟦3⟧.
10hei7x.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，一国购买盟友的⟦1⟧，以补偿该盟友动用⟦2⟧购买本国资源（即便这些资源根本用不上）的行为。也常用于补偿为获取⟦3⟧而付出的相关成本。

1swpc22.en: ⟦0⟧ and hotfixes are free updates for Hearts of Iron IV, though they are different in purpose:
1swpc22.zh: ⟦0⟧ 与热修复都是钢铁雄心 IV 的免费更新，但目的有所不同：

9f05q2.en: ⟦0⟧ fix bugs and/or implement balance tweaks. They are sometimes released alongside a new, major ⟦1⟧. When this occurs, a portion of the DLC's features are usually shipped as part of the coinciding free patch, thus made available to anyone who has the base game.
9f05q2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修复错误和/或调整平衡。它们有时会随新的重大 ⟦1⟧ 一同发布。此时，DLC 的部分功能通常会作为同期免费补丁的一部分提供，因此任何拥有基础游戏的玩家都能使用。

14wx0ym.en: ⟦0⟧ are very small updates to the game that usually fix only a few bugs and may contain a few changes to the gameplay as well. Hotfixes are commonly released shortly after major patches to fix any unforeseen bugs that came with the previous update, or independently to fix newly-discovered bugs or exploits.
14wx0ym.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是极小的游戏更新，通常只修复少量错误，也可能包含少量玩法改动。热修复通常在大型补丁之后不久发布，用以修复上次更新带来的意外错误，或独立发布以修复新发现的错误或漏洞。

1qtrxsi.en: Note that newer DLCs cannot be activated if you are playing on an older patch version. This is also applicable to ⟦0⟧, which have various levels of compatibility with new patches.
1qtrxsi.zh: 请注意，如果你游玩的是较旧的补丁版本，较新的 DLC 无法激活。这同样适用于 ⟦0⟧，它们与新补丁的兼容程度各不相同。

k8x5kt.en: When a new version is released in Steam, this normally updates the files on your computer automatically. If you wish to continue to play an earlier version you can do this from Steam. This can allow you to continue to play a game that started in a previous version, if your game is not compatible with the currently released version, or you have technical problems in the current version.
k8x5kt.zh: 当 Steam 发布新版本时，通常会自动更新你电脑上的文件。如果你想继续游玩更早的版本，可以在 Steam 中操作。这能让你继续游玩在旧版本中开始的游戏——如果你的游戏与当前发布的版本不兼容，或你在当前版本中遇到技术问题。

165f4n1.en: Right-click on ⟦0⟧ and from the menu that just opened select ⟦1⟧.
165f4n1.zh: 右键点击 ⟦0⟧，在刚打开的菜单中选择 ⟦1⟧。

1tnuwwa.en: Click on ⟦0⟧, where you can click on the ⟦1⟧ blue down arrow.
1tnuwwa.zh: 点击 ⟦0⟧，在这里可以点击 ⟦1⟧ 的蓝色下拉箭头。

19t7spb.en: Select the version you want to opt into.
19t7spb.zh: 选择你想切换到的版本。

xiuduk.en: By default it is set to ⟦0⟧ (which means that one uses the current version). On this list you will see several versions listed, but not the currently released version. Despite the way this is presented by Steam, these older version are not beta versions, instead they are the earlier released (live) versions. Choosing one of these causes Steam to install the files from that version on your computer.
xiuduk.zh: 默认设置为 ⟦0⟧（即使用当前版本）。在此列表中你会看到多个版本，但不包含当前发布的版本。尽管 Steam 如此呈现，这些旧版本并非测试版，而是更早发布的（正式）版本。选择其中之一会让 Steam 把该版本的文件安装到你的电脑上。

jgh6z2.en: ⟦0⟧ Per HOI4 forum posts Changes to Playing Previous Versions of PDS Titles and How To Roll-back Your Game Version, both dated 24-Sep-2018, there will be two ways to roll back the game to a previous version. One for versions that are from ⟦1⟧ the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) changes and one for versions that are ⟦2⟧. This can allow you to continue to play a game that started in a previous version, if your game is not compatible with the currently released version, or you have technical problems in the current version. The steps listed above will not work for versions released before October 1st, 2018; please use the How To Roll-back Your Game Version.
jgh6z2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 根据 HOI4 论坛帖子 Changes to Playing Previous Versions of PDS Titles 与 How To Roll-back Your Game Version（两者均发布于 24-Sep-2018），把游戏回退到先前版本将有两种方式。一种适用于 ⟦1⟧ 《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）变更的版本，另一种适用于 ⟦2⟧ 的版本。这能让你继续游玩在旧版本中开始的游戏——如果你的游戏与当前发布的版本不兼容，或你在当前版本中遇到技术问题。上述步骤不适用于 2018 年 10 月 1 日之前发布的版本；请使用 How To Roll-back Your Game Version。

d1a05q.en: The vanilla checksum can be seen in the bottom right corner of the launcher. The four characters that are displayed in parentheses after the version number are the checksum.
d1a05q.zh: 原版校验和可在启动器右下角看到。版本号后括号中显示的四个字符即为校验和。

3s3880.en: The final checksum can be changed by the debug launch option and mods that you have enabled. (Note that not all mods affect the checksum.) You can see the final checksum in-game under the main menu when you load the game (it's also referred to as the ⟦0⟧). For all intents and purposes this is the relevant checksum.
3s3880.zh: 最终校验和会被调试启动选项和你已启用的模组改变。（注意并非所有模组都会影响校验和。）加载游戏后，你可以在游戏内主菜单下方看到最终校验和（它也被称为 ⟦0⟧）。实际上，这才是真正相关的校验和。

i6hq7m.en: For ⟦0⟧ it's important to have the standard checksum in-game, which in turn depends on which version of the game you use. On the top of this page you can read what's the correct checksum for the version you use.
i6hq7m.zh: 对于 ⟦0⟧ 来说，游戏内保持标准校验和很重要，而这又取决于你使用的游戏版本。在本页顶部可以查看你所使用版本对应的正确校验和。

1fmwvjb.en: For multiplayer you usually want the standard checksum as well, since one can only play with people who have the same checksum. If you want to play multiplayer with mods that change the checksum you need to make sure that all the involved parties use the same checksum-changing mods. (Otherwise you won't have the same checksum and therefore it won't work.)
1fmwvjb.zh: 进行多人游戏时，通常也需要标准校验和，因为你只能与校验和相同的玩家一起游玩。如果你想在启用会改变校验和的模组的情况下进行多人游戏，必须确保所有参与者使用相同的改变校验和的模组。（否则你们的校验和不同，也就无法联机。）

ob2v3w.en: If you have a non-standard checksum---although you don't have mods enabled that change it---try clicking on the "Clear user directory" button in the launcher. That fixes most problems like that.
ob2v3w.zh: 如果你遇到了非标准校验和——尽管你并未启用会改变它的模组——请尝试点击启动器中的「清除用户目录」按钮。这能解决大多数此类问题。
