1a8kada.en: Can be chained indefinitely as FROM.FROM. Used to target various hardcoded scopes inherent to the block, often a secondary scope in addition to ROOT. For example: In events, this refers to the country that sent the event (i.e. if the event was fired using an effect, then it's the ROOT scope where it was fired). In targeted decisions or diplomacy scripted triggers, this refers to the scope that is targeted.
1a8kada.zh: 可以无限串联为 FROM.FROM。用于指向该语句块固有的各种硬编码作用域，通常是除 ROOT 之外的第二作用域。例如：在事件中，它指发送事件的国家（即若该事件是通过效果触发的，则为触发它的 ROOT 作用域）。在有目标决议或外交脚本触发器中，它指被选为目标的作用域。

tlf5sv.en: The overlord of the country if it is a subject. ⟦0⟧
tlf5sv.zh: 如果该国是附庸国，则为其宗主国。⟦0⟧

pwhv3h.en: Subject to the 'invalid event target' error.

13tr63l.en: Faction leader of the faction the country is a part of. ⟦0⟧
13tr63l.zh: 该国所属阵营的阵营领袖。⟦0⟧

7ctio0.en: Within state, character, or combatant scope only
7ctio0.zh: 仅限州、角色或参战方作用域内

u304x7.en: In state scope, the country that owns the state. In ⟦0⟧, the country that owns the divisions. In character scope, the country that has recruited the character. ⟦1⟧ when used for a state.
u304x7.zh: 在州作用域中，指拥有该州的国家。在⟦0⟧中，指拥有这些师的国家。在角色作用域中，指已招募该角色的国家。用于州时为⟦1⟧。

o2vd01.en: Subject to the 'invalid event target' error

1u8pv9v.en: The controller of the current state. ⟦0⟧

lc8s4u.en: The state where the capital of the current country is located in. ⟦0⟧ in rare cases.
lc8s4u.zh: 当前国家首都所在的州。少数情况下为⟦0⟧。

1eic3r6.en: Saved ⟦0⟧, with no space after the colon. ⟦1⟧
1eic3r6.zh: 已保存的⟦0⟧，冒号后不加空格。⟦1⟧

dcahzx.en: event target or global event target
dcahzx.zh: 事件目标或全局事件目标

fr8ep3.en: ⟦0⟧ set to a scope. When used as a target rather than a scope, the var: can be omitted in most cases.
fr8ep3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 被设为一个作用域。当作为目标而非作用域使用时，大多数情况下可省略 var:。

wgp0i.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the Modifier. ⟦1⟧ If you specify it, your dynamic modifier will be scoped to this scope. Optional. ⟦2⟧ The modifiers will be removed after x days have passed. Optional.
wgp0i.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修正的名称。⟦1⟧ 若指定，动态修正将被限定到该作用域。可选。⟦2⟧ 经过 x 天后，这些修正将被移除。可选。

14lihvy.en: Adds a dynamic modifier to the specified scope (the default scope is ROOT). It will be updated daily, unless forced to update early by force_update_dynamic_modifier effect.
14lihvy.zh: 向指定作用域添加一个动态修正（默认作用域为 ROOT）。它每天更新一次，除非通过 force_update_dynamic_modifier 效果强制提前更新。

khizju.en: Examples can be found in ⟦0⟧. Any modifiers that use variables within of the dynamic modifier will not show up in the tooltip of this effect, while those that are set to a static value will. Supports the state, country, character, and special project scopes.
khizju.zh: 示例可在⟦0⟧中找到。动态修正中任何使用变量的修正项都不会显示在此效果的工具提示中，而设为静态值的修正项则会显示。支持州、国家、角色和特殊项目作用域。

3vxylh.en: Removes a dynamic modifier from the current scope
3vxylh.zh: 从当前作用域移除一个动态修正

f2tgx0.en: Forces an update to the effects given by variables within dynamic modifiers.
f2tgx0.zh: 强制更新动态修正中由变量给出的效果。

146e9k5.en: An update is done daily by default; this can be used if the applied values need to be changed urgently, such as if modifiers are checked or used later in the effect block.
146e9k5.zh: 默认每天更新一次；当应用的值需要紧急变更时可以使用，例如之后在效果块中检查或使用这些修正时。

1xtqmk.en: Adds either a resistance or compliance modifier to a state. Can only use modifiers from the ⟦0⟧ that are marked as ⟦1⟧
1xtqmk.zh: 向某个州添加抵抗度或顺从度修正。只能使用⟦0⟧中标记为⟦1⟧的修正项

8n6hoi.en: Removes either a resistance or compliance modifier from a state. Can only use modifiers from the ⟦0⟧ that are marked as ⟦1⟧
8n6hoi.zh: 从某个州移除抵抗度或顺从度修正。只能使用⟦0⟧中标记为⟦1⟧的修正项

1dd5f8e.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the global flag with. OR flag = <flag> The flag to set. days = <int> Sets the flag to last for the specified amount of days. Optional. value = <int> The new value of the flag on the scale from -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647.
1dd5f8e.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该全局旗标的唯一字符串。或 flag = <flag> 要设置的旗标。days = <int> 设置旗标持续的指定天数。可选。value = <int> 旗标的新值，取值范围从 -2 147 483 648 到 2 147 483 647。

8tqeqy.en: The flag in this effect is used in the meaning of 'boolean flag', used to store information.
8tqeqy.zh: 此效果中的 flag 是「布尔旗标」的含义，用于存储信息。

1eqdgz6.en: ⟦0⟧ A music file located in the music folder and .asset
1eqdgz6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 位于 music 文件夹和 .asset 中的音乐文件

qkmabx.en: The song must be defined in a music station in order to work. More information can be found in the ⟦0⟧ page. If you wish to simply play a sound, the ⟦1⟧ effect should be used instead. The song will start playing for every country if the effect is executed. See scoped_play_song if only one country should have the song.
qkmabx.zh: 歌曲必须定义在音乐电台中才能生效。更多信息可在⟦0⟧页面中找到。若只想播放音效，则应改用⟦1⟧效果。若执行该效果，歌曲将对所有国家开始播放。若只希望一个国家播放该歌曲，见 scoped_play_song。

1u3p4z6.en: ⟦0⟧ The unique string of a global flag to clear.
1u3p4z6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要清除的全局旗标的唯一字符串。

1kh7jaw.zh: 清除已定义的全局旗标。

1e4qanf.en: ⟦0⟧ The flag to modify. value = <value> The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0. days = <int> The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.
1e4qanf.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的旗标。value = <value> 为旗标增加的值。默认为 0。days = <int> 旗标在被清除前持续的天数。可选，默认为永久。

1f167e7.en: Adds an integer value to a flag.
1f167e7.zh: 为旗标增加一个整数值。

1ue9rhi.en: The flag must be already set.

10qnsyt.en: ⟦0⟧ A localized string to display in the tooltip.
10qnsyt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要在工具提示中显示的本地化字符串。

15avl6x.en: Displays a localized key in the effect tooltip.
15avl6x.zh: 在效果工具提示中显示一个本地化键。

1927r2m.en: ⟦0⟧ A localized string to display in the tooltip. not_tooltip = <string> A localized string to display in the tooltip for NOT block. Optional.
1927r2m.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要在工具提示中显示的本地化字符串。not_tooltip = <string> 用于 NOT 块的、要在工具提示中显示的本地化字符串。可选。

1eozv4j.en: Executes the provided effects but with a custom tooltip surpressing all tooltips from all other effects inside this block.
1eozv4j.zh: 执行所提供的效果，但使用自定义工具提示，抑制此块内所有其他效果的工具提示。

1gadvc4.en: Can also be used as trigger.

14cgs8u.en: Displays the effects in the tooltip without executing them.
14cgs8u.zh: 在工具提示中显示这些效果，但不执行它们。

ja103v.en: ⟦0⟧ An string to in the game.log
ja103v.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要写入 game.log 的字符串

1uwaj1o.en: Displays a string in the ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ file when executed, as well as showing up in the console if it is open when the logging effect was executed.
1uwaj1o.zh: 执行时在⟦0⟧⟦1⟧文件中显示字符串；若执行该记录效果时控制台处于打开状态，也会显示在控制台中。

ncmr2d.zh: 接受所有本地化指令（例如 ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 等）

1titsgm.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the event target with.
1titsgm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该事件目标的唯一字符串。

robnmh.en: Saves the current scope as a key. Is cleared once execution ends (i.e. end of event).
robnmh.zh: 将当前作用域保存为一个键。执行结束时（即事件结束时）被清除。

1jnafcn.en: Use event_target:<key> to access the scope. Do not use in Scripted GUIs.
1jnafcn.zh: 使用 event_target:<key> 访问该作用域。不要在脚本化 GUI 中使用。

19ybr2d.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the global event target with.
19ybr2d.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该全局事件目标的唯一字符串。

s06jif.en: Saves the current scope as a key. Persists after execution until cleared via effect.
s06jif.zh: 将当前作用域保存为一个键。执行后持续存在，直到通过效果清除。

1oy6ek1.en: ⟦0⟧ The unique string of the global event target to clear.
1oy6ek1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要清除的全局事件目标的唯一字符串。

kk4tp6.en: Clears a specific global event target.
kk4tp6.zh: 清除指定的全局事件目标。

hhjdf9.zh: 清除所有全局事件目标。

yn8jek.en: ⟦0⟧ A sound reference from an .asset file.
yn8jek.zh: ⟦0⟧ 来自 .asset 文件的音效引用。

ymf2qa.en: The sound effect must be properly defined in ⟦0⟧ See also: ⟦1⟧. The sound will play for every country if the effect is executed. See scoped_sound_effect if only one country should hear it.
ymf2qa.zh: 音效必须在⟦0⟧中正确定义。另见：⟦1⟧。若执行该效果，音效将对所有国家播放。若只希望一个国家听到，见 scoped_sound_effect。

1l1zelq.en: Randomizes the weather with the specified seed.
1l1zelq.zh: 使用指定的种子随机化天气。

uhwuy8.en: ⟦0⟧ The id of the province to be changed. name = <string> The name to change the province to.
uhwuy8.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要更改的省份 id。name = <string> 将该省份改成的名称。

1i1aq8y.en: Changes the specified province/victory point's name to the specified name.
1i1aq8y.zh: 将指定省份/胜利点的名称更改为指定名称。

zf6i8q.en: Localisation keys are to be defined in ⟦0⟧

pqh17u.en: ⟦0⟧ The id of the province to reset.

qks2ot.en: ⟦0⟧ Province where to damage units. state = <id> State where to damage units. region = <id> Strategic region where to damage units. limit = { <triggers> } Will only delete units if the triggers within are met for the country that owns the units. damage = <fraction> The percentage of damage done to units. org_damage = <fraction> The percentage of damage done to units to organisation in particular. str_damage = <fraction> The percentage of damage done to units to strength in particular. ratio = <yes> Will damage a ratio damage to total organisation/strength of unit if set. template = <string> If specified, requires the template name to match. army = <bool> Will damage the army units. navy = <bool> Will damage the navy units.
qks2ot.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要对单位造成伤害的省份。state = <id> 要对单位造成伤害的州。region = <id> 要对单位造成伤害的战略区域。limit = { <triggers> } 仅当拥有这些单位的国家满足其中的触发器时才会删除单位。damage = <fraction> 对单位造成的伤害百分比。org_damage = <fraction> 对单位组织度造成的伤害百分比。str_damage = <fraction> 对单位兵力造成的伤害百分比。ratio = <yes> 若设置，将按单位总组织度/兵力的比例造成伤害。template = <string> 若指定，要求模板名称匹配。army = <bool> 将对陆军单位造成伤害。navy = <bool> 将对海军单位造成伤害。

lerts5.en: Damages units in the specified area.
lerts5.zh: 对指定区域内的单位造成伤害。

jez9m2.en: ⟦0⟧ The entity to spawn, defined within ⟦1⟧ files. id = int A number ID which can be referred to by other effects. Optional. var = <variable> If provided, the id of the entity will be stored using this variable. Optional. x = <int> The X position of the entity. y = <int> The Y position of the entity. z = <int> The Z position of the entity. province = <int> The province the middle of which to use as the entity's position. state = <int> The state the middle of which to use as the entity's position. rotation = <decimal> The rotation of the entity in radians. scale = <decimal> The size of the entity. min_zoom = <decimal> Minimum zoom level needed to be able to see the entity. visible = <scripted_trigger> The scripted trigger that must be met for a country for it to see the entity.
jez9m2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要生成的实体，在⟦1⟧文件中定义。id = int 一个数字 ID，可供其他效果引用。可选。var = <variable> 若提供，实体的 id 将存储在该变量中。可选。x = <int> 实体的 X 坐标。y = <int> 实体的 Y 坐标。z = <int> 实体的 Z 坐标。province = <int> 以其中央位置作为实体位置的省份。state = <int> 以其中央位置作为实体位置的州。rotation = <decimal> 实体的旋转角度，单位为弧度。scale = <decimal> 实体的尺寸。min_zoom = <decimal> 能看到该实体所需的最小缩放级别。visible = <scripted_trigger> 一个国家要看到该实体必须满足的脚本化触发器。

rgsqsa.en: Uses the ⟦0⟧ A positive change in rotation results in counter-clockwise rotation, a full 360 degrees rotation is approximately 6.28 radians. For comparison, default minimum zoom level (closest to the map) is 50 units, while default maximum zoom level is 3000 units.
rgsqsa.zh: 使用⟦0⟧ 旋转角度的正变化会导致逆时针旋转，完整的 360 度旋转约为 6.28 弧度。作为对比，默认最小缩放级别（最接近地图）为 50 单位，而默认最大缩放级别为 3000 单位。

6kktt5.en: the same coordinate system that the map uses.
6kktt5.zh: 地图所使用的同一坐标系。

lfkg6u.en: ⟦0⟧ The ID of the entity to destroy.

ogzz0s.en: ⟦0⟧ The ID of the entity to modify. ratio = <int> Distance between starting position and target position where the entity is to be placed. rotation = <int> The rotation to apply after the positioning. start and target arguments: x = <int> The X position of the point. y = <int> The Y position of the point. z = <int> The Z position of the point. province = <int> The province the middle of which to use as the point. state = <int> The state the middle of which to use as the point.
ogzz0s.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的实体的 ID。ratio = <int> 起始位置与目标位置之间的距离，实体将被放置在该距离处。rotation = <int> 定位后要应用的旋转角度。start 与 target 参数：x = <int> 该点的 X 坐标。y = <int> 该点的 Y 坐标。z = <int> 该点的 Z 坐标。province = <int> 以其中央位置作为该点的省份。state = <int> 以其中央位置作为该点的州。

b9og2h.en: The X position of the point.

1dztqb8.en: The Y position of the point.

1nwynaf.en: The Z position of the point.

i5bsfz.en: The province the middle of which to use as the point.
i5bsfz.zh: 以其中央位置作为该点的省份。

4r2xmw.en: The state the middle of which to use as the point.
4r2xmw.zh: 以其中央位置作为该点的州。

c67rsr.en: Sets the position and rotation of an entity using two coordinates.
c67rsr.zh: 使用两个坐标设置实体的位置和旋转角度。

p4rthd.en: IDs are set by the ⟦0⟧. Uses the ⟦1⟧ A positive change in rotation results in counter-clockwise rotation, a full 360 degrees rotation is approximately 6.28 radians.
p4rthd.zh: ID 由⟦0⟧设置。使用⟦1⟧ 旋转角度的正变化会导致逆时针旋转，完整的 360 度旋转约为 6.28 弧度。

1ro2i56.en: Sets the position of an existing entity

17txdrf.en: IDs are set by the ⟦0⟧. Uses the ⟦1⟧

q651nb.en: ⟦0⟧ The ID of the entity to modify. rotation = <decimal> The new angle in radians.
q651nb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的实体的 ID。rotation = <decimal> 新的角度，单位为弧度。

1v08p59.en: Sets the currently-facing angle of an existing entity.
1v08p59.zh: 设置现有实体的当前朝向角度。

1m262cf.en: IDs are set by the ⟦0⟧. A positive change results in counter-clockwise rotation, a full 360 degrees rotation is approximately 6.28 radians.
1m262cf.zh: ID 由⟦0⟧设置。正变化会导致逆时针旋转，完整的 360 度旋转约为 6.28 弧度。

r5oat9.en: ⟦0⟧ The ID of the entity to modify. scale = <decimal> The scale to change the entity to.
r5oat9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的实体的 ID。scale = <decimal> 要将实体更改成的缩放比例。

1n30lfu.en: Sets the size of an existing entity.

1oawoqu.en: ⟦0⟧ The ID of the entity to modify. animation = <animation_type> The animation entry to apply.
1oawoqu.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的实体的 ID。animation = <animation_type> 要应用的动画条目。

1ii7tqc.en: Sets the animation of a specified entity.

1ca0bnn.en: IDs are set by the ⟦0⟧. Animations are defined within the ⟦1⟧ files.
1ca0bnn.zh: ID 由⟦0⟧设置。动画在⟦1⟧文件中定义。

rzpggh.en: ⟦0⟧ Defaults to 1 build_only_on_allied = <bool> No by default, if yes and in a country scope, it will only build on allied territories for the country scoped. fallback = <bool> Defaults to no, if yes each option will try to fallback to the next available one. path = { <list of provinces> } start_province = <int> target_province = <int> start_state = <int> target_state = <int> If using start state/target state, the game will pick the provinces with the best supply available. If using state province/target province, the game will link those two provinces.
rzpggh.zh: ⟦0⟧ 默认为 1。build_only_on_allied = <bool> 默认否；若为是且处于国家作用域，则只会在此作用域所指国家的盟友领土上建造。fallback = <bool> 默认为否；若为是，每个选项都会尝试回退到下一个可用选项。path = { <list of provinces> } start_province = <int> target_province = <int> start_state = <int> target_state = <int> 若使用起始州/目标州，游戏将挑选可用补给最佳的省份。若使用起始省份/目标省份，游戏将连接这两个省份。

1ouo9b4.en: Adds a railway level between two provinces or along a predefined path.
1ouo9b4.zh: 在两个省份之间或沿预定义路径增加一级铁路。

1phhd3e.en: Shows the tooltip usually received for hovering over an event option with the specified name.
1phhd3e.zh: 显示将鼠标悬停在指定名称的事件选项上时通常会看到的工具提示。

1mfy1w7.en: ROOT and FROM scopes are swapped.
1mfy1w7.zh: ROOT 与 FROM 作用域互换。

izz87b.en: ⟦0⟧ The seller in the contract. buyer = <country> The buyer in the contract. civilian_factories = <int> The amount of civilian factories required by the contract. equipment = { ... } The equipment that the contract is for. In particular, contains these attributes: type = <archetype> The archetype of the equipment. amount = <int> The amount of the specified equipment.
izz87b.zh: ⟦0⟧ 合同中的卖方。buyer = <country> 合同中的买方。civilian_factories = <int> 合同所需的民用工厂数量。equipment = { ... } 合同所涉及的装备。具体而言，包含以下属性：type = <archetype> 装备的原型。amount = <int> 指定装备的数量。

16omnj7.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of the specified equipment.

1de08s9.en: Creates a purchase contract with the specified parameters.
1de08s9.zh: 创建带有指定参数的采购合同。

1izvxa7.en: These effects refer to the border wars that simulate combat on a border between two countries, with provinces where it takes place being highlighted in white. For the state-based border wars represented with orange stripes on states, see ⟦0⟧ in the state scope.
1izvxa7.zh: 这些效果指的是模拟两国边境作战的边境战争，发生战斗的省份会以白色高亮显示。关于以州上的橙色条纹表示的、基于州的边境战争，请参见州作用域中的⟦0⟧。

13itwa8.zh: 边境战争相关的任意作用域效果：

eh63pb.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether the state changes hands after the war. Attacker or Defender scope state = <id> / <variable> The state the side is fighting on. num_provinces = <id> The number of provinces used in the state. on_win = <id> The event to fire for the side on a win. on_lose = <id> The event to fire for the side on a loss. on_cancel = <id> The event to fire for the side on a draw. modifier = <decimal> The modifier on combat. Defaults to 0. dig_in_factor = <decimal> The modifier applied to dig-in bonuses. Defaults to 1. terrain_factor = <decimal> The modifier applied to terrain bonuses. Defaults to 1.
eh63pb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 战后该州是否易手。攻击方或防御方作用域 state = <id> / <variable> 该方作战所在的州。num_provinces = <id> 该州中使用的省份数量。on_win = <id> 该方获胜时触发的事件。on_lose = <id> 该方失败时触发的事件。on_cancel = <id> 该方打平时触发的事件。modifier = <decimal> 战斗修正。默认为 0。dig_in_factor = <decimal> 应用于掘壕固守加成的修正。默认为 1。terrain_factor = <decimal> 应用于地形加成的修正。默认为 1。

ijv15m.zh: 攻击方或防御方作用域

1scbp4b.en: Starts a border war for the specified attacker and defender. The participating countries are the owners of the specified states.
1scbp4b.zh: 为指定的攻击方和防御方开启一场边境战争。参战国家为指定州的拥有者。

1kiq8w.en: ⟦0⟧ The attacker state. defender = <id> / <variable> The defender state. attacker_modifier = <id> / <variable> The modifier applied to attacker strength. defender_modifier = <id> / <variable> The modifier applied to attacker strength. combat_width = <id> / <variable> The combat width used in the border war battle.
1kiq8w.zh: ⟦0⟧ 攻击方的州。defender = <id> / <variable> 防御方的州。attacker_modifier = <id> / <variable> 应用于攻击方兵力的修正。defender_modifier = <id> / <variable> 应用于防御方兵力的修正。combat_width = <id> / <variable> 边境战争战斗中所用的战斗宽度。

1fulbq7.en: Sets the bonuses or penalties for the attacker and defender in an on-going border war. Used after ⟦0⟧.
1fulbq7.zh: 设置进行中的边境战争中攻击方和防御方的加成或惩罚。在⟦0⟧之后使用。

1l5cd7v.en: ⟦0⟧ The attacker state. defender = <id> / <variable> The defender state. dont_fire_events = <bool> Stops the events from start_border_war from firing.
1l5cd7v.zh: ⟦0⟧ 攻击方的州。defender = <id> / <variable> 防御方的州。dont_fire_events = <bool> 阻止 start_border_war 中的事件触发。

s55z55.en: Cancels an on-going border war without a winner.
s55z55.zh: 在没有获胜者的情况下取消进行中的边境战争。

1tgbth4.en: ⟦0⟧ The attacker state. defender = <id> / <variable> The defender state. attacker_win = <bool> Makes the attacker the winner. defender_win = <bool> Makes the defender the winner.
1tgbth4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 攻击方的州。defender = <id> / <variable> 防御方的州。attacker_win = <bool> 使攻击方成为获胜者。defender_win = <bool> 使防御方成为获胜者。

2cgqu6.zh: 结束进行中的边境战争。

r9sqc2.en: The following is a list of variable-related effects and triggers. Variable-modifying effects have an equivalent for temporary variables, with ⟦0⟧ being used instead of ⟦1⟧, and these temporary variable operators are also valid triggers, as described above. Every operator can be used with variables that do not exist, assuming a value of 0 unless a null-coalescing operator is used.
r9sqc2.zh: 以下是与变量相关的效果和触发器列表。修改变量的效果都有对应的临时变量版本，只是用⟦0⟧代替⟦1⟧，且这些临时变量运算符同样可作为触发器使用，如上所述。每个运算符都可以用于不存在的变量，此时假定其值为 0，除非使用了空值合并运算符。

t8y5b8.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to modify or create. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to set the variable to. tooltip = localisation_keyLocalisation used by the operation. Optional.
t8y5b8.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改或创建的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 要将变量设成的值。tooltip = localisation_key 该操作使用的本地化。可选。

16qjq9d.en: Sets a variable's value to the specified amount, creating it if not defined.
16qjq9d.zh: 将变量的值设为指定数值，若未定义则创建该变量。

18zg4n0.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to modify or create. min = <decimal> The minimum possible value, defaults to 0. max = <decimal> The maximum possible value, defaults to 1. integer = <bool> Sets if the variable must be an integer or if it can be decimal. Defaults to false.
18zg4n0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改或创建的变量。min = <decimal> 最小可能值，默认为 0。max = <decimal> 最大可能值，默认为 1。integer = <bool> 设置该变量必须是整数还是可以为小数。默认为 false。

crk5cy.en: Sets a variable's value to the specified amount, creating it if not defined. The result will be greater than or equal than the minimum and strictly less than the maximum.
crk5cy.zh: 将变量的值设为指定数值，若未定义则创建该变量。结果将大于或等于最小值，且严格小于最大值。

130mn2c.en: Shortened version exists with ⟦0⟧, setting it to a decimal between 0 and 1. Can be used in triggers.
130mn2c.zh: 存在使用⟦0⟧的简写版本，会将其设为 0 到 1 之间的小数。可用于触发器。

1a3oq5r.en: Clears the value from the memory entirely.
1a3oq5r.zh: 将该值从内存中完全清除。

183hhht.en: Can only be used on regular variables.

o9nf30.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to add to. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to add to the variable. tooltip = localisation_keyLocalisation used by the operation. Optional.
o9nf30.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要增加的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 要为该变量增加的值。tooltip = localisation_key 该操作使用的本地化。可选。

1pgpma7.en: Increases a variable's value by the specified amount, creating it if not defined.
1pgpma7.zh: 将变量的值增加指定数值，若未定义则创建该变量。

14b5r22.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to subtract from. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to subtract from the variable. tooltip = localisation_keyLocalisation used by the operation. Optional.
14b5r22.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要减小的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 要从该变量中减去的值。tooltip = localisation_key 该操作使用的本地化。可选。

1ypccy3.en: Decreases a variable's value by the specified amount, creating it if not defined.
1ypccy3.zh: 将变量的值减少指定数值，若未定义则创建该变量。

14g0y9g.en: Shortened version exists with ⟦0⟧. Equivalent to adding a negative amount.
14g0y9g.zh: 存在使用⟦0⟧的简写版本。等同于加上一个负值。

ad9fvr.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to multiply. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to multiply the variable by. tooltip = localisation_keyLocalisation used by the operation. Optional.
ad9fvr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要相乘的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 与该变量相乘的值。tooltip = localisation_key 该操作使用的本地化。可选。

34ipgd.en: Multiplies a variable's value by the specified amount.
34ipgd.zh: 将变量的值乘以指定数值。

12hjki3.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to divide. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to divide the variable by. tooltip = localisation_keyLocalisation used by the operation. Optional.
12hjki3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要相除的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 用来除该变量的值。tooltip = localisation_key 该操作使用的本地化。可选。

ykwk9p.en: Divides a variable's value by the specified amount.
ykwk9p.zh: 将变量的值除以指定数值。

qqdbvn.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to modulo. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to modulo the variable by. tooltip = localisation_keyLocalisation used by the operation. Optional.
qqdbvn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要求模的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 对该变量取模所用的值。tooltip = localisation_key 该操作使用的本地化。可选。

1jrcye1.en: Makes the variable become the remainder of Euclidean division of the variable by the specified value.
1jrcye1.zh: 使变量变为该变量除以指定值后欧几里得除法的余数。

1lni91k.en: Rounds the variable towards the closest integer value.
1lni91k.zh: 将变量舍入到最接近的整数值。

10pt7uy.en: If exactly between two integers (Such as 1.5), the option with lager absolute val gets chosen ( if -1.5,will be -2 ).
10pt7uy.zh: 若恰好位于两个整数之间（例如 1.5），则选择绝对值更大的那个（如 -1.5 将变为 -2）。

9a1z9l.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to clamp. min = <decimal>/<variable> The minimum value of the variable after the clamp. max = <decimal>/<variable> The maximum value of the variable after the clamp.
9a1z9l.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要限制的变量。min = <decimal>/<variable> 限制后变量的最小值。max = <decimal>/<variable> 限制后变量的最大值。

1ctivel.en: Clamps the variable to ensure its value is between the two specified numbers, raising to the minimum if smaller or lowering to the maximum if larger.
1ctivel.zh: 将变量限制在两个指定数值之间：若更小则提升到最小值，若更大则降低到最大值。

1nh9buz.en: Either min or max can be omitted, in which case it'll not be checked. Does nothing if the variable is already in the range between min and max. ⟦0⟧, it can still go beyond the minimum or the maximum after the clamp.
1nh9buz.zh: min 或 max 可以省略，此时不会检查该项。若变量已处于 min 与 max 之间的范围内，则不做任何操作。⟦0⟧，限制后它仍可能超出最小值或最大值。

1r62mk5.en: This only changes the current value of the variable
1r62mk5.zh: 这只会改变变量的当前值

18blgcg.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to modify or create. value = <decimal>/<variable> The value to set the variable to.
18blgcg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改或创建的变量。value = <decimal>/<variable> 要将变量设成的值。

rjz28l.en: Sets a temporary variable to a value or another variable.
rjz28l.zh: 将一个临时变量设为一个值或另一个变量。

1pduwtd.en: ⟦0⟧ The array to modify. value = <decimal>/<variable> The variable to add. index = <integer> The index to place the variable on in the array. Optional, defaults to the end of the array.
1pduwtd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的数组。value = <decimal>/<variable> 要添加的变量。index = <integer> 将该变量放入数组中的索引位置。可选，默认为数组末尾。

19b9zri.en: Adds an element to the array either at the specified index, defaulting to the end otherwise.
19b9zri.zh: 向数组添加一个元素，可指定索引位置，否则默认添加到末尾。

1lsvnw8.en: ⟦0⟧ The array to modify. value = <decimal>/<variable> The variable to remove. Optional. index = <integer> The index to remove the variable from in the array. Optional.
1lsvnw8.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的数组。value = <decimal>/<variable> 要移除的变量。可选。index = <integer> 要从数组中移除该变量的索引位置。可选。

1e7b2na.en: Removes an element from the array with the specified value or index.
1e7b2na.zh: 从数组中移除具有指定值或索引的元素。

10j5bzp.en: Shortened version exists with ⟦0⟧. If neither value nor index are specified, then the last element is deleted.
10j5bzp.zh: 存在使用⟦0⟧的简写版本。若既未指定 value 也未指定 index，则删除最后一个元素。

x3go1r.en: Clears the array, removing every element inside.
x3go1r.zh: 清空数组，移除其中的所有元素。

1tyz4gz.en: ⟦0⟧ The array to modify. value = <decimal>/<variable> The variable to add to the array if the size is larger than the array's current size. Optional, defaults to 0. size = <integer> The amount of elements inside of the array after the resizing.
1tyz4gz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的数组。value = <decimal>/<variable> 若尺寸大于数组当前大小，则要添加到数组中的变量。可选，默认为 0。size = <integer> 调整大小后数组内的元素数量。

1rt5mb9.en: Resizes the array, removing or adding elements in the end if necessary.
1rt5mb9.zh: 调整数组大小，必要时在末尾移除或添加元素。

1l6r6wq.en: ⟦0⟧ The array to modify. value = <variable> The temporary variable where the largest value will get stored. index = <variable> The temporary variable where the index of the largest value will get stored.
1l6r6wq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的数组。value = <variable> 用于存储最大值的临时变量。index = <variable> 用于存储最大值索引的临时变量。

5mawqe.en: Finds the largest value in the array and assigns its value and index to a temporary variable.
5mawqe.zh: 找出数组中的最大值，并将其值与索引赋给一个临时变量。

3tyok0.en: Either value or index are optional to specify.
3tyok0.zh: value 和 index 均为可选指定。

b7f6mu.en: ⟦0⟧ The array to modify. value = <variable> The temporary variable where the smallest value will get stored. index = <variable> The temporary variable where the index of the smallest value will get stored.
b7f6mu.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的数组。value = <variable> 用于存储最小值的临时变量。index = <variable> 用于存储最小值索引的临时变量。

1b9dip7.en: Finds the smallest value in the array and assigns its value and index to a temporary variable.
1b9dip7.zh: 找出数组中的最小值，并将其值与索引赋给一个临时变量。

sggk10.en: The effects here must be used within a ⟦0⟧ scope.
sggk10.zh: 此处的效果必须在⟦0⟧作用域内使用。

t6rnlz.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the country flag with. OR flag = <flag> The flag to set. days = <int> Sets the flag to last for the specified amount of days. Optional. value = <int> The new value of the flag on the scale from -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647.
t6rnlz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该国家旗标的唯一字符串。或 flag = <flag> 要设置的旗标。days = <int> 设置旗标持续的指定天数。可选。value = <int> 旗标的新值，取值范围从 -2 147 483 648 到 2 147 483 647。

1hplj45.en: In order to change the flag that represents the country, see ⟦0⟧
1hplj45.zh: 要更改代表国家的旗帜，请参见⟦0⟧

1vuwj1v.en: ⟦0⟧ The unique string of a country flag to clear.
1vuwj1v.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要清除的国家旗标的唯一字符串。

1m3pkv7.zh: 清除已定义的国家旗标。

ann4vu.en: ⟦0⟧ The event to fire. days = <int> / <variable> Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional. hours = <int> / <variable> Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional. random_hours = <int> / <variable> Adds a random number (between 0 and random_hours, inclusive) of hours to the scheduled fire time. Optional. random_days = <int> / <variable> Adds a random number (between 0 and random_days, inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional.
ann4vu.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要触发的事件。days = <int> / <variable> 在指定天数后触发该事件。可选。hours = <int> / <variable> 在指定小时数后触发该事件。可选。random_hours = <int> / <variable> 为计划的触发时间增加一个随机小时数（0 到 random_hours 之间，含两端）。可选。random_days = <int> / <variable> 为计划的触发时间增加一个随机天数（0 到 random_days 之间，含两端）。可选。

j7mfwi.en: Fires the specified event for the current country.
j7mfwi.zh: 为当前国家触发指定事件。

1h79j6.en: Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked ⟦0⟧ can be a performance light alternative to ⟦1⟧ for scheduling events. Shortened variant exists if the event's ID is used instead of arguments.
1h79j6.zh: 在触发器无需反复检查的情况下，⟦0⟧ 可作为比 ⟦1⟧ 更轻量的排定事件方式。若使用事件 ID 而非参数，则存在简写形式。

8jvaxt.en: Fires the specified news event for the current country.
8jvaxt.zh: 为当前国家触发指定新闻事件。

o59sov.en: The news event uses a different interface to the country event. Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked random can be a performance light alternative to mean_time_to_happen for scheduling events. Shortened variant exists if the event's ID is used instead of arguments.
o59sov.zh: 新闻事件使用的界面与国家事件不同。在触发器无需反复检查的情况下，random 可作为比 mean_time_to_happen 更轻量的排定事件方式。若使用事件 ID 而非参数，则存在简写形式。

1jzl8h0.en: ⟦0⟧ The cosmetic tag to switch to.

1kb2v1e.en: Makes the current scope use the specified cosmetic tag, changing name and flag.
1kb2v1e.zh: 使当前作用域使用指定的外观标签，更改名称与旗帜。

shsrb6.en: Makes the current scope drop the current cosmetic tag they are using.
shsrb6.zh: 使当前作用域放弃其正在使用的外观标签。

vyudqg.en: ⟦0⟧ Boolean. desc = <localisation key> The localisation used as the description for why the rule is set.
vyudqg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 布尔值。desc = <localisation key> 用作设置该规则原因的说明的本地化。

tskaxt.en: Toggles the special game rules for the current scope. Note: each rule can only be toggled a few times before a reload is required.
tskaxt.zh: 切换当前作用域的特殊游戏规则。注意：每条规则只能切换少数几次，之后需要重新载入。

zizlsk.en: Game rule list The following game rules exist as possible options: Internal name Localised name Notes can_access_market Can access International Market (Puppets and Overlords can always access each other's market) can_be_spymaster Can be Spy Master can_boost_other_ideologies Can boost popularity of other ideologies can_boost_own_ideology Can boost own party popularity in other countries can_create_collaboration_government Can create collaboration governments can_create_factions Can Create Factions can_declare_war_on_same_ideology Can declare war on country with the same ideology group without a war goal can_declare_war_without_wargoal_when_in_war Can declare war on a neighbor without a wargoal when at war with a major can_decline_call_to_war Can decline call to war can_force_government Can force government of another country to adopt the same ideology can_generate_female_aces Women in your country are allowed to become military pilots can_generate_female_country_leaders Can generate female country leaders can_generate_female_unit_leaders Can generate female unit leaders can_guarantee_other_ideologies Can guarantee other ideologies can_join_factions Can join factions can_join_factions_not_allowed_diplomacy Country's name is not allowed to join factions can_join_opposite_factions Can Join Factions led by another Ideology can_lower_tension Lowers World Tension with Guarantees can_not_build_buildings CAN_NOT_BUILD_BUILDINGS Doesn't seem to work. can_not_declare_war Can not declare wars Prevents generating wargoals, but not using existing ones. can_occupy_non_war Can hold territory owned by a country they are not at war with can_only_justify_war_on_threat_country Can justify war goals against a country that have not generated world tension can_puppet Can puppet a country can_send_volunteers Can send volunteer forces can_use_kamikaze_pilots Can use kamikaze pilots contributes_operatives Contributes Operatives to Spy Master: Yes Only has an effect for subjects. units_deployed_to_overlord Control over deployed units go to overlord Only has an effect for subjects.
zizlsk.zh: 游戏规则列表 以下游戏规则可作为选项： 内部名称 本地化名称 备注 can_access_market 可访问国际市场（傀儡国与宗主国始终可以访问彼此的市场） can_be_spymaster 可成为特工大师 can_boost_other_ideologies 可提升其他意识形态的支持率 can_boost_own_ideology 可提升本国政党在其他国家的支持率 can_create_collaboration_government 可建立合作政府 can_create_factions 可创建阵营 can_declare_war_on_same_ideology 可在没有战争目标的情况下向同一意识形态组的国家宣战 can_declare_war_without_wargoal_when_in_war 在与主要国家交战时，可在没有战争目标的情况下向邻国宣战 can_decline_call_to_war 可拒绝参战号召 can_force_government 可迫使其他国家政府采纳相同意识形态 can_generate_female_aces 允许本国女性成为军事飞行员 can_generate_female_country_leaders 可生成女性国家领袖 can_generate_female_unit_leaders 可生成女性部队指挥官 can_guarantee_other_ideologies 可保障其他意识形态 can_join_factions 可加入阵营 can_join_factions_not_allowed_diplomacy 国家名称不被允许加入阵营 can_join_opposite_factions 可加入由其他意识形态领导的阵营 can_lower_tension 通过保障独立降低世界紧张度 can_not_build_buildings CAN_NOT_BUILD_BUILDINGS 似乎不起作用。 can_not_declare_war 无法宣战 阻止制造战争目标，但不阻止使用已有战争目标。 can_occupy_non_war 可占据未与其交战的国家所拥有的领土 can_only_justify_war_on_threat_country 可对没有产生世界紧张度的国家制造战争目标 can_puppet 可将一个国家变为傀儡国 can_send_volunteers 可派遣志愿军 can_use_kamikaze_pilots 可使用神风飞行员 contributes_operatives 向特工大师提供特工：是 仅对附庸国生效。 units_deployed_to_overlord 已部署部队的控制权归宗主国 仅对附庸国生效。

1ojc642.zh: 以下游戏规则可作为选项： 内部名称 本地化名称 备注 can_access_market 可访问国际市场（傀儡国与宗主国始终可以访问彼此的市场） can_be_spymaster 可成为特工大师 can_boost_other_ideologies 可提升其他意识形态的支持率 can_boost_own_ideology 可提升本国政党在其他国家的支持率 can_create_collaboration_government 可建立合作政府 can_create_factions 可创建阵营 can_declare_war_on_same_ideology 可在没有战争目标的情况下向同一意识形态组的国家宣战 can_declare_war_without_wargoal_when_in_war 在与主要国家交战时，可在没有战争目标的情况下向邻国宣战 can_decline_call_to_war 可拒绝参战号召 can_force_government 可迫使其他国家政府采纳相同意识形态 can_generate_female_aces 允许本国女性成为军事飞行员 can_generate_female_country_leaders 可生成女性国家领袖 can_generate_female_unit_leaders 可生成女性部队指挥官 can_guarantee_other_ideologies 可保障其他意识形态 can_join_factions 可加入阵营 can_join_factions_not_allowed_diplomacy 国家名称不被允许加入阵营 can_join_opposite_factions 可加入由其他意识形态领导的阵营 can_lower_tension 通过保障独立降低世界紧张度 can_not_build_buildings CAN_NOT_BUILD_BUILDINGS 似乎不起作用。 can_not_declare_war 无法宣战 阻止制造战争目标，但不阻止使用已有战争目标。 can_occupy_non_war 可占据未与其交战的国家所拥有的领土 can_only_justify_war_on_threat_country 可对没有产生世界紧张度的国家制造战争目标 can_puppet 可将一个国家变为傀儡国 can_send_volunteers 可派遣志愿军 can_use_kamikaze_pilots 可使用神风飞行员 contributes_operatives 向特工大师提供特工：是 仅对附庸国生效。 units_deployed_to_overlord 已部署部队的控制权归宗主国 仅对附庸国生效。

1rt6t9s.en: Can access International Market (⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ can always access each other's market)
1rt6t9s.zh: 可访问国际市场（⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧始终可以访问彼此的市场）

1kxo3sk.en: Can boost popularity of other ideologies
1kxo3sk.zh: 可提升其他意识形态的支持率

36f7tg.en: Can boost own party popularity in other countries
36f7tg.zh: 可提升本国政党在其他国家的支持率

1r9kzc6.en: Can declare war on country with the same ideology group without a war goal
1r9kzc6.zh: 可在没有战争目标的情况下向同一意识形态组的国家宣战

14kvbu2.en: Can declare war on a neighbor without a wargoal when at war with a major
14kvbu2.zh: 在与主要国家交战时，可在没有战争目标的情况下向邻国宣战

6fsg1n.en: Can force government of another country to adopt the same ideology
6fsg1n.zh: 可迫使其他国家政府采纳相同意识形态

1q068xf.en: Women in your country are allowed to become military pilots
1q068xf.zh: 允许本国女性成为军事飞行员

6uxi64.zh: 可生成女性部队指挥官

a60x4n.en: ⟦0⟧ is not allowed to join factions

1nb868j.en: Can Join Factions led by another Ideology
1nb868j.zh: 可加入由其他意识形态领导的阵营

qx9ssm.zh: 通过保障独立降低世界紧张度

wh6asu.en: Prevents generating wargoals, but not using existing ones.
wh6asu.zh: 阻止制造战争目标，但不阻止使用已有战争目标。

vonqk5.en: Can hold territory owned by a country they are not at war with
vonqk5.zh: 可占据未与其交战的国家所拥有的领土

1c9uoyy.en: Can justify war goals against a country that have not generated world tension
1c9uoyy.zh: 可对没有产生世界紧张度的国家制造战争目标

z5o600.zh: 可将一个国家变为傀儡国

12zz5pp.en: Contributes Operatives to Spy Master: Yes
12zz5pp.zh: 向特工大师提供特工：是

1jo0ac1.en: Only has an effect for subjects.

15tuyrb.en: Control over deployed units go to overlord
15tuyrb.zh: 已部署部队的控制权归宗主国

1uhljay.en: ⟦0⟧ Ideology group of the party. desc = <localisation key> A description used for the rule. Optional, defaults to being the same as default. <rule> = <bool> Rule's new value.
1uhljay.zh: ⟦0⟧ 政党的意识形态组。desc = <localisation key> 用于该规则的描述。可选，默认为与 default 相同。<rule> = <bool> 规则的新值。

rv4h6j.en: Toggles the special game rules for the current scope's political party.
rv4h6j.zh: 切换当前作用域政党专属游戏规则。

towi1v.en: ⟦0⟧ Target of the rule. usage_desc = <localisation key> A description used as the reason for the rule applying. Optional. trigger = <scripted trigger> A scripted trigger deciding when the override should be active. Optional, defaults to always true. <rule> = <bool> Rule's new value.
towi1v.zh: ⟦0⟧ 规则的目标。usage_desc = <localisation key> 用作该规则生效原因的说明。可选。trigger = <scripted trigger> 决定该覆盖何时生效的脚本化触发器。可选，默认为始终为真。<rule> = <bool> 规则的新值。

ffczjm.en: Toggles the special game rules for the current scope in diplomacy towards the specified country only, if the trigger is met.
ffczjm.zh: 在满足触发器条件时，仅针对指定国家切换当前作用域在外交中的专属游戏规则。

xm2xud.en: Currently ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are supported. In case of overlap, restricting actions is preferred (e.g. ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ are preferred over the alternatives). In the scripted trigger, ⟦4⟧ is the country with the override and ⟦5⟧ is the target.
xm2xud.zh: 目前支持 ⟦0⟧ 与 ⟦1⟧。若出现重叠，优先采用限制行动的一方（例如 ⟦2⟧ 或 ⟦3⟧ 优先于对应的替代项）。在脚本化触发器中，⟦4⟧ 是拥有该覆盖的国家，⟦5⟧ 是目标。

11j4djl.en: ⟦0⟧ Target of the rule. usage_desc = <localisation key> A description used as the reason for the rule applying. Optional. trigger = <scripted trigger> A scripted trigger for identifying the relation rule. <rule> = <bool> Rule's new value.
11j4djl.zh: ⟦0⟧ 规则的目标。usage_desc = <localisation key> 用作该规则生效原因的说明。可选。trigger = <scripted trigger> 用于识别该关系规则的脚本化触发器。<rule> = <bool> 规则的新值。

1v9vt76.zh: 移除通过 ⟦0⟧ 添加的切换项。

1h3yjwa.en: Plays the specified sound once only for the current country.
1h3yjwa.zh: 仅对当前国家播放一次指定音效。

w9mj0i.en: The sound effect must be properly defined in ⟦0⟧ More info can be found in the ⟦1⟧ article.
w9mj0i.zh: 音效必须在 ⟦0⟧ 中正确定义。更多信息见 ⟦1⟧ 条目。

cdtm5m.en: Plays an audio track for the specified country only.
cdtm5m.zh: 仅对指定国家播放一段音乐。

1lw7xfh.en: The song must be defined in a music station in order to work. More information can be found in the ⟦0⟧ page. If you wish to simply play a sound, the scoped_sound_effect effect should be used instead.
1lw7xfh.zh: 歌曲必须定义在音乐电台中才能生效。更多信息见 ⟦0⟧ 页面。若只想播放音效，应改用 scoped_sound_effect 效果。

1qcqvl1.en: ⟦0⟧ The id of the province go to.

sk8ww1.en: Moves the camera position over the specified province.
sk8ww1.zh: 将镜头移动到指定省份。

6oy69u.en: ⟦0⟧ The id of the state go to.

tloo54.en: Moves the camera position over the specified state.

x9gmk8.en: Switches the player to the current scope from the target scope. Nothing happens if the target scope is controlled by AI.
x9gmk8.zh: 将玩家从目标作用域切换为当前作用域。若目标作用域由 AI 控制，则不会发生任何变化。

1jyd34f.en: ⟦0⟧ For example, ⟦1⟧ will make the player controlling XYZ play as ABC instead.
1jyd34f.zh: ⟦0⟧ 例如，⟦1⟧ 会让控制 XYZ 的玩家改为扮演 ABC。

d6f5lp.en: The country the player becomes needs to be the scope in which the command is used.
d6f5lp.zh: 玩家将要扮演的国家必须是使用该指令的作用域。

pveou0.en: Reserves the dynamic country, making sure that it does not get recycled for civil war even if it does not exist.
pveou0.zh: 保留动态国家，确保即使它不存在也不会被内战回收复用。

u6fxjc.en: ⟦0⟧ Triggers required for the map mode to refresh. Optional. mapmode = <id> The ID of the custom map mode.
u6fxjc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 地图模式刷新所需的触发器。可选。mapmode = <id> 自定义地图模式的 ID。

1e95tsu.en: Forcefully refreshes the specified mapmode for the player, rather than waiting for a daily update.
1e95tsu.zh: 为玩家强制刷新指定地图模式，而不必等待每日更新。

1xlcus9.en: ⟦0⟧ The type of strategy. id = <country> What country the strategy is against. value = <int> The weighting added by the strategy.
1xlcus9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 策略的类型。id = <country> 该策略针对哪个国家。value = <int> 该策略增加的权重。

ogstxl.en: Sets an AI strategy for the current scope.
ogstxl.zh: 为当前作用域设置 AI 策略。

y9pz2x.en: ⟦0⟧ The original tag to be used by the country. copy_tag = <tag> If specified, copies stuff from this tag rather than the original tag. <effects> Effects that will be executed on the new dynamic country.
y9pz2x.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该国家使用的原始 tag。copy_tag = <tag> 若指定，则从此 tag 而非原始 tag 复制内容。<effects> 将在新动态国家上执行的效果。

141trol.en: Creates a new dynamic country, akin to ones used in civil wars.
141trol.zh: 创建一个新的动态国家，类似内战中使用的那些。

17ouvj5.en: The ⟦0⟧ effect can be used if the dynamic country does not yet exist in order to ensure that it does not get overwritten by other creations of dynamic countries. If this is not done, the dynamic country will immediately stop existing if no states are transferred in the same scope. Every state of the original country immediately gets set as a dynamic country's core: if that's unneeded, the cores would need to be removed after creation.
17ouvj5.zh: 若动态国家尚不存在，可使用 ⟦0⟧ 效果来确保它不会被其他动态国家的创建覆盖。若不这样做，且在同一作用域内没有转移任何州，该动态国家将立即停止存在。原始国家的每个州都会立即被设为该动态国家的核心：若不需要，则需要在创建后移除这些核心。

rmu85c.en: These effects in particular are country-scoped effects that are related to states rather than effects within the state scope.
rmu85c.zh: 这些效果特别是与州相关的、以国家为作用域的效果，而非州作用域内的效果。

3qd1pj.zh: 与州相关的国家作用域效果：

uawwvm.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to add core to.

d82p9h.en: Adds a core for the current scope to the specified state.
d82p9h.zh: 为指定州添加当前作用域的核心。

1pg8aji.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to remove core from.

1en244d.en: Removes the core of the current scope from the specified state.
1en244d.zh: 从指定州移除当前作用域的核心。

t4j2ju.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to make capital. remember_old_capital = no Whether the old capital gets "remembered", making the country change to it in case the current capital is lost.
t4j2ju.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要设为首都的州。remember_old_capital = no 是否「记住」旧首都，以便在当前首都失守时改回旧首都。

10ys4et.en: Makes the specified state the current scope's capital state.
10ys4et.zh: 将指定州设为当前作用域的首都州。

1uvfzc9.en: Syntax has been changed in 1.11. It was "set_capital = 345" Old capital is remembered, if not specified otherwise.
1uvfzc9.zh: 语法在 1.11 中已更改。以前为「set_capital = 345」。如未另行指定，旧首都将被记住。

12zc0f2.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to add a claim to.

u1013q.en: Adds a claim for the current scope on the specified state.
u1013q.zh: 为当前作用域添加对指定州的宣称。

1ji1q3o.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to remove the claim from.

zvjzle.en: Removes a claim of the current scope from the specified state.
zvjzle.zh: 移除当前作用域对指定州的宣称。

iq7ji5.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to change ownership of.

uqa42j.en: Makes the current scope the owner of the specified state.
uqa42j.zh: 使当前作用域成为指定州的所有者。

16ati6i.en: This can fail to carry over the control, so it's recommended to instead use ⟦0⟧ unless transferring the ownership without transferring over the control.
16ati6i.zh: 这可能无法一并转移控制权，因此除非只想转移所有权而不转移控制权，建议改用 ⟦0⟧。

zg08om.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to change controller of.

8k4a2e.en: Makes the current scope the controller of the specified state.
8k4a2e.zh: 使当前作用域成为指定州的控制者。

1se50po.en: Adds a contested owner to a state. The effect can be used either from a country or a state scope and accepts the other as parameter.
1se50po.zh: 为州添加争夺所有者。该效果既可在国家作用域使用，也可在州作用域使用，并接受另一方作为参数。

ezwwe.en: Can also be used in state scope.

f2uw7r.en: Removes a contested owner to a state. The effect can be used either from a country or a state scope and accepts the other as parameter.
f2uw7r.zh: 移除州的一个争夺所有者。该效果既可在国家作用域使用，也可在州作用域使用，并接受另一方作为参数。

qjqiu0.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to change owner and controller of.
qjqiu0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要变更所有者和控制者的州。

1c1wb2w.en: Makes the current scope the owner and controller of the specified state.
1c1wb2w.zh: 使当前作用域成为指定州的所有者和控制者。

11l2q7r.en: ⟦0⟧ The province to change controller of.

1l9t95w.en: Changes the controller of the specified province to the current scope.
1l9t95w.zh: 将指定省份的控制者变更为当前作用域。

1ly9ubi.en: A peace conference or the controller being at peace will reset the control of the province to the owner unless the controller is at war with the owner.
1ly9ubi.zh: 和平会议或控制者处于和平状态时，会把该省份的控制权重置为所有者，除非控制者正与所有者交战。

awc4ns.en: Mana in this usage means political power, stability, war support, and other values in the topbar. Fuel is, instead, in the ⟦0⟧, while convoys can be added/removed with ⟦1⟧.
awc4ns.zh: 此处的 Mana 指政治点数、稳定度、战争支持度以及顶栏中的其他数值。燃料则位于 ⟦0⟧ 中，而运输船队可通过 ⟦1⟧ 添加或移除。

nnxjgj.zh: 与 Mana 相关的国家作用域效果：

1e4mhsk.en: Adds the specified amount of political power to the current scope.
1e4mhsk.zh: 为当前作用域添加指定数量的政治点数。

4jv8an.en: Sets the specified amount of political power for the current scope.
4jv8an.zh: 将当前作用域的政治点数设为指定数量。

mrrab7.en: Adds to the current stability value for the current scope.
mrrab7.zh: 增加当前作用域的稳定度数值。

d263c4.zh: 稳定度数值介于 0 与 1 之间。

1vcofz9.en: Sets the current stability value for the current scope.
1vcofz9.zh: 设置当前作用域的稳定度数值。

1bc77mx.en: Adds to the current war support value for the current scope.
1bc77mx.zh: 增加当前作用域的战争支持度数值。

1hy2rse.en: War Support values are between 0 and 1.
1hy2rse.zh: 战争支持度数值介于 0 与 1 之间。

12i28wf.en: Sets the current war support value for the current scope.
12i28wf.zh: 设置当前作用域的战争支持度数值。

1w36ewu.en: Adds the specified amount of command power to the current scope.
1w36ewu.zh: 为当前作用域添加指定数量的指挥点数。

xjx4c1.en: Adds the specified amount of manpower to the current scope.
xjx4c1.zh: 为当前作用域添加指定数量的人力。

yt8ohx.en: Adds the specified amount of army experience to the current scope.
yt8ohx.zh: 为当前作用域添加指定数量的陆军经验。

7exx2m.en: Adds the specified amount of navy experience to the current scope.
7exx2m.zh: 为当前作用域添加指定数量的海军经验。

wd2574.en: Adds the specified amount of air experience to the current scope.
wd2574.zh: 为当前作用域添加指定数量的空军经验。

u3h3y7.zh: 政治类国家作用域效果：

18d17cz.en: ⟦0⟧ The party to set. elections_allowed = <bool> Whether elections are allowed. Optional. last_election = <date> When the last election was. Optional. election_frequency = <int> How often in months an election occurs. Optional. long_name = <string> The long name of the country's new ruling party, appearing when hovering over it. Optional. name = <string> The name of the country's new ruling party. Optional.
18d17cz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要设置的政党。elections_allowed = <bool> 是否允许选举。可选。last_election = <date> 上次选举的时间。可选。election_frequency = <int> 选举每隔多少个月举行一次。可选。long_name = <string> 该国新执政党的全名，悬停时显示。可选。name = <string> 该国新执政党的名称。可选。

ah2ew0.en: Sets the political status of the country, including the ruling party and elections.
ah2ew0.zh: 设置该国的政治状态，包括执政党与选举。

170pztt.en: Before 1.7, included ⟦0⟧ for assigning party popularities, which has been moved to ⟦1⟧
170pztt.zh: 1.7 之前包含用于指派政党支持率的 ⟦0⟧，该功能已移至 ⟦1⟧

1ih5qls.en: Sets the political party popularities for the current scope.
1ih5qls.zh: 设置当前作用域各政党的支持率。

1nypuqa.en: The popularities must add up to 100, otherwise the command will have no effect.
1nypuqa.zh: 各支持率之和必须为 100，否则该指令不会生效。

bz5aaa.en: ⟦0⟧ The party to change. If using a tag, uses that tag's ruling party. popularity = <int> / <variable> The amount of popularity to change.
bz5aaa.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要改变的政党。若使用 tag，则采用该 tag 的执政党。popularity = <int> / <variable> 要改变的支持率数量。

ow1bj4.en: Adjusts the popularity for the specified party in the current scope.
ow1bj4.zh: 调整当前作用域中指定政党的支持率。

6uwt1t.en: Values used are 0 to 1. You can use ideology = ROOT to increase the popularity of the currently ruling party.
6uwt1t.zh: 使用的数值为 0 到 1。可使用 ideology = ROOT 来提升当前执政党的支持率。

3v4eoh.en: ⟦0⟧ The party to change. popularity = <int> The amount of popularity to set.
3v4eoh.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要改变的政党。popularity = <int> 要设置的支持率数量。

ujzxte.en: Sets the popularity for the specified political party in the current scope.
ujzxte.zh: 设置当前作用域中指定政党的支持率。

c9gpze.en: ⟦0⟧ The party to change. long_name = <string> The new full name for the party. name = <string> The new short name for the party.
c9gpze.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要改变的政党。long_name = <string> 该政党的新全名。name = <string> 该政党的新简称。

1uvf00w.en: Changes the name of the specified political party for the current scope.
1uvf00w.zh: 更改当前作用域中指定政党的名称。

ycd19a.en: The name appears in the country politics/diplomacy view, the long name appears in the tooltip when hovering over the party.
ycd19a.zh: 名称显示在国家政治/外交视图中，全名则在悬停于该政党时显示在提示框中。

5k6hm0.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to hold an election for.
5k6hm0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要为其举行选举的国家。

16cytcs.en: Executes the events in the ⟦0⟧ on action for the current scope.
16cytcs.zh: 为当前作用域执行 ⟦0⟧ 的 on action 中的事件。

1n77xdx.en: Balance of power is defined in ⟦0⟧ files.
1n77xdx.zh: 权力平衡定义于 ⟦0⟧ 文件中。

1x07rck.zh: 与权力平衡相关的国家作用域效果：

1hh1ect.en: ⟦0⟧ Balance of power to set/modify. left_side = <BoP side ID> The left side of the BoP. right_side = <BoP side ID> The right side of the BoP. set_default = <bool> Resets the BoP to the initial state defined in the file. Optional, defaults to false. set_value = <decimal> The new value of the BoP. Optional, defaults to not changing the value.
1hh1ect.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要设置/修改的权力平衡。left_side = <BoP side ID> 权力平衡的左侧。right_side = <BoP side ID> 权力平衡的右侧。set_default = <bool> 将权力平衡重置为文件中定义的初始状态。可选，默认为 false。set_value = <decimal> 权力平衡的新数值。可选，默认不改变数值。

10knqun.en: Sets a new balance of power or edits the existing one.
10knqun.zh: 设置新的权力平衡或编辑已有的权力平衡。

fhg1v6.en: Necessary for a balance of power to appear. For the default state, ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ directly inside of the BoP are read.
fhg1v6.zh: 这是权力平衡得以显示的必要条件。对于默认状态，会直接读取权力平衡内的 ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧。

qo5ssy.en: Removes the balance of power in entirety.

1ar264s.en: ⟦0⟧ Balance of power to modify. value = <decimal> The value to add. tooltip_side = <BoP side ID> The side to show in the tooltip. Optional.
1ar264s.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的权力平衡。value = <decimal> 要添加的数值。tooltip_side = <BoP side ID> 在提示框中显示的一侧。可选。

11p5srd.en: Pushes the balance of power towards one side.
11p5srd.zh: 将权力平衡推向某一侧。

1csfszn.en: ⟦0⟧ Balance of power to modify. modifier = <static modifier> The static modifier to apply.
1csfszn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的权力平衡。modifier = <static modifier> 要应用的静态修正。

1y0eflp.en: Applies a balance of power modifier.
1y0eflp.zh: 应用一个权力平衡修正。

1q5iv44.en: Cancels a balance of power modifier.
1q5iv44.zh: 取消一个权力平衡修正。

ixlj6f.en: Cancels all balance of power modifiers.
ixlj6f.zh: 取消所有权力平衡修正。

skmn37.en: ⟦0⟧ Balance of power to modify. side = <BoP side ID> The side whose GFX to change. gfx = <sprite> The sprite to change the GFX to.
skmn37.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的权力平衡。side = <BoP side ID> 要更改 GFX 的一侧。gfx = <sprite> 要将 GFX 更改为的 sprite。

1auc05q.en: Changes the appearance of one of the sides within the balance of power.
1auc05q.zh: 更改权力平衡中某一侧的外观。

1ms22dx.zh: Sprite 定义于 ⟦0⟧ 文件中。

18b42i0.en: Makes the current scope a major country.
18b42i0.zh: 使当前作用域成为主要国家。

6w4a04.en: Releases the specified non-existent country as a free nation within the current country's owned states.
6w4a04.zh: 在当前国家拥有的州内，将指定的不存在国家释放为自由国家。

1rk883p.en: The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost. If looking to make a subject into an independent nation, use set_autonomy. States that are owned but not controlled will be transferred to the released country, but won't be controlled by it.
1rk883p.zh: 若该国家已存在，该效果不会产生任何作用。指定国家拥有核心的所有州都会交给它。若当前国家在转移给该获释国家的州上拥有核心，该核心将会失去。若想把附庸国变为独立国家，请使用 set_autonomy。拥有但未控制的州会转移给该获释国家，但不会由其控制。

6w4xd9.en: Releases the specified non-existent country as a free nation within the current country's controlled states.
6w4xd9.zh: 在当前国家控制的州内，将指定的不存在国家释放为自由国家。

1woteoc.en: The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost.
1woteoc.zh: 若该国家已存在，该效果不会产生任何作用。指定国家拥有核心的所有州都会交给它。若当前国家在转移给该获释国家的州上拥有核心，该核心将会失去。

mjopzw.en: Releases the specified non-existent country as a puppet of the current scope within the current country's owned states.
mjopzw.zh: 在当前国家拥有的州内，将指定的不存在国家释放为当前作用域的傀儡国。

qumx4v.en: The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost. States that are owned but not controlled will be transferred to the released country, but won't be controlled by it.
qumx4v.zh: 若该国家已存在，该效果不会产生任何作用。指定国家拥有核心的所有州都会交给它。若当前国家在转移给该获释国家的州上拥有核心，该核心将会失去。拥有但未控制的州会转移给该获释国家，但不会由其控制。

1b384ud.en: Releases the specified non-existent country as a puppet of the current scope within the current country's controlled states.
1b384ud.zh: 在当前国家控制的州内，将指定的不存在国家释放为当前作用域的傀儡国。

126osmu.en: ⟦0⟧ The subject country. autonomy_state = <type> The type of autonomy state to set. freedom_level = <float> The new freedom level value. Optional.
126osmu.zh: ⟦0⟧ 附庸国。autonomy_state = <type> 要设置的自治状态类型。freedom_level = <float> 新的自由等级数值。可选。

1hpkk12.en: Releases the specified non-existent country as a subject of the specified autonomy of the current scope within the current country's owned states.
1hpkk12.zh: 在当前国家拥有的州内，将指定的不存在国家释放为当前作用域指定自治状态的附庸国。

18otvqw.en: The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost. States that are owned but not controlled will be transferred to the released country, but won't be controlled by it. The autonomy states are found in ⟦0⟧.
18otvqw.zh: 若该国家已存在，该效果不会产生任何作用。指定国家拥有核心的所有州都会交给它。若当前国家在转移给该获释国家的州上拥有核心，该核心将会失去。拥有但未控制的州会转移给该获释国家，但不会由其控制。自治状态见 ⟦0⟧。

16tbjhg.en: The current scope guarantees the target country.
16tbjhg.zh: 当前作用域保障目标国家的独立。

dvlj2z.en: ⟦0⟧ effect can be used to remove it.
dvlj2z.zh: 可使用 ⟦0⟧ 效果将其移除。

1vljep8.en: The current scope grants military access to the target country.
1vljep8.zh: 当前作用域给予目标国家军事通行权。

17r5p5h.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country with an attache.
17r5p5h.zh: ⟦0⟧ 派驻有武官的目标国家。

us0f72.en: Recalls the current scope's attaché from the specified country.
us0f72.zh: 从指定国家召回当前作用域的武官。

cwd5o7.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country to alter the relationship with ROOT. relation = <type> The relation to change. active = <bool> Whether the relation is started or broken.
cwd5o7.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要改变与 ROOT 关系的目标国家。relation = <type> 要改变的关系。active = <bool> 该关系是建立还是中断。

84ft2l.en: Used to define a diplomatic relation between the current scope and target scope country.
84ft2l.zh: 用于定义当前作用域与目标作用域国家之间的外交关系。

z629ij.en: Possible relations: non_aggression_pact guarantee puppet military_access docking_rights embargo air_base_access
z629ij.zh: 可能的关系：non_aggression_pact guarantee puppet military_access docking_rights embargo air_base_access

1qrz3f3.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The opinion modifier to add.
1qrz3f3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。modifier = <modifier> 要添加的舆论修正。

17l3pvz.en: The current scope gains the specified opinion modifier ⟦0⟧. Can also be used to modify trade relations by adding 'trade = yes' in the opinion <modifier> in ⟦1⟧. If used with a trade opinion_modifier the behaviour is reversed, meaning that the target gains the trade opinion towards the ⟦2⟧.
17l3pvz.zh: 当前作用域获得指定的舆论修正 ⟦0⟧。也可在 ⟦1⟧ 中的舆论 <modifier> 内加入 'trade = yes' 来修改贸易关系。若与贸易 opinion_modifier 一起使用，行为会反转，即目标国家获得对 ⟦2⟧ 的贸易舆论。

1cbd6sa.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The opinion modifier to remove.
1cbd6sa.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。modifier = <modifier> 要移除的舆论修正。

opxzls.en: The current scope loses the specified opinion modifier ⟦0⟧.
opxzls.zh: 当前作用域失去指定的舆论修正 ⟦0⟧。

7nm7pa.en: The target scope gains the specified opinion modifier ⟦0⟧.
7nm7pa.zh: 目标作用域获得指定的舆论修正 ⟦0⟧。

1awbm7h.en: Opinion modifiers are found in ⟦0⟧. Useful for when you don't know what the current scope will be.
1awbm7h.zh: 舆论修正见 ⟦0⟧。当你不确定当前作用域会是什么时很有用。

1crnach.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The relation modifier to add.
1crnach.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。modifier = <modifier> 要添加的关系修正。

1jwsv5g.en: The current scope gains the specified relation modifier ⟦0⟧.
1jwsv5g.zh: 当前作用域获得指定的关系修正 ⟦0⟧。

gi5s2f.en: Relation modifiers are found in ⟦0⟧ files, used to apply a ⟦1⟧ with a non-static target. To change the diplomatic opinion of a country, see ⟦2⟧.
gi5s2f.zh: 关系修正见 ⟦0⟧ 文件，用于施加带有非固定目标的 ⟦1⟧。若要改变某国的外交舆论，见 ⟦2⟧。

4zzw90.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The relation modifier to remove.
4zzw90.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。modifier = <modifier> 要移除的关系修正。

1r868lv.en: The current scope loses the specified relation modifier for ⟦0⟧.
1r868lv.zh: 当前作用域失去对 ⟦0⟧ 的指定关系修正。

1m9fj66.en: Relation modifiers are found in ⟦0⟧, used to apply a ⟦1⟧ with a non-static target. To change the diplomatic opinion of a country, see ⟦2⟧.
1m9fj66.zh: 关系修正见 ⟦0⟧，用于施加带有非固定目标的 ⟦1⟧。若要改变某国的外交舆论，见 ⟦2⟧。

npb80g.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. value = <0-1> How much collaboration to add.
npb80g.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。value = <0-1> 要添加多少合作度。

1c8n1au.en: Adds collaboration in TAG with the scoped country.
1c8n1au.zh: 增加 TAG 与当前作用域国家的合作度。

1a6frz5.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. value = <0-1> How much collaboration will be set.
1a6frz5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。value = <0-1> 将设置多少合作度。

9mm8dg.en: Sets the collaboration in TAG with the scoped country.
9mm8dg.zh: 设置 TAG 与当前作用域国家的合作度。

135ww42.en: Recalls volunteers sent to the specified country back to the current country.
135ww42.zh: 将派往指定国家的志愿军召回当前国家。

7ho3fg.en: ⟦0⟧ The new occupation law enacted by the previous scope or ⟦1⟧.
7ho3fg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 由前一作用域或 ⟦1⟧ 颁布的新占领法令。

q39zow.en: USA = { GER = { set_occupation_law = foreign_civilian_oversight } } # Changes USA's occupation law for GER. USA = { USA = { set_occupation_law = default_law } } # Changes the USA's default occupation law to the default.
q39zow.zh: USA = { GER = { set_occupation_law = foreign_civilian_oversight } } # 更改美国对德国的占领法令。 USA = { USA = { set_occupation_law = default_law } } # 将美国的默认占领法令改回默认值。

1whu4eo.en: Sets the occupation law of the country.

1n04jz4.en: ⟦0⟧ will be the country for whom the occupation law will be changed. If PREV is not a country, nothing changes. If PREV is the same country, changes the default occupation law. If PREV is different, default_law resets the country-specific law to the global default, otherwise it resets the default law to the occupation law with ⟦1⟧ in definition. Can also be used in state scope.
1n04jz4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将是其占领法令被更改的国家。若 PREV 不是国家，则不会发生任何变化。若 PREV 是同一个国家，则更改默认占领法令。若 PREV 不同，default_law 会把该国专属法令重置为全局默认值，否则会把默认法令重置为定义中带有 ⟦1⟧ 的占领法令。也可在州作用域使用。

soa4ja.en: USA = { GER = { set_occupation_law_where_available = foreign_civilian_oversight } } # Changes USA's occupation law for GER where possible. USA = { USA = { set_occupation_law_where_available = default_law } } # Changes the USA's default occupation law to the default where possible.
soa4ja.zh: USA = { GER = { set_occupation_law_where_available = foreign_civilian_oversight } } # 在可能的情况下更改美国对德国的占领法令。 USA = { USA = { set_occupation_law_where_available = default_law } } # 在可能的情况下将美国的默认占领法令改回默认值。

125tckl.en: Identical to ⟦0⟧, except if the law is impossible to set, tries again at every smaller sub-set: if default is impossible, tries every single individual occupied country; if the country's law is impossible to change, tries every single state within the country.
125tckl.zh: 与 ⟦0⟧ 相同，区别在于若该法令无法设置，则会尝试每一个更小的子集：若默认值不可行，则尝试每一个被占领国家；若该国法令无法更改，则尝试该国境内的每一个州。

1xdqz2p.zh: 停止对目标国家实施禁运。

1nbxga6.en: As of 1.14.7, this effect ignores country scoping and always applies to the ROOT, instead the ⟦0⟧ effect can be used to break the embargoes of other countries.
1nbxga6.zh: 自 1.14.7 起，该效果忽略国家作用域，始终作用于 ROOT，因此可改用 ⟦0⟧ 效果来解除其他国家的禁运。

3itiy3.en: Opens market access between the two countries.
3itiy3.zh: 开放两国之间的市场准入。

1o9hw2u.zh: 与阵营相关的国家作用域效果：

5p229e.en: Creates a faction with the specified name for the current scope. The current scope and any subjects automatically join the faction.
5p229e.zh: 为当前作用域创建一个指定名称的阵营。当前作用域及其所有附庸国自动加入该阵营。

ijtvyc.en: ⟦0⟧ Faction template id. OR template = <string> The template of the faction. name = <loc_key> The name of the faction. icon = <sprite> The icon of the faction. color = <int> The color of the faction in RGB format.
ijtvyc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 阵营模板 id。或 template = <string> 阵营的模板。name = <loc_key> 阵营的名称。icon = <sprite> 阵营的图标。color = <int> 阵营的颜色，RGB 格式。

onladm.en: Create a faction from a template allows for optional customization of name, icon and color.
onladm.zh: 从模板创建阵营，可选择自定义名称、图标和颜色。

hj93d5.en: ⟦0⟧ The TAG of the nation to add to the faction of the current scope.
hj93d5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要加入当前作用域阵营的国家 TAG。

51vjql.en: Adds the country to the faction of the current scope.
51vjql.zh: 将该国家加入当前作用域的阵营。

mdeud9.en: Dismantles the faction of the current scope.
mdeud9.zh: 解散当前作用域的阵营。

6ol1bj.en: Removes the current scope from the faction they are part of.
6ol1bj.zh: 使当前作用域退出其所属的阵营。

1rm2evg.en: Removes the specified scope from the faction led by the current scope.
1rm2evg.zh: 将指定作用域从当前作用域领导的阵营中移除。

1k3mhbc.en: Sets a faction name as the loc name.
1k3mhbc.zh: 将某个本地化名称设为阵营名称。

jy5d5y.en: Sets the current country as the faction leader.
jy5d5y.zh: 将当前国家设为阵营领袖。

sk1h07.en: Sets the current country as the faction spymaster.
sk1h07.zh: 将当前国家设为阵营特工大师。

120tana.en: Set a rule on the country's faction.
120tana.zh: 在该国所属阵营上设置一条规则。

awsgdb.en: Changes current country's faction manifest, the previous manifest is removed.
awsgdb.zh: 更改当前国家的阵营宣言，原有宣言会被移除。

1man65c.en: Adds a goal to the current’s country faction.
1man65c.zh: 为当前国家的阵营添加一个目标。

193nomr.en: Remove a goal from the current’s country faction.
193nomr.zh: 从当前国家的阵营中移除一个目标。

1s9gkaj.en: ⟦0⟧ The category of the faction goal. value = <int> / <variable> A value of the faction goal slot.
1s9gkaj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 阵营目标的类别。value = <int> / <variable> 阵营目标槽位的数值。

1dypl5b.en: Adds extra goal slots to the faction for a specific category.
1dypl5b.zh: 为阵营的特定类别添加额外的目标槽位。

pw3bbg.en: Adds influence to the country based on the given ratio of the faction’s total influence.
pw3bbg.zh: 按给定比例（占阵营总影响力的比例）为国家增加影响力。

tqwzac.en: Adds influence to the country in the faction.
tqwzac.zh: 为阵营中的该国家增加影响力。

1jk5s9t.en: Adds Faction Initiative points to the current country’s faction.
1jk5s9t.zh: 为当前国家所在的阵营增加阵营主动权点数。

1zu8zh.en: Adds power projection to the faction.
1zu8zh.zh: 为该阵营增加实力投射。

ctvo5t.en: Set either a member upgrade for the specified tag.
ctvo5t.zh: 为指定 tag 设置一项成员升级。

13v800u.en: Set a faction's minimal requirements for an faction member upgrade group.
13v800u.zh: 为某个阵营成员升级组设置阵营的最低要求。

4iini0.en: Sets wheter the current countries faction can make changes to the faction research section.
4iini0.zh: 设置当前国家所在阵营能否对阵营科研部分做出更改。

76tb4u.zh: 与自治度相关的国家作用域效果：

1bcacb3.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. OR target = <country> The target country. end_wars = <bool> Whether the target country will peace out in all of its non-civil wars it's participating in. Defaults to true. end_civil_wars = <bool> Whether the target country will peace out in all of its civil wars it's participating in. Defaults to true.
1bcacb3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。或 target = <country> 目标国家。end_wars = <bool> 目标国家是否将退出其参与的所有非内战战争。默认为 true。end_civil_wars = <bool> 目标国家是否将退出其参与的所有内战。默认为 true。

1uzx88r.en: Makes the specified country a subject of the current scope.
1uzx88r.zh: 使指定国家成为当前作用域的附属国。

1vd3rcc.en: The autonomous state picked is one which contains ⟦0⟧ and where ⟦1⟧ is fulfilled within the ⟦2⟧ definition, rather than necessarily being autonomy_puppet. ⟦3⟧
1vd3rcc.zh: 所选取的自治状态是满足以下条件的那一个：其中包含 ⟦0⟧，且 ⟦1⟧ 在 ⟦2⟧ 定义内得到满足，而不必是 autonomy_puppet。⟦3⟧

1yau1id.en: Results in a crash-to-desktop if the game is unable to find any such autonomous states.
1yau1id.zh: 如果游戏找不到任何此类自治状态，将导致游戏崩溃至桌面。

65poey.en: Removes the subject status between the target and the current scope.
65poey.zh: 解除目标与当前作用域之间的附属关系。

u69art.en: Must be used within the overlord's scope.
u69art.zh: 必须在宗主国的作用域内使用。

k4x78u.en: ⟦0⟧ The freedom score to add. localization = <string> The localization key for the modifier.
k4x78u.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的自由度分数。localization = <string> 该修正的本地化键。

1y1wxth.en: Adds a freedom score ratio modifier to the current scope.
1y1wxth.zh: 为当前作用域添加一个自由度分数比例修正。

18k5g2o.zh: 在附属国的作用域中使用。

16rkqez.en: Adds an exact freedom score modifier to the current scope.
16rkqez.zh: 为当前作用域添加一个确切的自由度分数修正。

knfyaw.en: ⟦0⟧ The subject country. autonomous_state = <type> The type of autonomy state to set. freedom_level = <float> The new freedom level value. Optional. end_wars = <yes/no> Will end any wars the subject is involved in. end_civil_wars = <yes/no> Will end any civil wars the subject is subject to
knfyaw.zh: ⟦0⟧ 附属国。autonomous_state = <type> 要设置的自治状态类型。freedom_level = <float> 新的自由度数值。可选。end_wars = <yes/no> 将结束该附属国参与的任何战争。end_civil_wars = <yes/no> 将结束该附属国正在经历的任何内战

4zfane.en: Sets the autonomy level for the specified country, ⟦0⟧.
4zfane.zh: 设置指定国家的自治等级，⟦0⟧。

1ckft4g.en: The autonomy_free state will free the subject, ⟦0⟧ for this to have effect. The autonomy states are found in ⟦1⟧ files. Although end_wars is an optional argument defaulting to no, omitting it results in the country's occupied states returning to its control, stranding enemy units. When setting the autonomy level in the history files, it is preferable to do it before the political effects in the subject's history file scoping to the overlord's tag, to avoid overwriting.
1ckft4g.zh: autonomy_free 状态将释放该附属国，⟦0⟧ 方能生效。自治状态可在 ⟦1⟧ 文件中找到。尽管 end_wars 是可选参数且默认为 no，但省略它会导致该国被占领的州归还其控制，从而使敌方单位滞留。在历史文件中设置自治等级时，最好在附属国历史文件的政治效果之前进行，并将作用域指向宗主国的 tag，以免被覆盖。

mibers.en: however this effect has to be executed within the scope of the target country's current overlord
mibers.zh: 不过该效果必须在目标国家当前宗主国的作用域内执行

1m6guzz.zh: 与流亡政府相关的国家作用域效果：

c3wwh2.en: Adds legitimacy to a government in exile.
c3wwh2.zh: 为流亡政府增加合法性。

1qkt16.en: Sets the legitimacy of governments in exile.
1qkt16.zh: 设置流亡政府的合法性。

1ezylyo.en: Makes a country a government in exile in a set country, with a set starting legitimacy.
1ezylyo.zh: 使某国在指定国家成为流亡政府，并设定初始合法性。

1xk4pl.en: become_exiled_in = { target = <Host tag> legitimacy = <0-100> (starting legitimacy, optional) }
1xk4pl.zh: become_exiled_in = { target = <Host tag> legitimacy = <0-100>（初始合法性，可选） }

t7waut.en: Must be fired from ROOT, the country that should be exiled, or a TAG specification must be used. This effect would not automatically force a country to capitulate.
t7waut.zh: 必须从 ROOT（即应流亡的国家）触发，或必须使用 TAG 指定。该效果不会自动迫使国家投降。

zyvsno.zh: 与战争相关的国家作用域效果：

7r1451.en: Adjusts the level of World Tension.

4jx9w3.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount to change by. name = <string> The localization string.
4jx9w3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要改变的数量。name = <string> 本地化字符串。

1aiod6i.en: Adjusts the level of World Tension and adds an entry in the World Tension tooltip.
1aiod6i.zh: 调整世界紧张度水平，并在世界紧张度提示框中添加一条记录。

15ukibf.en: ⟦0⟧ Which country to annex. transfer_troops = yes Whether to transfer the troops of the annexed country.
15ukibf.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要吞并的国家。transfer_troops = yes 是否转移被吞并国家的部队。

v8mz4f.en: Annex the specified country for the current scope.
v8mz4f.zh: 为当前作用域吞并指定国家。

fo2asa.en: Without transfering troops, the annexed country's divisions' equipment is lost.
fo2asa.zh: 若不转移部队，被吞并国家的师所拥有的装备将丢失。

1gnd1rm.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to assist. enemy = <country> The country attacking the ally. hostility_reason = <string> Localization for the reason for joining. Optional.
1gnd1rm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要援助的国家。enemy = <country> 攻击该盟友的国家。hostility_reason = <string> 参战原因的本地化。可选。

1vqcdgh.en: Forces the current scope to join the war of the specified ally against the specified enemy.
1vqcdgh.zh: 强制当前作用域加入指定盟友对抗指定敌人的战争。

1gg7fur.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to attack. type = <wargoal> The wargoal to declare with. generator = { <state id> } The states to supply the wargoal (i.e. take_state_focus).
1gg7fur.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要攻击的国家。type = <wargoal> 宣战所用的战争目标。generator = { <state id> } 为该战争目标提供的州（即 take_state_focus）。

twpadq.en: Makes the current scope declare war on the specified country with the specified wargoal.
twpadq.zh: 使当前作用域以指定的战争目标向指定国家宣战。

550ger.en: Wargoal types can be found in ⟦0⟧. See also ⟦1⟧ in order to assign a war between different countries to be a civil war.
550ger.zh: 战争目标类型可在 ⟦0⟧ 中找到。另见 ⟦1⟧，以将不同国家之间的战争指定为内战。

190tnd.en: ⟦0⟧ The scope to white peace. OR tag = <country> / <variable> The scope to white peace. message = <localisation key> The reason for peace showing up in the pop-up.
190tnd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要白色和平的作用域。或 tag = <country> / <variable> 要白色和平的作用域。message = <localisation key> 弹出窗口中显示的和平原因。

1qla896.en: Makes the current scope white peace the specified scope.
1qla896.zh: 使当前作用域与指定作用域白色和平。

14p72yi.en: ⟦0⟧ The scope to peace with. score_factor = <decimal> / <variable> The fraction of the total score awarded to the winners compared to regular victory. message = <localisation key> The reason for peace showing up in the pop-up. Optional. winner_scope = <scope type> Which countries should be present in the conference on the winner side alongside the current scope. Optional, defaults to LIMITED_FACTION. loser_scope = <scope type> Which countries should be present in the conference on the loser side alongside the target country. Optional, defaults to LIMITED_FACTION.
14p72yi.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要与之和平的作用域。score_factor = <decimal> / <variable> 与常规胜利相比，分配给胜利方的总分数比例。message = <localisation key> 弹出窗口中显示的和平原因。可选。winner_scope = <scope type> 除当前作用域外，哪些国家应出现在会议胜方一侧。可选，默认为 LIMITED_FACTION。loser_scope = <scope type> 除目标国家外，哪些国家应出现在会议败方一侧。可选，默认为 LIMITED_FACTION。

mk40gn.en: Makes the current scope start a peace conference with the specified scope on the other side.
mk40gn.zh: 使当前作用域与指定作用域开启一场和平会议，双方各居一侧。

ti58p2.en: Current scope is the winner, target and its subjects are the losers. Can only be used if at war with the target. A score_factor of 0.0 is equivalent to a whitepeace. ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ have the following possible values: ALL: all countries at war with the other side. FACTION: all countries in the same faction as the current scope or under its overlordship. LIMITED_FACTION: includes faction members if and only if the country is a faction leader, and includes subjects of the country. LIMITED: includes only subjects of the country.
ti58p2.zh: 当前作用域为胜方，目标及其附属国为败方。只有与目标处于战争状态时才能使用。score_factor 为 0.0 等同于白色和平。⟦0⟧ 与 ⟦1⟧ 具有以下可能取值：ALL：所有与另一方交战的国家。FACTION：与当前作用域同属一个阵营或处于其宗主统治下的所有国家。LIMITED_FACTION：当且仅当该国是阵营领袖时包含阵营成员，并包含该国的附属国。LIMITED：仅包含该国的附属国。

1e4uez0.en: ⟦0⟧: all countries at war with the other side.

17zjtjp.en: ⟦0⟧: all countries in the same faction as the current scope or under its overlordship.
17zjtjp.zh: ⟦0⟧：与当前作用域同属一个阵营或处于其宗主统治下的所有国家。

19zb8yj.en: ⟦0⟧: includes faction members if and only if the country is a faction leader, and includes subjects of the country.
19zb8yj.zh: ⟦0⟧：当且仅当该国是阵营领袖时包含阵营成员，并包含该国的附属国。

1skj3j2.en: ⟦0⟧: includes only subjects of the country.

1xcjm3u.en: ⟦0⟧ The scope to truce with. days = <int> The duration of the truce.
1xcjm3u.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要停战的作用域。days = <int> 停战的持续天数。

k83d5m.en: Makes the current scope truce with the specified scope.
k83d5m.zh: 使当前作用域与指定作用域停战。

1actzxf.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to target. type = <wargoal> The wargoal to generate. generator = { <state id> } The states to supply the wargoal (i.e. take_state_focus). expire = 365 The amount of days that the wargoal will last before expiring. If unset or set to 0, will never expire.
1actzxf.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要作为目标的国家。type = <wargoal> 要生成的战争目标。generator = { <state id> } 为该战争目标提供的州（即 take_state_focus）。expire = 365 战争目标在失效前持续的天数。若未设置或设为 0，则永不失效。

3yhozo.en: Grants the current scope a wargoal against the specified country.
3yhozo.zh: 授予当前作用域对指定国家的战争目标。

adaqn2.en: Wargoal types can be found in ⟦0⟧
adaqn2.zh: 战争目标类型可在 ⟦0⟧ 中找到

nuqyj6.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to target. type = <wargoal> The wargoal to remove. "all" will remove all wargoals.
nuqyj6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要作为目标的国家。type = <wargoal> 要移除的战争目标。"all" 将移除所有战争目标。

k2ugdy.en: Removes wargoals from the current scope to the specified country.
k2ugdy.zh: 移除当前作用域对指定国家的战争目标。

h4o2wj.en: ⟦0⟧ The ideology of the breakaway country. ruling_party = <ideology> Changes the ideology of the original, player-led country, if set. Optional. size = <float> The size of the breakaway country and the fraction of the original stockpile and military units it will receive by default. Optional, defaults to 0.5. army_ratio = <float> The size of the land army that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. navy_ratio = <float> The size of the naval forces that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. air_ratio = <float> The size of the airforce that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. capital = <state> The capital state of the breakaway country. Optional. states = { <state> } The states included in the breakway country. Optional, defaults to random states based off size. all will result in all states that meet the filter going to the breakaway. states_filter = { <triggers> } A trigger block checked for the state that must be met to be transferred to the breakaway. Optional. keep_unit_leaders = { <unit leader id> } List of unit leaders to be kept by their legacy_id. Optional. keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { <triggers> } Trigger block checked for every unit leader that forces them to be kept if they meet the triggers. The default scope is the unit leader, ROOT is the country receiving the unit leader, while FROM is the original owner of the unit leader. Optional. keep_scientists_trigger = { <triggers> } Trigger for scientist to remain with the original country. keep_political_leader = <bool> Controls if the promoted party leader (i.e. the one that'd take power if the country were to be switched to that ideology group) of the revolting ideology group will be kept by the country or join the revolt, yes resulting in the former. Optional, defaults to false. keep_political_party_members = <bool> Controls if non-promoted party leaders of the revolting ideology group will be kept by the country or join the revolt, yes resulting in the former. Optional, defaults to false. keep_all_characters = yes If true, the revolter will have no characters from the original country transferred to them. Optional, defaults to false. <effects> An effect block executed for the breakaway country.
h4o2wj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 分离国家的意识形态。ruling_party = <ideology> 若设置，则改变原国家（玩家领导的国家）的意识形态。可选。size = <float> 分离国家的大小，以及它默认获得的原库存与军事单位的比例。可选，默认为 0.5。army_ratio = <float> 分离国家获得的陆军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。navy_ratio = <float> 分离国家获得的海军兵力规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。air_ratio = <float> 分离国家获得的空军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。capital = <state> 分离国家的首都州。可选。states = { <state> } 分离国家所包含的州。可选，默认根据 size 随机选取州。all 将导致所有符合筛选条件的州都归分离国家。states_filter = { <triggers> } 针对州检查的触发块，必须满足才能被移交给分离国家。可选。keep_unit_leaders = { <unit leader id> } 要保留的部队领袖列表，按其 legacy_id 指定。可选。keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { <triggers> } 针对每个部队领袖检查的触发块，满足触发条件即强制保留他们。默认作用域为部队领袖，ROOT 为接收该部队领袖的国家，而 FROM 为该部队领袖的原所属国。可选。keep_scientists_trigger = { <triggers> } 科学家留在原国家的触发条件。keep_political_leader = <bool> 控制叛乱意识形态集团的已晋升党派领袖（即若该国改换至该意识形态集团时会掌权的那位）将由国家保留还是加入叛乱，yes 表示前者。可选，默认为 false。keep_political_party_members = <bool> 控制叛乱意识形态集团的未晋升党派领袖将由国家保留还是加入叛乱，yes 表示前者。可选，默认为 false。keep_all_characters = yes 若为 true，叛乱方将不会从原国家获得任何人物。可选，默认为 false。<effects> 为分离国家执行的效果块。

137iyjr.zh: 原国家（玩家领导的国家）

1uktj9f.en: start_civil_war = { ruling_party = communism # Original country's ideology changes to communism ideology = ROOT # Breakaway gets old ideology of ROOT size = 0.8 capital = 282 states = { 282 533 536 555 529 530 528 } keep_unit_leaders = { 750 751 752 } keep_political_leader = yes keep_political_party_members = yes } start_civil_war = { ideology = democratic size = 0.1 states = all states_filter = { is_on_continent = europe is_capital = no } set_country_flag = TAG_my_country_tag_alias_trigger # Sets a country flag that gets used in a country tag alias. } (See country tag aliases) start_civil_war = { ideology = neutrality size = 0.1 army_ratio = 0.5 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { has_trait = my_trait_name } keep_all_characters = yes PREV = { # Original country TAG_airforce_leader = { # Character set_nationality = PREV.PREV # Transfers to breakaway } } promote_character = TAG_airforce_leader } (See usage for PREV and PREV.PREV)
1uktj9f.zh: start_civil_war = { ruling_party = communism # 原国家的意识形态变为共产主义 ideology = ROOT # 分离方获得 ROOT 原有的意识形态 size = 0.8 capital = 282 states = { 282 533 536 555 529 530 528 } keep_unit_leaders = { 750 751 752 } keep_political_leader = yes keep_political_party_members = yes } start_civil_war = { ideology = democratic size = 0.1 states = all states_filter = { is_on_continent = europe is_capital = no } set_country_flag = TAG_my_country_tag_alias_trigger # 设置一个用于国家 tag 别名的国家标记。 }（见国家 tag 别名） start_civil_war = { ideology = neutrality size = 0.1 army_ratio = 0.5 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { has_trait = my_trait_name } keep_all_characters = yes PREV = { # 原国家 TAG_airforce_leader = { # 人物 set_nationality = PREV.PREV # 转移至分离方 } } promote_character = TAG_airforce_leader }（见 PREV 与 PREV.PREV 的用法）

4e5jys.en: See usage for PREV and PREV.PREV
4e5jys.zh: 见 PREV 与 PREV.PREV 的用法

11haa9a.en: Starts a civil war for the current scope with the specified parameters.
11haa9a.zh: 按指定参数为当前作用域发动一场内战。

1sbszs7.en: ⟦0⟧ would include every single state controlled by the country. ⟦1⟧. ⟦2⟧ can be used to change the capital beforehand, with ⟦3⟧ being used to set it back to the default after the civil war ends. Elections will always be disallowed for the breakaway. If the ruling_party attribute is used, the original country will have its elections disallowed. In the base game files, an on action is set up to ensure that elections get allowed if the democratic side wins the civil war. A civil war started via this effect cannot have more than two sides and the effect cannot be used in history or bookmark's effect = { ... }. For adding more sides or starting one before the game's start, this can be simulated by setting an existing war (typically originating from a dynamic country created via create_dynamic_country) as a civil war via add_civil_war_target.
1sbszs7.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将包含该国控制的每一个州。⟦1⟧。⟦2⟧ 可用于事先更改首都，⟦3⟧ 用于在内战结束后将其设回默认值。分离方的选举将始终被禁止。若使用 ruling_party 属性，原国家的选举也将被禁止。在原版游戏文件中，设置了一个 on action 以确保民主主义一方赢得内战时会重新允许选举。通过该效果发动的内战不能超过两方，且该效果不能用于历史文件或书签的 effect = { ... }。若要添加更多方或在游戏开始前发动内战，可以通过 add_civil_war_target 将一场已有的战争标记为内战来模拟（该战争通常源自通过 create_dynamic_country 创建的动态国家）。

15wof6k.en: If the country's current capital state is set as one of the states that the revolt can gain, it won't fire
15wof6k.zh: 若该国当前的首都州被设为叛乱可能获得的州之一，则不会触发

1s371bv.en: ⟦0⟧ - The country to set as the target.

1mmfir1.en: Sets that the war between ROOT and TAG is a civil war, resulting in the victory being the annexation of the other side and setting world tension limits on intervention.
1mmfir1.zh: 设置 ROOT 与 TAG 之间的战争为内战，其结果是胜利方吞并另一方，并对干预设置世界紧张度限制。

u7lj8q.en: ROOT and TAG must already be at war with each other for the effect to take place.
u7lj8q.zh: ROOT 与 TAG 必须已处于相互交战状态，该效果才会生效。

b14vi7.en: Removes the status of the war as a civil war between the pair of countries.
b14vi7.zh: 解除这对国家之间的战争的内战状态。

1g3ug43.en: The ongoing war must already be marked as a civil war, whether it was initiated by ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ was used to mark it as one.
1g3ug43.zh: 正在进行的战争必须已被标记为内战，无论它是由 ⟦0⟧ 发动的，还是使用 ⟦1⟧ 将其标记为内战的。

16sdb4h.en: ⟦0⟧ The country which should receive the units from the current scope. size = <float> The size of the breakaway country and the fraction of the original stockpile and military units it will receive by default. Optional, defaults to 0.5. army_ratio = <float> The size of the land army that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. navy_ratio = <float> The size of the naval forces that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. air_ratio = <float> The size of the airforce that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. keep_unit_leaders = { <unit leader id> } List of unit leaders to be kept by their legacy_id. Optional. keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { <triggers> } Trigger block checked for every unit leader that forces them to be kept if they meet the triggers. The default scope is the unit leader, ROOT is the country receiving the unit leader, while FROM is the original owner of the unit leader. Optional.
16sdb4h.zh: ⟦0⟧ 应接收当前作用域部队的国家。size = <float> 分离国家的大小，以及它默认获得的原库存与军事单位的比例。可选，默认为 0.5。army_ratio = <float> 分离国家获得的陆军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。navy_ratio = <float> 分离国家获得的海军兵力规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。air_ratio = <float> 分离国家获得的空军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。keep_unit_leaders = { <unit leader id> } 要保留的部队领袖列表，按其 legacy_id 指定。可选。keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { <triggers> } 针对每个部队领袖检查的触发块，满足触发条件即强制保留他们。默认作用域为部队领袖，ROOT 为接收该部队领袖的国家，而 FROM 为该部队领袖的原所属国。可选。

4dcmjn.en: Transfers a fraction of the military to a target, including units (either type: land, navy, or air), equipment, and unit leaders.
4dcmjn.zh: 将一部分军事力量转移给目标，包括部队（陆、海、空任一类型）、装备和部队领袖。

1f75wuo.en: Adds nuclear bomb to TAG's stockpile.
1f75wuo.zh: 向 TAG 的库存中添加核弹。

iil7f1.en: Adds specified number of nukes to the country's stockpile
iil7f1.zh: 向该国的库存中添加指定数量的核弹

gio4tm.en: Needs the Nuke tech to use.
gio4tm.zh: 需要拥有核科技才能使用。
