cy8w51.en: ⟦0⟧ The specific province to nuke. state = <ID> The state to nuke. controller = <TAG> Prioritises provinces controlled by this country. use_nuke = <boolean> Whether a nuke should be deducted from the country's stockpile. Defaults to false. nuke_type = <nuke_type> type of nuke to use (e.g. nuclear_bomb, thermonuclear_bomb etc.)
cy8w51.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要核击的特定省份。state = <ID> 要核击的州。controller = <TAG> 优先选择该国控制的省份。use_nuke = <boolean> 是否从该国库存中扣除一枚核弹。默认为 false。nuke_type = <nuke_type> 要使用的核弹类型（例如 nuclear_bomb、thermonuclear_bomb 等）

wx7a0n.en: Nukes the specified province or a province in the needed state. If a state is set rather than the specific province, first prioritises the country set in ⟦0⟧, then prioritises the countries at war with the current scope, and then countries that are neutral.
wx7a0n.zh: 对指定省份或所需州内的某个省份实施核击。若设置的是州而非特定省份，则优先选择 ⟦0⟧ 中设置的国家，其次优先选择与当前作用域交战的国家，然后选择中立国家。

1l737fz.en: If set to use a nuke, then requires at least one nuclear bomb in the stockpile.
1l737fz.zh: 若设置为使用核弹，则库存中至少需要一枚核弹。

1sz0x0.zh: 与资源相关的国家作用域效果：

1umlvez.en: ⟦0⟧ The resource to add. amount = <int> The amount of resource to add. state = <id>Which state to add the resource to. Variables can be used. show_state_in_tooltip = <bool> Whether the state should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.
1umlvez.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的资源。amount = <int> 要添加的资源数量。state = <id>要向哪个州添加资源。可使用变量。show_state_in_tooltip = <bool> 是否在提示框中显示该州。默认为 true。

wqb4nr.en: Adds the specified resource in the specified amount to the specified state.
wqb4nr.zh: 向指定州添加指定数量的指定资源。

1n9dh5f.en: ⟦0⟧ The resource to import. amount = <int> The amount of resource to import. exporter = <id>Which country exports the resource.
1n9dh5f.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要进口的资源。amount = <int> 要进口的资源数量。exporter = <id>哪个国家出口该资源。

18y59zr.en: Creates an import for the current scope with the specified resource and from the specified exporter.
18y59zr.zh: 为当前作用域创建一项进口，使用指定资源并来自指定出口国。

1747x1u.en: ⟦0⟧ The country that would get the resource rights. state = <state> The state where the resource rights are located. resources = { <resource> <...> <resource> } The resources to which give resource rights to. Optional, defaults to all.
1747x1u.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将获得资源开采权的国家。state = <state> 资源开采权所在的州。resources = { <resource> <...> <resource> } 授予资源开采权所针对的资源。可选，默认为全部。

nuxs4a.en: Gives all the resources of a state to the target country
nuxs4a.zh: 将某个州的所有资源给予目标国家

vvcwho.en: The resource rights will only be provided as long as the current country controls the state with resource rights.
vvcwho.zh: 只要当前国家控制着拥有资源开采权的州，资源开采权就会持续提供。

saut85.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to remove current country's resource rights from.
saut85.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除当前国家资源开采权的州。

1ic30jo.zh: 移除给定的资源开采权

twvd6q.en: Adds fuel to the current country.

4fjd2d.zh: 设置该国当前的燃料数量。

192724c.en: Set country's current fuel ratio relative to its capacity.
192724c.zh: 设置该国当前燃料占其容量的比例。

1imln8k.zh: 与建筑相关的国家作用域效果：

4x1sie.en: ⟦0⟧ The building to add. level = <level> / <variable> The maximum level to add.
4x1sie.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的建筑。level = <level> / <variable> 要添加的最高等级。

obh9do.en: Adds an off-map (offmap) building for the current scope that produces its effects without being present in a state.
obh9do.zh: 为当前作用域添加一座地图外（offmap）建筑，其效果无需存在于某个州中即可产生。

jefz4x.en: ⟦0⟧ The building to modify. resource = <resource> The resource to add. amount = <amount> The amount of resource to add.
jefz4x.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的建筑。resource = <resource> 要添加的资源。amount = <amount> 要添加的资源数量。

m41az2.en: Modifies the resource output of the specified building for the current scope.
m41az2.zh: 修改指定建筑为当前作用域提供的资源产出。

1vzhzfj.en: ⟦0⟧ The building to damage. state = <id> / <variable> The state to target. tags = <building_tag> The buildings with this tag to damage. tags = { <building_tag> } The buildings with these tags to damage. repair_speed_modifier = <float> Repair will be x% slower until building is fully repaired damage = <float> The amount of damage to inflict. province = <id> / <variable> The province to target for provincal buildings.
1vzhzfj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要破坏的建筑。state = <id> / <variable> 要作为目标的州。tags = <building_tag> 要破坏的带有该标签的建筑。tags = { <building_tag> } 要破坏的带有这些标签的建筑。repair_speed_modifier = <float> 在建筑完全修复前，修复速度将减慢 x%。damage = <float> 要造成的破坏量。province = <id> / <variable> 省级建筑要作为目标的省份。

3apu06.en: Damages a building in a targeted state or province.
3apu06.zh: 破坏目标州或省份中的一座建筑。

10dfswj.en: The health of buildings is determined by the ⟦0⟧ attribute in a building's definition. This is multiplied by their level to get their total health. Can also be used in state scope.
10dfswj.zh: 建筑的生命值由建筑定义中的 ⟦0⟧ 属性决定。该值乘以其等级即为其总生命值。也可在州作用域中使用。

1sfen8u.zh: 与国策相关的国家作用域效果：

c78y7f.en: ⟦0⟧ The national focus tree to load. OR tree = <focus tree ID> The national focus tree to load. keep_completed = <bool> Whether focuses shared between the old and new trees should stay completed. Defaults to false. copy_completed_from = <tag> Copy completed focus from an existing country.
c78y7f.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要加载的国策树。或 tree = <focus tree ID> 要加载的国策树。keep_completed = <bool> 新旧国策树共有的焦点是否应保持已完成状态。默认为 false。copy_completed_from = <tag> 从现有国家复制已完成的焦点。

r4xm1x.en: Loads a new focus tree for the current scope, retaining any shared focuses if set.
r4xm1x.zh: 为当前作用域加载新的国策树，若设置则保留所有共有的焦点。

g0o3o7.en: Focuses that aren't present in the newly-loaded tree will not be kept as completed for ⟦0⟧ checks or when loading the old tree back.
g0o3o7.zh: 新加载的国策树中不存在的焦点将不会保持为已完成状态，无论是对于 ⟦0⟧ 检查，还是在重新加载旧国策树时。

87mwuv.en: Bypasses the specified focus for the current scope (marks as complete without firing ⟦0⟧ of the focus).
87mwuv.zh: 为当前作用域跳过指定焦点（标记为已完成，但不触发该焦点的 ⟦0⟧）。

10x4i7r.en: ⟦0⟧ The focus to complete. OR focus = <focus> The focus to complete. use_side_message = <bool> Create popup notification in the bottom right that includes originator_name instead of normal focus popup. originator_name = <string> Used for tooltip only.
10x4i7r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要完成的焦点。或 focus = <focus> 要完成的焦点。use_side_message = <bool> 在右下角创建弹出通知，其中包含 originator_name，而非普通的焦点弹出窗口。originator_name = <string> 仅用于提示框。

g4h0kf.en: Completes the specified focus for the current scope.
g4h0kf.zh: 为当前作用域完成指定焦点。

1eckel3.en: In 1.15 block version was added, 'originator_name' can be TAG, character, state, or any other localization key.
1eckel3.zh: 在 1.15 中加入了 block 版本，'originator_name' 可以是 TAG、人物、州或任何其他本地化键。

89fr2r.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 默认为 "no"。可选。⟦2⟧ 默认为 "no"。可选。

83ihiu.en: Removes a focus from list of completed focus, and potentially all focuses requiring it as a prerequisite. If the focus has one, the 'on_uncomplete' effect will be executed on each uncompleted focus.
83ihiu.zh: 从已完成焦点列表中移除一个焦点，并可能移除所有以它为前置条件的焦点。若该焦点拥有 'on_uncomplete' 效果，则会在每个被取消完成的焦点上执行该效果。

1esf9v7.en: Refreshes the focus tree for the specified country, restarting the checks in ⟦0⟧ and position offsets for focuses.
1esf9v7.zh: 刷新指定国家的国策树，重新开始 ⟦0⟧ 中的检查以及焦点的位置偏移。

1ciqxg0.en: If put within a focus' completion reward, the focus will not be marked as complete at the time the effect is executed, leading to ⟦0⟧ checks specifying that focus in particular to be marked as false. This can be bypassed by putting an effect within a hidden event fired immediately within the focus or by reloading the same focus tree with load_focus_tree set to keep completed focuses, marking the focus as complete, before using the effect.
1ciqxg0.zh: 若放在某个焦点的完成奖励中，该效果执行时该焦点尚未被标记为已完成，这会导致指定该焦点的 ⟦0⟧ 检查被标记为 false。可以通过在该焦点内立即触发的隐藏事件中放置效果，或在效果生效前用 load_focus_tree 并将保留已完成焦点设为启用，重新加载同一国策树以将该焦点标记为已完成，从而绕过此问题。

ppltgb.en: ⟦0⟧ The focus to activate a shine effect on.
ppltgb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要激活闪光效果的焦点。

14sut8a.en: Activates the shine effect on the focus with the given id. Focuses that are completed cannot have an activated shine effect.
14sut8a.zh: 在具有给定 id 的焦点上激活闪光效果。已完成的焦点无法拥有已激活的闪光效果。

gig0c5.en: Tooltips are only shown in debug mode. Can be used to simulate work on more than one focus at a time.
gig0c5.zh: 提示框仅在调试模式下显示。可用于模拟同时研究多个焦点。

1mltpga.en: ⟦0⟧ The focus to deactivate a shine effect on.
1mltpga.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要取消闪光效果的焦点。

m5o5g1.en: Deactivate the shine effect on the focus with the given id. The current focus cannot have it's shine effect removed.
m5o5g1.zh: 在具有给定 id 的焦点上取消闪光效果。当前正在研究的焦点无法移除其闪光效果。

1252vxt.en: Tooltips are only shown in debug mode.
1252vxt.zh: 提示框仅在调试模式下显示。

23tyxb.en: ⟦0⟧ The focus to reduce cost time. cost = <int> / <variable> Time to reduce (in days).
23tyxb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要减少耗时成本的焦点。cost = <int> / <variable> 要减少的时间（以天计）。

1gc3efu.en: Reduce the cost needed to complete a specific focus. The cost accepts script constants. The focus can be a uniform list or a single token.
1gc3efu.zh: 减少完成特定焦点所需的成本。该成本接受脚本常量。焦点可以是统一列表或单个 token。

lzyxqm.zh: 与决议相关的国家作用域效果：

1aougpr.en: Activates the specified decision for the current scope, ignoring triggers for the decision.
1aougpr.zh: 为当前作用域激活指定决议，忽略该决议的触发条件。

9h9q5d.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to target. decision = <decision> The decision to activate.
9h9q5d.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要作为目标的国家。decision = <decision> 要激活的决议。

1pam2rm.en: Activates the specified targeted decision for the specified target for the current scope.
1pam2rm.zh: 为当前作用域对指定目标激活指定的目标决议。

mpnp0q.en: Decisions are found in ⟦0⟧Only works on missions; regular decisions targeted this way become visible but do not activate.
mpnp0q.zh: 决议可在 ⟦0⟧ 中找到仅对任务有效；以此方式作为目标的普通决议会变为可见，但不会激活。

2z4lli.en: Removes the specified targeted decision for the current scope.
2z4lli.zh: 为当前作用域移除指定的目标决议。

1p461e5.en: ⟦0⟧ The decision to display. <show_effect_tooltip> Show decision effects (default is no) <show_modifiers> Show decision modifiers. (default is no)
1p461e5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要显示的决议。<show_effect_tooltip> 显示决议效果（默认为 no）<show_modifiers> 显示决议修正。（默认为 no）

balwh5.en: Displays a special tooltip for the specified decision in the effect tooltip.
balwh5.zh: 在效果提示框中为指定决议显示特殊提示框。

sid7wr.en: Displays a special tooltip for the specified decision category in the effect tooltip.
sid7wr.zh: 在效果提示框中为指定决议类别显示特殊提示框。

16ixhal.zh: 决议类别可在 ⟦0⟧ 中找到

bglw9s.en: ⟦0⟧ The decision to add days to. days = <int> The number of days to add to the decision.
bglw9s.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要增加天数的决议。days = <int> 要为该决议增加的天数。

1hphu5y.en: Adds the number of days to the timer created by a decision's days_remove. Does not work with variables.
1hphu5y.zh: 为决议的 days_remove 所创建的计时器增加天数。不适用于变量。

ct463j.en: Allows to remove specified decision without running remove_effect.
ct463j.zh: 允许在不运行 remove_effect 的情况下移除指定决议。

11t8oxo.en: ⟦0⟧ The decision that is to be removed.

108x84o.en: If the decision is on cooldown, it gets removed, in order to reactivate or remove completely.
108x84o.zh: 若该决议处于冷却中，则将其移除，以便重新激活或彻底移除。

1l2nmtc.zh: 与任务相关的国家作用域效果：

14avocd.en: Activates the specified mission for the current scope, ignoring any triggers for the decision.
14avocd.zh: 为当前作用域激活指定任务，忽略该决议的任何触发条件。

qja9mf.en: Displays a special tooltip for the specified mission in the effect tooltip.
qja9mf.zh: 在效果提示框中为指定任务显示特殊提示框。

1619vkm.en: Removes the specified mission for the current scope.
1619vkm.zh: 为当前作用域移除指定任务。

bsncvv.en: ⟦0⟧ The mission to add days to. days = <int> / <variable> The number of days to add to the mission.
bsncvv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要增加天数的任务。days = <int> / <variable> 要为该任务增加的天数。

odr6mf.en: Adds the number of days to the specified mission.

1oy3gki.zh: 与科技相关的国家作用域效果：

yfzo25.en: ⟦0⟧ The number of slots to add or remove.
yfzo25.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加或移除的科研槽数量。

1k85dxj.en: Adjusts the number of research slots the current scope has. Can remove slots with negatives.
1k85dxj.zh: 调整当前作用域拥有的科研槽数量。可用负值移除科研槽。

ta4zjt.en: ⟦0⟧ The number of slots to set.

16xlwtx.en: Sets the number of research slots the current scope has.
16xlwtx.zh: 设置当前作用域拥有的科研槽数量。

m3fe3w.en: ⟦0⟧ The bonus to technology given, default 0. uses = <int> The amount of times the bonus can be used, default 1. ahead_reduction = <float> The cost reduction if ahead of time, default 0. category = <string> Which technology category the bonus applies to. Multiple can be defined. technology = <string> Which technology the bonus applies to. Multiple can be defined. name = <string> Tooltip shown in research tabs, optional.
m3fe3w.zh: ⟦0⟧ 所给予的科技加成，默认为 0。uses = <int> 该加成可使用的次数，默认为 1。ahead_reduction = <float> 超前研究时的成本削减，默认为 0。category = <string> 该加成适用的科技类别。可定义多个。technology = <string> 该加成适用的科技。可定义多个。name = <string> 显示在科研标签页中的提示框，可选。

15pv8cf.en: Grants a research bonus to the current scope with the specified parameters.
15pv8cf.zh: 按指定参数为当前作用域授予科研加成。

1qz0kcn.en: Research bonus categories are defined in ⟦0⟧ files, while technologies are defined in ⟦1⟧ files.
1qz0kcn.zh: 科研加成类别定义在 ⟦0⟧ 文件中，而科技定义在 ⟦1⟧ 文件中。

10hyhzi.en: ⟦0⟧ The technology to add. ⟦1⟧ To not show the popup after adding technology
10hyhzi.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的科技。⟦1⟧ 添加科技后不显示弹出窗口

hn074w.en: Grants the specified technology to the current scope.
hn074w.zh: 为当前作用域授予指定科技。

dntlvm.en: A value of 1 sets the technology. A value of 0 removes the technology, but if it is a researchable technology, the duration it takes to research isn't reset, meaning it can be researched in 1 day. Technologies that are mutually exclusive with other technologies can not be removed by this effect. Technologies are defined in ⟦0⟧ files. To show the effects of the technology use custom_effect_tooltip = tech_effect|<technology_token>
dntlvm.zh: 数值 1 设置该科技。数值 0 移除该科技，但若它是可研究的科技，其研究所需时长不会被重置，意味着它可在 1 天内研究完成。与其他科技互斥的科技无法通过该效果移除。科技定义在 ⟦0⟧ 文件中。要显示该科技的效果，请使用 custom_effect_tooltip = tech_effect|<technology_token>

1ars935.en: ⟦0⟧ The group to add the current scope to.
1ars935.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将当前作用域加入的组。

1ogj9xw.en: Adds the current scope to the specified technology sharing group.
1ogj9xw.zh: 将当前作用域加入指定的科技共享组。

18egr05.en: Technology sharing groups are found in ⟦0⟧
18egr05.zh: 科技共享组可在 ⟦0⟧ 中找到

v3o4yv.en: ⟦0⟧ The group to remove the current scope from.
v3o4yv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将当前作用域移出的组。

6g30c0.en: Removes the current scope from the specified technology sharing group.
6g30c0.zh: 将「当前作用域」从指定的科技共享组中移除。

1uh6zrn.en: ⟦0⟧ The group to modify. bonus = <float> The new bonus.
1uh6zrn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的组。bonus = <float> 新的加成。

26p3db.en: Modifies the specified technology sharing group.
26p3db.zh: 修改指定的科技共享组。

1yljgub.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to inherit technology from.

1mkkx4k.en: Makes the current country's researched technologies be copied from the specified country.
1mkkx4k.zh: 使当前国家已研究的科技从指定国家复制而来。

1h21l3t.en: Useful when making a country independent.
1h21l3t.zh: 在使一个国家独立时很有用。

m2oetb.en: Forces the refresh of the hidden technologies for the scoped country.
m2oetb.zh: 强制刷新作用域国家的隐藏科技。

1tvjfo.en: This includes national spirits, laws, designers, and advisors. (using the idea_token)
1tvjfo.zh: 包括国家精神、法令、设计商和顾问。（使用 idea_token）

4mssoj.zh: 与理念相关的国家作用域效果：

c91983.en: Adds the specified ideas to the current scope.
c91983.zh: 将指定的理念添加到「当前作用域」。

hfx1uk.en: Can be used as a scope to add multiple at once. If used to add ideas from categories where only one slot exists, it will replace any existing idea.
hfx1uk.zh: 可作为作用域一次添加多个。如果用于添加仅有单个槽位的类别中的理念，会替换掉任何已存在的理念。

1g2luuj.en: ⟦0⟧ The idea to add. days = <int> / <variable> The number of days to add the idea for. months = <int> / <variable> The number of months to add the idea for. A month is equal to 30 days. years = <int> / <variable> The number of years to add the idea for. A year is equal to 365 days.
1g2luuj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的理念。days = <int> / <variable> 添加该理念的天数。months = <int> / <variable> 添加该理念的月数。一个月等于 30 天。years = <int> / <variable> 添加该理念的年数。一年等于 365 天。

1g8i6js.en: Adds the specified ideas to the current scope for the specified number of days.
1g8i6js.zh: 将指定的理念添加到「当前作用域」，持续指定的天数。

nv7gff.en: Either one of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, or ⟦2⟧ is mandatory. The tooltip will use the exact same phrasing in years/months/days as used in the attributes.
nv7gff.zh: ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ 三者中必须指定一个。提示框将使用与属性中完全相同的年/月/日措辞。

1o4tljr.en: ⟦0⟧ The idea to modify. days = <int> / <variable> The number of days to modify the idea by. months = <int> / <variable> The number of months to modify the idea by. A month is equal to 30 days. years = <int> / <variable> The number of years to modify the idea by. A year is equal to 365 days.
1o4tljr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的理念。days = <int> / <variable> 修改该理念天数的数值。months = <int> / <variable> 修改该理念月数的数值。一个月等于 30 天。years = <int> / <variable> 修改该理念年数的数值。一年等于 365 天。

1k4c8ju.en: Extends or shortens the duration of the timed idea by the specified amount.
1k4c8ju.zh: 按指定数值延长或缩短限时理念的持续时间。

weriet.en: Positives add to the time, negatives shorten it. Either one of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, or ⟦2⟧ is mandatory. The tooltip will use the exact same phrasing in years/months/days as used in the attributes.
weriet.zh: 正值增加时间，负值缩短时间。⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ 三者中必须指定一个。提示框将使用与属性中完全相同的年/月/日措辞。

g64dxn.en: ⟦0⟧ The idea to add. remove_idea = <idea> The idea to remove.
g64dxn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的理念。remove_idea = <idea> 要移除的理念。

wiczkw.en: Switches two ideas with a tooltip displaying any modifier differences between them.
wiczkw.zh: 交换两个理念，并在提示框中显示两者之间的任何修正差异。

1sipnc8.en: If the ideas have the same name in the localisation, it will show up as modifying the idea rather than swapping them. The add will occur before the removal of the old idea.
1sipnc8.zh: 如果这些理念在本地化中同名，则会显示为修改该理念而非交换它们。添加会在移除旧理念之前进行。

zs5obm.en: Removes the specified idea from the current scope.
zs5obm.zh: 从「当前作用域」移除指定的理念。

3v1q75.en: Can be used as a scope to remove multiple at once.
3v1q75.zh: 可作为作用域一次移除多个。

fkd53.en: Removes all ideas for the current scope that use the specified trait.
fkd53.zh: 移除「当前作用域」中所有使用指定特质的理念。

cik1a0.en: Displays the specified idea in the tooltip for the current effect scope. Does not add the idea.
cik1a0.zh: 在「当前效果作用域」的提示框中显示指定的理念。不会添加该理念。

jkykxm.zh: 与单位相关的国家作用域效果：

1ndvsik.en: ⟦0⟧ The filename of the order of battle to load, without the .txt extension.
1ndvsik.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要加载的战斗序列文件名，不含 .txt 扩展名。

na0uso.en: Loads the specified order of battle for the current scope, applying the effects within. The filename with the ⟦0⟧ extension omitted is used as the effect's target.
na0uso.zh: 为「当前作用域」加载指定的战斗序列，并应用其中的效果。省略 ⟦0⟧ 扩展名的文件名被用作该效果的目标。

19ntrcv.en: Orders of battle are stored within ⟦0⟧. Primarily used to spawn divisions at specified locations.
19ntrcv.zh: 战斗序列存储在 ⟦0⟧ 中。主要用于在指定位置生成师。

14bzt3c.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the division. regiments = { <unit> = { x = 0 y = 0 } } regimental_support = { <unit> = { x = 0 y = 0 } } support = { <unit> = { x = 0 y = 0 } } The composition of the division. Sub-units are defined in /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/*.txt files. division_names_group = <group> The division names group that the template will use, deciding on the automatically-generated names of any new divisions built using that template. Optional, assigns one automatically if omitted. These are defined within /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/names_divisions/*.txt files. is_locked = <bool> Whether the division is locked to modification and deletion. Optional. force_allow_recruiting = <bool> Whether the locked template can have units deployed using it without allowing editing. Optional, only has an effect in locked templates. division_cap = <int> The maximum amount of divisions that this template may have; requires the template to be locked. Optional. priority = <int> The priority the template receives in receiving supplies. Goes from 0 to 2. Optional, 1 by default. template_counter = <int> The icon used by the division as an integer. Optional, defaults to the icon of the most common sub-unit within. The icons are defined as sprites within any /Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx file (By default subuniticons.gfx) with the pattern of GFX_div_templ_<int>_large and GFX_div_templ_<int>_small. override_model = <entity> Enforces the entity used by the units using this template to be the specified one. Optional.
14bzt3c.zh: ⟦0⟧ 师的名称。regiments = { <unit> = { x = 0 y = 0 } } regimental_support = { <unit> = { x = 0 y = 0 } } support = { <unit> = { x = 0 y = 0 } } 该师的编制。子单位定义在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/*.txt 文件中。division_names_group = <group> 该模板使用的师名组，决定使用该模板新建的师自动生成的名称。可选，省略时会自动分配一个。这些定义在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/names_divisions/*.txt 文件中。is_locked = <bool> 该师是否锁定以防止修改和删除。可选。force_allow_recruiting = <bool> 锁定模板是否可以在不允许编辑的情况下使用它部署单位。可选，仅在锁定模板中有效。division_cap = <int> 该模板可拥有的最大师数量；需要模板处于锁定状态。可选。priority = <int> 该模板在接收补给时的优先级。从 0 到 2。可选，默认为 1。template_counter = <int> 该师使用的图标，以整数表示。可选，默认取其中最常见子单位的图标。图标以 sprite 形式定义在任何 /Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx 文件中（默认是 subuniticons.gfx），命名模式为 GFX_div_templ_<int>_large 和 GFX_div_templ_<int>_small。override_model = <entity> 强制使用该模板的单位使用指定的实体。可选。

1dn4sz.en: Enforces the entity used by the units using this template to be the specified one
1dn4sz.zh: 强制使用该模板的单位使用指定的实体

1pv26ks.en: Creates and adds the specified division template to the current scope.
1pv26ks.zh: 创建指定的师编制并将其添加到「当前作用域」。

6mxlu9.en: The ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ attributes represent the rows and columns in the division designer and start from 0. No tooltip is shown.
6mxlu9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 属性代表师设计器中的行和列，从 0 开始。不显示提示框。

oxrue.en: ⟦0⟧ Country tag for an overlords subject. division_template = { ... } The regular effect to create a division template.
oxrue.zh: ⟦0⟧ 宗主的附庸国的国家标签。division_template = { ... } 用于创建师编制的常规效果。

15hkemg.en: Create a colonial division template for overlord/owner.
15hkemg.zh: 为宗主国/所有者创建殖民地师编制。

13hvxhv.en: In country scope of overlord, E.g. ROOT = ENG.
13hvxhv.zh: 在宗主国的国家作用域中，例如 ROOT = ENG。

v6cp9r.en: ⟦0⟧ The template to change. Optional if used in division scope. regiments = { <unit> = <column> } regimental_support = { <unit> = <column> } support = { <unit> = <column> } The units to add to the template. Sub-units are defined in /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/*.txt files.
v6cp9r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要更改的模板。在师作用域中使用时可选。regiments = { <unit> = <column> } regimental_support = { <unit> = <column> } support = { <unit> = <column> } 要添加到模板的单位。子单位定义在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/*.txt 文件中。

owjo9r.en: Adds the specified brigades to first available slots of specified columns to the template (if possible).
owjo9r.zh: 将指定的旅添加到模板中指定列的第一个可用槽位（如果可能）。

15h83o3.en: Columns go left-to-right starting with 0. Can also be used in division scope.
15h83o3.zh: 列从左到右以 0 开始编号。也可在师作用域中使用。

nfq27o.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the division template. is_locked = <bool> Whether the division is locked or not.
nfq27o.zh: ⟦0⟧ 师编制的名称。is_locked = <bool> 该师是否锁定。

gusmhg.en: Toggles the locked status on a division template for the current scope, which prevents editing or deletion.
gusmhg.zh: 切换「当前作用域」某个师编制的锁定状态，锁定后无法编辑或删除。

1t85l7e.en: ⟦0⟧ Boolean. OR is_locked = <bool> Boolean. desc = <loc_key> Tooltip.
1t85l7e.zh: ⟦0⟧ 布尔值。或 is_locked = <bool> 布尔值。desc = <loc_key> 提示框。

1dr1vnt.en: Locks all division templates for the current scope.
1dr1vnt.zh: 锁定「当前作用域」的所有师编制。

1kfat6.en: Used to prevent training, disbanding, and editing units.
1kfat6.zh: 用于阻止训练、解散和编辑单位。

myxz4a.en: ⟦0⟧ Template to modify. force_allow_recruiting = <bool> Whether to allow or disallow recruiting. Defaults to true if unset.
myxz4a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的模板。force_allow_recruiting = <bool> 是否允许招募。未设置时默认为 true。

99f6ah.en: Changes whether it's possible to recruit divisions of a locked template without unlocking the template.
99f6ah.zh: 更改是否可以在不解锁模板的情况下招募锁定模板的师。

1jjkyrb.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the division template. division_cap = <int> The division cap.
1jjkyrb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 师编制的名称。division_cap = <int> 师数量上限。

rhfohp.en: Sets the cap of a division template. The template has to be locked first.
rhfohp.zh: 设置师编制的数量上限。该模板必须首先处于锁定状态。

11x3qkb.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the division template.

1msz62o.en: Clears the cap on the template, allowing it to have an unlimited amount of divisions.
1msz62o.zh: 清除模板的数量上限，使其可拥有无限数量的师。

1miq0nk.en: delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Infantry Division" disband = yes #will refund equipment and manpower }
1miq0nk.zh: delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Infantry Division" disband = yes #将返还装备和人力 }

1q14eee.en: Deletes the specified division template and all units using it for the current scope.
1q14eee.zh: 删除「当前作用域」指定的师编制以及所有使用它的单位。

1iztmn.en: ⟦0⟧ The id number of the state the unit must be in. division_template = <string> The template the units must use to be deleted. id = <int> The id given to the unit if created via the create_unit effect. disband = <bool> If true, will refund equipment and manpower.
1iztmn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该单位必须所在州的 id 编号。division_template = <string> 这些单位必须使用才能被删除的模板。id = <int> 通过 create_unit 效果创建时赋予该单位的 id。disband = <bool> 如果为 true，将返还装备和人力。

uwm47b.en: delete_unit = { state = 787 disband = yes #will refund equipment and manpower } delete_unit = { division_template = "Infantry Division" } delete_unit = {} # Will delete all units
uwm47b.zh: delete_unit = { state = 787 disband = yes #将返还装备和人力 } delete_unit = { division_template = "Infantry Division" } delete_unit = {} # 将删除所有单位

1ognfjz.en: Deletes all units that meet the filters.
1ognfjz.zh: 删除所有符合筛选条件的单位。

5gf5r8.en: No tooltip is generated. delete_units can be used if deleting all units of a specific template.
5gf5r8.zh: 不会生成提示框。如果要删除某个特定模板的所有单位，可以使用 delete_units。

dnpw3d.en: ⟦0⟧ The template the units must use to be deleted. disband = <bool> If true, will refund equipment and manpower.
dnpw3d.zh: ⟦0⟧ 这些单位必须使用才能被删除的模板。disband = <bool> 如果为 true，将返还装备和人力。

16zc01s.en: Deletes all units with a certain template.
16zc01s.zh: 删除所有使用某个模板的单位。

b5fmyd.en: Generates a tooltip, unlike delete_unit. Mandatory to specify a division_template.
b5fmyd.zh: 与 delete_unit 不同，会生成提示框。必须指定 division_template。

18fycpv.en: ⟦0⟧ Equipment type used by the railway gun. name = <string> The name used by the railway gun. Optional. location = <province> Location where the railway gun is created. Assumes the capital by default.
18fycpv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 列车炮使用的装备类型。name = <string> 列车炮使用的名称。可选。location = <province> 创建列车炮的位置。默认为首都。

12el2ib.en: Teleports all railway guns to the province where they get deployed.
12el2ib.zh: 将所有列车炮传送到它们被部署的省份。

j0ywm6.en: Adds permanent subunit and subunit category bonuses for country.
j0ywm6.zh: 为国家添加永久的子单位与子单位类别加成。

mw0bd6.zh: 与装备相关的国家作用域效果：

wk8a27.en: ⟦0⟧ The fraction of equipment to remove.

upbq0w.en: Reduces the overall equipment stockpile by the specified fraction.
upbq0w.zh: 按指定比例减少整体装备库存。

1ujf6dk.en: This should ⟦0⟧ be used in civil wars to simulate stockpile splitting. ⟦1⟧ automatically divides stockpiles according to the respective size.
1ujf6dk.zh: 在内战中 ⟦0⟧ 应使用此效果来模拟库存分配。⟦1⟧ 会根据各自的规模自动分配库存。

ki35nl.en: ⟦0⟧ The equipment to add. Either types and archetypes are accepted. amount = <int> / <variable> The amount to add. producer = <country> / <variable> Defines who produced the equipment. Optional, defaults to the current scope. variant_name = <string> The equipment variant to add. Mandatory if a variant needs to be created to produce the equipment, optional otherwise.
ki35nl.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的装备。类型和原型均可接受。amount = <int> / <variable> 要添加的数量。producer = <country> / <variable> 定义谁生产了该装备。可选，默认为「当前作用域」。variant_name = <string> 要添加的装备变体。如果需要创建变体来生产该装备则为必填，否则可选。

qkh8bu.en: Edits the equipment stockpile of the current scope, adds or removes equipment of a specified type or archetype.
qkh8bu.zh: 编辑「当前作用域」的装备库存，添加或移除指定类型或原型的装备。

16f51tj.en: With negative numbers, optionally specifying a producer will ensure only equipment with that producer gets removed. The equipment must be unlocked by the producer for the effect to succeed.
16f51tj.zh: 使用负数时，可选地指定生产国将确保只移除该生产国生产的装备。该装备必须已由该生产国解锁，效果才会成功。

1ruqxpm.en: ⟦0⟧ The equipment to add. Can be archetype. amount = <int> / <variable> The amount to add. target = <country> / <variable> Which country receives the equipment.
1ruqxpm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的装备。可以是原型。amount = <int> / <variable> 要添加的数量。target = <country> / <variable> 哪个国家接收该装备。

185d71b.en: Sends the specified amount of equipment to the specified target, removing said equipment from the current scope.
185d71b.zh: 向指定目标发送指定数量的装备，并从「当前作用域」移除这些装备。

md3nnf.en: Cannot remove equipment into negatives, in which case equipment will not be received by the target in entirety.
md3nnf.zh: 不能将装备移除至负数，在这种情况下目标将完全收不到装备。

14fi7a1.en: ⟦0⟧ How much equipment to send. target = <country> / <variable> Which country receives the equipment.
14fi7a1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要发送多少装备。target = <country> / <variable> 哪个国家接收该装备。

y9tt5d.en: Sends the specified fraction of equipment to the specified target, removing said equipment from the current scope.
y9tt5d.zh: 向指定目标发送指定比例的装备，并从「当前作用域」移除这些装备。

l2em9h.en: ⟦0⟧ Which country receives the license. new_prioritised = <boolean> Whether new equipment is prioritised or not. Yes by default. cost_factor = <float> Modifies the production cost. Equipment scope type = <equipment> The equipment the country is licensed to produce. Must be an non-archetype equipment. version = <int> The version indicates which variant should be licensed. The default is 0, meaning the base variant.
l2em9h.zh: ⟦0⟧ 哪个国家获得该许可。new_prioritised = <boolean> 是否优先考虑新装备。默认为 yes。cost_factor = <float> 修改生产成本。Equipment scope type = <equipment> 该国获得许可生产的装备。必须是非原型装备。version = <int> 版本指示应许可哪个变体。默认为 0，即基础变体。

1q0v833.en: Grants the specified country a license to produce the specified equipment from the current scope.
1q0v833.zh: 向指定国家授予从「当前作用域」生产指定装备的许可。

ddn0yx.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of economic capacity required by the subsidy. equipment_type = <archetype> The equipment archetype that the subsidy is for. seller_tags = { <countries } Countries that can have the subsidy. seller_trigger = <scripted trigger> The trigger deciding which countries can have the subsidy.
ddn0yx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该补贴所需的经济产能。equipment_type = <archetype> 该补贴针对的装备原型。seller_tags = { <countries } 可以接受该补贴的国家。seller_trigger = <scripted trigger> 决定哪些国家可以接受该补贴的触发器。

1g3qxg1.en: Creates an equipment subsidy on the ⟦0⟧.
1g3qxg1.zh: 在 ⟦0⟧ 上创建一个装备补贴。

70kapz.en: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are mutually exclusive. In the scripted trigger, ⟦2⟧ is the country with the subsidy and ⟦3⟧ is the seller.
70kapz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 互斥。在脚本化触发器中，⟦2⟧ 是接受补贴的国家，⟦3⟧ 是卖方。

t3nggl.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of economic capacity to add.
t3nggl.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的经济产能数量。

1lc8x3u.en: Modifies the economic capacity bank on the ⟦0⟧.
1lc8x3u.zh: 修改 ⟦0⟧ 上的经济产能储备。

1m9u8oj.en: The economic capacity will be capped to 0 if the total after the effect is negative.
1m9u8oj.zh: 如果效果生效后的总值为负数，经济产能将被限制为 0。

ajpv8r.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the variant. type = <equipment> The equipment type the variant is of. parent_version = <int> Ordering for multiple variants of the same equipment. 0 is the oldest, 1 is the second-oldest, etc. Optional, 0 by default. show_position = <bool> Dynamic equipment version numbering. If disabled removes the suffix from the equipment name. Numbering linked to parent_version. Optional, yes by default. obsolete = <bool> Whether the equipment variant is flagged as obsolete within the GUI and for AI. Optional, no by default. mark_older_equipment_obsolete = <bool> Marks all older (non-chassis) equipment variants as obsolete as long as the following matches: Archetype, niche, mission set (for planes). Optional, defaults to false. name_group = <name group> The name group used for equipment. Stored in /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/names_ships. Optional, can only be defined for ships. role_icon_index = <int>/auto Index of the role icon that will be used, as an integer. If set to "auto", will pick automatically. If set to 0, will be unset. Optional, only can be defined for ships. model = <model name> Model that will be used by the equipment on the world map. Optional. icon = <sprite> The icon that will be used by equipment. Stored as a spriteType within /Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx. Optional. design_team = mio:<MIO> The military industrial organisation that should be set as the designer of the equipment. Optional. allow_without_tech = <bool> If set, bypasses the requirement that the equipment that the variant is for must be unlocked through research. Optional, defaults to false. Upgrade scope <upgrade> = <amount> The upgrades configuration for the variant. Module scope <slot> = <module> The modules configuration for the variant.
ajpv8r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 变体的名称。type = <equipment> 该变体所属的装备类型。parent_version = <int> 同一装备多个变体的排序。0 是最旧的，1 是第二旧的，依此类推。可选，默认为 0。show_position = <bool> 动态装备版本编号。如果禁用，将从装备名称中移除后缀。编号与 parent_version 关联。可选，默认为 yes。obsolete = <bool> 该装备变体是否在图形界面中以及对于 AI 被标记为过时。可选，默认为 no。mark_older_equipment_obsolete = <bool> 在满足以下匹配条件时，将所有较旧的（非底盘）装备变体标记为过时：原型、定位、任务集（适用于飞机）。可选，默认为 false。name_group = <name group> 用于装备的命名组。存储在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/names_ships。可选，只能为舰船定义。role_icon_index = <int>/auto 将要使用的定位图标索引，以整数表示。如果设为 "auto"，将自动选择。如果设为 0，将被取消设置。可选，只能为舰船定义。model = <model name> 该装备在世界地图上使用的模型。可选。icon = <sprite> 装备将使用的图标。以 spriteType 形式存储在 /Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx 中。可选。design_team = mio:<MIO> 应被设为该装备设计商的军工组织。可选。allow_without_tech = <bool> 如果设置，则绕过「该变体所属装备必须通过科研解锁」的要求。可选，默认为 false。升级作用域 <upgrade> = <amount> 该变体的升级配置。模块作用域 <slot> = <module> 该变体的模块配置。

1tuo55r.en: Creates the specified equipment variant for the current scope.
1tuo55r.zh: 为「当前作用域」创建指定的装备变体。

s9zrlk.en: Role icons for ships are defined in ⟦0⟧. Upgrades are defined within /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/equipment/upgrades/*.txt. Equipment types, including module slots for them, are defined within /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/equipment/*.txt. Equipment modules are defined within /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/equipment/modules/*.txt.
s9zrlk.zh: 舰船的定位图标定义在 ⟦0⟧ 中。升级定义在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/equipment/upgrades/*.txt 中。装备类型（包括其模块槽位）定义在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/equipment/*.txt 中。装备模块定义在 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/units/equipment/modules/*.txt 中。

13tuzur.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount to produce before automatically stopping. Optional. requested_factories = <int> The number of factories to assigned initially. Optional. progress = <float> The initial production progress. Optional. efficiency = <float> The initial production efficiency. Optional. name = <string> The name that'll be used for the equipment, such as with ships. Optional. industrial_manufacturer = mio:<MIO> The military industrial organisation that's set as the equipment's designer. Equipment scope type = <equipment> The name of the equipment to produce. creator = <country> The country which is producing the equipment. Used if root scope isn't producer. Optional. version_name = <string>The name of the variant to produce. Optional.
13tuzur.zh: ⟦0⟧ 自动停止前要生产的数量。可选。requested_factories = <int> 初始分配的工厂数量。可选。progress = <float> 初始生产进度。可选。efficiency = <float> 初始生产效率。可选。name = <string> 该装备将使用的名称，例如舰船。可选。industrial_manufacturer = mio:<MIO> 被设为该装备设计商的军工组织。装备作用域 type = <equipment> 要生产的装备的名称。creator = <country> 生产该装备的国家。在根作用域不是生产国时使用。可选。version_name = <string>要生产的变体的名称。可选。

18y0kg3.en: Starts a production line for the specified equipment for the current scope.
18y0kg3.zh: 为「当前作用域」启动指定装备的生产线。

1j52w3u.en: ⟦0⟧ Name. uses = <int> The amount of times the discount can be used. cost_factor = <float> Discount. equipment = <equipment> Can be equipment type and archetype.
1j52w3u.zh: ⟦0⟧ 名称。uses = <int> 该折扣可使用的次数。cost_factor = <float> 折扣。equipment = <equipment> 可以是装备类型和原型。

fwtg0f.en: Add free bonus design discount to given types with a set of uses.
fwtg0f.zh: 为指定类型的装备添加带使用次数的免费设计折扣。

n6r9tb.en: The value for ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ can either be an absolute value or a script constant. Can use several equipment types, where 1 is mandatory.
n6r9tb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 的值可以是绝对值或脚本常量。可使用多个装备类型，其中 1 个为必填。

5k0ylq.en: ⟦0⟧ Optional, special project scope for using special project name. If not set, the name will be used. name = <loc_key> Name. bonus = { ... } Bonus.
5k0ylq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可选，用于使用特殊项目名称的特殊项目作用域。如果未设置，将使用该名称。name = <loc_key> 名称。bonus = { ... } 加成。

r3x6be.en: Adds the specified equipment bonuses to the country. As description the given loc key or the name of given special project will be used. Same usage as in Ideas/National spirits.
r3x6be.zh: 为国家添加指定的装备加成。描述将使用给定的本地化键或给定特殊项目的名称。用法与理念/国家精神中相同。

1sxwml9.en: ⟦0⟧ Equipment type. version = <int> Version to set.
1sxwml9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 装备类型。version = <int> 要设置的版本。

yfox8x.en: Changes current version number for a given equipment type to N. The next equipment variant created from that type will have version number N+1.
yfox8x.zh: 将给定装备类型的当前版本号更改为 N。由该类型创建的下一个装备变体将具有版本号 N+1。

1g3dd27.en: Set "Variant max version" to specified version. Provides no tooltip.
1g3dd27.zh: 将「Variant max version」设为指定版本。不提供提示框。

1b63sw7.zh: 与军事相关的国家作用域效果：

1likhp2.en: ⟦0⟧ The type of ship to destroy. count = <int> or all The amount to destroy.
1likhp2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要摧毁的舰船类型。count = <int> 或 all 要摧毁的数量。

1j1pgov.en: Destroys the specified type and amount of ships controlled by the current scope.
1j1pgov.zh: 摧毁「当前作用域」控制的指定类型和数量的舰船。

smv0bz.en: Transfers the current scope navy to the specified country.
smv0bz.zh: 将「当前作用域」的海军移交给指定国家。

16eau6b.en: ⟦0⟧ The type of ship to transfer. target = <country> The target country. prefer_name = <string> Name of ship in origin navy that will preferably be transferred to target navy. Optional. exclude_refitting = <bool> Determines whether ships that are being refitted will be transferred. Optional.
16eau6b.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移交的舰船类型。target = <country> 目标国家。prefer_name = <string> 原海军中优先移交给目标海军的舰船名称。可选。exclude_refitting = <bool> 决定正在改装中的舰船是否会被移交。可选。

1udte83.en: Transfers the specified type of ship from the current scope to the specified country.
1udte83.zh: 将「当前作用域」指定类型的舰船移交给指定国家。

194xs0m.en: ⟦0⟧ The type of ship to create. equipment_variant = <string> The equipment variant to use. creator = <country> The country that created this ship. Optional. name = <string> Name of the ship. Optional. amount = <int> The amount of ships to create. Optional, defaults to 1.
194xs0m.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要创建的舰船类型。equipment_variant = <string> 要使用的装备变体。creator = <country> 创建该舰船的国家。可选。name = <string> 舰船的名称。可选。amount = <int> 要创建的舰船数量。可选，默认为 1。

1bzu9fr.en: Create a ship from another country and assign it to the reserve fleet. If not set, it will be the scoped country.
1bzu9fr.zh: 创建一艘来自其他国家的舰船并将其编入预备舰队。如果未设置，则使用作用域国家。

1w3zl1r.en: Add mines to a strategic region for the current country.
1w3zl1r.zh: 为「当前国家」向某个战略区域添加水雷。

1cq22bm.en: Add mines to a strategic region.
1cq22bm.zh: 向某个战略区域添加水雷。

uikrmn.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the ace. surname = <string> The surname of the ace. callsign = <string> The callsign of the ace. type = <type> The ace type. is_female = <bool> The gender of the ace.
uikrmn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 王牌飞行员的名称。surname = <string> 王牌飞行员的姓氏。callsign = <string> 王牌飞行员的呼号。type = <type> 王牌飞行员类型。is_female = <bool> 王牌飞行员的性别。

qabb4s.en: Adds an ace for the current scope.
qabb4s.zh: 为「当前作用域」添加一名王牌飞行员。

sxeh9v.zh: 王牌飞行员类型可在 ⟦0⟧ 中找到。

1ertsmt.en: Unlocks the specified combat tactic for the country.
1ertsmt.zh: 为该国家解锁指定的战斗战术。

14aostu.zh: 与学说相关的国家作用域效果：

bg0edd.en: ⟦0⟧ Optional tooltip showing why the doctrine has reduced cost in the doctrine menu. cost_reduction = <float> Percentage of cost reduced. uses = <int> Number of times the cost reduction can be used. category = <doctrine category> Which doctrine category the cost reduction will apply to. (Ex: land_doctrine, air_doctrine.)
bg0edd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可选提示框，在学说菜单中显示该学说费用降低的原因。cost_reduction = <float> 费用降低的百分比。uses = <int> 该费用降低可使用的次数。category = <doctrine category> 费用降低将适用于哪个学说类别。（例如：land_doctrine、air_doctrine。）

jdx6rl.en: Adds a limited use cost reduction for doctrines.
jdx6rl.zh: 为学说添加有限次使用的费用降低。

hxzcq8.en: For a general doctrine cost reduction, see "<land/air/naval>_doctrine_cost_factor" in ⟦0⟧.
hxzcq8.zh: 关于通用的学说费用降低，请参见 ⟦0⟧ 中的 "<land/air/naval>_doctrine_cost_factor"。

1k4tg5a.en: ⟦0⟧ Amount of mastery to add. folder = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder. grand_doctrine = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine. sub_doctrine = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine. track = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks of the specified type. index = <int> Optional - will filter by the track index within the folder (0-indexed).
1k4tg5a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的掌握度数量。folder = <string> 可选 —— 将按指定文件夹中的路线进行筛选。grand_doctrine = <string> 可选 —— 将按具有指定宏学说的文件夹中的路线进行筛选。sub_doctrine = <string> 可选 —— 将按具有指定子学说的路线进行筛选。track = <string> 可选 —— 将按指定类型的路线进行筛选。index = <int> 可选 —— 将按文件夹中的路线索引（从 0 开始）进行筛选。

1yqfn9j.en: You can use flexible filters to have this effect apply to all tracks that match the specified folder, grand doctrine, subdoctrine or specific track. If a certain filter is not present, it will be counted as a pass. For example, you can add mastery to all active tracks in all folders by not specifying any filters at all.
1yqfn9j.zh: 你可以使用灵活的筛选器，使该效果作用于所有匹配指定文件夹、宏学说、子学说或具体路线的路线。如果某个筛选器不存在，则视为通过。例如，完全不指定任何筛选器即可为所有文件夹中的所有已激活路线添加掌握度。

1wzl6x9.en: ⟦0⟧ Amount of mastery to add per day. days = <int> Number of days to apply the daily mastery gain for. name = <loc_key> Loc key - will be used in descriptions to show the source of the mastery gain. folder = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder. grand_doctrine = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine. sub_doctrine = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine. track = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks of the specified type. index = <int> Optional - will filter by the track index within the folder (0-indexed).
1wzl6x9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 每天要添加的掌握度数量。days = <int> 应用每日掌握度获取的天数。name = <loc_key> 本地化键 —— 将用于描述中以显示掌握度获取的来源。folder = <string> 可选 —— 将按指定文件夹中的路线进行筛选。grand_doctrine = <string> 可选 —— 将按具有指定宏学说的文件夹中的路线进行筛选。sub_doctrine = <string> 可选 —— 将按具有指定子学说的路线进行筛选。track = <string> 可选 —— 将按指定类型的路线进行筛选。index = <int> 可选 —— 将按文件夹中的路线索引（从 0 开始）进行筛选。

1yykhch.en: Adds doctrine mastery daily for a certain duration.
1yykhch.zh: 在特定持续时间内每天添加学说掌握度。

1beh0t.en: ⟦0⟧ Bonus factor, e.g. 0.1 = +10% days = <int> Number of days to apply the bonus mastery gain for. name = <loc_key> Loc key - will be used in descriptions to show the source of the mastery gain. folder = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder. grand_doctrine = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine. sub_doctrine = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine. track = <string> Optional - will filter by tracks of the specified type. index = <int> Optional - will filter by the track index within the folder (0-indexed).
1beh0t.zh: ⟦0⟧ 加成系数，例如 0.1 = +10% days = <int> 应用掌握度获取加成的天数。name = <loc_key> 本地化键 —— 将用于描述中以显示掌握度获取的来源。folder = <string> 可选 —— 将按指定文件夹中的路线进行筛选。grand_doctrine = <string> 可选 —— 将按具有指定宏学说的文件夹中的路线进行筛选。sub_doctrine = <string> 可选 —— 将按具有指定子学说的路线进行筛选。track = <string> 可选 —— 将按指定类型的路线进行筛选。index = <int> 可选 —— 将按文件夹中的路线索引（从 0 开始）进行筛选。

132riwe.en: Get a bonus to doctrine mastery gain for a certain duration.
132riwe.zh: 在特定持续时间内获得学说掌握度获取加成。

19vedzy.en: Activate (unlock and assign) the specified grand doctrine.
19vedzy.zh: 激活（解锁并指定）指定的宏学说。

6u3sko.en: ⟦0⟧ Subdoctrine id. OR sub_doctrine = <string> Subdoctrine id. folder = <string> Optional, in case you need to specify the folder. track = <int> Optional, in case you need to specify the track index within the folder. Note that this is the track index (starting with 0) among ALL the tracks in the folder, not just the ones that match the subdoctrine. So in a case where a grand doctrine has the tracks: 'infantry - armor - armor - operations', you would use track = 1 to refer to the first armor track, and track = 2 to refer to the second armor track.
6u3sko.zh: ⟦0⟧ 子学说 id。或 sub_doctrine = <string> 子学说 id。folder = <string> 可选，在你需要指定文件夹时使用。track = <int> 可选，在你需要指定文件夹中的路线索引时使用。注意这是该文件夹中所有路线（从 0 开始）的索引，而不仅仅是匹配该子学说的路线。因此，如果某个宏学说拥有路线：'infantry - armor - armor - operations'，则 track = 1 指第一条 armor 路线，track = 2 指第二条 armor 路线。

1ckrq1q.en: Activate (unlock and assign) the specified subdoctrine.
1ckrq1q.zh: 激活（解锁并指定）指定的子学说。

1ufob1i.en: By default, the subdoctrine is assigned to the first matching track that the system can find. However, you can also specify a specific folder and track index to assign the subdoctrine to, in case the same track appears in multiple folders, or multiple times in the same folder.
1ufob1i.zh: 默认情况下，子学说会被指定给系统能找到的第一条匹配路线。不过，你也可以指定特定的文件夹和路线索引来指定子学说，以防同一条路线出现在多个文件夹中，或在同一文件夹中多次出现。

11s0dcr.zh: 与情报相关的国家作用域效果：

1jpo561.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the intelligence agency. (Optional) icon = <sprite> The icon of the intelligence agency. (Optional)
1jpo561.zh: ⟦0⟧ 情报机构的名称。（可选）icon = <sprite> 情报机构的图标。（可选）

17yjgb1.en: Both parameters are not required, thus you can call the effect with just ⟦0⟧. This will check if any specific intelligence agency cosmetics should be used for the nation, and if not it uses the default.
17yjgb1.zh: 两个参数都不是必需的，因此你可以只用 ⟦0⟧ 调用该效果。这会检查是否有任何针对该国的特定情报机构外观应被使用，如果没有则使用默认外观。

1n801q2.en: Allows to unlock automatically an intelligence agency upgrade
1n801q2.zh: 允许自动解锁一项情报机构升级

215y7f.zh: 解锁一项情报机构升级。

zef07d.en: Upgrades can be found in common/intelligence_agency_upgrades
zef07d.zh: 升级可在 common/intelligence_agency_upgrades 中找到

18z4tm3.en: ⟦0⟧ Towards which country to add decryption. amount = <int> How much decryption to add in flat numbers. ratio = <0-1> How much decryption ratio to add.
18z4tm3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 针对哪个国家添加解密。amount = <int> 以绝对值添加多少解密。ratio = <0-1> 添加多少解密比例。

1xmnknw.en: Adds decryption towards the target country
1xmnknw.zh: 添加针对目标国家的解密

i7wogw.en: ⟦0⟧ Towards which country to add intelligence. civilian_intel = <int> How much civilian intel to add. army_intel = <int> How much army intel to add. navy_intel = <int> How much navy intel to add. airforce_intel = <int> How much airforce intel to add.
i7wogw.zh: ⟦0⟧ 针对哪个国家添加情报。civilian_intel = <int> 添加多少民用情报。army_intel = <int> 添加多少陆军情报。navy_intel = <int> 添加多少海军情报。airforce_intel = <int> 添加多少空军情报。

1kz2rtk.en: Adds the specified amount of intel towards the specified country.
1kz2rtk.zh: 向指定国家添加指定数量的情报。

4c9693.en: If an intel argument is left out, 0 is assumed.
4c9693.zh: 如果省略某个情报参数，则视为 0。

1gqnm9j.en: ⟦0⟧ Towards which country to add a token on. token = <id> Which token to add.
1gqnm9j.zh: ⟦0⟧ 向哪个国家添加令牌。token = <id> 要添加的令牌。

7ecftz.en: Adds an operation token towards the country, allowing access to more intel or applying a targeted modifier.
7ecftz.zh: 向该国添加一个行动令牌，从而可以获取更多情报或施加针对性修正。

1p1sc9d.zh: 行动令牌定义于 ⟦0⟧ 中。

1wvu67i.en: ⟦0⟧ Towards which country to remove a token from. token = <id> Which token to remove.
1wvu67i.zh: ⟦0⟧ 从哪个国家移除令牌。token = <id> 要移除的令牌。

17pihos.en: Removes an operation token from the country.
17pihos.zh: 从该国移除一个行动令牌。

tdkniy.en: ⟦0⟧ Which operative to capture. ignore_death_chance = <bool> Whether to ignore the death chance on capture (no by default).
tdkniy.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要捕获的特工。ignore_death_chance = <bool> 是否忽略捕获时的死亡概率（默认为 no）。

150b4hm.en: Operatives can be referred to by using ⟦0⟧
150b4hm.zh: 特工可通过 ⟦0⟧ 来引用

y72aeh.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether the operative is directly added to the list of available operatives or needs to be recruited. available_to_spy_master = <bool> Whether the operative can be recruited by the spy master. bypass_recruitment should be set to no. portrait_tag_override = <bool> If selecting a random portrait, create one that is from the specified country rather than the current country. name = <string> The name of the operative. GFX = <string> The graphical reference of the picture of the leader, defined as a sprite within any /Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx file. nationalities = { <tag> } The nationalities of the operative. traits = { <trait> } The traits the leader spawns with. gender = <male|female> The gender of the operative. Defaults to random.
y72aeh.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该特工是直接加入可用特工列表，还是需要招募。available_to_spy_master = <bool> 该特工能否被特工大师招募。bypass_recruitment 应设为 no。portrait_tag_override = <bool> 若选择随机肖像，则创建一个来自指定国家而非当前国家的肖像。name = <string> 特工的名字。GFX = <string> 领袖图片的图形引用，在任何 /Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx 文件中定义为 sprite。nationalities = { <tag> } 特工的国籍。traits = { <trait> } 领袖生成时拥有的特质。gender = <male|female> 特工的性别。默认为随机。

mkgjqr.en: Creates an operative for the current scope with the specified attributes.
mkgjqr.zh: 为当前作用域创建一个具有指定属性的特工。

1998ton.en: Traits are found in ⟦0⟧. All arguments aside from bypass_recruitment are optional. ⟦1⟧, a direct link as in "gfx/leaders/TAG/filename.dds" will not work.
1998ton.zh: 特质见 ⟦0⟧。除 bypass_recruitment 外，所有参数均为可选。⟦1⟧，诸如 "gfx/leaders/TAG/filename.dds" 这样的直接链接无法使用。

12ttpys.en: Must use a spriteType for the portrait

15m9zka.en: ⟦0⟧ The country that captured the operative. all = <bool> Whether to free all operatives or not (Defaults to no).
15m9zka.zh: ⟦0⟧ 捕获该特工的国家。all = <bool> 是否释放所有特工（默认为 no）。

p8air9.en: Frees one random captured operative or all of them.
p8air9.zh: 释放一名随机的被俘特工，或释放全部被俘特工。

1oda1i8.en: Turns the targeted operative against their own country, transferring them to the current country.
1oda1i8.zh: 策反目标特工背叛其本国，并将其转至当前国家。

13jvgwl.en: Operatives can be referred to by using ⟦0⟧. This counts as the operative dying and will trigger the corresponding ⟦1⟧. Logs an error if used against your own operative.
13jvgwl.zh: 特工可通过 ⟦0⟧ 来引用。这视为该特工死亡，并会触发相应的 ⟦1⟧。若对本国特工使用则会记录错误。

yy2o6h.en: ⟦0⟧ The category to steal from. See ⟦1⟧ for list. folder = naval_folder The folder to steal from. See /Hearts of Iron IV/common/technology_tags/* for list. ahead_reduction = <float> The reduction to the ahead of time penalty. bonus = <float> The bonus to research speed. base_bonus = <float> The backup bonus if no tech is available. instant = <bool> Whether to instantly give a tech instead of a bonus or not. No by default. dynamic = <bool> Changes between instant and non-instant based on type. No by default. name = <localisation key> The name of the bonus. target = <tag> The country to steal from. uses = <int> How many times the bonus can be used.
yy2o6h.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要窃取的类别。列表见 ⟦1⟧。folder = naval_folder 要窃取的文件夹。列表见 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/technology_tags/*。ahead_reduction = <float> 超前时间惩罚的减少量。bonus = <float> 科研速度加成。base_bonus = <float> 无科技可窃取时的备用加成。instant = <bool> 是否直接给予一项科技而非加成。默认为 no。dynamic = <bool> 根据类型在 instant 与非 instant 之间变化。默认为 no。name = <localisation key> 加成的名称。target = <tag> 要窃取的目标国家。uses = <int> 该加成可使用多少次。

1svas8v.en: Steals a random tech bonus from the specified country.
1svas8v.zh: 从指定国家窃取一项随机科技加成。

1bbflgi.en: If a country does not have a tech to be stolen, a random bonus will be applied by using base_bonus as a base.
1bbflgi.zh: 若该国没有可窃取的科技，则以 base_bonus 为基础施加一项随机加成。

1qkaaln.en: These are the character-related effects in the country scope. For effects in character scope, see ⟦0⟧.
1qkaaln.zh: 以下是国家作用域中与角色相关的效果。角色作用域中的效果见 ⟦0⟧。

hcvd9h.zh: 与角色相关的国家作用域效果：

1dl1v4j.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. character = <character> The character to transfer.
1dl1v4j.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。character = <character> 要转移的角色。

135v3xr.en: Switches the specified character to the specified country.
135v3xr.zh: 将指定角色转换到指定国家。

dj1l2r.en: If you wish to change the nationality of a specific character, and the country getting the effect doesn't have the character recruited already, use the every_possible_country = { limit = { has_character = ID } random_character = { limit = { is_character = ID } set_nationality = TAG } } command to call them up. Only necessary in 1.11 and beyond.
dj1l2r.zh: 若要更改某个角色的国籍，而接受该效果的国家尚未招募该角色，可使用 every_possible_country = { limit = { has_character = ID } random_character = { limit = { is_character = ID } set_nationality = TAG } } 指令将其调出。仅在 1.11 及以后版本中需要这样做。

1acmjb6.en: Retires the character, removing every role they hold and making them disappear from the game.
1acmjb6.zh: 使该角色退役，移除其担任的所有职务，并使其从游戏中消失。

18dwlu4.en: Country scope only. The character cannot be re-recruited after retiring.
18dwlu4.zh: 仅限国家作用域。角色退役后无法再次招募。

1bhviwr.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. name = <localisation key> The new name of the character.
1bhviwr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。name = <localisation key> 角色的新名字。

1sssytg.en: Sets the new name for the target character.
1sssytg.zh: 为目标角色设置新名字。

zogwns.en: Can also be used in character scope.
zogwns.zh: 也可在角色作用域中使用。

1eysb35.en: ⟦0⟧ Triggers that must be fulfilled to show up in the list. random_select_amount = <int> Upper bound on the characters that may be shown.
1eysb35.zh: ⟦0⟧ 必须满足才能出现在列表中的触发器。random_select_amount = <int> 可显示角色数量的上限。

1q4onqb.en: Displays a list of every character meeting the specified limitation and recruited by the current country.
1q4onqb.zh: 显示一份列表，包含所有满足指定限制条件且已被当前国家招募的角色。

15h9mmx.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. slot = <slot> Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ideology = <sub-ideology> Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. trait = <trait> The trait to add.
15h9mmx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。slot = <slot> 角色的槽位。对顾问是必需的。ideology = <sub-ideology> 角色的意识形态类型。对国家领袖是必需的。trait = <trait> 要添加的特质。

9xq9m2.en: Adds the specified country leader trait to the character.
9xq9m2.zh: 为该角色添加指定的国家领袖特质。

p4j290.en: ⟦0⟧. Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon. The character slot can be the character's name or id. Using name is recommended because 1.11 made id obsolete.
p4j290.zh: ⟦0⟧。意识形态类型指分配给角色的意识形态组子类型，社区俗称亚意识形态。角色槽位可以是角色的名字或 id。推荐使用名字，因为 1.11 已使 id 过时。

wzyc12.en: Can also be used in character scope
wzyc12.zh: 也可在角色作用域中使用

hnfox8.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. slot = <slot> Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ideology = <sub-ideology> Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. trait = <trait> The trait to remove.
hnfox8.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。slot = <slot> 角色的槽位。对顾问是必需的。ideology = <sub-ideology> 角色的意识形态类型。对国家领袖是必需的。trait = <trait> 要移除的特质。

5sqvr9.en: Removes the specified trait from the character.
5sqvr9.zh: 从该角色移除指定的特质。

1qm2447.zh: 若通过军官团将其任命为部长，所创建的军级指挥官将无法拥有肖像，从而导致错误。

1kd3nfq.zh: 为当前作用域创建一个具有指定属性的元帅。

z3fgkc.en: Traits are found in ⟦0⟧. Deprecated, recommended to use ⟦1⟧ instead when possible. ⟦2⟧

ed4koa.zh: 若通过军官团将其任命为部长，所创建的元帅将无法拥有肖像，从而导致错误。

j6fav1.en: Creates a naval leader for the current scope with the specified attributes.
j6fav1.zh: 为当前作用域创建一个具有指定属性的海军领袖。

6xby5q.en: The created admiral will not be able to have a portrait if assigned to be a minister via officer corps, causing errors.
6xby5q.zh: 若通过军官团将其任命为部长，所创建的海军上将将无法拥有肖像，从而导致错误。

1firl2p.en: ⟦0⟧ The id of the unit leader.

13cyv0t.en: Removes the specified unit leader by their legacy ID.
13cyv0t.zh: 按旧版 ID 移除指定的部队领袖。

qisxof.en: Does not work with the character ID. Instead, ⟦0⟧ within the scope of the character is recommended when possible.
qisxof.zh: 不能使用角色 ID。建议尽可能改在角色的作用域内使用 ⟦0⟧。

1ev0wli.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. <...> Army leader role definition
1ev0wli.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。<...> 陆军领袖职务定义

15hhkzw.en: Sets the specified character to also act as a corps commander.
15hhkzw.zh: 将指定角色设置为同时担任军级指挥官。

2oqu2b.en: Sets the specified character to also act as a field marshal.
2oqu2b.zh: 将指定角色设置为同时担任元帅。

1u0qaz9.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. <...> Navy leader role definition
1u0qaz9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。<...> 海军领袖职务定义

1jnby5j.en: Sets the specified character to also act as an admiral.
1jnby5j.zh: 将指定角色设置为同时担任海军上将。

igdzrw.en: ⟦0⟧ The character whose name is to be shown.

3i9t3m.en: Shows the name of the specified character as a tooltip.
3i9t3m.zh: 以提示框形式显示指定角色的名字。

1mlvxdr.zh: 与国家领袖相关的国家作用域效果：

1jxk5gs.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the leader. desc = <string> The description of the leader. picture = <spriteType> The graphical reference to the leader portrait. expire = <string> When the leader dies in history. ideology = <string> The sub-ideology of the country leader. 1ilil36.en: The portrait uses a spriteType, defined within ⟦0⟧. Sub-ideologies are defined in /Hearts of Iron IV/common/ideologies. Deprecated. Recommended to use add_country_leader_role instead when possible.
1ilil36.zh: 肖像使用 spriteType，定义于 ⟦0⟧ 中。亚意识形态定义于 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/ideologies。已废弃。建议尽可能改用 add_country_leader_role。

c19ic5.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. country_leader = { ... } Country leader role definition promote_leader = <bool> Will promote the leader to be the leader of the assigned party. Optional, defaults to false.
c19ic5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。country_leader = { ... } 国家领袖职务定义 promote_leader = <bool> 将该领袖提升为所属政党的领袖。可选，默认为 false。

1q6ovyx.zh: 将指定角色设置为同时担任国家领袖，并在指定时提升为政党领袖。
