kn5yz0.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to promote. OR character = <character> The character to promote. ideology = <ideology type> The ideology type used by the country leader role.
kn5yz0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要提升的角色。或 character = <character> 要提升的角色。ideology = <ideology type> 国家领袖职务使用的意识形态类型。

1pznrm3.en: Promotes a character to the leader of their political party.
1pznrm3.zh: 将角色提升为其所属政党的领袖。

1eq0hdk.en: ⟦0⟧ If the character has multiple country leader roles, specifying the ideology type is mandatory. Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon.
1eq0hdk.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若该角色拥有多个国家领袖职务，则必须指定意识形态类型。意识形态类型指分配给角色的意识形态组子类型，社区俗称亚意识形态。

158i533.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. ideology = <string> The ideology type of the character.
158i533.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。ideology = <string> 角色的意识形态类型。

1n9wxay.en: Removes a country leader role from a character.
1n9wxay.zh: 移除角色的国家领袖职务。

xny4e4.en: ⟦0⟧ Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon.
xny4e4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 意识形态类型指分配给角色的意识形态组子类型，社区俗称亚意识形态。

ryzf51.en: Kills the country leader of the designated ideology for the current scope.
ryzf51.zh: 杀死当前作用域中指定意识形态的国家领袖。

epdfca.en: Retires and removes the country leader of the ideology party for the current scope.
epdfca.zh: 使当前作用域中该意识形态政党的国家领袖退役并将其移除。

1d3aln9.en: Kills the country leader for the current scope.
1d3aln9.zh: 杀死当前作用域的国家领袖。

jjvxtz.en: Retires and removes the country leader as head of their party for the current scope.
jjvxtz.zh: 使当前作用域的国家领袖作为其政党领袖退役并将其移除。

oqem98.en: Changes the country leader's government type for the current scope.
oqem98.zh: 更改当前作用域中国家领袖的政府类型。

1n8db5a.en: ⟦0⟧ The ideology of the country leader, optional. desc = <localisation key> The new description.
1n8db5a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 国家领袖的意识形态，可选。desc = <localisation key> 新的描述。

1ma6y0k.en: Must use a localisation key from any ⟦0⟧ file, putting the description in quotes will not work. ⟦1⟧ for more info
1ma6y0k.zh: 必须使用任意 ⟦0⟧ 文件中的本地化键，将描述放在引号中无效。更多信息见 ⟦1⟧

lui5eb.en: ⟦0⟧ The ideology of the country leader, optional. name = <localisation key> The new name.
lui5eb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 国家领袖的意识形态，可选。name = <localisation key> 新的名字。

1y8fgz2.en: ⟦0⟧ The ideology of the country leader, optional. portrait = <sprite name> The new portrait.
1y8fgz2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 国家领袖的意识形态，可选。portrait = <sprite name> 新的肖像。

ffwv14.en: The portrait must be defined in ⟦0⟧
ffwv14.zh: 肖像必须定义于 ⟦0⟧ 中

9smbn0.en: Adds the specified trait to the current country's country leader.
9smbn0.zh: 为当前国家的国家领袖添加指定的特质。

u0ozw6.en: Removes the specified trait from the current scope's country leader.
u0ozw6.zh: 从当前作用域的国家领袖移除指定的特质。

1y86y1i.en: Similar to swap_ideas. Removes one trait and adds another.
1y86y1i.zh: 类似于 swap_ideas。移除一个特质并添加另一个特质。

16jlswe.zh: 与顾问相关的国家作用域效果：

1ighvrx.en: Hires an advisor, placing them into their respective slot.
1ighvrx.zh: 聘用一名顾问，并将其放入相应的槽位。

ymrycc.en: Dismisses an advisor from their respective slot, leaving it empty.
ymrycc.zh: 将顾问从其槽位解职，使该槽位空置。

1wrsn3j.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. advisor = { ... } Advisor role definition activate = <bool> Will activate the advisor (add them directly when the command is run to the countries government). Optional, defaults to false.
1wrsn3j.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。advisor = { ... } 顾问职务定义 activate = <bool> 将启用该顾问（在指令运行时直接将其加入该国政府）。可选，默认为 false。

1kh0uom.en: Sets the specified character to also act as an advisor, activating if specified.
1kh0uom.zh: 将指定角色设置为同时担任顾问，并在指定时启用。

a9juvm.en: ⟦0⟧ Trigger and effect blocks (such as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧) cannot be added within advisor definitions created this way.
a9juvm.zh: 用这种方式创建的顾问定义中不能添加 ⟦0⟧ 触发与效果块（例如 ⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧）。

1nfl29g.en: ⟦0⟧ Specifies the character if the effect is executed in country scope. slot = <int> The slot where to remove the advisor slot from.
1nfl29g.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若该效果在国家作用域中执行，则用于指定角色。slot = <int> 要从中移除顾问的槽位。

1x23e5b.en: Removes the specified advisor role from the character.
1x23e5b.zh: 移除该角色的指定顾问职务。

1vnn0n0.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. slot = <slot> The slot of the character to modify. value = <bool> The value to set.
1vnn0n0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。slot = <slot> 要修改的角色的槽位。value = <bool> 要设置的值。

9funjd.en: Changes the ⟦0⟧ attribute of the advisor, preventing the player from dismissing the advisor.
9funjd.zh: 更改顾问的 ⟦0⟧ 属性，使玩家无法解职该顾问。

1gyvujc.zh: 与科学家相关的国家作用域效果：

1fxw9nu.en: ⟦0⟧ The character to modify. <...> Scientist role definition
1fxw9nu.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色。<...> 科学家职务定义

12jtfah.en: Adds the scientist role to a character.
12jtfah.zh: 为角色添加科学家职务。

11gpq34.en: The scientist role format is the same as in the character DB. Except the visible trigger, a scientist role created via effect cannot have triggers. Can also be used in character scope.
11gpq34.zh: 科学家职务的格式与角色数据库中相同。除可见触发器外，通过效果创建的科学家职务不能带有触发器。也可在角色作用域中使用。

1cnopcu.en: Remove the scientist role from a character.
1cnopcu.zh: 移除角色的科学家职务。

19a6t50.en: ⟦0⟧ Optional, random portrait by default. portrait_tag_override = <country> / <variable> Optional, accepts variable and keyword, only relevant if using random portrait, by default use country in scope. gender = <gender> Optional, by default random gender. skills = { ??? } Optional array, same format as in scientist role in character DB, by default all skills are at 1. traits = { <trait> } Optional array.
19a6t50.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可选，默认使用随机肖像。portrait_tag_override = <country> / <variable> 可选，接受变量与关键字，仅在使用随机肖像时相关，默认使用作用域中的国家。gender = <gender> 可选，默认为随机性别。skills = { ??? } 可选数组，格式与角色数据库中的科学家职务相同，默认所有技能均为 1。traits = { <trait> } 可选数组。

1ba46eq.en: Generate a new character with a scientist role and recruit it in the country in scope.
1ba46eq.zh: 生成一个拥有科学家职务的新角色，并在作用域中的国家招募该角色。

1rysdbo.en: These are the MIO-related effects in the country scope. For effects in ⟦0⟧ scope, see ⟦1⟧.
1rysdbo.zh: 以下是国家作用域中与军工组织相关的效果。⟦0⟧ 作用域中的效果见 ⟦1⟧。

2c08up.zh: 与军工组织相关的国家作用域效果：

1adbybm.en: Displays a tooltip that shows the name of the MIO and its initial trait (if present).
1adbybm.zh: 显示一个提示框，展示该军工组织的名称及其初始特质（若存在）。

6j726s.en: Doesn't change the availability of the MIO directly.
6j726s.zh: 不会直接改变该军工组织的可用性。

1vdl2cj.en: Display a tooltip saying the MIO is made available (aka unlocked).
1vdl2cj.zh: 显示一个提示框，说明该军工组织已可用（即已解锁）。

1bijcgs.en: ⟦0⟧ Policy to display. OR policy = <policy> Policy to display. show_modifiers = <bool> Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.
1bijcgs.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要显示的政策。或 policy = <policy> 要显示的政策。show_modifiers = <bool> 是否在提示框中显示该特质的修正。默认为 true。

s9vy7n.en: Displays a tooltip that says that the policy is made available.
s9vy7n.zh: 显示一个提示框，说明该政策已可用。

1641t8b.en: Doesn't change the availability of the policy directly.
1641t8b.zh: 不会直接改变该政策的可用性。

1prptmt.en: ⟦0⟧ Policy to modify. value = <int> Amount in political power to add.
1prptmt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的政策。value = <int> 要增加的政治点数。

1ronby3.en: Modifies the base cost of a MIO policy.
1ronby3.zh: 修改军工组织政策的基础花费。

1o04hr2.en: The base amount is capped at 0 from below.

11bdmmc.en: ⟦0⟧ Policy to modify. value = <int> Amount in political power to set.
11bdmmc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的政策。value = <int> 要设置的政治点数。

1h37692.en: ⟦0⟧ Policy to modify. value = <int> Amount in days to add.
1h37692.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的政策。value = <int> 要增加的天数。

1ihih2b.en: Modifies the base length of a MIO policy cooldown.
1ihih2b.zh: 修改军工组织政策冷却时间的基础长度。

hr4ndb.en: ⟦0⟧ Policy to modify. value = <int> Amount in days to set.
hr4ndb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的政策。value = <int> 要设置的天数。

mpzx5p.en: These are special project related effects in the country scope.
mpzx5p.zh: 以下是国家作用域中与特殊项目相关的效果。

v5d01t.en: ⟦0⟧Project to complete. OR project = sp:<project> Project to complete. scientist = <character> Optional, default to current scientists on the project. state = <string> Optional, default to current state of the project. iteration_output = { <list> } Optional, can be a single reward or reward = option. show_modifiers = <bool> Optional, default = yes.
v5d01t.zh: ⟦0⟧要完成的项目。或 project = sp:<project> 要完成的项目。scientist = <character> 可选，默认为项目中当前的科学家。state = <string> 可选，默认为项目的当前状态。iteration_output = { <list> } 可选，可以是单个奖励或 reward = option。show_modifiers = <bool> 可选，默认 = yes。

1hs1kj0.en: Complete a special project for the country in scope. This effect will not take into account the current state of the project tree and will allow you to unlock a project even if the one before is not unlocked. Since the project is not completed within a facility, the facility state and scientist effects are NOT applied.
1hs1kj0.zh: 为作用域中的国家完成一个特殊项目。此效果不会考虑项目树的当前状态，即使前置项目未解锁也可解锁某个项目。由于该项目并非在设施中完成，设施状态与科学家效果不会生效。

1pxjjxq.en: project, scientist, state accepts variables and keywords. Using optional iteration output makes the use of state and scientist argument mandatory.
1pxjjxq.zh: project、scientist、state 接受变量与关键字。使用可选的 iteration output 会使 state 与 scientist 参数变为必填。

c2yoi6.en: ⟦0⟧ The specialization e.g. specialization_land. value = <int> The amount of specialization breakthrough points to add.
c2yoi6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 专精，例如 specialization_land。value = <int> 要增加的专精突破点数。

o1nrxb.en: Add breakthrough points to one specialization or all for a country scope.
o1nrxb.zh: 为国家作用域中的某个专精或全部专精增加突破点数。

1wp9bes.en: ⟦0⟧ The specialization e.g. specialization_land. value = <int> The amount of specialization breakthrough progress to be added.
1wp9bes.zh: ⟦0⟧ 专精，例如 specialization_land。value = <int> 要增加的专精突破进度。

8ex1n7.en: Add breakthrough progress to one specialization or all for a country scope.
8ex1n7.zh: 为国家作用域中的某个专精或全部专精增加突破进度。

af6sdn.en: The value can either be an absolute value or a script constant.
af6sdn.zh: 该值可以是绝对值或脚本常量。

193l2pg.en: These are career profile related effects in the country scope.
193l2pg.zh: 以下是国家作用域中与生涯档案相关的效果。

it65sm.en: Step completed Mussolini missions by one for the career profile.
it65sm.zh: 将生涯档案中已完成的墨索里尼任务数加一。

19n8e8n.en: These effects can ⟦0⟧, failing when used outside. However, they're considered effects anyway rather than history arguments, as they can be used in if statements.
19n8e8n.zh: 这些效果 ⟦0⟧，在文件外使用时会失败。不过它们仍被视为效果而非历史参数，因为它们可用于 if 语句中。

c6xssb.en: only be used within history files
c6xssb.zh: 只能在历史文件中使用

1wz7kow.en: Effects to be used in country history files:
1wz7kow.zh: 用于国家历史文件的效果：

2hw0i5.en: Initially assigns the specified character to the current country.
2hw0i5.zh: 在初始时将指定角色分配给当前国家。

1wzpz1f.en: ⟦0⟧ Mandatory, acts as the character token. name = <localisation key> The name used for the character. Generates a random name if not set.
1wzpz1f.zh: ⟦0⟧ 必填，作为角色令牌。name = <localisation key> 该角色使用的名字。未设置时生成随机名字。

oyckmr.en: Generates a character for current country.
oyckmr.zh: 为当前国家生成一个角色。

fu2txq.en: If used to create an advisor, the idea token of the advisor role will be the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ (defaulting to the slot if the idea token is not set) concatenated, with an underscore as a separator. In the provided example, the idea token will be ⟦2⟧; if ⟦3⟧ wasn't present, it'd be ⟦4⟧.
fu2txq.zh: 若用于创建顾问，则顾问职务的理念令牌将由 ⟦0⟧ 与 ⟦1⟧ 拼接而成（若未设置理念令牌，则默认使用槽位），以下划线作为分隔符。在给出的示例中，理念令牌将是 ⟦2⟧；若没有 ⟦3⟧，则为 ⟦4⟧。

gw6rfw.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the file used for the order of battle without the ⟦1⟧ extension.
gw6rfw.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于战斗序列的文件名，不含 ⟦1⟧ 扩展名。

aydx5c.en: Sets the order of battle to be used for the current country's divisions, overriding every other non-naval and non-air order of battle.
aydx5c.zh: 设置当前国家各师所使用的战斗序列，覆盖所有其他非海军、非空军的战斗序列。

b1nqu1.en: Orders of battle are defined in ⟦0⟧ files.
b1nqu1.zh: 战斗序列定义于 ⟦0⟧ 文件中。

hl2v2n.en: Sets the order of battle to be used for the current country's divisions, overriding every other naval order of battle.
hl2v2n.zh: 设置当前国家各师所使用的战斗序列，覆盖所有其他海军战斗序列。

1se3lvb.en: Sets the order of battle to be used for the current country's divisions, overriding every other air order of battle.
1se3lvb.zh: 设置当前国家各师所使用的战斗序列，覆盖所有其他空军战斗序列。

1gf4ovw.en: ⟦0⟧ The key used for the file. name = <order of battle> The name of the file used for the order of battle without the .txt extension.
1gf4ovw.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该文件使用的键。name = <order of battle> 用于战斗序列的文件名，不含 .txt 扩展名。

14ey710.en: Sets the order of battle to be used for the current country's divisions, overriding every other keyed order of battle that uses the same key.
14ey710.zh: 设置当前国家各师所使用的战斗序列，覆盖所有其他使用相同键的键控战斗序列。

1nb3hbn.en: These are variable related effects in the country scope.
1nb3hbn.zh: 以下是国家作用域中与变量相关的效果。

g4wxhr.en: ⟦0⟧ Id that is used in country scorer. var Variable name that the result will be stored. (default is highest_scored_country)
g4wxhr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 国家评分器中使用的 Id。var 用于存储结果的变量名。（默认为 highest_scored_country）

jeddom.en: Calculates the highest scored country that is defined in a country scorer and sets it to a variable.
jeddom.zh: 计算国家评分器中定义的得分最高的国家，并将其存入变量。

207fhx.en: ⟦0⟧ Id that is used in country scorer. array = <string> A name to store sorted countries as a temp array (default to sorted_country_list) scores = <string> Corresponding score temp array for countries stored in array (default to country_list_scores)
207fhx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 国家评分器中使用的 Id。array = <string> 用于将排序后的国家存储为临时数组的名称（默认为 sorted_country_list）scores = <string> 与 array 中存储的国家对应的得分临时数组（默认为 country_list_scores）

1lebcd0.en: Calculates & sorts all countries in a country scorer and stores them and their scores in temp arrays.
1lebcd0.zh: 计算并排序国家评分器中的所有国家，并将其及对应得分存入临时数组。

a6stu9.en: ⟦0⟧ Variable name to set. type = <type> Can be truck or train. need = <bool> Default no. If yes, gets the number of needed vehicles.
a6stu9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要设置的变量名。type = <type> 可以是 truck 或 train。need = <bool> 默认为 no。若为 yes，则获取所需车辆的数量。

wgxbux.en: Sets a variable to the number of supply vehicles in stockpile or that are needed.
wgxbux.zh: 将变量设置为库存中或所需的补给车辆数量。

52c42x.en: Sets a temp variable to the number of supply vehicles in stockpile or that are needed.
52c42x.zh: 将临时变量设置为库存中或所需的补给车辆数量。

kxmw4q.en: ⟦0⟧ The event to fire. days = <int> / <variable> Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional. hours = <int> / <variable> Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional. random = <int> / <variable> Adds a random number (between 0 and random, inclusive) of hours to the scheduled fire time. Optional. random_days = <int> / <variable> Adds a random number (between 0 and random_days, inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional.
kxmw4q.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要触发的事件。days = <int> / <variable> 在指定的天数后触发该事件。可选。hours = <int> / <variable> 在指定的小时数后触发该事件。可选。random = <int> / <variable> 在预定触发时间上增加随机小时数（介于 0 与 random 之间，含两端）。可选。random_days = <int> / <variable> 在预定触发时间上增加随机天数（介于 0 与 random_days 之间，含两端）。可选。

1554rln.en: Fires the specified event for the current state.
1554rln.zh: 为当前州触发指定的事件。

qohrf2.en: Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked ⟦0⟧ can be a performance light alternative to ⟦1⟧ for scheduling events. Using days = <event> / <variable> or hours may still be bugged and will not fire the event.
qohrf2.zh: 在无需反复检查触发器的场合，⟦0⟧ 可作为安排事件时性能开销更低的 ⟦1⟧ 替代方案。使用 days = <event> / <variable> 或 hours 可能仍有 bug，会导致事件无法触发。

1mva3km.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the state flag with. OR flag = <flag> The flag to set. days = <int> Sets the flag to last for the specified amount of days. Optional. value = <int> The new value of the flag on the scale from -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647.
1mva3km.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识州旗标的唯一字符串。或 flag = <flag> 要设置的旗标。days = <int> 使该旗标持续指定的天数。可选。value = <int> 旗标的新数值，范围为 -2 147 483 648 到 2 147 483 647。

ifk5oq.en: ⟦0⟧ The unique string of a state flag to clear.
ifk5oq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要清除的州旗标的唯一字符串。

t6fnp9.en: Changes the current state's name to the specified name.
t6fnp9.zh: 将当前州的名称更改为指定名称。

1hpmpsd.en: Resets any changes to the current state's name.
1hpmpsd.zh: 重置对当前州名称所做的任何更改。

7wp9z1.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to add the claim for.
7wp9z1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要为其添加宣称的国家。

18d5ad.en: Adds a claim for the specified country on the current scope.
18d5ad.zh: 为指定国家在当前作用域上添加宣称。

13pc52s.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to remove the claim for.
13pc52s.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要为其移除宣称的国家。

oe5v16.en: Removes a claim by the specified country on the current scope.
oe5v16.zh: 移除指定国家在当前作用域上的宣称。

1gdfues.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to add the core for.
1gdfues.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要为其添加核心的国家。

l06rii.en: Adds a core for the specified country on the current scope.
l06rii.zh: 为指定国家在当前作用域上添加核心。

1wumq97.en: ⟦0⟧ The country to remove the core for.
1wumq97.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要为其移除核心的国家。

hc6vev.en: Removes a core for the specified country on the current scope.
hc6vev.zh: 移除指定国家在当前作用域上的核心。

167flxi.en: Makes the current scope a demilitarized zone.
167flxi.zh: 将当前作用域设为非军事区。

1kn0a2n.en: Changes the current state category to the specified category.
1kn0a2n.zh: 将当前州类别更改为指定类别。

1h0zq2t.en: ⟦0⟧ <modifier> = <float> Adds a modifier to the state.

697kjt.en: Adds a ⟦0⟧ to the current state.

w0b3lu.en: Adds the specified amount of total population to the current state.
w0b3lu.zh: 为当前州添加指定数量的总人口。

12yg1jm.en: Note that when using negative manpower it will, besides reducing the population, also add directly to the recruitable manpower of the state. Which will increase your manpower
12yg1jm.zh: 注意：使用负人力时，除了减少人口外，还会直接加入该州的可招募人力，从而增加你的人力。

pjdggn.en: ⟦0⟧ The resource to add. amount = <int> / <variable> The amount to add.
pjdggn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的资源。amount = <int> / <variable> 要添加的数量。

8edaa2.en: Adds the specified resource in the specified amount to the current state.
8edaa2.zh: 为当前州添加指定资源的指定数量。

rueds7.en: Can also be used in country scope.
rueds7.zh: 也可在国家作用域中使用。

nzo225.en: Enables Border War status for the current state.
nzo225.zh: 为当前州启用边境战争状态。

uaz759.en: Used for the state-based border wars, represented with orange stripes, see ⟦0⟧ for the border wars that simulate combat on a border between two countries. On the end of the border war, ⟦1⟧ is fired for the state that where the border war was lost.
uaz759.zh: 用于以州的边境战争，在地图上以橙色条纹表示，模拟两国边境上的战斗的边境战争参见⟦0⟧。边境战争结束时，会对输掉边境战争的州触发⟦1⟧。

1s0fjc3.en: ⟦0⟧ The division string. owner = <country> The owner of the division. prioritize_location = <province> If possible, this province within the state gets used. Optional. allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = yes Allows the units to be created on provinces owned by the division owner's enemy. Defaults to false. count = <int> The amount of units to create. Defaults to 1. id = <int> The ID to identify the unit. Only used in delete_unit. country_score = { ... } A MTTH block deciding the province in the state where the division should spawn, evaluates in the scope of the controller. Defaults to prioritising owner's controlled provinces first and then owner's allies. divisional_commander_xp = <int> give the division commander experience on unit creation The following arguments go within division = "": name = \"<string>\" The name of the division. division_template = \"<string>\" The template to be used by the division. start_experience_factor = <double> Experience of the division, with 0 being none and 1 being full training. Defaults to 1. start_equipment_factor = <double> Equipment stockpile of the division. Defaults to 1. start_manpower_factor = <double> Manpower stockpile of the division. Defaults to 1. force_equipment_variants = { <equipment type> = { owner = \"<country>\" amount = <int> version_name = \"<string>\" } } Forces a certain type of equipment to be used. Multiple equipment types can be added by adding multiple <equipment type> = {} lines.
1s0fjc3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 师字符串。owner = <country> 该师的所有者。prioritize_location = <province> 如有可能，会使用该州内的此省份。可选。allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = yes 允许在师所有者的敌方所拥有的省份上创建单位。默认为 false。count = <int> 要创建的单位数量。默认为 1。id = <int> 用于标识该单位的 ID。仅在 delete_unit 中使用。country_score = { ... } 一个 MTTH 块，决定该师应在州内哪个省份生成，在控制者作用域中求值。默认优先考虑所有者控制的省份，其次为所有者的盟友。divisional_commander_xp = <int> 在创建单位时给予该师指挥官经验。以下参数需写在 division = "" 之内：name = \"<string>\" 该师的名称。division_template = \"<string>\" 该师使用的模板。start_experience_factor = <double> 该师的经验，0 表示无经验，1 表示满训练。默认为 1。start_equipment_factor = <double> 该师的装备储备。默认为 1。start_manpower_factor = <double> 该师的人力储备。默认为 1。force_equipment_variants = { <equipment type> = { owner = \"<country>\" amount = <int> version_name = \"<string>\" } } 强制使用某一类装备。添加多条 <equipment type> = {} 行即可指定多类装备。

19ry5uz.en: ⟦0⟧ The template to be used by the division.

16mgznw.en: ⟦0⟧ Experience of the division, with 0 being none and 1 being full training. Defaults to 1.
16mgznw.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该师的经验，0 表示无经验，1 表示满训练。默认为 1。

8jwhbj.en: ⟦0⟧ Equipment stockpile of the division. Defaults to 1.
8jwhbj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该师的装备储备。默认为 1。

fkm1c6.en: ⟦0⟧ Manpower stockpile of the division. Defaults to 1.
fkm1c6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该师的人力储备。默认为 1。

iowo81.en: ⟦0⟧ Forces a certain type of equipment to be used. Multiple equipment types can be added by adding multiple <equipment type> = {} lines.
iowo81.zh: ⟦0⟧ 强制使用某一类装备。添加多条 <equipment type> = {} 行即可指定多类装备。

wqwti3.en: Adds the specified division to the current state.
wqwti3.zh: 将指定的师添加到当前州。

1q38t1e.en: The division string ⟦0⟧. A linebreak in the middle of ⟦1⟧ will break the effect and result in no units being spawned. Can only be used within a state scope, such as capital_scope. The effect will do nothing when put into a country's scope. Equipment factor cannot be set to zero. If set to zero, it will be treated as a 1. Created equipment will be the latest available to the country.
1q38t1e.zh: 师字符串⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧中间出现换行会破坏该效果，导致不会生成任何单位。只能在州作用域内使用，例如 capital_scope。放入国家作用域时该效果不会产生任何作用。装备系数不能设为零。若设为零，将被视为 1。创建的装备将是该国当前可用的最新装备。

1ui6r38.en: Can only be used within a state scope
1ui6r38.zh: 只能在州作用域内使用

ent7fb.en: Equipment factor cannot be set to zero.

1eotgbz.en: ⟦0⟧ The condition that must be true for the owner of the armies for them to teleport. to_state_array = <array> The state array the armies will get teleported to. to_province = <ID> The province the armies will get teleported to. to_state = <ID> The state the armies will get teleported to.
1eotgbz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 军队所有者必须满足该条件，其军队才会被传送。to_state_array = <array> 军队将被传送到的州数组。to_province = <ID> 军队将被传送到的省份。to_state = <ID> 军队将被传送到的州。

iioggw.en: Teleports all armies in the specified state if the owner of the armies meets the condition.
iioggw.zh: 若军队所有者满足条件，则传送指定州内的所有军队。

umqo86.en: Only define one of to_state_array, to_state, or to_province. If none is specified, it defaults to the capital.
umqo86.zh: to_state_array、to_state 和 to_province 只能定义其中一个。若都未指定，则默认为首都。

ij65mc.en: ⟦0⟧ The list of modifiers. ⟦1⟧The province to apply the modifiers to.⟦2⟧Scope for selecting multiple provinces. The following arguments have to go inside it: ⟦3⟧The ID of the province. Multiple can be specified. ⟦4⟧Selects all provinces to which the limitations apply. The following arguments require it: ⟦5⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only coastal ones. ⟦6⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only ones bordering a different country. ⟦7⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only ones that have a naval base. ⟦8⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only ones that have a victory point, or a city, in them. ⟦9⟧ Will be temporary if specified, can be variable
ij65mc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修正列表。 ⟦1⟧要应用修正的省份。⟦2⟧用于选择多个省份的作用域。以下参数必须写在其中： ⟦3⟧省份的 ID。可指定多个。 ⟦4⟧选择所有符合限制条件的省份。以下参数需要它： ⟦5⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅沿海省份。 ⟦6⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅与不同国家接壤的省份。 ⟦7⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅拥有海军基地的省份。 ⟦8⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅拥有胜利点或城市的省份。 ⟦9⟧ 若指定则为临时修正，可以使用变量

1o1vtfy.en: Adds a province modifier to the specified provinces in this state.
1o1vtfy.zh: 为该州内指定的省份添加一项省份修正。

o5cyae.en: ⟦0⟧ The list of modifiers. ⟦1⟧The province to apply the modifiers to.⟦2⟧Scope for selecting multiple provinces. The following arguments have to go inside it: ⟦3⟧The ID of the province. Multiple can be specified. ⟦4⟧Selects all provinces to which the limitations apply. The following arguments require it: ⟦5⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only coastal ones. ⟦6⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only ones bordering a different country. ⟦7⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only ones that have a naval base. ⟦8⟧ Limits the selection of provinces to only ones that have a victory point, or a city, in them.
o5cyae.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修正列表。 ⟦1⟧要应用修正的省份。⟦2⟧用于选择多个省份的作用域。以下参数必须写在其中： ⟦3⟧省份的 ID。可指定多个。 ⟦4⟧选择所有符合限制条件的省份。以下参数需要它： ⟦5⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅沿海省份。 ⟦6⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅与不同国家接壤的省份。 ⟦7⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅拥有海军基地的省份。 ⟦8⟧ 将省份选择限制为仅拥有胜利点或城市的省份。

1jratf9.en: Removes a province modifier to the specified provinces in this state.
1jratf9.zh: 移除该州内指定省份的省份修正。

og0hrr.en: Add victory points to a province

15tvgdu.en: Adds victory points to a province.

3p6qj.en: Set the victory points of a province

1qrb8wx.en: Sets the number of victory point in a province.
1qrb8wx.zh: 设置省份的胜利点数量。

1bfyngv.en: ⟦0⟧ The new controller of the province. limit = { <triggers> } The triggers that must be fulfilled by the province's current controller to be transferred to the new controller. ⟦1⟧
1bfyngv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 省份的新控制者。limit = { <triggers> } 省份当前控制者必须满足这些触发器，才会被移交给新的控制者。 ⟦1⟧

1dz7dif.en: limit = { <triggers> } The triggers that must be fulfilled by the province's current controller to be transferred to the new controller.
1dz7dif.zh: limit = { <triggers> } 省份当前控制者必须满足这些触发器，才会被移交给新的控制者。

1x47i6n.en: Changes the controller of all provinces within that state controlled by countries that meet triggers to the specified country.
1x47i6n.zh: 将该州内由满足触发器的国家控制的所有省份的控制者更改为指定国家。

9k9v49.en: ⟦0⟧ Country to transfer the state to.
9k9v49.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将该州移交给的国家。

n6snu6.en: Sets owner and controller of the state to the given country
n6snu6.zh: 将该州的所有者和控制者设置为指定国家

qnycxh.en: ⟦0⟧ Country to set the owner ⟦1⟧ of the state to.
qnycxh.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将该州的所有者⟦1⟧设置为的国家。

k9eel4.en: Sets the owner of the state to the given country
k9eel4.zh: 将该州的所有者设置为指定国家

10540gj.en: Use ⟦0⟧ unless the control specifically shouldn't be given.
10540gj.zh: 除非明确不应给予控制权，否则请使用⟦0⟧。

1v0mweg.en: ⟦0⟧ Country to set the controller ⟦1⟧ of the state to.
1v0mweg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将该州的控制者⟦1⟧设置为的国家。

1fnamft.en: Sets the controller of the state to the given country
1fnamft.zh: 将该州的控制者设置为指定国家

1ezyr6y.en: ⟦0⟧ Country to add contest to state.
1ezyr6y.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要为该州添加争夺的国家。

opo71b.en: ⟦0⟧ Country to remove contest to state.
opo71b.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除对该州争夺的国家。

zjqk6l.en: Add a strategic location to a province using state scope. The available strategic locations are defined in strategic_locations and are specified with a province id.
zjqk6l.zh: 使用州作用域为省份添加一个战略位置。可用的战略位置在 strategic_locations 中定义，并通过省份 id 指定。

1bot8l1.zh: 可以包含多个战略位置。

x6xihn.en: Add strategic locations to a state in scope. The available strategic locations are defined in strategic_locations.
x6xihn.zh: 为作用域中的州添加战略位置。可用的战略位置在 strategic_locations 中定义。

14lbunf.zh: 与建筑相关的州作用域效果：

17sgplq.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of slots to add or remove.
17sgplq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加或移除的槽位数量。

pq6mk1.en: Changes the number of shared building slots for the current state.
pq6mk1.zh: 更改当前州的共享建筑槽位数量。

h68r2l.en: Shared buildings slots being the ones used for multiple building types, such as military or civilian factories. This is in contrast to non-shared slots, such as those used by radio stations or air bases, which only can be changed globally with technologies. Note: When using a variable and a saved event target, must be used as "saved_event.var_name" because "event_target:saved_event.var_name" will not work.
h68r2l.zh: 共享建筑槽位指可供多种建筑类型使用的槽位，例如军用工厂或民用工厂。这与非共享槽位相对，例如无线电台或空军基地使用的槽位，它们只能通过科技全局更改。注意：使用变量和已保存的事件目标时，必须写作 "saved_event.var_name"，因为 "event_target:saved_event.var_name" 无法生效。

kd2yur.en: ⟦0⟧ The building to add. level = <int> / <variable> The level to set the building to. instant_build = <bool> Defines whether the buildings are instantly built. province = <id> Defines the exact province to add provincal buildings in. Can be used as a scope. Province scope all_provinces = <bool> Affect all provinces within the state that meet each limit. Used in the province scope. id = <id> Affect the specified province ID. Used in the province scope, will apply for each province if inserted multiple times. limit_to_coastal = <bool> Affect only coastal provinces within the selection. Used in the province scope. limit_to_naval_base = <bool> Affect only provinces that have naval bases built. Used in the province scope. limit_to_border = <bool> Affect only provinces that lie on a border between countries. Used in the province scope. limit_to_border_country = <country> Affect only provinces that border a specific other country. Used in the province scope. limit_to_victory_point = <int>/<bool> Affect only provinces that meet the victory point amount prerequisite. If yes is used in place of a number, any amount of victory points works. Used in the province scope. limit_to_supply_node = <bool> Affect only provinces that have a supply node. Used in the province scope. level = <int> Affect only provinces with buildings level below, at or above the specified level. Used in the province scope.
kd2yur.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的建筑。level = <int> / <variable> 要将建筑设置到的等级。instant_build = <bool> 定义建筑是否瞬间建成。province = <id> 定义要在其中添加省份建筑的具体省份。可用作作用域。省份作用域 all_provinces = <bool> 影响州内所有满足各项限制的省份。在省份作用域中使用。id = <id> 影响指定的省份 ID。在省份作用域中使用，若多次插入则会对每个省份生效。limit_to_coastal = <bool> 仅影响所选范围内的沿海省份。在省份作用域中使用。limit_to_naval_base = <bool> 仅影响已建有海军基地的省份。在省份作用域中使用。limit_to_border = <bool> 仅影响位于国家之间边境上的省份。在省份作用域中使用。limit_to_border_country = <country> 仅影响与某个特定国家接壤的省份。在省份作用域中使用。limit_to_victory_point = <int>/<bool> 仅影响满足胜利点数量前提的省份。若用 yes 代替数字，则任意数量的胜利点均可。在省份作用域中使用。limit_to_supply_node = <bool> 仅影响拥有补给节点的省份。在省份作用域中使用。level = <int> 仅影响建筑等级低于、等于或高于指定等级的省份。在省份作用域中使用。

4ymc3r.en: Starts construction in the current state for the specified building.
4ymc3r.zh: 在当前州开始建造指定的建筑。

1dsvr30.en: For provincial buildings, ⟦0⟧ even if done on a specific province. ⟦1⟧ until a recalculation of buildings, such as by changing consumer goods or reloading a savefile. Can only be used within a state scope, such as random_owned_controlled_state. The effect will do nothing when put into a country's scope. For the list of building IDs present in the base game, see Building modding#Types.
1dsvr30.zh: 对于省份建筑，⟦0⟧，即使是对特定省份操作也一样。⟦1⟧，直到重新计算建筑为止，例如通过更改消费品或重新加载存档。只能在州作用域内使用，例如 random_owned_controlled_state。放入国家作用域时该效果不会产生任何作用。基础游戏中存在的建筑 ID 列表参见 Building modding#Types。

18p5xtv.en: must be done within the scope of the state that contains the province
18p5xtv.zh: 必须在包含该省份的州的作用域内进行

1za1hm.en: If the controller country doesn't have an ⟦0⟧, the buildings will not show up within the production menu
1za1hm.zh: 如果控制者国家没有⟦0⟧，这些建筑将不会出现在生产菜单中

19jtlig.en: order of battle assigned within the history file
19jtlig.zh: 在历史文件中分配的作战序列

lt4igv.en: Sets the specified building to the current state (or provinces within the state).
lt4igv.zh: 将指定的建筑设置到当前州（或该州内的省份）。

1kyx62k.en: The province scope is used for provincal level buildings. You can limit the construction to victory points using : ⟦0⟧ (only build province buildings on province with VP over 5 ) ⟦1⟧ (only build province buildings on province with VP) For provincial buildings, ⟦2⟧ even if done on a specific province.
1kyx62k.zh: 省份作用域用于省份级建筑。你可以使用以下方式将建造限制到胜利点： ⟦0⟧（只在胜利点高于 5 的省份上建造省份建筑） ⟦1⟧（只在拥有胜利点的省份上建造省份建筑） 对于省份建筑，⟦2⟧，即使是对特定省份操作也一样。

8if86r.en: ⟦0⟧ The building to damage. tags = <building_tag> The buildings with this tag to damage. tags = { <building_tag> } The buildings with these tags to damage. repair_speed_modifier = <float> Repair will be x% slower until building is fully repaired damage = <float> The amount of damage to inflict. province = <id> / <variable> The province to target for provincal buildings.
8if86r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要损坏的建筑。tags = <building_tag> 要损坏的带有此标签的建筑。tags = { <building_tag> } 要损坏的带有这些标签的建筑。repair_speed_modifier = <float> 在建筑完全修复前，修复速度将减慢 x%。damage = <float> 要造成的损坏量。province = <id> / <variable> 省份建筑的目标省份。

5agsgy.en: The health of buildings is determined by the ⟦0⟧ attribute in a building's definition. This is multiplied by their level to get their total health. Can also be used in country scope.
5agsgy.zh: 建筑的生命值由建筑定义中的⟦0⟧属性决定。它乘以建筑等级即为总生命值。也可在国家作用域中使用。

1iwitts.en: ⟦0⟧ The building to remove. tag = <building_tag> The buildings with this tag to remove. tag = { <building_tag> } The buildings with these tags to remove. level = <int> / <variable> The levels to remove.
1iwitts.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除的建筑。tag = <building_tag> 要移除的带有此标签的建筑。tag = { <building_tag> } 要移除的带有这些标签的建筑。level = <int> / <variable> 要移除的等级数。

6ra4kd.en: Removes the specified building in the current state. For shared buildings level determines the amount, whereas for the others it is the actual level.
6ra4kd.zh: 移除当前州中指定的建筑。对于共享建筑，level 决定数量；对于其他建筑，它表示实际等级。

cct9de.en: Set building level in a random province of state scope.
cct9de.zh: 在州作用域内的随机省份设置建筑等级。

1rvjw96.zh: 与抵抗度相关的州作用域效果：

zl8z0p.en: Adds compliance to the specified state.
zl8z0p.zh: 为指定的州添加顺从度。

1faftpv.en: Adds resistance to the specified state.
1faftpv.zh: 为指定的州添加抵抗度。

4s2o77.en: Increases resistance target in the specified state.
4s2o77.zh: 提高指定州的抵抗度目标。

11aipef.en: ⟦0⟧ The ID of the target increase. ⟦1⟧ The amount to increase the resistance target by. ⟦2⟧ Will only apply the increase if the the occupied country is the specified scope. ⟦3⟧ Will only apply the increase if the the occupier is the specified scope. ⟦4⟧ If set, the resistance target will only be increased for the specified amount of days. ⟦5⟧ The tooltip to show in the resistance target tooltip.
11aipef.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该目标增加的 ID。 ⟦1⟧ 抵抗度目标提高的数量。 ⟦2⟧ 仅当被占领国家为指定作用域时才会应用该提高。 ⟦3⟧ 仅当占领者为指定作用域时才会应用该提高。 ⟦4⟧ 若设置，抵抗度目标只会在指定的天数内提高。 ⟦5⟧ 在抵抗度目标工具提示中显示的工具提示。

14etpvg.en: Cancels resistance activity for the current state.
14etpvg.zh: 取消当前州的抵抗度活动。

1m70ccu.en: Disables resistance for the scoped state when the occupier is the specified country.
1m70ccu.zh: 当占领者为指定国家时，禁用作用域州的抵抗度。

7v6990.en: ⟦0⟧ If set to yes, will clear resistance. ⟦1⟧ Resistance will be disabled if the occupier is the specified scope. ⟦2⟧ Resistance will be disabled if the occupied country is the specified scope.
7v6990.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若设为 yes，将清除抵抗度。 ⟦1⟧ 若占领者为指定作用域，抵抗度将被禁用。 ⟦2⟧ 若被占领国家为指定作用域，抵抗度将被禁用。

s4rf9t.en: Enables resistance for the scoped state when the occupier is the specified country.
s4rf9t.zh: 当占领者为指定国家时，启用作用域州的抵抗度。

an1o77.en: Does not start resistance by itself, only removes the checks forcefully disabling it. Use with ⟦0⟧ in order to immediately start resistance.
an1o77.zh: 它本身不会启动抵抗度，只会移除那些强制禁用抵抗度的检查。与⟦0⟧配合使用即可立即启动抵抗度。

css1wm.en: ⟦0⟧ If set to yes, will clear resistance. ⟦1⟧ Resistance will be enabled if the occupier is the specified scope. ⟦2⟧ Resistance will be enabled if the occupied country is the specified scope.
css1wm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若设为 yes，将清除抵抗度。 ⟦1⟧ 若占领者为指定作用域，抵抗度将被启用。 ⟦2⟧ 若被占领国家为指定作用域，抵抗度将被启用。

1u63lnh.en: ⟦0⟧ The id of the resistance target to remove. (Must be set with add_resistance_target)
1u63lnh.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除的抵抗度目标的 id。（必须通过 add_resistance_target 设置）

1buhic2.en: Removes a set resistance target increase in the specified state.
1buhic2.zh: 移除指定州中已设置的抵抗度目标提高。

1cx3gy9.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount to set the compliance to.
1cx3gy9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将顺从度设置为的数量。

11f9o7g.en: Sets compliance in the specified state.

ol8e8j.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount to set the resistance to.
ol8e8j.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要将抵抗度设置为的数量。

1v8j2fa.en: Sets resistance in the specified state.

1im4qgt.en: The resistance should be enabled in the state, either via ⟦0⟧ or through the in-game process. Occassionally it may take a tick for resistance to start after the controllership change, so it's preferable to do so on states that are given to the country immediately before this gets executed, such as if this is executed in country history.
1im4qgt.zh: 该州应已启用抵抗度，可以通过⟦0⟧或游戏内流程启用。控制权变更后，抵抗度有时需要过一个 tick 才会开始，因此最好在紧接该效果执行之前交给该国的州上执行，例如在国家历史文件中执行时。

wq674k.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether to start resistance or not. If using a country as the parameter, the state will only start resistance if occupied by the target country.
wq674k.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是否启动抵抗度。若以国家作为参数，则该州只有在被目标国家占领时才会启动抵抗度。

1oei0sa.en: Starts resistance in the specified state.
1oei0sa.zh: 在指定的州启动抵抗度。

q2rjyp.en: If used on a state that normally can't start resistance, use alongside with ⟦0⟧.
q2rjyp.zh: 若用于通常无法启动抵抗度的州，请与⟦0⟧配合使用。

1pezjo8.en: Sets the strength of the garrison in the specified state.
1pezjo8.zh: 设置指定州驻军的强度。

q8irdr.en: GER = { every_controlled_state = { set_occupation_law = military_governor_occupation } } # Changes GER's occupation law for every controlled state.
q8irdr.zh: GER = { every_controlled_state = { set_occupation_law = military_governor_occupation } } # 更改 GER 每个受控州的占领法令。

kijy19.en: Sets the occupation law of the state.

1e311g6.en: ⟦0⟧ will be the country for whom the occupation law will be changed. If PREV is not a country, nothing changes. If PREV doesn't occupy the state, nothing happens until it does. If using ⟦1⟧, resets to the law set by the country's occupation. Can also be used in country scope.
1e311g6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将是更改其占领法令的国家。若 PREV 不是国家，则不会有任何变化。若 PREV 未占领该州，则在占领之前不会发生任何事。若使用⟦1⟧，则重置为该国的占领所设置的法令。也可在国家作用域中使用。

1118rl2.zh: 与突袭相关的州作用域效果：

1pqozi9.en: Reduce progress to the special project in state. Root scope is raid instance scope. The input value is a ratio of the total needed progress to complete the special project, i.e. a decimal number between 0 and 1.
1pqozi9.zh: 减少州内特殊项目的进度。根作用域为突袭实例作用域。输入值为完成特殊项目所需总进度的比例，即 0 到 1 之间的小数。

ckzn08.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the character flag with. OR flag = <flag> The flag to set. days = <int> Sets the flag to last for the specified amount of days. Optional. value = <int> The new value of the flag on the scale from -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647.
ckzn08.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该角色旗标的唯一字符串。或者 flag = <flag> 要设置的旗标。days = <int> 将旗标设为持续指定的天数。可选。value = <int> 旗标的新值，取值范围为 -2 147 483 648 到 2 147 483 647。

11ltgbn.en: Changes the character's name to the specified localisation key's value.
11ltgbn.zh: 将角色的名称更改为指定本地化键的值。

e4hgpe.zh: 使当前角色退役（将其移除）。

vlnuak.en: Switches the current character to the specified country, giving them the character.
vlnuak.zh: 将当前角色切换到指定国家，并把该角色交给该国。

1valwea.en: ⟦0⟧ The character name. Optional if in character scope. Army scope: small = <sprite> The sprite used as an advisor. large = <sprite> The sprite used as a general. Character scope:large = <sprite> The sprite used as a country leader.
1valwea.zh: ⟦0⟧ 角色名称。若在角色作用域中则可选。陆军作用域：small = <sprite> 用作顾问的立绘。large = <sprite> 用作将领的立绘。角色作用域：large = <sprite> 用作国家领袖的立绘。

c16b06.en: Changes the specified portraits of a character.

ycr7lv.en: ⟦0⟧ Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ideology = <sub-ideology> Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. trait = <trait> The trait to add.
ycr7lv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 角色的槽位。顾问必需。ideology = <sub-ideology> 角色的意识形态类型。国家领袖必需。trait = <trait> 要添加的特质。

nkvuhz.en: Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon. The character slot can be the character's name or id. Using name is recommended because 1.11 made id obsolete.
nkvuhz.zh: 意识形态类型指赋予角色的意识形态组下的子类型，社区术语中通常称为次意识形态。角色槽位可以是角色的名称或 id。推荐使用名称，因为 1.11 版本已使 id 过时。

98i59q.en: ⟦0⟧ Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ideology = <sub-ideology> Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. trait = <trait> The trait to remove.
98i59q.zh: ⟦0⟧ 角色的槽位。顾问必需。ideology = <sub-ideology> 角色的意识形态类型。国家领袖必需。trait = <trait> 要移除的特质。

k4p5ch.en: Does nothing if the character already has a country leader role in the ideology group.
k4p5ch.zh: 若该角色在意识形态组中已拥有国家领袖身份，则不会产生任何作用。

1d11btg.en: ⟦0⟧ Boolean. OR <ideology type> The ideology type used by the country leader role.
1d11btg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 布尔值。或者 <ideology type> 国家领袖身份使用的意识形态类型。

1oz04xt.en: If the character has multiple country leader roles, specifying the ideology type is mandatory. Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon.
1oz04xt.zh: 若该角色拥有多个国家领袖身份，则必须指定意识形态类型。意识形态类型指赋予角色的意识形态组下的子类型，社区术语中通常称为次意识形态。

obrm56.en: ⟦0⟧ The ideology type of the character.

bbz827.en: Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon.
bbz827.zh: 意识形态类型指赋予角色的意识形态组下的子类型，社区术语中通常称为次意识形态。

1j6q95a.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ activate = <bool> Will activate the advisor (add them directly when the command is run to the countries government). Optional, defaults to false.
1j6q95a.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ activate = <bool> 将激活该顾问（执行该指令时直接将其加入该国政府）。可选，默认为 false。

1qazxtt.en: Trigger and effect blocks (such as ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧) cannot be added within advisor definitions created this way.
1qazxtt.zh: 以这种方式创建的顾问定义中不能添加触发器和效果块（例如⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧）。

1jk01dc.en: ⟦0⟧ The slot where to remove the advisor slot from.
1jk01dc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要从中移除顾问的槽位。

v1bvr3.en: The scientist role format is the same as in the character DB. Except the visible trigger, a scientist role created via effect cannot have triggers. Can also be used in country scope.
v1bvr3.zh: 科学家身份的格式与角色数据库中相同。除了 visible 触发器外，通过效果创建的科学家身份不能拥有触发器。也可在国家作用域中使用。

1ae5azq.en: ⟦0⟧ Level to add. specialization = <specialization> Specialization to add.
1ae5azq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的等级。specialization = <specialization> 要添加的专业方向。

1lk5jsw.en: Add levels to a special project specialization for a scientist character in scope.
1lk5jsw.zh: 为作用域中的科学家角色添加特殊项目专业方向的等级。

mdq00u.en: ⟦0⟧ Amount of days to apply injure.

1l5q70k.en: Injure a scientist for x amount of days to a scientist character in scope.
1l5q70k.zh: 使作用域中的科学家角色受伤 x 天。

7sdcpl.en: Add a trait to a scientist character in scope.
7sdcpl.zh: 为作用域中的科学家角色添加一个特质。

1upjf19.en: ⟦0⟧ Expierience to add. specialization = <specialization> Specialization to add.
1upjf19.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的经验。specialization = <specialization> 要添加的专业方向。

dbt53f.en: Add experience to a special project specialization for a scientist character in scope.
dbt53f.zh: 为作用域中的科学家角色添加特殊项目专业方向的经验。

1bzqtd2.en: ⟦0⟧ The slot of the character to modify. value = <bool> The value to set.
1bzqtd2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要修改的角色的槽位。value = <bool> 要设置的值。

xdimtl.en: These can only be used with characters of the unit leader type.
xdimtl.zh: 这些只能用于单位指挥官类型的角色。

pt0yx.zh: 通用单位指挥官作用域效果：

vifs3m.en: Fires the specified event for the owner of the current unit leader.
vifs3m.zh: 为当前单位指挥官的所有者触发指定事件。

e31xt7.en: Uses a special interface displaying the current unit leader portrait. Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked random can be a performance light alternative to mean_time_to_happen for scheduling events.
e31xt7.zh: 使用显示当前单位指挥官立绘的特殊界面。在无需反复检查触发器的情况下，random 可作为比 mean_time_to_happen 更轻量的替代方式来安排事件。

oj2v0s.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the unit leader flag with.
oj2v0s.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该单位指挥官旗标的唯一字符串。

1sgxha3.zh: 定义一个单位指挥官旗标。

a7631f.en: Deprecated. Use ⟦0⟧ instead. No tooltip is shown.
a7631f.zh: 已弃用。请改用⟦0⟧。不显示工具提示。

dry8ss.en: ⟦0⟧ The unique string of a unit leader flag to clear.
dry8ss.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要清除的单位指挥官旗标的唯一字符串。

1uchiuq.en: Clears a defined unit leader flag.
1uchiuq.zh: 清除已定义的单位指挥官旗标。

9miqqd.en: The flag must be already set. Deprecated. Use ⟦0⟧ instead.
9miqqd.zh: 该旗标必须已经设置。已弃用。请改用⟦0⟧。

4faq5y.en: Promotes the current unit leader to Field Marshal (if Commander).
4faq5y.zh: 将当前单位指挥官晋升为元帅（若为指挥官）。

z2pwgc.en: Demotes the current unit leader to Commander (if Field Marshal).
z2pwgc.zh: 将当前单位指挥官降为指挥官（若为元帅）。

1wgkdly.en: Adds the specified trait to the current unit leader.
1wgkdly.zh: 为当前单位指挥官添加指定的特质。

ojlsby.en: Removes the specified trait from the current unit leader.
ojlsby.zh: 移除当前单位指挥官的指定特质。

9pnenh.en: Adds a random trait from the list to the character.
9pnenh.zh: 从列表中为该角色随机添加一个特质。

zwnng5.en: ⟦0⟧ The trait to add. days = <int> The duration of the trait.
zwnng5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的特质。days = <int> 该特质的持续时间。

mmnin8.en: Adds the specified trait to the current unit leader for the specified duration.
mmnin8.zh: 为当前单位指挥官添加指定持续时间的指定特质。

1sk3ynm.en: ⟦0⟧ The trait to replace. replace = <trait> The new trait to add.
1sk3ynm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要替换的特质。replace = <trait> 要添加的新特质。

1rf3yx8.en: Replaces the specified trait with the new trait.
1rf3yx8.zh: 将指定的特质替换为新特质。

e836mh.en: Traits are found in ⟦0⟧ files. Warning: This effect is extremely buggy. It does not properly replace traits and is crash prone. Use remove_unit_leader_trait and add_unit_leader_trait instead.
e836mh.zh: 特质可在⟦0⟧文件中找到。警告：该效果极易出错。它无法正确替换特质，并且容易导致崩溃。请改用 remove_unit_leader_trait 和 add_unit_leader_trait。

s6ay46.en: Remove the exile tag on an army leader, making them no longer be considered exile leaders.
s6ay46.zh: 移除陆军指挥官的流亡标签，使其不再被视为流亡指挥官。

14g1pae.zh: 移除指挥官的流亡标签。

1805ekm.en: Adds experience to the current unit leader, promoting to the next skill level if applicable.
1805ekm.zh: 为当前单位指挥官增加经验，若满足条件则晋升到下一技能等级。

1460jzm.en: Removes every unit leader role from the character
1460jzm.zh: 移除该角色的所有单位指挥官身份

cmler9.en: These can only be used with characters of the country leader type.
cmler9.zh: 这些只能用于国家领袖类型的角色。

u2rt7a.en: ⟦0⟧ The trait to add. OR: ideology = <sub-ideology> The sub-ideology of the country leader role to which the trait is added. trait = <trait> The trait to add.
u2rt7a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的特质。或者：ideology = <sub-ideology> 要添加特质的国家领袖身份的次意识形态。trait = <trait> 要添加的特质。

hmhzxe.en: Adds the specified trait to the current character.
hmhzxe.zh: 为当前角色添加指定的特质。

e40ooh.en: The former only if the character has one country leader role.
e40ooh.zh: 前者仅在该角色只有一个国家领袖身份时适用。

1cxqcq4.en: ⟦0⟧ The trait to remove. OR: ideology = <sub-ideology> The sub-ideology of the country leader role to which the trait is added. trait = <trait> The trait to remove.
1cxqcq4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除的特质。或者：ideology = <sub-ideology> 要为其添加特质的国家领袖身份的次意识形态。trait = <trait> 要移除的特质。

1h6nsa.en: Removes the specified trait from the current character.
1h6nsa.zh: 从当前角色移除指定的特质。

10yqtvb.en: ⟦0⟧ Trait to remove add = <trait> Trait to add ideology = <sub-ideology> Sub-ideology of the leader where to swap traits.
10yqtvb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除的特质 add = <trait> 要添加的特质 ideology = <sub-ideology> 要交换特质的领袖的次意识形态。

1egd9tq.en: Swaps traits of the current character.

167s7ct.zh: 与战斗相关的单位指挥官作用域效果：

1f16wil.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of hours of supply.

9bapj3.en: Adds the specified amount of hours of supply to troops led by the current unit leader.
9bapj3.zh: 为当前单位指挥官率领的部队添加指定小时数的补给。

oiwa6p.en: Adds the specified amount of assignable trait slots to the current unit leader.
oiwa6p.zh: 为当前单位指挥官添加指定数量的可分配特质槽位。

1g6z48e.en: Adds skill to the current unit leader.
1g6z48e.zh: 为当前单位指挥官增加技能。

1owqrgj.en: ⟦0⟧ How many skill levels to add.

8l1kyd.en: Adds logistics skill to the current unit leader.
8l1kyd.zh: 为当前单位指挥官增加后勤技能。

wyeeht.en: Adds planning skill to the current unit leader.
wyeeht.zh: 为当前单位指挥官增加计划技能。

kjn5fa.en: Adds defense skill to the current unit leader.
kjn5fa.zh: 为当前单位指挥官增加防御技能。

n1maiw.en: Adds attack skill to the current unit leader.
n1maiw.zh: 为当前单位指挥官增加攻击技能。

15nq0ch.en: Adds coordination skill to the current navy leader.
15nq0ch.zh: 为当前海军指挥官增加协同技能。

16kzdyd.en: Adds maneuver skill to the current navy leader.
16kzdyd.zh: 为当前海军指挥官增加机动技能。

1k0fdhq.en: This is a list of all ⟦0⟧ for each ⟦1⟧ with all ⟦2⟧ enabled. It does not include most ⟦3⟧.
1k0fdhq.zh: 本列表列出所有⟦0⟧，涵盖每个⟦1⟧，且已启用全部⟦2⟧。其中不包括大部分⟦3⟧。

26rgw9.en: For the most part, ⟦0⟧ in Hearts of Iron 4 is bilateral, meaning all relations, offers and requests are done one to one, between the player and the target country or between two AI countries. The exception to this is when a ⟦1⟧ is created. All members of a ⟦2⟧ will join defensive wars together and may also invite other ⟦3⟧ members to join offensive wars along with the aggressor.
26rgw9.zh: 大体而言，《Hearts of Iron 4》中的⟦0⟧是双边的，也就是说，所有关系、提议与请求都是一对一进行的，即发生在玩家与目标国家之间，或两个 AI 国家之间。唯一的例外是创建⟦1⟧时。⟦2⟧的所有成员会共同加入防御战争，也可以邀请其他⟦3⟧成员与侵略者一同加入进攻战争。

nr0k2l.en: Additionally, diplomacy is not symmetric. This means that all variables affecting the opinion of another country or the likelihood to accept an offer are completely independent for each country. For example, the player country may have positive relations with another country while that country might have negative relations with the player. Relations can be increased by being in the same ⟦0⟧, having the same ⟦1⟧, by Guaranteeing, through ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧.
nr0k2l.zh: 此外，外交并非对称的。这意味着，所有影响他国观感或接受提议可能性的变量，对每个国家来说都是完全独立的。例如，玩家国家可能对另一国持有正面关系，而该国对玩家却可能持有负面关系。关系可以通过以下方式提升：处于同一⟦0⟧、拥有相同⟦1⟧、提供保障独立、通过⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧。

1g29foi.en: There are a number of diplomatic actions in the game. All the diplomatic actions in the following table are the primary action, all the actions that are cancellable have a related diplomatic action that becomes available once the primary action is taken. It will also replace the primary action in the diplomatic menu. The only exceptions are Expeditionary Force, which will be cancelled by "Return Expeditions", and Ask for control of State, which will be cancelled by "Give control of State".
1g29foi.zh: 游戏中有若干外交行动。下表中所列的外交行动均为主体行动；所有可取消的行动都有一个与之关联的外交行动，在主体行动执行后即可使用。该行动还会在外交菜单中取代主体行动。仅有的例外是远征军——它会被「遣返远征军」取消——以及索取州的控制权——它会被「移交州的控制权」取消。

p7mszs.en: Guarantee the independence of another country. If anyone declares war on a guaranteed nation, that guaranteed nation will automatically join the ⟦0⟧ of the guarantor. Exception: If a nation guarantees both the nation that declares war and the nation that war is being declared upon, the guaranteeing nation will not automatically intervene.
p7mszs.zh: 保障另一国家的独立。若任何国家对被保障国宣战，该被保障国将自动加入保障国的⟦0⟧。例外：若一国同时保障宣战国与被宣战国的独立，该保障国不会自动介入。

n8ltpj.en: Target country has the same ideology. Costs 15 Political Power, +15 for each country already guaranteed.[2] World Tension threshold reached.
n8ltpj.zh: 目标国家拥有相同意识形态。花费 15 政治点数，每已保障一个国家再 +15。[2] 达到世界紧张度门槛。

1vs7dih.en: Costs 15 ⟦0⟧, +15 for each country already guaranteed.⟦1⟧
1vs7dih.zh: 花费 15 ⟦0⟧，每已保障一个国家再 +15。⟦1⟧

1mxjmbf.en: Target country does not guarantee you.
1mxjmbf.zh: 目标国家未保障你的独立。

1ryzmy.en: Calls an ally into a war.

s8dt7v.en: Is a member of the same ⟦0⟧.

184bxv8.en: Military access allows moving troops through the territory of another country, allied or not. Military access is granted automatically to members of the same ⟦0⟧.
184bxv8.zh: 军事通行权允许部队通过另一国家的领土，无论是否为盟国。同一⟦0⟧的成员会自动获得军事通行权。

qd7vy8.en: No troops on the target country's territory.
qd7vy8.zh: 目标国家领土上没有你的部队。

1pz2kqi.en: Offer to provide military access to another country. If they accept, it will not automatically grant you military access.
1pz2kqi.zh: 向另一国家提供军事通行权。若对方接受，并不会自动给予你军事通行权。

gmp23g.en: The target country has no troops on the territory of the country that has been granting access.
gmp23g.zh: 目标国家在提供通行权的国家领土上没有部队。

1efevaq.en: Docking rights allow moving ships into the ports of another country, allied or not. Docking rights are granted automatically to members of the same ⟦0⟧. Docking rights extends the naval range of your naval units.
1efevaq.zh: 停靠权允许舰船进入另一国家的港口，无论是否为盟国。同一⟦0⟧的成员会自动获得停靠权。停靠权可延长你的海军单位的航程。

16c046s.en: Offer to provide docking rights to another country. If they accept, it will not automatically grant you docking rights.
16c046s.zh: 向另一国家提供停靠权。若对方接受，并不会自动给予你停靠权。

ptuhso.en: Start improving relations between you and the target country up to +100 over time. Relation affects trade influence and the success likelihood of other diplomatic actions.
ptuhso.zh: 开始随时间改善你与目标国家之间的关系，最高可达 +100。关系会影响贸易影响力以及其他外交行动的成功可能性。

1xk50su.en: Must not be at war with target country. Costs 10 Political Power, +0.2 per day if both countries have the same ideology and +0.4 per day with differing ideology.[3]
1xk50su.zh: 不得与目标国家处于战争状态。花费 10 政治点数；若两国意识形态相同，每天 +0.2；意识形态不同则每天 +0.4。[3]

1ndntgg.en: Must not be at war with target country.
1ndntgg.zh: 不得与目标国家处于战争状态。

2ag9q2.en: Costs 10 ⟦0⟧, +0.2 per day if both countries have the same ⟦1⟧ and +0.4 per day with differing ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧

cri3cj.en: Sends an attache to a country. This gives the sender additional ⟦0⟧ and War support. They can also see the receiver's military positioning.
cri3cj.zh: 向一国派遣武官。这会使派遣方获得额外的⟦0⟧和战争支持度。派遣方还能看到受遣方的军队部署。

rda7xp.zh: 目标必须处于战争状态。

1kfd697.en: Having a non-aggression pact (NAP) disables "Justify War goal" and "Declare war" diplomatic actions.
1kfd697.zh: 拥有互不侵犯条约（NAP）会禁用「制造战争目标」和「宣战」外交行动。

1x5kyqg.en: Not cancellable without having a common border or within the first 12 months of the pact.⟦0⟧ After 12 months, the ability to break a NAP will depend on the relative size of armies along the common border.⟦1⟧ Up to 18 months past the NAP, the country will require a 2:1 ratio of troops compared to its opponent on the common border.⟦2⟧ Between 18 and 24 months, a 1:1 ratio is required.⟦3⟧ Past 24 months after the NAP, a 1:2 ratio is required to break the pact.⟦4⟧ NAPs dissolve after 48 months.⟦5⟧ If you declare war on a third country which is guaranteed by a country you have a NAP with, this country will join the war against you nevertheless. You cannot justify a war goal or declare war on a member of another faction if you have a NAP with that faction's leader.
1x5kyqg.zh: 在没有共同边界或条约签订后的最初 12 个月内无法取消。⟦0⟧ 12 个月后，能否撕毁互不侵犯条约取决于共同边界上双方军队的相对规模。⟦1⟧ 在条约签订后的 18 个月内，该国需要在共同边界上对对手拥有 2:1 的兵力比例。⟦2⟧ 在 18 至 24 个月之间，需要 1:1 的比例。⟦3⟧ 在互不侵犯条约签订超过 24 个月后，撕毁条约需要 1:2 的比例。⟦4⟧ 互不侵犯条约会在 48 个月后失效。⟦5⟧ 如果你向第三国宣战，而该国的独立受到与你签有互不侵犯条约的国家的保障，该国仍会加入对你的战争。如果你与某一阵营的领袖签有互不侵犯条约，你无法对该阵营的成员制造战争目标或宣战。

167segw.zh: 邀请另一国家加入你的⟦0⟧。

ltgzkg.en: Faction leader. Target country must accept. Requires popularity of inviting country's ideology > 30%.
ltgzkg.zh: 阵营领袖。目标国家必须接受。要求邀请国意识形态的支持率 > 30%。

aa2bw5.en: Must not be faction leader. Must not be in war with other faction members. If a country has been kicked from a faction, 90 days must pass before they are allowed to rejoin it.[12]
aa2bw5.zh: 不能是阵营领袖。不得与其他阵营成员交战。若一国曾被踢出阵营，必须经过 90 天才能重新加入。[12]

1w0b3k3.en: Must not be in war with other ⟦0⟧ members.

ipw892.en: If a country has been kicked from a faction, 90 days must pass before they are allowed to rejoin it.⟦0⟧
ipw892.zh: 若一国曾被踢出阵营，必须经过 90 天才能重新加入。⟦0⟧

v4w6mo.en: Requests ⟦0⟧ for specified equipment from target country, allowing you to produce that equipment yourself and ⟦1⟧ the technology to unlock it faster. ⟦2⟧ are used to pay for the license.
v4w6mo.zh: 向目标国家申请指定装备的⟦0⟧，使你能够自行生产该装备，并⟦1⟧相关科技以更快解锁。⟦2⟧ 用于支付许可费用。

w8d45z.en: 30 days minimum must pass before a license can be cancelled.⟦0⟧
w8d45z.zh: 取消许可前必须至少经过 30 天。⟦0⟧

167ogcb.en: If you are not already in a ⟦0⟧ and a ⟦1⟧ allows you to create a ⟦2⟧, you may invite another country to create a new ⟦3⟧.
167ogcb.zh: 如果你尚未处于某个⟦0⟧中，而某项⟦1⟧允许你创建⟦2⟧，你可以邀请另一国家创建新的⟦3⟧。

1jcy93f.en: Same ideology. Target country must accept.
1jcy93f.zh: 意识形态相同。目标国家必须接受。

xvwzsu.en: Must not be faction leader. Must not be in war with other faction members.
xvwzsu.zh: 不能是阵营领袖。不得与其他阵营成员交战。

n2bpjt.en: Allows you to join a ⟦0⟧. Will automatically join existing war(s).
n2bpjt.zh: 允许你加入一个⟦0⟧。会自动加入已存在的战争。

vewqyl.en: Target country must be faction leader. Must not be in a faction. World Tension threshold reached. Faction leader must accept.
vewqyl.zh: 目标国家必须是阵营领袖。不得处于任何阵营中。达到世界紧张度门槛。阵营领袖必须接受。

1se7df7.en: Must not be in war with other faction members. May not Leave Faction if already in a war as part of the faction.
1se7df7.zh: 不得与其他阵营成员交战。若已作为阵营一员参战，则不能「退出阵营」。

lfqhfv.en: May not Leave Faction if already in a war as part of the ⟦0⟧.
lfqhfv.zh: 若已作为⟦0⟧的一员参战，则不能「退出阵营」。

1tyspdl.en: Send any equipment to another non-enemy country currently at war. It's possible to send a single shipment of a specified amount, or set a specified monthly amount or percentage of monthly production to be sent. Shipments occur once per month and information on past and present shipments is available in a tooltip for the Lend-Lease section at the top of the Recruit/Deploy window.
1tyspdl.zh: 向另一个当前处于战争状态的非敌对国家运送任意装备。你可以选择一次性运送指定数量的装备，也可以设定每月运送的固定数量或占月产量的百分比。运送每月进行一次，有关以往和当前运送的信息可在「招募与部署」窗口顶部的租借栏提示框中查看。

18wcul1.en: Target country must have enough convoys to receive the equipment, unless there's an unobstructed land path. World Tension threshold reached.
18wcul1.zh: 目标国家必须有足够的运输船队来接收装备，除非存在畅通的陆路。达到世界紧张度门槛。

1f4r7ay.en: Target country must have enough convoys to receive the equipment, unless there's an unobstructed land path.
1f4r7ay.zh: 目标国家必须有足够的运输船队来接收装备，除非存在畅通的陆路。

owe3qe.en: None. Click on the Lend Lease action to modify or cancel Lend Lease instructions.
owe3qe.zh: 无。点击租借行动即可修改或取消租借指令。

14zx66n.en: Ask a country to send lend-lease of specific equipment archetypes. The selection screen shows the stockpile and production rates of the target country.
14zx66n.zh: 请求某国租借特定装备原型。选择界面会显示目标国家的库存和生产速度。

1rq6mko.en: Target country must accept. Must be at war.
1rq6mko.zh: 目标国家必须接受。必须处于战争状态。

xgmy2v.en: Allows you to join the war of another ⟦0⟧ member.
xgmy2v.zh: 允许你加入另一⟦0⟧成员的战争。

anfpnb.en: Must not already be in war with allies. Target country must be faction leader.
anfpnb.zh: 不得已与盟友交战。目标国家必须是阵营领袖。

k0mpfd.en: Must not already be in war with allies.

newfm5.en: Send a limited number of divisions to a country. Control over the units is retained, but return only when donor is at war.
newfm5.zh: 向一国派遣数量有限的师。派遣方保留对部队的控制权，但只有在派遣国处于战争状态时才能召回。

7kygjb.en: Target country must be at war. Must be at peace. Must not be in the same faction as the target country. Total number of divisions threshold reached. World Tension threshold reached.
7kygjb.zh: 目标国家必须处于战争状态。你必须处于和平状态。不得与目标国家处于同一阵营。达到师总数门槛。达到世界紧张度门槛。

15w1717.en: Target country must be at war.
15w1717.zh: 目标国家必须处于战争状态。

169303p.en: Must not be in the same ⟦0⟧ as the target country.
169303p.zh: 不得与目标国家处于同一⟦0⟧。

1ry3i4o.en: Total number of divisions threshold reached.

i03946.en: Send an unlimited number of divisions to a fellow member of the ⟦0⟧. Control over the units is transferred.
i03946.zh: 向⟦0⟧的其他成员派遣数量不限的师。部队的控制权会转移。

1spvpw8.en: Must be fighting a war together. Target country must be an ally. Target country must accept. Divisions must be on land.
1spvpw8.zh: 必须共同作战。目标国家必须是盟友。目标国家必须接受。师必须位于陆地上。

rzdz4.en: Must be fighting a war together.

1e1g8hz.en: Target country must be an ally.

9mah5k.en: Donor must activate Return Expeditions to recover Divisions. A target country Disband order to Expeditions returns them to donor.
9mah5k.zh: 派遣方必须启用「遣返远征军」才能收回师。目标国家对远征军下达解散命令会将其归还给派遣方。

e1jg4q.en: Recovers control over all units currently sent as Expeditionary force to the target country.
e1jg4q.zh: 收回当前作为远征军派往目标国家的所有部队的控制权。

h55ule.en: Gives control over a selected number of divisions that are part of the military of the target country.
h55ule.zh: 将目标国家军队中选定数量的师的控制权交给你。

1up2cv5.zh: 目标国家必须是我们的⟦0⟧。

1tqzs72.en: A Disband order to the requested forces returns them to the puppet.
1tqzs72.zh: 对请求的部队下达解散命令会将其归还给傀儡国。

1y63yfy.en: 200 Political Power or more, accumulating at a maximum rate of 0.5 per day.[15] This cost is modified by Subversive Activities modifiers. Thousands of infantry equipment.
1y63yfy.zh: 200 或更多政治点数，最高以每天 0.5 的速度累积。[15] 该花费会受到颠覆活动修正的影响。数千件步兵装备。

1gznihs.en: 200 ⟦0⟧ or more, accumulating at a maximum rate of ⟦1⟧ per day.⟦2⟧ This cost is modified by Subversive Activities modifiers.
1gznihs.zh: 200 或更多⟦0⟧，最高以每天 ⟦1⟧ 的速度累积。⟦2⟧ 该花费会受到颠覆活动修正的影响。

1mx29ba.en: Ask current controller of an occupied State to give up control.
1mx29ba.zh: 要求被占领州的当前控制方交出控制权。

19io36e.en: Must be in a war together. Must have sufficient war contribution. Target country must accept. Target State must not be considered a Core of the target country.
19io36e.zh: 必须共同作战。必须有足够的战争贡献。目标国家必须接受。目标州不能被视作目标国家的核心。

e11111.en: Must be in a war together.

13remmc.zh: 必须有足够的战争贡献。

5rngxz.en: Target State must not be considered a ⟦0⟧ of the target country.
5rngxz.zh: 目标州不能被视作目标国家的⟦0⟧。

b5wsot.en: Can (in theory) be canceled through the "Give control of state" action. Otherwise not cancellable.
b5wsot.zh: （理论上）可以通过「移交州的控制权」行动取消。否则无法取消。

9f0feb.en: Give control of one or multiple occupied States.
9f0feb.zh: 移交一个或多个被占领州的控制权。

15hbdmw.en: Can (in theory) be canceled through the "Ask for control of state" action. Otherwise not cancellable.
15hbdmw.zh: （理论上）可以通过「索取州的控制权」行动取消。否则无法取消。

uma2x7.zh: 降低附庸的自治度等级。

r7mbxd.en: The subject's autonomy is low enough to be reduced a level. Can afford the Political Power cost.
r7mbxd.zh: 附庸的自治度足够低，可以再降低一级。能够承担政治点数花费。

old4ob.en: The subject's autonomy is low enough to be reduced a level.
old4ob.zh: 附庸的自治度足够低，可以再降低一级。

9ifaba.en: Ask a ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ member to provide manpower to fill garrisons.
9ifaba.zh: 请求⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧成员提供人力以充实驻军。

1jdkbhs.en: Requires By Blood Alone Must not be at war with the target country Must not be in the same faction Target country has generated a certain amount of World Tension Can afford the Political Power cost
1jdkbhs.zh: 需要「以血盟誓」。不得与目标国家处于战争状态。不得处于同一阵营。目标国家已产生一定量的世界紧张度。能够承担政治点数花费。

19g18s3.en: Must not be at war with the target country
19g18s3.zh: 不得与目标国家处于战争状态

iiz0e7.en: Must not be in the same ⟦0⟧

izahzt.en: Target country has generated a certain amount of World Tension
izahzt.zh: 目标国家已产生一定量的世界紧张度

11udyae.en: ⟦0⟧: The ⟦1⟧ cost will start at ⟦2⟧ for the first guarantee and will then increase by 15 for every subsequent guarantee, in the following fashion: ⟦3⟧ for the second, ⟦4⟧ for the third, ⟦5⟧ for the fourth, and so on.⟦6⟧
11udyae.zh: ⟦0⟧：首次保障独立时，⟦1⟧花费从 ⟦2⟧ 开始，此后每多保障一个国家便增加 15，具体如下：第二个为⟦3⟧，第三个为⟦4⟧，第四个为⟦5⟧，依此类推。⟦6⟧

1e11pg5.en: ⟦0⟧: Once military access is granted (either explicitly via this diplomatic action or by being in the same ⟦1⟧), the granting nation becomes eligible to claim for provinces that you capture, as explained in the Territorial Control article.
1e11pg5.zh: ⟦0⟧：一旦授予军事通行权（无论通过该外交行动明确授予，还是因处于同一⟦1⟧而自动获得），授予国便有资格索取你占领的省份，详见「领土控制」条目。

1556no4.en: ⟦0⟧: the conditions to cancel these diplomatic actions are essentially the same. They're the conditions to activate the ⟦1⟧ diplomatic action, except that you cannot be the faction leader when you join a ⟦2⟧. The tooltip does not warn you, but if you go to war along with the faction then you may not leave it, so Leave Faction is timely in the event of a Call to Arms.
1556no4.zh: ⟦0⟧：取消这些外交行动的条件基本相同。它们就是启用⟦1⟧外交行动的条件，区别在于加入⟦2⟧时你不能是阵营领袖。提示框不会发出警告，但如果你随阵营一同参战，就不能再退出阵营，因此在收到「号召参战」时「退出阵营」要及时。

1219ohn.en: ⟦0⟧: This diplomatic action also requires to select the State of origin of the civil war. At the onset of the civil war, the rebelling State will be joined by a number of other States, the number of which will vary based on the proportional party popularity when the full ⟦1⟧ requirement is filled. For this reason, Stage a Coup is more effective when combined with "Boost party popularity" to well over 50%. The amount of infantry equipment required appears to be a function of the target country's civilian population. The more populous the country, the more infantry equipment a nation has to give in preparation for the civil war. Coups will automatically succeed with over 40% party popularity if performed in a country with only one state. Otherwise a successful coup will start a civil war. For further information about civil wars, refer to the ⟦2⟧ article.
1219ohn.zh: ⟦0⟧：该外交行动还需要选择内战的起始州。内战爆发时，会有若干其他州加入叛乱州，其数量取决于满足完整⟦1⟧要求时政党的支持率比例。因此，「策划政变」与「提升政党支持率」结合使用、将支持率提升到远超 50% 时效果更好。所需的步兵装备数量似乎是目标国家平民人口的函数。国家人口越多，该国为准备内战所需提供的步兵装备就越多。在只有一个州的国家中，支持率超过 40% 时政变会自动成功。否则，成功的政变会引发内战。关于内战的更多信息，请参阅⟦2⟧条目。

1phufj1.en: ⟦0⟧ acts as a measurement of how close the game is to another world war. Many diplomatic actions are limited by world tension. Annexing countries, joining ⟦1⟧, declaring war on nations are all examples of things that increase world tension. World tension does decay over time, but very slowly.
1phufj1.zh: ⟦0⟧用于衡量游戏距离又一次世界大战还有多近。许多外交行动都受世界紧张度限制。吞并国家、加入⟦1⟧、对他国宣战，都是会提高世界紧张度的例子。世界紧张度会随时间衰减，但速度非常慢。

av1it0.en: Generally speaking, ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ powers want world tension to stay low to delay their enemies' rearmament and diplomatic efforts against them, while ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ powers want world tension to increase quickly so that they can rearm their militaries earlier and intervene in foreign wars.
av1it0.zh: 一般而言，⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧国家希望世界紧张度保持低位，以延缓敌人重整军备以及针对自己的外交努力；而⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧国家则希望世界紧张度迅速上升，以便更早重整军备并介入他国战争。

1hc9jfp.en: When world tension is high, a country that has war declared upon it is likely to accept an offer to join from a ⟦0⟧ of the same ⟦1⟧.
1hc9jfp.zh: 当世界紧张度较高时，被宣战的国家很可能会接受⟦0⟧的加入邀请，只要双方⟦1⟧相同。

bgpnkh.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a nation that is more or less controlled by another, often stronger nation, through an installed government that is loyal to the controlling nation.
bgpnkh.zh: ⟦0⟧是指一个或多或少受另一个往往更强大的国家控制的国家，其政府由控制国安插，并效忠于控制国。

keukx3.en: When a country is puppeted, its government is replaced by one installed by the puppet master, matching the puppet master's ideology. If a puppet master declares war, they can call in their puppets as allies. In the ⟦0⟧ that ensues after a successful war, puppeted countries will not be able to make demands by themselves (except for high autonomy level puppets such as dominions and satellites), though the puppet master can dictate demands in favor of its puppets if they choose to do so. As a result, an already puppeted country cannot puppet other countries.
keukx3.zh: 当一国被傀儡化时，其政府会被宗主国安插的政府取代，并遵奉宗主国的意识形态。如果宗主国宣战，它可以召集其傀儡国作为盟友参战。在战争胜利后举行的⟦0⟧中，被傀儡化的国家无法自行提出要求（自治度较高的傀儡国除外，例如自治领和卫星国），但宗主国若愿意，可以为其傀儡国主张要求。因此，已被傀儡化的国家不能再傀儡化其他国家。

1gshl2l.en: If a puppet master is forced to capitulate, its puppets will automatically capitulate as well if they aren't in a faction with a major country that has yet to capitulate. If a puppet master capitulates but there are still majors in a puppet's faction, the puppet will earn autonomy points. Upon defeating a puppet master (and other majors in faction with it), the victorious nations can choose to detach puppeted countries from their puppet master, making them free-standing nations again. Communist countries get a 35% cost reduction for puppeting other countries.
1gshl2l.zh: 如果宗主国被迫投降，而其傀儡国并未与尚未投降的主要国家同处一个阵营，这些傀儡国也会自动投降。如果宗主国投降，但傀儡国所在阵营中仍有主要国家，该傀儡国将获得自治度点数。击败宗主国（以及与其同阵营的其他主要国家）后，战胜国可以选择把被傀儡化的国家从宗主国手中剥离，使其重新成为独立国家。共产主义国家傀儡化其他国家时可获得 35% 的费用减免。

1k9nqz4.en: The puppet master nation may ⟦0⟧ goods from its puppet or subject state at a rate discounted below the standard trade rate of up to 8 loads of a resource per factory. For example, puppet or an integrated puppet, such as Malaya, provides 80 loads per factory to its British master (90% discount), while a colony (British Raj) offers 16 loads (50% discount) and British dominions offer 10 loads per factory (25% discount).
1k9nqz4.zh: 宗主国可以以低于标准贸易率的折扣价从其傀儡国或附属国⟦0⟧货物，每座工厂最多可达 8 单位资源量。例如，傀儡国或整合傀儡国（如马来亚）每座工厂向其英国宗主国提供 80 单位（90% 折扣），而殖民地（英属印度）每座工厂提供 16 单位（50% 折扣），英国各自治领每座工厂提供 10 单位（25% 折扣）。

lc21yp.en: The puppet master may access far more of the puppet's resources than it could otherwise with its own trade laws if directly annexed. Extra Trade for overlord provides a bonus on top of the puppet's Trade Law to market rate. So if a Puppet would have 200 ⟦0⟧ available and has ⟦1⟧, typically, only 80% of their resources go to export (160 ⟦2⟧) the rest can be kept for themselves. With the Extra trade bonus of +25% (from Dominion level autonomy) this brings the total ⟦3⟧ available to export from a puppet to 170 (160 + 10, where 10 is 25% of 40, where 40 is 200 - 160) out of their total of 200. This can mean with Integrated Puppets the puppet master may purchase all of their resources even if they switch to ⟦4⟧. The extra trade to overlord is applied to the resources not exported.
lc21yp.zh: 宗主国通过傀儡国所能获取的资源，远多于直接吞并时仅靠自身贸易法令所能获取的数量。对宗主国的额外贸易会在傀儡国贸易法令的基础上按市场价提供加成。因此，如果某傀儡国有 200 ⟦0⟧可用，且实行⟦1⟧，通常只有 80% 的资源用于出口（160 ⟦2⟧），其余可留作自用。再加上 +25% 的额外贸易加成（来自自治领级自治度），傀儡国可供出口的⟦3⟧总量就达到 170（160 + 10，其中 10 是 25%（占 40），而 40 等于 200 - 160），而其总量为 200。这意味着对于整合傀儡国，宗主国即使对方改用⟦4⟧，也能买下其全部资源。对宗主国的额外贸易适用于未出口的那部分资源。

1fq6dpc.en: Integrated Puppets, Reichskommissariats/Reichsprotektorates and Imperial Associates/Protectorates give a small share of their civilian factories (incl. refineries) and a major share of their military factories to the puppet master. Naval dockyards are unaffected. See charts for details.
1fq6dpc.zh: 整合傀儡国、帝国专员辖区/帝国保护国以及帝国准成员/保护国会把其民用工厂（含炼油厂）的一小部分和军用工厂的大部分交给宗主国。海军船坞不受影响。详情参见图表。

1ql8xrs.en: At certain levels of autonomy a puppet master may request license production of a puppet's equipment, at a discount or even completely free. In addition to being given access to equipment without needing to research it, there is also a bonus conferred to researching that equipment while the license is in effect. Speeding up research for domestic equipment.
1ql8xrs.zh: 在特定自治度等级下，宗主国可以申请许可生产傀儡国的装备，可享受折扣甚至完全免费。除了无需研究即可获得该装备的使用权外，在许可有效期内研究该装备还会获得加成，从而加快本国装备的研究进度。

adtrkm.en: It is possible to "request" control over the troops of the puppet; this provides additional divisions for the puppet master, although puppet divisions may not be very well designed.
adtrkm.zh: 玩家可以“请求”获得对傀儡国军队的控制权；这能为宗主国提供额外的师，不过傀儡国的师可能编制不佳。

1u0q5r1.en: Puppet can still receive lend-lease from countries other than the puppet's master - and puppet, most likely, ⟦0⟧ ask others for equipment, as it usually has equipment shortages, and often has little-to-no industry. Then, puppet master can request lend-lease equipment from puppet, to drain puppet's stocks. Puppet and puppet master have separate lend-lease cooldowns. Therefore, puppet master can use puppet to beg equipment from other factions.
1u0q5r1.zh: 傀儡国仍可从宗主国以外的国家获得租借——而且傀儡国很可能⟦0⟧向其他国家索要装备，因为它通常装备短缺，且往往几乎没有工业。随后，宗主国可以向傀儡国索要租借装备，抽干傀儡国的库存。傀儡国与宗主国拥有各自独立的租借冷却时间。因此，宗主国可以利用傀儡国向其他阵营讨要装备。

p125j1.en: The master can effectively boost their own manpower by raising units including a mix of master and puppet manpower (70% for a Colony, 90% for a Puppet, and 100% for an Integrated Puppet). Such colonial divisions are controlled by the puppet master. The templates for such colonial divisions are those taken or adapted from the puppet's own template list (open by clicking the Crown icon at the top of the Division Designer in the Recruit/Deploy menu). If a puppet is newly released, it will receive templates of the puppet master.
p125j1.zh: 宗主国可以通过组建混合使用宗主国与傀儡国人力的部队来有效提升自身人力（殖民地 70%、傀儡国 90%、整合傀儡国 100%）。此类殖民地师由宗主国控制。这些殖民地师的编制取自或改编自傀儡国自身的编制列表（点击招募/部署菜单中师编制设计器顶部的皇冠图标即可打开）。如果傀儡国是刚被释放的，它将获得宗主国的编制。

1ejc02w.en: Puppet can send garrison support to save up on manpower.
1ejc02w.zh: 傀儡国可以派遣驻军支援，以节省人力。

1augxe2.en: Puppet doesn't need garrison - what allows to save up on manpower and weapons.
1augxe2.zh: 傀儡国无需驻军——这样可以节省人力和武器。

b2ypsw.en: Puppeting countries can often be safer than annexing them as it generates less World Tension than territorial annexation, reducing the risk of foreign intervention by other potentially hostile countries.
b2ypsw.zh: 傀儡化其他国家往往比吞并它们更安全，因为它产生的世界紧张度低于领土吞并，从而降低其他潜在敌对国家进行外国干预的风险。

2engzv.en: Puppeting allows countries to retain any fleets. As capital ships take a long time to construct, this can drastically aid naval supremacy.
2engzv.zh: 傀儡化可以让国家保留其舰队。由于主力舰建造耗时很长，这能极大地帮助夺取制海权。

1nb3k3s.en: Communist countries can puppet defeated nations at a 10% discount in peace deals, allowing them to put more territory under their (indirect) control after a war.
1nb3k3s.zh: 共产主义国家在和平会议中可以以 10% 的折扣傀儡化战败国，从而在战后把更多领土置于其（间接）控制之下。

1tdqvci.en: Some puppet autonomy levels will transfer some of their war score to their overlord.
1tdqvci.zh: 某些傀儡国自治度等级会把其部分战争贡献转交给宗主国。

dc02la.en: Puppets can research different technologies than his Puppet Master. Then, Puppet Master and Puppets can share their research with each other, ⟦0⟧.
dc02la.zh: 傀儡国可以研究与其宗主国不同的科技。之后，宗主国与傀儡国可以互相共享研究成果，⟦0⟧。

2k9w46.en: using Technology sharing and Equipment licensing
2k9w46.zh: 通过科技共享与装备许可生产

8oojr1.en: Master's divisions can get resupplied from puppet's logistics network if they are on puppet's territory. If master's underequipped divisions are stationed on puppet's territory, it will allow to arm said divisions at the expense of puppet, which doesn't increase puppet's autonomy. Similarly, some pieces of master's equipment may end up in possession of puppet's divisions if puppet's divisions move to master's territory.
8oojr1.zh: 宗主国的师若位于傀儡国领土上，可以从傀儡国的后勤网络获得补给。如果宗主国装备不足的师驻扎在傀儡国领土上，就能以牺牲傀儡国为代价来武装这些师，而这不会提高傀儡国的自治度。同样，如果傀儡国的师进入宗主国领土，宗主国的部分装备也可能落入傀儡国师的手中。

7u1hbc.en: It's also possible to drain weapons via rump state Puppet. When conquering a country, ideally with lots of weapons, in Peace Conference annex all States of country except the most worthless one, and make the conquered country a Puppet while only leaving that one state for them. Then, order Puppet to give you their equipment via lend-lease - getting access to the other half of their arsenal which you didn't recieve upon capitulating the country. Eventually after a very long while, the rump states becomes independent again, at which point it can be conquered again or just ignored.
7u1hbc.zh: 也可以通过残余国家傀儡国来抽干武器。在征服一个国家时——最好是武器很多的国家——在和平会议中吞并该国除最无价值的一个州以外的所有州，并把被征服国变为傀儡国，只给它留下那一个州。然后，命令傀儡国通过租借把装备交给你——从而获得该国投降时你未能得到的那另一半军火库。最终在很久之后，这个残余国家会重新独立，届时可以再次征服它，或者干脆置之不理。

42kc8r.en: On one hand, if you release Puppet earlier, it will have more time to complete it's focus tree, construct buildings, field divisions and beg others for lend-lease. On the other side, newly released puppet will receive templates of the puppet master - so, if you're planning to use Puppet for war (be it colonial divisions, or divisions of puppet you "requested" control), you should consider ⟦0⟧. Also, many Puppets have less research slots than their masters - so, if they get released more early, then they will be less technologically advanced in the long run (not a big problem).
42kc8r.zh: 一方面，如果你更早释放傀儡国，它就有更多时间完成国策树、建造建筑、组建师并向他人讨要租借。另一方面，新释放的傀儡国会获得宗主国的编制——所以，如果你打算把傀儡国用于战争（无论是殖民地师，还是你“请求”控制权的傀儡国师），就应当考虑⟦0⟧。此外，许多傀儡国的科研槽比其宗主国少——因此若释放得更早，长期来看它们的科技会更落后（这不是大问题）。

1qsjyam.en: making all needed, battle-ready templates before releasing Puppet
1qsjyam.zh: 在释放傀儡国前制定好所有必需的、可随时投入战斗的编制

1rc928i.en: Puppeting small countries with few resources is less efficient than simply annexing the country, especially if the puppet has less than 8 but more than 0 units of the resource, as factories still have to be paid. If the would-be puppet country is conquered, the problem can be greatly postponed by Resource Rights Demands.
1rc928i.zh: 把资源很少的小国变为傀儡国，不如直接吞并该国划算，尤其是当傀儡国的资源量少于 8 但多于 0 单位时更是如此，因为工厂仍然需要付费。如果潜在傀儡国是被征服的，可以通过资源权利要求大大推迟这一问题。

ec8my1.en: If the would-be puppet country is conquered, the problem can be greatly postponed by ⟦0⟧.
ec8my1.zh: 如果潜在傀儡国是被征服的，可以通过⟦0⟧大大推迟这一问题。

fwziy8.en: If you give too much land to a puppet, it may refuse to give you your land back.
fwziy8.zh: 如果你给傀儡国太多土地，它可能会拒绝把土地还给你。

2cqw9m.en: Puppets can receive lend lease from their master, even in peacetime. This may help in multiplayer games to grant a puppet a head-start in multiplayer games with a 1936 start date.
2cqw9m.zh: 傀儡国可以接收来自宗主国的租借，即使在和平时期也是如此。在 1936 年开局的多人游戏中，这有助于让傀儡国取得先发优势。

xfu824.en: Puppets generally can receive lend lease from their master at a lower tension level than normal.
xfu824.zh: 傀儡国通常可以在比正常情况更低的世界紧张度水平下接收来自宗主国的租借。

ign8in.en: If a nation declares war on a puppet, its master will automatically turn hostile towards the nation that declared war on it and join the war, bringing them as well as all their other puppets into the fight.
ign8in.zh: 如果一国向某傀儡国宣战，其宗主国会自动对该宣战国转为敌对并加入战争，把本国以及所有其他傀儡国都卷入战斗。

1s8hdm7.en: A puppet receives a reduced number of factories for giving resources to its master. This can hinder early-game industry development.
1s8hdm7.zh: 傀儡国因向宗主国提供资源而获得较少的工厂。这会阻碍游戏前期的工业发展。

ar92oz.en: A puppet can neither justify war goals nor can it declare war on another country, in addition to that, puppets cannot make demands in a peace conference, meaning that a puppet's territorial expansion is entirely decided by the puppet master.
ar92oz.zh: 傀儡国既不能制造战争目标，也不能向其他国家宣战；除此之外，傀儡国无法在和平会议中提出要求，这意味着傀儡国的领土扩张完全由宗主国决定。

kt6bml.en: If a puppet master declares war on a nation, they can freely force the puppet into the war (Imperial Subjects can decline it). If matched up against a stronger opponent and fighting alone, the odds are clearly not in its favor. Even if the puppet proves stronger and defeats that enemy, it gets nothing but glory (and autonomy points) from the war unless the puppet master provides something in the peace or thereafter.
kt6bml.zh: 如果宗主国向某国宣战，它可以随意迫使傀儡国参战（帝国臣民可以拒绝参战）。如果对手更强大而自己又孤军作战，胜算显然不利。即使傀儡国证明更强并击败了敌人，除非宗主国在和会中或之后给予补偿，它从这场战争中除荣耀（以及自治度点数）外一无所获。

orrczx.en: A puppet has to deal with autonomy or risk further disadvantages in favor of its overlord or, at worst, direct annexation by its overlord. One of the quickest and most reliable ways to raise autonomy is to use a continuous focus, wasting time that could be used for completing other national focuses. A puppet may also gain autonomy by trading or lend-leasing goods to its overlord. However, puppets with unique focus trees usually have a national focus that is even quicker than said method.
orrczx.zh: 傀儡国必须处理自治度问题，否则就要承受对宗主国更有利的进一步劣势，最坏情况下会被宗主国直接吞并。提高自治度最快、最可靠的方法之一是使用持续国策，但这会浪费本可用于完成其他国策的时间。傀儡国也可以通过向宗主国贸易或租借货物来获得自治度。不过，拥有独特国策树的傀儡国通常有一个比上述方法更快的国策。

1yxu92v.en: Associated Dominion File:Autonomy associated dominion icon.png
1yxu92v.zh: 附属自治领 File:Autonomy associated dominion icon.png

wqppg1.en: Indonesian Union State File:Autonomy taog indonesian union state.png
wqppg1.zh: 印度尼西亚联合邦 File:Autonomy taog indonesian union state.png

1hqh4o6.en: Some puppets are more independent than others. To represent the difference between largely autonomous dominions like Canada, somewhat autonomous colonies like the British Raj, and totally subservient puppet states like Malaya, the game divides subject states into four levels of autonomy. Within each level, ⟦0⟧ has a numerical level between 0 and 1000.
1hqh4o6.zh: 有些傀儡国比其他傀儡国更独立。为了体现高度自治的自治领（如加拿大）、部分自治的殖民地（如英属印度）和完全听命的傀儡国（如马来亚）之间的差异，游戏把附属国划分为四个自治度等级。在每个等级内，⟦0⟧都有一个 0 到 1000 的数值。

9g36j8.en: At 1000 ⟦0⟧, the subject may advance to a higher tier, or become free if it is already a ⟦1⟧. At 0 autonomy, the master may decrease autonomy to a lower tier, or annex the puppet entirely if it is already an ⟦2⟧. Changing tiers costs 50 ⟦3⟧, while annexing a subject costs 300 ⟦4⟧ and becoming free costs 300 ⟦5⟧.⟦6⟧
9g36j8.zh: 在 1000 ⟦0⟧ 时，附属国可以晋升到更高一级；如果它已经是⟦1⟧，则可以获得自由。当自治度降到 0 时，宗主国可以把自治度降到更低一级；如果它已经是⟦2⟧，则可以把傀儡国完全吞并。变更等级需要 50 ⟦3⟧，吞并一个附属国需要 300 ⟦4⟧，获得自由需要 300 ⟦5⟧。⟦6⟧

g3l2dl.en: May declare wars May decline call to war Control over deployed units goes to overlord Overlord can build in provinces Can be spymaster Generates spies for spymaster Can create collaboration governments
g3l2dl.zh: 可以宣战 可以拒绝参战号召 已部署部队的控制权归宗主国 宗主国可以在省份内建造 可担任特工首脑 为特工首脑提供特工 可以创建合作政府

1oclyw3.en: Control over deployed units goes to overlord
1oclyw3.zh: 已部署部队的控制权归宗主国

medi4.zh: 宗主国可以在省份内建造

t0axld.en: Extra trade for Overlord: +25% Overlord trade cost: −25% Peace Score transferred to Overlord: +5% Lend-lease tension limit from puppet: -10%
t0axld.zh: 对宗主国的额外贸易：+25% 宗主国贸易花费：−25% 转交给宗主国的和平会议得分：+5% 来自傀儡国的租借紧张度上限：-10%

1ckvnoc.zh: 转交给宗主国的和平会议得分：⟦0⟧

rzg2pd.zh: 来自傀儡国的租借紧张度上限：⟦0⟧

1p7093p.en: Extra trade for Overlord: +50% Overlord trade cost: −50% Research sharing bonus factor: −50% Subject manpower requirement: +70% Peace Score transferred to Overlord: +10% Lend-lease tension limit from puppet: -30%
1p7093p.zh: 对宗主国的额外贸易：+50% 宗主国贸易花费：−50% 科技共享加成系数：−50% 附属国人力征用要求：+70% 转交给宗主国的和平会议得分：+10% 来自傀儡国的租借紧张度上限：-30%

1y5f9ns.en: Extra trade for Overlord: +100% Overlord trade cost: −90% Research sharing bonus factor: −50% Subject manpower requirement: +90% Peace Score transferred to Overlord: +10% Lend-lease tension limit from puppet: -40%
1y5f9ns.zh: 对宗主国的额外贸易：+100% 宗主国贸易花费：−90% 科技共享加成系数：−50% 附属国人力征用要求：+90% 转交给宗主国的和平会议得分：+10% 来自傀儡国的租借紧张度上限：-40%

1q3ihfy.en: Extra trade for Overlord: +100% Overlord trade cost: −90% Research sharing bonus factor: −50% Subject manpower requirement: +100% Civilian Industry controlled by overlord: +25% Military Industry controlled by overlord: +75% Peace Score transferred to Overlord: +20% Lend-lease tension limit from puppet: -40%
1q3ihfy.zh: 对宗主国的额外贸易：+100% 宗主国贸易花费：−90% 科技共享加成系数：−50% 附属国人力征用要求：+100% 由宗主国控制的民用工业：+25% 由宗主国控制的军用工业：+75% 转交给宗主国的和平会议得分：+20% 来自傀儡国的租借紧张度上限：-40%

1okcw5n.zh: 由宗主国控制的民用工业：⟦0⟧

1p0fbr5.zh: 由宗主国控制的军用工业：⟦0⟧

1jibqfr.zh: 自治度等级（法西斯主义）

1py0th6.en: ⟦0⟧ countries use a slightly different system for their subjects. While there are fewer levels of autonomy (3), the same amount of ⟦1⟧ has to be increased overall to break free (or decreased to annex), as autonomy is now numerically classified from 0 to 1500 at each level except ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ costs remain unchanged: 50 ⟦4⟧ to change tiers, 300 ⟦5⟧ to annex a subject, and 300 ⟦6⟧ to become free.⟦7⟧
1py0th6.zh: ⟦0⟧国家对其附属国使用一套略有不同的系统。虽然自治度等级更少（只有 3 级），但要挣脱（或降到最低以吞并）所需增加的⟦1⟧总量相同，因为现在每个等级的自治度数值都按 0 到 1500 分级，⟦2⟧除外。⟦3⟧花费不变：变更等级需要 50 ⟦4⟧，吞并一个附属国需要 300 ⟦5⟧，获得自由需要 300 ⟦6⟧。⟦7⟧

92t3dc.zh: 可以宣战 可以拒绝参战号召 部队部署给宗主国 宗主国可以在省份内建造 可担任特工首脑 为特工首脑提供特工 可以创建合作政府

s6yorz.zh: 附属国与宗主国之间的许可生产花费：⟦0⟧
