1k6f25t.en: The Supervised State subject is created in a peace deal by a nation in a faction founded by a ⟦0⟧ nation. This subject type boosts the overlord's ideology in the subject and disallows the appointment of any government minister that may alter the ideological makeup of the nation. The overlord cannot annex this subject nation and the subject gains more autonomy over time, eventually allowing them to become free from their overlord. Note that a ⟦1⟧ nation may still gain ordinary puppets by annexing the defeated nations in the peace deal and releasing them as puppets.
1k6f25t.zh: 受监管国这一附属国类型由⟦0⟧国家所创建阵营中的国家在和会上设立。该附属国类型会在附属国内提升宗主国的意识形态，并禁止任命任何可能改变该国意识形态构成的政府部长。宗主国不能吞并该附属国，而附属国会随时间获得更多自治度，最终得以脱离宗主国获得自由。请注意，⟦1⟧国家仍可通过在和会上吞并战败国并将其作为傀儡国释放来获得普通傀儡国。

1281sr2.en: These two subject levels interact very unusually with the autonomy system. First, this is how they work for ⟦0⟧: For ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ they replace all other autonomy levels, thus being placed between ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧. A China of any other ideology adds one additional subject level above ⟦5⟧. This being ⟦6⟧ Dominion for ⟦7⟧ / ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧ for ⟦11⟧ ⟦12⟧
1281sr2.zh: 这两个附属国等级与自治度系统的互动方式非常特殊。首先，它们在⟦0⟧中的运作方式如下：对于⟦1⟧⟦2⟧，它们取代所有其他自治度等级，因而位于⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧之间。其他任何意识形态的中国都会在⟦5⟧之上增加一个附属国等级：⟦6⟧自治领，适用于⟦7⟧ / ⟦8⟧⟦9⟧，而⟦10⟧则适用于⟦11⟧⟦12⟧。

u99v1d.en: For all other nations its a bit more complicated: First of all, the "Integrated warlord subject" level is usually unavailable but can be gained in some cases if the overlord is ⟦0⟧. For all other ideologies, "Warlord Subject" will be placed between "⟦1⟧" and "⟦2⟧". For ⟦3⟧ nations, it will be placed between "⟦4⟧" and "⟦5⟧". Furthermore, once the subject reaches "Warlord Subject", the previous level will turn into "Integrated Warlord subject" (even though they previously were a ⟦6⟧). From "Integrated Warlord Subject" they can again turn into a "⟦7⟧".
u99v1d.zh: 对于所有其他国家，情况要复杂一些：首先，“整合军阀附庸”等级通常不可用，但在宗主国为⟦0⟧的某些情况下可以获得。对于其他所有意识形态，“军阀附庸”会被置于“⟦1⟧”和“⟦2⟧”之间。对于⟦3⟧国家，它会被置于“⟦4⟧”和“⟦5⟧”之间。此外，一旦附属国达到“军阀附庸”，此前的等级就会变为“整合军阀附庸”（即使它们此前是⟦6⟧）。从“整合军阀附庸”出发，它们还可以再次变为“⟦7⟧”。

1yvhunr.en: An overlord performing any ⟦0⟧ in a subject lowers the subject's autonomy by 0.7 for every 100 industrial capacity invested.⟦1⟧ For example, building a ⟦2⟧, with a cost of 7200 units, will lower autonomy by (7200 * 0.7 / 100) = 50.4. Note that certain subject types prevent overlords from constructing in them (unless the subject is in a ⟦3⟧ with their overlord, since faction members can always construct in each other's territory).
1yvhunr.zh: 宗主国在附属国中进行任何⟦0⟧都会使该附属国的自治度降低 0.7（每投入 100 点工业产能）。⟦1⟧ 例如，建造一座⟦2⟧，其成本为 7200 单位，会使自治度降低 (7200 * 0.7 / 100) = 50.4。注意，某些附属国类型会阻止宗主国在其境内建造（除非该附属国与其宗主国同属一个⟦3⟧，因为阵营成员总是可以在彼此领土上建造）。

1vyl8wn.en: A ⟦0⟧ is an important tool that helps players visualize how their divisions will advance, allows the AI to control the player's divisions automatically, and can confer a ⟦1⟧. Plans do not have to be drawn in order to give divisions orders, but are generally recommended as they reduce micromanagement, improve the flow of gameplay and provide bonuses to unit performance that can offset those enjoyed by heavily ⟦2⟧ enemies.
1vyl8wn.zh: ⟦0⟧是一项重要工具，能帮助玩家直观地了解其师将如何推进，允许 AI 自动控制玩家的师，并可以提供⟦1⟧。不绘制计划也能给师下达命令，但通常建议绘制，因为计划可减少微操、改善游戏节奏，并提供能抵消处于高度⟦2⟧状态的敌人所享优势的部队表现加成。

1n8oel4.en: If desired, different divisions within a single army may be allocated to different battle plans. In this case, players will usually have to manually assign divisions to each front, or they will default to the first front drawn.
1n8oel4.zh: 如有需要，同一集团军内的不同师可以分配到不同的作战计划。在这种情况下，玩家通常必须手动将师分配到各条前线，否则它们会默认归入所绘制的第一条前线。

xcwabt.en: An example of a battle plan would be a major invasion of Italy, north of enemy lines, designed to crush an enemy preoccupied with an engagement from the south. The player can set up and separately activate one or more amphibious landings, paradrops, and attacks by ground forces already facing the enemy, each at the time they think best. Some of these plan orders might be set up to be implemented by the player at the same time, while others may be set up to occur in sequence, in each case activated by the player as needed by shift-clicking only on that specific order to activate it, and with the ability to change that element of the plan or the troops assigned to it before or after activation. This allows different parts of an army to perform separate tasks for the player within an overall strategy, much as army corps performed different missions for WW2 armies. Use of such complex plans is optional, but occasionally very useful when a player has to launch multiple different operations at the same time or by stages.
xcwabt.zh: 作战计划的一个示例是：在敌军防线以北对意大利发动大规模登陆，目的是击溃正忙于应对南面交战的敌人。玩家可以设置并分别激活一次或多次两栖登陆、空降以及由已与敌接触的地面部队发起的进攻，各自选择自认为最佳的时机。其中一些计划命令可以设置为由玩家同时执行，另一些则可设置为按顺序依次发生；无论哪种情况，玩家都只需按住 Shift 并点击该特定命令即可按需激活它，并且可以在激活之前或之后更改计划的该部分或其所属部队。这样，一支集团军的不同部分就能在总体战略下为玩家执行不同任务，正如二战中的军为各国陆军执行不同任务一样。此类复杂计划的使用是可选的，但当玩家必须同时或分阶段发起多场不同作战时，偶尔会非常有用。

1pow6yo.en: To make a battle plan for offensive land operations, the player must first define a ⟦0⟧ – this is the point from which the army group will begin operations. Select the Front Line button or press ⟦1⟧, then click on or draw a line on the map along a national border or the current line between opposing forces to indicate where the army's currently selected divisions will assemble. Then click the ⟦2⟧ button (a line with an arrow) or press ⟦3⟧ and draw the front to which the armies should advance from the current Front Line.
1pow6yo.zh: 要为陆上进攻作战制定作战计划，玩家必须首先划定一条⟦0⟧——这是集团军群开始作战的起点。选择「前线」按钮或按⟦1⟧，然后在地图上沿国境线或双方当前接触线点击或拖画出一条线，以标明集团军当前选中的师将在何处集结。接着点击⟦2⟧按钮（一条带箭头的线）或按⟦3⟧，绘出各集团军应从前线向前推进的目标线。

nl05eh.en: The battle plan tools can be accessed via the ⟦0⟧ that opens when an army (a general) or an army group (a field marshal) is selected.
nl05eh.zh: 选中一支集团军（由将领指挥）或一个集团军群（由元帅指挥）时会打开⟦0⟧，作战计划工具即可在其中使用。

hkjio7.en: the player can select if the battle plan is executed ⟦0⟧, in ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧.
hkjio7.zh: 玩家可以选择以⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧的方式执行作战计划。

vuxrhg.en: ⟦0⟧ Same as Naval invasion above, but requires one floating harbor in stockpile.
vuxrhg.zh: ⟦0⟧与上文的海军登陆相同，但需要在储备中拥有一个浮动港口。

1c435ka.zh: 带浮动港口的海军登陆

1q08yj2.en: Same as Naval invasion above, but requires one ⟦0⟧ in stockpile.
1q08yj2.zh: 与上文的海军登陆相同，但需要在储备中拥有一个⟦0⟧。

g0jpc3.en: is described in the following sections.

176apxd.en: A naval invasion is an amphibious attack on enemy territory. It is a very powerful tool to open up new fronts against an enemy where they least expect them.
176apxd.zh: 海军登陆是对敌方领土发动的两栖攻击。它是在敌人最意想不到的地方开辟新战线的极为强大的工具。

oy73li.en: Naval invasions may be launched from any friendly port that the player has access to. This means that an invasion of enemy territory can be launched from the port of an ally that is not at war with the enemy.
oy73li.zh: 海军登陆可以从玩家可使用任意友方港口发起。这意味着可以从一个并未与敌人交战的盟友的港口发起对敌方领土的入侵。

ngq3c0.en: A naval invasion is constrained by two separate caps:
ngq3c0.zh: 海军登陆受两个独立上限的限制：

5fzsro.en: the ⟦0⟧ — maximum number of divisions per single naval invasion order, and
5fzsro.zh: ⟦0⟧——单个海军登陆命令可分配的最大师数，以及

jyxiim.en: the ⟦0⟧ — maximum number of naval invasion orders that may be prepared at the same time.
jyxiim.zh: ⟦0⟧——可同时准备的海军登陆命令的最大数量。

g3hbx9.en: The base values are ⟦0⟧ per order and ⟦1⟧ at a time. Both caps are raised by researching naval transport technology. Without ⟦2⟧, these come from the base ⟦3⟧ tech tree; with Man the Guns, they come from the equivalent ⟦4⟧ tree.
g3hbx9.zh: 基础值为每个命令⟦0⟧、同时⟦1⟧。两个上限都可通过研究海军运输科技提高。没有⟦2⟧时，它们来自基础的⟦3⟧科技树；拥有全民持枪时，则来自对应的⟦4⟧科技树。

14rn3so.zh: ⟦0⟧ 入侵防御；⟦1⟧ 准备天数

8sukvg.en: ⟦0⟧ Amphibious Invasion; ⟦1⟧ Invasion Defense; ⟦2⟧ prep days
8sukvg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 两栖入侵；⟦1⟧ 入侵防御；⟦2⟧ 准备天数

15gpley.en: Selecting either ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ in the ⟦2⟧ special-forces tree grants ⟦3⟧ additional division cap and ⟦4⟧ additional plan cap respectively. Several national focuses, ideas and Military Industrial Organisations also grant invasion-cap modifiers.
15gpley.zh: 选择⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧（位于⟦2⟧特种部队科技树中），可分别提供⟦3⟧额外师数上限和⟦4⟧额外计划上限。若干国策、理念和军工组织也会提供入侵上限修正。

ziu3pe.en: A naval invasion order with more divisions assigned than the division cap will not take place. The arrow on the map appears but with the text ⟦0⟧. The assigned divisions keep their ⟦1⟧ exclamation mark which indicates that they have no orders.
ziu3pe.zh: 分配师数超过师数上限的海军登陆命令不会执行。地图上会显示箭头，但带有文字⟦0⟧。已分配的师会保留表示其没有命令的⟦1⟧感叹号。

1l3q50z.en: A country's invasion capacity is measured in division count, not total weight or combat width. Wider and more powerful division templates allow players to execute stronger invasions, at the cost of more convoys (see ⟦0⟧).
1l3q50z.zh: 一个国家的入侵容量以师的数量衡量，而不是总重量或战斗宽度。更宽、更强的师编制让玩家能够执行更强的入侵，代价是需要更多运输船队（见⟦0⟧）。

d7y72f.en: Naval invasions require time to prepare before they may be executed. The exact time it will take is dependent on technology and the amount of divisions to be shipped over. With only the first level of naval invasion technology, a 1-division invasion will take 7 days and a 10-division invasion will take 70 days of planning. ⟦0⟧ technology (1940) and ⟦1⟧ (1944) further reduce the required time, as do ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ land doctrines and the ⟦4⟧ fleet-in-being subdoctrine.
d7y72f.zh: 海军登陆在执行前需要时间准备。所需的确切时间取决于科技以及要运送的师的数量。仅拥有第一级海军登陆科技时，1 个师的入侵需要 7 天的准备，10 个师的入侵则需要 70 天。⟦0⟧科技（1940）和⟦1⟧（1944）可进一步缩短所需时间，⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧陆军学说以及⟦4⟧存在舰队子学说也有同样效果。

3uzuua.en: The planning will proceed immediately, even while the divisions are still on their way to the departure port.
3uzuua.zh: 计划会立即开始推进，即使各师仍在前往出发港的途中。

1xqau5v.en: It is possible to prepare several invasions from different ports in parallel, even to the same target province(s), saving on total preparation time, as long as the plan cap is not exceeded. It is also possible to prepare several invasions to different target provinces from the same port.
1xqau5v.zh: 只要不超过计划上限，就可以从不同港口并行准备多场入侵，甚至针对同一目标省份，从而节省总准备时间。也可以从同一港口准备针对不同目标省份的多场入侵。

b7iqny.en: In order to ship units over to foreign lands, sufficient convoys are required to do so. The amount of convoys an individual division requires is dependent on its ⟦0⟧; the weight is equivalent with the amount of convoys required to ship over one division. The amount of convoys required is rounded up. Technology may decrease the amount of convoys required for an invasion.
b7iqny.zh: 要把部队运往海外，需要足够的运输船队。单个师所需的运输船队数量取决于其⟦0⟧；重量等同于运送一个师所需的运输船队数量。所需运输船队数量向上取整。科技可以减少入侵所需的运输船队数量。

ojk2ho.en: Anti-Air Anti-Tank Artillery Bicycle Cavalry Infantry Mountaineers Marines Motorized Anti-Tank Motorized Anti-Air Motorized Artillery Motorized Rocket Artillery Paratroopers Penal Battalion Rocket Artillery Truck-drawn Rocket Artillery
ojk2ho.zh: 防空 反坦克 火炮 自行车 骑兵 步兵 山地兵 海军陆战队 摩托化反坦克 摩托化防空 摩托化火炮 摩托化火箭炮 伞兵 惩戒营 火箭炮 卡车牵引火箭炮

1di85iq.en: Amphibious Tank Battalion Amtrac Battalion Heavy Amphibious Tank Battalion Light Amphibious Tank Battalion Light SP Anti-Air Light SP Artillery Light Tank Light Tank Destroyer Mechanized Infantry Medium Amphibious Tank Battalion
1di85iq.zh: 两栖坦克营 两栖履带车营 重型两栖坦克营 轻型两栖坦克营 轻型自行防空 轻型自行火炮 轻型坦克 轻型坦克歼击车 机械化步兵 中型两栖坦克营

1at3or7.en: Medium SP Anti-Air Medium SP Artillery Medium Tank Medium Tank Destroyer
1at3or7.zh: 中型自行防空 中型自行火炮 中型坦克 中型坦克歼击车

py4dun.en: Heavy SP Anti-Air Heavy SP Artillery Heavy Tank Heavy Tank Destroyer Modern SP Anti-Air Modern SP Artillery Modern Tank Modern Tank Destroyer
py4dun.zh: 重型自行防空 重型自行火炮 重型坦克 重型坦克歼击车 现代自行防空 现代自行火炮 现代坦克 现代坦克歼击车

3zt1lx.en: Superheavy SP Anti-Air Superheavy SP Artillery Superheavy Tank Superheavy Tank Destroyer
3zt1lx.zh: 超重型自行防空 超重型自行火炮 超重型坦克 超重型坦克歼击车

8ipp98.en: ⟦0⟧ gets reduced if ⟦1⟧ is low. At ⟦2⟧ intel or less, supremacy is reduced to ⟦3⟧ of its nominal value. The penalty linearly improves and disappears at ⟦4⟧ intel.
8ipp98.zh: ⟦0⟧会在⟦1⟧较低时随之降低。当情报为⟦2⟧或更低时，制海权会降至其标称值的⟦3⟧。该惩罚会线性改善，并在情报达到⟦4⟧时消失。

1obhotd.en: The actual value of ⟦0⟧ of a seazone can be seen in the seazone property window, that you get when you click a seazone. You have to hover with the mouse over the naval supremacy bar. Alternatively you can see it, when you hover with your mouse over a seazone in the ⟦1⟧ (accessible with the ⟦2⟧ button).
1obhotd.zh: 某个海区的⟦0⟧实际数值可以在点击海区后打开的海区属性窗口中查看，需要将鼠标悬停在制海权条上。或者，将鼠标悬停在⟦1⟧（可通过⟦2⟧按钮打开）中的某个海区上也可以看到。

15f2cqq.en: ⟦0⟧, the intel you have of a country can be seen in the intel ledger of that country. When you hover with the mouse over the naval section of the intel ledger, you see how the navy intel is calculated.
15f2cqq.zh: ⟦0⟧，你对某个国家拥有的情报可以在该国的情报账本中查看。将鼠标悬停在情报账本的海军部分上时，可以看到海军情报是如何计算的。

l9yao9.en: There are several factors that contribute to ⟦0⟧. The ⟦1⟧ against a specific enemy country, expressed as a percentage between 0 and 100, is the sum of each of the following factors:
l9yao9.zh: 有若干因素会影响⟦0⟧。针对某个特定敌国的⟦1⟧以 0 到 100 之间的百分比表示，为以下各因素之和：

1rp5zqw.zh: 敌方⟦0⟧（民主主义：20%，中立主义：20%，共产主义：12.5%，法西斯主义：10%）

a092ob.en: Fighting the enemy ⟦0⟧ (Naval intel gained from naval battles decays by around -0.2%/week.)
a092ob.zh: 与敌方⟦0⟧交战（从海战中获得的海军情报每周约衰减 -0.2%。）

6rqnxo.en: Intel from faction members (30% of the intel difference)
6rqnxo.zh: 来自阵营成员的情报（情报差值的 30%）

1hdnjmp.en: The ⟦0⟧ upgrade to ⟦1⟧ boosts the ⟦2⟧ by +25% of its total value, i.e. it is multiplied by 1.25.
1hdnjmp.zh: 将⟦0⟧升级为⟦1⟧可使⟦2⟧提高其总值的 +25%，即乘以 1.25。

8h77rl.en: Factors on ⟦0⟧ only without the DLC La Résistance:
8h77rl.zh: 仅在不拥有 DLC 抵抗运动时影响⟦0⟧的因素：

1itzopm.en: As illustrated by the picture opposite: Democratic ideology (20%), Export Focus trade law (10%), Radar coverage (16.9%) and Spy network (5.5%) adding up to 52.4%, then multiplied by 1.25 from the ⟦0⟧, give the total ⟦1⟧ of 65.5% against this particular instance of UK.
1itzopm.zh: 如对侧图片所示：民主主义意识形态（20%）、出口焦点贸易法令（10%）、雷达覆盖（16.9%）和特工网络（5.5%）合计为 52.4%，再乘以来自⟦0⟧的 1.25，得到针对此特定英国的⟦1⟧总计为 65.5%。

4nv3hr.en: Example without the DLC La Résistance:
4nv3hr.zh: 不拥有 DLC 抵抗运动时的示例：

1e7mo6j.en: If you don't use the DLC La Résistance and want to naval invade a ⟦0⟧ country (10%) that has ⟦1⟧ (0%) and has researched ⟦2⟧ and you have ⟦3⟧ (15%) and have no radars that cover any enemy territory: You get a ⟦4⟧ of ⟦5⟧, reducing your naval supremacy to 75% of the normal value.
1e7mo6j.zh: 如果你不使用 DLC 抵抗运动，并想海军登陆一个⟦0⟧国家（10%），该国拥有⟦1⟧（0%）且已研究⟦2⟧，而你拥有⟦3⟧（15%）且没有任何覆盖敌方领土的雷达：你的⟦4⟧为⟦5⟧，这会使你的制海权降至正常值的 75%。

1iirgme.en: To be able to get ⟦0⟧, you have to have at least ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧.
1iirgme.zh: 要想获得⟦0⟧，你必须至少拥有⟦1⟧⟦2⟧。

13tgoru.en: ⟦0⟧ of a navy depends on what ⟦1⟧ it is running, how ⟦2⟧ it is on the region, ⟦3⟧ it has and ⟦4⟧ they are. ⟦5⟧ in a strategic region (sea zone) is the sum of ⟦6⟧ of the taskforces assigned to it.
13tgoru.zh: 一支海军的⟦0⟧取决于它执行何种⟦1⟧、它在该区域上的⟦2⟧程度、它拥有的⟦3⟧以及它们的⟦4⟧。某个战略区域（海区）中的⟦5⟧是分配到该区域的特遣舰队⟦6⟧之和。

arzqmz.zh: 制海权（占基础值的比例）

1a6k3pn.en: Task forces with ⟦0⟧ order do not contribute to ⟦1⟧.
1a6k3pn.zh: 处于⟦0⟧命令下的特遣舰队不会为⟦1⟧作出贡献。

1nzkofq.zh: 在制海权不足时继续推进

4p8zhn.en: Invading divisions travel through the sea province by province on convoys, and can be intercepted by enemy fleets and bombers just like supply and trade convoys. It is recommended to use escorts for the convoys, lest the enemy rally their entire fleet to intercept the invading fleet.
4p8zhn.zh: 入侵的师乘坐运输船队逐省穿越海域，并像补给和贸易运输船队一样可能被敌方舰队和轰炸机拦截。建议为运输船队提供护航，以免敌人集结其整支舰队拦截入侵舰队。

n4bxaf.en: When invaders reach the shores and begin to disembark, the side being invaded gets a notification with an icon and a sound and has a brief moment to rally any defenders.
n4bxaf.zh: 当入侵者抵达海岸并开始下船时，被入侵方会收到带有图标和声音的通知，并有短暂时间来集结防守部队。

1okqwc8.en: Invasion speed is improved by technology, and is greatly delayed by attacks on the convoys.
1okqwc8.zh: 入侵速度可通过科技提高，而运输船队遭受攻击会大幅拖延入侵速度。

158szn.en: If the invasion meets resistance, similar to attacking over a naval strait, the landing troops receive a default ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ penalty to attack and breakthrough in the ensuing combat (see ⟦2⟧). The Amphibious adjuster of the division can modify this penalty. Heavy equipment generally makes it worse, while marines, engineers, amphibious vehicles, and flame tanks perform better (see ⟦3⟧).
158szn.zh: 如果入侵遭遇抵抗，与跨越海峡进攻类似，登陆部队在随后的战斗中会获得默认的⟦0⟧⟦1⟧攻击与突破惩罚（见⟦2⟧）。师的“两栖”调整项可以改变该惩罚。重型装备通常会加重惩罚，而海军陆战队、工兵、两栖车辆和喷火坦克表现更好（见⟦3⟧）。

10tmays.en: Additionally, divisions have increased breakthrough (⟦0⟧⟦1⟧) but reduced attack (⟦2⟧⟦3⟧) while being protected by their transports. These effects fade away⟦4⟧ as the landing progresses and the troops leave their landing crafts, measured by movement progress (usually ending after 48 hours⟦5⟧). The ⟦6⟧ modifier gives units a head start in this landing progress and reaching normal combat effectiveness sooner.
10tmays.zh: 此外，各师在受到运输船保护时突破（⟦0⟧⟦1⟧）提高，但攻击（⟦2⟧⟦3⟧）降低。这些效果会随着登陆推进、部队离开登陆艇而逐渐消失⟦4⟧，以移动进度衡量（通常在 48 小时后结束⟦5⟧）。⟦6⟧修正可使部队在这一登陆进度上获得先手，从而更快达到正常战斗效能。

ee310l.en: The ⟦0⟧ modifier primarily provided by later landing craft technologies has two separate effects:
ee310l.zh: 主要由后期登陆艇科技提供的⟦0⟧修正有两个独立效果：

41ajv2.en: it is additive with the ⟦0⟧ starting breakthrough bonus, but fades away as well;
41ajv2.zh: 它与⟦0⟧起始突破加成相加，但同样会逐渐消失；

u7jaxu.en: it multiplicatively improves the landing penalty: the effective penalty is (⟦0⟧ + ⟦1⟧) multiplied by ⟦2⟧(0, 1 − ⟦3⟧ ÷ 3.5).⟦4⟧

12f8tu1.en: Creating a paradrop order requires a minimum of 50 transport planes available at the originating air base.⟦0⟧ Air bases that have this minimum will be highlighted blue during paradrop order creation. To be considered available, transports must not be assigned to other ⟦1⟧, must not be in transit, and must have sufficient fuel supply via the local ⟦2⟧.
12f8tu1.zh: 创建空降命令需要出发空军基地至少有 50 架可用运输机。⟦0⟧拥有这一最低数量的空军基地在创建空降命令时会以蓝色高亮显示。要被判定为可用，运输机不得被分配到其他⟦1⟧、不得处于运输途中，并且必须通过当地⟦2⟧获得足够的燃料补给。

6ywwym.en: After order creation, executing a paradrop order requires 45 transport planes available per division⟦0⟧ assigned to the order at the departure air base. This requirement may be modified as follows:
6ywwym.zh: 命令创建后，执行空降命令需要在出发空军基地为分配到该命令的每个师⟦0⟧提供 45 架可用运输机。该要求可能按以下方式修正：

lm89cn.en: With the DLC ⟦0⟧, the special forces doctrine Strategic Air Lift Corps reduces the transport plane requirement by 50% (i.e., base requirement * 0.5).
lm89cn.zh: 拥有 DLC ⟦0⟧ 时，特种部队学说“战略空运军”可将运输机需求降低 50%（即基础需求 * 0.5）。

1sdsax.en: If both Glider Planes and Strategic Air Lift Corps are active, their benefits stack multiplicatively (i.e., base requirement * 0.9 * 0.5). Neither modifier overrides the 50 plane minimum for a given paradrop order, but they effectively discount the planes required for two divisions and up.
1sdsax.zh: 如果“滑翔机”和“战略空运军”同时生效，其效果以乘法叠加（即基础需求 * 0.9 * 0.5）。这两个修正都不会覆盖特定空降命令 50 架的最低要求，但对于两个师及以上的情况，它们实际上会减少所需飞机数量。

opuob3.en: The table at right provides a summary of transport plane requirements for up to 12 divisions given any active modifiers.
opuob3.zh: 右侧表格汇总了在任意生效修正下最多 12 个师的运输机需求。

93e6vl.en: If launching multiple orders from the same air base, the same transport planes will be used multiple times for different orders in waves if there are enough planes for individual orders but not enough for all orders to go simultaneously. Upon selecting the execute button, these orders will launch in waves automatically in the sequence that they were created and will continue to the last order unless the requirements for later paradrop orders are no longer met (e.g., insufficient air superiority in the required regions or insufficient planes for remaining orders due to aircraft losses). Each order takes about 4 to 8 hours to complete, so the biggest disadvantage of executing in waves with fewer planes is the extended time of the overall paradrop effort, which may give the enemy time to react.
93e6vl.zh: 如果从同一空军基地发起多条命令，在单条命令的飞机足够、但不足以让所有命令同时进行时，同一批运输机会被分批多次用于不同命令。选择执行按钮后，这些命令会按创建顺序自动分批发起，并持续到最后一条命令，除非后续空降命令的要求不再满足（例如相关区域制空权不足，或因飞机损失导致剩余命令飞机不足）。每条命令约需 4 到 8 小时完成，因此用较少飞机分批执行的最大缺点是整体空降行动时间延长，可能给敌人留下反应时间。

14sn0v4.en: The transport wings assigned to a paradrop order must be adequately supplied in order to take off. When transport wings lack the fuel to fly, they will be treated as unavailable upon executing the paradrop order. Reducing supply consumption in the province of the air base or improving supply infrastructure should resolve this issue.
14sn0v4.zh: 分配到空降命令的运输航空队必须有充足的补给才能起飞。当运输航空队缺乏飞行所需燃料时，在执行空降命令时会被视为不可用。降低空军基地所在省份的补给消耗或改善补给基础设施应能解决此问题。

6wpaz2.en: Each paradrop order is targeted on one destination province, whether in friendly or enemy territory. Paradrop orders targeting friendly (own or allied) territory may be executed at any time. Paradrop orders on non-allied territory require a state of war to execute.
6wpaz2.zh: 每条空降命令都以一个目的地省份为目标，无论该省份位于友方还是敌方领土。以友方（本国或盟国）领土为目标的空降命令可随时执行。针对非盟国领土的空降命令需要处于战争状态才能执行。

k0kavy.en: The destination province must be in range of the transport wing, which may vary depending on the technology level of the planes within the wing. In-range provinces are indicated with green highlighting during order creation after selecting the departure air base. Provinces belonging to an air region whose geographic center is outside of the transport wing's range will not be considered in range, even if the individual province is within the range ring of the transport wing.
k0kavy.zh: 目的地省份必须在运输航空队的航程内，航程会因航空队内飞机的科技等级而异。选择出发空军基地后创建命令时，航程内的省份会以绿色高亮显示。属于地理中心位于运输航空队航程之外的航空区域的省份不会被视为在航程内，即使该省份本身位于运输航空队的航程圈内。

exugnw.en: There must be either neutral air or a minimum of 70% air superiority in the departure, enroute, and destination regions of paradrop orders in order to execute.⟦0⟧ Neutral air is defined as the absence of any friendly or enemy air missions in the air region.
exugnw.zh: 空降命令的出发、航路和目的地区域必须为中立方空域或拥有至少 70% 制空权才能执行。⟦0⟧中立空域定义为航空区域内没有任何友方或敌方空军任务。

1j6zeei.en: If multiple paradrop orders pass through different air regions, those that have sufficient air superiority in their applicable regions will launch, while those that do not have air superiority will not launch. It is possible to have momentary air superiority in some waves but lose it in later waves. When air superiority is regained in the required regions, the pending waves will automatically launch.
1j6zeei.zh: 如果多条空降命令经过不同的航空区域，在各自相关区域内拥有足够制空权的命令会发起，而制空权不足的则不会发起。有可能在某些批次中短暂拥有制空权，但在后续批次中失去。当相关区域重新获得制空权时，待发的批次会自动发起。

pd9sth.en: The paradrop mechanic provides several interface components that provide information about paradrop orders. Some of the information in this interface is non-intuitive, so the below guidance is provided.
pd9sth.zh: 空降机制提供若干界面组件，用于显示空降命令的相关信息。该界面中的某些信息并不直观，因此提供以下指引。

z7yvup.en: Execute Button – The green execute button above the army icon displays a tooltip on mouse hover with information that is common to all army orders. For paradrop orders, this tooltip will also indicate if insufficient air superiority in one or more affected regions will prevent order execution. Unlike naval invasions, there is no progress bar or countdown number as paradrop orders do not have an arbitrary preparation time and can launch as soon as assigned paratroopers are at the field along with transport planes.
z7yvup.zh: 执行按钮——集团军图标上方的绿色执行按钮在鼠标悬停时会显示提示，其中的信息对所有集团军命令通用。对于空降命令，该提示还会指出一个或多个相关区域制空权不足是否会阻止命令执行。与海军登陆不同，这里没有进度条或倒计时数字，因为空降命令没有固定的准备时间，只要分配的伞兵连同运输机到位就可以发起。

1x8x0bw.en: Paradrop Order Arrows – Paradrop orders appear on the map between the departure air base and the destination province. Text on the arrows display the name of the order, number of divisions, and transport planes assigned to the order. If no divisions are assigned to an order, it will appear ghosted. Prior to executing the order, the arrow will be solid and static. Upon executing, the arrow will become dashed and animated until the transport planes actually start launching, at which point it will be dashed and static. This may give the impression that the order is not working, but paratroopers should start landing in their drop-zones within a few hours.
1x8x0bw.zh: 空降命令箭头——空降命令会显示在地图上出发空军基地与目的地省份之间。箭头上的文字显示命令名称、师的数量以及分配到该命令的运输机。如果命令没有分配任何师，箭头会以虚化状态显示。执行命令之前，箭头为实线且静止。执行后，箭头会变为虚线并带有动画，直到运输机真正开始起飞，此时它会变为虚线且静止。这可能让人以为命令没有生效，但伞兵应在数小时内开始降落到其空投区。

32ptsy.en: The insufficient transport wings alert displays before and during order execution if there are not enough transport planes available at the air base for any reason (number of planes, planes on other missions, insufficient supply, etc.). The additional required transports is indicated in terms of wing numbers, rather than individual planes, so it tends to be a vague indicator. The insufficient transport wings alert may also display in the tooltip during order execution even if there are sufficient transports and paratroopers are dropping.
32ptsy.zh: 如果因任何原因（飞机数量、飞机执行其他任务、补给不足等）导致空军基地可用运输机不足，运输航空队不足警告会在命令执行前和执行期间显示。额外所需运输机以航空队数量而非单架飞机来表示，因此这一指标往往较为模糊。即使运输机充足且伞兵正在空投，命令执行期间提示中也可能显示运输航空队不足警告。

1xm0y2f.en: The division attrition alert indicates that the division is losing strength and will perform poorly if launched. Division attrition alone will not prevent launching the order, but presence of attrition may indicate poor supply in the area, which may prevent the transport planes from launching due to insufficient fuel.
1xm0y2f.zh: 师损耗警告表示该师正在损失兵力，若发起将表现不佳。仅凭师损耗并不会阻止发起命令，但出现损耗可能说明该地区补给不佳，这可能因燃料不足而导致运输机无法起飞。

1s0ii8q.en: An Offensive Line is a line that a player draws through enemy provinces that contain objectives for the assigned army units to move to and capture. From a front line, or from another offensive line, a player can draw one or several offensive lines or arrows that tell the AI how the player wants the selected plan's divisions to advance from the front line. The width and arc of the offensive line can be adjusted as described on the tooltip. If the mouse cursor is dragged over the offensive line or arrow the game will show the exact visualisation of how the AI will advance the divisions, step for step. ALT for edit mode and TAB to shift the arrow's base can be useful to direct the main effort.
1s0ii8q.zh: 进攻线是玩家穿过敌方省份绘制的一条线，这些省份包含供分配部队前往并夺取的目标。玩家可以从前线或另一条进攻线出发，绘制一条或多条进攻线或箭头，告诉 AI 希望所选计划中的师如何从前线推进。进攻线的宽度和弧度可按提示中所述进行调整。如果将鼠标光标拖过进攻线或箭头，游戏会逐步显示 AI 将如何推进师的确切可视化预览。用 ALT 进入编辑模式、用 TAB 移动箭头基点，有助于引导主攻方向。

19wyols.en: The order to execute battle plans is given with the button above the commander portrait, along with a tooltip that provides information and advice from the staff regarding the battle plan. The AI then executes the battle plan until the troops reach their offensive line which has then become the new front line. If that front line has offensive line orders beyond it then the execute button has to be pressed again to resume the advance from the new front line. Pausing to rest, resupply, refit, regroup, and coordinate further plans was common between phases of a major offensive. This is also a good time to detach troops to consolidate control over occupied territory, which usually involves smaller divisions that specialize in discouraging unrest. The Garrison Area battle plan order is one used in such a situation.
19wyols.zh: 执行作战计划的命令通过指挥官头像上方的按钮下达，提示中会提供参谋部关于该作战计划的信息和建议。随后 AI 会执行作战计划，直到部队抵达其进攻线，此时该进攻线就成为新的前线。如果该前线之外还有进攻线命令，则必须再次按下执行按钮，从新前线继续推进。在大规模攻势的各阶段之间，暂停以休整、补给、整编、重新集结并协调后续计划是常见做法。这也是抽调部队巩固对占领区控制的良机，通常涉及专门用于压制骚乱的小型师。「驻防区域」作战计划命令就是在这种情况下使用的。

1eripl9.en: More examples for front line and offensive line
1eripl9.zh: 前线与进攻线的更多示例

pjwbo7.en: The spearhead order starts from a front line and can be used alongside or instead of the Offensive Line within an army. Unlike the normal battle plan that spreads out to cover its flanks and adjusts to circumstances, spearheads advance in a narrow path one province wide to their objective, exactly as it was when first defined. This makes them suitable for blitzkrieg-style armored penetrations that can capture a specific goal or work with another spearhead pincer to encircle enemy cities or armies in pockets, sealed in a ring of steel by the mobile and regular infantry divisions following behind. Encircled armies can thus be annihilated, as routed divisions which lack friendly territory to retreat to are destroyed.
pjwbo7.zh: 突击命令从前线开始，可以在集团军内与进攻线配合使用，也可以替代进攻线。与展开以掩护侧翼并随机应变的普通作战计划不同，突击会沿一条宽度为一个省份的狭窄路径向目标推进，完全按照最初划定的路线前进。这使其适合闪电战式的装甲突破，可用于夺取特定目标，或与另一支突击部队形成钳形攻势，将敌方城市或军队包围成口袋，由随后跟进的机动师和普通步兵师封成钢铁之环。被包围的军队由此可被歼灭，因为溃败的师若无友方领土可退，就会被消灭。

p2wxvc.en: Spearheads (shortcut 'SHIFT + X') may be used only through territory past the attacking army's front line or territory assigned to a naval invasion (tanks rolling off the landing craft into battle). It may also only be used as an order for armies; Spearheads are unusable for any army group as a whole. Spearheads follow the exact paths traced on the map by right-clicking and dragging the mouse through successive provinces. This may enable the attacking forces to plan a path that bypasses forts, cities, or other undesirable terrain in order to maintain their momentum.
p2wxvc.zh: 突击（快捷键「SHIFT + X」）只能用于越过进攻军队前线之外的领土，或用于分配给海军登陆的领土（坦克直接从登陆艇投入战斗）。它也只能作为军的命令下达；突击不能以整个集团军为单位使用。突击会沿着玩家在地图上按住鼠标右键拖过一连串省份所描绘的精确路径推进。这可以让进攻部队规划出一条绕过要塞、城市或其他不利地形的路线，以保持进攻势头。

1mpzkkd.en: The player can draw fallback lines in controlled territory, and that will tell the AI upon order execution to move and deploy its divisions behind the fallback line in the same manner as with a front line, hold the line against enemy assaults, and counter-attack to restore the position if the line is broken. Unlike front lines, divisions stationed at fallback lines do not receive a planning bonus; however, divisions that are stationed a long time in a province can accumulate an entrenchment bonus while remaining in that position.
1mpzkkd.zh: 玩家可以在己方控制的领土上绘制撤退线，命令执行后，这会指示 AI 以与前线相同的方式把各师移动并部署到撤退线之后，坚守该线抵御敌军进攻，并在防线被突破时实施反击以恢复原有阵地。与前线不同，驻守撤退线的师不会获得计划加成；不过，长期驻扎在某个省份的师可以在原地积累构筑工事加成。

16hlpjr.en: Area Defense assigns the entire army to guard an area rather than a front line. It is mainly useful to protect against naval invasions and paratroopers. As the divisions are spread out over one or more states rather than concentrated in a position for defense, this posture is ill-suited near the front line. If part of the area is lost to the enemy, then the garrison units will automatically attempt to recover the lost territory.
16hlpjr.zh: 区域防御会把整个军指派去守卫一片区域，而不是一条前线。它主要用于防范海军登陆和伞兵。由于各师是分散在一个或多个州而不是集中在某一位置进行防御，这种姿态不适合在前线附近使用。如果区域的一部分被敌军占领，驻防单位会自动尝试收复失地。

1drjw1z.en: The defense command has multiple subsections (see graphic):
1drjw1z.zh: 防御命令包含多个子项（见图示）：

1q6pj4d.en: The player can choose which of these they wish to guard and the UI will tell the player how many divisions the AI considers necessary to satisfy the command. The garrison area order ⟦0⟧ the limit of units under a commander to 72 without incurring a debuff.
1q6pj4d.zh: 玩家可以选择要守卫其中哪些目标，界面会告诉玩家 AI 认为需要多少师才能满足该命令。驻防区域命令会使指挥官麾下的单位上限⟦0⟧，达到 72 而不会受到减益。

1nvziye.en: When a division is at the starting position of an offensive battle plan (⟦0⟧) and is neither moving or fighting, it will accumulate a ⟦1⟧ at the start of each day, expressed as a percentage, until a maximum planning bonus is reached. This confers greater combat performance for the division. Planning can be accumulated even if the unit is not assigned to the frontline with the offensive battle plan, so long as the unit is under the command of the same commander to whom that frontline belongs. For example, if the player draws a field marshal frontline with an offensive battle plan and then manually moves some divisions that are under the command of a general under that field marshal next to the frontline, those divisions will start to accumulate planning even if they are not assigned to the field marshal's frontline.
1nvziye.zh: 当一个师位于进攻作战计划（⟦0⟧）的起始位置，且既不在移动也不在战斗时，它会在每天开始时积累⟦1⟧，以百分比表示，直到达到最大计划加成。这能为该师带来更强的战斗表现。即使单位没有被分配到带有该进攻作战计划的前线，只要该单位隶属于拥有该前线的同一指挥官，也可以积累计划。例如，如果玩家绘制了一条元帅前线并带有进攻作战计划，然后手动把隶属于该元帅麾下某位将领的若干师移动到前线附近，即使这些师没有被分配到该元帅的前线，它们也会开始积累计划。

f8kpiw.en: i.e. a battle plan containing at least one Offensive Line or Spearhead order
f8kpiw.zh: 即包含至少一条进攻线或突击命令的作战计划

1r52v4g.en: The planning bonus is a combat modifier that increases attack and breakthrough by 1%, per 1% planning.
1r52v4g.zh: 计划加成是一种战斗修正，每 1% 计划使攻击和突破提高 1%。

5yrcbp.en: When a division with a planning bonus is moving or fighting, it will lose some of its planning bonus each day. The planning bonus for a division will decay by ⟦0⟧ per day if the division is being automatically managed by the battle plan AI. If a division is manually commanded by the human player, the planning bonus will decay ⟦1⟧ daily.
5yrcbp.zh: 当带有计划加成的师在移动或战斗时，它每天都会损失一部分计划加成。如果该师由作战计划 AI 自动管理，其计划加成每天衰减⟦0⟧。如果该师由人类玩家手动指挥，则计划加成每天衰减⟦1⟧。

1ym4lqk.en: Planning is normally not available for ⟦0⟧, as naval invasion planning gain receives a ⟦1⟧ penalty despite there being a base gain of ⟦2⟧ planning per day. However, with ⟦3⟧, if the ⟦4⟧ marine doctrine is taken, the first penalty is reduced to ⟦5⟧, allowing all units assigned to naval invasions to slowly gain planning over time.
1ym4lqk.zh: 计划通常不能用于⟦0⟧，因为海军登陆的计划获取会承受⟦1⟧惩罚，尽管其基础获取为每天⟦2⟧计划。不过，拥有⟦3⟧时，若选择了⟦4⟧中的海军陆战学说，第一项惩罚会降至⟦5⟧，使所有分配到海军登陆的单位都能随着时间缓慢积累计划。

57htrl.en: Since achieving the maximum planning bonus will take a number of days, it may be worthwhile to prepare battle plans during peacetime, so that each division will have a full planning bonus upon the outbreak of war.
57htrl.zh: 由于达到最大计划加成需要若干天，因此在和平时期就开始准备作战计划可能是值得的，这样每个师在战争爆发时都能拥有完整的计划加成。

1ugd71n.en: If the player wishes to minimise the rate of planning bonus decay, it may be helpful to prepare a complex battle plan containing multiple orders. This can enable divisions to achieve their objectives without requiring manual commands from the player.⟦0⟧
1ugd71n.zh: 如果玩家希望尽量降低计划加成的衰减速度，准备一份包含多条命令的复杂作战计划可能会有所帮助。这可以让各师无需玩家手动下达命令即可达成目标。⟦0⟧

15ck9q3.en: Alternatively, the human player can micromanage their divisions, to achieve finer control or the ability to react to changing circumstances. This presents a tradeoff, as planning bonus will be lost more quickly when manual commands are issued.
15ck9q3.zh: 或者，人类玩家可以微操自己的师，以实现更精细的控制或应对局势变化的能力。这是一种权衡，因为下达手动命令时计划加成会流失得更快。

126duuo.en: Manual control and battle plan; support attack
126duuo.zh: 手动控制与作战计划；支援攻击

7liwm6.en: Divisions that belong to a battle plan and receive a manual order will revert back to AI control after implementing the order.
7liwm6.zh: 属于某个作战计划并收到手动命令的师，在执行完该命令后会重新交由 AI 控制。

1xx1buy.en: Once combat is joined, the player may select an unengaged division and then Ctrl+right click (or Ctrl+alt+right click) on the combat icon to make the selected division join in a support attack. This allows the division to assist in the attack without automatically advancing the division into the enemy-occupied area upon victory. The battle plan AI may automatically order such a support attack, as well.
1xx1buy.zh: 一旦进入战斗，玩家可以选择一个尚未交战的师，然后对战斗图标按 Ctrl+右键（或 Ctrl+Alt+右键），让所选师加入支援攻击。这使该师能够协助进攻，而不会在胜利后自动推进到敌军占领的区域。作战计划 AI 也可能自动下达此类支援攻击命令。

1rt7x91.en: Players can see their allies' battle plans (an option that can be toggled on and off in the lower right corner of the screen). This may help in multiplayer to coordinate with allies and in single player to understand what the AI is doing because AI countries create their own battle plans.
1rt7x91.zh: 玩家可以看到盟友的作战计划（该选项可在屏幕右下角开启或关闭）。这在多人游戏中有助于与盟友协调，在单人游戏中则有助于理解 AI 的行动，因为 AI 国家会创建自己的作战计划。

4tcikq.en: ⟦0⟧ = -0.5, multiplied by the (1 − Invasion Defense / 3.5) factor described below — see ⟦1⟧

cjz6sc.en: ⟦0⟧ = 3.5; with '40 and '44 landing-craft tech (Invasion Defense 0.15 and 0.65 respectively) the effective penalty drops to ≈ 95.7% and ≈ 81.4% of the base.
cjz6sc.zh: ⟦0⟧ = 3.5；采用 '40 和 '44 登陆艇科技（登陆防御分别为 0.15 和 0.65）后，实际惩罚降至基础值的约 95.7% 和约 81.4%。

nh7ap5.en: For an example of this, see Zwirbaum's battle plan tutorial on Youtube
nh7ap5.zh: 关于此点的示例，参见 Zwirbaum 在 Youtube 上的作战计划教程

ztsxvk.zh: 本类舰船有多少艘处于现役

gxoaa4.zh: 本类舰船有多少艘正在生产中

5h88pa.en: Effects (also known as Commands) are used in order to affect the game dynamically from within a specific scope. They are a one-time change to the current condition of the game, ⟦0⟧. Instead, ⟦1⟧ are used to have a continuous, everlasting effect on the game's condition that can be represented with a number. Effect blocks cannot be used to apply modifiers directly, however they can add something that can apply modifiers, most commonly with ⟦2⟧.
5h88pa.zh: 效果（也称指令，Commands）用于在特定作用域内动态影响游戏。它们是对游戏当前状态的一次性改动，⟦0⟧。与之相对，⟦1⟧ 用于对游戏状态施加可量化的持续、永久影响。效果块不能直接施加修正，但可以添加能够施加修正的东西，最常见的是通过 ⟦2⟧。

19kx7yp.en: without the ability to have a lasting effect

yeb5t0.en: Effects are used throughout the game in numerous scopes, most commonly edited effect blocks are ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.
yeb5t0.zh: 效果在游戏中用于众多作用域，最常见的可编辑效果块是 ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧。

1434wcj.zh: 效果列表可能已经过时。完整但未排序的效果列表可在 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 中找到。

1dko6nx.zh: 对符合限制条件且由包含此效果的所在国家控制的每个州执行其中包含的效果。

10slxh6.zh: 对符合限制条件且由包含此效果的所在国家招募的一个随机单位指挥官（军长、元帅、海军上将）执行其中包含的效果。

1itywpl.zh: 在1.12.8之前的游戏版本中，该角色必须已被此作用域所属国家招募。
