1vf48z6.en: The special project identified by that ID as defined within the ⟦0⟧ file.
1vf48z6.zh: 由该ID标识的特殊项目，定义于 ⟦0⟧ 文件中。

cl4ojx.en: Targets the root node of the block, an inherent property of each block. Most commonly, this is the default scope: for example, ROOT ⟦0⟧ will always refer to the country doing the focus and ROOT ⟦1⟧ will always refer to the country getting the event. However, some blocks do distinguish between the default scope and ROOT, such as ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧. If a block doesn't have ROOT defined (such as ⟦4⟧), then it is impossible to use it.
cl4ojx.zh: 指向所在块的根节点，这是每个块固有的属性。最常见的情况是，它就是默认作用域：例如 ROOT ⟦0⟧ 始终指向执行该焦点的国家，ROOT ⟦1⟧ 始终指向收到该事件的国家。不过，某些块会区分默认作用域与 ROOT，例如 ⟦2⟧ 或 ⟦3⟧。若某个块没有定义 ROOT（例如 ⟦4⟧），则无法使用它。

1g85fhg.en: Targets the scope that the current scope is contained in. Can have additional applications where the assumed default scope differs from the ROOT, such as in state events or some on_actions. Can be chained indefinitely as PREV.PREV. ⟦0⟧: what's shown to the player doesn't always correlate with reality. See also: PREV usage.
1g85fhg.zh: 指向包含当前作用域的那个作用域。在默认假定作用域与 ROOT 不同的情况下（例如州事件或某些 on_actions）可能有额外用法。可无限链式调用，如 PREV.PREV。⟦0⟧：向玩家显示的内容并不总是与现实相符。另见：PREV 用法。

12cyzen.zh: 通常会导致提示框显示异常

hpwtjk.en: ⟦0⟧ Expected number of factories put on Consumer Goods
hpwtjk.zh: ⟦0⟧ 预计投入消费品生产的工厂数

14e04bc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 每单位石油的燃料产量

1u2jchp.en: The ⟦0⟧ of a seazone is calculated from the intel you have from nations you are ⟦1⟧ and that ⟦2⟧ in that seazone. If you are not at war, you have 100% ⟦3⟧ everywhere. If you are at war with one country, you have 100% ⟦4⟧ in all seazones in which this country has no ships assigned (the value ⟦5⟧ is 0). In the seazones in which the country has ships assigned (⟦6⟧ > 0), the ⟦7⟧ is the intel you have of that country. If you are at war with more countries, and more than one of these countries have ships in one seazone, the ⟦8⟧ is weighted towards the country that has more naval supremacy in that seazone.
1u2jchp.zh: 某个海区的⟦0⟧由你从与其⟦1⟧且在该海区⟦2⟧的国家所获得的情报计算得出。如果未处于战争状态，你在所有地方都拥有 100% 的⟦3⟧。如果与一个国家交战，在该国未分配舰船的所有海区中，你拥有 100% 的⟦4⟧（⟦5⟧值为 0）。在该国分配了舰船的海区中（⟦6⟧ > 0），⟦7⟧就是你对该国拥有的情报。如果与多个国家交战，且其中不止一个国家在同一海区拥有舰船，则⟦8⟧会向在该海区拥有更多制海权的国家加权。

1hywd6q.en: To ⟦0⟧ a naval invasion, a country requires ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ (also called 'naval superiority' in some tooltips) ⟦3⟧ (sea zones) in which the divisions will need to traverse the sea en-route to their destination. These are the regions the arrow of the naval invasion battle plan passes through.
1hywd6q.zh: 要⟦0⟧海军登陆，一个国家需要拥有⟦1⟧⟦2⟧（在某些提示中也被称为“海军优势”），并且需要在前进途中经过的各⟦3⟧（海区）中满足这一条件。它们就是海军登陆作战计划箭头所经过的区域。

ubq2s6.en: ⟦0⟧ contribute ⟦1⟧ to ⟦2⟧. For example the Italian early battleship ⟦3⟧ provides around 356 ⟦4⟧ on a strike-force mission, while a single ⟦5⟧ Italian early destroyer provides around 117. Per-ship supremacy scales with the ship's production cost and manpower; the exact constants are not currently exposed in ⟦6⟧ and are determined by the engine.
ubq2s6.zh: ⟦0⟧为⟦1⟧的⟦2⟧作出贡献。例如，意大利早期战列舰⟦3⟧在执行打击舰队任务时提供约 356 点⟦4⟧，而单艘⟦5⟧意大利早期驱逐舰提供约 117 点。单舰制海权随舰船的生产成本和人力而变化；确切的常数目前未在⟦6⟧中公开，由引擎决定。

2a8hcn.en: ⟦0⟧ is only required for a ⟦1⟧ to launch the prepared invasion. After that the invasion will ⟦2⟧. Once the naval invasion has been properly planned, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ have been attained, and sufficient convoys are gathered, the plan may be activated.
2a8hcn.zh: ⟦0⟧只需在⟦1⟧内拥有，就足以让已准备好的入侵得以发动。此后入侵将⟦2⟧。一旦海军登陆得到妥善计划、达成⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧并集结了足够的运输船队，计划就可以激活。

1c7984v.en: Divisions are paradropped at ⟦0⟧ of their organization, regardless of whether they were disrupted or not. They receive a ⟦1⟧ penalty to their recovery rate for 120⟦2⟧ hours afterward. They also receive a ⟦3⟧ penalty to their attack and defense in combat for 48⟦4⟧ hours.
1c7984v.zh: 各师空降后组织度为⟦0⟧，无论其是否被打乱。此后其恢复速度会受到⟦1⟧惩罚，持续 120⟦2⟧小时。其战斗中的攻击和防御也会受到⟦3⟧惩罚，持续 48⟦4⟧小时。

3p2q2y.en: Deployments facilitate the creation of one or multiple divisions of a particular type. A deployment is started by clicking "Train" on one of the available division templates. Multiple divisions can be trained in parallel in one deployment by clicking "Add Unit" and divisions can also be trained sequentially by changing the number above. A location on the map must be selected where divisions will spawn as they leave the deployment phase. Optionally they can also be assigned an order or command group which they will join as soon as they spawn. This is done by clicking the grey circle next to the location button and then selecting a command group or an order on the map.
3p2q2y.zh: 部署用于便捷地创建一个或多个特定类型的师。在某个可用师编制上点击「训练」即可开始一项部署。通过点击「添加单位」，可以在一次部署中并行训练多个师；也可以修改上方的数量来按顺序训练多个师。必须在地图上选择一个位置，各师完成部署阶段后将在此出现。还可以选择性地为它们指派一条命令或一个集团军，它们一经出现便会加入其中。方法是点击位置按钮旁边的灰色圆圈，然后在地图上选择一个集团军或一条命令。

grdfv8.en: A country can only simultaneously train divisions that require in total 75%⟦0⟧ of its currently fielded ⟦1⟧ or 100000⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, whichever is higher.
grdfv8.zh: 一个国家同时训练的师，其总需求上限为其当前已部署⟦0⟧的 75%⟦1⟧，或 100000⟦2⟧⟦3⟧，以较高者为准。

1x491rx.en: Lend-Lease is donation of ⟦0⟧ to another country. See the Start Lend-Lease diplomatic options under ⟦1⟧. A separate panel with tooltip information for each of the player nation’s Lend-Lease relationships is shown. Lend-lease always has highest priority above all other items. Changes or cancellation must be made through a diplomatic action.
1x491rx.zh: 租借是向另一个国家赠送⟦0⟧。参见⟦1⟧下的「开始租借」外交选项。界面会显示一个独立面板，其中包含玩家国家每项租借关系的提示信息。租借始终拥有高于所有其他项目的最高优先级。变更或取消必须通过外交行动进行。

6ohufn.en: Divisions in the field will request reinforcements if they are lacking any ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. This can happen as a result of taking damage in combat, changes to their division template, or attrition.
6ohufn.zh: 战场上的师只要缺少任何⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧，就会请求增援。这可能由战斗受损、师编制变更或损耗造成。

pp7ey3.en: Upgrades are replacement of divisions' existing equipment with better types or variants. Troops will seek higher tier equipment if made available to them.
pp7ey3.zh: 升级是指用更好的类型或改型替换师现有的装备。只要能获得更高档次的装备，部队就会主动换装。

ytfjb2.en: It is also possible through the division template to downgrade equipment for a division template (e.g., giving a garrison or security division old small arms) to free up better equipment in the future for more important uses or assign old equipment to be used up in training and military exercises.
ytfjb2.zh: 也可以通过师编制为某个师编制降级装备（例如给驻军或安保师配备老旧的轻武器），以便将来把更好的装备腾出来用于更重要的用途，或指定用旧装备消耗于训练和军事演习中。

pvcqpi.en: The Reinforcements and Upgrades panels offer tooltip information on current equipment requests and the ability to set high, medium, or low priority that determines how equipment as a whole will be allocated among competing needs for reinforcements, upgrades, and equipment of recruits for training. These decisions have important effects down the road.
pvcqpi.zh: 增援和升级面板会以提示信息的形式提供当前装备需求，并允许设置高、中或低优先级，以决定装备在增援、升级和用于训练新兵的装备等相互竞争的需求之间如何整体分配。这些决定会在后续产生重要影响。

kma31n.en: The fastest way to recruit troops is to have all the needed equipment ready in stockpiles for training purposes rather than waiting for it to be manufactured and delivered to the waiting unit. The easiest troops to train are standard infantry who can be trained using up stockpiles of current, obsolete, or captured basic infantry equipment. The division template is where to specify and change the exact equipment the player wants the template's divisions to use. There is no experience cost for changing the division equipment authorizations with an update. Accordingly, some careful equipment managers create basic training templates that parallel the organization of the combat templates but use older equipment for training and exercises. The big risk here is sleepless gamers accidentally assigning combat units to a training template. Whether under control of the planner or conducting field exercises, it is important to provide a division with ample time to re-equip and recover organization to be ready for combat.
kma31n.zh: 招募部队最快的方法是：在库存中准备好训练所需的全部装备，而不是等待其生产出来再交付给等待中的单位。最容易训练的是标准步兵，可以用现有、过时或缴获的基础步兵装备库存来训练。师编制正是指定和更改该编制的师所用确切装备的地方。通过更新更改师的装备授权不需要花费经验。因此，一些细心的装备管理者会创建基础训练编制，其编成与作战编制相同，但使用较旧的装备进行训练和演习。这里最大的风险是熬夜的玩家不小心把作战单位分配到训练编制上。无论是交由编制器控制还是进行实地演习，都必须给师留出充足的时间重新装备并恢复组织度，以便为战斗做好准备。

1dn4qrg.en: Create a new army ordered to exercise (it may also be ordered to Garrison Area so as to serve a useful purpose) and assign to it all freshly deployed units. They will increase their experience to regular level, after which they can be switched to a front-line unit or continue exercise to create a small flow of added land experience at the cost of consuming further equipment.
1dn4qrg.zh: 新建一个军并命令其进行演习（也可以命令其执行驻防区域，以便发挥实际作用），然后把所有刚部署的单位都分配给它。它们会把经验提升到正规级别，之后可以转为前线单位，或继续演习，以消耗更多装备为代价产生少量持续的陆军经验。

rt2p7e.en: The game uses a limited number of preset colors for command groups, but allows for color customization. To change the colors, select the command group and click on the colored bar to the right of the command group's name above the list of divisions, or the icon of the command group. Command groups can be assigned icons to differentiate between command groups or for historical immerersion. The insignia can be changed the same way as colors.
rt2p7e.zh: 游戏为集团军使用数量有限的预设颜色，但也允许自定义颜色。要更改颜色，请选中该集团军，然后点击集团军名称右侧、师列表上方的彩色条，或点击集团军的图标。可以为集团军指派图标，以便区分不同的集团军，或出于历史沉浸感。徽章可以像颜色一样更改。

yyz4xh.en: Battle plans are a mechanic to give orders to command groups as a whole or may include different specific orders for different parts of the command group.
yyz4xh.zh: 作战计划是一种向整个集团军下达命令的机制，也可以为集团军的不同部分包含不同的具体命令。

1l50b1s.en: An army group can be commanded like any other group of units and simply given a right-click move order to a destination. However, they fight better if they are given "plans" – a general order that is coordinated along a front, either to advance, defend or make an orderly withdrawal. Once the player hits the execute button, the AI will direct forces through the plan, although the player can still micromanage to correct the AI and for complex maneuvers such as encircling. The player may also decide whether the AI should act carefully, balanced or rushed.
1l50b1s.zh: 集团军可以像任何其他单位集群一样指挥，只需右键点击目的地下达移动命令。不过，如果给它们「计划」——一条沿前线协调的总体命令，用于进攻、防御或有序撤退——它们会打得更好。玩家按下执行按钮后，AI 会按计划指挥部队，不过玩家仍可以进行微操来纠正 AI，以及执行包围等复杂机动。玩家还可以决定 AI 应当谨慎、均衡还是冒进地行动。

s91wue.en: When selecting a command group, the player will see a row of general orders appear at the bottom of the screen. Each of these has rollover text that explains in detail how to use this instruction.
s91wue.zh: 选中一个集团军时，玩家会看到屏幕底部出现一排总体命令。每条命令都带有悬停文本，详细说明如何使用该指令。

1rxb849.en: Command groups may be assigned a commander, increasing their effectiveness in combat.
1rxb849.zh: 集团军可以指派一名指挥官，以提高其战斗效能。

iyx2g7.en: Military exercises including drill, weapons practice, and field maneuvers are a less deadly way to gain experience than combat, although at some level there is no substitute for experiencing combat conditions. Any command group may exercise, which can provide two separate benefits. While exercising, the divisions gain experience until they reach regular status, after which they need combat experience to improve further. The country, however, gains land combat ⟦0⟧ whenever troops that are trained or better are conducting an exercise. Such experience is needed to edit or create new divisions. Training is one way to provide needed land experience while at peace. Commanders do not gain experience from exercising, only combat time.
iyx2g7.zh: 军事演习包括操练、武器练习和野外机动，是比战斗更安全的获取经验的方式，尽管在某种程度上，实地体验战斗环境仍是无可替代的。任何集团军都可以进行演习，这能带来两项不同的好处。演习期间，各师会获得经验，直到达到正规级别，此后它们需要战斗经验才能进一步提高。不过，只要有训练有素或更高水平的部队在进行演习，国家就会获得陆战⟦0⟧。编辑或创建新的师正需要这种经验。训练是在和平时期提供所需陆军经验的一种方式。指挥官不会从演习中获得经验，只有战斗时间才能带来经验。

i98bos.en: In the simplest case, for a fully equipped, fully fueled division and a country that does not have training modifiers and did not reduce its division count recently, the amount of experience the country gets from an exercising division depends on the following components:
i98bos.zh: 在最简单的情况下，对于一个装备齐全、燃料充足的师，且国家没有训练修正、近期也没有减少师的数量的情况下，国家从演习中的师获得的经验量取决于以下组成部分：

1e6ezz0.en: B: number of battalions and support companies in the division
1e6ezz0.zh: B：师中的营与支援连数量

1nfjssd.en: C(day): the number of divisions in the field and in training on a given day
1nfjssd.zh: C(day)：某一天在战场上和训练中的师数量

12l5pnd.en: More generally, the following additional inputs are considered:
12l5pnd.zh: 更一般地说，还需考虑以下附加输入：

17am9l6.en: F: (for units needing fuel) fuel factor scales between 0 and 1 according to ⟦0⟧ availability in the division
17am9l6.zh: F：（对于需要燃料的单位）燃料系数根据师内⟦0⟧的可用程度在 0 到 1 之间缩放

159dmtj.en: R: the division's fighting strength ratio (reduced when lacking manpower or equipment)
159dmtj.zh: R：师的战斗力比例（缺少人力或装备时降低）

1qu3256.en: While in an exercise, divisions have a ⟦0⟧ increase in attrition of their equipment. Their ⟦1⟧ is set to 20%⟦2⟧ and may take about a week after they stop to fully recover. Note that arming fresh troops with older weapons from inventory (by setting their division template equipment button setting to use the older equipment) conserves more expensive current weapons for combat units. To help with this, it is sound practice to attach all divisions that need exercising to a training Army during the training period by using the Army View (hotkey "o") to click or shift-click to select all those needing training and then right-clicking on the training army icon to assign them there before giving the exercise order at the army command level. By checking periodically, the same process can be used to re-assign back the divisions that have completed their intended training.
1qu3256.zh: 演习期间，各师的装备损耗会增加⟦0⟧。其⟦1⟧会被设为 20%⟦2⟧，并且停止演习后可能大约需要一周才能完全恢复。注意，用库存中的旧武器武装新兵（把其师编制的装备按钮设置为使用较旧的装备）可以把更昂贵的现役武器留给作战单位。为便于做到这一点，一种合理的做法是：在训练期间，使用陆军视图（快捷键「o」）点击或按住 Shift 点击，选中所有需要训练的师，然后右键点击训练军的图标把它们分配到那里，再在军级下达演习命令。通过定期检查，也可以用同样的流程把已完成预定训练的师重新分配回去。

q04vny.en: You can shift-click to have the exercises automatically cancel when all troops are at regular level.
q04vny.zh: 你可以按住 Shift 点击，使所有部队达到正规级别后自动取消演习。

1tl1ghx.en: bug report Training time modifier increases experience gain
1tl1ghx.zh: 错误报告：训练时间修正会提高经验获取

1w59o2x.en: Improving relations is initiated at the cost of 10 political power, and costs a base rate of .2 political power per day for a country with a matching ideology. If the improving relations action is taken with the target being a separate ideology, the cost per day is 0.4 political power. For example, if Germany was improving relations with fascist ⟦0⟧ it would cost .2 political power per day, but improving relations with the democratic ⟦1⟧ would cost .4 political power per day.
1w59o2x.zh: 改善关系的启动花费为 10 政治点数，之后对意识形态相同的国家每天基础花费 0.2 政治点数。若改善关系的目标意识形态不同，则每天花费 0.4 政治点数。例如，德国若与法西斯主义的⟦0⟧改善关系，每天花费 0.2 政治点数，但与民主主义的⟦1⟧改善关系则每天花费 0.4 政治点数。

1piaa5x.en: Decisions act as a middle ground between national focuses and ⟦0⟧. The outcomes vary between instantaneous or timed effects.
1piaa5x.zh: 决议介于国策与⟦0⟧之间，其效果可以是即时生效，也可以是限时生效。

1cq3tr.en: Elections occur in most Democracies and some Non-Aligned countries, along with ⟦0⟧(), ⟦1⟧() and ⟦2⟧() at the start of the game. Communist ⟦3⟧, communist/fascist ⟦4⟧, fascist ⟦5⟧, and Communist China can have elections via their national focus. The length of time between an election depends on the country, ranging from one to eight years between elections.
1cq3tr.zh: 大多数民主国家和部分不结盟国家会举行选举，游戏开始时⟦0⟧（）、⟦1⟧（）与⟦2⟧（）亦然。共产主义⟦3⟧、共产主义／法西斯主义⟦4⟧、法西斯主义⟦5⟧以及中国共产党可通过其国策获得选举。两次选举之间的间隔因国家而异，从一年到八年不等。

eks1u3.en: Stability is expressed as a percentage from 0% to 100%⟦0⟧, and represents the people's support for the current government. Stability has various effects. At high stability, the nation receives production bonuses. At low stability, various crises can ravage the nation. Details below.
eks1u3.zh: 稳定度以 0% 至 100% 的百分比表示⟦0⟧，代表民众对当前政府的支持程度。稳定度有多种影响：稳定度高时国家获得生产加成，稳定度低时各种危机可能重创国家。详见下文。

1ugf4ch.en: Further, stability affects resistance targets in occupied territories from 0% at 100% up to ⟦0⟧ at 0%.⟦1⟧
1ugf4ch.zh: 此外，稳定度还会影响被占领土的抵抗度目标：稳定度 100% 时为 0%，稳定度 0% 时升至⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧

uusdck.en: ⟦0⟧ from having "Popular Figurehead" ruler trait or political advisor (both can be stacked together)
uusdck.zh: 拥有「受欢迎的名义领袖」统治者特质或政治顾问时获得的⟦0⟧（两者可以叠加）

1yj3kjq.en: Command power (CP) represents the ability of the government to bypass the chain of command and directly influence the military. Command power is capped at 80,⟦0⟧ however, both the growth and the cap can be increased by Doctrines, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧. Hiring ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ will also increase the cap, and the country's War support also affects Command power growth.
1yj3kjq.zh: 指挥点数（CP）代表政府绕过指挥体系、直接干预军队的能力。指挥点数上限为 80，⟦0⟧但其增长速度和上限都可以通过学说、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧来提高。聘用⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧也会提高上限，而国家的战争支持度同样影响指挥点数的增长速度。

1eyb6pz.en: 40Command power is only a base cost, it can be further modified by personality traits.
1eyb6pz.zh: 40 指挥点数只是基础花费，还可由性格特质进一步修正。

14ii0bx.en: Command power is used and allocated so long as the mission is active.
14ii0bx.zh: 只要任务处于激活状态，就会持续占用并分配指挥点数。

inuljf.en: Command power is used and allocated so long the command is active and there are planes operating in the air zone.
inuljf.zh: 只要该指挥机构处于激活状态、且空域内有飞机在执行任务，就会持续占用并分配指挥点数。

prmtkj.en: An ⟦0⟧ is a technical expert on a country's diplomatic staff at a foreign capital that can be sent to a country currently at war by a country currently not at war. Sending an attaché will result in higher military cooperation and give benefits to both countries. It costs the sending country 100⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ and 50⟦3⟧ Command power to send the attaché, of which the 50 is constantly allocated to maintain the attaché.
prmtkj.zh: ⟦0⟧是驻在外国首都的武官，属于本国外交人员中的技术专家，可由未处于战争状态的国家派往正在交战的国家。派出武官会带来更高的军事合作，并使双方都获益。派遣国需为此支付 100⟦1⟧⟦2⟧和 50⟦3⟧指挥点数，其中 50 点会被持续占用以维持该武官。

1pq6b23.en: In the lower right corner of the map before starting the game are the game settings. Here the player can toggle ⟦0⟧ and historical focus on or off and use the difficulty settings to make the game harder or easier for the player and also boost the relative power of one or more of the more important nations (this makes them stronger, but not smarter). There is also an icon for showing if steam ⟦1⟧ can be earned in the game or not, they require ironman mode and regular or higher difficulty. When finished press the ⟦2⟧ button in the lower right hand corner to start the game.
1pq6b23.zh: 开始游戏前，地图右下角是游戏设置。在这里玩家可以开启或关闭⟦0⟧与历史国策，并用难度设置让游戏更难或更简单，还可以增强一个或多个主要国家的相对实力（这只是让它们更强，而不是更聪明）。这里还有一个图标用于显示本局能否获得 Steam ⟦1⟧，这需要铁人模式以及普通或更高难度。设置完成后，点击右下角的⟦2⟧按钮开始游戏。

rh0ofw.en: This is the amount of political capital the nation's leadership has accumulated. Political power can be spent on completing ⟦0⟧ ideas, appointing ⟦1⟧ (political advisors, designers, theorists, and military staff), taking decisions, changing ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and some ⟦5⟧. Each ⟦6⟧ gains ⟦7⟧⟦8⟧ points of political power per day which can be modified by ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧, ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧ selection, ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧, or player actions.
rh0ofw.zh: 这是国家领导层积累的政治资本。政治点数可用于完成⟦0⟧理念、任命⟦1⟧（政治顾问、设计商、理论家和军事参谋）、推行决议、变更⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧以及部分⟦5⟧。每个⟦6⟧每天获得⟦7⟧⟦8⟧点政治点数，这一数值可受⟦9⟧、⟦10⟧、⟦11⟧、⟦12⟧、⟦13⟧的选择、⟦14⟧、⟦15⟧或玩家操作影响。

e4iuwr.en: The number of men available to create and reinforce military units. This is based on the territories under the nation's control (⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ giving different manpower yields) and affected by a number of factors, primarily ⟦2⟧, National Spirits and the number of "units under construction", also known as units under ⟦3⟧.
e4iuwr.zh: 可用于创建和补充军事单位的人力。它取决于国家控制的领土（⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧提供的人力产出不同），并受多种因素影响，主要是⟦2⟧、国家精神以及“在建单位”的数量，也就是处于⟦3⟧状态的单位。

16n886d.en: A nation is comprised of states. Factories, infrastructure, and most other improvements built using Civilian Factories are done at State level. Each state is limited in how many improvements it can have. States also have names!
16n886d.zh: 国家由各个州组成。工厂、基础设施以及大多数用民用工厂建造的设施都以州为单位进行建设，每个州可拥有的设施数量有限。州还有自己的名称！

zs1e1h.en: The Flag and 9 icon buttons (10 with La Résistance ) to the immediate right of the Flag provide direct access to the primary menus for interaction with your country. The hotkeys for these menu buttons are noted below. They follow, from left to right, across the top row of the keyboard.
zs1e1h.zh: 国旗及其右侧紧邻的 9 个图标按钮（启用 La Résistance 后为 10 个）可直接打开与国家互动的主要菜单。这些菜单按钮的快捷键见下文，它们按键盘最上一排从左到右依次排列。

1urkuqx.en: To the far left of the screen is the national flag. Click on this flag to open a view of national status. This includes a portrait of the national leader, political system and level of support for each of the four ideologies, the ⟦0⟧ that currently apply, and three rows of items that can be changed by spending political power. The view includes buttons for managing occupied territories, exiled governments and subjects.
1urkuqx.zh: 屏幕最左侧是国旗。点击国旗可打开国家状态视图，其中包含国家领袖肖像、政治制度、四种意识形态各自的支持率、当前生效的⟦0⟧，以及三排可通过花费政治点数更改的项目。该视图中还有管理被占领土、流亡政府和附属国的按钮。

eh317.en: Up to three political advisors can be hired to give the country bonuses in different fields.
eh317.zh: 最多可聘用三名政治顾问，在不同领域为国家提供加成。

141pe28.en: There are multiple design companies that can be added, such as a tank designer, ship designer, aircraft designer, material designer and industrial concern, to earn reductions and bonuses for the relevant field. These bonuses can include any combination of a reduction in research time, an increase in equipment production, or an increase in equipment combat abilities.
141pe28.zh: 可以聘用多家设计公司，例如坦克设计商、舰船设计商、飞机设计商、装备设计商和工业集团，以在相关领域获得费用减免与加成。这些加成可能包括研究时间缩短、装备产量提高或装备战斗能力提升的任意组合。

f1y14l.en: It is also possible to add a theorist to reduce doctrine experience costs, to reduce costs for rocket research or nuclear research, or to increase max speed by 10% for armor equipment.
f1y14l.zh: 还可以聘用理论家来降低学说经验花费、降低火箭研究或核研究的花费，或为装甲装备提高 10% 的最大速度。

angce8.en: ⟦0⟧: research better infantry weapons and equipment and unlock specialized types of infantry divisions. This is where mobile infantry (motorized infantry and mechanized infantry), paratroopers, marines, mountain troops, trucks, motorized rocket artillery (MRA), amphibious vehicles, and armored cars (requires La Résistance DLC) will be unlocked. Infantry technology screen - outdated (doctrines removed from research and added to officer corps with patch 1.11.0 Barbarossa).
angce8.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究更好的步兵武器与装备，并解锁专门的步兵师类型。摩托化步兵（摩托化步兵与机械化步兵）、伞兵、海军陆战队、山地部队、卡车、摩托化火箭炮（MRA）、两栖车辆以及装甲车（需要 La Résistance DLC）都在这里解锁。步兵科技界面——已过时（自 1.11.0 Barbarossa 补丁起，学说已从科研中移出并归入军官团）。

1uiphhl.en: Armor: research that unlocks and improves light (LARM), medium (MARM), heavy (HARM), super heavy (SHARM), and modern battle tanks (MBT), as well as their variants: tank destroyer (TD), self-propelled artillery/gun (SHART or SPG), and self-propelled anti-air (SPAA). With the ⟦0⟧ DLC, the panel consists of various tank chassis technologies as well as individual module technologies ranging from armor plate to engines.
1uiphhl.zh: 装甲：解锁并改进轻型（LARM）、中型（MARM）、重型（HARM）、超重型（SHARM）与现代主战坦克（MBT）的研究，以及它们的变体：坦克歼击车（TD）、自行火炮（SHART 或 SPG）和自行防空炮（SPAA）。启用⟦0⟧ DLC 后，该面板由各种坦克底盘科技以及从装甲板到发动机的各类模块科技组成。

lvg8ol.en: There are six major resources in the game: oil, aluminum, rubber, tungsten, steel, and chromium. These are used to help in the construction of tanks, battleships, planes and so forth. Each new production line of a major weapon system will require a certain amount of resources. Though it is possible to build these units without the necessary resources, production will be much slower and less efficient.
lvg8ol.zh: 游戏中有六种主要资源：石油、铝、橡胶、钨、钢铁和铬。它们用于建造坦克、战列舰、飞机等。每一条新开设的重型武器装备生产线都需要一定数量的资源。虽然没有必需资源也能生产这些单位，但生产速度会慢得多、效率也低得多。

1b7ir1.en: Civilian factories make all the improvements to a State. The number of factories available for construction will depend on the size of the nation, how many factories are being dedicated to providing consumer goods for the country (the Economy Law), and how many factories that are “traded” for strategic resources. The number of civilian factories can be increased by building more, but be careful since each province can only support a certain number of factories. A maximum of fifteen factories can be devoted to a single construction project, and any left over will work on the next item in the queue.
1b7ir1.zh: 民用工厂负责对州进行一切建设。可用于建造的工厂数量取决于国家规模、有多少工厂被用于为国民生产消费品（经济法案），以及有多少工厂被“交换”以换取战略资源。民用工厂可以通过继续建造来增加，但要小心，因为每个省份能支撑的工厂数量有限。单个建造项目最多可投入十五座工厂，多出的工厂会继续处理队列中的下一个项目。

s7abis.en: ⟦0⟧: Stations and repairs naval fleets, and can send and receive supplies and resources via convoys. Each naval base level increases supply capacity and supply throughput.
s7abis.zh: ⟦0⟧：驻扎并维修海军舰队，还可通过运输船队收发补给与资源。每提升一级海军基地都会增加补给容量与补给吞吐量。

5dav4m.en: The gray button with the wrench opens the ⟦0⟧ menu. This is where military factories and dockyards are assigned to build ⟦1⟧, army vehicles, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. The more factories dedicated to building a specific item, the more will be produced. Infantry, armor and artillery units made will then be assigned to the appropriate military divisions, either for new units being constructed or reinforcement and upgrades for units in the field. Excess equipment is left in the national stockpile. Airplanes produced will be deposited into a reserve pool. Naval units will be automatically placed in the highest level naval base, though one can assign a port or fleet if that would be preferable (recommended for the ⟦4⟧ so they don't end up with all new ships stuck in the Black Sea).
5dav4m.zh: 带扳手的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单。在这里为军用工厂和船坞分配任务，以建造⟦1⟧、军用车辆、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧。投入某个项目的工厂越多，产量就越高。生产出的步兵、装甲和火炮装备随后会被分配给相应的师，用于组建新单位，或用于补充与升级现有部队。多余的装备会留在国家库存中。生产出的飞机会存入预备机库。海军单位会自动进驻等级最高的海军基地，不过也可以指定港口或舰队（建议对⟦4⟧这样做，以免新造舰船全都困在黑海）。

tdmyc0.en: The gray button with the tank opens the ⟦0⟧ menu to recruit and deploy units. This is where it is decided what types of divisions are to be trained. These divisions will be filled by the equipment and vehicles built in the production menu. What is required to complete a new unit is shown by hovering over the green progress bars.
tdmyc0.zh: 带坦克的灰色按钮会打开⟦0⟧菜单，用于招募和部署单位。在这里决定要训练哪些类型的师。这些师将由生产菜单中建造的装备和车辆来补充。把鼠标悬停在绿色进度条上，可以查看完成一个新单位需要什么。

1pfcjj6.en: The country starts with a few default divisions that can be built. Army experience can be spent to design new division templates or edit ones that already exist.
1pfcjj6.zh: 国家开局自带几个可以建造的默认师。可以花费陆军经验来设计新的师编制，或修改已有的师编制。

n5l8n0.en: ⟦0⟧, which has a above the column, shows the average production efficiency of all the lines of production producing that type of equipment. The yellow bar inside the area represents the average production efficiency for each equipment type.
n5l8n0.zh: ⟦0⟧（列标题上方带有一个图标）显示生产该类装备的所有生产线的平均生产效率。区域内的黄色条表示各类装备的平均生产效率。

q7amts.en: ⟦0⟧ shows the resources that the production line is currently using to produce that equipment. If none of that equipment is being produced, it will not show the resources.
q7amts.zh: ⟦0⟧显示该生产线当前为生产该装备所占用的资源。若该类装备已不再生产，则不会显示资源。

yjpyon.en: You can create armies of units by selecting a group of them and then clicking on the silhouetted portrait or green plus sign at the bottom of the screen. Then, go to the selected unit profile in the upper left and click on the silhouetted portrait. This will open up the list of generals you can assign to armies. There are two types of military leaders – generals and field marshals, both of whom can normally only effectively command 24 units; but some up to 32. Commanders may also have attributes that give them bonuses in certain types of combat situations. If one promotes a general to field marshal, they lose their attributes (except "old guard") as field marshals have different attributes.
yjpyon.zh: 选中一批单位后，点击屏幕底部的剪影肖像或绿色加号即可创建集团军。然后在左上角选中该单位档案并点击剪影肖像，就会打开可分配给集团军的将领列表。军事指挥官分两类——上将与陆军元帅，通常都只能有效指挥 24 个单位，有些可指挥 32 个。指挥官还可能拥有在特定战斗情形下提供加成的属性。若把上将晋升为陆军元帅，其属性会丢失（“老近卫军”除外），因为陆军元帅拥有不同的属性。

1y2gsox.en: Countries will gain army experience mostly through combat, but one can start a trickle of early experience by having soldiers "exercise". To do this, select the army group. A Battle Plans toolbar will appear; click the exercise button in the far left of the toolbar. Be aware that this results in higher equipment attrition, which may not be desirable as a country with limited industrial capacity.
1y2gsox.zh: 国家主要通过战斗获得陆军经验，但也可以让部队“演习”来获取少量早期经验。具体做法是选中集团军群，此时会出现作战计划工具栏，点击工具栏最左侧的演习按钮即可。请注意这会加快装备损耗，对工业能力有限的国家来说可能并不划算。

vy1k9d.en: An army group can be commanded like any other group of units and by giving a right-click move order to a destination. However, they will fight better if they are given "battle plans" – a general order that is coordinated along a front, either to advance or defend.
vy1k9d.zh: 集团军群可以像其他任何单位编组一样指挥，右键点击目的地即可下达移动命令。不过，如果给它们下达“作战计划”——一种沿前线协调的总体命令，用于进攻或防御——它们会打得更好。

7aupj6.en: Naval invasion: Use this for amphibious attacks on enemy territory. (You can move into friendly territory this way, but it is more efficient to simply use port to port movement as described above.)
7aupj6.zh: 海上登陆：用于对敌方领土发起两栖攻击。（也可以用这种方式进入友方领土，但如上所述，直接使用港口到港口的移动更有效率。）

1wylo8h.en: Land operations: To make a ⟦0⟧ for offensive land operations, you must first define one's defensive front – this is the point from which the army group will begin their operations. Select the defensive front button and, on the map, draw a line to indicate where an army group will start. (In many cases, this will be a national border or the current line dividing enemy armies). Then, click the offensive front button (a line with an arrow) and draw the front to where the armies should advance.
1wylo8h.zh: 陆上作战：要为进攻性陆上作战制定⟦0⟧，必须先划定防御前线——这是集团军群开始行动的位置。选择防御前线按钮，在地图上画一条线，标明集团军群从哪里开始行动（多数情况下这是国境线或当前两军的分界线）。然后点击进攻前线按钮（带箭头的线），把前线画到部队应当推进到的位置。

17dzk8h.en: You can research doctrines and hire advisors that will reduce the time for a military plan to be prepared or add bonuses to units that are operating with a plan.
17dzk8h.zh: 可以研究学说并聘用顾问，以缩短军事计划的准备时间，或为按计划作战的部队提供加成。

hlhi7u.en: Assign commanders to your fleets by clicking on the silhouetted portrait and choosing from available naval commanders. You may recruit new admirals for the fleets. Like generals, admirals may have skills that are assets in particular battle situations or while commanding certain types of vessels. Admirals normally have a maximum amount of 10 fleets to lead.
hlhi7u.zh: 点击剪影肖像并从可用的海军指挥官中选择，即可为舰队指派指挥官。也可以为舰队招募新的海军上将。与上将一样，海军上将可能拥有在特定战斗情形或指挥特定类型舰船时很有用的技能。海军上将通常最多可指挥 10 支舰队。

1pipuyu.en: If a fleet is selected, a row of different orders will appear below in a Missions toolbar. These range from simple patrol missions to convoy escort duty. Choose a mission for the fleet (submarines, for example, are best used to interrupt convoys), and then right-click on up to three contiguous sea zones, i.e., sea zones that touch each other. This fleet will then carry out that mission over these areas. You can remove these orders by returning the fleet to port and assigning a new mission.
1pipuyu.zh: 选中一支舰队后，下方会出现一排不同的命令，即任务工具栏，从简单的巡逻任务到运输船队护航任务都有。为舰队选择一个任务（例如潜艇最适合用于袭击运输船队），然后右键点击最多三个相连的海域，也就是彼此相邻的海域。该舰队随后就会在这些区域执行该任务。把舰队调回港口并指派新任务即可取消这些命令。

wddttc.en: Unlike other units, airplanes that are constructed are sent to a reserves hangar. You can mobilize them by clicking on an air base, then creating an air wing using the button to the upper right of the resultant menu (it has a plus sign). The larger the airfield, the more planes it can efficiently use.
wddttc.zh: 与其他单位不同，建造完成的飞机会被送往预备机库。点击空军基地，再点击弹出菜单右上角的按钮（带加号）创建航空队，即可将其投入作战。机场规模越大，能高效使用的飞机就越多。

ffw4hz.en: Like naval units, air units operate over regions and are given specific missions relevant to the type of aircraft. Fighters can perform air superiority or interception missions, strategic bombers can target industry or infrastructure, tactical bombers can provide close support for land attacks, and so on. To assign an air wing to a region and a mission, click on an air field. This will open the air information map mode.
ffw4hz.zh: 与海军单位类似，空军单位按区域行动，并被赋予与机型相符的具体任务。战斗机可以执行争夺制空权或截击任务，战略轰炸机可以打击工业或基础设施，战术轰炸机可以为陆上进攻提供近距支援，等等。点击机场即可把航空队分配到某个区域并赋予任务，这会打开空军信息地图模式。

1cqq52m.en: Armies in the field will require supplies to remain in fighting shape. An army out of supply can take no offensive actions at all, including simple movement, even if unopposed. Supply is determined on a territorial basis (i.e., potentially larger than a single State) where each territory is able to support a specific number of troops. However, the final value of this supply to an actual unit is modified by the infrastructure of the State the unit is stationed within. If a territory can support 10 units easily, but if the army is in a province with very low or damaged infrastructure, a supply bottleneck will develop, so not every unit in that army will get what it needs.
1cqq52m.zh: 前线部队需要补给才能保持战斗力。补给断绝的集团军完全无法采取任何进攻行动，连简单的移动都不行，即使没有敌军阻挡。补给按领土（也就是说其范围可能大于单个州）计算，每块领土能支撑的部队数量是固定的。不过，补给在送抵实际单位时的最终数值，还会受该单位所在州的基础设施影响。如果一块领土本可轻松支撑 10 个单位，但集团军所处省份的基础设施很差或已受损，就会出现补给瓶颈，于是该集团军并非每个单位都能得到所需补给。

1nfmk2p.en: When land paths are unavailable supplies will be transported via sea. Overseas supply is done through convoys and sea ports. Larger ports can funnel more supply across the ocean, though this will also require more convoy ships. For overseas convoys to be most effective, one will need to assign some of one's naval vessels to Escort duty in the regions that they will cross.
1nfmk2p.zh: 当陆路不可用时，补给会通过海路运输。海外补给依靠运输船队和港口完成。规模更大的港口能把更多补给运过海洋，但这也需要更多运输船队。要让海外运输最有效率，就需要把一部分海军舰艇派往船队将要穿越的区域执行护航任务。

14t9pfu.en: Once a country has lost owned territory above a certain threshold that depends on its war support, it will capitulate. All divisions they own in their ⟦0⟧ or occupied territory will be disbanded and their ⟦1⟧ territory will be instantly occupied by the aggressor, but they carry on as a government-in-exile and keep control of their colonies (non-core provinces) - for example, the Netherlands keeps control of the Dutch East Indies. Partisans in occupied territory will continue to be a problem as long as the country's fellow faction members carry on the war - after all, they can still hope for liberation.
14t9pfu.zh: 当一国失去的固有领土超过某个取决于其战争支持度的阈值时，它就会投降。它在自己的⟦0⟧或被占领土上的所有师都会被解散，其⟦1⟧领土会被侵略者立即占领，但它会以流亡政府的形式继续存在，并保留对其殖民地（非核心省份）的控制——例如荷兰仍控制着荷属东印度。只要该国所在阵营的成员继续作战，被占领土上的游击队就仍会是个麻烦——毕竟他们仍可指望获得解放。

306jwe.en: If more than one country is fighting on the losing side of the war, the entire faction will surrender when the last ⟦0⟧ country in it surrenders (you can see which countries are considered majors on the world diplomacy screen). When this happens, the game will pause and a ⟦1⟧ will begin. The peace conference proceeds in stages based on the war effort expended by the victorious powers. So, for example, if the Allies defeat Germany and the ⟦2⟧ achieved the most in the war followed by the ⟦3⟧, the United States will have the first chance to make demands on the Germans, followed by the United Kingdom. Then, the next most significant victor(s) will make their demands.
306jwe.zh: 如果战败一方有多个国家参战，那么当其中最后一个⟦0⟧国家投降时，整个阵营都会投降（在世界外交界面上可以看到哪些国家被视为主要国家）。此时游戏会暂停，并开始⟦1⟧。和平会议按战胜国付出的战争贡献分阶段进行。例如，如果同盟国击败德国，而⟦2⟧在战争中的贡献最大、⟦3⟧次之，那么美国将首先获得向德国提出要求的权利，其次是英国；随后再由贡献次之的战胜国提出要求。

mb0dc8.en: You start the game with a few production lines of weapons already active. The most important of these is infantry ⟦0⟧, so, until more military factories have been built, put most of your energy here.
mb0dc8.zh: 开局时你已经有几条武器生产线在运作，其中最重要的是步兵⟦0⟧，所以在建成更多军用工厂之前，把主要精力放在这里。

1cvp8ij.en: When your country is training new ⟦0⟧, have multiple lines of infantry going at once. If you don't, you will fall behind in army size.
1cvp8ij.zh: 当你的国家在训练新⟦0⟧时，要同时开设多条步兵生产线，否则你的军队规模就会落后。

ucqpf6.en: Plan out ⟦0⟧ early in the game. For instance Germany will want to move quickly along the paths that give it claims on ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. The USA will need to get itself out of the Great Depression. ⟦3⟧ has to watch its political stability. Have a long term goal in mind. Keep in mind you don't have to research all the National Focuses one after another. Sometimes it is best to wait a bit for the opportune moment, especially with research boosting focuses.
ucqpf6.zh: 在游戏早期就规划好⟦0⟧。例如德国会希望尽快走完那些让它获得对⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧主张的路线；美国需要走出大萧条；⟦3⟧则必须留意自身的政治稳定度。心中要有一个长期目标。请记住，你不必把国策一个接一个地连续研究完，有时最好稍作等待以抓住时机，尤其是那些提供科研加成的焦点。

jzphdj.en: If a powerful ⟦0⟧ is not central to your war plans, you can usually ignore this aspect of the war and research tree. However, convoys are always useful for trade and supply, so it's best to have whatever dockyards you own focus on them.
jzphdj.zh: 如果某个强大的⟦0⟧并非你战争计划的核心，通常可以忽略这方面的战争与科研树。不过运输船队对贸易和补给总是有用的，所以最好让你拥有的船坞专注于建造它们。

1g3xw6p.en: If you is at peace, armies should exercise so they can train until they reach regular status and earn ⟦0⟧. Adding an extra regiment, line battalion, or support company to an existing division design is an easy way to beef up one's forces – unless you don't have the equipment on hand to reinforce what you have.
1g3xw6p.zh: 如果你处于和平状态，部队应当演习，以便训练到常规水平并获得⟦0⟧。在现有师编制中额外加入一个团、一线营或支援连，是增强部队实力的简便办法——除非你手头的装备不足以补充现有部队。

1vj6alv.en: Democracies should change their economic ⟦0⟧ as soon as they can in order to free up civilian factories that are otherwise dedicated to producing civilian goods.
1vj6alv.zh: 民主国家应尽早更改经济⟦0⟧，以释放那些原本用于生产消费品的民用工厂。

1fww53u.en: This guide is intended as a beginner's tour of the interface and ⟦0⟧ in ⟦1⟧. For more detailed information on the mechanics, including some of the detailed math behind some of the computer's calculations, follow the links to the articles dedicated specifically to those concepts.
1fww53u.zh: 本指南旨在带新手熟悉界面的⟦0⟧，即⟦1⟧。若想深入了解各项机制（包括电脑计算背后的一些具体数学公式），请点击专讲这些概念的条目链接。

euue6l.en: ⟦0⟧ encompasses the number of people serving in the different branches of military and the number of people available for service. As all military ⟦1⟧ need manpower, it is critical to manage its availability. The free manpower for the player's country is shown at the top left of the screen. The tooltip when mousing over the number shows a more detailed breakdown.
euue6l.zh: ⟦0⟧涵盖在各军种服役的人数以及可供服役的人数。由于所有军事⟦1⟧都需要人力，管理好人力供给至关重要。玩家国家的可用人力显示在屏幕左上角，把鼠标悬停在该数值上可看到更详细的构成。

1kg10w6.en: Free manpower is available for training/deploying new units, like ⟦0⟧, air wings, and ⟦1⟧, and for ⟦2⟧. It is usually the sum of recruitable populations in all ⟦3⟧ the country controls, but a country can also store free manpower off-map if necessary.
1kg10w6.zh: 可用人力可用于训练／部署新单位，如⟦0⟧、航空队和⟦1⟧，以及用于补充⟦2⟧。它通常等于该国控制的所有⟦3⟧中可招募人口之和，但必要时国家也可以在地图外储存可用人力。

1n4u12s.en: It can be increased in multiple ways:

21ju8z.en: Extracting more manpower from already controlled states. Enacting new conscription laws or otherwise increasing the recruitable population ratio (e.g. through certain national focuses). This usually provides the bulk of free manpower increase but needs to be planned in advance because it takes time to mobilize the recruits. Some focuses and decisions (e.g. USA's decision to grant statehood to Alaska) allow changing states into cores, removing the non-core penalty from their recruitable population ratio. A Prince of Terror political advisor changes the recruitable population penalty in non-core states from -98% to -96%. Picking gentler occupation policies increases recruitable population in occupied non-core states.
21ju8z.zh: 从已控制的州中榨取更多人力。颁布新的征兵法案，或以其他方式提高可招募人口比例（例如通过某些国策）。这通常提供可用人力增长的大部分，但必须提前规划，因为动员新兵需要时间。某些焦点和决议（例如美国授予阿拉斯加州地位的决议）可以把州变为核心州，从而消除其可招募人口比例上的非核心惩罚。恐怖亲王政治顾问可把非核心州的可招募人口惩罚从 -98% 改为 -96%。选择更温和的占领政策会提高被占领的非核心州的可招募人口。

16ugns.en: Enacting new conscription laws or otherwise increasing the ⟦0⟧ ratio (e.g. through certain ⟦1⟧). This usually provides the bulk of free manpower increase but needs to be planned in advance because it takes time to ⟦2⟧ the recruits.
16ugns.zh: 颁布新的征兵法案，或以其他方式提高⟦0⟧比例（例如通过某些⟦1⟧）。这通常提供可用人力增长的大部分，但必须提前规划，因为⟦2⟧新兵需要时间。

qy3105.en: Some focuses and decisions (e.g. USA's decision to grant statehood to Alaska) allow changing states into cores, removing the non-core penalty from their recruitable population ratio.
qy3105.zh: 某些焦点和决议（例如美国授予阿拉斯加州地位的决议）可以把州变为核心州，从而消除其可招募人口比例上的非核心惩罚。

f939z9.en: A Prince of Terror political advisor changes the recruitable population penalty in non-core states from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧.
f939z9.zh: 恐怖亲王政治顾问可把非核心州的可招募人口惩罚从⟦0⟧改为⟦1⟧。

15bmpd6.en: Picking gentler occupation policies increases recruitable population in occupied non-core states.
15bmpd6.zh: 选择更温和的占领政策会提高被占领的非核心州的可招募人口。

82fo0s.en: ⟦0⟧ in states passively contributes a small amount of recruitable population each month
82fo0s.zh: 各州的⟦0⟧每月会被动提供少量可招募人口

165d3fy.en: Taking control of additional states, especially if they are cores.
165d3fy.zh: 控制更多州，尤其是当它们成为核心州时。

htl3z.en: Some events and focuses grant flat amounts of manpower.
htl3z.zh: 某些事件和焦点会直接给予固定数量的人力。

14h5nmm.en: Less important units can be disbanded, deleted, or reduced in size to gain back some free manpower instantly.
14h5nmm.zh: 可以解散、删除或缩减较不重要的单位规模，以立即回收一部分可用人力。

1rwhr3s.en: Manpower gained through one of the last two options will be stored in controlled states or off-map if all states are at capacity.
1rwhr3s.zh: 通过上述最后两种方式获得的人力会储存到已控制的州中；若所有州都已达到容量上限，则储存到地图外。

wypzfn.en: Recruitable manpower in states can be lost if they are captured by the enemy.
wypzfn.zh: 各州中的可招募人力在被敌人占领后会损失。

19n9065.en: The used manpower is split into the three branches of military.
19n9065.zh: 已用人力分为三个军种。

1gp4x2g.en: The army manpower includes all divisions of the country. The army manpower in the field, used as a condition in some focuses(e.g: Danzig or War requires 950k manpower in the field), includes all divisions that have been deployed and have not been sent as volunteers. Army manpower in training includes all divisions that have not yet been deployed. The amount of manpower that can be used for training new divisions is restricted to ⟦0⟧ of the manpower in the field or ⟦1⟧, whichever is higher. Divisions can start training partially while just a fraction of the required manpower is available.
1gp4x2g.zh: 陆军人力包括该国所有的师。前线陆军人力被用作某些焦点的条件（例如“但泽或战争”需要 95 万前线人力），它包括所有已部署且未被派为志愿军的师。训练中陆军人力包括所有尚未部署的师。可用于训练新师的人力上限为前线人力的⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧，取两者中较高者。只要有一部分所需人力到位，师就可以开始部分训练。

xa0qsm.en: Manpower is needed for every battalion or support company in your ⟦0⟧. For example:
xa0qsm.zh: 你的⟦0⟧中每个营或支援连都需要人力。例如：

ykgpmb.en: Infantry battalions need 1000 manpower to be full strength.
ykgpmb.zh: 步兵营需要 1000 人力才能满编。

1nlf0q0.en: Engineer support companies need 300 manpower to be full strength.
1nlf0q0.zh: 工兵支援连需要 300 人力才能满编。

o03tun.en: The ⟦0⟧ shows the total manpower required by a division template.
o03tun.zh: ⟦0⟧显示一个师编制所需的总人力。

onz483.en: For the air force and navy, the total service manpower of their units is shown in the manpower tooltip respectively. Ships and air wings can only be deployed if the required service manpower is available.
onz483.zh: 空军与海军单位的服役人力总量分别在人力提示框中显示。只有所需服役人力到位，舰船和航空队才能部署。

1vyg7va.zh: 驱逐舰 1 型（1922）需要 250 海军服役人力

tkw8qx.zh: 航空母舰 3 型（1940）需要 5.5K 海军服役人力

rismzk.en: Air wings with tactical bombers require 40 air wing service manpower for each plane
rismzk.zh: 配备战术轰炸机的航空队每架飞机需要 40 航空队服役人力

1l4py8x.en: Air wings with fighters require 20 air wing service manpower for each plane
1l4py8x.zh: 配备战斗机的航空队每架飞机需要 20 航空队服役人力

1z8qf9.en: This is the sum of the country's off-map free manpower and all controlled states' ⟦0⟧, additionally itemized by core and non-core states. It has no practical purpose for the game and importantly is not the sum of any of the other manpower numbers.
1z8qf9.zh: 这是该国地图外可用人力与所有已控制州⟦0⟧的总和，并按核心州与非核心州分别列出。它在游戏中对实际玩法没有作用，而且重要的是，它并不等于其他任何人力数值之和。

1cci06n.en: Manpower can be lost as casualties of war. When damage taken by units during accidents or combat results in casualties, they are instantly removed from the units manpower pool, which may reduce the units combat effectiveness. If a division gets overrun or disbanded/destroyed in an encirclement, ⟦0⟧ of its remaining manpower gets returned, the rest is lost.
1cci06n.zh: 人力会因战争伤亡而损失。当单位在事故或战斗中所受伤害造成伤亡时，这些人力会立即从该单位的人力池中移除，这可能降低该单位的战斗力。如果某个师被击溃，或在包围圈中被解散／摧毁，其剩余人力的⟦0⟧会被返还，其余则损失掉。

1aq1i1m.en: Divisions that lack full manpower request reinforcements from the free manpower pool as long as they have a supply line back to the capital. Reinforcements arrive in increments of ⟦0⟧ of the division's full manpower. Ships can replenish lost crew at a rate of ⟦1⟧ daily.
1aq1i1m.zh: 人力不足的师只要还有通往首都的补给线，就会从可用人力池中请求补充。补充按该师满编人力的⟦0⟧为单位到达。舰船每天可按⟦1⟧的速度补充损失的船员。

1fhwpdh.en: Exercising divisions, air wings, or task forces does not cause casualties, nor does any kind of attrition on divisions.
1fhwpdh.zh: 让师、航空队或特遣舰队演习不会造成伤亡，师遭受的任何损耗也不会造成伤亡。

155fdzn.en: This article describes ⟦0⟧. For naval terrain, see ⟦1⟧.
155fdzn.zh: 本条目介绍的是⟦0⟧。关于海上地形，请见⟦1⟧。

z1nj9d.en: Each land province has a terrain type, which is shown when the province is selected.
z1nj9d.zh: 每个陆地省份都有一种地形类型，选中该省份时即会显示。

k9rl8p.en: ⟦0⟧ Maximum amount of battalions that can fight in a province. "+Additional attacks" is how much combat width will be added for each extra direction of attack into the province.
k9rl8p.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可在一个省份内参战的最大营数。“+额外进攻方向”表示该省份每增加一个进攻方向所增加的战斗宽度。

1rkk6xz.en: ⟦0⟧ Increases the distance units have to travel by this factor.
1rkk6xz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 使单位必须行进的距离乘以该系数。

ixtdvi.en: ⟦0⟧ When at war, land units moving from this terrain type suffer this amount of attrition.
ixtdvi.zh: ⟦0⟧ 处于战争状态时，从该地形类型出发移动的陆军单位会承受这一数量的损耗。

r3hhi0.en: ⟦0⟧ Adjuster to the attacker's soft/hard attack and breakthrough when the defender is in this terrain.
r3hhi0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 当防守方位于该地形时，对进攻方软攻／硬攻与突破的调整值。

q8n933.en: ⟦0⟧ If the enemy has air superiority, their bonus is reduced by this amount.
q8n933.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若敌方拥有制空权，其加成会减少这一数量。

1d6srf5.en: ⟦0⟧ The maximum level of ⟦1⟧ that can be built in the province as a baseline, can be improved through ⟦2⟧ technologies.
1d6srf5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该省份可建造的⟦1⟧基础上限等级，可通过⟦2⟧科技提高。

v4pk6o.en: ⟦0⟧ Army leaders may become temporarily ⟦1⟧ when at least 75% of the units they are commending are in this terrain.
v4pk6o.zh: ⟦0⟧ 当陆军指挥官所统率的单位中至少有 75% 位于该地形时，他们可能暂时进入⟦1⟧状态。

1kr43jt.en: ⟦0⟧ Reduces the flow of ⟦1⟧ into a province with this terrain.
1kr43jt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 减少⟦1⟧流入该地形省份的数量。

if4bo4.en: ⟦0⟧ Increases the rate of attrition for trucks used to ⟦1⟧ in this terrain.
if4bo4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 提高在该地形中用于⟦1⟧的卡车的损耗率。

1biuksv.en: ⟦0⟧ Biases temperatures in the province by a certain amount, also affecting neighboring provinces.
1biuksv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 使该省份温度产生一定偏移，同时也会影响相邻省份。

1dbqrdy.en: A path between two adjacent provinces is the straight line between their centers. It is traced on a pixel grid⟦0⟧, making diagonal lines noticeably longer than north-south and east-west lines. The terrain along this path (along with its distance) determines its movement cost.
1dbqrdy.zh: 两个相邻省份之间的路径就是连接二者中心的直线。它在像素网格上描绘⟦0⟧，因此斜线明显比南北向和东西向的线更长。沿该路径的地形（连同其距离）决定其移动花费。

dait36.en: The path may consist of the source and target province's terrain in varying proportions or even different terrains altogether. For example the path between two coastal mountain provinces at a fjord might consist of 40% mountain and 60% ocean, resulting in ⟦0⟧ movement cost for this path instead of ⟦1⟧ in a pure mountain range.
dait36.zh: 该路径可能由起点与目标省份的地形按不同比例组成，甚至完全由不同地形组成。例如，两个位于峡湾处的沿海山地省份之间的路径可能由 40% 山地和 60% 海洋组成，于是这条路径的移动花费为⟦0⟧，而不是在纯山脉中的⟦1⟧。

1e7rp10.en: The path also determines whether direction-dependent terrain features apply.
1e7rp10.zh: 路径还决定与方向相关的地形特征是否生效。

1sukoci.en: The path cost of amphibious landings is fixed at 24⟦0⟧ pixels (170.736 km).⟦1⟧
1sukoci.zh: 两栖登陆的路径花费固定为 24⟦0⟧像素（170.736 公里）。⟦1⟧

1073e7f.en: Terrain features can apply adjusters and modifiers in addition to the base terrain. They stack multiplicatively with base terrain values. Unlike other terrain modifiers, they only affect the attacker because many depend on the specific path the attackers take, and the defender might fight against attackers from different directions. Attack adjusters apply to the attacker's soft and hard attack, and the defense adjusters apply to their breakthrough.
1073e7f.zh: 地形特征可以在基础地形之外附加调整值与修正。它们与基础地形数值以乘法叠加。与其他地形修正不同，它们只影响进攻方，因为许多特征取决于进攻方所走的具体路径，而防守方可能面对来自不同方向的进攻者。攻击调整值作用于进攻方的软攻与硬攻，防御调整值作用于其突破。

1syzsdc.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ to attack and defense and ⟦2⟧ to movement.
1syzsdc.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧对攻防的影响，以及⟦2⟧对移动的影响。

1waqdr1.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ to attack and defense per level of the fort, up to ⟦2⟧ at level 10.
1waqdr1.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧对攻防的影响，每级要塞叠加一次，10 级时达到⟦2⟧。

xa2tbo.en: The river adjuster applies when a path intersects a river. If a river modifier is applied in combat, this also enables certain ⟦0⟧.
xa2tbo.zh: 当路径与河流相交时，河流调整值就会生效。如果在战斗中应用了河流修正，还会启用某些⟦0⟧。

x5mefs.en: The amphibious landing penalty applies when a unit attacks a land province from a sea province. It also applies on top of a multiplicative scaling modifier of ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ to the attackers' soft and hard attack and ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ to their breakthrough that slowly disappears over the course of combat.⟦4⟧ Both of these modifiers and the speed at which they disappear is affected by ⟦5⟧. The movement speed of a naval invasion is fixed to a speed of 3.557 km/h⟦6⟧⟦7⟧ that can be increased or decreased through division terrain modifiers.
x5mefs.zh: 当单位从海洋省份进攻陆地省份时，两栖登陆惩罚就会生效。它还会在⟦0⟧⟦1⟧的乘法缩放修正之外，对进攻方的软攻与硬攻再施加⟦2⟧⟦3⟧的突破惩罚，该惩罚会随战斗进程逐渐消失。⟦4⟧这两项修正及其消失速度都受⟦5⟧影响。海军入侵的移动速度固定为 3.557 公里／小时⟦6⟧⟦7⟧，可通过师的地形修正提高或降低。

1m4o8mi.en: The fort adjuster applies to ⟦0⟧ in all directions, though not to naval invasions. Flanking attacks diminish this penalty, with each additional direction of attacking reducing the effective level of a fort by 1 (i.e., effectively acting as a ⟦1⟧ adjuster). ⟦2⟧ reduce the attack when attacking in a naval invasion and when attacking across a strait.
1m4o8mi.zh: 要塞调整值作用于来自所有方向的⟦0⟧，但不作用于海军入侵。侧翼进攻会削弱这一惩罚，每增加一个进攻方向就使要塞的有效等级降低 1（实际上相当于一个⟦1⟧调整值）。⟦2⟧会降低海军入侵以及跨海峡进攻时的攻击力。

1y5y9z0.en: Main article: List of terrain adjusters by unit
1y5y9z0.zh: 主条目：按单位列出的地形调整值列表

urpc3t.en: Units may have specific adjusters in addition to the base terrain and terrain feature adjusters. The net adjuster for a division is the average of its combat battalions, plus the sum of the adjusters of its support battalions. Divisions lacking manpower have proportionately smaller bonuses and penalties.
urpc3t.zh: 除基础地形与地形特征调整值之外，单位还可能拥有专属调整值。一个师的净调整值等于其战斗营的平均值，加上其支援营调整值之和。人力不足的师，其加成与惩罚按比例缩小。

ah0by.en: For adjusters to regular terrain, the attack value modifies the attacker's soft attack, hard attack, and breakthrough, and the defense value modifies the defender's soft attack, hard attack, and defense.
ah0by.zh: 对于常规地形的调整值，攻击值修正进攻方的软攻、硬攻与突破，防御值修正防守方的软攻、硬攻与防御。

1mwkaxu.en: Terrain feature adjusters work differently than regular terrain modifiers, with both attack and defense value modifiers affecting attackers:
1mwkaxu.zh: 地形特征调整值的作用方式与常规地形修正不同，其攻击值与防御值修正都作用于进攻方：

a04wjy.en: For river adjusters, the attack value modifies the attacker's soft and hard attack, and the defense value modifies the attacker's breakthrough. Defenders cannot get river adjusters.
a04wjy.zh: 对于河流调整值，攻击值修正进攻方的软攻与硬攻，防御值修正进攻方的突破。防守方无法获得河流调整值。

14qfoi.en: For fort adjusters, the attack value modifiers the attacker's soft and hard attack, and the defense value modifiers the attacker's breakthrough and the defender's defense.
14qfoi.zh: 对于要塞调整值，攻击值修正进攻方的软攻与硬攻，防御值修正进攻方的突破与防守方的防御。

1xh6d3t.en: For the amphibious adjusters, the attack value modifiers the attacker's soft attack, hard attack, and breakthrough, and the defense value does nothing. Defenders cannot get amphibious adjusters.
1xh6d3t.zh: 对于两栖调整值，攻击值修正进攻方的软攻、硬攻与突破，防御值不起作用。防守方无法获得两栖调整值。

1nvprsr.en: For attackers, these adjusters apply additively onto the base adjusters from the given terrain feature, effectively negating their penalties. Amphibious and fort attack adjusters are capped by the base penalties of their respective terrain features and cannot exceed those penalties to produce overall terrain bonuses, while river adjusters can. Fort defense modifiers also have no cap for defenders.
1nvprsr.zh: 对进攻方而言，这些调整值与相应地形特征的基础调整值相加，实际上抵消了它们的惩罚。两栖与要塞的攻击调整值以其各自地形特征的基础惩罚为上限，不能超过这些惩罚从而产生整体地形加成，而河流调整值则可以。要塞防御修正对防守方也没有上限。

nekxk.en: Units move at the slowest speed of a combat battalion, adjusted for terrain. Some support companies can also affect a division's movement speed, either increasing it in certain types of terrain and/or decreasing it as a result of being slower than the rest of the division.
nekxk.zh: 单位按战斗营中最慢的速度移动，并受地形调整。某些支援连也会影响师的移动速度，或在某些地形中提高速度，或因比师内其他单位更慢而降低速度。

1457y0z.zh: 文件 Hearts of Iron IV\common\weather.txt

87w9fw.en: The ⟦0⟧ of land ⟦1⟧ can affect the movement and combat performance of units, and cause ⟦2⟧. Harsh terrain tends to favor the defender.
87w9fw.zh: 陆地的⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧会影响单位的移动与作战表现，并造成⟦2⟧。恶劣地形往往对防守方有利。

1lvso2o.en: ⟦0⟧ is the exchange of goods between countries, consisting of resources being exchanged for the use of ⟦1⟧.
1lvso2o.zh: ⟦0⟧是国家之间的货物交换，即以资源换取⟦1⟧的使用权。

ea4ou5.en: Depending primarily on a country's trade law, a percentage of its domestic strategic resource extraction is set aside to be exported to the global market. These resources are unavailable for use by the producing country, regardless of whether trade deals have been struck for those resources or not. This mechanism is used to abstract a varying production level of resources. ⟦0⟧ can have additional access to their ⟦1⟧' resources beyond what would be dictated by their trade laws.
ea4ou5.zh: 主要取决于一国的贸易法案，其国内战略资源开采量中会有一定比例被留出用于出口到全球市场。无论是否已就该资源达成贸易协议，这部分资源都无法由生产国自用。这一机制用于抽象表示资源产量的浮动。⟦0⟧还可以在其贸易法案所允许的范围之外，额外获得⟦1⟧的资源。

188drle.en: If a specific resource has no buyer, then it will not be exploited, and it will remain available to the market as untapped capacity. Resources can be bought with the production capacity generated by ⟦0⟧, meaning the resource-producing nation will receive ⟦1⟧ in exchange for their exported resources.
188drle.zh: 如果某种资源没有买家，它就不会被开采，并作为未开发产能留在市场上。资源可以用⟦0⟧产生的产能来购买，也就是说资源生产国会以其出口的资源换取⟦1⟧。

894b53.en: This has major implications for economic strategy and military planning. Since the portion of resource extraction capacity devoted to export is determined by the country's trade laws, having the right laws in effect can be critical. Ideally, a country wishes to keep exactly enough resources to satisfy its domestic ⟦0⟧ needs and export the rest to foreign buyers. In practice, this can be very difficult, and so countries may often want to seek out long-term trade partners with whom they can form mutualistic relationships, buying each other's resources that they can afford thanks to the factories received from each other's trade. Alternatively, countries can seek to create ⟦1⟧ whose resources they can then buy at a discount.
894b53.zh: 这对经济战略与军事规划有重大影响。由于用于出口的资源开采能力比例由该国的贸易法案决定，因此让合适的法案生效可能至关重要。理想情况下，一国希望只保留刚好满足其国内⟦0⟧需求的资源，把其余部分出口给外国买家。但实际操作中这非常困难，因此各国往往需要寻找能与之建立互利关系的长期贸易伙伴：双方用彼此贸易换来的工厂去购买对方负担得起的资源。另一种做法是制造⟦1⟧，然后以折扣价购买其资源。

174ozlg.en: A country can conclude a trade deal with any non-hostile country with whom they have at least 0⟦0⟧ trade influence, to whom they have trade access, and who have goods available for export. The exporter does not need to approve of the deal and will not be notified that a deal has been made.
174ozlg.zh: 一国可以与任何非敌对、与其贸易影响力至少为 0⟦0⟧、对其拥有贸易准入且其有可出口货物的国家达成贸易协议。出口方无需批准该协议，也不会收到协议已达成的通知。

1h8o1l2.en: The importer will need to spend the production of at least 1 ⟦0⟧ as the cost of importing. Each ⟦1⟧ spent will allow the importation of a maximum of 8 units of a resource,⟦2⟧ if available on the market. Even if the exporting country is unable to export 8 units of a resource, the importing country will still need to spend the full ⟦3⟧ to strike the deal for whatever is left.
1h8o1l2.zh: 进口方需要至少投入 1 个⟦0⟧的产能作为进口成本。每投入一个⟦1⟧，最多可进口 8 单位资源⟦2⟧（如果市场上有货）。即使出口国无法出口 8 单位资源，进口国仍须支付完整的⟦3⟧才能就剩余部分达成协议。

1keddmy.en: When importing goods from its puppets, a country can buy more resources per ⟦0⟧. Closely aligned puppets, such as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, can offer huge discounts of 80 units of the resource per ⟦3⟧, while more independent ones, such as ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧, offer more modest ones of between 16 and 10 resoures per factory.
1keddmy.zh: 从傀儡国进口货物时，每⟦0⟧可买到更多资源。关系紧密的傀儡国（例如⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧）可提供每⟦3⟧ 80 单位的巨大折扣，而独立性更强的傀儡国（例如⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧）折扣较小，每座工厂可换 16 至 10 单位资源。

1l3jn6w.en: Certain ⟦0⟧ can also enable special laws or ⟦1⟧ that directly modify the number of resources that can be bought per ⟦2⟧. Examples include Increased Trade for Germany, Port of Antwerp for ⟦3⟧, and Special Economic Zones for ⟦4⟧.
1l3jn6w.zh: 某些⟦0⟧还能启用特殊法案或⟦1⟧，直接改变每⟦2⟧可购买的资源数量。例如德国的“扩大贸易”、⟦3⟧的“安特卫普港”以及⟦4⟧的“经济特区”。

1sqo1nb.en: Trade deals are automatically voided if the importer ceases to have enough ⟦0⟧ available to maintain them.
1sqo1nb.zh: 如果进口方不再拥有足够的可用⟦0⟧来维持贸易协议，该协议会自动失效。

18ebwkv.en: Even if a trade deal is made to buy a country's resources, those resources need to actually be able to be transported from the exporter to the importer for them to become available to the importer. For trade routes over land, this means that there needs to be a route through non-hostile countries through which the imported resources can be transported. For trade routes over the sea, the importing country needs to be able to allocate enough convoys to the trade route and to have valid ⟦0⟧ to the exporting country. Should no valid trade route become available to a given exporter, any active trade deals with said exporter will stop providing resources (though ⟦1⟧ will still be spent), and no new trade deals can be struck with the exporter.
18ebwkv.zh: 即使达成了购买某国资源的贸易协议，这些资源也必须确实能从出口国运到进口国，进口国才能使用它们。对于陆上贸易路线，这意味着需要存在一条穿过非敌对国家的路线供进口资源运输。对于海上贸易路线，进口国需要能为该贸易路线分配足够的运输船队，并对出口国拥有有效的⟦0⟧。如果某个出口国没有任何可用的有效贸易路线，那么与该出口国的一切生效贸易协议都将停止提供资源（但⟦1⟧仍会被消耗），也无法再与该出口国达成新的贸易协议。

1h84x58.en: When there is greater demand to buy a country's resources than what the country can produce, the tie breaker for who ends up being able to import how many resources is determined by the share of each potential importer's trade influence with the exporter.
1h84x58.zh: 当购买某国资源的需求超过该国产量时，谁能进口多少资源取决于各潜在进口国与该出口国之间贸易影响力的占比。

1j7xqbh.en: If all potential importers' trade influence with the exporter is identical, then they can will be able to access equal shares of the exporter's resources. However, if one country has far more trade influence with the exporter than others, it will be able to access a far greater share of the exporters. Similarly, if a country has far less trade influence with the exporter than others, its maximum potential share of the exporter's exported resources will be far lower. For example, if one country has 120 trade influence with an exporter and another has only 80, in a scenario where there is not enough resources to satisfy the trade desires of both countries, the first country gets priority access for up to 60% of the exporter's resources, potentially being able to muscle out the second country's trade down to 40% of the exporter's resources. If then a third country enters the picture with 200 trade influence, then they get priority access to up to 50% of the exporter's resources to match their share of the total amount of trade influence competing for a resource, dropping the priority access shares of the first and second countries to 30% and 20%, respectively.
1j7xqbh.zh: 如果所有潜在进口国对出口国的贸易影响力相同，它们就能获得该出口国资源的均等份额。但如果某国对出口国的贸易影响力远高于其他国家，它就能获得远高于他国的份额；反之，若某国的影响力远低于他国，其可获得的最大出口资源份额也会低得多。例如，若一国对某出口国的贸易影响力为 120，另一国仅为 80，在资源不足以满足两国贸易需求的情况下，前者可优先获得该出口国最多 60% 的资源，从而把后者的贸易份额压低到 40%。若此时出现第三个贸易影响力为 200 的国家，它就能优先获得该出口国最多 50% 的资源，以匹配其在争夺该资源的总贸易影响力中所占的份额，而前两国优先份额则分别降至 30% 和 20%。

1po5mep.en: If trade influence reaches 0,⟦0⟧ a country may no longer import resources from the country in question. This typically only tends to happen through embargoes, though it can also happen through other means.
1po5mep.zh: 如果贸易影响力降至 0，⟦0⟧一国就不能再从该国进口资源。这通常只会因禁运而发生，但也可能通过其他途径出现。

l57rri.en: Trade influence is influenced by the following:
l57rri.zh: 贸易影响力受以下因素影响：

1dti3td.en: Opinion of the importing country with the exporting one: between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧ scaling with opinion
1dti3td.zh: 进口国对出口国的好感度：介于⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧之间，⟦2⟧随好感度缩放

1ok3awj.en: Existing active trade deals: ⟦0⟧ per month, up to a maximum of ⟦1⟧
1ok3awj.zh: 现有生效贸易协议：每月⟦0⟧，最高不超过⟦1⟧

1i3422z.en: Support for the importing country's ruling ⟦0⟧ in the exporting country: up to ⟦1⟧ at 100% support
1i3422z.zh: 出口国内对进口国执政⟦0⟧的支持度：支持度 100% 时最高⟦1⟧

14szani.en: ⟦0⟧ performing ⟦1⟧ mission: ⟦2⟧ per day (with a stacking ⟦3⟧ multiplier for each operative beyond the first), up to a maximum of ⟦4⟧
14szani.zh: ⟦0⟧执行⟦1⟧任务：每天⟦2⟧（从第二名特工起每多一名叠加⟦3⟧倍率），最高不超过⟦4⟧

trxwxb.en: In practice, due to the relative scarcity of both ⟦0⟧ with which to buy resources and ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ to consume those resources, the strategic importance of large resources deposits and wars in general will make trade influence usually irrelevant for the first few years of gameplay in any scenario. As the game progresses, however, trade influence can become a way to deny enemies access to vital resources from neutral countries.
trxwxb.zh: 实际上，由于用于购买资源的⟦0⟧以及消耗这些资源的⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧都相对稀缺，大型资源矿藏的战略重要性和战争本身会使得在任何剧本的前几年里，贸易影响力通常都无关紧要。但随着游戏推进，贸易影响力可以成为让敌人无法从中立国获得关键资源的手段。

18ab9g8.en: Trade by land has priority. A ⟦0⟧ gets used if:
18ab9g8.zh: 陆上贸易优先。满足以下条件时会使用⟦0⟧：

krtr4z.en: it can be traced through non-hostile controlled states from one capital to the other
krtr4z.zh: 它可以沿非敌对势力控制的州从一方首都追踪到另一方首都

c8klgw.en: the distance between the two countries' capitals is shorter than: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧⟦2⟧
c8klgw.zh: 两国首都之间的距离短于：⟦0⟧⟦1⟧⟦2⟧

1xm0j9r.en: For example, land trade between Tannu Tuva and Luxembourg is not possible because the distance between their capitals is 9917 km, which exceeds the 8376 km from the equation.
1xm0j9r.zh: 例如，唐努乌梁海与卢森堡之间无法进行陆上贸易，因为两国首都之间的距离为 9917 公里，超过了公式算出的 8376 公里。

s5kxhh.en: Here is the math for those interested:
s5kxhh.zh: 以下是给感兴趣者的计算过程：

10iindm.en: Otherwise, a pair of ports are chosen for a ⟦0⟧. Candidate ports are found by checking the surrounding area of each capital. In contrast to land trade routes, this search only traverses states controlled by the exporter, importer, and/or their respective ⟦1⟧ or, if they are ⟦2⟧, their host countries. Distance is measured in number of states from the capital, and only the largest valid ⟦3⟧ port in each state is used. The search expands around the capital until at least ten states with a valid port have been found or no more states are reachable via land. ⟦4⟧ are also checked, with ports to whom no allowed paths can be found being excluded from the candidates pool.
10iindm.zh: 否则，就会为一条⟦0⟧选出一对港口。候选港口通过检查各自首都周边区域来确定。与陆上贸易路线不同，这一搜索只经过出口国、进口国及／或它们各自⟦1⟧控制的州，若它们本身是⟦2⟧，则经过其宗主国控制的州。距离按距首都的州数计算，每个州只取等级最高的有效⟦3⟧港口。搜索会以首都为中心向外扩展，直到找到至少十个拥有有效港口的州，或无法再通过陆路抵达更多州为止。还会检查⟦4⟧，无法找到任何允许路径的港口会被排除在候选池之外。

gtbh5e.en: A pair of ports is chosen from the candidates by minimizing route length (weighted by ⟦0⟧ and maximizing port levels.
gtbh5e.zh: 从候选中通过最小化路线长度（以⟦0⟧加权）并最大化港口等级来选出一对港口。

1w4flls.en: The following term gets maximized: ⟦0⟧ where
1w4flls.zh: 下面这一项会被最大化：⟦0⟧，其中

w9u1tk.en: ⟦0⟧ is the total number of provinces on the map.

1lz7kvu.en: ⟦0⟧ are the sea zones through which the route passes.

najzz2.en: ⟦0⟧ is the number of provinces in a given sea zone.

1sraauu.en: ⟦0⟧ is normally 1. It is 1000 if the province's sea regions is set to ⟦1⟧, or 100 if it is set to ⟦2⟧.
1sraauu.zh: ⟦0⟧通常为 1。若该省份的海域设为⟦1⟧则为 1000，若设为⟦2⟧则为 100。

1xfyoyr.en: ⟦0⟧ is the level of the source ⟦1⟧ port.

4woat8.en: ⟦0⟧ is the level of the destination ⟦1⟧ port.

1m0eerg.en: For example, sea trade between the ⟦0⟧ (10 ⟦1⟧ ports in range of Moscow before the search stops) and ⟦2⟧ (7 ⟦3⟧ ports in range of Tokyo) gives 70 possible routes to be considered. The chosen route from Northeast Siberia to Hiroshima has a score of ⟦4⟧. Other routes either have to start from Europe (the search for ports in the ⟦5⟧ stops expanding before reaching Vladivostok) or lead to lower level Japanese ports, both of which reduces their score. If Japan were to block off ⟦6⟧ in the Black Sea and Barents Sea and restrict access in the Coast of Japan, the route that would be chosen for them would instead be between Vladivostok and the port to the north of Kyoto, which is more defensible because the route only goes through a single sea zone that would need to be watched instead of two.
1m0eerg.zh: 例如，⟦0⟧（搜索停止前莫斯科周边有 10 个⟦1⟧港口）与⟦2⟧（东京周边有 7 个⟦3⟧港口）之间的海上贸易共有 70 条可能路线可供考虑。所选定的从东北西伯利亚到广岛的路线得分为⟦4⟧。其他路线要么必须从欧洲出发（⟦5⟧寻找港口的搜索在到达符拉迪沃斯托克之前就停止扩展了），要么通向等级更低的日本港口，这都会降低其得分。如果日本封锁黑海和巴伦支海的⟦6⟧并限制日本沿海的准入，那么为其选定的路线将改为符拉迪沃斯托克与京都以北某港口之间的路线，这条路线更易防守，因为它只经过一个需要监视的海域，而不是两个。

1rylvyr.en: The same methods above are used for resource transfers within a country, except that the source is the state containing the resources instead of the capital of another country and the distance limit for land routes does not apply.
1rylvyr.zh: 一国之内的资源转运也使用上述相同方法，只是起点变为蕴藏该资源的州而非他国首都，而且陆上路线的距离限制不适用。

vd435h.en: Overseas trade requires convoys for the importing nation, which are vulnerable to enemy ⟦0⟧ by surface raiders and submarines. It is possible to see the routes convoys take in the resource map mode. A country at war may want to use its navy to ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ in sea zones through which the convoys traverse to defend their resource flows. It can also use its air force to ⟦3⟧ and/or ⟦4⟧ those zones, should it be equipped to do so. A country that cannot defend its shipping from enemy raiders is usually better off seeking trade partners nearby; they can also make sure their convoys travel through sea zones that are more easily defended by naval patrols by manipulating ⟦5⟧.
vd435h.zh: 海外贸易需要进口国投入运输船队，而这些船队容易遭到敌方水面袭击舰和潜艇的⟦0⟧。在资源地图模式下可以看到运输船队所走的路线。处于战争状态的国家可能希望派海军在船队经过的海域执行⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧以保护其资源流通，若具备相应能力，也可派空军⟦3⟧和／或⟦4⟧那些海域。无法保护自身航运免受敌方袭击舰攻击的国家，通常更适合在附近寻找贸易伙伴；它们也可以通过调整⟦5⟧，确保自己的运输船队经过更易由海军巡逻保护的海域。

kur8qk.en: For the buying and selling of ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧, see ⟦2⟧.
kur8qk.zh: 关于买卖⟦0⟧以及⟦1⟧的内容，请见⟦2⟧。

1use3ro.en: The ⟦0⟧ spent to purchase a country's resources will be added to those of the exporter while the trade is ongoing. This means they will be available for ⟦1⟧, count for any ⟦2⟧ that require a certain amount of factories, and can be used to pay for various special projects, like those related to special decisions or espionage. They can also be used to buy resources from other countries, though this was not the case in earlier versions of the game.
1use3ro.zh: 用于购买某国资源的⟦0⟧会在贸易持续期间加入出口国的同类资源。这意味着它们可用于⟦1⟧，计入任何要求一定工厂数量的⟦2⟧，还可用于支付各种特殊项目，例如与特殊决议或间谍活动相关的项目。它们也可以用来向其他国家购买资源，不过在游戏较早的版本中并非如此。

9gbz4o.en: Distance between the two countries' capitals: ⟦0⟧ per 7.114 km⟦1⟧ of distance
9gbz4o.zh: 两国首都之间的距离：⟦0⟧（每 7.114 公里⟦1⟧距离）

1oibywm.en: "Anti-monopoly" factor: ⟦0⟧ if the exporting country is selling at least 50%⟦1⟧ of their available resources to the importer
1oibywm.zh: “反垄断”系数：⟦0⟧（若出口国将其可用资源的至少 ⟦1⟧ 卖给该进口国）

791oq0.en: ⟦0⟧ is 2 if at least one of the two ⟦1⟧ ports is controlled by the exporter; 1 otherwise.
791oq0.zh: ⟦0⟧：若至少有一个⟦1⟧港口由出口国控制则为 2，否则为 1。

qlp99x.en: Each country has one of the four ⟦0⟧ (usually referred to as ⟦1⟧). These are difficult to change and affect under what circumstances a country can perform certain actions, and what happens to occupied territory.
qlp99x.zh: 每个国家都属于四种⟦0⟧之一（通常称为⟦1⟧）。它们很难改变，并影响一国能在何种情况下采取某些行动，以及被占领土会如何处置。

udysht.en: Ideology types (usually referred to as sub-ideologies) have only a modest impact on the game: interacting with the alt-history focuses of several nations (Communist Italy, Right Opposition USSR, and Fascist Poland all have focuses that distinguish between the Marxist and Stalinist sub-ideologies of Communism, the Rexist sub-idology of Fascism, and the Democratic Socialism sub-ideology of Democracy; for instance) but have almost no impact on historical paths.
udysht.zh: 意识形态类型（通常称为次意识形态）对游戏的影响不大：它主要与若干国家的架空历史焦点互动（例如共产主义意大利、右翼反对派苏联和法西斯波兰都有区分马克思主义与斯大林主义这两个共产主义次意识形态的焦点，以及法西斯主义的雷克斯主义次意识形态、民主主义的民主社会主义次意识形态），但对历史路线几乎没有影响。

pz58np.en: The main effect sub-ideologies have in the base game is that countries with the same ideology subtype gain the ⟦0⟧ ( ⟦1⟧ opinion) opinion modifier toward each other, while countries with the same ideology group yet different sub-ideologies gain the ⟦2⟧ ( ⟦3⟧ opinion) opinion modifier toward each other.
pz58np.zh: 在原版游戏中，次意识形态的主要作用是：意识形态子类型相同的国家之间会获得⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧好感度）好感修正，而意识形态组相同但次意识形态不同的国家之间会获得⟦2⟧（⟦3⟧好感度）好感修正。

fa14yy.en: The name and the description of the ideology type shows up when hovering over the ideology icon in the country's politics or diplomacy view. In case of the anarchism ideology within the non-aligned group, a different icon is also used.
fa14yy.zh: 把鼠标悬停在该国政治或外交视图中的意识形态图标上时，会显示意识形态类型的名称与描述。对于不结盟组中的无政府主义意识形态，还会使用不同的图标。

1dlil3l.en: Democracy is a form of government in which the popular vote governs, directly or indirectly. It is characterized by a commitment to civil liberties.
1dlil3l.zh: 民主制是一种由民众直接或间接投票治理的政府形式，其特征是致力于保障公民自由。

v88ckq.en: ⟦0⟧: Considering rapid changes to society to be potentially harmful, conservatism espouses tradition and moderate reforms, sometimes advocating a return to old moral values.
v88ckq.zh: ⟦0⟧：认为社会的急剧变革可能有害，因而主张传统与温和改良，有时还倡导回归旧有的道德价值观。

1t75qck.en: ⟦0⟧: With a long philosophical tradition of valuing personal liberty, liberalism views safeguarding these rights as the primary function of the state.
1t75qck.zh: ⟦0⟧：自由主义拥有重视个人自由的悠久哲学传统，视保障这些权利为国家的首要职能。

mmtb6c.en: ⟦0⟧: Striving for equality and a socialist state by reformist means, democratic socialism aims to abolish or mitigate the effects of capitalism with public mandate.
mmtb6c.zh: ⟦0⟧：民主社会主义试图以改良手段追求平等与社会主义国家，旨在凭借民众授权废除资本主义或减轻其影响。

1cpcb6n.en: ⟦0⟧: A political movement with little clear ideological framework. Populists advocate for policies from across the spectrum that are popular with the electorate or are perceived as at odds with the preferences of the political 'elite.'
1cpcb6n.zh: ⟦0⟧：一种意识形态框架并不清晰的政治运动。民粹主义者主张各种在选民中受欢迎、或被认为与政治“精英”偏好相左的政策。

bsq2mb.en: Cannot justify war goals against countries that have not generated ⟦0⟧
bsq2mb.zh: 不能对尚未产生⟦0⟧的国家制造战争目标

ky6bbc.en: Democracies cannot occupy territory owned by neutral countries, it is given to the owner instead.
ky6bbc.zh: 民主国家不能占领中立国家拥有的领土，这些领土会交给原所有者。

ho9wg5.en: Join faction: ⟦0⟧, capped at 50% during a defensive war.
ho9wg5.zh: 加入阵营：⟦0⟧，防御战争中上限为 50%。

1b0nb22.en: Impact of war declaration on World Tension: ⟦0⟧
1b0nb22.zh: 宣战对世界紧张度的影响：⟦0⟧

1coa58c.en: Impact of joining faction on World Tension: ⟦0⟧
1coa58c.zh: 加入阵营对世界紧张度的影响：⟦0⟧

8fyw2b.en: Change ideology on Fascist country cost ⟦0⟧
8fyw2b.zh: 改变法西斯国家意识形态的花费 ⟦0⟧

17vrds7.en: Change ideology on Communist country cost ⟦0⟧
17vrds7.zh: 改变共产主义国家意识形态的花费 ⟦0⟧

v50mqq.en: Democratic nations can employ ⟦0⟧ occupation law.
v50mqq.zh: 民主国家可以采用⟦0⟧占领法案。

2w6a2k.en: Countries that start out as a democracy
2w6a2k.zh: 开局即为民主制的国家

1sevrx9.en: Communism is a form of government based on social equality and collective ownership of the means of production.
1sevrx9.zh: 共产主义是一种以社会平等和生产资料公有制为基础的政府形式。

1spjcvv.en: ⟦0⟧: Encompassing a broad spectrum of economic and historical views, Marxist politics seek to apply the theories of Karl Marx to political practice. Class struggle and the need for transition to a society based on common ownership of the means of production characterize these ideologies.
1spjcvv.zh: ⟦0⟧：马克思主义政治涵盖广泛的经济与历史观点，试图把卡尔·马克思的理论应用于政治实践。其特点是强调阶级斗争，以及向生产资料公有制社会过渡的必要性。

967bjp.en: ⟦0⟧: A political ideology based in Marxist thought, Leninism seeks to establish a socialist state by a vanguard party leading a revolution overthrowing capitalist society. Once in power, the party rules through a system whereby policies are open for internal debate until a decision has been made.
967bjp.zh: ⟦0⟧：列宁主义是一种以马克思主义思想为基础的政治意识形态，主张由先锋党领导革命、推翻资本主义社会，从而建立社会主义国家。掌权后，该党通过一套内部可公开辩论政策、直至作出决定的体制进行统治。

msoy6u.en: ⟦0⟧: Identifying as a form of government applying and developing Marxist-Leninist policies, Stalinism emphasizes rapid industrialization and collectivization as well as the need for a strong authoritative socialist state to purge any counter-revolutionary elements.
msoy6u.zh: ⟦0⟧：斯大林主义自称是应用并发展马克思列宁主义政策的政府形式，强调快速工业化与集体化，以及需要一个强大的权威社会主义国家来清除一切反革命分子。

1dcc0xr.en: ⟦0⟧: A reaction to the many ideologies claiming to be successors to Marxism, Anti-Revisionism advocates retaining key elements of original revolutionary theory. Mainly opposing incorporation of capitalist economic elements into socialist states, the ideology is defined as much by what it isn't as what it is.
1dcc0xr.zh: ⟦0⟧：面对众多自称继承马克思主义的意识形态，反修正主义主张保留原始革命理论的关键要素。它主要反对把资本主义经济要素纳入社会主义国家，其定义既在于它不是什么，也在于它是什么。

1d0ulrj.en: ⟦0⟧: An ideology embracing the idea of communism as a stateless society, Anarchist Communism eschews the idea of a transitionary socialist state and favors a society based on voluntary associations and mutual aid.
1d0ulrj.zh: ⟦0⟧：这种意识形态把共产主义视为一种无国家社会，摒弃过渡性社会主义国家的设想，倾向于以自愿结社与互助为基础的社会。

1p92y6j.en: ⟦0⟧: Buddhist socialism, also referred to as Dhammic or Natural socialism, is a political ideology which advocates socialism based on the principles of Buddhism. Both Buddhism and socialism seek to provide an end to suffering by analyzing its conditions and removing its main causes through praxis. Both also seek to provide a transformation of personal consciousness to bring an end to human alienation and selfishness.
1p92y6j.zh: ⟦0⟧：佛教社会主义又称法社会主义或自然社会主义，是一种主张以佛教原理为基础的社会主义政治意识形态。佛教与社会主义都试图通过分析苦难的成因、并以实践消除其主要根源来终结苦难；两者也都追求个人意识的转变，以终结人的异化与自私。

hp4gq.en: World Tension required to join faction: ⟦0⟧
hp4gq.zh: 加入阵营所需的世界紧张度：⟦0⟧

153a88e.en: Communist nations can employ ⟦0⟧ occupation law.
153a88e.zh: 共产主义国家可以采用⟦0⟧占领法案。

1y8hsx7.en: Countries that start out as communist
1y8hsx7.zh: 开局即为共产主义的国家

o57m24.en: Fascism is a form of government characterized by authoritarian nationalism.
o57m24.zh: 法西斯主义是一种以威权民族主义为特征的政府形式。

adv4lt.en: ⟦0⟧: Rooted in extreme nationalism, National Socialism is driven by ideas of Germanic supremacy. It promotes aggressive expansionism and a totalitarian state where the people are united under a leader with absolute power, the Führer.
adv4lt.zh: ⟦0⟧：国家社会主义扎根于极端民族主义，由日耳曼优越论驱动。它鼓吹侵略扩张，以及一个由拥有绝对权力的领袖——元首——统一人民的极权国家。

d1ze61.en: ⟦0⟧: Rooted in extreme nationalism, National Socialism is driven by ideas of racial supremacy. It promotes aggressive expansionism and a totalitarian state where the people are united under a leader with absolute power.
d1ze61.zh: ⟦0⟧：国家社会主义扎根于极端民族主义，由种族优越论驱动。它鼓吹侵略扩张，以及一个由拥有绝对权力的领袖统一人民的极权国家。

6m1zx3.en: ⟦0⟧: Encompassing a variety of ultra-nationalist movements, fascism typically venerates devotion to the state and uniting the people under a strong leader.
6m1zx3.zh: ⟦0⟧：法西斯主义涵盖多种极端民族主义运动，通常崇尚对国家奉献，以及把人民团结在一位强有力领袖之下。

o5tpmd.en: ⟦0⟧: An authoritarian ideology with traits of fascism and conservatism, Falangism values national and Catholic identity.
o5tpmd.zh: ⟦0⟧：长枪党主义是一种兼具法西斯主义与保守主义特征的威权意识形态，重视民族与天主教认同。

3pjf1s.en: ⟦0⟧: Strongly opposed to both liberal and communist ideals, Rexism is a staunchly conservative nationalist movement who advocate a corporatist economic policy. Employing increasingly populist and authoritarian rhetoric, their ideals are shifting closer to other fascist movements.
3pjf1s.zh: ⟦0⟧：雷克斯主义强烈反对自由主义与共产主义理念，是一场坚定的保守民族主义运动，主张实行法团主义经济政策。它使用日益民粹与威权的言辞，理念也逐渐向其他法西斯运动靠拢。

1hnhuk7.en: ⟦0⟧: Emperor Fascism is a form of Ultranationalism in which the masses do not hold a say, often referred to as 'fascism from above', where the rule is held by the military and aristocratic bureaucrats, with great reverence for the nations emperor, a monarch who is regarded as an infallible divine figure.
1hnhuk7.zh: ⟦0⟧：天皇法西斯主义是一种民众没有发言权的极端民族主义，常被称为“自上而下的法西斯主义”：统治权掌握在军方与贵族官僚手中，并对国家天皇——一位被视为绝无谬误的神圣君主的君主——怀有极大崇敬。

fc40lh.en: Is also called "Nazism" in-game, but "gen_nazism" in the localization files.
fc40lh.zh: 在游戏中也称为“纳粹主义”，但在本地化文件中为“gen_nazism”。

r2tn7l.en: Time to justify war when at war with major power: ⟦0⟧
r2tn7l.zh: 与主要国家交战时制造战争目标所需时间：⟦0⟧

5ejkei.en: World Tension requirement to join faction: ⟦0⟧
5ejkei.zh: 加入阵营所需的世界紧张度：⟦0⟧

6aa5hi.en: Fascist nations can employ ⟦0⟧ occupation law.
6aa5hi.zh: 法西斯国家可以采用⟦0⟧占领法案。

1i9hyfb.en: Countries that start out as fascist
1i9hyfb.zh: 开局即为法西斯主义的国家

q8n6lc.en: The term "Non-Aligned" is used to describe any remaining ideology that does not align with the other three categories.
q8n6lc.zh: “不结盟”一词用于描述其他三个类别之外的一切意识形态。

n8dn10.en: ⟦0⟧: Despotism is a form of government in which a single person rules with absolute power.
n8dn10.zh: ⟦0⟧：专制是一种由单人掌握绝对权力的政府形式。

p472i6.en: ⟦0⟧: An oligarchy is a form of government in which a small group of individuals holds absolute power.
p472i6.zh: ⟦0⟧：寡头制是一种由少数个人掌握绝对权力的政府形式。

1av5rgp.en: ⟦0⟧: Moderatism is a form of government which avoids the extremes of left and right by taking a moderate position or course of action.
1av5rgp.zh: ⟦0⟧：温和主义是一种通过采取中间立场或行动路线来避免左右两极的政府形式。

1ks06hn.en: ⟦0⟧: Centrism is a form of government which wants to achieve common sense solutions that appropriately address current and future needs, that support the public trust and serve the common good with consideration of risk and capacity in context of these needs.
1ks06hn.zh: ⟦0⟧：中间主义是一种政府形式，追求以常识性方案恰当满足当前与未来的需求，在兼顾风险与能力的前提下维护公众信任、服务公共利益。

46m433.en: ⟦0⟧: Anarchism is the rejection of authority itself, promoting the division of society into self-managing and self-governing collectives instead of a singular, centralized state.
46m433.zh: ⟦0⟧：无政府主义否定权威本身，主张把社会划分为自我管理、自治的集体，而不是单一集权的国家。

kd52ke.en: ⟦0⟧: Militarism is an ideology in which the leader of the nation holds only nominal control, and acts more like a puppet to the nation's military than an independent politician, constantly forwarding their agenda with the end goal of rapid expansionist policy.
kd52ke.zh: ⟦0⟧：军国主义是一种国家领袖仅拥有名义控制权的意识形态，其行为更像军队的傀儡而非独立政治家，不断推进军队的议程，最终目标是迅速推行扩张政策。

s5x3qz.en: Can impose its ideology on other countries
s5x3qz.zh: 可以把自己的意识形态强加于其他国家

1axggh3.en: Impact of declaring war on World Tension: ⟦0⟧
1axggh3.zh: 宣战对世界紧张度的影响：⟦0⟧

16t629.en: Impact of joining factions on World Tension: ⟦0⟧
16t629.zh: 加入阵营对世界紧张度的影响：⟦0⟧

k8h1ko.zh: 开局即为不结盟的国家

1r9hxql.en: A country can change its ideology in four ways:
1r9hxql.zh: 一国可以通过四种方式改变其意识形态：

gmarg0.en: Having an election while another ideology has more than 50% support. This creates an event that enables a peaceful change of power without a civil war.
