13r9pt2.en: The ⟦0⟧ is where most tactical and strategic decisions happen. It also provides information related to these purposes, such as, weather, ⟦1⟧, land combat, naval combat, and buildings.
13r9pt2.zh: ⟦0⟧是大多数战术与战略决策发生的地方。它也提供与这些用途相关的信息，例如天气、⟦1⟧、陆战、海战和建筑。

1kf2ajg.en: The Map can be divided into three subdivisions:

652fui.en: ⟦0⟧ are the smallest subunit of the map. It is here that ⟦1⟧, weather, capitals, land combat, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ are handled.
652fui.zh: ⟦0⟧是地图上最小的单位。⟦1⟧、天气、首都、陆战、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧都在这一级处理。

26worh.en: ⟦0⟧ are the next smallest subunit of the map, where ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and country borders are decided.
26worh.zh: ⟦0⟧是地图上第二小的单位，⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和国界都在这一级确定。

18eljrs.en: ⟦0⟧ are the largest of the subdivisions, and are where naval combat and ⟦1⟧ occur.
18eljrs.zh: ⟦0⟧是最大的分区单位，海战与⟦1⟧发生在这一级。

haw15b.en: Using different ⟦0⟧, you can alter the information presented on the map. These map modes can be activated by either clicking on the appropriate button (icon) located in the lower right corner of the main screen or by pressing the associated ⟦1⟧. Additional map modes can be revealed by clicking the arrow button.
haw15b.zh: 使用不同的⟦0⟧可以改变地图上呈现的信息。这些地图模式可以通过点击主界面右下角相应的按钮（图标）或按下对应的⟦1⟧来激活。点击箭头按钮还能显示更多地图模式。

uujzmh.en: The default map mode is a combination of the political map mode and terrain map mode from previous games. It shows the name of all the nations, with their political color. Zoomed out, mainly the nation's color is seen, however, when zooming in, the terrain becomes more and more visible, integrating both map modes into one. Air fields, naval bases, capitals, and almost any other object on the map can be seen in this mode, represented by different symbols:
uujzmh.zh: 默认地图模式是前作中政治地图模式与地形地图模式的结合。它显示所有国家的名称，并以各自的政治颜色着色。缩小时主要看到国家的颜色，放大时地形则越来越明显，把两种地图模式融为一体。机场、海军基地、首都以及地图上几乎所有其他物体都能在此模式下看到，并以不同符号表示：

14r44p4.en: ⟦0⟧ are a top down picture of an airplane.

152my5w.en: ⟦0⟧ are identified by a star , which can be ⟦1⟧ if it is the nation's capital, ⟦2⟧ if it is any other nation's capital, or ⟦3⟧ if it is the capital of any of the nation's enemies. All capitals contain victory points.
152my5w.zh: ⟦0⟧以星形图标标识，若为该国首都则为⟦1⟧，若为其他任何国家的首都则为⟦2⟧，若为该国任一敌国的首都则为⟦3⟧。所有首都都含有胜利点。

acl1va.en: ⟦0⟧ are denoted by either a square , a pentagon , or a circle , depending on the value. They are named when zoomed in and follow the color scheme of capitals.
acl1va.zh: ⟦0⟧按价值分别以方形、五边形或圆形表示。放大时会显示名称，并沿用首都的配色方案。

szk5n8.en: ⟦0⟧ can be seen as counters or sprites on the map.
szk5n8.zh: ⟦0⟧在地图上以棋子或贴图形式显示。

1vqymzm.en: ⟦0⟧ can be seen as pointers that are ⟦1⟧ if the nation is winning the battle, ⟦2⟧ if the battle is favoring neither side, or ⟦3⟧ if the nation is losing the battle, and it shows a number that summarizes how much the battle favors one side or the other.
1vqymzm.zh: ⟦0⟧以指针形式显示：若该国正在赢得战斗则为⟦1⟧，若战斗对双方均无优势则为⟦2⟧，若该国正在输掉战斗则为⟦3⟧，并显示一个概括战斗对哪一方有利程度的数字。

d9bmcd.en: ⟦0⟧ can be seen along with navies and their missions.
d9bmcd.zh: ⟦0⟧可与海军及其任务一同显示。

dd350u.en: ⟦0⟧ can be seen flying where aircraft are in operation.
dd350u.zh: ⟦0⟧会在有飞机活动的上方飞过。

1u8y8r5.en: ⟦0⟧ and any other state- or province-wide constructions are also visible.
1u8y8r5.zh: ⟦0⟧以及任何其他州级或省级建筑也可见。

nzylnz.en: ⟦0⟧ will be a ⟦1⟧ outline around any demilitarized area. The only time they are used is at the beginning of the game in the Rhineland, Danzig, the Turkish Straits (requires ⟦2⟧) and Åland. An exception is the option to create demilitarized zones (DMZ) during peace conferences (requires ⟦3⟧).
nzylnz.zh: ⟦0⟧会以⟦1⟧轮廓标示任何非军事区。它们只在游戏开始时用于莱茵兰、但泽、土耳其海峡（需要⟦2⟧）和奥兰群岛。唯一的例外是在和平会议中选择建立非军事区（DMZ）（需要⟦3⟧）。

h0utsu.en: Shows ⟦0⟧ relevant to naval activity, with information on naval supremacy and naval tasks.
h0utsu.zh: 显示与海军活动相关的⟦0⟧，并包含制海权与海军任务的信息。

6292tg.en: The naval map mode consists of the world's strategic regions, with a color scheme similar to the diplomacy for states on land under it. Convoy routes are also shown here with the following color scheme:
6292tg.zh: 海军地图模式由世界各战略区域组成，其配色与陆地上各州的外交配色相似。运输船队航线也在此显示，配色如下：

bvpxhq.en: ⟦0⟧ trade routes are supply transfers to oversea units.
bvpxhq.zh: ⟦0⟧贸易路线是向海外单位输送补给。

lezrmy.en: ⟦0⟧ trade routes are resource transfers. These are imports, exports or resource transfers from non-owned oversea resources.
lezrmy.zh: ⟦0⟧贸易路线是资源转运。这些是非自有海外资源的进口、出口或转运。

3mnfbo.en: ⟦0⟧ trade routes are resource transfers. These are imports, exports or resource transfers from owned oversea resources.
3mnfbo.zh: ⟦0⟧贸易路线是资源转运。这些是自有海外资源的进口、出口或转运。

120cgrk.en: ⟦0⟧ trade routes are lend lease equipment routes and international market routes.
120cgrk.zh: ⟦0⟧贸易路线是租借装备路线与国际市场路线。

19s5nrd.en: ⟦0⟧ trade routes are those that have insufficient convoys to maintain 100% efficiency. The lack of convoys is due to either a country not producing enough convoys for the demand or due to convoys being sunk by the enemy (red X's indicate the region where convoys are being sunk).
19s5nrd.zh: ⟦0⟧贸易路线是运输船队不足以维持 100% 效率的路线。船队不足可能是由于该国生产的运输船队满足不了需求，或是船队被敌方击沉（红色叉号表示船队被击沉的区域）。

4b1fd8.zh: 贸易路线需要⟦0⟧才能运作。

1mntl41.en: Strategic regions that have sea provinces will be highlighted with ⟦0⟧ if they are under allied naval superiority. Provinces that are striped ⟦1⟧ are out of the fleets' operational range.
1mntl41.zh: 拥有海域的战略区域若处于盟友制海权之下，会以⟦0⟧高亮。呈⟦1⟧条纹的省份在舰队作战范围之外。

1frq8e0.en: Canals or any type of controlled strait are shown on this map mode, and by hovering over them it is possible to see the access permissions your country has as well as the land provinces controlling the strait (⟦0⟧ outline). Straits are also shown on the Supply Map Mode and the Resource Map mode.
1frq8e0.zh: 运河或任何类型的受控海峡都会在此地图模式中显示，把鼠标悬停其上即可看到你的国家所拥有的通行权限，以及控制该海峡的陆地省份（⟦0⟧轮廓）。海峡也会在补给地图模式和资源地图模式中显示。

15w42v5.en: The following, are the names and province control points of the straits/canals on map and their respective permissions granted to nations (depending on the relations with the strait controllers).
15w42v5.zh: 以下列出地图上各海峡／运河的名称与省份控制点，以及授予各国的相应通行权限（取决于与海峡控制者的关系）。

13opmsf.zh: 石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因

4aup59.zh: 巴拿马运河（美国占领）、巴拿马

11wi1v4.en: Shows ⟦0⟧ with information on aerial supremacy. It is automatically activated when an air base is selected.
11wi1v4.zh: 显示⟦0⟧以及制空权信息。选中空军基地时会自动激活。

1h6a2b1.en: The air map mode is, at first glance, merely a map of the strategic regions of the map. However, when at war, the regions can be highlighted with three colors:
1h6a2b1.zh: 空军地图模式乍看只是地图上战略区域的呈现。但在战时，这些区域会用三种颜色高亮：

14sug0d.en: ⟦0⟧, which means the enemy has air superiority.

batnm9.en: ⟦0⟧, which means the nation or its allies has air superiority.
batnm9.zh: ⟦0⟧，表示本国或其盟友拥有制空权。

htdyl8.en: ⟦0⟧, which means the air superiority is contested.

2tw177.en: This map mode also shows all of the air missions currently set with the total number of planes assigned. In the strategic air map mode more ground crews can be assigned, by clicking the icon in the desired strategic region. This gives a ⟦0⟧ bonus to mission efficiency in the strategic region.
2tw177.zh: 此地图模式还会显示当前设定的所有空中任务及已分配的飞机总数。在战略空军地图模式中，可以点击目标战略区域中的图标来分配更多地勤人员，从而为该战略区域带来⟦0⟧的任务效率加成。

nmcgm0.en: Shows the operatives, their missions, on-going operations, and intel network spread. See ⟦0⟧ for more detail.
nmcgm0.zh: 显示特工、其任务、正在进行的行动以及情报网络覆盖范围。更多细节请见⟦0⟧。

idqwqe.en: The supply map mode shows the supply network for a nation, its territories, and its allies' territories. Reference ⟦0⟧ for more detail regarding supply.
idqwqe.zh: 补给地图模式显示某国及其领土和盟友领土的补给网络。有关补给的更多细节请参阅⟦0⟧。

16v9kn7.en: ⟦0⟧: Light grayish with a bit yellow or green

1udrkry.en: The resistance map mode shows resistance per state. Yellow indicates low, orange higher and red high resistance. The percentage of resistance (0%-100%) is shown for each state. A green arrow downwards shows decreasing resistance, a red arrow upwards increasing resistance. Also 4 resistance tiers are shown:
1udrkry.zh: 抵抗地图模式显示各州的抵抗度。黄色表示抵抗度低，橙色较高，红色则很高。每个州都会显示抵抗度百分比（0%–100%）。绿色向下箭头表示抵抗度下降，红色向上箭头表示抵抗度上升。此外还显示 4 个抵抗度层级：

128i1jm.en: Shows compliance per state. Lighter blue means more compliance. The percentage of compliance (0%-100%) is shown for each state. Also 5 compliance tiers are shown:
128i1jm.zh: 显示各州的顺从度。蓝色越浅表示顺从度越高。每个州都会显示顺从度百分比（0%–100%）。此外还显示 5 个顺从度层级：

gmz4mg.en: Shows resource locations and trade routes.
gmz4mg.zh: 显示资源位置与贸易路线。

4ljvuk.en: The resources map mode shows any convoy/ trade routes that are connected to the nation and canals/ straits across the world, similar to the naval map mode. However, this map mode looks like the default map mode when zoomed out, but when zoomed in, it shows a resource icon above any state that has a resource, along with the number of that resource produced in that state.
4ljvuk.zh: 资源地图模式显示与该国相连的任何运输船队／贸易路线以及世界各地的运河／海峡，与海军地图模式类似。不过，此模式在缩小时看起来像默认地图模式，放大时则会在任何拥有资源的州上方显示资源图标，以及该州所生产该资源的数量。

rt3d3l.en: The diplomacy map mode shows its information through a multitude of colors.
rt3d3l.zh: 外交地图模式通过多种颜色来呈现信息。

1ymyix7.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color that any land owned and controlled by the nation
1ymyix7.zh: ⟦0⟧是该国拥有并控制的土地所显示的颜色

n9vlow.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color that any land occupied by the nation will be colored.
n9vlow.zh: ⟦0⟧是该国占领的任何土地所显示的颜色。

khuk31.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of any nation that has very good relations with the nation.
khuk31.zh: ⟦0⟧是与该国关系非常好的国家所显示的颜色。

aqvri9.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of any nations that the nation is currently at war with.
aqvri9.zh: ⟦0⟧是该国当前正与之交战的国家所显示的颜色。

18fcooi.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of friendly territory that is occupied by enemies.
18fcooi.zh: ⟦0⟧是被敌方占领的友方领土所显示的颜色。

1ow2moj.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of countries that the nation has wargoals against.
1ow2moj.zh: ⟦0⟧是该国对其拥有战争目标的国家所显示的颜色。

sngwi7.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of any country the nation has very bad relations with.
sngwi7.zh: ⟦0⟧是与该国关系非常差的国家所显示的颜色。

1fylhak.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of any allied nations.

b9ecuu.en: The factions map mode shows the factions that exist around the world. The faction is colored the color of the leader nation, i.e. the Axis is grey due to the color of Germany, and it stretches across all nations in that faction.
b9ecuu.zh: 阵营地图模式显示世界各地存在的阵营。阵营使用领袖国的颜色，例如轴心国因德国的颜色而呈灰色，并覆盖该阵营中的所有国家。

1uipuem.en: The states map mode shows an outline of every state in the world. These outlines are different colors based on the state category which is associated with the quantity of shared building slots. This directly controls how many factories are allowed to be built in a state. The type of state can be found by simply hovering over it.
1uipuem.zh: 州地图模式显示世界上每个州的轮廓。这些轮廓按州类别显示不同颜色，州类别与共享建筑槽位数量相关，而槽位数量直接决定一个州允许建造多少工厂。把鼠标悬停其上即可查看该州的类型。

ja4nz4.en: The infrastructure map mode shows the level of ⟦0⟧ in each state.
ja4nz4.zh: 基础设施地图模式显示各州的⟦0⟧等级。

zhvctg.en: The Population map mode shows the amount of ⟦0⟧ in each state.
zhvctg.zh: 人口地图模式显示各州的⟦0⟧数量。

16vkfra.en: The Ideology map mode shows the countries by their ⟦0⟧.
16vkfra.zh: 意识形态地图模式按⟦0⟧显示各国。

1iytn8u.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of communist nations.
1iytn8u.zh: ⟦0⟧是共产主义国家所显示的颜色。

1h81t3y.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of democratic nations.

mpy8qm.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of fascist nations.
mpy8qm.zh: ⟦0⟧是法西斯国家所显示的颜色。

1ppzw33.en: ⟦0⟧ is the color of non-aligned nations.
1ppzw33.zh: ⟦0⟧是不结盟国家所显示的颜色。

1f98vtw.en: The terrain map mode shows the ⟦0⟧ of each region on the map using simplified colors. Land terrain has high adjusters for attack, defense and movement of land units while ⟦1⟧ has different adjusters for attack, defense and movement of naval units. The terrain map mode can be useful to plan your offense or defense using favorable terrain.
1f98vtw.zh: 地形地图模式用简化颜色显示地图上各区域的地形⟦0⟧。陆地地形对陆军单位的攻击、防御和移动有较高的调整值，而⟦1⟧对海军单位的攻击、防御和移动有不同的调整值。地形地图模式有助于利用有利地形规划进攻或防御。

tjexs9.en: Aircraft are ⟦0⟧ that can be used to equip air wings and are ⟦1⟧ in military factories (or sometimes rocket sites). For details on how aircraft statistics affect air wing operation, see ⟦2⟧ and air wing.
tjexs9.zh: 飞机是可用于装备航空队的⟦0⟧，在军用工厂（有时是火箭发射场）中⟦1⟧。关于飞机属性如何影响航空队运作的细节，请见⟦2⟧与航空队。

1d7ssq3.en: All aircraft start with 80% reliability unless otherwise noted.
1d7ssq3.zh: 除另有说明外，所有飞机初始可靠性均为 80%。

vgmwg9.zh: 舰载近距空中支援 I

7qum8.zh: 舰载近距空中支援 II

f3nfv.zh: 舰载近距空中支援 III

1l5o37w.zh: 喷气式战术轰炸机 I

lu3m5b.zh: 喷气式战术轰炸机 II

10j004m.zh: 喷气式战略轰炸机 I

tw3vo8.en: Requires completion of Rocket Engines research.
tw3vo8.zh: 需要完成火箭发动机研究。

mbwkmg.en: None - auto generate 1 per day per rocket site
mbwkmg.zh: 无——每个火箭发射场每天自动生成 1 枚

ryqjux.en: Only available for ⟦0⟧, requiring the completion of the ⟦1⟧ national focus, which requires completion of the Rocket Engines technology.
ryqjux.zh: 仅⟦0⟧可用，需要完成⟦1⟧国策，而该焦点又需要完成火箭发动机科技。

165ac2k.en: Scout planes are used to perform the ⟦0⟧ mission or Naval Patrol mission to add to intel gathered in the assigned air zone and to help friendly ships on patrol spot enemy ships.
165ac2k.zh: 侦察机用于执行⟦0⟧任务或海上巡逻任务，以增加指定空域中收集到的情报，并帮助巡逻中的友方舰船发现敌方舰船。

1024uon.en: A ship refers both to a piece of ⟦0⟧ produced by dockyards and, once launched and manned, a member of a task force ready to participate in ⟦1⟧.
1024uon.zh: 舰船既指出船坞生产的⟦0⟧，也指下水并配备人员后、随时可参与⟦1⟧的特遣舰队成员。

urtmeg.en: At the start of the game, each country will have a selection of ⟦0⟧ available for production, based upon hull types which have already been researched.
urtmeg.zh: 游戏开始时，每个国家都会根据已研究的船体类型获得一批可供生产的⟦0⟧。

st2qym.en: Some hull types may serve as the foundation for more than one ship type, depending upon the modules that are fitted during the design of a given ship variant. For example, ⟦0⟧ can serve as the basis for light cruisers or heavy cruisers depending upon the type of guns that are fitted.
st2qym.zh: 某些船体类型可以作为不止一种舰船类型的基础，取决于设计该舰船改型时所装的模块。例如，⟦0⟧既可以作为轻巡洋舰的基础，也可以作为重巡洋舰的基础，取决于所装火炮的类型。

wxsvrx.en: Hull types and their corresponding ship type(s) are listed below:
wxsvrx.zh: 船体类型及其对应的舰船类型如下：

t0moje.zh: 巡洋舰船体 鱼雷巡洋舰船体

ge0zuo.zh: 轻巡洋舰 重巡洋舰

1nz7s7x.en: Panzerschiff hull Coastal Defense Ship hull
1nz7s7x.zh: 装甲舰船体 岸防舰船体

12trfe2.zh: 战列巡洋舰 战列舰

l1bc5.zh: 航空母舰 护航航空母舰

fzn0s.zh: 潜艇船体 巡洋潜艇船体

dvve8g.zh: 潜艇 弹道导弹潜艇

6pf3aw.en: Nuclear submarine Nuclear ballistic missile submarine
6pf3aw.zh: 核潜艇 核弹道导弹潜艇

ipg8fl.en: Surface warships are categorized either as ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧, while submarines and convoys have their own unique mechanics.
ipg8fl.zh: 水面军舰分为⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧，而潜艇与运输船队则有其独特的机制。

9ys7p6.en: As the main surface combatants, capital ships are designed to sink enemy ships in surface battles.
9ys7p6.zh: 作为主要的水面战斗力量，主力舰的设计目标是在水面战斗中用炮火击沉敌舰。

16cxr1t.en: ⟦0⟧ (BB): With their heavy armor, battleships are capable of surviving substantial amounts of incoming fire from the enemy battle line. They can also deal considerable damage of their own. Battleships are expensive and take some time to build.
16cxr1t.zh: ⟦0⟧（BB）：凭借厚重装甲，战列舰能够承受敌方战列线的大量火力，自身也能造成相当可观的伤害。战列舰造价高昂，建造也颇费时间。

nxdag.en: ⟦0⟧ (BC): Battlecruisers share the same hull as battleships and use the same types of armament, but are distinguished by somewhat lighter armor and a lower construction cost. Although they can withstand less damage than a battleship, their lighter weight also makes them faster and slightly harder to hit.
nxdag.zh: ⟦0⟧（BC）：战列巡洋舰与战列舰共用相同的船体并使用同类武器，但装甲略轻、建造成本更低。虽然承受伤害的能力不如战列舰，但更轻的重量使它们速度更快，也更难被命中。

1pt4wno.en: ⟦0⟧ (SHBB): SHBBs are particularly powerful and heavily-armored battleships based upon a dedicated SHBB hull, though they are referred to as BBs in-game. Unlike other hulls which receive new iterations over the years, there is only one SHBB hull in the tech tree. SHBBs are powerful enough to remain a potent threat throughout the game despite the lack of hull iterations. However, they are also prohibitively expensive and take a very long time to build.
1pt4wno.zh: ⟦0⟧（SHBB）：超重型战列舰是基于专用 SHBB 船体建造的特别强大、装甲极厚的战列舰，不过在游戏中仍被称为 BB。与其他船体随年代不断推出新版本不同，科技树中只有一种 SHBB 船体。尽管缺少船体迭代，超重型战列舰的强大程度仍足以在整个游戏中保持威慑力。但它们的造价高得离谱，建造时间也非常长。

1bk6bnm.en: ⟦0⟧ (CA): Heavy cruisers share the same hull as light cruisers, and are distinguished by their heavier guns. With the lightest armor of any capital ship, heavy cruisers have low survivability against battlecruisers and battleships.
1bk6bnm.zh: ⟦0⟧（CA）：重巡洋舰与轻巡洋舰共用相同的船体，区别在于火炮更重。由于装甲是主力舰中最轻的，重巡洋舰在面对战列巡洋舰和战列舰时生存能力较低。

p6bl0n.en: ⟦0⟧ (CB): Large cruisers are specialized heavy cruisers that are built using more expensive Panzerschiff and Coastal Defense Ship hulls, though they are still referred to as CAs in-game. They can mount even heavier guns that match those found on battleships and battlecruisers. However, despite having costs comparable to battlecruisers, they are similarly lightly armored as regular heavy cruisers and so are no less survivable.
p6bl0n.zh: ⟦0⟧（CB）：大型巡洋舰是使用更昂贵的装甲舰与岸防舰船体建造的专用重巡洋舰，不过在游戏中仍被称为 CA。它们可以安装与战列舰和战列巡洋舰相当、甚至更重的火炮。然而，尽管造价与战列巡洋舰相当，它们的装甲却与普通重巡洋舰一样轻，因此生存能力并不更强。

qq1bhs.en: ⟦0⟧ (CV): Dedicated aircraft carriers can carry deploy specialized carrier air wings for various tasks, including vying for control of the air and dealing bomb damage to enemy ships during ⟦1⟧, as well as being deployed on ⟦2⟧ outside of them. They can be expensive to build and to fuel, especially with their accompanying aircraft, but can be highly effective for their cost.
qq1bhs.zh: ⟦0⟧（CV）：专用航空母舰可以搭载专门的舰载航空队执行各种任务，包括在⟦1⟧中争夺制空权并对敌舰投弹造成伤害，也可以在这些战斗之外部署执行⟦2⟧。它们的建造与燃料消耗都很昂贵，尤其是还要配上舰载机，但以其造价而言可能极为高效。

fskvl.en: ⟦0⟧ (CVE): Smaller and cheaper aircraft carriers with only one or two hangar slots, these designs are made possible with the ship designer, though they are still referred to as CVs in-game. While they can be built out of the same hulls as dedicated carriers, they can also be converted from cruisers, which can be a way to keep a navy's aging cruisers relevant for longer. Slow and unable to field as many air wings, they are less effective in battle, but because they can be produced in much larger numbers, they can be deployed in a much wider capacity.
fskvl.zh: ⟦0⟧（CVE）：更小更便宜的航空母舰，只有一两个机库槽位，这些设计可通过舰船设计器实现，不过在游戏中仍被称为 CV。它们既可以用与专用航母相同的船体建造，也可以由巡洋舰改装而来，这可以让海军老旧的巡洋舰继续发挥作用更长时间。它们速度慢、能搭载的航空队更少，因此战斗力较弱，但由于可以大量生产，可以部署的范围要广得多。

1otlns0.en: ⟦0⟧ are named for their ability to protect capital ships and convoys from torpedoes during naval battles.
1otlns0.zh: ⟦0⟧之所以得名，是因为它们能在海战中保护主力舰和运输船队免受鱼雷攻击。

18sxh2m.en: ⟦0⟧ (CL): Tougher and more expensive than destroyers, light cruisers are highly versatile and can be outfitted for a range of roles. When equipped with airplane catapults, they can serve as excellent scouts. When dedicated to firepower, they excel at destroying other screens and can even put a dent into more lightly armored, enemy heavy cruisers.
18sxh2m.zh: ⟦0⟧（CL）：比驱逐舰更坚固也更昂贵，轻巡洋舰用途极为广泛，可以装备成承担多种角色。装设飞机弹射器时，它们可以充当出色的侦察舰；专注于火力时，它们擅长摧毁其他护卫舰，甚至能对装甲较轻的敌方重巡洋舰造成损伤。

3diykl.en: ⟦0⟧ (DD): As the lightest screen ships, the strength of destroyers lies in their numbers. During battle, they can form the bulk of a screening line to protect capital ships from torpedoes. Destroyers are also ideally suited to convoy escort missions. Both of these roles call for a sufficient quantity of ships, and destroyers are the most economical vessel to produce in the numbers required. They also boast relatively low fuel requirements. Beyond their basic armament, they can be outfitted with additional guns to increase their effectiveness against other screen ships, or torpedoes to threaten capital ships. Further reading: ⟦1⟧.
3diykl.zh: ⟦0⟧（DD）：作为最轻的护卫舰，驱逐舰的优势在于数量。战斗中，它们可以构成护卫线的主体，保护主力舰免受鱼雷攻击。驱逐舰也非常适合执行运输船队护航任务。这两个角色都需要足够的数量，而驱逐舰是达到所需数量时最经济的选择。它们的燃料需求也相对较低。除基本武器外，还可以加装额外火炮以提高对付其他护卫舰的效能，或加装鱼雷以威胁主力舰。延伸阅读：⟦1⟧。

oxzds9.en: ⟦0⟧ (SS): Cheap, slow, and stealthy, submarines are frequently used as convoy raiders and minelayers. During ⟦1⟧, submarines may be ⟦2⟧ under certain circumstances, which protects them from attack, and even when they are revealed, they can only be damaged by other ships using depth charges. They are, however, particularly vulnerable to patrolling aircraft, especially outside of battles.
oxzds9.zh: ⟦0⟧（SS）：廉价、缓慢且隐蔽，潜艇常被用作袭击运输船队和布设水雷。在⟦1⟧中，潜艇在特定情况下可以处于⟦2⟧状态，从而免受攻击；即使被发现，也只有使用深水炸弹的其他舰船才能伤害它们。不过，它们特别容易遭到巡逻飞机攻击，尤其是在战斗之外。

gx0kx0.en: ⟦0⟧ (SSN): Nuclear submarines are special submarines available with Götterdämmerung that run on nuclear power instead of combustion engines. As such, they consume no fuel and have a very long operational range, though they are more easily spotted than more advanced non-nuclear submarines and require a lot of technological development to produce.
gx0kx0.zh: ⟦0⟧（SSN）：核潜艇是随《诸神黄昏》推出的特殊潜艇，使用核动力而非内燃机。因此它们不消耗燃料，作战半径极长，但比更先进的非核潜艇更容易被发现，而且生产所需的技术积累很大。

1mp7dlf.en: ⟦0⟧ (SSB): Missile launching submarines, also known as ballistic missile submarines, are submarines available with Götterdämmerung that are equipped with missile-launching bays. They can therefore be used as mobile launch platforms for missiles for a variety of tasks. However, they also require a lot of technological development.
1mp7dlf.zh: ⟦0⟧（SSB）：导弹发射潜艇，又称弹道导弹潜艇，是随《诸神黄昏》推出、装备导弹发射舱的潜艇。因此它们可以作为机动导弹发射平台执行多种任务，但也需要大量技术积累。

1uni547.en: ⟦0⟧ (SSBN): Nuclear missile launching submarines, also known as nuclear ballistic missile submarines, are a combination of nuclear submarines and ballistic missile submarines available with Götterdämmerung. Being able to launch a variety of missiles silently from anywhere in the world is a very potent combination, albeit one that requires inordinate amounts of technological investment.
1uni547.zh: ⟦0⟧（SSBN）：核导弹发射潜艇，又称核弹道导弹潜艇，是随《诸神黄昏》推出的核潜艇与弹道导弹潜艇的结合体。能够从世界任何地方悄无声息地发射多种导弹，是非常强大的组合，但需要极其庞大的技术投入。

nflzip.en: ⟦0⟧ are ships which carry land units, resources, ⟦1⟧, reinforcements, and lend-lease equipment across water. They are treated more abstractly than all other ship types, with a variety of unique mechanics.
nflzip.zh: ⟦0⟧是运载陆军单位、资源、⟦1⟧、补充兵和租借装备穿越水域的船只。与其他所有舰船类型相比，它们被更抽象地处理，拥有一系列独特机制。

18kwj9.en: Convoys are distinguished by the following characteristics:
18kwj9.zh: 运输船队具有以下特征：

4h6ktw.en: ⟦0⟧ are mostly unarmed, except for 0.25 Light Gun with Piercing 1 and 0.1 Anti-Air.⟦1⟧
4h6ktw.zh: ⟦0⟧基本没有武装，只装有 0.25 门轻型火炮（穿甲 1）和 0.1 门防空炮。⟦1⟧

1vg2l23.en: The positions of convoys are not shown on the map, regardless of map mode. (Convoy ⟦0⟧ can be seen on the ⟦1⟧.) Convoys are only ever directly seen during naval battles, e.g. when a ⟦2⟧ task force automatically interdicts some convoys.
1vg2l23.zh: 无论何种地图模式，运输船队的位置都不会显示在地图上。（船队⟦0⟧可以在⟦1⟧上看到。）只有海战中才能直接看到运输船队，例如当某个⟦2⟧特遣舰队自动拦截了一些船队时。

4vsivu.en: Damaged convoys do not need to return to dockyards in order to be repaired. Any convoy that is damaged (but not destroyed) during battle will be immediately restored to perfect condition after the battle has ended.
4vsivu.zh: 受损的运输船队无需返回船坞修理。任何在战斗中受损（但未被摧毁）的船队都会在战斗结束后立即恢复到完好状态。

12hqhb9.en: Convoys that are not currently in use are kept in an abstract reserve, and have no tangible presence in the game world.
12hqhb9.zh: 当前未使用的运输船队保存在抽象的后备池中，在游戏世界里没有实体存在。

d1nz0x.en: Convoys cannot be directly controlled by the player. However, it is possible to influence convoy routes by setting ⟦0⟧ for specific regions.
d1nz0x.zh: 玩家不能直接控制运输船队。不过，可以通过为特定区域设置⟦0⟧来影响船队航线。

wkmu76.en: The concepts of hulls and modules do not apply to convoys. Instead, there is only one standard convoy model. There are no technologies available to unlock more advanced convoy models.
wkmu76.zh: 船体与模块的概念不适用于运输船队。只有一种标准运输船队型号，也没有解锁更先进船队型号的科技。

sh5x6n.en: It is not possible to create convoy variants or designs.
sh5x6n.zh: 无法创建运输船队的改型或设计。

y2jl26.en: Convoys can be lend-leased to other countries and are the only ships that can be transfered in this way (outside of ⟦0⟧ and unique decisions).
y2jl26.zh: 运输船队可以租借给他国，也是唯一能以这种方式转让的舰船（⟦0⟧和特殊决议除外）。

vti2l.en: Convoys are defenseless against enemy warships, but can be ⟦0⟧ by friendly warships for protection.
vti2l.zh: 运输船队面对敌方军舰毫无防御能力，但可以由友方军舰⟦0⟧以获得保护。

1xfg9nd.en: ⟦0⟧ (sometimes called Mulberry harbors) are “ships” that can act as a temporary ⟦1⟧ for naval invasion purposes. If you own at least one, then you will have access to a unique naval invasion order where they will be automatically used upon landing on an enemy shore. They create a fully stocked ⟦2⟧ at the location of the naval invasion, but they only last for a while before disappearing, depending on different factors. The ⟦3⟧ technology is required to produce floating harbors. At least one ⟦4⟧ is required to produce a floating harbor with a cost of 400 ⟦5⟧ and 1 .
1xfg9nd.zh: ⟦0⟧（有时称为桑树港）是可以在海军入侵中充当临时⟦1⟧的“舰船”。如果你至少拥有一个，就能使用一种特殊的海军入侵命令，在登陆敌方海岸时会自动使用它们。它们会在海军入侵地点建立一个物资充足的⟦2⟧，但只会维持一段时间后消失，时长取决于多种因素。生产浮动港口需要⟦3⟧科技。生产一个浮动港口至少需要⟦4⟧，花费 400 ⟦5⟧和 1 个。

8c2st1.en: Main article: Strategic region § Naval access level
8c2st1.zh: 主条目：战略区域 § 海军准入等级

1c8t7k4.en: For any strategic region containing sea provinces, an ⟦0⟧ can be set to determine whether ships can enter the region.
1c8t7k4.zh: 对于任何包含海域的战略区域，都可以设置⟦0⟧来决定舰船能否进入该区域。

cx80xs.en: Left clicking on a ship silhouette in the fleet will bring up its ship details. From here its statistical values are visible, along with any combat history on the second tab. It is possible to ⟦0⟧ the ship by pressing its name. Carriers will show the attached air wings. Reorganizing air wings is done through the ⟦1⟧ management system. To ⟦2⟧ a ship, press the red trash bin in the upper right corner of the ship detail screen, this will return its ⟦3⟧ to the pool and is an alternative to sending old ships off on suicidal missions.
cx80xs.zh: 左键点击舰队中的舰船剪影即可调出该舰的详情。在这里可以看到它的各项统计数值，第二个标签页还会显示战斗历史。点击舰船名称可以⟦0⟧该舰。航空母舰会显示其配属的航空队；重组航空队需通过⟦1⟧管理系统完成。要⟦2⟧一艘舰船，请点击舰船详情界面右上角的红色垃圾桶图标，这会把它的⟦3⟧返还到资源池，也是把老旧舰船送去执行自杀式任务之外的另一种选择。

akrw4b.en: When building a carrier, the player has the option to pre-define how its air wings should be organized. Only carrier-capable aircraft may be based on carriers, and must be produced and either researched or designed (depending on whether ⟦0⟧ is active or not) separately from their land-based counterparts. The air wings of existing carriers can be adjusted by selecting the air wing in the air force overview or by selecting an air region in the air map mode, which brings up a list of all bases, and then selecting the fleet the carrier is a part of to bring up the air base windows for all carriers in that fleet. From the (carrier) base window, the process is identical to establishing or managing a wing stationed at an air base.
akrw4b.zh: 建造航空母舰时，玩家可以预先设定其航空队的编成方式。只有舰载机型才能驻扎在航母上，而且必须与陆基同型机分开生产，并（视⟦0⟧是否启用而定）单独研究或设计。现有航母的航空队可以通过在空军总览中选择该航空队来调整，也可以在空军地图模式中选择一个空域，调出所有基地的列表，然后选择该航母所属的舰队，从而调出该舰队中所有航母的空军基地窗口。在（航母）基地窗口中，其操作与在空军基地建立或管理航空队完全相同。

18w1rew.en: Hearts of Iron IV tracks the ⟦0⟧, skill, and history of individual ships, which can be seen in the Fleet View. Select the fleet which the player wants to review. You will notice that each individual ship in your fleet is listed with a green organization and a brown strength bar, a silhouette for the ship class, a rank icon to show the ship's experience level, a vertical progress bar showing how much experience that ship has accumulated towards the next rank and the name of the ship. If the ship has participated in combat and sunk any enemy vessels, an additional icon appears next to the ship name for history. Holding the mouse over this history icon will give you a summary of how many ships the player has sunk with this vessel. Clicking on the history icon will open the ship details pop up displaying the history of ships sunk for that particular vessel.
18w1rew.zh: 《钢铁雄心 IV》会记录每艘舰船的⟦0⟧、技能和历史，可在舰队视图中查看。选择你想查看的舰队，就会看到舰队中每艘舰船都列有绿色组织度条和棕色兵力条、舰级的剪影、显示该舰经验等级的军衔图标、显示该舰距离下一等级已积累多少经验的纵向进度条，以及舰船名称。如果该舰参加过战斗并击沉过敌舰，舰名旁会额外出现一个历史图标。把鼠标悬停在该历史图标上，会显示你用这艘舰击沉了多少艘敌舰的概要；点击该历史图标会打开舰船详情弹窗，显示该舰击沉舰船的历史。

uuyqyf.en: Each class of ship has a number of values referred to as stats. These are described below. Most of these stats can be improved by building a new ⟦0⟧. Researching ⟦1⟧ can also increase certain stats, as can employing the right admirals and, with ⟦2⟧, using ⟦3⟧ spirits. Some ⟦4⟧ can also provide ⟦5⟧ that affect certain ship stats.
uuyqyf.zh: 每一类舰船都有一系列被称为“属性”的数值，下面逐一说明。其中大多数属性都可以通过建造新的⟦0⟧来提高。研究⟦1⟧也能提升某些属性，聘用合适的海军上将、以及在⟦2⟧下使用⟦3⟧精神同样有效。某些⟦4⟧还能提供影响特定舰船属性的⟦5⟧。

185gnd2.en: ⟦0⟧ Maximum speed represents a value that indicates how quickly a naval vessel can move under optimal conditions. A faster ship has an easier time of disengaging from pursuers. It is also less likely to be hit by enemy fire, can pursue contacts easier when spotting the enemy, can evade enemy patrols for longer, and moves faster outside of battle.
185gnd2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 最大速度表示海军舰船在最佳条件下能多快移动。速度更快的舰船更容易摆脱追击者，也更不容易被敌方火力命中，发现敌人时能更容易地追蹤接触目标，能更久地躲避敌方巡逻，在战斗之外移动也更快。

1dg3emr.en: ⟦0⟧ A ship's range represents its onboard stores of fuel and foodstuffs, which will limit how far it can travel from the nearest friendly ⟦1⟧
1dg3emr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 舰船航程代表其舰上携带的燃料与食品储备，它会限制该舰能离开最近的友方⟦1⟧多远。

1ywso3n.en: ⟦0⟧ Organization is an indicator of a ship's combat readiness. The higher the organization rating of a ship, the longer it can stay in a fight. A ship with low or no organization cannot fight or move effectively. See also ⟦1⟧.
1ywso3n.zh: ⟦0⟧ 组织度表示舰船的战斗准备程度。舰船的组织度越高，能在战斗中坚持得越久。组织度低或为零的舰船无法有效作战或移动。另见⟦1⟧。

1hy408j.en: ⟦0⟧ Deck size is a measurement of how many planes a carrier can fit on board. The act of exceeding a carrier's deck size (plane limit) is known as ⟦1⟧ and it results in a penalty to carrier plane missions. See also Sortie efficiency.
1hy408j.zh: ⟦0⟧ 甲板容量衡量一艘航母能搭载多少架飞机。超出航母甲板容量（飞机上限）的行为被称为⟦1⟧，会导致航母飞机任务受到惩罚。另见出动效率。

jye130.en: ⟦0⟧ HP is an abbreviation for "hit points" and is the ability to absorb damage. It represents strength which is how much damage a ship can sustain before being destroyed.
jye130.zh: ⟦0⟧ HP 是“生命值”的缩写，指承受伤害的能力。它代表兵力，即一艘舰船在被摧毁前能承受多少伤害。

1xh85xl.en: ⟦0⟧ Reliability is the ability of a ship to continue functioning during combat. The lower the value the more likely the ship is of suffering a critical hit. Ships may receive critical hits that are much stronger than usual hits primarily because of exploding ammo or fuel tanks. Increasing a ship's reliability will reduce the chance that a received hit becomes critical. Note that the highest critical chance is done by torpedoes and not by a ship's main guns. Reference ⟦1⟧.
1xh85xl.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可靠性指舰船在战斗中持续运作的能力。数值越低，舰船越容易遭受致命一击。舰船遭受的致命一击可能远强于普通命中，主要原因是弹药库或燃料舱爆炸。提高舰船可靠性会降低所受命中变成致命一击的几率。请注意，致命一击几率最高的是鱼雷而非舰船主炮。参阅⟦1⟧。

4xf1.en: ⟦0⟧ How much supply the unit consumes per day. Please read ⟦1⟧ on the significance of this.
4xf1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该单位每天消耗多少补给。关于其重要性请阅读⟦1⟧。

szu37w.en: ⟦0⟧ Damage done by light guns. Light guns are better at targeting smaller ships, but can only target the first non-empty row in ⟦1⟧.
szu37w.zh: ⟦0⟧ 轻型火炮造成的伤害。轻型火炮更擅长瞄准较小的舰船，但只能攻击⟦1⟧中第一排非空的舰船。

glr7b0.en: ⟦0⟧ Damage done by the heavy guns. Heavy guns are better at targeting bigger ships and can target the first two non-empty rows in ⟦1⟧.
glr7b0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 重型火炮造成的伤害。重型火炮更擅长瞄准较大的舰船，可以攻击⟦1⟧中前两排非空的舰船。

n5ucpb.en: ⟦0⟧ Torpedo attack is a value that represents a vessel's capability to damage enemy ships via torpedoes. Torpedoes can target any row in ⟦1⟧, but can be blocked by screening efficiency.
n5ucpb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 鱼雷攻击表示舰船用鱼雷伤害敌舰的能力。鱼雷可以攻击⟦1⟧中的任何一排，但可能被护卫效率阻挡。

15hkfmg.en: ⟦0⟧ Depth charges are a value that represents a ship's capability to damage enemy submarines via depth charges. Depth charges are the only ship-based weapon that can damage submarines.
15hkfmg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 深水炸弹表示舰船用深水炸弹伤害敌方潜艇的能力。深水炸弹是唯一能伤害潜艇的舰载武器。

1jek1vy.en: ⟦0⟧ Armor is a value that represents a ship's steel decking thickness, belt thickness, bulkheads, etc. The purpose of armor is to help protect a ship from attack. See ⟦1⟧.
1jek1vy.zh: ⟦0⟧ 装甲表示舰船的钢甲板厚度、舷侧厚度、舱壁等。装甲的作用是保护舰船免受攻击。见⟦1⟧。

q6hb09.en: ⟦0⟧ Anti-air, also known as Naval AA attack, is a value that represents how much firepower that a ship's anti-air guns can provide in shooting down enemy planes that target the ship. It also provides a small amount of damage reduction against aerial attacks. See also ⟦1⟧.
q6hb09.zh: ⟦0⟧ 防空，又称海军防空攻击，表示舰船防空火炮在击落瞄准该舰的敌机时能提供的火力。它还能对空袭提供少量减伤。另见⟦1⟧。

q1k2gs.en: ⟦0⟧ How much ⟦1⟧ a unit uses while it is operating. Sea units will consume fuel while on active missions or during training, but not while idly sitting still. The amount of fuel they use varies on the type of mission they are performing.
q1k2gs.zh: ⟦0⟧ 单位运作时消耗多少⟦1⟧。海上单位在执行任务或训练时会消耗燃料，但静止不动时不会。其燃料消耗量随所执行任务的类型而变化。

1d66pdl.en: ⟦0⟧ Surface visibility is a value that represents a ship's profile. The higher the value, the more visible a surface ship becomes, making it more likely to be spotted outside of battle and the easier it is to hit in battle. The smaller the value, the less visible the ship becomes, making it harder to spot outside of battle and harder to hit in battle.
1d66pdl.zh: ⟦0⟧ 水面可见度表示舰船的轮廓大小。数值越高，水面舰船越显眼，在战斗之外越容易被发现，战斗中也越容易被命中；数值越小，舰船越不显眼，在战斗之外越难被发现，战斗中也越难被命中。

1vmbpz1.en: ⟦0⟧ Similar to surface visibility, but only available to submarines. Outside of battle, both it and surface visibility contribute to how quickly submarines are spotted by patrolling ships or aircraft. In battle, it contributes to how quickly a hidden submarine is ⟦1⟧ and how easy it is to hit a revealed submarine with depth charges before it becomes hidden again.
1vmbpz1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 与水面可见度类似，但只适用于潜艇。在战斗之外，它与水面可见度共同决定潜艇被巡逻舰船或飞机发现的快慢；在战斗中，它决定隐蔽中的潜艇被⟦1⟧的快慢，以及被暴露的潜艇在被再次隐蔽前被深水炸弹命中的难易程度。

rjipjr.en: ⟦0⟧ Surface detection is a ship's ability to detect enemy vessels navigating on top of the sea (not under the sea such as submarines). A fleet can only engage ships if it knows they're there. Surface fleets start out hidden and have a chance of being spotted if they get too close to enemy ships or patrolling aircraft. Surface detection also helps raiders, including submarines, avoid enemy patrols, slowing down the speed at which they are detected. Reference ⟦1⟧. Surface detection may be increased by the following means:
rjipjr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 水面侦察指舰船发现海面上（而非海面下如潜艇）航行敌舰的能力。舰队只有在知道对方存在时才能与之交战。水面舰队一开始是隐蔽的，若靠敌方舰船或巡逻飞机太近就有被发现的机会。水面侦察也有助于袭击舰（包括潜艇）避开敌方巡逻，减缓其被发现的快慢。参阅⟦1⟧。水面侦察可通过以下方式提高：

x6bbyn.en: Adding more ships to a fleet or sea region with a high surface detection value. The surface detection of a task force is the average value of its ships', so adding more ships with lower surface detection will make the task force worse at detecting ships.
x6bbyn.zh: 向具有高水面侦察值的舰队或海域增派舰船。特遣舰队的水面侦察值是其各舰的平均值，因此加入水面侦察值较低的舰船反而会降低该特遣舰队的侦察能力。

1gff8qn.en: Adding more planes to a sea region, especially with air superiority
1gff8qn.zh: 向海域增派飞机，尤其是在拥有制空权时

161apnq.en: Increasing ⟦0⟧ coverage of a sea region
161apnq.zh: 提高某海域的⟦0⟧覆盖范围

1rv563o.en: Having better decryption than an enemy vessel's encryption provides a ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ surface and sub detection bonus
1rv563o.zh: 解密能力优于敌方舰船的加密能力时，会提供⟦0⟧⟦1⟧的水面与潜艇侦察加成

1nev5t4.en: Researching better surface detection technology. This is covered by ⟦0⟧.
1nev5t4.zh: 研究更好的水面侦察科技。这由⟦0⟧涵盖。

n5v2ck.en: Researching ⟦0⟧ that include bonuses to surface detection
n5v2ck.zh: 研究包含水面侦察加成的⟦0⟧

1ca9ots.en: With La Résistance, having extra naval intel by having a spy network in a target country, capturing their agents, cracking their cypher, and using spy planes
1ca9ots.zh: 在《抵抗运动》中，通过在目标国建立特工网络、抓捕其特工、破解其密码并使用侦察机来获得额外海军情报

137xk57.en: ⟦0⟧ Sub detection is a ship's ability to detect enemy submarines. A fleet can only engage submarines if it knows they are there. Submarine wolfpacks start out hidden and have a chance of being spotted if they get too close to enemy ships or patrolling aircraft. Once in battle, hidden submarines [[⟦1⟧, even against dedicated anti-submarine vessels, so getting the jump on them and forcing them to start a battle revealed can be crucial to defeating them (which is also why they are so vulnerable to aircraft outside of battle). Sub detection may be increased by the following means:
137xk57.zh: ⟦0⟧ 潜艇侦察指舰船发现敌方潜艇的能力。舰队只有在知道对方存在时才能与潜艇交战。潜艇狼群一开始是隐蔽的，若靠敌方舰船或巡逻飞机太近就有被发现的机会。一旦进入战斗，隐蔽的潜艇[[⟦1⟧，即使面对专门的反潜舰船也是如此，因此抢得先机、迫使它们以暴露状态开始战斗，对击败它们至关重要（这也是它们在战斗之外特别容易遭到飞机攻击的原因）。潜艇侦察可通过以下方式提高：

4qc2d6.en: can remain so for a very long time
4qc2d6.zh: 可以长期保持这种状态

77hd9a.en: Adding more ships to a fleet or sea region with a high sub detection value. The sub detection of a task force is the average value of its ships', so adding more ships with lower sub detection will make the task force worse at detecting ships. In general, only dedicated anti-submarine warfare destroyers, light cruisers, and heavy cruisers will have adequate sub detection.
77hd9a.zh: 向具有高潜艇侦察值的舰队或海域增派舰船。特遣舰队的潜艇侦察值是其各舰的平均值，因此加入潜艇侦察值较低的舰船反而会降低该特遣舰队的侦察能力。一般来说，只有专门执行反潜战的驱逐舰、轻巡洋舰和重巡洋舰才具备足够的潜艇侦察能力。

7efzng.en: Adding more planes to a sea region, especially with air superiority. Submarines are particularly vulnerable to being spotted and destroyed by aircraft.
7efzng.zh: 向海域增派飞机，尤其是在拥有制空权时。潜艇特别容易被飞机发现并摧毁。

1f0bxs.en: Researching better sub detection technology. This is covered by ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
1f0bxs.zh: 研究更好的潜艇侦察科技。这由⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧涵盖。

g3jnx8.en: Creating ship ⟦0⟧ incorporating higher sub detection
g3jnx8.zh: 创建包含更高潜艇侦察值的舰船⟦0⟧

2v9dc6.en: Hiring ⟦0⟧ (without ⟦1⟧) or patronizing ⟦2⟧ (with ⟦3⟧) that can increase sub detection
2v9dc6.zh: 聘用⟦0⟧（无⟦1⟧时）或资助⟦2⟧（有⟦3⟧时）以提高潜艇侦察

1xwvbu5.en: Researching ⟦0⟧ that include bonuses to sub detection
1xwvbu5.zh: 研究包含潜艇侦察加成的⟦0⟧

a05bur.en: Hiring ⟦0⟧ figures who specialize in anti-submarine warfare
a05bur.zh: 聘用专精反潜战的⟦0⟧人物

ie3m8i.en: Hulls are the foundational component of ships and are unlocked through ⟦0⟧. Each hull type contains a number of ⟦1⟧ with restrictions and limitations based on the specific hull type. These slots can be populated by ⟦2⟧ via the ⟦3⟧ in order to form complete ship designs that can be produced by ⟦4⟧.
ie3m8i.zh: 船体是舰船的基础部件，通过⟦0⟧解锁。每种船体类型都包含若干⟦1⟧，其数量与限制取决于具体船体类型。这些⟦2⟧可以通过⟦3⟧装入槽位，从而形成可由⟦4⟧生产的完整舰船设计。

1n9tzc5.en: ⟦0⟧, often abbreviated to XP, is gained at the national, commander, and unit level, and is mainly earned through combat. At a national level, it is used to modify land divisions, ships, and planes. At a commander level, it allows commanders to increase their skills and earn traits to enhance their performance. At a unit level, it can provide bonuses when it is high and penalties when it is low, and it can be lost when units experience losses.
1n9tzc5.zh: ⟦0⟧常缩写为 XP，可在国家、指挥官和单位三个层级获得，主要通过战斗取得。在国家层级，它用于修改陆军师、舰船和飞机；在指挥官层级，它让指挥官提升技能并获取特质以增强表现；在单位层级，经验高时提供加成、经验低时带来惩罚，而且单位遭受损失时经验也会流失。

5863uq.en: There are three types of national experience: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧. Each can be used to modify equipments, designs, and/or templates associated with their field, and can be used to unlock doctrines and ⟦3⟧ spirits associated with land, sea, and air combat. At a national level, the maximum amount of experience that can be stored is capped at 500⟦4⟧, 500⟦5⟧, and 500⟦6⟧.
5863uq.zh: 国家经验有三种：⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧。每种都可用于修改其所属领域的装备、设计和／或编制，也可用于解锁与陆、海、空作战相关的学说和⟦3⟧精神。在国家层级，可储存的经验上限分别为 500⟦4⟧、500⟦5⟧和 500⟦6⟧。

123f4lv.en: National experience is gained during combat and training, including from attachés, volunteer forces, and ⟦0⟧ equipment. ⟦1⟧, as well as some political advisors, give a fixed amount of experience per day. Some national focuses and ⟦2⟧ can also give national experience.
123f4lv.zh: 国家经验在战斗和训练中获得，来源包括武官、志愿军以及⟦0⟧装备。⟦1⟧以及某些政治顾问每天提供固定数量的经验。某些国策和⟦2⟧也能提供国家经验。

4t8ywz.en: Commanders gain experience as the forces under their command engage in combat, with generals and field marshals giving bonuses to land units and admirals giving bonuses to naval units. There are no air commanders, however, air combat may generate aces, who can boost the air wing to which they are assigned so long as they remain alive.
4t8ywz.zh: 指挥官在其麾下部队参战时获得经验：上将与陆军元帅为陆军单位提供加成，海军上将为海军单位提供加成。游戏中没有空军指挥官，但空战可能产生王牌，只要他们存活，就能为所属航空队提供加成。

1j3vtyo.en: Individual ⟦0⟧, air wings, and naval units also gain experience. This gives them a modifier to combat:
1j3vtyo.zh: 各个⟦0⟧、航空队和海军单位也会获得经验，从而获得战斗修正：

gjvs6d.en: Air units scale the experience effects between levels according to experience progress, so that 99% progress on the 'trained' level gives the same bonuses as 0% progress on the 'seasoned' level. Note that scout planes receive significantly lower bonuses and penalties.
gjvs6d.zh: 空军单位按经验进度在各等级之间按比例换算经验效果，因此在“训练有素”等级上 99% 的进度所提供的加成，与在“老练”等级上 0% 的进度相同。请注意，侦察机获得的加成与惩罚都明显更低。

1n3rlb4.en: Newly deployed land units normally begin with 'trained' experience, but can be deployed early with 'green' experience. Naval and air units always start on the 'fresh' and 'rookies' levels, respectively. ⟦0⟧ units in the field allows them to advance up to regular experience level, at the cost of time and equipment (and fuel in case of fuel-consuming units). Higher levels can only be gained through combat.
1n3rlb4.zh: 新部署的陆军单位通常以“训练有素”经验起步，但也可以提前部署而以“新兵”经验投入战场。海军与空军单位则分别总是从“生手”和“新兵”等级开始。让前线单位进行⟦0⟧可使它们提升到常规经验等级，代价是时间和装备（对消耗燃料的单位而言还有燃料）。更高的等级只能通过战斗获得。

1vby1sx.en: Replacing casualties reduces the experience of a unit. This loss can be reduced with ⟦0⟧ and certain ⟦1⟧. Air units lose ⟦2⟧ less experience over friendly territory. For navies, some terrain types increase the amount of casualties, and therefore XP loss, they suffer.
1vby1sx.zh: 补充伤亡人员会降低单位的经验。这种损失可以通过⟦0⟧和某些⟦1⟧来减少。空军单位在友方领土上空的经验损失会少⟦2⟧。对海军而言，某些地形类型会增加其所受的伤亡，从而增加经验损失。

du3v7g.en: Changes to the template of a land unit can produce additional experience losses beyond those incurred for any ⟦0⟧ reinforcements that the new template might require. Converting a division from one template to another incurs ⟦1⟧ experience lost if all battalions are the same between the old and new templates, but up to an additional ⟦2⟧ experience lost for any changed battalions.
du3v7g.zh: 修改陆军单位的编制，除了新编制可能需要的⟦0⟧补充所带来的经验损失之外，还会造成额外的经验损失。把某个师从一种编制转换为另一种编制时，若新旧编制的所有营都相同，则损失⟦1⟧经验；每有一个营发生变化，最多再额外损失⟦2⟧经验。

gzx1fc.en: When they are assigned to a division, most medals give 100 experience to that division's divisional commander.
gzx1fc.zh: 颁发给某个师时，大多数勋章会给该师的师级指挥官 100 点经验。

z1tc00.en: States are divided into three main categories based on resistance: core states (also known in-game as national territory), occupied states, and colony states. Occupied states have resistance enabled, while colony states do not. If a core state has resistance turned on (whether if the requirement to enable resistance is changed in a mod or an effect forces it to be enabled, such as with the ⟦0⟧ operation), it will be listed as an occupied state, while still not having the mali that apply to non-core states such as with manpower or building slots.
z1tc00.zh: 各州按抵抗度分为三大类：核心州（游戏内也称本国领土）、被占领州和殖民地州。被占领州启用了抵抗，而殖民地州没有。如果某个核心州开启了抵抗（无论是通过 mod 修改了启用抵抗的条件，还是通过效果强制启用，例如⟦0⟧行动），它会被列为被占领州，但仍不会承受适用于非核心州的人力或建筑槽位等惩罚。

1tly819.en: If a state does not have resistance at the start of the game, then it will remain disabled unless the state changes hands⟦0⟧ or another mechanic enables it (such as various ⟦1⟧ decisions that enable resistance in certain colonial states in Africa and Arabia).
1tly819.zh: 如果某个州在游戏开始时没有抵抗，那么它将一直处于禁用状态，除非该州⟦0⟧易主，或另一机制将其启用（例如各种⟦1⟧决议会在非洲和阿拉伯的某些殖民地州启用抵抗）。

1cho7wv.en: The resistance system is based on the resistance strength, which slowly grows or decays towards the resistance target.
1cho7wv.zh: 抵抗系统基于抵抗强度，抵抗强度会缓慢地朝抵抗目标增长或衰减。

3sc1ii.en: Resistance strength measures the severity of the populace's resistance to the controller's occupation of the state. Upon the state being captured, the initial resistance is set to 1%,⟦0⟧ from where it rises or falls to the ⟦1⟧. If the state shouldn't have resistance any longer, the resistance decays towards 0 by -0.25%⟦2⟧ per day. The resistance strength is capped between 0.01%⟦3⟧ and 100%.⟦4⟧ It affects the debuffs applied to the state, frequency, and severity of resistance actions. When resistance strength reaches certain thresholds, various debuffs begin to apply on a per-state basis:⟦5⟧
3sc1ii.zh: 抵抗强度衡量民众对控制国占领该州的抵抗程度。该州被占领时，初始抵抗度设为 1%，⟦0⟧此后它会朝⟦1⟧上升或下降。如果该州不应再有抵抗，抵抗会以每天 -0.25%⟦2⟧的速度衰减至 0。抵抗强度被限制在 0.01%⟦3⟧至 100% 之间。⟦4⟧它会影响施加于该州的减益、抵抗行动的频率与严重程度。当抵抗强度达到某些阈值时，各种减益会按州开始生效：⟦5⟧

cy263d.en: ⟦0⟧: Base ⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧ increased by upgrading the agency or assigning more agents. Each subsequent agent is only ⟦3⟧ as efficient as the previous one.
cy263d.zh: ⟦0⟧：基础⟦1⟧，⟦2⟧可通过升级机构或指派更多特工来提高。此后每名特工的效率只有前一名特工的⟦3⟧。

h0jsdv.en: Spread from a neighbouring state with a higher resistance target, as ⟦0⟧ of the difference. Only one state can be selected to have the spread from, and it picks the highest one. In this case, the difference is calculated between this state's resistance target (before the spread) and the neighbouring state's either resistance target without the spread or only the spread that it received. For example, a state with a 70% resistance target neighbouring a state with a 10% resistance target will increase the latter's total target to 40% by adding half of the difference between 10% and 70%. If another state with a 10% resistance target borders the state now with a 40% target, it will raise to 20% through half of the difference between the 10% base and the 30% spread from the first state.
h0jsdv.zh: 从抵抗目标更高的相邻州扩散而来，扩散量为差值的⟦0⟧。只能选择一个州作为扩散来源，系统会挑选最高的那一个。此时，差值按本州抵抗目标（扩散前）与相邻州在无扩散时的抵抗目标、或仅计算其获得的扩散量之间的差额计算。例如，一个抵抗目标为 70% 的州与一个抵抗目标为 10% 的州相邻，会把后者总目标提高到 40%，即加上 10% 与 70% 差值的一半。如果另一个抵抗目标为 10% 的州与现在目标为 40% 的州相邻，它会通过 10% 基础值与来自第一个州的 30% 扩散量之间差值的一半，提高到 20%。

s3vtgj.en: For example, a state with a 70% resistance target neighbouring a state with a 10% resistance target will increase the latter's total target to 40% by adding half of the difference between 10% and 70%. If another state with a 10% resistance target borders the state now with a 40% target, it will raise to 20% through half of the difference between the 10% base and the 30% spread from the first state.
s3vtgj.zh: 例如，一个抵抗目标为 70% 的州与一个抵抗目标为 10% 的州相邻，会把后者总目标提高到 40%，即加上 10% 与 70% 差值的一半。如果另一个抵抗目标为 10% 的州与现在目标为 40% 的州相邻，它会通过 10% 基础值与来自第一个州的 30% 扩散量之间差值的一半，提高到 20%。

1btmed2.en: The resistance target can only fall down to 10%⟦0⟧ with most of these modifiers, only compliance can push it down further to 0. If resistance falls to 0, then the resistance will only be re-enabled once the resistance target reaches 10%⟦1⟧.
1btmed2.zh: 在大多数这些修正的作用下，抵抗目标最多只能降到 10%⟦0⟧，只有顺从度才能把它进一步压到 0。如果抵抗降到 0，那么只有抵抗目标重新达到 10%⟦1⟧时抵抗才会再次启用。

bk89lc.en: If the resistance strength doesn't match up with the resistance target, it will gradually change towards the resistance target. If the resistance strength is rising, this is ⟦0⟧; if it is falling, this is ⟦1⟧. By default, resistance growth increases it by ⟦2⟧ per day, while resistance decay decreases it by ⟦3⟧ per day. Further modifiers to them are applied multiplicatively.
bk89lc.zh: 如果抵抗强度与抵抗目标不符，它会逐渐朝抵抗目标变化。若抵抗强度在上升，这称为⟦0⟧；若在下降，则称为⟦1⟧。默认情况下，抵抗增长每天使其增加⟦2⟧，抵抗衰减每天使其减少⟦3⟧。对它们的进一步修正以乘法方式生效。

148gonf.en: If the country has a claim on the occupied state, the resistance decay is increased by ⟦0⟧. Below 10 resistance strength, decay is changed by ⟦1⟧, while below 20 strength, decay is changed by ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧
148gonf.zh: 如果该国对被占领州拥有声称，抵抗衰减会提高⟦0⟧。抵抗强度低于 10 时，衰减变化为⟦1⟧；强度低于 20 时，衰减变化为⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧

1fgz1pp.en: In terms of modifiers, there are the following ways to change it:⟦0⟧

1ejfgdp.en: The ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ for governments in exile increases the resistance growth by ⟦2⟧ within the core states of the country with the spirit.
1ejfgdp.zh: 流亡政府的⟦0⟧⟦1⟧会使拥有该精神的国家的核心州内抵抗增长提高⟦2⟧。

1yuhti0.en: The ⟦0⟧ land doctrine in the Mass Assault doctrine branch increases the resistance growth by ⟦1⟧ within the core states of the country with the doctrine.
1yuhti0.zh: 大规模突击学说分支中的⟦0⟧陆军学说会使拥有该学说的国家的核心州内抵抗增长提高⟦1⟧。

4k6nrm.en: In addition to damage to garrisons, there is a chance that resistance activity will "penetrate" the garrison and cause damage to local ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, or ⟦2⟧. The base chance is ⟦3⟧ per resistance activity, but this can be increased through ⟦4⟧. Certain unique ⟦5⟧ and political advisors can reduce garrison penetration chance.
4k6nrm.zh: 除了对驻军造成伤害之外，抵抗活动还有几率“突破”驻军，对当地的⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧造成破坏。基础几率为每次抵抗活动⟦3⟧，但可以通过⟦4⟧提高。某些独特的⟦5⟧和政治顾问可以降低驻军被突破的几率。

19n47i7.en: Compliance is a representation of a non-core territory's population's loyalty to the occupying regime. The in-game number represents the proportion of people in the local population that are loyalists.
19n47i7.zh: 顺从度体现非核心领土民众对占领政权的忠诚程度。游戏内的数值代表当地人口中忠于占领者的比例。

t5pk2n.en: Compliance is calculated on a per-state basis with its own local effects while providing overall bonuses for occupied land when reaching a certain average threshold.
t5pk2n.zh: 顺从度按州单独计算并带有各自的本地效果，同时在达到某个平均阈值时为被占领土地提供整体加成。

v05u18.en: Compliance in an occupied state starts at ⟦0⟧. Once a state capitulates or is annexed, if a ⟦1⟧ has been prepared beforehand, starting compliance in all of its original states will increase to the country's collaboration percentage. Non-core states at the beginning of the game start with 70%⟦2⟧ compliance by default. If a non-core state switches owners, its new owner will receive ⟦3⟧⟦4⟧ of the old owner's compliance in that state.
v05u18.zh: 被占领州的顺从度初始为⟦0⟧。一旦某州投降或被吞并，如果事先已准备好⟦1⟧，其所有原有州的初始顺从度将提高到该国的合作度百分比。游戏开始时的非核心州默认以 70%⟦2⟧顺从度起步。如果非核心州更换所有者，新所有者将获得原所有者在该州顺从度的⟦3⟧⟦4⟧。

q75v6j.en: Compliance base gain is ⟦0⟧ per day by default, but it is modified by occupation laws, some national spirits, and leader traits. The following values that modify it:
q75v6j.zh: 顺从度基础增长默认为每天⟦0⟧，但会受到占领法令、某些国家精神和领袖特质的修正。以下数值会修改它：

h6ftdf.en: (Previous) Controller has (temporarily) lost control of the state: ⟦0⟧ per day for controller
h6ftdf.zh: （前任）控制国（暂时）失去对该州的控制：控制国每天⟦0⟧

16t29az.en: Modifiers or effects, such as the following:⟦0⟧ Occupation laws: -0.11% to +0.03% per day[21] No Garrison occupation law: Compliance gain disabled
16t29az.zh: 修正或效果，例如以下各项：⟦0⟧ 占领法令：每天 -0.11% 至 +0.03%[21] “无驻军”占领法令：顺从度增长被禁用

a9gf2j.en: Compliance gain can be increased by compliance growth from the following sources:
a9gf2j.zh: 顺从度增长可以通过以下来源的顺从度增长来提高：

duuy04.en: Modifiers or effects, such as the following:⟦0⟧ Compassionate Gentleman political advisor: +2%
duuy04.zh: 修正或效果，例如以下各项：⟦0⟧ 仁慈绅士政治顾问：+2%

9tei73.en: This is counteracted by compliance decay. There are two main sources of compliance decay, both of which are applied after compliance growth modifiers have been incorporated into compliance gain:
9tei73.zh: 它会受到顺从度衰减的抵消。顺从度衰减有两个主要来源，两者都在顺从度增长修正被计入顺从度增长之后才应用：

aywt3h.en: Existing compliance: ⟦0⟧ per day per existing compliance, up to ⟦1⟧ per day at 100% compliance
aywt3h.zh: 现有顺从度：每点现有顺从度每天⟦0⟧，100% 顺从度时每天最多⟦1⟧

1in6e9s.en: Setting up a ⟦0⟧ switches the occupied states to a puppet state and dispenses with resistance, making compliance unnecessary.
1in6e9s.zh: 建立⟦0⟧会把被占领州转为傀儡国并免除抵抗，从而使顺从度变得不必要。

q2xj2b.en: Compliance provides bonuses to available factories (⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧) within a state. The formula looks like this:
q2xj2b.zh: 顺从度为州内可用工厂（⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧）提供加成。公式如下：

11nk8w2.en: (Refineries are unaffected by this. They will always produce the maximum amount of fuel and rubber, depending on technology, same applies for fuel silos)
11nk8w2.zh: （炼油厂不受此影响，它们始终按科技水平产出最大数量的燃料和橡胶，燃料储罐同理）

1n4e9b6.en: The same applies to the resources and manpower provided by the occupied states:
1n4e9b6.zh: 被占领州提供的资源与人力也是如此：

1z0xo7a.en: The average level of compliance between states also provides flat percentage bonuses:
1z0xo7a.zh: 各州之间的平均顺从度水平还会提供固定百分比加成：

15pdx9j.zh: 敌方特工被发现几率偏移：⟦0⟧

wgknxa.zh: 所需驻军：-25% 额外可招募人口：+0.5%

1i31iag.zh: 本地资源：+10% 本地工厂：+10%

64ka3z.en: Triggers event to establish a Collaboration Government
64ka3z.zh: 触发事件以建立合作政府

zn5co1.en: A state at 100% Compliance will provide 100% of its factories, 105% of its resources, and 40.5% of its manpower to its occupier by default, thanks to the modifiers listed above.
zn5co1.zh: 得益于上述修正，处于 100% 顺从度的州默认会向占领国提供其 100% 的工厂、105% 的资源和 40.5% 的人力。

yajm6p.en: The following can also affect the amount of factories, resources, and manpower that an occupied state provides:
yajm6p.zh: 以下因素也会影响被占领州所提供的工厂、资源和人力数量：

ar3t4x.en: Prince of Terror political advisor: ⟦0⟧ manpower from non-core states
ar3t4x.zh: 恐怖亲王政治顾问：来自非核心州的⟦0⟧人力

17fbj86.en: ⟦0⟧:⟦1⟧ Local Factories: -35% to +60% Local Resources: -35% to +60% Local Manpower: +0% to +8%

1pyfoq4.en: While having access to more than 100% of a state's factories or resources is usually temporary because compliance decay will outgrow compliance gain, there are some situations where this is not the case. Certain ⟦0⟧, political advisors, and decisions on certain countries can result in a compliance gain that overwhelms the additional compliance decay created by more extractive ⟦1⟧. In particular, the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧-exclusive ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧-specific ⟦6⟧ occupation laws all provide additional factories and resources while having low enough compliance gain reduction that they can be easily overwhelmed by additional sources of compliance gain.
1pyfoq4.zh: 虽然能获得超过某州 100% 的工厂或资源通常是暂时现象，因为顺从度衰减最终会超过顺从度增长，但在某些情况下并非如此。某些⟦0⟧、政治顾问以及针对特定国家的决议可以使顺从度增长压倒更具掠夺性的⟦1⟧所带来的额外顺从度衰减。尤其是⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧专属的⟦4⟧以及⟦5⟧特有的⟦6⟧占领法令，它们都提供额外的工厂和资源，同时顺从度增长削减足够低，很容易被额外的顺从度增长来源所压倒。

130zxdu.en: Fractional factories and resources are rounded down for each individual factory and resource type. On game startup, they are also grouped by tag and have a different rounding procedure, but this is corrected a few days into the game, when factories from occupation are first recalculated.
130zxdu.zh: 小数工厂和资源会按每座工厂和每种资源类型向下取整。在游戏启动时，它们还会按 tag 分组并采用不同的取整方式，但游戏进行几天后、占领所得的工厂首次重新计算时，这一点就会被修正。

klurw4.en: For example, the ⟦0⟧ in 1936 occupies many different states at 70% compliance, giving them access to 80% of those states' factories. This includes 1 ⟦1⟧ from the Western Indian States, 1 ⟦2⟧ from Mysore, 2 ⟦3⟧ from Hyderabad, and 2 ⟦4⟧ from Pakistan. This nominally adds up to 0.8 military factories and 4 civilian factories from occupied states, which should round down to 0 military factories and 4 civilian factories. In practice, the ⟦5⟧ only receives 0 military factories and 3 civilian factories from occupation on 1st Jan 1936 because of the previously mentioned different rounding methods, but a few days afterward, their factory counts from occupation are recalculated, and they receive the proper 0 military factories and 4 civilian factories.
klurw4.zh: 例如，1936 年的⟦0⟧以 70% 顺从度占领许多不同的州，从而可以使用这些州 80% 的工厂。这包括来自西印度诸邦的 1 座⟦1⟧、来自迈索尔的 1 座⟦2⟧、来自海得拉巴的 2 座⟦3⟧以及来自巴基斯坦的 2 座⟦4⟧。名义上这合计为来自被占领州的 0.8 座军用工厂和 4 座民用工厂，应向下取整为 0 座军用工厂和 4 座民用工厂。实际上，由于前述不同的取整方式，⟦5⟧在 1936 年 1 月 1 日只从占领中获得 0 座军用工厂和 3 座民用工厂，但几天之后其占领所得工厂数会重新计算，它们便会得到应得的 0 座军用工厂和 4 座民用工厂。

bq0nvw.en: The collaboration value represents the local population's willingness to cooperate with and aid the occupiers. Collaboration is necessary for curbing and eliminating resistance. There are two stages of collaboration: local collaboration and collaboration governments. Local collaboration is gained through the "create a collaboration government" covert operation and provides the following effects:
bq0nvw.zh: 合作度数值代表当地民众与占领者合作并提供协助的意愿。合作是遏制并消除抵抗的必要条件。合作分为两个阶段：地方合作与合作政府。地方合作通过“建立合作政府”秘密行动获得，并提供以下效果：

1vcoeol.en: Increases initial starting compliance in occupied states by 30-45% per use, up to a maximum of ⟦0⟧ collaboration (as an example, 70% collaboration will give you 70% compliance)
1vcoeol.zh: 每次使用使被占领州的初始顺从度提高 30–45%，最高可达⟦0⟧合作度（例如 70% 合作度会给你 70% 顺从度）

1knwb3q.en: Decreases the surrender progress threshold needed for capitulation
1knwb3q.zh: 降低投降所需的投降进度阈值

w83jfh.en: The current amount of collaboration can be seen in the "collaboration governments" tab on the country screen.
w83jfh.zh: 当前合作度数值可在国家界面的“合作政府”标签页中查看。

tgfoc3.en: If the average local collaboration in all occupied states rises to 80%, the occupying nation will be given the opportunity to install a collaboration government formed from loyal and sympathetic local civilians, to administer and govern the occupied territories. ⟦0⟧ that a democratic country cannot create collaboration governments. The collaboration government itself is a special type of puppet, available with La Résistance DLC and it has the following puppet rules:
tgfoc3.zh: 如果所有被占领州的平均地方合作度升到 80%，占领国将有机会扶植一个由忠诚且同情的当地平民组成的合作政府，来管理和治理被占领土。⟦0⟧民主国家不能建立合作政府。合作政府本身是一种特殊类型的傀儡国，需拥有《抵抗运动》DLC，并具有以下傀儡规则：

14pk4qr.en: Master can build constructions on the subject's territory
14pk4qr.zh: 宗主国可在附属国领土上建造建筑

ts9npf.en: Once created, the collaboration government is a separate tag and will be given the Generic national focus tree for use, unless the opposing country for the cores doesn't exist. Additionally, the collaboration government will also gain cores on every state that is a core state of the country the collaboration government is meant to represent, regardless of what territory the collaboration government actually controls.
ts9npf.zh: 一旦建立，合作政府就是一个独立的 tag，并会获得通用国策树供其使用，除非其核心州对应的对立国不存在。此外，合作政府还会在其旨在代表的国家的每一个核心州上获得核心，无论合作政府实际控制哪些领土。

bsnxn1.en: The collaboration government will adopt the puppet master's color and will also use the puppet master's adjective in its name to represent the close connection between the two governments. However, the puppet will be granted the research progress of the country it is meant to represent. If you are creating a collaboration government of a tag that is using the generic tree by default, your collaborationist government also inherits the generic tree progression, despite the continued existence of that country.
bsnxn1.zh: 合作政府会采用宗主国的颜色，并在其名称中使用宗主国的形容词，以体现两国政府之间的紧密联系。不过，该傀儡国会获得它旨在代表的国家的科研进度。如果你为一个默认使用通用国策树的 tag 建立合作政府，你的合作政府也会继承通用国策树的进度，即使该国依然存在。

j8z0vg.en: Currently, Compliance will only be checked from one tag per state. If the state's owner has a core on it, the owner will be the target of compliance, otherwise, it's the leftmost flag in the list of the cores. This can be checked by annexing the Chinese Warlords: ⟦0⟧ is given a core before the warlords, meaning the resistance will be directed towards them.
j8z0vg.zh: 目前，每个州的顺从度只会从一个 tag 进行检查。如果该州的所有者对其拥有核心，则所有者就是顺从度的目标；否则就取核心列表中排在最左侧的旗帜。可以通过吞并中国军阀来验证这一点：⟦0⟧会先于军阀们获得核心，这意味着抵抗将针对它们。

m3q2ql.en: For example, if ⟦0⟧ creates a collaboration network in Communist China, the collaboration will be counted from Communist China towards ⟦1⟧ for the state of Shaanxi only. They can then immediately be released as a collaboration government since the Communist Chinese collaboration is NOT checked for the other Japanese-owned states in China, as their collaboration is counted from ⟦2⟧ toward ⟦3⟧. When released they will only receive the provinces from which their compliance is calculated but retain their other cores.
m3q2ql.zh: 例如，如果⟦0⟧在中国共产党境内建立合作网络，那么仅对陕西州而言，合作度会从中国共产党计入⟦1⟧。随后它们可以立即被释放为合作政府，因为中国共产党在日占中国其他州中的合作度不会被检查，那些州的合作度是从⟦2⟧计入⟦3⟧的。释放时它们只会获得据以计算其顺从度的省份，但仍保留其他核心。

u88soa.en: This mechanic prevents the formation of some pre-existing tags that are another nation's core. ex: Macedonia, Croatia, Occitania, Algeria, etc. They cannot be formed into collaboration governments (unless released, attacked, and annexed), only released as regular puppets. this also prevents the formation of a collaboration government from provinces in which the releasing nation has cores, these provinces will, however, be released with an eventual collaboration government. An example of this is if Italy creates a Yugoslavian collaboration government, they would then lose control and their core on Istria which would be ceded to the collaboration government in ⟦0⟧.
u88soa.zh: 这一机制会阻止某些作为他国核心的既有 tag 成立，例如马其顿、克罗地亚、奥克西塔尼亚、阿尔及利亚等。它们无法被组建为合作政府（除非被释放、攻击并吞并），只能作为普通傀儡国释放。这也会阻止在释放国拥有核心的省份中组建合作政府，不过这些省份最终会随合作政府一同被释放。举例来说，如果意大利建立一个南斯拉夫合作政府，那么它将失去对伊斯特拉的控制权和核心，该地会在⟦0⟧中割让给合作政府。

knxm0p.en: Since a collaboration government has cores on its territory, the puppet master will not need to garrison the territory and resistance will not form.
knxm0p.zh: 由于合作政府在其领土上拥有核心，宗主国无需驻军该领土，抵抗也不会形成。

16jzgun.en: Collaboration governments cannot be created from an existing puppet, neither can they themselves increase their own autonomy status when controlled by A.I. However, when controlled by a player, they can increase their own autonomy status and become a regular puppet, allowing them to eventually become independent through the normal puppet autonomy ladder.
16jzgun.zh: 合作政府无法由现有傀儡国建立，在由 AI 控制时它们自身也无法提升自治度。但在由玩家控制时，它们可以提高自身自治度并成为普通傀儡国，从而最终通过正常的傀儡自治阶梯获得独立。

1di3dmv.en: In order to combat resistance and police the population, occupied states will need to be garrisoned by military troops to perform police duties. The in-game Garrison represents this and can be assigned from the Occupied Territories tab.
1di3dmv.zh: 为了对抗抵抗并维持治安，被占领州需要由军事部队驻守以执行警察任务。游戏内的驻军即体现这一点，可从“被占领土”标签页进行指派。

n4xo4i.en: The divisions needed to staff the garrisons are not visible on the map and are allocated and get their equipment automatically. The equipment allocation can be set via the Recruit & deploy dialog.
n4xo4i.zh: 用于填充驻军的师不会显示在地图上，它们会被自动分配并自动获得装备。装备分配可通过“招募与部署”对话框设置。

7rtw0m.en: Occupation laws are scaled with Garrison Efficiency. If a Garrison reinforcement order is not fulfilled, all effects from the occupation law will be scaled by this value:⟦0⟧
7rtw0m.zh: 占领法令的效果按驻军效率缩放。如果驻军补充命令未得到满足，占领法令的所有效果都会按该数值缩放：⟦0⟧

14gdznu.en: For every point of resistance, the occupying country will require 0.75⟦0⟧ points of suppression in each state. However, even if resistance strength is lower than 10%⟦1⟧, the number of garrisons needed will remain as if it was 10%. The same mechanic applies when resistance strength rises above 50%⟦2⟧, capping the amount of suppression needed for states with high resistance.
14gdznu.zh: 每一点抵抗，占领国在每个州都需要 0.75⟦0⟧点镇压。不过即使抵抗强度低于 10%⟦1⟧，所需驻军数量仍按 10% 计算。当抵抗强度升到 50%⟦2⟧以上时也是同样机制，从而为高抵抗州所需的镇压量设定了上限。

pmk2fs.en: Occupation laws can be selected in a country's occupied, i.e., non-core, territories. They can be assigned on a country-wide, per-occupied-country, or per-state basis. They regulate the resistance targets, compliance generation rates, amounts of industry and resources available to the player in their applied states. Some occupation laws can also give several other, unique advantages.
pmk2fs.zh: 占领法令可以在一个国家的被占领（即非核心）领土中选择。它们可以按全国、按被占领国或按州指派。它们调节抵抗目标、顺从度生成速率、以及玩家在其适用州内可获得的工业与资源数量。某些占领法令还会提供若干其他独特优势。

bg7x3o.en: Enemy intel network strength gain: -25% Enemy operative detection chance offset: +1%
bg7x3o.zh: 敌方情报网强度增长：-25% 敌方特工被发现几率偏移：+1%

1o08127.en: Civilian Factory Repair Speed: +25% Resource Sabotage Chance: -25% Resource Sabotage Duration: -25%
1o08127.zh: 民用工厂修复速度：+25% 资源破坏几率：-25% 资源破坏持续时间：-25%

o9a2ob.en: Military Factory Repair Speed: +25% Civilian Factory Repair Speed: +25% Military Factory Sabotage Chance: -25% Civilian Factory Sabotage Chance: -25%
o9a2ob.zh: 军用工厂修复速度：+25% 民用工厂修复速度：+25% 军用工厂破坏几率：-25% 民用工厂破坏几率：-25%

1ppe10x.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on Kurdish core states and only if completed either A Common Destiny for All of Turkey or Permit Regional Elections.
1ppe10x.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于库尔德核心州可用，且必须完成“所有人的共同命运：土耳其”或“允许地区选举”。

p802i4.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on African states and only if Ministry of Italian Africa is complete. Also available for ⟦2⟧ core states if Albanian Fascist Militia is complete.
p802i4.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于非洲各州可用，且必须完成“意大利非洲部”。若完成“阿尔巴尼亚法西斯民兵”，⟦2⟧核心州也可用。

1jv5cw.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on African states and only if Regional Development is complete. Also available for ⟦2⟧ core states if Albanian Fascist Militia is complete.
1jv5cw.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于非洲各州可用，且必须完成“区域发展”。若完成“阿尔巴尼亚法西斯民兵”，⟦2⟧核心州也可用。

77t961.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on African states and only if Polizia dell'Africa Italiana is complete. Also available for ⟦2⟧ core states if Albanian Fascist Militia is complete.
77t961.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于非洲各州可用，且必须完成“意属非洲警察”。若完成“阿尔巴尼亚法西斯民兵”，⟦2⟧核心州也可用。

1vze4p5.en: Exclusive to occupiers of ⟦0⟧ with Götterdämmerung on their core states and only if they have completed Secretaries General.
1vze4p5.zh: 仅⟦0⟧的占领者在其核心州上、启用《诸神黄昏》时可用，且必须完成“总书记们”。

1mfca9l.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on princely states and only if Princely States Policy is complete.
1mfca9l.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于土邦可用，且必须完成“土邦政策”。

eln9a3.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on Chinese states and only if Invest in Senbu is complete.
eln9a3.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于中国各州可用，且必须完成“投资宣抚工作”。

cacnc9.en: Exclusive to Japan with No Compromise, No Surrender on Asian states and only if The Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere is complete and the option "The Emperors supreme Authority must always come first!" has been chosen.
cacnc9.zh: 仅日本在《不妥协，不投降》下、于亚洲各州可用，且必须完成“大东亚共荣圈”并选择“天皇的最高权威必须永远居于首位！”这一选项。

16hawgd.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on Asian states and only if The Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere is complete and the option "We must pursue Prosperity for all Asian states" has been chosen.
16hawgd.zh: 仅⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧下、于亚洲各州可用，且必须完成“大东亚共荣圈”并选择“我们必须为所有亚洲州追求繁荣”这一选项。

1cpf5ss.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Stricter than capitulation: the target must not control any states. ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ There is a large quantity of effects and modifiers that modify this, with a lot being country-specific. Only effects and/or modifiers that can modify it when playing any country have been selected here. ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ If the country initiating the operation has completed the Export Saboteurs ⟦6⟧, the bonus-less resistance target changes to ⟦7⟧.
1cpf5ss.zh: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ 比投降更严格：目标不得控制任何州。⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ 有大量效果和修正会修改它，其中许多是特定国家专属的。此处只选取了在任何国家游玩时都能修改它的效果和／或修正。⟦4⟧⟦5⟧ 如果发起该行动的国家已完成“出口破坏者”⟦6⟧，无加成时的抵抗目标会变为⟦7⟧。

txurxc.en: The ⟦0⟧ scripted trigger, by default in ⟦1⟧

i3a7hy.en: Enemy intelligence ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ (with bonus) on a successful ⟦3⟧ operation⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧ (with bonus) on a successful ⟦6⟧ operation.⟦7⟧
i3a7hy.zh: ⟦0⟧敌方情报：⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧（带加成），在成功的⟦3⟧行动中⟦4⟧；或⟦5⟧（带加成），在成功的⟦6⟧行动中。⟦7⟧

7a95g1.en: The ⟦0⟧ occupation law available to ⟦1⟧ increases the resistance decay by ⟦2⟧ in the states where it's applied to.
7a95g1.zh: ⟦0⟧占领法令⟦1⟧可使⟦2⟧在其适用州内的抵抗衰减提高。

e4w5jd.en: For example, if ⟦0⟧ creates a collaboration government representing ⟦1⟧ in East Hebei (which starts off controlled by ⟦2⟧), the collaboration government will be named "Japanese China" and gain cores on every Chinese core state, while being of the same map color as Japan. If, however, ⟦3⟧ did not exist when the collaboration government was formed, the collaboration government will assume the role of ⟦4⟧, including the focus tree.
e4w5jd.zh: 例如，如果⟦0⟧建立一个代表⟦1⟧的合作政府于冀东（开局由⟦2⟧控制），该合作政府将被命名为“日本中国”，并在每一个中国核心州上获得核心，同时地图颜色与日本相同。但如果建立合作政府时⟦3⟧并不存在，合作政府将取代⟦4⟧的角色，包括其国策树。

dx1vjv.en: Target country has a ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧ plus ⟦2⟧ per ⟦3⟧ of the ⟦4⟧, up to a total of ⟦5⟧ at 100% ⟦6⟧

blwlif.en: Each day that resistance is active, the game rolls for resistance activity. The chance for resistance activity to happen in a state increases by ⟦0⟧ per ⟦1⟧ of resistance in that state, up to a maximum of ⟦2⟧ at ⟦3⟧ resistance.⟦4⟧
blwlif.zh: 在抵抗存在的每一天，游戏都会判定是否发生抵抗活动。某州发生抵抗活动的几率按⟦0⟧提高，每⟦1⟧抵抗，最高为⟦2⟧，在⟦3⟧抵抗时。⟦4⟧

1as71h2.en: Whenever resistance activity happens in a state, local partisans will attack and destroy ⟦0⟧ of the state garrison's equipment and ⟦1⟧ of the state garrison's manpower. Equipment losses are applied to all currently used equipment by the garrison based on the garrison's current fulfillment rate and are rounded up for all equipment types. ⟦2⟧ increases the potential damage to both equipment and manpower. Certain ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, political advisors, and ⟦5⟧ can increase or decrease the amount of damage dealt to garrisons in certain occupied states. The garrison template's hardness reduces both types of damage by ⟦6⟧ per ⟦7⟧ hardness, capped at a maximum of ⟦8⟧ at ⟦9⟧ hardness or more. This reduction occurs regardless of the actual equipment the garrison has available.⟦10⟧ For example, a garrison template with a ⟦11⟧ battalion will have its damage reduced even if the country has no heavy tanks to fulfill their garrisons' equipment request. It also stacks additively with other sources of garrison damage reduction up to a maximum total damage reduction of ⟦12⟧.⟦13⟧ This can mean that additional garrison hardness is effectively wasted when enough damage reduction sources from ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧, political advisors, etc. is present.
1as71h2.zh: 每当某州发生抵抗活动，当地游击队会攻击并摧毁该州驻军装备的⟦0⟧和该州驻军人力的⟦1⟧。装备损失按驻军当前满足率施加于驻军当前使用的所有装备，并对所有装备类型向上取整。⟦2⟧会同时增加对装备和人力的潜在伤害。某些⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、政治顾问和⟦5⟧可以增减在某些被占领州对驻军造成的伤害。驻军编制的硬度会按⟦6⟧减少两类伤害，每⟦7⟧硬度，最多减少⟦8⟧，在硬度达到或超过⟦9⟧时。无论驻军实际拥有多少装备，这种减免都会生效。⟦10⟧例如，一个含⟦11⟧营的驻军编制即使该国没有重型坦克来满足驻军的装备请求，其伤害也会被减免。它还会与其他驻军伤害减免来源加算叠加，总伤害减免上限为⟦12⟧。⟦13⟧这意味着当来自⟦14⟧、⟦15⟧、政治顾问等的伤害减免来源足够多时，额外的驻军硬度实际上会被浪费。

1drfz06.en: State is a core of a country with a ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧ per day per ⟦2⟧ of the ⟦3⟧, up to ⟦4⟧ per day at 100% ⟦5⟧
1drfz06.zh: 该州是具有⟦0⟧的国家的核心州：每天⟦1⟧，每⟦2⟧的⟦3⟧，每天最多⟦4⟧，在 100%⟦5⟧时

pbq5i4.zh: 快捷键#作战计划快捷键

bujn1t.en: When selecting a naval invasion order, the player will be asked to left-click on a province with a naval base as a point of departure and right-click on the enemy province(s) to invade. The army will automatically gather at the naval base they will depart from for the assault.
bujn1t.zh: 选择海军入侵命令时，玩家需要左键点击一个有海军基地的省份作为出发地，然后右键点击要入侵的敌方省份。陆军会自动在出发的海军基地集结以准备突击。

121hcuj.en: Enemy Trade law (Free trade: 20%, Export focus: 10%, Limited exports: 5%, Closed economy: 0%)
121hcuj.zh: 敌方贸易法令（自由贸易：20%，出口导向：10%，有限出口：5%，封闭经济：0%）

1ot8mr.en: Radar coverage (Radars that cover ⟦0⟧ seazone with enemy ships on missions can provide up to 20% ⟦1⟧. Naval intel gathered per radar is only one value per country, not per seazone. Naval intel about the UK gathered per radar that covers the English Channel can provide ⟦2⟧ for a naval invasion in the Mediterranean Sea.)
1ot8mr.zh: 雷达覆盖（覆盖了⟦0⟧海域且有敌方舰船在执行任务的雷达，最多可提供 20% ⟦1⟧。每座雷达收集的海军情报是按国家计的单一数值，而非按海域计。某座覆盖英吉利海峡的雷达收集到的关于英国的海军情报，可以为在地中海的海军入侵提供⟦2⟧。）

4xmml3.en: Factors on ⟦0⟧ only with the DLC La Résistance:
4xmml3.zh: 仅在 DLC《抵抗运动》下对⟦0⟧生效的因素：

13bhrc6.en: Decrypted enemy ciphers (passive bonus 10% and 30 days bonus 50%)
13bhrc6.zh: 已破译的敌方密码（被动加成 10%，30 天加成 50%）

1ss60au.en: Own Decryption level and enemy Encryption level
1ss60au.zh: 己方解密等级与敌方加密等级

1mas3k5.en: Example with the DLC La Résistance:
1mas3k5.zh: 使用 DLC《抵抗运动》的示例：

1upgl47.zh: 意大利皇家海军 安德烈亚·多里亚号

iz110f.en: Air superiority and ⟦0⟧ provide a bonus to ⟦1⟧. The maximum possible bonus from air superiority is +100% to the ship amount, making each ship count for two. It is achieved when air superiority is 100% and there are enough planes to cover 100% of the sea region.
iz110f.zh: 制空权与⟦0⟧会为⟦1⟧提供加成。来自制空权的最大可能加成为舰船数量 +100%，即每艘舰船按两艘计算。当制空权达到 100% 且有足够飞机覆盖 100% 的海域时即可实现。

bu7dzb.en: Consider using Shore bombardment to support the invasion, as well as any ⟦0⟧ in range.
bu7dzb.zh: 考虑使用舰炮支援来支援入侵，以及任何射程内的⟦0⟧。

5ge3ny.en: Unless invading divisions have captured a port or a city, they might be cut off from supply, and need to achieve these objectives within 72 hours before supplies run out. A floating harbor will provide a temporary supply hub in the landing province, giving the invaders a few weeks to secure an alternative supply source.
5ge3ny.zh: 除非入侵的师已夺取港口或城市，否则它们可能与补给断绝，必须在补给耗尽前的 72 小时内达成这些目标。浮动港口会在登陆省份提供一个临时补给枢纽，让入侵者有几周时间来确保替代的补给来源。

150et5h.en: A paradrop is a battle plan order that uses ⟦0⟧ to land one or more paradrop-capable divisions onto a target ⟦1⟧. The paradrop order button is available in the battle plan toolbar for an army with at least one paradrop-capable division. After selecting the button, the player must left-click the province of an air base that contains a minimum of 50 transport planes and then right-click a province that is within transport range as the paradrop destination.
150et5h.zh: 伞降是一种作战计划命令，它使用⟦0⟧把一个或多个可伞降的师投送到目标⟦1⟧。只要集团军中至少有一个可伞降的师，作战计划工具栏中就会出现伞降命令按钮。选择该按钮后，玩家必须左键点击一个至少含 50 架运输机的空军基地所在省份，然后右键点击一个在运输航程内的省份作为伞降目标。

1kb1b1p.en: Executing a paradrop order requires sufficient transport planes for the number of divisions assigned to the order (by default, 45 planes per division) and either neutral or 70% air superiority in all required regions.
1kb1b1p.zh: 执行伞降命令需要为该命令所分配的师数量提供足够的运输机（默认每个师 45 架），并且在所有所需区域拥有中立或 70% 的制空权。

1ewf1.en: In order to be paradrop-capable, a division must contain only paradrop-capable battalions among its line battalions and support companies. Paradrop-capable divisions will have a checkmark on the parachute icon at the top left of the ⟦0⟧ window. Paradrop-capable battalions are indicated by a parachute symbol in their unit icons during battalion selection. Currently, only the ⟦1⟧ battalion is paradrop-capable as a line battalion. Paradrop-capable support companies are listed below; all other support companies are not paradrop-capable.
1ewf1.zh: 要具备伞降能力，一个师的一线营和支援连中必须只包含可伞降的营。可伞降的师会在⟦0⟧窗口左上角的降落伞图标上显示对勾。可伞降的营在营级选择时会在其单位图标中显示降落伞符号。目前作为一线营只有⟦1⟧营可伞降。可伞降的支援连列于下表；其他所有支援连都不能伞降。

1r6rv8s.en: If the general commanding the divisions has the ⟦0⟧ commander trait, he will have access to the ⟦1⟧ ability, which decreases the transport plane requirement by 10% (i.e., base requirement * 0.9) for seven days at the expense of 0.1 command power per battalion.
1r6rv8s.zh: 如果指挥这些师的将领拥有⟦0⟧指挥官特质，他将能使用⟦1⟧能力，在七天内把运输机需求降低 10%（即基础需求 × 0.9），代价是每个营 0.1 指挥点数。

1xg03ye.en: Paradrop Order Arrow Tooltip - Hovering over a paradrop arrow will display a tooltip with more detailed order information, as well as alerts if there are insufficient transport wings or the presence of division attrition. The tooltip will not display if hovering over a body of water, only over land.
1xg03ye.zh: 伞降命令箭头提示框——将鼠标悬停在伞降箭头上会显示一个包含更详细命令信息的提示框，若运输机航空队不足或存在师损耗也会显示警告。悬停在水域上时不会显示提示框，只在陆地上显示。

1b551fu.en: A Front Line is the starting point of attacks into enemy territory. A player can either assign a whole country's border as a front line by clicking on the border or a player can assign a part of a country's border as a front line by holding the right mouse button and dragging the mouse over the provinces the player wants to belong to the front line deployment area. The AI will then move all the divisions into the position that the commander assigns to that front line. They are assigned either by having them selected when the front line button is clicked or added later by selecting them and Control-Clicking on that line. A player can also create several unconnected front lines and assign divisions between them, which may be particularly useful for a field marshal who may command an unlimited amount of divisions conducting various operations in different locations around the world. Divisions that are stationed at a front line that borders a non-ally will receive a planning bonus for their pre-attack preparation time. Front lines can only be positioned at a border, and the front line of battle between opposing forces counts as a border for this purpose.
1b551fu.zh: 前线是向敌方领土发起进攻的起点。玩家既可以点击边界来把整个国家的边界指定为前线，也可以按住鼠标右键并拖过希望纳入前线部署区域的省份，从而只把国家边界的一部分指定为前线。随后 AI 会把所有师移动到指挥官为该前线指定的位置。这些师可以是在点击前线按钮时被选中的，也可以是之后选中它们并按 Ctrl 点击该前线来加入的。玩家还可以创建几条互不相连的前线并在其间分配师，这对可能指挥无限数量师、在世界各地执行各种行动的陆军元帅来说尤其有用。驻扎在与非盟友接壤的前线上的师，会因其进攻前的准备时间而获得计划加成。前线只能设置在边界上，而敌对双方之间的战线在此意义上也算作边界。

1j98y72.en: For defending an area against partisans, see garrison.
1j98y72.zh: 关于防御某地区以对抗游击队，请见驻军。

tgtm3l.en: The max planning bonus for each division (⟦0⟧), or the rate of daily planning bonus accumulation, can be increased by certain ⟦1⟧ choices and National Spirits. The base daily gain is ⟦2⟧, so it will take, e.g., 15 days to accumulate to the 30% cap. Using a general will also add both to the max planning bonus and the rate of daily planning bonus accumulation. Each point of a general's planning rating will contribute +2% of max planning bonus, and +5% to the daily planning bonus accumulation. However, the +5% to the daily planning bonus is multiplicative to the 2% daily base rate. So for example, when using a general with a planning rating of 4, they will add +8% to the max planning bonus (so 30% + 8% = 38%, assuming no other bonuses), and the daily planning bonus accumulation will be 2.4% (2% * (1 + (4 * 5% = 20%)) = 2.4%). Continuing the example, it will now take 16 days to complete the full planning bonus (38% / 2.4% = 15.83 days). Commanders, especially field marshals, can also increase the max planning bonus and/or planning speed with certain ⟦3⟧, like ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧. Various ⟦7⟧ can also increase planning speed or max planning bonus, as can officer spirits like ⟦8⟧ and certain political advisors.
tgtm3l.zh: 每个师的最大计划加成（⟦0⟧），或每日计划加成累积速率，可以通过某些⟦1⟧选择和国家精神来提高。每日基础获取量为⟦2⟧，因此需要例如 15 天才能累积到 30% 的上限。使用一名上将也会同时提高最大计划加成和每日计划加成累积速率。上将每点计划能力会贡献 +2% 最大计划加成，以及 +5% 的每日计划加成累积。不过，那 +5% 的每日计划加成是对 2% 每日基础速率的乘法加成。举例来说，使用一名计划能力为 4 的上将，他们会提供 +8% 最大计划加成（假设没有其他加成，即 30% + 8% = 38%），而每日计划加成累积将为 2.4%（2% × (1 + (4 × 5% = 20%)) = 2.4%）。继续这个例子，现在需要 16 天才能完成完整的计划加成（38% / 2.4% = 15.83 天）。指挥官，尤其是陆军元帅，还可以通过某些⟦3⟧来提高最大计划加成和／或计划速度，例如⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧。各种⟦7⟧也能提高计划速度或最大计划加成，军官精神如⟦8⟧以及某些政治顾问同样如此。

1ljluai.en: To increase the planning bonus in a hurry, the player can use the ⟦0⟧ ability, which can increase the planning speed by ⟦1⟧ for 7 days at the cost of Command power.
1ljluai.zh: 若要快速提高计划加成，玩家可以使用⟦0⟧能力，它能在 7 天内把计划速度提高⟦1⟧，代价是消耗指挥点数。

1dwqw6a.en: Executes a scripted effect, within the currently selected scope.
1dwqw6a.zh: 在当前选定的作用域内执行一个脚本化效果。

eu84m7.en: Once a paradrop executes, the division may suffer losses if its paradrop is disrupted. These losses will be between ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ to ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ of the division's strength, including ⟦4⟧⟦5⟧ to ⟦6⟧⟦7⟧ of its ⟦8⟧ and ⟦9⟧⟦10⟧ to ⟦11⟧⟦12⟧ of its equipment, with an additional potential ⟦13⟧ amount of randomness to all factors regardless of the actual amount of disruption. These losses can occur even when the target province is empty, i.e., when it does not have an enemy division in it. Based on repeated tests of the same drop (i.e., the same order form the same save file), such losses do not seem to be dependent on air superiority (i.e., it happens even when at 100% air superiority), but ⟦14⟧ can contribute to how much a division is disrupted.⟦15⟧ Such losses also seem to occur much more frequently when the drop is at higher latitudes (e.g., in Norway or Northern China), or into coastal provinces.
eu84m7.zh: 伞降一旦执行，如果投送受到干扰，该师可能会遭受损失。这些损失介于该师兵力的⟦0⟧⟦1⟧至⟦2⟧⟦3⟧之间，包括⟦4⟧⟦5⟧至⟦6⟧⟦7⟧的其⟦8⟧，以及⟦9⟧⟦10⟧至⟦11⟧⟦12⟧的其装备，并且无论实际干扰程度如何，所有因素都会额外带有⟦13⟧的随机量。即使目标省份为空，即其中没有敌方师，这类损失也可能发生。基于对同一次投送的反复测试（即同一存档下的同一命令），这类损失似乎并不取决于制空权（即即使在 100% 制空权下也会发生），但⟦14⟧会影响一个师受到干扰的程度。⟦15⟧这类损失在较高纬度投送（例如在挪威或中国北方）或投送到沿海省份时似乎也发生得频繁得多。

4oteje.en: To make paradrops more effective, a player can use the ⟦0⟧ ability with a commander who has the ⟦1⟧ trait. This allows paradropping divisions within the next 7 days to land with a lot more organization (up to ⟦2⟧) and take fewer losses from disruption, though this comes at the cost of Command power.
4oteje.zh: ⟦0⟧能力可以让伞降更有效，如果配合拥有⟦1⟧特质的指挥官。这会使接下来 7 天内伞降的师以高得多的组织度着陆（最高⟦2⟧），并减少受干扰造成的损失，代价是消耗指挥点数。

92cutw.en: A modifier is essentially a variable used in internal calculations. However, unlike ⟦0⟧, modifiers are dynamically changeable within any modifier block. In general, modifiers are typically used to create a consistent and long-lasting effect that can be easily reversed. Each modifier has the exact same layout: ⟦1⟧. This adds the specified value to the modifier's total value for the scope where it is applied.⟦2⟧ For example, assuming that there are no other modifiers changing that to the country, having ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ applied to the country (potentially in different modifier blocks) will result in a total of ⟦5⟧ political power gain above the base gain. Due to how modifiers work, ⟦6⟧ This also means that negative modifiers will always work and have the opposite effect of positive modifiers. A modifier's current total value can be received as a variable by reading ⟦7⟧, such as ⟦8⟧. This works for countries and states, but for unit leaders, ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧ is used instead.
92cutw.zh: 修正本质上是一个用于内部计算的变量。不过，与⟦0⟧不同，修正可以在任何修正块中动态改变。一般而言，修正用于创建一种稳定、持久且易于撤销的效果。每个修正的写法都完全相同：⟦1⟧。这会把指定的数值加到该修正在其所应用作用域上的总数值中。⟦2⟧ 例如，假设没有其他修正改变该国的这项数值，那么对该国（可能位于不同的修正块中）应用⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧，会使政治点数增益在基础增益之上总共增加⟦5⟧。由于修正的工作方式，⟦6⟧ 这也意味着负向修正总是会生效，并且效果与正向修正相反。修正当前的总数值可以通过读取⟦7⟧作为变量获取，例如⟦8⟧。这对国家和州都适用，但对单位指挥官则改用⟦9⟧和⟦10⟧。

1bmyp9p.zh: 装备加成，例如降低建造某个装备原型的成本。同样，这属于⟦0⟧，可以以相同方式用于顾问和国家领袖特质，但不能用于其他地方。
