4hpppd.en: Dynamic modifiers, defined in ⟦0⟧ files, are a type to apply modifiers that accept variables. The modifiers are updated daily, unless the ⟦1⟧ is used to forcefully refresh the impact of modifiers. They can be applied to both countries and states, in case of the latter, the variable must be defined for the state, not for the country-owner or controller. They can also be applied to unit leaders.
4hpppd.zh: 动态修正定义在⟦0⟧文件中，是一种可接受变量的修正类型。修正每天更新一次，除非使用⟦1⟧强制刷新修正的影响。它们既可应用于国家也可应用于州，对于后者，变量必须为州定义，而不是为国家所有者或控制者定义。它们也可以应用于单位指挥官。

1kgzjmv.en: Unlike ideas, ⟦0⟧ via debug mode or console, any changes to their definitions require a game restart to apply in-game. Additionally, due to the daily refresh of the variable check, these are more poorly optimised than ideas are. Due to this, when it's feasible to not use variables for a country-scoped dynamic modifier, it's both easier and more optimised ⟦1⟧
1kgzjmv.zh: 与理念不同，无法通过调试模式或控制台⟦0⟧，对其定义的任何改动都需要重启游戏才能在游戏中生效。此外，由于变量检查每天刷新，它们的优化程度不如理念。因此在不需要为国家作用域的动态修正使用变量时，既更简单也更高效的做法是⟦1⟧

1x2xjk9.en: there is no way to reload definitions of dynamic modifiers
1x2xjk9.zh: 没有任何办法重新加载动态修正的定义

25uqwa.en: The dynamic modifiers are evaluated daily for each scope. The process consists of the following:
25uqwa.zh: 动态修正会按每个作用域每天进行一次求值。该过程包含以下步骤：

14cwwl3.en: At the beginning of each day, each variable modifier value for each dynamic modifier is temporarily reset to 0, even if the null-coalescing operator is used to assume a different number as the default. Constant values do not get reset.
14cwwl3.zh: 每天开始时，每个动态修正的每个变量修正值都会被临时重置为 0，即使使用了空值合并运算符来假定一个不同的默认值。常量值不会被重置。

1bbmgv1.en: The variable values inside of a dynamic modifier are assumed to be 0 until every variable inside is calculated. This includes those that rely on other modifiers, which includes the ⟦0⟧ game variable or MTTH variables that utilise that game variable.
1bbmgv1.zh: 在动态修正内部的每个变量都被计算出来之前，其中的变量值都被视为 0。这包括那些依赖其他修正的值，其中也包括⟦0⟧游戏变量，或使用该游戏变量的 MTTH 变量。

1fzqpbl.en: After the variables are calculated for a single dynamic modifier, the modifiers apply to the scope with the dynamic modifier and the game moves onto the next dynamic modifier added to the current scope until each one is calculated.
1fzqpbl.zh: 在单个动态修正的变量计算完成之后，修正会随该动态修正一并应用到作用域上，随后游戏继续处理添加到当前作用域的下一个动态修正，直到每个动态修正都计算完毕。

1m853is.en: ⟦0⟧ decides what is the icon used for the dynamic modifier. The icon uses a sprite defined in any ⟦1⟧ file. If the icon is not specified, it will be hidden.
1m853is.zh: ⟦0⟧决定动态修正使用哪个图标。该图标使用任意⟦1⟧文件中定义的精灵图。如果未指定图标，它将被隐藏。

zpfl46.en: ⟦0⟧ decides when exactly the dynamic modifier's modifiers apply. If the dynamic modifier is set, but the country or state it's set to does not fulfill the requirements, its effects will not apply. Optional.
zpfl46.zh: ⟦0⟧准确决定动态修正的修正何时生效。如果动态修正已设置，但它所设置到的国家或州不满足要求，其效果就不会生效。可选。

19exjgl.en: ⟦0⟧ will automatically remove the dynamic modifier upon the triggers being met. Optional.
19exjgl.zh: ⟦0⟧会在触发器满足时自动移除该动态修正。可选。

11krsi4.en: ⟦0⟧, with the same syntax, or ⟦1⟧ can be used to remove these from the country.
11krsi4.zh: 可以用相同语法的⟦0⟧，或用⟦1⟧把这些修正从国家上移除。

syno7i.en: For a state, a dynamic modifier will show up in the special section for them in the bottom of the selected state view, marked with ⟦0⟧ in ⟦1⟧.
syno7i.zh: 对于州，动态修正会显示在⟦0⟧中，位于选中州视图底部的专属区域内，在⟦1⟧里标记。

1jdacvd.en: ⟦0⟧ - This primarily includes but is not limited to national spirits and hidden ideas. ⟦1⟧ by using an ⟦2⟧, such as a national focus reward, by using ⟦3⟧ or ⟦4⟧. These only work for countries.
1jdacvd.zh: ⟦0⟧——主要包括但不限于国家精神和隐藏理念。⟦1⟧的方式是使用⟦2⟧（例如国策奖励）、使用⟦3⟧或⟦4⟧。这些只对国家级作用域有效。

uxn78s.en: Dynamic modifiers are then evaluated in the order that they were given to the scope with ⟦0⟧.
uxn78s.zh: 随后动态修正会按照它们通过⟦0⟧赋予作用域的顺序依次求值。

1l4dfhj.en: Modifier definitions allow the creation of a custom modifier, which can be accessed as a variable when you wish to use it. After being defined, they function entirely like a new variable, being possible to read as a variable with the same ⟦0⟧ procedure. They will not have any effect by default and function only as a way to change the variable's value in an additive way with modifier blocks. Each modifier token is defined within ⟦1⟧ files as a separate code block, where the name of the code block serves as the ID of the modifier definition. There are the following arguments that can go inside of it:
1l4dfhj.zh: 修正定义允许创建一个自定义修正，在你想使用它时可以作为变量访问。定义之后，它完全像一个新变量那样运作，可以用相同的⟦0⟧流程作为变量读取。默认情况下它不会有任何效果，只是作为一种通过修正块以加算方式改变该变量数值的手段。每个修正记号都在⟦1⟧文件中定义为一个独立的代码块，代码块的名称即该修正定义的 ID。它内部可以包含以下参数：

onusmr.en: ⟦0⟧ decides the colour of the modifier's value itself. There are three values, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧ is permamently yellow, while ⟦5⟧ turns the positive values ⟦6⟧ and negative values ⟦7⟧. ⟦8⟧ is the reversal of ⟦9⟧.
onusmr.zh: ⟦0⟧决定修正数值本身的颜色。共有三个取值：⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧。⟦4⟧永远是黄色，而⟦5⟧会把正值显示为⟦6⟧、负值显示为⟦7⟧。⟦8⟧则与⟦9⟧相反。

19wa7nw.en: ⟦0⟧ decides the way the number will show up in the tooltip. There are the following values this argument can be set to: number will make the exact value of the modifier show up. 0.02 will show up like "Modifier definition: 0.02". percentage will make the modifier show up as a percentage on the scale from 0 to 1. 0.2 will show up like "Modifier token: 20%". percentage_in_hundred will make the modifier show up as a percentage on the scale from 0 to 100. 10 will show up like "Modifier token: 10%". yes_no shows up as a boolean: anything larger than 1 will shows up as yes, while 0 will show up as no.
19wa7nw.zh: ⟦0⟧决定数字在提示框中的显示方式。该参数可以设为以下取值：number 会显示修正的确切数值，0.02 会显示为“Modifier definition: 0.02”。percentage 会让修正以 0 到 1 为刻度的百分比显示，0.2 会显示为“Modifier token: 20%”。percentage_in_hundred 会让修正以 0 到 100 为刻度的百分比显示，10 会显示为“Modifier token: 10%”。yes_no 以布尔值显示：任何大于 1 的数值都显示为是，而 0 显示为否。

1mgxx0d.en: ⟦0⟧ will make the exact value of the modifier show up. 0.02 will show up like "Modifier definition: 0.02".
1mgxx0d.zh: ⟦0⟧会显示修正的确切数值。0.02 会显示为“Modifier definition: 0.02”。

1v2vsy5.en: ⟦0⟧ will make the modifier show up as a percentage on the scale from 0 to 1. 0.2 will show up like "Modifier token: 20%".
1v2vsy5.zh: ⟦0⟧会让修正以 0 到 1 为刻度的百分比显示。0.2 会显示为“Modifier token: 20%”。

du41pp.en: ⟦0⟧ will make the modifier show up as a percentage on the scale from 0 to 100. 10 will show up like "Modifier token: 10%".
du41pp.zh: ⟦0⟧会让修正以 0 到 100 为刻度的百分比显示。10 会显示为“Modifier token: 10%”。

mzaccy.en: ⟦0⟧ shows up as a boolean: anything larger than 1 will shows up as ⟦1⟧, while 0 will show up as ⟦2⟧.
mzaccy.zh: ⟦0⟧以布尔值显示：任何大于 1 的数值都显示为⟦1⟧，而 0 显示为⟦2⟧。

1q0bxro.en: ⟦0⟧ decides how many numbers will be shown after the period in the tooltip. For example, if it is set to 1, the tooltip will show 0.341 as if it was 0.3. Note that the game inherently does not support more than 3 decimal numbers, so it cannot be larger than 3.
1q0bxro.zh: ⟦0⟧决定提示框中在小数点后显示几位数字。例如，如果设为 1，提示框会把 0.341 显示得如同 0.3。请注意游戏本身不支持超过 3 位小数，因此该值不能大于 3。

yv12bq.en: ⟦0⟧ decides what will be added after the value of the modifier in the tooltip. Allowed values are 'none' (Default), 'days', 'hours', and 'daily'.
yv12bq.zh: ⟦0⟧决定在提示框中修正数值之后附加什么内容。允许的取值为 'none'（默认）、'days'、'hours' 和 'daily'。

1ol6g2i.en: ⟦0⟧ decides on the category of the modifier. By default, the category is 'all', which makes it be in every single category. Certain tooltips will only show modifiers if they belong to a certain category. It is possible to set multiple categories for the same modifier definition by defining them one after another.
1ol6g2i.zh: ⟦0⟧决定该修正的类别。默认类别为 'all'，即属于每一个类别。某些提示框只会显示属于特定类别的修正。可以为同一个修正定义设置多个类别，只需把它们依次定义即可。

13cudmu.en: The modifier definition's ID is also used as the ⟦0⟧ key needed to change the name of the modifier depending on the currently turned on language.
13cudmu.zh: 修正定义的 ID 也被用作⟦0⟧键，以便根据当前开启的语言更改该修正的名称。

152obro.en: The function of modifier definitions is to modify the value of a game variable, which can be read by other variables. You can set a variable to be equal to the sum of all values of the same modifier token in the current scope by doing ⟦0⟧. This example will set var_name to be equal to the total value of modifier_token_name.
152obro.zh: 修正定义的作用是改变某个游戏变量的数值，而该变量可以被其他变量读取。你可以通过执行⟦0⟧，把某个变量设为等于当前作用域中同一修正记号所有数值之和。这个示例会把 var_name 设为等于 modifier_token_name 的总数值。

19g4r4c.en: Note that, unlike countries and states, unit leaders use leader_modifier@modifier_definition_name or unit_modifier@modifier_definition_name in their scopes.
19g4r4c.zh: 请注意，与国家、州不同，单位指挥官在其作用域中使用的是 leader_modifier@modifier_definition_name 或 unit_modifier@modifier_definition_name。

125cgrm.en: Example usage of making a modifier token create civilian factories in random core states monthly, in any on action file:
125cgrm.zh: 让某个修正记号每月在随机的核心州中创建民用工厂的用法示例，可放在任意 on action 文件中：

12q0qyf.en: Despite their name, opinion modifiers are not related to modifiers in any way, instead they are used to modify the diplomatic or economic relations between a pair of countries.
12q0qyf.zh: 尽管名字如此，关系修正与修正本身毫无关系，它们用于改变两个国家之间的外交或经济关系。

1mtj2gh.en: The opinion modifiers are made in any ⟦0⟧ file as an entry in the ⟦1⟧ block, with the name of the entry being the ID of the opinion modifier. In case of there being several entries with the same ID, the one that was ⟦2⟧ will take priority, meaning that copying a base game file is never necessary in a mod.
1mtj2gh.zh: 关系修正在任何⟦0⟧文件中作为⟦1⟧块里的一项创建，该项的名称即该关系修正的 ID。如果存在多个 ID 相同的项，则以⟦2⟧的那一项优先，这意味着在 mod 中永远不需要复制基础游戏的文件。

1l3jt5v.en: evaluated later based on the filename and order in files
1l3jt5v.zh: 根据文件名和文件内顺序在更晚时求值

1rza1nz.en: There are the following attributes that are used in opinion modifiers:
1rza1nz.zh: 关系修正中会用到以下属性：

1gwzsir.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to decide whether the opinion modifier changes the diplomatic relations or the trade opinion from one country to another. If unset, defaults to being false making it diplomatic.
1gwzsir.zh: ⟦0⟧用于决定该关系修正改变的是外交关系还是两国之间的贸易好感度。若未设置，默认为 false，即外交关系。

140wxcz.en: ⟦0⟧ is the value of the modifier that decides by how much the diplomatic or trade opinion should change once the opinion modifier is added.
140wxcz.zh: ⟦0⟧是该修正的数值，决定关系修正被添加后外交或贸易好感度应改变多少。

beskvk.en: ⟦0⟧ details the speed at which the opinion modifier trends towards zero monthly. Optional, defaults to the modifier not changing if unset.
beskvk.zh: ⟦0⟧详细说明该关系修正每月趋向零的速度。可选；若未设置，默认为该修正不变化。

i96afj.en: ⟦0⟧ | ⟦1⟧ | ⟦2⟧ decides the time for how much the opinion modifier should last before it will get automatically removed. A month is interpreted as exactly 30 days, while a year is 365. Optional, the modifier will be permanent if neither is set.
i96afj.zh: ⟦0⟧ | ⟦1⟧ | ⟦2⟧决定该关系修正自动移除之前应持续多久。一个月被解释为恰好 30 天，一年为 365 天。可选；若都未设置，该修正将永久存在。

74lv6y.en: ⟦0⟧ | ⟦1⟧ detail the minimum and maximum value that the opinion modifier can change to. As the only non-hardcoded way to change the value of an existing opinion modifier is through decay, this can be used to limit how far it can apply.
74lv6y.zh: ⟦0⟧ | ⟦1⟧详细说明该关系修正可以变化到的最小值和最大值。由于改变现有关系修正数值的唯一非硬编码方式是通过衰减，这可用于限制其适用幅度。

1e7p1kw.en: The ⟦0⟧ is created in any ⟦1⟧ file encoded in UTF-8 using the byte order mark (aka UTF-8-BOM), with the localisation key being the name of the modifier.
1e7p1kw.zh: ⟦0⟧创建于任意⟦1⟧文件中，使用带字节顺序标记的 UTF-8 编码（即 UTF-8-BOM），其本地化键即该修正的名称。

1ju3axr.en: New opinion modifiers can only be added using the ⟦0⟧ (or the similar ⟦1⟧) in any effect block, such as a ⟦2⟧, a ⟦3⟧, or an idea's ⟦4⟧. Similarly, already applied new opinion modifiers can only be removed with ⟦5⟧. When ⟦6⟧ is used to apply an opinion modifier, only the country where the effect is executed will change its opinion towards the target.
1ju3axr.zh: 新的关系修正只能通过在任意效果块中使用⟦0⟧（或类似的⟦1⟧）来添加，例如⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧或理念的⟦4⟧。同样，已施加的新关系修正也只能用⟦5⟧移除。使用⟦6⟧施加关系修正时，只有执行该效果的国家会改变其对目标国的好感度。

17gcptd.en: There is no way to use a modifier block to directly apply an opinion modifier, but it can be simulated by adding or removing an opinion modifier at the same time the modifier block's effects are. For example, this national spirit would simulate applying an opinion modifier towards every other country that has the idea:
17gcptd.zh: 无法用修正块直接施加关系修正，但可以在修正块效果生效的同时添加或移除关系修正来模拟。例如，这个国家精神会模拟对每一个拥有该理念的其他国家施加关系修正：

1ia9ssk.en: Example code of a national spirit that uses opinion modifiers
1ia9ssk.zh: 使用关系修正的国家精神示例代码

a155yp.en: ideas = { country = { idea_opinion_modifier = { on_add = { # Note: Doesn't work if the idea is added within country history or a bookmark's effect. every_other_country = { # If it's added in country history, then replicate the effects there as well. limit = { has_idea = idea_opinion_modifier } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } } } on_remove = { every_other_country = { limit = { has_idea = idea_opinion_modifier } remove_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } ROOT = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } } } } modifier = { custom_modifier_tooltip = add_opinion_modifier_tt # Since on_add/on_remove aren't shown to the player } } } }
a155yp.zh: ideas = { country = { idea_opinion_modifier = { on_add = { # 注意：如果该理念是在国家历史或书签的效果中添加的，则不会生效。every_other_country = { # 如果在国家历史中添加，则也要在那里复制这些效果。limit = { has_idea = idea_opinion_modifier } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } } } on_remove = { every_other_country = { limit = { has_idea = idea_opinion_modifier } remove_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } ROOT = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = test_diplomatic_modifier } } } } modifier = { custom_modifier_tooltip = add_opinion_modifier_tt # 因为 on_add/on_remove 不会显示给玩家 } } } }

w8f5pn.en: The list of modifiers may be outdated. A complete, but unsorted, list of modifiers can be found in ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧.
w8f5pn.zh: 修正列表可能已过时。完整但未排序的修正列表可在⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧中找到。

1ribwkm.en: Changes the monthly population gain in states owned by the country.
1ribwkm.zh: 改变该国所拥有州的每月人口增长。

1e06bh5.en: Changes speed at which nukes are produced.

9edkqi.en: Works in state scope, in which case it'll apply to the owner.
9edkqi.zh: 在州作用域中也有效，此时会作用于其所有者。

wypnd8.en: Changes the bonus in research speed per country when technology sharing.
wypnd8.zh: 改变科技共享时每个国家提供的研究速度加成。

ox82v2.en: Changes the bonus in research speed per country when technology sharing by a percentage.
ox82v2.zh: 按百分比改变科技共享时每个国家提供的研究速度加成。

nkve6d.en: Changes the speed that special projects are completed.
nkve6d.zh: 改变特殊项目的完成速度。

k9g30n.en: Resource extraction efficiency. Modifies the amount of available resources.
k9g30n.zh: 资源开采效率。修改可用资源的数量。

ko53bu.en: Changes the percentage of victory points the country needs to lose control of to capitulate.
ko53bu.zh: 改变该国要投降所需失去控制的胜利点百分比。

m6gzu5.en: The larger, the more victory points are needed to capitulate a country.
m6gzu5.zh: 数值越大，使一个国家投降所需的胜利点越多。

1492zow.en: Controls the maximum surrender progress of a nation.
1492zow.zh: 控制一个国家的最大投降进度。

11u2atm.en: For example, 0.4 means that the country cannot require more than 60% victory points to capitulate, no matter the surrender_limit.
11u2atm.zh: 例如，0.4 表示无论 surrender_limit 如何，该国投降所需控制的胜利点都不能超过 60%。

ex89g4.en: Changes the percentage of victory points the country needs to lose control of to capitulate, bypassing the minimum or maximum.
ex89g4.zh: 改变该国要投降所需失去控制的胜利点百分比，且绕过最小值或最大值。

cyfa2e.en: The larger, the more victory points are needed to capitulate a country. Applied after the minimum and maximum are applied, leading to making it possible to have it below ⟦0⟧ or above the maximum defined with max_surrender_limit_offset.
cyfa2e.zh: 数值越大，使一个国家投降所需的胜利点越多。它在最小值和最大值应用之后才生效，因此可能低于⟦0⟧，或高于用 max_surrender_limit_offset 定义的最大值。

1a9bt44.en: Directly modifies the country's resource stockpile.
1a9bt44.zh: 直接修改该国的资源储备。

9mxo6y.en: Modifies the country's cost to buy resources from others.
9mxo6y.zh: 修改该国向他国购买资源的成本。

153c6if.en: A positive value will grant more resources for the same amount of factories traded while a negative amount will do the opposite. Does not affect other countries buying resources from the one modified.
153c6if.zh: 正值会在交易同等数量工厂时获得更多资源，负值则相反。它不影响其他国家从被修改国购买资源。

hue9ra.en: Directly modifies the country's energy usage per factory
hue9ra.zh: 直接修改该国每座工厂的能源用量

1598zh8.en: Changes the amount of resources to market.
1598zh8.zh: 改变投放市场的资源数量。

lhzkpc.en: Makes AI more likely to purchase resources from this country.
lhzkpc.zh: 使 AI 更有可能从该国购买资源。

1gahcsi.en: Changes the penalty to the stability invoked by participating in a defensive war.
1gahcsi.zh: 改变因参与防御战争而受到的稳定度惩罚。

r106gc.en: Disables manually changing ideas (including ministers and laws).
r106gc.zh: 禁止手动更改理念（包括大臣与法令）。

14rer9n.en: Changes the cost in political power to add an idea or character within the specified slot.
14rer9n.zh: 改变在指定槽位中添加理念或人物所需的政治点数花费。

oox19t.en: Idea slots can be found in common/idea_tags. ⟦0⟧
oox19t.zh: 理念槽位可在 common/idea_tags 中找到。⟦0⟧

ln0ib1.en: Requires an idea or a character of that category to be present in an earlier-evaluated file.
ln0ib1.zh: 需要在更早求值的文件中存在该类别的一个理念或人物。

16bmh4c.en: Changes the cost in army experience to add an idea within any of the categories with the specified type.
16bmh4c.zh: 改变在具有指定类型的任一类别中添加理念所需的陆军经验花费。

1th8k4f.en: Idea category definitions can be found in ⟦0⟧ files, a type is assigned with ⟦1⟧.
1th8k4f.zh: 理念类别定义可在⟦0⟧文件中找到，类型通过⟦1⟧指定。

jou5rv.en: Changes the cost in political power to add an advisor assigned the specified military ledger.
jou5rv.zh: 改变添加被指派了指定军事分类的顾问所需的政治点数花费。

82beg1.en: Ledgers are assigned to categories and characters in common/idea_tags and common/ideas. Modifier works with air, army, and navy.
82beg1.zh: 分类在 common/idea_tags 和 common/ideas 中被指派给类别和人物。该修正适用于空军、陆军和海军。

1797d8i.en: Changes the cost in command power to turn a unit leader into an advisor.
1797d8i.zh: 改变把单位指挥官转为顾问所需的指挥点数花费。

n2sf6j.en: Changes the cost in political power to maintain improvement of relations.
n2sf6j.zh: 改变维持改善关系所需的政治点数花费。

2hu1k4.en: Changes the chance for a randomly-generated country leader to be female.
2hu1k4.zh: 改变随机生成的国家领袖为女性的几率。

1h5s0b.en: Modifies the stability penalty received from participating in an offensive war.
1h5s0b.zh: 修改因参与进攻战争而受到的稳定度惩罚。

xmjd11.en: Modifies the stability gained by the popularity of the ruling party.
xmjd11.zh: 修改执政党支持率所带来的稳定度。

1jru8eo.en: Modifies daily gain in political power.
1jru8eo.zh: 修改每日政治点数增益。

150wttu.en: Modifies daily gain in political power by a percentage.
150wttu.zh: 按百分比修改每日政治点数增益。

1bfo6p6.en: Modifies weekly stability gain of the country.
1bfo6p6.zh: 修改该国的每周稳定度增益。

1iih37c.en: Modifies weekly stability gain of the country by a percentage.
1iih37c.zh: 按百分比修改该国的每周稳定度增益。

15yilg8.en: Modifies the stability loss caused by being at war.
15yilg8.zh: 修改因处于战争状态而造成的稳定度损失。

1aqcw1g.en: Modifies war support of the country.
1aqcw1g.zh: 修改该国的战争支持度。

109x48g.en: Modifies weekly war support gain of the country.
109x48g.zh: 修改该国的每周战争支持度增益。

e72ujm.en: Modifies weekly war support gain of the country by a percentage.
e72ujm.zh: 按百分比修改该国的每周战争支持度增益。

18epju2.en: Modifies weekly war support gain of the country depending on the casualties suffered by it.
18epju2.zh: 根据该国所受的伤亡修改其每周战争支持度增益。

jl6je0.en: Modifies weekly war support gain of the country depending on the amount of its convoys that have been sunk.
jl6je0.zh: 根据该国被击沉的运输船队数量修改其每周战争支持度增益。

22ky0d.en: Modifies weekly war support gain of the country depending on the enemy bombing of its states.

1y1847x.en: Each Faction Theater requires a Theater Commander. A country that owns a Faction Theater may assign any of its Field Marshals or Admirals as the Theater Commander. A Theater Commander and its Theater is assigned to a number of regions and countries, depending on the commander's skill level. The Theater Commander will only give bonuses to divisions controlled by the countries selected, within the regions it has been assigned. The Theater Commander's country receives a portion of the Mastery earned by other faction members in the theater based on the commander's Attack and Defense skills. Selected countries in a theater receive a bonus to land and naval Supply Consumption, based on the commander's Planning and Logistics, or Maneuvering and Coordination skills. An Admiral will convey a higher bonus to naval supply consumption, whereas a Field Marshal will convey a better bonus to land supply consumption.

10iu7gh.en: Most nations are able to join factions by default, this is however not true for all of them. Besides certain nations simply lacking the game rule that allows them to join a faction, in most cases countries that are already faction leader also cannot join other factions. However, certain factions have the rule "can_leader_join_other_factions = yes". Leaders of such factions can join other factions (as long as they fulfill the other conditions of the faction they want to join of course). If a faction leader does this; they aswell as all their subject will join the new faction, while their old faction will be completely disbanded.
10iu7gh.zh: 大多数国家默认都能加入阵营，但并非所有国家都如此。除了某些国家单纯缺少允许其加入阵营的游戏规则外，在多数情况下，已经身为阵营领袖的国家也不能加入其他阵营。不过，某些阵营拥有“can_leader_join_other_factions = yes”这条规则。此类阵营的领袖可以加入其他阵营（当然前提是满足其想加入阵营的其他条件）。如果某阵营领袖这样做，那么他本人及其所有附属国都会加入新阵营，而其原有阵营将被完全解散。

16is67w.en: Faction members can make their Experimental Facilities into Joint Research Facilities at a cost of 1 ⟦0⟧ per facility. Only 3 Joint Research Facility may be assigned at a time, though they can be unassigned by its owner without any cost. Other faction members can assign Scientists to Joint Research Facilities to them as Supportive Scientists for 25 ⟦1⟧. A Supportive Scientist will work at 25% effectiveness at the facility, as well as earning 10% progress to a project in their own country for each iteration completed.
16is67w.zh: 阵营成员可以花 1 点⟦0⟧把各自的实验设施改建为联合研究设施。同一时间最多只能指派 3 个联合研究设施，不过其所有者可以无代价地取消指派。其他阵营成员可以花 25 点⟦1⟧向它们指派科学家作为支援科学家。一名支援科学家在该设施中以 25% 的效率工作，同时每完成一次迭代都会为本国的一个项目贡献 10% 的进度。

drswu0.en: A country may only form a new faction if the respective country rule is enabled. At the start of the game the four existing faction leaders Germany, the ⟦0⟧ and the ⟦1⟧, along with the ⟦2⟧, have this rule. Other nations gain the capability to form their own factions through their national focus trees. Joining a faction is again limited by country rules. Depending on ideology and national spirits, countries need various amounts of world tension before they can join or ask someone to join a faction.
drswu0.zh: 只有在相应国家规则启用时，一个国家才能组建新阵营。游戏开始时，现有的四个阵营领袖——德国、⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧，以及⟦2⟧——拥有该规则。其他国家通过各自的国策树获得组建本国阵营的能力。加入阵营同样受国家规则限制。视意识形态和国家精神而定，国家在加入阵营或邀请他人加入阵营之前需要达到不同的世界紧张度。

1cdtouy.en: If a country fights alongside ⟦0⟧ allies, it will only surrender once all of the majors in the faction have capitulated. For instance if ⟦1⟧ joined the Allies, it will not surrender before the United Kingdom and ⟦2⟧ capitulate, and will instead continue on as a government-in-exile. Inversely that also means that a Poland that manages to fight off Germany will nevertheless be forced to surrender, should Germany somehow capitulate France and Great Britain.
1cdtouy.zh: 如果一个国家与⟦0⟧盟友并肩作战，那么只有当该阵营中所有主要国家都已投降后，它才会投降。例如，如果⟦1⟧加入了同盟国，那么在英国和⟦2⟧投降之前它不会投降，而是会继续作为流亡政府存在。反过来说，这也意味着：即使某国成功击退了德国，只要德国设法使法国和英国投降，它仍将被迫投降。

16x46sr.en: Faction members can choose to leave a faction, but this causes a significant relations modifier ⟦0⟧ (-75 relations). A faction member cannot leave while fighting a war on the side of other members. The faction leader may kick another country out even while at war or disband the faction altogether if it contains no other members than themselves and their subjects. If the faction leader ceases to exist, the largest remaining member takes over.
16x46sr.zh: 阵营成员可以选择退出阵营，但这会造成显著的关系修正⟦0⟧（-75 关系）。阵营成员在与其他成员一同作战期间不能退出。阵营领袖即使处于战争状态也可以把另一个国家踢出阵营，或者在该阵营除自己和自己的附属国外再无其他成员时完全解散它。如果阵营领袖不复存在，则由剩余成员中最大的一个接管。

ayoeh3.en: Faction Theaters are coordinated regions led by a Theater Commander. The number of regions and participating countries depends on the commanders Skill Level. Commanders gain Experience and their nations gain Doctrine Mastery from allied combat within their Theater. A faction can have a maximum of 4 Faction Theaters. Each costs 1 ⟦0⟧ to unlock and is owned by the country that unlocks it.
ayoeh3.zh: 阵营战区是由战区司令协调的区域。区域数量和参与国家数量取决于该指挥官的技能等级。指挥官可从其战区内的盟军作战中获得经验，其国家则可获得学说精通。一个阵营最多可以有 4 个阵营战区。解锁每个战区需花费 1 点⟦0⟧，并由解锁它的国家拥有。

z73e1n.en: Faction members will gain a research bonus for technologies already unlocked by other member states. The research bonus starts at 0% and increases by 5% for every Supportive Scientist in the faction, multiplied by the number of member countries that have unlocked the technology, at a maximum of 50%. Note that the ⟦0⟧ already start with Technology Sharing via ⟦1⟧.

1d3qoib.en: Every faction starts with a set of rules that define how its members can join/leave or even conduct themselves internationally. Rules may be changed by spending ⟦0⟧, but some can only be edited if various conditions are fulfilled. Enacting or removing a rule costs 1 ⟦1⟧.

120w55k.en: A faction leader is the leader of a ⟦0⟧. The default faction leaders in-game are the ⟦1⟧ leading the ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧ leading the ⟦4⟧, the ⟦5⟧ leading the ⟦6⟧ and the ⟦7⟧ leading the ⟦8⟧. They are usually joined by ⟦9⟧ leading the ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧ leading the ⟦12⟧.
120w55k.zh: 阵营领袖是⟦0⟧的领袖。游戏中的默认阵营领袖是：⟦1⟧领导⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧领导⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧领导⟦6⟧，以及⟦7⟧领导⟦8⟧。通常还会有⟦9⟧领导⟦10⟧，以及⟦11⟧领导⟦12⟧加入它们。

1li9l00.en: With La Résistance DLC, Satellites, Dominions, Imperial Subjects, and Supervised States can contribute spies to a spymaster.

4kfuyb.en: Personal Unions are a unique subject type, currently available only for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ Germany and ⟦2⟧ through their focus trees. They are one time creations that cannot be regained should the subject be lost. Personal Unions cannot be annexed, furthermore should they increase their autonomy, they will break free.
4kfuyb.zh: 君合国是一种独特的附属国类型，目前只有⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧德国和⟦2⟧可以通过各自的国策树获得。它们是一次性创建的，一旦失去该附属国就无法重新获得。君合国不能被吞并；此外，如果它们提高自治度，就会挣脱独立。

852l01.en: Should ⟦0⟧ ever become the overlord of any of these nations, it can manually decrease their autonomy level to become "Nordic defense council members", even if they were not gained through the "The Nordic Defense Council" focuses. This however also means, that ⟦1⟧ can never diplomatically annex another Nordic nation.
852l01.zh: 如果⟦0⟧成为这些国家中任何一个的宗主国，它可以手动把它们的自治度降低到“北欧防御理事会成员”，即使它们并非通过“北欧防御理事会”国策获得。不过这也意味着，⟦1⟧永远无法通过外交吞并另一个北欧国家。

iinee8.en: A subject lend-leasing equipment to their overlord will raise their autonomy by 1 for every 20 ⟦0⟧ of the transferred equipment.⟦1⟧ The equipment must be as good as the best the overlord can produce (or better), so dumping obsolete equipment to an overlord does not their weaken authority over the puppet.
iinee8.zh: 附属国向宗主国租借装备时，每转移 100 点⟦0⟧的装备会使其自治度提高 1。⟦1⟧ 装备必须至少与宗主国能生产的最好装备相当（或更好），因此把过时装备倾销给宗主国并不会削弱宗主国对该傀儡国的控制。

4yyl9w.en: If an overlord ⟦0⟧ for some of one of their subject's resources, the subject gains 0.005⟦1⟧ autonomy per day per resource exported. Note that it does not matter how much of those resources the overlord ends up actively using, only how much they receive from ⟦2⟧ with their puppet.
4yyl9w.zh: 如果宗主国⟦0⟧某个附属国的部分资源，该附属国每出口一种资源每天获得 0.005 点⟦1⟧自治度。请注意，宗主国最终实际使用了多少这些资源并不重要，重要的是它通过⟦2⟧从傀儡国那里获得了多少。

1aqfvl2.en: Subjects gain autonomy for their contributions to their overlord's wars roughly equivalent to 60%⟦0⟧ of the war score they generate.⟦1⟧
1aqfvl2.zh: 附属国会因其对宗主国战争的贡献而获得自治度，大致相当于其产生的战争分数的 60%⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧

1x6a6eg.en: The continuous focus ⟦0⟧ lowers all subjects' autonomy by 0.5 daily, while the focus ⟦1⟧ raises it by 0.5 daily for the subject taking the focus. If both focuses are active at the same time, they will cancel each other out.
1x6a6eg.zh: 持续国策⟦0⟧会使所有附属国的自治度每天降低 0.5，而国策⟦1⟧会使采取该国的附属国自治度每天提高 0.5。如果两个国策同时生效，它们会互相抵消。

hsdf6u.en: Several nation-specific focuses and ⟦0⟧ increase or decrease autonomy - currently, these are limited to the ⟦1⟧, Commonwealth nations, the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧.
hsdf6u.zh: 若干国家专属国策和⟦0⟧会提高或降低自治度——目前仅限于⟦1⟧、英联邦国家、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧。

3h1jdo.en: If an overlord capitulates (to anyone), all of their subjects immediately gain autonomy equal to 50%⟦0⟧ of the total amount of autonomy that would be required for them to progress to their next tier. This is normally 500 autonomy. For fascist overlords who have fewer puppet tiers with much larger autonomy ranges, if they capitulate, their subjects can gain a lot more autonomy.
3h1jdo.zh: 如果宗主国投降（向任何人），其所有附属国会立即获得相当于提升到下一等级所需自治度总量 50%⟦0⟧的自治度。这通常是 500 点自治度。对于傀儡国等级较少、但各等级自治度区间大得多的法西斯宗主国，如果它们投降，其附属国可能获得多得多的自治度。

1ud1rhz.en: For ⟦0⟧ overlords who have fewer puppet tiers with much larger autonomy ranges, if they capitulate, their subjects can gain a lot more autonomy.
1ud1rhz.zh: 对于傀儡国等级较少、但各等级自治度区间大得多的⟦0⟧宗主国，如果它们投降，其附属国可能获得多得多的自治度。

12dhqxi.en: An overlord sending an attaché to their puppet reduces autonomy by 0.05 per day,⟦0⟧ whereas a puppet sending an attaché to their overlord generates 0.05 autonomy points per day.⟦1⟧
12dhqxi.zh: 宗主国向自己的傀儡国派遣武官每天降低 0.05 点自治度，⟦0⟧而傀儡国向宗主国派遣武官每天产生 0.05 点自治度。⟦1⟧

1br3put.en: An overlord lend-leasing equipment to a subject lowers autonomy by 1 for every 100 ⟦0⟧ of the transferred equipment.⟦1⟧ For example, giving 1000 Infantry Weapons I (unit cost 0.5 ) will lower autonomy by (1000 * 0.5 / 100) = 5 units. The equipment must be at least as good as the best equipment of that type the subject can produce with its own technology (or better) and can not be foreign-made (neither lend-leased nor captured), so ⟦2⟧ (lend leasing obsolete equipment from a master to a puppet might decrease the puppet's autonomy. This master-to-puppet effect needs to be confirmed. In one posting in the Bug Report forum, the British lend-leased 10000 basic infantry equipment to the British Raj, lowering the Raj's autonomy by 30).
1br3put.zh: 宗主国向附属国租借装备时，每转让 100⟦0⟧装备，自治度降低 1 点。⟦1⟧例如，给予 1000 单位步兵装备 I（单位成本 0.5），自治度将降低 (1000 * 0.5 / 100) = 5 点。该装备必须至少与附属国凭自身科技所能生产的最好同类装备相当（或更好），且不能是外国制造（既非租借而来，也非缴获）。因此⟦2⟧（宗主国向傀儡国租借过时装备可能会降低傀儡国的自治度。这一宗主国对傀儡国的效果尚待确认。在 Bug 报告论坛的一则帖子中，英国向英属印度租借了 10000 单位基础步兵装备，使印度的自治度下降了 30）。

1ywprez.en: An alternative method of achieving independence is to increase autonomy to a sufficient degree. One may accomplish this by providing the puppet master with any type of equipment through the Lend-Lease program. In response, the puppet master may attempt to diminish the autonomy of the nation in question by initiating construction projects within its borders or, if consent is granted, by providing loans or other forms of financial assistance. It can be concluded that the attainment of independence through a peaceful process is feasible with the implementation of the Together For Victory strategy; however, it is a protracted and intricate procedure.
1ywprez.zh: 实现独立的另一种方式是使自治度提升到足够程度。可以通过租借计划向宗主国提供任何类型的装备来实现。作为回应，宗主国可能会在其境内发起建设项目来削弱该国的自治度，或在获得同意的情况下提供贷款或其他形式的财政援助。可以得出结论：在启用《共赴胜利》策略的情况下，通过和平进程实现独立是可行的；不过这是一个漫长而复杂的过程。

rnjo2t.en: There's also a weird "non-existent puppet" or "virtual puppet" bug. If you release a puppet, all currently controlled states of which are your cores (e.g. Papal States for ⟦0⟧, Occitania for France), while keeping cores, puppet is technically released but doesn't receive any states. This results in puppet existing only "on paper", without physical representation on map; so much as ⟦1⟧ them requires quick double-click in Open Country List. Such non-existent puppets do give small benefits, as they do their own research, but do clutter the interface.
rnjo2t.zh: 还存在一个奇怪的「不存在的傀儡国」或「虚拟傀儡国」bug。若你释放一个傀儡国，而其当前控制的所有州都是你的核心州（例如⟦0⟧的教宗国、法国的奥克西塔尼亚），在保留核心州的同时，傀儡国在技术上已被释放，但没有获得任何州。这导致傀儡国只「存在于纸面上」，在地图上没有实体表现；以至于要在国家列表中快速双击才能⟦1⟧它。这类不存在的傀儡国确实会带来少量好处，因为它们会自行研究，但会让界面变得杂乱。

1qqk9oh.en: Once hostilities commence, the newly independent government will be engaged in armed conflict with the original puppet government, which may still seek assistance from the puppet master. The outcome of this struggle for independence is contingent upon the rebels' ability to overpower both the master and the loyalists. Should the puppet succeed, they will be presented with the opportunity to assume control of their former overlord.
1qqk9oh.zh: 敌对行动一旦开始，新独立的政府将与原傀儡国政府陷入武装冲突，而后者可能仍会向宗主国寻求援助。这场独立斗争的结局取决于叛军能否同时压倒宗主国与效忠派。若傀儡国成功，它将有机会接管其原宗主国。

1x754pv.en: The ⟦0⟧ level caps at 1000 ⟦1⟧, and disallows freedom. ⟦2⟧ can only become free via national focus. Furthermore, ⟦3⟧ can only raise their autonomy level from ⟦4⟧ to ⟦5⟧ after completing either Strengthen the Concordia Association or Obedience. To gain the ⟦6⟧ level, ⟦7⟧ can either complete the focus Assertiveness to immediately become one, or can manually become one after completing The Two Emperors or Claim Outer Manchuria
1x754pv.zh: ⟦0⟧等级上限为 1000⟦1⟧，且不允许获得自由。⟦2⟧只能通过国策获得自由。此外，⟦3⟧只有在完成「加强协和会」或「服从」之后，才能将自治等级从⟦4⟧提升到⟦5⟧。要获得⟦6⟧等级，⟦7⟧可以完成国策「自信」以立即成为该等级，或在完成「两位皇帝」或「索取外满洲」后手动成为该等级。

1gadw8w.en: It is possible for puppets to break free from their puppet masters. However, this cannot be done peacefully if the player wishes to do it swiftly. One potential method for achieving this would be to provide increased support for a different ideology than that espoused by the current government, utilizing political advisors and triggering a civil war as a means of liberating oneself from the existing authority structure.
1gadw8w.zh: 傀儡国是有可能挣脱其宗主国的。但如果玩家希望迅速达成，就无法通过和平方式实现。一种可行的方法是为与当前政府不同的意识形态提供更多支持，利用政治顾问并引发内战，以此从现有权力结构中解放自己。

mg7gna.en: When a country is part of a research group, it gets a research speed bonus for each other country in the group that has already unlocked that technology, up to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ Tech sharing bonus functions in the same way as Limited-use bonus: once applied, the bonus is locked to the tech; changes in the country's tech sharing situation will only reflect in future research. 5y131n.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a collection of ⟦1⟧ that can be assigned to and led by a ⟦2⟧. It is either an army or an army group. A command group is tied to the theater in which it operates.

11rx924.zh: 关于海军集团军，参见舰队。

262k15.en: The composition of each division is specified by its division template. Each country starts with one or more division templates that may be used to order recruiting and deployment of new land units. Division templates may be created and modified by spending army experience. New templates may be created by either using the Duplicate button to make a duplicate of a template, giving it a name different from existing templates, and then making modifications to a template as described below, or by selecting the name and pressing "Create Empty". Certain technologies that unlock new battalion types, such as mountaineers, also create basic templates for them. Land experience is not charged until the changes are saved using the Save button on which the total cost is also shown, so players can experiment and analyze the results of changes before making a decision.
262k15.zh: 每个师的编成由其师编制决定。每个国家开局都有一个或多个师编制，可用于下达新陆军单位的招募与部署命令。师编制可通过消耗陆军经验来创建和修改。创建新编制的方式有两种：一是使用「复制」按钮复制某个编制，给它取一个与现有编制不同的名称，然后按下文所述对该编制进行修改；二是选中名称后按「创建空白」。某些解锁新营类型的科技（例如山地兵）也会为其生成基础编制。陆军经验只有在使用「保存」按钮保存修改时才会扣除，该按钮上同时显示总花费，因此玩家可以在做决定之前反复试验并分析修改结果。

111py0t.en: The ⟦0⟧ is the primary ⟦1⟧ depicted on the map during gameplay. Divisions operate inside of a ⟦2⟧, may be transported via naval invasion, and may participate in land combat.
111py0t.zh: ⟦0⟧是游戏过程中在地图上显示的主要⟦1⟧。师在⟦2⟧内作战，可通过海军入侵运输，并可参与陆战。

rmz4nz.en: Mines have ⟦0⟧, and the AI pays little attention to mines. They will only perform minimal minesweeping efforts at most, regardless of how many mines there are. It is thereby possible to gain a strong naval advantage over the AI through extensive mining. The resulting naval supremacy can be useful for facilitating naval invasions, as well.
rmz4nz.zh: 水雷具有⟦0⟧，而 AI 几乎不关注水雷。无论水雷数量多少，AI 最多只会进行最低限度的扫雷。因此，通过大规模布雷有可能对 AI 取得显著的海军优势。由此获得的海军霸主地位也有助于实施海军入侵。

2x8rnu.en: To minimise convoy losses, it is important for a fleet performing convoy escort to achieve 100% escort efficiency. Escort efficiency is a function of ⟦0⟧ of ships rather than quality; the weakest possible destroyer will contribute exactly as much escort efficiency as a battleship would.
2x8rnu.zh: 为把运输船队损失降到最低，执行护航任务的舰队达成 100% 护航效率十分重要。护航效率取决于舰船的⟦0⟧而非质量；最弱的驱逐舰与战列舰提供的护航效率完全相同。

jtdj3s.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ on Asian states and only if The Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere is complete and the option "The Emperors supreme Authority must always come first!" has been chosen.
jtdj3s.zh: 仅限⟦0⟧在亚洲州上拥有⟦1⟧时使用，且必须已完成「大东亚共荣圈」并选择了「天皇的最高权威必须始终至上！」这一选项。

u8u7kv.en: ⟦0⟧ consists of the deployment of air wings to ⟦1⟧, where they can undertake ⟦2⟧ targeting enemy air forces, ⟦3⟧, naval units or buildings. Given that air warfare is the only type that directly affects all three types of combat (on top of the strategic targeting), the air war is something the player must take into account when devising successful strategies.
u8u7kv.zh: ⟦0⟧指的是把航空队部署到⟦1⟧，在那里它们可以执行⟦2⟧，以敌方空军、⟦3⟧、海军单位或建筑为目标。鉴于空战是唯一能直接影响全部三种战斗类型（外加战略打击）的形式，玩家在制定成功战略时必须把空战纳入考量。

116766x.en: Using carrier fleets might also be very useful if the region has a coast where the player can (safely) anchor the fleet. Especially if the attack on the region is being carried out by a ⟦0⟧. The carrier fleet can carry out the multiple roles of protecting the transport convoys, and providing shore bombardment.
116766x.zh: 如果该地区有海岸可供（安全）锚泊舰队，使用航母舰队也会非常有用。特别是在由⟦0⟧执行对该地区的进攻时。航母舰队可以同时承担保护运输船队和提供舰炮支援等多重角色。

1a9ckoo.en: ⟦0⟧ act as additional, floating air bases. Their capacity is determined by the deck size stat of the ship. Most carriers can only support carrier-capable aircraft, though ice carriers can support all types of planes.
1a9ckoo.zh: ⟦0⟧可作为额外的浮动空军基地。其容量由舰船的飞行甲板规模属性决定。大多数航母只能搭载舰载型飞机，不过冰上航母可以搭载所有类型的飞机。

1f7n1xv.en: Air wings are a ⟦0⟧ of planes forming an air unit attached to an air base. A new air wing is deployed from the air base screen. An air wing may be created only if there are sufficient planes and ⟦1⟧ available.
1f7n1xv.zh: 航空队是由飞机组成的⟦0⟧，构成一个隶属于空军基地的空军单位。新航空队从空军基地界面部署。只有在飞机与⟦1⟧都充足时才能创建航空队。

199cpc6.en: Air combat has a chance of generating aces. An air wing may be assigned up to one ace only. For a list of aces by country, see ⟦0⟧.
199cpc6.zh: 空战有几率产生王牌。一个航空队最多只能指派一名王牌。按国家分列的王牌列表见⟦0⟧。

1177xnd.en: When the training process finishes, the unit automatically deploys with experience level ⟦0⟧ (no combat modifier) at the selected location.⟦1⟧ If the division already reached the minimum training level (20%⟦2⟧ by default), it can be deployed early, but it will only have experience level ⟦3⟧ (⟦4⟧ combat modifier) and experience progress towards ⟦5⟧ depending to its training progress. At the cost of equipment, spawned divisions can be exercised on the map to increase their experience up to ⟦6⟧ level (⟦7⟧ combat modifier).⟦8⟧
1177xnd.zh: 训练过程结束后，单位会自动以经验等级⟦0⟧（无战斗修正）在选定位置部署。⟦1⟧如果该师已达到最低训练水平（默认 20%⟦2⟧），可以提前部署，但它只会具有经验等级⟦3⟧（⟦4⟧战斗修正），并根据训练进度获得朝⟦5⟧积累的经验进度。以消耗装备为代价，已生成的师可以在地图上进行操练，将其经验提升至⟦6⟧级（⟦7⟧战斗修正）。⟦8⟧

1wlge1p.en: The Recruit & Deploy screen (⟦0⟧) allows viewing and controlling the flow of ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ into new and existing ⟦3⟧ as well as lend-lease. Deployments can be created from division templates to form new divisions. Deployments, reinforcements, and upgrades can be set to low, medium, or high priority to determine which units get equipment and manpower first in the event of a shortage or the latest update of an equipment.
1wlge1p.zh: 「招募与部署」界面（⟦0⟧）可用于查看和控制⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧流入新建及现有⟦3⟧的情况，以及租借。可根据师编制创建部署以组建新师。部署、补充与升级可设为低、中、高优先级，以决定在装备短缺或装备更新时哪些单位优先获得装备与人力。

1qolae8.en: A division cannot be deployed immediately and must first complete training. Once sufficient ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are available to the training division, the division will gradually gain experience. If training is halted due to shortages of manpower or equipment, the equipment status bar will turn yellow. Training speed depends on the division template and can be modified by certain national ideas.
1qolae8.zh: 师无法立即部署，必须先完成训练。一旦训练中的师获得足够的⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧，该师就会逐渐获得经验。如果因人力或装备短缺而中止训练，装备状态条会变为黄色。训练速度取决于师编制，并可由某些国家理念修正。

j2wmy0.en: Manpower reinforcements arrive in chunks of 10%⟦0⟧ of the division's maximum manpower (less if not enough free manpower is available). The arrival time of each chunk depends on the delivery speed, which is 10⟦1⟧ manpower per hour times the supply area's ⟦2⟧ (which is normally close to 1).
j2wmy0.zh: 人力补充以该师最大人力的 10%⟦0⟧为单位成批到达（可用空闲人力不足时则更少）。每批的到达时间取决于输送速度，即每小时 10⟦1⟧人力乘以补给区的⟦2⟧（通常接近 1）。

1ewgd1t.en: ⟦0⟧ can be converted into ⟦1⟧ for base cost of 4000,⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ can be converted into ⟦4⟧ for base cost of 9000.⟦5⟧ The base cost is modified by economy laws and can be futher modified by ⟦6⟧ and political advisors. To convert a factory, simply click on the corresponding state and hover over the factory that is to be converted. Alternatiely, use the convert button in the construction tab, and conversions will appear in the tab, just like any other building project.
1ewgd1t.zh: ⟦0⟧可以转换为⟦1⟧，基础成本 4000⟦2⟧；⟦3⟧可以转换为⟦4⟧，基础成本 9000。⟦5⟧基础成本受经济法案修正，还可进一步由⟦6⟧和政治顾问修正。要转换工厂，只需点击相应的州，然后将鼠标悬停在要转换的工厂上。或者，使用建造标签页中的转换按钮，转换项目会像其他建筑项目一样出现在该标签页中。

4uzb0d.en: ⟦0⟧: the amount of production that can be sent to the target country can be a fixed number of units out of the monthly production or a percentage of the monthly production, but not both at the same time. It's possible to modify the Lend lease at will. For further discussion of Lend-lease, refer to the corresponding section.
4uzb0d.zh: ⟦0⟧：可送往目标国的产量可以是每月产量中的固定单位数，也可以是每月产量的百分比，但不能同时使用两者。租借可以随意修改。关于租借的进一步讨论，请参阅相应章节。

1en2k3y.en: Starts preparations for a Coup d'État in the target country. The most common effect is to start a civil war in the country. The result of this action will depend on the popularity of the political party belonging to your ⟦0⟧. With La Résistance, this diplomatic action is moved to the Orchestrate Coup operation.
1en2k3y.zh: 开始在目标国筹备政变。最常见的效果是在该国引发内战。该行动的结果取决于属于你⟦0⟧的政党在该国的支持度。启用《抵抗运动》后，该外交行动被移入「策划政变」行动。

an6m1m.en: ⟦0⟧: With La Résistance, an ⟦1⟧ can perform the ⟦2⟧ mission to make a target country more willing to accept a faction invitation or sign a non-aggression pact. It also makes the target country less inclined to do these deals with other countries.
an6m1m.zh: ⟦0⟧：启用《抵抗运动》后，⟦1⟧可以执行⟦2⟧任务，使目标国更愿意接受阵营邀请或签署互不侵犯条约。它也会让目标国更不愿意与其他国家达成此类交易。

h5mz7y.en: Exception: If a nation guarantees both the nation that declares war and the nation that war is being declared upon, the guaranteeing nation will not automatically intervene.
h5mz7y.zh: 例外：如果一个国家同时保障了宣战国与被宣战国的独立，该保障国不会自动介入。

7cx5zu.en: Increases the popularity of the target country's local party with the same ⟦0⟧. With La Résistance, this diplomatic action is replaced by the ⟦1⟧ mission.
7cx5zu.zh: 提高目标国内与⟦0⟧相同的本地政党的支持度。启用《抵抗运动》后，该外交行动被⟦1⟧任务取代。

1wf44rr.en: If you declare war on a third country which is guaranteed by a country you have a NAP with, this country will join the war against you nevertheless.
1wf44rr.zh: 如果你向一个由与你签有互不侵犯条约的国家所保障的第三国宣战，该国仍会加入对你不利的战争。

1qtq4t0.en: You cannot justify a war goal or declare war on a member of ⟦0⟧ faction if you have a NAP with that faction's leader.
1qtq4t0.zh: 如果你与某阵营领袖签有互不侵犯条约，你就无法对⟦0⟧阵营的成员制造战争目标或宣战。

1stq305.en: 50 Command power is used to maintain the attaché.⟦0⟧
1stq305.zh: 维持武官需要消耗 50 指挥点数。⟦0⟧

1ef37c2.en: Statistics, stats, or equipment values are values that equipment types can carry. They form the basis of equipment variant stats, which in turn influence the combat abilities of units using them. While a unit can not operate without equipment, it is important to distinguish between equipment stats and unit stats. The latter are also influenced by many other factors such as additional and inherent stats, experience, leaders, supply etc.
1ef37c2.zh: 统计数据、属性或装备数值是装备类型可以携带的数值。它们构成装备变体属性的基础，进而影响使用这些装备的单位的战斗能力。虽然单位离开装备无法运作，但区分装备属性与单位属性很重要。后者还受许多其他因素影响，例如附加属性与固有属性、经验、将领、补给等。

1bnet33.en: Faction has researched a number of new technologies since selecting this goal. The target amount is a percentage that depends on the number of technologies researched by the faction when selected
1bnet33.zh: 阵营自选定该目标以来已研究若干新科技。目标数量是一个百分比，取决于选定该目标时阵营已研究的科技数量

12qc652.en: Troops can be transported across the water and between two friendly ports. When a division is standing at a port, simply right-click another port to have them attempt to transport themselves there. Transporting troops requires convoys equal to the division's weight rounded up, and if the country or its allies do not have naval supremacy over the sea region, they may be intercepted resulting in casualties. If a division is not standing in a port, right-clicking on the port province, then shift-clicking on the destination port symbol will allow it to be transported in a single order.
12qc652.zh: 部队可以跨海并在两个友好港口之间运输。当一个师驻扎在港口时，只需右键点击另一个港口，即可让其尝试自行运输到那里。运输部队需要与该师重量向上取整相等的运输船队；如果该国或其盟国不具备该海域的海军霸主地位，运输可能被拦截并造成伤亡。如果师不在港口内，右键点击港口省份，再按住 Shift 点击目的地港口图标，即可让其以单次命令完成运输。

17pxc46.en: A theater is a player-defined high-level group of command groups. Alerts such as being in low supply, and a summary of combat progress, are provided for an entire theater, and reinforcement priority can be set for an entire theater.
17pxc46.zh: 战区是玩家定义的高层级集团军编组。补给不足等警报以及战斗进展摘要都按整个战区提供，补充优先级也可以按整个战区设定。

ic7skc.en: Equipment conversion speed bonuses from sources like ⟦0⟧, certain focuses like Salvaged and Retooled, etc. are applied as bonuses on the reduction of the ⟦1⟧ due to conversion. It only applies to equipment that can be converted, such as tanks with ⟦2⟧ and aircraft with ⟦3⟧, not ships, as alterations to ships are considered refits, not conversions. ⟦4⟧: the UI is currently bugged and does highlight conversion speed bonuses when refitting ships, even though their bonuses are not applied.
ic7skc.zh: 来自⟦0⟧、某些国策（如「回收再造」）等来源的装备改装速度加成，是作为减少改装所需⟦1⟧的加成才生效的。它只适用于可改装的装备，例如带有⟦2⟧的坦克和带有⟦3⟧的飞机，不适用于舰船，因为舰船的改动被视为改装（refit）而非转换（conversion）。⟦4⟧：目前 UI 存在 bug，在改装舰船时会错误地高亮显示改装速度加成，尽管这些加成并未实际生效。

je7prt.en: Negative effects from these modifiers can be reduced by up to 50% (at best halved) through acclimatization. Effects from ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ can be reduced with hot acclimatization, and effects from ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ can be reduced with cold acclimatization. Units gain hot acclimatization by spending time in provinces with ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧. Units gain cold by spending time in provinces with ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, and/or ⟦11⟧. Acclimatization speed is increased by ⟦12⟧⟦13⟧ when a unit is in combat, and it can also be increased through various sources of acclimatization factor bonuses, e.g., the ⟦14⟧ commander trait or the ⟦15⟧ special forces doctrine. Acclimatization decays over time when a unit is not in a province with a modifier that would benefit from it. It also decays at ⟦16⟧ speed⟦17⟧ when a unit with cold acclimatization is in a province where it would benefit from hot acclimatization or vice versa.
je7prt.zh: 这些修正带来的负面效果最多可通过适应气候降低 50%（即最多减半）。⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧的效果可通过炎热适应降低，⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的效果可通过寒冷适应降低。单位在⟦4⟧或⟦5⟧的省份中停留即可获得炎热适应。单位在⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧、⟦9⟧、⟦10⟧和/或⟦11⟧的省份中停留即可获得寒冷适应。当单位处于战斗中时，适应速度会提高⟦12⟧⟦13⟧；也可通过各种适应系数加成来源提高，例如⟦14⟧指挥官特质或⟦15⟧特种部队学说。当单位不在能从适应中获益的修正省份中时，适应度会随时间衰减。当具有寒冷适应的单位处于能从炎热适应获益的省份中（或反之）时，适应度也会以⟦16⟧速度衰减⟦17⟧。

154tems.en: With Götterdämmerung, any ⟦0⟧ launching missiles on ⟦1⟧ also adds ⟦2⟧ air power to their side for each missile wing times the air attack of that wing, up to a theoretical maximum of ⟦3⟧ per site. In practice, ⟦4⟧ is the only such equipment available for these missions, and it only has an Air Attack of 0.25, which translates to ⟦5⟧ air superiority per active missile wing, up to a maximum of ⟦6⟧ air superiority per ⟦7⟧, which is also before factoring in their reduced mission efficiency from their low range.
154tems.zh: 在《诸神黄昏》中，任何⟦0⟧向⟦1⟧发射导弹时，也会为其一方增加⟦2⟧空中力量，数值为每个导弹航空队乘该队的空中攻击，每个发射场理论上最高可达⟦3⟧。实际上，可用于此类任务的此类装备只有⟦4⟧，而其空中攻击仅为 0.25，即每个现役导弹航空队折算⟦5⟧制空权，每个目标最高⟦6⟧制空权（按⟦7⟧计）；这还没有计入其因航程短而降低的任务效率。

8ywdlk.en: The return on investment of building an additional Civilian Factory will depend on the Construction Speed bonus as well the Economy Law currently in place, or expected in the future. The higher the Construction Speed bonus is, the more Output will be done by the newly built Civilian Factory and the faster it will accumulate an Output equal to its cost, 10800. This variable is the time, in days, required to recover the cost of building the factory, or payback time.
8ywdlk.zh: 增建一座民用工厂的投资回报取决于建造速度加成以及当前（或预期将来）实施的经济法案。建造速度加成越高，新建民用工厂的产出就越多，也越快积累到等于其成本的产出，即 10800。这个变量就是以天数计的回本时间，也就是收回建厂成本所需的时间。

jwee3o.en: Each building level has 100⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. They may get damaged by port strikes (naval bases), land combat (infrastructure, forts), resistance (factories), strategic bombing, or explicit events (like the ⟦2⟧'s decision to move factories to the Urals). ⟦3⟧ can destroy multiple or all levels of a building at once, for details see ⟦4⟧.
jwee3o.zh: 每级建筑拥有 100⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧。它们可能因港口打击（海军基地）、陆战（基础设施、要塞）、抵抗（工厂）、战略轰炸或明确的事件（例如⟦2⟧将工厂迁往乌拉尔的决定）而受损。⟦3⟧可以一次摧毁一座建筑的多级甚至全部等级，详见⟦4⟧。

1gtcr9a.en: ⟦0⟧ make all the improvements to a territory and are necessary to build any of the constructions listed under the Construction tab . All nations start with a certain number of civilian factories and a percentage will be used for consumer goods, depending on the economy law and ⟦1⟧ that are currently in place.
1gtcr9a.zh: ⟦0⟧对一个地区进行全部改造，是建造「建造」标签页下所列任何建筑的必要条件。所有国家开局都拥有一定数量的民用工厂，其中一定比例会用于消费品，具体取决于当前实施的经济法案与⟦1⟧。

1qc5aw8.en: Many of these buildings can be targeted by strategic bombing; if they receive even a single point of damage, the effects of the first level of the building are immediately disabled. This is especially effective against expensive buildings with only a single level, such as ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧.
1qc5aw8.zh: 这些建筑中有许多可以成为战略轰炸的目标；一旦受到哪怕 1 点伤害，该建筑第一级的效果就会立即失效。这对于只有单级的昂贵建筑尤其有效，例如⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧。

1x4xsb3.en: Stations naval fleets, and can send and receive supplies and resources via convoys. Each naval base level increases supply capacity, supply throughput and the number of local ship repairs⟦0⟧. Resource output in states with a connected supply hub or naval base is increased by ⟦1⟧.⟦2⟧
1x4xsb3.zh: 停泊海军舰队，并可通过运输船队收发补给与资源。海军基地每升一级都会提高补给容量、补给吞吐量以及本地舰船修理数量⟦0⟧。拥有连通的补给枢纽或海军基地的州，其资源产出提高⟦1⟧。⟦2⟧

ed28d8.en: Consumer Goods Factories factor (CGFF) is an additional factor that is available in some countries, most notably Germany. It is the additional percentages of consumer goods in porportion to the current consumer goods factories. The number is multiplicative, not additive.
ed28d8.zh: 消费品工厂系数（CGFF）是某些国家（最著名的是德国）可用的一项额外系数。它是相对于当前消费品工厂的额外消费品百分比。该数值是相乘而非相加的。

1brndhw.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Germany can increase this building's production by ⟦2⟧ after completing Industrial Expansion or by ⟦3⟧ after completing Establish Buna-Werke. ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ can increase this building's production by ⟦7⟧ after appointing William Rhodes Davis as a political advisor.
1brndhw.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 德国可在完成「工业扩张」后将该建筑的产量提高⟦2⟧，或在完成「建立布纳工厂」后提高⟦3⟧。⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ 可在任命威廉·罗兹·戴维斯为政治顾问后将该建筑的产量提高⟦7⟧。

eatggh.en: Each state has a ⟦0⟧, which then decides the base number of shared slots. Various technologies give percentage bonuses to how many slots a state can have. Various national focuses may give additional bonus slots. The total number of slots is capped at 25.⟦1⟧
eatggh.zh: 每个州都有一个⟦0⟧，它决定共享槽位的基础数量。各种科技会为州可拥有的槽位数提供百分比加成。各种国策可能提供额外的奖励槽位。槽位总数上限为 25。⟦1⟧

17d6jti.en: Produces consumer goods and constructions, or can be used for ⟦0⟧, for purchases on the ⟦1⟧, or to create and upgrade ⟦2⟧. Base output is ⟦3⟧⟦4⟧ (per day)
17d6jti.zh: 生产消费品与建造项目，或可用于⟦0⟧、在⟦1⟧上采购，或创建与升级⟦2⟧。基础产出为⟦3⟧⟦4⟧（每日）

37x38g.en: Reminder: all effects are immediately removed if/when the building suffers any damage from strategic bombing
37x38g.zh: 提醒：当该建筑因战略轰炸受到任何伤害时，所有效果会立即移除

1juc7fz.en: ⟦0⟧ as economy law ( Regional Defense Council of Aragón only, from focus All Must Bear the Torch)
1juc7fz.zh: ⟦0⟧作为经济法案（仅限阿拉贡地区防卫委员会，来自国策「所有人都必须举起火炬」）

1vg50m7.en: Anarchist Spanish national spirit Anarchist Society (from focus Agrarian Collectivization)
1vg50m7.zh: 西班牙无政府主义国家精神 无政府主义社会（来自国策「土地集体化」）

opct32.zh: ：修正后的建造成本 = 所需建造成本 · 建造速度修正

iiimfc.en: Anarchist Spanish national spirit Anarchist Society (from focus Communal Autarky)
iiimfc.zh: 西班牙无政府主义国家精神 无政府主义社会（来自国策「公社自给自足」）

18duxi1.zh: 西班牙无政府主义国家精神 无政府主义社会（来自国策「共同负担」）

10gwglo.en: Bases and repairs air units. Each air base level can host 200⟦0⟧ aircraft.
10gwglo.zh: 驻扎并修理空军单位。每级空军基地可容纳 200⟦0⟧架飞机。

11spa2j.en: Produces and repairs ships. Base output is ⟦0⟧ (per day), modified by ⟦1⟧.
11spa2j.zh: 生产并修理舰船。基础产出为⟦0⟧（每日），由⟦1⟧修正。

1w00qe8.en: Total Consumer Goods=Consumer Goods granted by Economy Law· (1+CGFF)
1w00qe8.zh: 消费品总量=经济法案赋予的消费品·（1+CGFF）

1jdy2qg.en: Canadian national spirit ⟦0⟧ (from focus Canada Wheat Board)
1jdy2qg.zh: 加拿大国家精神⟦0⟧（来自国策「加拿大小麦局」）

1xfe67v.en: : Switch Time = Target Time - (2)/(ln(2)) · Payback Time
1xfe67v.zh: ：切换时间 = 目标时间 - (2)/(ln(2)) · 回本时间

1r9m6sj.en: Canadian national spirit ⟦0⟧ (from focus War Bonds)
1r9m6sj.zh: 加拿大国家精神⟦0⟧（来自国策「战争债券」）

izy65o.en: Canadian national spirit ⟦0⟧ (from focus If Day)
izy65o.zh: 加拿大国家精神⟦0⟧（来自国策「如果日」）

spj6tn.zh: 加拿大国家精神⟦0⟧（开局即拥有）

kz2cum.zh: （每超过 50% 的 10% 稳定度提供⟦0⟧）

1rvzza9.en: The total amount of resources can be increased by researching the excavation technologies. Each level of excavation technology gives a resource gain efficiency increase of ⟦0⟧ to the total of all extracted resources (extracted resources are those that come from the ground via drilling or mining; it does not include resources from ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧). There are five (5) levels of excavation technology; researching all of them will give a ⟦3⟧ bonus to the extracted resources total.
1rvzza9.zh: 资源总量可通过研究开采科技来提高。每级开采科技为所有已开采资源的总量提供⟦0⟧的资源获取效率提升（已开采资源指通过钻探或采矿从地下获得的资源；不包括来自⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧的资源）。开采科技共有五（5）级；研究全部五级将为已开采资源总量提供⟦3⟧加成。

1ewlwf6.en: A nation with good relations with a foreign nation can request a license from them to produce the foreign equipment. The equipment type an AI-controlled nation is willing to license out depends on their relations and how advanced the technology is. Germany, for example, may not be willing to license out their latest tank or fighter designs, but would be happy to provide Panzer IIs to friendly or neutral nations. ⟦0⟧ may also provide a way to gain licenses.
1ewlwf6.zh: 与外国关系良好的国家可以向其申请生产该外国装备的许可证。AI 控制的国家愿意发放许可的装备类型取决于双方关系以及该科技有多先进。例如，德国可能不愿发放其最新坦克或战斗机设计的许可，但乐于向友好或中立国家提供二号坦克。⟦0⟧也可能提供获得许可的途径。

1thxutn.en: A production line can be set to produce an item by converting obsolete or foreign (captured, lend-leased, license-built, or ⟦0⟧) equipment of the same chassis. This can be done at any time (assuming input items are available) by clicking the button in the bottom-left of the production line's box, and incurs no loss of production efficiency. When the line runs out of equipment to convert it will automatically revert to production from raw materials.
1thxutn.zh: 生产线可以设定为通过改装同底盘的过时或外国（缴获、租借、许可生产或⟦0⟧）装备来生产某件物品。只要（假设）有可用的输入物品，任何时候都可以通过点击生产线方框左下角的按钮进行改装，且不会损失生产效率。当该生产线没有可改装的装备时，它会自动恢复为从原材料生产。

ude104.en: When licensing equipment, design companies and ⟦0⟧ applied to the original equipment do not transfer their bonuses to the licensed equipment. However, country-wide bonuses from national spirits, political advisors, and/or ⟦1⟧ that affect the production cost of the original equipment will transfer over with the license.
ude104.zh: 许可生产装备时，应用于原装备的设计公司和⟦0⟧不会把其加成转移给获许可生产的装备。不过，来自国家精神、政治顾问和/或⟦1⟧、影响原装备生产成本的全属性加成会随许可一并转移。

xr2qaq.en: Ship refitting speed bonuses from sources like the ⟦0⟧ officer corps spirit, certain focuses like Expand the Repair Yards, etc., act as additional ⟦1⟧ bonuses that are only applied when refitting ships. This makes them have a smaller relative effect the more ⟦2⟧ the country already has.
xr2qaq.zh: 来自⟦0⟧军官团精神、某些国策（如「扩建修理厂」）等来源的舰船改装速度加成，作为额外的⟦1⟧加成效生效，且仅在改装舰船时应用。因此，该国已有的⟦2⟧越多，它们的相对效果就越小。

1c84en9.en: Each nation can use a percentage of the resources on its territory for military production, with the rest being reserved exclusively for ⟦0⟧. This percentage depends on the trade law, with ⟦1⟧ making all resources available for internal production and no resources available for ⟦2⟧.
1c84en9.zh: 每个国家可以将其领土上一定比例的资源用于军事生产，其余部分专供⟦0⟧使用。该比例取决于贸易法案，采用⟦1⟧时所有资源都可用于国内生产，没有资源可供⟦2⟧使用。

113nkz0.en: Production efficiency starts at a base (10%⟦0⟧ without modifiers) and increases each day up to a production efficiency cap (50%⟦1⟧ without modifiers). All of these can potentially be increased by ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and national focuses. The base production efficiency growth per day is:
113nkz0.zh: 生产效率从基础值（无修正时为 10%⟦0⟧）开始，并逐日提升至生产效率上限（无修正时为 50%⟦1⟧）。所有这些都可能被⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和国策提高。每日基础生产效率增长为：

1ti8np5.en: Some ⟦0⟧ provide bonuses to license production that can offset these penalties, such as License German Equipment or Befriend Japan. In particular, Extensive Licensing Program can allow ⟦1⟧ to produce licensed equipment faster than their own.
1ti8np5.zh: 某些⟦0⟧提供可抵消这些惩罚的许可生产加成，例如「许可生产德国装备」或「与日本交好」。特别是「广泛许可计划」可以让⟦1⟧以比自产更快的速度生产获许可的装备。

vxhign.en: ⟦0⟧: Used for ⟦1⟧ (including repair), ⟦2⟧, consumer goods, purchasing equipment licenses, the ⟦3⟧ (with ), and Intelligence agencies and their upgrades (with ). These have a base output of ⟦4⟧ and powered output of ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ per day.
vxhign.zh: ⟦0⟧：用于⟦1⟧（包括修理）、⟦2⟧、消费品、购买装备许可、⟦3⟧（需 ），以及情报机构及其升级（需 ）。这些的基础产出为⟦4⟧，有电力时的产出为⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧每日。

l1k9f4.en: : production efficiency growth per day= 0.001 (( production efficiency cap )^2)/(current production efficiency)
l1k9f4.zh: ：每日生产效率增长= 0.001 (( 生产效率上限 )^2)/(当前生产效率)

fgzk0i.en: Some countries have access to unique political advisors, ⟦0⟧ and/or ⟦1⟧ that can reduce these penalties.
fgzk0i.zh: 某些国家可以使用独特的政治顾问、⟦0⟧和/或⟦1⟧来减少这些惩罚。

vv40xi.en: : Real Production Efficiency = \max( Production Efficiency with Retention, Base Production Efficiency )
vv40xi.zh: ：实际生产效率 = \max( 带保留的生产效率, 基础生产效率 )

1j178c.en: : Production Efficiency with Retention = CPE · ( RET + (1 - RET ) · BON )
1j178c.zh: ：带保留的生产效率 = CPE · ( RET + (1 - RET ) · BON )

lzi6fh.en: Some ⟦0⟧ and unique political advisors can also provide additional ⟦1⟧.
lzi6fh.zh: 某些⟦0⟧和独特的政治顾问也可以提供额外的⟦1⟧。

1bkh2rc.en: Gain rights to resources through ⟦0⟧ or unique decisions.
1bkh2rc.zh: 通过⟦0⟧或独特决议获取资源开采权。

g29dzp.en: Change trade Law to keep more domestic production.
g29dzp.zh: 修改贸易法案以保留更多国内产量。

mk7z5u.en: There are also modifiers which only affect a single type of building. These are, primarily, the political advisors (Captain of Industry, Fortification Engineer, Quartermaster General and War Industrialist) but can also be one of many other ⟦0⟧ activated by national focuses or ⟦1⟧.
mk7z5u.zh: 还有一些修正只影响单一类型的建筑。它们主要是政治顾问（工业领袖、筑垒工程师、军需总长与战争工业家），但也可能是⟦0⟧中由国策或⟦1⟧激活的众多项目之一。

1qg0ptq.en: For example, a powered factory at ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ with ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ from having ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ due to low Stability, the production of each ⟦7⟧ would be ⟦8⟧ per day.
1qg0ptq.zh: 例如，一座位于⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧的有电力工厂，若从⟦2⟧获得⟦3⟧、从⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧获得加成，并因稳定度低而⟦6⟧，则每个⟦7⟧的产量为每日⟦8⟧。

1d23qds.en: old_design_cost * (0.2 + newly_added_module_prod_modifiers) + (module_upgrade_cost if available, new_module_cost if not) * prod_modifiers + dismantle_costs
1d23qds.zh: 旧设计成本 * (0.2 + 新装模块生产修正) + (模块升级成本（若可用），否则为新模块成本) * 生产修正 + 拆解成本

p6prmi.zh: (基础底盘成本 * (0.9 - 科技) + 新模块成本) * 生产修正 + 拆解成本

1d7nhfh.en: All ⟦0⟧ have pre-defined temperature ranges that their provinces are allowed to have at on any given day of the year. Some can have very large ranges of temperatures throughout the year (e.g., temperatures in Manchuria can range between -25 and 31 degrees throughout the year)⟦1⟧, while others can have fairly stable temperatures that are temperature throughout the entire year (e.g., temperatures in Southern England can range between -5 and 25 degrees throughout the year)⟦2⟧. Similarly, some regions can tend to have very high temperatures (e.g., temperatures in South Indochina can range between 16 and 36 degrees throughout the year)⟦3⟧, while others can tend to have very low temperatures (e.g., provinces in Northern Norway can range between -23 and 18 degrees throughout the year)⟦4⟧.
1d7nhfh.zh: 所有⟦0⟧都为其省份预设了在一年中任何一天所允许处于的温度范围。有些全年温度变化范围很大（例如满洲的气温全年可在 -25 到 31 度之间），⟦1⟧而另一些则相当稳定（例如英格兰南部的气温全年可在 -5 到 25 度之间）。⟦2⟧同样，有些地区倾向于温度很高（例如中南半岛南部的气温全年可在 16 到 36 度之间），⟦3⟧而另一些则倾向于温度很低（例如挪威北部的省份全年可在 -23 到 18 度之间）。⟦4⟧

1rm19qm.en: Temperature affects how quickly collected snow and water disappear from each province. ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ in provinces with temperatures at or above 0 degrees will melt into collected water, with melting speed increasing linearly with temperature until it caps out at 12 degrees. Collected water (that could produce ⟦2⟧) will start to evaporate at temperatures of 2 degrees or warmer. Evaporation speed increases linearly with temperature until it caps out at 38 degrees, though any precipitation in the meantime can refill provinces' collected water. ⟦3⟧ in provinces with temperatures of -1 degrees or colder will also freeze, negating its effects until temperatures become warm enough to thaw it out.
1rm19qm.zh: 气温会影响每个省份积雪与积水的消失速度。气温在 0 度或以上的省份中的⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧会融化为积水，融化速度随气温线性上升，在 12 度时达到上限。积水（可产生⟦2⟧）在 2 度或更暖时开始蒸发。蒸发速度随气温线性上升，在 38 度时达到上限，不过期间任何降水都可能重新补充省份的积水。气温在 -1 度或更低的省份中的⟦3⟧也会冻结，其效果会被抵消，直到气温回暖到足以解冻。

z5gsuu.en: The game simulates full day-night cycles for every province on the map every hour. Over the course of a year, every province will have roughly 12 hours of daytime and 12 hours of nighttime per day, though the amount of daytime and nighttime that a province receives per day can vary depending on the day of the year. Provinces closer to the Equator will have little variance in their daytime and nighttime hours over the course of a year, whereas provinces closer to the poles can experience months with large amounts of daytime during their summer seasons and months with large amounts of nighttime during their winter seasons.
z5gsuu.zh: 游戏每小时为地图上每个省份模拟完整的昼夜循环。一年之中，每个省份大致每天有 12 小时白昼与 12 小时黑夜，不过一个省份每天所得的白昼与黑夜时长会随一年中的日期而变化。靠近赤道的省份全年昼夜时长变化很小，而靠近两极的省份在夏季可能经历白昼极长的月份、在冬季经历黑夜极长的月份。

1j0qfay.en: Wise players will try to avoid launching major offensives during the mud seasons of a given location. In places like the Western ⟦0⟧ and the Northeastern ⟦1⟧, this happens during the spring, when cold and snowy winters are followed by a wet and mild spring, as well as in the late autumn, when heavy rainfall and low temperatures cause a buildup of unevaporated water. In Northern ⟦2⟧ and the Southern ⟦3⟧, this can happen during mild but very wet winters when temperatures are not cold enough to cause mud to freeze, but also not warm enough for the buildup of water to evaporate, especially in areas with less ⟦4⟧.
1j0qfay.zh: 明智的玩家会尽量避免在特定地区的泥泞季节发动大规模攻势。在⟦0⟧西部和⟦1⟧东北部这类地方，这发生在春季——寒冷多雪的冬季之后是潮湿温和的春天；也发生在深秋——强降雨与低温造成未蒸发的水积聚。在⟦2⟧北部和⟦3⟧南部，这可能发生在温和但极为潮湿的冬季：气温既不冷到让泥浆冻结，也不暖到让积聚的水蒸发，在⟦4⟧较少的地区尤其如此。

47rtg9.en: If the area is set up as being susceptible to mud during a particular time of year, and the water level over a time period is high enough, mud develops. ⟦0⟧, a ⟦1⟧, or even melting ⟦2⟧ can be the source of the water. The game logs how much water is collected in each province based on past precipitation and temperature. Higher levels of ⟦3⟧ will reduce the growth of mud in a province by up to ⟦4⟧.
47rtg9.zh: 如果某地区被设定为在一年中特定时段易发泥泞，且某段时间内的水量足够高，就会形成泥泞。⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧，甚至融化的⟦2⟧都可以是水的来源。游戏根据过去的降水与气温记录每个省份收集了多少水。⟦3⟧水平越高，一个省份泥泞的增长最多可减少⟦4⟧。

3bxspw.en: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧: Snow can only fall on a province when it is 1 degree or colder, and the rate of snowfall for ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ increases linearly until -4 degrees before capping out. Snow only starts melting into in provinces at 0 degrees or warmer (snowmelt will become collected water), and the rate of snowmelt increases linearly until 12 degrees before capping out.
3bxspw.zh: ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧：只有当省份气温为 1 度或更低时才会降雪，且⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧的降雪速率随气温线性上升，在 -4 度时达到上限。积雪只在气温 0 度或以下时开始融化。

4w83sp.en: Temperature is tracked for every province on the map and updated regularly. Every update tick, the temperature of a province can change up to 6 degrees Celsius,⟦0⟧ though both temperature changes and temperatures as a whole are smoothed between neighboring provinces to be more gradual overall.⟦1⟧
4w83sp.zh: 地图上每个省份的气温都会被追踪并定期更新。每个更新刻，一个省份的气温最多可变化 6 摄氏度，⟦0⟧不过气温变化与气温本身都会在相邻省份之间平滑处理，使其整体更渐进。⟦1⟧

1fe14dd.en: While winter attrition can be reduced by appointing the armies to a commander with a ⟦0⟧ trait, there is no corresponding trait to reduce heat attrition. Commanders gain the ⟦1⟧ trait by fighting for a longer time in cold weather. ⟦2⟧ has a unique focus Desert Equipment reducing heat attrition.
1fe14dd.zh: 虽然冬季损耗可以通过把集团军指派给拥有⟦0⟧特质的指挥官来减少，但并没有对应特质来减少炎热损耗。指挥官通过在寒冷天气中作战较长时间来获得⟦1⟧特质。⟦2⟧拥有一个独特国策「沙漠装备」，可减少炎热损耗。

15uxydn.en: A dynamic counterpart to ⟦0⟧, weather can affect movement and combat of all types of units. Weather has a big impact on logistics and how one is able to supply units. It should be noted provinces do not always have weather, and some provinces have no temperature modifiers.
15uxydn.zh: 作为⟦0⟧的动态对应物，天气可以影响所有类型单位的移动与战斗。天气对后勤以及如何为部队提供补给有重大影响。应当注意，省份并不总是有天气，有些省份没有气温修正。

npktsz.en: While the likelihood of weather events such as ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ and modifiers representing their long-term effects like ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ are primarily defined though ⟦7⟧ for each month of the year, temperature can also have an indirect effect in the following ways:
npktsz.zh: 虽然诸如⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧这类天气事件的发生几率，以及代表其长期影响的修正（如⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧）主要通过对一年中每个月的⟦7⟧来定义，但气温还可以通过以下方式产生间接影响：

cwvj6l.en: ⟦0⟧: The rate at which collected water in a province evaporates increases linearly from 2 degrees to 38 degrees, which means mud dries out quicker at hotter temperatures. The modifier also disappears at temperatures of -1 degree or colder, as the mud freezes.
cwvj6l.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个省份中积水蒸发的速率从 2 度到 38 度线性上升，这意味着气温越高泥泞干得越快。该修正也会在气温 -1 度或更低时消失，因为泥浆冻结了。

3sjgu4.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Increases the supply use of a division in a state or province experiencing that weather. ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ Reduces the rate that supplies flow into a province in the state experiencing that weather.
3sjgu4.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 提高处于该天气的州或省份中一个师的补给消耗。⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ 降低处于该天气的州中补给流入一个省份的速率。

tqqcqx.en: Provinces that are experiencing more extreme temperatures can be assigned one of the following modifiers, which will have the following effects on units in the province:
tqqcqx.zh: 经历更极端气温的省份可以被赋予下列修正之一，它们会对该省份中的单位产生以下效果：

glsoul.en: The ⟦0⟧ of a province can also bias its temperature. The following terrain types will statically bias the temperature of their province by the following amount:⟦1⟧
glsoul.zh: 一个省份的⟦0⟧也会影响其气温。以下地形类型会按其数值静态影响所在省份的气温：⟦1⟧

1sauvdm.en: Some terrain makes it more or less likely for a weather event to occur and/or for province modifiers from collected water and/or snow to appear.
1sauvdm.zh: 某些地形会提高或降低天气事件发生的可能性，以及/或者积水与积雪省份修正出现的可能性。

1i4mggj.en: Weather events spawn modifiers that can have an impact on single provinces and/or entire states.
1i4mggj.zh: 天气事件会生成修正，可能影响单个省份和/或整个州。

1u5m1mx.en: Temperature plays a very important role in the game's weather systems.
1u5m1mx.zh: 气温在游戏的天气系统中扮演着非常重要的角色。

kxjw86.zh: 文件 Hearts of Iron IV\map\strategicregions\228-South Indochina.txt

133at4q.zh: 文件 Hearts of Iron IV\map\strategicregions\1-Southern England.txt

hnsrd3.en: Attrition from weather only applies if controller is at war.
hnsrd3.zh: 天气造成的损耗只在控制方处于战争状态时才生效。

ogz77n.en: Temperature Impacts on Weather Events and Modifiers
ogz77n.zh: 气温对天气事件与修正的影响

1xs5bra.en: Night Operations Chief of Air Force
1xs5bra.zh: 夜间作战 空军总司令

rur17b.en: These penalties can be offset by modifiers that are explicitly stated as night penalty reductions, e.g., from ⟦0⟧ or a ⟦1⟧. Land Night Attack bonuses, e.g., from ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧, also negate the base penalty to land attack at nighttime instead of just adding land attack at night, which is an important difference to consider when multiple sources of this bonus are applied.
rur17b.zh: 这些惩罚可以被明确标注为「夜间惩罚减免」的修正抵消，例如来自⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧的修正。陆上夜间攻击加成（例如来自⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧的加成）也会抵消极基础的夜间陆上攻击惩罚，而不只是单纯增加夜间陆上攻击；当叠加多个此类加成来源时，这一区别很重要。

1rygze0.en: ⟦0⟧: This modifier can only be applied to eligible sea zones when they are between 0 and -5 degrees. Once applied, they also can only be removed once the given sea zone is between 1 and 5 degrees. Some sea zones, e.g. the Bering Sea, will always have this modifier applied, while others, e.g. the Denmark Strait, might only have it applied during colder, winter months.
1rygze0.zh: ⟦0⟧：该修正只能在符合条件的海域处于 0 至 -5 度之间时施加。一旦施加，也只有当该海域处于 1 至 5 度之间时才能移除。有些海域（例如白令海）会始终带有该修正，而另一些（例如丹麦海峡）可能只在较冷的冬季月份带有该修正。

7f7zvn.en: It should be noted that carrier aircraft are affected both by nighttime penalties to their aerial mission as well as by night penalties to the carriers off of which they are based. Nighttime penalty reductions to aircraft alone are therefore far less effective on carrier aircraft unless also accompanied by nighttime penalty reductions to carriers.
7f7zvn.zh: 应当注意，舰载机既会受到其空中任务的夜间惩罚影响，也会受到其所属航母的夜间惩罚影响。因此，若不同时减免航母的夜间惩罚，仅对飞机本身减免夜间惩罚对舰载机的效果要差得多。

14omlim.en: High levels of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ will affect unit movement speed and greatly hinder the power of any offensive. These debuffs stack on top of those of ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧, so smart players should be mindful of launching winter offensives in colder climates without adequate preparation, including the potential use of ⟦4⟧ with ⟦5⟧. ⟦6⟧ will increase attrition levels, especially for supply trucks used for motorized supply, and can similarly grind offensives to a halt.
14omlim.zh: 高水平的⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧会影响单位移动速度，并极大削弱任何攻势的威力。这些减益与⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧的减益叠加，因此明智的玩家在较冷气候下发动冬季攻势时应留意准备是否充分，包括可能使用⟦4⟧并搭配⟦5⟧。⟦6⟧会提高损耗，对用于摩托化补给的补给卡车尤其如此，同样可能让攻势陷入停滞。

ghpi7d.en: For example a country may create a variant of their light fighter 2 base variant, increasing its range, by spending air experience. Ship variants (ship classes) have a particular set of modules attached to them. ⟦0⟧ makes designing variants an integral step of building ships, as only individual hulls and modules get researched that don't unlock ship variants (or classes) by themselves.
ghpi7d.zh: 例如，一个国家可以消耗空军经验，为其轻型战斗机 2 的基础型号创建一个增加航程的变体。舰船变体（舰船级别）各自挂载一组特定的模块。⟦0⟧使得设计变体成为建造舰船不可或缺的一步，因为只有单件舰体与模块可被研究，它们本身并不会解锁舰船变体（或级别）。

1ucsv4t.en: The equipment needs of units refer to general equipment ⟦0⟧. For example a German ⟦1⟧ that needs 100 medium tanks can use any mix of variants of Panzer IIIs, Panzer IVs, Panthers, or foreign medium tank equipment. By contrast, equipment of different archetypes, such as light and medium tanks, are never interchangeable.
1ucsv4t.zh: 单位的装备需求指的是通用装备⟦0⟧。例如，一个需要 100 辆中型坦克的德国⟦1⟧可以使用三号坦克、四号坦克、黑豹或外国中型坦克装备的各种变体任意组合。相反，不同原型的装备（例如轻型坦克与中型坦克）绝不能互换。

r84d9o.en: Researching an equipment technology unlocks a basic variant of the equipment type particular to that country. Equipment variants can alternatively be licensed from other countries. In either case, countries can further modify several types of equipment by spending the respective kind of experience.
r84d9o.zh: 研究一项装备科技会解锁该装备类型中该国特有的一个基础变体。装备变体也可以从其他国家获得许可生产。无论哪种情况，国家都可以消耗相应类型的经验来进一步改造若干种装备。

pegi4w.en: ⟦0⟧: How much fuel this unit uses while it is operating. Air and Sea units will consume fuel while on active missions or during training. Land units with fuel consumption will consume fuel in idle as well, but the combat, movement or training will further increase the consumption.
pegi4w.zh: ⟦0⟧：该单位在运作时消耗多少燃料。空军与海军单位在执行任务或训练期间会消耗燃料。有燃料消耗的陆军单位在空闲时也会消耗燃料，而战斗、移动或训练会进一步提高消耗。

11rf7qj.en: ⟦0⟧: A faster ship has an easier time disengaging from pursuers when attempting to retreat from combat. It is also less likely to be hit by enemy fire, can pursue contacts easier when spotting the enemy, and moves faster outside of battle.
11rf7qj.zh: ⟦0⟧：航速更快的舰船在试图脱离战斗时更容易摆脱追击者。它也更不容易被敌方火力命中，在发现敌人时能更容易跟踪接触目标，并在战斗之外移动得更快。

fjn9mb.en: ⟦0⟧ is the military hardware needed by ⟦1⟧ to operate and largely determines their stats. It gets unlocked by researching technologies and is produced by production lines. Support Equipment is an example of a type of equipment.
fjn9mb.zh: ⟦0⟧是⟦1⟧运作所需的军事装备，并在很大程度上决定其属性。它通过研究科技解锁，由生产线生产。支援装备就是装备类型的一个例子。

1xrl00g.en: The parent of an equipment type is the type unlocked by the previous technology in the chain belonging to the same archetype. For example Infantry Equipment 1 is the parent of Infantry Equipment 2. This has an effect on ⟦0⟧.
1xrl00g.zh: 一个装备类型的父级，是同一原型科技链中由前一项科技解锁的类型。例如步兵装备 1 是步兵装备 2 的父级。这会对⟦0⟧产生影响。

1xhqhp1.en: ⟦0⟧: Having armor that is higher than the opponents piercing value makes you take less damage and also makes it possible to perform more attacks in combat as the unit has more freedom of movement.
1xhqhp1.zh: ⟦0⟧：装甲高于对手的穿透值时，你受到的伤害更少，并且由于单位机动更自由，还能在战斗中发动更多次攻击。

vid3z0.en: ⟦0⟧: Hardness represents how much of a division is made up of armored or at least protected vehicles. It decreases the ratio of soft attacks received, while increasing the ratio of hard attacks.
vid3z0.zh: ⟦0⟧：硬度表示一个师中有多大比例由装甲车辆或至少有防护的车辆构成。它降低所受软攻的比例，同时提高所受硬攻的比例。

12ejm9b.en: A family of equipment types share common mechanical parts that make transitioning production between them easier. Each tank equipment type and the armored vehicles based on it form a family.
12ejm9b.zh: 同一族的装备类型共享通用机械部件，这使得在它们之间切换生产更为容易。每种坦克装备类型以及以其为基础的装甲车辆构成一族。

1tgogcz.en: ⟦0⟧: An extra reliability bonus from support companies. This bonus is applied to an equipment type's reliability and reduces the chance of breakdowns and accidents.
1tgogcz.zh: ⟦0⟧：来自支援连的额外可靠性加成。该加成作用于某个装备类型的可靠性，降低故障与事故的几率。

1nu0vox.en: ⟦0⟧: How much fuel this unit can store. Higher fuel capacity means that the unit will be able to operate at full capacity longer when it lacks the fuel supply.
1nu0vox.zh: ⟦0⟧：该单位能储存多少燃料。燃料容量越高，意味该单位在缺乏燃料补给时能以满负荷运作更久。

ckvbna.en: ⟦0⟧: The lower the value the more likely the equipment is of suffering random failure, accidents or exploding in a fiery ball of death when lightly bumped.
ckvbna.zh: ⟦0⟧：该数值越低，装备就越容易在受到轻微碰撞时发生随机故障、事故或炸成一团火球。

1sa7y3j.en: When a country unlocks a type of equipment while employing a matching design company, its bonuses will be attached to all variants of that equipment type.
1sa7y3j.zh: 当一个国家在聘用匹配的设计公司时解锁某类装备，该公司的加分会附加到该装备类型的所有变体上。

17ajmkc.en: ⟦0⟧: Having equal or greater §HPiercing§! to the targets §HArmor§! value allow you to do more damage and more effectively pin down their armored forces
17ajmkc.zh: ⟦0⟧：拥有等于或高于目标§H装甲§!值的§H穿透§!，可以让你造成更多伤害，并更有效地牵制其装甲部队

1h8ete2.en: ⟦0⟧: A ship's range represents its onboard stores of fuel and foodstuffs, which limit how far it can travel from the nearest friendly Naval Base.
1h8ete2.zh: ⟦0⟧：舰船的航程代表其舰上储存的燃料与食物，这限制了它能离开最近友方海军基地多远。

17yi5pt.en: ⟦0⟧: How quickly this division can traverse terrain under optimal circumstances. How quickly this unit can fly under optimal circumstances.
17yi5pt.zh: ⟦0⟧：在最佳情况下该师穿越地形的速度。在最佳情况下该单位能飞多快。

mxzbfo.en: ⟦0⟧: How many enemy attacks a division can attempt to avoid while on the offensive, effectively allowing it to stay on the offense longer.
mxzbfo.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个师在进攻时能尝试规避多少次敌方攻击，实际上让它能更久地保持攻势。

1lygvqu.en: ⟦0⟧: Organization indicates combat readiness and how organized a unit is. A unit with no organization can't fight or move effectively.
1lygvqu.zh: ⟦0⟧：组织度表示战斗准备程度以及单位有多整齐。没有组织度的单位无法有效战斗或移动。

szpcnd.en: ⟦0⟧: How many enemy attacks a division can attempt to avoid while on the defensive, effectively allowing it to hold the line longer.
szpcnd.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个师在防御时能尝试规避多少次敌方攻击，实际上让它能更久地守住防线。

13zz101.en: ⟦0⟧: The ability to scout ahead and anticipate the enemy. Increases the chance that a division can pick better tactics in battle.
13zz101.zh: ⟦0⟧：侦察前方并预判敌人的能力。提高一个师在战斗中选出更好战术的几率。

1gmy17t.en: ⟦0⟧: The higher the Initiative a unit has, the quicker it can reinforce into a battle, and the quicker it gets its planning done.
1gmy17t.zh: ⟦0⟧：单位的主动性越高，它补充进战斗的速度越快，完成计划的速度也越快。

1wcv3dg.en: ⟦0⟧: How much the unit will weigh. Heavier units will require more transports to ship and perform invasions effectively.
1wcv3dg.zh: ⟦0⟧：该单位有多重。更重的单位需要更多运输船队来运送，也才能有效执行入侵。

rkdjf4.en: ⟦0⟧: How much damage we can do against airplanes. High Air Attack also helps to counter enemy Air Superiority effects.
rkdjf4.zh: ⟦0⟧：我们对飞机能造成多少伤害。高空中攻击也有助于抵消敌方的制空权效果。

9mmsvs.en: ⟦0⟧: How agile a plane is. Agility affects how easy it is to hit another plane, and how easily it can avoid being hit.
9mmsvs.zh: ⟦0⟧：飞机有多灵活。机动性影响命中另一架飞机的难易，以及它规避被命中的难易。

1d10e4p.en: An equipment type belongs to an archetype and forms the basis of variants that countries create when they unlock it.
1d10e4p.zh: 一个装备类型属于某个原型，并构成各国在解锁它时所创建变体的基础。

1d4bok1.en: ⟦0⟧: How much experience is lost in a division when they take casualties and have to replace them.
1d4bok1.zh: ⟦0⟧：当一个师遭受伤亡并不得不补充兵员时，会损失多少经验。

1tltj88.en: ⟦0⟧: How much damage the plane can do to enemy divisions on the ground when helping out in combat.
1tltj88.zh: ⟦0⟧：该飞机在协助战斗时能对地面上敌方师造成多少伤害。

1bsrs2a.en: ⟦0⟧: The proportion of losses in combat that can be saved and returned to the manpower pool.
1bsrs2a.zh: ⟦0⟧：战斗中能够被救回并返还人力池的损失比例。

15p6o0v.en: ⟦0⟧ (or morale): How much extra organization can be regained hourly when not in combat.
15p6o0v.zh: ⟦0⟧（或士气）：不在战斗时每小时能额外恢复多少组织度。

k3o8we.en: ⟦0⟧: Damage done by the heavy guns. Heavy guns are better at targetting bigger ships.
k3o8we.zh: ⟦0⟧：重型火炮造成的伤害。重型火炮更擅长瞄准更大的舰船。

124x6uw.en: ⟦0⟧: Strength represents how much damage this unit can suffer before it is destroyed.
124x6uw.zh: ⟦0⟧：兵力表示该单位在被摧毁前能承受多少伤害。

ts1s61.en: ⟦0⟧: Damage done by light guns. Light guns are better at targetting smaller ships.
ts1s61.zh: ⟦0⟧：轻型火炮造成的伤害。轻型火炮更擅长瞄准更小的舰船。

1eyboon.en: These values for the maximum speed do ⟦0⟧ apply to ⟦1⟧ other than recon companies.
1eyboon.zh: 这些最大速度数值⟦0⟧适用于侦察连以外的⟦1⟧。

b8c0y.en: ⟦0⟧: How much anti-air firepower the ship carries for shooting down enemy planes.
b8c0y.zh: ⟦0⟧：该舰船携带多少防空火力用于击落敌机。

poza75.en: ⟦0⟧: The ability to make proper defensive entrenchments before a hostile attack.
poza75.zh: ⟦0⟧：在敌方进攻前构筑适当防御工事的能力。

xhb1us.en: ⟦0⟧: How much the plane helps the overall air superiority of a strategic area.
xhb1us.zh: ⟦0⟧：该飞机对一个战略区域的整体制空权有多大帮助。

19ehifm.en: ⟦0⟧: How many attacks a division can make versus enemies with high hardness.
19ehifm.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个师能对高硬度敌人发动多少次攻击。

1cnqsjo.en: ⟦0⟧: How many attacks a division can make versus enemies with low hardness.
1cnqsjo.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个师能对低硬度敌人发动多少次攻击。

1am9j70.en: ⟦0⟧: How much damage we can do to the enemy submarines with depth charges.
1am9j70.zh: ⟦0⟧：我们用深水炸弹能对敌方潜艇造成多少伤害。

j917dj.en: Battalions have a maximum speed no slower than 4, regardless of equipment
j917dj.zh: 无论装备如何，营的最大速度不慢于 4

1j37tq.en: ⟦0⟧: Percentage of the equipment that will be captured from enemy loses.
1j37tq.zh: ⟦0⟧：从敌方损失中缴获的装备百分比。

1yfeh4m.en: The table below ⟦0⟧ armor designed by the ⟦1⟧ DLC tank designer.
1yfeh4m.zh: 下表⟦0⟧由⟦1⟧ DLC 坦克设计器设计的装甲。

94dqar.en: ⟦0⟧: How much damage we can do when using the ship's torpedoes.
94dqar.zh: ⟦0⟧：使用舰船鱼雷时我们能造成多少伤害。

9y3o48.en: ⟦0⟧: The speed at which a unit acclimatizes in a warm climate.
9y3o48.zh: ⟦0⟧：单位在温暖气候中适应气候的速度。

14dl5cx.en: ⟦0⟧: The speed at which a unit acclimatizes in a cold climate.
14dl5cx.zh: ⟦0⟧：单位在寒冷气候中适应气候的速度。

jbtos9.en: ⟦0⟧: How much damage the plane inflicts upon hitting a ship.
jbtos9.zh: ⟦0⟧：飞机命中舰船时造成多少伤害。

slgunp.en: ⟦0⟧: How many hits a plane can take before being shot down.
slgunp.zh: ⟦0⟧：飞机在被击落前能承受多少次命中。

v627jw.en: ⟦0⟧: Efficiency in finding and neutralizing the sea mines.

1ssca23.en: ⟦0⟧: How much Factory Output a piece of equipment needs.
1ssca23.zh: ⟦0⟧：一件装备需要多少工厂产出。

11t4xwo.en: ⟦0⟧: How far away the plane can perform missions.

141h2ad.en: ⟦0⟧: How many planes a carrier can fit on board.
141h2ad.zh: ⟦0⟧：一艘航母能搭载多少架飞机。

enb62f.en: ⟦0⟧: How good a plane is at strategic bombing.

1g2imr7.en: ⟦0⟧: How much supply a unit consumes per day.
1g2imr7.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个单位每天消耗多少补给。

1yusdx2.en: ⟦0⟧: How likely the plane is to hit a ship.

1w6cfqe.en: ⟦0⟧: Efficiency in laying the sea mines.

12sn7j3.en: ⟦0⟧: How easy to detect a submarine is.
12sn7j3.zh: ⟦0⟧：一艘潜艇被探测到的难易程度。

1katupp.en: ⟦0⟧: Armor piercing of the light guns.

q5q92.en: ⟦0⟧: Armor piercing of the heavy guns.

umf6rh.en: ⟦0⟧: How hard to find this ship is.
