1pd98px.en: At full, 100% radar coverage over a country's controlled land provinces, ⟦0⟧ can provide ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ over that country.⟦9⟧ These are multiplied by each ⟦10⟧'s intel gathering efficiency and are also decreased linearly as the fraction of controlled land provinces with radar coverage decreases. A ⟦11⟧ can provide additional intel on other countries based on how many provinces in its coverage range are land provinces controlled by the target country. At a maximum, this constitutes ⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧, ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧ ⟦17⟧, and ⟦18⟧ ⟦19⟧ per ⟦20⟧,⟦21⟧ multiplied by that station's intel gathering efficiency and the number of land provinces it covers that are controlled by the target country, then divided by the total amount of provinces covered by the station.
1pd98px.zh: 当一个国家所控制的陆上省份被 100% 雷达覆盖时，⟦0⟧可以对该国提供⟦1⟧⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧⟦8⟧。⟦9⟧这些数值会乘以每个⟦10⟧的情报搜集效率，并随被雷达覆盖的受控陆上省份比例下降而线性减少。一个⟦11⟧可以根据其覆盖范围内有多少省份是目标国控制的陆上省份，提供关于其他国家的额外情报。最大情况下，这相当于每⟦12⟧⟦13⟧、⟦14⟧⟦15⟧、⟦16⟧⟦17⟧和⟦18⟧⟦19⟧提供⟦20⟧，⟦21⟧再乘以该站点的情报搜集效率，以及它所覆盖且由目标国控制的陆上省份数，然后除以该站点覆盖的省份总数。

1l7sztc.en: ⟦0⟧, short for ⟦1⟧, is a mechanic in Hearts of Iron 4 through which nations can try to observe what other nations are doing. It can be found in the Intel Ledger. At lower intel levels, this includes seeing how many factories other nations have, what they are producing with their ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧, what technologies they have researched, what doctrines they have chosen, and what equipment types they have in stockpile. At higher intel levels, nations can even get information about the exact equipment ⟦4⟧ and designs being used and the specific ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ the target country is performing. Intel can also provide bonuses in ⟦7⟧, for ⟦8⟧ and evading enemy ships, and for reducing the effectiveness of enemy naval mines, as well as detecting enemy ⟦9⟧.
1l7sztc.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧的缩写）是《钢铁雄心 4》中的一项机制，国家借此可以尝试观察其他国家在做什么。它可在情报台账中查看。在较低情报等级下，这包括看到其他国家有多少工厂、它们用⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧在生产什么、它们研究了哪些科技、选择了哪些学说，以及它们库存中有哪些装备类型。在较高情报等级下，国家甚至能获得关于正在使用的确切装备⟦4⟧与设计，以及目标国正在执行的特定⟦5⟧与⟦6⟧的信息。情报还能在⟦7⟧中提供加成，对⟦8⟧与规避敌舰提供加成，降低敌方水雷的效果，以及探测敌方⟦9⟧。

1yuitsz.en: ⟦0⟧ involving enemy ⟦1⟧ also generate air intel. The base daily air intel gain rate from ⟦2⟧ is ⟦3⟧ per ⟦4⟧ with at least one enemy ⟦5⟧, plus ⟦6⟧ per enemy plane in those ⟦7⟧, all multiplied by ⟦8⟧.⟦9⟧ This is further modified by a dynamic gain rate and decay rate given to all intel gained from ⟦10⟧, as well as by ⟦11⟧' reconnaissance values; see the dedicated ⟦12⟧ section for more details about these. The maximum effective cap on air intel gained in this way is ⟦13⟧,⟦14⟧ and the maximum hard cap on civilian intel gained in this way is ⟦15⟧.⟦16⟧ The hard cap does not contribute directly to a country's air intel, but intel gained within it can act as a buffer that absorbs intel decay before it can affect a country's effective air intel.
1yuitsz.zh: 涉及敌方⟦0⟧的⟦1⟧也会产生空军情报。来自⟦2⟧的基础每日空军情报获取率为：每个至少有一架敌方⟦3⟧的⟦4⟧获得⟦5⟧，再加上这些⟦6⟧中每架敌机提供⟦7⟧，全部乘以⟦8⟧。⟦9⟧这还会受到赋予来自⟦10⟧的全部情报的动态获取率与衰减率进一步修正，以及⟦11⟧的侦察值修正；详见专门的⟦12⟧章节。以此方式获得的空军情报的有效上限为⟦13⟧，⟦14⟧而以此方式获得的民用情报硬上限为⟦15⟧。⟦16⟧硬上限不会直接计入一个国家的空军情报，但在其范围内获得的情报可以起到缓冲作用，在情报衰减影响一个国家的有效空军情报之前先行吸收衰减。

bjnumg.en: ⟦0⟧ involving enemy ⟦1⟧ can also generate air intel. The base daily air intel gain rate from ⟦2⟧ is ⟦3⟧ per ⟦4⟧ with at least one enemy ⟦5⟧, plus ⟦6⟧ per enemy carrier ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧ per enemy non-carrier ⟦9⟧ in those ⟦10⟧, all multiplied by ⟦11⟧. This is further modified by a dynamic gain rate and decay rate given to all intel gained from ⟦12⟧; see the dedicated ⟦13⟧ section for more details about these. The maximum effective cap on air intel gained in this way is ⟦14⟧,⟦15⟧ and the maximum hard cap on civilian intel gained in this way is ⟦16⟧.⟦17⟧ The hard cap does not contribute directly to a country's air intel, but intel gained within it can act as a buffer that absorbs intel decay before it can affect a country's effective air intel.
bjnumg.zh: 涉及敌方⟦0⟧的⟦1⟧也能产生空军情报。来自⟦2⟧的基础每日空军情报获取率为：每个至少有一架敌方⟦3⟧的⟦4⟧获得⟦5⟧，再加上这些⟦6⟧中每艘敌方航母⟦7⟧提供⟦8⟧、每艘敌方非航母⟦9⟧提供⟦10⟧，全部乘以⟦11⟧。这还会受到赋予来自⟦12⟧的全部情报的动态获取率与衰减率进一步修正；详见专门的⟦13⟧章节。以此方式获得的空军情报的有效上限为⟦14⟧，⟦15⟧而以此方式获得的民用情报硬上限为⟦16⟧。⟦17⟧硬上限不会直接计入一个国家的空军情报，但在其范围内获得的情报可以起到缓冲作用，在情报衰减影响一个国家的有效空军情报之前先行吸收衰减。

1iyil06.en: Intel is particularly important in multiplayer, where otherwise somewhat predictable AI opponents are replaced with potentially very unpredictable human ones. Intel serves as one of the main ways with which to deal with that unpredictability, observing what other players are doing and anticipating what will be needed to fight them while it is early enough to make such decisions. Denying enemy intel has similarly elevated importance in multiplayer: while AI opponents cannot predict or anticipate a player's moves, human opponents can, so preventing them from seeing what you are doing until it is too late for them to prepare appropriate countermeasures can be crucial to long-term strategy.
1iyil06.zh: 情报在多人游戏中尤为重要——在那里，原本多少有些可预测的 AI 对手被可能极难预测的人类对手取代。情报是应对这种不可预测性的主要手段之一：观察其他玩家在做什么，并在还来得及做出决策的时候预判对抗他们需要什么。在多人游戏中，阻止敌方获取情报的重要性同样上升：AI 对手无法预测或预判玩家的行动，人类对手却可以，因此在对手还来不及准备适当反制措施之前阻止他们看到你在做什么，可能对长期战略至关重要。

1c6l6gs.en: Additionally, fighting an enemy country's ⟦0⟧ convoys can temporarily provide additional civilian intel. The base intel gain rate is ⟦1⟧ per ⟦2⟧ convoy per day, though this is further modified by a dynamic gain rate and decay rate given to all intel gained from naval combat; see the dedicated ⟦3⟧ section for more details about these. The maximum effective cap on civilian intel gained in this way is ⟦4⟧,⟦5⟧ and the maximum hard cap on civilian intel gained in this way is ⟦6⟧.⟦7⟧ The hard cap does not contribute directly to a country's civilian intel, but intel gained within it can act as a buffer that absorbs intel decay before it can affect a country's effective civilian intel.
1c6l6gs.zh: 此外，打击敌国的⟦0⟧运输船队可以临时提供额外的民用情报。基础情报获取率为每⟦1⟧运输船队每天⟦2⟧，不过这还会受到赋予来自海战的全部情报的动态获取率与衰减率进一步修正；详见专门的⟦3⟧章节。以此方式获得的民用情报的有效上限为⟦4⟧，⟦5⟧而以此方式获得的民用情报硬上限为⟦6⟧。⟦7⟧硬上限不会直接计入一个国家的民用情报，但在其范围内获得的情报可以起到缓冲作用，在情报衰减影响一个国家的有效民用情报之前先行吸收衰减。

1rfhx80.en: At the top of the intel ledger are four buttons, each corresponding to one of the four intel types. Within each of these buttons is a percentage. This represents the intel level that the current country has on the target country in the associated intel type. Hover over one of these buttons will display a tooltip showing all intel sources that contribute to the total intel level on the target country. Selecting either of these four buttons will open up a screen showing detailed information related to that intel type; yellow chevrons on the left- and right-hand sides of a button communicate that the currently opened information is related to the indicated intel type.
1rfhx80.zh: 情报台账顶部有四个按钮，分别对应四种情报类型。每个按钮内都有一个百分比，表示当前国家对目标国在该情报类型上的情报等级。将鼠标悬停在其中一个按钮上会显示提示框，列出所有对该目标国情报等级总量有贡献的情报来源。选中这四个按钮中的任意一个都会打开一个界面，显示与该情报类型相关的详细信息；按钮左右两侧的黄色箭头表示当前打开的信息对应所示的情报类型。

17w1sjw.en: Infiltrating a country's civilian administration, army, navy, or air force using the corresponding ⟦0⟧ can provide additional civilian, army, navy, and air intel, respectively. Each of these operations adds ⟦1⟧ intel of their corresponding type as long as the infiltration lasts.⟦2⟧ The Make Resistance Contacts ⟦3⟧ also provides ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ against the target country while resistance ⟦6⟧ are available.⟦7⟧ There is currently a bug in the game where infiltrations like these are removed after loading a saved game,⟦8⟧ requiring the ⟦9⟧ to be refreshed afterward. The ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧ upgrade can increase the amount of intel gained from the assets obtained from these ⟦12⟧.
17w1sjw.zh: 使用相应的⟦0⟧渗透一个国家的民政机构、陆军、海军或空军，可以分别提供额外的民用、陆军、海军和空军情报。只要渗透持续，这些行动各自即可提供其对应类型的⟦1⟧情报。⟦2⟧「建立抵抗联系」⟦3⟧也会在抵抗⟦4⟧可用时提供针对目标国的⟦5⟧⟦6⟧。⟦7⟧目前游戏中存在一个 bug：此类渗透在读取存档后会被移除，⟦8⟧需要在此之后重新刷新⟦9⟧。⟦10⟧⟦11⟧升级可以提高从这些⟦12⟧所获资产中得到的情报量。

1cgx97.en: The intel gathering efficiency of ⟦0⟧ depends on both how many provinces of the target country are within their radar coverage, how many provinces the target country controls in total (the more provinces they control, the less intel is gathered from radar coverage over a single province), and the level of the ⟦1⟧ itself. At a maximum level of 6, a single ⟦2⟧ has an intel gathering efficiency of ⟦3⟧,⟦4⟧ and this decreases linearly with each missing level, down to ca. ⟦5⟧ efficiency at level 1. When multiple ⟦6⟧ cover a single province, the intel gathering efficiency of each station beyond the first is decreased by ⟦7⟧ for that province.
1cgx97.zh: ⟦0⟧的情报搜集效率取决于：目标国有多少省份处于其雷达覆盖范围内、目标国总共控制多少省份（他们控制的省份越多，从单个省份的雷达覆盖中搜集到的情报就越少），以及⟦1⟧本身的等级。在最高 6 级时，单个⟦2⟧的情报搜集效率为⟦3⟧，⟦4⟧并随每缺少一级而线性下降，1 级时降至约⟦5⟧效率。当多个⟦6⟧覆盖同一个省份时，该省份上第一个站点之外的每个站点的情报搜集效率都会降低⟦7⟧。

jith1a.en: If an observer country has more navy intel over a target country than the target has over the observer, the observer gains a bonus to their spotting speed against the target and the target gains a penalty to their spotting speed against the observer. Starting with a navy intel difference of at least ⟦0⟧ percentage points, the observer gains ⟦1⟧ spotting speed for every percentage point of difference in navy intel, up to a maximum of ⟦2⟧ spotting speed at a ⟦3⟧ percentage point difference in navy intel. The target receives a mirrored ⟦4⟧ spotting speed penalty per percentage point difference, up to a maximum penalty of ⟦5⟧.
jith1a.zh: 如果观察国对目标国的海军情报多于目标国对观察国的海军情报，观察国对其的发现速度获得加成，目标国对观察国的发现速度则受到惩罚。从海军情报差值至少达到⟦0⟧个百分点开始，海军情报每相差一个百分点，观察国获得⟦1⟧发现速度，在海军情报相差⟦2⟧个百分点时最多获得⟦3⟧发现速度。目标国则对应地每相差一个百分点受到⟦4⟧发现速度惩罚，最高惩罚为⟦5⟧。

wojd05.en: Radar coverage over sea provinces also incorporates a given ⟦0⟧'s intel gathering efficiency, but works based on the number and type of ship operating in the ⟦1⟧ to which the province belongs. Each submarine can provide up to ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ against its owner, each screen ship can provide up to ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ against its owner, each capital ship can provide up to ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧ against its owner, and each aircraft carrier can provide up to ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ against its owner,⟦10⟧ all multiplied by the fraction of radar coverage over the ⟦11⟧ in which they are operating and the intel gathering efficiency of the ⟦12⟧ providing that coverage.
wojd05.zh: 海面省份的雷达覆盖也会计入特定⟦0⟧的情报搜集效率，但其运作基于该省份所属⟦1⟧中运作的舰船数量与类型。每艘潜艇最多可对其拥有者提供⟦2⟧⟦3⟧，每艘屏卫舰最多可提供⟦4⟧⟦5⟧，每艘主力舰最多可提供⟦6⟧⟦7⟧，每艘航空母舰最多可提供⟦8⟧⟦9⟧，⟦10⟧全部乘以它们所在⟦11⟧的雷达覆盖比例，以及提供该覆盖的⟦12⟧的情报搜集效率。

17xd4s7.en: Civilian intel provides information that is observable from the civilian intel tab of the intel ledger. Some types of information have binary civilian intel requirements: either the country has enough civilian intel over a target to see them, or they don't. Other types of information have more gradation: a country must have enough civilian intel over the target to see them, but the information starts out very fuzzy and becomes more precise with more civilian intel. Many of these effects are summarized in the table below. In addition, all laws, national spirits, and design companies are always visible.⟦0⟧
17xd4s7.zh: 民用情报提供可在情报台账的民用情报标签页中查看的信息。某些类型的信息对民用情报有二元要求：要么该国对目标拥有足够的民用情报从而能看到，要么看不到。另一些类型的信息则更有层次：一个国家必须先拥有足够的民用情报才能看到目标，但信息起初非常模糊，会随民用情报增多而变得更精确。其中许多效果汇总于下表。此外，所有法案、国家精神和设计公司始终可见。⟦0⟧

1gln8rv.en: Air intel is closely tied to the detection of ⟦0⟧. Having at least ⟦1⟧ air intel is required to know when a raid has been launched, but having more allows for incoming raids to be detected while they are still in their preparation phases. Each percentage point of air intel against a target allows raids to be detected one percentage point earlier into their preparation phase: ⟦2⟧ air intel allows raids to be detected at ⟦3⟧ preparation, ⟦4⟧ air intel allows raids to be detected at ⟦5⟧ preparation, ⟦6⟧ air intel allows raids to be detected at ⟦7⟧ preparation, etc.⟦8⟧
1gln8rv.zh: 空军情报与探测⟦0⟧密切相关。至少拥有⟦1⟧空军情报才能知道空袭已经发起，而拥有更多情报则可以在来袭空袭仍处于准备阶段时就探测到它们。对目标每有一个百分点的空军情报，空袭就能在其准备阶段提前一个百分点被发现：⟦2⟧空军情报可在⟦3⟧准备度时发现空袭，⟦4⟧空军情报可在⟦5⟧准备度时发现，⟦6⟧空军情报可在⟦7⟧准备度时发现，依此类推。⟦8⟧

1nweugr.en: Army intel provides information that is observable from the army intel tab of the intel ledger. Some types of information have binary army intel requirements: either the country has enough army intel over a target to see them, or they don't. Other types of information have more gradation: a country must have enough army intel over the target to see them, but the information starts out very fuzzy and becomes more precise with more army intel. Many of these effects are summarized in the table below. In addition, all ⟦0⟧ selections and ⟦1⟧ are always visible.⟦2⟧
1nweugr.zh: 陆军情报提供可在情报台账的陆军情报标签页中查看的信息。某些类型的信息对陆军情报有二元要求：要么该国对目标拥有足够的陆军情报从而能看到，要么看不到。另一些类型的信息则更有层次：一个国家必须先拥有足够的陆军情报才能看到目标，但信息起初非常模糊，会随陆军情报增多而变得更精确。其中许多效果汇总于下表。此外，所有⟦0⟧选择与⟦1⟧始终可见。⟦2⟧

15m39m4.en: Without La Résistance, observing countries can gain additional intel based on their decryption levels relative to a target country's encryption levels. The main source for both are ⟦0⟧. With a decryption level that matches the target's encryption level, the observing country gains ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ over the target country,⟦9⟧ unless the observing country has a decryption level of ⟦10⟧, in which case they gain no intel. For mismatched decryption and encryption levels, these base levels of extra intel are modified as such:
15m39m4.zh: 在没有《抵抗运动》时，观察国可以根据其相对目标国加密等级的解密等级获得额外情报。两者的主要来源都是⟦0⟧。当解密等级与目标国的加密等级相同时，观察国对目标国获得⟦1⟧⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧⟦8⟧，⟦9⟧除非观察国的解密等级为⟦10⟧，那样他们将得不到任何情报。当解密与加密等级不匹配时，这些基础额外情报量按如下方式修正：

l7559u.en: The amount of intel that captured ⟦0⟧ can provide against their country of origin has both an effective cap and a hard cap. The effective cap is the maximum amount of bonus intel that can be gained from the operative. The hard cap serves as an extra intel gain buffer that does not directly provide intel to the observing country, but intel gained within its limits will be the first to absorb intel decay once there are no more captured ⟦1⟧ present from the target country. The effective and hard caps for each type of intel are as follows:
l7559u.zh: 被俘获的⟦0⟧能对其原属国提供的情报量既有有效上限也有硬上限。有效上限是从该特工处能获得的额外情报的最大值。硬上限则充当额外的情报获取缓冲：它不直接向观察国提供情报，但当目标国不再有被俘获的⟦1⟧存在时，在其限度内获取的情报会最先吸收情报衰减。各类情报的有效上限与硬上限如下：

wyyyh7.en: The amount of intel that ⟦0⟧ can provide over a target country has both an effective cap and a hard cap. The effective cap is the maximum amount of bonus intel that can be gained from planes flying that mission type at any given time. The hard cap serves as an extra intel gain buffer that does not directly provide intel to the observing country, but is the first to absorb intel decay should the observing country stop flying ⟦1⟧ missions over a target country. The effective and hard caps for each type of intel are as follows:
wyyyh7.zh: ⟦0⟧能对目标国提供的情报量既有有效上限也有硬上限。有效上限是在任意给定时刻执行该任务类型的飞机所能提供的额外情报的最大值。硬上限则充当额外的情报获取缓冲：它不直接向观察国提供情报，但当观察国停止对目标国执行⟦1⟧任务时，它会最先吸收情报衰减。各类情报的有效上限与硬上限如下：

13j0275.en: The base daily army intel gain rate is ⟦0⟧ per active ⟦1⟧, plus ⟦2⟧ per enemy division actively fighting in the battle, ⟦3⟧ per enemy division in reserve in the battle, and ⟦4⟧ per enemy division retreating from the battle, all multiplied by ⟦5⟧.⟦6⟧ The base gain is then modified by ⟦7⟧ for each point of reconnaissance that the observing country or its allies has in a given ⟦8⟧, which can be further increased with the ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧ spirit with ⟦11⟧. The actual amount of intel gained from ⟦12⟧ per day is:⟦13⟧
13j0275.zh: 基础每日陆军情报获取率为：每个活跃的⟦0⟧提供⟦1⟧，再加上战斗中每个正在积极作战的敌方师提供⟦2⟧、战斗中每个处于预备的敌方师提供⟦3⟧、每个从战斗中撤退的敌方师提供⟦4⟧，全部乘以⟦5⟧。⟦6⟧随后，基础获取量会根据观察国或其盟国在特定⟦7⟧中每点侦察值获得⟦8⟧修正，还可用带有⟦9⟧的⟦10⟧⟦11⟧精神进一步提高。每天从⟦12⟧实际获得的情报量为：⟦13⟧

1g05s6.en: Additionally, if an observer country has more army intel on a target country than the target has on the observer, the observer's ⟦0⟧ can receive combat bonuses when fighting the target's ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧. Starting an army intel difference of at least ⟦3⟧ percentage points, the observer's units receive a ⟦4⟧ bonus to their soft attack, hard attack, defense, and breakthrough stats for every percentage point of difference in army intel, up to a maximum of ⟦5⟧ at a ⟦6⟧ percentage point difference.
1g05s6.zh: 此外，如果观察国对目标国的陆军情报多于目标国对观察国的陆军情报，观察国的⟦0⟧在与目标国的⟦1⟧于⟦2⟧中交战时可以获得战斗加成。从陆军情报差值至少达到⟦3⟧个百分点开始，陆军情报每相差一个百分点，观察国的单位就在软攻、硬攻、防御和突破属性上获得⟦4⟧加成，在相差⟦5⟧个百分点时最多获得⟦6⟧。

1eshb6s.en: The ⟦0⟧ air mission is a special mission that provides intel of all kinds about countries over which planes on the mission are flying. Dedicated scout planes are the best suited to this role, as they can perform the mission over both neutral and enemy countries and only require wings of 10 aircraft. With ⟦1⟧, any aircraft equipped with a ⟦2⟧ module can perform this mission, though planes other than dedicated scout planes do not provide intel about neutral countries, only enemies.
1eshb6s.zh: ⟦0⟧空中任务是一项特殊任务，可提供执行该任务的飞机所飞越国家的各类情报。专用侦察机最适合这一角色，因为它们可以对中立国和敌国都执行该任务，且只需要 10 架飞机组成的航空队。有了⟦1⟧之后，任何装备了⟦2⟧模块的飞机都可以执行该任务，不过除专用侦察机之外的飞机不会提供关于中立国家的情报，只会提供关于敌国的。

pmyqw8.en: There are four types of intel: civilian intel, army intel, navy intel, and air intel. The amount of intel that each country has on each other country is tracked individually for these four categories. Each type of intel can be gained through different sources, and higher levels in each intel type provide both different passive information about the target country to its observer and potential bonuses (or penalties) for the observer country against the target country.
pmyqw8.zh: 情报共有四种类型：民用情报、陆军情报、海军情报和空军情报。每个国家对其他每个国家在这四个类别上的情报量都会分别追踪。每种情报都可以通过不同来源获得，而每种情报类型等级越高，既会向观察国提供关于目标国的不同被动信息，也可能为观察国对目标国带来加成（或惩罚）。

1kw6iwy.en: Intel networks in a country can provide civilian, army, navy, and air intel to the networks' owners against the target country. These can be built up using ⟦0⟧ performing the ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ and, once a sufficient size is reached, quieted using the ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧. The maximum amount of intel provided by a network is ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧, and ⟦11⟧ ⟦12⟧,⟦13⟧ all of which are scaled by ⟦14⟧ the intel network coverage in the target country. It does not matter if the networks are active or have been quieted, their coverage contributes to providing intel regardless. This amount can also be increased with the ⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧ upgrade. ⟦17⟧ is based on the coverage of ⟦18⟧ instead of just states, with a ⟦19⟧ states coverage multiplier if no ⟦20⟧ are covered by intel networks, though the total maximum of ⟦21⟧ ⟦22⟧ from intel networks still applies.
1kw6iwy.zh: 一个国家内的情报网可以为情报网的拥有者提供针对目标国的民用、陆军、海军和空军情报。它们可以通过⟦0⟧执行⟦1⟧⟦2⟧来建立，一旦达到足够规模，还可以用⟦3⟧⟦4⟧使其静默。一个情报网能提供的情报上限为⟦5⟧⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧⟦8⟧、⟦9⟧⟦10⟧和⟦11⟧⟦12⟧，⟦13⟧这些数值都会按⟦14⟧（目标国中的情报网覆盖度）缩放。情报网是活跃还是已静默并不重要，其覆盖度都会照常提供情报。该数值也可以通过⟦15⟧⟦16⟧升级来提高。⟦17⟧则基于⟦18⟧的覆盖度而非仅基于州，若情报网未覆盖任何⟦19⟧，则带有一个⟦20⟧州的覆盖倍率，不过来自情报网的总上限⟦21⟧⟦22⟧仍然适用。

1rbbcp0.en: Certain national spirits and political advisors can reduce the amount of army intel given to other countries or increase the amount of army intel gained from other countries. Notably, the ⟦0⟧ spirit for Germany and the ⟦1⟧ decision for the ⟦2⟧ unlocked by SMERSH can lower the amount of army intel given to other countries significantly. With ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ spirit exclusive to ⟦6⟧ countries also reduces the amount of army intel given to other countries.
1rbbcp0.zh: 某些国家精神和政治顾问可以减少提供给其他国家的陆军情报量，或增加从其他国家获得的陆军情报量。其中最值得注意的是德国的⟦0⟧精神，以及 SMERSH 解锁的⟦1⟧为⟦2⟧提供的决议，二者都能显著降低提供给其他国家的陆军情报量。有了⟦3⟧之后，⟦4⟧⟦5⟧精神（仅限⟦6⟧国家）也会减少提供给其他国家的陆军情报量。

1islu0q.en: With ⟦0⟧, the observer also takes reduced damage from the target's naval mines if they have more navy intel on the target than the target has on them. Starting with a navy intel difference of at least ⟦1⟧ percentage points, the observer receives ⟦2⟧ damage from the target's naval mines for every percentage point of difference in navy intel, up to a maximum of ⟦3⟧ damage from the target's naval mines at a ⟦4⟧ percentage point difference in navy intel.
1islu0q.zh: 有了⟦0⟧之后，如果观察国对目标国的海军情报多于目标国对观察国的海军情报，观察国因目标国水雷受到的伤害也会减少。从海军情报差值至少达到⟦1⟧个百分点开始，海军情报每相差一个百分点，观察国从目标国水雷受到的伤害为⟦2⟧，在海军情报相差⟦3⟧个百分点时最多降至⟦4⟧。

lmn32f.en: Fighting enemy ships in naval combat can temporarily provide navy intel over the ships' owning countries. The maximum effective cap on navy intel gained in this way is ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ and the maximum hard cap on navy intel gained in this way is ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧ The hard cap does not contribute directly to a country's navy intel, but intel gained within it can act as a buffer that absorbs intel decay before it can affect a country's effective navy intel.
lmn32f.zh: 在海战中打击敌方舰船可以临时提供关于这些舰船所属国家的情报。以此方式获得的海军情报有效上限为⟦0⟧，⟦1⟧而以此方式获得的海军情报硬上限为⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧硬上限不会直接计入一个国家的海军情报，但在其范围内获得的情报可以起到缓冲作用，在情报衰减影响一个国家的有效海军情报之前先行吸收衰减。

1kvtfcf.en: ⟦0⟧ also provide intel depending on the fraction of a target country's convoys that pass through the ⟦1⟧ they cover, including those used for ⟦2⟧, supply, and transporting troops. As a baseline, this is ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧ per ⟦11⟧ per ⟦12⟧,⟦13⟧ multiplied by the fraction of the target's convoys that pass through that region as well as each ⟦14⟧'s intel gathering efficiency and overall coverage of each ⟦15⟧.
1kvtfcf.zh: ⟦0⟧也会根据目标国运输船队中穿过其覆盖的⟦1⟧的比例提供情报，其中包括用于⟦2⟧、补给和运送部队的船队。作为基准，这相当于每⟦3⟧⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧⟦8⟧和⟦9⟧⟦10⟧，按每⟦11⟧每⟦12⟧计，⟦13⟧再乘以目标国船队穿过该区域的比例，以及每个⟦14⟧的情报搜集效率和它对每个⟦15⟧的整体覆盖度。

60a8wq.en: Certain national spirits and political advisors can reduce the amount of navy intel given to other countries or increase the amount of navy intel gained from other countries. Notably, the ⟦0⟧ spirit for Germany and the ⟦1⟧ decision for the ⟦2⟧ unlocked by SMERSH can lower the amount of navy intel given to other countries significantly. With ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ spirit also reduces the amount of navy intel given to other countries.
60a8wq.zh: 某些国家精神和政治顾问可以减少提供给其他国家的海军情报量，或增加从其他国家获得的海军情报量。其中最值得注意的是德国的⟦0⟧精神，以及 SMERSH 解锁的⟦1⟧为⟦2⟧提供的决议，二者都能显著降低提供给其他国家的海军情报量。有了⟦3⟧之后，⟦4⟧⟦5⟧精神也会减少提供给其他国家的海军情报量。

1qzitip.en: Fighting enemy ⟦0⟧ in ⟦1⟧ can temporarily provide army intel against the enemy units' owners. The maximum effective cap on army intel gained in this way is ⟦2⟧,⟦3⟧ and the maximum hard cap on army intel gained in this way is ⟦4⟧.⟦5⟧ The hard cap does not contribute directly to a country's army intel, but intel gained within it can act as a buffer that absorbs intel decay before it can affect a country's effective army intel.
1qzitip.zh: 打击⟦0⟧敌方单位（在⟦1⟧中）可以临时提供针对敌方单位所属国的陆军情报。以此方式获得的陆军情报有效上限为⟦2⟧，⟦3⟧而以此方式获得的陆军情报硬上限为⟦4⟧。⟦5⟧硬上限不会直接计入一个国家的陆军情报，但在其范围内获得的情报可以起到缓冲作用，在情报衰减影响一个国家的有效陆军情报之前先行吸收衰减。

kaefnu.en: Certain national spirits and political advisors can reduce the amount of air intel given to other countries or increase the amount of air intel gained from other countries. Notably, the ⟦0⟧ spirit for Germany and the ⟦1⟧ decision for the ⟦2⟧ unlocked by SMERSH can lower the amount of air intel given to other countries significantly. With ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ spirit also reduces the amount of air intel given to other countries.
kaefnu.zh: 某些国家精神和政治顾问可以减少提供给其他国家的空军情报量，或增加从其他国家获得的空军情报量。其中最值得注意的是德国的⟦0⟧精神，以及 SMERSH 解锁的⟦1⟧为⟦2⟧提供的决议，二者都能显著降低提供给其他国家的空军情报量。有了⟦3⟧之后，⟦4⟧⟦5⟧精神也会减少提供给其他国家的空军情报量。

1nwl7xt.en: Fighting enemy ⟦0⟧ in ⟦1⟧ can temporarily provide navy intel over the ships' owning countries. The maximum effective cap on air intel gained in this way is ⟦2⟧,⟦3⟧ and the maximum hard cap on air intel gained in this way is ⟦4⟧.⟦5⟧ The hard cap does not contribute directly to a country's air intel, but intel gained within it can act as a buffer that absorbs intel decay before it can affect a country's effective air intel.
1nwl7xt.zh: 打击⟦0⟧敌方舰船（在⟦1⟧中）可以临时提供关于这些舰船所属国家的情报。以此方式获得的空军情报有效上限为⟦2⟧，⟦3⟧而以此方式获得的空军情报硬上限为⟦4⟧。⟦5⟧硬上限不会直接计入一个国家的空军情报，但在其范围内获得的情报可以起到缓冲作用，在情报衰减影响一个国家的有效空军情报之前先行吸收衰减。

191a6bj.en: Capturing enemy ⟦0⟧ can also provide additional intel against their country of origin. Captured operatives provide a base daily intel gain of ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧,⟦9⟧ multiplied by a random factor between ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧.⟦12⟧ These values can be increased with the ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧ upgrade, but is also decreased if the captured operative has the ⟦15⟧ trait. The actual amount of intel gained per day is then:⟦16⟧
191a6bj.zh: 俘获敌方⟦0⟧也可以提供针对其原属国的额外情报。被俘特工提供的基础每日情报获取量为⟦1⟧⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧⟦8⟧，⟦9⟧再乘以一个介于⟦10⟧与⟦11⟧之间的随机系数。⟦12⟧这些数值可以通过⟦13⟧⟦14⟧升级提高，但如果被俘特工拥有⟦15⟧特质则会降低。每天实际获得的情报量为：⟦16⟧

186khi6.en: ⟦0⟧ covers intelligence related to a country's ⟦1⟧, laws, ⟦2⟧, resources, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧, as well as its ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ technologies. The information provided by civilian intel can be especially important in the pre-war build-up phase to help anticipate what future enemies might be planning to do and prepare appropriately. Civilian intel does not provide any direct bonuses, only information.
186khi6.zh: ⟦0⟧涵盖与一个国家的⟦1⟧、法案、⟦2⟧、资源、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧相关的信息，以及其⟦5⟧与⟦6⟧科技。民用情报提供的信息在战前建设阶段可能尤其重要，有助于预判未来的敌人可能计划做什么并相应做好准备。民用情报不提供任何直接加成，只提供信息。

1pvba1y.en: The base amount of intel provided by ⟦0⟧ is ⟦1⟧ per plane per ⟦2⟧. Each ⟦3⟧ over land can provide up to ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧, and ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧ over countries operating in that region.⟦12⟧ Each ⟦13⟧ over sea zones can provide up to ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧ ⟦17⟧, ⟦18⟧ ⟦19⟧, and ⟦20⟧ ⟦21⟧ over countries operating in that region.⟦22⟧ The actual amount of intel gained per day is:⟦23⟧
1pvba1y.zh: ⟦0⟧提供的基础情报量为每⟦1⟧每架飞机每⟦2⟧。陆地上空的每个⟦3⟧最多可对在该区域运作的国家提供⟦4⟧⟦5⟧、⟦6⟧⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧⟦9⟧和⟦10⟧⟦11⟧。⟦12⟧海域上空的每个⟦13⟧最多可对在该区域运作的国家提供⟦14⟧⟦15⟧、⟦16⟧⟦17⟧、⟦18⟧⟦19⟧和⟦20⟧⟦21⟧。⟦22⟧每天实际获得的情报量为：⟦23⟧

177yao1.en: Cracking a country's ciphers with cryptology increases the amount of civilian, army, navy, and air intel against them. The bonus provided from passive decryption is ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧.⟦8⟧ This is increased to ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧ ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧, and ⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧ whenever the cracked ciphers are revealed,⟦17⟧ though this only lasts for 30⟦18⟧ days.
177yao1.zh: 用密码学破解一个国家的密码会增加针对该国的民用、陆军、海军和空军情报量。被动解密提供的加成为⟦0⟧⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧⟦7⟧。⟦8⟧每当已破解的密码被揭示时，这会提高到⟦9⟧⟦10⟧、⟦11⟧⟦12⟧、⟦13⟧⟦14⟧和⟦15⟧⟦16⟧，⟦17⟧不过这只持续 30⟦18⟧天。

1phrfew.en: Certain national spirits and political advisors can reduce the amount of civilian intel given to other countries or increase the amount of civilian intel gained from other countries. Notably, the ⟦0⟧ spirit for Germany and the ⟦1⟧ decision for the ⟦2⟧ unlocked by SMERSH can lower the amount of civilian intel given to other countries significantly.
1phrfew.zh: 某些国家精神和政治顾问可以减少提供给其他国家的民用情报量，或增加从其他国家获得的民用情报量。其中最值得注意的是德国的⟦0⟧精神，以及 SMERSH 解锁的⟦1⟧为⟦2⟧提供的决议，二者都能显著降低提供给其他国家的民用情报量。

1n82vd.en: Having too little navy intel against a target country applies a penalty when attempting to establish or contest naval supremacy against the target country's ships. Below ⟦0⟧ navy intel against a target country, the observer country receives a ⟦1⟧ penalty to their naval supremacy against the target country for each percentage point of naval intel missing, down to a maximum penalty of ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ at ⟦4⟧ or lower naval intel.
1n82vd.zh: 对目标国的海军情报过少时，在尝试对目标国舰船建立或争夺海军霸主地位会受到惩罚。当对目标国的海军情报低于⟦0⟧时，观察国每缺少一个百分点的海军情报，就对目标国的海军霸主地位受到⟦1⟧惩罚，最多受到⟦2⟧⟦3⟧的惩罚，即在海军情报为⟦4⟧或更低时。

1730xzu.en: La Résistance unlocks many more potential sources for civilian intel, both from ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. See the dedicated ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ sections for more details. Without La Résistance, countries can receive additional civilian intel based on their decryption level relative to target countries' encryption levels. See the dedicated ⟦4⟧ section for more details.
1730xzu.zh: 《抵抗运动》解锁了更多潜在的民用情报来源，既有来自⟦0⟧的，也有来自⟦1⟧的。详见专门的⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧章节。没有《抵抗运动》时，国家可以根据其相对目标国加密等级的解密等级获得额外的民用情报。详见专门的⟦4⟧章节。

qpsdi2.en: La Résistance unlocks many more potential sources for army intel, both from ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. See the dedicated ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ sections for more details. Without La Résistance, countries can receive additional army intel based on their decryption level relative to target countries' encryption levels. See the dedicated ⟦4⟧ section for more details.
qpsdi2.zh: 《抵抗运动》解锁了更多潜在的陆军情报来源，既有来自⟦0⟧的，也有来自⟦1⟧的。详见专门的⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧章节。没有《抵抗运动》时，国家可以根据其相对目标国加密等级的解密等级获得额外的陆军情报。详见专门的⟦4⟧章节。

16a0g4a.en: La Résistance unlocks many more potential sources for navy intel, both from ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. See the dedicated ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ sections for more details. Without La Résistance, countries can receive additional navy intel based on their decryption level relative to target countries' encryption levels. See the dedicated ⟦4⟧ section for more details.
16a0g4a.zh: 《抵抗运动》解锁了更多潜在的海军情报来源，既有来自⟦0⟧的，也有来自⟦1⟧的。详见专门的⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧章节。没有《抵抗运动》时，国家可以根据其相对目标国加密等级的解密等级获得额外的海军情报。详见专门的⟦4⟧章节。

1r5bgby.en: La Résistance unlocks many more potential sources for air intel, both from ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. See the dedicated ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ sections for more details. Without La Résistance, countries can receive additional air intel based on their decryption level relative to target countries' encryption levels. See the dedicated ⟦4⟧ section for more details.
1r5bgby.zh: 《抵抗运动》解锁了更多潜在的空军情报来源，既有来自⟦0⟧的，也有来自⟦1⟧的。详见专门的⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧章节。没有《抵抗运动》时，国家可以根据其相对目标国加密等级的解密等级获得额外的空军情报。详见专门的⟦4⟧章节。

1acax7u.en: ⟦0⟧, also known as ⟦1⟧, covers intelligence related to a country's ⟦2⟧ (including ⟦3⟧), air bases, active ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and air-related ⟦6⟧ spirits, as well as its ⟦7⟧. Should the target country plan or launch a ⟦8⟧ against the observer country, the latter will be notified of it earlier at higher levels of air intel.
1acax7u.zh: ⟦0⟧（又称⟦1⟧）涵盖与一个国家的⟦2⟧（包括⟦3⟧）、空军基地、活跃的⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧以及与空军相关的⟦6⟧精神有关的信息，以及其⟦7⟧。如果目标国计划或对观察国发动⟦8⟧，空军情报等级越高，观察国就会越早收到通知。

uutm0k.en: ⟦0⟧ can provide additional intel of all types against other countries depending on their coverage. At their maximum, they can provide up to ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ over other countries.⟦9⟧ Intel from ⟦10⟧ is considered "static intel", meaning it is gained and lost instantaneously.
uutm0k.zh: ⟦0⟧可以根据其覆盖度提供针对其他国家的各类额外情报。在最大覆盖度下，它们最多可对其他国家的⟦1⟧⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧⟦8⟧。⟦9⟧来自⟦10⟧的情报被视为「静态情报」，即它是瞬时获得与失去的。

19asf5n.en: The intel ledger is the place where intel levels on a country can be checked, as well as the main place where information based on gathered intel can be viewed. It can be found by opening up the diplomacy menu of another country, then selecting the tab labelled ⟦0⟧ next to the one labelled ⟦1⟧.
19asf5n.zh: 情报台账是查看一个国家情报等级的地方，也是查看基于已获取情报的信息的主要场所。打开另一个国家的外交菜单，然后选择标有⟦0⟧、紧邻标有⟦1⟧的标签页旁的那个标签页即可找到它。

l3zxis.en: ⟦0⟧ covers intelligence related to a country's ⟦1⟧, special forces, stockpiled ⟦2⟧ (including ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧), ⟦5⟧, and army-related ⟦6⟧ spirits, as well as its ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, and ⟦10⟧. In ⟦11⟧, the side with more army intel over the other receives a bonus to its combat stats.
l3zxis.zh: ⟦0⟧涵盖与一个国家的⟦1⟧、特种部队、库存⟦2⟧（包括⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧）、⟦5⟧以及与陆军相关的⟦6⟧精神有关的信息，以及其⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧、⟦9⟧和⟦10⟧。在⟦11⟧中，陆军情报多于对方的一方会获得战斗属性加成。

y0egzm.en: Generally speaking, more information will become available in the intel ledger at higher intel levels, and existing information will also become more precise at higher intel levels. For more details, consult the dedicated effects sections for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧.
y0egzm.zh: 一般来说，情报等级越高，情报台账中可用的信息就越多，已有信息也会变得更精确。更多细节请查阅⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧各自的效果章节。

s5305y.en: ⟦0⟧ covers intelligence related to a country's ships (including ⟦1⟧), naval bases, active ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and navy-related ⟦4⟧ spirits, as well as its ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧. Having low navy intel against an enemy confers a penalty to contesting naval supremacy against them.
s5305y.zh: ⟦0⟧涵盖与一个国家的舰船（包括⟦1⟧）、海军基地、活跃的⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧以及与海军相关的⟦4⟧精神有关的信息，以及其⟦5⟧与⟦6⟧。对敌人的海军情报较低时，在对其争夺海军霸主地位时会受到惩罚。

1c5rj19.en: Finally, when in a ⟦0⟧ with an ally who has more civilian intel on a target country, the observing country receives ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ of the difference between them and their ally as bonus civilian intel against the target country.
1c5rj19.zh: 最后，当观察国与一位对某目标国拥有更多民用情报的盟友处于同一⟦0⟧时，观察国可获得二者情报差值的⟦1⟧⟦2⟧，作为针对该目标国的额外民用情报。

152hyuz.en: The base daily navy intel gain rate is ⟦0⟧ per ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ per enemy submarine, ⟦3⟧ per enemy screen ship, ⟦4⟧ per enemy submarine, ⟦5⟧ per enemy capital ship, and ⟦6⟧ per aircraft hosted on aircraft carriers in the naval battle(s). The actual amount of intel gained from ⟦7⟧ per day is (for all intel types):⟦8⟧
152hyuz.zh: 基础每日海军情报获取率为：⟦0⟧（按每⟦1⟧计），每艘敌方潜艇⟦2⟧，每艘敌方屏卫舰⟦3⟧，每艘敌方潜艇⟦4⟧，每艘敌方主力舰⟦5⟧，以及海战中的航空母舰所搭载的每架飞机⟦6⟧。每天从⟦7⟧实际获得的情报量（对全部情报类型均适用）为：⟦8⟧

13kvoqt.en: Finally, when in a ⟦0⟧ with an ally who has more army intel on a target country, the observing country receives ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ of the difference between them and their ally as bonus army intel against the target country.
13kvoqt.zh: 最后，当观察国与一位对某目标国拥有更多陆军情报的盟友处于同一⟦0⟧时，观察国可获得二者情报差值的⟦1⟧⟦2⟧，作为针对该目标国的额外陆军情报。

lthvvb.en: Finally, when in a ⟦0⟧ with an ally who has more navy intel on a target country, the observing country receives ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ of the difference between them and their ally as bonus navy intel against the target country.
lthvvb.zh: 最后，当观察国与一位对某目标国拥有更多海军情报的盟友处于同一⟦0⟧时，观察国可获得二者情报差值的⟦1⟧⟦2⟧，作为针对该目标国的额外海军情报。

1j7vbx6.en: It should be noted that unlike army intel, air intel does not provide any bonuses to ⟦0⟧. However, with La Résistance, having decrypted enemy ciphers provides some bonuses to ⟦1⟧. See cryptology for more details.
1j7vbx6.zh: 需要注意的是，与陆军情报不同，空军情报不为⟦0⟧提供任何加成。不过，装用《抵抗运动》后，破解敌方密码会为⟦1⟧提供一些加成。详见密码学。

jqut99.en: Finally, when in a ⟦0⟧ with an ally who has more air intel on a target country, the observing country receives ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ of the difference between them and their ally as bonus air intel against the target country.
jqut99.zh: 最后，当观察国与一位对某目标国拥有更多空军情报的盟友处于同一⟦0⟧时，观察国可获得二者情报差值的⟦1⟧⟦2⟧，作为针对该目标国的额外空军情报。

1l5uakw.en: Civilian intel is generally focused on a country's economy, giving a lot of information in a broad range of topics, but providing no other bonuses besides this information. It can range between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.⟦2⟧
1l5uakw.zh: 民用情报通常侧重于一个国家的经济，在广泛的主题上提供大量信息，但除了这些信息之外不提供其他加成。其取值范围在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧之间。⟦2⟧

73v61z.en: Army intel is generally focused on a country's land-based military and can provide land combat bonuses to whichever side has more army intel over the other. It can range between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.⟦2⟧
73v61z.zh: 陆军情报通常侧重于一个国家的陆上军事力量，并可为陆军情报多于对方的一方提供陆战加成。其取值范围在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧之间。⟦2⟧

1k5qlc3.en: Navy intel is generally focused on a country's navy, and having too little navy intel over an enemy can make finding and contesting their navy harder. It can range between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.⟦2⟧
1k5qlc3.zh: 海军情报通常侧重于一个国家的海军，而对敌人的海军情报过少会使发现和对抗其海军变得更困难。其取值范围在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧之间。⟦2⟧

1319cuu.en: Higher tiers of economy law are generally more efficient than lower ones, especially when constructing factories. Although ⟦0⟧ reduces the amount of recruitable population available for ⟦1⟧, the effect can be counteracted with the ⟦2⟧ decision that becomes available for 100 ⟦3⟧ (though it will need to be retaken should the country no longer be at war).
1319cuu.zh: 更高层级的经济法案通常比更低层级更高效，在建造工厂时尤其如此。尽管⟦0⟧会减少可用于⟦1⟧的可征召人口，但该影响可以用⟦2⟧决议来抵消——该决议需花费 100⟦3⟧解锁（不过如果国家不再处于战争状态，就需要重新执行一次）。

1a61kkm.en: Once the focus Armed Neutrality is completed, the militias will be able to be expanded, improved and eventually, deployed using the ⟦0⟧ decision. While the militias are deployed, penalties to the Swiss economy will stack up over time, but they'll reset after they're recalled.

121tqt4.en: The economy law of a country defines how many ⟦0⟧ of all factories are needed to produce ⟦1⟧, the ⟦2⟧ and conversion costs of factories, and the efficiency of ⟦3⟧ production. It can be changed for 150 ⟦4⟧ if the prerequisites are met.

iqfw1d.en: ⟦0⟧ is the default trade law and the starting one for most countries. However, some countries start with ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ instead, including Germany, ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧. Communist China is the only country that starts with ⟦7⟧.
