oosaxd.en: ⟦0⟧ Represents the ability of a unit to build temporary defensive structures like trenches and pick favourable defensive positions like hills, to better defend against an enemy attack. Entrenchment level is mentioned in the army selection. Entrenchment affect both attack and defence stats of divisions. Divisions build up entrenchment daily when not engaged in combat and stationary (not moving). Divisions will lose all their entrenchment if they are attacking, with the exception of using the probing attack ability (Reference: Command Power). It provides a massive bonus when defending the province, going as far as an outright force multiplier. The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
oosaxd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 表示一个单位建造临时防御工事（如战壕）以及选择有利防御位置（如丘陵）以更好地抵御敌方进攻的能力。工事等级会在陆军选择界面中显示。工事会同时影响师的攻击与防御属性。师在未交战且静止（不移动）时每天都会累积工事。师在进攻时会失去全部工事，使用试探性攻击能力时例外（参见：指挥点数）。它在防御省份时提供巨大加成，甚至能达到成倍的兵力倍增效果。该师的此项属性是全部营与连该项属性的⟦1⟧。

vzikpb.en: Fuel Usage: How much fuel a unit uses while it is operating. Land units with fuel consumption will consume fuel when moving, in combat, or training. Divisions low on fuel can only be refueled in provinces with enough supply. Using ⟦0⟧ support companies can lower a division's fuel usage. The stat for the division is the ⟦1⟧ of those of all battalions and companies, though some support companies do not increase fuel usage despite requiring equipment that normally requires fuel.
vzikpb.zh: 燃油消耗：一个单位在运作期间消耗多少燃油。有燃油消耗的陆军单位在移动、交战或训练时都会消耗燃油。燃油不足的师只能在补给充足的省份加油。使用⟦0⟧支援连可以降低师的燃油消耗。该师的此项属性是全部营与连该项属性的⟦1⟧，不过有些支援连尽管需要通常消耗燃油的装备，却不会增加燃油消耗。

licouy.en: Equipment is produced by ⟦0⟧ Lines. All units use Equipment of some sort. An Equipment Type is a more abstract grouping, such as Medium Tanks. A Division that has a Division template that uses Medium Tanks can use any type of Medium Tank Equipment to fill its Equipment needs. The statistics of a unit are determined by the statistics of its equipment types. This may be modified by the unit itself; for example, ⟦1⟧ typically get penalties to most combat statistics.
licouy.zh: 装备由⟦0⟧生产线生产。所有单位都会使用某种装备。装备类型是更抽象的分组，例如中型坦克。一个使用了中型坦克师编制的师，可以用任意类型的中型坦克装备来满足其装备需求。一个单位的属性由其装备类型的属性决定，也可能被单位本身修改；例如⟦1⟧通常在大多数战斗属性上会受到惩罚。

1xhjsa9.en: Most of these stats can be improved through building and using ⟦0⟧ and, with ⟦1⟧, using different ⟦2⟧. However, be aware that increasing one stat can adversely affect a different stat. Researching ⟦3⟧ can also increase stats, as can various technologies and, with ⟦4⟧, certain special forces doctrines. Some ⟦5⟧ and political advisors can also increase the stats of certain unit types.
1xhjsa9.zh: 这些属性大多可以通过建造并使用⟦0⟧来提升，而在有⟦1⟧时还可以使用不同的⟦2⟧。不过要注意，提升某一项属性可能会对另一项属性产生不利影响。研究⟦3⟧也能提升属性，各种科技也能，而在有⟦4⟧时某些特种部队学说同样可以。一些⟦5⟧与政治顾问也能提升特定单位类型的属性。

14bitm4.en: Exclusive to ⟦0⟧ from start of the game. With ⟦1⟧ dlc also for ⟦2⟧, Egypt, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, ⟦6⟧, Palestine, Qatar, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, Syria, United Arab Emirates, ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, and all countries in european Italy. ⟦11⟧ can unlock via Weltpolitik, ⟦12⟧ can unlock via Desert Camel Corps and The Tuz Gölü Training Facility, ⟦13⟧ can unlock via Animal Husbandry.
14bitm4.zh: ⟦0⟧自游戏开局起独有。在有⟦1⟧DLC 时也适用于⟦2⟧、埃及、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧、约旦、科威特、黎巴嫩、⟦6⟧、巴勒斯坦、卡塔尔、⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧、叙利亚、阿拉伯联合酋长国、⟦9⟧、⟦10⟧以及意大利欧洲部分的全部国家。⟦11⟧可以通过「世界政策」解锁，⟦12⟧可以通过「沙漠骆驼军团」与「图兹湖训练设施」解锁，⟦13⟧可以通过「畜牧业」解锁。

1eoiz37.en: Support companies normally do not have combat width, do not affect the speed of divisions, and can be paradropped unless otherwise noted. Unlike line battalions, each support company can only be added to a division once. Some support companies also prevent certain other support companies from being taken.
1eoiz37.zh: 支援连通常没有战斗宽度、不影响师的速度，且除非另有说明都可以空降。与一线营不同，每个支援连在一个师中只能添加一次。有些支援连还会阻止其他某些支援连被选用。

mx77am.en: Railway artillery are affected by supply, including both their movement speed (which decreases to up to ⟦0⟧ in low supply) and their bombardment. Unlike other land units, supply for railway artillery cannot be motorized at a unit- or army-level, so supply hubs must be motorized manually.
mx77am.zh: 铁道炮会受到补给影响，包括其移动速度（在低补给下最多降至⟦0⟧）与轰击效果。与其他陆军单位不同，铁道炮的补给无法在单位或集团军层级摩托化，因此补给枢纽必须手动摩托化。

1wf6scy.en: ⟦0⟧ How much supply the unit consumes per day. Please read Supply on the significance of this. Adding a Logistics support company will reduce your division's daily supply consumption. Reference ⟦1⟧. The stat for the division is the ⟦2⟧ of those of all battalions and companies.
1wf6scy.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该单位每天消耗多少补给。关于其重要性请阅读「补给」章节。添加后勤支援连会降低师的每日补给消耗。参见⟦1⟧。该师的此项属性是全部营与连该项属性的⟦2⟧。

n7qqp1.en: Exclusive to the Netherlands. Unlocked via Japan’s Bicycle Battalions national focus, Italy’s Bersaglieri national focus, Finland’s Establish Jaeger Movement national focus, Sweden’s Militärcykel national focus, or Brazil’s Establish Caloi Factory national focus.
n7qqp1.zh: 荷兰独有。可通过日本国策「自行车营」、意大利国策「狙击兵」、芬兰国策「建立猎兵运动」、瑞典国策「军用自行车」或巴西国策「建立卡洛伊工厂」解锁。

1jt6k5z.en: Production of railway artillery is similar to the production of ships in which the equipment and the unit are essentially one and the same. When one railway artillery piece is produced, it automatically gets deployed in the nation's capital.
1jt6k5z.zh: 铁道炮的生产类似于舰船的生产——其装备与单位本质上是同一个东西。当一门铁道炮被生产出来时，它会自动部署在该国首都。

1hhtz2v.en: Paradrop: A simple true or false check if the division can be paradropped. For it to be true, all line battalions must be ⟦0⟧. However, most support companies can be mixed in freely.
1hhtz2v.zh: 空降：一个简单的真假判定，用于检查该师能否空降。要使其为真，所有一线营都必须是⟦0⟧。不过大多数支援连都可以自由混编。

1bx925n.en: +1 Recon, +10% ⟦0⟧ trickleback, -5% ⟦1⟧ loss from casualties, -5% Supply Consumption, Cannot paradrop, Blocks other helicopter companies, +3% All Infantry HP
1bx925n.zh: +1 侦察，+10% ⟦0⟧回流，-5% 伤亡造成的⟦1⟧损失，-5% 补给消耗，无法空降，阻止其他直升机连，+3% 全部步兵生命值

nc9p7x.en: +3 Max Entrench., Various ⟦0⟧ bonuses, Cannot paradrop, Blocks other engineers, +0.05 Tanks & Armor Variants Breakthrough, +0.2 All Infantry Max Entrech.
nc9p7x.zh: +3 工事上限，各种⟦0⟧加成，无法空降，阻止其他工兵连，+0.05 坦克与装甲变体突破，+0.2 全部步兵工事上限。

1hib2zv.en: Speed affects division, Various ⟦0⟧ attack bonuses, ⟦1⟧ movement bonus, Cannot paradrop, Blocks other flame tank companies, +5% All Infantry Breakthrough
1hib2zv.zh: 速度影响师，各种⟦0⟧攻击加成，⟦1⟧移动加成，无法空降，阻止其他喷火坦克连，+5% 全部步兵突破

1f4uwij.en: +30% Suppression, +1 Recon, Cannot paradrop, Blocks Military Police, +20% All Infantry Recovery Rate, +20% Mot. & Mech. Infantry Suppression
1f4uwij.zh: +30% 镇压，+1 侦察，无法空降，阻止军事警察，+20% 全部步兵恢复率，+20% 摩托化与机械化步兵镇压

1qt8ea1.en: +1 Recon, Speed affects division, Various ⟦0⟧ movement bonuses, Cannot paradrop, Blocks other recon, +10% Tanks & Armor Variants Hard Atk.
1qt8ea1.zh: +1 侦察，速度影响师，各种⟦0⟧移动加成，无法空降，阻止其他侦察连，+10% 坦克与装甲变体硬攻。

1mqv7np.en: +2 Recon, Various ⟦0⟧ movement bonuses, Cannot paradrop, Blocks other recon, Blocks Helicopter Brigade, +10% All Artillery Soft Atk.
1mqv7np.zh: +2 侦察，各种⟦0⟧移动加成，无法空降，阻止其他侦察连，阻止直升机旅，+10% 全部火炮软攻。

tm89r8.en: +2% Reliability, ⟦0⟧, +10% Equipment Recovery, Cannot paradrop, Blocks Maintenance Company, +0.1 Tanks & Armor Variants HP
tm89r8.zh: +2% 可靠性，⟦0⟧，+10% 装备回收，无法空降，阻止维修连，+0.1 坦克与装甲变体生命值

uu3zug.en: +2 Max Entrench., Various ⟦0⟧ bonuses, Cannot paradrop, Blocks other engineers, +10% Leg Infantry Breakthrough
uu3zug.zh: +2 工事上限，各种⟦0⟧加成，无法空降，阻止其他工兵连，+10% 徒步步兵突破

1d12onl.en: Speed affects division, Various ⟦0⟧ penalties, Cannot paradrop, Unaffected by support company bonuses
1d12onl.zh: 速度影响师，各种⟦0⟧惩罚，无法空降，不受支援连加成影响

19v6y8.en: ⟦0⟧, Cannot paradrop, Blocks Signal Company, +5% Tanks & Armor Variants Breakthrough
19v6y8.zh: ⟦0⟧，无法空降，阻止通信连，+5% 坦克与装甲变体突破

ok90dl.en: Speed affects division, Various ⟦0⟧ penalties, ⟦1⟧ attack bonus, Cannot paradrop
ok90dl.zh: 速度影响师，各种⟦0⟧惩罚，⟦1⟧攻击加成，无法空降

118qaql.en: Unlocked via the Soviet Union’s Penal Battalions national focus.
118qaql.zh: 通过苏联国策「惩戒营」解锁。

1kcmv52.en: ⟦0⟧ can unlock via Elephants for the Modern Age.

q9q8jx.en: ⟦0⟧: A cheesy strategy where the high resource costs of expensive tanks and aircraft are bypassed by simultaneously producing basic, bare-bones designs that are marked as outdated and ⟦1⟧ them immediately to their final designs. This can happen because the resource costs of these equipments is often incurred only by the base chassis/airframe and the main armament, while these are only a minority of the total production costs of the final design. Especially with the help of ⟦2⟧, the amount of production lost to this strategy ends up being negligible, while the civilian factory savings from not having to ⟦3⟧ for as many resources can be huge.
q9q8jx.zh: ⟦0⟧：一种「奶酪」打法，通过同时生产被标记为过时的基础简陋设计，并把它们立即⟦1⟧为最终设计，来绕过昂贵坦克与飞机的高资源成本。之所以可行，是因为这些装备的资源成本通常只由基础底盘/机体与主武器产生，而这两者只占最终设计总生产成本的一小部分。尤其是在⟦2⟧的帮助下，这种打法损失的生产量可以忽略不计，而由于不必为那么多资源进行⟦3⟧所节省的民用工厂则可能非常巨大。

9zj9w0.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: A strategy or part of a strategy that provides some notable advantage and that is unlikely to be intentional by the game's developers. Somewhat related to exploits, but usually considered "softer" and more fair to use. Examples include constant conversion, completely removing an enemy's planning bonus by having every member of a ⟦2⟧ set one of their spies to build a network near their frontline, tying down an enemy's navy by using many tiny submarine task forces to Always Engage, et al.
9zj9w0.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：一种能提供某些显著优势、且不太可能是游戏开发者有意设计的策略或策略的一部分。它与漏洞利用有些关联，但通常被认为「更温和」、用起来更公平。例子包括持续转换、通过让⟦2⟧的每个成员都派一名特工在其前线附近建立情报网来完全消除敌人的计划加成、用大量微型潜艇特遣舰队设置「始终交战」来牵制敌人海军等等。

1c4f8kr.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: The practice of setting of a dummy order-of-battle with lower-quality generals that can then be used to dramatically reduce the command power cost of performing the respectively named ⟦2⟧. This is done by temporarily assigning the specific divisions for which the ability is to be used to one of those dummy generals, activating the commander ability on the dummy general, and only assigning the unit(s) back to their regular generals after the ability is no longer needed.
1c4f8kr.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：设置一个由素质较低将领组成的假指挥体系，然后用它来大幅降低执行相应命名的⟦2⟧的指挥点数成本。做法是：把要使用该能力的特定师临时编给其中一个假将领，在假将领身上激活指挥官能力，等到不再需要该能力后才把部队编回其正规将领。

1br2lrg.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: The practice of rapidly switching air wings, usually bombers, between multiple air zones, either to abuse the mechanics behind naval strike and port strike air missions to make attacks happen far more frequently than intended, or simply to overload the micromanagement abilities of enemy air controllers in multiplayer.
1br2lrg.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：在多条空中区域之间快速切换航空队（通常是轰炸机）的做法，要么是利用海军打击与港口打击空中任务背后的机制，使攻击发生的频率远超设计意图，要么只是为了在多人游戏中压垮敌方空中管制员的微操能力。

v9w0mc.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, the practice of one country buying the resources of an ally to offset said ally using their civilian factories to purchase the first country's resources, even when those resources would go unused. Also often used to offset the civilian factory cost of obtaining ⟦1⟧.
v9w0mc.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，一个国家购买盟友的资源，以抵消该盟友用其民用工厂购买第一个国家资源的行为，即使那些资源最终不会被使用。也常用于抵消获得⟦1⟧的民用工厂成本。

1f3fmi5.en: ⟦0⟧: Considered the opposite of "micro", refers to the larger choices made and strategy used outside of controlling individual units, including for ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, political power expenses, and the order and timing of ⟦4⟧.
1f3fmi5.zh: ⟦0⟧：被视为「微操」的对立面，指在操控单个单位之外所做的更大选择与战略，包括⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、政治点数支出，以及⟦4⟧的顺序与时机。

2a50sk.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, the act of exploiting a certain bug around naval invasions that allow them to be launched against a player without triggering the visual or audio alert for them for an ongoing naval invasion.
2a50sk.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中，利用海军登陆方面的某个 bug，使其能够在不触发视觉或音频警报的情况下对玩家发动登陆。

1k79fhu.en: Alternatively, the flood of small infantry divisions used to help hold a frontline made possible thanks to the uniquely strong bonuses given by the Mass Mobilization branch of the Mass Assault land doctrine.
1k79fhu.zh: 另一种情况是用于帮助守住前线的大量小编制步兵师，它们之所以可行，要归功于「大规模突击」陆军学说中「大规模动员」分支所给予的独特强大加成。

en2co.en: ⟦0⟧: Dedicated player who focuses their attention on micromanaging air wings for their ⟦1⟧ and tries to obtain strong bonuses to their air units through ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ choices. Very common in multiplayer games.
en2co.zh: ⟦0⟧：专注于为自己的⟦1⟧微操航空队、并试图通过⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的选择获得强大空军加成的专精玩家。在多人游戏中非常常见。

agl3py.en: ⟦0⟧: A marine division with a few mechanized battalions included, usually to greatly increase the division's HP and therefore make it last longer when performing naval invasions using the Force Attack ⟦1⟧.
agl3py.zh: ⟦0⟧：一个加入了若干机械化营的海军陆战队师，通常是为了大幅提高该师的兵力值，从而使其在使用「强攻」⟦1⟧执行海军登陆时能坚持更久。

1n9toyo.en: ⟦0⟧: Done in many multiplayer-oriented mods and custom save games to avoid people wanting to grind generals manually and therefore speed up the game, as grinding an normally be somewhat micro-intensive.
1n9toyo.zh: ⟦0⟧：在许多面向多人游戏的模组与自定义存档中这样做，是为了避免玩家需要手动刷将领，从而加快游戏节奏——因为刷将领通常相当耗费微操。

1lw1sra.en: Constant Conversion, a cheesy strategy that allows certain expensive ⟦0⟧ to be produced at a fraction of its normal resource costs through the use of equipment conversion (see ⟦1⟧ section).
1lw1sra.zh: 持续转换，一种「奶酪」打法，通过使用装备改装，使某些昂贵的⟦0⟧能以远低于其正常资源成本的方式生产（参见⟦1⟧章节）。

ry0op9.en: ⟦0⟧: After having decrypted an enemy country's cipher, revealing it for a major temporary bonus at the cost of needing to re-decrypt their cipher after the bonus expires.
ry0op9.zh: ⟦0⟧：在破解了一个敌国的密码之后，将其揭示以获得一次重大的临时加成，代价是加成到期后需要重新破解对方的密码。

19u1npn.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: Bastardization of the very annoying ⟦2⟧ combat tactic, usually when unlocked through the Mass Mobilization branch of the Mass Assault land doctrine.
19u1npn.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧：对那个非常恼人的⟦2⟧战斗战术的戏称/劣化版本，通常是在通过「大规模突击」陆军学说的「大规模动员」分支解锁时。

t0w6m3.en: ⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, similar to an air controller, but as a player playing co-operatively for a nation that is not 100% dedicated to managing air wings.
t0w6m3.zh: ⟦0⟧：在多人游戏中与「空中管制员」类似，但指的是合作操控一个并非 100% 专职管理航空队的国家的玩家。

15qtkvr.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for a political advisor who increases the country's political power gain, usually one with the Silent Workhorse trait.
15qtkvr.zh: ⟦0⟧：能够提高国家政治点数获取的政治顾问的简称，通常指拥有「沉默的实干家」特质的顾问。

13ym59h.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for a political advisor who increases the country's stability, usually one with the Popular Figurehead trait.
13ym59h.zh: ⟦0⟧：能够提高国家稳定度的政治顾问的简称，通常指拥有「受民众爱戴的领袖」特质的顾问。

f1j9qv.en: Danzig or War - A common National Focus choice for Germany. OR ⟦0⟧ - Can be used as a verb ("Japan just DOW'd the USA!").
f1j9qv.zh: 「但泽或战争」——德国常见的一个国策选择。或者指⟦0⟧——可以当作动词使用（“日本刚刚对美宣战了！”）。

g4xmaf.en: Fog of War - Prevents ⟦0⟧ from seeing parts of the ⟦1⟧ they do not either border, or have an army or ⟦2⟧ adjacent to.
g4xmaf.zh: 战争迷雾——使⟦0⟧无法看到⟦1⟧中那些既不与其接壤、也没有军队或⟦2⟧与之相邻的部分。

17cnobd.en: Construction industrial capacity - Capacity provided by Civilian factories for the ⟦0⟧ of any structure in HoI4.
17cnobd.zh: 建造工业产能——民用工厂为《钢铁雄心 4》中任何建筑的⟦0⟧所提供的产能。

1hna3k9.en: Political power - Point acquired over time and required for all political actions in the game.
1hna3k9.zh: 政治点数——随时间获取的点数，是游戏中所有政治行动所必需的。

1nrw0v4.en: ⟦0⟧ - The metric used to measure how long, on average, it takes for an event to trigger.
1nrw0v4.zh: ⟦0⟧——用于衡量一个事件平均需要多久才会触发的指标。

1ned05a.en: La Résistance - the 3rd major expansion by Paradox for Hearts of Iron IV.
1ned05a.zh: 《抵抗运动》——Paradox 为《钢铁雄心 4》推出的第 3 个大型扩展包。

1hne9ve.en: ⟦0⟧: Slang for numerical Political power, ⟦1⟧, and other points.
1hne9ve.zh: ⟦0⟧：对政治点数、⟦1⟧以及其他各类点数的俗称。

d3myer.en: The Mass Mobilization branch of the Mass Assault land doctrine.
d3myer.zh: 「大规模突击」陆军学说的「大规模动员」分支。

1gzvg5k.zh: 另一种情况是指《诸神黄昏》DLC。

qf012z.en: The Germans will turn to the west, so you only have to prepare for a ⟦0⟧ attack. You can beat the ⟦1⟧ on your own, by stacking defensive bonuses and holding the line until you have opportunities for a counter-attack. Proceed to attack the Axis once Russia is under your control.
qf012z.zh: 德国人会转向西线，所以你只需要为⟦0⟧的进攻做准备。你可以靠堆叠防御加成、守住战线直到出现反击机会，独自击败⟦1⟧。在俄罗斯被纳入你的控制之后，再着手进攻轴心国。

1lc3410.en: Start as ⟦0⟧, throne Mindaugas III and go down the Livonia/Commonwealth branches. This focus path essentially turns you into ⟦1⟧, giving you a ⟦2⟧ larger army and industrial base. Conquer ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ for extra factories.
1lc3410.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，让明道加斯三世登基，然后走利沃尼亚/联邦分支。这条国策路线本质上会把你变成⟦1⟧，为你带来⟦2⟧更庞大的军队与工业基础。征服⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧以获得额外工厂。

1qfrkos.en: If ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ end up in Allied hands, you will have to fight them as well. The required provinces only need to be occupied/controlled, not owned. The Baltic Sea Islands, Gotland and Åland, are not necessary.
1qfrkos.zh: 如果⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧最终落入盟国手中，你也必须与他们作战。所需省份只需被占领/控制，不必被拥有。波罗的海岛屿、哥特兰岛与奥兰群岛都不需要。

gsxkhx.en: As any Baltic State, conquer the entire shoreline of the Baltic Sea.
gsxkhx.zh: 以任意波罗的海国家征服波罗的海的整条海岸线。

em0wza.en: ⟦0⟧, which are modifiers that have wide-ranging effects on a country and are usually set at game start or by the ⟦1⟧ tree
em0wza.zh: ⟦0⟧，即对一个国家有广泛影响的修正，通常在游戏开局时设定，或由⟦1⟧树设定

9ahtfv.en: ⟦0⟧ for the Officer Corps, which are chosen by players to develop their armed forces' way of warfare
9ahtfv.zh: 用于军官团的⟦0⟧，由玩家选择，以发展其武装力量的作战方式

nqvhc2.en: Do note the following: You need to ⟦0⟧ control your cores, so make sure you capture every island in a chain you have a core on. Also note that you will need to at least briefly go to war with the Soviets over North Sakhalin.
nqvhc2.zh: 请注意以下几点：你需要⟦0⟧控制你的核心领土，因此务必拿下你所拥有核心的每一座岛屿链中的全部岛屿。另外请注意，你将至少需要为了北萨哈林与苏联短暂开战。

11zl559.en: Note that after Germany completes the focus "Negotiate old colonies in the east", it will demand that Japan return its former colonies, which include core territories. Be sure to choose ⟦0⟧.
11zl559.zh: 请注意，德国完成国策「谈判东方的旧殖民地」后，会要求日本归还其旧殖民地，其中包含核心领土。务必选择⟦0⟧。

ntc8q9.en: Can be easily obtained in a regular Japan playthrough by just taking the appropriate focus once conditions are filled. The focus gives you cores on the following states:
ntc8q9.zh: 在正常的日本流程中，只要在条件满足后选取相应的国策即可轻松获得。该国会给予你以下各州的核心：

7nnu8s.en: As Japan, proclaim the Eternal Empire and control all of your core states.
7nnu8s.zh: 以日本宣布「永恒帝国」，并控制你的全部核心州。

1i2dint.en: Doing this achievement with historical focuses on is the most reliable way to ensure Churchill remains the UK country leader. For Churchill to remain in power once the UK is puppeted, India must also be democratic. One way to do this achievement is to achieve independence, leave the Allies, and go down the secret 'Nuclear Gandhi' path which will allow you to justify against the UK while remaining democratic. Another method is to remain in the Allies once you become independent, build up enough industry in India, and become the faction leader to then kick the UK out of the Allies where they can be easily conquered on their own.
1i2dint.zh: 在开启历史国策的情况下完成此成就，是确保丘吉尔继续担任英国国家领袖最可靠的方式。要让丘吉尔在英国被傀儡化后继续掌权，印度也必须是民主制。一种完成方法是：先取得独立、退出同盟国，然后走秘密的「核弹甘地」路线——这样你就能在保持民主制的同时对英国制造战争目标。另一种方法是：成为独立国家后继续留在同盟国，在印度积累足够工业，然后成为阵营领袖，把英国踢出同盟国，这样就能轻松单独征服它。

1nh418p.en: ⟦0⟧ if any UK states are left independent in a peace conference, they will remain as the "true" government of the UK and retain Churchill as their leader.
1nh418p.zh: ⟦0⟧如果在和平会议后仍有任何英国州保持独立，它们将继续作为英国的「正统」政府存在，并保留丘吉尔作为其领袖。

77zzaj.en: As India puppet the UK with Churchill as it's leader
77zzaj.zh: 以印度傀儡化英国，并让丘吉尔担任其领袖

lkin1c.en: "Total cost" is computed as production cost + 1.5/8 * resource cost, based on the import rate (8) and the cost ratio between military (7200) and civilian (10800) factories.
lkin1c.zh: 「总成本」按生产成本 + 1.5/8 × 资源成本计算，依据是进口比率（8）以及军用工厂（7200）与民用工厂（10800）之间的成本比。

1cy7iiy.en: These statistics do not take doctrine technologies into account, as they do not have years associated with them, and many are mutually exclusive.
1cy7iiy.zh: 这些统计未计入学说科技，因为学说科技没有关联年份，且许多彼此互斥。

1914sps.en: New flavour countries generally receive a ⟦0⟧ tree, ⟦1⟧ (such as political advisors and design companies), unique ⟦2⟧, 2D pictures and 3D models of their ⟦3⟧, unique decisions and ⟦4⟧, and music inspired by these cultures. Voice overs (activated when a player clicks on units) are added if they are not in the base game.
1914sps.zh: 新的风味国家通常可以获得⟦0⟧树、⟦1⟧（例如政治顾问与设计公司）、独特的⟦2⟧、其⟦3⟧的 2D 图片与 3D 模型、独特的决议与⟦4⟧，以及受这些文化启发的音乐。如果基础游戏里没有，还会加入语音（玩家点击单位时触发）。

1nc2ljp.en: ⟦0⟧: Guide ⟦1⟧ or the Communist China through the war, guided by your own vision of the future.
1nc2ljp.zh: ⟦0⟧：指引⟦1⟧或中国共产党走过战争，由你自己对未来的构想主导。

1mx20c6.en: ⟦0⟧: Focus trees for Canada, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧ (India) and ⟦4⟧.

1w25v7m.zh: dlc019 – Sabaton 原声带 第 2 卷

q1p3v8.en: ⟦0⟧ replaces the basic air technology system with a more modular system that feeds into the ⟦1⟧. Rather than researching aircraft within different roles, the new system splits up research based on the airframes from which plane designs are built and the modules that are to go into said airframes, including weaponry, engines, and even some special modules.
q1p3v8.zh: ⟦0⟧用一套更模块化的系统取代了基础空军科技系统，并向⟦1⟧供给数据。新系统不再按不同角色研究飞机，而是依据飞机构建所基于的机体，以及将要装入该机体的模块（包括武器、发动机，甚至某些特殊模块）来拆分研究。

1xq55dk.en: With the introduction of special projects in Götterdämmerung and the accompanying ⟦0⟧, all air technologies now also generate aerodynamics and avionics breakthrough progress while being researched.
1xq55dk.zh: 随着《诸神黄昏》引入特殊项目以及随之而来的⟦0⟧，所有空军科技在研究时现在也会产生空气动力学与航空电子学突破进度。

3561sh.en: These techs are only available for certain countries under the appropriate conditions.
3561sh.zh: 这些科技仅在适当条件下对特定国家可用。

1m9b1o1.en: For air technology without ⟦0⟧, see the separate ⟦1⟧ page.
1m9b1o1.zh: 不含⟦0⟧的空军科技，请参见单独的⟦1⟧页面。

fa7adk.en: ⟦0⟧ via Strengthen the Divine Wind() or ⟦1⟧() with ⟦2⟧

1pril7k.en: Justify a war goal on the ⟦0⟧ (or if possible join the Axis) and attack them from behind. This should make the UK lose in Egypt as they have to send some troops to fight you. If that's the case ⟦1⟧ will take Palestine so ask for control over it. If you don't have enough war score just cause the Allies more casualties. If ⟦2⟧ doesn't take Palestine, drive straight there. Make sure to get some ports along the way so you don't get cut off from supplies.
1pril7k.zh: 对⟦0⟧制造战争目标（如果可能则加入轴心国）并从背后进攻它。这应当会让英国在埃及战败，因为他们不得不抽调部分部队来与你作战。若果真如此，⟦1⟧会拿下巴勒斯坦，届时向它索取该地的控制权。如果你的战争贡献不够，就多给盟国制造伤亡。如果⟦2⟧没有拿下巴勒斯坦，就直接开过去。沿途务必夺取一些港口，以免补给被切断。

irmgaj.en: Remember to defend your ports. The basic District Brigade (3xINF) division template will do the job nicely. Failing to defend your ports is the only quick way to lose because it will take ages for the Allies to get to you through land (way longer than your troops going for Palestine will take).
irmgaj.zh: 记得防守你的港口。基础的「地方旅」（3×步兵）师编制就能很好地胜任。防守港口失败是唯一会迅速落败的途径——因为盟国经陆路抵达你那里要花很久（远比你的部队开往巴勒斯坦所需的时间长）。

py6gjr.en: Take the ⟦0⟧ route for independence, leave the Allies, justify war on ⟦1⟧, and take their colonies. This should be done before start of WWII.
py6gjr.zh: 走⟦0⟧路线取得独立，退出同盟国，对⟦1⟧制造战争目标，并夺取其殖民地。这应在二战开始前完成。

1qzx4q0.en: As ⟦0⟧, finish the A King for Our People focus and take Jerusalem.
1qzx4q0.zh: 以⟦0⟧完成「我们人民的国王」国策并夺取耶路撒冷。

103nurk.en: The cosmetic tag is set after completing the focus Proclaim the Jobukkokudo. This focus is hidden and is unlocked via the "The Revitalization of Buddhism" event which is only triggered by the Raise the Red Flag High focus while having Kanson Arahata as your country leader and Jun Tsuji and Giro Seno'o hired as advisors. Make sure to elect Giro Seno'o in that event.
103nurk.zh: 外观标签在完成国策「宣告净土国」后设置。该国会是隐藏的，需通过「佛教的复兴」事件解锁——此事件只能由「高举红旗」国策触发，且需要荒畑寒村担任你的国家领袖、辻润与妹尾义郎被聘为顾问。务必在该事件中选举妹尾义郎。

1ih12eu.en: Kanson Arahata can be elected via the event of the The Labor-Farmer Faction Ascendant focus, Jun Tsuji is unlocked via the Cooperate with Anarchists focus and Giro Seno'o is unlocked via the Incorporate Buddhist Socialism focus. All three of these focuses require you to pick the Labor Farmer Faction in the event of the "The Red Sun Rises for a New Era" focus.
1ih12eu.zh: 荒畑寒村可通过「劳农派占上风」国策的事件当选，辻润通过「与无政府主义者合作」国策解锁，妹尾义郎通过「吸纳佛教社会主义」国策解锁。这三个国策都要求你在「红日为新纪元升起」国策的事件中选择劳农派。

1dkca4x.en: Completing Proclaim the Jobukkokudo will require you to conquer Seoul, Beijing and Tonkin or be allied to their owners.
1dkca4x.zh: 完成「宣告净土国」将要求你征服首尔、北京与东京（北部湾），或与其拥有者结盟。

onr49c.en: As Japan, proclaim the creation of a Pure Buddhist Land.
onr49c.zh: 以日本宣告创建净土佛国。

1sdr83v.en: Turn communist and join the Comintern. No need to take The Romanian Question or the The Polish Division, as ⟦0⟧ guarantees your independence, and they will join the Comintern once you both are on the same side of the war. Build up Sudetenland to level 7 forts via focus, prepare for war against the Axis and refuse Germany's demand for it. Wait for Comintern members to flood their divisions to your frontline to halt Germany, and then concentrate your divisions to push to Munich. It might be easier with historical AI turned off, since ⟦1⟧ might take ⟦2⟧ or ally ⟦3⟧ so Germany will be weaker). Capturing Munich is enough to control Oberbayern.
1sdr83v.zh: 转为共产主义并加入共产国际。不必选取「罗马尼亚问题」或「波兰师」，因为⟦0⟧会保障你的独立，而且一旦你俩站在战争的同一方，它们就会加入共产国际。通过国策把苏台德地区建成 7 级要塞，准备对轴心国开战，并拒绝德国对该地的要求。等共产国际成员把部队涌向你的前线以阻止德国，然后集中你的师向慕尼黑推进。关闭历史 AI 可能会更容易，因为⟦1⟧可能会拿下⟦2⟧或与⟦3⟧结盟，从而使德国更弱）。夺取慕尼黑就足以控制上巴伐利亚。

3i2ut3.en: Can also be done by rushing out paratroopers and hoping for an early war with Germany following An Entente of Our Own focus path, you may need to concentrate research & ministers on planes for air superiority.
3i2ut3.zh: 也可以通过速出伞兵来完成，并寄望于走「我们自己的协约」国策路线后与德国提前开战；你可能需要把科研与部长集中在飞机上以取得制空权。

1h6zzkj.en: As Czechoslovakia, occupy Munich while at war with Germany.
1h6zzkj.zh: 以捷克斯洛伐克在与德国交战期间占领慕尼黑。

10nuyu6.en: Don't take any focuses and once you have 50 pp justify on ⟦0⟧. The Justification should be done around October, declare war and then do the focus Rally the Wehrmacht. The war with ⟦1⟧ should be easily done within 70 days, making you the owner of Leinster.
10nuyu6.zh: 不要选取任何国策，攒够 50 政治点数后就对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。战争目标制造大约会在十月完成，宣战，然后执行国策「集结国防军」。与⟦1⟧的战争应能在 70 天内轻松打完，让你成为伦斯特的拥有者。

1y3nwm1.en: After the Civil War go down the path of the Kaiser. You can speed up your ⟦0⟧ popularity by doing the Anti-Fascist, Democratic and Communist decisions (giving you over 40% non-aligned before the Revive the Kaiserreich focus is finished.
1y3nwm1.zh: 内战结束后走德皇路线。你可以通过执行反法西斯、民主与共产主义决议来加快⟦0⟧支持度的增长（在「复兴德意志帝国」国策完成前就能让你拥有超过 40% 的中立主义支持度）。

pnee5b.en: The Focus Our Place in the Sun will give you Qingdao and the Focus Rekindle Imperial Sentiment will give you Bohemia. Once Austria-Hungary forms they always automatically join the Central Powers.
pnee5b.zh: 国策「我们在阳光下的位置」会给你青岛，国策「重燃帝国情怀」会给你波希米亚。奥匈一旦成立，它们总会自动加入中央列强。

ppm1h4.en: Follow the 'Rhineland' path down to 'The fate of Czechoslovakia' which will give you Bohemia.
ppm1h4.zh: 沿「莱茵兰」路线一路走到「捷克斯洛伐克的命运」，这会给你波希米亚。

10mi4yl.en: As Germany, control Budweis, Tsingtao, and Guinness directly or through a faction member.
10mi4yl.zh: 以德国直接控制布德魏斯、青岛与吉尼斯，或通过阵营成员控制。

34bycn.en: Either send your own divisions to conquer Qingdao or wait until ⟦0⟧ does it for you.
34bycn.zh: 要么派出你自己的师去征服青岛，要么等⟦0⟧替你完成。

1khm8lg.en: When ⟦0⟧ has declared on ⟦1⟧, justify/declare on ⟦2⟧, too.
1khm8lg.zh: 当⟦0⟧对⟦1⟧宣战后，也对⟦2⟧制造战争目标/宣战。

rb7pmb.en: Disband the Axis and join the ⟦0⟧ faction.
rb7pmb.zh: 解散轴心国并加入⟦0⟧阵营。

qjer9g.zh: 尽早对⟦0⟧制造战争目标/宣战/海军登陆。

1adk6o3.en: Required states include all states needed for "Awake and Angry" - that is, starting territories of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, all warlords (including ⟦2⟧), ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ from Tibet, as well as 3 states (Taiwan, East Hebei, and Dairen) which start under Japanese control - and also the three treaty ports (Kouang-Tcheou-Wan, Macau, and Hong Kong). You ⟦7⟧ need Korea, ⟦8⟧, or the rest of ⟦9⟧. All states must be controlled fully (missing even one province of one state would block the achievement), so, you can have 100% faction manifest fulfillment (76/76 states controlled) without meeting the conditions.
1adk6o3.zh: 所需州包括「觉醒与愤怒」成就所需的一切州——即⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、所有军阀（包括⟦2⟧）、⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧的起始领土，西藏的⟦5⟧⟦6⟧，以及 3 个开局由日本控制的州（台湾、冀东与大连）——另外还有三个条约港（广州湾、澳门与香港）。你⟦7⟧需要朝鲜、⟦8⟧或⟦9⟧的其余部分。所有州都必须被完整控制（哪怕只缺一个州的一个省份也会使成就无法达成），因此你完全可能在拥有 100% 阵营纲领达成度（控制 76/76 个州）的情况下仍不满足条件。

y9qg52.en: It is possible, with some luck, to get the European treaty ports handed over via the ⟦0⟧ focus (only available in the "Dang Guo" / non-aligned focus tree branch). To increase the chances of acceptance, join their faction and their wars, and have their opinion be higher than 50.
y9qg52.zh: 运气好的话，可以通过⟦0⟧国策让欧洲的条约港被移交给你（该国会仅在「党国」/中立主义国策树分支中可用）。要提高对方接受的概率，就加入他们的阵营与其战争，并把他们的好感度保持在 50 以上。

1njwvvi.en: As China, fully control all core states alone or with subjects.
1njwvvi.zh: 以中国单独或与附属国一起完全控制全部核心州。

m3zeux.en: Request Handover of the Coastal Cities

9dc8bm.en: Go down End the White Terror and win the Civil War by taking Budapest. After Restore the Socialist Federative Republic, take Restore the Hungarian Red Army and build up your army. Make sure you have a full army on the ⟦0⟧ border and declare war. If German demands the Sudetenland, they might go to war with the Czechoslovakians, allowing you to join the Axis. After building your army further, declare war on ⟦1⟧, annex them, then do the same with ⟦2⟧. At this point, you will be at war with the Allies. Make sure ⟦3⟧ isn't invaded by the Allies to prevent the Civil War. Take A Pannonian Socialist Union to gain cores. Take Hero of the Revolution to gain more manpower and then Denounce Marxism-Leninism after Germany declares war on the ⟦4⟧. Join the war and occupy as much of the Soviet Union as possible. If Germany captures Leningrad and won't accept handing over control to you, give them some Soviet territory in exchange until they accept.
9dc8bm.zh: 走「终结白色恐怖」并在攻占布达佩斯后赢得内战。在「恢复社会主义联邦共和国」之后，选取「重建匈牙利红军」并扩充你的军队。确保你在⟦0⟧边境上有一整支军队，然后宣战。如果德国索要苏台德地区，他们可能会与捷克斯洛伐克开战，从而使你得以加入轴心国。进一步扩充军队后，对⟦1⟧宣战、吞并它，然后对⟦2⟧如法炮制。此时你将与盟国处于战争状态。确保⟦3⟧不被盟国入侵，以防内战爆发。选取「泛诺尼亚社会主义联盟」以获得核心。选取「革命英雄」以获得更多人力，然后在德国对⟦4⟧宣战后谴责马克思列宁主义。加入战争并尽可能多地占领苏联领土。如果德国夺取了列宁格勒又不同意把控制权移交给你，就用一些苏联领土交换，直到他们同意。

48qvmq.en: As Communist Hungary bring back the Lenin-fiúk and take control over Leningrad
48qvmq.zh: 以共产主义匈牙利带回列宁少年队并取得对列宁格勒的控制

1hiuyjx.en: Created in collaboration with veteran modders Logan "Spicy Alfredo" Calkins, Abbus Fung and Marijn "marijn211" Vroegh, this Focus Pack offers new options for ⟦0⟧ in a desperate fight for survival against overwhelming odds, posing a unique challenge to all ⟦1⟧ players.
1hiuyjx.zh: 这个国策包由资深模组作者 Logan “Spicy Alfredo” Calkins、Abbus Fung 与 Marijn “marijn211” Vroegh 合作制作，为⟦0⟧在众寡悬殊的绝境求生之战中提供了新的选项，对所有⟦1⟧玩家构成一项独特的挑战。

xm4qcn.en: ⟦0⟧ is the 1st ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧. It was announced on 2025-09-25 and was released on 2026-04-22⟦3⟧, coinciding with patch 1.18.

10zli4z.en: All developer diaries about the ⟦0⟧ focus pack and ⟦1⟧ (aka Case Green).
10zli4z.zh: 所有关于⟦0⟧国策包与⟦1⟧（又名「绿色方案」）的开发日志。

1e3t8lz.en: Forum, Developer Diary | RDA Peace for our Time, 2026-04-14.
1e3t8lz.zh: 论坛，开发日志 | RDA《我们时代的和平》，2026-04-14。

1tqc0nt.zh: 架空历史捷克斯洛伐克与分裂国家重做

shyfsb.en: Fascist and Communist branches for Czechoslovakia
shyfsb.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克的法西斯与共产主义分支

l6znm1.en: Democratic and shared branches for Czechoslovakia
l6znm1.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克的民主与共享分支

1mmbud9.en: Art and achievements of ⟦0⟧, and other content
1mmbud9.zh: ⟦0⟧的美术与成就，以及其他内容

vqgwlv.en: Peace for Our Time release date announcement
vqgwlv.zh: 《我们时代的和平》发布日期公告

aw1xk8.en: Air technologies are used to ⟦0⟧, unlock, and improve different types of aircraft. They are divided into eight different aircraft types: fighters, close air support, naval bombers, heavy fighters, tactical bombers, strategic bombers, scout planes, and transport planes. Each non-jet fighter, close air support, and naval bomber model also has a carrier variant that can be researched. These variants are able to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
aw1xk8.zh: 空军科技用于⟦0⟧、解锁并改进不同类型的飞机。它们分为八种飞机类型：战斗机、近距空中支援、海军轰炸机、重型战斗机、战术轰炸机、战略轰炸机、侦察机与运输机。每种非喷气式战斗机、近距空中支援与海军轰炸机型号都有一个可研究的舰载变体。这些变体能够从航空母舰上起飞并降落。

kncn5f.en: With the introduction of special projects in Götterdämmerung and the accompanying ⟦0⟧, all air technologies now also generate aerodynamics and avionics breakthrough progress while being researched. Air technologies are particularly intertwined with the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ special projects, which act as prerequisites for many later technologies in the tree.
kncn5f.zh: 随着《诸神黄昏》引入特殊项目以及随之而来的⟦0⟧，所有空军科技在研究时现在也会产生空气动力学与航空电子学突破进度。空军科技与⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧特殊项目尤为交织，后者是科技树中许多后续科技的前置条件。

vbf831.en: For available missions per aircraft type, see ⟦0⟧.
vbf831.zh: 各飞机类型可用的任务，请参见⟦0⟧。

1owqarw.en: ⟦0⟧ via Strengthen the Divine Wind without ⟦1⟧
1owqarw.zh: 通过「强化神风」获得⟦0⟧，且不依赖⟦1⟧

wvsd81.en: Start placating the ⟦0⟧ immediately after you complete Gateway to Europe. If done properly, you will be able to do Cave to the British within 70 days. Meanwhile, you can go for a secondary focus depending on your intended progression after the achievement.
wvsd81.zh: 完成「通往欧洲的门户」后立即开始安抚⟦0⟧。如果做得得当，你就能在 70 天内完成「向英国让步」。同时，你可以根据自己在达成成就之后的发展规划，去走一个次要国策。

tcjjzr.en: Completing Form the Benelux will put ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ in your faction. This activates the decision ⟦2⟧. Save up 300 ⟦3⟧, take the decision and once ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ accept, you will annex them and earn the achievement.
tcjjzr.zh: 完成「组建比荷卢」会让⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧加入你的阵营。这会激活决议⟦2⟧。攒够 300⟦3⟧，执行该决议，一旦⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧接受，你就会吞并它们并获得成就。

1dhc5jo.en: Completing the focuses in the order given above is not necessary, but it is the fastest progression towards the achievement.
1dhc5jo.zh: 不必按上述顺序完成这些国策，但这是通往该成就最快的进程。

9gdy9s.en: You can go for the non country-specific achievements like ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ along with this one.
9gdy9s.zh: 你可以在做这个成就的同时去拿那些非国家专属的成就，例如⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧。

1gh9mj.en: Ensure you have +100 relations with ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ to guarantee success.
1gh9mj.zh: 确保你与⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧的关系达到 +100，以保证成功。

a6w7xs.en: After completing this achievement, you can go for ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧.
a6w7xs.zh: 完成此成就后，你可以去拿⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧。

1qozvqt.zh: ⟦0⟧（如果目标是⟦1⟧）⟦2⟧⟦3⟧（如果目标是「解放」）

1s7fw4g.en: Conquer Belgium and Luxembourg as Netherlands.
1s7fw4g.zh: 以荷兰征服比利时与卢森堡。

nct03l.en: Starting as the ⟦0⟧, go down the The Left Opposition tree. Justify war goals on ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ as soon as possible after winning the civil war to avoid them joining factions or getting guaranteed. Continue down your focus tree until you reach Autonomous Soviet Republics. Grab the Secure Leningrad focus along the way and when ⟦3⟧ sues for peace, keep going and annex them completely. Then release yourself as independent Sapmi. Make sure to uncheck 'Retain States With Our Core'.
nct03l.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，走「左翼反对派」国策树。赢得内战之后，尽快对⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧制造战争目标，以免它们加入阵营或获得保障。继续沿着你的国策树推进，直到「自治苏维埃共和国」。沿途顺手拿掉「确保列宁格勒」国策，当⟦3⟧求和时，继续进攻并完全吞并它。然后把自己释放为独立的萨普米。务必取消勾选「保留拥有我们核心的州」。

ojczr8.en: Follow the ⟦0⟧ strategy and after defeating the Soviets, simply annex all the Sapmi lands the ⟦1⟧ owned. After the peace deal, release Sapmi with all its cores (Play as; not as a puppet; don't retain core states!).
ojczr8.zh: 沿用⟦0⟧的策略，在击败苏联之后，直接吞并⟦1⟧所拥有的全部萨普米土地。在和平协议之后，以全部核心释放萨普米（以该国的身份游玩；不要作为傀儡国；不要保留核心州！）。

c7sxuj.en: Get the Kola peninsula in the peace deal. Taking puppeting border states to ⟦0⟧ can help later.
c7sxuj.zh: 在和平协议中拿下科拉半岛。把边境国家傀儡化后转交给⟦0⟧，日后会有帮助。

1pkdk57.en: Justify/declare on ⟦0⟧ while you're still in the Axis so the German guarantee will be void.
1pkdk57.zh: 在你仍留在轴心国时对⟦0⟧制造战争目标/宣战，这样德国的保障就会失效。

1g66jrp.en: Support the Axis during Barbarossa. Should be no problem without the Allies as a threat.
1g66jrp.zh: 在巴巴罗萨行动中支持轴心国。没有盟国作为威胁，应该不成问题。

eh2go9.en: Release Sapmi with all its cores (Play as; not as a puppet; don't retain core states!)
eh2go9.zh: 以全部核心释放萨普米（以该国的身份游玩；不要作为傀儡国；不要保留核心州！）

1733tji.en: Take at least the two Finnish states with Sapmi cores.
1733tji.zh: 至少拿下拥有萨普米核心的两个芬兰州。

iday2l.en: As Sami, own and control every Sami core.
iday2l.zh: 作为萨米人，拥有并控制每一个萨米核心。

jikep.en: Simply go Fascist and help Germany defeat the Allies. For more manpower and a bigger navy you can invade ⟦0⟧. But it's not needed. A Fascist Denmark has enough manpower to produce around 24 good divisions and a couple bad ones for port protection. To get enough war score, make sure to have the majority of your army at the ⟦1⟧ border when Germany finishes the focus Danzig or War. After you've helped with defeating Poland move your army westwards and help with defeating The Benelux and ⟦2⟧. After that, plan your naval invasions from Denmark to the east coast of the UK and wait, because sooner or later you'll have a moment of naval dominance and your invasions will launch. You might have to fight the Germans for a couple states. If the peace deal didn't go well, don't confirm and leave, but reload the save file. When you load back in you're back at the beginning of the peace deal and you can try again.
jikep.zh: 直接转法西斯并帮助德国击败盟国。若想获得更多人力与更强大的海军，你可以入侵⟦0⟧，但并非必要。法西斯丹麦的人力足以产出约 24 个优质师，外加几个用于守港的劣质师。要拿到足够的战争贡献，务必在德国完成国策「但泽或战争」时把你大部分军队部署在⟦1⟧边境。协助击败波兰之后，把军队西调，协助击败比荷卢与⟦2⟧。之后规划从丹麦到英国东海岸的海军登陆并等待，因为迟早会出现一个制海权窗口，你的登陆就会发动。你可能不得不为了几个州与德国开战。如果和平协议的结果不理想，不要确认、直接退出，而是重新读取存档。重新载入后你会回到和平协议开始时，可以再试一次。

ipm0p3.en: After Patch 1.15, this strategy no longer works exactly as described because the UK actually guards their waters properly and there is never "a moment of naval dominance". You will need to either build a proper navy or an airforce to invade them.
ipm0p3.zh: 1.15 补丁之后，这一策略不再完全如所述那样有效，因为英国确实会认真守卫其海域，再也不会出现「制海权窗口」。你需要么建立一支像样的海军，要么建立一支空军来入侵它们。

1m7h0ip.en: ⟦0⟧ adds dedicated national focus trees to the minor powers around the Black Sea and the Aegean. Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey can each chart unique historical and alternate history paths as they resist efforts by the major powers to dominate the strategic sea-lanes of the Bosporus and Dardanelles.
1m7h0ip.zh: ⟦0⟧为黑海与爱琴海周边的小国添加了专属国策树。保加利亚、希腊与土耳其各自都能走出独特的历史与架空历史路线，抵抗列强试图主宰博斯普鲁斯与达达尼尔海峡这条战略航道的企图。

171ow4e.en: ⟦0⟧ is the 3rd ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧. Announced on 2020-09-23⟦3⟧, and was released on 2020-10-15. The country pack coincides with patch 1.10.

1e4ej5j.en: Description of Yugoslav focus tree changes and briefly talking about pathways and talking about minor changes to Romania
1e4ej5j.zh: 介绍南斯拉夫国策树改动，简要谈及各条路线，并说明对罗马尼亚的小幅改动

1g9kiow.en: Forum, Protect the Straits in Hearts of Iron IV: Battle for the Bosporus on October 15th, 2020-09-23.
1g9kiow.zh: 论坛，《在〈钢铁雄心 4：博斯普鲁斯之战〉中保卫海峡》，10 月 15 日，2020-09-23。

1slfytl.en: Short description of Telemetry of how player behaviour changed since the DLC release
1slfytl.zh: 简要介绍遥测数据所反映的 DLC 发布以来玩家行为的变化

13bl57m.en: All developer diaries about the ⟦0⟧ country pack and ⟦1⟧ (aka Collie).
13bl57m.zh: 所有关于⟦0⟧国家包与⟦1⟧（又名「柯利牧羊犬」）的开发日志。

kbhoiz.en: Description of Bulgarian focus tree and briefly talking about pathways
kbhoiz.zh: 介绍保加利亚国策树，并简要谈及各条路线

fsp8he.en: Description of Turkish focus tree and briefly talking about pathways
fsp8he.zh: 介绍土耳其国策树，并简要谈及各条路线

rra2py.en: Description of Greek focus tree and briefly talking about pathways
rra2py.zh: 介绍希腊国策树，并简要谈及各条路线

1vm9ujq.zh: ⟦0⟧之后的统计，以及对 2021 年的总体展望

brh988.en: The factions of which these countries join WILL send troops to defend these countries eventually. They won't just ignore you. Also, you'll most likely be fighting in the amazon if they join the Allies, which has no supply at all and the areas that your troops can actually enter snakes everywhere, so catching and eliminating those divisions is a very slow and frustrating game of cat and mouse.
brh988.zh: 这些国家所加入的阵营最终必然会派兵来防守它们，不会对你置之不理。此外，如果它们加入盟国，你很可能要在亚马孙地区作战——那里完全没有补给，而你的部队真正能进入的区域又像蛇一样四通八达，因此围歼并消灭那些师会是一场极其缓慢而令人烦躁的猫鼠游戏。

1a00uin.en: If you wait too long with attacking the remaining South American nations, they might join either the Allies or the Axis, but this doesn't matter. You'll only have to occupy the states in question, a peace deal is not required.
1a00uin.zh: 如果你拖太久才进攻其余的南美国家，它们可能会加入盟国或轴心国，但这无关紧要。你只需要占领相关州，并不需要和平协议。

4lzw9n.en: Furthermore, the focus South American Unity allows you to core all of South-America. This does cost 75 ⟦0⟧ for every state, so only choose the states that have a lot of ⟦1⟧ and factories.
4lzw9n.zh: 此外，国策「南美统一」允许你把整个南美洲设为核心。这每州要花费 75⟦0⟧，所以只选择那些拥有大量⟦1⟧与工厂的州。

1ioqp94.en: Don't forget to take and defend Curaçao (from the ⟦0⟧), the Falkland Island (from the UK), Easter Island ( ⟦1⟧) and Galapagos Island ( ⟦2⟧).
1ioqp94.zh: 不要忘记夺取并防守库拉索（取自⟦0⟧）、福克兰群岛（取自英国）、复活节岛（⟦1⟧）与加拉帕戈斯群岛（⟦2⟧）。

5zdskv.en: Can be done in conjunction with ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ if the last country that you invade is ⟦2⟧.
5zdskv.zh: 可以与⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧一并完成，前提是你最后入侵的国家是⟦2⟧。

1i1nlhe.en: After conquering ⟦0⟧ no other country in South-America will be able to stop you.
1i1nlhe.zh: 征服⟦0⟧之后，南美洲再没有其他国家能阻挡你。

uvgidl.en: Taking the Falkland Islands immediately gives you the achievementː ⟦0⟧.
uvgidl.zh: 夺取福克兰群岛会立即给你成就ː ⟦0⟧。

fofe7j.en: As Argentina, own all of Latin America except Bolivia
fofe7j.zh: 以阿根廷拥有除玻利维亚以外的全部拉丁美洲

pcxu1a.zh: 第二次西斯拉普拉塔战争：电力布加洛版

wgre3j.en: It is recommended to have one army of infantry divisions holding the Maginot Line, while an army group of two infantry armies attacks Germany from the German-Polish border. Put all mountaineers, cavalry, motorized and tank divisions into one army group as well, and set it up to take over East Prussia (after which you can send it to help ⟦0⟧ as they might have trouble holding out).
wgre3j.zh: 建议用一支步兵师组成的集团军守住马奇诺防线，同时用一个由两支步兵集团军组成的集团军群从德波边境进攻德国。把所有山地兵、骑兵、摩托化与坦克师也编入同一个集团军群，并安排它去接管东普鲁士（之后你可以派它去支援⟦0⟧，因为他们可能难以支撑）。

z7xylx.en: Ensure you have +100 relations with all concerned nations during each focus to ensure success. After completing these focuses, it is recommended to go for focuses that strengthen your industry and military. Make sure to complete Defensive Stratagems as soon as possible.
z7xylx.zh: 在每个国策期间，确保与所有相关国家的关系都达到 +100，以保证成功。完成这些国策后，建议转向强化工业与军事的国策。务必尽快完成「防御战略」。

qwbkhb.en: 1. Form the Popular Front 2. Reform the Labour Laws 3. Review Foreign Policy 4. Confirm Eastern Commitments 5. Strengthen the Little Entente 6. Strengthen Government 7. Revive the Franco-Polish Alliance 8. Invite Yugoslavia 9. Invite Romania 10. Join the Ententes
qwbkhb.zh: 1. 组建人民阵线 2. 改革劳动法 3. 审视外交政策 4. 确认东方承诺 5. 强化小协约国 6. 强化政府 7. 恢复法波同盟 8. 邀请南斯拉夫 9. 邀请罗马尼亚 10. 加入各协约

ih8zw.en: After completing the focuses mentioned above, you should have ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ in your faction. The Sudeten Crisis should lead to war, at which point it will be trivial to defeat Germany as it has no chance of holding out against your faction.
ih8zw.zh: 完成上述国策后，你的阵营里应该有⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧。苏台德危机应当会引发战争，届时击败德国将轻而易举，因为它根本不可能抵挡你的阵营。

1dprbxp.en: As France, complete the "Little Entente" National Focus, and have all German cores owned by you or someone in your faction.
1dprbxp.zh: 以法国完成「小协约国」国策，并让你或你阵营中的某个成员拥有德国的全部核心。

1q78k3j.en: The war should be over by mid-1939. Make sure all German states are annexed or puppetted.
1q78k3j.zh: 战争应在 1939 年中期结束。确保所有德国州都被吞并或傀儡化。

1bwbrgl.en: ⟦0⟧ starts as a ⟦1⟧ nation. It is recommended to change to ⟦2⟧ ideology as soon as possible (when rushing Fascist via a civil war, be aware that the Democratic faction will start a new civil war whenever they have more than 70% support because of the ⟦3⟧). It may be advantageous to push ⟦4⟧ in ⟦5⟧ because otherwise, they will produce more divisions as a ⟦6⟧ nation. Once ⟦7⟧ ideology has been switched, Justify against ⟦8⟧ and ⟦9⟧. Once that is over, prepare for war against ⟦10⟧. Land forts on the border could be good, as they may have a larger division count. Because ⟦11⟧ does not have any ships, Naval Invasion to their capital is possible. Capitulate them and repeat with ⟦12⟧. However, since they have a navy, naval invasions are not possible. Once the decision to create Gran Colombia is available, select it. ⟦13⟧ may continue to expand to other Central American Countries for resources. ⟦14⟧ is a good choice because of the large amount of chromium that can be traded for civilian factories. Build Naval factories to create the required ships. It's a good idea to replace military factories to naval factories for faster ship building.
1bwbrgl.zh: ⟦0⟧开局是一个⟦1⟧国家。建议尽快转为⟦2⟧意识形态（在通过内战速转法西斯时要注意：由于⟦3⟧的存在，民主派一旦支持度超过 70% 就会发动新的内战）。推动⟦4⟧进入⟦5⟧可能是有利的，否则他们作为⟦6⟧国家会产出更多师。一旦完成⟦7⟧意识形态的转换，就对⟦8⟧与⟦9⟧制造战争目标。等这一切结束后，准备对⟦10⟧开战。在边境修陆地要塞可能不错，因为他们的师数量可能更多。由于⟦11⟧没有任何舰船，可以对其首都发动海军登陆。迫使其投降，然后对⟦12⟧重复同样的做法。不过，由于他们有海军，无法进行海军登陆。一旦「建立大哥伦比亚」决议可用，就选择它。⟦13⟧可以继续向其他中美洲国家扩张以获取资源。⟦14⟧是个好选择，因为那里有大量铬可以换取民用工厂。建造海军工厂以造出所需的舰船。把军用工厂改建成海军工厂以加快造舰速度是个好主意。

ownvgb.en: This achievement is most likely in reference to Colombian-Haitian song "Hips Don't Lie" by Shakira and Wyclef Jean.
ownvgb.zh: 这个成就很可能是在呼应哥伦比亚-海地歌曲——夏奇拉与怀克里夫·让的《Hips Don't Lie》。

1ct56b5.en: This Achievement requires ⟦0⟧ to form Gran Colombia and be in possession of 10 battleships and 10 carriers.
1ct56b5.zh: 该成就要求⟦0⟧建立大哥伦比亚，并拥有 10 艘战列舰与 10 艘航空母舰。

nfbur3.en: Defeat the remaining Belgian Congo loyalists and join the Allies, then invade Belgium from the UK. As Belgium no longer exists, their states can be occupied or transferred control of without issue
nfbur3.zh: 击败剩余的比属刚果保皇派并加入盟国，然后从英国入侵比利时。由于比利时已不复存在，其州可以被随意占领或移交控制权

1690jor.en: Build up the economy and take focuses that can only be taken while still a Belgian puppet (prioritize the research slot, resources and reducing the effects of An Uncontrollably Vast Nation)
1690jor.zh: 发展经济，并选取只有在仍是比利时傀儡国时才能选的国策（优先考虑科研槽、资源，以及减轻「一个无法控制的庞大国家」的影响）

1ie8kkv.en: Since Belgium is considered to be in an offensive war, they cannot join the Allies, and will be annexed by Germany upon capitulation
1ie8kkv.zh: 由于比利时被视为处于进攻性战争中，它无法加入盟国，并会在投降时被德国吞并

rogryt.en: As Congo break free from the shackles of your old overlord and take control of all of their starting states
rogryt.zh: 以刚果挣脱旧宗主的枷锁，并控制其全部起始州

100w0x4.en: Research Landing Craft and go down the naval tree to obtain convoys (Expand the Shipping Industry)
100w0x4.zh: 研究登陆艇并沿海军科技树推进以获取运输船队（「扩大航运业」）

1qijhvo.en: Launch the independence war around March/April 1940, right before the Germans attack Belgium
1qijhvo.zh: 在 1940 年 3、4 月前后、即德国进攻比利时的前夕发动独立战争

1vsgegi.en: Launch the naval invasion once the Germans declare war and capture the required states.
1vsgegi.zh: 在德国宣战后立即发动海军登陆并夺取所需州。

1533txv.en: Contribute in wars to gain high war participation. (Easiest to do after France falls)
1533txv.zh: 通过参与战争来获得高战争参与度。（在法国沦陷后最容易做到）

1aoy8qr.en: Since ⟦0⟧ the states is required, ⟦1⟧ them, the following steps will be the easiest.
1aoy8qr.zh: 由于需要⟦0⟧这些州，就⟦1⟧它们，接下来的步骤是最容易的。

t8rf8a.en: Use your war score to request control of the required states from Germany.
t8rf8a.zh: 用你的战争贡献向德国索取所需州的控制权。

1nlhksf.en: Request Access from the UK and set up a naval invasion for Belgium
1nlhksf.zh: 向英国请求通行权，并为比利时筹备一次海军登陆

u508py.en: Focus on battles to maximize contribution efficiently.
u508py.zh: 专注于战斗，以高效地最大化贡献。

7y1gbg.en: Turn Communist as Congo and join the Comintern
7y1gbg.zh: 以刚果转为共产主义并加入共产国际

1l0ak2m.en: Turn fascist as Congo, then join the Axis.
1l0ak2m.zh: 以刚果转为法西斯，然后加入轴心国。

4lbkh8.en: This is a list of all ⟦0⟧. Most of these are not released with the "Asia Decolonized" game rule. All have unique leaders, except Timor-Leste and West Papua.
4lbkh8.zh: 这是全部⟦0⟧的列表。其中大多数在使用「亚洲去殖民化」游戏规则时不会释放。除东帝汶与西巴布亚外，所有国家都有独特的领袖。

nz218a.en: The ⟦0⟧ starts as ⟦1⟧ with elections every 4 years. Next election is in January 1940.
nz218a.zh: ⟦0⟧开局时为⟦1⟧，每 4 年举行一次选举。下一次选举在 1940 年 1 月。

hplaoy.en: For the other releasable countries in Asia, see ⟦0⟧.
hplaoy.zh: 亚洲其他可释放国家，请参见⟦0⟧。

1yzf7dl.en: Union of Bornean and Sulawesian People's Republics
1yzf7dl.zh: 婆罗洲与苏拉威西人民共和国联盟

103nfhz.en: For the Releasable countries main page, see ⟦0⟧.
103nfhz.zh: 可释放国家主页面，请参见⟦0⟧。

1fxmzgn.zh: 东帝汶革命民主共和国

p17ylg.en: People's Commune of Western New Guinea

k6sr1k.en: Soviet Republic of Siak Sri Indrapura
k6sr1k.zh: 锡亚克·斯里·因陀罗补罗苏维埃共和国

t1rgry.en: Shares a core each with ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧
t1rgry.zh: 分别与⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧共享一个核心

1svkvt7.zh: 西加里曼丹苏维埃共和国

rmjpi9.zh: 苏丹穆罕默德·塔希尔·穆希布丁

q9shjp.zh: 阿拉丁·穆罕默德·达乌德·沙阿二世

1tyvk4q.en: Heir to the Rooster of the East

1si3mhu.zh: 西婆罗洲达雅克共和国

56eh9x.en: Ida I Dewa Agung Gde Oka Geg
56eh9x.zh: 伊达·伊·德瓦·阿贡·格德·奥卡·格

17g3u2r.en: The King Who Gave His Crown

1hmvarf.zh: 苏丹穆罕默德·贾比尔·沙阿

wzyxgz.en: Once ⟦0⟧ has capitulated either annex or puppet them and then plan a naval invasion for ⟦1⟧, to make it a bit faster/easier also put 1 or 2 divisions on Narvik. Once ⟦2⟧ is gone, declare war on and take ⟦3⟧. If done correctly neither ⟦4⟧ nor ⟦5⟧ should get guaranteed at any point. However, there is a small chance that ⟦6⟧ gets guaranteed after you capitulate ⟦7⟧. But since you only need to occupy the land it isn't a big problem if they join a faction.
wzyxgz.zh: 一旦⟦0⟧投降，就吞并或傀儡化它，然后为⟦1⟧筹划一次海军登陆；为了更快更省事，也可以在纳尔维克放 1 到 2 个师。一旦⟦2⟧消失，就对⟦3⟧宣战并占领它。如果做得正确，⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧在任何时点都不应获得保障。不过，⟦6⟧在你迫使⟦7⟧投降之后有很小的概率会获得保障。但由于你只需要占领那片土地，即使它们加入阵营也不是什么大问题。

1gptwpu.en: Next go for Empower Finnish Militants and National Pride Marches in Finland. While you take the decisions to boost fascism in ⟦0⟧, go for Develop Natural Resources and Invest in Baltic Trade. In the meantime don't forget about researching Transport Ships, otherwise, you won't be able to naval invade ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.
1gptwpu.zh: 接着去拿「赋能芬兰激进分子」与芬兰的「民族自豪游行」。当你执行在⟦0⟧提升法西斯主义的决议时，去走「开发自然资源」与「投资波罗的海贸易」。同时不要忘记研究运输船，否则你将无法对⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧发动海军登陆。

1ywvpy4.en: Once ⟦0⟧ is Fascist go for Unite Our Nations and around this time you should start justifying on ⟦1⟧. Next, go for The Veteran's Government and Anti-Communist Militia. The 4 divisions from this focus should be attacking the port you target for your naval invasions.
1ywvpy4.zh: 一旦⟦0⟧成为法西斯，就去拿「联合我们的民族」，大约在这个时间你应当开始对⟦1⟧制造战争目标。接着去拿「老兵政府」与「反共民兵」。该国会提供的 4 个师应当用于进攻你为海军登陆选定的港口。

tv2wzs.en: Go for "Proclaim Finno-Ugra" and around the time this Focus is done your war goal on ⟦0⟧ should be ready, declare war on them. Improve relations with ⟦1⟧ and the UK and go for the Focus "Unite The Sami", which gives you war goals on ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
tv2wzs.zh: 去拿「宣告芬兰-乌戈尔」，大约在这个国策完成时，你对⟦0⟧的战争目标也应准备就绪，对他们宣战。改善与⟦1⟧和英国的关系，并去拿国策「联合萨米人」，它会给你对⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的战争目标。

1u4009b.en: Go to Rally the Nation. You will get decisions to march around the country which increases ⟦0⟧ support. When it is possible, take The March on Tallinn. It can start a classic civil war but this is easy to win.
1u4009b.zh: 前往「集结全国」。你会获得在全国各地游行的决议，可提高⟦0⟧支持度。在可行时，选取「向塔林进军」。它可能引发一场典型的内战，但那很容易获胜。

uj1b1w.zh: 以爱沙尼亚确保控制斯堪的纳维亚。

1lhufan.en: Note that even though the description doesn't say so, you actually need to fully control (but not own) all your cores as well after taking the respective focus. This adds a lot of difficulty since it means a war with the Allies and potentially the Soviets (if the PRC joins their faction/Sinkiang fails to unite), or try focus Request Handover of the Coastal Cities and border wars. Pick ⟦0⟧ on historical and follow the shared tree with Guanxi Clique. Unify with Guanxi clique and don't back down with China. They will declare on you, but it's easy to just hold the line for a year and they will white peace you. Go opposition and don't join the CUF and the war against Japan, but start border wars with China and warlords to eat states off of them over time. When the final focus on the opposition tree is taken you will switch to Nat. China focus tree but you will retain the border wars mechanic. When Japan shares a border with you they will declare on you, don't join any faction and push them back together with the united front. Since you are not in faction and you have cores on all of China, whatever you conquer will be under your control and not China. When Japan is pushed back (it won't white peace because the AI doesn't accept it), declare on the CUF (At this point China should be left with 2/3 states) and capitulate it. At this point, just occupy Hong Kong, Macau and Guangzhouwan and the achievement will fire.
1lhufan.zh: 请注意，尽管描述中没有说明，但在选取相应国策后，你实际上还需要完全控制（但不必拥有）你的全部核心。这大大增加了难度，因为它意味着要与盟国开战，还可能要与苏联开战（如果中华人民共和国加入他们的阵营/新疆未能统一），或者尝试国策「请求移交沿海城市」与边境战争。在历史模式下选择⟦0⟧，并走与桂系共享的国策树。与桂系统一，并且不要对中国退让。它们会对你宣战，但只要守住战线一年就很容易，它们会与你白和。走反对派路线，不要加入统一战线，也不要参加对日战争，但要与中国和各军阀打边境战争，逐步从他们身上割取州。当反对派树上的最后一个国策被选取后，你会切换到国民中国的国策树，但你仍保留边境战争机制。当日本与你接壤时它们会对你宣战，不要加入任何阵营，与统一战线一起把它们推回去。由于你不在阵营中，且拥有全中国的核心，你征服的一切都会归你控制，而不是中国。当日本被推回去后（它不会白和，因为 AI 不接受），对统一战线宣战（此时中国应当只剩下 2/3 个州）并迫使它投降。到这一步，只要占领香港、澳门与广州湾，成就就会触发。

c3jw5y.en: As a Warlord, proclaim a new Chinese Empire.
c3jw5y.zh: 以军阀宣告一个新的中华帝国。

rwwwfu.en: Before going to war with the Allies conquer both ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. You should declare on ⟦2⟧ first, as their port is much easier to invade than ⟦3⟧. As long as you haven't joined the Comintern and you do this during WWII they should not get guaranteed. Remember to only annex the states from ⟦4⟧ that border the Red Sea and to puppet the rest. Otherwise, you might get overrun on the Arabian Peninsula
rwwwfu.zh: 在与盟国开战之前，先征服⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。你应当先对⟦2⟧宣战，因为他们的港口比⟦3⟧好入侵得多。只要你还未加入共产国际，并且是在二战期间这么做，它们就不应获得保障。记住只吞并⟦4⟧中与红海接壤的州，其余的都傀儡化。否则，你可能在阿拉伯半岛上被击溃

19an3a1.en: When the war starts focus in the south on securing Aden and in the north on conquering Northern Egypt (ports and Suez Canal). Once that is done start pushing upwards from ⟦0⟧ to surround the allied divisions left in Egypt and to take the remaining states.
19an3a1.zh: 战争开始后，在南方专注于夺取亚丁，在北方专注于征服北埃及（港口与苏伊士运河）。完成之后，开始从⟦0⟧向上推进，以包围留在埃及的盟军师并夺取剩余的州。

i0qoin.en: Once ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are no more, prepare for war with the Allies. Have between 48-72 good divisions. Because you need to be able to overrun the Allied divisions in Egypt and be able to defend your home against both land attacks and naval invasions.
i0qoin.zh: 一旦⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧不复存在，就准备与盟国开战。要有 48 到 72 个优质师。因为你既要能击溃埃及的盟军师，又要能守住本土抵御陆上进攻与海军登陆。

1qevkwe.en: For this ⟦0⟧, you only need to occupy the states in question. It doesn't matter which side of the communist path you go down. However, the Soviet path does have the risk of ending up as a Soviet Puppet.
1qevkwe.zh: 对于这个⟦0⟧，你只需要占领相关州。走共产主义路线的哪一支都无所谓。不过，苏联路线确实有最终沦为苏联傀儡的风险。

13ie4cj.en: Forming The Horn of Africa and The African Union decisions can be very helpful towards this goal. However, the latter does take longer to get results from.
13ie4cj.zh: 「组建非洲之角」与「非洲联盟」决议对此目标可能非常有帮助。不过后者见效更慢。

10ws83x.en: The naval focus branch allows you to purchase older ships and/or the exp is enough to design a submarine.
10ws83x.zh: 海军国策分支允许你购买老旧舰船，且/或获得的经验足以设计一艘潜艇。

1i92kya.en: Because you'll have to fight the Allies and for that, you need a fair amount of good divisions.
1i92kya.zh: 因为你将不得不与盟国作战，而为此你需要相当数量的优质师。

1wjjyex.en: After the civil war focus on getting more manpower and factories.
1wjjyex.zh: 内战之后，专注于获取更多人力与工厂。

1x3cd3r.en: Start off by going down the Communist path up to Align more Closely with Landsorganisationen, you can get the 10% Communist support by going for Poverty Reduction. Then focus on lowering your stability (to at least 50%) and upping your Communist popularity to 35%. By taking respective focuses like Götaverken, Seize Landsverk, and Form SAAB for decreasing stability and Affordable Housing and Accept the Saltsjöbaden Agreement for increasing Communist support. Once you have lower than 50% stability and more than 35% Communist support a Communist civil war will start and you will soon after get an event to exit the mainland. (Try to rush as many VPs as you can before the event, but be careful not to capitulate the Communists - watch their capitulation progress, and, once you get close to 100%, park a couple of units next to victory points in the north.) From here on out you should have the ⟦0⟧ modifier. This modifier gives you a huge debuff of ⟦1⟧ defense and ⟦2⟧ attack, but a nice buff of ⟦3⟧ speed. Using the speed you might be lucky and VP snipe them, but due to the huge amount of free units the Communists spawn, this is unlikely the happen. After an in-game year when the modifier runs out, if you were able to snipe them, you will get the achievement. Otherwise you will have to reinvade the mainland. Note that Rushing the south will not be enough to capitulate ⟦4⟧. You will have to get Lulea in the North as well.
1x3cd3r.zh: 一开始沿共产主义路线走到「与 Landsorganisationen 更紧密结盟」，你可以通过「减贫」获得 10% 的共产主义支持度。然后专注于降低稳定度（至少降到 50%）并把共产主义支持度提到 35%。为此可分别选取「约塔韦尔肯」、「没收兰茨韦尔克」与「组建萨博」来降低稳定度，选取「可负担住房」与「接受萨尔茨约巴登协议」来提高共产主义支持度。一旦你的稳定度低于 50% 且共产主义支持度高于 35%，共产主义内战就会爆发，随后不久你会获得一个撤离大陆的事件。（尽量在该事件前抢下尽可能多的胜利点，但注意不要把共产党逼到投降——盯住他们的投降进度，一旦接近 100%，就把几支部队停在北方胜利点旁边。）此后你应当拥有⟦0⟧修正。该修正给你一个巨大的减益：防御⟦1⟧、攻击⟦2⟧，但有一个不错的增益：速度⟦3⟧。利用这个速度，你也许能走运抢下他们的胜利点，但由于共产党会刷出大量免费部队，这不太可能发生。在游戏内一年后该修正失效，如果你成功抢到了胜利点，就会获得成就。否则你就必须重新入侵大陆。请注意，仅仅快速拿下南方并不足以迫使⟦4⟧投降。你还必须拿下北方的吕勒奥。

quyuxm.en: As the exiled King of Gotland, retake mainland Sweden
quyuxm.zh: 作为流亡的哥特兰国王，夺回瑞典本土

145zdno.en: Artillery drawn by horses have a speed of 4km/h, Artillery drawn by trucks have a speed of 12km/h. To the latter the cost of 50 Trucks have to be added and they have a hardness of 10% instead of 0%. Supply consumption is 0.2 versus 0.3.
145zdno.zh: 马拉火炮的速度为 4 公里/小时，卡车牵引火炮的速度为 12 公里/小时。后者还需要加上 50 辆卡车的成本，并且硬度为 10% 而非 0%。补给消耗为 0.2 对 0.3。

hs80xz.en: Unlike ⟦0⟧ where the values are a combination of motorized_equipment + infantry_equipment, there are three mechanized_equipment_x. It is unknown whether the used infantry_equipment further modifies the end-values.
hs80xz.zh: 与⟦0⟧（其数值是 motorized_equipment + infantry_equipment 的组合）不同，机械化装备有三种 mechanized_equipment_x。所使用的 infantry_equipment 是否会进一步影响最终数值尚不清楚。

1pvv93x.en: Note: There is only one type of "motorized" equipment: the trucks available from 1936. Differences in the attack, defense, etc. stem from the infantry_equipment_x distributed to the batallion!
1pvv93x.zh: 注意：「摩托化」装备只有一种类型，即 1936 年起可用的卡车。攻击、防御等方面的差异源自分配给该营的 infantry_equipment_x！

x8v5m.en: ⟦0⟧ distinguishes four distinct types of reconnaissance companies: mounted, motorized, armored_car and light_tank. Each has its own recon-value and requires different type of equipment!
x8v5m.zh: ⟦0⟧区分四种不同的侦察连类型：骑马、摩托化、装甲车与轻型坦克。每一种都有自己的侦察值，并且需要不同类型的装备！

d4xrmc.en: "Total cost" is computed as IC cost + 1.5/8 * resource cost, based on the import rate and the cost ratio between military and civilian factories.

5gxe28.en: At least as of 1.16, neither France nor the UK will even attend the conference unless they have over 20% war support, so, if you rush the Resurrecting the Megali Idea focus and trigger the event too early, the conference will simply not happen. And if you choose to cooperate with fascists when you get the "Negotiations with the EEE" event, that also makes their participation unlikely. You'll be able to bypass the focus and move on to Horror and Fear, which lets you declare war on Turkey alone. It will be tricky work, since Turkey will likely have a larger standing army than you, and especially because Turkey will be guaranteed by Romania at that point, but it can be done. (It has to be done relatively quickly, though: if the conference fails, the UK tends to guarantee Turkey by March 1939, and Romania will join the Axis in mid-1940 if you're lucky, the Allies in September 1939 if you're not.) When going down this route, it helps to puppet Bulgaria before attempting Turkey.
5gxe28.zh: 至少在 1.16 版本中，除非法国与英国的战时支持度超过 20%，否则它们甚至不会出席会议；因此，如果你速推「复兴伟大理想」国策并过早触发该事件，会议根本不会召开。而如果你在「与 EEE 谈判」事件中选择与法西斯合作，那也会让它们不太可能参与。你可以绕过该国会转而推进「恐怖与恐惧」，这让你能够单独对土耳其宣战。这会是件棘手的事，因为土耳其的常备军很可能比你多，尤其因为此时土耳其会受到罗马尼亚的保障，但还是能做到的。（不过必须相对迅速地完成：如果会议失败，英国往往会在 1939 年 3 月前保障土耳其，而罗马尼亚如果运气好会在 1940 年中期加入轴心国，运气不好则在 1939 年 9 月加入盟国。）走这条路线时，在尝试对付土耳其之前先傀儡化保加利亚会有帮助。

1xvjqwk.en: The ⟦0⟧ focuses resulting from Resurrecting the Megali Idea allow for a war with ⟦1⟧ where you will gain Istanbul ⟦2⟧. Simply invite the UK, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧, and promise them all concessions. Some of them will join the war and grant you the needed land.
1xvjqwk.zh: 「复兴伟大理想」所引出的⟦0⟧国策允许你与⟦1⟧开战，从而获得伊斯坦布尔⟦2⟧。只需邀请英国、⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧，并向它们全部许诺让步。其中一些会参战并把所需的土地让给你。

3jzp09.en: Even if the ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ has agreed to split up ⟦2⟧, they can individually bail on the war when you declare war. The achievement is earned by taking 3 decisions: ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧.
3jzp09.zh: 即使⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧已同意瓜分⟦2⟧，它们也可能在你宣战时各自退出战争。该成就通过执行 3 个决议获得：⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧。

1c8h7ag.en: As Greece, capture Istanbul and rename it to Constantinople.
1c8h7ag.zh: 以希腊夺取伊斯坦布尔并将其改名为君士坦丁堡。

jb9pc.en: The strategy is the same as described in as for ⟦0⟧. Rush Scandinavia through your civil war (delete your army, train a single cavalry division etc.), follow the path down to the annexation of all faction members and form Scandinavia. Don't build civilian factories as you'll have enough through the other countries but rather create a defensive line (plus state anti-air if you like to) and focus on military factories. Raid and/or disband ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ parties to avoid the balance of power switch.
jb9pc.zh: 策略与⟦0⟧所述的相同。通过你的内战速通斯堪的纳维亚（解散你的军队、训练一个骑兵师等），沿路线一路走到吞并全部阵营成员并组建斯堪的纳维亚。不要建造民用工厂，因为你会从其他国家获得足够的数量，而应建立一条防线（如果你愿意，再加上州级防空）并专注于军用工厂。突袭并/或解散⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧政党，以避免力量平衡发生翻转。

1prdyhs.en: If you also want the other two achievements make sure you only have one other faction member (most likely ⟦0⟧ then) when the ⟦1⟧ capitulate. Then annex every state required for this achievement in the peace deal (or simply everything). After the peace deal release all required puppets for ⟦2⟧.
1prdyhs.zh: 如果你还想要另外两个成就，请确保在⟦0⟧投降时你只有一个其他阵营成员（届时最可能是⟦1⟧）。然后在和平协议中吞并该成就所需的每一个州（或者干脆全部吞并）。和平协议之后，为⟦2⟧释放全部所需的傀儡国。

11cxcfp.en: You'll need to form a faction in order to get the Scandinavian nations into it and to ultimately annex them, but that doesn't invalidate the achievement requirements as you only mustn't JOIN a faction. Creating a faction yourself is allowed as of patch 1.13.3.
11cxcfp.zh: 你需要组建一个阵营才能把斯堪的纳维亚国家拉进来并最终吞并它们，但这并不违反成就要求，因为你只是不能加入阵营。自 1.13.3 补丁起，自己创建阵营是允许的。

1p56887.en: Deploy port guards and a capable army (good old 7/2s work very well again) while you create a collaboration government in the ⟦0⟧. When the Winter War starts, improve the ⟦1⟧ and Finish Army spirits as much as you want and roll over the Red Army.
1p56887.zh: 部署港口守备队与一支能打的军队（经典的 7/2 编制又一次非常好用），同时在⟦0⟧建立一个合作政府。当冬季战争开始时，随意把⟦1⟧与芬兰陆军国家精神提升到你想要的程度，然后碾过红军。

dt4jls.en: Much easier when going the ⟦0⟧ route as you don't need to fight the Axis and/or Allies over cores in ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.
dt4jls.zh: 走⟦0⟧路线会容易得多，因为你不需要为了⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧的核心与轴心国和/或盟国开战。

10bqrml.en: As ⟦0⟧, form Greater Finland and own every core and claim without having ever joined a faction.
10bqrml.zh: 以⟦0⟧组建大芬兰，并在从未加入任何阵营的情况下拥有每一个核心与宣称。

1gf4g84.en: Best combined with ⟦0⟧. See the strategy there for more details.
1gf4g84.zh: 最好与⟦0⟧一起完成。更多细节参见该处的策略。

1v40yqz.en: Build the industrial and research foundation to survive the world's greatest conflict In ⟦0⟧. In this expansion, players can write new histories of Germany, Austria, Hungary, Belgium, and Congo. Pursue exciting new research and military options, opening new paths for devastating new weapons and dramatic raids on strategic targets.
1v40yqz.zh: 在⟦0⟧中打造足以在世界上最激烈的冲突中存续的工业与科研基础。在这个扩展包中，玩家可以书写德国、奥地利、匈牙利、比利时与刚果的新历史。探索激动人心的新科研与军事选项，为毁灭性新武器与对战略目标的戏剧性突袭开辟新路径。

amm5di.en: One additional wrinkle is that, after a sufficiently long and bloody conquest as Brazil or Argentina, your Welsh Argentina cores may have a population deficit. Meaning that you must either wait for the population to regenerate or set the conscription law to "Service By Requirement" just to get 20K manpower in the field. As a non-aligned nation, you can't raise conscription above "Limited Conscription" unless you're at war. Wales has more than twice your core population and may easily have 40K or more manpower by the time you're done justifying on them. In that case, you'll also want to go fascist/communist.
amm5di.zh: 还有一个额外的麻烦：在以巴西或阿根廷完成一场足够漫长而血腥的征服之后，你的威尔士阿根廷核心可能会出现人口赤字。这意味着你必须要么等待人口恢复，要么把征兵法案设为「按需服役」，才能凑出 2 万人力投入战场。作为一个中立主义国家，除非处于战争状态，你无法把征兵提高到「有限征兵」以上。威尔士的核心人口是你的两倍多，而且当你完成对他们的战争目标制造时，他们很可能已有 4 万或更多人力。那种情况下，你也会想转法西斯/共产主义。

n076yz.en: For that, you'll need to switch ideology, since Welsh Argentina starts non-aligned. E.g., if doing this after "Bad Ending", you'll need to go communist. (You can try to work around this somehow, since switching ideology takes a long time.)
n076yz.zh: 为此你需要转换意识形态，因为威尔士阿根廷开局是中立主义。例如，如果在「坏结局」之后做这件事，你就需要转共产主义。（你可以尝试用某种方式绕过这一点，因为转换意识形态要花很长时间。）

1230aa5.en: Build an early heavy ship with at least 375 naval supremacy. An early heavy ship without any modules should suffice but does need 4000 manpower.
1230aa5.zh: 尽早建造一艘重型舰船，至少达到 375 制海权。一艘不带任何模块的早期重型舰船应该就够了，但确实需要 4000 人力。

8eiyit.en: Build up your southern cores that are also Welsh Argentinas cores (⟦0⟧ + ⟦1⟧). Also build some Civs to trade for steel and chromium.

p7i7xx.zh: 把威尔士释放为独立国家。在此之前，你也可以删除威尔士核心上的一些工厂。

181vkr.zh: 前置条件：你已压制盟国并控制大不列颠，最好在「坏结局」成就之后进行

z25oei.en: Delete your army, as you may have almost no manpower as Welsh Argentina otherwise.
z25oei.zh: 解散你的军队，否则作为威尔士阿根廷你可能几乎没有人力。

prz707.en: Additionally youll need at least 4 Convoys to move your troops to England.
prz707.zh: 此外，你至少需要 4 支运输船队才能把部队运到英格兰。

oo1kf8.zh: 以「威尔士阿根廷」控制威尔士

158xymg.en: Declare and get that Welsh booty!
158xymg.zh: 宣战，拿下那笔威尔士战利品！

nm6fqz.en: Write new alternate histories of the globe’s most dramatic conflict in ⟦0⟧, a new country pack for ⟦1⟧. Explore and dominate a world where the strife of the Second World War threatens the safety and security of South American nations. Build a regional superpower to counter the rising global powers, or join the war early, taking your chances with one of the major ideological blocs. South America is rich in resources and manpower - can you lead Argentina, Brazil or Chile to a glorious alternate future?
nm6fqz.zh: 在⟦0⟧——⟦1⟧的新国家包中书写这场全球最激烈冲突的全新架空历史。探索并主宰一个二战纷争危及南美各国安危的世界。建立区域超级大国以对抗崛起中的全球列强，或提早参战，在某个主要意识形态集团中碰碰运气。南美拥有丰富的资源与人力——你能带领阿根廷、巴西或智利走向辉煌的架空未来吗？

1bckzt6.en: ⟦0⟧ is the 4th ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧. It was announced on 2024-01-25⟦3⟧, and was released on 2024-03-07. The country pack coincides with patch 1.14 (Bolivar).

19iavmn.zh: ⟦0⟧：次要内容以及若干新的可释放与可成立国家。

1inwugn.zh: 历史巴西国策树、国家精神与决议

9ob54c.en: Only the unique raids count for this achievement. Its thus highly advised to only launch the raid if you have a very high chance of success, as the raids are not repeatable and most nations don't have access to multiple raids in a single campaign. The following are the raids that are relevant for this achievement and how to unlock them:
9ob54c.zh: 只有独特的突袭才算入这个成就。因此强烈建议只在你成功几率非常高时才发动突袭，因为突袭不可重复，而且大多数国家在一局游戏中无法获得多次突袭机会。以下是与该成就相关的突袭，以及如何解锁它们：

gmf4sy.en: So far this achievement can only be gained by the ⟦0⟧, Germany and ⟦1⟧. All three countries have unique pros for getting it; Great Britain doesn't need to fulfill any conditions besides being at war, Austria will get the achievement even when failing the raid, and Germany has three chances instead of only one.
gmf4sy.zh: 到目前为止，这个成就只能通过⟦0⟧、德国与⟦1⟧获得。这三个国家在获得它的方面各有独特优势：大不列颠除了处于战争状态外无需满足任何条件，奥地利即使突袭失败也能获得成就，而德国有三次机会而非只有一次。

ssrj45.en: You need either a limited success, success, or critical success for the raid to count. The sole exception for this is the Austrian Reichstags Raid. It will award the achievement even if the raid results in a failure (this is likely an oversight).
ssrj45.zh: 你需要有限成功、成功或关键成功，突袭才会计入。唯一的例外是奥地利国会大厦突袭。即使突袭结果为失败，它也会授予成就（这很可能是疏漏）。

ysjvxx.en: In conjunction with ⟦0⟧ As the ⟦1⟧, focus your production on fighters and bombers. Via the raid panel, plan the Reichstag raid. Make sure it has a high chance of success, and launch the mission.
ysjvxx.zh: 与⟦0⟧配合。作为⟦1⟧，把生产集中于战斗机与轰炸机。通过突袭面板规划国会大厦突袭。确保它有很高的成功几率，然后发动任务。
