1mtuef6.zh: 成功对一处地标发动突袭

lgdarf.en: You can also do this without joining any faction. Just turn either ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. It doesn't really matter which. After that fabricate a war goal against ⟦2⟧ and put a few divisions on a naval invasion order for the Svealand province. You only need Stockholm for the achievement. ⟦3⟧ should have put most of their divisions on your border, but only rarely do they put any in Stockholm. Once the war starts you should have naval supremacy for a few hours. Enough for your invasions to be able to be launched. Even if ⟦4⟧ intercepts one divisions, they never will be able to get them all. So once you land either directly in Stockholm or land near it and then take it, the achievement pops up.
lgdarf.zh: 你也可以不加入任何阵营就完成这件事。只需转成⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧。转哪一个其实都无所谓。之后对⟦2⟧伪造战争目标，并把几个师放入针对斯韦阿兰省份的海军登陆命令中。这个成就你只需要斯德哥尔摩。⟦3⟧应该已经把大部分师部署在你的边境上，但它们很少会在斯德哥尔摩驻军。战争一开始，你会有几个小时的制海权。足以让你的登陆得以发动。即使⟦4⟧拦截了你一个师，它们也永远无法拦下全部。所以一旦你直接登陆斯德哥尔摩，或在其附近登陆然后攻占它，成就就会弹出。

1v42gg.en: At the start of the game, get both a ⟦0⟧ demagogue and a ⟦1⟧ revolutionary and switch to ⟦2⟧ via civil war. This will allow you to quickly get manpower bonuses from the ⟦3⟧ political tree as well as joining the Axis to avoid a ⟦4⟧ attack, while ⟦5⟧ support builds up for later (remove the ⟦6⟧ demagogue after your civil war but ensure ⟦7⟧ support stays below 60% to avoid a second civil war).
1v42gg.zh: 游戏开局时，同时获得一个⟦0⟧煽动家和一个⟦1⟧革命者，并通过内战转为⟦2⟧。这样你就能快速从⟦3⟧政治树获得人力加成，并加入轴心国以避免遭到⟦4⟧进攻，同时让⟦5⟧支持度逐步累积以备后用（内战后移除⟦6⟧煽动家，但要确保⟦7⟧支持度保持在 60% 以下以避免第二次内战）。

1n4ri2n.en: Declare war on ⟦0⟧ after your ⟦1⟧ support reaches 50%, then call in your allies and switch to . With German support, capitulating ⟦2⟧ should be straightforward and they will likely attack through your border rather than navally invading allowing for you to occupy all the land including Stockholm.
1n4ri2n.zh: 在⟦0⟧的⟦1⟧支持度达到 50% 后对其宣战，然后召唤你的盟友并切换到 。在德国的支持下，迫使⟦2⟧投降应当很直接，而且他们很可能会从你的边境发起进攻而不是海军登陆，从而让你能够占领包括斯德哥尔摩在内的全部土地。

1xu919z.en: Build up your army to about 15 infantry divisions to naval invade southern ⟦0⟧. Produce cheap submarines to ensure naval supremacy and create some cavalry divisions for defending your ports against naval invasions and at the ⟦1⟧ border, which can also be built up with forts.
1xu919z.zh: 把军队扩充到约 15 个步兵师，以海军登陆瑞典南部的⟦0⟧。生产廉价潜艇以确保制海权，并组建一些骑兵师用于防守你的港口、抵御海军登陆，以及驻守⟦1⟧边境，那里也可以用要塞加固。

iaefix.en: Requires that the ⟦0⟧ DLC is not enabled.

1htdund.zh: 以⟦0⟧丹麦占领斯德哥尔摩。

whodgf.en: The way to get this achievement while playing historical is to quickly change to fascist (start working on the Intelligence Agency in the meantime and use the Focuses that grant additional agents after regime change), stage a coup in Poland, while justifying a war on it. If timed well, the justification can be done shortly after the civil war kicks off. Join Axis, declare on Non-Aligned Poland and help the Falangist Poland win an independence war. (Germany will do most of the job). After that, guarantee the Falangist Poland, but try not to join their wars, when the USSR attacks, be ready to declare an offensive war and help the Axis deal with the USSR. You can avoid fighting Allies completely, just make sure to support the Axis with Lend-Lease to hold until 1945.
whodgf.zh: 在玩历史路线时获得这个成就的方法是：迅速转为法西斯（在此期间开始建设情报机构，并在政权更迭后利用那些给予额外特工的国策），在波兰策划一场政变，同时对它制造战争目标。如果时机把握得好，战争目标可以在内战爆发后不久就完成。加入轴心国，对中立主义的波兰宣战，并帮助长枪党波兰赢得独立战争。（德国会完成大部分工作。）之后，保障长枪党波兰，但尽量不要加入他们的战争；当苏联进攻时，准备好宣战进攻并帮助轴心国对付苏联。你可以完全避免与盟国作战，只要确保用租借支援轴心国撑到 1945 年。

1l1fgxo.en: The best way to do this is by playing a-historical and go into the custom game rules and set ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ to historical. Then, make sure Germany and ⟦2⟧ go through civil wars. If they don't, your best bet is to just reset. You should also stay non-aligned and make sure your army continues to build-up so you can guarantee ⟦3⟧. From there, you should be able to protect ⟦4⟧ and yourself from just about anything. Join the Allies if you can. The achievement requires the guarantee on Poland to be active at any point after 1944 meaning the guarantee can be made after 1944, however, the guarantee will need to be remade if you come to their defense.
1l1fgxo.zh: 最好的做法是玩非历史模式，进入自定义游戏规则，把⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧设为历史路线。然后确保德国与⟦2⟧经历内战。如果没有，你最好的选择就是直接重开。你还应保持中立主义，并确保军队持续扩充，以便你能保障⟦3⟧。从那时起，你应当能够保护⟦4⟧和自己免受几乎任何威胁。如果可以，加入盟国。该成就要求在 1944 年之后的任一时刻对波兰的保障处于生效状态，这意味着保障可以在 1944 年之后做出；不过，如果你为它们出兵防御，就需要重新做出保障。

yj8au9.en: Alternatively, if you Don't want the German Empire to take Poland after the Germany Civil war, Just disable the Gottergammerung DLC for less RNG. Note make sure Poland does NOT join Germany's faction since Poland will lose the war with Germany. You just want Poland to sit and do nothing essentially.
yj8au9.zh: 另外，如果你不希望德意志帝国在德国内战之后拿下波兰，只需禁用诸神黄昏 DLC 以减少随机性。注意要确保波兰不要加入德国的阵营，因为波兰会输掉与德国的战争。你其实只是想让波兰坐着什么都不做。

ghkspr.en: As Iran, guarantee Poland's independence and ensure it does not capitulate by 1945
ghkspr.zh: 以伊朗保障波兰的独立，并确保它在 1945 年前不投降

vfy0a7.en: When Germany attacks you after refusing the Munich Conference, hold your border while allowing your fighters and state AA to kill the German fighters and bombers over Czechoslovakia. If you have spare troops, helping ⟦0⟧ kill the East Prussia exclave early will relieve some of the pressure on your alliance. Once the German air force is sufficiently destroyed, push out and capitulate Germany. You can puppet or annex Germany, given that their surrounding countries are either ⟦1⟧ or your allies. When 1941 comes and you are at peace, you can complete the focus Return to Democracy. If ⟦2⟧ is fascist or not a member of your faction by this point, complete Pressure Romania with Hungarian Claims to make them fulfil the prerequisites for Return to Democracy.
vfy0a7.zh: 当德国在你拒绝慕尼黑会议后进攻你时，守住边境，同时让你的战斗机与州级防空在捷克斯洛伐克上空击落德国的战斗机与轰炸机。如果你有富余部队，早点帮忙消灭⟦0⟧的东普鲁士飞地，会减轻你阵营承受的部分压力。一旦德国空军被充分摧毁，就向外推进并迫使德国投降。你可以傀儡化或吞并德国，因为它们周边的国家要么是⟦1⟧，要么是你的盟友。当 1941 年来临且你处于和平状态时，你可以完成国策「回归民主」。如果到那时⟦2⟧是法西斯或不是你阵营的成员，就完成「以匈牙利主张施压罗马尼亚」，使它们满足「回归民主」的前置条件。

59sp20.en: On Historical AI, go for Kickstart Rapid Rearmament and then go down the ⟦0⟧ route. Build only ⟦1⟧ and make sure to build a good amount of fighters. Complete the focus Expand the Rome Protocols before the end of 1937 so you can invite ⟦2⟧ into your faction and prevent them from being Anschluss'ed. Once your Divided Nation spirit is gone, the focus Rally Against Germany will give you ⟦3⟧ for free. Going for the focuses A Strong Poland will get you a good ally, and Facilitate a Strong Hungary will give you an industry buff when puppeting them. ⟦4⟧ is optional as they are more difficult to defeat if they refuse their puppet event.
59sp20.zh: 在历史 AI 下，走「启动快速重整军备」，然后沿⟦0⟧路线推进。只建造⟦1⟧，并确保造出数量充足的战斗机。在 1937 年底前完成国策「扩大罗马议定书」，这样你就能邀请⟦2⟧加入你的阵营，防止它们被德奥合并。一旦你的「分裂的国家」国家精神消失，国策「集结对抗德国」就会免费给你⟦3⟧。走「一个强大的波兰」国策会让你得到一个好盟友，而「扶助一个强大的匈牙利」会在傀儡化它们时给你工业加成。⟦4⟧是可选的，因为如果它们拒绝傀儡事件，就更难击败。

1fwtvii.en: One of the prerequisites for the focus Return to Democracy requires that all your neighbor countries to either be ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ having caused less than 5% world tension, or in your faction once world tension passes 20%. With "Historical AI Focuses" disabled, it is also possible to avoid war with Germany altogether if Germany goes democratic and world tension stays below 20%.
1fwtvii.zh: 国策「回归民主」的前置条件之一要求你所有的邻国要么是⟦0⟧、要么是造成世界紧张度低于 5% 的⟦1⟧、要么在世界紧张度超过 20% 后加入你的阵营。在关闭「历史 AI 国策」的情况下，如果德国走民主路线且世界紧张度保持在 20% 以下，也完全可能避免与德国开战。

7fowet.en: As fascist Czechoslovakia, complete "Return to Democracy".
7fowet.zh: 以法西斯捷克斯洛伐克完成「回归民主」。

14eqnty.en: Depending on the how much of the British Fleet you took or how much of your own Navy you had to build in order to take the UK, you can also try naval invasions. If you try from Greenland, it is such a short distance from Canada that you can usually get the required Naval Dominance to launch an invasion across that single sea zone before the enemy fleets arrive. If you lost Greenland, you can island hop from the Faroe Islands to Iceland to Greenland to Canada as well using the same strategy.
14eqnty.zh: 取决于你夺取了多少英国舰队，或为拿下英国你必须自建多少海军，你也可以尝试海军登陆。如果你从格陵兰出发，那里离加拿大非常近，通常能在敌方舰队抵达前就取得所需的海军霸主地位，从而跨越那一个海域发动登陆。如果你失去了格陵兰，也可以用同样的策略从法罗群岛跳到冰岛、再到格陵兰、再到加拿大。

yvm8ai.en: If ⟦0⟧ is in the ⟦1⟧ and still alive, you can also just naval invade, paradrop, or even justify a war goal through Guatemala (though this is actually tricky because the war ends so fast you literally might not be able to walk through the country to get to ⟦2⟧ land in time).
yvm8ai.zh: 如果⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧中且仍然存活，你也可以直接海军登陆、空降，甚至经由危地马拉制造战争目标（不过这其实很棘手，因为战争结束得太快，你可能真的来不及穿过该国及时抵达⟦2⟧的土地）。

limg6.en: If you did: While building up your army, also improve your Canadian lands (⟦0⟧, etc). Move your army to the USA and justify on ⟦1⟧. When you declare war on ⟦2⟧, they'll call in the USA and in 1941 it should be fairly easy to defeat both.
limg6.zh: 如果你做到了：在扩充军队的同时，也改善你的加拿大土地（⟦0⟧等）。把军队调到美国并对⟦1⟧制造战争目标。当你对⟦2⟧宣战时，它们会召唤美国，而到 1941 年击败双方应该相当容易。

wikk4s.en: You now control ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and England. This allows you to reform the ⟦3⟧ and, more importantly, the far more powerful North Sea Empire, giving you loads of ⟦4⟧ and factories.
wikk4s.zh: 现在你控制了⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与英格兰。这让你能够重建⟦3⟧，更重要的是重建强大得多的北海帝国，给你带来大量⟦4⟧与工厂。

19nthrq.en: Defeat the ⟦0⟧ (wait until they progressed quite a bit into the ⟦1⟧) - >Take Canada in the peace deal -> Justify on ⟦2⟧ - > Defeat the USA - > Defeat ⟦3⟧.
19nthrq.zh: 击败⟦0⟧（等到它们在⟦1⟧中推进相当多之后）- > 在和平协议中拿下加拿大 -> 对⟦2⟧制造战争目标 - > 击败美国 - > 击败⟦3⟧。

ug2iui.en: Depending on whether you got part of Canada in a peace deal with the ⟦0⟧ or not makes the next step easy or a long longer.
ug2iui.zh: 取决于你是否在与⟦0⟧的和平协议中拿到了加拿大的一部分，这会让下一步变得容易，或漫长得多。

p5bcs1.en: Next increase your army to 120 divisions to field five full armies.
p5bcs1.zh: 接下来把军队扩充到 120 个师，以编成五支满编集团军。

15meb6s.en: As ⟦0⟧, own and control every ⟦1⟧ core.
15meb6s.zh: 以⟦0⟧拥有并控制每一个⟦1⟧核心。

2ca5kj.en: Continuing on from the guide for ⟦0⟧:

1snm5hw.en: Justify on ⟦0⟧ -> Declare war -> Leave the ⟦1⟧ and join ⟦2⟧ in the ⟦3⟧ - > Defeat ⟦4⟧ together -> Defeat USA together -> Annex the American border with ⟦5⟧ -> Justify on ⟦6⟧.
1snm5hw.zh: 对⟦0⟧制造战争目标 -> 宣战 -> 退出⟦1⟧并在⟦2⟧中加入⟦3⟧ - > 一同击败⟦4⟧ -> 一同击败美国 -> 吞并美国与⟦5⟧接壤的边境 -> 对⟦6⟧制造战争目标。

1ijoc6x.en: The Second Sino-Japanese War (SJW) was historically started by ⟦0⟧ under pretense of the Marco Polo bridge incident on the 7th of July 1937, which led to 8 years of war in ⟦1⟧ until Japan's capitulation on September 9th, 1945. In Hearts of Iron 4, the SJW is represented by a number of mechanics designed to allow for the slow paced warfare that historically took place. To start the SJW, due to Japan's reluctance to justify war goals under Emperor ⟦2⟧, Japan needs to take the ⟦3⟧ national focus. Alternatively, Japan can wait until world tension hits the 75% mark to justify a war goal or until any Chinese faction nation takes the ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧ national focus and starts a war. In the latter two cases, Japan will bypass the Marco Polo Bridge Incident national focus and enter the conflict without the according debuffs.
1ijoc6x.zh: 第二次中日战争（SJW）在历史上由⟦0⟧以卢沟桥事变（七七事变）为借口于 1937 年 7 月 7 日发动，导致⟦1⟧境内长达 8 年的战争，直到 1945 年 9 月 9 日日本投降。在《钢铁雄心 4》中，SJW 通过若干机制来表现，以再现历史上那种缓慢节奏的战争。要开启 SJW，由于日本在⟦2⟧天皇治下不愿制造战争目标，日本需要选取⟦3⟧国策。或者，日本也可以等到世界紧张度达到 75% 时制造战争目标，或等到任一中国阵营国家选取⟦4⟧或⟦5⟧国策并挑起战争。在后两种情况下，日本会跳过卢沟桥事变国策，并在不承受相应减益的情况下进入冲突。

1y0lt1y.en: The Ichi Go decision gives a buff to Japanese forces versus Chinese factions for the 365 days duration of the ⟦0⟧ mission, which on succesful completion gives ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ , or the reverse effects if failed. The mission is accomplished by capitulating ⟦3⟧. It costs 50 to take it.
1y0lt1y.zh: 「一号作战」决议在⟦0⟧任务持续的 365 天内为日军提供对中国各阵营的增益；该任务成功完成会给予⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧，失败则产生相反效果。该任务通过迫使⟦3⟧投降来完成。执行它需要花费 50。

1dep6rt.en: This Japanese national focus serves to debuff Japan's army in the beginning of the SJW. The debuffs can be undone in five steps by repeatedly taking the ⟦0⟧ decision. Taking the ⟦1⟧ focus removes the Marco Polo debuffs entirely and allows the ⟦2⟧ decision to be taken.
1dep6rt.zh: 这个日本国策用于在 SJW 初期削弱日本陆军。这些减益可以通过反复选取⟦0⟧决议分五步消除。选取⟦1⟧焦点会完全移除卢沟桥减益，并允许选取⟦2⟧决议。

1isu7m1.en: The Chinese starting national spirit gives the chinese factions in the SJW debuffs similar, but worse than the Japanese. It can be removed by taking the ⟦0⟧ decisions.
1isu7m1.zh: 中国的初始国家精神会给 SJW 中的中国各阵营带来与日本类似但更严重的减益。它可以通过选取⟦0⟧决议来移除。

7l3j7j.en: The decision requires the ⟦0⟧ national focus, takes 90 days to complete and costs 100 army XP. Taking it three times removes the army related debuffs for China.
7l3j7j.zh: 该决议需要⟦0⟧国策，需 90 天完成，并花费 100 陆军经验。选取三次即可移除中国与陆军相关的减益。

1e01b9m.en: The decision to ⟦0⟧ costs ⟦1⟧ and can be repeated every 30 days. After 5 times, the effects of the Marco Polo Bridge Incident national spirit are gone.
1e01b9m.zh: ⟦0⟧的决议花费⟦1⟧，每 30 天可重复一次。5 次之后，卢沟桥事变国家精神的效果就会消失。

dok8x4.en: During the SJW, China, Chinese warlord factions and Communist China may engage in ⟦0⟧ against each other.
dok8x4.zh: 在 SJW 期间，中国、中国军阀阵营与中国共产党可能会相互之间进行⟦0⟧。

16ulhl6.en: Nationalist China and Warlords - Army Corruption
16ulhl6.zh: 国民中国与各军阀 - 陆军腐败

1mifbuw.zh: 国民中国与各军阀的决议

1o1f1zr.en: Resource prospecting decisions take up a number of civilian factories for a time in order to permanently add base resources to a state. They can be taken by any country that both owns and controls the corresponding state (occupying it in a war is not sufficient most of the time). Most require a certain level of Construction or Excavation technology. All of these decisions cost 25 or 50 ⟦0⟧ to take.
1o1f1zr.zh: 资源勘探决议会临时占用若干民用工厂，以便为某个州永久增加基础资源。任何同时拥有并控制相应州的国家都可以执行它们（在战争中仅仅占领该州，在大多数情况下并不足够）。大多数决议需要一定等级的建造或采掘科技。所有这些决议执行时都需要花费 25 或 50⟦0⟧。

960s8a.en: This table gives the construction cost measured in base construction output. This is intended to give a rough comparison to building costs. However, note that these decisions are not affected by construction speed modifiers.
960s8a.zh: 此表给出的建造成本以基础建造产出为计量单位。其目的是与建筑成本作一个粗略比较。但请注意，这些决议不受建造速度修正的影响。

1dg6skn.en: A few of these decisions are repeatable. These take twice as long the second time, three times as long the third time, etc.
1dg6skn.zh: 其中少数决议可以重复执行。第二次耗时为两倍，第三次为三倍，以此类推。

t257xz.en: Only for ⟦0⟧ after Establish the Northern Resource Area focus is completed. Can be taken without having to own the state.
t257xz.zh: 仅在完成国策「建立北方资源区」后适用于⟦0⟧。无需拥有该州即可执行。

17d4kk7.en: For Republic of Paraguay only after Exploit Mineral Wealth focus is completed. Otherwise no requirement. Cost is 50 ⟦0⟧.
17d4kk7.zh: 仅适用于巴拉圭共和国，且需在完成国策「开发矿产资源」之后。其他情况下无要求。花费为 50⟦0⟧。

aovdy4.en: Only for Kingdom of Hungary after Tap Newfound Oil Deposits focus is completed. Cost is 50 ⟦0⟧.
aovdy4.zh: 仅适用于匈牙利王国，且需在完成国策「开采新发现的油田」之后。花费为 50⟦0⟧。

1hq4u53.en: Only for Kingdom of Hungary after Tap Newfound Oil Deposits focus is completed. Cost is 75 ⟦0⟧.

1iiax5r.en: ⟦0⟧: The Raj is the jewel of the British Empire, rich and strategically vital. However, a growing independence movement threatens to disrupt the war effort and dissolve the empire. A large focus tree emphasising the struggle of Indian Independence offers many alternate historical paths, including not just the revival of the East India Company as a corporate nation, but also the possibility of freedom for the Princely States, and the formation of Pakistan and Bangladesh.
1iiax5r.zh: ⟦0⟧：英属印度是大英帝国的明珠，富庶且具有战略上的关键意义。然而，不断壮大的独立运动有可能破坏战争努力并瓦解帝国。一棵庞大的国策树聚焦于印度独立斗争，提供许多架空历史路线，不仅包括把东印度公司复兴为一个公司制国家，还包括各土邦获得自由的可能，以及巴基斯坦与孟加拉国的建立。

1qjwh79.en: Navigate the difficult channel between nationalist dreams and imperial oppression in Graveyard of Empires, a new country pack for Paradox Interactive's popular grand strategy wargame. Resist the demands of foreign great powers and claim your own place on the world stage, engaging in diplomacy and warfare to lead a great national rebirth in the vast lands between the Euphrates and the Gulf of Bengal.
1qjwh79.zh: 在《帝国坟场》中，穿行于民族主义梦想与帝国压迫之间的险恶航道——这是 Paradox Interactive 广受欢迎的大战略战争游戏的全新国家包。抵抗外国列强的要求，在世界舞台上争取属于你的位置，通过外交与战争，在幼发拉底河与孟加拉湾之间的广袤土地上领导一场伟大的民族复兴。

18rc06k.en: ⟦0⟧: Iran is a potential great power, hemmed in by the imperial pressure of the Soviet Union and the British Empire. A significant new focus tree will allow you to resist the imperial incursions that historically weakened Iran, as well as offering potential for a new and modern Persian Empire.
18rc06k.zh: ⟦0⟧：伊朗是一个潜在的大国，却被苏联与大英帝国的帝国压力所围困。一棵重要的新国策树将让你能够抵抗历史上削弱伊朗的帝国入侵，并提供建立一个崭新而现代的波斯帝国的可能。

122nunv.en: ⟦0⟧: Historically known as the Graveyard of Empires, isolated from the wider war, Afghanistan offers many alternate paths. Continue the historical path of neutrality and isolation, or choose the road of rapid industrialization and building a new power in the mountains of Central Asia.
122nunv.zh: ⟦0⟧：阿富汗历史上被称为「帝国坟场」，与更广泛的战争相隔绝，提供许多架空路线。延续中立与孤立的历史路线，或选择快速工业化、在中亚群山中建立新强权的道路。

1me0ni2.en: This country pack adds new National Focus trees for key actors in West, Central, and South Asia, with a focus on regional resistance to European domination of the region.

6tb0z3.en: Go down the Tsarist Russia route. Win the civil war. (It helps a lot to practice infiltration aggressively: preferably, you should have infiltrated every state along the Trans-Siberian Railway as far as Chelyabinsk and Akhtubinsk by the time you start the civil war.) Release the peripheral states as puppets. The only places where this won't work (your border runs through your core states that can't be released) are 1) Krasnoyarsk, and 2) Leningrad and adjacent states. You will need to go to war with Tannu Tuva, Finland, Latvia, and Estonia to annex them before they can be puppeted. The biggest complication is that Latvia and Estonia might join the Allies (or the Triple Entente) before you have a chance to annex them, so you need to rush down the focuses and get them before it's too late.
6tb0z3.zh: 走沙皇俄国路线。赢得内战。（大力演练渗透会有很大帮助：最好在你发动内战时，已经渗透了西伯利亚大铁路沿线直到车里雅宾斯克与阿赫图宾斯克的每一个州。）把外围各州释放为傀儡国。唯一行不通的地方（你的边境穿过无法释放的核心州）是 1）克拉斯诺亚尔斯克，以及 2）列宁格勒及相邻各州。你需要先对唐努乌梁海、芬兰、拉脱维亚与爱沙尼亚开战并吞并它们，之后才能傀儡化。最大的麻烦是拉脱维亚与爱沙尼亚可能会在你来得及吞并之前加入盟国（或三国协约），所以你需要速推这些国策，赶在太晚之前拿下它们。

o8c7su.en: Go down The Path of Marxism Leninism and follow down The Left Opposition path, try to keep Stalin's paranoia down with the fake report decision as well as the Infiltrate the NKVD focus. Build up your HQ anywhere you like (Ukraine has the largest population and the most industry) and keep expanding outwards. Take the focuses to exile any advisors you want to keep and if you want to keep Tukhachevsky you must start the civil war before he is killed in the second purge.
o8c7su.zh: 走「马克思列宁主义之路」，然后沿「左翼反对派」路线推进，尽量用假报告决议以及「渗透 NKVD」国策压低斯大林的偏执度。在你喜欢的任何地方建设你的总部（乌克兰人口最多、工业最强），并持续向外扩张。选取那些流放你想保留的顾问的国策；如果你想保住图哈切夫斯基，就必须在他在第二次大清洗中被杀之前发动内战。

9cnvca.en: Once you reach around ~40% support you can Ignite the Flames and will be able to win the civil war rather easily as Stalin's Russia is weakened greatly. While in the war, begin The Comintern, Baltic Security, Claims in Baltic and Secure Leningrad (Note: Playing with Historical AI turned on will ensure that the Baltic claims are accepted and the Finnish demands are rejected for a wargoal).
9cnvca.zh: 一旦支持度达到约 40%，你就可以「点燃火焰」，并且由于斯大林的俄国被大幅削弱，你将能相当轻松地赢得内战。战争期间，开始推进「共产国际」、「波罗的海安全」、「波罗的海主张」与「确保列宁格勒」（注意：开启历史 AI 将确保波罗的海主张被接受、芬兰的要求被拒绝从而给你一个战争目标）。

19laap9.en: Justify war goals on ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, as they remained loyal to Stalin, and take their land. Once you finish Autonomous Soviet Republics you will need to release all of these nations as puppets: ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan, Bukharan Jadidist Republic, Altai and The Far Eastern Republic.
19laap9.zh: 对⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧制造战争目标，因为它们仍忠于斯大林，并夺取它们的土地。一旦你完成「自治苏维埃共和国」，你就需要把以下所有国家释放为傀儡国：⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、乌克兰、格鲁吉亚、哈萨克斯坦、阿塞拜疆、白俄罗斯、吉尔吉斯斯坦、土库曼斯坦、布哈拉青年党人共和国、阿尔泰以及远东共和国。

1ac0nt6.en: Declare war on ⟦0⟧, but only annex Åland and click Done. Put a few units there to guard the island. Delete the rest of your army and declare war on Germany. Let Germany invade and capitulate you. They should annex all your cores and leave you all alone on the islands with no neighbors and the achievement.

ew4t4n.en: The two recommended paths for this achievements is either the secret Macarthur path, which gives research bonuses, or the "election overturned" path which gives much more core territory in which facilities can be built. If you find that your bottleneck is breakthrough, the "Election Overturned" path is better. On the other hand, the Macarthur path lets you start working on your nuclear research 2 years earlier and gives you speed bonuses towards nuclear special projects. Since the main load of projects that need to be completed are naval though, this is overall not that useful.
ew4t4n.zh: 这个成就推荐的两条路线，要么是秘密的麦克阿瑟路线（提供科研加成），要么是「选举被推翻」路线（提供多得多的核心领土用于建造设施）。如果你发现瓶颈在于突破，那么「选举被推翻」路线更好。另一方面，麦克阿瑟路线让你能提前 2 年开始核研究，并给予核特殊项目的速度加成。不过由于需要完成的项目主要负担在海军方面，所以总体而言那并不太有用。

1sessm5.en: Even ignoring the duration it takes to generate breakthroughs, the earliest you will be done with this achievement, is around 1955. In 1940 you can research nuclear theory which takes till 1941. Then you can research the two reactors and the engine project, which will take you till around mid 1946. Then you can start working on the nuclear submarine. This will be done by around mid 1950. Then you will have to spend another 4 years working on the Nuclear missile submarine.
1sessm5.zh: 即使不考虑产生突破所需的时间，你最早也只能在 1955 年左右完成这个成就。1940 年你可以研究核理论，这要花到 1941 年。然后你可以研究两座反应堆与发动机项目，这大概会让你到 1946 年中期。接着你可以开始研制核潜艇。这大概会在 1950 年中期完成。之后你还得再花 4 年研制核导弹潜艇。

1ishvgg.en: Thus you will need at least a Aerodynamics, a Naval and a Physics facility. However its recommended to have at least 2 physics facilities, so that you can work on both the engines and the bombs simultaneously. The Naval and Aerodynamics projects all build on each other, so any more than one facilities will only be used to generate more breakthroughs.
1ishvgg.zh: 因此你至少需要一个空气动力学设施、一个海军设施与一个物理学设施。不过建议至少有 2 个物理学设施，这样你就能同时推进发动机与核弹。海军与空气动力学项目彼此前后依赖，所以超过一个设施只会被用来产生更多突破。

mtz8g2.en: To complete this you need both a Submarine with the "Nuclear missile launcher" module (unlocked via the "Nuclear Missile Submarine" project) and at least a "Medium range nuclear missile" (unlocked via the "Nuclear Warheads" project).
mtz8g2.zh: 要完成这个，你既需要一艘装有「核导弹发射器」模块的潜艇（通过「核导弹潜艇」项目解锁），也需要至少一枚「中程核导弹」（通过「核弹头」项目解锁）。

1197ju8.en: This requires the completion of the following special projects (somewhat in order):
1197ju8.zh: 这需要完成以下特殊项目（大致按顺序）：

1ygz6p4.en: As the Philippines, launch nuclear missiles from a nuclear submarine.
1ygz6p4.zh: 以菲律宾从核潜艇上发射核导弹。

1bc33eb.en: Nuclear Fission Bomb Project (Physics, 1 breakthrough)(~720 days)
1bc33eb.zh: 核裂变弹项目（物理学，1 突破）（约 720 天）

acywgg.en: Total breakthroughs needed: Physics; 5, Naval; 9, Aerodynamics; 4
acywgg.zh: 所需突破总数：物理学 5、海军 9、空气动力学 4

ow4uif.zh: 商业核反应堆（物理学，1 突破）（约 720 天）

13g2azb.zh: 导弹发射潜艇（海军，2 突破）（约 510 天）

1ptxf1t.zh: 核导弹潜艇（海军，2 突破）（约 1440 天）

116tqwx.zh: 弹道导弹（空气动力学，3 突破）（约 480 天）

1tr0wp8.zh: 核潜艇（海军，3 突破）（约 1200 天）

ks7478.zh: 核弹头（物理学，1 突破）（约 720 天）

1gcs6r.zh: 核反应堆（物理学，1 突破）（约 720 天）

abq6w9.zh: 核发动机（物理学，1 突破）（约 510 天）

1pj17d5.zh: 巡洋潜艇（海军，1 突破）（约 340 天）

s0vumr.zh: 舰队潜艇（海军，1 突破）（约 510 天）

agnmk8.zh: 中程弹道导弹（空气动力学，1 突破）（约 480 天）

1rg8ts2.en: Aside from the countries covered in the focus tree, you won't have to justify on ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, or ⟦6⟧; former 3 will get eaten by Germany, ⟦7⟧ can give you a War goal through an event, and ⟦8⟧ will eat the latter 3). Unless the French AI has flipped to ⟦9⟧, they'll still have ⟦10⟧; launch naval invasions across the English Channel (take Secure the Italian Alliance to have the French divert their forces), and rush Paris (Cavalry, Motorized, or Tank Divisions with Motorized are ideal choices); while fighting the French, also justify on the ⟦11⟧ and ⟦12⟧, and then conquer them (and ⟦13⟧ if you got a War goal on them; if not, you can let the Germans take Luxembourg, as it's not that big of a help to them).
1rg8ts2.zh: 除了国策树已涵盖的国家之外，你不需要对⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧或⟦6⟧制造战争目标；前 3 个会被德国吃掉，⟦7⟧可以通过一个事件给你战争目标，而⟦8⟧会吃掉后 3 个）。除非法国 AI 已翻转为⟦9⟧，它们仍然会拥有⟦10⟧；跨越英吉利海峡发动海军登陆（选取「确保意大利同盟」可让法国分散其兵力），并速攻巴黎（骑兵、摩托化或配备摩托化的坦克师都是理想选择）；在对法作战的同时，也对⟦11⟧与⟦12⟧制造战争目标，然后征服它们（如果拿到了对⟦13⟧的战争目标就一并征服；如果没有，你可以让德国拿下卢森堡，因为它对德国的帮助并不大）。

12jlmw4.en: A good choice is the ⟦0⟧, since not only can you also get One Empire, but you can also form the European Federation on top of the Imperial Federation. An easy strategy is to go down the God Save the King path, and after defeating the ⟦1⟧, go after ⟦2⟧ (as you went off the rails, ⟦3⟧ will always refuse to give up Sudetenland; if you do Pre-Empt the Ideological Threat and Expose the Belly of the Bear while fighting the US, you'll be able to justify, and since the US is a major, you can quickly justify on ⟦4⟧ and another country - ⟦5⟧ is a good choice; don't justify on ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, the ⟦8⟧, or Germany, since you can get War Goals on those countries through events or focuses).
12jlmw4.zh: 一个不错的选择是⟦0⟧，因为你不仅能拿到「一个帝国」，还能在帝国联邦之上组建欧洲联邦。一个简单的策略是走「天佑国王」路线，击败⟦1⟧之后去打⟦2⟧（由于你偏离了正轨，⟦3⟧总会拒绝交出苏台德地区；如果你在对美作战期间选取「先发制人应对意识形态威胁」与「暴露熊的软腹」，你就能制造战争目标，而且由于美国是主要国家，你可以迅速对⟦4⟧和另一个国家制造战争目标——⟦5⟧是个好选择；不要对⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧或德国制造战争目标，因为你可以通过事件或国策获得对那些国家的战争目标）。

1eeq0j4.en: Wait until Germany is deep in the ⟦0⟧, then declare on them - the closer the Germans are to capitulating the ⟦1⟧ when you declare on them, the better (if you're really lucky, the ⟦2⟧ will capitulate right before the Germans capitulate to you). Then, kick the Italians and conquer them, and after forming the Imperial Federation, you can form the European Federation. At this point, it should be trivial to conquer the rest of the world (you can also just join the Japanese faction if you annex ⟦3⟧ before they get the chance to ally them, thus eliminating the need to conquer them).
1eeq0j4.zh: 等到德国深陷⟦0⟧之后，再对它们宣战——你宣战时德国人越接近迫使⟦1⟧投降越好（如果你运气极好，⟦2⟧会在德国向你投降之前就投降）。然后踢掉意大利人并征服他们，在组建帝国联邦之后，你就可以组建欧洲联邦。至此，征服世界其余部分应当是轻而易举的（如果你在⟦3⟧有机会与他们结盟之前就吞并了它们，你也可以直接加入日本阵营，从而免去征服它们的必要）。

1n4vlfq.en: You can also alternatively start as a nation that has no puppets, turn fascist and just conquer and annex every other nation present.
1n4vlfq.zh: 你也可以换一种做法：从一个没有傀儡国的国家开始，转法西斯，然后直接征服并吞并所有其他国家。

a8muyl.en: Avoid accepting anyone into your faction who is not fascist, as you can't go to war with them later to change their ideology.
a8muyl.zh: 避免接纳任何非法西斯国家加入你的阵营，因为你之后无法对它们开战来改变其意识形态。

smq5na.en: Puppets may only change ideology via 'Paramilitary Training' Decisions or war.
smq5na.zh: 傀儡国只能通过「准军事训练」决议或战争来改变意识形态。

n0yexp.en: Neutral nations forced into your faction might create neutral puppets.
n0yexp.zh: 被强行拉入你阵营的中立国家可能会产生中立的傀儡国。

1dmir53.en: This Achievement requires turning all countries in the world fascist.
1dmir53.zh: 该成就要求把世界上所有国家都转为法西斯。

1rx3f3x.en: Some things to keep in mind for this achievement:
1rx3f3x.zh: 做这个成就时需要记住的几点：

91w3at.en: Take the focus Swedish Volunteer Corps. Once you have the bus and WW2 kicks off, move the bus around the Stockholm area before offering it as a volunteer to ⟦0⟧. However, There's a monthly check which verifies that the bus still exist. If you happen to have the bus in transit during this time, the spirit representing the bus will be removed and an event will fire, killing your leader. If that happens, you can no longer get the achievement. Therefore, make sure to send the bus just after the month ticks. Once it arrives, enable "strategic redeployment" on the army (the railway icon visible when selecting an army) to force it to use railways. Then move the division to Cape Town.
91w3at.zh: 选取国策「瑞典志愿军团」。一旦你有了那辆巴士且二战开打，就在斯德哥尔摩一带移动巴士，然后再把它作为志愿部队提供给⟦0⟧。不过，每月都有一次检查，用于确认巴士仍然存在。如果你恰好在此时让巴士处于运输途中，代表巴士的国家精神会被移除并触发一个事件，杀死你的领袖。如果发生这种情况，你就再也拿不到这个成就了。因此，务必在每月结算刚过之后派出巴士。它一抵达，就在该集团军上启用「战略再部署」（选择集团军时可见的铁路图标）以强制它使用铁路。然后把该师移动到开普敦。

1kkcyd0.en: When WW2 starts and world tension reaches 100% after the fall of ⟦0⟧ join the allies. Either help them to defeat the Axis or wait for the war to end on its own. The majority of playthroughs should end with an Allied victory anyways. Assisting in ending the war quickly will prevent the Soviets gaining too much war score, though. You must have the unit ⟦1⟧ from the focus Per Albin Hansson Bus, this achievement will not work with any other unit.
1kkcyd0.zh: 当二战开始、且在⟦0⟧沦陷后世界紧张度达到 100% 时，加入盟国。要么帮他们击败轴心国，要么等战争自行结束。大多数游戏局最终都会以盟国胜利收场。不过，协助迅速结束战争可以防止苏联获得过多战争贡献。你必须拥有来自国策「佩尔·阿尔宾·汉森巴士」的单位⟦1⟧，这个成就用任何其他单位都不行。

1m10qor.en: Start from the airport in Södermanland, you don't need to start in Stockholm itself. Assign the bus to the drop order and execute it. From here you should go speed 3 at maximum and assign the bus to each consecutive drop order, jumping from airport to airport. Small gaps when you're forced to drop next to an airport instead of directly onto it are no problem as you'll have plenty of time.
1m10qor.zh: 从南曼兰的机场出发，你不需要从斯德哥尔摩本身开始。把巴士分配到空投命令并执行它。此后你应该最多以 3 倍速度进行，并把巴士分配到每一个连续的空投命令，从一个机场跳到下一个机场。当你被迫降落在机场旁边而不是正落在机场上时，出现的小段间隙没有问题，因为你的时间会非常充裕。

i5ja54.en: After or even during the war build airports with only 200 capacity along the entire way. Europe won't require many new ones, but Africa does. Depending on which airports you have and intend to use you'll need ~16 airwings of 50 transports each on all the airports you want to drop from. Reusing the airwings doesn't work as they'll take longer than the paradrop itself.
i5ja54.zh: 在战后、甚至战争期间，沿整条路线建造容量只有 200 的机场。欧洲不需要新建太多，但非洲需要。取决于你拥有并打算使用哪些机场，你需要在你想要空投的所有机场上各配备约 16 个航空队、每队 50 架运输机。重复使用航空队是行不通的，因为它们耗时会长于空投本身。

1ns6s08.en: Once you reach the Cape state the achievement will fire. You might have to move to another tile or just wait some in-game hours for it to happen. Going to Cape town itself also isn't necessary. The entire way can be done in ~7 days.
1ns6s08.zh: 一旦你抵达开普州，成就就会触发。你可能需要移动到另一个格子上，或者只是在游戏内等上几个小时才会发生。也不必前往开普敦本身。整条路线大约可以在 7 天内完成。

6n9dsd.en: Play the game (historical) focused on civilian economy especially getting the ⟦0⟧ spirit removed. Afterwards focus on military factories and equipment for divisions you find suitable for fighting the Axis.
6n9dsd.zh: 以历史模式进行游戏，重点放在民用经济上，尤其是设法移除⟦0⟧国家精神。之后专注于军用工厂，以及为你认为适合对轴心国作战的师生产装备。

n38dc2.en: The Yalta conference will ensure your land bridge from ⟦0⟧ over ( ⟦1⟧; not necessary though) Germany, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ to Egypt. From there the ⟦4⟧ owns all the required territory anyways.
n38dc2.zh: 雅尔塔会议将确保你从⟦0⟧经（⟦1⟧；不过并非必需）德国、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧到埃及的陆桥。从那里起，⟦4⟧本来就拥有全部所需领土。

1decw43.en: From version 1.13.5 (beta patch) it is finally possible to get this achievement.
1decw43.zh: 从 1.13.5 版本（测试版补丁）开始，终于有可能获得这个成就了。

1c3p2cg.en: After you defeat and annex ⟦0⟧, release most of the land you occupy, otherwise you will get manpower issues. Personally, I would keep the mainland Europe ⟦1⟧ cores because you can core part of it yourself with the last focus of the ⟦2⟧ Path.
1c3p2cg.zh: 在你击败并吞并⟦0⟧之后，释放你占领的大部分土地，否则你会遇到人力问题。就我个人而言，我会保留欧洲大陆的⟦1⟧核心，因为你可以用⟦2⟧路线的最后一个国策把其中一部分设为自己的核心。

17k8pqq.en: Once most of ⟦0⟧ is liberated and ⟦1⟧ has largely fallen simply leave the Axis and justify on Germany. A fast way is to choose Voralberg, as it's a core of ⟦2⟧ and therefore you only need 15 days before you can declare war.
17k8pqq.zh: 一旦⟦0⟧大部分被解放、且⟦1⟧大体上已经沦陷，直接退出轴心国并对德国制造战争目标。一个快速的办法是选择福拉尔贝格，因为它是⟦2⟧的核心，因此你只需要 15 天就能宣战。

156pg4o.en: Follow the focus tree to fortify against Germany and ⟦0⟧, then Frontier Defense Plan. After that you can take the All Adults Training and Pro Helvetia paths. Focus on defense and forts.
156pg4o.zh: 沿着国策树构筑针对德国与⟦0⟧的防御工事，然后是「边境防御计划」。之后你可以走「全体成人训练」与「为了赫尔维蒂亚」路线。专注于防御与要塞。

zmhadn.en: This method could take some tries if Germany doesn’t goes to civil war or when the ⟦0⟧ capitulates before they can declare war on you, in this case just restart the game and try again.
zmhadn.zh: 如果德国没有走向内战，或者⟦0⟧在能够对你宣战之前就投降了，这个方法可能需要试几次；这种情况下只需重启游戏再试一次。

1nrmzdh.en: Let Germany get to -85 opinion so they get the war goal against you. While this is happening, you can get guarantees from ⟦0⟧ and Britain through the decision menu.
1nrmzdh.zh: 让德国把对你的好感降到 -85，这样他们就会获得对你的战争目标。在此期间，你可以通过决议菜单从⟦0⟧和英国获得保障。

1rmd0bz.en: Simply start your game without historical focuses on, take your first focus and look if Germany takes its Oppose Hitler focus. If not, restart until they do.
1rmd0bz.zh: 干脆在关闭历史国策的情况下开始游戏，选取你的第一个国策，看看德国是否选取其「反对希特勒」国策。如果没有，就重启直到他们选取为止。

pawpeo.en: You can help the German Military Junta to win the war or just sit it out if you want, you should get the achievement as soon as the civil war ends.
pawpeo.zh: 你可以帮助德国军事军政府赢得战争，或者如果你想，就坐着不管；内战一结束你就应该能拿到成就。

htywoe.en: Once you've declared war simply hold your cores and help with defeating the Axis powers. You may even get (temporarily) invited to the Allies.
htywoe.zh: 一旦你宣战，只需守住你的核心并协助击败轴心国。你甚至可能（临时）被邀请加入盟国。

ohlpw0.en: Just do the focus to unlock the decisions to denounce the ⟦0⟧ (the ⟦1⟧ one) and take this decision until they get the war goal on you.
ohlpw0.zh: 只要执行那个解锁谴责⟦0⟧决议的国策（即⟦1⟧那个），并反复执行该决议，直到他们获得对你的战争目标。

e0ha58.en: In 1938 Germany will declare war and drag the Allies in even before they declare on ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. Join them. Allies win by '41/'42.
e0ha58.zh: 1938 年德国会宣战，并在他们向⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧宣战之前就把盟国拖进来。加入盟国。盟国会在 41/42 年获胜。

1wrqion.en: Note: Make sure you have some units on the border with ⟦0⟧ so Germany doesn't sneak part of the East Swiss Alps when they annex.
1wrqion.zh: 注意：确保你在与⟦0⟧的边境上部署一些部队，以免德国在吞并时偷偷拿走东瑞士阿尔卑斯的一部分。

15y2xod.en: In some versions/patches, this achievement can also be achieved if you win an offensive war without losing any core territory.
15y2xod.zh: 在某些版本/补丁中，如果你在不丢失任何核心领土的情况下赢得一场进攻性战争，也能获得这个成就。

kk1xbb.en: Increase your army up to 48 mountaineers / regular divisions and just wait until the Allies are landing in ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
kk1xbb.zh: 把军队扩充到 48 个山地兵/常规师，然后只等盟国在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧登陆。

1th8au3.en: Simply follow the Swiss Cheese or and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton! achievement strategy from this wiki.
1th8au3.zh: 只需照搬本 wiki 上「瑞士奶酪」或「你得到一个州，每个人都得到一个州！」成就的策略。

1bmiclb.en: When they declare war on you then you basically can’t fail anymore because they shouldn’t be able to reach you.
1bmiclb.zh: 当他们向你宣战时，你基本上就不可能失败了，因为他们应该无法抵达你。

1eu5p95.en: An easy and fast way to do this achievement is to go ahistorical and participate in the German Civil War.
1eu5p95.zh: 做这个成就的一个简单快捷的方式是走非历史路线并参与德国内战。

1frhysj.en: As ⟦0⟧ win a defensive war without ever losing Western Swiss Alps, Eastern Swiss Alps or Ticino.
1frhysj.zh: 以⟦0⟧在不丢失西瑞士阿尔卑斯、东瑞士阿尔卑斯或提契诺的情况下赢得一场防御性战争。

69np7h.en: Once ⟦0⟧ is conquered, you will be able to bypass ⟦1⟧. Move all your armies towards the West - prepare to invade the Benelux and ⟦2⟧. You should have 5 cavalry armies, 24 infantry divisions and some tank divisions (you may convert Austrian units to tank divisions as well). Once Around Maginot is complete, declare war on the Benelux nations. At this point, ⟦3⟧ and the ⟦4⟧ should have been called into the war, and you can simply battleplan your way to ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧. This will cause ⟦7⟧ to capitulate, at which point you will earn the achievement.
69np7h.zh: 一旦⟦0⟧被征服，你就能跳过⟦1⟧。把你所有集团军调往西线——准备入侵比荷卢与⟦2⟧。你应当拥有 5 个骑兵集团军、24 个步兵师以及一些坦克师（你也可以把奥地利部队改编为坦克师）。一旦「绕过马奇诺」完成，就对比荷卢诸国宣战。此时，⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧应当已被拉入战争，你只需用作战计划一路推进到⟦5⟧⟦6⟧。这会导致⟦7⟧投降，届时你就会获得该成就。

bvq47u.en: With your first 50 ⟦0⟧, justify a war on ⟦1⟧. Convert all your starting non-infantry to tanks and start spam training one full army group of cavalry divisions (120 divisions). Put your armies on the Polish border and wait for your justification to complete. This is your time to go for all the recommended focuses above.
bvq47u.zh: 用你最初的 50⟦0⟧对⟦1⟧制造战争目标。把你开局所有非步兵部队改编为坦克，并开始疯狂训练一整个集团军群的骑兵师（120 个师）。把集团军部署在波兰边境，等待你的战争目标完成。这段时间正是你去拿上述所有推荐国策的时机。

1i13obl.en: When your justification is complete, crush ⟦0⟧. Once you are at war, you will be able to bypass ⟦1⟧ at which point you can start going for the diplomatic focuses - towards ⟦2⟧. At the peace conference, try to annex all of ⟦3⟧ but if you want to reduce occupation costs, you can puppet Ukraine and Belarus. ⟦4⟧
1i13obl.zh: 当你的战争目标完成时，碾碎⟦0⟧。一旦进入战争，你就能跳过⟦1⟧，此时你可以开始走外交国策——迈向⟦2⟧。在和平会议上，尽量吞并⟦3⟧全境，但如果你想降低占领成本，可以傀儡化乌克兰与白俄罗斯。⟦4⟧

1eko4h5.en: After completing this achievement, it is easy to go for Operation Sealion, ⟦0⟧ and potentially ⟦1⟧ as well. If you don't declare war on ⟦2⟧ directly but end up at war with them due to their guarantee of ⟦3⟧, and you win the war, you will earn Why Die for Danzig? as well.
1eko4h5.zh: 完成这个成就之后，就很容易接着去做「海狮行动」、⟦0⟧，也可能包括⟦1⟧。如果你不直接对⟦2⟧宣战，而是因为它们对⟦3⟧的保障而最终与它们开战，并且你赢得了战争，你还会同时获得「为什么为但泽而死？」。

n9fvs0.en: Go for focuses that build up your army and industry first. Do ⟦0⟧ complete ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ as they will be bypassed later. The exact order and path of the focuses are left to the player's competence, however the following focuses are recommended:
n9fvs0.zh: 优先选取能建设你军队与工业的国策。要⟦0⟧完成⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧，因为它们稍后会被跳过。这些国策的确切顺序与路线取决于玩家的水平，不过推荐以下国策：

v3qn2.en: Hiring military experts first is recommended. The choices are also left to the player, but the following advisors are recommended:
v3qn2.zh: 建议优先聘用军事专家。选择同样取决于玩家，不过推荐以下顾问：

i2fg1o.en: Remember that you ⟦0⟧ have a Polish puppet or this achievement will not fire.
i2fg1o.zh: 请记住你⟦0⟧拥有一个波兰傀儡国，否则这个成就是不会触发的。

1k2tt40.en: As Germany have both Poland and France surrender before January 1st 1940.
1k2tt40.zh: 作为德国，让波兰与法国都在 1940 年 1 月 1 日之前投降。

5m0qck.en: The following strategy requires Götterdämmerung to be enabled.
5m0qck.zh: 以下策略需要启用《诸神黄昏》。

pq5r6u.en: Depending on how you released it, you would either have the hypothetical borders of Pashtunistan, or already have all of Afghanistan. No matter if you chose the former or the latter, the main goal as Emirate of Pashtunistan would be to reclaim its old borders to unite the Pashto under an Emirate state. To give this console releasable nation a challenge, add core to North Baluchistan, and work on the focus tree to make a possibility to unite with that core, but... go in a lengthy war with the Allies.
pq5r6u.zh: 取决于你如何释放它，你要么拥有普什图尼斯坦的假想边界，要么已经拥有整个阿富汗。无论你选择前者还是后者，作为普什图尼斯坦酋长国的主要目标都是收复其旧有边界，把普什图人统一在一个酋长国之下。为了给这个可用控制台释放的国家增加挑战，把北俾路支斯坦设为核心，并在国策树上做工作以创造与该核心统一的可能性，但……要陷入一场与盟国的漫长战争。

3zqwoa.en: Pashtunistan is a historical region in South Asia where it compromises mostly of Pashtun peoples as this country represents the idea of them having their own nation state. Furthermore, for years the Pashtuns have been divided by Pakistan and ⟦0⟧, even being the major ethnic group for the latter. During the partition of India, there were plans for ⟦1⟧ to unite with the North-west Frontier, however that never came to be as it became part of Pakistan.
3zqwoa.zh: 普什图尼斯坦是南亚的一个历史地区，主要由普什图人构成，因为这个国家代表着他们拥有自己民族国家的理念。此外，多年来普什图人被巴基斯坦与⟦0⟧分隔，后者之中他们甚至是主要族群。在印度分治期间，曾有让⟦1⟧与西北边境合并的计划，然而这从未实现，因为该地成为了巴基斯坦的一部分。

14jj5mt.en: In order to play as early as Emirate of Pashtunistan, you would have to spawn it via console commands with either manually adding cores to release it with its tag ⟦0⟧, have it own states by manually doing the setowner PSH command then tag PSH to switch, or by annexing any country to Emirate of Pashtunistan with the command annex AFG PSH to annex Afghanistan, even including North Baluchistan.
14jj5mt.zh: 为了尽早以普什图尼斯坦酋长国游玩，你必须通过控制台指令把它生成出来：要么手动添加核心并用其标签⟦0⟧释放它，要么手动执行 setowner PSH 指令让它拥有州、再执行 tag PSH 切换过去，或者用 annex AFG PSH 指令把任何国家吞并到普什图尼斯坦酋长国名下以吞并阿富汗，甚至包括北俾路支斯坦。

dl6rl8.en: Pashtunistan starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
dl6rl8.zh: 普什图尼斯坦开局有 2 个科研槽，不过它可以透过通用国策树再获得最多 3 个额外科研槽。作为一个可释放国家，它被释放时会继承释放国已经研究过的所有科技。

168a881.en: Emirate of Pashtunistan, despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands.
168a881.zh: 普什图尼斯坦酋长国虽然在游戏中是一个「国家」，但按铁人模式的选择它是不可游玩的，所以玩家只能通过使用控制台指令来受益于游玩该国。

1be2e0e.en: Not to be confused with the formable Pashtunistan which can be formed by the Kingdom of Afghanistan when it goes down the Unite Pashtunistan or Declare a Republic paths.
1be2e0e.zh: 不要与可成立的普什图尼斯坦混淆，后者可由阿富汗王国在走「统一普什图尼斯坦」或「宣告共和国」路线时成立。

15lhbwn.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country that cannot appear in-game as it has no core states and cannot gain any.
15lhbwn.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个可释放国家，但它无法在游戏中出现，因为它没有任何核心州，也无法获得核心州。

1ai4dpa.en: Pashtunistan, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
1ai4dpa.zh: 普什图尼斯坦没有独特的国策树，因此改用通用国策树。

1fw1aqp.en: When released, Pashtunistan will be a ⟦0⟧ nation with no elections.
1fw1aqp.zh: 被释放时，普什图尼斯坦将是一个⟦0⟧国家，且没有选举。

8bu2we.en: The ⟦0⟧ does not have any unique cosmetic names for its equipment.
8bu2we.zh: ⟦0⟧没有任何独特的装备外观名称。

1s8491m.en: Uniting with the North-West Frontier Province (NWFP)

1vp0vbe.en: Pashtunistan has the following political parties:
1vp0vbe.zh: 普什图尼斯坦拥有以下政党：

msk0ml.en: Overview of the Emirate of Pashtunistan nation
msk0ml.zh: 普什图尼斯坦酋长国概况

dsxxpt.zh: 普什图尼斯坦工人共和国

1k5h2s5.zh: 普什图尼斯坦伊斯兰国

qpphd7.en: The number of resources in this list is the total base amount from each state each country owns. Rubber gained from synthetic refineries are also included. These numbers are then increased due to infrastructure levels, supply hubs and Compliance level, hence why the in-game values seen in the Trade interface may differ from those in this list, even at the start of the game.
qpphd7.zh: 此列表中的资源数量是每个国家所拥有的各州基础数量总和。来自合成炼油厂的橡胶也计入其中。这些数值随后会因基础设施等级、补给枢纽与顺从度等级而提高，因此在贸易界面中看到的游戏内数值可能与本列表不同，即使是在游戏开局时也是如此。

1nweo6p.en: Countries are the acting entities of Hearts of Iron IV. Each is controlled by a player or by AI and pursues its own national focus tree during a game as well as choosing various political ⟦0⟧, engaging in ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and the command of its military ⟦5⟧. There are 344 countries (not including ⟦6⟧) in the game, 99 of which appear at the 1936 start.
1nweo6p.zh: 国家是《钢铁雄心 4》中的行为主体。每一个都由玩家或 AI 控制，在游戏中推进自己的国策树，并选择各种政治⟦0⟧、参与⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧，以及对其军事⟦5⟧的指挥。游戏中共有 344 个国家（不含⟦6⟧），其中 99 个出现在 1936 年开局。

i3xlon.en: The number of military/civilian factories and dockyards in this list are the amount which each country actually owns. The number of available factories/dockyards may be different depending on the Compliance level in non-core states, certain State Modifiers, or if the country is an overlord or a ⟦0⟧, hence why they may differ from the in-game numbers.
i3xlon.zh: 此列表中的军用/民用工厂与船坞数量是每个国家实际拥有的数量。可用工厂/船坞数量可能会有所不同，取决于非核心州的顺从度等级、某些州修正，或该国是否为宗主国或⟦0⟧，因此它们可能与游戏内数值不同。

1bqatet.en: Releasable countries are countries that do not exist as independent nations at game start. They can be released by countries who own their core territory through the ⟦0⟧ screen, through certain national focuses, ⟦1⟧, or decisions, or forced to do so by a victorious power in a ⟦2⟧. They can also exist at game start through various game rules.
1bqatet.zh: 可释放国家是指在游戏开局时并不作为独立国家存在的国家。它们可以由拥有其核心领土的国家通过⟦0⟧界面、某些国策、⟦1⟧或决议来释放，或在⟦2⟧中由获胜的列强强制释放。它们也可以通过各种游戏规则在开局时存在。

1q6j9jn.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a three-letter code for a country that doesn't vary with localization or with changes in ideology, unlike a name (GER is always the same country, even though it's called the ⟦1⟧ when fascist and Germany when democratic). ⟦2⟧ require referring to countries by tag, and they're sometimes also used as fan jargon.
1q6j9jn.zh: ⟦0⟧是国家的三字母代码，它不会因本地化或意识形态变化而改变，这一点与国名不同（GER 永远是同一个国家，即使它在法西斯时被称为⟦1⟧，在民主时被称为德国）。⟦2⟧要求以标签指代国家，它们有时也被用作玩家圈子的行话。

1w83s6y.en: Becoming eligible for various decisions, most notably the decisions associated with hosting ⟦0⟧ and, with ⟦1⟧, the Diversify Elite Forces decision
1w83s6y.zh: 取得各种决议的资格，其中最值得注意的是与主办⟦0⟧相关的决议，以及在启用⟦1⟧时的「精英部队多元化」决议

152dbat.en: During peace conferences, can receive various cost discounts to certain demands and apply cost penalties to non-major pursuing certain demands
152dbat.zh: 在和平会议期间，可以对某些要求获得各种成本折扣，并对追求某些要求的非主要国家施加成本惩罚

mwgrjf.en: With La Résistance, ⟦0⟧ starts with state modifiers on ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, reducing the number of available building slots.
mwgrjf.zh: 启用《抵抗运动》后，⟦0⟧在⟦1⟧⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧⟦6⟧上开局即带有州修正，减少可用建筑槽位数量。

1m5vjfh.en: The game starts by granting all ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ to both the ⟦2⟧ and the ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧ can cancel these oil grants via Nationalize the Oil Fields.
1m5vjfh.zh: 游戏开局时把全部⟦0⟧⟦1⟧授予⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧双方。⟦4⟧可以通过「石油田国有化」取消这些石油授予。

147bzdn.en: Available building slots reduced due to state modifier .⟦0⟧ Without ⟦1⟧, Turkey starts with cores on its Kurdish states.
147bzdn.zh: 因州修正导致可用建筑槽位减少。⟦0⟧若不启用⟦1⟧，土耳其开局即拥有其库尔德各州的核心。

17g1lao.en: ⟦0⟧ (and Aussa) starts with state modifiers on all owned states, which reduce the number of available building slots.
17g1lao.zh: ⟦0⟧（以及奥萨）在所有拥有的州上开局即带有州修正，会减少可用建筑槽位数量。

1rwsdd9.en: Without ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧ gets cores on all states except those of Manipur and Pakistan (not including ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧).
1rwsdd9.zh: 若不启用⟦0⟧，⟦1⟧会获得除曼尼普尔与巴基斯坦各州之外所有州的核心（不含⟦2⟧⟦3⟧）。

37d6es.en: With Götterdämmerung, ⟦0⟧ loses direct ownership of Congo, which is instead owned by its puppet state ⟦1⟧.
37d6es.zh: 启用《诸神黄昏》后，⟦0⟧失去对刚果的直接所有权，改由其傀儡国⟦1⟧拥有。

1enkqaw.en: Becoming eligible as targets for certain events and other countries' ⟦0⟧, usually to their benefit
1enkqaw.zh: 成为某些事件以及其他国家⟦0⟧的目标，通常对它们有利

1t24i97.en: Xibei San Ma, and also starts with the states of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧.
1t24i97.zh: 西北三马，并且还会开局拥有⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧⟦5⟧各州。

1y7a9q6.en: With La Résistance, are much harder to target with coup ⟦0⟧
1y7a9q6.zh: 启用《抵抗运动》后，被政变⟦0⟧锁定的难度大得多

4vqhq7.en: Starts with 3 research slots without La Résistance.
4vqhq7.zh: 未启用《抵抗运动》时开局拥有 3 个科研槽。

1md3iv2.zh: 未启用《诸神黄昏》时开局拥有刚果。⟦0⟧

1oh38ct.en: Without ⟦0⟧, it starts as Xibei San Ma.⟦1⟧
1oh38ct.zh: 若不启用⟦0⟧，它开局为西北三马。⟦1⟧

1lt40x4.en: In 1921, the Tuvan People's Revolutionary Party, backed by the Red Army, took control of Tuva, installing Mongush Nimachap and Mongush Buyan-Badyrgy as leaders of the newly formed Tuvan People's Republic. In 1925, former monk Donduk Kuular became Prime Minister of ⟦0⟧, improving relations with Mongolia and declaring Buddhism the state religion. In 1929, after four years in power, Joseph Stalin orchestrated a coup by sending Tuvan youths to depose Kuular and bring ⟦1⟧ into closer alignment with the ⟦2⟧. Several short-lived leaders followed until Salchak Toka assumed control in 1932. Toka suppressed religion in Tuva and initiated rapid modernization, including the industrialization of the urban center of Kyzyl.
1lt40x4.zh: 1921 年，在红军支持下，图瓦人民革命党控制了图瓦，推举蒙古什·尼马查普与蒙古什·布扬-巴德尔格为新成立的图瓦人民共和国的领导人。1925 年，前僧侣栋杜克·库乌拉尔成为⟦0⟧的总理，改善了与蒙古的关系，并宣布佛教为国教。1929 年，在掌权四年之后，约瑟夫·斯大林策划了一场政变，派出图瓦青年推翻库乌拉尔，使⟦1⟧更紧密地向⟦2⟧靠拢。此后又经历了几位短命的领导人，直到 1932 年萨尔查克·托卡掌权。托卡在图瓦压制宗教，并启动了快速现代化，包括把城市中心克孜勒工业化。

f6nfow.en: One should start by attacking ⟦0⟧ since it is the weakest of the warlords that Tannu Tuva is able to attack. After peacing out with them, by either annexing or puppeting, it is recommended that the player attacks Xibei San Ma as ⟦1⟧ is better defended. Take out as many warlords as possible until the Marco Polo Bridge incident occurs and Japan and the United Front are at all-out war. It is suggested then that the player attacks alongside ⟦2⟧, calling the Soviets, as previously stated, Tannu Tuva's communist allies won't take land away or make puppets, this includes ⟦3⟧ too. Use the tactic 'Shadow Puppeting⟦4⟧FeedBackGaming⟦5⟧
f6nfow.zh: 应当先从进攻⟦0⟧开始，因为它是图瓦能够进攻的军阀中最弱的一个。在与之达成和平（无论是吞并还是傀儡化）之后，建议玩家转而去打西北三马，因为⟦1⟧的防御更好。尽可能多地消灭军阀，直到卢沟桥事变发生、日本与统一战线全面开战。此时建议玩家与⟦2⟧一同进攻，并召唤苏联；如前所述，图瓦的共产主义盟友不会抢走土地或制造傀儡，这也包括⟦3⟧。使用「影子傀儡化」这一战术⟦4⟧FeedBackGaming⟦5⟧

1ibkp4j.en: In December 1911, after ⟦0⟧ declared independence, the Qing vassal state of Tannu Uriankhai became the independent Uriankhay Republic. The new republic was unstable, as many Tuvans preferred joining ⟦1⟧ over remaining independent. Fearing Chinese occupation, ⟦2⟧ joined Russia as an autonomous Protectorate in April of 1914. In 1918, chaos erupted as ⟦3⟧ invaded during the outbreak of the Russian Civil War. Between 1918 and 1921, Tuva became a warzone contested by the ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧.
1ibkp4j.zh: 1911 年 12 月，在⟦0⟧宣告独立之后，清朝的藩属唐努乌梁海成为独立的乌梁海共和国。这个新共和国并不稳定，因为许多图瓦人更愿意加入⟦1⟧而不是保持独立。由于担心中国占领，⟦2⟧于 1914 年 4 月作为自治保护国加入俄国。1918 年，随着俄国内战爆发、⟦3⟧入侵，混乱随之爆发。1918 年至 1921 年间，图瓦成为⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧争夺的战区。

wcbrz4.en: A good strategy for Tannu Tuva is to exploit the ⟦0⟧ for military help in China. Since they generally don't have any interest in the area, should the player beat Japan to it, they can gain huge amounts of manpower, even by taking out only the warlords.
wcbrz4.zh: 对图瓦来说，一个好策略是利用⟦0⟧在中国获取军事援助。由于它们通常对该地区没有任何兴趣，只要玩家抢在日本之前动手，即使只是消灭各军阀，也能获得大量人力。

1knu3tr.en: on Youtube, in which you puppet China with the cheapest province, preventing ⟦0⟧ from creating Reorganized Nationalist ⟦1⟧ making them uninterested in all of the Chinese provinces that do not border the sea.
1knu3tr.zh: 在 YouTube 上，用一个最廉价的省份傀儡化中国，从而阻止⟦0⟧建立重组国民⟦1⟧，使它们对所有不临海的中国省份都不感兴趣。

1f51m65.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in East Asia with a population of ⟦1⟧. It borders the ⟦2⟧ to the north, and ⟦3⟧ to the south. Its south is mostly mountainous and the north is forests and hills.
1f51m65.zh: ⟦0⟧是东亚的一个小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它北邻⟦2⟧，南接⟦3⟧。其南部多为山地，北部则是森林与丘陵。

109buok.en: ⟦0⟧ has a number of unique names for various technologies and equipment, listed here. Particularly Soviet armaments. Note that generic names are not listed.
109buok.zh: ⟦0⟧对各种科技与装备有许多独特的名称，列于此处。尤其是苏联军械。请注意通用名称不在此列。

c0k0x5.en: ⟦0⟧ is in the Comintern with the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. The ⟦3⟧ may ask for the annexation of Tannu Tuva via their focus.
c0k0x5.zh: ⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧同属共产国际。⟦3⟧可以通过其国策要求吞并图瓦。

1wz3cjp.en: ⟦0⟧ owns 1 state. Which shares a core with the ⟦1⟧
1wz3cjp.zh: ⟦0⟧拥有 1 个州。该州与⟦1⟧共享一个核心

7wdzzj.en: ⟦0⟧ does not have any national spirit.

15qur25.en: Communist Party of the Soviet Union

vkit6s.zh: 霍穆什库·楚尔古伊-奥勒

11h5txg.zh: V. I. 库利科夫斯基

1j26fvm.en: Each country has a predefined capital state, of which the capital province is the province with the most Victory Points in that state. The capital province also contains the ⟦0⟧. If the original capital city is occupied, the capital usually moves to the city with the next-highest number of Victory Points. Capitals are identified by a star , which can be ⟦1⟧ if it is the nation's capital, ⟦2⟧ if it is any other nation's capital, or ⟦3⟧ if it is the capital of any of the nation's enemies.
1j26fvm.zh: 每个国家都有一个预定的首都州，该州中胜利点最多的省份即为首都省份。首都省份还包含⟦0⟧。如果原首都城市被占领，首都通常会转移到胜利点数量次高的城市。首都会用星形标识，如果它是本国首都则为⟦1⟧，如果是其他任何国家的首都则为⟦2⟧，如果是本国任一敌国的首都则为⟦3⟧。

t96li8.en: Forts, Naval Forts, Naval Bases, Railways, and Supply Hubs are built at the province level. The attacker gets a malus of ⟦0⟧ per fort level being attacked. Naval Bases allow ships to repair if they dock there, as well as acting as a base for naval transports and naval invasions. Railways allow rapid movement of army divisions using strategic redeployment and allow connection of the capital to supply hubs. Supply hubs distribute supplies if connected to the capital.
t96li8.zh: 要塞、海军要塞、海军基地、铁路与补给枢纽都在省份层级建造。进攻方每攻击一级要塞就会承受⟦0⟧的惩罚。海军基地允许舰船在此停靠时进行维修，同时也可作为海军运输与海军登陆的基地。铁路允许陆军师通过战略再部署快速移动，并允许把首都与补给枢纽连接起来。补给枢纽在与首都连通时才会分发补给。

1k32ksw.en: Terrain is handled at the province level. Terrain modifies how long it takes to traverse a province, how much attrition units take there and the attack penalty based on terrain modifiers of the attacking party. Some unit types also get bonuses or penalties depending on terrain.
1k32ksw.zh: 地形在省份层级处理。地形会改变穿越一个省份所需的时间、部队在该地承受的损耗，以及基于进攻方所面对的地形修正而产生的攻击惩罚。某些单位类型也会因地形而获得加成或惩罚。

9yb353.en: Weather is partly handled at the province level. Provinces can get modifiers like snow or mud, that increase attrition and movement cost. Temperature is also logged at province level. A very high or very low temperature leads to attrition and other penalties.
9yb353.zh: 天气部分在省份层级处理。省份可以获得诸如积雪或泥泞之类的修正，它们会增加损耗与移动成本。温度也在省份层级记录。极高或极低的温度会导致损耗与其他惩罚。

1wjn6tx.en: Each city increases local state supply by ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, which allows pockets of enemies to be in supply even when cut off from the main supply route. This does not mean that these units get new equipment.
1wjn6tx.zh: 每座城市会为当地州补给增加⟦0⟧⟦1⟧，这使得被包围的敌军即使与主要补给线被切断也仍能获得补给。但这并不意味着这些部队能获得新装备。

1vveugq.en: When conditions are met, a nuclear strike can be ordered for a selected province. Nuking a province will heavily damage the state's infrastructure as well as all the units in the nuked province.
1vveugq.zh: 在满足条件时，可以对选定的省份下令发动核打击。对一个省份实施核打击会严重破坏该州的基础设施，以及被核打击省份内的所有部队。

1x69105.en: VP's follow the color scheme of capitals, that is, they can be ⟦0⟧ if they belong to the nation, ⟦1⟧ if they belong to any other nation, or ⟦2⟧ if they belong to any of the nation's enemies.
1x69105.zh: 胜利点遵循首都的配色方案，也就是说，如果它们属于本国则为⟦0⟧，属于其他任何国家则为⟦1⟧，属于本国任一敌国则为⟦2⟧。

1oz3v5y.en: The worth of a province (for example to determine capitulation) is ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. In other words, each province on its own (i.e. not counting the VPs on it) is worth 0.1 VP.
1oz3v5y.zh: 一个省份的价值（例如用于判定投降）为⟦0⟧⟦1⟧。换言之，每个省份自身（即不计其上的胜利点）价值 0.1 个胜利点。

wpevvx.en: Named cities have a varying number of Victory Points (VP) which are denoted by either a square , a pentagon , a circle , or a star depending on the value:
wpevvx.zh: 具名城市拥有不同数量的胜利点（VP），根据其数值用方形、五边形、圆形或星形表示：

yvts6c.en: Occupied cities raise the resistance target of the state they are in based on their total amount of Victory Points⟦0⟧:
yvts6c.zh: 被占领的城市会依据其胜利点总量提高所在州的抵抗目标⟦0⟧：

f0ku5r.zh: 查看省份 id 地图请见 Forum:1895208，省份汇总表格可在此处找到 Forum:1701801

1f0v1qc.en: ⟦0⟧ are the atomic geographic unit. ⟦1⟧ consist of a set of provinces.
1f0v1qc.zh: ⟦0⟧是基本的地理单位。⟦1⟧由一组省份构成。

um20nn.en: ⟦0⟧ Can be done in conjunction with the ⟦1⟧ achievement as Canada. After capitulating and annexing the ⟦2⟧, prepare a naval invasion force and fleet to attack the ⟦3⟧. Annexing the US may help industrially and the Send in the Zombies focus may help with the recruitable population. It may be necessary to justify against ⟦4⟧. Try to take the UK before Germany or ⟦5⟧ tries a naval invasion. If the peace conference triggers before the achievement does, try to annex all of Great Britain as the other Axis members may take the required territory. It may be advisable to create a faction with ⟦6⟧ instead of joining the Axis to make it harder for Germany to take British states in the peace conference. With ⟦7⟧ DLC and historical focus off, the UK has a chance of becoming fascist or non-aligned. In that case, a democratic Canada may form a faction with the ⟦8⟧.
um20nn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可作为加拿大与⟦1⟧成就一并完成。在迫使⟦2⟧投降并将其吞并之后，准备一支海军登陆部队与舰队去进攻⟦3⟧。吞并美国在工业上可能有帮助，而国策「派遣僵尸」可能有助于可征召人口。可能有必要对⟦4⟧制造战争目标。尽量在德国或⟦5⟧尝试海军登陆之前拿下英国。如果和平会议在成就触发之前就发生了，尽量吞并整个大不列颠，因为其他轴心国成员可能会拿走所需的领土。与⟦6⟧组建阵营而不是加入轴心国可能是明智之举，这样德国就更难在和平会议中拿走英国各州。启用⟦7⟧DLC 且关闭历史国策时，英国有概率转为法西斯或中立主义。那种情况下，民主的加拿大可以与⟦8⟧组建阵营。

nt00.en: Playing as Canada is the best and quickest option so pick Canada, train up 30 cavalry divisions and disband the rest of your army. The Focuses should simply be rushing down to Swastika Clubs then after that it doesn't matter until you become independent. When you get your first 150pp pick fascist demagogue, there is no rush though so don't waste political power until you get around 45% fascist to discredit government and become fascist. When fascist and independent pick support the blue shirts and if you're doing ‘It's 1812 All Over Again’ achievement now is the time you go down Support a Synarchist Baja but i would recommend doing them in separate runs.
nt00.zh: 以加拿大游玩是最好的、也是最快的选择，所以选加拿大，训练 30 个骑兵师并解散其余军队。国策应当直接速推到「卐字俱乐部」，之后再怎么走都无所谓，直到你独立为止。当你拿到最初的 150 政治点数时选法西斯煽动家，不过不必着急，所以在法西斯支持度达到约 45% 之前不要浪费政治点数，那时再用「抹黑政府」转为法西斯。在成为法西斯且独立后，选取「支持蓝衫军」；如果你现在要做「又是 1812 年」成就，那正是你去走「支持巴哈的锡纳基主义」的时候，不过我建议把这两件事分开在不同局里做。

jnwfxx.en: ⟦0⟧ Can be done as ⟦1⟧ and in conjunction with ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and the ⟦4⟧. Build 50 transport planes, research and train paratroopers and hire a fascist demagogue, turn fascist, spike world tension by justifying on the ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ to remove the Distance negative modifier (to join the Axis). Once you join the Axis, wait until ⟦8⟧ capitulates, join the war and paradrop into port cities in Southern England (if you don't have air supremacy don't use your planes and wait until the British stop using the planes over the English channel, then you can put the air force back). Then invade Britain from then on.
jnwfxx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可作为⟦1⟧完成，并与⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧及⟦4⟧一并达成。建造 50 架运输机，研究并训练伞兵，聘用一名法西斯煽动家，转为法西斯，通过对⟦5⟧、⟦6⟧与⟦7⟧制造战争目标来拉高世界紧张度，以消除「距离」负修正（以便加入轴心国）。一旦你加入轴心国，就等到⟦8⟧投降，参战并空降到英格兰南部的港口城市（如果你没有制空权，就不要动用飞机，等英国人停止在英吉利海峡上空使用飞机后，再把空军放回去）。此后即可入侵英国。

s013j8.en: After becoming independent send your 30 cavalry divisions to Britain to garrison the required states(⟦0⟧). Move your troops off victory points with British divisions in them, leave the allies when the troops arrive in the ⟦1⟧, justify a war goal on the ⟦2⟧ & any other minor nation that the ⟦3⟧ will guarantee, the baltic countries work great and when you successfully get only Britain to guarantee cancel justification on the ⟦4⟧.
s013j8.zh: 在独立之后，把你的 30 个骑兵师派往英国，驻守所需的州（⟦0⟧）。把部队从有英国师驻守的胜利点上移开，在部队抵达⟦1⟧后退出盟国，对⟦2⟧以及⟦3⟧会保障的任何其他小国制造战争目标；波罗的海国家效果很好；当你成功做到只有英国提供保障时，取消对⟦4⟧的战争目标。

n8g22m.en: Declare war on the country that Britain guaranteed in order to "Order 66" them. Move your cavalry divisions to victory points and attempt to breakthrough and flank the British garrison. Joining the axis is fine since when they capitulate you will gain control over all states anyway and it ties up more enemy divisions.
n8g22m.zh: 对英国所保障的那个国家宣战，以便对它们执行「66 号指令」。把你的骑兵师移动到胜利点，并尝试突破、包抄英国驻军。加入轴心国也没问题，因为它们投降时你无论如何都会获得所有州的控制权，而且这还能牵制更多敌军师。

1bmwaiv.en: This achievement requires ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, Canada, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ controlling all of ⟦5⟧'s starting cores except for Northern Ireland (119).
1bmwaiv.zh: 该成就要求⟦0⟧：⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、加拿大、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧控制⟦5⟧的全部起始核心，但北爱尔兰（119）除外。

o0i4ck.en: don't garrison Northern Ireland & victory points only
o0i4ck.zh: 不要驻守北爱尔兰，且只驻守胜利点

pflkc2.en: Weapons of the Third Emu War
pflkc2.zh: 第三次鸸鹋战争的武器

1fk7jdw.en: ⟦0⟧ replaces the existing ⟦1⟧ system of set, successive designs with an extensive modular system that allows players to create more highly customized individual ship classes. Each ship has a number of slots for modules depending on its hull type, located above and below its portrait in the ship design screen. The bottom-side slots are considered fundamental mountings for the class and are universal to them, though some such as AA or torpedoes need not be filled. For instance, all destroyers have bottom-side mountings for one battery gun, one AA mount, a fire control/sonar, a sonar/radar, a torpedo launcher, and an engine. All ships also are required to have certain mountings -- a destroyer, for instance, must have a battery and an engine, as otherwise it has no means to move or defend itself.
1fk7jdw.zh: ⟦0⟧用以取代⟦1⟧既有的「成套、逐级设计」体系，改为一套庞大的模块化系统，让玩家能够创建高度定制的单舰舰级。每艘舰船依据其船体类型拥有若干模块槽位，位于舰船设计界面中其立绘的上方与下方。下方的槽位被视为该舰级的基础挂载点，对所有同类舰级通用，不过其中一些（如防空或鱼雷）不必填满。例如，所有驱逐舰下方都有挂载点用于一门主炮、一个防空挂载点、一套火控/声呐、一套声呐/雷达、一具鱼雷发射器与一台发动机。所有舰船也必须配备某些挂载——例如驱逐舰必须有主炮与发动机，否则它将无法移动或自卫。

11766wl.en: However, the mountings above the portrait are additional slots for customizing the class, and contain no mandatory elements. These are divided into three sections for the ship -- front, middle, and rear, with up to two front and rear slots and three middles ones. As an example, the Early Destroyer only has one middle and one rear slot above-portrait, but the 1940 Destroyer has a middle, rear, and front.
11766wl.zh: 不过，立绘上方的挂载点是为定制该舰级而设的额外槽位，其中不含任何必填要素。它们分为前、中、后三个区段，前方与后方各最多两个槽位，中部最多三个。举例来说，早期驱逐舰在立绘上方只有一个中部与一个后部槽位，而 1940 年驱逐舰则有中部、后部与前方。

1s38h0g.en: Exactly what can go in the optional slots also changes from ship class to ship class. Cruisers and battleships can only mount main guns or AA in their front slots, but destroyers can mount depth charges in theirs (as the 1940 technology bracket also unlocks the Depth Charge Mortar). A wide variety of equipment exists that can produce highly specialized ships.
1s38h0g.zh: 可选槽位中究竟能装什么，也随舰级不同而变化。巡洋舰与战列舰的前方槽位只能安装主炮或防空，但驱逐舰可以在其前方槽位安装深水炸弹（因为 1940 年科技档位同时解锁了深水炸弹迫击炮）。游戏中存在种类繁多的装备，可以打造高度专业化的舰船。

rujv5x.en: Any nation, by taking the "Coastal Defense Fleet" Fleet doctrine
rujv5x.zh: 任何国家，通过选取「近海防御舰队」海军学说

t21lh9.en: For naval technology without ⟦0⟧, see the separate ⟦1⟧ page.
t21lh9.zh: 不含⟦0⟧的海军科技，请参见单独的⟦1⟧页面。

14zsirh.zh: 改进型水上飞机弹射器

1dhrhyi.en: Now the states you are missing are controlled by Italy and ⟦0⟧. No one should declare war on you, so you can sit it out for as long as you want to build up a large army. Attack Italy and Germany when their troops are deep in the Soviet Union. Turkey will be guaranteed by both Germany and the UK. To get around this, start a communist coup in them and join its war through decision but do NOT invite them into the faction. When the communists win you can justify on them and they will not be guaranteed.
1dhrhyi.zh: 现在你缺少的那些州由意大利与⟦0⟧控制。应该不会有人对你宣战，所以你可以一直坐等，想花多久建立一支庞大军队都行。当他们的部队深陷苏联时进攻意大利与德国。土耳其会同时受到德国与英国的保障。要绕过这一点，就在他们那里发动一场共产主义政变，并通过决议加入其战争，但不要邀请他们加入阵营。共产党获胜后你就可以对他们制造战争目标，而他们不会再受到保障。

1uiq5w2.en: Take the Balkan Federation of Socialist Republics focus to influence ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, ignore ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. Do not spend PP on ⟦4⟧. Once Greece and Romania are 20% communist you should be able to launch coups in both of them (if you need extra infantry equipment, delete your army. Note this is only possible if you have already refused the army restrictions). You might have to run propaganda missions to lower their stability.
1uiq5w2.zh: 选取国策「巴尔干社会主义共和国联邦」以影响⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧，忽略⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧。不要把政治点数花在⟦4⟧上。一旦希腊与罗马尼亚的共产主义支持度达到 20%，你就应该能在两国都发动政变（如果你需要额外的步兵装备，就解散你的军队。注意这只有在你已经拒绝了军队限制的情况下才可能做到）。你可能需要执行宣传任务来降低它们的稳定度。

xp5lsz.en: Once you are fighting the wars on the same side as the communists, they will accept invites to the faction. Once the civil wars are over, immediately take The Unification of the Balkans focus, from test runs this can consistently be done Jan-March 1939, annexing Greece, Yugoslavia and Romania. By delaying it roughly half a year, the couping, allying and, annexation of Albania should be well within possibility.
xp5lsz.zh: 一旦你与共产党在同一方作战，他们就会接受加入阵营的邀请。内战结束后，立即选取国策「巴尔干统一」，从测试来看这可以稳定地在 1939 年 1 至 3 月完成，从而吞并希腊、南斯拉夫与罗马尼亚。如果把它推迟大约半年，那么对阿尔巴尼亚的政变、结盟与吞并就完全在可能范围之内。

1pir9iy.en: At start immediately save 150 PP to get the communist revolutionary and completely avoid faction interactions until you turn ⟦0⟧. You will only need to integrate the Zveno and get broad socialist loyalty over 50. Don't spend PP negotiating for rearmament, refuse the restrictions once you form your faction. You should be able to take the focus The People's Republic of Bulgaria by December 1936.
1pir9iy.zh: 开局立即攒下 150 政治点数以获取共产主义革命者，并在转为⟦0⟧之前完全避免阵营互动。你只需要整合「兹韦诺」并把广泛的社会主义忠诚度提高到 50 以上。不要把政治点数花在重整军备的谈判上，在你组建阵营后要拒绝那些限制。你应该能在 1936 年 12 月前选取国策「保加利亚人民共和国」。

1gqbsxb.en: Set all of your military factories to produce infantry equipment and build more mils in all of your states (you need lots of guns for coups). Build a spy agency from the very start and make 5 improvements. With The People's Militia Directorate focus you can get 3 spies then you should increase this to 4 with an advisor.
1gqbsxb.zh: 把你所有军用工厂都设为生产步兵装备，并在你所有的州建造更多军用工厂（政变需要大量枪械）。从一开始就建立特工机构并完成 5 项改进。借助国策「人民民兵总局」你可以获得 3 名特工，之后再用一名顾问把它提高到 4 名。

1ai2dcd.en: Sign Non Aggression Pact with Italy so they don't declare for their Yugoslavian claims. If the ⟦0⟧ demand Bessarabia you can just deny it, the event only gives them a war goal against Romania (which now no longer exists) not the owner of the state. (as of 2025, this last statement is not true).
1ai2dcd.zh: 与意大利签订互不侵犯条约，这样他们就不会为对其南斯拉夫的宣称而宣战。如果⟦0⟧索要比萨拉比亚，你直接拒绝就行；该事件只会给他们一个针对罗马尼亚的战争目标（而罗马尼亚现在已不复存在），而不是针对该州的所有者。（截至 2025 年，最后这句话已不成立。）

1vk92r4.en: If you have time it is possible to coup Albania communist before ⟦0⟧ annexes them but your priority should be Greece and Yugo. (This method is much faster and more consistent than waiting for them to flip peacefully due to the possibility of bad RNG rolls).
1vk92r4.zh: 如果你有时间，可以在⟦0⟧吞并阿尔巴尼亚之前先在那发动共产主义政变，但你的优先目标应当是希腊与南斯拉夫。（这个方法比等待它们和平转向要快得多、也稳定得多，因为有可能出现不利的随机结果。）

1f2ryl2.en: Whilst the coups are underway/preparing take all focuses up to United, We Shall Prevail! do not take The Unification of the Balkans. After each individual coup launches, you can join the civil wars on the communist side and invite Yugoslavia to the wars.
1f2ryl2.zh: 在政变进行/筹备期间，取完直到「团结起来，我们必将胜利！」的全部国策，但不要取「巴尔干统一」。在每一场政变发动之后，你都可以加入共产主义一方参与内战，并邀请南斯拉夫加入这些战争。

12lylud.en: Whilst the achievement toolbox doesn't mention it, but you need the Turkish territories in Balkans for it to trigger.
12lylud.zh: 虽然成就提示里没有提到，但你需要巴尔干地区的土耳其领土才能触发它。

1gv96us.en: As Communist Bulgaria, form the United Balkan Federation and own all Balkan states as cores.
1gv96us.zh: 作为共产主义保加利亚，组建巴尔干联合联邦，并以核心拥有所有巴尔干州。

1vu4mjq.en: Refuse all calls to war from your allies. this is to make sure the Allies does not naval invade you. Make sure the main fighting divisions are at the Soviet Border. ⟦0⟧ will have capitulated and the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact will have taken effect. By around 1940, the ⟦1⟧ will ask you for Bessarabia. Refuse. This will force all the Axis to join a defensive war. Do not attack the Soviet Troops until they get weak. They will not be able to push through your border, However they might try to push through to ⟦2⟧. Build forts there if you want. The Germans may be able to push them back. Help Germany to invade the Soviets, but make sure that your coast and border is secure, since you cannot lose any states! Should you not reach Moscow before Germany, try to trade territory and ask for Moscow. Alternatively, take it in a peace deal.
1vu4mjq.zh: 拒绝盟友所有要求你参战的召唤。这样做是为了确保盟国不会对你发动海军登陆。务必让主力作战师部署在苏联边境。⟦0⟧届时已经投降，莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约也已生效。大约到 1940 年，⟦1⟧会向你索要比萨拉比亚。拒绝。这将迫使整个轴心国加入一场防御性战争。在苏军变弱之前不要进攻他们。他们无法突破你的边境，不过他们可能会试图冲向⟦2⟧。如果你愿意，可以在那里修筑要塞。德国人也许能把他们推回去。帮助德国入侵苏联，但务必确保你的海岸与边境安全，因为你不能丢掉任何一个州！如果你没能比德国先抵达莫斯科，就试着交换领土并索要莫斯科。或者，在和平协议中拿下它。

ngzzds.en: To defend against the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ needs to defend its border with ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ with land forts and coastal forts on the Black Sea. Save your political power and take Institute Royal Dictatorship and Revise the Constitution. Then, using the discount, pick the Silent Workhorse and switch to Partial Mobilization and increase the Conscription Law. King Carol II will lavishly spend state finances via events, decide if you want to spend political power or civilian factories. One strategy could be to save political power for the first 2 or 3 events, in order to spend it early and while you have a discount, and then save civilian factories. Focus on getting another Research slot and industrial focuses, following the Balkans Dominance branch.
ngzzds.zh: 为了防御⟦0⟧，⟦1⟧需要用陆地要塞保卫其与⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧的边境，并在黑海沿岸修筑海岸要塞。攒下你的政治点数，选取「建立皇家独裁」与「修订宪法」。然后利用折扣，选择「沉默的实干家」，并切换到部分动员并提高征兵法案。卡罗尔二世国王会通过事件大肆挥霍国家财政，你要决定是花政治点数还是民用工厂。一种策略是把前 2 到 3 个事件的政治点数攒下来，以便在有折扣时尽早花掉，之后再攒民用工厂。专注于获取另一个科研槽与工业国策，沿「巴尔干霸权」分支推进。

jm25ln.en: With 500k manpower, you can pick Divide Yugoslavia and try to gain as much influence as desired, in order to gain more puppets. It is possible to take Secure Greece if World Tension is low enough, but it is not necessary. Take Force Abdication if King Carol II is not needed for ⟦0⟧. With the focuses requiring manpower on the field completed, disband any unwanted cavalry divisions and train a proper army. Place troops on the entire Black Sea Coast, including in Bulgaria, perhaps by using the divisions from your puppets. The Soviets will most likely naval invade you. Take Appoint Pro-Axis Government and take the Fascist Demagogue. Join the Axis.
jm25ln.zh: 拥有 50 万人力后，你可以选取「瓜分南斯拉夫」，并尽可能多地获取影响力以得到更多傀儡国。如果世界紧张度足够低，也可以选取「确保希腊」，但并非必要。如果⟦0⟧不需要卡罗尔二世国王，就选取「强制退位」。完成那些要求战场上有人力的国策后，解散不需要的骑兵师并训练一支正规军队。把部队部署到整个黑海沿岸，包括保加利亚境内，或许可以使用你傀儡国的师。苏联很可能会对你发动海军登陆。选取「任命亲轴心政府」并聘用法西斯煽动家。加入轴心国。

zg5jb3.en: At the same time, recruit cavalry divisions on high priority and deploy them immediately until you have 400k manpower on the field. Take Align Hungary and Puppet Bulgaria to make them your puppet. Restart if they refuse, though they rarely do. If you later turn ⟦0⟧, Hungary and ⟦1⟧ will become ⟦2⟧ and you will gain a lot of factories. Try to reduce their autonomy by building in their territory if they are close to raise raising their autonomy level. Take the Fortify the Borders and construct land forts on the border with the ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧, and coastal forts on the Black Sea, including in Bulgaria.
zg5jb3.zh: 与此同时，以高优先级招募骑兵师并立即部署它们，直到你在战场上拥有 40 万人力。选取「结盟匈牙利」与「傀儡化保加利亚」使他们成为你的傀儡国。如果他们拒绝就重开游戏，不过他们很少拒绝。如果你之后转为⟦0⟧，匈牙利与⟦1⟧会变为⟦2⟧，你会获得大量工厂。如果他们接近提升自治度等级，就试着在他们的领土上建造以降低其自治度。选取「加固边境」，并在与⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧的边境上修建陆地要塞，在黑海沿岸（包括保加利亚境内）修建海岸要塞。

395eog.en: This ⟦0⟧ requires ⟦1⟧ to make it to 1942 and control the capital state of Germany or the ⟦2⟧ without losing any starting states.
395eog.zh: 这个⟦0⟧要求⟦1⟧撑到 1942 年，并在不丢失任何起始州的情况下控制德国的首都州或⟦2⟧。

1mfw00l.en: As Romania, make it to 1942 with all the states you started it with and control either Moscow or Berlin.
1mfw00l.zh: 作为罗马尼亚，带着开局时的所有州撑到 1942 年，并控制莫斯科或柏林。

h5tdmu.en: In newer versions of the game, the Axis will almost never make it past the Maginot Line into ⟦0⟧ without your participation (and ⟦1⟧ gets equally stuck on the southern front at the Alps). Because of this, you will probably have to declare first on the Axis and push into Germany and take Brandenburg. Then immediately (without pushing further because you do not want to destabilize the Axis any more than you already did), turn around with at least 2 out of your 5 armies (use the other 3 to maintain your lines - you may want to consolidate some, but do not interrupt the conflict between the Allies and Axis at the Maginot Line), and justify and declare on ⟦2⟧. They will not be prepared since you had a 10 day justification, and you can just rush down Ile de France before the Allies come down on you. It's best to try to do this as late as you can (mid-1943 is probably about as late as you can wait) and with several thousand 1940 fighters in addition to the 12 Inf/3 Arty army group described earlier in the strategy.
h5tdmu.zh: 在较新版本中，如果你不参与，轴心国几乎永远无法越过马奇诺防线进入⟦0⟧（而⟦1⟧在阿尔卑斯山的南线同样会卡住）。因此，你很可能必须先行对轴心国宣战，推进到德国并拿下勃兰登堡。然后立即（不要再继续推进，因为你不想让你已经造成的轴心国动荡进一步加剧）用你 5 个集团军中的至少 2 个掉头（用另外 3 个维持战线——你可能想合并其中一些，但不要打断盟国与轴心国在马奇诺防线的冲突），并对⟦2⟧制造战争目标后宣战。由于你只有 10 天的战争目标制造时间，他们会措手不及，你完全可以在盟国扑向你之前直取法兰西岛。最好尽可能晚做这件事（1943 年中期大概是最晚的时点），并且除了前面策略中所述的 12 步 3 炮集团军群之外，还要准备数千架 1940 年战斗机。

oegjb4.en: Continue focusing on building up industry and training a full army group. 12 Inf/3 Arty is good, even better with recon rangers, support artillery, and engineers. Since we're using Line Artillery, make sure to pick up the Land subdoctrine Fire Concentration and train your infantry until you trigger the second level mastery bonus that reduces their combat width by 0.8. Also upgrade your agency along the way.
oegjb4.zh: 继续专注于建设工业并训练一整个集团军群。12 步兵/3 炮兵不错，若加上侦察游骑兵、支援炮兵与工兵会更好。由于我们使用线列炮兵，务必选取陆上学说「火力集中」，并训练你的步兵，直到触发第二级精通加成，使其战斗宽度减少 0.8。同时沿途升级你的特工机构。

1c1w57f.en: Focus on building up your army and industry, but make sure you join the Axis before Germany takes Around Maginot, so that Germany doesn't gain a war goal on you. Don't join any wars! You can leave the Axis after around Maginot has completed.
1c1w57f.zh: 专注于建设你的军队与工业，但务必在德国拿下「绕过马奇诺」之前加入轴心国，以免德国获得对你的战争目标。不要加入任何战争！在「绕过马奇诺」完成后，你可以退出轴心国。

1b3w9z2.en: You will now wait a couple of years until the Axis is weakened. Best case scenario is that the Germans are held down in the east while the ⟦0⟧ are being naval invaded. However, make sure you invade the Axis before any Normandy landings!
1b3w9z2.zh: 现在你要等上几年，直到轴心国被削弱。最好的情况是德国人在东线被拖住，而⟦0⟧正被海军登陆。不过，务必在任何诺曼底登陆之前入侵轴心国！

1ix2vd4.en: First rush down to Repudiate Treaty With France to gain as much fascist support. Then, rush down to Abandon Neutrality. Get an agency when you can, and hire the financial expert so you get more available civs.
1ix2vd4.zh: 首先速推到「废除对法条约」以获取尽可能多的法西斯支持度。然后速推到「放弃中立」。在可以的时候建立一个特工机构，并聘用金融专家，这样你就能获得更多可用的民用工厂。

wrk6n0.en: ⟦0⟧ might declare on you later than 1941, but when they do, you can join the Chinese United Front and possibly join their war against Germany if they are at war with the Axis.
wrk6n0.zh: ⟦0⟧可能会在 1941 年之后才对你宣战，但当他们宣战时，你可以加入中国统一战线，并且如果他们正与轴心国交战，还可能加入他们对德国的战争。

1hk1n68.en: Once the focus completes, immediately justify on the ⟦0⟧. Annex the Netherlands and the East Indies. Make sure to set garrison to a cavalry division with local police force.
1hk1n68.zh: 一旦该国会完成，立即对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。吞并荷兰与东印度。务必把驻军设为配属地方警察部队的骑兵师。

1xv7fkn.en: Rush towards the capitals you are missing and the achievement will pop. Note that you need the entire state where the capitals reside and not just the capital square itself.
1xv7fkn.zh: 直取你尚未拿下首都的那些国家，成就就会弹出。请注意你需要的是首都所在的整个州，而不仅仅是首都那一格本身。

m708bv.en: Put diplomatic pressure on ⟦0⟧ and take the The French Horse And the Red Rider. If ⟦1⟧ accepts, great! If not, don't worry, it's not the end of the run.
m708bv.zh: 对⟦0⟧施加外交压力，并选取「法国马匹与红色骑手」。如果⟦1⟧接受，那太好了！如果不接受，也不必担心，这不是这局的终点。

1iwq1zo.en: Once you declare on the Axis, DO NOT give/ask for military access to ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. Allowing this will let you gain their territory which you conquered.
1iwq1zo.zh: 一旦你对轴心国宣战，绝对不要给⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧军事通行权，也不要向他们索取。允许这一点会让你把已征服的领土拱手让给他们。

jakie5.en: This strategy relies on not joining the Allies and simply rushing towards Paris and Berlin, thus occupying them for yourself.
jakie5.zh: 这个策略依赖于不加入盟国，而是直接冲向巴黎与柏林，从而把这两座城市据为己有。

1taybzr.en: As Belgium, have the National Spirit “Rexist Legion” and be in control of all of your starting neighbors’ Capitals.
1taybzr.zh: 作为比利时，拥有国家精神「雷克斯军团」，并控制你开局时所有邻国的首都。

1eke8z8.zh: 创新的安全特性：科研加成⟦0⟧，设计团队指派成本⟦1⟧，工业制造商指派成本⟦2⟧

dm31pv.zh: 由国策解锁，完成后将不再在其他组织中提供
