mkdyei.zh: 仅适用于机械化装备，由国策解锁

1q37sm0.en: only for Train, unlocked by focus
1q37sm0.zh: 仅适用于列车，由国策解锁

1tsc9po.zh: 仅适用于牵引式反坦克炮

1v4fv7w.zh: 德国 - 福克-阿赫格利斯

1u7v28g.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 皇家轻武器工厂恩菲尔德

1otlmwx.zh: 经验丰富的制造商：可靠性⟦0⟧

w25kvj.en: only for Towed Anti air, Towed Anti-Tank
w25kvj.zh: 仅适用于牵引式防空炮、牵引式反坦克炮

5wg0ol.en: Hearts of Iron 4 can be launched with a number of additional command line arguments (or launch options in Steam). Hearts of Iron 4 command line arguments cannot include spaces or hyphens, except for the hyphen at the start of each argument. Quotes cannot be used to get around this limitation. So if, for example, one wishes to use ⟦0⟧ to load a save on startup, the filename cannot include spaces or hyphens.
5wg0ol.zh: 《钢铁雄心 4》可以通过若干额外的命令行参数（在 Steam 中称为启动选项）来启动。《钢铁雄心 4》的命令行参数不能包含空格或连字符，每个参数开头的那一个连字符除外。引号也无法用来绕过这一限制。因此，举例来说，如果有人想用⟦0⟧在启动时载入一个存档，该文件名就不能包含空格或连字符。

6b4kch.en: Computes and writes out the overall checksum and the checksum of each individual game data file to ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧. Useful when trying to identify if there is a modification to a single file, or some other file that exists but shouldn't, throwing off the checksum and blocking multiplayer.
6b4kch.zh: 计算并把总校验和以及每个单独游戏数据文件的校验和写入⟦0⟧的⟦1⟧。当你想判断是某个单独文件被改动，还是存在某个本不该存在、从而扰乱校验和并阻止多人游戏的文件时，这很有用。

17uxczl.en: Allows save games with older save game versions to be loaded with only a tooltip warning, instead of blocking them altogether. Especially useful for testing shortly after increasing the save game version, since recent save games will still be loadable and relevant.
17uxczl.zh: 允许较旧存档版本的存档仅以一条提示框警告的形式载入，而不是完全阻止它们。在刚提高存档版本之后进行测试时尤其有用，因为较新的存档仍然可以载入且仍然有效。

1b8f53f.en: Automatically starts a 1936 game as ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ unpaused, running at maximum speed, with human AI turned on. Additional effects include enabling the AI testing, test logs, and view, disabling the end screen, and disabling frame smoothing.
1b8f53f.zh: 自动以⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧开启一个 1936 年的游戏，不暂停，以最高速度运行，并开启人类 AI。其他效果包括启用 AI 测试、测试日志与视图，禁用结束界面，以及禁用帧平滑。

1em6cy0.en: Indicates that the game should be run in debug mode, enabling a variety of extra behavior to help with development or testing. Some of the features can be turned on from the game console using the ⟦0⟧ console command.
1em6cy0.zh: 表示游戏应以调试模式运行，启用各种额外行为以帮助开发或测试。其中一些功能可以通过游戏控制台使用⟦0⟧控制台指令来开启。

jszlmr.en: Forces the historical focus gameplay setting on or off. Only works in conjunction with any ⟦0⟧ option, like ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ The default value in game is ⟦3⟧ so only ⟦4⟧ has any real effect currently.
jszlmr.zh: 强制开启或关闭历史国策游戏设置。只能与任意⟦0⟧选项配合使用，例如⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧。游戏中的默认值为⟦3⟧，所以目前只有⟦4⟧有实际效果。

n2yakx.en: Overrides the debug_saves count in the user's settings.txt file. Specifies how many autosave files are kept before the oldest one is deleted when creating a new one.
n2yakx.zh: 覆盖用户 settings.txt 文件中的 debug_saves 计数。指定在创建新自动存档时，保留多少个自动存档文件后才删除最旧的那一个。

6rvcns.en: Turns off the file watcher, which observes game folders and reloads databases or UI when files change. Off by default in Release, but is turned on by ⟦0⟧
6rvcns.zh: 关闭文件监视器，它会观察游戏文件夹并在文件变化时重新载入数据库或 UI。在 Release 版本中默认关闭，但会被⟦0⟧开启。

4ce4in.en: Collects data on errors based on crashes that occur with critical bugs and malfunctions. Including if a buggy mod is activated from the launcher.
4ce4in.zh: 收集因严重 bug 与故障导致的崩溃所产生的错误数据。包括从启动器启用了有问题的模组的情况。

3jeccn.en: Starts the application minimized to the taskbar. Only available in Debug and Release_D. Only implemented for Windows at the time of writing.
3jeccn.zh: 以最小化到任务栏的方式启动程序。仅在 Debug 与 Release_D 中可用。截至撰写时仅在 Windows 上实现。

150iypd.en: Turns off all AI in the game by default, equivalent to automatically applying the ⟦0⟧ console command with the in-game console.
150iypd.zh: 默认关闭游戏中的所有 AI，等同于用游戏内控制台自动执行⟦0⟧控制台指令。

127s439.en: Creates the ⟦0⟧ file (which lists Effects, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and Game variables) in the game's folder instead of launching the game.
127s439.zh: 在游戏文件夹中创建⟦0⟧文件（其中列出效果、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与游戏变量），而不是启动游戏。

18lsi6b.en: Overrides the autosave interval in the user's settings.txt file. Can be one of the following: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧
18lsi6b.zh: 覆盖用户 settings.txt 文件中的自动存档间隔。可以是以下之一：⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧

1gc2rnt.en: Skips the launcher and resumes the last game with the enabled mods listed in the ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧, usually the last enabled mods.
1gc2rnt.zh: 跳过启动器，并使用⟦0⟧的⟦1⟧中列出的已启用模组继续上一次的游戏，通常是最后一次启用的模组。

q2kb24.en: Skips the main menu and directly loads a save file (specified by file name but without the ".hoi4" extension).
q2kb24.zh: 跳过主菜单，直接载入一个存档文件（以文件名指定，但不含「.hoi4」扩展名）。

13n6fwt.en: Executes the ⟦0⟧ console command when a game is started/loaded, allowing to execute more commands.
13n6fwt.zh: 在游戏启动/载入时执行⟦0⟧控制台指令，从而可以执行更多指令。

16rxn91.en: Turns human AI on, so that even the country that the player is controlling is managed by AI.
16rxn91.zh: 开启人类 AI，这样即使是玩家所控制的国家也由 AI 管理。

mux5gw.en: Skips the main menu and directly starts a 1936 game as the country specified by TAG.
mux5gw.zh: 跳过主菜单，直接以 TAG 指定的国家开启一个 1936 年的游戏。

8lcnfu.en: Sets the initial speed of the game (0-4).

lmiqxa.en: In the south lies the third continent, facing its own challenges. Inhabited by various cultures, ranging from comparable in development to Equestria, to tribes without firearms, they all face different challenges. Half of this land was recently ravaged by the yeti Storm King's raids, only stopped by the hippogriffs at the battle of Ain Trotgourait, leaving those affected to somehow deal with the aftermath, while the Storm Kingdom itself has descended into a civil war to decide who becomes the previous ruler's successor. Meanwhile, convinced by delegates from Equestria, Kiria finally decides to end the period of total isolation; but catching up to a century of progress in mere 3.5 years is going to be quite a challenge, as their new rivals are forming right behind their western and southern borders.
lmiqxa.zh: 南方便是第三块大陆，正面临着它自己的挑战。那里居住着各种文化，从发展程度与 Equestria 相当的国家，到连火器都没有的部落，它们都面临着不同的难题。这片土地的一半最近被雪怪风暴之王的突袭所蹂躏，只在 Ain Trotgourait 战役中被骏鹰拦下，留下受灾者设法应对余波；而风暴王国自身则陷入了内战，以决定由谁成为前任统治者的继承者。与此同时，在 Equestria 代表的劝说下，Kiria 终于决定结束完全孤立的状态；但要在短短 3.5 年内追上整整一个世纪的进步，将是相当大的挑战，因为它们的新对手正于其西部与南部边境后方成形。

fc8nzd.en: Across the sea to the east, things are even worse. The Griffonian Empire, after centuries of stability, has collapsed, and millions lie dead as lords, kings and revolutionaries rush to fight over the spoils. The vulnerable ponies of the colony of New Mareland find Equestria more distant than ever. In the cursed north, the Necromancers of the Dread League stir to battle the Holy Knights of the Arcturian Order. And in the far east the ponies of the disparate nations of the River Coalition face this dangerous world with no alicorns, no harmony, no advanced technology, wielding only the grim determination of those who fight to protect their home and lives.
fc8nzd.zh: 隔海向东，情况甚至更糟。格里芬帝国在数百年的稳定之后已经崩溃，随着领主、国王与革命者争相抢夺战利品，数百万人已然死去。殖民地新马兰的脆弱小马们发现 Equestria 比以往任何时候都更加遥远。在被诅咒的北方，恐怖联盟的死灵法师们蠢蠢欲动，要与阿克图里安教团的神圣骑士一战。而在远东，河湾联盟各个分散国家的小马们面对着这个危险世界，没有天角兽、没有和谐、没有先进科技，手中只有那些为保护家园与性命而战者的冷峻决心。

4w1q6v.en: Everywhere Equestria finds new challenges. To the west, Queen Chrysalis has abandoned her attempts at infiltration and instead mobilised the Changeling Hives for industry and war, planning her revenge on Equestria. To the north, the Crystal Empire, returned after centuries in limbo, considers its future in this strange world even as the threat of Sombra's return remains ever present. Communists spread radical ideas in Stalliongrad to the east, and the griffons of the north are thrown into chaos by the assassination of their governor.
4w1q6v.zh: 在每一处，Equestria 都遭遇新的挑战。在西边，虫茧女王已放弃渗透的尝试，转而动员幻形灵蜂巢投入工业与战争，筹划她对 Equestria 的复仇。在北边，在数个世纪的放逐后归来的水晶帝国，正思量着它在这个奇异世界中的未来，而索姆布拉归来的威胁始终存在。共产党人在东边的斯塔利昂格勒传播激进思想，北方的格里芬们则因总督遭刺杀而陷入混乱。

dzt0mw.en: Released in July 2017, Equestria at War has grown to be one of the most comprehensive mods for HOI4. With a custom made map, 60+ countries with 30+ unique focus trees, racial tech trees and units, a huge variety of complex interweaving events, and more custom icons and portraits than the entire base game, it shouldn't exist, but it somehow does.
dzt0mw.zh: 《Equestria at War》于 2017 年 7 月发布，如今已成长为《钢铁雄心 4》最全面的模组之一。它有自制地图、60 多个国家与 30 多棵独特国策树、种族科技树与单位、种类繁多且相互交织的复杂事件，以及比整个游戏本体还多的自定义图标与立绘——它本不该存在，但它偏偏就是存在。

pa521k.en: It is 7 years since Princess Luna was saved and the Elements of Harmony restored by Princess Twilight and her friends. The world is changing. The peaceful isolation of the village and farm under a distant monarch is giving way to a new world, with radical ideas, terrifying weapons, centralised nation states and industrialised cities.
pa521k.zh: 距离露娜公主被救回、和谐元素被暮光公主与她的朋友们恢复，已经过去了 7 年。世界正在改变。在遥远君主统治下的村庄与农场的和平孤立，正让位于一个有着激进思想、可怕武器、中央集权民族国家与工业化城市的新世界。

zoisz6.en: Already Equestria has suffered invasions, coup attempts, a rogue demigod, and even near annihilation at the hands of stolen time travel magic. A long awaited commission has released a scathing report condemning the Canterlot administration for its gross unpreparedness for military, magical and internal threats.
zoisz6.zh: Equestria 已经遭受过入侵、政变企图、一位失控的半神，甚至因被盗取的时间旅行魔法而几近毁灭。一项期盼已久的调查委员会发布了一份措辞严厉的报告，谴责坎特洛特当局在应对军事、魔法与内部威胁方面严重准备不足。

a9b38d.en: Equestria at War combines the detailed political and military simulation of Hearts of Iron IV with a modified, grimmer version of the My Little Pony setting and storyline.
a9b38d.zh: 《Equestria at War》把《钢铁雄心 4》详尽的政治与军事模拟，与一个经过改写、更加阴郁的《小马宝莉》设定与剧情结合在一起。

17qfjys.en: In this modern world of danger and impending war, the Magic of Friendship can seem very distant indeed...
17qfjys.zh: 在这个充满危险与迫近战争的现代世界里，友谊的魔法看上去确实非常遥远……

11i3w1l.en: New Puppet Interactions: Fascist countries get new subject levels like Reichskommissariat, with access to licenses, industry and strategic resources. The instated governments are held in an iron grip, making it harder for them to break free.
11i3w1l.zh: 新的傀儡互动：法西斯国家获得新的附属国等级，例如帝国专员区，并可使用许可证、工业与战略资源。被建立的政府被牢牢掌控，使它们更难挣脱。

1n3gic8.en: Its now possible to stop being capitulated by getting back to 90% and recovering your capital. Rules show on war participant items when they have the capitulate icon up.
1n3gic8.zh: 现在可以通过回到 90% 并夺回首都来摆脱投降状态。当参战方拥有投降图标时，战争参与者条目上会显示规则。

s4ko5m.en: New Music and Art: 3 new thematic musical tracks from composer Andreas Waldetoft, new art content for the four focus nations, and new troop voiceovers.
s4ko5m.zh: 新音乐与美术：3 首来自作曲家 Andreas Waldetoft 的新主题音乐、四个焦点国家的新美术内容，以及新的部队配音。

1kqsr6u.en: New Diplomatic Interactions: License military technology to bring other nations' weapons to the field or sell your advances to the highest bidder.
1kqsr6u.zh: 新外交互动：为军事科技发放许可证，把其他国家的武器投入战场，或把你的先进成果卖给出价最高者。

hrjclj.en: Equipment Conversion: Update your arsenal by converting older units - or make use of captured enemy vehicles and gear.
hrjclj.zh: 装备改装：通过改装较旧的单位来更新你的军备——或者利用缴获的敌方载具与装备。

1pall87.en: New beta patch with additional fixes, more portraits for free and an interim solution to an old AI transport problem
1pall87.zh: 新的测试版补丁，含有额外修复、更多免费立绘，以及针对一个陈旧 AI 运输问题的临时解决方案

13vji9n.en: New impassable borders and areas (Sahara) making warfare in certain parts of the world much more interesting
13vji9n.zh: 新的不可通行边界与区域（撒哈拉），使世界某些地区的战争变得有趣得多

1rp25ib.en: Four New Focus Trees: Experience the war from the difficult perspectives of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧.
1rp25ib.zh: 四棵新国策树：从⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧各自艰难的视角体验战争。

ql0cse.en: Announcement of new content pack coming with the free 1.4 Oak along with details on AI improvements
ql0cse.zh: 宣布随免费 1.4「橡树」一同到来的新内容包，并详述 AI 改进

39k28o.zh: 测试版补丁状态、DoD 之后的初步游戏统计数据，以及新团队成员介绍

1ikqa18.zh: 更新了战争概览界面。现在会显示更多伤亡、兵力与工业信息。

ar79c0.zh: 增加了重命名航空队的功能，并为大多数国家添加了历史命名方案

2fy4yw.zh: 1.4「橡树」与即将到来的扩展将带来地图改进以及获取科技的新方式

s884ru.zh: 在和平会议上夺取他人占领的领土现在昂贵得多

1plfodf.zh: 新的附属国等级、成就、音乐、各类便利性功能以及 AI 更新 #3

1vus0kz.zh: 更新了贸易界面，以便更轻松地总览与核查运输船队

1clqbnq.en: Yugoslavia unique flavor and more details on aerial combat overhaul in 1.4 Oak
1clqbnq.zh: 南斯拉夫的独特风味，以及 1.4「橡树」中空战重制的更多细节

1fumqnv.zh: 空中任务与航空队现在可在地图上看到并选取，并显示航程等信息

d6qe5q.zh: 让我们来看看捷克斯洛伐克，以及 Steelvolt 带来的又一次 AI 更新

12h31ii.zh: 全部新的空中控制与界面，包括新的空战界面

17x8td5.zh: 关于⟦0⟧国家包与⟦1⟧（又名「橡树」）的全部开发日志。

uemxe3.zh: 论坛，Death or Dishonor - 新国家包公布！，2017-04-26。

1vnl217.zh: 雷达现在更易看到，并在地图上显示可切换的探测范围

1wjsabq.zh: 旧物新用以及战争概览的改进

16g1xg3.zh: 为改善游戏体验对地图与战略区域做出的若干改动

1twg4ry.zh: 1.4.1 测试版补丁中处理的新旧 bug

1dglak0.zh: ⟦0⟧为东欧的许多国家增添了更多细节、反映苏联政治的独特游戏系统，以及对游戏军事方面的诸多改进。

6bq28e.en: Changes to weather, QoL changes concerning equipment and building in allied territories / Departure of Game Director Dan "Podcat" Lind
6bq28e.zh: 天气改动、针对盟友领土内装备与建造的便利性改动 / 游戏总监 Dan「Podcat」Lind 离职

1brf978.en: A look at the historical and shared parts of the new Soviet Focus Tree and new mechanics for the Soviet Union
1brf978.zh: 审视新苏联国策树的历史分支与共同分支，以及苏联的新机制

119d1oj.en: ⟦0⟧: Burn and ruin the land as the enemy marches on it to slow them down and give debuffs.
119d1oj.zh: ⟦0⟧在敌军推进时焚烧并毁坏土地，以拖慢他们并施加减益。

1ylitd1.en: Aside from the branches' top level focuses, most other focuses have additional requirements in need of fulfillment before they can be picked. If a requirement of an on-going focus has become invalidated, the focus will either be paused until the requirement is restored (if possible) or outright be cancelled when such a thing is not easily possible. For cases such as the latter, focuses will have bypass conditions to allow the player to proceed past them - the player will be notified of the bypass within a few days (they will display a golden bracket as if completed regularly). For example, Motorization Effort can be bypassed if the Motorized Infantry technology has already been researched beforehand.
1ylitd1.zh: 除了各分支顶层的国策之外，大多数其他国策还有需要满足的额外条件才能选取。如果某个进行中国策的条件变得无效，该国策要么会被暂停直到条件恢复（如果可能），要么在无法轻易恢复时被直接取消。对于后一种情况，国策会有跳过条件让玩家能够越过它们继续推进——玩家会在几天内收到跳过通知（它们会像正常完成一样显示金色方框）。例如，如果摩托化步兵科技事先已经研究完毕，「摩托化努力」就可以被跳过。

dx1p68.en: ⟦0⟧ - Some focuses may have the ⟦1⟧ icon appearing in-between them. The icon denotes that only one of two may be selected. Further more, depending on the focuses outgoing connections it may also exclude from picking any of the focuses connected to them further down the line. For example, choosing between Collectivist Ethos or Liberty Ethos will make any of the other side's subsequent connected focuses unavailable for picking up until Technology Sharing (linked to both sides by an ⟦2⟧ connection).
dx1p68.zh: ⟦0⟧——某些国策之间可能会出现⟦1⟧图标。该图标表示两者之中只能选择一个。此外，根据这些国策向外的连接，它也可能排除选取它们下游所连接的任何国策。例如，在「集体主义精神」或「自由精神」之间做出选择，会使另一侧后续连接的国策都无法选取，直到「技术共享」（通过一个⟦2⟧连接与两侧相连）为止。

msmudf.en: ⟦0⟧ - Focuses are connected by colored lines. The color indicates whether its preceding focus is completed (green) or not (light-blue). The connection may also appear as a solid or dotted line, with the former indicating a logical ⟦1⟧ and the latter a logical ⟦2⟧. For example, to pick Special Forces would require all 3 of the focuses preceding it while picking Technology Sharing requires only one of the 2 preceding it.
msmudf.zh: ⟦0⟧——国策之间由彩色线条连接。线条的颜色表示其前置国策是否已完成（绿色为已完成，浅蓝色为未完成）。连接也可能显示为实线或虚线，前者表示逻辑上的⟦1⟧，后者表示逻辑上的⟦2⟧。例如，要选取「特种部队」需要它之前的全部 3 个国策，而要选取「技术共享」只需要其之前的 2 个国策中的任意一个。

3nzwv2.en: The seven ⟦0⟧ as well as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ have a unique national focus tree in the base game. Additional countries - ⟦3⟧ - received a unique focus tree as part of different DLCs. All other nations use the generic national focus tree.

lj7ewb.en: Justifying a war goal costs political power, increases world tension and usually takes between 6-9 months to complete. When a country has a war goal, it can start a war against the target country. Countries succeeding in their war goals get an advantage in peace conferences. There are several ⟦0⟧ that will give countries historical war goals. However, ahistorical war goals are also possible, such as Sweden restoring its historical borders. The target state of the wargoal can be claimed at a discount at the peace conference. It is also possible to declare a ⟦1⟧.
lj7ewb.zh: 制造战争目标会消耗政治点数、提高世界紧张度，通常需要 6 到 9 个月才能完成。当一个国家拥有战争目标时，它就可以对目标国家发动战争。成功达成战争目标的国家在和平会议中获得优势。有若干⟦0⟧会赋予国家历史性的战争目标。不过，非历史的战争目标也是可能的，例如瑞典恢复其历史边界。战争目标所指的目标州可以在和平会议上以折扣价索取。也可以宣告⟦1⟧。

1ms4hcd.en: At the end of game, beside individual scores, is the Factions ranking. This is derived from various statistics such as manpower, naval, air and ground forces, industrial power, terrain points, research, war progress, casualties, etc. Basically, it describes which faction has won the game.
1ms4hcd.zh: 在游戏结束时，除了各个单独得分之外，还有阵营排名。它由人力、海军、空军与地面部队、工业实力、地形点数、科研、战争进展、伤亡等各种统计数据推导而来。基本上，它描述的是哪个阵营赢得了这局游戏。

9f9yw7.en: Besides the ⟦0⟧, war goal justification will require one or multiple conditions to be met before it can even begin. The conditions will be different depending on the ⟦1⟧ (Communism, Democracy, Fascism or Non-aligned) as well as the ⟦2⟧ (Allies, Axis, Commintern, others) and the ⟦3⟧ level.
9f9yw7.zh: 除了⟦0⟧之外，制造战争目标还需要在能够开始之前满足一项或多项条件。条件会因⟦1⟧（共产主义、民主、法西斯或中立主义）以及⟦2⟧（盟国、轴心国、共产国际、其他）和⟦3⟧等级的不同而不同。

176odbz.en: Once the justification is ongoing, it will also be necessary to spend 0.2 political power per day on the war goal justification to complete it in the minimum number of days. Any deficiency in political power will stall the war goal justification.
176odbz.zh: 一旦开始制造，还必须在战争目标制造上每天花费 0.2 政治点数，才能在最少天数内完成它。政治点数的任何不足都会使战争目标的制造停滞。

184cox.en: ⟦0⟧ are very limited in how they can begin wars, to simulate the influence of popular opinion during the time period. These limitations are lifted if a country becomes fascist or communist.
184cox.zh: ⟦0⟧在如何发动战争方面受到极大限制，以模拟那个时期公众舆论的影响。如果一个国家转为法西斯或共产主义，这些限制就会被解除。

1e0245u.en: Fascists have virtually no restriction on justifying war goals. If a fascist country is already at war with a major power, they can justify a new wargoal 80% faster than normal.
1e0245u.zh: 法西斯在制造战争目标方面几乎没有限制。如果一个法西斯国家已经与一个主要国家交战，它们制造新战争目标的速度比正常快 80%。

gowznx.en: All ideologies have one or multiple effect on the cost of war goal justification or enactment at the peace conference.
gowznx.zh: 所有意识形态都会对战争目标制造的成本或和平会议上的执行成本产生一项或多项影响。

18ptpom.en: It's necessary to spend a certain amount of political power to start justification of a war goal.
18ptpom.zh: 必须花费一定数量的政治点数才能开始制造战争目标。

eys0ee.en: A war goal is needed to declare war. A war goal is usually a conquest of a desired state.
eys0ee.zh: 宣战需要一个战争目标。战争目标通常是对某个目标州的征服。

1e6zsny.en: Cannot occupy a country without war (captured neutral territory will be returned).
1e6zsny.zh: 不通过战争就无法占领一个国家（被夺取的中立领土将被归还）。

v7hjn8.en: Cannot justify against a nation that has not increased the world tension.
v7hjn8.zh: 不能对没有提高世界紧张度的国家制造战争目标。

n2qirk.en: A regular justified casus belli is, after finished, valid for 2 months.
n2qirk.zh: 一个常规制造的宣战理由在完成后有效期为 2 个月。

1hkwy02.en: Justifying against another country to take non-claimed states (5 max.)
1hkwy02.zh: 对另一个国家制造战争目标以夺取未宣称的州（最多 5 个）

1tcvqqg.en: Justifying against another country to take claimed states (5 max.)
1tcvqqg.zh: 对另一个国家制造战争目标以夺取已宣称的州（最多 5 个）

jjx151.en: Communists have virtually no restriction on justifying war goals.
jjx151.zh: 共产主义者在制造战争目标方面几乎没有限制。

1crvutw.zh: 基础成本为 xx，随后适用以下修正：

wcdk9w.en: ⟦0⟧ cost and ⟦1⟧ World Tension added for annexing target country
wcdk9w.zh: 吞并目标国家的⟦0⟧成本以及增加的⟦1⟧世界紧张度

1asqf3c.en: Justifying against another country to take core states (5 max.)
1asqf3c.zh: 对另一个国家制造战争目标以夺取核心州（最多 5 个）

ksgvvy.en: ⟦0⟧ When justifying war goal against a major power at war.
ksgvvy.zh: ⟦0⟧在战时对主要国家制造战争目标时。

cw32ee.en: ⟦0⟧ cost for changing the target country's government
cw32ee.zh: 改变目标国家政府的⟦0⟧成本

t4e72s.en: Cannot start a war against another democracy.
t4e72s.zh: 不能对另一个民主国家发动战争。

1yp0zwj.zh: 傀儡化目标国家的⟦0⟧成本

dvikhl.en: Can occupy a country without war.
dvikhl.zh: 可以不通过战争占领一个国家。

169gj91.zh: 不能傀儡化另一个国家。

16dmgwe.zh: 可以傀儡化另一个国家。

16avn5w.en: When a nation that is not yet a treaty signatory reaches around 20% of the capital ships of the ⟦0⟧, they can be invited into the treaty. Heavier capital ships like battleships count more for these purposes than lighter ones like heavy cruisers. Should such a nation decline the offer and continue to expand their navy, the treaty nations can try to force them to disarm up to 80% of their capital ships. A refusal to disarm may lead to war. If a signatory nation exceeds the allocated amount of capital ships, they immediately get a mission to reduce the number of capital ships, at the threat of major stability loss.
16avn5w.zh: 当一个尚非条约签署国的国家达到⟦0⟧主力舰数量的约 20% 时，它可能会被邀请加入该条约。就这些用途而言，像战列舰这样更重的主力舰比像重巡洋舰这样较轻的舰船计得更多。如果这样一个国家拒绝该提议并继续扩张其海军，条约国可以尝试强迫它们裁减最多 80% 的主力舰。拒绝裁军可能导致战争。如果一个签署国超出了分配给它的主力舰数量，它们会立即获得一个减少主力舰数量的任务，否则将面临严重的稳定度损失。

1jn3whm.en: The second London Naval Treaty is a mission that finishes in June 1936. During the mission, leaving the treaty is an option for all parties, but only the ⟦0⟧ treaty parties of ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ can do so easily. After the mission's conclusion, all countries that did not leave the treaty will continue to be subjected to the limitations of the treaty until it becomes defunct, or until becomes high enough to allow them to withdraw at the cost of ⟦3⟧.
1jn3whm.zh: 第二次伦敦海军条约是一个于 1936 年 6 月结束的任务。在任务期间，退出条约是所有各方都有的选项，但只有⟦0⟧⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧的条约方可以轻松做到。任务结束后，所有没有退出条约的国家将继续受条约限制约束，直到它失效，或直到它变得足够高，允许它们以⟦3⟧为代价退出。

1fso089.en: The ⟦0⟧ (LNT) is a mechanic introduced with ⟦1⟧. It limits the major powers of the ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ in terms of the maximum ⟦7⟧ of carriers, cruisers, and heavy ships (battlecruisers and battleships), as well as the number of capital ships in relation to the number of capital ships of the ⟦8⟧. They may ⟦9⟧ any ship, but can only produce ones that are within the limits.
1fso089.zh: ⟦0⟧（LNT）是随⟦1⟧引入的一项机制。它限制⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧与⟦6⟧这些主要国家在航母、巡洋舰与重型舰船（战列巡洋舰与战列舰）的⟦7⟧上限，以及主力舰数量相对于⟦8⟧主力舰数量的比例。它们可以⟦9⟧任何舰船，但只能建造处于限制范围内的舰船。

12rta3f.en: During the ⟦0⟧ mission, any participating nation can take the decision to ⟦1⟧ for 25 ⟦2⟧ if they are nations and 150 ⟦3⟧ if they are not. Withdrawing from the treaty removes its limitations for the withdrawing country. After April 30th 1936, 20% World Tension must be reached before the decision to withdraw becomes available again.
12rta3f.zh: 在⟦0⟧任务期间，任何参与国都可以作出决定⟦1⟧：如果它们是签约国则花费 25⟦2⟧，如果不是则花费 150⟦3⟧。退出条约会为退出国解除其限制。1936 年 4 月 30 日之后，必须达到 20% 世界紧张度，退出决定才会再次可用。

1cvvsin.en: ⟦0⟧ nations can cheat on the LNT, increasing the maximum allowed ⟦1⟧ of their ships while keeping the LNT in being and thus forcing non-fascist treaty parties to still respect its limitations. ⟦2⟧ starts the game in 1936 already cheating on the treaties, other ⟦3⟧ countries will need to spend 50 ⟦4⟧ to do so.
1cvvsin.zh: ⟦0⟧国家可以在 LNT 上作弊，提高其舰船允许的⟦1⟧上限，同时让 LNT 继续存在，从而迫使非法西斯的条约方仍然遵守其限制。⟦2⟧在 1936 年开局时就已经在条约上作弊，其他⟦3⟧国家需要花费 50⟦4⟧才能这样做。

11dapoo.en: This is a 120 days mission starting on Jan 1st, 1936, during which the player nation can decide to withdraw from the treaty. After the mission ends, the only options left are ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ until certain World Tension thresholds are reached.
11dapoo.zh: 这是一个从 1936 年 1 月 1 日开始的 120 天任务，在此期间玩家国家可以决定退出条约。任务结束后，在达到某些世界紧张度门槛之前，剩下的选项只有⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。

1wjkhcx.en: After a country withdraws from the LNT, a 365-day mission timer starts that changes the London naval treaty spirit for all remaining signatories to the ⟦0⟧ spirit. This significantly increases the ⟦1⟧ limits on ships for these nations.
1wjkhcx.zh: 在一个国家退出 LNT 之后，会开始一个 365 天的任务计时器，它会把所有其余签署国的伦敦海军条约精神改为⟦0⟧精神。这会显著提高这些国家的舰船⟦1⟧上限。

ehpt49.en: Notably, cheating on the treaties can allow ⟦0⟧ nations to construct bare-bones super-heavy battleships, whereas other nations must either leave the treaty, wait for it to become defunct, or wait for the Escalator Clause to be invoked.
ehpt49.zh: 值得注意的是，在条约上作弊可以让⟦0⟧国家建造简陋配置的超重型战列舰，而其他国家必须要么退出条约、要么等它失效、要么等自动扶梯条款被援引。

iumbet.en: At 20% World Tension or if another country withdraws from the treaty, a mission starts which replaces the ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ after 365 days. This increases the maximum cost for ships for treaty signatories.
iumbet.zh: 在世界紧张度达到 20% 时，或者如果另一个国家退出条约，会开始一个任务，在 365 天后用⟦0⟧取代⟦1⟧。这会提高条约签署国的舰船成本上限。

19s1z0w.en: The treaty becomes defunct after any two major powers (except any Chinese faction) are at war, or when World Tension reaches 75%.
19s1z0w.zh: 在任何两个主要国家（中国各派系除外）交战时，或世界紧张度达到 75% 时，该条约失效。

j7flp8.en: Cheating on the treaty raises its ⟦0⟧ limits for the cheating nation by the following:
j7flp8.zh: 在条约上作弊会为作弊国提高其⟦0⟧上限，幅度如下：

rbvqkh.zh: 第二次伦敦海军条约进行中

8ias4o.en: These technologies are heavily interlinked with special projects, with many of them either requiring or unlocking certain projects. Some engineering technologies are also tied to specific special project categories, providing breakthrough progress in them when being researched and benefitting from any ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in the field. Notably, technologies with a red ribbon in the bottom right-hand corner of their icons are tied to aerodynamics and avionics projects, those with a yellow ribbon in the bottom right-hand corner of their icons are tied to nuclear research projects, and those with both red and yellow ribbons (e.g. radar technologies) are tied to both special project categories.
8ias4o.zh: 这些科技与特殊项目高度交织，其中许多要么需要、要么会解锁某些项目。一些工程科技也与特定的特殊项目类别绑定，在研究时会为其提供突破进展，并从任何在该领域从事被动研究的⟦0⟧中获益。值得注意的是，图标右下角带红色绶带的科技与空气动力学和航空电子学项目绑定，图标右下角带黄色绶带的科技与核研究项目绑定，而同时带红黄两色绶带的科技（例如雷达科技）则与这两个特殊项目类别都绑定。

1b9gdm.en: ⟦0⟧ unlocks technologies related to computing, radios, radar, fortifications, nuclear weapons, rockets, and rocket engines. Like ⟦1⟧, engineering technologies tend to provide general bonuses on the country level, but unlike industry technologies, these bonuses tend to be ones related to research speed or unit stats, not economic benefits (at least, not directly). Without La Résistance, it also includes technologies that affect encryption and decryption.
1b9gdm.zh: ⟦0⟧解锁与计算、无线电、雷达、筑垒工事、核武器、火箭与火箭发动机相关的科技。像⟦1⟧一样，工程科技往往在国家层面提供通用加成，但与工业科技不同，这些加成往往与科研速度或单位属性相关，而非经济利益（至少不是直接的经济利益）。如果不启用《抵抗运动》，它还包括影响加密与解密的相关科技。

18s70ru.en: This tree is heavily intertwined with various Aerodynamics and Avionics special projects related to rockets and rocketry. Experimental rockets is also sometimes referred to as ⟦0⟧.
18s70ru.zh: 这棵树与各种涉及火箭与火箭技术的空气动力学及航空电子学特殊项目高度交织。「实验火箭」有时也被称为⟦0⟧。

vu990n.en: This tree contains a single research that is required to unlock all current Nuclear Research special projects. Atomic research is also sometimes referred to as ⟦0⟧.
vu990n.zh: 这棵树包含一项单一研究，它是解锁当前所有核研究特殊项目所必需的。原子研究有时也被称为⟦0⟧。

13vn0gm.en: Any country via the Isotope Separation Facilities special project prototype outcome
13vn0gm.zh: 任何国家通过「同位素分离设施」特殊项目原型成果

s87uko.en: These techs are only available by completing special projects.
s87uko.zh: 这些科技只能通过完成特殊项目来获得。

kotv1j.en: If is ⟦0⟧ and is at war with ⟦1⟧, play music ⟦2⟧
kotv1j.zh: 如果⟦0⟧且正与⟦1⟧交战，则播放音乐⟦2⟧

1x21feo.zh: 改进型分米波海军搜索雷达

162je4.en: Static anti air hit chance factor: ⟦0⟧
162je4.zh: 静态防空命中几率系数：⟦0⟧

8j3vnc.zh: 改进型无线电陆上巡洋舰模块

ua6p2e.zh: 先进无线电陆上巡洋舰模块

1ptmego.zh: 基础无线电陆上巡洋舰模块

8wbb4.en: ⟦0⟧ was the 2nd ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧. It was announced on 2017-04-26⟦3⟧ and released on 2017-06-14⟦4⟧, alongside patch 1.4.

19t2uiw.en: In order to play as early as the United Baltic Duchy(UBD), is to play first as Germany and go with the non aligned path. In this case, just invade and occupy the Baltics states before preparing yourself to fight against Soviets for the war. Considering that the Baltics if lived for long, they'd be claimed by the Soviets. In the usual scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases goes for the UBD focuses, as in Establish Eastern Grand Duchies. Therefore, acquiring the decision of 'Found a Baltic-German State'. If Germany invades and annexes the Baltics, the 'Found a Baltic-German State' decision releases the United Baltic Duchy.
19t2uiw.zh: 要想尽早以联合波罗的海公国（UBD）游玩，方法是先以德国游玩并走中立主义路线。在这种情况下，只需在准备与苏联开战之前先行入侵并占领波罗的海各州。考虑到波罗的海国家如果存在得足够久，就会被苏联索要。在通常的情形下，玩家必须速推那些释放它的国策，转向 UBD 相关国策，例如「建立东方大公国」。从而获得「建立一个波罗的海德意志国家」决议。如果德国入侵并吞并了波罗的海，那么「建立一个波罗的海德意志国家」决议就会释放联合波罗的海公国。

bqsq8u.en: Fortunately, as stated earlier, the colony nation inherits most of the Germany's technology, ranging from small arms, tanks, planes and navy. Thus, opening opportunities to start and produce if needed necessary. However, being a colony state it has many draw backs. It has a decent amount of factories but some go to the colony's overlord, and some are unusable which have to be resorted to raise compliance above 70%. Therefore, independence and high compliance mean to get the great number of factories back up. Or with other means.
bqsq8u.zh: 幸运的是，如前所述，这个殖民地国家继承了德国的大部分科技，从小型武器、坦克、飞机到海军都有。因此，若有需要，它具备开始并生产必要装备的机会。不过，作为一个殖民地州它有许多缺点。它拥有数量可观的工厂，但其中一些会划归该殖民地的宗主国，还有一些无法使用，必须靠把顺从度提高到 70% 以上来解决。因此，独立与高顺从度意味着能把大量工厂重新收回。或者通过其他手段。

13zsfst.en: The United Baltic Duchy, despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is almost unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. But, another way is to release them as a puppet, wait until they get cores throughout their decisions. Playing this country is a challenge all about maintaining peace and order on the owned lands of the Baltics.
13zsfst.zh: 联合波罗的海公国虽然在游戏中是一个「国家」，但按铁人模式的选择它几乎无法游玩，所以玩家只能通过使用控制台指令来受益于游玩该国。不过，另一种方式是把它们作为傀儡国释放，然后等它们通过决议获得核心。游玩这个国家是一场关于在波罗的海所拥土地上维持和平与秩序的挑战。

116vmlj.en: In a matter of technology, UBD also inherits whatever Germany gains from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Germany a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the puppet state, UBD gets them altogether.
116vmlj.zh: 在科技方面，UBD 也会继承德国通过国策或决议获得的任何成果；如果玩家希望以德国多玩一会儿、只为让自身科技对傀儡国来说足够可用，UBD 会一并获得它们。

114o8bw.en: The ⟦0⟧ nation can be released by non aligned Germany. As it is released it starts with the political advisors, the instantly formed agency and with an unique leader. It doesn't have any starting national spirit or an unique national focus.
114o8bw.zh: ⟦0⟧国家可以由中立主义的德国释放。被释放时，它开局即拥有政治顾问、即时组建的特工机构以及一位独特的领袖。它没有任何起始国家精神，也没有独特的国策。

a1sd5c.en: The United Baltic Duchy, was a short-lived client state of the German Empire during World War I, proclaimed by leaders of the local Baltic German nobility but never fully realized.
a1sd5c.zh: 联合波罗的海公国是第一次世界大战期间德意志帝国的一个短命附庸国，由当地波罗的海德意志贵族的领袖们宣告建立，但从未真正实现。

1yn3hke.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country that can be created by the German Empire via the ⟦1⟧ decision, which becomes available after completing the focus Establish Eastern Grand Duchies.
1yn3hke.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个可释放国家，可以由德意志帝国通过⟦1⟧决议创建，该决议在完成国策「建立东方大公国」后可用。

1hwvi0y.en: The ⟦0⟧ does not start with an army, but inherits all division templates from the German Empire when created.
1hwvi0y.zh: ⟦0⟧开局时没有军队，但被创建时会继承德意志帝国的所有师编制。

1w0f894.en: The ⟦0⟧ inherits whatever industry and resources that ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ had in their starting territory.
1w0f894.zh: ⟦0⟧继承⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧在其起始领土上所拥有的任何工业与资源。

11krod6.en: The ⟦0⟧, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
11krod6.zh: ⟦0⟧没有独特的国策树，因此改用通用国策树。

o76cvh.en: The ⟦0⟧ uses generic ministers, military staff, and companies.
o76cvh.zh: ⟦0⟧使用通用大臣、军事参谋与公司。

1jbopw0.en: The invasion of the Baltics and government creation
1jbopw0.zh: 入侵波罗的海与政府创建

suvbh6.en: The ⟦0⟧ starts under a ⟦1⟧ with the German Empire.
suvbh6.zh: ⟦0⟧开局处于与德意志帝国的⟦1⟧之下。

3fib82.en: The ⟦0⟧ has no navy, but starts with 50 convoys.
3fib82.zh: ⟦0⟧没有海军，但开局拥有 50 支运输船队。

3qz47g.zh: 梅克伦堡-什未林家族（贵族正统派）

nrg3bn.zh: 联合波罗的海公国概况

1x8ttso.en: Aim to flip Fascist as soon as reasonably possible. Simply take all decisions provided by the focus: Appeal for Support. You'll only have to face the consequences if you take the focus The Counter Revolution. If you wish to continue the fascist side of the tree choose your own path and not the puppet side.
1x8ttso.zh: 目标是在合理范围内尽快转为法西斯。只需采纳国策「呼吁支持」所提供的全部决议。只有在你选取国策「反革命」时才会承担后果。如果你想继续走这棵树的法西斯一侧，就选择你自己的路线，而不要选傀儡那一侧。

1tvk7ql.en: Once Germany declares on ⟦0⟧ and they've joined the Allies, you declare on ⟦1⟧. Decline the puppet option in the event that follows and conquer them completely for yourself. If you're lucky ⟦2⟧ doesn't not join the Allies and you can annex them freely. Make sure to join the Axis before they cap.
1tvk7ql.zh: 一旦德国对⟦0⟧宣战且它们已加入盟国，你就对⟦1⟧宣战。在随后的事件中拒绝傀儡化选项，并将它们彻底征服归你所有。如果你运气好，⟦2⟧没有加入盟国，你就可以随意吞并它们。务必在它们投降前加入轴心国。

x7trlh.en: Once you are fascist justify on ⟦0⟧. They should be an easy target. Your starting army should be enough to take the south-west of the country. Use a couple cheap divisions to cover a small part of the northern border. After ⟦1⟧ capitulates annex the entire country.
x7trlh.zh: 一旦你成为法西斯，就对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。它们应该是个容易的目标。你的起始军队应该足够拿下该国西南部。用几个廉价的师来覆盖北方边境的一小段。在⟦1⟧投降后吞并整个国家。

18vcjc0.en: The combined navies of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ should be enough to be able to naval invade the ⟦3⟧. Once they fall take Danzig in the peace deal. It will be a German core so they'll be willing to spend some of their score on it.
18vcjc0.zh: ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧的联合海军应该足以对⟦3⟧发动海军登陆。一旦它们陷落，就在和平会议中拿下但泽。它将成为德国的核心，所以它们愿意为此花掉一部分战争分数。

1m9mfcb.en: You can wait for the option for a national referendum, but if you want to save some time I suggest you ignite a civil war. Make sure to have military and civilian support. They are crucial for you to win the civil war.
1m9mfcb.zh: 你可以等待全国公投这个选项，但如果你想节省一些时间，我建议你点燃一场内战。务必拥有军事与民事支持。它们对你赢得内战至关重要。

137dmbr.en: Once you've won the civil war, improve relations with the ⟦0⟧, ask for military access, and get a non-aggression pact. These 3 will make them have a 100+ opinion of you. Now you can join the Comintern.
137dmbr.zh: 一旦你赢得内战，改善与⟦0⟧的关系，索取军事通行权，并签订互不侵犯条约。这三项会让它们对你的好感达到 100 以上。现在你就可以加入共产国际了。

1yyu27o.en: Make sure to keep an eye on your stability and focus on building civilian factories up to 41 to remove the debuff from low stability.
1yyu27o.zh: 务必留意你的稳定度，并专注于把民用工厂建到 41 个，以消除低稳定度带来的减益。

1530h0e.en: If you plan to do ⟦0⟧ after this, then focus on taking as much of the British fleet as you can (unless you prefer order 66).
1530h0e.zh: 如果你打算在此之后去做⟦0⟧，那么就专注于尽可能多地夺取英国舰队（除非你更偏好 66 号指令）。

yo3uz7.en: Once they fall take Danzig in the peace deal. It will be a German core so they'll be willing to spend a lot of their score.
yo3uz7.zh: 一旦它们陷落，就在和平会议中拿下但泽。它将成为德国的核心，所以它们愿意为此花掉大量战争分数。

1ff9ly1.en: Once justified, declare war on ⟦0⟧. Launch a naval invasion on Danzig and call the ⟦1⟧ into the war. You will win easily.
1ff9ly1.zh: 一旦制造完成，就对⟦0⟧宣战。对但泽发动海军登陆，并把⟦1⟧拉入战争。你会轻松取胜。

jrnt5d.en: You'll get invited to the Axis regardless of the negative modifier for 'strategic reasons' that Germany has.
jrnt5d.zh: 不管德国因「战略理由」而拥有的负修正如何，你都会被邀请加入轴心国。

911ad7.en: Besides the fascist path take focuses that give stability, war support, civilian and military factories.
911ad7.zh: 除了法西斯路线之外，选取那些提供稳定度、战争支持度、民用与军用工厂的国策。

ckiphk.en: ⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work. Otherwise, Germany will not invite you to the ⟦1⟧.
ckiphk.zh: 必须禁用⟦0⟧这个策略才能奏效。否则，德国不会邀请你加入⟦1⟧。

c5o2ox.en: As ⟦0⟧, do the Political Effort focus for political power. Then assign a communist revolutionary.
c5o2ox.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，选取国策「政治努力」以获取政治点数。然后指派一位共产主义革命者。

rmbd58.en: When the war starts, justify on a French state they'll keep e.g. French India or New Caledonia.
rmbd58.zh: 当战争开始时，对一个法国会保有的州制造战争目标，例如法属印度或新喀里多尼亚。

4lwqja.en: Aim to flip fascist peacefully before WW2 starts. Should be possible by late 1938/early 1939.
4lwqja.zh: 目标是在二战开始前和平转为法西斯。这应该能在 1938 年末/1939 年初做到。

1v9cndo.en: Justify on ⟦0⟧. Reset the run if the ⟦1⟧ guarantees ⟦2⟧. This most likely will not happen.
1v9cndo.zh: 对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。如果⟦1⟧保障⟦2⟧，就重开这一局。这很可能不会发生。

1smknw5.en: In the meantime build civilian factories up to 41 to avoid the debuff from low stability.
1smknw5.zh: 与此同时，把民用工厂建到 41 个，以避免低稳定度带来的减益。

416abr.en: Make sure you have a war goal ready on ⟦0⟧ just before or after Germany declares on ⟦1⟧.
416abr.zh: 务必准备好对⟦0⟧的战争目标，就在德国对⟦1⟧宣战之前或之后不久。

1q5ih5y.en: Once you control the Danish mainland cores you now ⟦0⟧ for some extra manpower, etc.
1q5ih5y.zh: 一旦你控制了丹麦本土的核心，你现在就可以⟦0⟧以获取一些额外人力等等。

dh9d1r.en: Can be expanded into ⟦0⟧ from here; getting ships in the peace deal can help later.
dh9d1r.zh: 从这里可以扩张为⟦0⟧；在和平会议中获得舰船对之后会有帮助。

1paf1vs.en: From this point on focus on improving your economy and conscription laws.
1paf1vs.zh: 从此刻起，专注于改善你的经济与征兵法案。

otcjle.en: Go for your own path, not directly towards becoming a German puppet.
otcjle.zh: 走你自己的路线，不要直接走向成为德国傀儡。

7d47cm.en: Support the Axis by invading the ⟦0⟧ via naval invasion or paradrop.
7d47cm.zh: 通过海军登陆或空降入侵⟦0⟧来支援轴心国。

b78wyt.en: If you want to continue up to ⟦0⟧ also grab the Sapmi cores in ⟦1⟧.
b78wyt.zh: 如果你想继续推进到⟦0⟧，也一并夺取⟦1⟧中的萨米核心。

bpkuu4.en: Once the war is over, take Danzig and the achievement is yours.
bpkuu4.zh: 一旦战争结束，拿下但泽，成就就是你的了。

13e5o34.en: As Sweden, own and control Danzig
13e5o34.zh: 作为瑞典，拥有并控制但泽

xwezgw.en: This can be done with ⟦0⟧ also.

4hhgzy.en: The ⟦0⟧ is easier to defeat the earlier you can attack them - instead of instigating the Loyalist Uprisings in the dominions, declare war on them directly and puppet them in peace deals; do not directly declare on Canada, as you don't want to fight the United States at the same time; declare on one of the other 3 dominions and Canada will be called in. Occupy at least one space from ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, and then capitulate Canada (if you want to also get the ⟦4⟧ at this point, feel free to declare on them as well; if Pakistan has spawned, wait for them to white peace with India before declaring on them, since they won't join the Commonwealth of Nations while at war with another member; like with the other 3 dominions, just occupy one tile each of Burma, India, and Pakistan).
4hhgzy.zh: ⟦0⟧越早进攻就越容易被击败——不要去煽动各自治领的保皇派起义，而是直接对它们宣战，并在和平会议中把它们傀儡化；不要直接对加拿大宣战，因为你不希望同时与美国作战；对另外 3 个自治领之一宣战，加拿大就会被拉进来。至少占领⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧各一块地，然后迫使加拿大投降（如果你此时也想拿到⟦4⟧，尽管对它们宣战；如果巴基斯坦已经生成，就等它与印度白和之后再对它宣战，因为它在与另一个成员国交战时不会加入国际联盟；与其他 3 个自治领一样，只需各占领缅甸、印度与巴基斯坦的一块地）。

14p5j9.en: During the peace deal, focus on taking American land - the Axis will be mostly focused on Africa and Mainland Europe (if you didn't generate enough war score, take the coastal states + Alaska and Hawaii first, then the states bordering Canada and ⟦0⟧; then, take the rest of the inner states; if the Axis manage to make a puppet of the US with one of their cores, you should be strong enough to beat the Axis if you attack while they're dealing with the ⟦1⟧) - if you want to annex the US, you can puppet them using a non-core state and still take the decision. After defeating the US, select the "Install American Monarchy" decision (said decision will not pop up if you haven't completed Unite the Anglosphere), and release Scotland as a puppet.
14p5j9.zh: 在和平会议期间，专注于夺取美国领土——轴心国主要会专注于非洲与欧洲大陆（如果你没有积累足够的战争分数，就先拿下沿海各州以及阿拉斯加和夏威夷，然后拿下与加拿大和⟦0⟧接壤的各州；之后，再拿其余内陆各州；如果轴心国成功用美国的一个核心把它变成傀儡国，那么只要你在他们正应付⟦1⟧时发动进攻，你应该足够强大到击败轴心国）——如果你想吞并美国，可以用一个非核心州把它们傀儡化，同时仍然能采纳该决议。在击败美国之后，选取「建立美国君主制」决议（如果你没有完成「统一盎格鲁圈」，该决议不会弹出），并把苏格兰作为傀儡国释放。

1aa4uu9.en: Train up at least 72-96 troops (because of the US's starting conscription and economic laws, if tension isn't high enough, the US won't have a lot of troops by 1938), and also 10 cavalry divisions to secure the Alaskan-Canadian Border (Imperial Conscription + going to Extensive Conscription, as well as taking Reassess Continental Commitments should give you more than enough manpower). If you hold off on forming the Imperial Federation until after defeating the United States, you should be able to declare war on the US by late-1938/early 1939.
1aa4uu9.zh: 至少训练 72 到 96 个部队（由于美国的起始征兵与经济法案，如果紧张度不够高，到 1938 年美国不会有太多部队），另外再训练 10 个骑兵师以确保阿拉斯加-加拿大边境安全（「帝国征兵」加上转为「广泛征兵」，以及选取「重新评估大陆义务」，应该能给你绰绰有余的人力）。如果你把组建帝国联邦推迟到击败美国之后，你应该能在 1938 年末/1939 年初对美国宣战。

o76uyf.en: After completing Unite the Anglosphere, attack from Canada using the war goal that focus gave you, and capitulate them. The ⟦0⟧ will likely also get involved (either they'll invite the US to their faction or the US will form a faction and France will join), so stage some naval invasions across the channel to capitulate them (they likely won't have removed the disjointed government spirit by this point, so just take a few victory points and Paris to capitulate them).
o76uyf.zh: 在完成「统一盎格鲁圈」之后，利用该焦点给你的战争目标从加拿大发动进攻，并迫使它们投降。⟦0⟧很可能也会卷入（要么它们会把美国邀请进它们的阵营，要么美国会组建一个阵营而法国会加入），所以跨越海峡安排一些海军登陆以迫使它们投降（此时它们很可能还没有移除「政府分裂」国家精神，所以只需拿下几个胜利点与巴黎就能迫使它们投降）。

1fmw3cc.en: As the United Kingdom, put Edward VIII in power, enforce an American monarchy, and have both it and Scotland as subjects.
1fmw3cc.zh: 作为英国，让爱德华八世掌权，强制建立美国君主制，并让美国与苏格兰都成为附属国。

fhv8rd.en: You need to either annex all USA core states, or puppet the USA and let it have all core states.
fhv8rd.zh: 你要么吞并美国所有核心州，要么把美国傀儡化并让它拥有所有核心州。

7c7fy0.en: Once you have annexed/puppeted the USA, a decision will appear to install an American Monarchy.
7c7fy0.zh: 一旦你吞并/傀儡化了美国，就会出现一个建立美国君主制的决议。

1lw9gs.en: You need to ensure Royal Marriage, so Wallis would be Queen Wallis
1lw9gs.zh: 你需要确保王室联姻，这样沃利斯就会成为沃利斯王后

1k79f69.en: You need take focus Unite the Anglosphere
1k79f69.zh: 你需要选取国策「统一盎格鲁圈」

1fpxdfc.zh: 要强制建立美国君主制：

1chbq5h.en: Note that the available states depending on where the entity is used (i.e. a unit entity will get combat states, where as a building entity will get building states, etc). All entities share the ⟦0⟧ state.
1chbq5h.zh: 请注意，可用状态取决于实体用在何处（即单位实体会获得战斗状态，而建筑实体会获得建筑状态等等）。所有实体都共用⟦0⟧状态。

g446q6.en: ⟦0⟧ determines the chance of this state entry occuring if it shares its name with multiple other state entries (i.e. training, whether to pushup, jumping jack, etc.)
g446q6.zh: ⟦0⟧决定当该状态条目与多个其他状态条目同名时（即训练、是否做俯卧撑、开合跳等等），此状态条目出现的几率。

1t1nl9k.en: Once a mesh is defined, you then need to add an entity definition to use it within script. This is done within a ⟦0⟧ file that you need to add within your mod.
1t1nl9k.zh: 一旦网格定义完成，你还需要添加一个实体定义，才能在脚本中使用它。这需要在你模组内添加的⟦0⟧文件中完成。

905rhc.en: Entities are definitions used by Hearts of Iron IV to link models with script objects that are used in places such as ⟦0⟧.
905rhc.zh: 实体是《钢铁雄心 4》用来把模型与脚本对象链接起来的定义，用于⟦0⟧等地方。

oy3f2b.en: To add a mesh, you need to add a ⟦0⟧ file in your mod that includes a mesh definition. Here is a generic example:
oy3f2b.zh: 要添加一个网格，你需要在模组中添加一个包含网格定义的⟦0⟧文件。以下是一个通用示例：

iqvn6l.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scope added for each animation associated with the mesh, linking the animation to an animation state.
iqvn6l.zh: ⟦0⟧是为该网格关联的每个动画添加的作用域，用于把动画链接到一个动画状态。

1rb955q.en: ⟦0⟧ inherits the state of the parent entity (i.e. used by the weapon entity that is part of a soldier).
1rb955q.zh: ⟦0⟧继承父实体的状态（即由作为士兵一部分的武器实体使用）。

h7pdpe.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the node from the entities skeleton, and the value is the entity to attach.
h7pdpe.zh: ⟦0⟧是实体骨架中节点的名称，其值是要附着的实体。

18knv99.en: ⟦0⟧ is the position of the location node, with the values being x, y and z co-ordinates.
18knv99.zh: ⟦0⟧是定位节点的位置，其值为 x、y、z 坐标。

1ex9v0t.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scope that attachs another entity to a skeleton node of the current entity.
1ex9v0t.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个作用域，用于把另一个实体附着到当前实体的骨架节点上。

1cbs3w2.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the state that a model may enter. All models have an ⟦1⟧ state.
1cbs3w2.zh: ⟦0⟧是模型可以进入的状态的名称。所有模型都有一个⟦1⟧状态。

1s81u0m.en: ⟦0⟧ specifies a locator node or model node to set the event position origin to.
1s81u0m.zh: ⟦0⟧指定一个定位节点或模型节点，以把事件位置原点设置到该处。

15z26rt.en: Animations for models are added in a ⟦0⟧ file found in ⟦1⟧ or the sub-folders.
15z26rt.zh: 模型的动画添加在⟦0⟧文件中，该文件位于⟦1⟧或其子文件夹里。

as93uu.en: ⟦0⟧ determines whether the particle persists past the duration of the event.
as93uu.zh: ⟦0⟧决定粒子是否在事件持续时间结束后继续存在。

1d0bjih.en: ⟦0⟧ is the relative filepath to the model that the mesh it associated with.
1d0bjih.zh: ⟦0⟧是其所关联模型文件的相对路径。

1msyjqu.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the entity that is referred to in places such as ⟦1⟧.
1msyjqu.zh: ⟦0⟧是实体的名称，用于⟦1⟧等地方引用。

2mbn3l.en: ⟦0⟧ is the blend time between the current and the specified animation.
2mbn3l.zh: ⟦0⟧是当前动画与指定动画之间的混合时间。

j9u9n.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the mesh that is then referred to in an ⟦1⟧ file.
j9u9n.zh: ⟦0⟧是网格的名称，随后会在⟦1⟧文件中被引用。

otqluz.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the actual animation defined in an .asset file.
otqluz.zh: ⟦0⟧是在 .asset 文件中定义的实际动画的名称。

1n1vg39.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scope added for each animation associated with the mesh.
1n1vg39.zh: ⟦0⟧是为该网格关联的每个动画添加的作用域。

icw7av.en: ⟦0⟧ is a distance at which the entity is culled from rendering.

fhhigf.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of animation that is then referred to in a ⟦1⟧.
fhhigf.zh: ⟦0⟧是动画的名称，随后会在⟦1⟧中被引用。

ip4ryo.en: Here is a comprehesive example of all possible attributes:
ip4ryo.zh: 以下是所有可能属性的完整示例：

1wpahuu.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scope that applies a particle or sound effect.
1wpahuu.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个作用域，用于施加粒子或音效。

1obqvz3.en: ⟦0⟧ propagates the current state to the specified node.
1obqvz3.zh: ⟦0⟧把当前状态传播到指定节点。

2nt09a.en: ⟦0⟧ is the animation state (from the pdxmesh) to play.
2nt09a.zh: ⟦0⟧是要播放的动画状态（来自 pdxmesh）。

1xa548v.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the animation within the pdxmesh.

i43caq.en: ⟦0⟧ is the default animation state for the entity.

1ndzjb8.en: ⟦0⟧ determines whether the event occurs only once.
1ndzjb8.zh: ⟦0⟧决定该事件是否只发生一次。

sw24dt.en: ⟦0⟧ determines whether this state loops or not.

io6i8t.en: The animation scope contains these attributes:
io6i8t.zh: 动画作用域包含以下属性：

euxdrq.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scope that adds a node to the entity.
euxdrq.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个作用域，用于向实体添加节点。

qxa9iw.en: ⟦0⟧ sets the next state for the current state.
qxa9iw.zh: ⟦0⟧为当前状态设置下一个状态。

1pkvys8.en: ⟦0⟧ is the relative filepath to the animation.

1vfwv8d.en: ⟦0⟧ is the duration of the event in seconds.
1vfwv8d.zh: ⟦0⟧是事件的持续时间，以秒为单位。

1bhwsa9.en: The locator scope contains these attributes:
1bhwsa9.zh: 定位作用域包含以下属性：

12y5cem.en: ⟦0⟧ is the mesh associated with the entity.

1u17c5r.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scalar for the size of the entity.

14wjyzh.en: ⟦0⟧ is the playback speed of the animation.

cca1hx.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scope that applies a sound effect.
cca1hx.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个作用域，用于施加音效。

1k17f09.en: ⟦0⟧ is a scalar for the size of the model.

6s5hqg.en: The state scope contains these attributes:
6s5hqg.zh: 状态作用域包含以下属性：

cbrulj.en: The event scope contains these attributes:
cbrulj.zh: 事件作用域包含以下属性：

1l85jxm.en: The sound scope contains these attributes:
1l85jxm.zh: 声音作用域包含以下属性：

1covpbd.en: ⟦0⟧ is the duration of the current state.

7xxc67.en: Both ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ files are found in ⟦2⟧.

ukwnn.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the attached entity.

13s2zxg.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the locator node.

1ulh4iq.en: ⟦0⟧ is the sound effect to play.

sdjud1.en: Has 5 levels that can be researched which span from 1936 and 1943. Each new level provides the same bonuses besides the first one, which provides slightly more ⟦0⟧ reduction than the rest. By choosing ⟦1⟧, the player reduces the vulnerability of their factories to ⟦2⟧, as well as increasing the base production efficiency of all of their production lines and the retention of said efficiency compared to what they would get by choosing ⟦3⟧. This reduces the player's susceptibility to ⟦4⟧, makes newly built military factories more efficient for the first couple of months of production, and allows the player more leeway in reacting to changes in production needs, including when switching them to upgraded versions of newly outdated equipment.
sdjud1.zh: 共有 5 个等级可研究，时间跨度从 1936 年到 1943 年。除第一个等级外，每个新等级提供相同的加成；第一个等级提供的⟦0⟧削减略多于其余等级。通过选择⟦1⟧，玩家能降低其工厂对⟦2⟧的脆弱性，同时提高其所有生产线的基准生产效率以及该效率的保持率，相比选择⟦3⟧所得到的更多。这降低了玩家对⟦4⟧的敏感度，使新建的军用工厂在生产的最初几个月里效率更高，并让玩家在应对生产需求变化时有更大余裕，包括把生产线切换为刚刚过时装备的升级型号时。

k7on9q.en: One can think of the two styles as maximizing potential production at any given production efficiency vs. decreasing time to achieve 100% production efficiency. In general, the ⟦0⟧ option produces more output after about a year to a year-and-a-half producing the same equipment on the same production line, while the ⟦1⟧ option produces more output in the first year to year-and-a-half of a new production line and the first two to three years for an existing production line that has been switched to produce an upgraded version of the same equipment type.⟦2⟧
k7on9q.zh: 可以把这两种风格理解为「在任何给定生产效率下最大化潜在产出」与「缩短达到 100% 生产效率所需的时间」。总体而言，在生产同一条生产线上产出相同装备大约一年到一年半之后，⟦0⟧选项产出更多；而在一条新生产线的最初一年到一年半里，以及一条既有生产线被切换为生产同类型装备升级型号后的最初两到三年里，⟦1⟧选项产出更多。⟦2⟧

1g2ln5l.en: ⟦0⟧ unlocks technologies related to industrial output, construction speed, repair speed, resource gain efficiency, fuel gain efficiency, and the construction of fuel infrastructure and synthetic refineries. Like ⟦1⟧, industry technologies tend to provide general bonuses on the country level, but unlike engineering technologies, these bonuses are all strictly related to economic bonuses, both direct and indirect.
1g2ln5l.zh: ⟦0⟧解锁与工业产出、建造速度、维修速度、资源获取效率、燃料获取效率，以及燃料基础设施与合成炼油厂建造相关的科技。像⟦1⟧一样，工业科技往往在国家层面提供通用加成，但与工程科技不同，这些加成全都严格与经济相关，无论直接还是间接。

14av3no.en: Has 5 levels that can be researched which span from 1936 to 1943. Each new level provides the same bonus as previous levels. By choosing ⟦0⟧, the player increases the output of their military factories more than what they would get by choosing ⟦1⟧. This allows the player to make both new and existing military factories more efficient, though only if they are assigned to producing the same equipment for a while.
14av3no.zh: 共有 5 个等级可研究，时间跨度从 1936 年到 1943 年。每个新等级提供的加成与之前等级相同。通过选择⟦0⟧，玩家提高其军用工厂产出的幅度大于选择⟦1⟧所能得到的。这使玩家能把新建与既有的军用工厂都变得更有效率，但前提是它们被分配去生产相同装备一段时间。

hhabcv.en: Both the ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ industry branches have their advantages and drawbacks, and the choice for which one to use depends on the player's play style. Should situations change in-game, players can also always switch from one branch to another, though doing so will force them to have to research all of the technologies in that branch from scratch.
hhabcv.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧工业分支各有其优势与劣势，选择使用哪一个取决于玩家的游玩风格。如果游戏内情况发生变化，玩家也总是可以从一个分支切换到另一个，不过这样做会迫使他们必须从头研究该分支中的所有科技。

1mwipso.en: as a result of this change: ⟦0⟧ increase per day is ⟦1⟧ what it was at a cap of ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ what it was at a cap of ⟦5⟧
1mwipso.zh: 此改动的结果：每天⟦0⟧增长为原来的⟦1⟧，原上限为⟦2⟧，⟦3⟧为原来的⟦4⟧，原上限为⟦5⟧

9rbj28.en: as a result of this change: ⟦0⟧ increase per day is ⟦1⟧ what it was at a cap of ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ what it was at a cap of ⟦5⟧
9rbj28.zh: 此改动的结果：每天⟦0⟧增长为原来的⟦1⟧，原上限为⟦2⟧⟦3⟧，⟦4⟧为原来的⟦5⟧

1i3r2mp.en: Aggressive focus decreases the threshold to execute battle plans, making the AI more likely to activate risky plans. It increases the research priority of synthetic refineries, motorization and armor. It defaults to 50 during peace (fascist countries 75), 0 when being in a defensive war and 100 when being in an aggressive war. Italy has a +50% bonus due to the Vittoria Mutilata national idea.
1i3r2mp.zh: 进攻性倾向会降低执行作战计划的门槛，使 AI 更可能启动有风险的计划。它会提高合成炼油厂、摩托化与装甲的科研优先级。它在和平时默认为 50（法西斯国家为 75），处于防御性战争时为 0，处于进攻性战争时为 100。意大利因「被肢解的胜利」国家理念获得 +50% 加成。

s1jxmr.en: Multiplied with PLAN_VALUE_TO_EXECUTE, defensive focus increases the threshold to execute battle plans. It increases the research priority of RADAR, construction and artillery among others. It defaults to 50 during peace, 100 when being in a defensive war and 0 when being in an aggressive war. France has a +50% bonus due to Édouard Daladier's Stout Defender trait.
s1jxmr.zh: 与 PLAN_VALUE_TO_EXECUTE 相乘后，防御性倾向会提高执行作战计划的门槛。它会提高雷达、建造与火炮等的科研优先级。它在和平时默认为 50，处于防御性战争时为 100，处于进攻性战争时为 0。法国因爱德华·达拉第的「坚定防御者」特质获得 +50% 加成。

k6x19s.en: Naval focus increases the research priority of naval doctrines by a large amount, marines and ship technologies to a lesser extent. Countries with dockyards have a default value of number_of_dockyards + (convoys_in_use + imported_resources)/5, capped at 100. This is reduced by 25% when at peace. Countries without dockyards default to -999.
k6x19s.zh: 海军倾向会大幅提高海军学说的科研优先级，并在较小幅度上提高海军陆战队与舰船科技的优先级。拥有船坞的国家默认值为 number_of_dockyards + (convoys_in_use + imported_resources)/5，上限 100。和平时此值降低 25%。没有船坞的国家默认为 -999。

1uam4tq.en: AI focuses balance competing interests in several aspects of the game such as being more or less careful with attacks or prioritizing one field of research over another. Every AI country has a value for each of the focuses with higher values making the country focus more on that characteristic.
1uam4tq.zh: AI 倾向在游戏的若干方面平衡相互竞争的利益，例如对进攻更谨慎或更不谨慎，或者把某个研究领域置于另一个之上。每个 AI 国家都为每个倾向设有一个数值，数值越高，该国越侧重于该特性。

1pzvhr.en: Aviation focus increases the research priority of air doctrines by a large amount, paratroopers and plane technologies to a lesser extent. The default value is 10 times the number of airports, capped at 100. This is reduced by 25% when at peace. Countries without airports default to -999.
1pzvhr.zh: 航空倾向会大幅提高空军学说的科研优先级，并在较小幅度上提高伞兵与飞机科技的优先级。默认值为机场数量的 10 倍，上限 100。和平时此值降低 25%。没有机场的国家默认为 -999。

nxm30.en: To add historical national focuses, you add a ⟦0⟧ that contains the national focuses the AI should prioritize. This system has been somewhat super-seeded by AI strategy plans which allow for historical focus lists but also deviating from them when basic assumptions are broken.
nxm30.zh: 要添加历史国策，你需要添加一个⟦0⟧，其中包含 AI 应优先选取的国策。这个系统在某种程度上已被 AI 战略计划取代，后者既允许历史焦点列表，也允许在基本假设被打破时偏离它们。

1yttpn2.en: Each of the AI focuses can be changed with a matching country specific modifier called ai_focus_<x>_factor that gets applied after the default calculations above. E.g. ai_focus_naval_air_factor = 0.5 adds a 50% bonus to the naval air focus of the country.
1yttpn2.zh: 每个 AI 倾向都可以用一个对应的国家特定修正来改变，名为 ai_focus_<x>_factor，它在上述默认计算之后被应用。例如 ai_focus_naval_air_factor = 0.5 会为该国的海军航空倾向增加 50% 加成。

10wtwaj.en: Military advancements focus increases the research priority for various advanced military techs like jets, night vision, nuclear etc. It defaults to 25 times the number of research slots (capped at 100) when at war and is reduced by 25% when at peace.
10wtwaj.zh: 军事进步倾向会提高各类先进军事科技的科研优先级，例如喷气机、夜视、核能等。战时它默认为科研槽数量的 25 倍（上限 100），和平时降低 25%。

1abspwz.en: Naval air focus increases the research priority of carrier plane variants and naval bombers. The default value is 20 times the number of carriers, capped at 100. This is reduced by 25% when at peace. Countries without carriers default to -999.
1abspwz.zh: 海军航空倾向会提高舰载机变体与海军轰炸机的科研优先级。默认值为航母数量的 20 倍，上限 100。和平时此值降低 25%。没有航母的国家默认为 -999。

1su709i.en: Military equipment focus increases the research priority of infantry technologies by a large amount, artillery and support equipment to a lesser extent. The default value is 75 when at peace, 100 when at war.
1su709i.zh: 军事装备倾向会大幅提高步兵科技的科研优先级，并在较小幅度上提高火炮与支援装备的优先级。默认值为和平时 75，战时 100。

4vebe3.en: War production focus increases the research priority of industry and electronics techs to a lesser extent. It defaults to 10 during peace (fascist countries 30) and 100 when at war.
4vebe3.zh: 战争生产倾向会在较小幅度上提高工业与电子科技的科研优先级。它在和平时默认为 10（法西斯国家为 30），战时为 100。

urovej.en: This focus doesn't have a value attached to it, but the AI will follow the national focuses in the specified order if historical AI focuses is enabled.
urovej.zh: 这个倾向本身没有附加数值，但如果启用了历史 AI 焦点，AI 会按指定顺序遵循国策。

1rauvi8.en: Peaceful focus increases the research priority for industry and electronics. It is 100 when at peace, 0 when at war.
1rauvi8.zh: 和平倾向会提高工业与电子的科研优先级。和平时为 100，战时为 0。

1iz1s4z.en: Each focus name can be postfixed with a country tag to make a specific focus setup for a country, i.e. ⟦0⟧.
1iz1s4z.zh: 每个倾向名称都可以附加一个国家标签，以为某个国家制定特定的倾向设置，即⟦0⟧。

1v7gqp8.en: The ⟦0⟧ files controls how much the AI focuses affect which kinds of research and national focuses.
1v7gqp8.zh: ⟦0⟧文件控制 AI 倾向对哪些类型的研究与国策产生多大影响。

r1jm4u.en: La Résistance adds secret agents, espionage missions, and new options for resistance movements to Hearts of Iron IV. Send agents into dangerous territory to decipher enemy secrets or prepare the ground for your invasion by propping up collaborators who will be happy for any taste of power.
r1jm4u.zh: 《抵抗运动》为《钢铁雄心 4》添加了秘密特工、特工任务以及抵抗运动的新选项。把特工派入危险地带以破译敌方机密，或通过扶植那些只要尝到一点权力滋味就会心满意足的合作者，为你的人侵做好准备。

13jwx9b.en: The enemy has installed a puppet government in an allied nation. Brave individuals promise to fight against their occupiers and oppressors. Use your agile espionage skills to support the work of La Résistance.
13jwx9b.zh: 敌人在一个盟国中安插了傀儡政府。勇敢的人们誓言要与占领者与压迫者斗争。运用你灵巧的特工技能来支援抵抗运动的工作。

6smnct.en: ⟦0⟧: Use your ⟦1⟧ to train spies to specialize in certain types of information warfare and develop passive resistance to enemy espionage, then let them perform ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
6smnct.zh: ⟦0⟧：使用你的⟦1⟧来训练特工，使其专精于某些类型的信息战，并培养对敌方间谍活动的被动抵抗能力，然后让他们执行⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧。

1kvhn65.en: ⟦0⟧ is the 3rd major ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧. It was announced on 2019-10-19⟦3⟧ and was released on 2020-02-25⟦4⟧. The expansion coincides with patch 1.9 (aka "Husky").
1kvhn65.zh: ⟦0⟧是⟦1⟧的第 3 个主要扩展，用于⟦2⟧。它于 2019-10-19⟦3⟧公布，并于 2020-02-25⟦4⟧发布。该扩展与 1.9 补丁（又名「哈士奇」）同时推出。

18d9hgx.en: ⟦0⟧: Scout planes can provide useful information on nearby areas while Armored cars help in detecting and suppressing resistance activities.
18d9hgx.zh: ⟦0⟧：侦察机可以提供附近区域的有用情报，而装甲车有助于侦测与压制抵抗活动。

3tvfw.en: ⟦0⟧: New National Focuses for ⟦1⟧ and the ⟦2⟧ Regime, as well as an option for conservatives to restore the old French Monarchy.
3tvfw.zh: ⟦0⟧：为⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧政权提供新的国策，并为保守派提供恢复旧法国君主制的选项。

575d2q.en: ⟦0⟧: Navigate the pressure of the World War, or involve yourself in the Spanish Conflict with the new Focus Tree for ⟦1⟧.
575d2q.zh: ⟦0⟧：在世界大战的压力中周旋，或用⟦1⟧的新国策树投身西班牙冲突。

15uch19.en: ⟦0⟧: Use your agents to prepare the ground for collaborators to fill the void once you’ve conquered your target.
15uch19.zh: ⟦0⟧：使用你的特工为合作者铺平道路，以便在你征服目标之后由他们填补权力真空。
