tlotae.en: This branch is split into a puppet section and an independent section. the puppet section gives research bonuses as well as a research slot. The independent section is also split into two sections. The first section allows the nation make the leader of the country a field marshal as well as gain war goals on other nations within the Horn of Africa and will be able to create the Horn of Africa formable nation. The other section allows alliances with foreign nations as well as sending volunteers.
tlotae.zh: 该分支分为傀儡部分与独立部分。傀儡部分提供科研加成以及一个科研槽。独立部分又分为两个部分。第一部分允许该国把国家领袖设为陆军元帅，并获得对非洲之角内其他国家的战争目标，且能够创建非洲之角可成立国家。另一部分允许与外国结盟以及派遣志愿军。

1k8720k.en: When released as a ⟦0⟧ subject of ⟦1⟧, it is known as the ⟦2⟧. When released from event chain via focus Topple Amhara Rulers, it will become a subject of ⟦3⟧, be known as Gojjam and gain a core on ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧.
1k8720k.zh: 当作为⟦0⟧附属国被⟦1⟧释放时，它被称为⟦2⟧。当通过国策「推翻阿姆哈拉统治者」由事件链释放时，它会成为⟦3⟧的附属国，被称为戈贾姆，并获得⟦4⟧⟦5⟧的核心。

17t33bi.en: When released as a ⟦0⟧ subject of ⟦1⟧, it is known as the ⟦2⟧. When released from event chain via focus Topple Amhara Rulers, it will become a subject of ⟦3⟧, be known as Jimma and gain a core on ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧.
17t33bi.zh: 当作为⟦0⟧附属国被⟦1⟧释放时，它被称为⟦2⟧。当通过国策「推翻阿姆哈拉统治者」由事件链释放时，它会成为⟦3⟧的附属国，被称为吉马，并获得⟦4⟧⟦5⟧的核心。

1mapte5.en: The army branch improves the irregular infantry, gives bonuses to the army, and depending on the nation, gives a national spirit that either boosts combat ability, factory output or research speed.
1mapte5.zh: 陆军分支改进非正规步兵，为陆军提供加成，并视国家不同给予一项国家精神，该精神会提升战斗能力、工厂产出或科研速度。

1c6m97f.en: ⟦0⟧: The number of cores and factories etc. are from the 1936 start with the "Ethiopia Fragmented" Custom Game Rule enabled.
1c6m97f.zh: ⟦0⟧：核心与工厂等数量取自启用「埃塞俄比亚四分五裂」自定义游戏规则的 1936 年开局。

fq9ny8.en: This branch develops the nation, gives bonuses to naval or air, and gives resources depending on the nation played.
fq9ny8.zh: 该分支发展国家，提供海军或空军加成，并视所游玩的国家提供资源。

1u5j5gr.en: When released as a ⟦0⟧ subject of ⟦1⟧, it is known as the ⟦2⟧. As a ⟦3⟧ subject of ⟦4⟧, it is known as the ⟦5⟧.
1u5j5gr.zh: 当作为⟦0⟧附属国被⟦1⟧释放时，它被称为⟦2⟧。作为⟦3⟧附属国被⟦4⟧拥有时，它被称为⟦5⟧。

6998gx.en: Also has a core on Djibouti. Has the only ⟦0⟧ core when the "Ethiopia Fragmented" Custom Game Rule is enabled.
6998gx.zh: 在吉布提也拥有一个核心。当启用「埃塞俄比亚四分五裂」自定义游戏规则时，拥有唯一的⟦0⟧核心。

dgb0w3.en: The Horn of Africa national focus tree can be divided into 3 branches:
dgb0w3.zh: 非洲之角国策树可以分为 3 个分支：

dbdw43.en: This focus tree is available to the ⟦0⟧ if the ⟦1⟧ DLC is enabled.
dbdw43.zh: ⟦0⟧可以使用这棵国策树，前提是启用了⟦1⟧DLC。

55sacz.en: Shares a core with Somalia. Also has two cores on ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
55sacz.zh: 与索马里共享一个核心。另外在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧上拥有两个核心。

1nfw0dd.en: When released as a ⟦0⟧ subject of ⟦1⟧, it is known as the ⟦2⟧.
1nfw0dd.zh: 当作为⟦0⟧附属国被⟦1⟧释放时，它被称为⟦2⟧。

14ebjlh.en: Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Socialist Union
14ebjlh.zh: 南方各族人民社会主义联盟

1c1vlsz.en: All ⟦0⟧ are able to form the Horn of Africa via decision.
1c1vlsz.zh: 所有⟦0⟧都能通过决议成立非洲之角。

1ruk1zk.en: Begemder Democratic Republic of People's Unity
1ruk1zk.zh: 贝格姆德尔人民团结民主共和国

wqm8ie.zh: 提格里尼亚人民革命人民国

14i6i2x.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a ⟦1⟧ country with no elections.

377xge.zh: 阿法尔革命民主统一阵线

1yd9f2l.en: Futurist Union of Qemant and Qwaran People
1yd9f2l.zh: 凯曼特与夸拉人民未来主义联盟

1prsdir.en: Only Aussa starts with a national spirit.
1prsdir.zh: 只有奥萨开局时拥有国家精神。

6zs1ia.en: Socialist Union of Funj and Gumuz Peoples
6zs1ia.zh: 丰吉与古穆兹人民社会主义联盟

14c6wwm.en: Event via focus Topple Amhara Rulers
14c6wwm.zh: 通过国策「推翻阿姆哈拉统治者」触发的事件

p9sahy.zh: 贝尼尚古尔-古穆兹自治区

nkrfx2.zh: 哈勒里人民社会主义共和国

ff2lz.zh: 阿努阿克-努埃尔人民人民国

kjysna.en: List of Horn of Africa nations

80w1qi.zh: 贝尼尚古尔-古穆兹共和国

1y9d5c2.en: The ⟦0⟧ are ⟦1⟧ that make up the core territory of ⟦2⟧. They can be released through the ⟦3⟧ tab like any other releasable country, but not by ⟦4⟧ with the ⟦5⟧ DLC enabled. They are released from game start if the "Ethiopia Fragmented" Custom Game Rule is enabled. The ⟦6⟧ starts as an independent country in 1936, but will normally be annexed by ⟦7⟧ early in the game via an event during historical playthroughs.
1y9d5c2.zh: ⟦0⟧是⟦1⟧，而这些国家构成了⟦2⟧的核心领土。它们可以像任何其他可释放国家一样通过⟦3⟧标签页释放，但在⟦4⟧于启用⟦5⟧DLC 时不能释放。如果启用了「埃塞俄比亚四分五裂」自定义游戏规则，它们在游戏开局时即被释放。⟦6⟧在 1936 年开局时是一个独立国家，但在历史游玩流程中通常会在游戏早期通过一个事件被⟦7⟧吞并。

3w40zn.en: After Malaya is done, move your troops to the French border. What's happened here is that as soon as you move your troops into position and/or France joins the Allies, they will send a large army over to sit on your border. However, it takes time for those units to get there, since they have to be shipped from overseas. You want to go in on France as soon as you can. As long as you have ~14 divisions and France has less than 5, you shouldn't have much of an issue, but make sure to aim for the ports. If you capture the 4 ports in Indochina, France can no longer receive that overseas army, and you've essentially won.
3w40zn.zh: 马来亚搞定之后，把你的部队调到法国边境。这里发生的情况是：一旦你把部队部署到位，并且/或者法国加入盟国，他们就会派一支庞大的军队过来驻守在你的边境上。不过，那些部队需要时间才能抵达，因为它们必须从海外运来。你要尽可能早地进攻法国。只要你有约 14 个师而法国少于 5 个师，应该不会有太大问题，但务必以港口为目标。如果你拿下中南半岛的 4 个港口，法国就再也无法接收那支海外军队，你基本上就赢了。

633hju.en: When you complete Retake Lost British States in mid-1937, it's go time. Take Burma first, then do Malaya. When doing these limited wars, don't bother trying to hold the borders you aren't attacking into. The goal is to be done in under a month with every conquest. If you get held up, you've probably already lost. Play on a non-max game speed and direct every unit, focusing on pinning enemy divisions while moving around theirs. You need to capture the majority of the victory points within the highlighted area (when you mouse over the decision to start the limited war) in order to end the limited war.
633hju.zh: 当你在 1937 年中期完成「夺回失去的英国各州」时，就是动手的时候了。先拿下缅甸，再做马来亚。打这些有限战争时，不必费心去守住你不进攻的那些边境。目标是在一个月内结束每一次征服。如果你被拖住了，很可能你已经输了。以非最高游戏速度游玩，并手动指挥每一个单位，专注于牵制敌方师、同时绕过它们机动。你需要在（把鼠标悬停在开始有限战争的决议上时）高亮区域内夺取大多数胜利点，才能结束这场有限战争。

1pvdob8.en: Get the Army Offense (Expert) quickly and use the first 15 Army experience to change the template by removing a regiment of Infantry (bringing the width down from 18 to 12). Train as many divisions as you can at once without running out of equipment (probably around ~10 total, though you might have to force deploy the last couple). Make sure to grab the Infantry (Expert) before you go to war.
1pvdob8.zh: 尽快拿到「陆军进攻（专家）」，并用最初的 15 点陆军经验修改编制，去掉一个步兵 regiment（把宽度从 18 降到 12）。在装备不耗尽的前提下尽可能多地同时训练师（大概总共 10 个上下，最后几个可能得强制部署）。务必在开战前拿到「步兵（专家）」。

qzf93c.en: The biggest challenge will be to get compliance to 65%. The civic faction spirit buff gives 0.05% compliance gain applied AFTER the high compliance malus, therefore making compliance rise fairly quickly. Wait with the compliance decisions until you own all the required land, as losing control will cost you most of your gathered compliance.
qzf93c.zh: 最大的挑战是把顺从度提到 65%。公民派系精神加成提供 0.05% 的顺从度增长，且它是在高顺从度减益**之后**才应用的，因此顺从度上升得相当快。要等到你拥有全部所需土地之后再执行顺从度决议，因为失去控制会让你损失掉大部分已积累的顺从度。

15fpzkj.en: Afterwards, take a moment to catch your breath, then head back down to the Malayan border in order to declare your last limited war (against the UK). You'll want half of your forces on the border holding the line, and the rest force-attacking into the one tile that the UK holds. As soon as you take that one tile, it's over.
15fpzkj.zh: 之后，花一点时间喘口气，然后回到马来亚边境，以便宣告你最后一场有限战争（对英国）。你要把一半兵力放在边境守住战线，其余兵力强行进攻英国所拥有的那一格。你一拿下那一格，就结束了。

1r9yvll.en: From here on out, change your garrison law to Civilian Oversight, and take focuses/decisions as needed in order to get Civilian Wing: Full Support (that's the only rank that gives you the compliance bonus). From there, it's just a waiting game until you can take the focus required to complete the achievement.
1r9yvll.zh: 从此刻起，把你的驻军法令改为「文官监督」，并按需选取国策/决议以取得「公民派系：全力支持」（这是唯一提供顺从度加成的等级）。从那里开始，就只是等待，直到你能选取完成该成就所需的国策。

1kie87.en: Start ticking national spirit: The Khana Ratsadon -> Consolidate Military Wing Control -> Embed Technocrats in Civilian Institutions -> Sell Privy Purse Lands
1kie87.zh: 开始推进国家精神：人民党 → 巩固军方派系控制 → 把技术官僚安插进民政机构 → 出售王室私库土地

1qly655.en: Rush down the Fascist political path to get to the limited wars as quickly as possible. Here's one possible path that gets you a decent bit of benefits:
1qly655.zh: 速推法西斯政治路线，以尽快进入有限战争。以下是一条能带来可观收益的可能路线：

1541i1k.en: Either hire one of the Civilian Wing advisors or take Strengthening the Civilian Wing Position next to prevent another possible civilian rebellion.
1541i1k.zh: 要么聘用一位公民派系顾问，要么接下来选取「加强公民派系地位」，以防备另一次可能的公民叛乱。

r50y3o.en: Either take the decision to Court the Civilian Wing or hire the Humanist advisor in order to prevent the civilian rebellion
r50y3o.zh: 要么采取「拉拢公民派系」决议，要么聘用「人道主义者」顾问，以防备公民叛乱

uoj00n.en: Get some economy: Industrialization Drive -> Asian Financial Compact -> Thai Rice Company -> Diversify Foreign Reserves
uoj00n.zh: 发展一些经济：工业化推动 → 亚洲金融协定 → 泰国大米公司 → 外汇储备多元化

1za468.en: Enable limited wars: Phibuns Premiership -> Pan-Thaiism -> Retake Lost British States -> Recover Indochina
1za468.zh: 启用有限战争：披汶出任总理 → 泛泰主义 → 夺回失去的英国各州 → 收复中南半岛

1inr1nt.en: King Anandas turns 15 on the 20th September 1940. So you need to be done with the focus by the 19th.
1inr1nt.zh: 阿南达国王于 1940 年 9 月 20 日满 15 岁。所以你必须在那之前 19 日就完成该焦点。

c6v584.en: As Siam, form Greater Thailand before King Ananda is 15 years old..
c6v584.zh: 作为暹罗，在阿南达国王满 15 岁之前成立大泰国。

1sxhmxs.en: Get War Support: Drum Up Irredentism -> War Fervor
1sxhmxs.zh: 获取战争支持度：鼓动民族统一主义 → 战争狂热

n5aexj.en: Modding governments in exile is very hard, as there is no clear way to do this and still play. In the base game, the governments in exile that could play as exiled governments are not triggered when the winner annex the country, but rather before as a capitulation event. Reverse-engineering Ethiopia shows this, as their capitulation triggers the events of exile. There ⟦0⟧ effects that trigger a government in exile, but using them when a country is completely annexed makes the player automatically lose the game. In this way, using the command tag = <country tag> on the debug mode will not cause the player to change to the exiled government: it would trigger a message error ⟦1⟧ . Still, the other players could yet host the government in exile, and have the tab in place.
n5aexj.zh: 为流亡政府做模组制作非常困难，因为没有明确的方法既做到这一点又能继续游玩。在游戏本体中，可作为流亡政府游玩的那些流亡政府并不是在获胜方吞并该国时才触发，而是在此之前作为投降事件触发。对埃塞俄比亚做逆向工程可以证明这一点，因为它们的投降触发了流亡事件。确实有⟦0⟧效果可以触发流亡政府，但在一个国家被完全吞并时使用它们会让玩家自动输掉游戏。这样一来，在调试模式下使用指令 tag = <国家标签> 并不会让玩家切换到流亡政府：它会触发一条消息错误⟦1⟧。不过，其他玩家仍然可以收容该流亡政府，并让相应标签页就位。

sj3n6r.en: Ethiopia in By Blood Alone is a country that gets exiled when invaded by ⟦0⟧, even if it not belongs to any faction. You can choose a host country as a triggered event, and you get exiled when you lose the war. Said events are in the Italian-Ethiopian war events, and are several and complex. The on-actions of ⟦1⟧ contain the following code as an ⟦2⟧ effect: ⟦3⟧ This code is simple enough. ⟦4⟧ is a variable containing a dynamic tag, which defines the country in which ⟦5⟧ has permission to get exiled in. Yet, this code in a custom event or decision doesn't really change anything as a player, as you still play in your original country if it wasn't annexed.
sj3n6r.zh: 《以血盟誓》中的埃塞俄比亚是一个在被⟦0⟧入侵时会流亡的国家，即使它不属于任何阵营。你可以通过触发事件选定一个收容国，并在输掉战争时流亡。这些事件位于意埃战争事件中，而且为数众多且复杂。⟦1⟧的 on-actions 中包含以下代码作为⟦2⟧效果：⟦3⟧这段代码足够简单。⟦4⟧是一个包含动态标签的变量，它定义了⟦5⟧有权流亡到的国家。然而，作为玩家，把这段代码放进自定义事件或决议里其实什么都不会改变，因为如果原国家未被吞并，你仍然在原来的国家游玩。

zb18ko.en: Yet, getting annexed ends the game, and you do not play as a government in exile. Your government in exile functions when you are occupied, but not annexed. If every part of a country gets owned by another country (such as in a peace conference), the game is over for the occupied country. It is unclear how to avoid a peace conference that annexes everything.
zb18ko.zh: 然而，被吞并会结束游戏，你不会作为流亡政府继续游玩。你的流亡政府在**被占领**时运作，但在被**吞并**时不运作。如果一个国家的每一部分都被另一个国家拥有（例如在和平会议中），那么这个被占领国家的游戏就结束了。目前不清楚如何避免一场吞并一切的和平会议。

7isap3.en: Legitimacy is the amount of recognition a government in exile has. It goes from 0 to 100, and it is related to the war score before capitulation. The greater the war score, the more legitimacy a government in exile has. Legitimacy has a number of benefits, from increasing ⟦0⟧ to receiving exiled ⟦1⟧ and veteran divisions.
7isap3.zh: 合法性是流亡政府所获得的承认程度。它的范围为 0 到 100，与投降前的战争分数相关。战争分数越高，流亡政府的合法性就越高。合法性有若干好处，从提高⟦0⟧到获得流亡⟦1⟧与老兵师。

3o60zx.en: Government in exile is a feature introduced in ⟦0⟧ and expanded in ⟦1⟧, where a defeated country can survive hosted by another country, mainly of their own faction. This feature was included originally only to Democratic countries annexed by Germany, but with ⟦2⟧, neutral ⟦3⟧ could be exiled in another country.
3o60zx.zh: 流亡政府是⟦0⟧中引入、并在⟦1⟧中扩展的功能，一个战败国可以在另一个国家（主要是其所在阵营的国家）的收容下存续。该功能最初仅适用于被德国吞并的民主国家，但有了⟦2⟧之后，中立主义的⟦3⟧也可以流亡到另一个国家。

eghur1.en: A government in exile can complete focuses and take decisions. Many of them are unlocked ⟦0⟧ the government exiles.
eghur1.zh: 流亡政府可以完成焦点并采取决议。其中许多是由流亡政府⟦0⟧解锁的。

h0moz0.en: Resistance target: ⟦0⟧ plus ⟦1⟧ per legitimacy of the government in exile, up to a total of ⟦2⟧ at 100% legitimacy
h0moz0.zh: 抵抗目标：⟦0⟧，加上流亡政府每点合法性⟦1⟧，100% 合法性时总计最高为⟦2⟧

1vrztcj.en: Compliance gain: ⟦0⟧ per day per legitimacy of the government in exile, up to ⟦1⟧ per day at 100% legitimacy
1vrztcj.zh: 顺从度增长：流亡政府每点合法性每天⟦0⟧，100% 合法性时每天最高为⟦1⟧

4u97ac.en: Must be fired from ROOT, the country that should be exiled, or a TAG specification must be used.
4u97ac.zh: 必须从 ROOT（应当流亡的那个国家）触发，否则必须使用一个 TAG 指定。

9jn7jk.en: Core states of a government in exile that are occupied will receive the following penalties:
9jn7jk.zh: 被占领的流亡政府核心州将受到以下惩罚：

w8aw23.en: The following are the the triggers relating to governments in exile.
w8aw23.zh: 以下是与会流亡政府相关的触发条件。

6xstxc.en: Must use either > or < operators. Legitimacy ranges from 0 to 100.
6xstxc.zh: 必须使用 > 或 < 运算符。合法性范围为 0 到 100。

x71tem.en: Checks how much legitimacy the current government in exile has.
x71tem.zh: 检查当前流亡政府拥有多少合法性。

6lkgmh.en: Checks if the current country is exiled in a different country.
6lkgmh.zh: 检查当前国家是否流亡在另一个国家。

mwxzvu.en: Checks if the current country is exiled in a specific country.
mwxzvu.zh: 检查当前国家是否流亡在一个特定国家。

tdkqca.en: Here there are the effects that affect governments in exile.
tdkqca.zh: 以下是影响流亡政府的效果。

1ghrtvj.en: Checks if the current country is hosting a specific exile.
1ghrtvj.zh: 检查当前国家是否在收容一个特定的流亡政府。

3nwcvl.en: Checks if the current country is hosting an exile.
3nwcvl.zh: 检查当前国家是否在收容一个流亡政府。

1sde9k2.en: <TAG> has no provinces, switch would resign.
1sde9k2.zh: <TAG> 没有任何省份，切换将会退出。

1clfgbi.en: If the Axis isn't incompetent, you tying up ⟦0⟧ troops in the east will allow them to win, while you get a few percent war score. With the peace conference system, that should be enough to grab the required states (Buryatia, Chita, Yakutsk, Dudinka, Kolyma, Udachny, Verkhoyansk) plus a few others so the border isn't so gory. If you want to keep playing, you can try to grab as much of the east as possible as well as there is a follow-on decision to core the far east.
1clfgbi.zh: 如果轴心国不是无能的，你在东线牵制住⟦0⟧的部队会让他们获胜，而你自己只拿到几个百分点的战争分数。以和平会议系统而言，这应该足以拿下所需各州（布里亚特、赤塔、雅库茨克、杜丁卡、科雷马、乌达奇内、韦尔霍扬斯克）再加上几个其他州，以免边界那么难看。如果你想继续游玩，也可以尽量多夺取东部，因为还有一个后续决议可以把远东设为核心。

vmmgyb.en: Play defensively and slowly push out. You can grab a couple of provinces in the northwest early, but don't be too aggressive. Watch the battle bubbles and manually move troops if you are close to losing. When the ⟦0⟧ stop pushing on you, you can strategically push on provinces where the have low supply. The have ⟦1⟧ due north not on a city in and due east on the city of Irkutsk. Grabbing these will weaken them.
vmmgyb.zh: 采取防御打法并缓慢向外推进。你可以在早期拿下西北的几个省份，但不要太激进。留意战斗气泡，如果快输了就手动调动部队。当⟦0⟧停止向你推进时，你就可以战略性地进攻他们补给不足的省份。他们在正北方有⟦1⟧（不在城市上），在正东方则有伊尔库茨克城。夺取这些会削弱他们。

6787az.en: With sufficient fighting strength, leave the Comintern, attack the ⟦0⟧ (during Operation Barbarossa) and take the necessary provinces. Call only allies that are necessary! However, priority is given to the ⟦1⟧ along the Transsiberian ⟦2⟧. You might have to build ⟦3⟧ in the North, save the Reorganize the Railway decisions until you need one in both Taymyria and Northeast Siberia.
6787az.zh: 在拥有足够战斗力后，退出共产国际，进攻⟦0⟧（在巴巴罗萨行动期间）并夺取必要的省份。只召唤必要的盟友！不过，优先目标是⟦1⟧，沿着西伯利亚大⟦2⟧。你可能不得不在北方建造⟦3⟧，并保留「重组铁路」决议，直到你在泰梅尔与东北西伯利亚都需要用到其中一个。

19rtt4i.en: By the time you can conquer Xibei San Ma, they will likely have joined the United Front. You can either go with ⟦0⟧ alone, or have the ⟦1⟧ defeat all Chinese factions. If you do the latter, create a puppet ⟦2⟧ or Communist China and give it all the Chinese territory.
19rtt4i.zh: 等你能征服西北三马时，他们很可能已经加入了统一战线。你要么单独对⟦0⟧下手，要么让⟦1⟧击败所有中国派系。如果选后者，就建立一个傀儡⟦2⟧或中国共产党，并把所有中国领土都给它。

j2zqmy.en: On historical Barbarossa happens in June 1941. You'll want to declare on the ⟦0⟧ in April/May to draw more troops off the German frontlines and make it easier for them. Justify on the most expensive Siberian states to reduce their cost at the peace conference.
j2zqmy.zh: 历史模式下巴巴罗萨发生在 1941 年 6 月。你需要在 4/5 月对⟦0⟧宣战，以把更多部队从德国前线吸引过来、让他们更轻松。对最昂贵的西伯利亚各州制造战争目标，以降低它们在和平会议中的成本。

1i3k8ra.en: Basically, make sure they are always losing battles to you. Defense first, but when they aren't pushing you, push them out very conservatively. If you go too far, they will overrun you. If you do it right, you won't run into an equipment deficit.
1i3k8ra.zh: 基本上，要确保他们总是输给你。先防御，但当他们不推进时，就以非常保守的方式把他们推出去。如果你推得太远，他们就会碾压你。如果你做对了，你就不会陷入装备赤字。

1e0kc2w.en: Quickly justify and declare on Xibei San Ma, but don't call in allies. They will put their troops in the north to defend against your allies getting called in, you can snake across to their capital, and puppet it all in the peace conference.
1e0kc2w.zh: 迅速对西北三马制造战争目标并宣战，但不要召唤盟友。他们会把部队调到北方，以防你的盟友被召唤进来；你可以一路蛇行到他们的首都，并在和平会议中把全部领土傀儡化。

j3r3t2.en: In case of annexation of Russian territories by the Germans, attack the ⟦0⟧ (justify on ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧). Once the ⟦4⟧ are conquered, it should be possible to even push the divisions back to Omsk,
j3r3t2.zh: 如果俄罗斯领土被德国吞并，就进攻⟦0⟧（对⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧制造战争目标）。一旦⟦4⟧被征服，甚至有可能把师一路推回到鄂木斯克，

1oh3cb2.en: While waiting for the ⟦0⟧ justification get a chief of army so you can build army XP and get Ideological Loyalty for the +500 manpower per week. Your manpower is too small without this.
1oh3cb2.zh: 在等待对⟦0⟧的战争目标制造期间，找一位陆军参谋长，这样你就能积累陆军经验，并取得「意识形态忠诚」以获得每周 +500 人力。没有这个，你的人力太少了。

1fe59xu.en: In ⟦0⟧ the ⟦1⟧ will puppet territory in ⟦2⟧, but the new peace conference system makes it easier to take the necessary conferences. Also key to this is Ideological Loyalty.
1fe59xu.zh: 在⟦0⟧中，⟦1⟧会把⟦2⟧的领土傀儡化，但新的和平会议系统让取得必要领土变得更容易。这其中的关键同样是「意识形态忠诚」。

12q7p24.en: Build up forces while you wait for Barbarossa. Build guns and artillery. Use templates from Xibei San Ma, but also build up a few 7/2's to push. Pick defensive focuses
12q7p24.zh: 在等待巴巴罗萨期间发展军力。生产枪械与火炮。使用西北三马的编制，但也要建一些 7/2 师用于进攻。选取防御性国策

33h14a.en: Quickly justify a war goal on the southeast state of ⟦0⟧ and call allies ( ⟦1⟧ ). Create a puppet in the southeast province and anything else you can grab.
33h14a.zh: 迅速对⟦0⟧的东南州制造战争目标并召唤盟友（⟦1⟧）。在东南省份以及任何你能夺取的地方建立一个傀儡国。

1snficg.en: ⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work as written, otherwise Xibei San Ma will not exist.
1snficg.zh: 必须禁用⟦0⟧这个策略才能按所写的方式奏效，否则西北三马将不存在。

1e25jvk.en: The key to this achievement is that the ⟦0⟧ never takes or puppet any territory in ⟦1⟧.
1e25jvk.zh: 这个成就的关键在于⟦0⟧从不夺取或傀儡化⟦1⟧的任何领土。

hr3ixq.en: Justify a war goal on ⟦0⟧ and call allies ( ⟦1⟧). Create a puppet of ⟦2⟧.
hr3ixq.zh: 对⟦0⟧制造战争目标并召唤盟友（⟦1⟧）。建立一个⟦2⟧的傀儡国。

bc2j21.en: Press the decision to form the Siberian State.
bc2j21.zh: 按下成立西伯利亚国家的决议。

woztny.en: at Irkutsk, Chita, Krasnoyarsk and Novosibirsk
woztny.zh: 在伊尔库茨克、赤塔、克拉斯诺亚尔斯克与新西伯利亚

17d07z.en: Start game with Historical AI Focuses.
17d07z.zh: 以历史 AI 焦点开始游戏。

1916ht7.en: Start game with Historical AI Focuses
1916ht7.zh: 以历史 AI 焦点开始游戏

j6u553.en: Build up as many troops as possible.

1vot27b.en: To get ready for the invasion, save up political power then justify against ⟦0⟧. World tension will not get as high as if ⟦1⟧ is being justified against. Have a naval invasion to the ⟦2⟧ and a larger one from the Marshall Islands to Honolulu. Make a naval invasion from Honolulu to Los Angeles as well. The preparation time for that naval invasion will coincide with the naval invasions with the armies. Have the ships with the highest range in a different navy group (you start with two converted carriers with 4000 km range and a few heavy ships with 3000 km range, they are the only ones that can project naval supremacy all the way to California from Hawaii). This will allow range towards the west coast from Honolulu. Have part of the fleet protect the ocean towards the Philippines and a larger part of the fleet protect the invasion towards Honolulu. Have a few divisions with the naval invasion towards the ⟦3⟧ for reinforcement. To prepare the invasion of the ⟦4⟧, move the rest of the army to the Marshall islands as well. Declare war against the Philippines when ready.
1vot27b.zh: 为入侵做准备，先攒下政治点数，然后对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。世界紧张度不会像对⟦1⟧制造战争目标时升得那么高。安排一次前往⟦2⟧的海军登陆，以及一次从马绍尔群岛前往檀香山的更大规模登陆。再安排一次从檀香山到洛杉矶的海军登陆。那次海军登陆的准备时间将与各集团军的海军登陆重合。把航程最远的舰船编入另一个海军编队（你开局有两艘航程 4000 公里的改装航母，以及几艘航程 3000 公里的重型舰船，它们是唯一能够从夏威夷一路投射制海权到加利福尼亚的舰船）。这将使从檀香山向西海岸投射成为可能。让一部分舰队保护通往菲律宾的海域，让更大一部分舰队保护前往檀香山的登陆。安排几个师随前往⟦3⟧的海军登陆作为增援。为准备入侵⟦4⟧，把其余军队也调到马绍尔群岛。准备就绪后对菲律宾宣战。

10mci7g.en: Naval Invade the Philippines and Honolulu. Once Honolulu is captured, place divisions on the naval invasion to Los Angeles and send the rest of the army to Honolulu. send the level 2 ships to protect the naval invasion to Los Angeles. They are the only ships that can reach. The other ships may protect important areas as well. Naval invade Los Angeles when ready. There may be a naval skirmish against the Americans. Make sure the level 2 ships do not repair. This will force them to stay on the sea zone so that they can protect the army. While naval invading towards Los Angeles, Take Philippine land and make them capitulate. Once landed in Los Angeles, Send the bulk of the army there as well. Take land from the United States but do not capitulate them. They will not capitulate until Pennsylvania and Maryland gets captured. Capitulate ⟦0⟧ before the United States. Take all the territory from ⟦1⟧. Encircle and grind down the United States.
10mci7g.zh: 对菲律宾与檀香山发动海军登陆。一旦檀香山被拿下，就把各个师安排到前往洛杉矶的海军登陆上，并把其余军队送往檀香山。派 2 级舰船去保护前往洛杉矶的海军登陆。它们是唯一能抵达那里的舰船。其他舰船也可以保护重要区域。准备就绪后对洛杉矶发动海军登陆。可能会与美国发生一场海军遭遇战。务必让 2 级舰船不要去维修。这会迫使它们留在该海域，从而能够保护陆军。在向洛杉矶发动海军登陆的同时，夺取菲律宾土地并迫使它们投降。一旦在洛杉矶登陆，也把大部分军队送到那里。夺取美国的土地但不要迫使它们投降。在宾夕法尼亚与马里兰被拿下之前，它们是不会投降的。在美国之前先迫使⟦0⟧投降。夺取⟦1⟧的全部领土。包围并消耗美国。

ug11gh.en: If you do this early (the party can kick off before the end of 1936), the Philippines and U.S. islands will be lightly defended or undefended. Your main difficulty will lie in having to deal with convoy raiding and supply line disruption (and the occasional reverse naval invasion). Your industry requires a lot of imported oil and steel, all of which needs to be imported via convoy, and you'll need even more convoys to first ship three armies worth of infantry to America, and then to supply them. You may want to assign dedicated task forces to convoy escort duty, and to start production of replacement convoys.
ug11gh.zh: 如果你很早就这么做（1936 年底之前就能启动），菲律宾与美国各岛屿的防御会很薄弱甚至没有防御。你的主要困难将在于应对运输船队袭击与补给线中断（以及偶尔出现的反向海军登陆）。你的工业需要大量进口石油与钢铁，这些都必须通过运输船队进口；而且你还需要更多运输船队，先把三支集团军规模的步兵运到美洲，然后再为它们提供补给。你可能应当把专门的特混舰队分配给护航任务，并开始生产补充用运输船队。

gpz78s.en: For this achievement, to annex ⟦0⟧, it is important to attack the ⟦1⟧ before they get too powerful as they have a guarantee over all countries in the western hemisphere if you don't have the ⟦2⟧ DLC enabled (and even with it enabled, the United States will get an event when you attack Mexico, and, on historical AI, will attempt to enforce peace, so, it amounts to the same thing.)
gpz78s.zh: 对于这个成就，要吞并⟦0⟧，在他们变得过于强大之前进攻⟦1⟧很重要，因为如果你没有启用⟦2⟧DLC，他们对西半球所有国家都提供保障（即使启用了，美国在你进攻墨西哥时也会获得一个事件，并且在历史 AI 下会试图强制和平，所以结果是一样的。）

197w24g.en: The achievement ⟦0⟧ requires ⟦1⟧ to annex ⟦2⟧ before taking European land, then conquer a coastal state in Europe. This must all be done before 1945. The name of the achievement alludes to the Sunset Invasion achievement which references the Sunset Invasion DLC from Crusader Kings II.
197w24g.zh: 成就⟦0⟧要求⟦1⟧在夺取欧洲土地之前先吞并⟦2⟧，然后征服欧洲的一个沿海州。这些都必须 1945 年之前完成。该成就的名称影射了「日落入侵」成就，后者指的是《十字军之王 II》的「日落入侵」DLC。

172ity3.en: After the war with the ⟦0⟧, there may be enough time to attack ⟦1⟧ before the Germans attack ⟦2⟧. If not, prepare war with the Allies. Once the Germans declare against the Allies, do that as well. Naval Invade from Canada to the British Isles.
172ity3.zh: 在对⟦0⟧的战争之后，可能还有足够时间在德国进攻之前先进攻⟦1⟧，然后才是⟦2⟧。如果没有，就准备与盟国开战。一旦德国对盟国宣战，你也一并宣战。从加拿大对不列颠群岛发动海军登陆。

v0wzwc.en: As Japan, conquer Mexico then Europe before 1945.
v0wzwc.zh: 作为日本，在 1945 年之前征服墨西哥，然后征服欧洲。

sez69e.en: In the mid 1930's Honduras being under the dictatorship of President Tiburcio Andino would start out having positive relations with Facist ruled nations due to high levels of European immigration which Andino promoted in the hopes that it would develop his nation. However relations began to collapse once Germany invaded ⟦0⟧ in 1939 which was one of the most important trading partners of Honduras. Several years later Honduras like several other nations in Central America would declare war on the Axis powers in December 1941. During the Second World War Honduras fighting on the side of the Allied powers provided money, limited manpower, shipping vessels, and natural resources to the United States of America. Additionally it would provide air patrols for the Caribbean and Central American coastline with its American equipped air force which would successfully engage U-boats active in the region.
sez69e.zh: 20 世纪 30 年代中期，洪都拉斯在蒂武西奥·卡里亚斯·安迪诺总统的独裁统治下，开局时与法西斯统治的国家保持着良好关系，原因是欧洲移民数量庞大——安迪诺鼓励移民，希望借此发展本国。然而，当德国于 1939 年入侵⟦0⟧（洪都拉斯最重要的贸易伙伴之一）之后，两国关系开始崩溃。数年后，洪都拉斯像中美洲其他几个国家一样，于 1941 年 12 月对轴心国宣战。第二次世界大战期间，洪都拉斯作为盟国一方参战，向美利坚合众国提供了资金、有限的人力、运输船只与自然资源。此外，它还用以美式装备武装的空军为加勒比与中美洲海岸线提供空中巡逻，并成功打击了在该地区活动的 U 型潜艇。

1ict2do.en: The largest threat for united Central America is Mexico, as its focus tree allows to declare war on Central American countries. However, if the army is well-led, it can be possible to refute the Mexican attacks and win the war. Either puppeting Mexico, allowing a larger army, or annexing it, allowing access to the state resources, are possible options. The USA can still easily overpower the most skilled Central American army at this point, so justifying on the US should be avoided. Focus instead on South America, which naturally requires a navy. With South America brought under the heel, notably Brazil and Argentina, Central America will have decent industry and manpower, allowing for a more powerful airforce and army. If avoiding a war with the USA, a large navy can be the main focus.
1ict2do.zh: 统一中美洲面临的最大威胁是墨西哥，因为其国策树允许它对中美洲国家宣战。不过，如果军队指挥得当，击退墨西哥的进攻并赢得战争是可能的。把墨西哥傀儡化（可获得更庞大的军队）或吞并它（可获得各州资源）都是可行选项。此时美国仍能轻易碾压最精锐的中美洲军队，所以应避免对美制造战争目标。转而把重心放在南美，那自然需要一支海军。把南美踩在脚下之后——尤其是巴西与阿根廷——中美洲将拥有相当不错的工业与人力，从而能支撑更强大的空军与陆军。如果避免与美国开战，一支庞大的海军可以成为主要发展方向。

1o0fr24.en: Recommended starting moves are focusing on Political Effort, justifying a wargoal on neighboring countries in the meantime. Afterwards, follow the generic fascist/communist tree for a much-needed manpower boost. After the justification on Guatemala finishes, the next choice is Honduras. After annexing, Honduras, El Salvador Nicaragua and Costa Rica, Central America can be formed, providing cores on conquered land, making the country's power base comparable to Nepal.
1o0fr24.zh: 推荐的起手操作是专注「政治努力」，同时在此期间对邻国制造战争目标。之后沿通用法西斯/共产主义树推进，以获得急需的人力提升。对危地马拉的战争目标完成后，下一个目标是洪都拉斯。吞并洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜与哥斯达黎加之后，就可以成立中美洲，从而在被征服的土地上获得核心，使该国的实力基础可与尼泊尔相比。

3gsact.en: Although the country has insignificant manpower, industry, and resources, it is a democratic country and has a small population in Central America, as well as having a small army. Thus, it's the recommended choice to go Fascist or Communist in order to form the Central American Union.
3gsact.zh: 尽管该国的人力、工业与资源都微不足道，但它是民主国家，在美洲人口稀少，军队也很小。因此，推荐转为法西斯或共产主义，以便成立中美洲联盟。

1bt2o1t.en: Historically Honduras was one of the stronger supporters for the reunification of the United States of Central America being an ally of ⟦0⟧ during that nations war to force Central America into reunification in 1885.
1bt2o1t.zh: 在历史上，洪都拉斯是中美洲合众国重新统一事业的较强支持者之一，在 1885 年该国以武力推动中美洲重新统一的战争中是⟦0⟧的盟友。

11objym.en: Honduras may form the United States of Central America if it controls all other independent Central American countries excluding ⟦0⟧. Doing so will give it cores on the required territories plus British Mexico (311).
11objym.zh: 如果洪都拉斯控制了除⟦0⟧之外所有其他独立的中美洲国家，它就可以成立中美洲合众国。这样做会让它在所需领土上获得核心，外加英属墨西哥（311）。

1jy9co8.en: ⟦0⟧ is a small country in Central America with a population of ⟦1⟧. It is bordered by ⟦2⟧ to the north and ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ to the south.
1jy9co8.zh: ⟦0⟧是中美洲的一个小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它北邻⟦2⟧，南接⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧。

100mkrv.en: ⟦0⟧ starts as ⟦1⟧ with elections every 4 years. The next election is in October 1936
100mkrv.zh: ⟦0⟧开局为⟦1⟧，每 4 年举行一次选举。下一次选举在 1936 年 10 月

w8jrdu.zh: 军备组织者 军需总监

wsgz63.zh: 亚伯拉罕·威廉姆斯·卡尔德隆

ufbcf.zh: 奥兰多·罗德里格斯·希米诺

dal91z.zh: 雷蒙多·斯托克勒·加西亚

1qcdp9s.zh: 蒂武西奥·卡里亚斯·安迪诺

1tca3dx.en: Syria and France negotiated a treaty of independence in September 1936, and Hashim al-Atassi was the first president to be elected under the first incarnation of the modern republic of Syria. However, the treaty never came into force because the French Legislature refused to ratify it. With the fall of France in 1940 during World War II, Syria came under the control of Vichy France until the British and Free French occupied the country in the Syria-Lebanon campaign in July 1941. Continuing pressure from Syrian nationalists and the British forced the French to evacuate their troops in April 1946, leaving the country in the hands of a republican government that had been formed during the mandate.
1tca3dx.zh: 叙利亚与法国于 1936 年 9 月谈判达成一项独立条约，哈希姆·阿塔西成为现代叙利亚共和国第一个形态下首位当选的总统。然而，该条约从未生效，因为法国立法机构拒绝批准它。随着 1940 年法国在第二次世界大战中陷落，叙利亚落入维希法国控制之下，直到英国与自由法国在 1941 年 7 月的叙利亚-黎巴嫩战役中占领该国。叙利亚民族主义者与英国持续施压，迫使法军于 1946 年 4 月撤出，把国家交到了托管期间成立的共和政府手中。

1ib9a6s.en: You can then take over Iraq and puppet them as well for manpower. Iraq and Turkey would be a great obstacle for Syria. Out of the two, Iraq is the weaker of the two, not only of their population, but also a small army and no navy. It is critical that the player strike quickly before Iran mobilize. If they muster a strong army, the best and perhaps only option would be to make a frontline around the Iraqi river in the south and north Iraq and some divisions in the center to prevent Baghdad to be under Iranian hands. Once Iran is defeated, only Turkey would be a serious block. By that moment, the player would have exploited the Middle Eastern manpower.
1ib9a6s.zh: 然后你可以接管伊拉克并把它们也傀儡化以获得人力。伊拉克与土耳其将是叙利亚的巨大障碍。两者之中，伊拉克更弱，不仅人口更少，军队也小且没有海军。玩家必须趁伊朗动员之前迅速出手，这一点至关重要。如果他们集结起强大的军队，最好也或许是唯一的选择，就是在伊拉克南部与北部沿伊拉克河流建立一条战线，并在中部部署一些师以阻止巴格达落入伊朗之手。一旦伊朗被击败，就只剩土耳其会是严重的阻碍。到那时，玩家已经充分利用了中东的人力。

mz3p9x.en: Small population, lack of resource as well as behind technology would represent a big problem for Syria. In order to even have a fighting chance with Iraq or any of the middle eastern nations, Syria must have gone to the decolonization focus branch in which France needs to give independence or not have any puppets like Lebanon or Syria, hence fore demanding to decolonize. Syria has a choice in its political branch: Manpower and fascism, political power and communism, and non-aligned status quo. Otherwise, start off with a political power to pick either fascist or communism in order to kickstart a civil war in Syria.
mz3p9x.zh: 人口稀少、缺乏资源以及科技落后，都将是叙利亚面临的重大问题。为了对伊拉克或任何中东国家哪怕有一战之力，叙利亚必须走非殖民化焦点分支——其中法国需要给予独立，或者不能拥有黎巴嫩或叙利亚这样的傀儡国，因此需要要求非殖民化。叙利亚在其政治分支中有选择：人力与法西斯主义、政治点数与共产主义，以及中立主义现状。否则，就从政治点数起步，选取法西斯或共产主义，以便在叙利亚点燃一场内战。

86pcvs.en: One of the better option would be to increase the quality of each division. Research toward artillery and equipment would be needed. It is also optional to mechanize since there wouldn't be a lack of oil, at least for Syrian consumption. The first target would be Lebanon since conquering Jordan first would overstretch Syria strength. After carefully pushing and defeating Palestine, it's advisable to puppet them for what manpower you can still use of them.
86pcvs.zh: 更好的选项之一是提高每个师的质量。需要向火炮与装备方向研究。机械化是可选的，因为至少对叙利亚自身的消耗而言并不缺石油。第一个目标应当是黎巴嫩，因为先征服约旦会让叙利亚的兵力过度分散。在谨慎推进并击败巴勒斯坦之后，建议把它们傀儡化，以利用你仍能使用的人力。

qvudya.en: In 1920, a short-lived independent Kingdom of Syria was established under Faisal I of the Hashemite family. However, his rule over Syria ended after only a few months, following the Battle of Maysalun. French troops occupied Syria later that year after the San Remo conference proposed that the League of Nations put Syria under a French mandate.
qvudya.zh: 1920 年，在哈希姆家族的费萨尔一世之下建立了一个短命的独立叙利亚王国。然而，在马伊萨伦战役之后，他对叙利亚的统治仅持续了几个月便告结束。同年晚些时候，在圣雷莫会议提议由国际联盟把叙利亚置于法国托管之下后，法军占领了叙利亚。

tbwj6w.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ in the Middle East with a population of ⟦3⟧. It borders ⟦4⟧ to the north, ⟦5⟧ to the east, Jordan to the south, and Lebanon and Palestine to the southeast.
tbwj6w.zh: ⟦0⟧是中东的一个⟦1⟧⟦2⟧，人口为⟦3⟧。它北邻⟦4⟧，东接⟦5⟧，南接约旦，东南与黎巴嫩和巴勒斯坦相邻。

wns8xy.en: As an Arab country, Syria can attempt to form Arabia and Mesopotamia by conquering the requisite territories.
wns8xy.zh: 作为一个阿拉伯国家，叙利亚可以通过征服所需领土来尝试成立阿拉伯与美索不达米亚。

1yfp9py.en: The ⟦0⟧ is one of the few countries that starts without a military force.
1yfp9py.zh: ⟦0⟧是少数开局时没有军事力量的国家之一。

ciw7rh.en: Mongolia starts out as a very weak nation, with very little manpower. As of the Waking the Tiger DLC, the Soviets have no interest in demanding Chinese terrirory during peace conferences, so make sure to call them into your first few wars against the Chinese warlords and Communist China. You want to start by justifying against Shanxi and then Communist China ASAP. This ensures you will be able to take them out BEFORE the Chinese United Front forms, and minimise the chance of the Soviets signing a non-agression pact with China. Once Shanxi is defeated, you should take all states. Once Communist China capitulates, you want to puppet them, and return the Shanxi territory to them. From this point on, any Chinese states you conquer should be handed to Communist China, giving you some of that sweet, sweet unlimited chinese manpower. At about this point, you want to flip fascist, and continue the game playing as a formidable Asian power.
ciw7rh.zh: 蒙古开局是一个非常弱小的国家，人力极少。自《唤醒猛虎》DLC 起，苏联在和平会议中不再有兴趣索要中国领土，所以务必在对中国军阀与中国共产党最初的几场战争中召唤他们参战。你应当先对山西制造战争目标，然后尽快对中国共产党的制造。这能确保你在中国统一战线成立**之前**就拿下它们，并把苏联与中国签署互不侵犯条约的可能性降到最低。山西被击败后，你应当占领其全部州。中国共产党投降后，你要把它们傀儡化，并把山西的领土还给它们。从此刻起，你征服的任何中国州都应交给中国共产党，从而获得那份甜美无比的无限中国人力。大约在这个时候，你应当转为法西斯，并继续以亚洲强权的身份游玩下去。

sx4njq.en: In 1919, after the October Revolution in Russia, Chinese troops re-occupied the country due to fears of communism spreading to mainland China. On October 1920, The White Russian General Baron Roman von Ungern-Sternberg led his troops into Mongolia, defeating the Chinese forces in the capital city of Ulaanbaatar. There, Ungern's eccentric, often violent treatment of enemies and his own men, earned him the sobriquet "the Mad Baron". In February 1921 he expelled Chinese troops from Mongolia and restored the monarchic power of the Bogd Khaan. In June 1921, Communist Mongolian Partisans aided by ⟦0⟧ established control over parts of the country and on July 6 The Bolsheviks would defeat the white army forces and seize the country for themselves, establishing a communist regime aligned with the Soviets.
sx4njq.zh: 1919 年，在俄国十月革命之后，中国军队因担心共产主义蔓延到中国大陆而重新占领了该国。1920 年 10 月，白俄将军罗曼·冯·恩琴-施特恩贝格男爵率军进入蒙古，在首都乌兰巴托击败了中国军队。在那里，恩琴对敌人和自己部下那种古怪且常常暴力的对待方式，为他赢得了「疯男爵」的绰号。1921 年 2 月，他把中国军队逐出蒙古，并恢复了博格多汗的君主权力。1921 年 6 月，由⟦0⟧援助的共产主义蒙古游击队控制了该国部分地区；7 月 6 日，布尔什维克击败白军部队并夺取了该国，建立起一个与苏联结盟的共产主义政权。

1b4xnor.en: With the fall of the Qing dynasty in 1911, Mongolia under the Bogd Khaan, (Mongolia's civil and religious ruler) declared independence. But, the newly established ⟦0⟧ considered Mongolia to be part of its own territory. After the 1915 tripartite Kyakhta Agreement, Russia, ⟦1⟧ and Mongolia agreed that Mongolia was autonomous under Chinese Control.
1b4xnor.zh: 随着 1911 年清朝覆灭，博格多汗（蒙古的世俗与宗教统治者）统治下的蒙古宣告独立。但新成立的⟦0⟧认为蒙古是其自身领土的一部分。在 1915 年三方恰克图协定之后，俄国、⟦1⟧与蒙古同意：蒙古在中国控制下享有自治。

r3jtdw.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in East Asia with a population of ⟦1⟧. It borders the ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ to the north, ⟦4⟧ to the west, Xibei San Ma, ⟦5⟧ and Mengkukuo to the south, and ⟦6⟧ to the east.
r3jtdw.zh: ⟦0⟧是东亚的一个小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它北邻⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧，西接⟦4⟧，南接西北三马、⟦5⟧与蒙疆，东邻⟦6⟧。

1lagyxd.en: ⟦0⟧ is prone to conquering by the Chinese via the Demand Mongolia national focus. Alternatively, Influence Mongolia invites them to a Chinese lead faction
1lagyxd.zh: ⟦0⟧很容易被中国通过国策「索要蒙古」所征服。另一种情况是，「影响蒙古」会邀请他们加入一个由中国领导的阵营

1jo8ulk.en: Mongolia features mountains in the north and west, open plains in the east, and desert areas in the south.
1jo8ulk.zh: 蒙古北部与西部为山脉，东部为开阔平原，南部为沙漠地区。

1b1zf9y.en: Mongolia has a relatively small military due to it's small population, it only has cavalry.
1b1zf9y.zh: 由于人口稀少，蒙古的军事力量相对很小，且只有骑兵。

9ww46l.en: By 1936, Haiti was a nation suffering from many internal issues. Due to an anti-American revolt and the threat it posed to US business interests the ⟦0⟧ had invaded and occupied the the country from 1914 until 1934 when it handed over control to Haitian civilian authorities. While infrastructure had been improved by the Americans during this time period the economy was crippled as of 1936. Such economic concerns would lead to the banning of the Haitian Communist Party in 1936 out of fears they could inspire a revolution amongst Haitians. In 1937 tensions with the ⟦1⟧ would flare up when the Dominican army carried out the Parsley massacre on Haitians living within Dominican borders. In 1941 Haiti would join the Allies by declaring war on the Axis Powers alongside many other nations in the Americas. During the war it would provide both limited shipping vessels and manpower but would be host to an American attempt to increase allied rubber war supplies with the Americans financing the creation of rubber plantations throughout Haiti. During the war Haiti would through the use of American Lend-Lease take the opportunity to equip its armed forces with more modern equipment with American surplus stockpiles.
9ww46l.zh: 到 1936 年，海地是一个深陷内部问题的国家。由于一场反美起义及其对美国商业利益的威胁，⟦0⟧曾于 1914 年入侵并占领该国，直到 1934 年才把控制权交还给海地文官当局。尽管在此期间美国人改善了基础设施，但到 1936 年经济已遭重创。这类经济忧虑导致海地共产党于 1936 年被取缔，原因是担心他们可能在海地人中激发一场革命。1937 年，当多米尼加军队对居住在多米尼加境内的海地人实施「欧芹大屠杀」时，与⟦1⟧的紧张关系骤然升级。1941 年，海地与其他许多美洲国家一道对轴心国宣战，加入了盟国。战争期间，它既提供了有限的运输船只与人力，也充当了美国试图增加盟军橡胶战争物资供应的基地——美国出资在海地各地建立橡胶种植园。战争期间，海地还借助美国的租借，抓住机会用美国剩余库存为其武装部队装备了更现代的装备。

71ft07.en: ⟦0⟧ in starts out in a relatively weak position with the United States dominating over the region. To start hire a fascist demagogue and research the first level of submarines to ensure that your troops (also research marines) can sail to an enemy country. It is also recommended the moment you have enough civilian factories that you create an intelligence agency. Once you are fascist, justify on the ⟦1⟧ ( prepare to core them since Haiti and Dominican republic share a same formable nation Hispaniola) and attack them by 1940 after passing an adequate conscription law. While they are included in the Monroe Doctrine of the ⟦2⟧, Haiti is too and they therefore won't declare on you. However, don't join any faction that might be at war with the United States. While Dominican troops endlessly attack your entrenched army, sneakily go naval invade their victory points with marines and capitulate them. If your timing is right you can then invade ⟦3⟧ the same way, forming Antillean Confederation at the way, then all the relatively weak Central American nations. It is important to make sure you are still guaranteed by the US and that no major power has guaranteed your target country.
71ft07.zh: ⟦0⟧开局时处境相对较弱，美国在该地区占据主导地位。首先聘用法西斯煽动家，并研究第一级潜艇，以确保你的部队（同时研究海军陆战队）能够航向敌国。还建议在你拥有足够民用工厂的那一刻就建立一个特工机构。一旦你成为法西斯，就对⟦1⟧制造战争目标（准备好把它们设为核心，因为海地与多米尼加共和国共享同一个可成立国家伊斯帕尼奥拉），并在通过适当的征兵法案后于 1940 年前进攻它们。虽然它们被纳入⟦2⟧的门罗主义，但海地同样如此，因此它们不会对你宣战。不过，不要加入任何可能正与美国交战的阵营。当多米尼加部队不断进攻你已构筑工事的军队时，偷偷用海军陆战队对其胜利点发动海军登陆并迫使它们投降。如果时机把握得好，你可以用同样方式接着入侵⟦3⟧，沿途成立安的列斯联邦，然后再收拾所有相对较弱的中美洲国家。务必确认你仍然受到美国的保障，且没有任何列强保障了你的目标国家。

oz4bhl.en: Haiti would gain independence from ⟦0⟧ in 1804 and from the very beginning be a nation embroiled in turmoil due to constant interference from outside powers. From 1822 until 1856 Haiti would invade and occupy what is now the ⟦1⟧ which at that time was still a colonial possession of ⟦2⟧. This occupation would help to create ongoing animosity between the two nations which has at times flared up into conflict.
oz4bhl.zh: 海地于 1804 年从⟦0⟧获得独立，并从一开始就是一个因外部列强不断干涉而陷入动荡的国家。从 1822 年到 1856 年，海地入侵并占领了如今的⟦1⟧，当时那仍是⟦2⟧的殖民地。这次占领助长了两国之间持续存在的敌意，这种敌意有时会爆发为冲突。

12bb82o.en: ⟦0⟧ is small country in the Caribbean with a population of ⟦1⟧. It shares the island of Hispaniola with the ⟦2⟧, and is located east of the island nation of ⟦3⟧.
12bb82o.zh: ⟦0⟧是加勒比地区的一个小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它与⟦2⟧共处伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，位于岛国⟦3⟧以东。

1pvuv1q.en: Historically Costa Rica was one of the nations that made up the United States of Central America however following disputes with the central government would secede in 1838. In the following decades it would encourage German migration in order to create more plantations and boost its economy. In 1921 it would engage in a minor border conflict with ⟦0⟧ over the Coto region called the Coto War. Both Costa Rica and Panama struggled to acquire weaponry to equip their respective armed forces but still had their limited forces take up positions for a wider conflict. However it came quickly to an end when the ⟦1⟧ intervened with its navy and demanded both sides cease hostilities. The result in the end was that Costa Rica received the disputed region in the peace treaty that settled the border.
1pvuv1q.zh: 在历史上，哥斯达黎加是中美洲合众国的组成国家之一，但在与中央政府发生争端后于 1838 年退出。在此后数十年里，它鼓励德国移民，以开辟更多种植园并提振经济。1921 年，它为科托地区与⟦0⟧爆发了一场小规模边境冲突，称为科托战争。哥斯达黎加与巴拿马都难以获得武器来装备各自的武装力量，但仍让其有限的部队进入阵位，以备更大规模的冲突。然而，当⟦1⟧以其海军介入并要求双方停止敌对行动时，冲突很快结束。最终结果是，在划定边界的和平条约中，哥斯达黎加获得了争议地区。

1cupqeq.en: Recommended starting moves are focusing on Political Effort, justifying a wargoal on your neighboring country Nicaragua, and then later on, following other countries in the meantime. Such as Honduras, Guatemala and El Salvador for last. Afterwards, follow the generic fascist/communist tree for a much-needed manpower boost. After annexing, Honduras, El Salvador Nicaragua and Costa Rica, Central America can be formed, providing cores on conquered land, making the country's power base comparable to Nepal.
1cupqeq.zh: 推荐的起手操作是专注「政治努力」，对邻国尼加拉瓜制造战争目标，然后稍后再对其他国制造。例如洪都拉斯、危地马拉，最后是萨尔瓦多。之后沿通用法西斯/共产主义树推进，以获得急需的人力提升。吞并洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜与哥斯达黎加之后，就可以成立中美洲，从而在被征服的土地上获得核心，使该国的实力基础可与尼泊尔相比。

12pt1pr.en: Costa Rica would remain neutral during the initial stages of the Second World War but in 1941 would declare on the Axis Powers. Once the war began Costa Rica would create an internment camp for German immigrants in the nation and seized their farms. It would also offer American air patrols and transports the use of its limited airfields to protect the approaches to the Panama Canal Zone.
12pt1pr.zh: 哥斯达黎加在第二次世界大战初期保持中立，但在 1941 年对轴心国宣战。战争开始后，哥斯达黎加在国内为德国移民设立了拘留营，并没收了他们的农场。它还向美国的空中巡逻与运输提供其有限机场的使用权，以保护通往巴拿马运河区的通道。

499ioa.en: Although the country has insignificant manpower, industry, and resources, it is an non aligned country and has a small population of all Central American nations, as well as not having an army. Thus, it's the recommended choice to go Fascist or Communist in order to form the Central American Union.
499ioa.zh: 尽管该国的人力、工业与资源都微不足道，但它是中立主义国家，在所有中美洲国家中人口最少，而且没有军队。因此，推荐转为法西斯或共产主义，以便成立中美洲联盟。

59lywr.en: Costa Rica may form the United States of Central America if it controls all other independent Central American countries excluding ⟦0⟧. Doing so will give it cores on the required territories plus British Mexico (311).
59lywr.zh: 如果哥斯达黎加控制了除⟦0⟧之外所有其他独立的中美洲国家，它就可以成立中美洲合众国。这样做会让它在所需领土上获得核心，外加英属墨西哥（311）。

gd7cre.en: ⟦0⟧ is a small country in Central America with a population of ⟦1⟧. It is bordered by ⟦2⟧ in the south and ⟦3⟧ in the north. It is also surrounded by the Pacific Ocean and The Caribbean Sea.
gd7cre.zh: ⟦0⟧是中美洲的一个小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它南邻⟦2⟧，北接⟦3⟧。它还濒临太平洋与加勒比海。

10cirz0.en: ⟦0⟧ starts as ⟦1⟧ with elections every 4 years. Next election is in February 1936.
10cirz0.zh: ⟦0⟧开局为⟦1⟧，每 4 年举行一次选举。下一次选举在 1936 年 2 月。

s0y7ob.en: By the start of HOI4 in 1936 the nation is under the dictatorship of President Anastasio Somoza García who had seized power in a coup that same year. From this time and until Nicaragua like its neighbors declared war on the Axis Powers in 1941, the nations efforts were focused on consolidating the Presidents grip on power. Once war was declared however, Nicaragua would primarily would use the opportunity to completely overhaul its military. With assistance from officers and loans from the ⟦0⟧ Nicaragua would establish military academies, begin training pilots for the newly established air force, train sailors for the navy, and attempt to acquire equipment from allied lend lease programs. However due to the fact Nicaragua refused to provide any manpower to the conflict itself, this meant equipment it received tended to be obsolete. During the war Nicaragua would allow the allies complete access to all its airfields and harbor facilities.
s0y7ob.zh: 到 1936 年《钢铁雄心 4》开局时，该国处于阿纳斯塔西奥·索摩查·加西亚总统的独裁统治之下，他于同年通过政变夺取了权力。从那时起直到尼加拉瓜像其邻国一样于 1941 年对轴心国宣战为止，该国的努力都集中在巩固总统对权力的掌控上。然而一旦宣战，尼加拉瓜主要会利用这个机会彻底重整其军队。在⟦0⟧的军官协助与贷款支持下，尼加拉瓜建立了军事学院，开始为新成立的空军训练飞行员、为海军训练水兵，并尝试通过盟国的租借计划获取装备。然而，由于尼加拉瓜拒绝为战争本身提供任何人力，这意味着它获得的装备往往已经过时。战争期间，尼加拉瓜允许盟国完全使用其所有机场与港口设施。

1b1ho51.en: Recommended starting moves are focusing on Political Effort, justifying a wargoal on Costa Rica, and then later on neighboring countries in the meantime. Such as Honduras, Guatemala and Panama. Afterwards, follow the generic fascist/communist tree for a much-needed manpower boost. After the justification on Guatemala finishes, the next choice is Honduras. After annexing, Honduras, El Salvador Nicaragua and Costa Rica, Central America can be formed, providing cores on conquered land, making the country's power base comparable to Nepal.
1b1ho51.zh: 推荐的起手操作是专注「政治努力」，对哥斯达黎加制造战争目标，然后稍后再对邻国制造。例如洪都拉斯、危地马拉与巴拿马。之后沿通用法西斯/共产主义树推进，以获得急需的人力提升。对危地马拉的战争目标完成后，下一个目标是洪都拉斯。吞并洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜与哥斯达黎加之后，就可以成立中美洲，从而在被征服的土地上获得核心，使该国的实力基础可与尼泊尔相比。

ixayqs.en: Nicaragua was one of the the five nations that made up the former United States of Central America. While it entered into this union willingly, disputes with the policies of the central government led Nicaragua to be the first nation to secede in 1838 which would culminate with the dissolution of the union in 1841.
ixayqs.zh: 尼加拉瓜是组成前中美洲合众国的五个国家之一。虽然它是自愿加入该联盟的，但与中央政府政策的分歧使尼加拉瓜成为 1838 年第一个退出的国家，最终导致该联盟于 1841 年解体。

1l97d7j.en: Although the country has insignificant manpower, industry, and resources, it is an non aligned country and has a small population in Central America, as well as having a small army. Thus, it's the recommended choice to go Fascist or Communist in order to form the Central American Union.
1l97d7j.zh: 尽管该国的人力、工业与资源都微不足道，但它是中立主义国家，在中美洲人口稀少，军队也很小。因此，推荐转为法西斯或共产主义，以便成立中美洲联盟。

15bgrp.en: Regardless of which ideology one chooses to do in the end, there are few steps which should be taken if one enters into conflict with the United States or United Kingdom and whatever their respective factions for the playthrough are. Due to the proximity of their territory to the Dominican Republic and their large Navy's it is more than likely they will try to naval invade your island several times. To counter this it is recommended to have at least one or two infantry unit focusing on HP, Entrenchment, and Defensive values at all times on top of the port. To provide a further defensive bonus on the port tile and to minimize the amount of troops needed to protect your port, one should also consider building a naval fortification on the port tile. If you annex Haiti and form Hispaniola you should remember to do the same thing for ports in Haiti.
15bgrp.zh: 无论最终选择哪种意识形态，如果有人与美国或英国以及它们各自的阵营（无论该局中具体是哪些）发生冲突，都有几个步骤应当采取。由于它们的领土距离多米尼加共和国很近，且拥有庞大的海军，它们很可能会多次尝试对你的岛屿发动海军登陆。为应对这一点，建议在港口上始终保留至少一到两个注重 HP、构筑工事与防御数值的步兵单位。为了给港口格子提供进一步的防御加成并减少保护港口所需的部队数量，还应当考虑在港口格子上建造海军要塞。如果你吞并了海地并成立伊斯帕尼奥拉，记得对海地的港口也做同样的事情。

fhl762.en: Start building up your navy trough national focuses and army trough experience, Justify and declare war on Haiti so that you can steal it's economy for your own good, here comes the naval part, get a foothold in Cuba in order to form Antillean Confederation even further. After that with the manpower increased, focus the naval invasion in mainland-Latin America, starting with Costa Rica, which is the weaker out of all of targets. Now you can continue to take Latin- and/or South America. Try to coup Argentina and Brazil in order to weaken and later take them.
fhl762.zh: 开始通过国策扩充你的海军、通过经验扩充你的陆军，对海地制造战争目标并宣战，以便窃取它的经济为你自己所用。接下来是海军部分：在古巴取得立足点，以便进一步成立安的列斯联邦。之后随着人力增加，把海军登陆的重点放在拉丁美洲大陆，先从哥斯达黎加开始，因为它是所有目标中最弱的一个。现在你可以继续夺取拉丁美洲和/或南美洲。尝试对阿根廷与巴西发动政变，以便削弱它们并在之后拿下它们。

15m08se.en: The ⟦0⟧ was under a dictatorship in the control of Rafael Trujillo. After the attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941, the Dominican Republic declared war on ⟦1⟧ and joined the Allies.
15m08se.zh: ⟦0⟧处于拉斐尔·特鲁希略控制的独裁统治之下。在 1941 年珍珠港遭袭之后，多米尼加共和国对⟦1⟧宣战并加入了盟国。

1kuncal.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a small country in the Caribbean with a population of ⟦1⟧. It shares the island of Hispaniola with ⟦2⟧, and is located east of the island nation of ⟦3⟧.
1kuncal.zh: ⟦0⟧是加勒比地区的一个小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它与⟦2⟧共处伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，位于岛国⟦3⟧以东。

167rfvf.zh: ⟦0⟧开局时有 2 个可用科研槽；另外 3 个可通过国策树解锁。

redfm9.en: Nepal starts in a difficult position surrounded by giants such as China and British Raj, Therefore there is limited expansion opportunity. They have very weak industrial base, so rushing industrial focus is recommended. Take communist support advisor and then rush the fascist focus tree(for manpower bonuses) so that it wont be locked out after you turn communist. The goal is to join the Comintern and flip to fascist(to get better puppets). After taking Tibet and Bhutan, justify on Xibei San Ma. Calling the USSR prevents Sinkiang and Communist China from joining the war, or at the very least makes them join later (this will ensure they do not take your warscore, which would lower the amount of states you can take in the peace conference). Meanwhile, other Chinese overlords will most likely join the war. After they capitulate, puppet Communist China and give them the states. Since the puppet will have cheaper war score, and Japan has yet to puppet China, they will take less lands. Now you have a big puppet with lots of manpower. Declare war on China and finish the war. when the war is won, give your Chinese puppet the land in china. Now go on conquering Afghanistan and Iraq. Germany will declare on the USSR (with historical AI on historical AI) so decide which side to join. Sometimes the UK will invite you to the Allies if you are in the same war. How much you can do now will depend on your skill.
redfm9.zh: 尼泊尔开局处境艰难，被中国与英属印度这样的庞然大物所包围，因此扩张机会有限。其工业基础非常薄弱，所以推荐尽快推进工业焦点。聘用共产主义支持顾问，然后速推法西斯国策树（以获取人力加成），这样在你转为共产主义后它就不会被锁死。目标是加入共产国际并转为法西斯（以获得更好的傀儡国）。拿下西藏与不丹之后，对西北三马制造战争目标。召唤苏联参战可以阻止新疆与中国共产党加入战争，或者至少让它们更晚加入（这能确保它们不会夺走你的战争分数——那会减少你在和平会议中能拿到的州数）。与此同时，其他中国宗主国很可能会加入战争。在它们投降之后，把中国共产党傀儡化并把各州交给它。由于傀儡国的战争分数成本更低，而日本尚未傀儡化中国，它们会占用更少的土地。现在你就拥有一个拥有大量人力的大傀儡国了。对中国宣战并结束战争。战争获胜后，把中国的土地交给你的中国傀儡。接下来继续征服阿富汗与伊拉克。德国会对苏联宣战（在历史 AI 下），所以决定加入哪一方。有时如果你与英国处于同一场战争，英国会邀请你加入盟国。此时你能做到多少取决于你的技术。

17j1mgx.en: The Rana regime, a tightly centralized autocracy, pursued a policy of isolating Nepal from external influences. This policy helped Nepal maintain its national independence during the British colonial era, but it also impeded the country's economic development and modernization. The Ranas were staunchly pro-British and assisted the British during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and later in both World Wars. At the same time, although Chinese claims, the British supported Nepalese independence at the beginning of the twentieth century.
17j1mgx.zh: 拉纳政权是一个高度集权的专制政体，推行让尼泊尔与外部影响隔绝的政策。这一政策帮助尼泊尔在英国殖民时代维持了国家独立，但也阻碍了该国的经济发展与现代化。拉纳家族坚定亲英，在 1857 年印度起义期间以及后来的两次世界大战中都援助了英国。与此同时，尽管中国提出主张，英国在 20 世纪初仍支持尼泊尔独立。

1ihpdx2.en: ⟦0⟧ is a landlocked minor country in South Asia with a population of ⟦1⟧. Located in the Western Himalayas, it borders the ⟦2⟧ to the south, east and west, and ⟦3⟧ to the north. To the east, it is separated from ⟦4⟧ by the Indian state of West Bengal.
1ihpdx2.zh: ⟦0⟧是南亚的一个内陆小国，人口为⟦1⟧。它位于西喜马拉雅地区，南、东、西三面与⟦2⟧接壤，北邻⟦3⟧。在东面，它与⟦4⟧之间隔着印度的西孟加拉邦。

9egffr.en: In December 1923, Britain and Nepal formally signed a "treaty of perpetual peace and friendship" superseding the Sugauli Treaty of 1816 and upgrading the British resident in Kathmandu to an envoy.
9egffr.zh: 1923 年 12 月，英国与尼泊尔正式签署了「永久和平友好条约」，取代了 1816 年的《苏高利条约》，并把英国驻加德满都的驻扎官升格为特使。

10r8mny.en: Custom difficulty settings are accessed with the gear icon on the difficulty panel. There is a slider bar for each of the 7 majors, France, German Reich, Italy, Japan (includes Manchukuo and Mengkukuo), Soviet Union, United Kingdom, and United States plus China (includes Communist China). The slider bar allows the option to strengthen that country by 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of the bonuses provided for that country. As of now, all these countries share one generic bonus profile, but this can be modded by the player to add, remove, or change the specific bonuses.
10r8mny.zh: 自定义难度设置可通过难度面板上的齿轮图标进入。7 个主要国家各有一个滑块条——法国、德意志帝国、意大利、日本（含满洲国与蒙疆）、苏联、英国与美国，外加中国（含中国共产党）。滑块条允许把该国所提供的加成强化至 25%、50%、75% 或 100%。就目前而言，所有这些国家共用同一套通用加成档案，但玩家可以通过模组制作来添加、移除或更改具体加成。

1cfp9j7.en: Difficulty in Hearts of Iron 4 is a modifier that can provide either more or less of a challenge to the player by modifying certain values for the player or the AI. Easier difficulties apply bonuses to the player, while higher difficulties will apply penalties to the player as well as bonuses to the AI.
1cfp9j7.zh: 《钢铁雄心 4》中的难度是一种修正，它通过修改玩家或 AI 的某些数值，为玩家提供更难或更简单的挑战。较低的难度会给玩家施加加成，而较高的难度会给玩家施加惩罚，同时给 AI 施加加成。

1r1t4xg.en: "Thirty years from now when you're sitting by your fireside with your grandson on your knee and he asks 'What did you do in the great World War Two?' you won't have to cough and say, 'Well, your granddaddy shoveled shit in Louisiana.'"
1r1t4xg.zh: 「三十年后，当你坐在炉边、孙子坐在你膝上，他问『你在伟大的第二次世界大战中做了什么？』时，你不必咳一声说：『嗯，你爷爷在路易斯安那铲屎。』」

gpzyg.en: Difficulty is set when creating a new game, shown in a menu in the bottom-right along with "Historical AI Focuses" and "Ironman Mode". There are five settings available⟦0⟧.
gpzyg.zh: 难度在创建新游戏时设定，显示在右下角的一个菜单中，与「历史 AI 焦点」和「铁人模式」并列。共有五种可用设置⟦0⟧。

1uh06e0.en: "I have full confidence in your courage, devotion to duty, and skill in battle. We will accept nothing less than full victory. Good Luck!"
1uh06e0.zh: 「我对你们的勇气、尽职与战斗技能充满信心。我们只接受完全的胜利。祝好运！」

1vynq9g.en: "For the enemy is strong. He may hurl back our forces. Success may not come with rushing speed, but we shall return again and again."
1vynq9g.zh: 「因为敌人很强大。他可能击退我们的部队。胜利也许不会以迅疾的速度到来，但我们会一次又一次地重返战场。」

uqy3yl.en: By default, the following settings are available, with the mentioned modifiers. The table is listed from easiest to hardest setting.

b1j7u6.en: You can let the Germans have the Sudetenland, they will leave you alone after that. Hungary starts with more aluminium than it will ever need: build a large air force to support your ground troops. Conquer ⟦0⟧, then ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧: the oil fields will supply your army, while chromium can be used to build battleships and heavy tanks, if desired. Be aware that ⟦3⟧ is probably guaranteed by ⟦4⟧, and unless you manage to knock both out quickly enough, Romania will join the Axis, making things significantly harder. Construct ships and naval bombers as soon as you have a coastal state, destroy buildings to make room for more dockyards if necessary. Find a good time to backstab Germany once they are at war with the ⟦5⟧ and join the Comintern. Attack the Allies immediately after the defeat of the Axis. You have to own the states, not just occupy them, do not let AI take them or you will have to go to war again. Unless you can manage to capitulate the ⟦6⟧ before 1942, the ⟦7⟧ will join in, especially if attacked by ⟦8⟧.
b1j7u6.zh: 你可以把苏台德地区让给德国人，此后他们就不会再来打扰你。匈牙利开局的铝多得永远用不完：建立一支庞大的空军来支援你的地面部队。征服⟦0⟧，然后是⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧：油田将供应你的军队，而铬可用于建造战列舰与重型坦克（如果有此意愿）。要注意⟦3⟧很可能由⟦4⟧保障，除非你能足够快地同时击溃两者，否则罗马尼亚会加入轴心国，使事情明显变得更困难。一旦你拥有沿海州就立刻建造舰船与海军轰炸机，必要时拆除建筑以便为更多船坞腾出空间。等德国与⟦5⟧开战时，找一个好时机背刺他们并加入共产国际。在轴心国被击败后立即进攻盟国。你必须**拥有**这些州，而不仅仅是占领，不要让 AI 拿走它们，否则你将不得不再次开战。除非你能在 1942 年之前迫使⟦6⟧投降，否则⟦7⟧会加入，尤其是在被⟦8⟧进攻的情况下。

1ndiy0k.en: Alternatively, refuse the Sudetenland: by that point, you’ll have Austria and Czechia as puppets and Slovakia as your core, giving you a sizable army. Then work toward ⟦0⟧ and either wait for Germany to declare war (which may take a few months), or strike them while they’re busy with ⟦1⟧, they’ll still be relatively weak and may have no allies (though ⟦2⟧ and/or ⟦3⟧ can still join in). Attack the Allies after capitulating Germany. Try to defeat the UK before the US joins the war. The rest of the Balkan territory should be relatively easy to get.
1ndiy0k.zh: 另一种做法是拒绝苏台德地区：到那时你将拥有作为傀儡国的奥地利与捷克，以及作为核心的斯洛伐克，从而拥有一支可观的军队。然后朝⟦0⟧努力，要么等德国宣战（可能需要几个月），要么趁他们忙于⟦1⟧时出手——他们相对仍然弱小，而且可能没有盟友（尽管⟦2⟧和/或⟦3⟧仍可能加入）。在迫使德国投降后进攻盟国。尽量在美国参战之前击败英国。其余巴尔干领土应当相对容易取得。

1lnncap.en: Take ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ ASAP to weaken ⟦2⟧. The focus Reintegrate the Railroads has a hidden effect that increases the chance of a peaceful annexation. As of patch 1.16, the chance of Czechoslovakia accepting is much higher (throw in +100 opinion, diplomatic pressure, and the focus, they’ll accept around 75% of the time). When the Germans demand the Sudetenland, there are two options:
1lnncap.zh: 尽快拿下⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧以削弱⟦2⟧。「重整铁路」焦点有一个隐藏效果，可以提高和平吞并的几率。截至 1.16 补丁，捷克斯洛伐克接受的几率高得多（再加上 +100 好感、外交压力与那个焦点，它们大约有 75% 的概率接受）。当德国索要苏台德地区时，有两种选项：

1pm6tgt.en: The Cosmetic tag can be gained in three ways: if Götterdämmerung is ⟦0⟧ active only via the Restoration of Austria-Hungary focus. If Götterdämmerung is active, it can be obtained either via the Renovatio Imperii focus or the A Thousand Year Federation focus on the Joint tree, which is available after completing the "The Lands of the Crown of Saint Stephen" focus.
1pm6tgt.zh: 外观标签可以通过三种方式获得：如果《诸神黄昏》⟦0⟧未启用，则只能通过「恢复奥匈帝国」焦点。如果《诸神黄昏》已启用，则可以通过「帝国复兴」焦点，或在联合树上完成「圣斯蒂芬王冠之地」焦点后解锁的「千年联邦」焦点获得。

1iwp9g2.en: Apart from the cosmetic tag, you need to collect a wide range of provinces; most of them can be demanded via focuses or need to be wrestled away from the Axis; the problematic ones are Franche-Comte (eastern France, with the cities of Nancy and Besancon), and Jordan (puppet of the UK).
1iwp9g2.zh: 除了外观标签之外，你还需要收集范围广泛的省份；其中大多数可以通过焦点索取，或需要从轴心国手中夺来；麻烦的是弗朗什-孔泰（法国东部，含南锡与贝桑松两座城市）以及约旦（英国的傀儡国）。

c3w670.en: After war starts and you are sure you can hold Germans, start lend-leasing to the ⟦0⟧ to increase autonomy. Once you are independent, push to Berlin, and take Warsaw along the way (don't grant military access to your allies, otherwise they might own the liberated territory instead of you if they get there first). Remember, you only have to control the four cities at the same time, you don't need to wait until you get them in the peace conference.
c3w670.zh: 战争开始并且你确信能守住德国人之后，开始向⟦0⟧租借以提高自治度。一旦你独立，就向柏林推进，沿途拿下华沙（不要给你的盟友军事通行权，否则如果他们先到，就可能拥有被解放的领土而不是你）。记住，你只需要**同时**控制这四座城市，不必等到在和平会议中拿到它们。

1gs0cca.en: You will get a bunch of decisions which increase monarchist support in ⟦0⟧. When they reach the required level, establish monarchism in ⟦1⟧. It can trigger a civil war in ⟦2⟧. The Kingdom of Poland gives you a personal union. You can annex them via focus Restore the Commonwealth.
1gs0cca.zh: 你会获得一系列提高⟦0⟧君主主义支持度的决议。当它们达到所需水平时，在⟦1⟧建立君主制。这可能引发⟦2⟧的内战。波兰王国会给你一个共主邦联。你可以通过「恢复联邦」焦点吞并它们。

bxiq1v.en: When you feel that the ⟦0⟧ have lost enough equipment and troops, counterattack. Up until this moment, Germany may break the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact. If this occurs, you can simply join the Axis temporarily, but remember to cut your allies off from the supplies on the front.
bxiq1v.zh: 当你感觉⟦0⟧已损失足够的装备与部队时，发动反击。在此之前，德国可能会撕毁《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》。如果发生这种情况，你可以暂时加入轴心国，但记住要切断盟友从前线获得补给的渠道。

1bnnmnb.en: Do the Lithuania-Belarus SSR focus, and then get war goals and cores on the Baltics. You can try to take them out yourself, or call the USSR in, as they will give all the land after war. You will also get all your ⟦0⟧ cores after Molotov-Ribbentrop fires.
1bnnmnb.zh: 完成「立陶宛-白俄罗斯苏维埃社会主义共和国」焦点，然后获得对波罗的海国家的战争目标与核心。你可以尝试自己拿下它们，也可以召唤苏联参战，因为战后他们会把全部土地都给你。在《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》触发后，你还会获得全部⟦0⟧核心。

do5mqf.en: After the ⟦0⟧ capitulation, you and the ⟦1⟧ collaboration government should have enough manpower and production to defeat the Axis. For the achievement, you only need to occupy Berlin, not own it via peace deal.
do5mqf.zh: 在⟦0⟧投降之后，你与⟦1⟧合作政府应当拥有足够的人力与产能来击败轴心国。就成就而言，你只需要**占领**柏林，不必通过和平协议拥有它。

13q90hd.en: In the meantime, start to build forts on the border with the ⟦0⟧. They should justify on you in Autumn 1939. Start to prepare a collaboration government. You will need at least two levels.
13q90hd.zh: 与此同时，开始在与⟦0⟧的边境上建造要塞。他们应当在 1939 年秋对你制造战争目标。开始准备一个合作政府。你至少需要两级。

pyj11t.en: Go ⟦0⟧, Seek the Support of the Soviets. Delete all units before civil war fires, then win with the ⟦1⟧ volunteer forces you get. You are now a puppet of the USSR.
pyj11t.zh: 走⟦0⟧路线，寻求苏联的支持。在内战爆发前删除所有单位，然后用你获得的⟦1⟧志愿军取胜。你现在是苏联的傀儡国了。

1o9n9cu.en: Via focus Claim Livonia You get war goals against other Baltic states. Use this for annexing them. Once you have Riga, Warsaw and Kanaus, all you need is Berlin.
1o9n9cu.zh: 通过焦点「索取利沃尼亚」，你获得对其他波罗的海国家的战争目标。用它来吞并它们。一旦你拥有里加、华沙与考纳斯，你只差柏林了。

jrjszw.en: Take the A King for Our People focus in order to put Mindaugas III on the throne and go straight to the Support Monarchism in Poland.
jrjszw.zh: 选取「人民的国王」焦点，以便让明道加斯三世登基，并直接推进到「支持波兰的君主主义」。

1sjwvhz.en: Do the whole left side of the ⟦0⟧ focus tree to get rid of debuffs (up to Crush the Forest Brothers and Realign the Paramilitarists)
1sjwvhz.zh: 完成⟦0⟧国策树的整个左侧以摆脱减益（直到「粉碎森林兄弟」与「重整准军事组织」）

odnh52.en: From now on, build up to be able to take on the Germans when they attack. Full defensive focus is advised.
odnh52.zh: 从现在起，发展实力以便在德国人进攻时能够应对。建议全面防御向。

1oxxhek.en: Refuse the ⟦0⟧ ultimatum and just hold the line for a while. Let them bleed themselves on the border.
1oxxhek.zh: 拒绝⟦0⟧的最后通牒，先守一段时间。让他们在边境上流血。

1gsluqv.en: Build better ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ on your eastern border. Supply there is very bad.
1gsluqv.zh: 在你的东部边境建造更好的⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。那里的补给非常差。

ez5f3f.en: Germany should not ask for Danzig. If they do, just give it away.
ez5f3f.zh: 德国不应该索要但泽。如果他们索要，就直接给出去。

f9tyb8.en: Build a defensive army. One full army should be sufficient.
f9tyb8.zh: 建立一支防御性军队。一个满编集团军应当足够。

1wbas3f.en: These strategies require that the ⟦0⟧ DLC is enabled.

17esekz.en: As ⟦0⟧, hold the capitals of all of your neighbours.
17esekz.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，控制你所有邻国的首都。

1awa6y0.en: Rush Subjugate the Warlords followed by Anti-Communism. Eliminate Warlords who don't submit quickly by rushing their victory points or in the case of ⟦0⟧ rush and take as many land from them as possible. To take out Communist China, use a fallback line to station your troop some distance away from their border to draw them out. If ⟦1⟧ submitted, take their troops so they don't station them on Communist China's borders. Once their troop has been drawn out, you can rush into their capital and capitulate them quickly. You should be just in time to dig in for the ⟦2⟧ invasion. Capitulate the Japanese puppets and kick them out of Korea, you need to accept the Japanese surrender to get the achievement. All that is left will be using ⟦3⟧ to do the 3 steps process in order to integrate each of the warlords that submitted.
1awa6y0.zh: 速推「征服军阀」，随后是「反共产主义」。对于不迅速臣服的军阀，通过速攻其胜利点来消灭它们；至于⟦0⟧，则速攻并尽可能多地夺取其土地。要消灭中国共产党，用一条退守线把你的部队驻扎在离其边境有一定距离处，以引诱他们出来。如果⟦1⟧已经臣服，就接管其部队，这样它们就不会把部队驻扎在中国共产党的边境上。一旦他们的部队被引出，你就可以冲进其首都并迅速迫使其投降。你应当刚好来得及为⟦2⟧的入侵构筑工事。迫使日本傀儡国投降并把它们赶出朝鲜，你需要接受日本的投降才能获得该成就。剩下的就只是用⟦3⟧执行三步流程，以整合每一个已臣服的军阀。

1jh0m08.en: As above, fight as United Chinese Front (or alone, if the Front does not form for some reason) until Japan white-peaces. Do "One China Policy", which disbands the faction. Declare on all warlords one by one. If Japan is still around, they'll join its faction, but Japan won't go to war with you because you'll have a truce. You'll probably want to build supply depots near their borders before fighting Guangxi and Yunnan. The only snag will be if Sinkiang decides to join Comintern (in which case, you'll have to fight the Soviet Union to get Sinkiang), but, by 1943 and after annexing all other warlords, you'll easily be able to go toe-to-toe with the Soviet Union - and besides, you'll probably get invited into Allies, which will make it a cakewalk.
1jh0m08.zh: 同上，作为中国统一战线（或者如果统一战线因某种原因没有成立，就独自）作战，直到日本白色和平。执行「一个中国政策」，这会解散阵营。逐个对所有军阀宣战。如果日本还在，它们会加入其阵营，但日本不会与你开战，因为你们之间有停战协定。在与广西和云南作战之前，你大概会想在其边境附近建造补给站。唯一的障碍是如果新疆决定加入共产国际（那样你就得与苏联作战才能拿到新疆），但到 1943 年并且吞并所有其他军阀之后，你将能轻松与苏联正面交锋——而且除此之外，你大概还会被邀请加入盟国，那就更容易了。

1col0u1.en: Do not accept cooperation with Communist China until the ⟦0⟧ are about to attack. Then, form the Chinese United Front and accept all invites. Quickly rush to Korea and push them off the continent. After they have offered peace, accept it, and kick Communist China from your faction. Declare on them and annex them as soon as possible, before they start war against you. Do the same with the other faction members, leaving ⟦1⟧ for last.
1col0u1.zh: 在⟦0⟧即将进攻之前，不要接受与中国共产党的合作。然后成立中国统一战线并接受所有邀请。迅速冲向朝鲜并把它们推离大陆。在它们提出和平之后接受它，并把中国共产党踢出你的阵营。对它们宣战并尽快吞并它们，赶在它们对你开战之前。对其他阵营成员也照做，把⟦1⟧留到最后。

1gmb1ef.en: "Force a Japanese surrender" means "kick Japan off the continent and ⟦0⟧ a white peace with them". Rejecting the white peace and trying to capitulate them instead will not trigger the achievement.
1gmb1ef.zh: 「迫使日本投降」的意思是「把日本赶出大陆并与它们⟦0⟧白色和平」。拒绝白色和平转而试图迫使其投降不会触发该成就。

1h7rex4.en: As China, reconquer all of China and Manchuria and force a Japanese surrender.
1h7rex4.zh: 作为中国，重新征服全中国与满洲，并迫使日本投降。

88muw.en: As of 1.11.4, if you are at war with other countries as Stalin before starting the civil war, it will be Stalin that keeps fighting them. As the opposer of Stalin, you can get military access from those countries during civil war. Thus, before starting the civil war, justifying war goal on Poland then Germany, as world tension rises, Poland will be guaranteed by the United Kingdom. Then declaring war on them. After the civil war started, they will help you defeat Stalin, returning every piece of Russian land they occupied because you are having a civil war. If you defeated Poland before civil war breaks out and the Allies failed to take it back, in another word, it is occupied by Germany after you declare on Germany, you will even have a peace conference to partition Poland.
88muw.zh: 截至 1.11.4，如果你在内战开始前作为斯大林正与其他国家交战，那么继续与它们作战的是斯大林。作为斯大林的对立方，你可以在内战期间从那些国家获得军事通行权。因此，在内战开始前，先对波兰制造战争目标，然后对德国——随着世界紧张度上升，波兰会得到英国的保障。然后对它们宣战。内战开始后，它们会帮你击败斯大林，并归还它们占领的每一寸俄国土地，因为你正处在内战中。如果你在内战爆发前就击败了波兰，而盟国没能夺回它——换句话说，在你对德国宣战后它被德国占领——你甚至会在和平会议中分割波兰。

1ro2g2n.en: Before WWII ends but when Czechoslovakia is partly liberated, take "Panslavic Nationalism" (make sure to boost opinion of Czechoslovakia to +100). This sends them an offer to be annexed. The odds of acceptance are greatly improved if they are weak compared to you, in your faction, have +95 or higher opinion, and are at war with a major.
1ro2g2n.zh: 在二战结束之前，但当捷克斯洛伐克被部分解放时，选取「泛斯拉夫民族主义」（务必把捷克斯洛伐克的好感提升到 +100）。这会向它们发出被吞并的提议。如果它们相比你较弱、身处你的阵营、好感为 +95 或更高，并且正与一个大国交战，那么接受的几率会大幅提高。

b5v0kz.en: You can get everything except Bohemia and Ankara in peace conference at the end of WWII. The remaining two are tricky, because Turkey tends to be guaranteed by multiple parties and Czechoslovakia may be guaranteed by the UK and/or be in the Allies. One way around it is as follows:
b5v0kz.zh: 在二战结束时的和平会议中，你可以得到除波希米亚与安卡拉之外的一切。剩下这两个很棘手，因为土耳其往往被多方保障，而捷克斯洛伐克可能被英国保障和/或身处盟国。绕过这一点的一种方法如下：

183wmr5.en: Worst case scenario, even if Czechoslovakia is in the Allies, the achievement only requires being the ⟦0⟧, not the owner, so, as long as you manage to overrun their capital state without losing any other required states to attacks and naval invasions, the achievement should fire.
183wmr5.zh: 最坏的情况下，即使捷克斯洛伐克身处盟国，该成就也只要求你是⟦0⟧，而不是拥有者，所以只要你能攻占其首都州，同时不因进攻与海军登陆而失去任何其他所需州，该成就就应该会触发。

jua3js.en: Justify on Afghanistan. It is guaranteed by Turkey, which lets you go to war with Turkey without the hassle of also fighting the entire Allies.
jua3js.zh: 对阿富汗制造战争目标。它由土耳其保障，这让你能与土耳其开战，而不必同时与整个盟国作战的麻烦。

9amwd9.en: Get military access from the Axis and the Allies during civil war then backstab them is a fast and easy way to achieve this.
9amwd9.zh: 在内战期间从轴心国与盟国获得军事通行权，然后背刺它们，是达成这一目标又快又容易的方法。

7zpfg7.en: Restore the Romanovs to the throne and conquer Germany, Hungary, Austria, Czechoslovakia, Turkey, and Bulgaria.
7zpfg7.zh: 恢复罗曼诺夫王朝的皇位，并征服德国、匈牙利、奥地利、捷克斯洛伐克、土耳其与保加利亚。

1mqc081.en: If they refuse, you have a wargoal against them that you can use later.
1mqc081.zh: 如果它们拒绝，你就获得了对它们的战争目标，可以在之后使用。

1vv0v6d.en: When Turkey and Afghanistan are capitulated, declare on Czechoslovakia.
1vv0v6d.zh: 当土耳其与阿富汗被逼投降时，对捷克斯洛伐克宣战。

13e603k.en: Leave the Allies (you can't justify wars as part of the Allies).
13e603k.zh: 退出盟国（作为盟国成员你无法制造战争目标）。

1gnqc2d.en: A lot of AI players' actions are also dictated by World Tension levels, especially in terms of how much World Tension a specific, target player has generated. At higher amounts of World Tension, the AI is less likely to accept conditional surrenders, and the AI is less willing to join factions with countries that have generated more World Tension and is more willing to embargo countries that have generated more World Tension.
1gnqc2d.zh: AI 玩家的许多行动同样受世界紧张度水平支配，尤其是在某个特定目标玩家已产生多少世界紧张度方面。在世界紧张度较高时，AI 更不可能接受有条件投降；AI 更不愿意与已产生较多世界紧张度的国家一起加入阵营，而更愿意对已产生较多世界紧张度的国家实施禁运。

1yzmbqi.en: Sets/shifts the World Tension threshold required to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ The ideology base is 1.00 (100%) for ⟦2⟧ Democratic and 0.5 (50%) for ⟦3⟧ Non-Aligned; ⟦4⟧ Communist and ⟦5⟧ Fascist have no base requirement. A negative modifier reduces it — e.g. the generic ⟦6⟧ leader trait gives ⟦7⟧ (−25% required Tension), and many aggressive leader traits give ⟦8⟧. The companion ⟦9⟧ applies the same shift only against a specific target country.
1yzmbqi.zh: 设定/改变执行⟦0⟧所需的世界紧张度门槛。⟦1⟧意识形态基准为：⟦2⟧民主 1.00（100%），⟦3⟧中立主义 0.5（50%）；⟦4⟧共产主义与⟦5⟧法西斯主义没有基准要求。负修正会降低它——例如通用⟦6⟧领袖特质提供⟦7⟧（所需紧张度 −25%），而许多侵略性领袖特质提供⟦8⟧。与之配套的⟦9⟧只对特定目标国家施加同样的偏移。

76jg4g.en: World Tension is the sum of every positive and negative event that has occurred to date reduced by their decay. Each individual event will gradually decay toward 0 at ⟦0⟧ per day, or ⟦1⟧ per year. Note that this also affects events which reduce World Tension, e.g. peace treaties reduce World Tension, but their effects decay just like aggressive events. World Tension events from countries at war do not decay.
76jg4g.zh: 世界紧张度是迄今发生的所有正面与负面事件之和，再减去它们的衰减。每个单独事件会以每天⟦0⟧（即每年⟦1⟧）的速度逐渐衰减至 0。注意这同样影响降低世界紧张度的事件，例如和平条约会降低世界紧张度，但其效果也会像侵略性事件一样衰减。来自处于战争状态国家的世界紧张度事件不会衰减。

1he300m.en: La Résistance A ⟦0⟧ operative mission can reduce the World Tension a target country needs in order to join a faction. The requirement drops by 0.001 per day per operative, up to a maximum reduction of 20% World Tension, and decays back when no operative is assigned. Multiple operatives working the same faction suffer diminishing returns (a stacking factor of 0.5 applied by efficiency rank).⟦1⟧
1he300m.zh: 《抵抗运动》中，一项⟦0⟧特工任务可以降低目标国家加入阵营所需的世界紧张度。该要求每名特工每天下降 0.001，最多降低 20% 世界紧张度，并在没有特工派驻时衰减回原值。多名特工针对同一阵营会有递减收益（按效率等级施加 0.5 的叠加系数）。⟦1⟧

1fhfl24.en: Certain game actions require a minimum level of World Tension to have been reached before they can be taken. Calling other countries to get involved in an ongoing ⟦0⟧ requires at least 50%⟦1⟧ World Tension to have been reached. Some national focuses, mainly for the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧, require a certain threshold of World Tension to have been reached before they can be enacted.
1fhfl24.zh: 某些游戏行动需要先达到最低世界紧张度水平才能采取。召唤其他国家介入一场进行中的⟦0⟧至少需要达到 50%⟦1⟧世界紧张度。一些国策——主要是⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧的——需要先达到一定世界紧张度门槛才能选取。

y9vnqn.en: The base World Tension a country needs to take a gated action is set by its ideology (see the ⟦0⟧ table above). Two country modifiers shift those thresholds directly, and are commonly attached to ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧/⟦3⟧ and country leader traits. They are expressed as a fraction of World Tension (1.0 = 100%), so a negative value ⟦4⟧ the requirement by that many percentage points.
y9vnqn.zh: 一个国家采取受限行动所需的基础世界紧张度由其意识形态决定（见上文⟦0⟧表）。有两个国家修正会直接改变这些门槛，它们通常附带在⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧/⟦3⟧以及国家领袖特质上。它们以世界紧张度的分数表示（1.0 = 100%），因此负值会把该要求⟦4⟧相应百分点。

1sehoef.en: The level of World Tension has several impacts on gameplay, in particular allowing or limiting ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and more. It is shown as an icon depicting Earth, with flames engulfing it more fully the higher current World Tension is. Generally, the higher the World Tension, the more popular support nations have for taking belligerent actions.
1sehoef.zh: 世界紧张度水平对玩法有若干影响，尤其是允许或限制⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧等等。它显示为一个描绘地球的图标，当前世界紧张度越高，包裹地球的火焰就越旺盛。总体而言，世界紧张度越高，各国国内对采取好战行动的支持就越普遍。

n34m02.en: ⟦0⟧ represents the overall level of fear and anxiety that exists among the nations of the World. The number displayed can be between 0% and 100%. Total World Tension can be higher than 100%, but there are no additional effects beyond the 100% limit—the overflow instead acts as a "buffer" against events that decrease Tension.
n34m02.zh: ⟦0⟧代表世界各国之间存在的总体恐惧与焦虑程度。显示的数字可以在 0% 到 100% 之间。总世界紧张度可以高于 100%，但超过 100% 上限后没有额外效果——溢出部分反而充当应对降低紧张度事件的「缓冲」。

985a41.en: While a country is in a ⟦0⟧, the limit used to join a faction becomes the lower of its own threshold or 50%.⟦1⟧ For example, a Democratic country that normally needs 80% World Tension can join a faction at 50% Tension while defending. (This is the cap referenced for Democratic "Join faction" in the table above.)
985a41.zh: 当一个国家处于⟦0⟧中时，用于加入阵营的上限变为其自身门槛与 50% 中的较低者。⟦1⟧例如，一个通常需要 80% 世界紧张度的民主国家，在防御时可以在 50% 紧张度下加入阵营。（这就是上文表格中民主国家「加入阵营」所提到的上限。）

131wwmb.en: While the ⟦0⟧ does not have hard World Tension thresholds for its national focuses, Two Ocean Navy Act and Selective Training Act require higher support in Congress if World Tension is less than 50%. It can also struggle to get the War support it needs for The Giant Wakes if World Tension is kept low.
131wwmb.zh: 虽然⟦0⟧的国策没有硬性世界紧张度门槛，但「两洋海军法案」与「选择性训练法案」在世界紧张度低于 50% 时需要国会更高的支持。如果世界紧张度维持低位，它也可能难以获得「巨人觉醒」所需的战争支持度。

6dkaf5.en: These are the ⟦0⟧ values defined per ideology in ideologies. The analogous ⟦1⟧ factor (Communist 0.75, Democratic/Non-Aligned 0.25, Fascist 1.0) scales the Tension from war declarations. As with all Tension sources, the contribution decays over time (see ⟦2⟧) unless the country is at war.
6dkaf5.zh: 这些是在 ideologies 中按意识形态定义的⟦0⟧数值。与之类似的⟦1⟧系数（共产主义 0.75，民主/中立主义 0.25，法西斯主义 1.0）会缩放宣战所产生的紧张度。与所有紧张度来源一样，其贡献会随时间衰减（见⟦2⟧），除非该国处于战争状态。

1iepxi8.en: When the AI evaluates faction actions, it factors in global World Tension weighted by 0.2.⟦0⟧ In practice the AI is less willing to invite or join factions alongside a country that has generated a lot of World Tension, and more willing to embargo such countries.
1iepxi8.zh: 当 AI 评估阵营行动时，它会把全球世界紧张度按 0.2 加权计入。⟦0⟧实际上，AI 不太愿意与已产生大量世界紧张度的国家一起受邀或加入阵营，而更愿意对此类国家实施禁运。

1quor5u.en: ⟦0⟧ interact with World Tension in three ways: forming or joining one ⟦1⟧ Tension, ⟦2⟧ one is gated behind a Tension threshold that depends on ideology, and the AI weighs a prospective member's generated Tension when deciding whether to let it in.
1quor5u.zh: ⟦0⟧以三种方式与世界紧张度互动：成立或加入一个会增加⟦1⟧紧张度，加入一个受制于⟦2⟧意识形态决定的紧张度门槛，以及 AI 在决定是否接纳某个潜在成员时会权衡其已产生的紧张度。

1k9hp2s.en: Sets/shifts the World Tension threshold required to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ The ideology base is 0.25 (25%) for ⟦2⟧ Democratic and 0.4 (40%) for ⟦3⟧ Non-Aligned. A negative modifier reduces it — e.g. the ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ leader trait gives ⟦6⟧ (−20% required Tension).
1k9hp2s.zh: 设定/改变执行⟦0⟧所需的世界紧张度门槛。⟦1⟧意识形态基准为：⟦2⟧民主 0.25（25%），⟦3⟧中立主义 0.4（40%）。负修正会降低它——例如⟦4⟧⟦5⟧领袖特质提供⟦6⟧（所需紧张度 −20%）。

fcewuo.en: Joining a faction adds a base of ⟦0⟧ World Tension.⟦1⟧ This base is multiplied by the joining country's ideology ⟦2⟧ factor (and by the global ⟦3⟧ define, which is 1 by default), so the actual amount depends on who joins:
fcewuo.zh: 加入一个阵营会增加⟦0⟧世界紧张度的基准值。⟦1⟧该基准值会乘以加入国的意识形态⟦2⟧系数（以及全局⟦3⟧define，默认为 1），因此实际数值取决于谁加入：

z1inq2.en: ⟦0⟧ Communism and Fascism set no positive requirement and additionally carry a hidden ⟦1⟧ modifier, so they can effectively join factions freely. ⟦2⟧ Capped at 50% during a defensive war — see below.
z1inq2.zh: ⟦0⟧共产主义与法西斯主义不设正面要求，并且额外带有一个隐藏的⟦1⟧修正，所以它们实际上可以自由加入阵营。⟦2⟧在防御战争中上限为 50%——见下文。

1ml00oj.en: Different ideologies have different effects on World Tension—both in terms of generation and in terms of how much World Tension is needed to take certain actions.
1ml00oj.zh: 不同意识形态对世界紧张度有不同影响——既体现在产生量上，也体现在采取某些行动需要多少世界紧张度上。

1xwz92f.en: Some National Focuses can't be chosen unless world tension is above a certain limit. Most of them are also possible if the country is at war.
1xwz92f.zh: 某些国策只有在世界紧张度高于一定限度时才能选取。其中大多数在该国处于战争状态时也变为可选。

1ec0b23.en: Each percentage of World Tension reduces the time (and cost) of justifying of war goals by ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ up to ⟦2⟧ at 100% World Tension.
1ec0b23.zh: 世界紧张度每提高一个百分点，制造战争目标的时间（与花费）就降低⟦0⟧，⟦1⟧在世界紧张度 100% 时最高可达⟦2⟧。

e75rl1.en: For countries with a generic ⟦0⟧ tree, Why We Fight requires more than 75% World Tension if they are not in a defensive war.
e75rl1.zh: 对于拥有通用⟦0⟧树的国家，如果他们不处于防御战争，「我们为何而战」需要世界紧张度高于 75%。

q8e42r.en: Whether a country is ⟦0⟧ to join a faction is gated behind a World Tension threshold set by its ideology's ⟦1⟧ modifier:
q8e42r.zh: 一个国家是否⟦0⟧加入阵营，受制于由其意识形态⟦1⟧修正设定的世界紧张度门槛：

jukhlk.en: Each percentage of World Tension also increases War support for all nations by ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ up to ⟦2⟧ at 100% World Tension.
jukhlk.zh: 世界紧张度每提高一个百分点，也会使所有国家的战争支持度提高⟦0⟧，⟦1⟧在世界紧张度 100% 时最高可达⟦2⟧。

cce0um.en: A country that joins an ongoing war on the attacker's side generates a further base of ⟦0⟧ World Tension.⟦1⟧
cce0um.zh: 一个以进攻方身份加入进行中战争的国家会额外产生⟦0⟧世界紧张度的基准值。⟦1⟧

1yw8sce.en: Some national focuses can lower the threshold. Below you find the base threshold without any modifiers.
1yw8sce.zh: 某些国策可以降低该门槛。以下是没有任何修正时的基础门槛。

156ew7e.en: National focuses, decisions, ideas and advisors can lower this threshold through further ⟦0⟧ modifiers.
156ew7e.zh: 国策、决议、理念与顾问可以通过进一步的⟦0⟧修正来降低该门槛。
