uaqc7u.en: The number of extra operative slots gained from being a Spy Master depends on the number of at least semi-independent countries in your faction and the size of their industry. Specifically, every independent county and ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧) in the ⟦5⟧ with at least 10 but less than 50 factories provides 0.25 extra operative slots, and every such country with at least 50 factories provides 0.5 extra operative slots.⟦6⟧ It should be noted that the factory count includes both ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧, but not ⟦9⟧.
uaqc7u.zh: 从「特工大师」身份获得的额外特工槽数量，取决于你阵营中至少半独立国家的数量及其工业规模。具体而言，每一个独立国家与⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧）在⟦5⟧中拥有至少 10 但少于 50 座工厂时提供 0.25 个额外特工槽，而每一个拥有至少 50 座工厂的此类国家提供 0.5 个额外特工槽。⟦6⟧应当注意，工厂数包含⟦7⟧与⟦8⟧，但不包含⟦9⟧。

1gwjekq.en: It is possible to decrypt multiple codes at once, but your ⟦0⟧ will be split into even parts as well, e.g., if you have ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ and are trying to break the codes of two countries at once, you will invest ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ towards decrypting one opponent's cipher and ⟦5⟧ towards the other. However, if you pause the decrypting process for one country, all your ⟦6⟧ will be used for the other code.
1gwjekq.zh: 可以同时破译多个密码，但你的⟦0⟧也会被平均分割，例如，如果你有⟦1⟧⟦2⟧并试图同时破解两个国家的密码，你将投入⟦3⟧⟦4⟧用于破译一个对手的密码，⟦5⟧用于另一个。不过，如果你暂停其中一个国家的破译进程，你的全部⟦6⟧都会用于另一个密码。

gncdta.en: For example, when Germany is a Spy Master for the Axis and it puppets ⟦0⟧, it will not receive an additional operative. When ⟦1⟧ joins the Axis, because it has more than 50 factories, Germany will gain 50% of a spy, giving it an additional operative. If ⟦2⟧ becomes a satellite and it has 10 - 50 (exclusive) factories, Germany will gain 25% of a spy.
gncdta.zh: 例如，当德国作为轴心国的特工大师并傀儡化⟦0⟧时，它不会获得额外特工。当⟦1⟧加入轴心国时，由于它有 50 座以上工厂，德国将获得 0.5 个特工，从而获得一个额外特工。如果⟦2⟧成为卫星国且拥有 10 到 50（不含）座工厂，德国将获得 0.25 个特工。

qvmcry.en: Once a country has upgraded its agency at least 3⟦0⟧ times, is independent or a ⟦1⟧ (⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧), and is a part of a ⟦6⟧, it can choose to invest ⟦7⟧⟦8⟧ to become its faction's Spy Master. Each faction can have at most one Spy Master at a time, though any faction member can invest ⟦9⟧ to take over as Spy Master.
qvmcry.zh: 一旦一个国家至少升级其机构 3⟦0⟧次、是独立国或⟦1⟧（⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧），并且是⟦6⟧的一部分，它就可以选择投入⟦7⟧⟦8⟧成为其阵营的特工大师。每个阵营同时最多只能有一个特工大师，不过任何阵营成员都可以投入⟦9⟧来接管特工大师之位。

isrl3f.en: The Defense branch interacts with operatives' missions. Counter-intelligence bonus from Passive Defence increases execution time of hostile operations on your territory and increases chances of stopping enemy's ⟦0⟧. Anti-partisan upgrade increases effectiveness of Root Out Resistance of your ⟦1⟧.

6pqify.en: All agency upgrades are divided into 5 branches: Intelligence, Defense, Operations, Operative Training, and Cryptology Department. Each upgrade requires a variable amount of ⟦0⟧ to be invested for 30⟦1⟧ days, but this time can be shortened by ⟦2⟧ (to effectively 25 days) if you employ an ⟦3⟧.

ga7oyr.en: An ⟦0⟧ is required for most of the espionage actions. It requires investing 5 ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ for 30⟦3⟧ days to become operational. Once it is created, it can be used to recruit ⟦4⟧ to perform ⟦5⟧ or ⟦6⟧, and it can be further enhanced with various upgrades.

1f5c2dg.en: The rest of your territory can be taken peacefully if you have a large army. Before demanding territory, make sure to take manpower focuses, as your army size is incredibly important, and reintegrate territory whenever you can to pump out more divisions (they do not need to be trained). You only need a large army and axis membership to maximize your chances. Focus on ⟦0⟧ first. Demand Carpathian Ruthenia and Demand Southern Slovakia in whatever order you like. ⟦1⟧ should accept, especially if you are in a faction while ⟦2⟧ isn't. If they do not accept, declare war but do not call the Germans in. Focus on taking the required territory first and then call the Germans in to capitulate them.
1f5c2dg.zh: 如果你有一支庞大的军队，其余领土可以和平取得。在索要领土之前，务必选取人力焦点，因为你的军队规模极其重要，并且只要有机会就重新整合领土，以便产出更多师（它们不需要经过训练）。你只需要一支庞大的军队与轴心国成员身份，就能最大化成功几率。先专注⟦0⟧。按你喜欢的任意顺序索要喀尔巴阡卢西尼亚与南斯洛伐克。⟦1⟧应当会接受，尤其是如果你身处一个阵营而⟦2⟧没有。如果它们不接受，就宣战，但不要召唤德国人。先专注夺取所需领土，然后再召唤德国人迫使其投降。

1ucf9u0.en: Play on historical. Pick Continue the Regency and then Undermine the Admiral. Keep Gyula Gömbos for more manpower and rush down to Wherever the Cross Points. Justify on ⟦0⟧ immediately once the focus completes. 9 units of 18 width infantry should suffice, but more always helps. Break through the Austrian lines and snake the victory points. if you can, join the Axis, but ⟦1⟧ call in Germany. This way, you can see if Germany is doing the Anschluss focus, notifying you to bring the war to an end. Either annex all of ⟦2⟧ or only Burgenland, your choice.
1ucf9u0.zh: 在历史模式下游玩。选取「延续摄政」然后「削弱海军上将」。保留久洛·贡伯什以获得更多人力，并速推至「十字架所指之处」。焦点一完成就立即对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。9 个 18 宽步兵单位应当足够，但更多总是有帮助。突破奥地利防线并蛇形攻占胜利点。如果可以，加入轴心国，但⟦1⟧不要召唤德国。这样你就能看出德国是否在做「德奥合并」焦点，从而提醒你结束战争。你可以吞并整个⟦2⟧，或者只吞并布尔根兰，由你选择。

1ny37ml.en: Next, ⟦0⟧. Pick Demand Transylvania and do the same as with ⟦1⟧. An event will appear that they reject, choose the escalation option and then ask Germany for mediation. You should receive all of Transylvania, but it might not be guaranteed.
1ny37ml.zh: 接下来是⟦0⟧。选取「索要特兰西瓦尼亚」，并像对待⟦1⟧那样操作。会出现一个它们拒绝的事件，选择升级选项，然后请德国调停。你应当会获得整个特兰西瓦尼亚，但这并不保证。

1i2ox34.en: Finally, ⟦0⟧. Demand the Vojvodina and choose Germany as a mediator. You should receive the Yugoslavian territory, after which you can do the focus Proclaim Greater Hungary and unlock the achievement.
1i2ox34.zh: 最后是⟦0⟧。索要伏伊伏丁那并选择德国作为调停者。你应当会获得南斯拉夫领土，之后你就可以完成「宣告大匈牙利」焦点并解锁该成就。

1lj226k.en: Turn ⟦0⟧, join the ⟦1⟧ and take ⟦2⟧ to have a border with ⟦3⟧. Build up Sudetenland to level 7 forts and don't give up Sudetenland. When ⟦4⟧ attacks hold on till the ⟦5⟧ arrive and beat them (if you are quick ⟦6⟧ will not join the ⟦7⟧). Take the best German states (by resources and IC), build up your forces and take Italy, the Balkans, and France (avoid fighting with the ⟦8⟧ if possible). Build up your navy, attack the ⟦9⟧ and island hop to ⟦10⟧. It is easier with historical AI turned off because ⟦11⟧ can take ⟦12⟧ and/or ally with ⟦13⟧, and ⟦14⟧ may not join the ⟦15⟧).
1lj226k.zh: 转为⟦0⟧，加入⟦1⟧并夺取⟦2⟧，以便与⟦3⟧接壤。把苏台德地区建成 7 级要塞，并且不要交出苏台德。当⟦4⟧进攻时坚守到⟦5⟧抵达并击败他们（如果你够快，⟦6⟧不会加入⟦7⟧）。夺取最好的德国州（按资源与工业产能），发展你的军力，然后拿下意大利、巴尔干与法国（尽量避免与⟦8⟧交战）。发展你的海军，进攻⟦9⟧并跳岛到⟦10⟧。关闭历史 AI 会更容易，因为⟦11⟧可能拿下⟦12⟧和/或与⟦13⟧结盟，而⟦14⟧可能不会加入⟦15⟧）。

1bt0mdk.en: Turn ⟦0⟧, justify wargoals on ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ ASAP (don't choose any focus to get extra ⟦3⟧) - make sure both justifications finish at around the same time to avoid guarantees (playing on non-historical will reduce guarantee chances). During your justifications, take the focus Trust In the West to get rid of the ⟦4⟧ guarantee on you, pulling ⟦5⟧ in the war. In peace deal, annex the states you need to form Austria-Hungary. You can then justify and annex ⟦6⟧ to form AH, giving you cores (⟦7⟧ + extra factories).
1bt0mdk.zh: 转为⟦0⟧，尽快对⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧制造战争目标（不要选取任何焦点，以获得额外的⟦3⟧）——确保两个战争目标大约同时完成，以避免遭到保障（在非历史模式下游玩会降低被保障的几率）。在制造战争目标期间，选取「信任西方」焦点以摆脱⟦4⟧对你的保障，从而把⟦5⟧拉入战争。在和平协议中，吞并你成立奥匈帝国所需的各州。之后你就可以制造战争目标并吞并⟦6⟧来成立奥匈，从而获得核心（⟦7⟧ + 额外工厂）。

1nhybts.en: Switch to ⟦0⟧ through civil war. Justify a War goal on ⟦1⟧. Join the ⟦2⟧, declare war, wait a few days for ⟦3⟧ to send more troops to the frontline, paradrop on ⟦4⟧ (don't call ⟦5⟧). Build an ⟦6⟧ in Aru Islands. Join the war when ⟦7⟧ attacks ⟦8⟧, paradrop into Northern Territory, take Canberra (don't call the ⟦9⟧).
1nhybts.zh: 通过内战转为⟦0⟧。对⟦1⟧制造战争目标。加入⟦2⟧，宣战，等几天让⟦3⟧向前线派出更多部队，然后伞降⟦4⟧（不要召唤⟦5⟧）。在阿鲁群岛建造一个⟦6⟧。当⟦7⟧进攻⟦8⟧时加入战争，伞降进入北部领地，夺取堪培拉（不要召唤⟦9⟧）。

nymps9.en: Exiled ⟦0⟧ desc: Haile Selassie has, for the time being, set up a government in exile from his base in [?ETH.host_nation.GetNameDef]. The situation is dire, but far from hopeless. A number of warriors managed to escape and hopefully more will join us over time. Additionally, the Imperial family is well situated, so we should be able to divert funds to improve our chances of reconquering Ethiopia.
nymps9.zh: 流亡⟦0⟧ 描述：海尔·塞拉西暂时以其在 [?ETH.host_nation.GetNameDef] 的基地设立了流亡政府。局势严峻，但远非绝望。一批战士成功逃脱，希望随着时间推移会有更多人加入我们。此外，皇室家族安置妥当，因此我们应当能够调拨资金来提高我们 reconquer 埃塞俄比亚的机会。

1his53w.en: Host country desc: Although their homelands are under enemy occupation, some brave soldiers and citizens are willing to continue the struggle. If we extend our recognition to friendly governments in exile, they can harness the resources of the expatriates, emigres and refugees, forming new units which will fight at our side.
1his53w.zh: 东道国描述：尽管他们的家园正被敌人占领，一些勇敢的士兵与公民仍愿意继续抗争。如果我们承认友好的流亡政府，他们就能利用侨民、移民与难民的资源，组建新的部队与我们并肩作战。

1vttmev.en: Exiled country desc: Although our homelands are under enemy occupation, the government has managed to escape. We need to build support for our cause, gather all expatriates, emigres and refugees here, and work with our host to recapture our homeland.
1vttmev.zh: 流亡国家描述：尽管我们的家园正被敌人占领，政府仍成功逃脱。我们需要为我们的志业建立支持，把所有侨民、移民与难民聚集到这里，并与我们的东道国合作以夺回我们的家园。

1bwsg7t.en: Our united front will smash the hated enemy! By joining forces, we will combine the best of the assets available to our nation and overcome any obstacle the aggressor may throw at us!
1bwsg7t.zh: 我们的联合阵线将粉碎可恨的敌人！通过联合力量，我们将结合我国可用资产中最优秀的部分，克服侵略者可能抛给我们的一切障碍！

17oy36t.en: This is a list of decisions involving exiled governments (from ⟦0⟧).
17oy36t.zh: 这是涉及流亡政府的决议列表（来自⟦0⟧）。

1p58aq8.en: Polynesia is a country that can be formed by any one of the Pacific island nations that are of Austronesian descent, allowing the peoples of the Pacific Ocean to be united under one power. In 1936, the required states are owned by ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧. Somewhat uniquely, Polynesia can be formed if the forming nation is a puppet (dominion-level), meaning that it is possible for a nation to puppet one of the eligible nations and let it form Polynesia by giving it the requisite territories.
1p58aq8.zh: 波利尼西亚是一个可由任何南岛语系太平洋岛国成立的国家，使太平洋各民族统一于一个政权之下。1936 年，所需各州分别由⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧拥有。颇为独特的是，如果成立国是傀儡（自治领级别），波利尼西亚仍可成立，这意味着一个国家有可能傀儡化某个符合资格的国家，并通过给予其必要领土来让它成立波利尼西亚。

1hwsepk.en: The formable also widely matches the ⟦0⟧ led by Pavel Bermondt-Avalov or Eric Campbell, which can be created by the ⟦1⟧ via decision after completing the focus Create Asian Reichskommisariats.
1hwsepk.zh: 该可成立国家也与由帕维尔·别尔蒙特-阿瓦洛夫或埃里克·坎贝尔领导的⟦0⟧大致吻合，后者可由⟦1⟧在完成焦点「创建亚洲帝国专员区」后通过决议创建。

7o2pcj.en: Out of all the eligible nations, ⟦0⟧ has by far the best hopes for forming Polynesia, due to it having the highest population and a unique national focus tree.
7o2pcj.zh: 在所有符合资格的国家中，⟦0⟧成立波利尼西亚的希望远远最大，因为它拥有最多的人口与独特的国策树。

jlrg0k.en: Once ⟦0⟧ selects the above decision, It may integrate the Indonesian Islands. It will not integrate the Malaysian part of Borneo and ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧.
jlrg0k.zh: 一旦⟦0⟧选取上述决议，它就可以整合印度尼西亚群岛。它不会整合婆罗洲的马来西亚部分与⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧。

1hxbzne.en: Then attack ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. They will join the Allies, and if you are not sure you can hold them in Western Europe, you may release puppets bordering the Allies. You may do a collaboration government in Turkey so you won't have to grind the Allies for the mountains in the south of Turkey.
1hxbzne.zh: 然后进攻⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧。它们会加入同盟国，如果你不确定能在西欧挡住它们，可以释放与同盟国接壤的傀儡。你可以在土耳其建立一个合作政府，这样就不必为了土耳其南部的山区与同盟国苦战。

1ev10fs.en: As Austria or Hungary, led by Otto von Habsburg, control the starting states of Austria, Hungary, Czechoslovakia, Romania, Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey as well as the states in Polish Galicia, Slovenia and Croatia.
1ev10fs.zh: 作为由奥托·冯·哈布斯堡领导的奥地利或匈牙利，控制奥地利、匈牙利、捷克斯洛伐克、罗马尼亚、保加利亚、希腊与土耳其的开局各州，以及波兰加利西亚、斯洛文尼亚与克罗地亚的各州。

1amt9m.en: ⟦0⟧: Requires the states of Lombardy-Venetia even though it isn't mentioned in the achievement description.
1amt9m.zh: ⟦0⟧：需要伦巴底-威尼西亚各州，尽管成就描述中并未提及。

vqllp0.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个仅⟦1⟧可通过决议成立的可成立国家，代表同名地理区域的统一。

5y4mdw.en: In ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ starts as an independent and united Polynesia, obviously including an annexed ⟦2⟧ among the cores.
5y4mdw.zh: 在⟦0⟧中，⟦1⟧开局即为独立且统一的波利尼西亚，其核心显然包含被吞并的⟦2⟧。

1ohnlmg.en: ⟦0⟧ is an optional game mode that restricts the player's control over their save file, effectively removing the ability to correct mistakes or change decisions made during the course of play. Ironman can be enabled from the settings screen when starting a new campaign.
1ohnlmg.zh: ⟦0⟧是一种可选游戏模式，它限制玩家对存档的控制，实际上移除了在游玩过程中纠正错误或改变已做决定的能力。铁人模式可以在开始新战役时从设置界面启用。

17gvyux.en: The "Steam Cloud" option must be enabled for the game in the Steam library (Hearts of Iron IV/Properties/Updates). This also requires that "Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for applications which support it" is enabled in the Steam settings (Steam/Settings/Cloud).
17gvyux.zh: 必须在 Steam 库中为该游戏启用「Steam 云」选项（Hearts of Iron IV/属性/更新）。这还要求 Steam 设置中已启用「为支持该功能的应用程序启用 Steam 云同步」（Steam/设置/云）。

19c9y4n.en: The checksum must be the same as one of the official releases. Any mod that changes it (broadly, this means one that affects gameplay) will cause ironman mode to be disabled.
19c9y4n.zh: 校验和必须与某个官方发行版本相同。任何改变它的模组（大致而言，即影响玩法的模组）都会导致铁人模式被禁用。

qo6gg9.en: A ⟦0⟧, short for ⟦1⟧, is an alteration of the game files to change the game's functionality. It also makes it more fun. You can add cheats like EasyBuff or Go back to WW1 in The Great War Redux.
qo6gg9.zh: ⟦0⟧是⟦1⟧的缩写，是对游戏文件的改动，用于改变游戏功能。它也让它更好玩。你可以加入像 EasyBuff 这样的作弊功能，或者在《大战役：赤色》中加入「回到一战」。

1dtse59.en: Mods can be installed manually from sources such as the Paradox Forums, installed automatically from Paradox Mods by the launcher or via the Steam Workshop.
1dtse59.zh: 模组可以从 Paradox 论坛等来源手动安装，也可以由启动器从 Paradox Mods 自动安装，或通过 Steam 创意工坊安装。

171nf1e.en: Make sure that your mod contains a good description of what it does, as well as having a good front page image.
171nf1e.zh: 务必让你的模组包含一份对其功能的良好描述，并拥有一张良好的首页图片。

m3p3t3.en: Wiki pages for modifications are the responsibility of the modification team, not the Paradox wiki team
m3p3t3.zh: 模组的 wiki 页面由模组团队负责，而非 Paradox wiki 团队

1rzz6b4.en: ⟦0⟧ accepts the ID of the song, defined as its name within the *.asset file. ⟦1⟧ defines the chance for a song to be picked if the playmode is set to Weighted Shuffle. The allowed arguments are ⟦2⟧, for multiplying the chance, ⟦3⟧, for adding to the chance, and ⟦4⟧, replacing the chance entirely. ⟦5⟧ allows the argument to modify the chance only be executed if all of the triggers within are met.
1rzz6b4.zh: ⟦0⟧接受歌曲 ID，其定义为其在 *.asset 文件中的名称。⟦1⟧定义当播放模式设为「加权随机」时歌曲被选中的几率。允许的参数为⟦2⟧（乘以几率）、⟦3⟧（加到几率上）与⟦4⟧（完全替换几率）。⟦5⟧允许该参数仅在其内部所有触发器都满足时才执行对几率的修改。

71d5wo.zh: 名称列表文件似乎有约 1500 行的上限。超出该上限的任何名称列表可能无法正确工作，或无法完整显示。

1tmgj6z.en: Units, both land and naval, obtain their names from either a set list of names.
1tmgj6z.zh: 陆军与海军单位都从某一套名称列表中获得它们的名称。

15i6cvu.en: This is a list of all ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ from ⟦2⟧.

jgjb6u.en: Start building up your industry and go for Surrender the East. You have to become a puppet to join the Axis or the Comintern and while you can become independent quicker with the fascist path, you won't be able to get your cores back later on. Do not declare independence through the focus as the ⟦0⟧ would declare war on you, ask the ⟦1⟧ for Eastern Poland back and they should accept.
jgjb6u.zh: 开始发展你的工业，并选取「交出东部」。你必须成为傀儡才能加入轴心国或共产国际，而虽然走法西斯路线能更快独立，但你之后将无法取回你的核心。不要通过焦点宣布独立，因为⟦0⟧会对你宣战，改为向⟦1⟧索回波兰东部，它们应当会接受。

cyhavo.en: Switch to the repeating focus to raise your autonomy when ready, Hand Danzig over to the Germans to buy time. Eventually Germany will declare war on the USSR and they will call you in automatically, focus on defense until you're well equipped enough to take the fight to them.
cyhavo.zh: 准备好后切换到重复焦点以提高你的自治度，把但泽交给德国人以争取时间。最终德国会对苏联宣战，并会自动召唤你，专注防御，直到你装备足够精良可以对它们开战。

iw1cv9.en: You should be able to gain independence before the end of the war, through war contribution and the autonomy focus. You need a decent war score because you gained cores on eastern Germany, you need your old cores and the eastern German provinces to get the achievement.
iw1cv9.zh: 你应当能在战争结束前通过战争贡献与自治度焦点获得独立。你需要一份不错的战争分数，因为你获得了东德的核心；你需要旧核心与东德各省才能获得该成就。

p5gstu.en: Pick Organize the Peasant's Strike, then the two communist options. Take the decision to expand the strike to the factories and use your PP and CP to pick the states with the largest numbers of factories but as long as you gain a bit of land the civil war is simple.
p5gstu.zh: 选取「组织农民罢工」，然后选取两个共产主义选项。采取决议把罢工扩大到工厂，并使用你的政治点数与指挥点数来选取工厂数量最多的州，但只要你能获得一点土地，内战就很简单。

x2gosm.en: Pick Assemble the Regency Council, and Seek an Alliance with the Kaiser once Germany completes Return of the Kaiser or The Monarchy Compromise. This puts you in the German faction, so you can safely keep Danzig if the Germans ask for it.
x2gosm.zh: 选取「召集摄政委员会」，并在德国完成「凯撒归来」或「君主制妥协」后选取「寻求与凯撒结盟」。这会让你进入德国阵营，因此如果德国人索要但泽，你可以安全地保留它。

4zs31t.en: Peacefully annex other countries with your king's focuses. Habsburgs gives you ⟦0⟧ (don't pick the Habsburg faction as it takes you out of the German one), Hohenzollern gives ⟦1⟧ and Commonwealth provides war goals on the Baltic States.
4zs31t.zh: 用你国王的焦点和平吞并其他国家。哈布斯堡给你⟦0⟧（不要选取哈布斯堡阵营，因为它会让你退出德国阵营），霍亨索伦给你⟦1⟧，而联邦则提供对波罗的海国家的战争目标。

tw5uf8.en: As Poland, be independent and ensure that both Germany and the USSR are either in your faction or don’t exist.
tw5uf8.zh: 作为波兰，保持独立，并确保德国与苏联要么都在你的阵营中，要么都不存在。

wyf7uu.en: Check which political path Germany takes. If it's Oppose Hitler or Rally the Wehrmacht:
wyf7uu.zh: 查看德国走哪条政治路线。如果是「反对希特勒」或「团结国防军」：

1pez57q.en: Defeat the ⟦0⟧ with the help of Germany.

1w3nkrv.en: Rush the Demand Hungarian Submission focus, then take Reform the Central Powers, so Germany will bypass Anschluss and you won't get the related negative events. If you get the event for the German advisor, accept it; you can replace him shortly after with the 150 PP you would've lost in the event chain otherwise. Build an agency and start building a collaboration government on the ⟦0⟧, or you may do one on Germany first to get quicker capitulation and compliance. After doing Subjugate the Lands of Old, puppet ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. Germany will attack you after demanding Sudetenland, so take your puppet's divisions, put the 9/1 divisions in an army and quickly take East Prussia, then make encirclements and after each one be sure to replace the under strengthened 9/1s with new divisions.
1w3nkrv.zh: 速推「索要匈牙利臣服」焦点，然后选取「改革中央同盟」，这样德国就会跳过德奥合并，你也不会遭遇相关的负面事件。如果出现德国顾问事件，接受它；你之后可以用本来会在事件链中损失的 150 政治点数把他替换掉。建立一个机构并开始对⟦0⟧建立合作政府，或者你也可以先对德国建一个，以便更快迫使其投降并提高顺从度。在完成「征服旧日之地」之后，傀儡化⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧。德国会在索要苏台德之后进攻你，因此接管你傀儡的师，把 9/1 师编入一支部队并迅速拿下东普鲁士，然后实施包围，每完成一次包围后务必用新的师替换建制不足的 9/1 师。

ry190h.en: ⟦0⟧ will join the Axis, but it is likely you will capitulate Germany before they join the war and they will be the leader of the Axis. Attack them with the war goal from the focus. ⟦1⟧ will join the Axis and the war and you may kick ⟦2⟧ out of your faction so that they will join the Axis and you will get them earlier. The Allies may get into a war with Italy, but you should have enough war score for the land in Europe. Then you will be attacked by the ⟦3⟧. Meanwhile, annex the puppets one by one.
ry190h.zh: ⟦0⟧会加入轴心国，但你很可能在它们参战前就迫使德国投降，届时它们会成为轴心国领袖。用焦点提供的战争目标进攻它们。⟦1⟧会加入轴心国与战争，你可以把⟦2⟧踢出你的阵营，这样它们就会加入轴心国，你也能更早得到它们。同盟国可能会与意大利开战，但你应当有足够的战争分数来获取欧洲的土地。随后你会遭到⟦3⟧的攻击。与此同时，逐个吞并各傀儡。

wvhfpl.en: Added a max framerate limiting system (defaults to 75fps) to help people with the combination of bad cooling, great graphics cards and very high screen refresh. If you are one of these with heat issues I would love to hear if this solved it (changing max_frame_rate in settings can let you remove its effect by making it higher, or go lower if you still have issues)
wvhfpl.zh: 加入了最大帧率限制系统（默认为 75fps），以帮助那些同时具备散热差、显卡好且屏幕刷新率极高的人。如果你正是这类有散热问题的人，我很想知道这是否解决了问题（在设置中修改 max_frame_rate 可以调高来移除其效果，或者如果你仍有问题可以调得更低）

91a45g.en: Fanny Jabcovsky (⟦0⟧), Lord Linlithgow (⟦1⟧), Li Zongren (⟦2⟧), Manuel Luis Quezon (⟦3⟧), Armand Calines (⟦4⟧), Gheorghe Tatarescu (⟦5⟧), Sheng Shicai (⟦6⟧), Milan Grol (⟦7⟧), Milan Stojadinovic (⟦8⟧)
91a45g.zh: 范妮·雅布洛夫斯基（⟦0⟧）、林利思戈勋爵（⟦1⟧）、李宗仁（⟦2⟧）、曼努埃尔·路易斯·奎松（⟦3⟧）、阿尔芒·克林内斯库（⟦4⟧）、格奥尔基·塔塔雷斯库（⟦5⟧）、盛世才（⟦6⟧）、米兰·格罗尔（⟦7⟧）、米兰·斯托亚迪诺维奇（⟦8⟧）

15wzt40.en: Large peace conference resolutions are now faster and also properly indicate that they are active to non-participants.
15wzt40.zh: 大型和平会议决议现在处理得更快，并且会正确地向非参与方表明它们处于生效状态。

16wyesc.en: Stopped an exploit where player could redirect a naval transfer into an invasion without preparation.
16wyesc.zh: 阻止了一种漏洞，即玩家可以在没有准备的情况下把海军运输改为登陆。

wk9ymm.en: Added GUI scaling option for people with very small or very high resolution displays (experimental).
wk9ymm.zh: 为分辨率极低或极高的显示器加入了 GUI 缩放选项（实验性）。

19zghjm.en: Fixed a case where fleets who found themselves outside base range would be instantly deleted.
19zghjm.zh: 修复了舰队发现自己超出基地航程时会被立即删除的情况。

skwqfx.en: Fixed an issue with deploying troops during spanish civil war when continuing savegames.
skwqfx.zh: 修复了在继续存档游戏时于西班牙内战期间部署部队的问题。

1x7qpoq.en: France can now send volunteers to Spain if they choose the Support Nationalists focus.
1x7qpoq.zh: 法国现在如果选取「支持民族主义者」焦点，就可以向西班牙派遣志愿军。

emd1dm.en: 1.0.1 is a hotfix which was released on 2016-06-13⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.

10dqvas.en: Improved a lot of alternate ideology nation names and party/leader names.
10dqvas.zh: 改进了大量替代意识形态的国家名称以及政党/领袖名称。

1kmlwoj.en: Fixed many localization issues, both in english and other languages.
1kmlwoj.zh: 修复了许多本地化问题，包括英语与其他语言。

1xpkquj.en: Can now zoom in and out using PgUp and PgDown buttons on keyboard.
1xpkquj.zh: 现在可以使用键盘上的 PgUp 与 PgDown 键进行缩放。

1i7mwv1.en: 1.0 was the release version, and as such had no changelog.
1i7mwv1.zh: 1.0 是发行版本，因此没有更新日志。

110hxl6.en: Fixed some highlighting issues in tutorial.
110hxl6.zh: 修复了教程中的一些高亮问题。

1f7m42j.en: Improved some VP/state names in China.
1f7m42j.zh: 改进了中国的一些胜利点/州名称。

1psbegn.zh: 修复了若干罕见的崩溃。

1miewuw.en: Changed language flag for English in launcher to show US/UK split (I fully expect everyone not to be happy with this, but this was at least what we wanted to do from the get-go)
1miewuw.zh: 更改了启动器中英语的语言标记，以显示美式/英式之分（我完全预计大家对此都不会满意，但这至少是我们从一开始就想做的）

13wt40j.en: Democracies allowing fascists in government no longer turn fascist faction leaders communist in election events
13wt40j.zh: 允许法西斯主义者进入政府的民主国家，在选举事件中不再把法西斯阵营领袖变成共产主义者

103k5zf.en: Fixed an issue for users who had mods installed prior to the mod system update refusing to update etc
103k5zf.zh: 修复了在模组系统更新之前安装了模组的用户拒绝更新等问题

1ewt9zd.en: AI now more careful about considering units in combats when it needs to rebalance fronts
1ewt9zd.zh: AI 在需要重新平衡战线时，现在会更谨慎地考虑战斗中的单位

114l547.en: 1.2.1 is a hotfix was released on 2016-09-23⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.

1piy2wg.en: Improved AI supply evaluation for fronts with supply issues
1piy2wg.zh: 改进了对有补给问题的战线的 AI 补给评估

g55tda.en: Changed default display mode in new launcher to borderless fullscreen from exclusive fullscreen when launched for the first time, to restore behavior from the previous launcher.
g55tda.zh: 把新启动器首次启动时的默认显示模式从独占全屏改为无边框全屏，以恢复先前启动器的行为。

1j5uy07.en: Prevented the Paradox Account login window from popping up when entering the multiplayer lobby when not using the Paradox matchmaking service.
1j5uy07.zh: 防止在不使用 Paradox 匹配服务时进入多人游戏大厅会弹出 Paradox 账户登录窗口。

1yx38qn.en: Fixed a potential security issue tied to the way LUA libraries were loaded for mods.
1yx38qn.zh: 修复了一个与模组加载 LUA 库方式相关的潜在安全问题。

1oqlz3a.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域决定天气系统何时出现，记法为⟦1⟧，即⟦2⟧表示天气系统在 1 月 1 日至 31 日之间（含这些天）出现。注意第一天与第一月标记为 0，而非 1。

1wpx7g2.en: Each strategic region is typically stored in it's own file, although you can store multiple strategic region definitions within the same file, as the ID is defined within the strategic region definition, rather than the file title.
1wpx7g2.zh: 每个战略区域通常存储在各自的文件中，不过你也可以在同一文件中存储多个战略区域定义，因为 ID 是在战略区域定义内部而非文件标题中定义的。

1nbq1sl.en: ⟦0⟧ defines the localization key the strategic region uses. You can use a non-localized string (i.e. "Paris"), but it is best practice to use localized strings.
1nbq1sl.zh: ⟦0⟧定义战略区域使用的本地化键。你可以使用非本地化字符串（即「Paris」），但最佳实践是使用本地化字符串。

kxwjnr.en: Each of the weather states are given a weight, determining how likely the state will occur within the weather system. The weather states can be found in ⟦0⟧.
kxwjnr.zh: 每种天气状态都被赋予一个权重，决定该状态在天气系统中出现的可能性。天气状态可以在⟦0⟧中找到。

1unu67n.en: When placing strategic regions, the provinces they are compose of should be contiguous. This means islands are normally part of a ⟦0⟧ strategic region.
1unu67n.zh: 放置战略区域时，它们所组成的省份应当是连续的。这意味着岛屿通常属于一个⟦0⟧战略区域。

1wdrpbr.en: ⟦0⟧ defines the numerical id used by the strategic region. The strategic region IDs must be added sequentially, skipping numbers will cause crashes.
1wdrpbr.zh: ⟦0⟧定义战略区域使用的数字 ID。战略区域 ID 必须按顺序添加，跳过数字会导致崩溃。

1ckkj5h.en: ⟦0⟧ scope determines the minimum amount of snow that is always present in the weather system. Typically only used for areas with year-round snow.
1ckkj5h.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域决定天气系统中始终存在的最小积雪量。通常只用于常年积雪的地区。

1huy01n.en: ⟦0⟧ scope determines the minimum and maximum temperature variability during day and night for the weather system.
1huy01n.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域决定天气系统在昼夜之间的最小与最大温度变化幅度。

83on8d.en: Each strategic region has a ⟦0⟧ scope that determines how the weather changes for provinces within it.
83on8d.zh: 每个战略区域都有一个⟦0⟧作用域，决定其内部省份的天气如何变化。

22fkca.en: ⟦0⟧ (This is no longer used since version 1.11, set all temperature ranges via temperature)
22fkca.zh: ⟦0⟧（自 1.11 版本起不再使用，请通过 temperature 设置所有温度范围）

1pcqb9m.en: ⟦0⟧ scope determines the weather within the provinces covered by the strategic region.
1pcqb9m.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域决定战略区域所覆盖省份内的天气。

1l0bxj5.en: ⟦0⟧ scope determines the minimum and maximum temperature for the weather system.
1l0bxj5.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域决定天气系统的最低与最高温度。

6d9znn.en: ⟦0⟧ scope defines which provinces the strategic region is composed over.
6d9znn.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域定义战略区域由哪些省份组成。

1cj68bp.en: Each weather system is defined within a ⟦0⟧ scope within the ⟦1⟧ scope.
1cj68bp.zh: 每个天气系统都在⟦0⟧作用域中定义，位于⟦1⟧作用域内。

67vtch.en: Here is a generic example of a strategic region:
67vtch.zh: 以下是一个战略区域的通用示例：

p17jry.en: Each supply area is typically stored in it's own file, although you can store multiple supply area definitions within the same file, as the ID is defined within the supply area definition, rather than the file title.
p17jry.zh: 每个补给区通常存储在各自的文件中，不过你也可以在同一文件中存储多个补给区定义，因为 ID 是在补给区定义内部而非文件标题中定义的。

p4nzs3.en: ⟦0⟧ defines the localization key the supply area uses. You can use a non-localized string (i.e. "Paris"), but it is best practice to use localized strings.
p4nzs3.zh: ⟦0⟧定义补给区使用的本地化键。你可以使用非本地化字符串（即「Paris」），但最佳实践是使用本地化字符串。

2gag0d.en: ⟦0⟧ defines the numerical id used by the supply area. The supply area IDs must be added sequentially, skipping numbers will cause crashes.
2gag0d.zh: ⟦0⟧定义补给区使用的数字 ID。补给区 ID 必须按顺序添加，跳过数字会导致崩溃。

wlft5c.en: When placing supply areas, the states they are compose of should be contiguous. This means islands should have their own supply areas.
wlft5c.zh: 放置补给区时，它们所组成的州应当是连续的。这意味着岛屿应当拥有各自的补给区。

o0pcxb.en: NOTE: Supply areas are deprecated as of patch 1.11 Barbarossa/No Step Back. The following only applies to version 1.10 and before.
o0pcxb.zh: 注意：补给区自 1.11 巴巴罗萨/绝不后退补丁起已弃用。以下内容仅适用于 1.10 及更早版本。

qv40y9.en: ⟦0⟧ scope defines which states the supply area covers. Note that supply areas should normally cover more than one state.
qv40y9.zh: ⟦0⟧作用域定义补给区覆盖哪些州。注意补给区通常应当覆盖一个以上的州。

1fxuuwq.en: ⟦0⟧ defines the amount of base supply the supply area grants. In vanilla, the supply varies from 0 to 16.
1fxuuwq.zh: ⟦0⟧定义补给区提供的基础补给量。在原版中，补给量从 0 到 16 不等。

nrtyid.en: Here is a generic example of a supply area:
nrtyid.zh: 以下是一个补给区的通用示例：

h8g4ga.en: The average supply value in vanilla is 10.
h8g4ga.zh: 原版中的平均补给值为 10。

1u3gom3.en: After that go to the decisions tab and start using the "Support anti-British resistance" options, which are available on the map. First do that in Tanganyika then in other required provinces. Now go for "Anti-British propaganda" decision. Just after resistance strength hits 70 in a given province use "Arm anti-British resistance" in the decision tab.
1u3gom3.zh: 之后前往决议标签页，开始使用地图上可用的「支持反英抵抗」选项。先在坦噶尼喀这样做，然后在其他所需省份这样做。接着选取「反英宣传」决议。当某省份的抵抗强度刚达到 70 时，在决议标签页使用「武装反英抵抗」。

1cjtybn.en: If the ⟦0⟧ will not accept your demands, don't use option to go to war with them. Wait, as there is a chance that the ⟦1⟧ and the liberated country will sign a white peace. If they do so, start justifying, start war, win, annex. If they don't do so, start the game all over again.
1cjtybn.zh: 如果⟦0⟧不接受你的要求，不要使用与其开战的选项。等待，因为有可能会⟦1⟧与被解放的国家签订白色和平。如果它们这样做，就开始制造战争目标、开战、取胜、吞并。如果它们不这样做，就重新开始游戏。

9mos0k.en: Wait until Tanzania breaks free (it will form from Tanganyika), then the same should happen with Kenya (will be formed from other 4 required provinces). Both countries will start a war for independence with the ⟦0⟧. Use decisions to demand ending the war.
9mos0k.zh: 等到坦桑尼亚挣脱独立（它会从坦噶尼喀成立），然后肯尼亚也应当发生同样的事（它将由其他 4 个所需省份成立）。这两个国家都会对⟦0⟧发动独立战争。使用决议要求结束战争。

1dkc6s7.en: Access to the focus Towards African Unity is, as before, possible through Rebuilding the country. Just don't do Jah or The One True Heir of Solomon.
1dkc6s7.zh: 与之前一样，可以通过「重建国家」来选取「走向非洲统一」焦点。只是不要做「Jah」或「所罗门唯一真正的继承人」。

1xdextm.en: Playing with historical-ai off has a chance of the ⟦0⟧ going anti-colonial, in which case you may not have to fight the Allies.
1xdextm.zh: 关闭历史 AI 游玩时有几率让⟦0⟧走向反殖民，那样的话你可能不必与同盟国作战。

41l6of.en: Meanwhile, stockpile a lot of infantry equipment (5k) and Political Power (215). You will also need about 125 Command Power.
41l6of.zh: 与此同时，囤积大量步兵装备（5k）与政治点数（215）。你还需要约 125 指挥点数。

1yvbmg4.en: If the ⟦0⟧ accepts your demands the country will join your faction, kick it and start justifying, start war, win, annex.
1yvbmg4.zh: 如果⟦0⟧接受你的要求，该国就会加入你的阵营，把它踢出去，然后开始制造战争目标、开战、取胜、吞并。

175x0pa.en: Rush the provinces it requires to get the achievement, all you need is to control them rather than owning them.
175x0pa.zh: 速推获得该成就所需的省份，你只需要控制它们而非拥有它们。

bc4i3q.en: Note that you only need to occupy the required states for this ⟦0⟧ to trigger.
bc4i3q.zh: 注意，你只需要占领所需各州即可触发此⟦0⟧。

88wn0k.en: Get your war goal from Pan-Africanism, then declare war on the ⟦0⟧.
88wn0k.zh: 从「泛非主义」获得你的战争目标，然后对⟦0⟧宣战。

14hs096.en: Wait for the Allies to fight ⟦0⟧ in North Africa.
14hs096.zh: 等待同盟国在北非与⟦0⟧交战。

uxtjij.en: Still can be done during a ⟦0⟧ achievement run.
uxtjij.zh: 仍然可以在⟦0⟧成就流程中完成。

24pmz.en: Can be done with The Lion that Roared.
24pmz.zh: 可以与「怒吼的狮子」一起完成。

43unoc.en: Go down the The Emperor Stays path.

lbe7q5.en: The below is a collection of PDX video tutorials for ⟦0⟧.
lbe7q5.zh: 以下是⟦0⟧的 PDX 视频教程合集。

km9xbu.en: Naval units are represented by single ships, and - unlike land and air units - are produced with shipyards. Naval units are assigned to strategic areas but operate in individual sea zones. Ships are divided into destroyers, cruisers (both heavy and light), battlecruisers, battleships (both normal and super-heavy), carriers, submarines, transports, and convoys. The latter two have no direct on-map presence. As in Hearts of Iron 3, more obscure ship classes (e.g. pre-dreadnought battleships or armoured cruisers) have been abstracted into the previously listed types.
km9xbu.zh: 海军单位以单艘舰船表示，并且——与陆军和空军单位不同——是用船坞生产的。海军单位被分配到战略区域，但在各个海区中独立行动。舰船分为驱逐舰、巡洋舰（重巡与轻巡）、战列巡洋舰、战列舰（普通与超重型）、航空母舰、潜艇、运输船与运输船队。后两者没有直接的地图存在。与《钢铁雄心 3》一样，更冷门的舰种（例如前无畏舰或装甲巡洋舰）已被抽象为前述类型。

5wmgsb.en: Land units in Hearts of Iron IV are represented on the map by ⟦0⟧. Divisions subdivide into regiments and then into battalions, and can be customized via the Division Designer. There is a maximum of five battalions in a regiment and five regiments in a division. Such regiments are in some countries referred to as "brigades". Also, up to five support companies can be attached to a division. Land units can be split into four groups: leg infantry, mobile infantry (e.g. cavalry and motorised infantry), tanks and support units (artillery, anti-tank guns, etc).
5wmgsb.zh: 《钢铁雄心 4》中的陆军单位在地图上以⟦0⟧表示。师细分为团，再细分为营，并可通过师设计师自定义。一个团最多五个营，一个师最多五个团。这类团在某些国家被称为「旅」。此外，一个师最多可附加五个支援连。陆军单位可分为四类：徒步步兵、机动步兵（例如骑兵与摩托化步兵）、坦克与支援单位（火炮、反坦克炮等）。

x3nahw.en: Unlike in previous Hearts of Iron games, the atomic unit for air units is not air wings or squadrons. Instead, each air unit represents an individual aircraft. Aircraft are deployed into strategic regions, and to obtain air superiority opposing air units in a strategic region must be overwhelmed. Aircraft divide into light, medium, and heavy airframes filling multiple roles, and can be customized with experience.
x3nahw.zh: 与以往的《钢铁雄心》游戏不同，空军单位的原子单位不是航空队或中队。相反，每个空军单位代表一架单独的飞机。飞机会部署到战略区域，要获得制空权就必须压制战略区域内的敌方空军单位。飞机分为轻型、中型与重型机体，承担多种角色，并可用经验进行自定义。

1b0jti9.en: In Hearts of Iron IV, ⟦0⟧ are the basic instrument through which the player wages war. As such, they are extremely important.
1b0jti9.zh: 在《钢铁雄心 4》中，⟦0⟧是玩家进行战争的基本工具。因此它们极其重要。

7v5x7h.en: Start the game with historical AI off, simulate the first 70 days and keep restarting the game until the Germany AI picks the Oppose Hitler focus and ⟦0⟧ Balanced Budget focus. 8/10 times the German Military Junta wins that war (1/10 they lose and 1/10 the civil war lasts for years). While the German civil war rages on, keep an eye on Hungary. Only if Hungary picks Invite the Habsburg Prince there will be Austria-Hungary. When the German civil war is over and the German Military Junta has won they always will go down the path to restore the Kaiserreich. At that point, you just need to be patient, because after that the AI will slowly progress down the focus tree and at some point reach The Central Powers focus. Once they complete it and the Central Powers faction exists you should be able to join that faction (unless you are somehow still democratic).
7v5x7h.zh: 关闭历史 AI 开始游戏，模拟前 70 天并反复重开，直到德国 AI 选取「反对希特勒」焦点且⟦0⟧选取「平衡预算」焦点。10 次中有 8 次德国军政府会赢得那场战争（10 次中有 1 次失败，10 次中有 1 次内战持续数年）。在德国内战持续期间，密切关注匈牙利。只有当匈牙利选取「邀请哈布斯堡王子」时才会有奥匈帝国。当德国内战结束且德国军政府获胜后，它们总是会走上恢复德意志帝国的道路。到那时你只需要耐心，因为此后 AI 会缓慢沿国策树推进，并在某个时点抵达「中央同盟」焦点。一旦它们完成该焦点且中央同盟阵营存在，你就应当能够加入该阵营（除非你不知为何仍是民主国家）。

2gtjlh.en: To better monitor the AI choices, build a spy agency and upgrade the economy/civilian branch. Get spies on both Germany and Hungary. When civilian intelligence is 50%, you can see which focuses they have taken. When it is 70%, you can see which focus they are currently working on.
2gtjlh.zh: 为了更好地监控 AI 的选择，建立一个特工机构并升级经济/民用分支。在德国与匈牙利都布置特工。当民用情报达到 50% 时，你可以看到它们已选取哪些焦点。当达到 70% 时，你可以看到它们当前正在研究哪个焦点。

1hgxs2m.en: Be aware that because of the fact that historical AI is off Hungary could create the Pact of Rome and get in an early war (non-historical ⟦0⟧ sometimes justifies on ⟦1⟧ 1937) or tries to form A-H itself and then fails. So you might need a bit of luck for this strategy to succeed.
1hgxs2m.zh: 请注意，由于关闭了历史 AI，匈牙利可能会创建罗马协定并卷入早期战争（非历史⟦0⟧有时会在 1937 年对⟦1⟧制造战争目标），或者试图自行组建奥匈但随后失败。因此这一策略可能需要一点运气才能成功。

1rjeb4e.en: Even if Hungary is unable to reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire, it is still possible for Germany to trigger its formation after it finishes the "Rekindle Imperial Sentiment" focus. To speed that up, you can boost your non-aligned ideology with a spy network in Czechoslovakia.
1rjeb4e.zh: 即使匈牙利无法重建奥匈帝国，德国仍有可能在完成「重燃帝国情怀」焦点后触发其成立。为加快这一进程，你可以在捷克斯洛伐克用特工网提升你的中立主义意识形态。

eeytv1.en: It is extremely important to turn off the ⟦0⟧ DLC. Also, revert to patch 1.14.5 so that Germany and Hungary retains their old focus trees. Otherwise, Germany and Hungary are even less likely to choose the right paths.
eeytv1.zh: 关闭⟦0⟧DLC 极其重要。同时回退到 1.14.5 补丁，以便德国与匈牙利保留它们的旧国策树。否则，德国与匈牙利选择正确路线的可能性会更低。

os7j6a.en: As Turkey, be in a faction with Germany and Austria-Hungary.
os7j6a.zh: 作为土耳其，与德国和奥匈帝国同处一个阵营。

1pzzx1w.en: Defeating the rest of Germany, will not be easy on its own. Console wise it is simple enough. But for an interesting challenge rather join the Allies to gain protection from the British, and build an army as fast as possible to hold the ground against the "East" German state. Declare war on them and subsequently annex them to form Germany.
1pzzx1w.zh: 击败德国其余部分本身并不容易。就控制台而言这很简单。但若想要有趣的挑战，不如加入同盟国以获得英国的保护，并尽快建立一支军队以守住阵地对抗「东」德国家。对它宣战并随后吞并它，以成立德国。

p3s1cf.en: In order to play as early as West Germany, you would have to spawn it via console commands with either manually adding cores to release it with its tag ⟦0⟧, have it own states by manually doing the setowner WGR command then tag WGR to switch, or by annexing any country to East Germany with the command annex GER WGR to annex Germany.
p3s1cf.zh: 要想尽早以西部德国游玩，你必须通过控制台指令生成它，方式可以是手动添加核心以按其 tag⟦0⟧释放它、手动执行 setowner WGR 指令让它拥有各州然后 tag WGR 切换，或者用 annex GER WGR 指令吞并德国，把任何国家吞并给东德。

aw56ac.en: West Germany starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
aw56ac.zh: 西部德国开局拥有 2 个科研槽，尽管它可以通过通用国策树最多再获得 3 个槽。作为一个可释放国家，被释放时它会继承释放国已经研究过的所有科技。

1a6wkes.en: The ⟦0⟧ was first made a concept during the Yalta Conference, when they decided where the Soviet and Allied spheres of influence in Europe would be. Eventually, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ reunified in 1990 one year before the dissolution of the ⟦3⟧.
1a6wkes.zh: ⟦0⟧最初是在雅尔塔会议上成为一个概念的，当时他们决定了苏联与盟国在欧洲的势力范围。最终，⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧于 1990 年重新统一，比⟦3⟧解体早一年。

1bul0ey.en: West Germany can only be played with Ironman turned off, as since it cannot be spawned without using console commands. However, it can form Germany if it controls the required states.
1bul0ey.zh: 西部德国只能在关闭铁人模式时游玩，因为不使用控制台指令就无法生成它。不过，如果它控制了所需各州，它就可以成立德国。

qliwvy.en: Not to be confused with the West Germany cosmetic tag used on Germany when the ⟦0⟧ event triggers that gets applied when the Germans get puppeted after the peace conference.
qliwvy.zh: 不要与德国在⟦0⟧事件触发时所使用的西部德国外观标签混淆，该标签会在和平会议后德国被傀儡化时应用。

7sevem.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country that cannot appear in-game as it has no core states and cannot gain any.
7sevem.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个可释放国家，无法在游戏中出现，因为它没有核心州且无法获得任何核心州。

6ha9jm.en: When released, West Germany will be a ⟦0⟧ nation with that holds elections every 4 years.
6ha9jm.zh: 被释放时，西部德国将是一个⟦0⟧国家，每 4 年举行一次选举。

asx2v6.en: West Germany has the following political parties:
asx2v6.zh: 西部德国拥有以下政党：

zoo67l.zh: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟

mg6l9e.en: Overview of the West German nation

kbrsfq.zh: 德意志社会主义共和国

1h6ts93.en: Since ⟦0⟧ has been integrated to the base game, this event can't be triggered.
1h6ts93.zh: 由于⟦0⟧已整合进基础游戏，该事件无法被触发。

tnnabm.en: ⟦0⟧ must be ⟦1⟧ for this strategy to work. This is because due to the new faction mechanics, the UK most probably will be able to call democracies that are being attacked into their faction already when World Tension is around 15%.
tnnabm.zh: ⟦0⟧必须为⟦1⟧，这一策略才能奏效。这是因为有了新的阵营机制，当世界紧张度约为 15% 时，英国很可能已经能够把正遭受进攻的民主国家召唤进其阵营。

w3v0ov.en: Alternatively just join the ⟦0⟧, get military access from ⟦1⟧ (when they are at war with the ⟦2⟧) and naval invade from Japan (VERY easy).
w3v0ov.zh: 或者直接加入⟦0⟧，从⟦1⟧获得军事通行权（当它们与⟦2⟧交战时），并从日本发动海军登陆（非常容易）。

11mc1r3.en: As Czechoslovakia, occupy Canberra while at war with the Allies.
11mc1r3.zh: 作为捷克斯洛伐克，在与同盟国交战时占领堪培拉。

1oee4uq.en: You can then join ⟦0⟧ faction and invade from their territory.
1oee4uq.zh: 然后你就可以加入⟦0⟧阵营，并从它们的领土发动入侵。

lx22ln.en: Replace the Cavalry Recon Attachment with Engineer Companies on your main Infantry Division. Switch the Mountaineers and 6 Cavalry to that template, and delete the rest of the Cavalry (you can't afford to keep them supplied). Divide your army in 2 stacks of 24, assigning a Field Marshal and Generals with high Defense. Your production line should consist of 1 factory on anti-air, 3 on support equipment and the rest on infantry equipment. Increase later on where needed. Create a duplicate of your Infantry Division which also include Support Anti-Air. Switch some to this template later on as you get enough equipment. Put your army group on a fallback line in a circle from Warzaw to Łódź, leaving a safe province in the middle (see Method 1 image). When your units start moving, push B with them selected to activate Strategic Redeployment. It'll get them to the fallback line an extra day or so early, which helps Entrenchment. Rush to construct level 1 ⟦0⟧ all along the fallback line. This gets you a large defensive boost from your Engineer Companies. Queue up some ⟦1⟧ as well for after the forts finish. Gather your entire air force around Warzaw and activate them to help brace off the initial onslaught. Focus your research on anti-air upgrades, engineer upgrades, and upgrades to infantry weapons/bonuses. Specifically, start with Engineer Company II, Improved Radio, Improved Infantry Equipment I, and the Rkm Browning (aka Improved Support Equipment II). It's worth it to use your 100% bonus in Industry to grab Assembly Line Production ahead of time when one of those researches finishes, as well.
lx22ln.zh: 把你主力步兵师中的骑兵侦察连替换为工兵连。把山地兵与 6 个骑兵切换到该编制，并删除其余骑兵（你无力维持它们的补给）。把你的军队分成 2 个各 24 个师的集群，分配一位元帅与防御高的将军。你的生产线应包含 1 座工厂生产防空、3 座生产支援装备，其余生产步兵装备。之后按需增加。复制你的步兵师并加入支援防空连。等装备足够后，把一些师切换到这个编制。把你的集团军放在一条环形退守线上，从华沙到罗兹，中间留出一个安全的省份（见方法 1 图片）。当你的单位开始移动时，选中它们并按 B 以激活战略再部署。这会让他们提前一天左右到达退守线，有助于构筑工事。速建沿整条退守线的 1 级⟦0⟧。这会通过你的工兵连为你带来巨大的防御加成。同时排好一些⟦1⟧的建造队列，等要塞建成后进行。把你全部空军集中到华沙附近并激活它们，以帮助抵挡最初的猛攻。把你的科研集中在防空升级、工兵升级以及步兵武器/加成升级上。具体而言，从工兵连 II、改进无线电、改进步兵装备 I 以及 Rkm 勃朗宁（又名改进支援装备 II）开始。当其中一项研究完成时，用你在工业上的 100% 加成提前拿下流水线生产也是值得的。

19ey568.en: For advisors and such: Pick the only Army Chief available and the Infantry (Expert). You can pick the weapons designer or spend PP on research bonuses (depending on if you have ⟦0⟧ enabled or not). Save the rest of your PP for when the war starts to pick ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, and to activate scorched earth in some of your states that are about to fall. It's worth taking the two static War Support increasing decisions when you can, as well. Release Ukraine and Belarus and ⟦4⟧ (in Zaolzie) as puppets ⟦5⟧ Germany invades and do ⟦6⟧ call them into war. For your focusses: The Castle -> Prepare for the Inevitable -> Resistance Industries -> Exile Industries -> The Sanation Right -> The Sanation Left down to A New King in the Castle -> Local Western Plans and then economic focusses for more factories/resources. For the Infantry land subdoctrine, you're going to want to take either Great War Infantry (+10% Defense bonus initially) or Defensive Postures (+20% Entrenchment bonus initially). As Great War Infantry is a half-cost subdoctrine, make sure you use your 100% cost reduction buff on a different subdoctrine (probably your Operations subdoctrine - for which most options are good) first if you go that route.
19ey568.zh: 关于顾问之类：选取唯一可用的陆军参谋长与步兵（专家）。你可以选取武器设计师，或者把政治点数花在科研加成上（取决于你是否启用了⟦0⟧）。把其余政治点数留到战争开始时用于选取⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧，以及在你一些即将陷落的州激活焦土。能选的时候拿下两个静态的战争支持度提升决议也是值得的。释放乌克兰与白俄罗斯以及（在扎奥尔杰的）⟦4⟧作为傀儡，在⟦5⟧德国入侵时，做⟦6⟧把它们召唤进战争。关于你的焦点：城堡 -> 为不可避免之事做准备 -> 抵抗工业 -> 流亡工业 -> 萨纳齐右派 -> 萨纳齐左派，一路到「城堡中的新国王」 -> 地方西部计划，然后是经济焦点以获得更多工厂/资源。关于步兵陆战次级学说，你会想选取「大战步兵」（初始 +10% 防御加成）或「防御姿态」（初始 +20% 构筑工事加成）。由于大战步兵是半价次级学说，如果你走那条路，务必先把你的 100% 花费减免 buff 用在另一个次级学说上（大概是你的作战次级学说——其中大多数选项都不错）。

1c38o2l.en: When the war starts, join the ⟦0⟧ and make sure to import resources, which is possible via the land route through your puppets to the east. The first months of the war are the hardest, you can't lose any provinces and have to constantly monitor where more divisions need to be relocated to keep holding the lines. However, ⟦1⟧ when it comes to moving troops around. The Entrenchment bonus on troops is a ⟦2⟧ deal, so keep at minimum 5-6 units stationary on every tile, and only have a couple of units move around to reinforce. When Germany attacks ⟦3⟧, it should be easy going afterwards. Give Wilno to the Soviets if they demand it. If ⟦4⟧ refuses to capitulate, the ⟦5⟧ either does not go to war with Germany at all, or the war happens much later (possibly in 1943 or later). You'll hit 1.8M long before the Soviet Union gets involved. You can hold the front indefinitely, but you will probably have difficulty breaking out without Soviet help (at best, you could recapture a few provinces here and there, but don't get too aggressive - even without its allies, the German Reich still has 3x your fielded manpower and 5x your military output.)
1c38o2l.zh: 战争开始时，加入⟦0⟧，并务必进口资源，这可以通过陆路经你东边的傀儡实现。战争的头几个月最艰难，你不能丢失任何省份，并且必须不断监控哪些地方需要调动更多师来守住阵线。不过，在调动部队方面⟦1⟧。部队上的构筑工事加成是⟦2⟧的事，所以每块地块上至少保持 5-6 个单位静止不动，只让少数单位移动以进行增援。当德国进攻⟦3⟧时，之后应当就轻松了。如果苏联索要维尔诺，就给它。如果⟦4⟧拒绝投降，⟦5⟧要么根本不与德国开战，要么战争会晚得多（可能在 1943 年或更晚）。你会在苏联介入之前很久就达到 180 万。你可以无限期守住阵线，但如果没有苏联的帮助，你大概会难以突破（充其量你能零星夺回几个省份，但不要过于激进——即使没有盟友，德意志帝国仍拥有你 3 倍的现役人力与 5 倍的军事产出。）

1rkyev7.en: Delete your entire army and air force immediately. Spend political power oriented towards a defensive infantry. Research towards the same. When Germany declares war join the ⟦0⟧ and wait for Germany to push towards Warsaw. If playing on an old version, you can do the lend lease trick (it has since been patched). Lend lease your entire stockpile of equipment to the ⟦1⟧. When you capitulate and become an exiled government, cancel the lend lease. Go down the exiled government subtree and focus on getting factories first. Build a small but capable army of maybe 12-16 divisions.
1rkyev7.zh: 立即删除你的全部陆军与空军。把政治点数花在防御性步兵上。科研也朝同一方向。当德国宣战时，加入⟦0⟧并等待德国向华沙推进。如果在旧版本上游玩，你可以用租借技巧（此后已被修复）。把你全部的装备储备租借给⟦1⟧。当你投降并成为流亡政府时，取消租借。沿流亡政府子树往下走，优先获得工厂。建立一支约 12-16 个师的小而精干的军队。

1xfp9q6.en: When you have enough troops trained and ready plan naval invasions into ⟦0⟧ (e.g. the Cherbourg area). Launch when Germany has weakened its defenses after starting Barbarossa. Secure a bridgehead of ~5 provinces and dig in. Once you've built up entrenchment you can basically go speed 5 and simply wait. With this method 'Hard' is already exaggerated. Alternatively you can stir up resistance in ⟦1⟧ and cause the Warsaw Uprising.
1xfp9q6.zh: 当你有足够部队训练完毕并准备就绪时，计划对⟦0⟧发动海军登陆（例如瑟堡地区）。在德国因发动巴巴罗萨而削弱防御后发起。确保一个约 5 个省份的桥头堡并挖壕固守。一旦你建起构筑工事，基本上就可以开 5 倍速干等。用这种方法，「困难」已经算是夸张了。或者你也可以在⟦1⟧煽动抵抗并引发华沙起义。

13nqhw3.en: As Poland in the 1939 “Blitzkrieg” scenario start, inflict over 1,800,000 casualties to Germany to beat the 2018 PDXCON HOI4 challenge. Extra bragging rights if you do it in 30 minutes or less!
13nqhw3.zh: 作为波兰在 1939 年「闪击战」剧本开局，给德国造成超过 1,800,000 伤亡，以击败 2018 年 PDXCON 的 HOI4 挑战。如果你在 30 分钟内完成，还有额外的吹嘘资本！

fexq7k.zh: 遵循前一份指南，但使用另一种防御布局（见方法 2 图片）。

1jl6tda.zh: 成就的本地化由两个 loc 键完成。后缀 NAME 指成就标题，DESC 指描述，描述可以是某个有趣的玩笑，也可以是你如何描述才能达成该成就。

owm3i7.en: Paradox allowed the creation of custom achievements to be displayed in the Career Profile of a player. The ability to create these achievements came with the Avalanche (1.12.1) release.
owm3i7.zh: Paradox 允许创建自定义成就，并显示在玩家的生涯档案中。创建这些成就的能力随雪崩（1.12.1）版本一同到来。

lvpk3j.zh: 成就可以在生涯档案中找到（游戏内该按钮称为「通关概览」），图像可在 Paradox 论坛获取。

eeg3ro.en: Images for achievements require three different images which are provided in ⟦0⟧. These do not require a spriteType in interface.
eeg3ro.zh: 成就要用到的图像需要三种不同的图片，它们提供在⟦0⟧中。这些不需要在 interface 中设置 spriteType。

1kov34o.en: ⟦0⟧ - (OPTIONAL) This is only required for ribbons. This allows you to change the colors of the ribbon utilizing RGB color code.
1kov34o.zh: ⟦0⟧ -（可选）仅丝带需要此项。它允许你使用 RGB 颜色代码更改丝带的颜色。

1dlrf1q.en: ⟦0⟧ - This is mandatory and custom to your mod. It references the name of the cloudsavefile that will store the achievements.
1dlrf1q.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 此项为必填，且对你的模组而言是自定义的。它引用的是将存储这些成就的云存档文件名。

mn8ll9.en: Some common triggers not used in the code example are tag checks (with either ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧) or ironman checks (⟦2⟧).
mn8ll9.zh: 代码示例中未使用的一些常见触发器是 tag 检查（用⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧）或铁人检查（⟦2⟧）。

1ttot0s.en: This is similar to ⟦0⟧ in decisions or ideas, though it is evaluated at the game's start rather than before.
1ttot0s.zh: 这类似于决议或理念中的⟦0⟧，不过它是在游戏开始时而非之前进行评估的。

1mma4pi.en: ⟦0⟧ - Once these conditions are met then the achievement is earned. (Usually instant to ~2 in-game hours)
1mma4pi.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 一旦满足这些条件，成就即被获得。（通常是即时到约 2 个游戏小时）

3kdh00.en: Checks if the player controlling the current scope has completed the specified custom achievement.
3kdh00.zh: 检查控制当前作用域的玩家是否已完成指定的自定义成就。

p26not.en: Refers to the colorized icon that is available should you complete the achievement.
p26not.zh: 指你完成成就后可用的彩色图标。

fwucyz.en: If the mod defining the achievement is not loaded, the trigger evaluates as false.
fwucyz.zh: 如果定义该成就的模组未加载，该触发器判定为假。

1klh3n5.en: If false at the game's start, getting the achievement will never be possible.
1klh3n5.zh: 如果在游戏开始时为假，那么获得该成就将永远不可能。

tw3qfo.en: Refers to the icon if it is not able to be earned during that playthrough.
tw3qfo.zh: 指在该通关流程中无法获得时所用的图标。

136e9zu.en: Refers to the icon if it is possible to be earned during that playthrough
136e9zu.zh: 指在该通关流程中可以获得时所用的图标

71rvoa.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 这是你该特定成就的唯一标识符。

qnx8pf.zh: [3] 在你的模组中编写成就文件的教程

1rn4at.zh: [2] 在模组成就中设计丝带的教程

wbfdec.en: Aircraft are ⟦0⟧ that can be used to equip air wings and are ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧. For details on how aircraft statistics affect air wing operation, see ⟦3⟧ and air wing.
wbfdec.zh: 飞机是⟦0⟧，可用于装备航空队，它们是⟦1⟧，位于⟦2⟧中。关于飞机属性如何影响航空队运作的细节，请见⟦3⟧与航空队。

gst7sa.en: Aircraft designed with these airframes can have the following roles depending on their primary armament (the weapon selected for the leftmost armament slot):
gst7sa.zh: 用这些机体设计的飞机，其可担任的角色取决于其主要武器（选在最左侧武器槽的武器）：

1wheczf.en: Design Cost of changing engine is 6 ⟦0⟧. When not changing number of engines, then directly upgrading engine for one level above costs only 3 ⟦1⟧.
1wheczf.zh: 更换引擎的设计花费为 6⟦0⟧。当不改变引擎数量时，直接把引擎升一级只需 3⟦1⟧。

c504yd.en: Designs equipped with at least one of these weapons will disable the conditional effects of other weapon types on ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ missions.
c504yd.zh: 装备了这些武器中至少一种的设计，会在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧任务中禁用其他武器类型的条件效果。

qnf8e4.en: Aircraft designs that use one of these weapons for their main armament are classified as Naval Bombers or Naval Patrol Bombers.
qnf8e4.zh: 把其中一种武器作为主要武器的飞机设计，被归类为海军轰炸机或海军巡逻轰炸机。

o3yu0.en: ⟦0⟧ (on Close Air Support, Strategic Bombing, Naval Strike, Port Strike, Logistics Strike, Naval Minelaying, Naval Patrol)
o3yu0.zh: ⟦0⟧（作用于近距空中支援、战略轰炸、对海攻击、港口打击、后勤打击、海军布雷、海军巡逻）

sfjfjb.en: Only one of each module type can be equipped on an airframe. E.g., if ⟦0⟧ is equipped, then ⟦1⟧ is also not available.
sfjfjb.zh: 每种模块类型在机体上只能装备一个。例如，如果装备了⟦0⟧，那么⟦1⟧也不可用。

gvn9rn.en: Aircraft designs that use one of these weapons for their main armament are classified as Fighters or Heavy Fighters.
gvn9rn.zh: 把其中一种武器作为主要武器的飞机设计，被归类为战斗机或重型战斗机。

sfxroa.en: These weapons cannot be used as a plane's main armament and therefore do not affect the classification of a design.
sfxroa.zh: 这些武器不能用作飞机的主要武器，因此不影响设计的分类。

m2gsdj.en: Multiple of the following can be equipped on an airframe, with the exact limit based on the specific airframe used.
m2gsdj.zh: 以下模块可以在机体上装备多个，具体上限取决于所使用的特定机体。

qftune.en: Aircraft designs that use one of these weapons for their main armament are classified as Close Air Support.
qftune.zh: 把其中一种武器作为主要武器的飞机设计，被归类为近距空中支援。

rhjvj9.en: Aircraft designs that use one of these weapons for their main armament are classified as Strategic Bombers.
rhjvj9.zh: 把其中一种武器作为主要武器的飞机设计，被归类为战略轰炸机。

197olge.en: Aircraft designs that use one of these weapons for their main armament are classified as Tactical Bombers.
197olge.zh: 把其中一种武器作为主要武器的飞机设计，被归类为战术轰炸机。

1ln9gfi.en: These specialized airframes are self-contained designs that cannot be used with the aircraft designer.
1ln9gfi.zh: 这些专用机体是自成一体的设计，无法在飞机设计器中使用。

t2y3le.en: Aircraft designs that use one of these weapons for their main armament are classified as Scout Planes.
t2y3le.zh: 把其中一种武器作为主要武器的飞机设计，被归类为侦察机。

a1vkp9.en: These modules can be equipped in the auxiliary, or special, module slots of an airframe.
a1vkp9.zh: 这些模块可以装备在机体的辅助或特殊模块槽中。

1t3h8ub.en: ⟦0⟧ (on Close Air Support, Naval Strike without any ⟦1⟧, Port Strike without any ⟦2⟧)
1t3h8ub.zh: ⟦0⟧（作用于近距空中支援、无任何⟦1⟧时的对海攻击、无任何⟦2⟧时的港口打击）

13r8qnz.zh: 作用于任务类型：海军巡逻、对海攻击、港口打击、战略轰炸

1j0w31n.zh: 除非另有说明，所有机体的可靠性均为 80%。

5cc55r.zh: 以下模块可以在机体上装备任意数量。

1369rmx.zh: 使用航母机体设计的飞机可以成为⟦0⟧。

kzss2z.zh: 关于模块数据，请参见⟦0⟧文件夹中的参考文件。
