1rc9pdb.zh: 每座工厂的资源使用量

1oq1odq.en: While at war, try to encircle the tank divisions and fast moving divisions, this will help massively. If this is done, it becomes less risky to call in ⟦0⟧. Hold out until the allies join the war, at which point the axis can easily be defeated. By controlling as much German territory as possible during the war and integrating, they are cheaper to claim in the peace deal. If the axis is defeated before you can core all states, this should be ok as the German Republic should not be a puppet or subject of ⟦1⟧/ ⟦2⟧ and not part of the allies. You will have much more manpower and can edit the infantry templates and add artillery and anti-air as necessary, as well as Austrian Italy potentially. The ⟦3⟧ will then declare war. Build sufficient mobilized infantry to encircle the soviet forces. Declare war on the German Republic (using "Annex Country" as cause if possible) and overrun them, they will be weakened. They may join ⟦4⟧ at which point you will have to defeat Japan to end the war.
1oq1odq.zh: 交战时，试着包围坦克师与快速移动师，这会大有帮助。如果做到了，召唤⟦0⟧的风险就会降低。坚守到同盟国参战，那时轴心国就能轻易被击败。在战争期间尽可能控制更多德国领土并进行整合，它们在和平协议中就更容易被索要。如果轴心国在你把所有州都设为核心之前就被击败，这应当也没问题，因为德意志共和国不应当是⟦1⟧/⟦2⟧的傀儡或附属国，也不应是同盟国的一员。你将拥有多得多的人力，可以按需编辑步兵编制并加入火炮与防空，还可能包括奥属意大利。之后⟦3⟧会宣战。建立足够的摩托化步兵来包围苏联军队。对德意志共和国宣战（尽可能用「吞并国家」作为理由）并碾压它们，它们会被削弱。它们可能会加入⟦4⟧，那时你就必须击败日本才能结束战争。

1xwfgd7.en: Make sure to keep political power aside for the diplomatic annexation decisions. Put your spy on diplomatic pressure and pressure Hungary, gaining an non-aggression pact while doing the Demand Hungarian Submission focus. Then do the same with ⟦0⟧. Take Subjugate the Lands of Old immediately after. Take the industrial bribery decision with Hungary and then invite them to become an Austro-Hungarian Vassal. For ⟦1⟧, rally against them and do border exercises, and send them the invite to become a subject. Hungary and ⟦2⟧ usually accept at "Likely to accept" threshold. Move your spy from ⟦3⟧ to ⟦4⟧ then ⟦5⟧ and offer non-aggression pacts to both. Improve relationships with the countries if need be. To maximize success with these three, take industrial bribery and joint military exercises before sending the invite to become a vassal. If time allows, do the same for Albania.
1xwfgd7.zh: 务必留出政治点数用于外交吞并决议。把你的特工用于外交施压并施压匈牙利，在做「索要匈牙利臣服」焦点期间获得一份互不侵犯条约。然后对⟦0⟧做同样的事。紧接着选取「征服旧日之地」。对匈牙利采取工业贿赂决议，然后邀请它成为奥匈附庸。对于⟦1⟧，对它们进行鼓动并做边境演习，然后向它们发出成为附属国的邀请。匈牙利与⟦2⟧通常在「可能接受」门槛上就会接受。把你的特工从⟦3⟧移到⟦4⟧，再移到⟦5⟧，并向两者提议互不侵犯条约。如有需要，改善与这些国家的关系。为了最大化对这三国的成功率，在发出成为附庸的邀请之前采取工业贿赂与联合军事演习。如果时间允许，对阿尔巴尼亚也这样做。

i4sj9w.en: At some point, work towards the A Thousand Year Federation to make annexing vassals easier. They will never promote to puppet from Austro-Hungarian vassal so do not worry about that. Work towards building up your military and annexing the territories after the war with the USSR, and proclaiming the Austro-Hungarian Empire. Should you still not be able to take all German territory, build up and prepare to attack the allies via The War Against the Guarantors. France should be relatively easy to capitulate via Austrian Italy, and then the allied German puppets should be small enough to overrun. Make sure to have defenses on the coast to prevent naval invasions.
i4sj9w.zh: 在某个时点，朝「千年联邦」努力，以便更容易吞并附庸。它们永远不会从奥匈附庸升级为傀儡，所以不用担心这一点。努力发展你的军队，并在与苏联的战争之后吞并领土，宣告奥匈帝国。如果你仍然无法拿下全部德国领土，就发展并准备通过「对抗保障者之战」进攻同盟国。法国通过奥属意大利应当相对容易投降，之后同盟国的德国傀儡应当小到足以碾压。务必在海岸设防以防海军登陆。

1majf66.en: Start by building max forts along the border with the Germans. Research AA after the basic industry and electronics research to build max AA in Tirol and Upper Austria after the forts. Build a spy agency and develop the diplomatic pressure upgrade. Take Repeal the May Constitution, Reichsbund der Österreicher, and Reinstate the Herrenhaus. Then work towards Devalue the Schilling. Take Architectural Advancements before continuing to Rebellious Rearmament.
1majf66.zh: 开始时沿与德国的边境修建最高级要塞。在基础工业与电子学研究之后研究防空，以便在要塞之后在蒂罗尔与上奥地利修建最高级防空。建立一个特工机构并开发外交施压升级。选取「废止五月宪法」、「奥地利人帝国联盟」与「恢复贵族院」。然后朝「让先令贬值」努力。在继续「叛乱性重整军备」之前选取「建筑进步」。

oux9xm.en: Once Germany declares, focus on holding the forts, and feel free to call in ⟦0⟧, Hungary, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ but do not call in ⟦3⟧. Take The Silesian Question and work towards The Better German State via renewing claims in Italy. It is worth getting a non-aggression pact with the soviet union throughout this to prevent going to war with them at the same time as Germany. Take the decision to integrate/core all German states over time.
oux9xm.zh: 一旦德国宣战，专注守住要塞，可以随意召唤⟦0⟧、匈牙利、⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧，但不要召唤⟦3⟧。选取「西里西亚问题」，并通过在意大利重申主张来朝「更好的德意志国家」努力。在整个过程中获得与苏联的互不侵犯条约是值得的，以免与德国同时开战。随时间推移采取决议整合/设为核心所有德国州。

1lgqyol.en: After Subjugate the Lands of Old, work down to Österreichisches Bundesheer, and then down to Improved Warfare Strategies, via Establish the Franz Böhme Plan. Take the focuses Bring Phönix Insurance From the Ashes, and The Great Austrian Economic Push, as soon as the idea ⟦0⟧ expires. Then start the joint focus tree with Indivisible and Inseparable.
1lgqyol.zh: 在「征服旧日之地」之后，往下走到「奥地利联邦军」，再通过「建立弗朗茨·伯梅计划」往下走到「改进战争策略」。在理念⟦0⟧到期后尽快选取「从灰烬中带来凤凰保险」与「奥地利大经济推动」焦点。然后以「不可分割与不可分离」开始联合国策树。

u9170v.en: Throughout this process, make sure to take the decisions to increase division defense on core territory for 25 political power and up security around military high command. Anschluss will happen soon. Try to get a non-aggression pact with ⟦0⟧ as soon as Germany declares war.
u9170v.zh: 在整个过程中，务必采取花 25 政治点数提高核心领土上师防御的决议，并加强军事最高统帅部周边的安全。德奥合并很快就会发生。尽量在德国宣战后尽快与⟦0⟧获得互不侵犯条约。

hyiviq.en: Once you have enough political power, hire ⟦0⟧, change mobilization law to partial mobilization, and hire ⟦1⟧. After taking Rebellious rearmament, train 18 of the standard infantry template.
hyiviq.zh: 一旦你有足够的政治点数，聘用⟦0⟧，把动员法令改为部分动员，并聘用⟦1⟧。在选取「叛乱性重整军备」之后，训练 18 个标准步兵编制。

q4uvu8.en: Integrate all the cores and the achievement should fire even if at war.
q4uvu8.zh: 整合所有核心，即使处于战争状态该成就也应当触发。

1ouy63q.en: As Austria, control all German starting states.
1ouy63q.zh: 作为奥地利，控制所有德国开局州。

t19p7k.en: This pair of technologies first unlocks a rather limited chassis for ⟦0⟧ and then unlocks a special module that can be used to make more flexible ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ amphibious tank designs. These units tend to be more expensive than their non-amphibious counterparts, but they are far better in wet ⟦4⟧ and at performing naval invasions. Their designs can also use heavier weapons that are normally reserved for without being forced to be classified as such, allowing them to retain more breakthrough and benefit from certain ⟦5⟧ bonuses that are given only to tanks and not to armor variants.
t19p7k.zh: 这对科技首先为⟦0⟧解锁一个相当受限的底盘，然后解锁一个特殊模块，可用于制造更灵活的⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧两栖坦克设计。这些单位往往比非两栖同类更贵，但它们在潮湿的⟦4⟧中以及执行海军登陆时好得多。它们的设计还可以使用通常保留给其他类型而不被迫如此分类的更重武器，从而使它们保留更多突破，并受益于某些只给予坦克而不给予装甲变型的⟦5⟧加成。

1is8xjp.en: ⟦0⟧ replaces the basic armor technology system with a more modular system that feeds into the ⟦1⟧. Rather than researching dedicated vehicles, the new system focuses on researching only the chassis for entire classes of vehicles, with a few armor technologies also unlocking new armor and special modules. Importantly, the armaments used by tanks in the ⟦2⟧, which are also used to dictate which specialized roles a given armor variant can take, are researched as part of ⟦3⟧ instead, and many powerful special modules require research in other technology trees, such as ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧.
1is8xjp.zh: ⟦0⟧用一个更模块化的系统取代了基础装甲科技体系，并接入⟦1⟧。新系统不再研究专用车辆，而是专注于只研究整类车辆的底盘，另有少数装甲科技也会解锁新的装甲与特殊模块。重要的是，⟦2⟧中坦克所使用的武器——它们也用于决定某个装甲变型可以承担哪些专门角色——改为作为⟦3⟧的一部分进行研究，而许多强大的特殊模块需要其他科技树中的研究，例如⟦4⟧或⟦5⟧。

1phz3gt.en: These technologies serve to unlock new chassis that can be used for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, as well as the ⟦4⟧ support company. They can also be used for ⟦5⟧. In the late game, they can also be used to unlock super-heavy chassis that can be used for ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧ support company; with Götterdämmerung, these can also lead to the development of equipment for the monstrous ⟦10⟧ support company. Heavy chassis technologies can act as alternative prerequisites to medium chassis technologies for unlocking modern chassis that can be used for ⟦11⟧, ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧, and ⟦14⟧.
1phz3gt.zh: 这些科技用于解锁可用于⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的新底盘，以及⟦4⟧支援连。它们也可用于⟦5⟧。在游戏后期，它们还可用于解锁可用于⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧与⟦9⟧支援连的超重型底盘；有了《诸神黄昏》，这些还可以导致为庞大的⟦10⟧支援连开发装备。重型底盘科技可以作为中型底盘科技的替代前置，用于解锁可用于⟦11⟧、⟦12⟧、⟦13⟧与⟦14⟧的现代底盘。

lhhrik.en: Medium chassis vehicles tend to strike a good balance between cost and effectiveness. While not as cheap as their light chassis cousins, the improvements they offer in stats and armament options can be far greater relative to their cost increase, regularly making them the best choice in terms of stats-per-cost. Their heavy chassis cousins can still absolutely outclass them in terms of one-on-one combat performance, but are far more expensive and so are far harder to field in critical mass numbers compared to vehicles based on medium chassis.
lhhrik.zh: 中型底盘车辆往往在成本与效能之间取得良好平衡。虽然不像其轻型底盘表亲那样便宜，但它们在属性与武器选项上的改进相对于成本增加可以大得多，常常使其在「属性/成本」方面成为最佳选择。它们的重型底盘表亲在一对一作战表现上仍能彻底压过它们，但要贵得多，因此与基于中型底盘的车辆相比，远更难形成关键数量。

1bojpjp.en: Heavy chassis vehicles tend to be amazing in terms of combat effectiveness, but have incredibly high production and resource costs. They also tend to be much slower than their lighter cousins and receive greater ⟦0⟧ penalties than them in more adverse conditions. Still, on the attack on the battlefield, they are essentially peerless, and opponents who face these vehicles will either have to match them with their own or find a less conventional way of dealing with them.
1bojpjp.zh: 重型底盘车辆在作战效能方面往往惊人，但生产与资源成本高得离谱。它们也往往比其更轻的表亲慢得多，并在更恶劣的条件下承受更大的⟦0⟧惩罚。尽管如此，在战场进攻中它们基本上无可匹敌，面对这些车辆的对手要么必须用自己的同类来对抗，要么找到一种不那么常规的方式来对付它们。

ysofh0.en: Light chassis tend to be cheap and make for faster and more reliable vehicles, especially in the earlygame, but they also tend to have little armor, far less breakthrough than their heavier counterparts, and far more limited armament options, especially in the later years, when they act far better as more specialized combat support vehicles or in support companies than as frontline tanks.
ysofh0.zh: 轻型底盘往往便宜，能造出更快、更可靠的车辆，尤其是在游戏前期，但它们也往往装甲薄弱，突破远少于更重的同类，武器选项也远更有限，尤其是在后期年份，那时它们作为更专门的战斗支援车辆或用于支援连，比作为前线坦克要好得多。

1rcdlxv.en: With the introduction of special projects in Götterdämmerung and the accompanying ⟦0⟧, all armor technologies now also generate land warfare breakthrough progress while being researched. Armor technologies are also particularly intertwined with the ⟦1⟧ land warfare special project.
1rcdlxv.zh: 随着《诸神黄昏》引入特殊项目以及随之而来的⟦0⟧，所有装甲科技现在在研究时也会产生陆战突破进度。装甲科技还与⟦1⟧陆战特殊项目特别紧密交织。

1bp3far.en: These technologies unlock new chassis on top of which new vehicles can be designed in the ⟦0⟧. The first chassis technology is unspecialized and unlocks a huge array of basic armored vehicle modules. Subsequent chassis technologies are far more specialized in what they unlock.
1bp3far.zh: 这些科技解锁新底盘，在此基础上可以在⟦0⟧中设计新车辆。第一项底盘科技不专门化，解锁大量基础装甲车辆模块。后续底盘科技在所解锁内容上要专门得多。

1gsexzp.en: These technologies serve to unlock new chassis that can be used for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, as well as the ⟦4⟧ support company. They can also be used for ⟦5⟧. In the late game, they can also be used to unlock modern chassis that can be used for ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧.
1gsexzp.zh: 这些科技用于解锁可用于⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的新底盘，以及⟦4⟧支援连。它们也可用于⟦5⟧。在游戏后期，它们还可用于解锁可用于⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧与⟦9⟧的现代底盘。

1thusbc.en: These technologies serve to unlock new chassis that can be used for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, as well as the ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and, with ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ support companies. They also help unlock ⟦8⟧ for amphibious designs, and their chassis can be used for ⟦9⟧ designs.
1thusbc.zh: 这些科技用于解锁可用于⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的新底盘，以及⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧支援连，并且在有⟦6⟧时还有⟦7⟧支援连。它们还有助于为两栖设计解锁⟦8⟧，其底盘可用于⟦9⟧设计。

xl20yi.en: These technologies increase the maximum amount of armor upgrades available in the ⟦0⟧, allowing tanks to resist more damage at the expense of increased cost and decreased speed and reliability. Some also unlock new armor and defensive special modules.
xl20yi.zh: 这些科技提高⟦0⟧中可用的最大装甲升级量，使坦克能以增加成本、降低速度与可靠性为代价抵抗更多伤害。有些还解锁新的装甲与防御特殊模块。

b0i5pn.en: These technologies improve the capabilities of or unlock new modules for ⟦0⟧. They all require having completed the ⟦1⟧ special project. Some also provide benefits for ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧ support companies.
b0i5pn.zh: 这些科技改进⟦0⟧的能力或为其解锁新模块。它们都要求已完成⟦1⟧特殊项目。有些还为⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧支援连提供收益。

1tt6b57.en: These technologies increase the maximum amount of engine upgrades available in the ⟦0⟧, allowing tanks to move faster at the expense of increased cost and fuel usage and decreased reliability.
1tt6b57.zh: 这些科技提高⟦0⟧中可用的最大引擎升级量，使坦克能以增加成本与燃料消耗、降低可靠性为代价移动更快。

187cm3q.en: All amphibious tanks count as special forces, benefitting from general bonuses given to special forces units, but also being limited by a country's special forces capacity.
187cm3q.zh: 所有两栖坦克都算作特种部队，享受给予特种部队单位的通用加成，但也受国家特种部队容量限制。

10kdl06.en: This technology improves the ⟦0⟧ bonuses of ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ flame tanks and unlocks a more powerful armament for them.
10kdl06.zh: 该科技改进⟦0⟧加成，针对⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧喷火坦克，并为它们解锁一种更强大的武器。

1cg7dw8.en: For armor technology without ⟦0⟧, see the separate ⟦1⟧ page.
1cg7dw8.zh: 关于没有⟦0⟧的装甲科技，请见单独的⟦1⟧页面。

tw6f73.en: Armor Upgrades values of ⟦0⟧ and above. ⟦1⟧

9b3vua.en: Engine Upgrades values of ⟦0⟧ and above.

1emn2q1.en: Armor Upgrades values of ⟦0⟧ and above.

wa6e4y.en: Anti-air artillery has a very powerful air attack, allowing it to shoot down enemy aircraft. Their hard attack and piercing capabilities are significantly better than those of standard artillery, but inferior to anti-tank, and their soft attack is a fraction of standard artillery. This makes them better than standard artillery at attacking lightly armored vehicles, like motorized and mechanized infantry, but relatively poor against infantry (though they will still do a serviceable job). Units that deal air attack damage also help to counter enemy air superiority in the strategic region they are located in and shoot down enemy Close Air Support.
wa6e4y.zh: 防空火炮拥有非常强大的对空攻击，能击落敌机。它们的硬攻与穿透能力明显优于标准火炮，但劣于反坦克炮，而它们的软攻只是标准火炮的一小部分。这使它们在攻击轻装甲车辆（如摩托化与机械化步兵）时优于标准火炮，但对步兵相对较差（尽管它们仍能起到尚可的作用）。造成对空攻击伤害的单位也有助于在它们所在的战略区域抗衡敌方制空权，并击落敌方近距空中支援。

yudjku.en: All of these technologies are interlinked with special projects, providing breakthrough progress in one or more categories while being researched as well as benefiting benefitting from any ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in their fields. Most are tied to land warfare projects, indicated by green ribbons in the lower right-hand corner of their icons. Some of them are tied to aerodynamics and avionics projects, indicated by red ribbons in the lower right-hand corner of their icons.
yudjku.zh: 所有这些科技都与特殊项目相互关联，在研究时为某一或多个类别提供突破进度，同时受益于任何⟦0⟧在其领域内进行的被动研究。大多数与陆战项目相关，由其图标右下角的绿色丝带表示。其中一些与空气动力学与航空电子学项目相关，由其图标右下角的红色丝带表示。

hkmtd9.en: ⟦0⟧ unlocks technologies related to different types of artillery, anti-air guns, and anti-tank guns. There are four larger branches in the tree: the artillery branch, the anti-air branch, the anti-tank branch, and the rocket artillery branch. The starting technology for each major branch unlocks a new piece of equipment, a line combat battalion, and a corresponding support company that can be used in templates in the ⟦1⟧.
hkmtd9.zh: ⟦0⟧解锁与不同类型火炮、防空炮与反坦克炮相关的科技。树中有四个较大的分支：火炮分支、防空分支、反坦克分支与火箭炮分支。每个主要分支的起始科技都会解锁一件新装备、一个战线战斗营，以及一个可在⟦1⟧的编制中使用的相应支援连。

c8vrxs.en: Wise commanders should note that 40%⟦0⟧ of a division's piercing comes from the piercing of the brigade or support company with the highest piercing value in that division. Just a single line brigade or support company that uses anti-tank guns can therefore be incredibly valuable, as they can ensure that the division can ⟦1⟧ enemy armored divisions.
c8vrxs.zh: 明智的指挥官应当注意，一个师 40%⟦0⟧的穿透来自该师中穿透值最高的旅或支援连的穿透。因此，仅仅一个使用反坦克炮的战线旅或支援连就可能极其宝贵，因为它们能确保该师可以⟦1⟧敌方装甲师。

niide5.en: Anti-air technologies are all tied to both the land warfare and aerodynamics and avionics special project categories, generating breakthrough progress in those categories when they are being researched and benefitting from ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in either category.
niide5.zh: 防空科技都同时与陆战以及空气动力学与航空电子学特殊项目类别相关，在研究时于这些类别中产生突破进度，并受益于在任一类别中进行被动研究的⟦0⟧。

ep57hx.en: Rocket artillery technologies are all tied to the aerodynamics and avionics special project category, generating breakthrough progress in that category when they are being researched and benefitting from ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in that category.
ep57hx.zh: 火箭炮科技都与空气动力学与航空电子学特殊项目类别相关，在研究时于该类别中产生突破进度，并受益于在该类别中进行被动研究的⟦0⟧。

1abi5t6.en: Artillery technologies are all tied to the land warfare special project category, generating breakthrough progress in that category when they are being researched and benefitting from ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in that category.
1abi5t6.zh: 火炮科技都与陆战特殊项目类别相关，在研究时于该类别中产生突破进度，并受益于在该类别中进行被动研究的⟦0⟧。

17sjcb.en: Anti-tank technologies are all tied to the land warfare special project category, generating breakthrough progress in that category when they are being researched and benefitting from ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in that category.
17sjcb.zh: 反坦克科技都与陆战特殊项目类别相关，在研究时于该类别中产生突破进度，并受益于在该类别中进行被动研究的⟦0⟧。

z6b32x.en: Anti-tank artillery deals a lot of hard damage and has high piercing, making them excel in taking out vehicles on the ground. However, their low soft attack means they are not very effective against softer targets, such as infantry.
z6b32x.zh: 反坦克炮造成大量硬伤害并具有高穿透，使其在消灭地面车辆方面表现出色。然而，它们低下的软攻意味着它们对较软的目标（如步兵）不太有效。

yplk13.en: Although slightly more expensive, rocket artillery tends to deal more soft damage and have much greater breakthrough than normal artillery, but is even less effective against armored vehicles.
yplk13.zh: 虽然略贵一些，火箭炮往往比普通火炮造成更多软伤害并拥有大得多的突破，但对装甲车辆的效果更加差。

1d4pemu.en: Normal artillery deals large amounts of soft damage, making them effective against infantry and lightly armored vehicles.
1d4pemu.zh: 普通火炮造成大量软伤害，使其对步兵与轻装甲车辆有效。

1oniuxv.en: ⟦0⟧ via Invest in Mountain Guns or Expand the Mountain Regiments
1oniuxv.zh: ⟦0⟧通过「投资山地炮」或「扩充山地团」

v50uo0.en: ⟦0⟧ via Revive the Screw Guns or Mountain Guns

6p3nw2.en: ⟦0⟧ via Invest in Ordnance Mountain Howitzers

15kfwoc.en: Static Anti Air hit chance factor: ⟦0⟧
15kfwoc.zh: 静态防空命中几率系数：⟦0⟧

1ibmqhp.en: There's a high risk that someone will join a major faction after you declare on them. The logic there is unclear and it may be random. Anyone who's over 30% Democratic can join the the Allies (this applies to Uruguay, Argentina, and Chile), and anyone who's over 30% Fascist can join the Axis (Peru and Venezuela). Rushing things is supposed to help (they are less likely to join factions if world tension is low; try to do as much conquering as you can before German invasion of Poland.) Jaguar Diplomacy and a non-aggression pact with the UK do ⟦0⟧ prevent the UK from letting your opponents into the Allies or from being called into a war against you. If your opponent joins the Axis, reroll (possibly after trying for Snakes on a plane and/or ⟦1⟧.) If they join the Allies, be prepared for naval invasions into every unprotected port and for a fleet with 10 capital ships to show up and start shredding your navy. It might still work if you bag Argentina and Chile (and make sure to take their navies in peace conference) before you have to fight the UK.
1ibmqhp.zh: 在你对某人宣战后，有很高风险会有人加入一个主要阵营。其中的逻辑并不清楚，可能是随机的。任何民主倾向超过 30% 的国家都可以加入同盟国（这适用于乌拉圭、阿根廷与智利），而任何法西斯倾向超过 30% 的国家都可以加入轴心国（秘鲁与委内瑞拉）。速战速决据说有帮助（世界紧张度低时它们加入阵营的可能性更小；尽量在德国入侵波兰之前完成尽可能多的征服）。「美洲豹外交」以及与英国的互不侵犯条约⟦0⟧阻止英国让你的对手加入同盟国，或被召唤进对你发动的战争。如果你的对手加入轴心国，就重开（也可以先尝试「飞机上的蛇」和/或⟦1⟧）。如果它们加入同盟国，就准备好在每一个未设防港口遭遇海军登陆，以及一支拥有 10 艘主力舰的舰队出现并开始撕碎你的海军。如果你必须在与英国作战之前先拿下阿根廷与智利（并确保在和平会议中夺取它们的海军），这可能仍然可行。

108md9n.en: If you're somehow still not at war with the Allies at this point, declare war on them, optionally join Axis, and naval invade the ⟦0⟧. One way that works reliably (even without the need to join the Axis) is to go across the North Atlantic. With the USA capitulated and their massive steel reserves at your disposal, ramp up naval output, invade Greenland, then Iceland, then Ireland (all three will be lightly protected), then, using Ireland as a staging area for your armies, launch simultaneous naval invasions aimed at several points across the Irish Sea. Once you have full control of their coastline from Liverpool to Glasgow and 48 divisions manning the line, UK's days are numbered. The hardest part will be amassing enough navy to get 50% naval superiority needed for the invasion.
108md9n.zh: 如果到这时你不知为何仍未与同盟国交战，就对它们宣战，可选地加入轴心国，并对⟦0⟧发动海军登陆。一种可靠可行的方法（甚至无需加入轴心国）是横跨北大西洋。在美国已投降、其庞大钢铁储备归你支配的情况下，加大海军产出，入侵格陵兰，然后冰岛，然后爱尔兰（这三者防御都会很薄弱），接着以爱尔兰作为你军队的集结地，对爱尔兰海沿岸若干地点同时发动海军登陆。一旦你完全控制了从利物浦到格拉斯哥的整条海岸线，并有 48 个师守在那条线上，英国的日子就屈指可数了。最困难的部分将是积攒足够的 海军以获得登陆所需的 50% 制海权。

wa0ece.en: Start aggressively building dockyards and a large fleet as soon as Chile and Argentina capitulate. You'll need a minimum of 12-15 capital ships and 60-80 well-equipped screens to have a decent chance of naval invasion of the UK. You'll get about half of that (~6 capital ships and a number of destroyers) as spoils of war from Chile and Argentina, the rest you'll have to build yourself (none of the other powers on the continent own capital ships, at best, you'll get a few destroyers and subs from them.) Note that you start with a -40% dockyard construction / -15% dockyard output malus and you need to do the Corrida Armamentista Naval focus to remove it.
wa0ece.zh: 一旦智利与阿根廷投降，就立即开始积极建造船坞与一支庞大舰队。你至少需要 12-15 艘主力舰与 60-80 艘装备良好的屏卫舰，才有像样的机会对英国发动海军登陆。你将从智利与阿根廷的战利品中获得其中约一半（约 6 艘主力舰与若干驱逐舰），其余你必须自己建造（该大陆上其他列强都不拥有主力舰，你从它们那里至多能得到几艘驱逐舰与潜艇。）注意你开局带有 -40% 船坞建造 / -15% 船坞产出的惩罚，你需要完成「海军军备竞赛」焦点来移除它。

14piczt.en: This approach can be combined with getting The Merry Band, URSAL, Proactive Defense and I'm Home!. It works because the Establish ULASR focus gives you cores in the ⟦0⟧ South and Central America as far as the border between Guatemala and Mexico, as well as the entire Caribbean. If you can manage to seize all your cores, Socialist Brazil (or, rather, ULASR) becomes the fourth largest country in the world by core population (after ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧), and with industrial output that rivals any of the other majors.
14piczt.zh: 这一方法可以与获得「快乐乐队」、「URSAL」、「主动防御」与「我回家了！」结合起来。它之所以可行，是因为「建立 ULASR」焦点会给你⟦0⟧南美与中美洲直至危地马拉与墨西哥边境的核心，以及整个加勒比地区。如果你能设法夺取你的全部核心，社会主义巴西（或者更确切地说，ULASR）将按核心人口成为世界第四大国（仅次于⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧），其工业产出可与任何其他列强匹敌。

x2wkyl.en: Minor note 1: Once you reach Mexico, you need to push hard and don't stop until you have most of the country. If you pause for regrouping and reinforcement, the USA will send its troops to reinforce the front line, and, instead of steamrolling over the defenders, you'll be stuck for months trying to push back a defensive line across central Mexico manned with 50 U.S. and Mexican divisions and receiving mountain/jungle defense bonuses.
x2wkyl.zh: 小提示 1：一旦你抵达墨西哥，你就必须强力推进，在拿下该国大部分之前不要停下。如果你停下来重整与增援，美国会派兵增援前线，那样你就不是碾压防御者，而是会被困住数月，试图推回一条横贯墨西哥中部、由 50 个美国与墨西哥师驻守并享有山地/丛林防御加成的防线。

joo3qo.en: If you are not in a hurry, use "reorganize the railways" decision to put extra supply hubs next to the borders of Bolivia and Paraguay, in Punta Pora and Guapore (and while you're at it, a third one in Amazonas by the Colombian border, for later use). Paraguay in particular can be very difficult without a supply hub, since it needs to be ground down to 0% VPs and you'll be out of supply once you reach their capital.
joo3qo.zh: 如果你不着急，就使用「重组铁路」决议，在玻利维亚与巴拉圭边境旁，在蓬塔波拉与瓜波雷增设补给枢纽（顺便在亚马孙州靠近哥伦比亚边境再设第三个，以备后用）。巴拉圭尤其在没有补给枢纽的情况下可能非常困难，因为它需要被磨到 0% 胜利点，而你一旦抵达其首都就会失去补给。

cmzwri.en: Europeans will mostly lose interest in you once you kick them off the continent. Preemptively put some units on the borders of their colonies in South America (Suriname, etc.), and, once you're at war with the UK, naval-invade the four Atlantic islands under Allied control (Falklands, South Georgia, Saint Helena, Ascension).
cmzwri.zh: 一旦你把欧洲人赶出该大陆，他们大多就会对你失去兴趣。预先在他们南美殖民地（苏里南等）的边境上放一些单位，并且一旦你与英国交战，就对同盟国控制下的四个大西洋岛屿（福克兰群岛、南乔治亚、圣赫勒拿、阿森松）发动海军登陆。

kppmhu.en: If you cap the Axis after puppetting the UK, you'll get the ⟦0⟧ achievement (but possibly only if you're still in your original faction): despite the description, that achievement fires if you control Berlin while in the same faction as the UK, whichever faction it is.
kppmhu.zh: 如果你在傀儡化英国之后再迫使轴心国投降，你就会获得⟦0⟧成就（但可能只在你仍处于原阵营时才行）：尽管描述如此，只要你与英国处于同一阵营时控制柏林，该成就就会触发，无论那是哪个阵营。

b2ljuz.en: Minor note 2: there's ⟦0⟧ railroad from Colombia to Costa Rica. If you discover your troops 'out of supply' for no apparent reason mid-conquest of the USA, it's because they are being supplied by convoy. Build the railroad.
b2ljuz.zh: 小提示 2：从哥伦比亚到哥斯达黎加有⟦0⟧铁路。如果你在征服美国的中途发现部队「失去补给」却找不到明显原因，那是因为它们正通过运输船队获得补给。修建那条铁路。

5ntde1.en: Go down the Second Intentona Comunista path and win the civil war. Just snake towards ⟦0⟧ and naval invade (send two divisions to Rio, Sao Paulo, and Porto Alegre), and the civil war will be over before you know it.
5ntde1.zh: 沿「第二次共产主义起义」路线走并赢得内战。只要蛇形推进到⟦0⟧并发动海军登陆（派两个师前往里约、圣保罗与阿雷格里港），内战就会在你反应过来之前结束。

1cygjkj.en: It is recommended to declare on minors while you are at war with a major faction, as they might join the faction and be included in the peace deal once you defeat every major in the faction.
1cygjkj.zh: 建议在你与一个主要阵营交战时对小国宣战，因为它们可能会加入该阵营，并一旦你击败该阵营中的每个主要国家就会被纳入和平协议。

hquxkq.en: If you want to do Jaguar Diplomacy, make sure you get non-aggression pacts BEFORE going Establish ULASR, as the cores you get will severely harm relations with the UK, ⟦0⟧ and the like.
hquxkq.zh: 如果你想做「美洲豹外交」，务必在建立 ULASR 之前获得互不侵犯条约，因为你获得的核心会严重损害与英国、⟦0⟧等国的关系。

ih304l.en: Don't go overboard building industry, but try to get at least 20 fully equipped 9/1's for the first war. You'll be getting lots of factories and infantry equipment with every conquest.
ih304l.zh: 不要过度建造工业，但尽量为第一场战争准备至少 20 个装备齐全的 9/1 师。每次征服你都会获得大量工厂与步兵装备。

r9kci9.en: Choose one of the three mutually exclusive foci to pick a leader. Cangaço Coup is pretty strong, but you can also go Align with Moscow for some extra support foci.
r9kci9.zh: 在三个互斥焦点中选择一个来挑选领袖。「卡加索政变」相当强，但你也可以走「与莫斯科结盟」以获得一些额外支援焦点。

iqpqhl.en: Best case scenario the Axis has NOT capitulated the ⟦0⟧. If they have, it might get very difficult to capitulate the Axis, but not impossible
iqpqhl.zh: 最好的情况是轴心国还没有迫使⟦0⟧投降。如果已经投降，要迫使轴心国投降可能会非常困难，但并非不可能

1etf09k.en: Once all the majors are gone, justify and declare on all remaining countries. ULASR will reign supreme!
1etf09k.zh: 一旦所有主要国家都不在了，就对所有剩余国家制造战争目标并宣战。ULASR 将称霸世界！

4npwur.en: You can end up at war with ⟦0⟧ if you declare on ⟦1⟧, so be mindful if you aren't prepared.
4npwur.zh: 你最终可能会与⟦0⟧交战，如果你对⟦1⟧宣战，所以如果你没有准备好就要留心。

fw6649.en: Possible order: Bolivia, Paraguay, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, then either Colombia or Peru.
fw6649.zh: 可能的顺序：玻利维亚、巴拉圭、阿根廷、智利、乌拉圭，然后是哥伦比亚或秘鲁。

727rjk.en: Take all of ⟦0⟧'s cores (including islands in the Atlantic!) to get I'm home!.
727rjk.zh: 夺取⟦0⟧的全部核心（包括大西洋中的岛屿！）以获得「我回家了！」。

1kvhvoa.en: Take Nottingham for The Merry Band achievement if you have Lampiao as leader.
1kvhvoa.zh: 如果你以兰皮昂为领袖，夺取诺丁汉以获得「快乐乐队」成就。

1ls65x4.en: NOTE: states need to be controlled directly (puppets don't count.)
1ls65x4.zh: 注意：各州必须被直接控制（傀儡不算。）

1jyp1lb.en: As ⟦0⟧, control every state in the world.
1jyp1lb.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，控制世界上的每一个州。

1cr8az2.en: From here on out, you can also do ⟦0⟧.
1cr8az2.zh: 从这里开始，你也可以做⟦0⟧。

14uq6q.en: Sooner or later ⟦0⟧ will declare on you (often around mid-1940 but there is a decent bit of variance here as well), do not call your puppets to war. If you didn't join the Allies you can start your own faction with ⟦1⟧. Kick the Italians out of ⟦2⟧ and if you get an opening, try launching a naval invasion at Italy and capitulate them to get more war score. You should be able to puppet Italy in the peace deal. You can then prepare the war with the USSR. If you somehow managed to keep your democratic popularity above 60% such as by hiring the Social Democrat advisor at the start or taking The Birthplace of Democracy focus beforehand, you can return to democratic at any time after this. This way you can guarantee ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧ and you can join in the fight and invite them to your faction once the USSR declare war on them. Otherwise, you can justify on USSR after you are done with the Axis, but it is best to wait until they declare war on Iran so they cannot focus their entire forces on you.
14uq6q.zh: 迟早⟦0⟧会对你宣战（通常在 1940 年中期前后，但这里也有相当大的浮动），不要召唤你的傀儡参战。如果你没有加入同盟国，你可以与⟦1⟧建立自己的阵营。把意大利人踢出⟦2⟧，如果出现机会，试着对意大利发动海军登陆并迫使其投降以获得更多战争分数。你应当能在和平协议中傀儡化意大利。然后你就可以准备与苏联的战争。如果你不知怎么设法把民主支持度保持在 60% 以上——比如开局聘用社会民主顾问，或事先选取「民主摇篮」焦点——此后你随时可以回到民主。这样你就能保障⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧，可以在苏联对它们宣战时加入战斗并邀请它们加入你的阵营。否则，你可以在解决轴心国之后对苏联制造战争目标，但最好等到它们对伊朗宣战，这样它们就无法把全部兵力集中在你身上。

1hrb1e3.en: Do not call Bulgaria to war yet, focus on defeating Turkey first. If you can get Naval Supremacy, naval invasions are great here, as you can just walk around the enemy to each of the VPs. Once you defeat Turkey and restore Byzantium, you can start working on Romania, dig in on the Bulgarian border and let the Romanian troops destroy themselves in the offensive, then start pushing in. You can start justifying on ⟦0⟧ now if you wish. Alternatively you can prepare some transport planes earlier and convert your mountaineers to paratroopers, once you have captured Bucharest you can send the paratroopers to snatch some victory points in the north and west to instantly capitulate Romania. Puppet or annex Romania. If you justified on Hungary, they should be an easier opponent than Romania and Turkey unless you are too late and they already joined the Axis.
1hrb1e3.zh: 暂时不要召唤保加利亚参战，先专注击败土耳其。如果你能获得制海权，海军登陆在这里很棒，因为你可以绕过敌人直接走向每个胜利点。一旦你击败土耳其并恢复拜占庭，你就可以开始处理罗马尼亚，在保加利亚边境挖壕固守，让罗马尼亚军队在进攻中自我消耗，然后开始推进。如果你愿意，现在就可以对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。或者你可以提前准备一些运输机并把你的山地兵改为伞兵，一旦你夺取布加勒斯特，你就可以派伞兵去夺取北部与西部的一些胜利点，从而立即迫使罗马尼亚投降。傀儡化或吞并罗马尼亚。如果你对匈牙利制造了战争目标，它们应当比罗马尼亚与土耳其更容易对付，除非你太迟而它们已经加入轴心国。

1dh10w1.en: Go down the left side focus and choose to work with the fascists. Once Resurrecting the Megali Idea focus is reached, start it and choose to invite ⟦0⟧ along to prevent the loss of stability. Do not follow up to Horror and Fear yet, pick any other focus for now and soon you will get the Anatolian Fascist coup. As soon as you turn fascist, justify on ⟦1⟧ immediately. Don't forget the planes you start with - even a small amount of Air Superiority and CAS damage goes a long way. Puppet Bulgaria and follow up with Horror and Fear to start the war with ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
1dh10w1.zh: 沿左侧焦点往下走并选择与法西斯主义者合作。一旦抵达「复活伟大理想」焦点，就启动它并选择邀请⟦0⟧一同参与，以防稳定度损失。暂时不要接着做「恐怖与恐惧」，先选取其他任意焦点，很快你就会得到安纳托利亚法西斯政变。一旦你转为法西斯，立即对⟦1⟧制造战争目标。别忘了你开局拥有的飞机——即使少量制空权与近距空中支援伤害也能起很大作用。傀儡化保加利亚，然后接着做「恐怖与恐惧」，以开始与⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧的战争。

1fmqk9i.en: Change government to fascism as quickly as possible (using Resurrecting the Megali Idea focus if ⟦0⟧ is active). Justify on ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, timing it so the justifications complete right after the Anschluss (February 1938). Join the Axis, which will consist of Germany alone. Declare both wars simultaneously, drawing ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ into a war with Germany. Get as much war participation as possible and puppet both in the peace conference. You can then proceed to defeat ⟦5⟧ and the ⟦6⟧ alongside the Axis.
1fmqk9i.zh: 尽快把政府改为法西斯（如果⟦0⟧处于激活状态，使用「复活伟大理想」焦点）。对⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧制造战争目标，把时机安排成在德奥合并（1938 年 2 月）之后立刻完成。加入轴心国，它将仅由德国构成。同时宣战，把⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧拖入与德国的战争。尽可能争取更多战争参与度，并在和平会议中傀儡化两者。然后你就可以与轴心国一起继续击败⟦5⟧与⟦6⟧。

hf0bqe.en: Note that Romania can sometimes decide to join the Axis in late 1939 based on your war, but this seems quite random. If you face this issue, you can push Turkey out of Istanbul, then guard the city with a small handful of troops, while you send the rest of your forces to crush Romania with your puppet's help. If doing this, you should be able to finish Romania before they have a chance to join the Axis, especially if you start the war in 1938.
hf0bqe.zh: 注意罗马尼亚有时会根据你的战争在 1939 年末决定加入轴心国，但这似乎相当随机。如果你遇到这个问题，你可以把土耳其赶出伊斯坦布尔，然后用少量部队守卫该城，同时派出其余兵力在你傀儡的帮助下粉碎罗马尼亚。如果这样做，你应当能在罗马尼亚有机会加入轴心国之前解决它，尤其是如果你在 1938 年就开战。

1tvot3n.en: It's okay to only get part of each country, but it may not fire unless the original is ⟦0⟧ gone. E.g., if you do it as part of the Allies, a plausible outcome is that you'll have Repubblica Sociale Italiana as a puppet and Hellenic Mandate of Russia as a supervised state, and there will be independent countries Italian Union (created when British Italy is released) and Russian Federation. That counts.
1tvot3n.zh: 只拿到每个国家的一部分也可以，但除非原本的国家⟦0⟧消失了，否则可能不会触发。例如，如果你作为同盟国的一员这么做，一个可能的结果是你会有意大利社会共和国作为傀儡、希腊托管俄罗斯作为受监管国，并且会有独立国家意大利联盟（在英国意大利被释放时创建）与俄罗斯联邦。这算数。

nwzrdt.en: Puppetting your targets is not difficult, as Germany prefers to take land for itself. The only one to watch for is Romania: if the Turkish Straits are closed, Germany will have no land or sea route to Romania and might puppet instead.
nwzrdt.zh: 傀儡化你的目标并不困难，因为德国更愿意为自己夺取土地。唯一要留意的是罗马尼亚：如果土耳其海峡被关闭，德国将没有通往罗马尼亚的陆路或海路，可能会改为傀儡化它。

yb6240.en: Timing is critical here: on historical, Romania may drop the guarantee in January 1939, and Turkey often/always gets guaranteed by the UK and/or France by March 1939, you want to go to war with Turkey before that happens.
yb6240.zh: 时机在这里至关重要：在历史模式下，罗马尼亚可能会在 1939 年 1 月放弃保障，而土耳其常常/总是会在 1939 年 3 月之前被英国和/或法国保障，你要在那之前对土耳其开战。

1ml6vdn.en: Can be done as any flavor of Byzantium ("Byzantine Empire", "East-Roman Democratic Republic", "Byzantine Commune", etc.)
1ml6vdn.zh: 可以作为任何类型的拜占庭完成（「拜占庭帝国」、「东罗马民主共和国」、「拜占庭公社」等）

ncqyuu.en: Restore Byzantium and have Italy, Romania, and Russia as subjects.
ncqyuu.zh: 恢复拜占庭并让意大利、罗马尼亚与俄罗斯成为附属国。

1ekp9q3.en: Public Trust is related to the current country leader of Finland. While the effects of Trust itself are always the same, the lower the Trust, the cheaper it will be to retrire the current country leader. Every leader has a personal agenda which will influence whether trust rises or sinks, depending on the players actions. Finland starts with "Pehr Evind Svinhufvud", who will be replaced by "Kyösti Kallio", who will be suceeded by "Rysto Ryti" and finally by "Juho Kusti Paasikivi". If Finland ever finds itself at war with a major power, they can put "Carl G. Mannerheim" in charge.
1ekp9q3.zh: 公众信任与芬兰当前的国家领袖相关。虽然「信任」本身的效果始终相同，但信任越低，让当前国家领袖退休就越便宜。每位领袖都有自己的个人议程，会根据玩家的行动影响信任上升还是下降。芬兰开局为「佩尔·埃温德·斯温胡武德」，他将被「屈厄斯蒂·卡利奥」取代，后者又由「里斯托·吕蒂」继任，最后由「尤霍·库斯蒂·帕西基维」继任。如果芬兰发现自己与某个列强交战，他们可以让「卡尔·G·曼纳海姆」掌权。

est2xb.en: Each country can have one balance of power at the same time with 2 sides: left and right. A BoP can be replaced only with another BoP from the same side -- for example, Benito Mussolini side can be replaced with Italo Balbo side, but not with Communist side.
est2xb.zh: 每个国家同时可以拥有一个力量平衡，分 2 方：左与右。一个 BoP 只能被同方的另一个 BoP 替换——例如贝尼托·墨索里尼一方可以被伊塔洛·巴尔博一方替换，但不能被共产主义一方替换。

1mpvnqe.en: Each side have multiple ranges, where range limit is from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧. Each balance of power have one middle range that isn't attached to any of the sides.
1mpvnqe.zh: 每一方都有多个区间，区间界限从⟦0⟧到⟦1⟧。每个力量平衡都有一个不属于任何一方的中间区间。

18izdjj.en: ⟦0⟧, aka ⟦1⟧, can be managed with national focuses, events and decisions providing bonuses to country or states.
18izdjj.zh: ⟦0⟧，又名⟦1⟧，可以通过为国家或各州提供加成的国策、事件与决议来管理。

xbyjvz.en: Losing non-core states will no longer impact Balance of Power while the value is greater than ⟦0⟧ towards ⟦1⟧.
xbyjvz.zh: 当数值朝⟦0⟧方向大于⟦1⟧时，失去非核心州将不再影响力量平衡。

1okip1i.en: ⟦0⟧ can receive its balance of power with Swiss Guiding Principles starting at (100%) Full Cantonal Power.
1okip1i.zh: ⟦0⟧可以从（100%）完全州权开始获得其「瑞士指导原则」力量平衡。

w5kmeq.en: In Czechoslovakia balance of power there are only 2 sides: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
w5kmeq.zh: 在捷克斯洛伐克的力量平衡中只有 2 方：⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。

151ayw5.en: Ethiopia starts game with balance of power with ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ sides.
151ayw5.zh: 埃塞俄比亚开局带有由⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧两方构成的力量平衡。

1fkn0hb.en: Anarchists and ⟦0⟧ can be gained only by government change to ⟦1⟧.
1fkn0hb.zh: 无政府主义者与⟦0⟧只能通过把政府改为⟦1⟧来获得。

1efmlen.en: Communists and ⟦0⟧ can be gained only by government change to ⟦1⟧.
1efmlen.zh: 共产主义者与⟦0⟧只能通过把政府改为⟦1⟧来获得。

tyoene.en: In Finland balance of power there are only 2 sides: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
tyoene.zh: 在芬兰的力量平衡中只有 2 方：⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。

1g6grig.en: In Denmark balance of power there are only 2 sides: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
1g6grig.zh: 在丹麦的力量平衡中只有 2 方：⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。

1r2435t.en: In Swiss balance of power there are only 2 sides: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
1r2435t.zh: 在瑞士的力量平衡中只有 2 方：⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。

soafsh.en: The Grand Council side is opposite to ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.

va8e5k.en: Generate war goal tension limit against country ⟦0⟧
va8e5k.zh: 对⟦0⟧国制造战争目标的紧张度限制

6vhcc3.zh: 最大指挥点数增长倍率：⟦0⟧

1u10ekm.zh: 进攻战争惩罚稳定度修正：⟦0⟧

1vg08o6.zh: 实际上是资源获取效率：⟦0⟧

1rwv9g2.en: The middle point between all sides.

v3h546.en: Motion of No Confidence in the Duce

jv1745.zh: 议会与各州之间的平衡

9uzalg.zh: 福利与战争之间的平衡

1e1eru3.en: Total Control of the Grand Council

ng0ckz.zh: 共产主义者在政治中占优势

1150xw7.zh: 社会主义者在政治中占优势

1rm27e7.zh: 无政府主义者控制政治

syb3x0.zh: 共产主义者在政治中占主导

tjp4vc.zh: 社会主义者在政治中占主导

132gfxi.zh: 无政府主义者影响政治

i9oag6.zh: 无政府主义者在政治中占主导

13zhg6.zh: 共产主义者在政治中占主导

8plfse.zh: 梅克瓦宁特在政治中占主导

mf9gk1.zh: 梅萨芬特在政治中占主导

oul0dx.zh: 维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世一方

xijaib.en: This is a list of all ⟦0⟧ relating to the Baltic nations (from ⟦1⟧).
xijaib.zh: 这是所有与波罗的海国家相关的⟦0⟧列表（来自⟦1⟧）。

1502skh.en: Now only Japan is left. Start researching paratroopers and transport planes and in the meantime focus on taking out the Warlords in the north / north-east and conquer Korea after that. Now all you have to do is build an airfield in "Gyeongsang" and from there paradrop on to the Japanese mainland. You don't need an Airforce for this, Japan often doesn't put theirs in the sky or you simply have to wait a little bit (Or simply reload the safe, it takes a few in game ours before air-superiority is registered). Your paratroopers will go (eventually). The Japanese AI doesn't properly protect the Home Isles with soldiers either, simply have your army waiting In a / multiple ports. Once your paratroopers take one simply transport them over (don't worry about them getting intercepted, the Navy AI seems to be passive in patch 1.17) and capitulate Japan. Same as China, Japan may have joined / created a faction which basically ensures you'll see an capitulation before any possible peace deal.
1502skh.zh: 现在只剩下日本了。开始研究伞兵与运输机，同时专注消灭北方/东北的军阀，之后再征服朝鲜。现在你所要做的就是在「庆尚」修建一座机场，并从那里伞降日本本土。你不需要空军来做这件事，日本常常不会把空军升空，或者你只需稍等一会儿（或者干脆重新读档，制空权登记需要几个游戏小时）。你的伞兵会（最终）出发。日本 AI 也不会用士兵妥善保卫本土，只需让你的军队在一个/多个港口待命。一旦你的伞兵拿下一个港口，就把他们运过去（不必担心被拦截，海军 AI 在 1.17 补丁中似乎很被动）并迫使日本投降。与中国一样，日本可能已加入/创建了一个阵营，这基本上确保你会在任何可能的和平协议之前看到投降。

1h94rtc.en: After Cooperate with Ulanhu, go to the left side of the focus tree and take the The Westward Expansion and The Eastward Expedition. At this point your army is already strong enough to easily win both border wars. Continue with The Unwilling Diarchy and Bring War to Neighboring Warlords With the factories you got form the border wars you should (if not already done) be able to increase yours militias to 20 with. Which is sufficient to destroy and annex Shanxi, The Northeastern Army, Gansu Ma and Ningxia Ma. In the mean time go down the infiltration route and after that work towards Demand the Loyalty of the Warlords. If you're lucky you get Shandong.
1h94rtc.zh: 在与乌兰夫合作之后，前往国策树左侧并选取「向西扩张」与「向东远征」。到这时你的军队已经强大到足以轻松赢得两场边境战争。继续「不情愿的双重君主制」与「把战争带给邻近军阀」。有了从边境战争中获得的工厂，你应当（如果还没做）能够把民兵提高到 20 个。这足以摧毁并吞并山西、东北军、甘肃马与宁夏马。与此同时走渗透路线，之后朝「索要军阀的效忠」努力。如果你运气好，你会得到山东。

1lgsyf2.en: Make sure your War Goals are ready by November 1939 by taking Expel the Occupiers and Preemptive Strike in time. 36 – 48 Militia Units with Support and one Line Arty should be sufficient to hold off and China. Together with how much you were able to infiltrate taking out China should be easy. With Historical AI off there is a good chance China joins a faction , ensuring you get the capitulation before any possible peace deal. With China's industry added to yours, protecting your coastline against Japanese naval invasions is easy. Just create a 12-with militia template with Artillery Support and spam enough of them.
1lgsyf2.zh: 务必通过及时选取「驱逐占领者」与「先发制人」让你的战争目标在 1939 年 11 月前就绪。36 – 48 个带支援的民兵单位与 1 个战线炮兵应当足以抵挡中国。再加上你能够渗透的程度，消灭中国应当很容易。关闭历史 AI 时中国很有可能加入一个阵营，从而确保你在任何可能的和平协议之前获得其投降。把中国的工业并入你的之后，保护你的海岸线免受日本海军登陆就很容易了。只要创建一个带火炮支援的 12 宽民兵编制并大量生产即可。

188pz43.en: During those prep years, focus first on getting a bit on an economy. Go down the middle path of the focus tree until at least Specialize CSCEC - Military Industry. Taking Allow Trade of Special Goods and Promote Paper Bank Notes is not required, but the buffs are nice. After that go down the right side of the focus tree, pick Instill Three Rules of Discipline and continue until Cooperate with Ulanhu Have one factory on artillery and the rest on guns. Later on add trains, Anti-Air and Trucks (but only when you can produce a good amount of guns and arty on a steady base).
188pz43.zh: 在那些备战年份里，先专注发展一点经济。沿国策树中间路线往下走，至少走到「专业化中建总公司 - 军事工业」。选取「允许特殊商品贸易」与「推行纸币」并非必需，但加成不错。之后沿国策树右侧往下走，选取「灌输三大纪律」并继续到「与乌兰夫合作」。用一座工厂生产火炮，其余生产枪械。之后再加入火车、防空与卡车（但只能在你能够稳定地生产大量枪械与火炮之后）。

bb20xd.en: The easiest way and probably also the most consistent way is to turn off Historical and restart until Japan goes down their Democratic / Communist path (left side of the political focus tree). This way Japan does not attack China and gives you nearly 4 years to prepare your wars with both countries. Put China on Historical. The event in which Japan's political future gets decided fires after 50 days, so resetting doesn't waste a lot of time.
bb20xd.zh: 最简单也大概最一致的方法是关闭历史模式并重开，直到日本走其民主/共产主义路线（政治国策树左侧）。这样日本就不会进攻中国，并给你将近 4 年时间来准备与两国的战争。把中国设为历史模式。决定日本政治未来的事件在 50 天后触发，所以重开不会浪费很多时间。

5i5yhc.en: For your army, focus on Militias and put your first 100 pp in Zhu De for Army xp. Keep mass assault as you doctrine and for sub-doctrines pick: "Guerilla Warfare", "People's Militia" and a bit later on "Artillery & Combat Support". Over time increase your militia template (Renmin Jundui) to 20 with and add support arty. Later on, if you can, add support Anti-Air and one artillery battalion (which results in 22.2 combat with)
5i5yhc.zh: 关于你的军队，专注民兵，并把你的前 100 政治点数花在朱德身上以获得陆军经验。保持大规模突击作为你的学说，次级学说选取：「游击战」、「人民民兵」，稍后再选「火炮与战斗支援」。随时间推移把你的民兵编制（人民军队）提高到 20 宽并加入支援火炮。之后如果可以，加入支援防空与一个火炮营（这会使战斗宽度达到 22.2）

ic7jdq.en: You need to declare war on China and Japan before 1940. Capitulation on the other hand has no time limit. The requirement to "capitulated" means you must achieve the highest score in the war against China and the highest score in the war against Japan.
ic7jdq.zh: 你必须在 1940 年之前对中国与日本宣战。另一方面，投降没有时间限制。「迫使投降」这一要求意味着你必须在对抗中国的战争中获得最高分数，并在对抗日本的战争中获得最高分数。

1e1piyf.en: ⟦0⟧: The requirements are a little vague & may actually be buggy. To be safe, put at least a one day gap between your war declarations on China and Japan. That should avoid any bugs that (still) may exist.
1e1piyf.zh: ⟦0⟧：要求有点含糊，实际上可能是有 Bug 的。为安全起见，在对中国与日本宣战之间至少间隔一天。这应当能避免任何（仍然）可能存在的 Bug。

13ho76s.en: As Communist China, fight both China and Japan before 1940 within 90 days of being at war with the other, and capitulate them both.
13ho76s.zh: 作为共产主义中国，在 1940 年之前与另一国交战后 90 天内同时与中国和日本作战，并迫使两者投降。

1og6ll6.en: The strongest warlord is the ⟦0⟧ due to their starting resources. Due to your early equipment deficits and lack of research capability but very high manpower, focus on getting as much of your manpower onto the field as quickly as possible. DON'T force the Xi'an incident or ⟦1⟧ could refuse and the Chinese United Front won't form at all - wait to join later. With your troops you can then join and help China against the ⟦2⟧ by placing defensive divisions on their coastline - you will need a high number to be able to repel better-equipped Japanese invasions. Go for Root Out Corruption, Power Struggle and Executive Yuan. This will give you enough ⟦3⟧ to do Power Struggle propaganda in three states to Chiang's two and will quickly put you on top. Push the Japanese out of China and Korea, while building a fleet and/or air force to cross the Sea of Japan. The focus Subjugate the Warlords gives a fixed 50% chance to puppet each of the warlords (even if they are in a different faction). You can then annex those who accept via decisions, and declare war against the ones who don't. Communist China may pursue a civil war with you while you are still fighting the Japanese, and you may not be able to use the Anti-Communism focus against them once you are in a faction together. It is important to deal with them early, however, as if left to the late game they can join the Allies and this will force you to fight on multiple fronts with the ⟦4⟧.
1og6ll6.zh: 最强的军阀是⟦0⟧，因为其开局资源。由于你早期装备短缺、科研能力不足但人力极高，专注尽快把你的人力尽可能多地投入战场。不要强行发动西安事变，否则⟦1⟧可能会拒绝，中国统一战线就根本不会形成——等以后再加入。有了你的部队，你随后就可以加入并帮助中国对抗⟦2⟧，在其海岸线部署防御师——你需要数量众多才能击退装备更好的日本入侵。选取「铲除腐败」、「权力斗争」与「行政院」。这会给你足够的⟦3⟧在三个州进行权力斗争宣传，而蒋只有两个州，从而迅速让你占据上风。把日本人赶出中国与朝鲜，同时建立一支舰队和/或空军以跨越日本海。「征服军阀」焦点给每个军阀一个固定的 50% 傀儡化几率（即使它们身处不同阵营）。然后你可以通过决议吞并那些接受的，并对不接受的宣战。共产主义中国可能会在你仍在与日本作战时对你发动内战，而一旦你们同处一个阵营，你可能无法对其使用「反共」焦点。然而，及早处理它们很重要，因为如果留到游戏后期，它们可能加入同盟国，这会迫使你在多条战线上与⟦4⟧作战。

1rbm059.en: Set historical focuses to Off as ⟦0⟧ and reload a few times to get the best outcome, where ⟦1⟧ doesn't try to annex you and ⟦2⟧ doesn't attack soon - or even at all. Get a research slot and rush Join the Republican Government. Then, DO NOT take any focuses for extra ⟦3⟧ income and start competing for the states. Thanks to extra PP, you can grow your presence in 2 states at once, and overtaking China should be possible in about a year or so. Once you become China, focus on subduing other Warlords, lest they join some non-Chinese faction and make things difficult. Remember to build infrastructure, railroads and supply hubs, as Chinese supply is mostly atrocious. Once you have the warlords puppeted or annexed, you can take on Japan - guard the coasts and use paratroopers to make the war relatively trivial. This approach is a bit RNG-dependent, but it shouldn't take more than 10 reloads at worst; just make sure to use the proper infantry templates and develop your industry accordingly.
1rbm059.zh: 作为⟦0⟧把历史焦点设为关闭并重载几次以取得最佳结果，即⟦1⟧不试图吞并你，且⟦2⟧不会很快进攻——甚至根本不进攻。获得一个科研槽并速推「加入共和政府」。然后，不要选取任何获得额外⟦3⟧收入的焦点，并开始争夺各州。由于额外的政治点数，你可以同时在 2 个州扩大存在，接管中国应当在大约一年左右可行。一旦你成为中国，就专注制伏其他军阀，以免它们加入某个非中国阵营而使事情变得困难。记住修建基础设施、铁路与补给枢纽，因为中国的补给大多是糟糕透顶的。一旦你把军阀傀儡化或吞并，你就可以对付日本——守住海岸并用伞兵让战争变得相对轻松。这一方法有点依赖随机性，但最坏情况下重载也不应超过 10 次；只要确保使用正确的步兵编制并相应发展你的工业。

1c30i8g.en: Once Japan is pushed out of Asia, do not accept their white peace. Kick out the Communist Chinese and declare war against them or follow the Chinese focus tree to Anti-Communism. If this is not done, they will make a civil war against the Chinese United Front by stealing all of the land. Take the Subjugate the Warlords to puppet the warlords. Make sure all the warlords are puppeted as it is the best possible outcome for that focus. Decrease their autonomy to annex them. As for ⟦0⟧, Naval invade when ready. If the Allies or Soviet have a large contribution, you can pre-empetively puppet Japan and annex it through the autonomy system. You get the achievements when Japan and all warlords are fully annexed.
1c30i8g.zh: 一旦日本被赶出亚洲，不要接受它们的白色和平。把共产主义中国踢出去并对它们宣战，或者按中国国策树走「反共」。如果不这样做，它们会通过窃取所有土地对中国统一战线发动内战。选取「征服军阀」以傀儡化各军阀。确保所有军阀都被傀儡化，因为那是该焦点最好的可能结果。降低它们的自治度以吞并它们。至于⟦0⟧，准备好后发动海军登陆。如果同盟国或苏联贡献很大，你可以先发制人地傀儡化日本，并通过自治度系统吞并它。当日本与所有军阀都被完全吞并时，你就会获得成就。

6rjgd2.en: This Achievement requires a Chinese Warlord to conquer all ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ cores not including the states of ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧, which are controlled by the European countries of the ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧. This achievement is possible if the Warlord usurps ⟦11⟧ because it is based on tag rather than name of country and the tag stays the same when changed to ⟦12⟧. States must be taken in peace conference (not merely controlled) and must be owned directly (not through puppets.)
6rjgd2.zh: 该成就要求一个中国军阀征服所有⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧核心，不包括由欧洲国家⟦2⟧⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧⟦5⟧与⟦6⟧⟦7⟧各州控制的⟦8⟧、⟦9⟧与⟦10⟧。如果军阀篡夺⟦11⟧，该成就是可能的，因为它基于 tag 而非国家名称，且改为⟦12⟧时 tag 保持不变。各州必须在和平会议中被夺取（而不仅仅是被控制），并且必须被直接拥有（不能通过傀儡。）

hq7z6r.en: Follow the Cooperation With the Nationalists branch of the focus tree and make sure the warlord becomes ⟦0⟧. This will make all ⟦1⟧ divisions as the player's. By this time, ⟦2⟧ will be at war with the Chinese United Front. Defeating ⟦3⟧ will be similar to ⟦4⟧, however this achievement calls for the annexation of Japan. Research Naval Invasion tech and submarines to do that.
hq7z6r.zh: 沿国策树的「与民族主义者合作」分支走，并确保该军阀成为⟦0⟧。这会使所有⟦1⟧师都归玩家所有。到这时，⟦2⟧将与 中国统一战线交战。击败⟦3⟧将与⟦4⟧类似，但该成就要求吞并日本。研究海军登陆科技与潜艇来做到这一点。

fogr0o.en: Requisite cores include several islands in the Pacific (Iwo Jima, Minamitorishima, Saipan, Okinawa, Taiwan, Kuril Islands, and South Sakhalin). They do ⟦0⟧ include Japanese non-core island possessions (Palau, Caroline Islands, Marshall Islands) or Korea. Additionally, as of patch 1.17 with ⟦1⟧, one of the Chinese cores (Kham) starts in possession of ⟦2⟧.
fogr0o.zh: 必需的核心包括太平洋中的若干岛屿（硫磺岛、南鸟岛、塞班岛、冲绳、台湾、千岛群岛与南萨哈林）。它们⟦0⟧包括日本非核心的岛屿属地（帕劳、加罗林群岛、马绍尔群岛）或朝鲜。此外，自 1.17 补丁起，配合⟦1⟧，其中一个中国核心（康区）开局由⟦2⟧占据。

e1tw85.en: ⟦0⟧ is an other option, as it can immediately join the Comintern and the ⟦1⟧ will never take land in China.
e1tw85.zh: ⟦0⟧是另一个选项，因为它可以立即加入共产国际，而⟦1⟧将永远不会在中国夺取土地。

1b0du0g.en: Note: this guide was written before 1.17 and No Compromise, No Surrender
1b0du0g.zh: 注意：本指南写于 1.17 与「不妥协，不投降」之前

1mucd18.en: As a warlord, conquer all of China and Japan.
1mucd18.zh: 作为一个军阀，征服全中国与日本。

mwlzsf.en: Now for the final part, make sure you have enough divisions to hold the Axis for around a week. Without massive losses to the ⟦0⟧, the German army will be quite big. Build forts if you think your line is too weak to hold. Finally, since you asked and got military access to both Germany and ⟦1⟧ during your war with the ⟦2⟧, you can simply walk some divisions into ⟦3⟧ and have them sit in one of the required states. They will need to be able to hold for about a week, so make sure you send enough divisions and also put a few on a port for safekeeping.
mwlzsf.zh: 现在是最后一部分，确保你有足够的师来守住轴心国大约一周。如果没有对⟦0⟧造成巨大损失，德国军队会相当庞大。如果你认为你的阵线太弱无法守住，就修建要塞。最后，由于你在与⟦1⟧的战争期间提出请求并获得了德国与⟦2⟧的军事通行权，你可以直接把一些师开进⟦3⟧，让他们驻扎在所需各州之一。他们需要能够坚守约一周，所以务必派出足够的师，并在一个港口放几个以确保安全。

1kqww2g.en: If you went with Friedrich, you'll also need at least 12 divisions to guard the Baltic ports against naval invasions. The Focuses The Belorussian Army and The Ruthenian Army can help you get a few of those divisions if your manpower is (too) low. Save at least 150 ⟦0⟧ for the start of the war, so you can immediately increase your conscription law. Finally, make sure you start gaining ⟦1⟧ in time because you want to switch your doctrine to Superior Firepower and preferably unlock the first few doctrines.
1kqww2g.zh: 如果你选择了弗里德里希，你还需要至少 12 个师来保卫波罗的海港口免受海军登陆。「白俄罗斯军队」与「鲁塞尼亚军队」焦点可以帮助你获得其中一些师，如果你的人力（太）低的话。至少留出 150⟦0⟧用于战争开始，这样你就可以立即提高你的征兵法令。最后，务必及时开始获得⟦1⟧，因为你会想把学说切换为优势火力，并最好解锁最初几个学说。

yc4a2.en: The first part of the war with the ⟦0⟧ is about holding and fending off their naval invasions. Once you feel you have a comfortable position start taking supply hubs and surrounding divisions. Make sure to justify and declare war in ⟦1⟧ while you are at war with the ⟦2⟧, this way they'll join the Comintern. If you are too late, they might get guaranteed by the UK. But this should not matter, since you are guaranteed as well.
yc4a2.zh: 与⟦0⟧战争的第一部分是关于守住并击退他们的海军登陆。一旦你觉得处境舒适，就开始夺取补给枢纽并包围师。务必在你与⟦1⟧交战时对⟦2⟧制造战争目标并宣战，这样它们就会加入共产国际。如果你太迟，它们可能会被英国保障。但这应当无关紧要，因为你也同样被保障了。

1rjgjz8.en: Start the game with Historical AI and go down the first focuses of the monarchy path. Which king (or queen) you choose is up to you, I would advise either Friedrich Christian or Michal II. (The hidden Romanov focus branch is also a very interesting option, and, if you go with Romanovs and finish this achievement, you will later have an option to install Wojtek as your monarch.)
1rjgjz8.zh: 以历史 AI 开始游戏，并走君主制路线的最初几个焦点。你选择哪位国王（或女王）由你决定，我建议选弗里德里希·克里斯蒂安或米哈伊尔二世。（隐藏的罗曼诺夫焦点分支也是一个非常有趣的选项，而且如果你选择罗曼诺夫并完成该成就，之后你将有一个选项把 Wojtek 立为你的君主。）

ptsebc.en: When the war with the ⟦0⟧ is over, annex them. To shorten the border with the Axis you can puppet Moldova. If ⟦1⟧ is in the peace deal as well, make sure to annex Hamadan. Otherwise, move 48 divisions to the ⟦2⟧ border and the rest to the border with the Axis. Declare war (you will get embargoed by a lot of countries for this) and simply defeat them.
ptsebc.zh: 与⟦0⟧的战争结束后，吞并它们。为缩短与轴心国的边境，你可以傀儡化摩尔多瓦。如果⟦1⟧也在和平协议中，务必吞并哈马丹。否则，把 48 个师调到与⟦2⟧的边境，其余调到与轴心国的边境。宣战（你会因此被很多国家禁运）并直接击败它们。

c8f5a0.en: Shortly before or after Germany demands Danzig the Soviets will start justifying on you and the justification will be done between January and March 1940. By the time the justification is done, you should have 48 - 72 divisions trained and on the border with the ⟦0⟧. Which should at least have Anti-Air, Artillery and Engineer Company in them.
c8f5a0.zh: 在德国索要但泽之前或之后不久，苏联会开始对你制造战争目标，该战争目标将在 1940 年 1 月至 3 月之间完成。到战争目标完成时，你应当已有 48 - 72 个师训练完毕并部署在⟦0⟧边境。这些师至少应当包含防空、火炮与工兵连。

gn3q97.en: During your war with the ⟦0⟧, Germany will declare war on the Soviets as well. This should not matter, because unless they have a border with the ⟦1⟧ there is no way for the Axis to gain more than 1% participation. However, when Germany does declare war on the ⟦2⟧, asks for military access from at least Germany and ⟦3⟧.
gn3q97.zh: 在你与⟦0⟧的战争期间，德国也会对苏联宣战。这应当无关紧要，因为除非它们与⟦1⟧有边境，否则轴心国无法获得超过 1% 的参与度。然而，当德国确实对⟦2⟧宣战时，至少向德国与⟦3⟧请求军事通行权。

1gyth0p.en: By early 1939 you should stop building factories and instead start building forts, railways and where necessary supply hubs. Furthermore, you could start taking some of the focuses from Plan East. When Germany demands Danzig give it to them, but don't select the fascist option in the event that follows soon afterwards.
1gyth0p.zh: 到 1939 年初你应当停止建造工厂，改为开始建造要塞、铁路以及必要处的补给枢纽。此外，你可以开始选取「东方计划」中的一些焦点。当德国索要但泽时就给它，但不要在随后不久的事件中选择法西斯选项。

zpnuud.en: In the meantime start going down the economic path of the tree. You can wait with the Agrarian Reform until the last few days of the timer, this focus adds 70 days to the timer when it is selected. So focus first on the 3rd research slot and your industry, until you have to go down that side of the economic path.
zpnuud.zh: 与此同时开始沿该树的经济路线往下走。你可以把「土地改革」推迟到计时器最后几天，该焦点在被选取时会给计时器增加 70 天。所以先专注第 3 个科研槽与你的工业，直到你不得不走经济路线的那个分支。

1gotmcw.en: ⟦0⟧ is an achievement that requires ⟦1⟧ to gain Vojtek as a commander. This happens upon triggering the Polish event "Wojtek Never Drops A Crate", which has 5 requirements:
1gotmcw.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个成就，要求⟦1⟧让 Vojtek 成为指挥官。这在触发波兰事件「Wojtek 从不掉落货箱」时发生，该事件有 5 个要求：

953g9w.en: Don't be in a faction with ⟦0⟧ (even if they've abandoned communism). This also means you can't have them as a puppet (tested with patch 1.13.4)
953g9w.zh: 不要与⟦0⟧同处一个阵营（即使它们已放弃共产主义）。这也意味着你不能把它们作为傀儡（已用 1.13.4 补丁测试）

5k2m8n.en: Near the end of 1937 (November/December) do the focus clamp down on Danzig and then continue down the monarchy path you've chosen.
5k2m8n.zh: 在 1937 年末（11 月/12 月）做「镇压但泽」焦点，然后继续沿你所选择的君主制路线往下走。

1bnrhvl.en: Once you declare war on Germany and ⟦0⟧ is called in, the achievement should trigger after no more than 7 in-game days.
1bnrhvl.zh: 一旦你对德国宣战且⟦0⟧被召唤参战，该成就应当在不迟于 7 个游戏日内触发。

1080jkn.en: Control the ⟦0⟧ Province of Hamadan (either by you or a faction member that is also at war with italy).
1080jkn.zh: 控制⟦0⟧的哈马丹省份（由你或与你一同对意大利交战的阵营成员控制均可）。

12dbli8.en: Be at war with ⟦0⟧ and have a division in Latium, Abruzzo, or Tuscan
12dbli8.zh: 与⟦0⟧交战，并在拉齐奥、阿布鲁佐或托斯卡纳拥有一个师

170ft70.en: Stay non-aligned (you can form any kingdom of your choice).
170ft70.zh: 保持中立主义（你可以成立任何你选择的王国）。

16g7l4b.en: When the war starts do not accept the invite to the allies.
16g7l4b.zh: 战争开始时不要接受加入同盟国的邀请。

q6z8ac.en: Have completed the focus Artillery Modernization.
q6z8ac.zh: 已完成焦点「火炮现代化」。

gx7rae.en: In the latest update, Yunnan can get cores and integrate Burma as its own states. But to do so, is to simply rush down in the Yunnan's Rally Around Long Yun Branch until you reach "Strengthen Burmic Ties" focus. This grants you a war goal on Burma, but in any circumstance but decolonization, declaring war on Burma is a wrong call. Not only that Burma is in the Allies faction, but you've declared war on the UK indirectly. If the UK decolonizes, this would open an opportunity for Yunnan to declare war and annex Burma, as the Burmese army is relatively weak, but can hold on its own due to its mountainous terrain. As Burma is annexed, this grants sea access to Yunnan, more manpower, more resources, more cores, and mildly more factories, depending if Burma has previously had completed the focuses or not. And naturally, more space to build. This puts Yunnan in one of the many warlords that can add extra cores to itself, besides coring entirety of China. Although, with Burma annexed and integrated, it would make the road to unify China, slightly easier.
gx7rae.zh: 在最新更新中，云南可以获得核心并把缅甸整合为自己的州。但要做到这一点，只需沿云南「团结在龙云周围」分支速推到「加强缅族纽带」焦点。这会给你一个对缅甸的战争目标，但在除去殖民化之外的任何情况下，向缅甸宣战都是错误的决定。不仅因为缅甸属于同盟国阵营，而且你还间接对英国宣战了。如果英国去殖民化，这就为云南宣战并吞并缅甸创造了机会，因为缅甸军队相对弱小，但凭借其山地地形可以自保。由于缅甸被吞并，这为云南提供了出海通道、更多人力、更多资源、更多核心，以及略多的工厂，取决于缅甸此前是否已完成过那些焦点。自然还有更多建造空间。这使云南成为众多可以为自己增加额外核心的军阀之一，此外还能把整个中国设为核心。不过，在缅甸被吞并并整合之后，统一中国之路会稍微容易一些。

1v7tb1j.en: Yunnan starts off with very little resources and little factories. However, they do have a decent amount of manpower as well as 3 units so you can train some up. Choose what focuses you want to do and purchase resources and build up factories. After some time has passed you can attack ⟦0⟧, prior going after China. You can then wait for the Japanese invasion and attack ⟦1⟧ along with ⟦2⟧. You can also join the Japanese faction too. Then you can betray the Japanese and take them over.
1v7tb1j.zh: 云南开局资源很少、工厂也很少。不过，它们拥有相当数量的人力以及 3 个单位，所以你可以训练一些。选取你想要的焦点，购买资源并建造工厂。过一段时间后，你可以在进攻中国之前先攻击⟦0⟧。然后你可以等待日本入侵，并攻击⟦1⟧以及⟦2⟧。你也可以加入日本阵营。之后你可以背叛日本人并接管他们。

1ytszj7.en: The Yunnan Clique was one of several mutually hostile cliques or factions that split from the Beiyang Government in the Republic of China's warlord era and is named after the Yunnan region. Long Yun, leader of the Yunnan Clique re-aligned Yunnan under the Nationalist government in Nanjing but stringently guarded the province's autonomy. Long Yun was a critic of Chiang Kai-shek and after the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War, he was removed from office.
1ytszj7.zh: 滇系是中华民国军阀时代从北洋政府分裂出来的若干相互敌对的派系或集团之一，以云南地区命名。滇系领袖龙云让云南重新归附南京的国民政府，但严格维护该省的自治。龙云是蒋介石的批评者，第二次中日战争结束后，他被免职。

1j8qwuq.en: ⟦0⟧ uses the shared Warlords national focus tree along with the other warlords and may inherit the ⟦1⟧ or Communist Chinese focus trees. With the ⟦2⟧ expansion enabled, the Warlords national focus tree is expanded. It also grants access to the new shared Nationalist and Communist focus trees for the warlords at the end of the tree.
1j8qwuq.zh: ⟦0⟧与其他军阀一样使用共享的军阀国策树，并可能继承⟦1⟧或共产主义中国的国策树。启用⟦2⟧扩展包后，军阀国策树会得到扩展。它还在国策树末端为军阀解锁新的共享国民党与共产党国策树。
