b4w4mi.en: The moment tension hits 50%, justify (one state only) on ⟦0⟧ (if Poland doesn't have or isn't working on (check their tree) its own faction - just restart). Conquer Poland (drive to Warsaw and through to the Prussian border to split the Polish Army in half - don't worry too much about your eastern and western flanks). Take everything except Danzig - which will become all of Poland. Build war materials, train and research and wait for the inevitable war between the Axis and Comintern to start. After the the ⟦1⟧ are substantially weakened (3mm casualties), consider justifying on them. Keep an eye on ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ as they can go Comintern - ten divisions (and the Bulgarians) can be taken from the ⟦4⟧ border to defend against them and even take one (but probably not both) out. (The gap between finishing Poland and declaring on the Soviets can be at least three years.) Capitulate the ⟦5⟧. Take provinces, and you are done (unless Bulgaria is still a puppet). Throughout, lend-lease extra stuff to Bulgaria (if puppeted) and build in Bulgaria to annex them. Do not join the Axis or the Allies, but try to keep relations with Germany cordial by buying steel from them. Building tanks is not advised until after beelining (starting just before 1940) to the Maresal Focus and then only to add a heavy to about a third of your infantry.
b4w4mi.zh: 当紧张度达到 50% 的那一刻，对⟦0⟧制造战争目标（仅一个州）（如果波兰没有自己的阵营、也没有在做（查看其国策树）——就直接重开）。征服波兰（向华沙推进并一路打到普鲁士边境，把波兰军队一分为二——不必太担心你的东西两翼）。除但泽之外拿走一切——但泽会变成整个波兰。建造战争物资、训练并研究，等待轴心国与共产国际之间不可避免的战争开始。在⟦1⟧被大幅削弱（300 万伤亡）之后，考虑对它们制造战争目标。留意⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧，因为它们可能转向共产国际——可以从⟦4⟧边境抽调十个师（以及保加利亚人）来防御它们，甚至消灭其中一个（但大概不能两个都消灭）。（结束波兰与向苏联宣战之间的间隔至少可以有三年。）迫使⟦5⟧投降。夺取省份，你就完成了（除非保加利亚仍是傀儡）。在整个过程中，把多余的东西租借给保加利亚（如果它被傀儡化），并在保加利亚建造以便吞并它。不要加入轴心国或同盟国，但试着通过向德国购买钢铁来与德国保持友好关系。在直奔马雷沙尔焦点（大约在 1940 年前开始）之前不建议建造坦克，之后也只给大约三分之一的步兵加入一个重型营。

1c5iegn.en: Hope ⟦0⟧ starts its own faction. Buzz through Align Hungary, Puppet Bulgaria and Divide Yugoslavia - taking the focuses as quickly as possible. Get to the required troop levels fast by increasing conscription levels at the earliest opportunities and deploying divisions as soon as allowed. The Greek and Turkey adventures can be counter-productive - so ignore. Divide your Theaters into a high priority (trained, equipped) group and low priority (green, unequipped) group. Hope for ⟦1⟧ guarantee of ⟦2⟧. War will be with the ⟦3⟧ at the same time, but there will be successive treaties as each capitulates. Before declaring on Yugoslavia, defend the ⟦4⟧ border with the green troops used to get troop levels up (except for the most eastern provinces -so the Czechs over extend into northern Romania and don't clog the road to Prague). Take all states in ⟦5⟧, then move north to finish ⟦6⟧. Take all states except Bohemia and the two Sudetenlands (to keep Germany on track).
1c5iegn.zh: 希望⟦0⟧创建自己的阵营。快速完成「与匈牙利结盟」、「傀儡保加利亚」与「瓜分南斯拉夫」——尽可能快地选取这些焦点。通过尽早提高征兵等级、一获允许就部署师，迅速达到所需的部队数量。希腊与土耳其的冒险可能适得其反——所以忽略它们。把你的战区分为一个高优先级（经过训练、装备齐全）组与一个低优先级（新兵、无装备）组。希望⟦1⟧保障⟦2⟧。战争将同时与⟦3⟧进行，但随着各方投降会陆续签订条约。在对南斯拉夫宣战之前，用那些用来凑部队数量的新兵部队防守⟦4⟧边境（最东部的省份除外——这样捷克人会过度伸入罗马尼亚北部，而不会堵塞通往布拉格的道路）。夺取⟦5⟧的所有州，然后北上解决⟦6⟧。除波希米亚与两块苏台德之外拿走所有州（以让德国保持正轨）。

n1c9nc.en: The ⟦0⟧ will take Eastern Poland via Molotov-Ribbentrop. Deny the ⟦1⟧ Moldova when they ask for it and then hold out against them after they declare war on you. You can start pushing by yourself or wait until Germany declares war against the ⟦2⟧ to push against them. If you want to push from another direction, you can try to get Military Access with the ⟦3⟧ in order to naval invade Vladivostok from ⟦4⟧. Try to push the ⟦5⟧ more than the Germans in order to take the most territory, especially if you didn't get ⟦6⟧ territory and will have to fight the Germans for it next. Take ⟦7⟧ and Eastern Polish territory if possible.
n1c9nc.zh: ⟦0⟧将通过莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约夺取东波兰。当⟦1⟧索要摩尔多瓦时加以拒绝，然后在他们对你宣战后坚守抵抗。你可以自己开始推进，或者等到德国对⟦2⟧宣战后再对他们推进。如果你想从另一个方向推进，可以试着与⟦3⟧获得军事通行权，以便从⟦4⟧海军登陆符拉迪沃斯托克。试着比⟦5⟧推进得更多，超过德国人，以夺取最多领土，尤其是如果你没有拿到⟦6⟧领土、接下来还要为此与德国人作战。如有可能，夺取⟦7⟧与东波兰领土。

b7hdlq.en: Take the Institute Royal Dictatorship focus first then Balkans Dominance. Make sure to build enough divisions to do Align Hungary but during that time, take Fortify the Borders and Revise the Constitution. Once Fortify the Borders is complete, Build max level forts on the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ border. If deemed necessary, delete your airforce and convert your Light Tank divisions to Infantry and sell all your planes and tanks on the ⟦2⟧ to make construction of the forts quicker.
b7hdlq.zh: 先选取「建立皇家独裁」焦点，然后是「巴尔干主导」。务必建造足够的师来完成「与匈牙利结盟」，但在此期间选取「加固边境」与「修订宪法」。一旦「加固边境」完成，就在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧边境修建最高级要塞。如认为有必要，删除你的空军，把你的轻型坦克师改为步兵，并把你的全部飞机与坦克在⟦2⟧上出售，以加快要塞的建造。

j1xmi3.en: Complete the Split Czechoslovakia focus. If Germany decides to not divide, you will only get a claim. Do not justify war against them as this may increase World Tension. ⟦0⟧ will have to declare on Germany later. If Germany accepts but ⟦1⟧ refuses, ⟦2⟧ will get a war goal. Declare on the ⟦3⟧ and move quickly. If both countries accept, You will get a ⟦4⟧ Puppet. Decrease their autonomy if that happens.
j1xmi3.zh: 完成「瓜分捷克斯洛伐克」焦点。如果德国决定不瓜分，你只会获得一个宣称。不要对其制造战争目标，因为这可能会提高世界紧张度。⟦0⟧之后将不得不对德国宣战。如果德国接受但⟦1⟧拒绝，⟦2⟧将获得一个战争目标。对⟦3⟧宣战并迅速行动。如果两国都接受，你将获得一个⟦4⟧傀儡。如果发生这种情况，降低它们的自治度。

sr3g75.en: Once Align Hungary is complete and if Hungary refuses to be aligned, Go to war with them. Increase relations with ⟦0⟧ and do the Puppet Bulgaria focus to puppet them so World Tension does not go too high. Reduce their autonomy. When completing the Divide Yugoslavia focus, choose the option to do it alone to get a war goal against them. Declare war and capitulate them quickly.
sr3g75.zh: 一旦「与匈牙利结盟」完成，如果匈牙利拒绝被结盟，就与它开战。改善与⟦0⟧的关系，并做「傀儡保加利亚」焦点来傀儡它，以免世界紧张度过高。降低它们的自治度。在完成「瓜分南斯拉夫」焦点时，选择单独行动的选项，以获得一个对它们的战争目标。宣战并迅速迫使它们投降。

1exao55.en: If you still need ⟦0⟧ territory, Get ready for war with Germany. When Ready, Justify on ⟦1⟧ and declare war. Join the Allies as soon as possible so they can help but make sure to do most of the work. When the war is over, you will be able to take ⟦2⟧ and Eastern Polish Land required for the achievement.
1exao55.zh: 如果你仍然需要⟦0⟧领土，就为与德国的战争做好准备。准备好后，对⟦1⟧制造战争目标并宣战。尽快加入同盟国以便他们能帮忙，但要确保大部分工作由你完成。战争结束后，你将能够夺取⟦2⟧以及该成就所需的东波兰土地。

1tthlgv.en: This Achievement requires ⟦0⟧ to own at least one core province of ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ while having Carol II as the country leader and not completing the focuses: All Parties Must End, Force Abdication, Handle the King
1tthlgv.zh: 该成就要求⟦0⟧拥有⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧、⟦6⟧至少各一个核心省份，同时以卡罗尔二世为国家领袖，且未完成以下焦点：「所有党派都必须终结」、「强制退位」、「处置国王」

1lga7t7.en: Here is a general list of Converter capabilities and conversion mechanic explanations. For more information feel free to ask for clarifications on forums or take a peek at the code. ⟦0⟧ The converter includes a ⟦1⟧ folder that contains all data files with rules it uses during conversion. These files are there for a reason - so the user can view them and modify them according to specific needs. Do not be shy to hack away and change them so the conversion fits expected goals.
1lga7t7.zh: 以下是转换器能力与转换机制说明的通用清单。如需更多信息，欢迎在论坛上请求澄清，或看一眼代码。⟦0⟧ 转换器包含一个⟦1⟧文件夹，其中包含它在转换期间所使用的全部规则数据文件。这些文件的存在是有原因的——让用户能够查看它们并按具体需求修改。不要不好意思去改它们，让转换结果符合预期目标。

jfndbh.en: Catching bugs and oddities earlier means they get fixed earlier. I try to release test versions of the converter on the forum for testing, so running those and looking things over is helpful. And if you have professional experience in testing, well, I'm sure we could be doing things far better. Tell me how!
jfndbh.zh: 更早发现 Bug 与异常就意味着它们能更早被修复。我会试着在论坛上发布转换器的测试版本以供测试，所以运行这些版本并检查是很有帮助的。如果你有专业测试经验，我相信我们能把事情做得更好。告诉我怎么做！

19ingxr.en: The Vic3 to HoI4 converter is a ⟦0⟧ that takes a Victoria 3 save and generates an HoI4 scenario from it. It can be downloaded from this forum thread. It is compatible with outputs from other converters, allowing the player to play a continuous ⟦1⟧ from Imperator to HoI4. This is a continuation of the ⟦2⟧.
19ingxr.zh: Vic3 到 HoI4 转换器是一个⟦0⟧，它读取维多利亚 3 存档并据此生成一个 HoI4 剧本。它可以从这个论坛帖下载。它与其他转换器的输出兼容，使玩家能够游玩一段从《英白拉多》到 HoI4 的连续⟦1⟧。这是⟦2⟧的延续。

t9ttnl.en: Province mappings always need more work. The order that HoI4 provinces are linked make a difference for where things like VPs end up, so if you can update province mappings (and send me the file) for areas you know, that'd be helpful.
t9ttnl.zh: 省份映射总是需要更多工作。HoI4 省份被关联的顺序会影响胜利点等东西最终落在哪里，所以如果你能为你熟悉的地区更新省份映射（并把文件发给我），那会很有帮助。

13nakdv.en: We can always use help figuring out how things work, and how we can do them better. If you know how to mod HoI4, we can use your help figuring it out. As well, there's always more room for flavor events, decisions, and the like.
13nakdv.zh: 我们总是需要帮助来弄清楚事物如何运作以及我们如何能做得更好。如果你会模组制作 HoI4，我们需要你的帮助来一起弄明白。此外，风味事件、决议之类总是有更多空间。

kjomsn.en: Q: I used a mod, will the converter work with it? A: It depends on what the mod changed. Your best bet is to simply try (and let us know how it went). As far as we can tell, it does work well with games converted from EU4.
kjomsn.zh: 问：我用了某个模组，转换器能与它配合吗？答：这取决于该模组改了什么。最好的办法就是直接试试（并告诉我们结果如何）。据我们所知，它与从 EU4 转换而来的游戏配合良好。

g0eja7.en: Industry is converted as one factory per 100,000 employed workers. If there are more than twelve factories in a state, they will be given to the owner's next state so that they don't go beyond HoI4's maximum.
g0eja7.zh: 工业按每 100,000 名受雇工人折算一座工厂进行转换。如果一个州内的工厂超过十二座，多出的会给予拥有者的下一个州，以免超出 HoI4 的上限。

1vixzaj.en: Victory points are assigned to each of the significant provinces defined by Vic3. The point values are determined by the type of significant province. This will be changed soon.
1vixzaj.zh: 胜利点会分配给 Vic3 定义的每个重要省份。点数值由重要省份的类型决定。这一点很快就会改动。

8zlt9k.en: Conversion-date bookmarks can be quite early, chaining converters from CK2 onward, one can play a 769 game in Hoi4 engine, though aside for the novelty that is a horrible idea.
8zlt9k.zh: 转换日期的书签可能相当早，把转换器从 CK2 一路串下去，一个人可以在 HoI4 引擎里玩 769 年的游戏，不过除了新鲜感之外，那是个糟糕的主意。

1jwf8sl.en: States are converted from Vic3's states, but islands and other disconnected provinces may be split into their own states. Wastelands are split into separate states.
1jwf8sl.zh: 州由 Vic3 的州转换而来，但岛屿与其他不相连的省份可能被拆分为自己的州。荒地被拆分为单独的州。

ce4xid.en: There may be future support for combining the converter's output with other HoI4 mods. But this will be a low priority, and currently this is completely untested.
ce4xid.zh: 未来可能会有把转换器输出与其他 HoI4 模组结合的支持。但这会是低优先级，而且目前完全未经测试。

qpqdye.en: Without front-end (running the converter manually) or on other OS-es, mod will be exported to converter's output/ folder, and will have to be moved by user.
qpqdye.zh: 如果没有前端（手动运行转换器）或在其他操作系统上，模组会被导出到转换器的 output/ 文件夹，用户必须自行移动它。

a7hji9.en: Converting earlier than 1936 will cause penalties in manpower levels, industrial footprint, and converted technologies, and is not recommended.
a7hji9.zh: 转换早于 1936 年的日期会导致人力水平、工业规模与转换后的科技受到惩罚，不建议这样做。

1hw6qpz.en: We can always handle more discussion on how things are converted over on the forum thread. And your encouragement helps more than you know.
1hw6qpz.zh: 我们总是可以在论坛帖上就事物如何转换进行更多讨论。而你的鼓励比你知道的更有帮助。

1oz4sx6.en: Q: The converter says "Saving Configuration: Failed!" How do I fix it? A: Disable your antivirus or allowlist the converter.
1oz4sx6.zh: 问：转换器显示「Saving Configuration: Failed!」我该怎么修？答：禁用你的杀毒软件，或把转换器加入白名单。

1opokpk.en: Countries are currently a blank-slate conversion and only keep their name, color, and land. This will be improved soon.
1opokpk.zh: 国家目前是白板式转换，只保留其名称、颜色与土地。这一点很快就会改进。

148gifn.en: The converter is designed to work with Vic3 mods, including games converted from EU4 to Vic3. Other mods may also work.
148gifn.zh: 该转换器被设计为可与 Vic3 模组配合，包括从 EU4 转换到 Vic3 的游戏。其他模组也可能可行。

hvt7nt.en: We can always use more programmers. The converter itself is in C++, and the tools that go with it are in C# and C++.
hvt7nt.zh: 我们总是需要更多程序员。转换器本身是 C++ 写的，配套工具则是 C# 与 C++ 写的。

1t62kck.en: If you wish to help with development, there are plenty of ways to do so. Descriptions of needs follow.
1t62kck.zh: 如果你希望协助开发，有很多方式可以做到。需求说明如下。

odpr5w.en: The smallest state category that can handle the number of converted factories is assigned.
odpr5w.zh: 会分配能够容纳转换后工厂数量的最小州类别。

hjto8n.en: On Windows, and using the front-end, the mod will be copied to Hoi4 mod/ directory.
hjto8n.zh: 在 Windows 上并使用前端时，模组会被复制到 Hoi4 的 mod/ 目录。

12y0jd5.en: Technologies are converted according to configurables/tech_mappings.txt.
12y0jd5.zh: 科技按照 configurables/tech_mappings.txt 进行转换。

10nh00u.en: Resources are distributed according to configurables/resources.txt.
10nh00u.zh: 资源按照 configurables/resources.txt 进行分配。

14ihpdu.en: Hearts of Iron 4, latest version. DLCs are optional.
14ihpdu.zh: 钢铁雄心 4，最新版本。DLC 可选。

1m821w6.en: Victoria 3, latest version. DLCs are optional.
1m821w6.zh: 维多利亚 3，最新版本。DLC 可选。

15rqfrg.en: Converter will produce a Hearts of Iron 4 mod.
15rqfrg.zh: 转换器将生成一个钢铁雄心 4 模组。

ww4r7a.zh: 转换后的模组支持一个书签：1936。

xstcuj.en: Manpower is simply the Vic3 population.
xstcuj.zh: 人力就是 Vic3 的人口。

1tnpodb.zh: Vic2 到 HoI4 转换器项目

1ncvg0b.en: Added global.province_controllers game variable array that returns an array containing the controller for each province, where array index is mapped to province ID. For example global.province_controllers^4135 returns the controller of Gibraltar.
1ncvg0b.zh: 添加了 global.province_controllers 游戏变量数组，它返回一个包含每个省份控制者的数组，其中数组索引映射到省份 ID。例如 global.province_controllers^4135 返回直布罗陀的控制者。

in3hd6.en: Added support for nesting localization strings, i.e. use a localization key within another localization string, enabling strings like "Unlock $nukes$ in the $technology$ screen" where 'nukes' and 'technology' are localization keys.
in3hd6.zh: 添加了对本地化字符串嵌套的支持，即在一个本地化字符串中使用另一个本地化键，从而实现诸如「Unlock $nukes$ in the $technology$ screen」这样的字符串，其中 'nukes' 与 'technology' 都是本地化键。

m5nkx9.en: add the modifiers navy_leader_start_level, navy_leader_start_attack_level, navy_leader_start_defense_level, navy_leader_start_maneuvering_level, navy_leader_start_coordination_level to match the sames for army_leader.
m5nkx9.zh: 添加修正 navy_leader_start_level、navy_leader_start_attack_level、navy_leader_start_defense_level、navy_leader_start_maneuvering_level、navy_leader_start_coordination_level，以与 army_leader 的同类修正保持一致。

5nhw1k.en: Added support for dollar signs in localization strings. Normally a dollar sign denotes the start or end of a variable. With this change "$$" will produce a single dollar sign in the resulting string.
5nhw1k.zh: 添加了对本地化字符串中美元符号的支持。通常美元符号表示变量的开始或结束。有了这项改动，「$$」将在结果字符串中产生单个美元符号。

1jaioch.en: Added support for the triggers is_enemy, is_friend and is_neutral to adjacency rules to enable script to determine which rule to use. Evaluation order is documented in adjacency_rules.txt.
1jaioch.zh: 为邻接规则添加了对触发器 is_enemy、is_friend 与 is_neutral 的支持，使脚本能够决定使用哪条规则。求值顺序记录在 adjacency_rules.txt 中。

8ib1nc.en: The external actor on the losing side of a civil war no longer get their units wiped if they were in the winner's territory as long as the civil war did not become a full blown out war
8ib1nc.zh: 内战中失败一方的外部参与者，只要内战没有演变为全面战争，其单位就不再会因为他们身处胜者领土而被消灭

1pr0du3.en: ⟦0⟧, aka "Collie", was not released officially. It was superseded by ⟦1⟧ which was released on 2020-10-15⟦2⟧ coinciding with the release of ⟦3⟧ DLC. The checksum is ⟦4⟧.
1pr0du3.zh: ⟦0⟧，又名「Collie」，并未正式发布。它被⟦1⟧取代，后者于 2020-10-15⟦2⟧发布，与⟦3⟧ DLC 的发售同时进行。校验和为⟦4⟧。

nb50an.en: Added the ability to specify a variable refering to an idea for triggers and effect has_idea, add_ideas, remove_ideas, swap_ideas, add_timed_idea and modify_timed_idea
nb50an.zh: 添加了为触发器与效果 has_idea、add_ideas、remove_ideas、swap_ideas、add_timed_idea 与 modify_timed_idea 指定引用某个理念的变量的能力

lmn9cd.en: Germany can no longer annex Yugoslavia with a single focus and no input from the Yugoslavian player under certain circumstances
lmn9cd.zh: 在某些情况下，德国不再能仅凭一个焦点、且无需南斯拉夫玩家任何介入就吞并南斯拉夫

o9azpl.en: naval supremacy is now scaled to a percentage depending on enemy intel level instead of getting reduced to 0% at low intel
o9azpl.zh: 制海权现在会根据敌方情报等级按百分比缩放，而不再在低情报时被降到 0%

1i3pb1u.en: Added a series of decisions for Yugoslavia to promote a communist uprising in Bulgaria, Albania, and other Balkan nations
1i3pb1u.zh: 为南斯拉夫添加了一系列决议，用于在保加利亚、阿尔巴尼亚及其他巴尔干国家推动共产主义起义

k2g8pu.en: fixed some issues with AI operative assignments that was trying to make them assign same operative multiple times
k2g8pu.zh: 修复了 AI 特工指派的一些问题，该问题会导致它们试图多次指派同一名特工

lkvlnm.en: Rocket sites will now properly delete remaining stock when captured and not crash the game further down the line
lkvlnm.zh: 火箭发射场在被占领时现在会正确删除剩余库存，而不会在之后导致游戏崩溃

mvkqxj.en: Banning Communism or Fascism should now also remove foreign communist/fascist influence national spirits.
mvkqxj.zh: 禁止共产主义或法西斯主义现在也应移除外国共产主义/法西斯主义影响的国家精神。

16vmdzp.en: Yugoslavia will now lose the Anti-German Military spirit if the military has already instigated a coup.
16vmdzp.zh: 如果军方已经发动过政变，南斯拉夫现在会失去「反德军队」精神。

1swpz9j.en: Added a nudger generated file to the list of files to backup and remove by the Clear Cache action
1swpz9j.zh: 把 nudge 生成的文件加入了「清除缓存」操作要备份与删除的文件列表

yqzv49.en: Improved performance of CPoliticalMinister that was evaluating decision with an ai_factor of zero
yqzv49.zh: 改进了 CPoliticalMinister 的性能，它此前在评估 ai_factor 为零的决议

383d0w.en: Fixed CTD caused by effect from history trying to access the not yet initialized graphical map
383d0w.zh: 修复了由历史记录中的效果试图访问尚未初始化的图形地图所导致的 CTD

1d8247i.en: Yugoslavia may now complete industry focuses if the owner of the province is their subject
1d8247i.zh: 如果该省份的拥有者是它们的附属国，南斯拉夫现在可以完成工业焦点

jbfi0l.en: added a special infantry model with Pickelhaube for Unaligned Germany (Waking the Tiger)
jbfi0l.zh: 为中立德国（唤醒猛虎）添加了一个戴尖顶盔的特殊步兵模型

1aqufc0.en: Fixed operative being stuck on rescue mission when there are no operative left to rescue
1aqufc0.zh: 修复了在没有剩余特工可营救时，特工卡在营救任务中的问题

nitk9t.en: removed Italian_generic_land_4 soldier and added Britain_generic_land_6 soldier instead.
nitk9t.zh: 移除了 Italian_generic_land_4 士兵，改为添加 Britain_generic_land_6 士兵。

100t3en.en: Fixed OOS triggered by displaying the description of some focuses and event effects
100t3en.zh: 修复了由显示某些焦点与事件效果的描述所触发的 OOS

v792n5.en: Fixed a typo in wtt_events_l_english.yml for Germany Anti-Soviet Pact news pop-up
v792n5.zh: 修复了 wtt_events_l_english.yml 中德国反苏条约新闻弹窗的一处拼写错误

1hjjd8j.en: Added console command Audio.PlayEffect to play a scripted sound effect at will
1hjjd8j.zh: 添加了控制台命令 Audio.PlayEffect，可随时播放脚本音效

1ulgi0r.en: Updated Institute Royal Monarchy focus to start with 65% Non-Aligned support
1ulgi0r.zh: 更新了「建立皇家君主制」焦点，使其开局拥有 65% 中立支持度

12kcs1c.en: Fixed has_dlc trigger to return false when the name of the dlc is not known
12kcs1c.zh: 修复了当 dlc 名称未知时 has_dlc 触发器返回假的问题

mx3uvs.en: Reworked and tweaked the starting position for Romania (Death or Dishonor)
mx3uvs.zh: 重做并调整了罗马尼亚的开局位置（死亡或耻辱）

10ghjkx.en: Fixed CTD when interacting with the army portraits while merging armies
10ghjkx.zh: 修复了在合并军队时与陆军人像交互所导致的 CTD

1jq0wx2.en: The Heavy Cruiser 3d Asset Pack has been merged into the base game
1jq0wx2.zh: 重巡洋舰 3D 素材包已被合并进基础游戏

9mbcax.en: Fixed a bug where Serbia was using the incorrect country colours.
9mbcax.zh: 修复了塞尔维亚使用错误国家颜色的问题。

ji2ywl.en: added some missing descriptions of special ship hulls (MtG only)
ji2ywl.zh: 添加了一些缺失的特殊舰体描述（仅 MtG）

1oxncpl.en: Forum: Patch 1.10.1 Collie Live - Checksum dd56, 2020-10-15.
1oxncpl.zh: 论坛：补丁 1.10.1 Collie 上线 - 校验和 dd56，2020-10-15。

99ec43.en: Fixed some mods being erroneously removed at game start
99ec43.zh: 修复了某些模组在游戏开始时被错误移除的问题

1s4vu06.en: fixed a missing national spirit icon in the French tree
1s4vu06.zh: 修复了法国国策树中一处缺失的国家精神图标

80vu4n.en: Reworked Focus Tree for Yugoslavia (Death or Dishonor)
80vu4n.zh: 重做了南斯拉夫的国策树（死亡或耻辱）

zhxwd0.en: Added missing "do nothing" option to an event
zhxwd0.zh: 为某个事件添加了缺失的「什么都不做」选项

16w59qr.en: Set ROM starting ruling party to non-aligned
16w59qr.zh: 把 ROM 的开局执政党设为中立

1wx3x86.en: Added General entry for Constantin Sanatescu
1wx3x86.zh: 为康斯坦丁·萨纳特斯库添加了将军条目

12wd0v9.en: Added allowed trigger for ai strategy plans
12wd0v9.zh: 为 AI 战略计划添加了 allowed 触发器

i5cuk7.en: Fixed CTD related to carrier air missions
i5cuk7.zh: 修复了与航母空中任务相关的 CTD

ojhz67.en: Added Kurdistan tag, history, and leaders
ojhz67.zh: 添加了库尔德斯坦 tag、历史与领袖

1h07993.en: Fixed OOS caused by localized state name
1h07993.zh: 修复了由本地化州名导致的 OOS

9j5wt4.en: Hooked Iraqi fascist leader into vanilla
9j5wt4.zh: 把伊拉克法西斯领袖接入原版

1k0lg5f.en: Battle for the Bosporus Country Pack
1k0lg5f.zh: 博斯普鲁斯之战国家包

5n33lh.zh: 添加了装备可建造触发器

14j8hvc.zh: 为原版 GER 添加了人像

zxmkyc.zh: 修复了 AI 代码中的 CTD

dxrxg.en: ⟦0⟧ are ⟦1⟧ that do not exist as independent nations at game start. They can be released by countries who own their core territory through the ⟦2⟧ screen, through certain national focuses, ⟦3⟧, or decisions, or forced to do so by a victorious power in a ⟦4⟧. They can also exist at game start through various game rules.
dxrxg.zh: ⟦0⟧是游戏开始时并不作为独立国家存在的⟦1⟧。它们可以被拥有其核心领土的国家通过⟦2⟧界面、通过某些国策、⟦3⟧或决议释放，或在⟦4⟧中被胜利的列强强制释放。它们也可以通过各种游戏规则在游戏开始时存在。

7zrbkf.en: Although they are listed in the occupied territories screen, countries with an asterisk cannot be released via the release nation button. It must be released via ⟦0⟧, or by another nation if they conquer the releasable lands. When playing ⟦1⟧, releasable nations can only be released after the Spanish Civil War is over.
7zrbkf.zh: 虽然它们会列在占领区界面中，但带星号的国家无法通过「释放国家」按钮释放。它必须通过⟦0⟧释放，或由征服了可释放领土的另一个国家释放。游玩⟦1⟧时，可释放国家只能在内战结束后才能释放。

1tzh3j3.en: ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧, Papal States and the ⟦2⟧ are usually ⟦3⟧ that need to be formed by another country, but can appear on their own through other means.

eblhmn.en: Now, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a communist advisor. Yes, I know, going communist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for communist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent communist support, so hold a referendum to become Communist Mughal West Britain Company. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids.Build cheap submarines, only a few suffice to make amends onto naval invasion, after going with the Naval Effort focus. Then, with decent political power hire a chief of army for an early army experience boost. After that, go for the political effort. Go communist, and ignite a civil war.
eblhmn.zh: 现在，你该做的第一件事是选取第一个政治焦点，它会给你 120 政治点数，加上你已经积累的 70。用它聘用一位共产主义顾问。是的，我知道，走共产主义基本上是每个小国的首选策略，但如果它有效，那就是有效。在你等待共产主义支持度上升的同时，选取一些工业焦点以获得一些免费工厂。先拿两座免费民用工厂，然后拿三座军用工厂。到这时你的共产主义支持度应当已超过百分之五十，所以举行公投以成为共产主义莫卧儿西不列颠公司。用你多余的政治点数实行战争经济，如果还有多余的，就选取「改善工人条件」或反共/民主突袭。建造便宜的潜艇，只要少数几艘就足以对海军登陆做出弥补，在走「海军努力」焦点之后。然后，凭借不错的政治点数聘用一位陆军参谋长以获得早期陆军经验加成。之后走政治努力。转为共产主义，并点燃一场内战。

1fklf84.en: At this point, you've flipped communist already, so start justifying on Ireland. With the same logic and console commands if you have released yourself from British Raj's clutches. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out, and start with the naval invasions and capture its capital. At the same time, justify on Republican Spain, if they are currently losing in the Spanish Civil War. Manpower can be an issue so take the "Ideological Loyalty" as the Welsh manpower will go absent way quick. Should you declare on Portugal, Iceland, or god forbid, the United Kingdom and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources and sea access for marine trade.
1fklf84.zh: 到这时，你已经转为共产主义了，所以开始对爱尔兰制造战争目标。如果你已经从英属印度的掌控中释放了自己，就用同样的逻辑与控制台命令。同时开始做政治焦点。制作一个只有一个骑兵单位的编制，并大量生产。到这时你也应当拥有相当多的政治点数，所以采取一些提高稳定度的决议。制作一个只有一个骑兵单位的编制，并大量生产，然后开始海军登陆并夺取其首都。同时，如果共和西班牙目前正在西班牙内战中失利，就对它制造战争目标。人力可能是个问题，所以选取「意识形态忠诚」，因为威尔士的人力会很快耗尽。如果你对葡萄牙、冰岛宣战，或者——但愿不要——对大不列颠宣战并战胜它们，每一场都能给你足够的扩张空间，以及获取一些宝贵资源与海上贸易通道的机会。

a0xibs.en: Mughal West Britain Company doesn't possess a tag of its own. Instead it comes with a civil war tag, and dependent by British Raj national focus. Although by console commands, all you have to do is to occupy Wales core with console commands. And with console commands again take the "Incorporate the West Britain Company" decision that allegedly releases them as a puppet state. Mughal West Britain Company starts with 2,3M core population but, a puppet state of British Raj. And with one civilian factory, three aluminium and 11 steel.
a0xibs.zh: 莫卧儿西不列颠公司并不拥有自己的 tag。它反而自带一个内战 tag，并依赖英属印度的国策。不过，通过控制台命令，你所需要做的就是占领威尔士核心。再通过控制台命令采取「合并西不列颠公司」决议，该决议据称会把它们作为傀儡国释放。莫卧儿西不列颠公司开局拥有 230 万核心人口，但它是英属印度的傀儡国。并且拥有一座民用工厂、3 份铝与 11 份钢。

ae8409.en: By now you should have a total of 8 or 9 factories- 6 civilian and 3 military. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.
ae8409.zh: 到这时你应当总共拥有 8 或 9 座工厂——6 座民用与 3 座军用。你的一座民用工厂将用于消费品，所以用剩下那座来建造更多民用工厂，或换取一些钢。用你 3 座军用工厂中的一座生产火炮，另 2 座生产枪械。等你获得更多军用工厂后，也安排一些工厂生产支援装备。

u3wqez.en: Tip: If you let independent Mughal West Britain Company be controlled by an AI, it will annex British Raj by referendum if they share the same ideology. Mughal West Britain Company that way will gain additional cores and as well as a bigger army, and inheriting claims from British Raj itself.
u3wqez.zh: 提示：如果你让独立的莫卧儿西不列颠公司由 AI 控制，只要它们意识形态相同，它就会通过公投吞并英属印度。这样莫卧儿西不列颠公司将获得额外核心以及一支更大的军队，并继承英属印度本身的宣称。

w9mq2w.en: The Mughal West Britain Company is a hypothetical nation encompassing the Welsh state. And the Mughal Empire has reformed, having been freed from the British shackles, and has taken the fight against the Allies, notably against the United Kingdom, extracting revenge for the 1857 decline.
w9mq2w.zh: 莫卧儿西不列颠公司是一个涵盖威尔士州的假想国家。莫卧儿帝国已然改革，从英国的枷锁中解脱出来，并对同盟国开战，尤其是对大不列颠，为 1857 年的衰落复仇。

j872ra.en: The ⟦0⟧, included in La Résistance DLC is one of the most complex series of ⟦1⟧ in the game, and it is the main theme of ⟦2⟧. It includes several files to simulate the different factions and factors of the war, as it is the first clash among several factions, preeminently the Comintern and the Axis. However, it also involves neutral countries such as ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ (usually involved on the Nationalist side) and, obviously, Spain. From the democratic side, ⟦5⟧ also has a few options to take sides.
j872ra.zh: 随《抵抗运动》DLC 加入的⟦0⟧是游戏中最复杂的一系列⟦1⟧之一，也是⟦2⟧的主题。它包含若干文件来模拟战争中的不同派系与因素，因为这是若干派系之间的首次冲突，其中尤以共产国际与轴心国最为突出。不过，它也牵涉中立国家，如⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧（通常站在民族主义一方），当然还有西班牙。在民主阵营方面，⟦5⟧也有若干选项来选边站。

1avedqp.en: In historical mode it is the first victory for the Fascist countries, and the first defeat of the Soviets, as ⟦0⟧ is the main choice of the AI. For modders, especially those involved in total conversion mods it is one of the most complex layouts, as it includes lots of lines of code, flags, decisions, events, and national focuses.
1avedqp.zh: 在历史模式下，这是法西斯国家的第一场胜利，也是苏联人的第一次失败，因为⟦0⟧是 AI 的主要选择。对模组制作者而言，尤其是参与全面转换模组的人，这是最复杂的布局之一，因为它包含大量代码行、标志、决议、事件与国策。

14tw8gw.en: In 1907, an epochal year for the country, Ugyen Wangchuck was unanimously chosen as the hereditary king of the country by an assembly of leading Buddhist monks, government officials, and heads of important families. The British government promptly recognized the new monarchy, and in 1910, Bhutan signed the Treaty of Punakha, a subsidiary alliance which gave the British control of Bhutan's foreign affairs and meant that Bhutan was treated as an Indian princely state. This had little real effect, given Bhutan's historical reticence, and also did not appear to affect Bhutan's traditional relations with Tibet. After the new Union of India gained independence from the United Kingdom on 15 August 1947, Bhutan became one of the first countries to recognize India's independence. On 8 August 1949, a treaty similar to that of 1910, in which Britain had gained power over Bhutan's foreign relations, was signed with the newly independent India.
14tw8gw.zh: 1907 年对该国是具有划时代意义的一年，乌颜·旺楚克被由著名佛教僧侣、政府官员与重要家族族长组成的集会一致推选为该国世袭国王。英国政府随即承认了这个新君主国，1910 年，不丹签署了《普那卡条约》，这是一项附属联盟，把不丹的外交事务控制权交给了英国，并意味着不丹被当作一个印度土邦对待。鉴于不丹历史上的缄默，这几乎没有实际效果，似乎也没有影响不丹与西藏的传统关系。1947 年 8 月 15 日新成立的印度联邦从联合王国获得独立后，不丹成为最早承认印度独立的国家之一。1949 年 8 月 8 日，不丹与新独立的印度签署了一项与 1910 年条约类似的条约，英国当年据此获得了对不丹外交关系的支配权。

1go8vp8.en: Having 5-6 divisions with artillery support is required at the start of the war (Support Equipment/Engineers after Militarism), and is recommended to have most on the eastern front. Technology should focus on infantry equipment and artillery, and generals should focus on defensive traits and reinforcement rates. Mass Assault Doctrine is a good choice for the Human Wave Offensive bonuses for Bhutan's low population and will generally help post China War game plan. Soviet Union will more than likely take south China territory by amphibious assault. If Tibet and China forces leave Bhutan's frontline, open up a clear path to Soviet Troops in the West (Tibet & Sinkiang) vs going into China on the Eastern front. During the peace conference, puppet China asap and take remaining territory as the China Puppet (coastal territory first).
1go8vp8.zh: 战争开始时需要 5-6 个带火炮支援的师（军国主义之后加支援装备/工兵），并建议把其中大部分部署在东线。科技应专注步兵装备与火炮，将军应专注防御特质与增援率。大规模突击学说是不错的选择，因为人海攻势加成适合不丹的低人口，并且总体上有助于中国战争之后的游戏规划。苏联很可能会通过两栖登陆夺取华南领土。如果西藏与中国部队离开不丹前线，就打开一条通往西部（西藏与新疆）苏联军队的清晰道路，而不是在东线进入中国。在和平会议期间，尽快傀儡化中国，并作为中国傀儡夺取剩余领土（优先沿海领土）。

k1ykyi.en: Bhutan lacks resources, manpower, and industry at the start of 1936. To tackle this issue Bhutan needs manpower from China as a puppet. First its important to navigate the national focuses very carefully to maximize the bonuses it holds on the fascist side but still allying with Russia while being a communist. This will lead to a very quick defeat for China, and robbing Japan the opportunity to puppet China for itself.
k1ykyi.zh: 1936 年初不丹缺乏资源、人力与工业。为解决这个问题，不丹需要把中国作为傀儡来获取人力。首先重要的是非常谨慎地规划国策，以最大化其在法西斯一方所拥有的加成，同时作为共产主义国家仍与俄罗斯结盟。这将导致中国极快失败，并剥夺日本把中国傀儡化为己有的机会。

83sa23.en: During the 1870s, power struggles between the rival valleys of Paro and Tongsa led to civil war in Bhutan, eventually leading to the ascendancy of Ugyen Wangchuck, the "Ponlop" (governor) of Tongsa. From his power base in central Bhutan, Ugyen Wangchuck defeated his political enemies and united the country following several civil wars and rebellions during 1882–85.
83sa23.zh: 1870 年代，帕罗与通萨两个对立谷地之间的权力斗争导致不丹内战，最终使通萨的「本洛」（总督）乌颜·旺楚克崛起。乌颜·旺楚克以他在不丹中部的权力基地为依托，在 1882–85 年间的数次内战与叛乱之后击败了他的政敌并统一了全国。

1y4kbcd.en: Bhutan will have access to massive amounts of population from its Chinese puppet. Leaving the Comintern and helping take out the Allies is one option (joining Japan), or Joining the Allies assisting in defeating Japan. Usually it's not possible to continue helping the Soviet Union, as Japan will puppet Tibet and Sinkiang.
1y4kbcd.zh: 不丹将从其中国傀儡获得大量人口。退出共产国际并帮助消灭同盟国是一个选项（加入日本），或者加入同盟国协助击败日本。通常不可能继续帮助苏联，因为日本会把西藏与新疆傀儡化。

11g3e56.en: In order to play as early as Don Host, is to play as Poland. Without having to turn on historical ai, because that would prevent Don Host being formed early in the first place. Thus, it is more assuring if Germany starts onto a plunging German civil war compared to the 1939 scenario as Germany enters the war with the Allies in the moment when declares war with Poland. In the early scenario, the player has to rush down with the "Assemble the Regency Council" Branch to make way to the "The Cossack-King" sub-branch. Otherwise, if the German Reich goes historical then the player has to seek an alliance with them should they secure their western borders. Finally, take "Complete the Bermontian Mission" focus, and should the German Reich help with the Soviet problem, make sure to occupy the Caucasus under the Polish command.
11g3e56.zh: 要尽早以顿河军游玩，就要以波兰游玩。不必开启历史 AI，因为那首先会阻止顿河军被提前成立。因此，与 1939 年剧本相比，如果德国一开始就陷入一场急剧爆发的德国内战，会更有保障——在 1939 年剧本中，德国一与波兰宣战就会与同盟国开战。在早期剧本中，玩家必须沿「组建摄政会议」分支速推，以便通往「哥萨克之王」子分支。否则，如果德意志帝国走历史路线，那么只要他们确保西部边境，玩家就必须寻求与他们结盟。最后，选取「完成别尔蒙任务」焦点，并且如果德意志帝国在苏联问题上出手相助，务必在波兰指挥下占领高加索。

ujsmn8.en: Console switch as Don Host, to finally play as them. As released as a puppet, Don Host has the following cores that Poland has under control (Rostov, Stalingrad, Millerovo, Volgodonsk, Astrakhan, Kalmykia and Mikhaylovka). Unfortunately, Don Host has no advisor of any kind, with a notable exception of ideology boosters and the Illusive Gentleman advisor. In a matter of technology, Don Host also inherits whatever Poland has from the start, if the player wishes to remain to play as Poland a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the state, Don Host gets them altogether.
ujsmn8.zh: 用控制台切换到顿河军，最终以它们游玩。作为傀儡被释放时，顿河军拥有以下波兰所控制的核心（罗斯托夫、斯大林格勒、米列罗沃、伏尔加顿斯克、阿斯特拉罕、卡尔梅克与米哈伊洛夫卡）。不幸的是，顿河军没有任何类型的顾问，明显的例外是意识形态推动者与「神秘绅士」顾问。在科技方面，如果玩家希望多玩一会儿波兰、好让科技达到可接受水平，顿河军也会一并继承波兰开局所拥有的一切。

19wgxnb.en: Instead, it may appear by Poland's decision if it does the focus Complete the Bermontian Mission and is already called as "The Bermontian Kingdom of Poland". Once the Complete the Bermontian Mission focus is completed by Poland, the decision to form the Host is added and if it controls or owns the Soviet cores in the Caucasus. If the decision is taken, the Don Host will obtain 7 cores upon release (Rostov, Stalingrad, Millerovo, Volgodonsk, Astrakhan, Kalmykia and Mikhaylovka). And in additional, it gains 15 units with 8 cavalry battalions.
19wgxnb.zh: 相反，它可能通过波兰的决议出现——如果波兰做了「完成别尔蒙任务」焦点，并且已经被称为「别尔蒙的波兰王国」。一旦波兰完成「完成别尔蒙任务」焦点，组建顿河军的决议就会被添加，前提是它控制或拥有高加索的苏联核心。如果采取该决议，顿河军在被释放时将获得 7 个核心（罗斯托夫、斯大林格勒、米列罗沃、伏尔加顿斯克、阿斯特拉罕、卡尔梅克与米哈伊洛夫卡）。此外，它还会获得 15 个单位与 8 个骑兵营。

u3hppj.en: The Don Republic ceased to exist after the Don Cossacks, who formed an essential part of the White Army, were defeated by the Red Army in the Russian Civil War. Many of the Russian Cossacks on Don were subjected to the Decossackization in 1919–1921, during the Soviet famine of 1932–33 and because of the repatriation of Cossacks after the Second World War by the United Kingdom to the Soviet Union, resulting in the eventual disappearance of the Don Cossacks' movement of resistance to the Soviet Union.
u3hppj.zh: 顿河共和国在俄国国内战争中被红军击败后不复存在，而顿河哥萨克曾是白军的重要组成部分。顿河上的许多俄国哥萨克在 1919–1921 年间的去哥萨克化、1932–33 年苏联饥荒期间，以及因第二次世界大战后联合王国把哥萨克遣返回苏联而遭受迫害，最终导致顿河哥萨克的反苏抵抗运动消失。

sw7i70.en: Defeating the rest of the Soviet Union, will not be easy on its own. Console wise it is simple enough. Console core the 7 cores of Don Host for a really early release. But for an interesting challenge rather join the Axis to gain protection from the Germans, and build an army as fast as possible to hold the ground against the Soviets. Declare war on them and subsequently annex them.
sw7i70.zh: 击败苏联其余部分本身并不容易。用控制台来说，这足够简单。用控制台把顿河军的 7 个核心设为核心，以便极早释放。但若想要有趣的挑战，不如加入轴心国以获得德国的保护，并尽可能快地建立一支军队来守住阵地对抗苏联。对他们宣战并随后吞并他们。

koidh8.en: The Don Republic claimed the territory of the Don region with the city of Novocherkassk as its capital. Administratively, the Don Republic was divided into ten okrugs, covering an area located in the Rostov and Volgograd Oblasts of RSFSR and in the Lugansk and Donetsk Oblasts of the neighboring Donetsk–Krivoy Rog Soviet Republic.
koidh8.zh: 顿河共和国声称拥有顿河地区领土，以新切尔卡斯克市为首都。在行政上，顿河共和国被划分为十个州，覆盖位于俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国罗斯托夫州与伏尔加格拉德州，以及邻接的顿涅茨克-克里沃罗格苏维埃共和国卢甘斯克州与顿涅茨克州的区域。

12r99wa.en: The Don Republic was an independent self-proclaimed anti-Bolshevik republic formed by the Armed Forces of South Russia on the territory of Don Cossacks against another self-proclaimed Don Soviet Republic. The Don Republic existed during the Russian Civil War after the collapse of the Russian Empire from 1918 to 1920.
12r99wa.zh: 顿河共和国是由南俄武装力量在顿河哥萨克领土上成立的、反对另一个自行宣告的顿河苏维埃共和国的独立反布尔什维克共和国。顿河共和国存在于俄罗斯帝国崩溃后 1918 至 1920 年的俄国国内战争期间。

14bgqlu.en: With Götterdämmerung, Germany can release Don and ⟦0⟧ through its focus Liberate Oppressed People, in the See to the Eastern Front subbranch of its monarchist path. Released this way, Don will gain cores on Rostov, Millerovo, and Volgodonsk.
14bgqlu.zh: 有了《诸神黄昏》，德国可以通过其焦点「解放被压迫人民」释放顿河与⟦0⟧，该焦点位于其君主制路线的「望向东线」子分支中。以这种方式被释放时，顿河将获得罗斯托夫、米列罗沃与伏尔加顿斯克的核心。

r9hbgv.en: Don Host can only be played with Ironman turned off, although being the only playable nation without any existing cores makes up for a challenge upon the Soviet lands.
r9hbgv.zh: 顿河军只能在关闭铁人的情况下游玩，不过作为唯一没有任何既有核心的可游玩国家，它在苏联土地上构成了挑战的弥补。

botcgz.en: Alternatively, it may be released through the Soviet Union Fragmented game rule, in which case it will hold the same states as when released by Germany.
botcgz.zh: 或者，它可以通过「苏联四分五裂」游戏规则被释放，在这种情况下它将拥有与由德国释放时相同的州。

7c8eg0.en: Don Host is a releasable state of the ⟦0⟧ that cannot be released by any state played normally.
7c8eg0.zh: 顿河军是⟦0⟧的可释放州，无法由任何正常游玩的国家释放。

8qgtvz.en: Don Host, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
8qgtvz.zh: 顿河军缺乏独特的国策树，因此改用通用国策树。

5ub885.en: ⟦0⟧: Relive the defining moment of ⟦1⟧ history, defying the odds in a war against a much more powerful Soviet adversary. Though disadvantaged in air and armored forces, Finnish forces have a strong advantage on homeland defense, so you should prepare an army specifically designed for Finland's terrain to fight invaders. Or, if you prefer, write your own history, strengthening Fascist sympathizers who want a Greater Finland or pursuing a socialist path - with or without Soviet support.
5ub885.zh: ⟦0⟧：重温⟦1⟧历史上决定性的时刻，在与强大得多的苏联对手的战争中逆势取胜。虽然在空军与装甲部队上处于劣势，但芬兰军队在本土防御上拥有强大优势，所以你应当专门准备一支为芬兰地形设计的军队来对抗入侵者。或者，如果你愿意，也可以书写自己的历史，加强想要大芬兰的法西斯同情者，或走上社会主义道路——有无苏联支持皆可。

fdvbrl.en: ⟦0⟧: The richest of the Nordic nations, Sweden is well-suited to a path of vigorous neutrality and to serve as both an arms designer and arms trader. Strong unions risk crippling unstable governments unless you can provide enough work. In a world on fire, Sweden must also upgrade its obsolete forces so it can defend itself. Can the Swedish democracy avoid taking the side of its occupied neighbors, or will the government collapse in favor of monarchist or Fascist alternatives?
fdvbrl.zh: ⟦0⟧：作为北欧国家中最富有的一个，瑞典很适合走积极中立之路，并同时充当武器设计者与武器贸易者。强大的工会可能会拖垮不稳定的政府，除非你能提供足够的工作。在一个燃烧的世界中，瑞典还必须升级其过时的军队以便自卫。瑞典民主制能否避免站在被占领邻国一边，还是政府会崩溃、让位于君主制或法西斯替代方案？

emoilj.en: ⟦0⟧: Relive the historical challenge of a young industrializing nation trying to stay neutral in the face of German aggression or prepare for war by quickly arming to resist the war that is coming to your doorstep. In alternate historical paths, unscrupulous domestic fascists may take advantage of domestic complacency and pursue Nordic union through betrayal, or a Communist revolution can choose to stand with or against Stalin's regime.
emoilj.zh: ⟦0⟧：重温一个年轻的工业化国家在面对德国侵略时努力保持中立的历史挑战，或者通过迅速武装来为即将临门的战争做准备。在替代历史路线中，肆无忌惮的国内法西斯分子可能利用国内的安逸，通过背叛追求北欧联盟，或者一场共产主义革命可能选择支持或反对斯大林政权。

1n90xfl.en: ⟦0⟧: To make sure you have an industry that matches your ambitions, national manufacturers and weapons designers can specialize their craft, improving the production and research of various items through the course of the war. Military Industrial Organizations will offer new ways to streamline production lines or develop high-performance weapons systems with advantages on the battlefield.
1n90xfl.zh: ⟦0⟧：为确保你的工业配得上你的雄心，国家制造商与武器设计师可以专精其手艺，在战争进程中改进各种物品的生产与研究。军工产业组织将提供精简生产线或开发在战场上占优的高性能武器系统的新方式。

sw15tk.en: ⟦0⟧: A long-standing policy of neutrality leaves Denmark unready for a continental war. Pursue the course of domestic harmony through a strong welfare state and agile diplomacy, or throw in with the democratic Allies, rearming for the coming storm. Alternate paths include chasing the dream of a united Scandinavia, reviving the old Kalmar Union.
sw15tk.zh: ⟦0⟧：长期的中立政策使丹麦对大陆战争毫无准备。通过强大的福利国家与灵活的外交追求国内和谐之路，或加入民主同盟国，为即将到来的风暴重新武装。替代路线包括追逐统一斯堪的纳维亚的梦想，复兴古老的卡尔马联盟。

zia0vd.en: ⟦0⟧: In the new ⟦1⟧, you can become an arms exporting powerhouse, selling weapons to other nations in return for civilian factory output, increasing your own industrial production at home while fueling the fires of war abroad. This is a new way for rich and advanced neutral nations to stay viable and active in a world war.
zia0vd.zh: ⟦0⟧：在新的⟦1⟧中，你可以成为武器出口强国，把武器卖给其他国家以换取民用工厂产出，既提升本国的工业生产，又为海外的战火添柴。这是富裕而先进的中立国家在世界大战中保持活力与作为的新方式。

1mcdrie.en: Four Northern democracies are seemingly helpless against nearby predatory dictatorships. Despite their size, Finland, Norway, Denmark, and Sweden have a chance to avoid conquest through clever diplomacy or fierce resistance. Write a new history of the Nordic countries in ⟦0⟧.
1mcdrie.zh: 四个北方民主国家面对附近掠夺成性的独裁政权似乎无能为力。尽管国土狭小，芬兰、挪威、丹麦与瑞典仍有机会通过巧妙的外交或激烈的抵抗来避免被征服。在⟦0⟧中书写北欧国家的新历史。

ijtmyz.en: The expansion adds new focus trees and alternate histories for the northernmost nations of Europe, customization of weapons manufacturers, and new ways to take advantage of neutrality to profit your own citizens.
ijtmyz.zh: 该扩展包为欧洲最北端的国家加入了新国策树与替代历史、武器制造商的定制，以及利用中立为自己公民谋利的新方式。

1yhd9fw.en: ⟦0⟧: Many updates and changes to the design and organization of military divisions, including customization of special forces units, divisional specializations, and more.
1yhd9fw.zh: ⟦0⟧：对军事师的设计与编制进行了大量更新与改动，包括特种部队单位的定制、师专精等等。

1o3asdj.en: ⟦0⟧ is the 6th ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧. It was announced on 2023-06-07⟦3⟧ and was released on 2023-10-10⟦4⟧. The expansion coincides with patch 1.13.

6aw8lj.en: A War Machine of Your Design

haufv5.en: Another strategy for Luxembourg and her hope for survival is to become fascist and join the axis. When Germany invades France or Belgium, Luxembourg (as an ally of Germany) can send in what little troops she has, and can attempt to assist enough in order to gain enough war experience, and potentially take some counties in Belgium, maybe even in France as well. From there, it gets a little easier, as with more land come more factories, which will help her industry. Don't bother with naval, or even aerial research for that matter, as in the early stages it isn't that necessary, however, a good boost to the army would be paratroopers, researching paratroopers will make it easier to annex the Netherlands, and Belgium if the German Reich hasn't attacked yet. Even if an initial attack fails on Belgium and Holland, if Luxembourg is an ally of Germany, she can call the Germans in to assist and win the war.
haufv5.zh: 卢森堡求生的另一个策略是转为法西斯并加入轴心国。当德国入侵法国或比利时之时，卢森堡（作为德国的盟友）可以投入它那点可怜的部队，并尝试提供足够协助以获得足够的战争经验，还可能夺取比利时的一些县，甚至法国的一些。从那时起就会稍微容易些，因为更多土地带来更多工厂，这会有助于它的工业。不必费心海军，甚至也不必费心空军研究，因为在早期阶段那并不那么必要；不过，对陆军而言伞兵是不错的加成，研究伞兵会使吞并荷兰更容易，如果德意志帝国尚未进攻的话，比利时也是。即使初次进攻比利时与荷兰失败，如果卢森堡是德国的盟友，它也可以把德国人叫来协助并赢得战争。

tdubq0.en: There is little hope for Luxembourg to survive in the face of her powerful neighbors: the ⟦0⟧, in particular, almost always use a focus to declare war on the BeNeLux to go around the Maginot line. Nevertheless, Luxembourg can greatly extend her existence by constructing land forts on its only province since day one. These forts, protected from being encircled and cut off from the capital, will end up more useful than the entire Maginot Line. Entrench as deep as possible, focus on defensive divisions, add a few artillery battalions, expand your army to no more than wide enough for the entire border (240), and try to cause as much casualties to your enemies as possible.
tdubq0.zh: 面对强大的邻国，卢森堡几乎没有生还的希望：尤其是⟦0⟧，几乎总是用一个焦点对比荷卢宣战以绕过马奇诺防线。尽管如此，卢森堡可以从第一天起就在其唯一的省份上修建陆上要塞，从而大大延长其存在时间。这些要塞因免于被包围、不会与首都断绝联系，最终会比整条马奇诺防线更有用。尽可能深地构筑工事，专注防御型师，加入几个火炮营，把你的军队扩展到不超过整条边境所需宽度（240），并尽可能给敌人造成更多伤亡。

zuwvyg.en: Luxembourg struggles to maintain a proper purpose on the great stage of Europe. In fact, its position between ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and Germany means that it is at great risk of invasion. Nonetheless, it has very little significance in the greater schemes of the great powers, and thus usually ends up as a footnote in history. Should a war break out between Germany and France, Luxembourg probably will be invaded because, like Belgium, it allows bypassing the heavily fortified French-German border. It's unlikely it would offer any major resistance.
zuwvyg.zh: 卢森堡很难在欧洲大舞台上维持一个像样的目标。事实上，它位于⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧与德国之间，意味着它面临极大的入侵风险。尽管如此，它对列强的宏大计划而言意义甚微，因此通常最终只是历史上的一个脚注。如果德国与法国之间爆发战争，卢森堡很可能会被入侵，因为与比利时一样，它允许绕过重兵设防的法德边境。它不太可能提供任何重大抵抗。

qlvjj7.en: Generally, since you only have 8 Iron and no fuel (and no way to buy resources, since you have no factories ⟦0⟧), using motorized/mechanized units or aircraft would be hard. Due to lack of resources and industry, amount of equipment produced will be small. You will heavily rely on lend-lease - what should help with basic things, and even get something interesting and high-tech on occasions (e.g. artillery, mechanized units, armored cars, tanks, aircraft, etc).
qlvjj7.zh: 一般来说，由于你只有 8 份铁且没有燃料（也没有办法购买资源，因为你没有工厂⟦0⟧），使用摩托化/机械化单位或飞机会很困难。由于缺乏资源与工业，生产的装备数量会很少。你将严重依赖租借——它应当能帮助解决基础事项，偶尔甚至能得到一些有趣且高科技的东西（例如火炮、机械化单位、装甲车、坦克、飞机等）。

11602ln.en: Once you max out land forts, consider building Anti-Air to decrease efficiency of enemy aviation. Air Base isn't very useful - lend-leased aircraft are acquired in small numbers, Axis will just shoot all of them down. Radar is unneeded. Factories and infrastructure are OK after finishing forts. Synthetic Refinery could make fuel for lend-leased vehicles - but that's only useful ⟦0⟧ you get vehicles via lend-lease in the first place.
11602ln.zh: 一旦你把陆上要塞修到满级，考虑修建防空炮以降低敌方航空的效率。空军基地不太有用——租借来的飞机数量很少，轴心国会把它们全部击落。雷达不需要。工厂与基础设施在修完要塞之后也可以。合成炼油厂可以为租借来的车辆制造燃料——但那只在⟦0⟧你首先能通过租借获得车辆时才有用。

1ra838s.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in Western Europe with a population of ⟦1⟧. It borders Germany to the east, ⟦2⟧ to the south, and ⟦3⟧ to the north and west. With only two provinces, Luxembourg is the smallest country in the game. It has very little in terms of resources, manpower or industrial power.
1ra838s.zh: ⟦0⟧是西欧的一个小国，人口⟦1⟧。它东邻德国，南邻⟦2⟧，北面与西面邻⟦3⟧。只有两个省份，卢森堡是游戏中面积最小的国家。它在资源、人力或工业实力方面都极少。

kg4sl0.en: As a Democratic country, ⟦0⟧ has a positive relationship with other Democratic countries (⟦1⟧ to ⟦2⟧) and a slight negative relationship with everyone else (⟦3⟧). It lacks colonies of any kind and does not hold any puppets at the start.
kg4sl0.zh: 作为一个民主国家，⟦0⟧与其他民主国家关系良好（⟦1⟧至⟦2⟧），与其他所有国家则略有负面关系（⟦3⟧）。它没有任何类型的殖民地，开局也不拥有任何傀儡。

ivaz75.en: ⟦0⟧ starts 1936 as a democracy with elections every four years, the next being in June 1937. The ruling party is the Rietspartei led by Joseph Bech.
ivaz75.zh: ⟦0⟧在 1936 年开局为民主制，每四年举行一次选举，下一次在 1937 年 6 月。执政党是由约瑟夫·贝克领导的法律党。

1o4aqq5.en: ⟦0⟧ is one of the few countries that starts without a military force.
1o4aqq5.zh: ⟦0⟧是少数开局没有军事力量的国家之一。

14y5oxl.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name you have given to the asset. This may be prefixed with various other segments, such as ⟦1⟧ for idea images, etc. ⟦2⟧ is the image to use for the progress bar. ⟦3⟧ is the image to use for the background of the progress bar. ⟦4⟧ defines the unprogressed color of the bar. It is decimal RGBA. Alpha is optional. ⟦5⟧ defines the progressed color of the bar. It is decimal RGBA. Alpha is optional. ⟦6⟧ defines the size of the progress bar section in height and width. ⟦7⟧ is used to define an effect state to apply to the image, i.e. the button press effect on a button image. Effects are found in ⟦8⟧. Multiple can be defined to add multiple effects. ⟦9⟧ defines whether the progress bar is horizontal or not. By default a bar is horizontal. ⟦10⟧ defines the precision of the progressbar or into how many frames it's split into. Defaults to 100 if unset.
14y5oxl.zh: ⟦0⟧是你为该素材指定的名称。它可能带有各种其他前缀段，例如用于理念图像的⟦1⟧等。⟦2⟧是用于进度条的图像。⟦3⟧是用于进度条背景的图像。⟦4⟧定义条形的未完成颜色。它是十进制 RGBA。Alpha 可选。⟦5⟧定义条形的已完成颜色。它是十进制 RGBA。Alpha 可选。⟦6⟧定义进度条部分的高度与宽度尺寸。⟦7⟧用于定义应用于图像的效果状态，即按钮图像上的按下效果。效果可在⟦8⟧中找到。可以定义多个以添加多个效果。⟦9⟧定义进度条是否为水平。默认情况下条形是水平的。⟦10⟧定义进度条的精度，即它被分成多少帧。未设置时默认为 100。

1ph5ox4.en: Note that for many assets, such as technology and equipment asset definitions, the image can be specified for a specific tag, i.e. ⟦0⟧, which only displays the asset for the specified tag. This will override the base asset of the same name. This also applies to graphical culture, i.e. ⟦1⟧.
1ph5ox4.zh: 请注意，对于许多素材（例如科技与装备素材定义），图像可以为特定 tag 指定，即⟦0⟧，它只为指定的 tag 显示该素材。这会覆盖同名的基准素材。这也适用于图形文化，即⟦1⟧。

835t2a.zh: 图形素材是在⟦0⟧文件中定义过的图像文件。这会把图像绑定到一个脚本名称，之后在⟦1⟧界面文件中引用该名称。

1hao24z.en: ⟦0⟧ defines whether or not an image can be clicked on and interacted with. If yes, the image will have no tooltip and can not be clicked on when used in game.
1hao24z.zh: ⟦0⟧定义图像是否可以被点击与交互。如果是，该图像在游戏中使用时将没有提示框且无法被点击。

1io3u4b.en: ⟦0⟧ defines whether the image is bound by its alpha channel with regards to player clicks. Otherwise the bounding box is the image dimensions.
1io3u4b.zh: ⟦0⟧定义图像在玩家点击方面是否受其 alpha 通道约束。否则，边界框就是图像尺寸。

16dv7dy.zh: ⟦0⟧用于一个字体有多个字体图像的情况，即支持英语与西里尔字母。它用于替代⟦1⟧。

1vwlndp.en: ⟦0⟧ is the path to the image, based of the ⟦1⟧, meaning you only include the folders within this folder, not the full filepath.
1vwlndp.zh: ⟦0⟧是图像的路径，基于⟦1⟧，意味着你只需包含此文件夹内的各层文件夹，而不是完整文件路径。

2ryxaz.en: ⟦0⟧ is used when their are multiple font images for one font, i.e. to support English and Cryllic. This is used inplace of ⟦1⟧.
2ryxaz.zh: ⟦0⟧用于一个字体有多个字体图像的情况，即支持英语与西里尔字母。它用于替代⟦1⟧。

dwqkzs.en: The Japanese will inevitably declare war, thus Mengjiang and Manchukuo will be included into the fight. In that matter it is better to reorganize the army defensively and not in a stretched line, and in tiles where the Great Wall provides better stats for the army. Obviously, the Japanese army will go for the rest of the cores, but its better to keep Beiping(the capital) in defense. The Japanese army will be interested on pushing deeper into China. With that possibility, push towards east Hebei to limit their supplies and as the opportunity provides, it becomes your core. The goal of the battle front is to push North, by capturing Mengjiang and Manchukuo. Watch out from the naval invasions as the Japanese have total dominance in the Chinese waters. Be sure to protect the coastal tiles while maintaing a left and right front from the Japanese and its puppets. Use a couple of the division of both fronts to push upwards to restrict access between Mengjiang and Manchukuo. While the rest of the left front for that matter push and cooperate with the United Front members to crush the Japanese invading divisions.
dwqkzs.zh: 日本必将宣战，因此蒙疆与满洲国会加入战斗。就此而言，最好以防御方式重组军队，而不要拉成一条长线，并把部队放在长城能提供更好属性的地块上。显然，日本军队会去夺取其余核心，但最好让北平（首都）保持防御。日本军队会有兴趣向中国更深处推进。面对这种可能，向东河北推进以限制他们的补给，并在机会出现时使它成为你的核心。该战线的目标是向北推进，夺取蒙疆与满洲国。要当心海军登陆，因为日本在中国水域拥有完全主导权。务必在维持对日本及其傀儡的左右两面的同时保护沿海地块。用两方面各几个师向上推进，以限制蒙疆与满洲国之间的通路。与此同时左面其余部分推进，并与统一战线成员合作粉碎日本入侵师。

182lbr.en: Initially, take the Industrial focuses freely without fearing any event of being annexed. Considering that Northeastern Army is more likely to press for peace and creating a United Front with Nationalists and Communists. Build a proper economy, taking the mentioned focuses and manually applying the construction stats. Depending on whatever path Japan takes, Hebei-Chahar has to reinforce defenses in the Manchurian and Mengjiang borders. If Japan has abandoned their ambitions for now, it is better to use the opportunity to declare war against Manchukuo and Mengjiang, thus concluding their annexation. This, of course, would help to have more lands to core on the long term if you wish to unify China as Hebei Chahar. Otherwise, if Japan is determined to fight with China, then Hebei-Chahar has to join the United Front and finally face the Japanese.
182lbr.zh: 起初，放心选取工业焦点，不必担心被吞并的事件。考虑到东北军更可能推动和平，并与国民党和共产党组建统一战线。建设一套像样的经济，选取上述焦点并手动应用建造加成。取决于日本走哪条路线，河北-察哈尔必须加强满洲与蒙疆边境的防御。如果日本暂时放弃了它们的野心，最好利用这个机会对满洲国与蒙疆宣战，从而完成对它们的吞并。当然，如果你希望以河北-察哈尔统一中国，这从长远看会有助于有更多土地可设为核心。否则，如果日本决意与中国开战，那么河北-察哈尔就必须加入统一战线，最终面对日本。

prps94.en: By pushing and prodding attacks against Mengjiang should push them into an early capitulation. As now the focus rests between Japan and Manchukuo. Divide the army to contribute to clean the Japanese invasions in Mainland China and to finish the Manchurian campaign up north. Push the invading forces up to Korea, until everything else in Central China has been liberated too. With the White peace on the way, Hebei-Chahar wins Mengjiang and Manchukuo territories along with East Hebei and Dalian. If Japan decides to not attack for the second time, then Hebei-Chahar should rebuild and expand its economy and army in order to reunite all of China.
prps94.zh: 通过对蒙疆发动持续推进与刺探式进攻，应当能推动它们早日投降。现在焦点落在日本与满洲国之间。把军队分开，一部分用于清理日本在中国大陆的入侵，一部分用于在北方结束满洲战役。把入侵部队一路推回朝鲜，直到中国中部的其他一切也被解放。随着白色和平到来，河北-察哈尔赢得蒙疆与满洲国领土，以及东河北与大连。如果日本决定第二次不进攻，那么河北-察哈尔应当重建并扩展其经济与军队，以便重新统一全中国。

1m81gon.en: During mid-1933, the Kuomintang government in Nanjing sought to strengthen control over the northern provinces of Hebei and Chahar, then under the control of Song's 29th Army. As such, He Yingqin replaced Zhang Xueliang as head of the Beiping Branch Military Council and Huang Fu installed as head of the new Political Affairs Commission, both men being Kuomintang officials loyal to Nanjing. Their impact, however, was limited, and any improvement of relations between the 29th Army and the central government came from personal relationships, such as that between Song and Liu Jianqun, political education officer in the 29th Army.
1m81gon.zh: 1933 年中期，南京的国民党政府试图加强对河北与察哈尔北方省份的控制，当时这些省份处于宋的 29 军控制之下。因此，何应钦取代张学良成为北平军分会负责人，黄郛则出任新的政务委员会负责人，两人都是忠于南京的国民党官员。然而他们的影响有限，29 军与中央政府之间关系的任何改善都来自私人关系，例如宋与 29 军政治教育官刘健群之间的关系。

u5b47c.en: Hebei-Chahar, starts in a pretty rugged terrain. With an unique setting, as it has a few Great Wall of China buffs in certain cores, and in Beiping's tiles too. Which is suited for a defense war against the Japanese. First thing's first, It is better to start improving a bit of infrastructure, small arms and trade for steel to increase and make the gun producing properly.
u5b47c.zh: 河北-察哈尔开局处于相当崎岖的地形。它有一个独特的设定，即在某些核心以及北平的地块上带有一些中国长城加成。这很适合对日防御战。首要之事是，最好先改善一点基础设施、轻武器，并用贸易换取钢铁，以提高并让枪械生产正常运转。

14pydfq.en: The Hebei–Chahar (or Hopeh-Chahar) Political Council, or Hebei-Chahar Political Commission was a political body established under General Song Zheyuan on 18 December 1935 to rule over the two northern Chinese provinces of Hebei and Chahar.
14pydfq.zh: 河北-察哈尔（或直隶-察哈尔）政务委员会，即河北-察哈尔政务委员会，是宋哲元将军于 1935 年 12 月 18 日建立的政治机构，用以治理中国北方的河北与察哈尔两省。

1ebjpey.en: In order to play as early as Kuban Host, is to play as Poland. Without having to turn on historical ai, because that would prevent Kuban Host being formed early in the first place. Thus, it is more assuring if Germany starts onto a plunging German civil war compared to the 1939 scenario as Germany enters the war with the Allies in the moment when declares war with Poland. In the early scenario, the player has to rush down with the "Assemble the Regency Council" Branch to make way to the "The Cossack-King" sub-branch. Otherwise, if the German Reich goes historical then the player has to seek an alliance with them should they secure their western borders. Finally, take "Complete the Bermontian Mission" focus, and should the German Reich help with the Soviet problem, make sure to occupy the Caucasus under the Polish command.
1ebjpey.zh: 要尽早以库班军游玩，就要以波兰游玩。不必开启历史 AI，因为那首先会阻止库班军被提前成立。因此，与 1939 年剧本相比，如果德国一开始就陷入一场急剧爆发的德国内战，会更有保障——在 1939 年剧本中，德国一与波兰宣战就会与同盟国开战。在早期剧本中，玩家必须沿「组建摄政会议」分支速推，以便通往「哥萨克之王」子分支。否则，如果德意志帝国走历史路线，那么只要他们确保西部边境，玩家就必须寻求与他们结盟。最后，选取「完成别尔蒙任务」焦点，并且如果德意志帝国在苏联问题上出手相助，务必在波兰指挥下占领高加索。

1vow9o1.en: Kuban Host is a releasable state of the ⟦0⟧ that cannot be released by any state played normally - it may only appear by Poland decision if it does the focus Complete the Bermontian Mission and is already called as "The Bermontian Kingdom of Poland". Once the Complete the Bermontian Mission focus is completed by Poland, the decision to form the Host is added and if it controls or owns the Soviet cores in the Caucasus. If the decision is taken, the Kuban Host will obtain 5 cores upon release (Crimea, Krasnodar, Stavropol, Sochi and Dagestan). And in additional, it gains 15 units with 8 cavalry battalions.
1vow9o1.zh: 库班军是⟦0⟧的可释放州，无法由任何正常游玩的国家释放——它可能只会通过波兰决议出现——如果波兰做了「完成别尔蒙任务」焦点，并且已经被称为「别尔蒙的波兰王国」。一旦波兰完成「完成别尔蒙任务」焦点，组建顿河军的决议就会被添加，前提是它控制或拥有高加索的苏联核心。如果采取该决议，库班军在被释放时将获得 5 个核心（克里米亚、克拉斯诺达尔、斯塔夫罗波尔、索契与达吉斯坦）。此外，它还会获得 15 个单位与 8 个骑兵营。

8nhsx.en: Some Ukrainian historians argue that the Kuban People's Republic was an attempt by the Kuban Cossacks to unite with Ukraine, citing the shifting alliances of the Rada. The last premier of the Republic, Vasil Ivanis, argued that had Pavlo Skoropadsky acted more decisively, and sent a UNR division led by General Natiev to the Kuban, Ukraine would have become the main nexus of the Anti-Bolshevik movement. Ivanis states that with the aid of the Central Powers they could have easily reclaimed all of Russia, given that Aleksander Kolchak would have acted in the same time frame in the East.
8nhsx.zh: 一些乌克兰历史学家主张，库班人民共和国是库班哥萨克试图与乌克兰联合的一次尝试，并援引拉达不断变化的联盟关系为证。该共和国最后一任总理瓦西里·伊万尼斯主张，如果帕夫洛·斯科罗帕茨基行动更果断，并派出一支由纳蒂耶夫将军率领的乌克兰人民共和国师前往库班，乌克兰就会成为反布尔什维克运动的主要枢纽。伊万尼斯表示，在同盟国的援助下，他们本可以轻易收复整个俄罗斯，因为亚历山大·高尔察克本会在同一时期在东方行动。

3tdlks.en: Console switch as Kuban Host, to finally play as them. As released as a puppet, Kuban Host has the following cores that Poland has under control (Crimea, Krasnodar, Stavropol, Sochi and Dagestan). Unfortunately, Kuban Host has no advisor of any kind, with a notable exception of ideology boosters and the Illusive Gentleman advisor. In a matter of technology, Kuban Host also inherits whatever Poland has from the start, if the player wishes to remain to play as Poland a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the state, Kuban Host gets them altogether.
3tdlks.zh: 用控制台切换到库班军，最终以它们游玩。作为傀儡被释放时，库班军拥有以下波兰所控制的核心（克里米亚、克拉斯诺达尔、斯塔夫罗波尔、索契与达吉斯坦）。不幸的是，库班军没有任何类型的顾问，明显的例外是意识形态推动者与「神秘绅士」顾问。在科技方面，如果玩家希望多玩一会儿波兰、好让科技达到可接受水平，库班军也会一并继承波兰开局所拥有的一切。

pw040y.en: The republic was proclaimed by the Kuban Rada on 28 January 1918 and declared its independence on 16 February. It included the entire territory of the former Kuban Oblast of the Russian Empire. During its brief independence, it unsuccessfully sought union with the Ukrainian People's Republic. The Kuban People's Republic was de facto occupied by the forces of Anton Denikin on 6 November 1919, before being fully occupied and annexed by the Soviets in the spring of 1920.
pw040y.zh: 该共和国由库班拉达于 1918 年 1 月 28 日宣告成立，并于 2 月 16 日宣布独立。它包括俄罗斯帝国前库班州的全部领土。在其短暂的独立期间，它曾试图与乌克兰人民共和国联合但未果。库班人民共和国于 1919 年 11 月 6 日被安东·邓尼金的部队事实上占领，随后在 1920 年春季被苏联人完全占领并吞并。

tpg8ra.en: Defeating the rest of the Soviet Union, will not be easy on its own. Console wise it is simple enough. Console core the 5 cores of Kuban Host for a really early release. But for an interesting challenge rather join the Axis to gain protection from the Germans, and build an army as fast as possible to hold the ground against the Soviets. Declare war on them and subsequently annex them.
tpg8ra.zh: 击败苏联其余部分本身并不容易。用控制台来说，这足够简单。用控制台把库班军的 5 个核心设为核心，以便极早释放。但若想要有趣的挑战，不如加入轴心国以获得德国的保护，并尽可能快地建立一支军队来守住阵地对抗苏联。对他们宣战并随后吞并他们。

1qne2rt.en: Both Soviet and later contemporary Russian historians viewed the decision of the Kuban People's Republic to break with the White Movement as a deceitful "back-stabbing" at a critical moment during the Russian Civil War. The act is perceived as one of the important contributions to the ultimate Bolshevik victory.
1qne2rt.zh: 苏联以及后来的当代俄罗斯历史学家都认为，库班人民共和国在俄国国内战争关键时刻与白军运动决裂的决定，是一种欺骗性的「背后捅刀」。这一行为被视为对布尔什维克最终胜利的重要贡献之一。

lcs1g1.en: With Götterdämmerung, Germany can release ⟦0⟧ and Kuban through its focus Liberate Oppressed People, in the See to the Eastern Front subbranch of its monarchist path. Released this way, Kuban will gain cores on Krasnodar, Sochi, and Stavropol.

b7aubc.en: ⟦0⟧. If there are duplicate definitions of a sprite with the same name in different files, the game will prioritise the one that would be ⟦1⟧, and the older sprite will be ignored in entirety. This can be ensured by beginning the replacement file's name with a symbol late in the ASCII character table. Typically the lowercase letter 'z' is used for this purpose. For example, to change the amount of frames in ⟦2⟧ to 10, it is possible to define a sprite with that name with 10 frames in the mod's ⟦3⟧ file instead of copying over the base game file. Since most .gfx files define integral parts of the user interface, copying them over can lead to the mod's loaded files missing sprites upon a major game update, which would appear in-game as the default image, which is the error dog by default. As to ease the burden of needing to check the interface files, it's best to never copy over .gfx files, unless more additions would be actively harmful to the mod, such as with ⟦4⟧
b7aubc.zh: ⟦0⟧。如果在不同文件中对同名 sprite 存在重复定义，游戏将优先使用⟦1⟧的那个，较旧的 sprite 会被完全忽略。可以通过把替换文件名的首字符设为 ASCII 字符表中较靠后的符号来确保这一点。通常为此使用小写字母 'z'。例如，要把⟦2⟧中的帧数改为 10，可以在模组的⟦3⟧文件中定义一个同名、含 10 帧的 sprite，而不必复制基础游戏文件。由于大多数 .gfx 文件定义了用户界面的组成部分，在游戏大版本更新时复制它们可能导致模组已加载的文件缺少 sprite，这在游戏内会显示为默认图像，即默认的错误狗。为了减轻检查界面文件的负担，最好永远不要复制 .gfx 文件，除非更多新增内容会主动损害模组，例如⟦4⟧的情况

5vbh4n.en: These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on increasing their divisions' Initiative, which allows them to gain planning bonus faster and be more likely to reinforce into available combat width in ongoing battles. The latter can be especially helpful when performing naval invasions or when trying to hold a defensive line with multiple divisions in the same province.
5vbh4n.zh: 这些科技解锁并增强⟦0⟧连及其变型。这些支援连专注提高其师的主动性，使它们能更快获得计划加成，并更有可能在正在进行的战斗中增援进入可用战斗宽度。后者在执行海军登陆或试图用多个师在同一省份守御防线时尤其有用。

1oq8uor.en: These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on increasing the reliability of all equipment in their divisions, preventing losses to attrition and increasing recovery rates after battles. They also provide additional equipment capture ratio to their divisions, allowing them to steal some enemy equipment that would otherwise be lost in battles.
1oq8uor.zh: 这些科技解锁并增强⟦0⟧连及其变型。这些支援连专注提高其师中所有装备的可靠性，防止损耗造成的损失并提高战斗后的恢复率。它们还为其师提供额外的装备缴获比例，使它们能夺取一些原本会在战斗中损失的敌方装备。

wiqyq3.en: These technologies unlock and enhance reconnaissance support companies, like ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. These support companies focus on providing the Recon stat to their divisions, which can allow them to be more likely to select advantageous ⟦2⟧ in battle. They also provide various ⟦3⟧ movement bonuses and are some of the few support companies whose movement speeds can decrease the speed of their divisions.
wiqyq3.zh: 这些科技解锁并增强侦察支援连，如⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧。这些支援连专注为其师提供侦察属性，这可以使它们更有可能在战斗中选取有利的⟦2⟧。它们还提供各种⟦3⟧移动加成，并且是少数移动速度可能拖慢其师的支援连之一。

1iqcgcl.en: These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on increasing the suppression of their divisions, making them more effective at handling ⟦1⟧ as off-map garrisons. They also somewhat improve the recovery rate of infantry brigades, allowing them to regain organization faster.

c8df8n.en: Modules extend the capabilities of an equipment variant in a more detailed manner than upgrades. Ship hulls, tank chassis, and plane airframes act as a base equipment types offering a number of module slots that can be used. The hulls, chassis, and airframes are researched individually and can mix different (researched) modules to create variants at the cost of naval/army/air experience in the appropriate designer. Without ⟦0⟧ nor ⟦1⟧, researched ship & tank equipment types automatically combine ship hulls and tank chassis and a standard configuration of modules that cannot be changed.
c8df8n.zh: 模块以比升级更细致的方式扩展装备变型的能力。舰体、坦克底盘与飞机机体充当基础装备类型，提供若干可使用的模块槽。舰体、底盘与机体分别研究，并可以在相应设计器中以花费海军/陆军/空军经验为代价混合不同（已研究的）模块来创建变型。既没有⟦0⟧也没有⟦1⟧时，已研究的舰船与坦克装备类型会自动组合舰体与坦克底盘以及一套无法更改的标准模块配置。

199d303.en: Each upgrade may be selected up to five times and may be made at different times. Existing equipment upgrades may be viewed in the Production screen. Upgrades in one area may reduce performance in another area - e.g., complexity reducing reliability or increased weight-reducing speed. Note that land units may use maintenance support companies that increase reliability for equipment in that division, and also that equipment stats and performance may also be affected by government staff with particular skills that provide modifiers.
199d303.zh: 每种升级最多可选取五次，并且可以在不同时间进行。已有装备升级可在生产界面查看。一个方面的升级可能会降低另一个方面的性能——例如复杂性降低可靠性，或增加重量降低速度。请注意，陆军单位可以使用维修支援连来提高该师装备的可靠性，另外装备属性与性能也可能受到具有特定技能、提供修正的政府参谋影响。

tjdjym.en: For example if Japan has Mitsubishi as its air design company (+20% agility, +10% speed) while completing research on the 1940 fighter equipment type (agility 65), the resulting equipment variant (Ki-43 Hayabusa) has 65 * 120% = 78 agility. If Japan upgrades this variant with five points into Engine upgrade (5 * 5%), the resulting variant Ki-43 Hayabusa Kai A has 65 * 145% = 94.25 agility.
tjdjym.zh: 例如，如果日本以三菱作为其飞机设计公司（+20% 机动性、+10% 速度），同时完成 1940 年战斗机装备类型（机动性 65）的研究，则所得的装备变型（Ki-43 隼）拥有 65 * 120% = 78 机动性。如果日本把该变型用五点升级到引擎升级（5 * 5%），所得变型 Ki-43 隼 甲拥有 65 * 145% = 94.25 机动性。

syla7q.en: The statistics of an equipment variant are based on the underlying equipment type, its design company, and upgrades or modules. Additive and averaged additive stats from modules are added to the stats of the equipment type. Multiplicative module stats as well as designer and upgrade stats stack additively among each other and are then applied as one factor.
syla7q.zh: 装备变型的统计数据基于其底层装备类型、其设计公司，以及升级或模块。来自模块的加法与平均加法属性会加到该装备类型的属性上。乘法模块属性以及设计师与升级属性彼此之间按加法叠加，然后作为一个系数应用。

iz2ua3.en: Variants are expensive in XP, so their use should take into account the expected benefit, production volume, and service lifetime of the variant in deciding where to commit these resources. This is especially important for capital ships, as they take a very long time to build and there are large year-gaps between models.
iz2ua3.zh: 变型在经验上代价高昂，因此在使用时应考虑预期收益、生产数量与变型的服役寿命，来决定把资源投在哪里。这对主力舰尤其重要，因为它们建造耗时极长，而且各型号之间有巨大的年份间隔。

u3azz3.en: When a country unlocks an equipment type by researching the corresponding technology, a base variant of it gets created. Where applicable, it uses the design company the country has at that moment. It is not necessary to already have the design company when the research starts.
u3azz3.zh: 当一个国家通过研究相应科技解锁某个装备类型时，会创建它的一个基础变型。在适用的情况下，它会使用该国当时拥有的设计公司。并不需要在该研究开始时就已经拥有该设计公司。

c3ogug.en: In games where the tank/ship/plane designer are disabled, there are several types of equipment which can have specific attributes upgraded using experience. Sometimes a small improvement in speed, protection, or firepower can make a significant difference in the field.
c3ogug.zh: 在禁用坦克/舰船/飞机设计器的游戏中，有几类装备可以用经验升级特定属性。有时速度、防护或火力上的一点小改进就能在战场上造成显著差异。

r32jg5.en: In games where the tank/ship/plane designer are enabled (with the appropriate DLC), equipment modules can be changed to create new variants of a specific model (for example, changing an engine within a tank).
r32jg5.zh: 在启用坦克/舰船/飞机设计器的游戏中（拥有相应 DLC），可以更改装备模块以创建特定型号的新变型（例如更换坦克内的引擎）。

1w8894b.en: Equipment variants are concrete, country-specific classes of ⟦0⟧ which are based on an equipment type. They may include customizations such as design companies, upgrades, or modules.
1w8894b.zh: 装备变型是基于某个装备类型的、具体的、国家专属的⟦0⟧类别。它们可能包含设计公司、升级或模块等定制。

1b2pi53.zh: 对于陆军装备，第一级升级花费 10⟦0⟧经验，对于空军与海军装备则花费 25⟦1⟧。此后每一级多花 5⟦2⟧经验。

1bdbp73.en: In order to play as early as the Galicia and Lodomeria(GAL), is to play first as Czechoslovakia and go with the Monarchist path. In this case, just go on by conquering neighboring states for the Moravian Kingdom before preparing yourself to fight against Germans or Soviets for the war. Considering that if Poland stays independent, they'd be claimed by the Soviets or Germans. In the usual scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases goes for the GAL focuses, as in Dismantle Poland. Or the Fascist route with the ⟦0⟧ focus. Therefore, Galicia and Lodomeria gains 3 cores in Southern Poland. Which coincidentally compass the Polish lands that were under the Austrian Empire rule. If Czechoslovakia invades and annexes Poland, then it can release Galicia and Lodomeria manually.
1bdbp73.zh: 要尽早以加利西亚与洛多梅里亚（GAL）游玩，就要先以捷克斯洛伐克游玩并走君主制路线。在这种情况下，只需继续征战邻国以建立摩拉维亚王国，然后再为与德国或苏联的战争做准备。考虑到如果波兰保持独立，它会被苏联或德国索要。在通常剧本中，玩家必须速推释放 GAL 的焦点，例如「肢解波兰」。或者走带有⟦0⟧焦点的法西斯路线。因此，加利西亚与洛多梅里亚在波兰南部获得 3 个核心。这恰好涵盖了曾处于奥地利帝国统治下的波兰土地。如果捷克斯洛伐克入侵并吞并波兰，那么它可以手动释放加利西亚与洛多梅里亚。

io6vws.en: ⟦0⟧ or colloquially ⟦1⟧, was a constituent possession of the Habsburg monarchy, encompassing the historical region of Galicia, and also including parts of historical regions of Lodomeria and Lesser Poland. The crown land was established in 1772, after the First Partition of Poland, when Habsburgs annexed those regions, previously belonging to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In 1804, it became a crown land of the newly proclaimed Austrian Empire. From 1867, it was a crown land within the Cisleithanian or Austrian half of the dual monarchy of Austria-Hungary. It maintained a degree of provincial autonomy. Its status remained unchanged until the dissolution of the monarchy in 1918.
io6vws.zh: ⟦0⟧，俗称⟦1⟧，是哈布斯堡君主国的一个组成部分，涵盖加利西亚的历史地区，也包括洛多梅里亚与小波兰历史地区的部分。该王室领地在 1772 年第一次瓜分波兰之后建立，当时哈布斯堡吞并了此前属于波兰立陶宛联邦的这些地区。1804 年，它成为新宣告成立的奥地利帝国的王室领地。从 1867 年起，它是奥匈帝国二元君主制中内莱塔尼亚即奥地利一方的王室领地。它保持了一定程度的省级自治。其地位一直不变，直到 1918 年君主国解体。

1jpkfam.en: Fortunately, as stated earlier, the nation inherits most of the releasing nation's technology, ranging from small arms, tanks, planes and navy. In this case: Czechoslovakia's. Thus, opening opportunities to start and produce if needed necessary. However, if started as a puppet state it has many draw backs. It has a decent amount of factories but some go to the nation's overlord, and some are unusable which have to be resorted to raise the puppet level. Therefore, independence which means to retake the great number of factories back up. Or with other means.
1jpkfam.zh: 幸运的是，如前所述，该国继承释放国的大部分科技，从小型武器、坦克、飞机到海军。在这种情况下：捷克斯洛伐克的。因此，如果必要，它有机会开始并生产所需之物。然而，如果作为傀儡国开局，它有许多缺点。它拥有相当数量的工厂，但其中一些归该国宗主国，还有一些无法使用，只能靠提高傀儡等级来解决。因此，独立——意味着夺回大量工厂。或者用其他手段。

8lxufc.en: The Galicia and Lodomeria, despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is almost unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. But, another way is to release them as a puppet, wait until they get cores throughout their decisions. Playing this country is a challenge all about maintaining peace and order on the owned lands of Southern Poland.
8lxufc.zh: 加利西亚与洛多梅里亚尽管是游戏内的「国家」，但按铁人选择它几乎无法游玩，所以玩家玩该国唯一的好处就是使用控制台命令。不过，另一种方法是把它们作为傀儡释放，等它们通过决议获得核心。游玩该国是一场关于在波兰南部所拥有的土地上维持和平与秩序的挑战。

1gzzijr.en: The ⟦0⟧ Polish nation can be released by any nation that occupies the three southern Polish cores, if Czechoslovakia has taken the ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ focus. As it is released it starts with the political advisors. It doesn't have any starting national spirit, an unique national focus or any unique leaders.
1gzzijr.zh: ⟦0⟧波兰国家可以被任何占领三个波兰南部核心的国家释放，如果捷克斯洛伐克已选取⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧焦点。被释放时它开局带有政治顾问。它没有任何开局国家精神、独特的国策或任何独特领袖。

58xm0m.en: In a matter of technology, GAL also inherits whatever Czechoslovakia gains from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Czechoslovakia a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the puppet state, Galicia and Lodomeria gets them altogether.
58xm0m.zh: 在科技方面，如果玩家希望多玩一会儿捷克斯洛伐克、好让其科技对该傀儡国可接受，加利西亚与洛多梅里亚也会一并继承捷克斯洛伐克从国策或决议中获得的一切。

hz4pn5.en: Galicia and Lodomeria starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
hz4pn5.zh: 加利西亚与洛多梅里亚开局拥有 2 个科研槽，不过它可以通过通用国策树获得最多 3 个额外科研槽。作为可释放国家，被释放时它会继承释放国已经研究过的全部科技。

1hi9hco.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country in the ⟦1⟧ southern regions. It can be released via Czechoslovakia's Set up Southern Polish Puppet State or Dismantle Poland focuses. It cannot be released manually, but can be released in a peace deal if its cores still exist.
1hi9hco.zh: ⟦0⟧是⟦1⟧南部地区的一个可释放国家。它可以通过捷克斯洛伐克的「建立南波兰傀儡国」或「肢解波兰」焦点释放。它无法手动释放，但如果其核心仍然存在，可以在和平协议中被释放。

122fkpg.en: Unfortunately, Galicia and Lodomeria doesn't get any formable decisions, or effectively restoring the Polish nation. Therefore, this can only be replicated by console commands. Alternatively, it can join Czechoslovakia's faction or start its own conquest.
122fkpg.zh: 不幸的是，加利西亚与洛多梅里亚没有任何可成立国家决议，也无法有效恢复波兰国家。因此，这只能通过控制台命令复现。或者，它可以加入捷克斯洛伐克的阵营，或开始自己的征服。

fojpgm.en: When released, Galicia and Lodomeria will be a ⟦0⟧ nation with no elections.
fojpgm.zh: 被释放时，加利西亚与洛多梅里亚将是一个不举行选举的⟦0⟧国家。
