1hgq4wb.en: On 30 October 1918, following the collapse of the Ottoman Empire, Imam Yahya Muhammad of the al-Qasimi dynasty declared northern Yemen an independent sovereign state. In 1926, Yahya proclaimed the Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen, becoming both a temporal king as well as a (Zaydi) spiritual leader, and won international recognition for his new state, such as with the Kingdom of Italy, entering into the Italo-Yemeni Treaty in 1926, and with Soviet Union, entering into the Soviet-Yemeni Treaty in 1928. In 1934 ⟦0⟧ would declare war on Yemen over disputed territories that Yemen occupied in the Northeast. While Yemeni soldiers would prevent the Saudi Arabian army from overrunning the kingdom, the better British equipped Saudi Arabian army would successfully occupy the disputed territories which Saudi Arabia would receive in the Peace Treaty of Taif thus ending the war.
1hgq4wb.zh: 1918 年 10 月 30 日，随着奥斯曼帝国崩溃，卡西米王朝的伊玛目叶海亚·穆罕默德宣布北也门为独立主权国家。1926 年，叶海亚宣告成立穆塔瓦基利亚也门王国，既成为世俗国王也成为（宰德派）精神领袖，并为其新国家赢得国际承认，例如与意大利王国于 1926 年签订意也条约，与苏联于 1928 年签订苏也条约。1934 年⟦0⟧就也门在东北部占领的有争议领土向也门宣战。虽然也门士兵阻止了沙特阿拉伯军队席卷该王国，但装备更好的沙特阿拉伯军队成功占领了这些有争议领土，沙特阿拉伯在《塔伊夫和约》中获得这些领土，战争就此结束。

12owjxu.en: You can then take over Iraq and puppet them as well for manpower. Iraq and Turkey would be a great obstacle for Yemen. Out of the two, Iraq is the weaker of the two, not only of their population, but also a small army and no navy. It is critical that the player strike quickly before Iran mobilize. If they muster a strong army, the best and perhaps only option would be to make a frontline around the Iraqi river in the south and north Iraq and some divisions in the center to prevent Baghdad to be under Iranian hands. Once Iran is defeated, only Turkey would be a serious block. By that moment, the player would have exploited the Middle Eastern manpower.
12owjxu.zh: 然后你可以接管伊拉克并同样把它傀儡化以获取人力。伊拉克与土耳其对也门而言会是巨大的障碍。在两者中，伊拉克是较弱的一个，不仅是人口，还有一支小军队且没有海军。玩家必须在伊朗动员之前迅速出击，这一点至关重要。如果他们集结起一支强大的军队，最好且也许唯一的选择是在南伊拉克与北伊拉克的伊拉克河周边建立一条战线，并在中部放一些师以防止巴格达落入伊朗之手。一旦伊朗被击败，就只有土耳其会是严重的阻碍。到那时，玩家将已充分利用中东的人力。

3pffuy.en: The Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen, which occupied the northern portion of modern Yemen, followed an isolationist foreign policy under King Yahya Muhammad Hamid ed-Din. It formed an alliance with ⟦0⟧ in 1936, and yet it remained neutral for the duration of the war. The southern portion of modern Yemen, known as the Aden Protectorate, was under British control. Yahya's non-recognition of his kingdom's southern boundary with the British Aden Protectorate (later the People's Democratic Republic of Yemen) that had been negotiated by his Ottoman predecessors resulted in occasional clashes with the British.
3pffuy.zh: 穆塔瓦基利亚也门王国占据现代也门的北部，在国王叶海亚·穆罕默德·哈米德·丁治下奉行孤立主义外交政策。它于 1936 年与⟦0⟧结成同盟，然而在整场战争中保持中立。现代也门的南部，即亚丁保护地，处于英国控制之下。叶海亚不承认其王国与英属亚丁保护地（后来的也门人民民主共和国）之间由其奥斯曼前任谈判确立的南部边界，导致与英国偶有冲突。

iexyit.en: Small population, lack of resource as well as behind technology would represent a big problem for Yemen. In order to even have a fighting chance with Saudi Arabia, the United Kingdom must have gone to the decolonization focus branch in which Britain need to give back Aden to Yemen. By this way, Yemeni population would be slightly higher than Iraq, but more enough than Saudi Arabia. Yemen has a choice in its political branch: Manpower and fascism, political power and communism, and non-aligned status quo.
iexyit.zh: 人口稀少、缺乏资源以及科技落后对也门而言都是大问题。为了哪怕有一丝与沙特阿拉伯抗衡的机会，联合王国都必须走殖民化焦点分支，即英国需要把亚丁归还也门。这样，也门人口会略多于伊拉克，但远多于沙特阿拉伯。也门在其政治分支中有选择：人力与法西斯主义、政治点数与共产主义，以及中立现状。

1509vsp.en: One of the better option would be to increase the quality of each division. Research toward artillery and equipment would be needed. It is also optional to mechanize since there wouldn't be a lack of oil, at least for Yemeni consumption. The first target would be Saudi Arabia since conquering Oman first would overstretch Yemeni strength. After carefully pushing and defeating Saudi Arabia, it's advisable to puppet them for what manpower you can still use of them.
1509vsp.zh: 更好的选项之一是提高每个师的质量。需要朝火炮与装备方向研究。由于至少对也门的消耗而言不会缺油，机械化也是可选的。第一个目标应当是沙特阿拉伯，因为先征服阿曼会使也门的力量过度伸展。在谨慎推进并击败沙特阿拉伯之后，建议把它们傀儡化，以利用你还能用到的其人力。

1x5kq2l.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in the Middle East with a population of ⟦1⟧. Located on the Arabian Peninsula, it is bordered by ⟦2⟧ to the north and the ⟦3⟧ to the east, as well as the Aden Province to the south, ruled by the ⟦4⟧. Its terrain is mostly mountainous and one province is a desert to the northeast.
1x5kq2l.zh: ⟦0⟧是中东的一个小国，人口⟦1⟧。它位于阿拉伯半岛，北邻⟦2⟧，东邻⟦3⟧，南邻由⟦4⟧统治的亚丁省。其地形多为山地，东北部有一个省份是沙漠。

wt8ftd.en: The ⟦0⟧ owns the Yemeni core of Province of Aden to the south and The ⟦1⟧ owns the rest of the Yemeni cores of Aden in the east and Socotra in the southeast.
wt8ftd.zh: ⟦0⟧拥有南部的也门核心亚丁省，⟦1⟧拥有东部其余也门核心亚丁以及东南部的索科特拉。

ngo12y.en: As an Arab country, Yemen may form Arabia if it controls all the necessary states.
ngo12y.zh: 作为一个阿拉伯国家，如果也门控制所有必要的州，它就可以成立阿拉伯。

epgyd1.zh: 伊玛目叶海亚·穆罕默德·哈米德·丁

rlaud7.zh: 马里布 萨那 塔伊兹

1m9wt88.en: Go to the Occupied Territories tab and release yourself as Khalistan, making sure that you check “Play As” and uncheck “Release as puppet”. Put all your ⟦0⟧ onto infantry equipment and use your one available ⟦1⟧ to buy steel. Train 24-36 of the single cavalry battalion divisions and force deploy them as soon as they reach the minimum training requirement. At this point, your focuses don't really matter unless you want to keep playing after uniting the subcontinent. Use your ⟦2⟧ to immediately justify on one of your claimed states from the East India Company (by this point there should be enough world tension to allow ⟦3⟧ countries to justify). When your war goal is ready, declare on the East India Company. When close to one of their puppets with your troops, declare war on it and rush for their capital and they should capitulate instantly. Because you are at war with their overlord, you can declare war instantly. Make sure that all puppets with ⟦4⟧ starting cores are in the war before it is over, thus ensuring that they will be in the peace deal. Use your cavalry to snake for victory points. If you encounter any enemy divisions, try to go around them. After capitulating the East India Company, annex all their states in the peace deal as well as those of their puppets, and you will get the achievement. This achievement can be done by mid-1940 or earlier.
1m9wt88.zh: 前往占领区标签页，把自己作为卡利斯坦释放，务必勾选「以该身份游玩」并取消勾选「作为傀儡释放」。把你全部的⟦0⟧投入步兵装备，并用你唯一可用的⟦1⟧购买钢铁。训练 24-36 个只有单个骑兵营的师，并在它们一达到最低训练要求时立刻强制部署。到这时，你的焦点其实并不重要，除非你打算在统一次大陆之后继续游玩。用你的⟦2⟧立即对你从东印度公司获得的某个声称州制造战争目标（到这时世界紧张度应当已足以允许⟦3⟧国家制造战争目标）。当你的战争目标就绪时，对东印度公司宣战。当你的部队接近其某个傀儡时，对它宣战并直取首都，它应当会立即投降。由于你正与其宗主国交战，你可以立即宣战。务必在战争结束前让所有拥有⟦4⟧开局核心的傀儡都参战，从而确保它们会被纳入和平协议。用你的骑兵蛇形推进以夺取胜利点。如果你遇到任何敌方师，尽量绕过它们。在东印度公司投降之后，在和平协议中吞并它的所有州以及其傀儡的州，你就会获得该成就。该成就可以在 1940 年中期或更早完成。

17oeyl4.en: Play as the ⟦0⟧ and do not join any wars. With historical AI turned on, rush down the East India Company route towards Hostile Takeover. Use your research slots to only research Computing and Construction technologies. When you release yourself as Khalistan, none of the researched ⟦1⟧ technologies will be inherited, so it is important to knee-cap the ⟦2⟧ as much as possible. Build ⟦3⟧ in ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧. Improve relations with the ⟦6⟧ and do Anti-Democratic Raids (if needed) while doing Seek Initial Funding to unlock Lobby Parliament. Train your starting divisions until you have 5 ⟦7⟧. Design a new division template with a single cavalry battalion. Switch your garrison division to this new template and then delete all of your other army templates. It is important that you do this before you release any puppets, so that the puppets do not inherit your large templates.
17oeyl4.zh: 以⟦0⟧游玩，不要加入任何战争。在开启历史 AI 的情况下，沿东印度公司路线速推到「敌意收购」。用你的科研槽只研究计算与建造科技。当你把自己作为卡利斯坦释放时，已研究的⟦1⟧科技都不会被继承，所以尽可能削弱⟦2⟧很重要。在⟦3⟧⟦4⟧⟦5⟧中建造。改善与⟦6⟧的关系，并在做「寻求初始资金」以解锁「游说议会」时（如有需要）进行反民主突袭。训练你的开局师，直到你拥有 5 个⟦7⟧。设计一个只有单个骑兵营的新师编制。把你的驻军师切换到该新编制，然后删除你所有其他陆军编制。在你释放任何傀儡之前这样做很重要，这样傀儡就不会继承你那些庞大的编制。

132iths.en: As you work through the focus tree, prioritize focuses that give you ⟦0⟧ and improve your construction speed. Buy land from the ⟦1⟧, prioritizing states with ⟦2⟧. Release princely states as puppets, which when combined with Princely Autonomy will feed you a lot of factories. Move your construction of ⟦3⟧ to higher infrastructure states like ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ or ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧ when you buy them so you can build factories faster. If you have the DLC ⟦8⟧, use your ⟦9⟧ to build artillery and support equipment to sell on the International Market for extra building bonuses.
132iths.zh: 当你沿国策树推进时，优先选取给你⟦0⟧并提高建造速度的焦点。向⟦1⟧购买土地，优先选择带有⟦2⟧的州。把土邦作为傀儡释放，这与「土邦自治」结合会为你带来大量工厂。把⟦3⟧的建造移过去，建到基础设施更高的州，如⟦4⟧⟦5⟧或⟦6⟧⟦7⟧，这样你能更快建造工厂。如果你拥有⟦8⟧DLC，用你的⟦9⟧生产火炮与支援装备，在国际市场上出售以换取额外建造加成。

1hwjwwd.en: Leave the ⟦0⟧. Delete any remaining divisions and your air force. Delete the production lines of all your equipment, and then delete your equipment stockpile. Delete every single factory you own that is NOT in a core of Khalistan (⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ are only claims, not cores and you will not receive them when you release yourself). The East India Company will still have some factories from their puppets, but if you act quickly, those will not matter.
1hwjwwd.zh: 退出⟦0⟧。删除任何剩余的师与你的空军。删除你所有装备的生产线，然后删除你的装备储备。删除你所拥有的、不在卡利斯坦核心内的每一座工厂（⟦1⟧⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧⟦4⟧只是声称，不是核心，你释放自己时不会获得它们）。东印度公司仍会从其傀儡那里拥有一些工厂，但如果你动作够快，那些就不重要了。

w7onc6.en: When you get to the focus Death knell of the Raj, start building 4 ⟦0⟧ and 5 ⟦1⟧ in the northern core states of Khalistan. Because Khalistan starts on ⟦2⟧, you will need need 4 ⟦3⟧ just to have 1 available for trade. If you are lucky, the focus Join the Shadow Scheme may spawn ⟦4⟧ in those states. When those factories are built, it’s time for sabotage.
w7onc6.zh: 当你推进到「英属印度的丧钟」焦点时，开始在卡利斯坦北部核心州建造 4 座⟦0⟧与 5 座⟦1⟧。由于卡利斯坦开局位于⟦2⟧，你将需要 4 座⟦3⟧才能有 1 座可用于贸易。如果你运气好，「加入影子计划」焦点可能在这些州生成⟦4⟧。当那些工厂建成后，就是搞破坏的时候了。

1jaz7fc.en: After completing Take Over Administrative Rights, buy the Silent Workhorse advisor. Save your ⟦0⟧ until ⟦1⟧ declares war on ⟦2⟧, then send an attaché to ⟦3⟧ and get ⟦4⟧. After this point, use your ⟦5⟧ for buying land, the Captain of Industry advisor, and Well-Mannered Imam advisor.
1jaz7fc.zh: 在完成「接管行政权」之后，购买「沉默的苦工」顾问。把⟦0⟧存起来，直到⟦1⟧对⟦2⟧宣战，然后向⟦3⟧派出武官并获得⟦4⟧。此后，把你的⟦5⟧用于购买土地、「工业巨头」顾问与「彬彬有礼的伊玛目」顾问。

zf1zb0.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ is not required. If playing as the ⟦3⟧, you must also be independent in order to release other countries.
zf1zb0.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧不是必需的。如果以⟦3⟧游玩，你为了释放其他国家还必须保持独立。

ey9tqn.en: As Khalistan, control all of the starting ⟦0⟧ states.
ey9tqn.zh: 作为卡利斯坦，控制所有开局⟦0⟧州。

wxqvc7.en: Sell all your equipment on the international market.
wxqvc7.zh: 在国际市场上出售你所有的装备。

14g5vr8.en: Option A: Build up ⟦0⟧ and supply on the former ⟦1⟧ / ⟦2⟧ and move your fleet there. Increase your army to 48 divisions and include some anti-air and perhaps an artilery piece in the template (besides the support company). Move your army to the area you build up and plan naval invasion(s) of the ⟦3⟧ home islands. Justify on ⟦4⟧ or their puppets (doesn't really matter guarantees are void since you are in the Axis). The fleet you stole from the British should be enough for the invasion to launch. Remember to get enough warscore (surround some ports but don't take them and keep killing off ⟦5⟧ troops, etc). Once you have enough war score and they have capped make sure that no independent ⟦6⟧ is left in the peace deal. Don't worry about the Chinese AI, they only make moves to annex land.
14g5vr8.zh: 方案 A：在前⟦0⟧上建设并供应，位于前⟦1⟧/⟦2⟧，并把你的舰队调往那里。把你的陆军扩充到 48 个师，并在编制中加入一些防空，也许再加一门火炮（除支援连之外）。把你的陆军调往你建设的区域，并规划对⟦3⟧本土的海军登陆。对⟦4⟧或其傀儡制造战争目标（其实并不重要，保障是无效的，因为你身处轴心国）。你从英国抢来的舰队应当足以发动入侵。记得获取足够的战争分数（包围一些港口但不占领它们，并持续消灭⟦5⟧部队等等）。一旦你拥有足够的战争分数且它们已投降，务必确保在和平协议中不留下任何独立的⟦6⟧。不必担心中国 AI，它们只会采取吞并土地的举动。

1me9u8.en: Option B: Have around 30 to 40 decent divisions and 30 - 40 crappy divisions (forming the Kalmar Union should provide enough manpower). Justify on ⟦0⟧ and once you declare war ⟦1⟧ will accept your request for military access. Move your army to ⟦2⟧ and cover a large part of the victory points. You don't want to cap ⟦3⟧ immediately because your war score will be to low and a small ⟦4⟧ is likely to remain alive. Once your army is in position simply wait for ⟦5⟧ to take the focus to invite ⟦6⟧ and justify on them. When ⟦7⟧ calls in ⟦8⟧ your army takes most of the country. Remember to do either the port of capital strategy for increased war score. When you're ready capitulate ⟦9⟧ and make sure that no independent ⟦10⟧ remains.
1me9u8.zh: 方案 B：拥有大约 30 到 40 个像样的师与 30 - 40 个蹩脚的师（成立卡尔马联盟应当能提供足够人力）。对⟦0⟧制造战争目标，一旦你宣战，⟦1⟧就会接受你的军事通行权请求。把你的陆军调往⟦2⟧并覆盖大部分胜利点。你不希望立刻让⟦3⟧投降，因为你的战争分数会太低，而一个小的⟦4⟧很可能仍然存活。一旦你的陆军就位，只需等待⟦5⟧选取那个焦点以邀请⟦6⟧，并对它们制造战争目标。当⟦7⟧召唤⟦8⟧时，你的陆军就会占领该国大部分。记得采用港口或首都策略以提高战争分数。当你准备好时，迫使⟦9⟧投降，并确保不留下任何独立的⟦10⟧。

5mk8s4.en: You will hopefully have the most warscore of any country by the time ⟦0⟧ capitulates. Puppet mainland ⟦1⟧ and Okinawa. ⟦2⟧ Do NOT let the Allies puppet or change the government any province of ⟦3⟧. Contest every province that they attempt to do so. ⟦4⟧
5mk8s4.zh: 当⟦0⟧投降时，希望你已拥有所有国家中最高的战争分数。把大陆⟦1⟧与冲绳傀儡化。⟦2⟧ 绝对不要让同盟国把⟦3⟧的任何省份傀儡化或更改政府。对它们试图这样做的每个省份都加以争夺。⟦4⟧

or4rrf.en: Send your troops to mainland ⟦0⟧ to hold the line and push if you are able. The goal is to accumulate as much warscore as possible. ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ biggest problem is manpower so try your best to keep your casualties minimal at this stage.
or4rrf.zh: 把你的部队派往大陆⟦0⟧守住阵线，如果能够就推进。目标是尽可能多地积累战争分数。⟦1⟧⟦2⟧最大的问题是人力，所以在这个阶段尽量把你自己的伤亡保持在最低。

3mh7ql.en: Once Japan has been successfully pushed off of mainland ⟦0⟧, immediately begin planning a naval invasion from Pusan to the ⟦1⟧ port North of Kyoto and Osaka. (This should be relatively unguarded compared to the major cities.)
3mh7ql.zh: 一旦日本被成功赶出大陆⟦0⟧，立即开始规划从釜山向京都与大阪以北的⟦1⟧港口发动海军登陆。（与主要城市相比，那里应当相对无人防守。）

j2d2di.en: Bring your fleet to Pusan, divide them into multiple task forces, and begin your invasion. ⟦0⟧ AI is not very good at defending its mainland in the early & midgame so it should be easy once you have the naval power to invade.
j2d2di.zh: 把你的舰队带到釜山，把它们分成多个特遣舰队，并开始你的入侵。⟦0⟧AI 在游戏前期与中期不太擅长防守其本土，所以一旦你拥有发动入侵的海军力量，这应当很容易。

15mjsv3.en: ⟦0⟧ will eventually go to war with the United States. Once this happens, begin pushing hard. ⟦1⟧ will take troops away from ⟦2⟧ to fight the Americans which should allow you to push them off of the Chinese mainland.
15mjsv3.zh: ⟦0⟧最终会与美国开战。一旦这发生，就开始大力推进。⟦1⟧会从⟦2⟧抽走部队去对抗美国人，这应当能让你把他们赶出中国大陆。

1sfaenl.en: Rush the monarchist focus path. Puppet and integrate ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ and Restore the Kalmar Union. ⟦3⟧ Do NOT puppet ⟦4⟧ yet nor invade the Baltics as this ⟦5⟧ lead to war with the ⟦6⟧!
1sfaenl.zh: 速推君主制焦点路线。把⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧傀儡化并整合，并恢复卡尔马联盟。⟦3⟧ 暂时不要傀儡化⟦4⟧，也不要入侵波罗的海国家，因为这会⟦5⟧导致与⟦6⟧开战！

ctkb39.en: Once World Tension reaches 40%, begin justifying on ⟦0⟧. Immediately declare war when it is finished and join the Chinese United Front.
ctkb39.zh: 一旦世界紧张度达到 40%，开始对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。它一完成就立即宣战，并加入中国统一战线。

17r4xfa.en: After the Winter War resolves between the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, take the focuses to puppet and integrate ⟦2⟧. Proclaim Nordic Unity.
17r4xfa.zh: 在⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧之间的冬季战争结束后，选取把⟦2⟧傀儡化并整合的焦点。宣告北欧统一。

1avsy04.en: If you haven't already, begin switching your industry from building military factories to building naval dockyards.
1avsy04.zh: 如果你还没做，开始把你的工业从建造军用工厂转为建造海军船坞。

y3nx5k.en: If the Allies puppet or change the government of any province in ⟦0⟧ then you will not get the achievement.
y3nx5k.zh: 如果同盟国傀儡化了⟦0⟧的任何省份或更改了其政府，你就不会获得该成就。

re7ay.en: Support the Axis during as they invade the ⟦0⟧. This should be no problem without the Allies as a threat.
re7ay.zh: 在轴心国入侵⟦0⟧时支持它们。在同盟国不构成威胁的情况下，这应当没有问题。

1rxf1gp.en: If you also want to do the Sapmi united by fire achievement, grab the Kola peninsula as well.
1rxf1gp.zh: 如果你还想完成「以火统一的萨米」成就，顺便拿下科拉半岛。

9hvt3d.en: ⟦0⟧ should have the highest score, but usually only takes land instead of puppeting it.
9hvt3d.zh: ⟦0⟧应当拥有最高分数，但通常只会夺取土地而不傀儡化。

1jdnve5.en: Join the war when you're ready to invade from Vladivostok by either sea or paradrop.
1jdnve5.zh: 当你准备好从符拉迪沃斯托克经海路或伞降发动入侵时加入战争。

14a8p22.en: ⟦0⟧ should declare on Germany/ ⟦1⟧ soon over claims on ⟦2⟧ and the ⟦3⟧.
14a8p22.zh: ⟦0⟧应当很快就会对德国/⟦1⟧宣战，出于对⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧的声称。

1qgczlf.en: In the peace deal take Vladivostok or puppet the Far Eastern Republic.
1qgczlf.zh: 在和平协议中夺取符拉迪沃斯托克或傀儡化远东共和国。

1bdkb4p.en: Generate as much warscore as possible to get at least a small puppet.
1bdkb4p.zh: 尽可能多地积累战争分数，以至少获得一个小傀儡。

1wve9z3.en: Contest every attempt e.g. by the USA to puppet them.
1wve9z3.zh: 对每一次傀儡化尝试（例如美国发起的）都加以争夺。

698nhs.en: Following up on Method 1 or 2 from the ⟦0⟧ strategy:
698nhs.zh: 在⟦0⟧策略的方法 1 或 2 之后继续：

1uktbtc.en: Now, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a fascist advisor. Yes, I know, going fascist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for fascist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent fascist support, so hold a referendum to become Fascist Khorasan. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids. Otherwise, if your manpower is still an issue you can go communist to get to the weekly manpower army experience.
1uktbtc.zh: 现在，你首先应当做的是选取第一个政治焦点，它会给你 120 政治点数，加上你已经积累的 70。用它聘用一位法西斯顾问。是的，我知道，走法西斯基本上是每个小国的首选策略，但如果它有效，那就是有效。在你等待法西斯支持度上升的同时，选取一些工业焦点以获得一些免费工厂。先拿两座免费民用工厂，然后拿三座军用工厂。到这时你的法西斯支持度应当已超过百分之五十，所以举行公投以成为法西斯呼罗珊。用你多余的政治点数实行战争经济，如果还有多余的，就选取「改善工人条件」或反共/民主突袭。否则，如果你的人力仍是问题，你可以转为共产主义以获得每周陆军人力的陆军经验。

1ghovf0.en: By the 20th century, Khorasan was firmly a province of Iran, divided into several administrative regions. Its capital was Mashhad, a major religious and cultural center, especially for Shi’a Islam. During WWII, its northeastern location made it strategically important for supply routes, especially for the Allies moving supplies to the USSR through Iran (the so-called Persian Corridor). When Britain and the USSR invaded Iran to secure oil and supply lines, northeastern Iran (including Khorasan) was relatively lightly affected compared to the south, but its location made it part of the larger strategic corridor.
1ghovf0.zh: 到 20 世纪，呼罗珊已牢固地是伊朗的一个省份，划分为若干行政区域。其首都是马什哈德，一个主要的宗教与文化中心，尤其对什叶派伊斯兰而言。二战期间，其东北部位置使其在补给路线上具有战略重要性，尤其是对经伊朗向苏联运送补给的同盟国而言（即所谓的「波斯走廊」）。当英国与苏联入侵伊朗以确保石油与补给线时，伊朗东北部（包括呼罗珊）受到的影响相对南部较轻，但其位置使其成为更大战略走廊的一部分。

13ba7le.en: At this point, you should've flipped fascist already, so start justifying on Afghanistan. With the same logic and console commands if you have released yourself from Afghanistan's clutches. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Should you declare on Iran, Iraq, or god forbid, British Raj and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources and sea access for marine trade.
13ba7le.zh: 到这时，你应当已经转为法西斯了，所以开始对阿富汗制造战争目标。如果你已经从阿富汗的掌控中释放了自己，就用同样的逻辑与控制台命令。同时开始做政治焦点。制作一个只有一个骑兵单位的编制，并大量生产。到这时你也应当拥有相当多的政治点数，所以采取一些提高稳定度的决议。如果你对伊朗、伊拉克，或者——但愿不要——对英属印度宣战并战胜它们，每一场都能给你足够的扩张空间，以及获取一些宝贵资源与海上贸易通道的机会。

1j7ubdg.en: Khorasan doesn't possess a tag of its own. Instead it comes with a civil war tag, and dependent by Afghan national focus. Although by console commands, all you have to do is to occupy the three Khorasani cores with console commands. And with console commands again take the "Establish Khorasan Buffer State" focus that allegedly releases them as a puppet state. Khorasan starts with 1.3M core population but, a puppet state of Afghanistan. And with two civilian factories.
1j7ubdg.zh: 呼罗珊并不拥有自己的 tag。它反而自带一个内战 tag，并依赖阿富汗的国策。不过，通过控制台命令，你所需要做的就是占领三个呼罗珊核心。再用控制台命令采取「建立呼罗珊缓冲国」焦点，该焦点据称会把它们作为傀儡国释放。呼罗珊开局拥有 130 万核心人口，但它是阿富汗的傀儡国。并且拥有两座民用工厂。

h11exr.en: By now you should have a total of 9 or 10 factories- 7 civilian and 3 military. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.
h11exr.zh: 到这时你应当总共拥有 9 或 10 座工厂——7 座民用与 3 座军用。你的一座民用工厂将用于消费品，所以用剩下那座来建造更多民用工厂，或换取一些钢。用你 3 座军用工厂中的一座生产火炮，另 2 座生产枪械。等你获得更多军用工厂后，也安排一些工厂生产支援装备。

191gtqb.en: Khorasan starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
191gtqb.zh: 呼罗珊开局拥有 2 个科研槽，不过它可以通过通用国策树获得最多 3 个额外科研槽。作为可释放国家，被释放时它会继承释放国已经研究过的全部科技。

1mlez4j.en: Tip: If you let independent Khorasan be controlled by an AI, it will annex Iran by referendum if they share the same ideology. Khorasan that way will gain additional cores and as well as a bigger army, and inheriting claims from Iran itself.
1mlez4j.zh: 提示：如果你让独立的呼罗珊由 AI 控制，只要它们意识形态相同，它就会通过公投吞并伊朗。这样呼罗珊将获得额外核心以及一支更大的军队，并继承伊朗本身的宣称。

1tk3nql.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country that can be created by ⟦1⟧ via decision after completing the Establish Khorasan Buffer State national focus, if Afghanistan controls and occupies the Khorasan states. It starts as a puppet state.
1tk3nql.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个可释放国家，可以在完成「建立呼罗珊缓冲国」国策后由⟦1⟧通过决议创建，前提是阿富汗控制并占领呼罗珊各州。它开局为傀儡国。

1xanuwf.en: ⟦0⟧ controls and cores ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ if it is nation released by the Kingdom of Afghanistan.
1xanuwf.zh: 如果它是由阿富汗王国释放的国家，⟦0⟧会控制并把⟦1⟧⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧⟦4⟧与⟦5⟧⟦6⟧设为核心。

13dt58u.en: When released, Khorasan will start as a Non Aligned nation that does not have elections upon release.
13dt58u.zh: 被释放时，呼罗珊将作为一个中立国家开局，被释放时不举行选举。

ktp9dz.en: Khorasan is technically a civil war tag of ⟦0⟧, it has the same political parties:
ktp9dz.zh: 呼罗珊在技术上属于⟦0⟧的内战 tag，它拥有相同的政党：

1cif7dx.en: El Salvador had a fascist dictatorship ruled by Maximiliano Hernandez Martínez since 1931 which repressed minorities in his country such as Chinese, Indian and black peoples among other groups. In 1932 there was a revolt done by indigenous peoples that were culturally repressed. The uprising failed and that group would continue suffering even more over time. El Salvador was neutral during the first world war. In the 1936 Olympic games, El Salvador didn't compete because the Olympic team wasn't recognized by the committee of the Olympic games until 1938. In the 1938 football (or soccer) world cup, El Salvador didn't participate. Before the United States of America entered the second world war, El Salvador was improving relations with all the fascist countries in the world. Soon after the American declaration of war on the Axis powers, El Salvador has joined the Allies. El Salvador has sent money and equipment to the Allied powers, also supplying the USA with manpower on a promise of American citizenship should they survive. Salvadoran troops have supported American troops during the D-day landings. At the time, El Salvador based its economy around farming, primarily in the elements of coffee, sugar, and corn.
1cif7dx.zh: 萨尔瓦多自 1931 年起由马克西米利亚诺·埃尔南德斯·马丁内斯实行法西斯独裁统治，他镇压了国内华人、印第安人与黑人等少数群体。1932 年，文化上受压迫的原住民发动了一场起义。起义失败，该群体此后遭受的苦难愈发加重。萨尔瓦多在第一次世界大战期间保持中立。在 1936 年奥运会上，萨尔瓦多没有参赛，因为其奥运代表队直到 1938 年才获得奥委会承认。在 1938 年足球世界杯上，萨尔瓦多没有参加。在美利坚合众国加入第二次世界大战之前，萨尔瓦多一直在改善与世界上所有法西斯国家的关系。在美国对轴心国宣战后不久，萨尔瓦多加入了同盟国。萨尔瓦多向同盟国提供了资金与装备，还向美国提供人力，以换取若幸存则获得美国公民身份的承诺。萨尔瓦多部队在诺曼底登陆期间支援了美军。当时，萨尔瓦多的经济以农业为基础，主要种植咖啡、甘蔗与玉米。

1lt73zk.en: The largest threat for united Central America is Mexico, as its focus tree allows to declare war on Central American countries. However, if the army is well-led, it can be possible to refute the Mexican attacks and win the war. Either puppeting Mexico, allowing a larger army, or annexing it, allowing access to the state resources, are possible options. Be sure to integrate the Republic of Yucatán for extra manpower and more space to build factories. The USA can still easily overpower the most skilled Central American army at this point, so justifying on the US should be avoided. Focus instead on South America, which naturally requires a navy. Notably with Panama which as a starter, it can be integrated in the United States of Central America. With South America brought under the heel, notably Brazil and Argentina, Central America will have decent industry and manpower, allowing for a more powerful airforce and army. If avoiding a war with the USA, a large navy can be the main focus.
1lt73zk.zh: 统一中美洲最大的威胁是墨西哥，因为其国策树允许对中美洲国家宣战。不过，如果军队指挥得当，就有可能击退墨西哥的进攻并赢得战争。把墨西哥傀儡化以获得更大军队，或吞并它以获取其州资源，都是可行的选项。务必整合尤卡坦共和国以获得额外人力与更多建造工厂的空间。此时美国仍能轻易压制最精锐的中美洲军队，所以应避免对美国制造战争目标。改为专注南美，这自然需要一支海军。尤其是巴拿马，作为开局者，它可以被整合进中美洲合众国。在南美被降服之后，尤其是巴西与阿根廷，中美洲将拥有不错的工业与人力，从而能够建立更强大的空军与陆军。如果避免与美国开战，一支庞大的海军可以成为主要重点。

3loqu.en: Recommended starting moves are focusing on Political Effort, justifying a wargoal on Guatemala in the meantime. Afterwards, follow the generic fascist tree for a much-needed manpower boost. After the justification on Guatemala finishes, the next choice is Honduras. After annexing Nicaragua and Costa Rica, Central America can be formed, providing cores on conquered land, making the country's power base comparable to Nepal.
3loqu.zh: 推荐的起手动作是专注「政治努力」，同时在此期间对危地马拉制造战争目标。之后沿通用法西斯树走下去，以获得急需的人力提升。对危地马拉的战争目标完成后，下一个目标选择洪都拉斯。在吞并尼加拉瓜与哥斯达黎加之后，就可以成立中美洲，从而在被征服的土地上获得核心，使该国的实力基础可与尼泊尔相比。

1y3ltry.en: Although the country has insignificant manpower, industry, and resources, it is the only fascist country and second most populous in Central America, as well as having a well-equipped army. Thus, it's the recommended choice to form the Central American Union.
1y3ltry.zh: 尽管该国的人力、工业与资源微不足道，但它是中美洲唯一的法西斯国家、人口第二多，并且拥有一支装备良好的军队。因此，它是成立中美洲联盟的推荐选择。

8c5tuo.en: El Salvador may form the United States of Central America if it controls all other independent Central American countries excluding ⟦0⟧. Doing so will give it cores on the required territories plus British Honduras (311).
8c5tuo.zh: 如果萨尔瓦多控制了除⟦0⟧之外所有其他独立的中美洲国家，它就可以成立中美洲合众国。这样做会使它在所需领土以及英属洪都拉斯（311）上获得核心。

1f4hear.en: ⟦0⟧ owns 1 state. Which shares it with Nahua Nation if it is released by ⟦1⟧ as a puppet or by custom game difficulty colonization status.
1f4hear.zh: ⟦0⟧拥有 1 个州。如果它被⟦1⟧作为傀儡释放，或按自定义游戏难度的殖民状态释放，该州会与纳瓦民族共享。

1igabdi.en: ⟦0⟧ is a small country in Central America with a population of ⟦1⟧. It is bordered by ⟦2⟧ to the north and ⟦3⟧ to the west.
1igabdi.zh: ⟦0⟧是中美洲的一个小国，人口⟦1⟧。它北邻⟦2⟧，西邻⟦3⟧。

hls9o1.en: ⟦0⟧ starts as ⟦1⟧ with elections every 4 years. Next election is in January 1939.
hls9o1.zh: ⟦0⟧开局为⟦1⟧，每 4 年举行一次选举。下一次选举在 1939 年 1 月。

v3ad1h.en: At the start of HOI4 in 1936 Venezuela is under the rule of President Eleazar López Contreras who was a former general under the previous dictator who had died in 1935. During these initial years of President Contreras rule, his focus was using the authoritarian system of government he inherited to force through new bills to develop the infrastructure of the nation as well as drafting a new constitution which would both start a process of Democratization of the government but also ban Communism in the country. Once World War Two started in 1939, Venezuela's primary focus became the protection of its oil industry from possible sabotage and to exploit the need for oil to increase its economy. Due to the fact the nation declared its neutrality in 1939 it became a notable nation in regards to its role to continue to sell oil to ⟦0⟧, Germany, and ⟦1⟧. It was this very reason however that also drew the attention of The ⟦2⟧ who would impose a blockade which caused all trade to Germany to cease. During this economic boom while Venezuela would sell oil to both the Axis and Allies, the nation would take the opportunity to finance the modernization of its military by purchasing aircraft from the ⟦3⟧ and vessels for its navy from ⟦4⟧. Under intense pressure from the Allies, Venezuela would break off relations with the Axis in 1941 after which several Venezuelan freighters would be sunk by U-boats in the Caribbean. In addition Venezuela would grant the Allies full access to its airfields and harbors in order to patrol against further U-boat attacks.
v3ad1h.zh: 1936 年 HOI4 开局时，委内瑞拉处于总统埃莱亚萨尔·洛佩斯·孔特雷拉斯统治之下，他是 1935 年去世的前独裁者手下的一名前将军。在孔特雷拉斯总统统治的最初几年，他的重点是利用他继承下来的威权政府体制强行通过新法案以发展国家基础设施，并起草一部新宪法——这既会开启政府民主化的进程，也会在该国禁止共产主义。1939 年第二次世界大战开始后，委内瑞拉的主要重点转为保护其石油工业免遭可能的破坏，并利用对石油的需求来提振其经济。由于该国在 1939 年宣布中立，它在继续向⟦0⟧、德国与⟦1⟧出售石油方面的角色使其成为一个引人注目的国家。然而正是这一点也引起了⟦2⟧的注意，后者实施了封锁，导致所有对德贸易中断。在这场经济繁荣期间，委内瑞拉一边向轴心国与同盟国出售石油，一边抓住机会为其军队现代化提供资金，从⟦3⟧购买飞机，从⟦4⟧为其海军购买舰船。在同盟国的巨大压力下，委内瑞拉于 1941 年与轴心国断绝关系，此后数艘委内瑞拉货船在加勒比海被 U 艇击沉。此外，委内瑞拉还给予同盟国对其机场与港口的完全使用权，以便巡逻防范进一步的 U 艇袭击。

bxyujg.en: Venezuela starts in a very weak position in 1936, but the advantage that it has compared to its neighbours, is that is fascist and can justify wargoals against the countries that hold the lands of the former Gran Colombia without any restrictions. Venezuela has a very weak army but it can compensate this via use of paratroopers, which will ease the conquering of the colombian countries. It is highly recommendable to send attaches to the Spanish civil war, which will help you develop army doctrines and edition of templates. It is advised to not join any faction before conquering all of Gran Colombia's territories because the other countries will more likely join a faction and more troops will fill the frontlines. Try to befriend the fascist powers of El Salvador, The Dominican Republic and the major fascist countries. If allied with Peru, you can easily take over Brazil.
bxyujg.zh: 委内瑞拉在 1936 年开局处境非常弱，但与邻国相比它拥有的优势是：它是法西斯国家，可以在没有任何限制的情况下对占据前大哥伦比亚领土的国家制造战争目标。委内瑞拉的军队非常弱，但它可以通过使用伞兵来弥补，这会减轻征服哥伦比亚诸国的难度。非常建议向西班牙内战派出武官，这会有助于你发展陆军学说并编辑编制。建议在征服大哥伦比亚全部领土之前不要加入任何阵营，因为其他国家会更可能加入某个阵营，届时会有更多部队填满前线。试着与萨尔瓦多、多米尼加共和国这些法西斯国家以及主要法西斯国家交好。如果与秘鲁结盟，你就能轻易接管巴西。

1y8iwzn.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in South America with a population of ⟦1⟧. It is bordered by ⟦2⟧ to the west, ⟦3⟧ to the south and ⟦4⟧ to the east. Venezuela is also bordered by the ⟦5⟧ and the ⟦6⟧ via strait crossing in the north. It is mountainous in the north and plains and jungle in the south.
1y8iwzn.zh: ⟦0⟧是南美的一个小国，人口⟦1⟧。它西邻⟦2⟧，南邻⟦3⟧，东邻⟦4⟧。委内瑞拉还通过北部的海峡通道与⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧相邻。其北部为山地，南部为平原与丛林。

x0oay.en: Historically Venezuela was one of the nations that made up the confederation of Gran Colombia. However upset with increasing centralization of the government and lack of autonomy for the confederation member nations, Venezuela would secede in 1830.
x0oay.zh: 历史上委内瑞拉是构成大哥伦比亚联邦的国家之一。然而由于对政府日益集权以及联邦成员国缺乏自治感到不满，委内瑞拉于 1830 年退出。

tos2y5.en: ⟦0⟧ doesn't have an air force in 1936. But in 1939, it has a small air force composed of a single wing of 12 C.32 fighters.
tos2y5.zh: ⟦0⟧在 1936 年没有空军。但在 1939 年，它拥有一支小型空军，由单个 12 架 C.32 战斗机的航空队组成。

1s824ir.en: In February of 1945 Venezuela would declare war on the Axis Powers.
1s824ir.zh: 1945 年 2 月，委内瑞拉对轴心国宣战。

nl5bsv.zh: 左翼国际 委内瑞拉

1nzbuii.en: From this point you can capitulate the UK quickly as the event to overthrow Hitler can happen within 6 months and you want to be at peace before this. You can additionally justify war goals to increase the land you can take in the UK peace deal to include anyone else you want in Europe. Once at peace, it is best to change your army to a 1 battalion anti-air division to weaken the enemy in the coming civil war. When the ⟦0⟧ event triggers, select the second option "Perhaps his removal would be for the best". The next event should fire that the conspiracy succeeded, at which point you can select Eva Braun in the 4th option to lead the country. ⟦1⟧ will start a civil war, but this should be trivial to win as you have changed the templates. Change your army back to a proper template or a small cavalry template to take victory points faster. You can call in other Axis members to assist you in the civil war.
1nzbuii.zh: 从这时起你可以迅速迫使英国投降，因为推翻希特勒的事件可能在 6 个月内发生，而你想在这之前处于和平状态。你还可以额外制造战争目标，以增加你在英国和平协议中能夺取的土地，把你在欧洲想要的任何其他国家也纳入其中。一旦处于和平，最好把你的军队改为 1 个营的防空师，以便在即将到来的内战中削弱敌人。当⟦0⟧事件触发时，选取第二个选项「也许他的移除是最好的结果」。下一个事件应当会触发阴谋成功，此时你可以在第 4 个选项中选取爱娃·布劳恩来领导这个国家。⟦1⟧会发动内战，但由于你已更改编制，这应当很容易获胜。把你的军队改回正规编制或一个小编制骑兵模板，以便更快夺取胜利点。你可以召唤其他轴心国成员在内战中协助你。

j5oaqy.en: Select the option to send Victoria Louise as liaison, which will prompt the event ⟦0⟧ which makes Victoria the Kaiserin and leader of your country. From that point do what you can to invade the USA, possibly by taking the Expand Pacific Holdings focus to take out ⟦1⟧, which will give staging grounds around the USA for future invasions (by capitulating France, you get three islands in the Caribbean and a tiny island off the coast of Canada.) You should be guaranteed by the UK so you can also justify on France directly. Don't forget to take French navy when you capitulate them (it's twice the size of your own, and will be a lot of help when dealing with the U.S. navy.) You can also easily take out Netherlands, getting even more navy and one more Caribbean island.
j5oaqy.zh: 选取派遣维多利亚·路易丝作为联络官的选项，这会触发事件⟦0⟧，使维多利亚成为女皇与你的国家领袖。从那时起尽你所能入侵美国，可能通过选取「扩大太平洋属地」焦点来消灭⟦1⟧，这会为你提供美国周边的集结地以便未来入侵（通过迫使法国投降，你会在加勒比获得三座岛屿以及加拿大海岸外的一座小岛）。你应当会被英国保障，所以你也可以直接对法国制造战争目标。别忘了在迫使它们投降时夺取法国海军（它的规模是你自己的两倍，在处理美国海军时会大有帮助）。你也可以轻易消灭荷兰，获得更多海军以及又一座加勒比岛屿。

uxugyr.en: Once you finish the civil war, take everything including the navy and you are then set to invade the USA (using Canada as a staging ground). You should be able to declare war before ⟦0⟧ attacks the USA, which should mean they haven't built up much of an army, and you have the combined fleets of all conquered nations from the Allies. Make a collaboration government so you don't have to walk troops all the way across the USA. Once finished, you can decide to annex or puppet them, and take their navy if you are going for anything else in the run.
uxugyr.zh: 一旦你结束内战，拿走一切包括海军，然后你就准备好入侵美国了（以加拿大作为集结地）。你应当能够在⟦0⟧攻击美国之前宣战，这应当意味着它们尚未建立起多少军队，而你拥有从同盟国征服来的所有国家的联合舰队。建立一个合作政府，这样你就不必让部队一路横穿美国。完成后，你可以决定吞并或傀儡化它们，如果你在这局里还想要别的什么，就夺取它们的海军。

v63sk3.en: Follow the HRE (Holy Roman Empire) strategy. Start and win the German Civil War. Make sure the Hindenburg survives by taking the ⟦0⟧ decision and go down the path to return the Kaiser. The ⟦1⟧ needs to block the return of the Kaiser event, which can be achieved by making your army smaller than the Dutch army (you can simply delete all army units), then select the option to make Wilhelm III your leader.
v63sk3.zh: 遵循神圣罗马帝国（HRE）策略。开始并赢得德国内战。通过采取⟦0⟧决议确保兴登堡存活，并沿通往迎回皇帝的道路走下去。⟦1⟧需要阻止皇帝回归事件，这可以通过让你的军队比荷兰军队更小来实现（你可以直接删除所有陆军单位），然后选取让威廉三世成为你领袖的选项。

u2c6sa.en: For ⟦0⟧, justify a war goal on them while at war with the Allies so they will pick up a guarantee. Declare war but don't push, then take the Reassert Eastern Claims focus. Being in the Allies they will refuse handing over Memel and this will be the first blunder. You can take them out once they refuse.
u2c6sa.zh: 对于⟦0⟧，在与同盟国交战期间对它们制造战争目标，这样它们就会获得一份保障。宣战但不要推进，然后选取「重申东部声称」焦点。由于身处同盟国，它们会拒绝交出梅梅尔，这将是第一次失误。一旦它们拒绝，你就可以消灭它们。

12go0tx.en: For ⟦0⟧, take the Demand Sudetenland focus and justify a war goal which should only take 10 days due to being at war with the Allies, and they should be guaranteed by the UK. Once the focus finishes, they should refuse to hand over the land which will be the second blunder.
12go0tx.zh: 对于⟦0⟧，选取「索要苏台德」焦点并制造战争目标，由于正与同盟国交战，这应当只需 10 天，而且它们应当会被英国保障。一旦焦点完成，它们应当会拒绝交出土地，这将是第二次失误。

5rzbql.en: Go through the historical ⟦0⟧ path but you need to trigger 2 blunders with Hitler as leader. These blunders are the claim on Memel and Demand Sudetenland focuses. It is best to early rush the Allies so you have ⟦1⟧ capitulated and a landing already established in the UK.
5rzbql.zh: 沿历史⟦0⟧路线走，但你需要以希特勒为领袖触发 2 次失误。这些失误就是对梅梅尔的声称与「索要苏台德」焦点。最好提前速攻同盟国，这样你就能迫使⟦1⟧投降，并在英国建立起一个登陆场。

o9a3x7.en: As Germany with a female leader either annex the USA, including Alaska and Hawaii or have an American puppet that owns all the American starting states, including Alaska and Hawaii.
o9a3x7.zh: 作为拥有女性领袖的德国，要么吞并美国（包括阿拉斯加与夏威夷），要么拥有一个占领美国全部开局州（包括阿拉斯加与夏威夷）的美国傀儡。

no8xnd.en: Reinstate Prince Wilhelm's Right of Succession
no8xnd.zh: 恢复威廉亲王的继承权

1b9soql.en: By the start of HOI4 in 1936, Guatemala is under the rule of the general turned dictator President Jorge Ubico. In the Pre-war years the nation maintained overall very positive relations with Germany due in large part to the sizable German immigrant population controlling many of the most productive plantations in the country and President Ubico comparing himself to Adolf Hitler. So strong were relations that the German Navy would make port calls and make Guatemala City the main distribution hub of Nazi propaganda in the Central American region. As such during the opening stages of World War Two the country pursued a policy of neutrality though under pressure from the ⟦0⟧ this would change in 1941 when like its neighboring Central American nations it declared war on the Axis Powers. During the war the President Ubico attempted to keep Guatemalan involvement in the conflict limited though he would allow an allied airbase to be constructed in the country, deport several hundred German immigrants to the United States for internment, and opportunistically seize German owned plantations. In 1944 there would be a popular democratic revolution against President Ubico which lead to his overthrow and the installment of Juan José Arévalo as Guatemala's first democratically elected president.
1b9soql.zh: 到 1936 年 HOI4 开局时，危地马拉处于由将军转变为独裁者的总统豪尔赫·乌维科统治之下。在战前年代，该国与德国整体保持着非常良好的关系，这在很大程度上是因为规模可观的德国移民群体控制着该国许多产量最高的种植园，而且乌维科总统把自己比作阿道夫·希特勒。关系之紧密以至于德国海军会进行港口访问，并把危地马拉城设为纳粹宣传在中美洲地区的主要分发中心。因此，在第二次世界大战的开局阶段，该国奉行中立政策，不过在⟦0⟧的压力下，这一政策在 1941 年发生变化，它与相邻的中美洲国家一样对轴心国宣战。战争期间，乌维科总统试图限制危地马拉卷入冲突的程度，不过他允许在该国修建一座同盟国空军基地，把数百名德国移民驱逐到美国拘留，并趁机夺取德资种植园。1944 年，一场针对乌维科总统的民众民主革命导致他被推翻，并让胡安·何塞·阿雷瓦洛就任危地马拉第一位民选总统。

1t2175j.en: Guatemala was historically the nation that pushed most strongly for the reunification of Central American nations back into the United States of Central America. Inspired by the unification of Germany and the power that it became in Europe, President Justo Rufino Barrios with the support of ⟦0⟧ would launch a war of reunification against ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ in 1885. However less than a month later President Barrios would die on the battlefield during the invasion of El Salvador at the Battle of Chalchuapa which would lead to both an end of the war and Guatemala's dream of leading a united Central America.
1t2175j.zh: 历史上危地马拉是最强烈推动中美洲国家重新统一为中美洲合众国的国家。受德国统一及其在欧洲崛起为强国的启发，总统胡斯托·鲁菲诺·巴里奥斯在⟦0⟧的支持下，于 1885 年对⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧与⟦3⟧发动了一场统一战争。然而不到一个月后，巴里奥斯总统就在入侵萨尔瓦多的查尔丘阿帕战役中阵亡，这既终结了战争，也终结了危地马拉领导统一中美洲的梦想。

81rdsg.en: Recommended starting moves are focusing on Political Effort, justifying a wargoal on other southern neighboring countries in the meantime. Afterwards, follow the generic fascist/communist tree for a much-needed manpower boost. After the justification on Guatemala finishes, the next choice is Honduras. After annexing, Honduras, El Salvador Nicaragua and Costa Rica, Central America can be formed, providing cores on conquered land, making the country's power base comparable to Nepal.
81rdsg.zh: 推荐的起手动作是专注「政治努力」，同时在此期间对南方其他邻国制造战争目标。之后沿通用法西斯/共产主义树走下去，以获得急需的人力提升。对危地马拉的战争目标完成后，下一个目标选择洪都拉斯。在吞并洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜与哥斯达黎加之后，就可以成立中美洲，从而在被征服的土地上获得核心，使该国的实力基础可与尼泊尔相比。

4nja3f.en: Although the country has insignificant manpower, industry, and resources, it is an non aligned country and has a populous in Central America, as well as having a well-equipped army. Thus, it's the recommended choice to go Fascist or Communist in order to form the Central American Union.
4nja3f.zh: 尽管该国的人力、工业与资源微不足道，但它是中立国家，在中美洲人口众多，并且拥有一支装备良好的军队。因此，它是转为法西斯或共产主义以成立中美洲联盟的推荐选择。

y1rdpl.en: Guatemala may form the United States of Central America if it controls all other independent Central American countries excluding ⟦0⟧. Doing so will give it cores on the required territories plus British Mexico (311).
y1rdpl.zh: 如果危地马拉控制了除⟦0⟧之外所有其他独立的中美洲国家，它就可以成立中美洲合众国。这样做会使它在所需领土以及英属墨西哥（311）上获得核心。

4smgqo.en: ⟦0⟧ is a small country in Central America with a population of ⟦1⟧. It is bordered by ⟦2⟧ to the north, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ to the south and the ⟦5⟧ to the east.

x9hmwr.en: The image size of an intelligence agency logo is ⟦0⟧ by ⟦1⟧ (x by y). This means the mid-point between your two icon frames should be at 117 pixels along the X axis. The frame on the left should be your unedited, actual intelligence agency icon. The frame on the right should be your icon when it is selected in the intelligence agency creation screen. In vanilla, this means a 2-pixel thick stroke/border with a gradient from white down to the main colour of your agency, and a strong, quickly-fading drop shadow. Once you are sure this is all correct, your GFX definition should be as well.
x9hmwr.zh: 情报机构标志的图像尺寸为⟦0⟧乘⟦1⟧（x 乘 y）。这意味着你的两个图标帧之间的中点应当位于 X 轴 117 像素处。左侧的帧应当是你未经编辑的、真实的情报机构图标。右侧的帧应当是它在情报机构创建界面中被选中时的图标。在原版中，这意味着一条 2 像素粗的描边/边框，带从白色到你机构主色的渐变，以及一个强烈且快速淡出的投影。一旦你确认这些都正确，你的 GFX 定义也应当正确了。

hd5o91.en: The ⟦0⟧ definition can list either hardcoded strings or localisation scopes (Vanilla files are typically hardcoded). They list out all the possible, random, names that can be given to the intelligence agency. These names are used when you call ⟦1⟧, unless another name is provided in the effect. In this example, either Hugin or Munin are used as the intelligence agency name, which is randomly picked when the effect is called.
hd5o91.zh: ⟦0⟧定义可以列出硬编码字符串或本地化作用域（原版文件通常为硬编码）。它们列出所有可以赋予该情报机构的可能随机名称。当你调用⟦1⟧时会使用这些名称，除非在效果中提供了另一个名称。在本例中，任意使用 Hugin 或 Munin 作为情报机构名称，它会在效果被调用时随机选取。

t6w0rj.en: ⟦0⟧ is the curve used for the light; each set of two decimals denote an x and y position on the curve graph, the game uses these points to calculate a change in whatever the animation is interacting with. The amount of decimals should always be even; the max y value is determined by "maxValue" argument, the min y value is determined by the "minValue" argument, the max x value is determined by "duration" and the min x value is determined by "start". You can have as many sets of decimals as you want but the last x coordinate must match with the duration and the first must match with "start".
t6w0rj.zh: ⟦0⟧是用于该灯光的曲线；每两个小数表示曲线图上的一个 x 与 y 位置，游戏使用这些点来计算该动画所作用对象的任何变化。小数的数量应当始终为偶数；最大 y 值由「maxValue」参数决定，最小 y 值由「minValue」参数决定，最大 x 值由「duration」决定，最小 x 值由「start」决定。你想要多少组小数都可以，但最后一个 x 坐标必须与 duration 匹配，第一个必须与「start」匹配。

9bwqfj.en: We are all working alone on separate projects but we always count on our fellow team members to help us out when we are in dire need of help or inspiration. All the features are always checked by a different member and run through multiple balance factors so that we ensure each addition to the mod is as balanced as possible.
9bwqfj.zh: 我们各自独立负责不同的项目，但当我们急需帮助或灵感时，我们总是依靠团队同伴伸出援手。所有功能都会由另一位成员检查，并经过多重平衡因素校验，以确保对模组的每一项新增内容都尽可能平衡。

1qy8yhg.zh: 我们所有的开发者与贡献者都可以在我们的官方 Discord 服务器中找到，如果你希望支持 The Road to 56 项目以释放其最大潜力，你随时可以成为 Patreon 赞助者！

ubxgha.en: Dedicated Art in the style of Vanilla, ranging from portraits, focuses, and spirits to all sorts of different icons.
ubxgha.zh: 采用原版风格的专门美术，涵盖肖像、焦点、国家精神到各种不同的图标。

w793xx.en: Bringing the Revolution Home - Win the German civil war as the communists, and don't ally with the Soviet Union.
w793xx.zh: 「把革命带回家」——作为共产主义者赢得德国内战，并且不与苏联结盟。

ahxz9d.en: Finlands Sak är Vår - As Sweden, join Finland in the Winter War and force the Soviet Union to capitulate.
ahxz9d.zh: 「芬兰的事业就是我们的」——作为瑞典，在冬季战争中加入芬兰一方，并迫使苏联投降。

14fld6k.en: Road to 56 has been authored by many people, especially as its Github is public. Current notable people:
14fld6k.zh: Road to 56 由许多人共同编写，尤其是因为它的 Github 是公开的。目前的知名人物有：

j22750.en: Many behind the curtains bug-fixes and improvements to things like the AI compared to the base game.
j22750.zh: 相比基础游戏，在幕后进行了许多错误修复，并对 AI 等做了改进。

5o5fnq.en: Technologies to do until as late as 1959 with a new dedicated specialization and mechanization tab.
5o5fnq.zh: 科技可研究到 1959 年，并新增专门的专精化与机械化标签页。

1u1dkqs.en: The mod also includes custom Achievements that are currently being developed. Achievements such as:
1u1dkqs.zh: 该模组还包含目前正在开发中的自定义成就。诸如以下成就：

w9ajs8.en: Hibernia Rules the Waves - As Ireland build a battleship and ensure the UK has no capital ships.
w9ajs8.zh: 「爱尔兰统治海洋」——作为爱尔兰建造一艘战列舰，并确保联合王国没有主力舰。

444xjh.en: New focus trees or improvements for almost all starting nations, and overhauls of vanilla ones.
444xjh.zh: 为几乎所有开局国家提供新的国策树或改进，并对原版国策树进行重制。

klr4dr.en: Anyone Want Some Freedom? - As the USA, control all oil-producing states in the Middle East.
klr4dr.zh: 「有人想要点自由吗？」——作为美国，控制中东所有产油州。

auakqy.en: That's not what I meant by Anschluss - As Austria, refuse Anschluss and capitulate Germany.
auakqy.zh: 「我说的德奥合并不是这个意思」——作为奥地利，拒绝德奥合并并迫使德国投降。

116kj4i.en: Guess who's back - As Mongolia, restore Genden to power after he is imprisoned.
116kj4i.zh: 「猜猜谁回来了」——作为蒙古，在根登被囚禁后恢复其权力。

1s9e23k.en: A Truly International City - As Danzig, control a state on every continent.
1s9e23k.zh: 「真正的国际城市」——作为但泽，在每一个大洲控制一个州。

8n5bn9.en: You Canute do that! - As Denmark, restore the North Sea Empire.
8n5bn9.zh: 「克努特，你做不到！」——作为丹麦，恢复北海帝国。

gzllcu.en: Banana America - As Fascist Honduras puppet the USA
gzllcu.zh: 「香蕉美洲」——作为法西斯洪都拉斯傀儡化美国

aq1np1.en: And many more achievements are on their way!

149w61b.en: New governmental laws in the country tab.
149w61b.zh: 国家标签页中的新政府法律。

15ekb8n.en: To become ⟦0⟧ quickly, take the focus Concessions to the Trade Unions and pick the first option in the Trade Unions decisions whenever they become available. Do not pick any other decisions, except the military factory one whenever it only costs 10 political power. Hold off on picking any focuses, unless you can reach Royal Ordnance Factories. Once you turn Communist, pick Move to Secure the Dominions (should only take 25 days), and start justifying on the ⟦1⟧, since that won't raise WT by much but still make sure the ⟦2⟧ gets involved. Move your army to Canada, making sure to spread the divisions out and declare martial law to prevent it from seceding. (It is not enough to create a front line along the border, as Nova Scotia doesn't border the US, so at least two divisions must be placed there manually). Install a communist government in Canada when it becomes available. Train a mix of Infantry and Cavalry divisions and request the Canadian troops when they become your puppet. Move your air force to Canada as well. For more manpower, hire the ⟦3⟧ advisor. Now, decide if you want to play safe or fast:
15ekb8n.zh: 要快速成为⟦0⟧，选取「向工会让步」焦点，并在「工会」决议每次可用时总是选取第一个选项。不要选取任何其他决议，除非那个军用工厂决议只花 10 政治点数。先不要选取任何焦点，除非你能到达「皇家军械工厂」。一旦你转为共产主义，选取「行动以确保各自治领」（应当只需 25 天），并开始对⟦1⟧制造战争目标，因为这不会使世界紧张度上升太多，但仍要确保⟦2⟧被卷入。把你的军队调往加拿大，务必把各师分散开，并宣布戒严以防止它脱离。（仅在边境沿线建立一条前线是不够的，因为新斯科舍不与美国接壤，所以必须手动在那里放置至少两个师）。当共产主义政府可用时在加拿大建立它。训练步兵与骑兵师的混合编制，并在加拿大部队成为你的傀儡时索取它们。同样把你的空军调往加拿大。为获得更多人力，聘用⟦3⟧顾问。现在，决定你想稳扎稳打还是速战速决：

yr6vyz.en: In order to not get a civil war, start Revisit Colonial Policy and rush down to Decolonization as fast as possible. When the justification is finished, declare war on the Philippines which will automatically draw in the US as they are a puppet, and call in Canada. Focus on encircling the US troops in New England, as well as moving through gaps in the frontline along the straight US-Canada border. Once enough US forces have been encircled and eliminated, you can activate aggressive battleplans. You do not need to use your navy at all.
yr6vyz.zh: 为了不引发内战，开始「重新审视殖民政策」并尽可能快地向「去殖民化」速推。当战争目标完成时，对菲律宾宣战，这会自动把作为其傀儡的美国卷入，并召唤加拿大。重点是在新英格兰包围美军，同时沿美加直线边境的前线缺口推进。一旦足够多的美军被包围并消灭，你就可以启用激进的作战计划。你完全不需要使用你的海军。

5y2q8x.en: The achievement requires taking the focus Crush the Dream which involves an alliance with the ⟦0⟧, and is unavailable if the US is already a puppet or not democratic. In order to take this focus there are two options: hold off on capitulating the US before it is completed (make sure that you control all of your puppets' divisions), or you can annex the US and release them as a puppet ⟦1⟧ the focus has been completed. To make sure you get what you want in the peace deal, keep the Comintern out of the war.
5y2q8x.zh: 该成就需要选取「粉碎梦想」焦点，其中涉及与⟦0⟧结盟，如果美国已经是傀儡或不是民主国家，该焦点便不可用。要选取这个焦点有两个选择：在它完成之前暂不迫使美国投降（务必控制你所有傀儡的师），或者你可以在焦点完成后吞并美国并把它作为傀儡释放⟦1⟧。为确保你在和平协议中得到想要的东西，不要让共产国际参战。

11glk4n.en: If you do not care to continue the game after the achievement is completed, another method is to rush down towards Crush the Dream as soon as you turn Communist. There is enough time to capitulate the US if you are careful, following the same plan attack as in method 1. You will not be able to avoid a civil war this way, but the achievement should be completed long before that.
11glk4n.zh: 如果你不在意在成就完成后继续游玩，另一个方法是在你转为共产主义后立即向「粉碎梦想」速推。如果你小心行事，时间是足够迫使美国投降的，攻击方式与方案 1 相同。这样你无法避免内战，但成就会在那之前很久就完成。

yg9b7.en: As a Communist United Kingdom, crush the American Dream by puppeting the U.S.A.
yg9b7.zh: 作为共产主义联合王国，通过傀儡化美国来粉碎美国梦。

17v4xqg.en: Alternatively, don't join the Comintern and start justifying on Denmark at around 1941, and line up your declaration with the time the Germans declare on the Soviets - this will let you join the comintern while bypassing their war declaration restrictions (this will also call Japan into the war, but they will never reach you on historical). From here, you just need to do a D-Day into the Netherlands and hold it until the end of the war, while gathering enough warscore to annex it once the peace deal comes. You can grant military access to allies members to assist with holding. Being in the comintern will allow you to annex an allied Netherlands, as long as youre at least partially occupying them at the time of the peace deal.
17v4xqg.zh: 或者，不加入共产国际，在 1941 年左右开始对丹麦制造战争目标，并让你的宣战时机与德国对苏联宣战的时机对齐——这会让你能加入共产国际，同时绕过它们的宣战限制（这也会把日本卷入战争，但在历史模式下它们永远到不了你这里）。从这时起，你只需要对荷兰发动一次登陆并守住它直到战争结束，同时积累足够的战争分数，以便在和平协议到来时吞并它。你可以给同盟国成员军事通行权，以协助守卫。身处共产国际将允许你吞并作为同盟国的荷兰，只要你在和平协议时至少部分占领了它们。

1dlhs08.en: Best done with historical focuses off except for German AI. Make sure the UK goes Fascist or Monarchist. Go down the fascist path and time the justification so that by the time Germany attacks Poland you have a wargoal on the Netherlands and Poland. Make sure to take all the decisions to purchase ships from the UK, USA and Germany. Declare on Poland first, this will let you join the Axis. Move your army on the Dutch border and declare war on the Netherlands. Use naval invasions if need be and annex everything. Repeat the same process for Denmark. If everything went right there should be no enemy faction involved, especially if you don't call Germany into the war.
1dlhs08.zh: 最好在关闭历史焦点、但保留德国 AI 历史行为的情况下完成。确保联合王国走法西斯或君主主义。沿法西斯路线走下去，并安排好战争目标的时机，使德国进攻波兰时你已经对荷兰和波兰拥有战争目标。务必采取所有从英国、美国与德国购买舰船的决议。先对波兰宣战，这会让你加入轴心国。把你的军队调到荷兰边境并对荷兰宣战。如有需要就使用海军登陆，并吞并一切。对丹麦重复同样的流程。如果一切顺利，就不应有任何敌方阵营被卷入，尤其是如果你不把德国召唤进战争的话。

1gaqfls.en: Can be done before WW2, rush the civil war, then hire the army advisor ASAP to take the +500 weekly manpower spirit. Start justifying on Denmark around late 1937, and go down the naval tree to get decisions to buy ships, they will be enough for naval superiority. Move your ships and army to Leningrad before declaring war and time the focus to join Comintern to end right after you declare war. Then justify on Netherlands and leave the Comintern to be able to declare on them, they should be weak enough to handle without Soviets' help. Make you sure you build marines and don't take any other focuses as you lack political power.
1gaqfls.zh: 可以在二战前完成：速推内战，然后尽快聘用陆军顾问，以获得 +500 每周人力的国家精神。在 1937 年末左右开始对丹麦制造战争目标，并沿海军树走下去以获得购买舰船的决议，它们足以取得制海权。在宣战前把你的舰船与军队调往列宁格勒，并把加入共产国际的焦点时机安排在宣战后立即结束。然后对荷兰制造战争目标并退出共产国际，以便能对它们宣战；它们应当弱到无需苏联帮助就能应付。务必建造陆战队，并且不要选取任何其他焦点，因为你缺政治点数。

7fzil5.en: Alternatively, a slightly less RNG reliant method can be done by going communist in historical mode.
7fzil5.zh: 或者，一个对随机性依赖稍低的方法可以在历史模式下走共产主义路线完成。

owttc3.en: As New Zealand, control and own the states of Brabant (Zeeland) and Sjaelland (Zealand).
owttc3.zh: 作为新西兰，控制并拥有布拉班特（泽兰）与西兰岛（西兰）两州。

1lwwc7g.en: An alternative and much easier way to get the achievement to fire off is to simply conquer the land before doing Oppose Hitler - as soon as you have the political power, justify on a country France is guaranteeing ( ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, or ⟦2⟧). Add 2 motorized divisions onto the starting panzer template, convert all non-infantry to the template, use those units (you should have 6) to stage invasions from Wilhelmshaven into Amiens, Le Harve, and Dieppe and use your infantry to guard the border with France, and train 48 Cavalry units to guard the Czech border. Use your navy to guard the English Channel (while the French Navy is more powerful than the German Navy, there is a period where you'll have naval supremacy and can launch the invasion. Hire Erwin Rommel and Franz Halder to boost your Panzer Division's attack power, and launch the invasions as soon as you declare war. Use the panzers to rush Paris + a few other victory points, and then capitulate France; take the Caribbean Land in the Peace Deal (don't worry about how much tension you generate - you don't need Wilhelm II for this achievement), and then take Oppose Hitler. Go down to Our Place in the Sun after winning the Civil War.
1lwwc7g.zh: 另一个容易得多的触发成就方式是：在做「反对希特勒」之前先直接征服那片土地——一有政治点数，就对法国保障的国家（⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧）制造战争目标。在开局装甲编制中加入 2 个摩托化师，把所有非步兵转换为该编制，用这些单位（你应当有 6 个）从威廉港向亚眠、勒阿弗尔与迪耶普发起登陆，用你的步兵守卫与法国的边境，并训练 48 个骑兵单位守卫捷克边境。用你的海军守卫英吉利海峡（虽然法国海军比德国海军更强，但会有一段时间你拥有制海权并能发动登陆。聘用埃尔温·隆美尔与弗朗茨·哈尔德以提升你装甲师的攻击力，并在宣战后立即发动登陆。用装甲部队速取巴黎加上其他几个胜利点，然后迫使法国投降；在和平协议中夺取加勒比土地（不必担心你制造了多少紧张度——这个成就你不需要威廉二世），然后选取「反对希特勒」。赢得内战后推进到「我们阳光下的地盘」。

wh1pow.en: Germany must take the Oppose Hitler or Rally the Wehrmacht focuses which will spark a civil war. The eastern parts of Germany and Bavaria will be the parts that will defect. Prepare for the war. It is suggested to focus the bulk of the attack in the middle to split off the north from Bavaria. Once the war is over, Follow the focus tree to Our Place in the Sun.Break the Anglo-French Colonial Hegemony will give Germany wargoals against the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ but before that, it may be beneficial to ally ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ via the focus tree. Rekindle Imperial Sentiment will make an Austria-Hungary which gives a chance to annex all their territory for free. Assassinate Mussolini will make ⟦4⟧ into a ⟦5⟧ ally. When ready, go to war with the allies. Invade the British after France has capitulated. In the peace deal, take Caribbean territory first so that the Italians do not take it for themselves. Note that taking Curacao from the Dutch does not fulfill the achievement.
wh1pow.zh: 德国必须选取「反对希特勒」或「重整国防军」焦点，这会引发内战。德国东部与巴伐利亚将是叛离的部分。为战争做准备。建议把主要进攻集中在中间，以便把北部与巴伐利亚分割开。战争结束后，沿国策树推进到「我们阳光下的地盘」。「打破英法殖民霸权」会给德国对⟦0⟧与⟦1⟧的战争目标，但在此之前，通过国策树与⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧结盟可能是有益的。「重燃帝国情怀」会造就一个奥匈，提供免费吞并其全部领土的机会。「刺杀墨索里尼」会使⟦4⟧成为⟦5⟧盟友。准备就绪后，与同盟国开战。在法国投降后入侵英国。在和平协议中优先夺取加勒比领土，以免意大利人自己拿走。请注意，从荷兰手中夺取库拉索并不能满足该成就。

11r9bdf.en: This achievement requires Germany to follow the Monarchist path of their focus tree. The Caribbean islands required are owned by either ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧, or the ⟦2⟧.
11r9bdf.zh: 该成就要求德国走其国策树的君主制路线。所需的加勒比岛屿由⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧拥有。

syu4xc.en: Meanwhile you can justify a war goal on Guangzhouwan ( ⟦0⟧). After ⟦1⟧ falls, declare war on them and join the Axis, you don’t need to push into France. After ⟦2⟧ falls to Germany, move your fleet and your 48 divisions to Wilhelmshaven and prepare a naval invasion on the UK, targeting on and around Newcastle. There should be a window of opportunity to launch a naval invasion, since the UK often only deploys enough ships after the first naval invasion has started. Use force attack to take Newcastle, and then land with all your 48 divisions, keeping some more behind to guard Portugal against potential naval invasions. If the invasion gets stuck on the beachhead and you get pushed out, you might want to restart. Otherwise keep pushing, sending additional troops over should it be needed, and you should be able to capitulate the UK. Remember to guard for UK counter naval invasions on Britain and to call in your puppets in China and India just before the UK capitulates.
syu4xc.zh: 同时你可以对广州湾（⟦0⟧）制造战争目标。在⟦1⟧陷落后，对它们宣战并加入轴心国，你不需要推进到法国境内。在⟦2⟧向德国投降后，把你的舰队与 48 个师调往威廉港，并准备对联合王国发动海军登陆，目标为纽卡斯尔及其周边。应当会有一个发动海军登陆的机会窗口，因为英国通常只在第一次海军登陆开始后才部署足够的舰船。使用强制攻击夺取纽卡斯尔，然后用你全部 48 个师登陆，并在后方留一些部队守卫葡萄牙以防可能的海军登陆。如果登陆在滩头受阻并被击退，你可能需要重开。否则继续推进，如有需要就送去更多部队，你应当能够迫使联合王国投降。记住在联合王国投降前守住英国本土以防英国的反登陆，并在联合王国投降前不久召唤你在中国与印度的傀儡。

rmmvp5.en: When the UK capitulates, give Hong Kong and Guangzhouwan to your Chinese puppet and take as much of the allied navies as you can. With the remaining points you can take as much territory as you want. For example, you could give the ⟦0⟧ to your Indian puppet and make puppets out of Malaysia and/or Indonesia. You should also be able to expand your army further by now, aim for at least 120 mainline divisions. Send the army to your Chinese ports and justify a war goal on ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ if they still exist. Declare war and take as much territory as possible. Remember to build railways, supply hubs and infrastructure as needed to deal with the bad supply.
rmmvp5.zh: 当联合王国投降时，把香港与广州湾交给你的中国傀儡，并尽可能多地夺取同盟国海军。用剩余点数你可以随意夺取领土。例如，你可以把⟦0⟧交给你的印度傀儡，并把马来西亚和/或印度尼西亚变为傀儡。到这时你也应当能够进一步扩充军队，目标至少 120 个一线师。把军队派往你的中国港口，并对⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧制造战争目标（如果它们仍然存在）。宣战并尽可能多地夺取领土。记住按需修建铁路、补给枢纽与基础设施，以应对糟糕的补给。

9gswj2.en: Turn on Historical AI Focuses. Set occupation law to Civilian Oversight and release all Collaboration Governments when possible. Go down the monarchist path, rushing down to Restoration of the Monarchy and then The Kingdom Reunited in order to get cores on ⟦0⟧. It should be possible without needing to fight a civil war in Brazil. With Brazil’s cores, build up an army of around 48 divisions towards ⟦1⟧, with an additional 10 or so staying behind to guard the coast. It might be beneficial to let the Brazilian army stay in Brazil to guard against the Guyanas.
9gswj2.zh: 开启历史 AI 焦点。把占领法令设为「民政监督」，并在可能时释放所有合作政府。沿君主制路线走下去，速推至「恢复君主制」，然后到「统一的王国」，以便在⟦0⟧获得核心。应当可以在无需在巴西打内战的情况下做到。有了巴西的核心，建立一支约 48 个师的军队向⟦1⟧进发，另外留下约 10 个师守卫海岸。让巴西军队留在巴西以防范圭亚那诸地可能是有益的。

irwrjn.en: Around now, ⟦0⟧ should start to declare war on the ⟦1⟧ (and the USA). Justify a war goal on Japan's Chinese puppet and declare war. Don’t call in the rest of the Axis unless you need to. Now push out ⟦2⟧ from mainland China and secure naval dominance. Naval invade Japan and make sure to give all of China to Macau in the peace deal.
irwrjn.zh: 大约在这时，⟦0⟧应当开始对⟦1⟧（以及美国）宣战。对日本的中国傀儡制造战争目标并宣战。除非需要，不要召唤轴心国其余成员。现在把⟦2⟧逐出中国大陆并确保海军优势。海军登陆日本，并务必在和平协议中把整个中国都交给澳门。

9gc4r.en: After Germany attacks ⟦0⟧, world tension should come above 50% and you can justify a war goal on ⟦1⟧, using the claims from the focuses to make it faster. With a few encirclements along the flanks, and defending against their naval invasion, Spain should fall in a few months. Puppet ⟦2⟧ and take their navy.
9gc4r.zh: 在德国进攻⟦0⟧之后，世界紧张度应当升到 50% 以上，你可以对⟦1⟧制造战争目标，利用焦点提供的声称使其更快。通过在侧翼进行几次包围，并防御它们发动的海军登陆，西班牙应当在几个月内陷落。傀儡化⟦2⟧并夺取它们的海军。

no947u.en: As Portugal, create a collaboration government in Macau and have it own all Chinese states.
no947u.zh: 作为葡萄牙，在澳门建立一个合作政府，并让它拥有全部中国州。

jhocxn.en: You will need to stage well timed coups against Russia and USA in order to have rebellion in your faction instead of the Axis (they shouldn't be in a war against another faction). A good time to start against Russia is around when ⟦0⟧ joins the Axis and then start on the USA a few months later (they both should have less than 80% stability at the time if you boosted non-aligned enough but it can differ sometimes). In the meantime you can annex or puppet ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ with naval invasions with Reclaim the Makedonyalı Sanjak claim.
jhocxn.zh: 你需要精心安排时机，对俄罗斯与美国发动政变，以便在你的阵营中而不是轴心国中引发叛乱（它们不应当正在与其他阵营交战）。对俄罗斯动手的好时机大约是⟦0⟧加入轴心国之时，然后过几个月再对美国动手（如果你把中立支持度提升得足够多，它们当时应当都低于 80% 稳定度，但有时会不同）。在此期间，你可以通过带有「夺回马其顿桑贾克声称」的海军登陆吞并或傀儡化⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧。

q88ki1.en: To become the Ottoman Empire, you need to go to the far left of the focus tree and choose Adnan Menderes after Hold Our First Multi-Party Election. This achievement requires one to be on the winning side against both the Axis and Allies. Easiest way is to disable La Résistance and start boosting non-aligned to ⟦0⟧ and USA from the beginning of the game and right after concluding the civil war against Kemalists.
q88ki1.zh: 要成为奥斯曼帝国，你需要前往国策树的最左侧，并在「举行我们的首次多党选举」之后选择阿德南·曼德列斯。该成就要求你在对轴心国与同盟国的战争中处于获胜一方。最简单的方法是禁用《抵抗运动》，并从游戏开始起就向⟦0⟧与美国提升中立支持度，且在对凯末尔主义者的内战结束后立即继续。

9quokf.en: Continue with Press the Austro-Hungarian Claim focus to be able to create factions. Justify against Russia and declare before the coup is complete, when the Russian coup is completed, invite the rebellion to your faction. You just need to hold your line and not let non-aligned Russia get capitulated (you don't need war participation, rebellion will have all Russia after Germany capitulates Russia).
9quokf.zh: 继续使用「施压奥匈声称」焦点，以便能够创建阵营。对俄罗斯制造战争目标，并在政变完成之前宣战；当俄罗斯政变完成时，把该叛乱邀请进你的阵营。你只需要守住阵线，不要让中立俄罗斯被投降（你不需要战争参与度，在德国迫使俄罗斯投降后，叛乱方将拥有整个俄罗斯）。

pdv5iv.en: After Democratic USA and Communist Russia is capitulated you will have 2 most powerful nations in your faction. Your faction can win any war against anyone. Keep an eye on non-aligned Russia's division count and declare war to the Axis when you are ready, after that either get control of capitals via naval invasion/paradrop or ask control from your allies.
pdv5iv.zh: 在民主美国与共产俄罗斯投降后，你的阵营中将拥有两个最强大的国家。你的阵营可以赢得对任何人的任何战争。留意中立俄罗斯的师数量，并在你准备就绪时对轴心国宣战，之后要么通过海军登陆/伞降夺取首都控制权，要么向你的盟友索要控制权。

1uge31u.en: You will also need to send a lot of divisions to help the USA rebellion so it's better to choose a city from the pacific side to start the coup (the Axis should have the Suez Canal by now and you can ask for access while being at war against Russia). Like with Russia, you need to justify against the USA and declare before the coup is finished.
1uge31u.zh: 你还需要派遣大量师去帮助美国叛乱，所以最好从太平洋一侧选择一座城市来发动政变（此时轴心国应当已控制苏伊士运河，你可以在与俄罗斯交战期间请求通行权）。与对俄罗斯一样，你需要对美国制造战争目标并在政变完成之前宣战。

o13sou.en: As the Ottoman Empire, hold the capitals of France, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Japan.
o13sou.zh: 作为奥斯曼帝国，守住法国、联合王国、意大利与日本的首都。

1ae6zcv.en: Manpower is the biggest issue in the beginning so it is recommended to play with ⟦0⟧ enabled so that ⟦1⟧ can be activated in the ⟦2⟧, which gives 500 weekly manpower. It is only available when ⟦3⟧, which is what you will be going anyway since you need ⟦4⟧ as your leader. Turning ⟦5⟧ is therefore your number one priority. Start with Political Effort and hire the ⟦6⟧. Work your way down to the 3rd Research Slot, then go for military factories. As for construction, start by building one ⟦7⟧, this will bypass the second Infrastructure focus, speeding up the process a bit. Then build maximum level land forts. You won't have any free slots for new factories yet. Get an Army Chief, and the ⟦8⟧.
1ae6zcv.zh: 开局时人力是最大的问题，所以建议启用⟦0⟧来游玩，这样就能在⟦1⟧中激活，它在⟦2⟧提供每周 500 人力。它只在⟦3⟧时可用，而这正是你无论如何都要走的路线，因为你需要⟦4⟧作为你的领袖。因此转为⟦5⟧是你的头等大事。从「政治努力」开始并聘用⟦6⟧。一路推进到第 3 个科研槽，然后争取军用工厂。至于建造，先建一座⟦7⟧，这会跳过第二个基础设施焦点，稍微加快进度。然后建造最高等级的陆上要塞。你暂时没有任何空余槽位用于新工厂。聘用一位陆军参谋长，以及⟦8⟧。

8mcbay.en: When you have turned ⟦0⟧, go for Indoctrination, which gives an additional 400 manpower weekly. Start building up an army. Aim for around 12 18 width infantry with engineering AA and artillery, but other setups also work. If you want, you can build a land warfare facility to add flamethrower tanks later on with a logistics company. Fight against ⟦1⟧, either by declaring war on ⟦2⟧ (if they exist, for lower World tension), or if they declare war on you. When they are defeated, declare war on the ⟦3⟧ via the ⟦4⟧, if possible.
8mcbay.zh: 当你转为⟦0⟧后，争取「灌输」，它额外提供每周 400 人力。开始建立军队。目标大约是 12 个 18 宽度、带工兵、防空与火炮的步兵师，但其他配置也行。如果你愿意，可以建一座陆战设施，以便之后配合后勤连加入喷火坦克。与⟦1⟧作战，要么对⟦2⟧宣战（如果它们存在，以获得更低的世界紧张度），要么等它们对你宣战。当它们被击败后，如果可能的话，通过⟦3⟧对⟦4⟧宣战。

foo3dw.en: Your best bet is probably to play non-historical and restart until Germany goes for its civil war. Forming ⟦0⟧ is critical before attacking Germany, since you need more cores to build up a large enough army. If you want to make sure that ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ or the ⟦3⟧ do not attack you, you could keep them at historical focuses. It could, however be beneficial to get a defensive war with ⟦4⟧ when it is time to expand.
foo3dw.zh: 你最好的选择大概是走非历史路线，并重开直到德国走向其内战。在进攻德国之前成立⟦0⟧至关重要，因为你需要更多核心来建立足够庞大的军队。如果你想确保⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧不进攻你，可以让它们保持历史焦点。不过，在需要扩张时与⟦4⟧打一场防御战可能是有益的。

1cyozy.en: When the Benelux has been formed, prepare for the war against Germany. Look for a good opportunity to attack them, they might be busy fighting the ⟦0⟧ or other European countries. You only need to occupy Trier, which is right near the border of Luxembourg.
1cyozy.zh: 当比荷卢成立后，为对德战争做准备。寻找进攻它们的好机会，它们可能正忙于与⟦0⟧或其他欧洲国家作战。你只需要占领特里尔，它就紧邻卢森堡边境。

1nd2bs7.en: Alternatively you can go historical, join the Comintern and take out Germany with your 300k manpower.
1nd2bs7.zh: 或者你可以走历史路线，加入共产国际，并用你的 30 万人力消灭德国。

1iftep3.en: As Luxembourg led by Charles Marx control both Brussels and Trier.
1iftep3.zh: 作为查尔斯·马克思领导的卢森堡，控制布鲁塞尔与特里尔两地。

1h61rbs.en: Start as ⟦0⟧. Join the Axis and move all your armies and navies to Germany. Don't pick a focus yet. Start fabricating a claim on ⟦1⟧ as soon as you have enough Political Power. Setup a naval invasion, making sure to include your light tanks and motorized infantry, from Germany to Dieppe and put your navy on naval invasion support. When your claim is finished, declare war on France. Don't call in anyone, especially Germany. After making a beachhead, put your entire army on French shores and conquer them. Use your motorized to secure Paris and Orleans, as this, in addition to taking Dieppe and Le Havre, is enough to capitulate France. Change 6 infantry to 6 bicycle battalions in the Hohei Shidan template.
1h61rbs.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局。加入轴心国，把你所有的陆军与海军调往德国。暂时不要选取焦点。一有足够的政治点数就开始对⟦1⟧伪造声称。安排一次海军登陆，务必包含你的轻型坦克与摩托化步兵，从德国到迪耶普，并把你的海军设为海军登陆支援。当你的声称完成后，对法国宣战。不要召唤任何人，尤其是德国。在建立滩头阵地后，把你整支军队都送上法国海岸并征服它们。用你的摩托化部队确保巴黎与奥尔良，因为加上夺取迪耶普与勒阿弗尔，这足以迫使法国投降。在「步兵师团」编制中把 6 个步兵改为 6 个自行车营。

1amm6t6.en: As ⟦0⟧, go for an early war with ⟦1⟧. You may join the Axis to access air bases in Germany for an easy capitulation of France using paratroopers. During the war take Bersaglieri focus. Keep in mind that if France joins the Allies, you'll have to invade Corsica. Once France is occupied, recruit ⟦2⟧ "Reggimento Bersaglieri" divisions or convert some of your infantry divisions.
1amm6t6.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，争取早期与⟦1⟧开战。你可以加入轴心国以使用德国的空军基地，从而用伞兵轻松迫使法国投降。战争期间选取「狙击兵」焦点。请记住，如果法国加入同盟国，你就必须入侵科西嘉。一旦法国被占领，招募⟦2⟧个「狙击兵团」师，或把你的一些步兵师转换过去。

17j6kyx.en: As the ⟦0⟧, go for Benelux unification by rushing Cave to the British. You can build your military surprisingly powerful and with the help of the Allies, when Germany eventually declares war on you, you can invade them. After this you can easily take ⟦1⟧, since they were weakened by the war and taking Paris should be no problem.
17j6kyx.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，通过速推「向英国人让步」来争取比荷卢统一。你可以把自己的军队建设得惊人地强大，并在德国最终对你宣战时借助同盟国入侵它们。此后你可以轻易拿下⟦1⟧，因为它们已被战争削弱，夺取巴黎应当不成问题。

woo83m.en: As Germany, play normally until you invade Britain. Take all of ⟦0⟧ and puppet the ⟦1⟧. Copy their bicycle division template and train the divisions.
woo83m.zh: 作为德国，正常游玩直到你入侵英国。夺取整个⟦0⟧并傀儡化⟦1⟧。复制它们的自行车师编制并训练这些师。

1mw67nb.en: 4 bicycle battalions each, also completing 'Bersaglieri' focus create 3 'Reggimento Bersaglieri' divisions.
1mw67nb.zh: 每个 4 个自行车营，另外完成「狙击兵」焦点可创建 3 个「狙击兵团」师。

icl5ma.en: Hungary: Unlocks with Expand the Diósgyör Machinery Factory (Götterdämmerung DLC required)
icl5ma.zh: 匈牙利：以「扩建迪欧什哲尔机械厂」解锁（需要《诸神黄昏》DLC）

au45t5.en: Occupy all of mainland France while having at least 20 fully equipped Bicycle regiments.
au45t5.zh: 在拥有至少 20 个装备齐全的自行车团的情况下占领法国本土全境。

e4b10v.en: ⟦0⟧: Unlocks with Establish Caloi Factory (⟦1⟧ DLC required)
e4b10v.zh: ⟦0⟧：以「建立卡洛伊工厂」解锁（需要⟦1⟧DLC）

3tb334.en: After getting Danzig, move your light tanks to a port near Denmark and prepare a naval invasion against France with ten of the eleven divisions. Send each one to a different coastal province of France, the ten closest to ⟦0⟧. The naval invasion will be ready in seven days, and your navy with ⟦1⟧ mission will be enough to get the naval superiority you need (in any case, support it from the air with fighters, CAS, bombers and so on with the order ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧). When your tanks arrive in France, change the planes' order to support troops over their territory and move the tanks quickly to the victory points (focusing on Paris). Try to avoid direct confrontations with their troops if possible. France will surrender quickly.
3tb334.zh: 在得到但泽之后，把你的轻型坦克调往丹麦附近的港口，并准备用 11 个师中的 10 个对法国发动海军登陆。把每个师派往法国不同的沿海省份，即最靠近⟦0⟧的十个。海军登陆将在七天内准备就绪，而你执行⟦1⟧任务的海军将足以获得你所需的制海权（无论如何，都从空中用战斗机、近距空中支援、轰炸机等以⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧命令支援它）。当你的坦克抵达法国时，把飞机命令改为支援其领土上的部队，并迅速把坦克调往胜利点（重点是巴黎）。尽可能避免与其部队直接交锋。法国会很快投降。

vzpt8g.en: Make sure you don't bring your allies (Especially ⟦0⟧, which will take your land unless you use all your war score on ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧). Organize your troops on the frontiers with France and Poland, but create one army with all your light tanks. This army should be next to Danzig. Merge all your ships in one single fleet and place it in one of your ports near ⟦3⟧ with the order ⟦4⟧ over the two regions between France and Germany (Eastern North Sea and English Channel). Prepare all your planes to attack Poland. Start the war. Don't invite your allies and don't activate your battle plans, except your light tanks army over Danzig.
vzpt8g.zh: 确保不要带上你的盟友（尤其是⟦0⟧，除非你把全部战争分数都用在⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧上，否则它会夺走你的土地）。把你的部队部署在与法国和波兰的边境上，但用你所有的轻型坦克组建一支军队。这支军队应当位于但泽附近。把你所有的舰船合并为单支舰队，并把它放在靠近⟦3⟧的某个港口，对法国与德国之间的两个区域（东北海与英吉利海峡）下达⟦4⟧命令。让所有飞机准备攻击波兰。开始战争。不要邀请你的盟友，也不要启用你的作战计划，除了但泽方向的那支轻型坦克军队。

11urh25.en: The trick for this achievement is that "you have to have suffered less than 475 casualties in the current wars" has a loophole. Don't be in any wars. If you're at peace with everyone and control every of France and Poland, you will earn the achievement. It isn't completely clear if this a bug or intended behavior, as this wasn't how the achievement initially worked when it was added. However, given that the achievement would otherwise be literally impossible in the current patches, it seems unlikely they will change things.
11urh25.zh: 这个成就的窍门在于「你必须在当前战争中伤亡少于 475 人」有一个漏洞。不要处于任何战争中。如果你与所有人和平相处，并控制法国与波兰的每一处，你就会获得该成就。目前并不完全清楚这是 bug 还是有意行为，因为该成就刚加入时并不是这样运作的。不过，考虑到在当前补丁下该成就否则将字面意义上不可能完成，他们似乎不太可能改变这一点。

a6zamf.en: Repeat the naval invasion, in this case against ⟦0⟧. Don't forget to change the regions of the planes to help your troops. Once in UK, focus on London and other victory points. Again, avoid direct fights with enemies if you can. When UK and France have surrendered and you have Danzig, the war will end. Take all the territory.
a6zamf.zh: 重复这次海军登陆，这次是针对⟦0⟧。别忘了更改飞机的区域以帮助你的部队。一旦进入英国，重点攻击伦敦与其他胜利点。同样，如果可以就避免与敌人直接交战。当英国与法国都已投降且你拥有但泽时，战争就会结束。夺取全部领土。

19mirzn.en: As Germany in a 1939 start, occupy all of Poland and France without taking more than 475 casualties.
19mirzn.zh: 作为德国在 1939 年开局，占领波兰与法国全境，且伤亡不超过 475 人。

1ip0pui.en: Paradropping troops sets country flag ⟦0⟧ which prevents this achievement.
1ip0pui.zh: 伞降部队会设置国家标记⟦0⟧，从而阻止该成就。

ujfc94.en: This strategy does not work as of 1.15. You won't get Naval superiority.
ujfc94.zh: 该策略自 1.15 起不再有效。你不会获得制海权。

1awslw2.en: In your new exiled focus tree branch after capitulation, reach and complete the The Heir of Solomon (NOT The One True Heir of Solomon) focus. You need to keep your legitimacy above 99 during the entire 70 days of the focus, so you might have to attempt doing it a couple of times since Italy can lower your legitimacy through a decision. The chance that the ⟦0⟧ agrees to your request is 50/50 regardless of player actions, so multiple attempts may be needed. If they agree, you will get an "Arranged Territorial Expansion" in Palestine, similar to Bulgarian ones.
1awslw2.zh: 在你投降后新出现的流亡国策树分支中，推进并完成「所罗门的继承人」（不是「所罗门唯一真正的继承人」）焦点。你需要在该焦点的整个 70 天内把正统性保持在 99 以上，所以你可能得尝试几次，因为意大利可以通过决议降低你的正统性。无论玩家做什么，⟦0⟧同意你请求的几率都是五五开，所以可能需要多次尝试。如果它们同意，你将在巴勒斯坦获得一次「安排领土扩张」，类似保加利亚的那些。

1hzdpb7.en: NOTE: Since patch 1.12.11, moving the capital to Aksum after forming the Empire of Aksum does ⟦0⟧ set the "moved the capital" flag; you ⟦1⟧ move the capital to Aksum and then to Jerusalem. However, you must own the state of Palestine (either take it in peace conference or have it handed to you some other way), not merely control it, even if you have core in it.
1hzdpb7.zh: 注意：自补丁 1.12.11 起，在成立阿克苏姆帝国之后把首都迁往阿克苏姆⟦0⟧设置「迁都」标记；你⟦1⟧把首都迁往阿克苏姆、然后再迁往耶路撒冷。不过，你必须拥有巴勒斯坦州（要么在和平会议中取得，要么通过其他方式被移交给你），而不仅仅是控制它，即使你在那里拥有核心。

1kyesc7.en: The easiest way to do this is to occupy Palestine and use Haile Selassie's + 0.1 weekly compliance gain buff to create a collaboration government and annex them through lend lease. Alternatively depending on whether you started the game with historical AI on or off, you can capitulate The Allies.
1kyesc7.zh: 最简单的方法是占领巴勒斯坦，并利用海尔·塞拉西 +0.1 每周顺从度增益的加成建立一个合作政府，然后通过租借吞并它们。或者，取决于你开局时是否开启历史 AI，你可以迫使同盟国投降。

116hlq5.en: Increase your legitimacy whenever its available through decisions by throwing parties and lobbying for support. You can also complete The Abuna focus to get an advisor that slightly increases legitimacy gain.
116hlq5.zh: 每当通过决议可以提升正统性时就提升它，方式是举办宴会并游说支持。你还可以完成「阿布纳」焦点，获得一位略微提高正统性获取的顾问。

aamotd.en: Complete Rally Around the Emperor focus, request permission to set up a government in exile in United Kingdom through decisions. Then complete Boarding the Train focus. Allow yourself to get capitulated.
aamotd.zh: 完成「团结在皇帝周围」焦点，通过决议请求允许在联合王国建立流亡政府。然后完成「登上火车」焦点。允许自己被迫投降。

1l84mcv.en: This Achievement requires the player, while playing ⟦0⟧, to move the Capital to Palestine. For the decision, to move your capital, to appear, you need to own the province of Palestine.
1l84mcv.zh: 该成就要求玩家在以⟦0⟧游玩时把首都迁往巴勒斯坦。要让迁都决议出现，你需要拥有巴勒斯坦省份。

421dx5.en: After the Allies go to war with Germany, most of the time they kick out ⟦0⟧ out of Africa and liberate ⟦1⟧. You can help out with exiled units if needed.
421dx5.zh: 在同盟国与德国开战后，大多数情况下它们会把⟦0⟧逐出非洲并解放⟦1⟧。如有需要，你可以用流亡单位提供帮助。

1bc8cji.en: When your country gets fully liberated and reinstated, you will get Palestine transferred to you and you can take the decision to make it your capital.
1bc8cji.zh: 当你的国家被完全解放并复国时，巴勒斯坦会被移交给你，你就可以采取决议把它设为你的首都。

1puz9t4.en: Depending on how you released it, you would either have the historical borders in East Germany, or already have all of Germany. No matter if you chose the former or the latter, the main goal as East Germany would be to form Germany and reclaim its old borders to unite the Germans under a socialist state with potentially having the Soviets as your ally.
1puz9t4.zh: 取决于你如何释放它，你要么拥有东德的历史边界，要么已经拥有整个德国。无论你选择前者还是后者，作为东德的主要目标都是成立德国并收复其旧边界，把德意志人统一在一个社会主义国家之下，并可能让苏联成为你的盟友。

17cvb5f.en: In order to play as early as East Germany, you would have to spawn it via console commands with either manually adding cores to release it with its tag ⟦0⟧, have it own states by manually doing the setowner DDR command then tag DDR to switch, or by annexing any country to East Germany with the command annex GER DDR to annex Germany.
17cvb5f.zh: 要想尽早以东德游玩，你必须通过控制台命令生成它：要么手动为其 tag⟦0⟧添加核心以便释放它，要么手动执行 setowner DDR 命令让它拥有各州后再用 tag DDR 切换过去，要么用 annex GER DDR 命令吞并德国，把任何国家吞并给东德。

6bt59o.en: East Germany starts the game with 2 Research slots, though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
6bt59o.zh: 东德开局拥有 2 个科研槽，不过它可以通过通用国策树获得最多 3 个额外科研槽。作为可释放国家，被释放时它会继承释放国已经研究过的全部科技。

11lahb4.en: The ⟦0⟧ was first made a concept during the Yalta Conference, when they decided where the Soviet and Allied spheres of influence in Europe would be. Eventually, ⟦1⟧ and West Germany reunified in 1990 one year before the dissolution of the ⟦2⟧.
11lahb4.zh: ⟦0⟧最初是在雅尔塔会议上成为构想的，当时他们决定了苏联与同盟国在欧洲的势力范围将在哪里。最终，⟦1⟧与西德于 1990 年重新统一，即⟦2⟧解体前一年。

6m1491.en: East Germany, despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. However, it can form Germany if it controls the required states.
6m1491.zh: 东德尽管是游戏内的一个「国家」，但按铁人选择它无法游玩，所以玩家玩该国唯一的好处就是使用控制台命令。不过，如果它控制了所需的州，它可以成立德国。

zhkyb6.en: Not to be confused with the East Germany cosmetic tag used on Germany when the ⟦0⟧ event triggers that gets applied when the Germans get puppeted by the ⟦1⟧ after the peace conference.
zhkyb6.zh: 不要与⟦0⟧事件触发时用于德国的东德外观标签混淆，该标签会在和平会议后德国被⟦1⟧傀儡化时被应用。

1q2mbji.en: When released, East Germany will be a ⟦0⟧ nation with that does not hold elections.
1q2mbji.zh: 被释放时，东德将是一个不举行选举的⟦0⟧国家。

1k9ni80.en: East Germany has the following political parties:

1ug6ckg.en: Overview of the East German nation

1wt7r1v.en: Go non-historical and have the ⟦0⟧ go monarchist. The UK will disband the Allies during the government collapse, giving you a chance to invite them by decision. Keep an eye on the ⟦1⟧ political tab. If they get the national spirit ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧, reset the run. If ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧ increases over 10%, reset as well. You want to see the national spirit ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ increasing steadily.
1wt7r1v.zh: 走非历史路线，并让⟦0⟧走君主制。联合王国会在政府崩溃期间解散同盟国，给你通过决议邀请它们的机会。留意⟦1⟧的政治标签页。如果它们获得国家精神⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧，就重开这一局。如果⟦4⟧或⟦5⟧升到 10% 以上，也要重开。你想看到的是国家精神⟦6⟧，并且⟦7⟧稳步上升。

1jdzin5.en: When the European Union faction is formed, ensure you have above ⟦0⟧ relations with ⟦1⟧, then use the decision to invite the ⟦2⟧ to Europe. This, along with them being of the same ideology as you (which they won't be if they go monarchist) is the only things that affect the AI in accepting this the invite.
1jdzin5.zh: 当欧洲联盟阵营成立时，确保你与⟦0⟧的关系高于⟦1⟧，然后使用决议邀请⟦2⟧加入欧洲。这一点，加上它们与你意识形态相同（如果它们走君主制就不会相同），是唯一影响 AI 是否接受该邀请的因素。

quckqb.en: When the European Union faction is formed, ensure you have above ⟦0⟧ relations with ⟦1⟧, then use the decision to invite the ⟦2⟧ to Europe. Unlike with ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧ will still accept even if they are not the same ideology as you.
quckqb.zh: 当欧洲联盟阵营成立时，确保你与⟦0⟧的关系高于⟦1⟧，然后使用决议邀请⟦2⟧加入欧洲。与⟦3⟧不同，即使⟦4⟧与你意识形态不相同，它们仍会接受。

zhxdsp.en: Austria is probably the easiest, as having Otto von Habsburg as your leader allows you to form the EU formable (something you ironically arent allowed to do if going democratic).
zhxdsp.zh: 奥地利大概是最容易的，因为让奥托·冯·哈布斯堡作为你的领袖可以让你成立欧盟这一可成立国家（讽刺的是，如果你走民主路线就不允许这样做）。

g4pnjw.en: Play Austria, go for Reinstate the Herrenhaus, then go to the Danubian Federation. Invite all of Europe into your faction, fabricate on GB, capitulate and Puppet them.
g4pnjw.zh: 以奥地利游玩，争取「恢复贵族院」，然后走向多瑙河联邦。邀请全欧洲加入你的阵营，对英国伪造声称，迫使它们投降并傀儡化它们。

korl2j.en: Belgium cannot get a wargoal on GB by themselfes if they stay democratic and has to rely on GB declaring on any european nation in their faction, which is very likely.
korl2j.zh: 如果比利时保持民主，它自己无法获得对英国的战争目标，只能依靠英国对其阵营中任何欧洲国家宣战，而这是很可能的。

1x3nrr.en: Alternatively the Netherlands can do something similar, as their Tree gives them a wargoal on GB after founding the EU.
1x3nrr.zh: 或者荷兰也可以做类似的事，因为它们的国策树在成立欧盟后会给予对英国的战争目标。

1xsoluv.en: As Austria, Belgium or the Netherlands be the leader of the EU and have the United Kingdom join your faction.
1xsoluv.zh: 作为奥地利、比利时或荷兰，成为欧盟的领袖并让联合王国加入你的阵营。
