1o321xc.en: The Paradox Wikis network are dedicated to various games published by ⟦0⟧. Their main purpose is to allow the community build a repository of game-related knowledge (aka ⟦1⟧), useful for both new and experienced players and for modders.
1o321xc.zh: Paradox Wikis 网络致力于⟦0⟧发行的各种游戏。它们的主要目的是让社区建立一个与游戏相关的知识库（即⟦1⟧），对新老玩家以及模组作者都有用。

1lnboir.en: Moderator is the highest level of power afforded to volunteers. They have the ability to block users, restrict editing of specific pages, roll back edits, delete pages, restore deleted pages, etc.
1lnboir.zh: 管理员是赋予志愿者的最高权限级别。他们有能力封禁用户、限制特定页面的编辑、回退编辑、删除页面、恢复已删除页面等。

t2zr9v.en: Half-ops serve as a middle-ground between moderators and regular users. They can't block users, but they can do many of the other things moderators can.
t2zr9v.zh: 半管理员是管理员与普通用户之间的中间层级。他们不能封禁用户，但可以做管理员能做的许多其他事情。

1qfe03l.en: All PDX wikis have dedicated forum threads on their game's sub-forum. Users can post in these threads to ask questions or collaborate with others.
1qfe03l.zh: 所有 PDX wiki 都在其游戏的子论坛中有专门的论坛帖。用户可以在这些帖子中提问或与他人协作。

1xm2dom.en: If the issue in question is private it is possible to directly contact the wiki moderation team via a PM on the forums using the links below.
1xm2dom.zh: 如果所涉问题属于私密性质，可以通过论坛私信使用下方链接直接联系 wiki 管理团队。

1uw7pgh.en: These threads are monitored by the wiki moderation team so there's a high chance of them responding quickly (up to a day or two).
1uw7pgh.zh: 这些帖子由 wiki 管理团队监控，所以它们有很高几率快速回复（最多一两天）。

1wmcg8u.en: The wikis are administered by grotaclas, Kami-sama and SolSys with the help of a community volunteer team.
1wmcg8u.zh: 这些 wiki 由 grotaclas、Kami-sama 与 SolSys 管理，并有一个社区志愿者团队协助。

1szgu0s.en: Wiki users and editors alike can join the Paradox Wikis on Discord for the following reasons:
1szgu0s.zh: wiki 用户与编辑者都可以出于以下原因加入 Paradox Wikis 的 Discord：

x39o91.en: Make improvement suggestions and work with others to implement them.
x39o91.zh: 提出改进建议，并与他人合作实施它们。

7kj78d.en: Collaborate with other editors on various wiki projects.
7kj78d.zh: 与其他编辑者在各种 wiki 项目上协作。

t07v5o.zh: 防止了在使用不同语言时与特工任务名称相关的一种罕见不同步。

105soqr.zh: AI 会并行规划海军登陆（大幅减少多核 CPU 上的尖峰）

1wni7ei.zh: 没有《诸神黄昏》时，比利时只能有一位法西斯顾问。

1mie7h7.zh: 鱼雷巡洋舰的可靠性与鱼雷升级不再重叠

bju2og.en: The studio produces what it terms "Grand Strategy games", meaning ones played on a real-world map, marked by the use of standard real-time elements but with an ability to make any and all changes while paused (and while unpaused). Almost all Paradox games have historical settings and demonstrate a reasonable commitment to historical accuracy. The focus of each game is different, but generally a player must manage the economy, commerce, internal politics, diplomacy, technological development, and military forces of a nation. Paradox Interactive games are also characteristically complex, with highly detailed gameplay models and consequently steep learning curves.
bju2og.zh: 该工作室制作其称之为「大战略游戏」的作品，即那些在真实世界地图上进行的游戏，以使用标准实时要素为特征，但同时具备在暂停时（以及未暂停时）做出任何与所有改动的能力。几乎所有 Paradox 游戏都采用历史背景，并表现出对历史准确性的合理坚持。每款游戏的重点各不相同，但总体而言，玩家必须管理一个国家的经济、商业、内政、外交、科技发展与军事力量。Paradox Interactive 的游戏还具有典型的复杂性，拥有高度细致的玩法模型，因而学习曲线陡峭。

s4g8r1.en: After action reports, usually abbreviated as AARs on the forums, provide a way for players to discuss their own gameplay in unique ways with other players. AARs are reports written by players about their experiences with a game, ranging in style from simple presentations of the development of the game with screenshots to highly embellished character-driven stories only loosely based on the events in the game. They are generally serialized in a forum topic, with every update post corresponding to a period of gameplay, and with comments and suggestions made by readers between updates.
s4g8r1.zh: 战后报告在论坛上通常缩写为 AAR，为玩家提供了一种以独特方式与其他玩家讨论自己玩法的方式。AAR 是玩家就其游戏体验所写的报告，风格从简单展示游戏进程配以截图，到高度修饰、以角色为驱动、仅松散基于游戏内事件的故事，各有不同。它们通常在某个论坛主题中连载，每一条更新帖对应一段游戏进程，读者则在更新之间发表评论与建议。

1rchm1p.en: The games are mostly based on an open game engine sandbox-style game with no set "victory" condition. Paradox tries to make games that are open and easy to edit (moddable), from tweaking a saved game to creating an entirely new scenario. Modding can be accomplished with simple tools and basic knowledge of scripting. To assist modders to figure out how to edit the game on their own, the Paradox forums provide fan-compiled libraries of "how to" advice. Due to this, each game has a very large number of mods, ranging from minor additions to complete system overhauls.
1rchm1p.zh: 这些游戏大多基于开放的游戏引擎，采用沙盒式玩法，没有设定的「胜利」条件。Paradox 力图让游戏保持开放且易于编辑（可模组化），从微调存档到创建全新剧本皆可。模组制作只需简单工具与基础脚本知识即可完成。为帮助模组作者自行弄清如何编辑游戏，Paradox 论坛提供了玩家汇编的「如何做」建议库。正因如此，每款游戏都有数量极其庞大的模组，从微小增补到完整系统重做不等。

1j1ajza.en: ⟦0⟧ Interactive is a Swedish video game publisher based in Stockholm that is known for publishing historical strategy computer games. It publishes its own games (developed by Paradox Development Studio) as well as other developers' through traditional retail channels as well as digital distribution services, such as Steam or Gamersgate. The lead game programmer is Johan Andersson.
1j1ajza.zh: ⟦0⟧ Interactive 是一家总部位于斯德哥尔摩的瑞典电子游戏发行商，以发行历史策略电脑游戏而闻名。它既发行自己的游戏（由 Paradox Development Studio 开发），也通过传统零售渠道以及 Steam、Gamersgate 等数字发行服务发行其他开发者的游戏。首席游戏程序员是 Johan Andersson。

1gwy6um.en: Paradox regularly releases patches to their games long after a game's initial release. Some games have required patches shortly after release to make them playable. Later patches may contain large changes to the game and the way the game is played, in response to the demands and requests of fans.
1gwy6um.zh: Paradox 会在游戏初次发布很久之后定期为其发布补丁。有些游戏需要在发布后不久打补丁才能游玩。较晚的补丁可能包含对游戏及游玩方式的重大改动，以回应粉丝的要求与请求。

f4el3a.en: Realistic repartriation of industry - revolving around historical figures rather than Vanilla's "playbility" design decision. This was done by translating the concept of "war potential" for each 1936 country and translating into ingame industry (civilian, military and dockyard). This results in the major powes having more than 90% of the world's IC with the gap between the last major power (Italy) and the first (the USA) being more than 1 to 10. Each vanilla IC is equivalent to 8 in the mod to have a more accurate repartition.
f4el3a.zh: 真实的工业再分配——围绕历史人物而非原版「可玩性」设计决策来构建。其做法是把每个 1936 年国家的「战争潜力」概念转换并落实为游戏内工业（民用、军用与船坞）。这导致主要强国拥有超过世界 90% 的工业产能，而最后一个主要强国（意大利）与第一个（美国）之间的差距超过一比十。模组中每个原版工业产能相当于 8 点，以实现更准确的再分配。

j7y61q.en: Ultra Historical Mod - Realism Overhaul is a project which aims to implement historical industry into Hearts of Iron IV. It implements major industrial balance changes, including a historial repatriation of industry using secondary sources such as The Wages of Destruction from Adam Tooze and The Rise and Fall of the Great Powers by Paul Kennedy among others. Over time, it has evolved into a more ambitious project - implementing dedicated unique tank and aircraft trees, infantry squad designer and overhauls the combat system.
j7y61q.zh: Ultra Historical Mod - Realism Overhaul 是一个旨在把历史工业纳入《钢铁雄心 4》的项目。它实施了重大工业平衡改动，包括借助二手资料进行历史性的工业再分配，例如亚当·图兹的《毁灭的代价》与保罗·肯尼迪的《大国的兴衰》等。随着时间推移，它已发展为一个更为雄心勃勃的项目——加入专门的独特坦克与飞机树、步兵班设计器，并重做战斗系统。

n4p4ah.en: Realistic resource deposits and production - with coal, iron and bauxite being introduced. Resources are less expensive to now trade for (resulting in less overpowered minors and majors having to trade half than industry away).

With the current weakness of the Dutch government, they surely would not dare refuse our kind offer of 'aiding' them in the defense of the islands...

1czwape.en: Now, should the British Raj stall for a bit, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a fascist advisor. Yes, I know, going fascist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for fascist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent fascist support, so hold a referendum to become fascist. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids. Otherwise, if your manpower is still an issue you can go communist to get to the weekly manpower army experience. Since Indian states have an abundance of population, this would not be a problem.
1czwape.zh: 现在，如果英属印度拖延一阵，你首先应当做的是选取第一个政治焦点，它会给你 120 政治点数，加上你已经积累的 70。用它聘用一位法西斯顾问。是的，我知道，走法西斯基本上是每个小国的首选策略，但如果它有效，那就是有效。在你等待法西斯支持度上升的同时，选取一些工业焦点以获得一些免费工厂。先拿两座免费民用工厂，然后拿三座军用工厂。到这时你的法西斯支持度应当已超过百分之五十，所以举行公投以成为法西斯。用你多余的政治点数实行战争经济，如果还有多余的，就选取「改善工人条件」或反共/民主突袭。否则，如果你的人力仍是问题，你可以转为共产主义以获得每周陆军人力的陆军经验。由于印度各州人口充裕，这不会是问题。

jmtraf.en: The Holwell Monument agitation was a political campaign led by Subhas Chandra Bose in 1940 to remove a monument to the Black Hole of Calcutta (now Kolkata). The agitation marked a significant moment of unity between Hindu nationalists and the All-India Muslim League. On 2 July 1940, Subhas Chandra Bose was arrested under the Defence of India Act of 1939 for calling for a Siraj-ud-Daulah Day coinciding with the 183rd anniversary of the latter's execution by Mir Jafar under orders from the East India Company. To prevent further agitation, Bengal Governor John Herbert quietly dismantled the monument. After a seven-day hunger strike, Bose was moved from the city's Presidency Jail to house arrest on 5 December, at which point he escaped to Nazi Germany, never to return to India.
jmtraf.zh: 霍尔韦尔纪念碑运动是苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯于 1940 年领导的一场政治运动，旨在移除一座纪念「加尔各答黑洞」（今加尔各答）的纪念碑。该运动标志着印度教民族主义者与全印穆斯林联盟团结的重要时刻。1940 年 7 月 2 日，苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯因号召把西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉被米尔·贾法尔奉东印度公司之命处决的 183 周年纪念日定为「西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉日」，而依 1939 年《印度国防法》被捕。为防止运动进一步扩大，孟加拉总督约翰·赫伯特悄悄拆除了该纪念碑。在绝食七天后，鲍斯于 12 月 5 日从该市总统监狱被转为软禁，此时他逃往纳粹德国，再未返回印度。

1jy8ll7.en: The "Indian Partisans", despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is almost unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. In order to play as early as the Indian Partisans, is to play first as the British Raj and go with the Onto the road of Independence focus path. In this case, rush and take the League against Gandhism, Forward Bloc and finally Protest Against The Holwell Monument. As the British Raj has been destabilized further, use console commands to switch to the "Indian Partisans" tag to play as them. Usually, Indian Partisans start in east Indian cores, and at various times in the middle of Indian cores.
1jy8ll7.zh: 「印度游击队员」尽管是游戏内的一个「国家」，但按铁人选择它几乎无法游玩，所以玩家玩该国唯一的好处就是使用控制台命令。要尽早以印度游击队员游玩，就要先以英属印度游玩并走「走上独立之路」焦点路线。在这种情况下，速推并依次选取「反甘地主义联盟」、「前进集团」，最后是「抗议霍尔韦尔纪念碑」。由于英属印度已被进一步动摇，用控制台命令切换到「印度游击队员」tag 来以它们游玩。通常，印度游击队员开局位于印度东部核心，有时也位于印度中部核心。

1fvap0f.en: At this point, you should've flipped fascist already, so start justifying on Bhutan. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Be sure to go for naval factories, and make submarines for naval invasions. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Should you declare on Tibet, Nepal, Burma or god forbid, India and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources.
1fvap0f.zh: 到这时，你应当已经转为法西斯了，所以开始对不丹制造战争目标。同时开始做政治焦点。务必争取海军工厂，并建造潜艇用于海军登陆。制作一个只有一个骑兵单位的编制，并大量生产。到这时你也应当拥有相当多的政治点数，所以采取一些提高稳定度的决议。如果你对西藏、尼泊尔、缅甸，或者——但愿不要——对印度宣战并战胜它们，每一场都能给你足够的扩张空间，以及获取一些宝贵资源与通道的机会。

4cm765.en: By now you should have a total of 4 or 5 factories- 2 civilian and 3 military, more or less, depending on what core that you start in. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.
4cm765.zh: 到这时你应当总共拥有 4 或 5 座工厂——2 座民用与 3 座军用，多少取决于你在哪个核心开局。你的一座民用工厂将用于消费品，所以用剩下那座来建造更多民用工厂，或换取一些钢。用你 3 座军用工厂中的一座生产火炮，另 2 座生产枪械。等你获得更多军用工厂后，也安排一些工厂生产支援装备。

7u61ry.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable "country" that can appear inside the ⟦1⟧. It appears via decisions after completing the Protest Against The Holwell Monument national focus, or as a result of an event-chain following foreign occupation of ⟦2⟧ territory if it has the ⟦3⟧ national spirit and ⟦4⟧ is enabled.
7u61ry.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个可释放的「国家」，可以出现在⟦1⟧内部。它在完成「抗议霍尔韦尔纪念碑」国策后通过决议出现，或者在⟦2⟧领土被外国占领后的事件链中作为结果出现——前提是它拥有⟦3⟧国家精神且启用了⟦4⟧。

1iv4rw3.en: ⟦0⟧ starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.

tong0o.en: AI weights on hiring advisors now makes more sense. You should see a better split between political advisors & research bureaus, and the AI no longer saves all PP for hiring chiefs at the exclusion of all else. [This has a pretty radical effect on early AI build-up, thus there may be some imbalance in the early game in this open beta - feedback especially welcome]
tong0o.zh: 聘用顾问的 AI 权重现在更合理了。你应当会看到政治顾问与研究机构之间更合理的分配，AI 也不再为了聘用参谋长而把所有政治点数都存起来、不顾其他一切。[这对 AI 前期扩张有相当激进的影响，因此这次公开测试中前期可能出现一些失衡——特别欢迎反馈]

1wpc53j.en: Cohesion settings should no longer result in unit clumping for the AI, and provide a much more stable frontline situation for all orders with less relocation, but may have slightly more overall movement than before. [GD note: from a design perspective, cohesion now works significantly better than previously; feedback particularly appreciated here]
1wpc53j.zh: 凝聚力设置不应再导致 AI 单位聚集，并为所有命令提供更稳定的前线态势、更少的重新调动，但总体移动量可能比之前略多。[GD 注：从设计角度看，凝聚力现在比之前明显更好地运作；特别感谢这方面的反馈]

7ijmj4.en: Increased base point calculation for winners in peace conference by 10% of base. This should result in fewer instances where original countries are left around. Several cost modifiers have been altered which should also result in it being slightly less expensive to make full demands in ordinary circumstances.
7ijmj4.zh: 把和平会议中胜利者的基础点数计算提高了基础的 10%。这应当会减少原国家被遗留下来的情况。若干花费修正也已被调整，这也应当使通常情况下的完全索求稍微便宜一些。

1o46n9j.en: Canadian Focuses 'National Steel Car' and 'Send in the Zombies' are no longer mutually exclusive. If Great Depression has already been removed, the focus on "War Fuelled Economy" and "Reactivate the Farmers Unity League" will grant a significant temporary construction speed boost.
1o46n9j.zh: 加拿大焦点「国家钢铁车」与「派出僵尸」不再互斥。如果「大萧条」已被移除，焦点「战争驱动的经济」与「重启农民团结联盟」将给予可观的临时建造速度加成。

fjj7a2.en: Peace Conference AI is now slightly more self-aware about contested bids. They will early-out of contests in some cases as an effort to reduce point wastage and to create more cohesive borders. Several defines added to control this behaviour. [Iterative change #2]
fjj7a2.zh: 和平会议 AI 现在对争夺性出价稍微更有自觉。它们在某些情况下会提前退出争夺，以减少点数浪费并创造更完整连贯的边界。新增了若干 defines 来控制这一行为。[迭代改动 #2]

18dv3c6.en: Focus Topple Amhara Rulers will no longer be available if ideology is not Fascist or Non-Aligned. The Ethiopian characters that become the country leaders of their respective puppet countries will become the leaders of both Fascist and Non-Aligned ideologies.
18dv3c6.zh: 如果意识形态不是法西斯或中立，焦点「推翻阿姆哈拉统治者」将不再可用。成为各自傀儡国国家领袖的埃塞俄比亚角色，将成为法西斯与中立两种意识形态的领袖。

1tb5kgu.en: Civil war can get complicated regarding characters. Add keep_all_characters parameter to start_civil_war effect. Target country will keep all characters, none will be transfered to revolter. It's then up to script to do the full dispatch of the characters.
1tb5kgu.zh: 内战在角色方面可能变得复杂。为 start_civil_war 效果添加 keep_all_characters 参数。目标国家将保留所有角色，不会有任何角色转移给叛乱方。之后由脚本来完成角色的完整分配。

1n5u67t.en: If Italy declines Germany's offer to assassinate Mussolini, Germany won't be able to ignore that rejection and go ahead with the assassination anyways. Also, if the Balance of Power is active for Italy, Mussolini's side will be switched out to the King's.
1n5u67t.zh: 如果意大利拒绝德国暗杀墨索里尼的提议，德国将无法无视这一拒绝并照样执行暗杀。此外，如果意大利的力量平衡处于启用状态，墨索里尼一方将被换成国王一方。

fvtuy8.en: Further Peace Conference AI balance changes, unaligned nations will now mostly embrace Empire, and take land for themselves. England now has a slight preference for coastal regions. AI is slightly less keen on multi-puppeting in multi-faction scenarios
fvtuy8.zh: 进一步的和平会议 AI 平衡改动：中立国家现在大多会拥抱帝国，并为自己夺取土地。英格兰现在对沿海地区略有偏好。在多阵营局面中，AI 对多头傀儡化的兴趣略有下降

3150qt.en: Cohesion settings should no longer cause some units to refuse to move to the frontline, however units may relocate somewhat further if they drop behind a swift advance. Incidentally fixed idle unit recognition for army group orders.
3150qt.zh: 凝聚力设置不应再导致某些单位拒绝移动到前线，但如果单位在快速推进中掉队，它们可能会移动得稍远一些。顺带修复了集团军命令中空闲单位的识别问题。

1f8x20l.en: Removing all the BoP requirements for the alt fascist branches; no other branch has such requirements, and it is very punishing if the player loses a core state to reach to necessary BoP levels to proceed down the alt fascist branch
1f8x20l.zh: 移除了替代法西斯分支的所有力量平衡要求；没有其他分支有这样的要求，而且如果玩家丢掉一个核心州、无法达到继续走替代法西斯分支所需的力量平衡水平，惩罚非常严厉

195t968.en: Fascist Canada now has the choice to offer concessions to the United Kingdom in return for Labrador and Newfoundland, which will be more likely to be accepted. Tooltips added for conditions leading to higher success chances.
195t968.zh: 法西斯加拿大现在可以选择向联合王国让出利益，以换取拉布拉多与纽芬兰，而这一提议被接受的几率也更高了。为带来更高成功几率的条件添加了提示框。

127ga38.en: Added a new alt-history branch to Canada's Communist path, allowing further reduction of the Great Depression, wargoals on the United States, and various other benefits, at the cost of being unable to join or create factions
127ga38.zh: 为加拿大的共产主义路线添加了一个新的替代历史分支，允许进一步削减大萧条、获得对美国的战争目标以及各种其他好处，代价是无法加入或创建阵营

1djlg37.en: Fix crash when using add_advisor_role on a character with already a role in the same slot. Add a log error if trying to put triggers and on_action in the advisor role in add_advisor_role, those can only work if in database.
1djlg37.zh: 修复了在同一槽位中已有职务的角色上使用 add_advisor_role 时的崩溃。如果在 add_advisor_role 的顾问职务中加入触发器与 on_action，则添加一条日志错误——那些只有在数据库中才能生效。

4tefu1.en: Hooked up the already existing historical and generic plane variant names to the corresponding BBA plane types, leaving only plane types without a non-BBA equivalent without proper variant names (we'll get there soon).
4tefu1.zh: 把已有的历史与通用飞机变型名称挂接到对应的 BBA 飞机类型上，只剩那些没有非 BBA 对应类型的飞机类型还没有合适的变型名称（我们很快会处理）。

s1h63r.en: Added a requirement for capital to be a core state when inviting members to the Organization of African Unity. This prevents countries like Belgium being eligible when they capitulate and move their capital to Africa.
s1h63r.zh: 在邀请成员加入非洲统一组织时，新增了首都必须为核心州的要求。这防止了像比利时这样的国家在投降并把首都迁到非洲后仍然符合资格。

13ohq8m.en: Bulgaria: National Railway Lines now take 35 days, from 70. Added two mutually exclusive focuses after this, choosing between exploiting aluminium resources (16 Aluminium) or natural gold deposits (stability + civ)
13ohq8m.zh: 保加利亚：国家铁路线现在需要 35 天，此前为 70 天。在此之后新增了两个互斥焦点，在开采铝资源（16 铝）与天然金矿（稳定度 + 民用工厂）之间选择

1ht7o6d.en: From now on, any trigger or effect, strictly requiring a country scope, but used in all_character, any_character, random_character, every_character, party_leader, characters_list_tooltip, will not work anymore
1ht7o6d.zh: 从现在起，任何严格需要国家作用域、却被用于 all_character、any_character、random_character、every_character、party_leader、characters_list_tooltip 中的触发器或效果都将不再生效

k09xbj.en: Air accident base chance increased from 0.05 to 0.1, accident chance multiplier increased from 0.5 to 1, accident effect multiplier increased from 0.005 to 0.01 ace death chance increased from 0.003 to 0.005
k09xbj.zh: 空难基础几率从 0.05 提高到 0.1，事故几率乘数从 0.5 提高到 1，事故效果乘数从 0.005 提高到 0.01，王牌死亡几率从 0.003 提高到 0.005

135lnpi.en: Fix add_ideas and activate_advisor effects. When applied to a slot that is already filled, dismiss the currently appointed advisor before hiring the new one. Will fix crash when opening Officer corps after.
135lnpi.zh: 修复 add_ideas 与 activate_advisor 效果。当应用于已被占用的槽位时，在聘用新顾问之前先解雇当前任命的顾问。这将修复之后打开军官团时的崩溃。

1cl64vb.en: If the pope - or anyone else BUT the King Vittorio III - is country leader, don't make Prince Umberto the new country leader. Also add King Vittorio back as an idea if the Balance of Power is in his favour
1cl64vb.zh: 如果国家领袖是教宗——或除国王维托里奥三世之外的任何其他人——就不要把翁贝托亲王设为新的国家领袖。此外，如果力量平衡对他有利，就把国王维托里奥作为理念加回来

1wkvkp7.en: Several ai modifiers have been added to the 'Protect Czechoslovakia' triggered event in the Hungarian focus tree, and a tooltip has been added to indicate what you can do to make it more likely to succeed
1wkvkp7.zh: 为匈牙利国策树中「保护捷克斯洛伐克」触发事件添加了若干 AI 修正，并添加了一个提示框，说明你可以做什么来提高其成功几率

18ujpiw.en: Minors and Puppets will now go back to trying to support their faction members with warscore, rather than striking out on their own. Silesia and Kashubia are now considered unlikely tags to be released.
18ujpiw.zh: 小国与傀儡国现在会重新尝试用战争分数支援其阵营成员，而不是自行其是。西里西亚与卡舒比亚现在被视为不太可能被释放的 tag。

h6l3bo.en: Fix OOS involving interception missions targeting an enemy airwing that's passing through a region, where both the enemy's mission region and the interception region updates on the same hourly tick.
h6l3bo.zh: 修复了一个不同步问题：拦截任务以一支正在穿越某地区的敌方航空队为目标时，敌方任务地区与拦截地区在同一小时刻更新。

yeupqk.en: Patch 1.12.6, aka "Operation Tungsten", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2022-11-11⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2022-11-24⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
yeupqk.zh: 补丁 1.12.6，又名「钨石行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2022-11-11⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2022-11-24⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

1d1lnwh.en: Hungary's Support Urbanization focus now grants one civilian factory in addition to the three building slots. Institute for Industrial Techniques now requires one of the prerequisites, not both.
1d1lnwh.zh: 匈牙利的「支持城市化」焦点现在除三个建筑槽位外还给予一座民用工厂。「工业技术研究所」现在只需要两个前置条件之一，而非两者都要。

3cflwj.en: Patch 1.12.12, aka "Operation Cockpit", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2023-04-06⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2023-04-12⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
3cflwj.zh: 补丁 1.12.12，又名「座舱行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2023-04-06⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2023-04-12⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

1evsus1.en: Patch 1.12.8, aka "Operation Capital", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2022-12-21⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2023-01-16⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
1evsus1.zh: 补丁 1.12.8，又名「首都行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2022-12-21⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2023-01-16⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

vuyl0c.en: Patch 1.12.7, aka "Operation Source", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2022-12-02⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2022-12-08⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
vuyl0c.zh: 补丁 1.12.7，又名「源头行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2022-12-02⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2022-12-08⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

1t8nzy2.en: Patch 1.12.10, aka "Operation Sabre", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2023-02-02⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2023-02-15⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
1t8nzy2.zh: 补丁 1.12.10，又名「军刀行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2023-02-02⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2023-02-15⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

17tx8to.en: Patch 1.12.13, aka "Operation Alpha", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2023-05-05⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2023-05-16⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
17tx8to.zh: 补丁 1.12.13，又名「阿尔法行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2023-05-05⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2023-05-16⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

7w3jl6.en: Patch 1.12.11, aka "Operation Pike", was released as an open beta patch as part of the ⟦0⟧ patches on 2023-03-02⟦1⟧. It was officially out of open beta on 2023-03-09⟦2⟧ with the checksum ⟦3⟧.
7w3jl6.zh: 补丁 1.12.11，又名「长矛行动」，作为⟦0⟧补丁的一部分于 2023-03-02⟦1⟧作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2023-03-09⟦2⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦3⟧。

1chx1xx.en: AI peace conference beahviour changed significantly when taking land for themselves. This is now much mroe distance based, and should result in more cohesive borders. [Iterative change #1]
1chx1xx.zh: AI 和平会议在为自己夺取土地时的行为发生了显著变化。现在这更多基于距离，应当会带来更完整连贯的边界。[迭代改动 #1]

1pjqx7m.en: Switzerland no longer gets "Breach of Neutrality" event when the Absolute Neutrality category is not present or when the hostile country is in a faction while not being the faction leader.
1pjqx7m.zh: 当「绝对中立」类别不存在，或当敌对国属于某阵营但不是阵营领袖时，瑞士不再触发「违反中立」事件。

5erbdr.en: Fixed an issue in the Pressure Government event chain for Italy and the Soviets in which the feedback event communicating the target's choice was sent to the target instead of the sender.
5erbdr.zh: 修复了意大利与苏联「施压政府」事件链中的一个问题：用于传达目标所选选项的反馈事件被发送给了目标，而不是发送者。

13xd40d.en: Added a new option when releasing nations. You can now choose to retain states upon which you have cores. Retained cores can still be returned to the puppet through the occupation menu.
13xd40d.zh: 释放国家时新增了一个选项。你现在可以选择保留你拥有核心的州。保留下来的核心仍可通过占领菜单归还给傀儡国。

sfyg05.en: SHIP_TO_FLEET_ANTI_AIR_RATIO increased from 0.2 to 0.25, ANTI_AIR_POW_ON_INCOMING_AIR_DAMAGE increased from 0.2 to 0.25, ANTI_AIR_MULT_ON_INCOMING_AIR_DAMAGE increased from 0.15 to 0.2
sfyg05.zh: SHIP_TO_FLEET_ANTI_AIR_RATIO 从 0.2 提高到 0.25，ANTI_AIR_POW_ON_INCOMING_AIR_DAMAGE 从 0.2 提高到 0.25，ANTI_AIR_MULT_ON_INCOMING_AIR_DAMAGE 从 0.15 提高到 0.2

1efbt7s.en: Scrambled carrier airwings that can perform naval strike or kamikaze mission will prioritize them over air superiority and interception unless they are fighter or interceptor airwings.
1efbt7s.zh: 紧急起飞的、能够执行海军打击或神风任务的航母航空队将优先执行这些任务，而非制空与拦截——除非它们是战斗机或截击机航空队。

1fqo3fo.en: Fixed issue with Italian Occupation of Ethiopia decision category preventing decisions related to electrify states from showing up if Ethiopia had capitulated before going into exile.
1fqo3fo.zh: 修复了意大利占领埃塞俄比亚决议类别的一个问题：如果埃塞俄比亚在流亡之前就已投降，会导致与电气化各州相关的决议无法显示。

117bbl1.en: Ivan Smirnov, Ivar Smilga and Aleksander Shlyapnikov now gets released out of prison if they are still alive and hasn't been released yet when completing Return Democracy to the party
117bbl1.zh: 伊万·斯米尔诺夫、伊瓦尔·斯米尔加与亚历山大·什利亚普尼科夫如果仍然在世且尚未被释放，在完成「把民主还给党」时现在会被释放出狱

akrzvm.en: Ethiopian states will go to the fascist side of the Italian civil war if Italy is still fighting a war in Ethiopia when the focus Defy the Duce is completed and the civil war starts.
akrzvm.zh: 如果在完成焦点「违抗领袖」并爆发内战时，意大利仍在埃塞俄比亚作战，埃塞俄比亚各州将归于意大利内战的法西斯一方。

t9zzmq.en: Hungarian Aluminium production is balanced between Transdanubia and Northern Hungary. Added 1 excavation decision to improve Transdanubian bauxite production, requiring excavation II
t9zzmq.zh: 匈牙利的铝产量在外多瑙与北匈牙利之间取得平衡。新增 1 个开采决议以改善外多瑙的铝土矿生产，需要开采 II

5d91na.en: Fixed issue with Italy completing two mutually exclusive focuses when failing on mussolini's missions to conquer North/South Ethiopia and withdrawing from Ethiopia at the same time.
5d91na.zh: 修复了意大利在未能完成墨索里尼征服北/南埃塞俄比亚的任务、同时又从埃塞俄比亚撤军时，会完成两个互斥焦点的问题。

sqxsn9.en: You can no longer use the exploit of leaving a minor DEI island free while you gobble up the rest of the resource giving island as Germany and expect Japan to just be fine with it
sqxsn9.zh: 作为德国，你不再能利用留下一个荷属东印度小岛不管、同时吞并其余产资源岛屿、还指望日本对此无所谓的漏洞

2cm64a.en: Add can_be_fired boolean flag in advisor role block in database. If at 'no', then the advisor can't be fired once hired. Warning modders : completely replaces removal_cost = -1 !
2cm64a.zh: 在数据库的顾问职务块中新增 can_be_fired 布尔标志。如果为「否」，则顾问一旦被聘用就无法被解雇。模组作者警告：它会完全取代 removal_cost = -1 ！

1w18nbh.en: Events and focuses which invite all un-faction-ed countries of a specific ideology to a faction will no longer target subjects (this affects Spain and the Soviet Union currently)
1w18nbh.zh: 邀请某特定意识形态所有未加入阵营的国家加入阵营的事件与焦点将不再以附属国为目标（这目前影响西班牙与苏联）

soupp0.en: Australian focus 'Naval Auxiliary Patrol' now grants 5% core defence factor, from 3%, and 10% naval experience gain (new). Experience gain from naval focuses increased slightly.
soupp0.zh: 澳大利亚焦点「海军辅助巡逻」现在给予 5% 核心防御系数，此前为 3%，并给予 10% 海军经验获取（新增）。海军焦点提供的经验获取略有提高。

1o1q6qt.en: Certain political branches in the Italian Focus Tree will now hide if they are no longer relevant when custom game rule "Show obsolete branches in Focus Tree" is set to "Hide".
1o1q6qt.zh: 当自定义游戏规则「在国策树中显示过时分支」设为「隐藏」时，意大利国策树中某些政治分支如果不再相关，现在会被隐藏。

1viarcl.en: Italy is now sending the right events to the UK if the UK is hosting the Ethiopian government in exile and Italy has war with them. Also added conditions to 2 Italian focuses
1viarcl.zh: 如果英国正在收容埃塞俄比亚流亡政府且意大利与之处于战争状态，意大利现在会向英国发送正确的事件。此外为 2 个意大利焦点添加了条件

nudckf.en: Basic Medium chassis now 1938 tech, amphibious tank now unlocked only by 1936 light, tank armour tech dates are now 36,38,41,44, amphibious tank no longer gets medium turrets
nudckf.zh: 基础中型底盘现在是 1938 年科技，两栖坦克现在仅由 1936 年轻型解锁，坦克装甲科技年份现在是 36、38、41、44，两栖坦克不再获得中型炮塔

1bq2bfr.en: Added bypasses to several German focuses if Germany is already in a faction and is not the faction leader; they shouldn't be able to invite other countries into the Faction
1bq2bfr.zh: 如果德国已在某阵营中且不是阵营领袖，为若干德国焦点添加了跳过；它们不应能够邀请其他国家加入该阵营

1nj8ry2.en: Added a new focus for Australia, 'Coordinate Central Bureau', which adds 2 signal company research/ahead of time bonuses, and a decryption bonus if La Resistance is owned.
1nj8ry2.zh: 为澳大利亚新增了一个焦点「协调中央调查局」，它给予 2 次通信连研究/提前研究加成，如果拥有《抵抗运动》还给予解密加成。

19fh0xz.en: Gave the AI an extra layer of though process behind taking states in peace conferences. Added several key areas of interest, and reduced their general interest elsewhere.
19fh0xz.zh: 为 AI 在和平会议中夺取州的决策背后增加了一层思考过程。新增了若干关键利益区域，并降低了它们在其他地方的一般兴趣。

7z3sv8.en: Taking occupied states in peace conferences is now considerably cheaper. AI is less likely to contest unoccupied states (though they still will if they have good reasons)
7z3sv8.zh: 在和平会议中夺取被占领的州现在便宜得多。AI 不太可能争夺未被占领的州（不过如果有充分理由它们仍会争夺）

1pz2ems.en: Re-introduced many tank icons for most countries that were screwed by No Step Back. Tank icons in the non-NSB generic tree will now appear in the Tank Designer with NSB.
1pz2ems.zh: 为大多数被《绝不后退》搞坏的国家重新引入了许多坦克图标。非 NSB 通用国策树中的坦克图标现在会在启用 NSB 时出现在坦克设计器中。

yp9xt.en: When retrieving a list of equipment icons or 3D models from the equipment graphic_db to display in the tank or plane designer any duplicate entries will now be removed.
yp9xt.zh: 从装备 graphic_db 中获取装备图标或 3D 模型列表以在坦克或飞机设计器中显示时，现在会移除任何重复条目。

1pmy26l.en: Fix create_operative_leader effect so that triggers with character scope using the resulting operative leaders work properly (ex: can_gain_xp in traits for operatives)
1pmy26l.zh: 修复 create_operative_leader 效果，使使用所生成特工领袖的角色作用域触发器能正常工作（例如：特工特质中的 can_gain_xp）

1n9arz0.en: Changed certain Italian Balance of Power Decisions from being available only one time to once a year. This should give players more leeway with the whole balancing act
1n9arz0.zh: 把某些意大利力量平衡决议从只能使用一次改为每年一次。这应当给玩家在整个平衡操作上更多余地

rrakm1.en: Turkey will no longer be able to ask again for investment to a country until the country has accepted the portfolio and finishes the decision to invest in Turkey.
rrakm1.zh: 在目标国接受投资组合并完成投资土耳其的决议之前，土耳其将无法再次请求向某国投资。

a7ymiv.en: Forming Byzantium without BftB will now appropriately grant cores on Constantinople and Amasya. Victory in Egypt and Tunis now requires and grants core on Cairo
a7ymiv.zh: 在没有 BftB 的情况下成立拜占庭现在会正确地给予君士坦丁堡与阿马西亚的核心。在埃及与突尼斯的胜利现在需要并给予开罗的核心

b07pml.en: Added bypass for Swiss Focus 'Trade Agreement with Germany' for when Germany is not fascist, and it will not be completed if Switzerland is at war with Germany
b07pml.zh: 为瑞士焦点「与德国签订贸易协定」在德国不是法西斯时添加了跳过，并且如果瑞士与德国处于战争状态，该焦点将不会完成

1lqerr2.en: Minor loc fix for concessions to monarchies for Switzerland. Used to say "Concessions to Swiss Monarchies", now "Concessions to X country (German)" Monarchies
1lqerr2.zh: 修复了瑞士向君主国让出利益的一处小型本地化问题。此前写作「向瑞士君主国让出利益」，现在写作「向 X 国（德国）君主国让出利益」

z2xwdm.en: Fixed issue in which Italian Aircraft Designer CRDA-CANT would require the wrong Naval Designer to be active. It now requires CRDA Naval Designer as intended.
z2xwdm.zh: 修复了意大利飞机设计师 CRDA-CANT 需要错误的海军设计师处于启用状态的问题。它现在按规定需要 CRDA 海军设计师。

dz3j7h.en: Losing non-cores as Italy will now only reduce BoP if the value is below 30% towards the Grand Council. Losing a core will now reduce 15% BoP instead of 20%.
dz3j7h.zh: 作为意大利，失去非核心现在只有在数值低于向大议会方向的 30% 时才会降低力量平衡。失去一个核心现在将降低 15% 力量平衡，而非 20%。

1hr3fs4.en: If a subject of Yugoslavia controls Dalmatia and Italy demands those states, Yugoslavia will get to decide the fate of those states - not the subject nation.
1hr3fs4.zh: 如果南斯拉夫的某附属国控制达尔马提亚，而意大利索要那些州，将由南斯拉夫——而非该附属国——决定那些州的命运。

1b18mjt.en: Fixed decisions to Offer Dodecanese Islands for Alliance so that they cannot be taken if Turkey or Greece are already in faction with Italy or are subjects.
1b18mjt.zh: 修复了「以群岛换同盟」决议，使其在土耳其或希腊已与意大利同阵营或为附属国时无法被选取。

1fkznk1.en: Grand Council of Fascism will now actually oust Kings or Christian Democrats in the form of the National Military Junta, if Balance of Power is low enough.
1fkznk1.zh: 如果力量平衡足够低，法西斯大议会现在会真正以国家军事委员会的形式罢黜国王或基督教民主党人。

e4aq92.en: Canadian focus 'Dollar-A-Year Men' now grants a national spirit with -33% political advisor cost. The exchange rate of dollars to political power is poor.
e4aq92.zh: 加拿大焦点「年薪一美元人士」现在给予一个国家精神，提供 -33% 政治顾问花费。美元与政治点数的汇率很差。

1y0fcf8.en: Fixed Italian Communist leader taking over the country when player chose democratic option in the Italian Civil War after completing focus Defy the Duce.
1y0fcf8.zh: 修复了在完成焦点「违抗领袖」后、玩家在意大利内战中选择了民主选项时，意大利共产主义领袖接管国家的问题。

qlb4tm.en: Fixed CTD when using console command "research all" and then interacting with the Kamikaze module Fixed Explosive Charge as any country other than Japan.
qlb4tm.zh: 修复了使用控制台命令「research all」后、再以日本之外的任何国家与神风模块「固定爆炸装药」交互时的崩溃。

115vteb.en: Ships transferred as part of a Peace Conference action no longer have crew included: ship experience is reduced to 25% of what it was before the transfer
115vteb.zh: 作为和平会议行动的一部分被转移的舰船不再包含船员：舰船经验被降低为转移前的 25%

jneres.en: Added one new Hungarian Focus to construct a new flagship, accelerating potential naval growth a bit. Admiral Horthy can now complete his transcendence.
jneres.zh: 新增了一个匈牙利焦点以建造一艘新的旗舰，略微加速潜在的海军增长。霍尔蒂海军上将现在可以完成他的超越。

1cva4hd.en: all countries will now build carrier aircraft if they have carriers, countries with low military factories are less likely to spend too much on fighters
1cva4hd.zh: 所有国家现在如果有航母就会建造舰载机，军用工厂较少的国家不太可能把过多资源花在战斗机上

xl13md.en: Fix potential OOS on hot-joining a second time without restarting the game, caused by erroneous reading of daily port strike limits from the savegame.
xl13md.zh: 修复了在不重启游戏的情况下第二次中途加入时潜在的不同步，其成因是从存档中错误读取每日港口打击上限。

1aq40fs.en: Lord Halifax now has two leader traits and reduces the requirements with the British Raj when forming the Imperial Federation/Commonwealth of Nations.
1aq40fs.zh: 哈利法克斯勋爵现在拥有两个领袖特质，并降低了成立帝国联邦/国家联邦时对英属印度的要求。

1irmbze.en: COMBAT_DAMAGE_SCALE_CARRIER returned to 5 was 1, NAVAL_STRIKE_DAMAGE_TO_STR decreased to 1 from 2, NAVAL_STRIKE_DAMAGE_TO_ORG decreased to 1.5 from 2
1irmbze.zh: COMBAT_DAMAGE_SCALE_CARRIER 恢复到 5，此前为 1，NAVAL_STRIKE_DAMAGE_TO_STR 从 2 降低到 1，NAVAL_STRIKE_DAMAGE_TO_ORG 从 2 降低到 1.5

j3zf1.en: Patch 1.12.4 was initially released as an open beta patch on 2022-10-14. It was officially out of open beta on 2022-10-18⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.
j3zf1.zh: 补丁 1.12.4 最初于 2022-10-14 作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2022-10-18⟦0⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦1⟧。

72gl6q.en: Patch 1.12.5 was initially released as an open beta patch on 2022-10-20. It was officially out of open beta on 2022-11-03⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.
72gl6q.zh: 补丁 1.12.5 最初于 2022-10-20 作为公开测试补丁发布。它于 2022-11-03⟦0⟧正式结束公开测试，校验和为⟦1⟧。

1x17ht8.en: Added conditions for entering peace talks between Italy and Ethiopia, as well as events, and loc, and other things concerning the peaxe conference.
1x17ht8.zh: 为意大利与埃塞俄比亚之间进入和平谈判添加了条件，以及事件、本地化，以及关于和平会议的其他内容。

ufv2yx.en: Indian focus 'British Army Support' now grants 2 uses of the 100% research bonus for support technology from 1 use, and 30 army experience, from 20
ufv2yx.zh: 印度焦点「英国陆军支援」现在给予 2 次支援科技 100% 研究加成的使用次数，此前为 1 次，并给予 30 陆军经验，此前为 20

9ef2ll.en: Focus tree screen will now properly refresh when something changes the display - like when the player chooses a branch and it hides the other ones.
9ef2ll.zh: 当有东西改变显示内容时——例如玩家选择某分支而它隐藏了其他分支——国策树界面现在会正确刷新。

1rcdw32.en: The Netherlands now bypasses either "Protect against Britain" or "Germany is the Greater Threat" if its in a faction with the country in question.
1rcdw32.zh: 如果荷兰与相关国家处于同一阵营，「防备英国」或「德国是更大的威胁」现在会被跳过。

1kttpo4.en: Fixed an instance where the Italian AI would always decline Ethiopian territorial expansions if Ethiopia went up to a satellite via the focus tree
1kttpo4.zh: 修复了如果埃塞俄比亚通过国策树升为卫星国、意大利 AI 总会拒绝埃塞俄比亚领土扩张的情况

14xsqlg.en: Italy will now be much less active on the French front for the first months of the war, unless France are losing badly, or Germany is under threat
14xsqlg.zh: 意大利在战争最初几个月在法国前线将远不如以前活跃，除非法国正节节败退，或德国受到威胁

158mgdt.en: Italian missions Conquer Northern Ethiopia and Conquer Southern Ethiopia should no longer fail if Ethiopia is defeated and puppeted while active.
158mgdt.zh: 意大利任务「征服北埃塞俄比亚」与「征服南埃塞俄比亚」在任务进行中埃塞俄比亚被击败并傀儡化时，不应再失败。

dtpxii.en: Switzerland: Added a few compliance bonuses in alt ideology branches to compensate for the big loss of compliance every time ideology is changed.
dtpxii.zh: 瑞士：在替代意识形态分支中新增了若干顺从度加成，以补偿每次意识形态改变时顺从度的大幅损失。

l95ptp.en: Tank Design: Secondary Cannon and HMG now have fewer drawbacks but higher production cost. HMG soft attack now 4, from 3, but hard attack removed
l95ptp.zh: 坦克设计：副炮与重机枪现在缺点更少但生产成本更高。重机枪软攻现在为 4，此前为 3，但移除了硬攻

zzw5vi.en: in peace conference, take navy peace action is now correctly unavailable if the victor does not own any naval base prior to the peace conference
zzw5vi.zh: 在和平会议中，如果胜利方在和平会议之前不拥有任何海军基地，「夺取海军」和平行动现在会正确地不可用

vucrxg.en: Fixed issue where variants created through focuses etc. would get unexpected modules and upgrades as a result of there being no default variant.
vucrxg.zh: 修复了通过焦点等途径创建的变型由于没有默认变型而获得意外模块与升级的问题。

z214r4.en: Fixed missing localization of equipment categories fighter and CAS, displayed in a naval combat tooltip and probably in a few other places too.
z214r4.zh: 修复了装备类别「战斗机」与「近距空中支援」缺失的本地化，它们会显示在海军战斗提示框中，大概也会出现在其他若干位置。

176197z.en: Carrier Naval strike multiplier increased, reduced naval strike detection chance from 0.7 to 0.5, reduced carrier disruption factor from 8 to 6
176197z.zh: 航母海军打击乘数提高，海军打击探测几率从 0.7 降低到 0.5，航母扰乱系数从 8 降低到 6

dkqmkn.en: Fixed issue where researching a new hull, chassis or airframe would not create the default variant if any variant of that type already existed.
dkqmkn.zh: 修复了研究新舰体、底盘或机体时，如果该类型已有任何变型，就不会创建默认变型的问题。

18wbflv.en: Italian Fiat 3000 and Fiat 3000B inter-war tanks will no longer be just hulls in the stockpile and will now show proper inter-war tank 2D icon.
18wbflv.zh: 意大利的菲亚特 3000 与菲亚特 3000B 战间期坦克将不再只是库存中的舰体，现在会显示正确的战间期坦克 2D 图标。

50qlq3.en: Resolved issue where it would appear as if the idea Swiss Neutrality was removed twice in the Swiss focuses 'Take a Stance' and 'Join France'.
50qlq3.zh: 解决了瑞士焦点「采取立场」与「加入法国」中理念「瑞士中立」看起来被移除两次的问题。

1gvpriy.en: When a player unlocks a mod achievement without having the cloud storage activated, catch the exception that was causing the game to shut down
1gvpriy.zh: 当玩家在未启用云存储的情况下解锁模组成就时，捕获此前导致游戏关闭的异常

4kbr.en: Reworked how ai_strategy unit_ratio is used to calculate and set build_airplane values. See common/ai_strategy/documentation.info for details.
4kbr.zh: 重做了 ai_strategy unit_ratio 用于计算与设置 build_airplane 数值的方式。详情见 common/ai_strategy/documentation.info。

1v2zv7.en: Timed peace stackables (resource rights + war reparations) now only cancel when at war with the receiver, rather than when at war with anyone.
1v2zv7.zh: 定时的和平可叠加项（资源权 + 战争赔款）现在只有在与接收方处于战争状态时才会取消，而非与任何人处于战争状态时都取消。

t1qd9m.en: Warscore contribution from lend leasing fuel and equipment roughly tripled. Warscore malus from receiving lendlease remains unchanged for now.
t1qd9m.zh: 租借燃料与装备带来的战争分数贡献大约增加了两倍。接收租借带来的战争分数惩罚目前保持不变。

15for7w.en: New variants received from auto-upgrades, focuses, events etc. are now highlighted in the production tab like variants received from research.
15for7w.zh: 通过自动升级、焦点、事件等获得的新变型现在会像通过研究获得的变型一样，在生产标签页中被高亮显示。

16h7qfk.en: Italy's Focus 'Negotiate Claims' will be bypassed if certain criteria is met. Certain events will also be skipped, if the criteria isn't met.
16h7qfk.zh: 如果满足某些条件，意大利焦点「谈判索取」将被跳过。如果条件不满足，某些事件也会被跳过。

9x47bq.en: Tooltips in Northern and Southern Italian designers now specify the need to complete the focus New Industrialization Program to improve them.
9x47bq.zh: 北意大利与南意大利设计器中的提示框现在会说明需要完成焦点「新工业化计划」来改进它们。

3nkszt.en: Australia has an additional shipyard focus. Each shipyard focus unlocks one of the naval designers, and naval designer traits are rebalanced.
3nkszt.zh: 澳大利亚新增了一个船坞焦点。每个船坞焦点解锁一名海军设计师之一，海军设计师特质也重新平衡。

qrdb6f.en: Iberian countries should no longer be rude and leave the Italian faction after deciding to join it via the Italian focus Iberian Protection.
qrdb6f.zh: 伊比利亚国家不应再无礼地在通过意大利焦点「伊比利亚保护」决定加入意大利阵营后又退出该阵营。

1jwplr5.en: Added property allow_without_tech to create_equipment_variant which will create the variant even if the technology it's based on is missing.
1jwplr5.zh: 为 create_equipment_variant 添加了属性 allow_without_tech，即使其所基于的科技缺失也会创建该变型。

1rqege6.en: Countries with a low war participation score will transfer all their Peace Score to other countries (can be disabled with custom game rules)
1rqege6.zh: 战争参与分数低的国家将把其全部和平分数转移给其他国家（可通过自定义游戏规则禁用）

sqtr99.en: The Balance of Power will now shift towards the country leader, and away from the Grand Council, when reclaiming lost, none core territory.
sqtr99.zh: 在收复失去的非核心领土时，力量平衡现在会向国家领袖倾斜，而远离大议会。

1ggyy0y.en: Pressure government decisions will no longer show up if the target country already has the same ideology and is in faction with the sender.
1ggyy0y.zh: 如果目标国已经拥有相同意识形态且与发送者同阵营，施压政府决议将不再显示。

1gezi6i.en: AI contesting other AIs in peace conferences should now resolve their conflicts based on a combination of relative power and map aesthetics
1gezi6i.zh: 在和平会议中与其他 AI 争夺的 AI 现在应当基于相对实力与地图美观度的组合来解决冲突

2a17vq.en: Equipment variants created through focuses etc. will be created first when the technology they are based on is researched, if it's missing.
2a17vq.zh: 通过焦点等创建的装备变型，如果其所基于的科技缺失，现在会在该科技被研究后首先创建。

vs7gi9.en: Divisional Commanders: XP requirements for level thresholds and for gaining an aptitude trait have been reduced across the board by 20-50%
vs7gi9.zh: 师级指挥官：等级门槛与获得资质特质的经验要求已全面降低 20-50%

gwjs19.en: Fixed wrong positioning of British focus "Embargo The Soviet Union" when hiding obsolete branches and Global Defense focus has been taken.
gwjs19.zh: 修复了在隐藏过时分支并已选取「全球防御」焦点时，英国焦点「对苏联禁运」位置错误的问题。

14egcyj.en: Paradrop orders without enough assigned transport wings now display how many wings are missing on the order instance (map arrow) tooltip.
14egcyj.zh: 未分配足够运输航空队的空降命令现在会在命令实例（地图箭头）提示框中显示缺少多少支航空队。

tbta54.en: Czech focus 'Equal Access Guarantee' no longer reduces heavy tank production cost, but reduces light tank production cost by 15%, from 5%
tbta54.zh: 捷克焦点「平等准入保障」不再降低重型坦克生产成本，而是把轻型坦克生产成本降低 15%，此前为 5%

jyuotm.en: New divisions spawned by Italian decision Train Irregulars will now spawn when the decision finishes instead of when the decision starts.
jyuotm.zh: 由意大利决议「训练非正规军」生成的新师现在会在决议结束时生成，而不是在决议开始时。

17mkjuk.en: Adjusted the time it takes for the incompetent Councilor to be assigned, made it so it wouldn't trigger once Switzerland is centralized.
17mkjuk.zh: 调整了不称职议员被任命所需的时间，并使其在瑞士完成中央集权后不再触发。

1egoct6.en: The capitulation of Germany will now make Republica Sociale Italiana to become free and take over the Axis if they were a German puppet.
1egoct6.zh: 德国投降现在将使意大利社会共和国获得自由，并在其原本是德国傀儡的情况下接管轴心国。

1wslp2p.en: Fixed issue in You Shall Not Pass Achievement making it available regardless of Switzerland winning a defensive war or an offensive one.
1wslp2p.zh: 修复了「你不得通过」成就的问题，该成就此前无论瑞士赢得的是一场防御战还是进攻战都可获得。

l2dhca.en: Indian focus 'Lions of the Great War' now provides 30 army experience. The spirit granted by this focus now also provides 5% war support
l2dhca.zh: 印度焦点「大战之狮」现在提供 30 陆军经验。该焦点给予的国家精神现在还提供 5% 战争支持度

10fmi2e.en: If Italy tries to join the Stresa Front and has any wargoals on a faction member, they will be removed before Italy can join the faction
10fmi2e.zh: 如果意大利试图加入斯特雷萨阵线且对某阵营成员拥有任何战争目标，这些战争目标将在意大利能够加入该阵营之前被移除

1gx2bvb.en: Forming the ottoman empire without BftB now grants a core on Cairo. Cairo is now required and cored for the respective decisions in BftB
1gx2bvb.zh: 在没有 BftB 的情况下成立奥斯曼帝国现在会给予开罗的核心。在 BftB 中，各相关决议现在需要开罗并给予其核心

1n46sau.en: When using a character token as input for a scope, search for the closest encapsulating country scope in order to interpret it correctly
1n46sau.zh: 把角色标记用作作用域输入时，搜索最接近的包含国家作用域以正确解释它

1l5liii.en: Changed 'Reclaiming Ethiopia' focus condition so that Ethiopa (or an ally) only needs to control any Ethiopian state to allow the focus
1l5liii.zh: 修改了「收复埃塞俄比亚」焦点条件，使埃塞俄比亚（或一个盟友）只需控制任意一个埃塞俄比亚州即可允许该焦点

11x90c.en: Added war escalation variable to Ethiopia when BBA is not enabled. Allows war escalation to continue functioning as expected for Italy.
11x90c.zh: 在未启用 BBA 时为埃塞俄比亚添加了战争升级变量。使战争升级对意大利能继续按预期运作。

9th9p2.en: Fixed issue where Citizen Militia Dynamic Modifiers were not properly removed from Switzerland when Militias are turned into regulars.
9th9p2.zh: 修复了当民兵被转为正规军时，公民民兵动态修正未被正确地从瑞士移除的问题。

1a3v9u7.en: Added tooltips in Swiss Focus Tree to notify when the Absolute Neutrality and Swiss Citizen Militia Decision Categories are disabled.
1a3v9u7.zh: 在瑞士国策树中添加了提示框，用于在「绝对中立」与「瑞士公民民兵」决议类别被禁用时进行通知。

gc7jsh.en: Fixed the event sent to France when Germany integrates Alsace-Lorraine to be sent to the Franco-British Union instead if that exists
gc7jsh.zh: 修复了德国整合阿尔萨斯-洛林时发送给法国的事件——如果法英联盟存在，应改为发送给法英联盟

16fldzy.en: Fix low probability CTD when a hull, chassis or airframe research completes and multiple equipment variants are auto-upgraded to it.
16fldzy.zh: 修复了舰体、底盘或机体研究完成且多个装备变型被自动升级到它时低概率崩溃的问题。

7itich.en: Medium and heavy batterys attack and peicing adjusted, bb and bc armour no longer increases visibility and have higher armour values
7itich.zh: 中型与重型炮组的攻击与穿透已调整，bb 与 bc 装甲不再增加可见度，并拥有更高的装甲值

ozffqe.en: Scaled the numbers of techs needed to complete the Faction Goal of "Develop Joint Research Practices" based on the average numbers of researched techs between the faction members when selecting the Faction Goal. The more techs the faction has when starting the Faction Goal, the less techs are required now.
ozffqe.zh: 在选择阵营目标时，根据阵营成员之间已研究科技的平均数量，调整了完成阵营目标「发展联合研究实践」所需科技的数量。阵营在开始该阵营目标时拥有的科技越多，现在所需的科技就越少。

mj9gm6.en: Added an 'immobile' cohesion setting, which turns off all automatic relocation for units attached to a battleplan. Planning speed is halved while using this setting. Shift+D hotkey will now open the cohesion menu in the battleplanning UI. (Arheo worked all night to get this in!)
mj9gm6.zh: 新增了一个「不可移动」凝聚力设置，它会关闭所有隶属于某作战计划的单位的自动调动。使用该设置时策划速度减半。Shift+D 热键现在会在作战计划界面中打开凝聚力菜单。（Arheo 通宵工作才把这个塞进去！）

4wf4zn.en: Multiple decisions for reducing the autonomy of the same warlord subject will no longer appear for China after taking the focus “Impair the Control Yuan”. Guangdong when becoming puppeted through the Liangguang incident will now also properly be targetable by those decisions.
4wf4zn.zh: 在选取焦点「削弱控制院」之后，中国不再出现多个用于降低同一个军阀附属国自治度的决议。在两次事件中通过两广事件成为傀儡国的广东，现在也能被那些决议正确设为目标。

xanax1.en: The Japanese focus “7075 Aluminium Alloy” now provides 5 aluminium in Osaka instead of 25% air breakthrough progress, and the focus “Develop New Fighters” now gives slightly bigger bonuses to air breakthrough and ahead of time penalty reduction for light planes.
xanax1.zh: 日本焦点「7075 铝合金」现在在大阪提供 5 铝，而非 25% 空中突破进度，而焦点「开发新型战斗机」现在为轻型飞机提供稍大的空中突破加成与提前研究惩罚减免。

8t8yqh.en: Fixed an issue where peaceful reunification could be sought even if not in a faction with the other side, an issue where Chen Mingshu would not properly become the democratic leader, and incorrect triggers for the focuses Subjugate Korea and Dare to Win
8t8yqh.zh: 修复了一个即使不与另一方同阵营也能寻求和平统一的问题、一个陈铭枢无法正确成为民主领袖的问题，以及焦点「征服朝鲜」与「敢于取胜」的触发器错误

887i8t.en: Turkey - Added two new starting ideas regarding the first five year plan and illiteracy. Added two new early-game focuses for utilising Sümerbank for more industry and tackling the illiteracy. Reduced the focus time for Ratify the Six Arrows to 35 days.
887i8t.zh: 土耳其——新增了两个关于第一个五年计划与文盲问题的开局理念。新增了两个早期焦点，分别用于利用苏美尔银行获得更多工业与解决文盲问题。把「批准六箭」的焦点时间缩短到 35 天。

16dgwvk.en: Fixed issues where Japan would keep the Potsdam Conference and National Defense State spirits after being puppeted, and made the US more likely to puppet Japan and less likely to force change their government when they surrender through their focus
16dgwvk.zh: 修复了日本在被傀儡化后仍会保留波茨坦会议与国防国家精神的问题，并使美国更有可能傀儡化日本、在其通过焦点投降时更不可能强行改变其政府

1ijyogw.en: A few fixes to ensure Chiang Kai Shek's wife becomes the country leader if he dies after completing “Denounce Feudalism” during the Liangguang incident etc, and fixed Hebei-Chahar being invited if the front was formed early through that chain.
1ijyogw.zh: 若干修复：确保蒋介石在完成「谴责封建主义」后于两广事件期间去世时，由其妻子成为国家领袖；并修复了如果通过该事件链提前成立阵线，河北-察哈尔会被邀请的问题。

t4x252.en: A Trotsky-harboring Mexico that hasn't invited him to the government and seeks to join the Comintern through the focus International Proletarianism will now send him to Moscow, instead of him forever being out of reach for the Soviets
t4x252.zh: 一个窝藏托洛茨基、却未邀请他入阁、并试图通过焦点「国际无产阶级主义」加入共产国际的墨西哥，现在会把他送往莫斯科，而不再让他永远对苏联遥不可及

xu9pgm.en: Tweaked German equipment production to better be in line with their templates, additionally improved decision making for: Convoy raiding, force concentration, and lend-leasing or selling equipment close to war breaking out
xu9pgm.zh: 调整了德国装备生产，使其更好地符合其编制，此外还改进了以下方面的决策：运输船队袭击、兵力集中，以及在战争即将爆发时租借或出售装备

17sz8kn.en: Yang Sen and Jamphel Yeshe Gyaltsen now start with country leader traits, and country leader swap for Qinghai Ma and the Sichuan Clique now properly preserve the country leader traits and roles for other ideology variants
17sz8kn.zh: 杨森与坚赞诺布现在开局拥有国家领袖特质，而青海马家与四川军阀的领袖替换现在会正确保留其他意识形态变型的国家领袖特质与职务

1jbnarn.en: Japanese Missile Submarine special project is now no longer incorrectly called "I-400-class Missile Submarine" - instead the "I-400 Submarine Carrier" name has been moved to the Japanese Carrier Submarine special project.
1jbnarn.zh: 日本导弹潜艇特殊项目不再被错误地称为「I-400 级导弹潜艇」——「I-400 潜艇母舰」这一名称已被移到日本航母潜艇特殊项目上。

1f45awr.en: Increased chance to hit for big guns by decreasing the maximum hit profile from 80 to 70. (Note: torpedo value is *not* changed from 100, this did get accidently changed in the open beta update, but has been reverted).
1f45awr.zh: 通过把最大命中轮廓从 80 降低到 70，提高了大口径火炮的命中几率。（注：鱼雷数值*没有*从 100 改动，它在公开测试更新中被意外改动过，现在已还原）。

u6g2ez.en: Added two new buildings,that provide scaling effects based on the infrastructure level - reduction of energy consumption or increased local resource gain efficiency. These Buildings are mutually exclusive in a state.
u6g2ez.zh: 新增了两座建筑，它们根据基础设施等级提供递进效果——降低能源消耗，或提高本地资源获取效率。这两座建筑在一个州内互斥。

1xxy98r.en: If Peace is accepted between China and Japan through the decision and subsequent events, truces are now also added with HBC and KUM and the Japanese AI will be less likely to attack and antagonise Chinese nations
1xxy98r.zh: 如果中国与日本通过决议及后续事件接受和平，现在也会与 HBC 和 KUM 添加停战，且日本 AI 将更不可能攻击和挑衅中国各国

1fbksx7.en: Fixed issues where certain countries intended to be able to form Central America and Gran Colombia weren't able to, and added Balta-Tiraspol as a target in all Greater Lithuania and Greater Commonwealth focuses
1fbksx7.zh: 修复了某些本应能够成立中美洲与大哥伦比亚的国家却无法成立的问题，并把巴尔塔-蒂拉斯波尔添加为所有大立陶宛与大联邦焦点的目标

1phf9hx.en: Updated the Kurdistan branch for Iraq to have more flavourful effects such as the ability to train militias from the Peshmerga focus, and added the ability for them to take Eastern Syria through a border war
1phf9hx.zh: 更新了伊拉克的库尔德斯坦分支，使其拥有更具风味的效——例如通过「佩什梅格」焦点训练民兵的能力——并添加了它们通过边境战争夺取东叙利亚的能力

ysl7uh.en: Germany has set air strategic air zone importance for Baltic, Eastern Poland, and Ukraine air regions until 1942 so the German air force concentrates on helping the army break through in the border battles
ysl7uh.zh: 德国为波罗的海、东波兰与乌克兰空域设置了直至 1942 年的战略空域重要性，以便德国空军专注于在边境战斗中帮助陆军突破

p2qesj.en: You can now select which backgrounds you want to have shown in the main menu, they will be randomly chosen every 20 seconds while in the main menu. The button can be found in the bottom right of the menu.
p2qesj.zh: 你现在可以选择希望在主菜单中显示哪些背景，它们会在主菜单中每 20 秒随机更换。该按钮位于菜单右下角。

1o4tov9.en: Fixed issues where Mexican characters who were unlocked through focuses and not intended to be transferred were transferred anyway to breakaway countries whenever any of their civil wars would fire
1o4tov9.zh: 修复了通过焦点解锁、本不应被转移的墨西哥角色，在其任何内战爆发时仍被转移给分离国家的问题

qy9ua7.en: The shared Chinese focus "Invite Soviet Advisors" now gives a national spirit that boosts army xp and org, and also brought a few NCNS shared branch focus times in line with the non-NCNS versions.
qy9ua7.zh: 中国共享焦点「邀请苏联顾问」现在给予一个国家精神，提升陆军经验与组织度，并使若干 NCNS 共享分支焦点的耗时与非 NCNS 版本保持一致。

wagteo.en: Fixed bug where ships and airplanes were referred to as battalions in faction goals, to the immense relief of sailors and airmen living in stark terror they might be issued an entrenching tool.
wagteo.zh: 修复了阵营目标中把舰船与飞机称为「营」的错误，这让水兵与飞行员们大大松了一口气——他们本在极度恐惧中担心自己会被发一把挖壕铲。

i7jv1k.en: Fixed an issue where task forces would not move closer to their active regions, even when homebase was set to close by. (This should make strike forces better at catching up to naval combats)
i7jv1k.zh: 修复了特遣舰队即使母港被设在附近也不向其活动地区靠近的问题。（这应当使打击舰队更善于追上海军战斗）

1f6ifw9.en: Japanese puppet governments in China can now unlock the Senbu occupation law, and warlord tags that declare a monarchy now get new names for their non-aligned and fascist political parties.
1f6ifw9.zh: 日本在中国的傀儡政府现在可以解锁「宣抚」占领法令，而宣布实行君主制的军阀 tag 现在会为其中立与法西斯政党获得新名称。

dgkscz.en: naval_dominance strategies now take ai areas as arguments as well as strategic regions. This allows you to nudge the AI to split up strike forces better - beware of spreading them too thin
dgkscz.zh: naval_dominance 策略现在除了战略地区之外也接受 AI 区域作为参数。这让你可以引导 AI 更好地拆分打击舰队——但小心不要把它们摊得太薄

bhtb06.en: Fixed AFG's "Reintroduce War Elephants" focus granting the Proper Heritage spirit, then immediately replacing it as invalid due to doctrine requirements for the spirit added with NCNS.
bhtb06.zh: 修复了 AFG 的「重新引入战象」焦点给予「正统传承」精神后，又因随 NCNS 加入的该精神学说要求而立即将其替换为无效的问题。

19potx8.en: PHI: USA will now grant independence after the peaceful conclusion of the American Intervention from the Maritime Communism path. You no longer need to complete Treaty of Manila too.
19potx8.zh: PHI：美国现在会在「海洋共产主义」路线的美国干预和平结束后给予独立。你也不再需要完成《马尼拉条约》。

hqbac2.en: The Ma Cliques will now not do their mutual guarantees focus until the late game, and the SIK ai will now not become a Soviet puppet unless the fully control all their owned states.
hqbac2.zh: 马家军阀现在在游戏后期之前不会执行其互相保障焦点，而 SIK 的 AI 现在除非完全控制其拥有的所有州，否则不会成为苏联傀儡。

13e6q2w.en: Fixed an issue where Nationalist China puppeting a warlord after completing the focus Appoint Sympathetic Judges would apply the intended spirit on themselves instead of the warlord
13e6q2w.zh: 修复了国民党在完成焦点「任命有同情心的法官」后傀儡化某军阀时，会把预定精神施加在自己而非该军阀身上的问题

1uk6ekj.en: The Ma Cliques will now not do their mutual guarantees focus until the late game, and the SIK ai will now not become a Soviet puppet unless they fully control all their owned states
1uk6ekj.zh: 马家军阀现在在游戏后期之前不会执行其互相保障焦点，而 SIK 的 AI 现在除非完全控制其拥有的所有州，否则不会成为苏联傀儡

1mh9ppd.en: Taskforces that are in combat are no longer reinforced from the reserve fleet. This solves an issue where those ships would arrive late to the battle and almost instantly killed.
1mh9ppd.zh: 处于战斗中的特遣舰队不再从预备舰队获得增援。这解决了一个问题：那些舰船会迟至战斗末尾才抵达，并几乎立刻被击沉。

1p0k12n.en: Japan now receives a slight malus to mastery gain from the Surprise Invasion modifier. Added the Densely Populated Rural Area modifier to a few more appropriate states in China.
1p0k12n.zh: 日本现在从「突袭入侵」修正中获得略微降低的精通获取惩罚。在中国若干更合适的州添加了「人口稠密农村地区」修正。

19rdzrg.en: The focus “Shifting the Balance” for democratic China now has alternative requirements and ideologically unavailable advisors are now hidden when going down the democratic path.
19rdzrg.zh: 民主中国的焦点「转变平衡」现在有替代要求，并且在走民主路线时，意识形态上不可用的顾问现在会被隐藏。

jd45e3.en: Disabled an event if "No Compromise, No Surrender" is enabled where the United Front is dismantled after defeating Japan, thus blocking China's focus "Victory over the Invaders"
jd45e3.zh: 在启用「不妥协，不投降」时禁用了某个在日本被击败后导致统一战线被解散、从而阻塞中国焦点「战胜侵略者」的事件

1lrlmza.en: Swapped cases of air_superiority_bonus_in_combat modifier (which only works on a character scope) to army_bonus_air_superiority_factor in various national spirits and focuses.
1lrlmza.zh: 把各类国家精神与焦点中 air_superiority_bonus_in_combat 修正（它只在角色作用域生效）的用法换成了 army_bonus_air_superiority_factor。

1o6o8h1.en: Fixed an issue where the AI strategy values added from the Iraqi focuses Nationalize Anglo-Iraqi Oil Company and Anglo-Iraqi Oil Expansion wouldn't properly apply for the UK
1o6o8h1.zh: 修复了由伊拉克焦点「国有化英伊石油公司」与「英伊石油扩张」添加的 AI 策略数值无法为英国正确生效的问题

bump40.en: Fixed an edge case where the Xian Incident would trigger from warlord decisions if CHI or PRC leaves the Chinese United Front, if formed by PRC without the Xian Incident.
bump40.zh: 修复了一个边界情况：如果 CHI 或 PRC 退出中国统一战线（若由 PRC 在没有西安事变的情况下成立），军阀决议会触发西安事变。

1fhq7sw.en: Division AA negated air superiority better when it is stronger, and weaker when it is not as strong. The maximum is around 50% decrease, versus 40% decrease previously.
1fhq7sw.zh: 师属防空在更强时能更好地抵消制空权，较弱时抵消效果也更弱。最大值约为减少 50%，此前为减少 40%。

wxpcgk.en: Rebalanced faction influence gain from various sources: Increased for Warscore and Lend Lease, decreased for Scientists, also slightly increases passive initiative gain
wxpcgk.zh: 重新平衡了来自各种来源的阵营影响力获取：战争分数与租借提高，科学家降低，同时略微提高了被动主动权获取

f926ai.en: Reduced destroyer surface visibility buffs in the "Patrol Boats" and "Light Task Forces" subdoctrines to -5%, as it could be stacked to make them too difficult to hit.
f926ai.zh: 把「巡逻艇」与「轻型特遣舰队」子学说中的驱逐舰水面可见度加成降低到 -5%，因为它可以叠加到使它们难以被命中的程度。

115k5ik.en: Updated localization for the new Guerrilla Expert trait and old Guerrilla Warfare Expert (now "Guerilla Warfare Expert" and "Counter Insurgency Expert", respectively).
115k5ik.zh: 更新了新的「游击专家」特质与旧的「游击战专家」的本地化（现在分别为「游击战专家」与「反叛乱专家」）。

1d6xkto.en: Historical Afghanistan can now seek investments from both the Axis and the Allies, provided that they expel the nationals of the one they sought investments from first
1d6xkto.zh: 历史路线阿富汗现在可以向轴心国与同盟国双方寻求投资，前提是它先驱逐其所寻求投资来源国的侨民

1m6djn6.en: Japan - Added an explanation of which levels exist for the factions in the Imperial Influence system when hovering over the Emperor in the focus tree inlay window
1m6djn6.zh: 日本——在国策树内嵌窗口中把鼠标悬停在天皇上方时，新增了对帝国影响力系统中各阵营存在哪些等级的解释

xmn1h2.en: Fixed an issue where the Spanish focus Join the Allies would ask multiple countries for faction joining at the same time, and would launch an incorrect news event
xmn1h2.zh: 修复了西班牙焦点「加入同盟国」会同时向多个国家请求加入阵营、并会触发错误新闻事件的问题

p2bzl2.en: Fixed bug that wrongly allowed divisions assigned to “Raid Weapon Depots” and “Paratrooper Raid” to change their template while preparing and executing the raid.
p2bzl2.zh: 修复了错误允许被分配至「袭击武器库」与「伞兵突袭」的师在准备和执行突袭期间更改其编制的错误。

afa3bg.en: Manchukuo can now request the annexation of other Japanese puppets in China through decisions when going down the Chinese Leadership path in the Obedience branch
afa3bg.zh: 满洲国现在可以在「服从」分支中走中国领导路线时，通过决议请求吞并在中国的其他日本傀儡国

zq26p3.en: Force attack will now correctly ruin the entrenchment of those who haven't taken the Chinese focus "Know Thy Enemy", was previously wrongly applied to everyone.
zq26p3.zh: 强制攻击现在会正确地破坏那些未选取中国焦点「知己知彼」的单位的工事，此前这一效果被错误地施加给了所有人。

xqdcrw.en: Changed stability penalty effects for the "Guarantee Tension Reduction 15/40%" and "Justify Wargoal Reduction 20/40%" Faction Rules to now be modifiers instead.
xqdcrw.zh: 把「保障紧张度降低 15/40%」与「战争目标正当化减免 20/40%」阵营规则的稳定度惩罚效果改为修正。

fl3mn7.en: Fixed an issue where the faction goal Fortify Okinawa was checking that the naval forts were being built in the wrong province, ending up unable to be completed
fl3mn7.zh: 修复了阵营目标「加固冲绳」检查海军要塞是否建在错误省份、最终无法完成的问题

crttxw.en: The Portuguese focus Portuguese Legion now also grants a one time research bonus to military police, and the national spirit granted also gives 5% core defence
crttxw.zh: 葡萄牙焦点「葡萄牙军团」现在也给予一次性的宪兵研究加成，并且所给予的国家精神还提供 5% 核心防御

8w26hh.en: The AI now evaluates convoy raiding on a per-naval-base basis, not a per-enemy-country basis. This fixes instances of fleets trying to cover the whole world.
8w26hh.zh: AI 现在以每个海军基地为基础、而非以每个敌国为基础来评估运输船队袭击。这修复了舰队试图覆盖全世界的情况。

1k91mte.en: Democratic China - The Stir Republican Sentiments decisions can no longer target warlords, which are already a target of a different democratisation decision
1k91mte.zh: 民主中国——「激起共和情绪」决议不再能以军阀为目标，因为它们已是另一个民主化决议的目标

1doanjr.en: Fixed mapmode brightness. (When fixing an old legacy bug in the rendering part of the game, it caused several mapmodes to become brighter, unintentionally.)
1doanjr.zh: 修复了地图模式亮度。（在修复游戏渲染部分一个陈旧遗留错误时，它意外导致若干地图模式变亮。）

13xyx0d.en: Reduced time cost for the Japanese focus “The Military Ministers' Attaché System” to 35 days, and adjusted the AI strategy plans to take this into account.
13xyx0d.zh: 把日本焦点「军部大臣现役武官制」的时间花费缩短到 35 天，并调整了 AI 策略计划以将其考虑在内。

lxou0z.en: Adjusted some post-independence Manchu AI focus values to be more reasonable if the strategy plan was cancelled due to Japan going democratic or communist.
lxou0z.zh: 调整了若干独立后满洲 AI 焦点数值，使其在日本转民主或共产主义导致策略计划被取消时更为合理。

wvmtu1.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese puppet governments in India and Burma wouldn't spawn if the recipient had capitulated by the time the decision was taken.
wvmtu1.zh: 修复了如果接收方在决议执行时已经投降，日本在印度与缅甸的傀儡政府就不会生成的问题。

1gchzsa.en: Added a national spirit and focus for the Chinese Warlord States regarding Military Looting to slow down production in exchange for a slight military boost
1gchzsa.zh: 为中国军阀国家添加了一个关于军事掠夺的国家精神与焦点，以减缓生产换取略微的军事提升

cqtz5f.en: The evacuate factories decisions for China and the warlords should no longer remove the factories from one state only to add them in the same state again.
cqtz5f.zh: 中国与各军阀的疏散工厂决议不应再把工厂从一个州移除后又添加回同一个州。

zfrtf8.en: Fixed an issue where AI countries would split up their ships into many, tiny taskforces, and fixed AI not assigning taskforces to training in peacetime.
zfrtf8.zh: 修复了 AI 国家把其舰船拆分为许多微小特遣舰队的问题，并修复了 AI 在和平时期不把特遣舰队分配给训练的问题。

1bp4uhg.en: Fixed issue where convoy protection map icon efficiency tooltip would repeat the same info for every task force in a fleet, though already accounted for
1bp4uhg.zh: 修复了护航保护地图图标效率提示框会为舰队中每支特遣舰队重复相同信息的问题——尽管那些信息已被计入

s5x5tz.en: The AI will now more actively try and move their fleets to their basing locations, reducing instances of strike forces getting stuck behind range-gates
s5x5tz.zh: AI 现在会更积极地把其舰队移动到其驻泊位置，减少打击舰队被卡在航程门槛之后的情况

1njvjlh.en: Communist China: Fixed incorrect stability modifier used in BoP decision Question Old Traditions, Criticize Dogmatism, Criticize The Former Leadership.
1njvjlh.zh: 中国共产党：修复了力量平衡决议「质疑旧传统，批判教条主义，批判前任领导层」中使用了错误的稳定度修正。

f2e005.en: PHI: "Scramble for Leadership" event now makes clear that José Laurel increases the chance for Japanese support in "Secure Japanese Guarantees" focus.
f2e005.zh: PHI：「争夺领导权」事件现在明确说明何塞·劳雷尔会提高「确保日本保障」焦点中获得日本支持的几率。

pnhfj4.en: RAJ - Sharpen the Tulwar - Fixed focus effect that still mentions receiving Mountain Infantry I technology, when the technology is already researched.
pnhfj4.zh: RAJ——磨利弯刀——修复了焦点效果在此科技已被研究时仍提及获得山地步兵 I 科技的问题。

s4yoi2.en: Added triggers to the "Coalition of Liberty" faction goal, so that it isn't available and can get auto-completed if the right criteria isn't fulfilled
s4yoi2.zh: 为「自由联盟」阵营目标添加了触发器，使其在不满足正确条件时不可用并可被自动完成

5u9uea.en: Austria: fixed an issue where Godwin von Burmowski would show up in the air chief role without giving air xp, he has been moved to a high command role
5u9uea.zh: 奥地利：修复了戈德温·冯·布尔莫夫斯基会出现在空军司令职务却不给予空军经验的问题，他已被移到高级指挥部职务

14yzhzd.en: Chinese Warlords can now access the Mining Commission industrial concern after completing the appropriate focus in the post-warlord Nationalist tree.
14yzhzd.zh: 中国军阀现在可以在后军阀国民党树中完成相应焦点后，获得矿业委员会工业集团。

7wuj9a.en: Added some missing states to the Turan formable, and allowed Kalmykia to form Greater Mongolia, which now also gains a core on the respective region.
7wuj9a.zh: 为图兰可成立国家添加了一些缺失的州，并允许卡尔梅克成立大蒙古，后者现在也会获得相应地区的核心。

1m3d3bp.en: Latvian Ugonkrusts divisions are now militias and their national spirit fascist paramilitaries now gives a slight boost to militia attack and defense
1m3d3bp.zh: 拉脱维亚的乌贡克鲁斯特师现在是民兵，其国家精神「法西斯准军事组织」现在给予民兵攻击与防御的略微提升

4d5oxw.en: Fixed an issue where Japan and the Soviet Union signing a separate peace would give the spirit Full Focus on the West to Japan instead of the Soviets
4d5oxw.zh: 修复了日本与苏联单独媾和时，会把「全力西顾」精神给予日本而非苏联的问题

ygrzp2.en: Afghanistan - Fixed an issue where a few focuses that mentioned claims didn't inform the player that they could core the claimed states once captured
ygrzp2.zh: 阿富汗——修复了若干提及声称的焦点没有告知玩家：一旦夺取，他们可以为所声称的州添加核心

10yf1za.en: The “Reclaim the North” focus will now give cores on the specified states that China controls, and not only on the states which it does not control.
10yf1za.zh: 「收复北方」焦点现在会给予中国所控制之指定州的核心，而不仅是它未控制的州。

fg5dlg.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese focus "The Chrysanthemum Throne" would not properly make Hirohito the country leader if the NCNS DLC was disabled.
fg5dlg.zh: 修复了在禁用 NCNS DLC 时，日本焦点「菊花王朝」无法正确让裕仁成为国家领袖的问题。

1s0atro.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese focus "The Chrysanthemum Throne" would not properly make Hirohito the country leader if the NCNS dlc was disabled.
1s0atro.zh: 修复了在禁用 NCNS DLC 时，日本焦点「菊花王朝」无法正确让裕仁成为国家领袖的问题。

1ejade9.en: Soviet Union now starts with -15% land mastery gain. Can be removed with Lessons of war. Purges makes the malus worse, some focuses makes it better
1ejade9.zh: 苏联现在以 -15% 陆军精通获取开局。可通过「战争教训」移除。大清洗会使该惩罚加重，某些焦点会使其减轻

155k6ro.en: Strike forces are allowed to repair if they are in harbour. They will repair up to a certain strength percentage, depending on the repair priority.
155k6ro.zh: 打击舰队在港内时被允许修理。它们会修理到一定的实力百分比，取决于修理优先级。

8flvgy.en: Added a new focus for Nationalist China in the air branch to open AFAMF factories, granting military factories and a small bonus to light airframes
8flvgy.zh: 为国民党在空军分支中新增了一个焦点以开设 AFAMF 工厂，给予军用工厂与对轻型机体的少量加成

me563h.en: Carriers on active naval missions should no longer send hundreds of network commands per tick (this resulted in higher latency on bad connections)
me563h.zh: 执行现役海军任务的航母不应再每刻发送数百条网络命令（这会导致在糟糕连接上延迟更高）

18uqq3f.en: Fix for "Establish a Marine Corps" faction goal not granting the listed general's reward when the country only possess amphibious tank technology.
18uqq3f.zh: 修复了「建立海军陆战队」阵营目标在该国仅拥有两栖坦克科技时，不给予所列将领奖励的问题。

17rdue4.en: Fixed an issue where the Democratic Chinese faction invitation decisions wouldn't add the target to the faction if China wasn't the faction leader
17rdue4.zh: 修复了如果中国不是阵营领袖，民主中国的阵营邀请决议不会把目标加入阵营的问题

c90543.en: Fixed air and naval exercises not properly displaying that they are on XP-limited training via shift+click in the same way as for army exercises.
c90543.zh: 修复了空军与海军演习无法像陆军演习那样，通过 shift+点击正确显示它们处于受经验限制的训练状态的问题。

1716t1v.en: To end the Peru-Ecuador war through decisions, both participants now need to be independent, and the war has to have started through the decision
1716t1v.zh: 要通过决议结束秘鲁-厄瓜多尔战争，现在双方参与者都必须独立，且战争必须是通过该决议开始的

kkrg92.en: Congo - If the Barotse Litunga has been approached before the war for liberation commences, Yeta III will now become available as a field marshal
kkrg92.zh: 刚果——如果在解放战争开始前已接触过巴罗策的利通加，叶塔三世现在将可作为陆军元帅使用

1yng738.en: Japanese AI will now automatically merge a Chinese puppet they create into the Reorganised Government upon the conclusion of a peace conference.
1yng738.zh: 日本 AI 现在会在和平会议结束时，自动将其创建的中国傀儡国合并入重组政府。

1kum6y1.en: Fix an exploit where switching a division to a new template with disabled or missing equipment could still allow mastery gain from that template
1kum6y1.zh: 修复了一个漏洞：把师切换到装备被禁用或缺失的新编制时，仍可从该编制获得精通获取

pjpanb.en: Tweaked the scaling requirements of the Faction Goal "Develop Joint Research Practices" to make it easier to understand, and faster to complete.
pjpanb.zh: 调整了阵营目标「发展联合研究实践」的递进要求，使其更易理解、完成也更快。

179ceny.en: Fixed an edge case where Xian incident would trigger from warlord decision if CHI or PRC leaves the CUF, if formed by PRC without Xian incident
179ceny.zh: 修复了一个边界情况：如果 CHI 或 PRC 退出 CUF（若由 PRC 在没有西安事变的情况下成立），军阀决议会触发西安事变

4tke3o.en: Added the ability for a westernising Iranian state to secularise, and made the choice between the different democratic leaders more interesting
4tke3o.zh: 为正在西化的伊朗国家添加了世俗化能力，并使不同民主领袖之间的选择更有意思

g62bd.en: Fixed an issue where the Nationalist Chinese focus The Seas of Tomorrow wouldn't grant the promised Naval Facility unless if controlling Hainan
g62bd.zh: 修复了国民党焦点「明日之海」除非控制海南，否则不会给予所承诺的海军设施的问题

qvipaj.en: Fixed an issue where the State Shintoism stability improvement wouldn't be properly applied if done by Manchukuo or the Reorganised Government
qvipaj.zh: 修复了如果由满洲国或重组政府执行，「国家神道教」稳定度提升无法正确生效的问题

pphmjd.en: Normalized AI weights for tank armor & engine research, generally they are done around the period where they make sense, rather than too soon.
pphmjd.zh: 把坦克装甲与引擎研究的 AI 权重正常化，总体而言它们现在会在合理的时期完成，而不是过早。

14zta7u.en: fixed “has_industry_to_become_leader”, has_enough_influence_for_leadership” and “has_manpower_to_become_leader” triggers not supporting = no.
14zta7u.zh: 修复了「has_industry_to_become_leader」、「has_enough_influence_for_leadership」与「has_manpower_to_become_leader」触发器不支持 = no 的问题。

1c8mwv6.en: Fixes CTD when a unit given from CountryA, which is exiled, to CountryB and the unit is standing in CountryC and then CountryC is also exiled
1c8mwv6.zh: 修复了当 CountryA（处于流亡状态）把某单位给予 CountryB，而该单位正驻扎在 CountryC，随后 CountryC 也进入流亡时的崩溃

m2lmec.en: Warlords - Fixed an issue where the Reach out to X country focuses in the shared branch could be taken even if said country no longer existed
m2lmec.zh: 军阀——修复了共享分支中「向 X 国伸出援手」焦点在该国已不存在时仍可选取的问题

1xq0dw6.en: Fixed an issue where a Belgian advisor and two Italian national spirits were attempting to use state based intel modifiers on a country scope
1xq0dw6.zh: 修复了一名比利时顾问与两个意大利国家精神试图在国家作用域上使用基于州的情报修正的问题

ltkauj.en: Added a new focus to the Brazilian industrial branch to found the Companhia Vale do Rio Doce to increase steel and aluminium in Minas Gerais
ltkauj.zh: 为巴西工业分支新增了一个焦点，成立多西河河谷公司以增加米纳斯吉拉斯的钢与铝

6819nf.en: Fixed an issue where democratic Japan could core non-asian states if annexing a subject with cores outside of Asia but with a capital in it
6819nf.zh: 修复了民主日本在吞并一个核心在亚洲之外但首都在亚洲的附属国时，可以为非亚洲州添加核心的问题

12g6b0b.en: Fixed an issue where the achievements Pand-monium and Make a Man out of You weren't available if playing as any of the newly added warlords
12g6b0b.zh: 修复了以任何新加入的军阀游玩时，成就「Pand-monium」与「Make a Man out of You」不可用的问题

yk5290.en: Afghanistan, Iraq - the Free Arabian and Turkestan Legion decisions now properly show their infantry equipment cost as part of the decision
yk5290.zh: 阿富汗、伊拉克——自由阿拉伯军团与突厥斯坦军团决议现在会正确地在其决议内容中显示步兵装备花费

w369n3.en: Adjustment to the Air Base Access AI Acceptance logic. AI should now be less accepting for Air Base Access, especially in other ideologies.
w369n3.zh: 调整了空军基地使用权的 AI 接受逻辑。AI 现在对空军基地使用权应当更不易接受，尤其是在其他意识形态方面。

na8i7l.en: Fixed an issue where the Lithuanian focus Restore Greater Lithuania would be unavailable if any of the target states had already been cored
na8i7l.zh: 修复了如果目标州中任何一个已被添加核心，立陶宛焦点「恢复大立陶宛」就会不可用的问题

1yv9wl5.en: Increased the number of battalions required by a faction to complete the "Establish a Marine Corps" and "Expand Our Armored Forces" Goals.
1yv9wl5.zh: 提高了阵营完成「建立海军陆战队」与「扩充我们的装甲部队」目标所需的营数量。

882i52.en: Added a requirement to control 50% of Austronesian claimed states before being able to take the Philippine "Masters of the Pacific" focus.
882i52.zh: 在能够选取菲律宾焦点「太平洋之主」之前，新增了控制 50% 南岛语系所声称州的要求。

343gip.en: Naval AI will no longer try to protect its coast if the enemy has no navy. This includes when not at war, so no more wasting fuel on that.
343gip.zh: 如果敌人没有海军，海军 AI 将不再试图保护其海岸。这包括非战争时期，所以不再为此浪费燃料。

uclyj9.en: Fixed an issue where Chinese guerillas could be rooted out by anyone, and not only the controller or overlord of the controller of a state
uclyj9.zh: 修复了中国游击队可以被任何人铲除、而不仅是州的控制者或其宗主的问题

19hpprq.en: Turkey - Fixed an issue where the Kurdish State Management decision category would disappear when there was no ongoing mission or decision
19hpprq.zh: 土耳其——修复了在没有进行中的任务或决议时，「库尔德国家管理」决议类别会消失的问题

1b36x6g.en: PHI: Added some research bonuses to the industrial concerns: Electronic to the Telephone Company, and Industrial to the Railroad Company.
1b36x6g.zh: PHI：为工业集团添加了一些研究加成：电话公司获得电子加成，铁路公司获得工业加成。

1pqyn8q.en: You require more division AA to get the maximum bonus to reduce cas damage. To reduce by the maximum 75% you need now ~55 anti air attack
1pqyn8q.zh: 你需要更多师属防空才能获得减少近距空中支援伤害的最大加成。要减少最多的 75%，你现在需要约 55 对空攻击

1sh5r59.en: He Yingqin now becomes available as a general for Nationalist China after completing the focus Crackdown on Corruption in the army branch
1sh5r59.zh: 何应钦现在会在国民党陆军分支中完成焦点「整肃腐败」后作为将领可用

1dt256g.en: Soviet Union - Fixed an issue where giving a Sinkiangi puppet control of Pamir would lock the Soviets out of taking the focus Gobi Gambit
1dt256g.zh: 苏联——修复了把帕米尔交给新疆傀儡国控制会使苏联无法选取焦点「戈壁谋略」的问题

1xnfjta.en: Resources from infrastructure reduced to 15% from 20% (note that with the new building, you can still end up with more than previously).
1xnfjta.zh: 基础设施提供的资源从 20% 降低到 15%（注意：有了新建筑，你最终仍可能比之前获得更多）。

fko160.en: Top bar tooltip for Factories will now include Factories sent/received from Subject Relations (Send to Overlord/Received from Subjects).
fko160.zh: 工厂的顶部栏提示框现在会包含从附属国关系送出/收到的工厂（送往宗主国/从附属国收到）。

1fc8yr9.en: Yasuhito will now properly be referred to as the Sesshō in the Imperial Influence window if that option was selected in the Kodoha path.
1fc8yr9.zh: 如果在皇道派路线中选择了该选项，雍仁现在会在帝国影响力窗口中正确地被称为摄政。

1n3dk1k.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese focus 'Strategic Offensives" wasn't being properly blocked by the 'Surprise Invasion' national spirit.
1n3dk1k.zh: 修复了日本焦点「战略攻势」未被「突袭入侵」国家精神正确阻塞的问题。

17pb6h3.en: The Nationalist Chinese and post-warlord focus "60-Divisions Plan" now displays the effect of the decision it unlocks, and takes 35 days
17pb6h3.zh: 国民党与后军阀焦点「六十师计划」现在会显示其解锁决议的效果，并且耗时 35 天

4ve9ze.en: Fixed an issue where Spanish general Enrique Líster wouldn't get Stalinist sympathies if Spain had completed the focus The Popular Front
4ve9ze.zh: 修复了如果西班牙已完成焦点「人民阵线」，西班牙将领恩里克·利斯特不会获得斯大林主义同情的问题

c520jq.en: PER - The Pahlavi Imperium - David Monshizadeh no longer remains visible as Political Advisor when fascist tree is no longer available.
c520jq.zh: PER——巴列维帝国——当法西斯树不再可用时，大卫·蒙希扎德不再作为政治顾问可见。

qnasvs.en: Fixed an issue where female characters in Arabic countries could have ibn in their surnames, instead of the linguistically correct bint
qnasvs.zh: 修复了阿拉伯国家中的女性角色其姓氏可能带有 ibn、而非语言上正确的 bint 的问题

1cbafbx.en: Fixed an issue where Mexico could be annexed by one of their revolts even though they were winning if both sides were the same ideology
1cbafbx.zh: 修复了如果双方意识形态相同，墨西哥即使正在取胜也可能被其某一叛乱方吞并的问题

1ad0n15.en: The shared tree used by Manchukuo and the post-warlord trees now has the option to ask for handover of the treaty port coastal cities.
1ad0n15.zh: 满洲国与后军阀树所使用的共享树现在有请求移交条约口岸沿海城市的选项。

lyz4om.en: Added three new focus for Afghanistan in the democratic branch to Ally the Young Afghans and gain more democratic support and advisors
lyz4om.zh: 为阿富汗民主分支新增了三个焦点，用于与青年阿富汗人结盟并获得更多民主支持与顾问

nkbthe.en: Fixed an issue where the Chinese Expedite the Political Tutelage decisions could be redone in states that had been lost and recaptured
nkbthe.zh: 修复了中国「加快推进政治训政」决议可以在已被丢失并重新夺回的州中重复执行的问题

5to49i.en: Fixed an issue where the Afghan and Raj focuses to attack Sinkiang wouldn't give wargoals on KHM if they occupied the target territory
5to49i.zh: 修复了阿富汗与英属印度攻击新疆的焦点在它们占领目标领土时不会给予对 KHM 的战争目标的问题

1oz3lki.en: Japan - Fixed an issue where the decisions from the focus East Asia Development Board wouldn't properly provide the promised factories
1oz3lki.zh: 日本——修复了焦点「东亚开发株式会社」的决议无法正确提供所承诺工厂的问题

1byb0de.en: Iraq can now bypass the focus "Nationalize the Anglo-Iraqi Oil Company" if the UK no longer has the resource rights to their country.
1byb0de.zh: 如果英国不再拥有对其国家的资源权，伊拉克现在可以跳过焦点「国有化英伊石油公司」。

1yehqfd.en: The tooltip for the achievement "The Winner Takes it All" now correctly displays The Chinese Soviet Republic's name instead of China.
1yehqfd.zh: 成就「赢家通吃」的提示框现在会正确显示中华苏维埃共和国的名称，而非中国。

1rfsaik.en: Lowered focus duration of "The Means to Wage War" and "Superior War Machines" from 70 to 35 days, and reduced the 75% bonuses to 50%.
1rfsaik.zh: 把「战争的手段」与「优越战争机器」的焦点时长从 70 天降低到 35 天，并把 75% 的加成降低到 50%。

1uq1tqn.en: Italy - if King Vittorio Emanuelle died while being a national spirit, he will be replaced by a national spirit version of Umberto II
1uq1tqn.zh: 意大利——如果国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱在以国家精神形式存在时去世，他将被翁贝托二世的国家精神版本取代

mzolbj.en: Eleftherios Venezelos passing away while Greece is democratic will no longer kill their country leader unless it is Venezelos himself
mzolbj.zh: 如果希腊是民主国家，埃莱夫塞里奥斯·韦尼泽洛斯去世将不再导致其国家领袖死亡——除非领袖就是韦尼泽洛斯本人

70xl18.en: Added “max_track_columns” and “max_track_rows” properties to grand doctrines, allowing dynamic multiple-row doctrine track layouts.
70xl18.zh: 为大型学说添加了「max_track_columns」与「max_track_rows」属性，允许动态的多行学说轨道布局。

e03y77.en: Fixed the Chinese Warlord "Personal Leadership" focus description to properly indicate the gained general trait will be randomized.
e03y77.zh: 修复了中国军阀「个人领导」焦点的描述，使其正确说明所获得的将领特质将是随机的。

4rr503.en: Reworked "Establish a Marine Corps" Goal to now require any type of Amphibious battalions, and to require them to be >90% equipped.
4rr503.zh: 重做了「建立海军陆战队」目标，现在它要求任意类型的两栖营，并要求它们装备度 >90%。

j9l2ly.en: Made the population of the Tohoku region more historically accurate, lowering the total Japanese core population by about 3 million
j9l2ly.zh: 使东北地区的人口在历史上更准确，把日本核心总人口降低了约 300 万

ih4b0j.en: Democratic Japan can no longer invite nations to the faction they are in through decisions if the faction leader isn't democratic.
ih4b0j.zh: 如果阵营领袖不是民主国家，民主日本不再能通过决议邀请国家加入其所在阵营。

okg2tg.en: Fixed an issue where the Guerilla state modifier applied by Nat China would disappear if the recipient wasn't at war with the PRC.
okg2tg.zh: 修复了国民党施加的游击州修正会在接收方未与 PRC 交战时不消失的问题。

153zlyn.en: Fixed an issue with naval AI where RAJ would not use the ships received from the UK following "The Jewel Becomes the Crown" focus.
153zlyn.zh: 修复了海军 AI 的一个问题：RAJ 在完成「宝石成为王冠」焦点后不会使用从英国获得的舰船。

1gr7jx1.en: The AI desire to recruit land scientists will now properly be checked when possessing a land facility, rather than a nuclear one.
1gr7jx1.zh: AI 招募陆军科学家的意愿现在会在拥有陆军设施——而非核设施——时被正确检查。

1ui9nfq.en: Added back the Chinese air force that was sent to the wrong states in the NCNS reworks, and blinked out of existence as a result.
1ui9nfq.zh: 把在 NCNS 重做中被送到了错误州、因而就此消失的中国空军加了回来。

4mormq.en: Added more coal to three pre-ncns focuses related to coal mining, and added a small amount of starting coal in the southern Congo
4mormq.zh: 为三个与采煤相关的 pre-ncns 焦点添加了更多煤炭，并在刚果南部添加了少量开局煤炭

1ex2io7.en: The AI will only build the required task forces before looking to see if it can build any of the additional, optional task forces
1ex2io7.zh: AI 现在会先建造所需的特遣舰队，然后再去看它是否能建造任何额外的可选特遣舰队

1yywzyt.en: Repairing ships can draw local supply if not enough is available from their homebase. This will only ever eat up leftover supply
1yywzyt.zh: 修理中的舰船如果从其母港获得的补给不足，可以抽取当地补给。这只会消耗剩余的补给

pztga8.en: Greece - The focus An Orthodox State can now be taken when going down the absolutist royalist path, and grants different bonuses
pztga8.zh: 希腊——在走专制保王路线时现在可以选取焦点「一个东正教国家」，并给予不同的加成

1c6r10s.en: Most navy move commands will ignore avoided areas, but still respect blocked areas. This allows navies to move a bit more freely
1c6r10s.zh: 大多数海军移动命令会忽略规避区域，但仍会遵守封锁区域。这让海军可以更自由地移动

qq2wv9.en: Fixed issue where stacking battalion bonuses of the same type were not displayed correctly in aggregated doctrine descriptions.
qq2wv9.zh: 修复了同类型叠加的营加成在汇总学说描述中未被正确显示的问题。
