15whciw.en: Adjusted "Justify Wargoal Reduction 20/40%" Faction Rule names to the more accurate "Justify Wargoal Tension Reduction 20/40%".
15whciw.zh: 把「战争目标正当化减免 20/40%」阵营规则名称调整为更准确的「战争目标正当化紧张度减免 20/40%」。

s2m5f4.en: Updated the Iraqi Military Branch to be more flavorful, giving them the ability to gain the river navy bonus among other things
s2m5f4.zh: 更新了伊拉克军事分支使其更具风味，除其他内容外还给予它们获得内河海军加成的能力

dfmcxs.en: Fixed an issue where Warlords could demand the subjugation of Chinese states that were already subjects of other foreign powers
dfmcxs.zh: 修复了军阀可以要求征服已经是其他外国势力附属国的中国国家的问题

1db1j8k.en: Fixed the military advisor Werner Junck being wrongly available for Iraq when he should be locked out by focus tree decisions.
1db1j8k.zh: 修复了军事顾问维尔纳·容克在应被国策树决议锁定时却被错误地提供给伊拉克的问题。

1wrgbo5.en: Replaced Equipment Conversion Technologies with Energy Gain Efficiency Technologies. +15% Energy Gain Per Coal per Technology.
1wrgbo5.zh: 把装备转换科技替换为能源获取效率科技。每项科技 +15% 每单位煤的能源获取。

171qzpm.en: Nationalist China can now inherit historical Kuomintang generals from warlord subjects they annex through the autonomy system.
171qzpm.zh: 国民党现在可以通过自治度系统继承其吞并的军阀附属国的历史国民党将领。

twmygx.en: Fixed an issue where AI controlled taskforces would sometimes abort a movement to go back to base, when there was no reason to
twmygx.zh: 修复了 AI 控制的特遣舰队有时会在毫无理由的情况下中止移动返回基地的问题

1cu4eba.en: PHI: You will no longer lose the Reino de Filipinas or Hispanic Empire tags when completing the Treaty of Manila while at war.
1cu4eba.zh: PHI：在战争期间完成《马尼拉条约》时，你不再会失去菲律宾王国或西班牙帝国 tag。

1f8zun1.en: Extended the speed bonuses from subdoctrines to motorized support units to include motorized and truck-drawn rocket artillery.
1f8zun1.zh: 把子学说对摩托化支援单位的速度加成扩展为包含摩托化与卡车牵引的火箭炮。

fclwmt.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese tactic Grand Banzai Charge would be enabled from the start instead of being enabled by focus
fclwmt.zh: 修复了日本战术「万岁冲锋」会从一开始就启用、而非由焦点启用的问题

hwydkw.en: Fixed the "Defeat of Anti-Fascists" faction goal wrongly allowing Stalin to have a change of heart and turn on the Comintern.
hwydkw.zh: 修复了「击败反法西斯主义者」阵营目标错误地允许斯大林回心转意并转而对抗共产国际的问题。

1ewkl8n.en: updated the width reduction effect on artillery from the Fire Concentration subdoctrine to also affect line rocket artillery.
1ewkl8n.zh: 更新了「火力集中」子学说中火炮的宽度缩减效果，使其也影响线列火箭炮。

3u80ct.en: The 4 Defense Areas now give their state modifier for 210 days instead of 120 and now applies to subjects and faction members
3u80ct.zh: 四个国防区现在给予其州修正 210 天而非 120 天，并且现在也适用于附属国与阵营成员

mkitud.en: A Shield Towards the Sky now gives 2 research bonuses a la 50% for Anti-Air and state AA now gets applied to subjects as well
mkitud.zh: 「直指天空之盾」现在给予 2 次类似 50% 的防空研究加成，州防空现在也会施加给附属国

j0fi4u.en: De-desertified the Philippines, and replaced them with lush jungle. 1x southern Central Islands, 1x northern Eastern Visayas.
j0fi4u.zh: 菲律宾去沙漠化了，并以茂密丛林取代。1 处在中南部岛屿，1 处在东米沙鄢北部。

1q2k6uc.en: Updated Superior War Machines requirements now to require basic medium tanks researched, rather than improved medium tanks.
1q2k6uc.zh: 更新了「优越战争机器」的要求，现在要求已研究基础中型坦克，而非改进型中型坦克。

1fr460d.en: Reforming the Chinese Empire as the Kumul Khanate or Ma Cliques now provides different flavour/versions of the cosmetic tag
1fr460d.zh: 作为哈密汗国或马家军阀重建中华帝国，现在会提供不同风味/版本的外观标签

1wm9tzk.en: Fixed an issue where the hidden event to change Mao's portrait would retire the character and incorrectly swap the portrait
1wm9tzk.zh: 修复了用于更改毛泽东肖像的隐藏事件会退役该角色并错误地替换肖像的问题

z7yqcr.en: France: Fixed an issue where the focus Grow the Empire would be unavailable if the states were controlled by a puppet Congo
z7yqcr.zh: 法国：修复了如果那些州由傀儡国刚果控制，焦点「壮大帝国」就会不可用的问题

53olmq.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese could be penalised by a mission for winning the border war against the Soviets too fast.
53olmq.zh: 修复了日本可能因为在边境战争中过快击败苏联而被某项任务惩罚的问题。

gtr3cj.en: Fixed Raj attempting to use an MIO it doesn’t have for infantry equipment production without Graveyard of Empires enabled.
gtr3cj.zh: 修复了在未启用《帝国坟场》时，英属印度试图使用一个它并不拥有的 MIO 来生产步兵装备的问题。

9u0i8n.en: Tweaked historical german focuses to pick slightly stronger start and align historical events closer to their actual dates
9u0i8n.zh: 调整了历史德国焦点以选取稍强的开局，并使历史事件更贴近其实际日期

1ha6a43.en: Changed an icon for USA jet_strat_bomber and jet_tac_bomber to fix errors that occur without the prototype vehicles pack.
1ha6a43.zh: 更改了美国 jet_strat_bomber 与 jet_tac_bomber 的图标，以修复在未拥有原型载具包时出现的错误。

61ziv4.en: AIP-Diesel Combination Engines technology moved from 1940 to 1939 and High-Speed Walter Engines moved from 1944 to 1943.
61ziv4.zh: AIP-柴油组合引擎科技从 1940 年移到 1939 年，高速瓦尔特引擎从 1944 年移到 1943 年。

kjravk.en: Fixed an issue where sometimes warlords would capitulate before they got the PP to ask to join the Chinese United Front.
kjravk.zh: 修复了军阀有时会在获得足够政治点数请求加入中国统一战线之前就投降的问题。

saw90a.en: The US will no longer send lend-lease to non-aligned Japan except if they have done the focus "Form the Jikyoku Iinkai".
saw90a.zh: 美国不再向中立日本发送租借，除非它们已完成焦点「成立时局委员会」。

15dm3fv.en: Made Naval AI pre-emptively protect the coast of home area if there are incoming war goals or world tension is above 50%
15dm3fv.zh: 如果存在即将到来的战争目标或世界紧张度高于 50%，使海军 AI 预先保护本土地区的海岸

1rzhyv9.en: Fixed a bug where Battle Royale would not trigger correctly if you declared war on both China and Japan on the same tick
1rzhyv9.zh: 修复了如果你在同一时刻同时对中国和日本宣战，大逃杀不会正确触发的错误

1nk5ely.en: Fixed an issue where the M24 Chaffee (USA) model shows up first in the list for Great War tanks if you have NSB disabled
1nk5ely.zh: 修复了在禁用 NSB 时，M24 查菲（美国）模型会首先出现在大战坦克列表中的问题

o8t20l.en: The Qing Empire now has access to the warlord integration decisions to speed up the lowering of their puppets' autonomy
o8t20l.zh: 大清帝国现在可以使用军阀整合决议，以加快降低其傀儡国的自治度

v9a884.en: The Portuguese focus Expand the Chinese Territories can now also be taken if Macau is controlled by a subject of theirs
v9a884.zh: 如果澳门由其附属国控制，葡萄牙焦点「扩张中国领土」现在也可以选取

ikw8bc.en: Fixed an issue where the reward from the faction goal to control the Bosphorus would construct forts in the wrong state
ikw8bc.zh: 修复了控制博斯普鲁斯阵营目标的奖励会在错误州建造要塞的问题

1t2fm7w.en: Sets a more reasonable initiative buff on Tank destroyer force and People's militia subdoctrines to avoid overstacking
1t2fm7w.zh: 为坦克歼击车部队与人民民兵子学说设置了更合理的主动权加成，以避免过度叠加

9ix5iv.en: Added new icons for the Submarine Nuclear Strike Raids and clarified that it is a submarine raid by renaming the raids
9ix5iv.zh: 为潜艇核打击突袭添加了新图标，并通过重命名突袭来明确这是一次潜艇突袭

ld6bt0.en: Fixed an issue where a "Warlord Demands Subjugation" event would always say the sender was China even though it wasn't
ld6bt0.zh: 修复了「军阀要求臣服」事件总会说发送者是中国、尽管实际上并非如此的问题

oyvqis.en: Raj - Restoring the Timurids as the Raj now also grants cores ´on their former Transoxianian and Caucasian territories
oyvqis.zh: 英属印度——作为英属印度恢复帖木儿现在也会给予其前河中地区与高加索领土的核心

1pubr9v.en: Fixed a bug where, without "No Compromise, No Surrender", Tannu Tuva had great ambition and was not afraid to show it
1pubr9v.zh: 修复了一个错误：在没有「不妥协，不投降」时，唐努乌梁海野心极大且毫不掩饰

1soxeud.en: Fixed "Defeat of Anti-Fascists" goal to correctly become visible when no faction members are communist or democratic.
1soxeud.zh: 修复了「击败反法西斯主义者」目标，使其在没有阵营成员是共产主义或民主国家时正确变为可见。

1pk020b.en: Added a new national spirit for the Guangdong and Guangxi cliques to incentivise them rushing the Liangguang Incident
1pk020b.zh: 为广东与广西军阀新增了一个国家精神，以激励它们速推两广事件

3r6i7r.en: Improved Naval AI reasoning for use of engagement rules, and added scriptable values by mission (risk/aggressiveness)
3r6i7r.zh: 改进了海军 AI 对交战规则的运用推理，并按任务添加了可脚本化数值（风险/侵略性）

79t9d6.en: Fixed an issue where democratic Japan could attract industrial investments from the same major country multiple times
79t9d6.zh: 修复了民主日本可以多次从同一个主要国家吸引工业投资的问题

1veoqy1.en: Fixed an Issue where the Philippines could flip-flop back and forth between their Maphilindo and Hispanic Empire tags
1veoqy1.zh: 修复了菲律宾可以在其「马来菲律宾」与西班牙帝国 tag 之间反复来回切换的问题

xu1tmh.en: Fixed an issue where Chinese warlords wouldn't get the appropriate decisions from taking the focus "Approach Japan".
xu1tmh.zh: 修复了中国军阀在选取焦点「接近日本」后不会获得相应决议的问题。

19cgct.en: Implemented active trigger for doctrine tracks, preventing subdoctrine assignment and mastery gain if not fulfilled.
19cgct.zh: 为学说轨道实现了主动触发器，在条件未满足时阻止子学说分配与精通获取。

1p6tehd.en: Fixed an issue where the focus "A New Dawn Over Manchuria" would give combat bonuses against a non-existent country.
1p6tehd.zh: 修复了焦点「满洲的新曙光」会给予对不存在的国家的战斗加成的问题。

4lmftx.en: The Greater Iraq integration decisions now take 14 days instead of 30, and target controlled states instead of owned
4lmftx.zh: 大伊拉克整合决议现在需要 14 天而非 30 天，并且以受控制的州而非拥有的州为目标

ksuz36.en: Fixed a bug where the naval distance was incorrectly calculated, which had an effect on the automated homebase logic
ksuz36.zh: 修复了海军距离被错误计算的错误，它影响了自动母港逻辑

37k3rl.en: Fixed a bug where AI or other players updating division templates would be affecting your template updates (UI only)
37k3rl.zh: 修复了 AI 或其他玩家更新师编制会影响你的编制更新的错误（仅界面）

nwlohl.en: The "Chinese United Front" faction manifest now gives up to 10% core defence the lower the manifest fulfilment is.
nwlohl.zh: 「中国统一战线」阵营纲领现在在纲领完成度越低时最多给予 10% 核心防御。

1pxt5cx.en: Basic Submarine Snorkel technology moved from 1940 to 1939 and Improved Submarine Snorkel moved from 1944 to 1943.
1pxt5cx.zh: 基础潜艇通气管科技从 1940 年移到 1939 年，改进型潜艇通气管从 1944 年移到 1943 年。

zepicc.en: Added support for setting the equipment ratio's for land units / unit categories in the count_in_collection effect
zepicc.zh: 添加了对在 count_in_collection 效果中设置陆军单位/单位类别装备比例的支持

1kqpzra.en: Adjusted the location of some starting resources in Brazil, and adding a small amount of rubber production to Acre
1kqpzra.zh: 调整了巴西若干开局资源的位置，并为阿克里添加了少量橡胶生产

l49weo.en: Fixed an issue where the Spanish Carlists wouldn't get the correct 3d unit models if going with a Habsburg monarch
l49weo.zh: 修复了如果选择哈布斯堡君主，西班牙卡洛斯派不会获得正确 3D 单位模型的问题

k8nb6j.en: Adjusted the surrender limit bonuses Chiang Kai Shek and Wang Jingwei can receive through the Chinese focus tree.
k8nb6j.zh: 调整了蒋介石与汪精卫可以通过中国国策树获得的投降上限加成。

rkqlkz.en: Philippines: Subject... Surrender branch rebalance - decreased resistance targets, increased damage to garrisons.
rkqlkz.zh: 菲律宾：附属国……投降分支重新平衡——降低了抵抗目标，提高了对驻军的伤害。

mru88d.en: Chinese Warlords now keep a starting trait when becoming leaders for the alternate ideologies of their countries.
mru88d.zh: 中国军阀在成为其国家替代意识形态的领袖时，现在会保留一个开局特质。

1g7j2gf.en: The Japanese Ai will now wait a little bit before popping out Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia as subjects in Indochina
1g7j2gf.zh: 日本 AI 现在会稍等一会儿再在中南半岛把越南、老挝与柬埔寨作为附属国弹出

1730olq.en: Fixed an issue where Communist China’s People’s Militia sub doctrine would not unlock mastery rewards correctly.
1730olq.zh: 修复了中国共产党的人民民兵子学说无法正确解锁精通奖励的问题。

rusmza.en: Fixed an issue where some warlord decisions meant to take over leadership from China stayed even after doing so.
rusmza.zh: 修复了某些本意是从中国夺取领导权的军阀决议在做到之后仍然保留的问题。

dpzd6u.en: Poland can now get their Habsburg alliance focus if Joseph August von Habsburg becomes country leader of Hungary
dpzd6u.zh: 如果约瑟夫·奥古斯特·冯·哈布斯堡成为匈牙利国家领袖，波兰现在可以获得其哈布斯堡同盟焦点

7bwsd.en: Fixed an issue where the event The Coronation of Mohammad Hassan Mirza wouldn't actually make Persia non-aligned
7bwsd.zh: 修复了事件「穆罕默德·哈桑·米尔扎的加冕」实际上不会使波斯转为中立的问题

d1k4qt.en: Bypassing "Clamp Down on Danzig" and "Ban the Nazi Party" will now remove resistance and rename the city - Fixes
d1k4qt.zh: 跳过「镇压但泽」与「取缔纳粹党」现在会移除抵抗并重命名该城市——修复

1i5xvr1.en: Implemented a simple equipment category dropdown and reset button in the model selector of the division designer
1i5xvr1.zh: 在师设计器的模型选择器中实现了一个简单的装备类别下拉菜单与重置按钮

1mchy24.en: Adjusted "Expand Our Armored Forces" short-term Goal to now require the armored battalions to be >90% equipped.
1mchy24.zh: 调整了「扩充我们的装甲部队」短期目标，现在要求装甲营装备度 >90%。

i7b5qq.en: Successfully imposing naval blockade should no longer restrict your access to trading through blockaded regions
i7b5qq.zh: 成功实施海上封锁不应再限制你通过被封锁地区进行贸易的通道

pxdikp.en: Moved the Location of Taiyuan to be more accurate to real life, and added a level 1 land fort in the province.
pxdikp.zh: 把太原的位置移动得更贴近现实，并在该省份添加了一座 1 级陆地要塞。

14wbb0v.en: Italy and the UK should beat each other to death in the Mediterranean to a more appropriately historical level
14wbb0v.zh: 意大利与英国应当在地中海互相厮杀到更符合历史的程度

17dfe2t.en: Fixed German “Danzig for Slovakia” focus not working if Czech is annexed via “Integrate Czechoslovakia” focus.
17dfe2t.zh: 修复了如果捷克通过「整合捷克斯洛伐克」焦点被吞并，德国「但泽换斯洛伐克」焦点就无法生效的问题。

1mpyv1q.en: Fixed a bug when a co-op player rejoins the server after being kicked, there would be several main controllers
1mpyv1q.zh: 修复了一个错误：当合作模式玩家在被踢出后重新加入服务器时，会出现多个主控制器

1xx14df.en: Raj - Fixed an issue where the Dams gained from the focus Industrialise the Ganges wouldn't show up on the map
1xx14df.zh: 英属印度——修复了从焦点「工业化恒河」获得的水坝不会显示在地图上的问题

1plws2f.en: Fixed a few instances where Uruguay would fail to go down the fascist path when set to do so in the game rules
1plws2f.zh: 修复了在游戏规则中设定乌拉圭走法西斯路线时，若干情况下会失败的问题

9m4p8a.en: The AI now uses 'fund the navy' and will wait more with naval doctrine selection until it has the bonus active
9m4p8a.zh: AI 现在会使用「资助海军」，并会在其加成生效之前更久地等待再选择海军学说

zy9bqs.en: Subdoctrines that have custom mastery conditions will display them when hovered over in the subdoctrine list.
zy9bqs.zh: 拥有自定义精通条件的子学说会在子学说列表中被悬停时显示这些条件。

17wvlnm.en: Implemented has_any_grand_doctrine trigger, which checks if a certain folder has any assigned grand doctrine.
17wvlnm.zh: 实现了 has_any_grand_doctrine 触发器，它检查某个文件夹是否有任何已分配的大型学说。

6knqpw.en: Military access will now only be given to those that one doesn't already have it to when forming the X-force.
6knqpw.zh: 在组建 X 部队时，军事通行权现在只会给予那些尚未拥有它的人。

1qrzled.en: PHI: Fixed "Reino de Filipinas" focus - Whole Spain cannot be cored if more than one flavour of Spain exists.
1qrzled.zh: PHI：修复「菲律宾王国」焦点——如果存在多个西班牙版本，则无法为整个西班牙添加核心。

c1js31.en: Fixed an issue where the PRC decision to oust the Yulin Garrison would stay after removing the state modifier
c1js31.zh: 修复了 PRC 驱逐榆林驻军的决议在移除州修正后仍会保留的问题

i75luo.en: PHI: Philippines will actually be granted independence if they peacefully complete the American Intervention.
i75luo.zh: PHI：如果菲律宾和平完成美国干预，它实际上将获得独立。

12g9b1r.en: Fixed an "airforce" typo and increased Lindberg's leader trait for air range to a more meaningful 5%, from 1%
12g9b1r.zh: 修复了一处「airforce」拼写错误，并把林德伯格的领袖特质空军航程从 1% 提高到更有意义的 5%

1gtyc98.en: Broke out Nevada and Tennessee Class ships from Pennsylvania Class in USA naval OOB. Created separate classes
1gtyc98.zh: 在美国海军开局军力中把内华达级与田纳西级舰船从宾夕法尼亚级中分出。创建了独立的级别

uu9kuk.en: The state of Banat is now included in the option "All of Transylvania" in the Second Vienna Award event chain
uu9kuk.zh: 巴纳特州现在被纳入第二次维也纳裁决事件链中的「全特兰西瓦尼亚」选项中

1vh65i3.en: Fixed a potential crash when a division template was being removed while you had exiled divisions in transfer
1vh65i3.zh: 修复了当你正有流亡师在转移中时移除师编制可能导致的崩溃

1de5xl4.en: Added Zhu Jiahua for China, Kawashima Naniwa for Manchukuo and Garegin Apresov for Sinkiang as new advisors.
1de5xl4.zh: 新增了中国的朱家骅、满洲国的川岛浪速与新疆的加雷金·阿普列索夫作为新顾问。

2dc1gc.en: Made operation Ichi-go more expensive to start, and have slightly harsher penalties if not completed in time
2dc1gc.zh: 使「一号作战」开始花费更高，并且如果未按时完成会有略微更严厉的惩罚

1qsttrv.en: Japan - the missions for Naval Demands relating to building more ships now last 545 days instead of one year
1qsttrv.zh: 日本——与建造更多舰船相关的海军要求任务现在持续 545 天而非一年

15i6djt.en: Implemented warning for triggers that work in a normalized range but gets compared to a non normalized range
15i6djt.zh: 为在归一化范围内工作、却被与非归一化范围比较的触发器实现了警告

eh7zyc.en: Changed add_faction_influence_effect localization to take into account possible negative faction influence.
eh7zyc.zh: 更改了 add_faction_influence_effect 的本地化，以将可能的负阵营影响力考虑在内。

1fao9zt.zh: 德国可施加于其他国家的共产主义影响力精神，在超时后若该国的共产主义支持度不足，将不再引发内战

12twisk.en: Added "count" functionality for all any_object triggers. It will evaluate true if at least "count" items fulfill the child triggers. The count field will support scoped variables
12twisk.zh: 为所有 any_object 触发器添加了「count」功能。若至少有「count」个条目满足子触发器，则判定为真。count 字段将支持作用域变量

lgytk7.en: The Focus 'Socialist Coup' can now be bypassed if they are already Communist, and the coup can be performed peacefully if there is more than 60% Communism support in the country
lgytk7.zh: 焦点「社会主义政变」现在在已是共产主义时可被跳过；若该国共产主义支持度超过 60%，政变可以和平方式进行

1c5b5oi.en: Fixed a bug that was hiding the last two focuses in the Swear Fealty branch that appear if a joint Anglo-Soviet invasion happened. These focuses will now appear as intended.
1c5b5oi.zh: 修复了一个 bug：当发生英苏联合入侵时出现的「宣誓效忠」分支中最后两个焦点被隐藏。这些焦点现在会按预期出现。

1h1dqo4.en: Partial fix for RK resistance management and compliance: RKs now correctly get their intended 25% compliance as part of the leader installation event after they're created.
1h1dqo4.zh: 部分修复了 RK 的抵抗管理与顺从度问题：RK 在创建后，现在会作为领袖安置事件的一部分正确获得其预期的 25% 顺从度。

tfr3na.en: India: Added North-Central and Western-Central India as areas targeted during the Mughal Uprising, giving the Mughal side more options for conquests during the civil war
tfr3na.zh: 印度：新增了中北印度与中西印度作为莫卧儿起义期间的目标区域，为莫卧儿一方在内战期间提供了更多征服选择

121b8j0.en: The redundant words "Chassis", "Airframe", and "Hull" have been removed from most instances of equipment designer templates. These classifications were already implied.
121b8j0.zh: 已从大多数装备设计器模板中移除冗余的「底盘」「机体」和「船体」字样。这些分类本已隐含其中。

1xp4gkk.en: Foreign countries (usually Japan) will no longer lose control of British Malayan territories if they transfer allegiance to Australia through the Australian focus tree
1xp4gkk.zh: 若英属马来亚领土通过澳大利亚国策树转投澳大利亚，外国（通常是日本）将不再失去对这些领土的控制

1delme0.en: Afghanistan: The decision "Alliance with the Turkic People" will no longer be locked saying "Establishing a Resistance cell in progress" after a decision is aborted
1delme0.zh: 阿富汗：决议「与突厥民族的联盟」在决议被中止后，不再会被锁定并显示「正在建立抵抗组织」

8xc8p.en: India: Renamed Train Robberies to the Peoples Railways, it no longer gives Train Robberies spirit, instead adds an optional decision and alters the railway focuses
8xc8p.zh: 印度：将「火车劫案」更名为「人民铁路」，它不再给予「火车劫案」精神，而是添加一项可选决议并改动铁路相关焦点

1t1gqfh.en: Added an extra event as part of the Fight For Iran branch where allies of the faction leader will peace out if the leader chooses to accept the peace negotiations
1t1gqfh.zh: 为「为伊朗而战」分支添加了一个额外事件：若阵营领袖选择接受和平谈判，其盟友将退出战争

fziqrw.en: Removed hostile armor speed factor from German Blitzkrieg operational planning modifier; this modifier only half-worked by virtue of a bug that has now been fixed
fziqrw.zh: 从德国闪电战作战计划修正中移除了敌军装甲速度系数；该修正此前只是因为有 bug 才勉强部分生效，而该 bug 现已修复

177h9kz.en: India: The ruling party of the Mughal Empire and British Raj are no longer flipped (Mughals getting GB and RAJ getting Mughal Court) after starting the civil war
177h9kz.zh: 印度：内战开始后，莫卧儿帝国与英属印度的执政党不再被互换（此前莫卧儿会得到 GB，而 RAJ 会得到莫卧儿宫廷）

1mifoln.en: Border wars now start immediately with all lines fighting, rather than starting in reserve. Units also don't rejoin the battle if they have already fought before
1mifoln.zh: 边境战争现在立即开始且所有战线都在作战，而不再从预备状态开始。此前已参战过的单位也不会重新加入战斗

1xkcdl.en: Completing the focuses "The Memphis Initiative" and "Glory of Cyrus the Great" will now allow Iran to get cores on all of the Middle East, Egypt and Afghanistan
1xkcdl.zh: 完成焦点「孟菲斯倡议」与「居鲁士大帝的荣光」现在会让伊朗获得整个中东、埃及和阿富汗的核心

myymc2.en: Added a focus for Afghanistan to gain the support of former Basmachi Movement members in the fascist branch, enabling for easier conquest of Soviet Central Asia
myymc2.zh: 为阿富汗在法西斯分支中新增了一个焦点，以获得前巴斯马奇运动成员的支持，从而更容易征服苏联中亚

1vcvusl.en: The Achievement "Cradle of Civilization" now only requires level 5 infrastructure in all core states that are *not* impassable, preventing potential softlocking
1vcvusl.zh: 成就「文明摇篮」现在只要求所有*非*不可通行的核心州拥有 5 级基础设施，以防出现潜在的卡死

19gp09.en: Added more places in the alt-history branches for Germany to lower the Consumer Goods Factory Factors if they have either the MEFO Bills or Economy of Conquest
19gp09.zh: 在德国的架空历史分支中添加了更多可降低消费品工厂系数的位置，条件是拥有 MEFO 票据或「征服经济」

979zui.en: Hungary can now take "Partial Mobilization" if it has either taken the focus "Secret Rearmament" or removed the "Treaty of Trianon", even when AAT is disabled
979zui.zh: 匈牙利现在只要选取了焦点「秘密重整军备」或移除了「特里亚农条约」，即可选取「部分动员」，即使禁用 AAT 也可以

mcbkg.en: Iran: Fixed a bug where the Islamic Revolution leader would not become country leader if a civil war was started in the "Strengthen Iranian Parliament" focus
mcbkg.zh: 伊朗：修复了一个 bug——若在「加强伊朗议会」焦点中引发内战，伊斯兰革命领袖不会成为国家领袖

lj98si.en: Denmark will no longer get any generic Election Event, with the one exception of "Wartime Exception" which can now trigger the ordinary Danish election event
lj98si.zh: 丹麦不再会获得任何通用选举事件，唯一的例外是「战时例外」，它现在可以触发普通的丹麦选举事件

7qkn6i.en: Fixed a bug where production was not recalculated when taking decisions. This fixes instances of bugs such as MEFO bills failing to update when they should
7qkn6i.zh: 修复了一个 bug：采取决议时生产未被重新计算。这修复了诸如 MEFO 票据本应更新却未更新之类的 bug

7f6es6.en: The national spirit "War Taxes" can no longer be lowered when not at war, now resets after a war ends, and can no longer be exploited to go above the limit
7f6es6.zh: 国家精神「战争税」在非战争状态不再能被降低，现在会在战争结束后重置，且不再能被利用以超过上限

bzhxzn.en: India: Forward Bloc now removes the occupation law No Garrison until independence is achieved through the focus Give Me Blood And I Will Grant You Freedom
bzhxzn.zh: 印度：前进同盟现在会移除占领法令「无驻军」，直到通过焦点「给我鲜血，我将给你自由」实现独立为止

5zouha.en: Fixed the "Agrarian Society" national spirit sometimes not having an effect for India when the Princely Breakaway State or East India Company was created
5zouha.zh: 修复了在土邦分离国或东印度公司成立时，印度的「农业社会」国家精神有时不生效的问题

16kcvuv.en: Turkish focus "Expand the Saadabad Pact" will now invite other signatories automatically with GOE enabled, but only if they share an ideology with Turkey
16kcvuv.zh: 土耳其焦点「扩大萨阿达巴德条约」现在会在启用 GOE 时自动邀请其他签署国，但仅限与土耳其意识形态相同的国家

s6iiwv.en: India: the Communist party will now be renamed to Communist Party of India when completing either of the focuses "Indian Socialism" or "Soviet Influence"
s6iiwv.zh: 印度：在完成焦点「印度社会主义」或「苏联影响」之一时，共产党现在会被更名为印度共产党

zer94j.en: Updated how air volunteers work. They now will always add the bonus from the modifier, making the intended behaviour of "Legion Condor" work as expected
zer94j.zh: 更新了空军志愿者的运作方式。它们现在始终会加上该修正提供的加成，使「秃鹰军团」的预期效果按预期生效

1ynhifq.en: Norway can no longer invite countries' subjects to their faction, and can no longer join factions through focuses while being a puppet of another nation
1ynhifq.zh: 挪威不再能邀请他国的附属国加入其阵营，也不再能在作为他国傀儡时通过焦点加入阵营

1g1x9zg.en: The Shared Chinese focus "Experimental Mechanised Unit" now only gives a subsidy towards the supporting nation, and not both the Soviets and the Germans
1g1x9zg.zh: 中国共享焦点「实验性机械化部队」现在只向支持方提供补贴，而不再同时给苏联和德国

1at18qc.en: Iranian focus "Diversify Industry" now gives "Fuel Storage" as well, if not already unlocked, to prevent getting "Synthetic Oil Experiments" before that
1at18qc.zh: 伊朗焦点「产业多元化」现在也会给予「燃料储存」（若尚未解锁），以防止在该科技之前获得「合成石油实验」

14w8alp.en: After taking the focus "The Enemy of My Enemy" Japan will only come to help and invade the Andamans for India if the two are not at war with each other
14w8alp.zh: 在选取焦点「敌人的敌人」后，只有当日本与印度未处于交战状态时，日本才会前来支援并为印度入侵安达曼群岛

24mc2z.en: Lowered the chances of the more obscure paths being taken by GoE countries if the game rules are set to non-historical or the country is set to random
24mc2z.zh: 降低了在游戏规则设为非历史或该国家设为随机时，GoE 国家走上更冷门路线的几率

1dkoybc.en: Added an event that fires off if the Soviet Union are in control of Iranian Kurdish territory, which will release Kurdistan as the Republic of Mahabad
1dkoybc.zh: 新增了一个事件：若苏联控制伊朗库尔德领土，将释放库尔德斯坦为马哈巴德共和国

1m485gz.en: Syria & Lebanon will no longer be able to chose to support vichy france or free france if they are occupied/owned by an unrelated country such as Iraq
1m485gz.zh: 若叙利亚和黎巴嫩被伊拉克等无关国家占领/拥有，它们将不再能选择支持维希法国或自由法国

pen994.en: Non-NSB Improved Medium Tank, Advanced Medium Tank, Improved Medium Tank Destroyer and Advanced Medium Tank Destroyers now have hardness value of 90%
pen994.zh: 非 NSB 的改进型中型坦克、先进中型坦克、改进型坦克歼击车和先进坦克歼击车现在硬度值为 90%

10i3yc.en: "Urge Violence against the British"-decisions now cost 13pp (down from 20pp), reduces compliance by -10%, and increases resistance by 50% (from 35%)
10i3yc.zh: 「煽动对英国人的暴力」决议现在花费 13 政治点数（从 20 政治点数下调），使顺从度降低 -10%，并使抵抗度提高 50%（从 35%）

wge4vx.en: Added a focus accessible to the non-aligned/democratic branches about constructing a national identity, gaining strong bonuses after some investment
wge4vx.zh: 新增了一个不结盟/民主分支可选取的焦点，主题是构建国家认同，在投入一定代价后可获得强力加成

tqdwnn.en: When the East India Company is formed while India is a subject of a nation other than the UK, Britain will no longer become the overlord of the Raj
tqdwnn.zh: 当印度是英国以外国家的附属国时成立东印度公司，英国将不再成为 RAJ 的宗主国

yrx3uq.en: The event chain from the focus "A Foothold in the Indus" now grants a war goal instead of automatically declaring war if India rejects the demands
yrx3uq.zh: 若印度拒绝要求，焦点「印度河畔的立足点」的事件链现在会给予战争目标，而不再自动宣战

cwzarv.en: Turkish focus "Reinstate the Darülfünûn-u Şahâne" no longer bypasses when you are not in a faction, locking you out of a research slot permanently
cwzarv.zh: 土耳其焦点「恢复 Darülfünûn-u Şahâne」在你不处于任何阵营时不再被跳过，从而不再会永久剥夺你的一个科研槽

1aubxlx.en: The army branch now contains two focuses relating to utilizing Camels in the military, with one of the focuses requiring Battle for the Bosphorus
1aubxlx.zh: 陆军分支现在包含两个与在军队中使用骆驼相关的焦点，其中一个需要「博斯普鲁斯之战」

sxcf0e.en: Self-Propelled Anti-Air Artillery now benefits from Anti-Air Upgrade Technology, providing +15%/+10%/+5% Air Attack per perspective technology
sxcf0e.zh: 自行高炮现在受益于防空升级科技，每项对应科技提供 +15%/+10%/+5% 对空攻击

b05vxm.en: Multiplayer: Fixed an issue where players would be unable to send chat messages in the lobby if their DLC configuration differed from the host
b05vxm.zh: 多人游戏：修复了玩家的 DLC 配置与主机不同时无法在大厅发送聊天消息的问题

1fdexwx.en: Removed reference to Jim Corbett from the British Raj focus "Rally The Indian Left" (he is actually unlocked by the focus "Lobby Parliament")
1fdexwx.zh: 从英属印度焦点「团结印度左翼」中移除了对 Jim Corbett 的引用（他实际上是由焦点「游说议会」解锁的）

1bie598.en: Removed the Gradual War Escalation mission for Italy when BBA is disabled, since the effect is only intended to work when the DLC is enabled
1bie598.zh: 在禁用 BBA 时移除了意大利的逐步战争升级任务，因为该效果本意只在启用该 DLC 时生效

2fvl78.en: Fixed an instance where if the UK decolonized at the same time as the Mughals broke away they would instantly white peace with the other RAJ
2fvl78.zh: 修复了一种情况：若英国去殖民化的同时莫卧儿分离，它们会立即与另一个 RAJ 白色和平

qz9skr.en: Afghanistan: The focus "Approach Foreign Intelligence Services" no longer attempts to create two separate agencies when playing as communist
qz9skr.zh: 阿富汗：以共产主义游玩时，焦点「接洽外国情报机构」不再会尝试创建两个独立机构

v7r3hn.en: EU leaders now have to be faction leaders to propose federalization or invite to faction via the "Development of the European Union" system
v7r3hn.zh: 欧盟领袖现在必须是阵营领袖，才能通过「欧盟发展」系统提议联邦化或邀请加入阵营

yz7i1p.en: India: AI will now be more friendly towards Kingmaker India, being more likely to want to be in an alliance with them and accept volunteers
yz7i1p.zh: 印度：AI 现在会对「造王者印度」更友好，更愿意与其结盟并接受志愿者

1gi8ijc.en: Added bypass to Revolt of the Princes if you already control all of India. Bypass gives the manpower and War Support you would normally get
1gi8ijc.zh: 为「诸王公的反叛」添加了跳过条件：若你已控制整个印度。跳过会给予你本应获得的人力与战争支持度

1vqg7k.en: Afghanistan: The decision "Exploit Turko-Persian Heritage" no longer gets soft-locked if a country gets annexed during a pending invitation
1vqg7k.zh: 阿富汗：若在邀请待处理期间某国被吞并，决议「利用突厥-波斯遗产」不再会被卡死

xjg6d4.en: The focus "Prepare for Operation Countenance" no longer creates a supply hub in Farah and Herat even if Afghanistan does not control them
xjg6d4.zh: 即使阿富汗未控制法拉与赫拉特，焦点「筹备面容行动」也不再会在那里创建补给枢纽

iht0bq.en: The tooltips for the event options in the events "Widespread protests" and "Religious Violence" now display the correct compliance values
iht0bq.zh: 事件「大规模抗议」与「宗教暴力」中事件选项的提示框现在会显示正确的顺从度数值

1dnnwll.en: Added formable "Mesopotamia" for Kurdistan, Iraq, Syria, Palestine, and Egypt, to allow for the restoration of the Cradle of Civilization
1dnnwll.zh: 为库尔德斯坦、伊拉克、叙利亚、巴勒斯坦和埃及添加了可成立国家「美索不达米亚」，以便恢复文明摇篮

1l12t1x.en: Fixed issue with political branches in British Raj that could potentially hide them even when the custom rule option was set to NOT HIDE.
1l12t1x.zh: 修复了英属印度政治分支的问题：即使自定义规则选项设为「不隐藏」，它们仍可能被隐藏。

17r2is0.en: The turkish focus "Taking over Defense of the Gulf" will no longer allow Britain to transfer states it does not own and control to Turkey
17r2is0.zh: 土耳其焦点「接管海湾防务」不再允许英国将其并不拥有和控制的州转让给土耳其

1k8iqv2.en: Iran: Allowed Organize Protests or Establish Local Opposition Groups to be bypassed if any of the focuses starting a civil war are taken
1k8iqv2.zh: 伊朗：若选取了任何引发内战的焦点，则「组织抗议」或「建立地方反对团体」可被跳过

1q4qslh.en: Fixed an issue where dismissing certain Special Project notifications could prevent future notifications of the same type from appearing
1q4qslh.zh: 修复了关闭某些特殊项目通知后，会导致同类通知日后不再出现的问题

99ioom.en: Afghanistan: Fixed an issue in the 1939 start where Afghanistan started with some focuses completed despite missing their parent focuses
99ioom.zh: 阿富汗：修复了 1939 年开局中阿富汗会以若干焦点已完成开局、却缺失其父焦点的问题

1vg2nye.en: Added a strong capstone focus to the Nufus branch that references the historical title of the Royal Afghan Army; Prussians of the Orient
1vg2nye.zh: 为人口（Nufus）分支添加了一个强力终极焦点，其名引用了皇家阿富汗军的历史称号——「东方的普鲁士人」

owiwxc.en: Multiplayer: Fix the Ready button being unclickable after loading a save file (forcing you to switch back and forth to another country)
owiwxc.zh: 多人游戏：修复了读取存档后「准备」按钮无法点击的问题（此前会迫使你来回切换到另一个国家）

jd9dil.en: It will no longer be possible for Germany to have both "Economy of Conquest" and "Recovering Economy" National Spirits at the same time
jd9dil.zh: 德国不再可能同时拥有「征服经济」和「复苏经济」两个国家精神

15i7g8z.en: Iranian focus "Soviet-Iranian Oil Collaboration" will no longer add the oil to a hardcoded state that doesnt correlate with the tooltip
15i7g8z.zh: 伊朗焦点「苏伊联合石油开发」不再会将石油添加到与提示框不符的硬编码州

dv6vtj.en: Iranian focus branch "The Fight for Iran" will no longer partially disappear when wars end even when you already completed the focuses
dv6vtj.zh: 伊朗焦点分支「为伊朗而战」在战争结束时不再会部分消失，即使你已完成这些焦点

d1r7lj.en: Iran: Adjusted focus branch offsets for the Iranian focus tree and how the Saadabad Pact branch accounts for collapsing focus branches
d1r7lj.zh: 伊朗：调整了伊朗国策树的焦点分支偏移，以及萨阿达巴德条约分支处理焦点分支折叠的方式

112zz1p.en: Fixed issue with ship weather penalty reduction also reducing positive modifiers (this will mostly affect destroyers - by quite a lot)
112zz1p.zh: 修复了舰船天气惩罚减免同时也会削减正面修正的问题（这主要影响驱逐舰——且幅度相当大）

7jjln5.en: Negative versions of the "Marginalized Muslim Community" national spirit is no longer retained by India after the split with Pakistan
7jjln5.zh: 在与巴基斯坦分裂后，印度不再保留「被边缘化的穆斯林社群」国家精神的负面版本

cy74vy.en: Changed display of matching MIOs in production line creation from "available / total" to just "total" due to obsolete differentiation
cy74vy.zh: 由于该区分已无意义，将创建生产线时匹配 MIO 的显示从「可用/总数」改为仅显示「总数」

3ia7lq.en: The focus "Special Operations Executive" no longer rewards an unusable cost reduction for paratroopers doctrine when AAT is disabled
3ia7lq.zh: 在禁用 AAT 时，焦点「特别行动执行局」不再给予无法使用的伞兵学说成本减免

ljwf7.en: Congo is now actually able to gain compliance when having Pierre Ryckmans as their leader, provided that they use civilian oversight
ljwf7.zh: 在 Pierre Ryckmans 作为领袖时，只要使用文官监督，刚果现在确实能够获得顺从度

ecfw0n.en: Afghanistan: There are now more ways of increasing democracy support, making it easier to avoid the civil war in the democratic path
ecfw0n.zh: 阿富汗：现在有更多提高民主支持度的方式，使民主路线更容易避免内战

yoiq7g.en: Iraq: Assures that none of the four members of the Golden Square join the Kurdish side when the focus "Launch a Revolt" is completed
yoiq7g.zh: 伊拉克：确保在完成焦点「发动起义」时，金方阵的四名成员都不会加入库尔德一方

1dlchj.en: Naval Aircraft MIO archetype now actually adds Naval Attack / Naval Targeting / Sub Detection and Surface Detection to their planes.
1dlchj.zh: 海军飞机 MIO 原型现在确实会为其飞机添加海军攻击/海军瞄准/潜艇探测和水面探测。

5cjoze.en: Added an event chain for Syria and Lebanon that allows them to side with Vichy/Free France or declare independence when Paris falls
5cjoze.zh: 为叙利亚和黎巴嫩添加了一条事件链，允许它们在巴黎陷落时选择支持维希/自由法国，或宣布独立

k44cm2.en: Added some missing states to the effect of the event from "Rekindle Imperial Sentiment" when Austria-Hungary is reformed through it
k44cm2.zh: 当通过「重燃帝国情怀」重建奥匈帝国时，为该事件的效果补充了一些缺失的州

1aaircx.en: You can no longer start the indian focus "Hegemony of the Subcontinent" that requires you to own pakistan right before india splits
1aaircx.zh: 你不再能在印度分裂前夕开始要求你拥有巴基斯坦的印度焦点「次大陆霸权」

1pxey34.en: National spirits for Army, Navy and Air force in Iraq now updates their name based on whether Iraq is Iraq, or has become Kurdistan
1pxey34.zh: 伊拉克的陆军、海军和空军国家精神现在会根据该国是伊拉克还是已变为库尔德斯坦来更新其名称

9nd9ub.en: Fixed a bug that would cause the first variant of equipment to always be called "Mk0" regardless of country-specific naming scheme
9nd9ub.zh: 修复了一个 bug：装备的第一个变体总是被称为「Mk0」，而不论该国的专属命名规则如何

1sdyytc.en: Afghanistan: Added a new focus for the Afghan Democratic branch to gain more democratic support as well as unlock two new advisors
1sdyytc.zh: 阿富汗：为阿富汗民主分支新增了一个焦点，可获得更多民主支持度并解锁两名新顾问

1xgn2eb.en: Fixed an issue where MIO selection persists across different equipment windows, which allowed using MIO for unsupported equipment.
1xgn2eb.zh: 修复了 MIO 选择会在不同装备窗口之间保留的问题，此前这允许为不受支持的装备使用 MIO。

jk3317.en: Overlords capitulating now always gives half progress to next autonomy level, disregarding of which autonomy level it currently is
jk3317.zh: 宗主国投降现在始终会给予下一自治等级的一半进度，不论当前处于哪个自治等级

2c6kf.en: German AI will create a few divisions with flame tanks if you have No Step Back and Assault engineers if you have Götterdämmerung
2c6kf.zh: 若你拥有「绝不后退」，德国 AI 会创建若干配备喷火坦克的师；若你拥有「诸神黄昏」，则会创建配备突击工兵的师

xjf71c.en: Iran no longer donates resource rights to Germany for states they do not control in focus "Donate Oil Fields to the German Reich"
xjf71c.zh: 在焦点「向德意志帝国赠送油田」中，伊朗不再会为其并不控制的州向德国转让资源权利

k27m45.en: India: Removed War Support modifier, reduced Party Popularity and added 60 Political Power to the focus "All Indian Kishan Sabha"
k27m45.zh: 印度：从焦点「全印农民协会」中移除了战争支持度修正，降低了党派支持率，并添加了 60 政治点数

164ra4r.en: India: The British Raj no longer loses certain spirits after separating from the East India Company or Princely Breakaway States
164ra4r.zh: 印度：英属印度在从东印度公司或土邦分离国中分离后，不再会失去某些精神

52ri1w.en: Fixed an issue where the Soviet army focus "Military Political Advisors" was broken when playing as Monarchist or Fascist Russia
52ri1w.zh: 修复了以君主制或法西斯俄罗斯游玩时苏联陆军焦点「军事政治顾问」失效的问题

1qaq2vq.en: Belgian decision to Boost Factory Worker's Unions now give proper production modifiers, also fixed a minor typo in decision name
1qaq2vq.zh: 比利时「提振工厂工人工会」决议现在会给予正确的生产修正，同时修复了决议名称中的一处小拼写错误

12cjhf2.en: Fixed several instances where countries with focus trees from Götterdämmerung could join or create factions while being subjects
12cjhf2.zh: 修复了多处「诸神黄昏」国策树国家在作为附属国时仍可加入或创建阵营的情况

16mojdf.en: India: Princely Subjugation now increases resistance target by 60% (from 20%) and reduces damage to garrison by -10% (from +50%)
16mojdf.zh: 印度：土邦征服现在使抵抗度目标提高 60%（从 20%），并使驻军受到的伤害降低 -10%（从 +50%）

1ryfe64.en: India: Aden no longer gets returned to the Raj after the Mughal Uprising if it was previously handed over to the United Kingdom
1ryfe64.zh: 印度：若亚丁此前已被移交给英国，则在莫卧儿起义后不再会被归还给 RAJ

blqmsb.en: Fixed an instance where the civil war started by the focus "Give Me Blood And I Will Grant You Freedom" would not end correctly
blqmsb.zh: 修复了一种情况：由焦点「给我鲜血，我将给你自由」引发的内战无法正确结束

1i47ax2.en: Fixed an issue where resuming into a deleted Ironman save game would cause a non-functional Back button in the load game window
1i47ax2.zh: 修复了继续进入一个已被删除的铁人模式存档时，读档窗口中的「返回」按钮失效的问题

17v2egn.en: Iraq: The focus "Propose Syrian Unification" can now be taken even if Syria is a puppet of Vichy France rather than Free France
17v2egn.zh: 伊拉克：即使叙利亚是维希法国而非自由法国的傀儡，现在也可以选取焦点「提议叙利亚统一」

sixtmh.en: Removed a duplicated trigger in the "Will Abort if:" section of the British mission "Trade Unions Demand Minister Appointment"
sixtmh.zh: 移除了英国任务「工会要求任命大臣」中「将在以下情况中止：」部分里重复的触发器

1t4b8dh.en: Iran: Added a focus under the Fight For Iran path that allows Iran to reinstate the Qajar dynasty if they are a British puppet
1t4b8dh.zh: 伊朗：在「为伊朗而战」路线下新增了一个焦点，使伊朗在作为英国傀儡时可以恢复卡扎尔王朝

1iwkioa.en: Iranian focus "Persian Gulf Hegemony" no longer says it gives you an annex war goal even though it gives you a puppet war goal
1iwkioa.zh: 伊朗焦点「波斯湾霸权」不再声称给予吞并战争目标，而实际给予的是傀儡战争目标

11bg7yw.en: India: The "Conquer Afghanistan" focus no longer attempts to give a special forces doctrine discount when you do not have AAT
11bg7yw.zh: 印度：在你没有 AAT 时，焦点「征服阿富汗」不再尝试给予特种部队学说折扣

qjpgpc.en: The correct country name will now be used if "India Fragmentation Status" is set to "British Raj Fragmented" in game settings
qjpgpc.zh: 若在游戏设置中将「印度分裂状态」设为「英属印度分裂」，现在会使用正确的国家名称

19hou4e.en: Adds a tooltip clarifying that weapons granted from "Secure Weapons" Will be given upon completion of focus "Mughal Uprising"
19hou4e.zh: 添加了一个提示框，说明从「确保武器」获得的武器将在完成焦点「莫卧儿起义」时给予

kr94wl.en: Fixed an instance where the "Election Season"-event would sometimes list a leader as retiring before being made leader again
kr94wl.zh: 修复了一种情况：「选举季」事件有时会将某位领袖列为即将退休，随后却又将其重新设为领袖

1m8p75m.en: Adjusted several Iranian focuses from 70 to 35 days, with minor tweaks to some of them as a result of the time being lowered
1m8p75m.zh: 将若干伊朗焦点从 70 天调整为 35 天，并因时长缩短而对其中一些做了小幅调整

n452wb.en: Afghanistan: Added a country leader to the communist path, as well as a Field Marshal and German General to the fascist path
n452wb.zh: 阿富汗：为共产主义路线添加了一名国家领袖，并为法西斯路线添加了一名陆军元帅和一名德国将军

159kopo.en: India: the AI will now take the decision to become independent when it is available, if it is going down the communist path
159kopo.zh: 印度：如果走共产主义路线，AI 现在会在「争取独立」决议可用时采取该决议

13jfehd.en: Removed non-functional Production Efficiency Gain modifier from one of the traits for the Finnish Crichton-Vulcan Naval MIO
13jfehd.zh: 从芬兰 Crichton-Vulcan 海军 MIO 的其中一个特质中移除了无效的生产效率增长修正

a34vf4.en: India: Adds a National Spirit that slowly erodes the autonomy of the Princely states if Raj takes the focus "Mughal Court"
a34vf4.zh: 印度：新增一个国家精神，若 RAJ 选取焦点「莫卧儿宫廷」，它会缓慢侵蚀各土邦的自治度

1krll1b.en: Fixed an issue where the focus "The Steel Lions" would give a tank template with tanks that didn't have any main armament
1krll1b.zh: 修复了焦点「钢铁雄狮」会给予一个坦克没有任何主武器的坦克编制的问题

9tzh5r.en: Added new focuses to the Nufus military branch, to gain a larger army, and potentially seek mutual guarantees with Turkey
9tzh5r.zh: 为人口（Nufus）军事分支新增了焦点，以获得更庞大的军队，并可能寻求与土耳其的相互保障

107sq4e.en: Afghanistan - Fixed the recruitable population modifier not applying correctly from the trait "The Last of the Bukharans"
107sq4e.zh: 阿富汗——修复了特质「最后的布哈拉人」的可征募人口修正未正确生效的问题

1nqrzai.en: Added the missing South Sudetenland to the effects of the non-Götterdämmerrung focus Restore Austria-Hungary for Hungary
1nqrzai.zh: 为匈牙利的非「诸神黄昏」焦点「恢复奥匈帝国」的效果补充了缺失的南苏台德

qc7tar.en: Iranian Decision "Soviet-Iranian Oil Collaboration" no longer only adds oil to Azerbaijan, despite mentioning two states
qc7tar.zh: 伊朗决议「苏伊联合石油开发」不再只把石油添加到阿塞拜疆，尽管其提到了两个州

1txj7qq.en: India: The decision to integrate the Princely States can now be taken even if the Princely states are puppets of the Raj
1txj7qq.zh: 印度：即使各土邦是 RAJ 的傀儡，现在也可以采取整合土邦的决议

kyxf1g.en: Italy now gets an event warning them in advance when getting closer to their leaders deposition in the Balance of Power
kyxf1g.zh: 意大利现在会在力量平衡中接近其领袖被废黜时，提前收到一个事件警告

ko72oz.en: The load_focus_tree effect can now copy completed focus from an existing country with the copy_completed_from parameter
ko72oz.zh: load_focus_tree 效果现在可以通过 copy_completed_from 参数从现有国家复制已完成的焦点

1pj1d6b.en: Mexico's Triumph of Synarchism now sends an event which lets the recipient choose to accept or counteract the influence
1pj1d6b.zh: 墨西哥的「同步主义胜利」现在会发送一个事件，让接收方选择接受或反制该影响

zm84tl.en: India: Fixed an issue where fascist UK decolonizing would attempt to turn India into a Dominion rather than a Satellite
zm84tl.zh: 印度：修复了法西斯英国去殖民化时会试图把印度变为自治领而非卫星国的问题

11zfg8z.en: Iran: The focuses "People's Revolutionary Airforce" and "People's Revolutionary Navy" are no longer mutually exclusive
11zfg8z.zh: 伊朗：焦点「人民革命空军」与「人民革命海军」不再互斥

40qh14.en: Divisions located in Burma will no longer be permanently exiled after the white peace triggers for the Mughal Uprising
40qh14.zh: 位于缅甸的师在莫卧儿起义触发白色和平后不再会被永久流放

3ctmlq.en: The Spirits of the Army "Bayonet Strength" and "Overwhelming Firepower" now also affect the cost of Bicycle Battalions
3ctmlq.zh: 陆军精神「刺刀力量」与「压倒性火力」现在也会影响自行车营的费用

hxvvnb.en: The Netherlands now inherits the puppets of Belgium and Luxembourg if annexed through the Benelux Unification decision
hxvvnb.zh: 若通过比荷卢统一决议被吞并，荷兰现在会继承比利时和卢森堡的傀儡

1w55cgn.en: The German leader trait "The Supreme Leader" will no longer reduce your own autonomy, but instead reduce your puppets'
1w55cgn.zh: 德国领袖特质「最高领袖」不再会降低你自己的自治度，而是降低你傀儡的自治度

1v21kgz.en: Improved multiplayer save file transfer speed significantly, which should help resyncing to be much faster than before
1v21kgz.zh: 大幅提升了多人游戏存档传输速度，这应有助于让重新同步比以往快得多

nm71uu.en: India: Fixed a typo in the description of the Risk of Famine national spirit, where "loses" is misspelled as "looses"
nm71uu.zh: 印度：修复了「饥荒风险」国家精神描述中的一处拼写错误，其中「loses」被误拼为「looses」

r78j8u.en: Fixed grammar issues and a typo in the tooltip and description of the focus "Funnel investments into Princely States"
r78j8u.zh: 修复了焦点「向土邦输送投资」提示框与描述中的语法问题和一处拼写错误

16tj628.en: Nerfed princely subjugation, it removes compliance faster than before and gives less boost to resources and factories
16tj628.zh: 削弱了土邦征服，它现在比以往更快地移除顺从度，并对资源和工厂提供更少的加成

nrzqhl.en: Declaring war on another member of the Saadabad Pact will no longer display a tooltip so large it goes off the screen
nrzqhl.zh: 对萨阿达巴德条约其他成员宣战时，不再会显示大到超出屏幕的提示框

or663i.en: Fixed issue with subunit modifiers for marines on attack, defense, organization and speed not being applied properly.
or663i.zh: 修复了海军陆战队的子单位攻击、防御、组织度和速度修正未正确生效的问题。

18uzl2z.en: Iran/Soviet Union: Fixed a bug in which the Soviets could not puppet Iran if they chose to justify without the focus
18uzl2z.zh: 伊朗/苏联：修复了一个 bug——若苏联选择不通过焦点而直接制造宣战理由，则无法将伊朗变为傀儡

pjuos.en: States added in Graveyard of Empires now get included in the formation of the appropriate German Reichskommissariats
pjuos.zh: 「帝国坟场」中新增的州现在会被纳入相应德国总督辖区（RK）的组建中

naht88.en: Fixed a bug where the national spirit "Neutral Foreign Policy" was not properly removed from Pakistan and Bangladesh
naht88.zh: 修复了一个 bug：国家精神「中立外交政策」未从巴基斯坦和孟加拉国正确移除

lrcvj9.en: Generals loyal to Pakistan or Britain will now be removed from the Raj upon completion of "Royal Indian Navy Mutiny"
lrcvj9.zh: 在完成「皇家印度海军兵变」后，效忠巴基斯坦或英国的将领现在会从 RAJ 中移除

b6qnfj.en: Fixed an instance where UK could swap India communist by completing decolonization while a dynamic india tag existed
b6qnfj.zh: 修复了一种情况：在存在动态印度标签时，英国可以通过完成去殖民化把印度换成共产主义

7bs0na.en: India: Independence unrest events no longer continue to appear after declaring independence in India's fascist path
7bs0na.zh: 印度：在印度法西斯路线中宣布独立后，独立动乱事件不再会继续出现

173t70b.en: Fixed a bug where Afghanistan did not start the game with artillery researched if Graveyard of Empires was disabled
173t70b.zh: 修复了一个 bug：若禁用「帝国坟场」，阿富汗开局未研究火炮

q5sd35.en: Fixed a bug causing some nuclear raids to not delete military factories correcty with "Bathe in Hellfire" completed
q5sd35.zh: 修复了一个 bug：在完成「沐浴地狱之火」后，某些核突袭无法正确删除军用工厂

iqy1pv.en: Fixed multiple instances where incorrect models and icons would be selected for Generic and German airplane designs
iqy1pv.zh: 修复了多处通用与德国飞机设计会选中错误型号和图标的情况

1tifc7h.en: Ensured that the player cannot take 'Expand the Imperial Guard' when not non-aligned or have the monarchy in power.
1tifc7h.zh: 确保玩家在不结盟或君主制未掌权时无法选取「扩充帝国卫队」。

1qubljt.en: The focuses "Establish the Airforce" and "Construct Air Bases" no longer grant building slots along with air bases
1qubljt.zh: 焦点「建立空军」与「修建空军基地」不再在给予空军基地的同时给予建筑位

13k7m0b.en: The German focus "Effective Operations" now modifies the National Spirit "Intelligence Wing" without La Resistance
13k7m0b.zh: 德国焦点「有效行动」现在在没有「抵抗运动」时也会修正国家精神「情报部门」

1mwyofi.en: The events from the Polish focus "Enforce Baltic Socialism" are now sent to all Baltic states, instead of just one
1mwyofi.zh: 波兰焦点「推行波罗的海社会主义」的事件现在会发送给所有波罗的海国家，而不再只发给一个

1czu3g1.en: Iraq: Added four focuses to the Kurdistan path for Iraq, allowing Kurdistan to go communist and join the comintern
1czu3g1.zh: 伊拉克：为伊拉克的库尔德斯坦路线添加了四个焦点，使库尔德斯坦可以走共产主义并加入共产国际

xwbber.en: The doctrine cost reduction from the Raj's focus "Special Operations Executive" now shares its name with the focus
xwbber.zh: RAJ 焦点「特别行动执行局」提供的学说成本减免现在与焦点同名

evug43.en: Fixed an issue where having the Diplomacy window open would highlight the International Market icon in the top bar
evug43.zh: 修复了打开外交窗口会导致顶栏的国际市场图标被高亮的问题

1to3rxh.en: Fixed several instances where the German Navy's name wouldn't change despite the nation's ideology having done so
1to3rxh.zh: 修复了多处德国海军名称在该国意识形态已改变时却不随之改变的情况

1pqq3z.en: Fixes focuses in the Baltic states to avoid factions being created or joined while the Baltics are subject states
1pqq3z.zh: 修复了波罗的海国家的焦点，以避免在波罗的海各国作为附属国时创建或加入阵营

36079d.en: Added a focus to the industrial branch to expand the Spinzar Cotton Factory, granting two more civilian factories
36079d.zh: 为工业分支新增了一个焦点，用于扩建 Spinzar 棉花工厂，给予两个额外的民用工厂

k8z9ml.en: Himmler will now complete the Inner Circle Focus Strengthen the Waffen-SS in the 140 days as stated in the Focus
k8z9ml.zh: 希姆莱现在会如焦点所述在 140 天内完成内圈焦点「强化武装党卫军」

sbsu1o.en: Added two new focuses to give democratic Iran the chance to get scientists, facilities and breakthrough progress
sbsu1o.zh: 新增了两个焦点，让民主伊朗有机会获得科学家、设施与突破进度

1f7ek4v.en: Removes controlling Maltya from the requirements of "United Kurdistan", adds Deir-Az-Zur as requirements instead
1f7ek4v.zh: 从「统一库尔德斯坦」的要求中移除了控制 Maltya，改为要求 Deir-Az-Zur

devvu7.en: India: The Mughal Influence state modifier will now be removed if no longer owned by the Mughal Empire or India
devvu7.zh: 印度：若该州不再由莫卧儿帝国或印度拥有，「莫卧儿影响力」州修正现在会被移除

1ddt5gv.en: Add front_role_override for division templates which lets you customize which type of front it gets assigned to
1ddt5gv.zh: 为师编制添加 front_role_override，让你可以自定义它被分配到哪种战线

1su4dh6.en: Removed empty space in the Political Instability National Focus displayed on Nation Selection Screen for Greece
1su4dh6.zh: 移除了希腊国家选择界面上显示的政治不稳定国策中的空白

4ajw34.en: Iran: Changed the bypass requirements for Soviet Alignment to prevent blocking if player joins faction manually
4ajw34.zh: 伊朗：修改了「苏联阵营」的跳过条件，以防玩家手动加入阵营时被卡住

3hh6yd.en: Countries will be more likely to accept your confederation with Pakistan if they are in the same Faction as you
3hh6yd.zh: 若某国与你处于同一阵营，它会更可能接受你与巴基斯坦的联邦

14clsn2.en: India: Famine now only requires you to lose a starting Indian State (excluding Aden) with 30 days to retake it
14clsn2.zh: 印度：饥荒现在只要求你失去一个开局的印度州（不包括亚丁），并有 30 天时间夺回它

1nbdej6.en: United Kingdom: Puppets breaking away from the UK when it goes fascist/communist should now function correctly
1nbdej6.zh: 英国：当英国走法西斯/共产主义时，其傀儡脱离英国的过程现在应能正确运作

1wee8wn.en: The Japanese focus "Exchange the Exiles" now properly displays what will happen if Manchukuo accepts the trade
1wee8wn.zh: 日本焦点「交换流亡者」现在会正确显示若满洲国接受该交易将会发生什么

3ffeiv.en: The Congolese Evolue events will now also happen if it was Belgium that completed the focus "Chefs Coutumiers"
3ffeiv.zh: 若完成焦点「传统首领」的是比利时，刚果的「进化者」事件现在也会发生

h6wern.en: Rebalanced indian national spirit "Growing Hindu Nationalism" to give +0.7% weekly war support rather than +1%
h6wern.zh: 重新平衡了印度国家精神「日益增长的印度教民族主义」，使其每周给予 +0.7% 战争支持度而非 +1%

ky96vs.en: Fixed an issue where Soviets would steal states from Kurdistan when Iran selected Swear Fealty to the Invaders
ky96vs.zh: 修复了当伊朗选取「向入侵者宣誓效忠」时苏联会从库尔德斯坦夺取州的问题

If a general has a preferred tactic selected, the selection weight of that combat tactic is increased by ⟦3⟧ for battles they are commanding. If a field marshal has a preferred tactic selected, the selection weight of that combat tactic is increased by ⟦4⟧ for all battles commanded by either them or generals in their army group.
qs74fq.zh: 在陆军元帅和将领层级，一旦技能等级达到至少 5 级，就可以在 ⟦0⟧ 的详情界面中选定偏好战术。⟦1⟧ 一旦选定，⟦2⟧ 的偏好战术便无法更改。若某位将领选定了偏好战术，则在其指挥的战斗中，该战斗战术的选用权重提高 ⟦3⟧。若某位陆军元帅选定了偏好战术，则在其本人或其集团军群内将领指挥的所有战斗中，该战斗战术的选用权重提高 ⟦4⟧。

1dd71g2.en: The side losing this comparison has to pick their tactic first. This allows the side with Initiative, if a countering tactic is available, to pick it in response with increased probability. Its weight gets a bonus of ⟦0⟧ for every point of advantage in the skill comparison. However, the side with Initiative can still choose a tactic that will be countered by the enemy, as the weights of those tactics is not reduced from having Initiative.
1dd71g2.zh: 比较中落败的一方必须先选择战术。这使拥有主动权的一方在存在反制战术时，能以更高的概率将其作为应对选出。技能比较中每多一点优势，其权重就获得 ⟦0⟧ 的加成。不过，拥有主动权的一方仍可能选出会被敌方反制的战术，因为拥有主动权并不会降低这些战术的权重。

1ku8apu.en: To determine Initiative, the leading generals' skill levels are compared. If either side has a higher reconnaissance value in one of their divisions (including reserves), it gets a bonus of ⟦0⟧ skill levels for this comparison, regardless of big the reconnaissance difference between the two sides is. The side with the higher effective skill level gets Initiative, with ties favoring the defender.
1ku8apu.zh: 主动权的判定是比较双方主将的技能等级。若任意一方的某个师（含预备队）拥有更高的侦察值，则在该比较中获得 ⟦0⟧ 个技能等级的加成，无论双方侦察值差距有多大。有效技能等级更高的一方获得主动权，相同时防守方优先。

dy5wlf.en: At the country level, preferred tactics can be selected at the ⟦0⟧. They can be changed at any time, though each change incurs the Command power cost. If a country-level preferred tactic is selected, the selection weight of that combat tactic is increased by ⟦1⟧ for all ⟦2⟧ of that country.
dy5wlf.zh: 在国家层级，可以在 ⟦0⟧ 选定偏好战术。它们可以随时更改，但每次更改都会产生指挥点数花费。若选定了国家级偏好战术，该战斗战术的选用权重提高 ⟦1⟧，适用于该国的所有 ⟦2⟧。

ai51ym.en: Only certain combat tactics can be selected as preferred tactics. Basic combat tactics like ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ cannot be selected as preferred tactics. Tactics only available in certain, unique phases, such as ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ also cannot be selected as preferred tactics.
ai51ym.zh: 只有特定战斗战术可被选为偏好战术。诸如 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 之类的基础战斗战术不能选为偏好战术。仅在特定独特阶段可用的战术，例如 ⟦2⟧ 或 ⟦3⟧，同样不能选为偏好战术。

138ho6d.en: Certain ⟦0⟧ spirits can increase this effect for certain preferred tactics, such as ⟦1⟧ with ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ with ⟦4⟧. This applies across all levels of preferred tactics. Some ⟦5⟧, like the one provided by I Am Death for the ⟦6⟧, can have a similar effect.
138ho6d.zh: 某些 ⟦0⟧ 精神可为特定偏好战术增强此效果，例如 ⟦1⟧ 搭配 ⟦2⟧，或 ⟦3⟧ 搭配 ⟦4⟧。这适用于所有层级的偏好战术。某些 ⟦5⟧，例如「我是死神」为 ⟦6⟧ 提供的那个，也能产生类似效果。

rktyvb.en: Tactics are picked according to the current phase, with battles always starting at default. The phase may change in response to picks being made, as listed in the following sections of tactics per phase.⟦0⟧
rktyvb.zh: 战术按当前阶段选取，战斗始终从默认阶段开始。阶段可能因做出的选择而改变，详见下文按阶段划分的战术各节。⟦0⟧

a0ng8s.en: Despite what the tooltips show during battle, the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ do not change the soft and hard attack of divisions (i.e. their number of attacks). Instead, they directly change the amount of ⟦2⟧.
a0ng8s.zh: 尽管战斗中的提示框如此显示，⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 并不会改变各师的软攻和硬攻（即其攻击次数）。它们直接改变的是 ⟦2⟧ 的数量。

p8d5g.en: The side with ⟦0⟧ (shown by a golden frame around that side's ⟦1⟧'s portrait and chevrons underneath) gets to choose its tactic second and has an increased chance to ⟦2⟧ their enemy's tactic.
p8d5g.zh: 拥有 ⟦0⟧ 的一方（表现为该方 ⟦1⟧ 头像周围的金色边框及其下方的箭头）可以在第二位选择战术，并有更高的几率 ⟦2⟧ 敌方的战术。

40qqnu.en: Tactics get re-selected every 12⟦0⟧ hours from a weighted list of all available tactics to each side's ⟦1⟧. Combat can have different ⟦2⟧, with different tactics available in each phase.
40qqnu.zh: 战术每 12⟦0⟧ 小时从双方 ⟦1⟧ 的所有可用战术加权列表中重新选取一次。战斗可以有不同的 ⟦2⟧，每个阶段可用的战术各不相同。

xknnlx.en: ⟦0⟧ can be selected at three different levels: at the country level, at the field marshal level, and at the general level. The effects of these levels can stack with one another.
xknnlx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可在三个不同层级选定：国家层级、陆军元帅层级和将领层级。各层级的效果可以相互叠加。

22ay1l.en: Attacking units by default have a movement penalty of ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ The ⟦2⟧ modifiers can offset or further increase this penalty, stacking additively.
22ay1l.zh: 进攻单位默认带有 ⟦0⟧ 的移动惩罚。⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 修正可以抵消或进一步增加这一惩罚，按加法叠加。

s8tvvs.en: Certain tactics can ⟦0⟧ other tactics. When a tactic is countered, its effects (including potential negative ones) are completely negated.
s8tvvs.zh: 某些战术可以 ⟦0⟧ 其他战术。当某战术被反制时，其效果（包括可能的负面效果）会被完全抵消。

1qgcmro.en: Selecting a preferred tactic comes at a one-time cost 20⟦0⟧ Command power. The ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ spirit can reduce this cost.
1qgcmro.zh: 选定偏好战术需要一次性花费 20⟦0⟧ 指挥点数。⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 精神可以降低此花费。

3b9qm4.en: ⟦0⟧ provide damage, movement speed, and combat width modifiers in ⟦1⟧.
3b9qm4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在 ⟦1⟧ 中提供伤害、移动速度和战斗宽度修正。

wj674q.en: ⟦0⟧ affects the base ⟦1⟧ of a battle, but not flanking combat width.
wj674q.zh: ⟦0⟧ 影响战斗的基础 ⟦1⟧，但不影响侧翼战斗宽度。

chhl0.en: 4, if commanding general has trait ⟦0⟧ and in urban terrain else 0.8
chhl0.zh: 若主将拥有特质 ⟦0⟧ 且处于城市地形则为 4，否则为 0.8

40yj1g.en: Does ⟦0⟧ have the ⟦1⟧: The Glory of the Red Army

jtac8r.en: Have the ⟦0⟧: The Glory of the Red Army

1r81of2.en: 8, if at least 1 of the following:

1kr1wnz.en: Tracks are split into four categories: Fighter Aircraft, Strike Aircraft, Medium Aircraft, and Heavy Aircraft. Each has a set of subdoctrines shared among each grand doctrine. Mastery is used to unlock milestones within the subdoctrine, granting further bonuses. Each track gains Mastery when certain units engage in action, or at a reduced rate while training. If a subdoctrine is not selected, up to 200 Mastery is held in reserve.
1kr1wnz.zh: 路线分为四个类别：战斗机、打击飞机、中型飞机和重型飞机。每条路线都有一套在各总体学说之间共享的子学说。精通度用于解锁子学说内的里程碑，提供进一步的加成。当特定单位参与行动时，每条路线都会获得精通度，训练时则以降低的速率获得。如果未选择子学说，最多可保留 200 点精通度。

1afll0o.en: Subdoctrines allow an air force to specialize in different types of combat. Subdoctrines provide some bonuses when picked and additional bonuses are unlocked when enough Mastery is accumulated in each Doctrine Track. Only one Subdoctrine can be enabled from each Doctrine Track at a time. Grand Doctrines do not affect which Subdoctrines are available.
1afll0o.zh: 子学说使空军能够专精于不同类型的战斗。子学说在被选中时提供一些加成，当每条学说路线中积累足够的精通度后，还会解锁额外加成。每条学说路线同时只能启用一个子学说。总体学说不会影响哪些子学说可用。

1rhb8rx.en: It is possible to change doctrine tree at any point, but all bonuses from previously unlocked doctrines are lost when unlocking a different doctrine tree. Any doctrine-exclusive ⟦0⟧ spirits are also automatically switched to different ones when a different doctrine tree is selected.
1rhb8rx.zh: 可以在任何时候更换学说树，但在解锁另一套学说树时，先前已解锁学说的所有加成都将丢失。当选择不同的学说树时，任何学说专属的⟦0⟧精神也会自动切换为其他精神。

3jyhao.en: Grand Doctrines represent the overall doctrine of an air force. They provide bonuses when unlocked, as well as unique milestones for each track once mastered. Only one Grand Doctrine can be enabled at a time.
3jyhao.zh: 总体学说代表一支空军的整体学说。解锁时提供加成，并在达到精通后为每条路线提供独特的里程碑。同时只能启用一个总体学说。

1ow26td.en: Some nations start the game with a air doctrine pre-selected and unlocked. They can still change doctrines as normal, though sticking with their starting doctrine can cost them less ⟦0⟧ in the long run.
1ow26td.zh: 有些国家在游戏开始时已预选并解锁了一项空军学说。它们仍可照常更换学说，不过从长远来看，坚持其初始学说可以让它们少花费⟦0⟧。

1667vep.en: Each individual grand doctrine and subdoctrine has a base cost of 100 ⟦0⟧ to unlock. This cost may be modified by spirits, advisors, and special bonuses from focuses, events, or decisions.
1667vep.zh: 每个单独的总体学说和子学说的解锁基础花费为 100 ⟦0⟧。该花费可能被精神、顾问以及来自国策、事件或决议的特殊加成所修正。

1wte6qz.en: ⟦0⟧ allows a nation to specialize the way its air force conducts ⟦1⟧. Air doctrines can be reviewed and unlocked from the ⟦2⟧ using ⟦3⟧. There are three mutually exclusive doctrine trees.
1wte6qz.zh: ⟦0⟧允许一个国家专精其空军进行⟦1⟧的方式。空军学说可以在⟦2⟧中使用⟦3⟧查看和解锁。共有三套互斥的学说树。

73muju.en: ⟦0⟧: Counteracts enemy detection when on Strategic Bombing mission, reducing the maximum number of enemy planes responding to the bombers. See ⟦1⟧.
73muju.zh: ⟦0⟧：执行战略轰炸任务时抵消敌方探测，减少响应轰炸机的敌方飞机最大数量。见⟦1⟧。

if5pa8.en: ⟦0⟧: Reduces the negative effects of night for planes on Strategic Bombing mission, notably the Ground Bombing Targeting penalty.
if5pa8.zh: ⟦0⟧：减轻夜间对执行战略轰炸任务飞机的负面影响，尤其是对地轰炸瞄准惩罚。

17yh1ku.en: ⟦0⟧: Modifies the negative effect enemy air superiority has on the combat ability of our ground troops. See ⟦1⟧.
17yh1ku.zh: ⟦0⟧：修正敌方制空权对我方地面部队作战能力的负面影响。见⟦1⟧。

b1wou5.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the amount of detection planes on Air Superiority mission contribute to the region. See ⟦1⟧.
b1wou5.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行制空权任务的飞机为该地区贡献的探测值。见⟦1⟧。

rd3qu3.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the contribution of planes on Air Superiority to their air zone's air superiority. See ⟦1⟧.
rd3qu3.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行制空权任务的飞机对其所在空域制空权的贡献。见⟦1⟧。

1stoeg2.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the amount of detection planes on Interception mission contribute to the region. See ⟦1⟧.
1stoeg2.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行拦截任务的飞机为该地区贡献的探测值。见⟦1⟧。

1emc149.en: ⟦0⟧: Improves air attack, air defense, and agility for planes on this mission. See ⟦1⟧.
1emc149.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行此任务的飞机的对空攻击、对空防御和机动性。见⟦1⟧。

g78xb4.en: When a track as been mastered, it unlocks the grand doctrine milestone for the track.
g78xb4.zh: 当某条路线达到精通后，会解锁该路线的总体学说里程碑。

o2kmcx.en: ⟦0⟧ Increases the scaling rate of the ⟦1⟧ bonus provided by air superiority. See ⟦2⟧.
o2kmcx.zh: ⟦0⟧ 提高制空权提供的⟦1⟧加成的成长速率。见⟦2⟧。

1f15yzk.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the air defense for planes on Strategic Bombing mission. See ⟦1⟧.
1f15yzk.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行战略轰炸任务飞机的对空防御。见⟦1⟧。

1g41po8.en: For the pre-1.17 doctrine system, see a previous version of this page.
1g41po8.zh: 关于 1.17 之前的学说系统，请参见本页的旧版本。

jf8bti.en: ⟦0⟧: Improves Strategic Bombing damage for planes on that mission.
jf8bti.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行该任务飞机的战略轰炸伤害。

123wqd7.en: ⟦0⟧: Increase the probability of generating aces during missions.
123wqd7.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高执行任务时产生王牌的几率。

4edqty.en: Tactical Bombers, Heavy Fighters, Scout Planes
4edqty.zh: 战术轰炸机、重型战斗机、侦察机

15d9s19.zh: 近距空中支援组织度伤害：⟦0⟧

10nf2nn.zh: 100 空勤人员生存与规避训练

1d4ckh7.zh: 战略轰炸机、海上巡逻轰炸机

43ykfc.zh: 200 不可预测的空中巡逻模式

70g7t8.zh: 近距空中支援、海军轰炸机

120ubqp.zh: 100 全面的空中机枪手训练

17rz25z.zh: 400 训练有素的弹射器操作组

1vcn97h.en: While aircraft do not suffer from attrition, they have a ⟦0⟧ base chance of suffering an accident. This gets modified by a balancing factor (⟦1⟧),⟦2⟧ their reliability (up to ⟦3⟧ at 0% reliability), if they are on an aircraft carrier (⟦4⟧),⟦5⟧ if they are currently performing ⟦6⟧ (⟦7⟧),⟦8⟧ their ⟦9⟧, weather, and other modifiers (though not country-level ones from national spirits if they are negative).⟦10⟧ Every game hour, all air bases are checked for accidents. ⟦11⟧ accident can happen per hour per airbase, but multiple planes could be destroyed in it. The accident can affect a random portion of the wing between 0% and 100%, but only ⟦12⟧ of the wing actually gets destroyed. If the effect is less than one plane (often the case with aircraft carriers), these fractional parts are accumulated on a country-wide level and added to the next accident effect.
1vcn97h.zh: 飞机不会遭受损耗，但它们有⟦0⟧的基础事故概率。该概率会被平衡系数（⟦1⟧）、⟦2⟧其可靠度（可靠度为 0% 时最高可达⟦3⟧）、是否位于航空母舰上（⟦4⟧）、⟦5⟧当前是否正在执行⟦6⟧（⟦7⟧）、⟦8⟧其⟦9⟧、天气以及其他修正（但不包括来自国家精神的全国性修正，若这些修正为负值）所调整。⟦10⟧每个游戏小时，都会对所有空军基地进行事故检查。每个空军基地每小时最多可发生⟦11⟧次事故，但一次事故可能摧毁多架飞机。事故可以影响航空队中 0% 到 100% 之间的随机一部分，但只有航空队的⟦12⟧会真正被摧毁。如果效果不足一架飞机（在航空母舰上常常如此），这些小数部分会在全国范围内累积，并计入下一次的事故效果。

yidw9g.en: All aircraft (other than ⟦0⟧ with Götterdämmerung) start with a reliability of at least 80%, though this can be modified up or down through the use of ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. With a reliability of 90% and no other modifiers, the average hourly loss rate from accidents would become 0.007% of a wing per airbase, which translates to 0.168% of a wing per airbase per day and 61.32% of an air wing per airbase per year. With a reliability of 40% (common with ⟦3⟧ without ⟦4⟧'s ⟦5⟧) and no other modifiers, the average hourly loss rate from accidents would become 0.042% of a wing per airbase, which translates to 1.008% of a wing per airbase per day and 367.92% of an air wing per airbase per year.
yidw9g.zh: 所有飞机（Götterdämmerung 中的⟦0⟧除外）初始可靠度至少为 80%，不过可以通过使用⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧来调高或调低。在可靠度为 90% 且没有其他修正的情况下，每空军基地每小时的平均事故损失率将为航空队的 0.007%，换算过来就是每空军基地每天 0.168%、每空军基地每年 61.32%。在可靠度为 40%（在⟦3⟧中，没有⟦4⟧的⟦5⟧时这是常见情形）且没有其他修正的情况下，每空军基地每小时的平均事故损失率将为航空队的 0.042%，换算过来就是每空军基地每天 1.008%、每空军基地每年 367.92%。

1t563k9.en: Ships can also suffer accidents from operating in ⟦0⟧. The chance of a ship hitting a mine in a particular sea zone depends on how saturated the sea zone is with mines (up to ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧) as well as the sea zone's ⟦3⟧. When a ship does hit a mine, it loses loses ⟦4⟧ of its current organization and takes ⟦5⟧ strength damage, which can sink smaller vessels outright. There is also a ⟦6⟧ chance of a training accident being a critical hit, which multiplies all organization and strength damage taken from the accident by ⟦7⟧,⟦8⟧ allowing mines to potentially instantly sink even larger vessels.
1t563k9.zh: 舰船也可能因在⟦0⟧中行动而遭遇事故。舰船在特定海域触雷的概率取决于该海域的水雷饱和程度（最高为⟦1⟧⟦2⟧）以及该海域的⟦3⟧。舰船一旦触雷，就会损失其当前组织度的⟦4⟧并受到⟦5⟧兵力伤害，这可能直接击沉较小的舰船。训练事故还有⟦6⟧的概率成为暴击，使事故造成的所有组织度和兵力伤害乘以⟦7⟧，⟦8⟧从而使水雷有可能瞬间击沉更大的舰船。

i8axt9.en: For attrition from training, it can be helpful to ⟦0⟧. Divisions can still be trained even when they are using outdated ⟦1⟧, or even no equipment, and do not lose any ⟦2⟧ from receiving more up-to-date equipment after they have been trained in the field. Restricting equipment can also be done for air wings performing ⟦3⟧, as losing old and outdated aircraft to training accidents is better than losing more expensive, up-to-date equipment.
i8axt9.zh: 对于训练造成的损耗，采取⟦0⟧可能会有帮助。师即使在使用过时⟦1⟧、甚至没有装备的情况下也仍然可以训练；而它们在实战训练之后再接收更新式的装备，也不会损失任何⟦2⟧。对于正在执行⟦3⟧的航空队也可以限制装备，因为让老旧过时的飞机损失在训练事故中，好过损失更昂贵、更先进的装备。

mjayyq.en: Ships that are performing ⟦0⟧ have a ⟦1⟧ chance of suffering an accident every hour. When it happens, the ship loses ⟦2⟧ of its current organization and ⟦3⟧ of its maximum HP, plus an extra ⟦4⟧ strength damage. There is also a ⟦5⟧ chance of a training accident being a critical hit, which multiplies all organization and strength damage taken from the accident by ⟦6⟧.⟦7⟧
mjayyq.zh: 正在执行⟦0⟧的舰船每小时有⟦1⟧的概率遭遇事故。事故发生时，舰船损失其当前组织度的⟦2⟧和最大 HP 的⟦3⟧，外加额外的⟦4⟧兵力伤害。训练事故还有⟦5⟧的概率成为暴击，使事故造成的所有组织度和兵力伤害乘以⟦6⟧。⟦7⟧

1m9ygqj.en: A division loses ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ organization per hour from attrition, both in combat and out of combat. Divisions that are out of supply also suffer up to ⟦2⟧ recovery rate (and thus, their hourly organization gain) based on both how much they are out of supply and how long they have been out of supply, with the maximum effect being achieved after 30⟦3⟧ days.
1m9ygqj.zh: 一个师因损耗每小时损失⟦0⟧⟦1⟧组织度，无论处于战斗中还是战斗之外都是如此。断补给的师还会根据其断补给的程度和断补给的时间损失最多⟦2⟧的恢复率（因而也损失每小时的组织度获取），在 30⟦3⟧天后达到最大效果。

1cw87xq.en: For attrition to off-map ⟦0⟧, it can be useful to reduce ⟦1⟧. This will reduce the range of ⟦2⟧ and potentially cause attrition for land units who will become out of supply as a result, so it can also be helpful to build new ⟦3⟧ or ⟦4⟧ to reduce increased load on the supply network caused by lowering the level of motorization.
1cw87xq.zh: 对于地图外⟦0⟧造成的损耗，降低⟦1⟧可能会有帮助。这会缩短⟦2⟧的范围，并可能使陆上单位因随之断补给而遭受损耗，因此建造新的⟦3⟧或⟦4⟧以缓解因降低摩托化程度而增加的后勤网络负荷也会有帮助。

1yd9daj.en: For 100% attrition and 0% reliability, about 12% of equipment will be lost per day. For 5% attrition and 80% reliability, which are very common conditions for training divisions that use a lot of infantry equipment, 67 days of training (enough to go from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧) will cost about 8.04% of equipment.
1yd9daj.zh: 在 100% 损耗和 0% 可靠度下，每天大约会损失 12% 的装备。在 5% 损耗和 80% 可靠度下——这是大量使用步兵装备的训练师的常见状况——训练 67 天（足以从⟦0⟧升到⟦1⟧）将花费大约 8.04% 的装备。

7twm1w.en: For attrition from high resistance, certain ⟦0⟧ like ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ and performing the ⟦3⟧ mission with ⟦4⟧ can be used to lower it. If enemy ⟦5⟧ are boosting resistance through ⟦6⟧, they can be thwarted by performing the ⟦7⟧ mission with ⟦8⟧ and/or taking the ⟦9⟧ and/or ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧ upgrades.
7twm1w.zh: 对于高抵抗度造成的损耗，可以动用某些⟦0⟧，例如⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧，并派⟦3⟧⟦4⟧任务来降低它。如果敌方⟦5⟧正在通过⟦6⟧提升抵抗度，而⟦7⟧任务可以由⟦8⟧执行来反击，和/或采取⟦9⟧和/或⟦10⟧⟦11⟧升级，即可挫败他们。

loo8ms.en: ⟦0⟧ will lead to the loss of ⟦1⟧ and organization (though not ⟦2⟧) beyond combat operations. Only land units suffer from attrition, but naval and air units can suffer ⟦3⟧ that act in a similar fashion, especially when training or operating in harsh weather.
loo8ms.zh: ⟦0⟧会导致在战斗行动之外损失⟦1⟧和组织度（但不损失⟦2⟧）。只有陆上单位会遭受损耗，但海军和空军单位会遭受作用方式类似的⟦3⟧，在训练或在恶劣天气中行动时尤为如此。

15gns70.en: For attrition due to ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ weather, acclimatizing units to that weather can reduce their attrition from it. Certain ⟦2⟧, support companies like ⟦3⟧, special forces doctrines/⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧ like ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ can speed up hot and/or cold acclimatization.
15gns70.zh: 对于⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧天气造成的损耗，让单位适应这种天气可以减少由此产生的损耗。某些⟦2⟧、诸如⟦3⟧之类的支援连、特种部队学说/⟦4⟧，以及⟦5⟧（诸如⟦6⟧和⟦7⟧），都可以加快炎热和/或寒冷适应。

izv4qx.en: Assuming a reliability of 80% and no other modifiers, the average amount of aircraft lost per hour would be 0.014% of a wing per airbase. This accumulates to 0.336% of a wing per airbase per day and 122.64% of an air wing per airbase per year.
izv4qx.zh: 假设可靠度为 80% 且没有其他修正，每小时损失的飞机平均为每空军基地航空队的 0.014%。这累积起来就是每空军基地每天 0.336%、每空军基地每年 122.64%。

kvn5h6.en: There is also an additional ⟦0⟧ balancing factor present for naval accidents, including from training and from mines. This ensures naval accidents are to occur at around that rate, preventing extremely lucky or unlucky streaks.
kvn5h6.zh: 对于海军事故，包括训练和触雷造成的事故，还额外存在一个⟦0⟧平衡系数。这可确保海军事故大致按该频率发生，避免出现极其幸运或极其不幸的连胜连败。

9xxcrn.en: For attrition from low supply, attaching a ⟦0⟧ to divisions can be helpful, as can improving the supply network, or even simply moving units out of overloaded areas until there is enough supply left for remaining units.
9xxcrn.zh: 对于补给不足造成的损耗，给师配属⟦0⟧可能会有帮助，改善补给网络也有帮助，甚至只需把单位移出过载区域，直到剩下的补给足够供给其余单位即可。

87k686.en: For attrition due to temporary weather effects, such as ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, or ⟦2⟧, it can be helpful to wait until these conditions clear up. The build-up of ⟦3⟧ in particular can also be reduced by upgrading a state's ⟦4⟧.
87k686.zh: 对于⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧等临时天气效果造成的损耗，等到这些状况消退可能会有帮助。特别是⟦3⟧的累积，还可以通过升级州的⟦4⟧来减少。

19dszjw.en: The game does still make references to naval attrition, however. Some of the game's defines supposedly control naval attrition effects,⟦0⟧ as do certain admiral traits like ⟦1⟧ and weather effects like ⟦2⟧.
19dszjw.zh: 不过，游戏中仍然保留着对海军损耗的引用。游戏中的一些 defines 被认为控制着海军损耗效果，⟦0⟧某些海军将领特质（如⟦1⟧）和天气效果（如⟦2⟧）也是如此。

k7gaec.en: For attrition due to rough ⟦0⟧, such as ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧, it can be helpful to reduce the amount of time spent in these terrains in the first place, especially with divisions containing low reliability equipment.
k7gaec.zh: 对于崎岖⟦0⟧（例如⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧）造成的损耗，首先减少在这些地形中停留的时间可能会有帮助，对于编有低可靠度装备的师尤其如此。

17e64tx.en: Prides of the fleet are far less affected by accidents. Their accident chances are scaled by ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ and even when they do get an accident, the chance of it being a critical hit are also scaled by ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧
17e64tx.zh: 舰队之傲受事故的影响要小得多。它们的事故概率按⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧缩放，而且即使真的发生事故，其成为暴击的概率也按⟦2⟧缩放。⟦3⟧

1tjdyf2.en: Off-map ⟦0⟧ have a baseline attrition rate ⟦1⟧ instead. They multiply all sources of attrition by ⟦2⟧, but can be far more adversely affected by certain sources of attrition than regular land units:
1tjdyf2.zh: 地图外⟦0⟧的基础损耗率为⟦1⟧。它们会把所有损耗来源乘以⟦2⟧，但某些损耗来源对它们的影响可能比普通陆上单位严重得多：

1lsptem.en: For land units, one way is to improve the reliability of their equipment by attaching a ⟦0⟧ to divisions or by creating new equipment ⟦1⟧ and designs (for ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧) with more reliability.
1lsptem.zh: 对于陆上单位，一种办法是通过给师配属⟦0⟧，或创建可靠度更高的新装备⟦1⟧和设计（针对⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧），来提高其装备的可靠度。

126plut.en: Adjusting the strength slider of a major country in its ⟦0⟧ settings prior to a game will reduce the amount of attrition that that country's units will receive. However, doing so disables ⟦1⟧.
126plut.zh: 在开局前于⟦0⟧设置中调整主要国家的实力滑块，会减少该国单位承受的损耗量。但这样做会禁用⟦1⟧。

vdwg0b.en: Higher reliability reduces equipment loss from attrition. Reliability above 100% has no further impact on equipment losses and acts identical to having a reliability of 100%.
vdwg0b.zh: 更高的可靠度会减少损耗造成的装备损失。可靠度高于 100% 不会对装备损失产生进一步影响，其效果与可靠度为 100% 完全相同。

vnott2.en: Due to how low the losses from accidents are when compared to actual combat, it's usually preferable to disregard reliability in favor of combat stats in most situations.
vnott2.zh: 由于与真正的战斗相比，事故造成的损失极低，因此在大多数情况下通常宁可无视可靠度，而优先选择战斗属性。

1h2g0y0.en: Ships do not suffer from attrition, but their reliability corresponds with probability of getting ⟦0⟧ by enemy attacks. However, they can suffer accidents.
1h2g0y0.zh: 舰船不会遭受损耗，但其可靠度对应着被敌方攻击击中⟦0⟧的概率。不过，它们会遭遇事故。

70rxfb.en: All on-map units have a baseline attrition rate of ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ Attrition can be caused or increased by the following:
70rxfb.zh: 所有地图上单位的基础损耗率为⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧损耗可以由以下因素造成或增加：

13k5hph.en: For sufficiently high equipment counts or low reliability, and with one day being 24 hours, this simplifies to:
13k5hph.zh: 对于足够高的装备数量或足够低的可靠度，并且以一天 24 小时计算，这可简化为：

1m2jdlu.en: Transporting supplies through rugged ⟦0⟧ (i.e., ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧): up to ⟦7⟧

cd04uh.en: For land units, the average amount of equipment lost per hour for each type of equipment is:
cd04uh.zh: 对于陆上单位，每种装备每小时平均损失的装备量为：

fp4civ.en: The ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ under the Mass Mobilization path of ⟦2⟧ reduces attrition for all land units
fp4civ.zh: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧是⟦2⟧总动员路线下的，会减少所有陆上单位的损耗

1q592mu.en: : Equipment lost per hour = 0.005 · attrition · number of equipment · (1 - reliability)
1q592mu.zh: ：每小时损失装备 = 0.005 · 损耗 · 装备数量 · （1 - 可靠度）

65ndhx.en: It should be noted that each equipment variant calculates attrition independently.
65ndhx.zh: 需要注意的是，每种装备变体都会独立计算损耗。

17ut6c7.en: Certain political advisors and ⟦0⟧ figures can reduce attrition when employed
17ut6c7.zh: 某些政治顾问和⟦0⟧人物在受雇时可以减少损耗

1s8fupn.en: Another way is to find the source of attrition and mitigate or eliminate it:
1s8fupn.zh: 另一种办法是找出损耗的来源并减轻或消除它：

10glpsl.en: : Average daily attrition rate = 12% · attrition · (1 - reliability)
10glpsl.zh: ：平均每日损耗率 = 12% · 损耗 · （1 - 可靠度）

1rf561c.en: There are also ways to reduce attrition globally. These include:
1rf561c.zh: 还有一些办法可以全局性地减少损耗。这些办法包括：

1ve4tz1.en: Moving in hostile ⟦0⟧ (i.e., ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧): up to ⟦5⟧

otlzkh.en: There are several ways to reduce the effects of equipment loss.
otlzkh.zh: 有若干种方法可以减少装备损失的影响。

5napol.en: Transporting supplies through adverse Weather: up to ⟦0⟧
5napol.zh: 通过恶劣天气运输补给：最高⟦0⟧

1upsys8.en: Certain ⟦0⟧ unlocked through ⟦1⟧ can reduce attrition
1upsys8.zh: 某些⟦0⟧经由⟦1⟧解锁后可以减少损耗

1ouwy5e.en: Less than 35%⟦0⟧ supply status: up to ⟦1⟧
