clh0nx.en: Each country has a special forces cap that dictates the maximum amount of special forces battalions they are allowed to field. This cap is the greater of either 24⟦0⟧ battalions or 5%⟦1⟧ of the total amount of non-SF battalions making up the rest of your deployed divisions. Divisions cannot be changed, trained, given a different template or have their template adjusted if that would result in exceeding the SF cap. By default, to increase the SF cap beyond the default 24 without any bonuses, you would have to exceed the 480 non-SF battalion breakeven point by 20 for each additional SF battalion. For example, you would need 500 non-SF battalions for 25 SF battalions, 520 non-SF battalions for 26 SF battalions, 540 non-SF battalions for 27 SF battalions, etc. These battalions do not need to be fully equipped or be at full strength, they just need to be part of divisions that are deployed in the field.
clh0nx.zh: 每个国家都有一个特种部队上限，它决定了该国最多可以部署多少个特种部队营。该上限取以下两者中的较大值：24⟦0⟧个营，或占其余已部署师中非特种部队营总数 5%⟦1⟧的营数。如果改动会使部队超过特种部队上限，则师不能被更改、训练、更换为其他师编制，其师编制也不能被调整。默认情况下，若没有任何加成而想把特种部队上限提高到默认的 24 以上，则每多一个特种部队营，就需要在 480 个非特种部队营的平衡点之上再多出 20 个。例如，25 个特种部队营需要 500 个非特种部队营，26 个需要 520 个，27 个需要 540 个，依此类推。这些营不需要满装备也不需要满兵力，它们只需隶属于已部署到战场上的师即可。

1lcdkmm.en: Mechanized technologies focus on improving ⟦0⟧ units and can benefit from motorized technology bonuses. Compared to ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ are slower, more expensive, and more fuel-intensive (though they are still much faster than ordinary ⟦3⟧), but they have far greater hardness and provide a lot more defense and HP. Their production costs can also be potentially through designing a variant using ⟦4⟧, which, when coupled with how few equipment losses they suffer thanks to their high HP, can actually make them more affordable in practice than ⟦5⟧ once the combat casualties start rolling in. Although their offensive stats lack compared to tanks', with enough upgrades, ⟦6⟧ can also be surprisingly capable on the offense and can even go toe-to-toe with enemy tanks when used alongside ⟦7⟧ units.
1lcdkmm.zh: 机械化科技专注于改进⟦0⟧单位，并可受益于摩托化科技加成。与⟦1⟧相比，⟦2⟧速度更慢、造价更高，也更耗燃料（尽管仍远快于普通的⟦3⟧），但其硬度高得多，并能提供多得多的防御和兵力。它们的生产成本也有可能通过使用⟦4⟧设计变体来降低；再加上它们因高兵力而装备损失很少，一旦战斗伤亡开始累积，这实际上能让它们比⟦5⟧更划算。尽管其进攻属性不如坦克，但只要有足够的升级，⟦6⟧在进攻端也能出人意料地强悍，与⟦7⟧单位配合使用时甚至可以与敌方坦克正面抗衡。

4kvbfk.en: These technologies increase the capabilities, and potentially also the number, of special forces units. The first tech will give them a boost to acclimatization speed. Afterwards, the tree splits into two options. One option is to train your special forces harder, to improve their skills and their ability to fight for longer before having to be resupplied. The other option is to expand the special forces training programs to accept more recruits: your special forces will be more numerous, but come with more drag and not quite as high speed. In the end, though, they will still be elite forces and will be able to develop training to make them even more skilled in fighting in the harshest of conditions.
4kvbfk.zh: 这些科技会提升特种部队单位的能力，也可能增加其数量。第一个科技会提升其适应速度。此后，国策树分为两个方向。一个方向是更严苛地训练特种部队，以提升其技能，并让它们在被补给之前能战斗更久。另一个方向是扩大特种部队训练项目以招收更多新兵：特种部队数量会更多，但阻力更大，速度也不那么高。不过归根结底，它们仍将是精锐部队，并能通过发展训练在最为严酷的条件下作战时更加娴熟。

peo1r4.en: With ⟦0⟧, they unfortunately suffer from being much less customizable than their tank-based counterparts. Thanks to the ⟦1⟧, once their ⟦2⟧ counterparts have become obsolete later in the game, they can get up-gunned and/or repurposed into ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, or ⟦5⟧, whereas obselete armored car upgrades are limited to incremental ⟦6⟧ where they are stuck with their outdated equipment forever. With ⟦7⟧, they further suffer from requiring their own, dedicated ⟦8⟧ that cannot be used for any other type of equipment, whereas their tank-based counterparts share their ⟦9⟧ with those that can also be used for other types of tanks, thereby offering industrial synergies that armored cars lack.
peo1r4.zh: 有了⟦0⟧，它们不幸地远不如以坦克为基础的同类装备那样可定制。得益于⟦1⟧，当它们的⟦2⟧同类在游戏后期过时之后，它们可以换装更强的火炮，和/或被改装为⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧或⟦5⟧，而过时的装甲车升级仅限于逐步的⟦6⟧，它们将永远被过时的装备所束缚。有了⟦7⟧，它们还苦于需要专属于自己的⟦8⟧，而这种装备不能用于任何其他类型的装备；反观以坦克为基础的同类装备，其⟦9⟧可与那些也能用于其他类型坦克的装备共用，从而带来装甲车所缺乏的工业协同效应。

1rgz0q9.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ are special forces versions of ⟦2⟧ more suited to wet terrain and naval invasions, and as special forces, are subject to a country's special forces cap. Although they have less breakthrough than their mechanized counterparts, consume a lot more fuel, and cannot be customized using ⟦3⟧ to discount them in the same way, amtracs not only receive terrain bonuses in ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ landings, but they also benefit from special forces attack bonuses from, e.g., special forces doctrines and ⟦7⟧.
1rgz0q9.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧是⟦2⟧的特种部队版本，更适合湿软地形和海军登陆；而作为特种部队，它们受国家特种部队上限的限制。尽管与机械化同类相比突破更低、燃料消耗高得多，也不能像它们那样用⟦3⟧来自定义减价，但两栖牵引车不仅在⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧登陆中获得地形加成，还能受益于特种部队攻击加成，例如来自特种部队学说和⟦7⟧的加成。

ij524e.en: Later technologies also provide infantry with decent hard attack and a small amount of piercing. Although ⟦0⟧ and/or ⟦1⟧ companies, even with older equipment, will still provide infantry divisions with far more piercing, especially because 40%⟦2⟧ of a division's piercing comes from the brigade or support company with the highest amount, the additional hard attack can still make these divisions far more effective against harder opponents, like tanks or mechanized infantry.
ij524e.zh: 后期科技还能为步兵提供可观的硬攻和少量穿透。尽管⟦0⟧和/或⟦1⟧连即使使用较旧的装备，仍能为步兵师提供多得多的穿透，尤其是因为一个师 40%⟦2⟧的穿透来自穿透值最高的旅或支援连，但额外的硬攻仍能让这些师在面对坦克或机械化步兵等更硬的对手时有效得多。

jfyw89.en: Representing an infantryman's standard kit of tools and weapons, Infantry Equipment is the basis of any army. The ⟦0⟧ technology starts researched for all countries, while all major powers and many minors have the ⟦1⟧ technology researched. As infantry equipment serves as the primary, potentially only, source of stats for most unit types, unlocking and fielding upgraded versions of them earlier than the enemy can provide a significant advantage.
jfyw89.zh: 步兵装备代表一名步兵的标准工具与武器配装，是任何军队的基础。⟦0⟧科技对所有国家都是已研究状态，而所有主要国家和许多小国都已研究⟦1⟧科技。由于步兵装备是大多数单位类型属性的主要来源、甚至可能是唯一来源，比敌人更早解锁并装备其升级版本可以带来显著优势。

jhnec2.en: Special forces cap can also be increased through certain political advisors, military high command posts, ⟦0⟧, and decisions that affect national spirits. With ⟦1⟧, the amount of special forces that can be fielded can be increased through special forces doctrines, both by increasing special forces cap and by decreasing the contribution of certain units to that cap. Without ⟦2⟧, special forces cap can be increased with the ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ technology.
jhnec2.zh: 特种部队上限也可以通过某些政治顾问、最高统帅部职位、⟦0⟧以及影响国家精神的决议来提高。有了⟦1⟧，可部署的特种部队数量可以通过特种部队学说来提高，既可以直接提高特种部队上限，也可以降低某些单位对该上限的占用。没有⟦2⟧时，特种部队上限可以通过⟦3⟧⟦4⟧科技来提高。

8q373g.en: Support weapons includes crew-served weapons such as medium and heavy machine guns and mortars. These technologies provide bonuses to the defense and breakthrough to all types of infantry and to cavalry. This reduces incoming damage taken in combat against enemies who have greater soft and/or hard attack (dependent on the given units' hardness), though it provides little to no additional benefit against enemies with lower attack values.
8q373g.zh: 支援武器包括中型和重型机枪、迫击炮等需要多人操作的武器。这些科技为所有类型的步兵和骑兵提供防御和突破加成。这能减少与软攻和/或硬攻更高（取决于给定单位的硬度）的敌人作战时受到的伤害，但面对攻击属性更低的敌人时几乎不会提供额外收益。

13gbajj.en: In addition to units, motorized technology enables and can enhance ⟦0⟧. Motorized supply extends the range of ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, allowing them to supply units that are much further away. However, this comes at the cost of motorized equipment, both when enabling motorization and when said motorized equipment suffers losses from breakdowns in rugged ⟦3⟧ and/or bad weather and/or losses from enemy ⟦4⟧.
13gbajj.zh: 除了单位之外，摩托化科技还能启用并强化⟦0⟧。摩托化补给扩大了⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧的范围，使它们能够为远得多的单位提供补给。但代价是消耗摩托化装备：无论是在启用摩托化时，还是在崎岖⟦3⟧和/或恶劣天气中因故障损失这些摩托化装备时，和/或遭受敌方⟦4⟧造成的损失时，都是如此。

1ybiz3g.en: ⟦0⟧ and their ⟦1⟧ counterparts are avaialble with La Résistance. These are effectively weaker, softer, much faster, and slightly cheaper alternatives to ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧, respectively. In theory, their niche is would be for somewhat of a hybrid role between light tanks and motorized infantry, though players may struggle to find a practical use for this niche.
1ybiz3g.zh: ⟦0⟧及其⟦1⟧同类随 La Résistance 提供。它们实际上是分别比⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧更弱、更软、快得多且略便宜的替代品。理论上，它们的定位介于轻型坦克与摩托化步兵之间，算是一种混合角色，不过玩家可能很难为这一细分定位找到实际用途。

1147skd.en: Some of these technologies, mainly the ones affecting motorized and mechanized equipment, are interlinked with special projects, providing breakthrough progress in land warfare projects and benefitting from any ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in that category. Such technologies have a green ribbons in the lower right-hand corner of their icons.
1147skd.zh: 其中一些科技——主要是影响摩托化和机械化装备的那些——与特殊项目相互关联，能在陆战项目中提供突破进度，并受益于任何在该类别中从事被动研究的⟦0⟧。此类科技的图标右下角会带有绿色缎带。

1qzppte.en: In addition to regular, motorized, and mechanized infantry, there are three specialized infantry types, known as ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ (not to be confused with the ⟦2⟧ Superior Firepower): ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧. These units are useful in specific situations. They only require standard infantry equipment, but tend to require more of it compared to ⟦6⟧.
1qzppte.zh: 除了常规、摩托化和机械化步兵之外，还有三种专业步兵类型，称为⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧（不要与⟦2⟧优势火力混淆）：⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧。这些单位在特定情况下很有用。它们只需要标准步兵装备，但与⟦6⟧相比往往需要更多。

1scxcu9.en: ⟦0⟧ are the only type of unit that can be paradropped into the field, which they do via transport plane. This allows them to perform operations behind enemy lines and in locations where other units cannot easily reach. It is important to note that divisions that mix ⟦1⟧ with other line battalions cannot be paradropped.
1scxcu9.zh: ⟦0⟧是唯一可以空投到战场上的单位类型，它们通过运输机进行空投。这使它们能够在敌后以及其他单位难以到达的地点执行行动。需要注意的是，将⟦1⟧与其他一线营混编的师无法空投。

6cl8ni.en: Motorized versions of line brigades tend to be much faster than their non-motorized counterparts, have slightly more hardness, and be slightly better on the attack thanks to having more breakthrough, but they also tend to be more expensive, be less reliable, have more penalties on rugged terrain, and require fuel.
6cl8ni.zh: 一线旅的摩托化版本往往比非摩托化同类快得多，硬度略高，并且由于突破更高而在进攻上略强；但它们往往也更贵、可靠性更低、在崎岖地形上受到更多惩罚，并且需要燃料。

2njcv3.en: Night vision equipment allows soldiers to see even in the dark, offsetting some of the ⟦0⟧ penalty that units receive when fighting at night, giving an edge over enemies who do not have such equipment. When combined with the ⟦1⟧ land doctrine, they can potentially remove all night fighting penalties altogether.
2njcv3.zh: 夜视装备让士兵即使在黑暗中也能够视物，从而抵销部队在夜间作战时受到的部分⟦0⟧惩罚，取得对没有此类装备的敌人的优势。当与⟦1⟧陆军学说结合时，它们有可能完全消除所有夜间作战惩罚。

1qd98fh.en: ⟦0⟧ unlocks new infantry ⟦1⟧, motorized equipment, and mechanized equipment, as well as improving infantry and cavalry performance as a whole. It also hosts technologies that enable and improve special forces infantry, as well as an additional set of technologies enhancing special forces without ⟦2⟧.
1qd98fh.zh: ⟦0⟧解锁新的步兵⟦1⟧、摩托化装备和机械化装备，并整体提升步兵与骑兵的表现。它还包含启用并改进特种部队步兵的科技，以及一套在没有⟦2⟧的情况下强化特种部队的额外科技。

pi2wka.en: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ units also count as special forces units. The former are closer to ⟦2⟧ units than to ⟦3⟧ and require their own, specialized ⟦4⟧. The latter are armored units that rely on ⟦5⟧. With ⟦6⟧, they can also be built out of ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧ chasses using the ⟦10⟧.
pi2wka.zh: ⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧单位也算作特种部队单位。前者更接近⟦2⟧单位而非⟦3⟧，并且需要专属的专用⟦4⟧。后者是依赖⟦5⟧的装甲单位。有了⟦6⟧，它们还可以由⟦7⟧、⟦8⟧和⟦9⟧底盘建造，并使用⟦10⟧。

14blr4p.en: ⟦0⟧ are specialized infantry trained to engage in wet terrain and perform amphibious invasions. They receive bonuses when attacking over wet ⟦1⟧ and during naval invasions. Marine units are very effective when supported by ⟦2⟧ or their ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, or ⟦5⟧ cousins.
14blr4p.zh: ⟦0⟧是经过专门训练、用于在湿软地形作战并执行两栖登陆的步兵。它们在越过湿软⟦1⟧进攻时以及海军登陆期间获得加成。海军陆战队单位在得到⟦2⟧或其⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧或⟦5⟧同类支援时非常有效。

kjqjpt.en: All mobile infantry technologies are linked to land warfare special projects. They provide breakthrough progress in that category when they are being researched, and they benefit from any ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in that category.
kjqjpt.zh: 所有机动步兵科技都与陆战特殊项目相关联。它们在研究期间会为该类别提供突破进度，并受益于任何在该类别中从事被动研究的⟦0⟧。

1on8l52.en: Mobile Infantry technology enables ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, as well as motorized versions of artillery brigades, motorized support companies, and other, more specialized motorized brigades.
1on8l52.zh: 机动步兵科技启用⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧，以及火炮旅、摩托化支援连和其他更专业化的摩托化旅的摩托化版本。

19fyzse.en: These technologies can also benefit from both motorized and mechanized technology bonuses, as well as technology bonuses for naval transports.
19fyzse.zh: 这些科技还可以同时受益于摩托化和机械化科技加成，以及海军运输相关科技的加成。

1bpb0ql.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ are specialized infantry that excel in maneuvering through and engaging in rough ⟦2⟧, such as ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧.
1bpb0ql.zh: ⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧是擅长在崎岖⟦2⟧（例如⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧）中机动和作战的专业步兵。

j75t7c.en: These technologies can also benefit from motorized and armor technology bonuses.
j75t7c.zh: 这些科技还可以受益于摩托化和装甲科技加成。

tzpd53.en: ⟦0⟧ via Light Infantry Divisions Doctrine or Light Infantry Divisions Doctrine
tzpd53.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过轻型步兵师学说或轻型步兵师学说获得

2b0jsu.en: If the United Kingdom agrees to give over the defense of the Gulf to Turkey.
2b0jsu.zh: 如果英国同意将波斯湾的防务交给土耳其。

19nmin0.en: The AI will use paratroopers in battle, but never uses them for paradrops.
19nmin0.zh: AI 会在战斗中使用伞兵，但从不使用它们进行空降。

avlgbv.en: ⟦0⟧ via Expand the Diósgyör Machinery Factory or Form the Gyorshadtest
avlgbv.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过扩建迪欧什哲尔机械厂或组建捷尔吉装甲部队获得

1lx6s5s.en: ⟦0⟧ via Legacy of Lake Tanganyika or A Brown-Water Navy
1lx6s5s.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过坦噶尼喀湖的遗产或褐水海军获得

1rur2b0.en: If the United Kingdom agrees to the Petra proposal.
1rur2b0.zh: 如果英国同意佩特拉方案。

1kbxw23.en: ⟦0⟧ via Battaglioni d'Assalto or Special Brigades
1kbxw23.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过突击营或特种旅获得

wg2o02.en: For ⟦0⟧ doctrines, see Special forces doctrine
wg2o02.zh: 关于⟦0⟧学说，参见特种部队学说

h9hzz3.en: ⟦0⟧ via Departamento de las Tropas de Asalto

1f1l912.en: ⟦0⟧ via Elephants for the Modern Age

1ttz8tv.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过国有化福特工厂获得

civ34k.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过坦噶尼喀湖的遗产获得

u2nv18.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过马扎尔童子军联合会获得

hgde5p.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过建立卡洛伊工厂获得

garym3.zh: 在⟦0⟧下开局即拥有此科技：

k2hbrq.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过利用阿伊努人的专长获得

1mj74jm.en: Aussa via Every Man a Warrior
1mj74jm.zh: 奥萨可通过人人皆战士获得

z8t8sz.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过大规模农村起义获得

9isva2.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过天狼星雪橇巡逻队获得

ysvmjk.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过武装洛塔·斯韦德获得

19i57zs.zh: ⟦0⟧可通过关东军特别演习获得

1rlkpzs.en: E.g. a 36 width division with 1000 attacks has five 14 width divisions with 200 defense on its list of targets. There are no additional modifiers to coordination in play. 650 attacks will then be allocated to the split attack. Each enemy division will receive 130 of those. The remaining 350 that was partitioned off with then be applied to whichever is considered the best target. If there are no other divisions left to be assigning attacks, the attacks are then compared to defences and resolved as hits. The 4 sub-targets will each receive 130 attacks compared to their 200 defense, while the primary target will receive 480 compared to 200 defense. If there was a second attacking division that had the exact same distribution, the sub-targets would each receive 260 hits against 200 defense, and the primary would get 960 against 200 defense.
1rlkpzs.zh: 例如，一个宽度为 36、拥有 1000 次攻击的师，其目标列表上有五个宽度为 14、防御为 200 的师。此时没有其他影响协调的修正。650 次攻击将被分配给拆分攻击。每个敌方师将分得其中的 130 次。剩下被分出的 350 次将施加于被认为是首选目标的那个师。如果没有其他师可供分配攻击，这些攻击就会与防御相比较并结算为命中。4 个次级目标各承受 130 次攻击，对比其 200 点防御；而首要目标承受 480 次攻击，对比其 200 点防御。如果还有第二个攻击师具有完全相同的分配，那么次级目标将各承受 260 次命中，对比 200 点防御；首要目标则承受 960 次命中，对比 200 点防御。

q6kmz7.en: The combat width of a division is the total width of its battalions. Most battalions have a combat width of two, artillery (including motorized and self-propelled) guns have a combat width of three. Anti-tank and anti-air battalions (including motorized) have a combat width of one. Support companies occupy no combat width. (See also ⟦0⟧.) The Vast Offensives and Human Wave Offensive technologies from mutually exclusive branches of the Mass Assault doctrine tree reduce the width of ordinary infantry battalions by 0.4, meaning 25% more infantry battalions can fit in the same infantry frontage. The Holding the Line technology from the Mountaineers Special Forces doctrine tree reduces the width of mountaineer battalions by 0.2.
q6kmz7.zh: 一个师的战斗宽度是其所有营的宽度总和。大多数营的战斗宽度为 2，炮兵（包括摩托化和自行火炮）的战斗宽度为 3。反坦克营和防空营（包括摩托化）的战斗宽度为 1。支援连不占用战斗宽度。（另见 ⟦0⟧。）大规模突击学说树中互斥分支上的「大规模攻势」和「人海突击」科技会将普通步兵营的宽度减少 0.4，这意味着同样的步兵正面宽度内可以多容纳 25% 的步兵营。山地兵特种部队学说树中的「坚守阵线」科技会将山地兵营的宽度减少 0.2。

48iunu.en: The winning side of the battle can capture a portion of the enemy's lost equipment if they have the Equipment Capture Ratio (ECR) stat. The default value for this stat is ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ but can be gained through the use of ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧ general trait, and various ⟦4⟧. Each division gets access to a portion of the enemy losses according to its manpower times its ECR and recovers equipment according to its ECR. For example, if the winning side of a battle has one division with 10000 ⟦5⟧ and 5% ECR and another division with 20000 ⟦6⟧ and 10% ECR, the former will recover 20% * 5% = 1% of the enemy's lost equipment while the latter will recover 80% * 10% = 8% (80% vs. 20% due to having 4 times the manpower times ECR).
48iunu.zh: 如果战斗的获胜方拥有装备缴获率（ECR）属性，就能缴获敌方损失装备的一部分。该属性的默认值为 ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧，但可以通过使用 ⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧ 将领特质以及各种 ⟦4⟧ 获得。每个师按其人力乘以 ECR 所占的比例分得敌方损失的一部分，并按自身 ECR 回收装备。例如，若战斗获胜方有一个师拥有 10000 ⟦5⟧ 和 5% ECR，另一个师拥有 20000 ⟦6⟧ 和 10% ECR，则前者将回收敌方损失装备的 20% * 5% = 1%，而后者将回收 80% * 10% = 8%（因人力乘以 ECR 为 4 倍，故为 80% 对 20%）。

otrek9.en: For example, a 36 width division has an engagement width of 72. Its list of targets could include five 14 width divisions (5*14 < 72) but if it were to encounter five 15 width divisions it would only engage four of them at a time (5*15 > 72). Whenever there is a pool of targets where none of them fit into the engagement width of the one picking the targets, one will be chosen randomly. If there are any targets that don't fit into the engagement width, and some others that do, the ones that do not fit are ignored and targets will only be chosen from those that do fit into the engagement width.
otrek9.zh: 例如，一个宽度为 36 的师，其交战宽度为 72。它的目标列表可以包含五个宽度为 14 的师（5*14 < 72）；但如果遇到五个宽度为 15 的师，它一次只能与其中四个交战（5*15 > 72）。当目标池中没有任何目标能装下选择目标一方的交战宽度时，将随机选择其中一个。如果有些目标装不下交战宽度、另一些能装下，则装不下的那些会被忽略，只会从能装下交战宽度的目标中选择。

1mp2ynu.en: For each hit, the amount of possible damage done is randomly determined by a die. For HP damage, the dice size is 2⟦0⟧ and for organization damage, it is 4⟦1⟧. The exact amount of damage done to HP and organization per hit is calculated by multiplying the obtained die rolls with the damage modifiers (base modifiers of ⟦2⟧ for strength and ⟦3⟧ for organization, tactics attack modifiers, and armor reduction).⟦4⟧ Other modifiers affect the number of attacks, thus the number of hits, but not the amount of resulting damage ⟦5⟧ hit.
1mp2ynu.zh: 对于每次命中，可能造成的伤害量由骰子随机决定。对于 HP 伤害，骰子大小为 2⟦0⟧；对于组织度伤害，骰子大小为 4⟦1⟧。每次命中对 HP 和组织度造成的确切伤害量，由掷出的点数乘以各项伤害修正得出（基础的 ⟦2⟧ 兵力修正和 ⟦3⟧ 组织度修正、战术攻击修正，以及装甲减免）。⟦4⟧ 其他修正会影响攻击次数、进而影响命中次数，但不会影响每次命中⟦5⟧所产生的伤害量。

14n4j86.en: As a defender, try providing reserves in a timely manner so they have time to reinforce the frontline and are not forced to retreat and potentially be overrun. If fighting at full width with fresh reserves, consider manually retreating your defending units that are very low on organization one at a time one province away from the front so they can recover and reserves can fill in. Otherwise, you run a risk that all frontline troops get low on organization and retreat at the same time, giving reserves no chance to reinforce.
14n4j86.zh: 作为防守方，要及时提供预备队，让它们有时间增援前线，而不至于被迫撤退甚至被歼灭。如果在满宽度下作战且拥有生力预备队，可以考虑把组织度极低的防守部队逐个手动撤退到离前线一个省份远的地方，让它们得以恢复、同时由预备队填补空缺。否则，你有可能面临所有前线部队同时组织度耗尽并撤退的局面，预备队将没有机会增援。

1ot0auk.en: If you are on the attacking side, consider not attacking with more units than can fit into combat width so that the rest, instead of waiting in reserve, can recover organization and gain the planning bonus. When you do have reserves and width available (if they caught up, or a division runs out of organization) and all defender units are already fighting, instead of waiting for reinforcement, it can be useful to stop the combat and attack again so all your units join immediately.
1ot0auk.zh: 如果你是进攻方，可以考虑不要投入超过战斗宽度所能容纳的部队，这样其余的部队就不必在预备队中等待，而是可以恢复组织度并获得计划加成。当你确实拥有预备队且宽度有余（例如它们赶到了，或某个师组织度耗尽），而所有防守部队都已投入战斗时，与其等待增援，不如停止战斗并再次进攻，这样你的所有部队都能立即加入。

1t087sm.en: When encountering a target of a particular hardness, the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ stats of the damage dealing division are combined to produce a number of attacks against the target. The more ⟦2⟧ the target has, the more hard attack factors into the number of attacks and vice versa. For example, a division with 0% hardness receives all soft attacks and none of the hard attacks while a division with 25% hardness would receive 25% of the hard attacks and 75% of the soft attacks.
1t087sm.zh: 当遇到具有特定硬度的目标时，造成伤害的师的 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 属性会结合起来，决定对该目标产生的攻击次数。目标的 ⟦2⟧ 越高，计入攻击次数的硬攻就越多，反之亦然。例如，硬度为 0% 的师会承受全部软攻、不受任何硬攻；而硬度为 25% 的师则承受 25% 的硬攻和 75% 的软攻。

1dduyja.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a combat in the defending ⟦1⟧' ⟦2⟧ initiated by attacking divisions trying to move into the province. It is resolved in one-hour-turns, with divisions dealing damage against automatically selected enemy divisions. The battle is won by either side when the opponent runs out of frontline divisions able to continue fighting. If the attacker wins, the defender's units are forced to retreat to another province (or shatter if they have nowhere to retreat).
1dduyja.zh: ⟦0⟧是指进攻方师试图进入某省份时，在防守方 ⟦1⟧ 的 ⟦2⟧ 中发起的战斗。它以一小时为一回合结算，各师对自动选定的敌方师造成伤害。当对方所有能继续作战的前线师耗尽时，另一方即获胜。如果进攻方获胜，防守方的部队将被迫撤退到另一个省份（若无处可退则溃散）。

1jijfoz.en: The winning side recovers a portion of its own equipment based on its reliability. Each division recovers ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ of its lost equipment, including shot down air support planes. With enough divisions, the total recovery ratio can exceed 100%.⟦2⟧ For example, 15 divisions successfully attacking with 90% reliability infantry equipment will in total recover ⟦3⟧ of the equipment they lost.
1jijfoz.zh: 获胜方会根据可靠性回收自身装备的一部分。每个师回收其损失装备的 ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧，其中包括被击落的空中支援飞机。若有足够多的师，总回收率可以超过 100%。⟦2⟧ 例如，15 个师使用可靠性 90% 的步兵装备成功进攻，总共将回收其损失装备的 ⟦3⟧。

1ojgxom.en: Infrastructure in the state and fortifications in the province receive damage based on the attacker's attacks. The amount scales with the attacker's number of attacks, soft attack component and damage scaling factor. Damage against fortifications only occurs with a probability of 5%⟦0⟧ while ⟦1⟧ always gets damaged. Attacks by close air support do not cause collateral damage.
1ojgxom.zh: 州内的基础设施和省份内的工事会根据进攻方的攻击而受到损伤。损伤量随进攻方的攻击次数、软攻成分和伤害缩放系数而变化。对工事的损伤只有 5%⟦0⟧ 的概率发生，而 ⟦1⟧ 则一定会受损。近距空中支援的攻击不会造成附带损伤。

1c7xjnc.en: Each attack has the potential to be a hit (causes HP and organization damage) or a miss (no effect on HP and organization). After each attack, the defending unit removes one defense (if it has some left). The hit chance depends on whether the defender had any defenses left. If it did, the hit chance is ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ Without any defenses left, the chance increases to ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧
1c7xjnc.zh: 每次攻击都可能命中（造成 HP 和组织度伤害）或未命中（对 HP 和组织度没有影响）。每次攻击后，防守单位会消耗一点防御（如果还有剩余）。命中率取决于防守方是否还有防御剩余。如果有，命中率为 ⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧ 若防御已耗尽，命中率则提高到 ⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧

1es4get.en: When armored units target a unit that has insufficient piercing, the organization dice size is increased to 6⟦0⟧, representing the ability of the armored unit to move more freely under fire, obtain better positioning and thus deal more damage. This means an unpierced armored unit on average does 3.5 organization damage per hit instead of 2.5, a ⟦1⟧ increase.
1es4get.zh: 当装甲单位以穿透不足的单位为目标时，组织度骰子大小会提高到 6⟦0⟧，这体现了装甲单位在火力下更自由地机动、取得更好站位并因此造成更多伤害的能力。这意味着未被穿透的装甲单位平均每次命中造成 3.5 点组织度伤害，而不是 2.5 点，即提高了 ⟦1⟧。

1el8u9u.en: The maximum concentration of force of both sides in a battle is limited by its combat width. The available width is increased if attackers are engaging from multiple provinces (flanking). Paradrops will add another flanking direction, as will naval invasions. Base width, and subsequently flanking width, is dependent on ⟦0⟧ where the combat is taking place.
1el8u9u.zh: 战斗中双方的最大兵力集中度受其战斗宽度限制。如果进攻方从多个省份发起进攻（侧翼包夹），可用宽度会增加。空降会额外增加一个侧翼方向，海军登陆也是如此。基础宽度以及随后的侧翼宽度，取决于战斗发生地点的 ⟦0⟧。

1sl4ljw.en: One unit in reserve has a chance to join combat every hour as long as there is combat width available. The base chance to join is only 2%⟦0⟧ per hour (so mean time to join is about 35 hours). This chance is greatly improved by having Radio researched, by division speed, doctrine tech, and having a signals company attached to the division.
1sl4ljw.zh: 只要有可用的战斗宽度，预备队中的一个单位每小时都有机会加入战斗。基础加入概率仅为每小时 2%⟦0⟧（因此平均加入时间约为 35 小时）。研究出无线电、师的速度、学说科技，以及为师配属通讯连，都能大幅提高这一概率。

a5v99l.en: Divisions do not attack enemies uniformly. Each division has an "Engagement Width"⟦0⟧ of twice⟦1⟧ its own combat width, used to create a list of targets. Enemy divisions are added in a random order, rejecting any that would cause the list of targets to exceed the engagement width. If none of the enemy division fit, one is picked randomly.
a5v99l.zh: 各师并非均匀地攻击敌人。每个师都有一个「交战宽度」⟦0⟧，为其自身战斗宽度的两倍⟦1⟧，用于生成目标列表。敌方师按随机顺序加入列表，凡是会使目标列表超出交战宽度的都会被排除。如果没有任何敌方师能装下，则随机挑选一个。

15onszr.en: Divisions that initially did not fit into the combat width or that join the combat after it has already started end up in reserves. While in reserve, these units do not take or deal damage, do not regain organization and do not increase their entrenchment or preparation bonuses. They do provide recon and anti-air capabilities though.
15onszr.zh: 最初装不下战斗宽度、或在战斗已经开始后才加入的师会进入预备队。在预备队中，这些单位既不承受也不造成伤害，不会恢复组织度，也不会增加其工事或准备加成。不过它们确实能提供侦察和防空能力。

3hzfmc.en: As a unit takes HP damage in combat, its damage output gets scaled down. The scaling is rounded to multiples of 10%, e.g. for strength less than 100% but greater or equal to 90%, the damage output is scaled by 90%. Note that damage done to a unit's HP does not change the other stats of the unit before the combat is finished.
3hzfmc.zh: 当单位在战斗中受到 HP 伤害时，其伤害输出会按比例缩减。缩放会四舍五入到 10% 的整数倍，例如兵力小于 100% 但不低于 90% 时，伤害输出按 90% 缩放。请注意，对单位 HP 造成的伤害在战斗结束前不会改变该单位的其他属性。

1vs3t0j.en: The attacks are split into an uncoordinated and coordinated part. Uncoordinated attacks are spread between all targets in the engagement width according to their respective width. One selected priority target additionally receives all of the coordinated attacks, increasing the chance to overcome its defenses.
1vs3t0j.zh: 攻击被分为未协调和已协调两部分。未协调的攻击按各自宽度分散到交战宽度内的所有目标上。被选中的一个优先目标还会额外承受全部已协调攻击，从而提高突破其防御的机会。

33wy4b.en: At the start of a battle or when reinforcing (see below), divisions will be added from the reserve to the frontline unless the combat width has already been filled or the combat width penalty would exceed ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ The combat width penalty is calculated as ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ * (total_width - battle_width) / battle_width.
33wy4b.zh: 在战斗开始时或增援时（见下文），师会从预备队加入前线，除非战斗宽度已经填满，或战斗宽度惩罚会超过 ⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧ 战斗宽度惩罚的计算方式为 ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ * (total_width - battle_width) / battle_width。

1we62m0.en: After the battle ends, the ratio of HP lost is translated into equipment and manpower losses with a factor of 70%.⟦0⟧ The stats of the unit are locked during the combat if the template is unchanged, and are only updated after the combat.
1we62m0.zh: 战斗结束后，损失的 HP 比例会以 70% 的系数换算为装备和人力损失。⟦0⟧ 若师编制未变，单位的属性在战斗期间会被锁定，仅在战斗结束后才更新。

wxo6si.en: The following factors modify the number of attacks and/or defenses a unit has in combat (list is not exhaustive). All factors stack multiplicatively, so it is possible to reach very low or high values depending the tactical situation.
wxo6si.zh: 以下因素会修正单位在战斗中的攻击次数和/或防御（列表并不完整）。所有因素以乘法叠加，因此根据战术态势的不同，有可能达到非常低或非常高的数值。

lvjwtz.en: In total, the armored division is expected to deal 25 * 3.5 * 90% * 0.053 = 4.17375 organization damage per hour. For a regular infantry division with 50-60 organization, the combat is expected to finish in about half a day.
lvjwtz.zh: 总计，该装甲师预计每小时造成 25 * 3.5 * 90% * 0.053 = 4.17375 点组织度伤害。对于组织度为 50-60 的普通步兵师，战斗预计约在半天内结束。

1pzjf6w.en: In a 70-width ⟦0⟧ battle, the last out of 8 divisions of 10-widths will remain in reserve, because the combat width is already filled, even though the combat width penalty would only be ≈ -14.29% (from -100% * (80-70)/70).
1pzjf6w.zh: 在一场 70 宽度的 ⟦0⟧ 战斗中，8 个宽度为 10 的师中最后一个将留在预备队，因为战斗宽度已经填满，尽管战斗宽度惩罚仅为约 -14.29%（来自 -100% * (80-70)/70）。

1nrsbim.en: The target of damage has a number of defenses to partially protect it. For divisions on the defender's side this is the ⟦0⟧ stat, on the attacker's side it is ⟦1⟧.
1nrsbim.zh: 受伤害的目标拥有一定数量的防御来部分保护自己。对于防守方的师，这是 ⟦0⟧ 属性；对于进攻方的师，则是 ⟦1⟧。

p4j0ws.en: Stacking penalty for having too many divisions in combat: ⟦0⟧ per division over the stacking limit. The stacking limit is 5⟦1⟧, plus 3⟦2⟧ per flanking direction.
p4j0ws.zh: 战斗中师数量过多造成的堆叠惩罚：超过堆叠上限的每个师 ⟦0⟧。堆叠上限为 5⟦1⟧，每个侧翼方向另加 3⟦2⟧。

rmm34f.en: Fort: penalty for attacker attack and breakthrough of ⟦0⟧ per fort level. Each extra attacking direction cancels out one fort level, but not the last level.
rmm34f.zh: 要塞：每级要塞使进攻方的攻击和突破受到 ⟦0⟧ 的惩罚。每多一个进攻方向可抵消一级要塞，但不会抵消最后一级。

13fag55.en: Tactics are automatically selected by the leading generals. They provide damage, movement speed, and base combat width modifiers in the battle.
13fag55.zh: 战术由领军将领自动选择。它们在战斗中提供伤害、移动速度和基础战斗宽度修正。

vdsjqy.en: Coordination is a global stat that is usually gained from researching ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, but can also be gained from certain ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ spirits.
vdsjqy.zh: 协调是一项全局属性，通常通过研究 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 获得，但也可以从某些 ⟦2⟧ 和 ⟦3⟧ 精神获得。

1a6qyts.en: considering how hardness affects the number of ⟦0⟧ the attacker would have against the target, with a slight bias for hard attacks⟦1⟧
1a6qyts.zh: 考虑硬度如何影响进攻方对目标所拥有的 ⟦0⟧ 数量，并略微偏向硬攻⟦1⟧

1k2jnai.en: In damage dealing, the number of attacks is ⟦0⟧ and the number of defenses is ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧. Both attacks and defenses reset every hour.
1k2jnai.zh: 在伤害结算中，攻击次数为 ⟦0⟧，防御次数为 ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧。攻击和防御均每小时重置一次。

m9r39q.en: To summarize the above with an example: an armored division with 1000 soft attack vs an infantry division with 500 defense stat.
m9r39q.zh: 用一个例子来总结上述内容：一个拥有 1000 软攻的装甲师对战一个防御属性为 500 的步兵师。

16xp6r8.en: Terrain: the attacker receives attack and breakthrough penalties in rough terrain, up to ⟦0⟧ (even more with heavy units)
16xp6r8.zh: 地形：进攻方在崎岖地形中会受到攻击和突破惩罚，最高可达 ⟦0⟧（重型单位还会更高）

1tmej7j.en: In an 80-width ⟦0⟧ battle, it is possible to have 106 total width (penalty of -32.5%), but not 107 (penalty of -33.75%).
1tmej7j.zh: 在一场 80 宽度的 ⟦0⟧ 战斗中，总宽度可以达到 106（惩罚 -32.5%），但达不到 107（惩罚 -33.75%）。

1s5gsp7.en: Initiative is a division stat that is usually gained from the ⟦0⟧, though it can also be gained from other sources.
1s5gsp7.zh: 主动性是一项师属性，通常从 ⟦0⟧ 获得，不过也可以通过其他途径获得。

v6hb7a.en: Low supply: scaling attack/defense penalties up to ⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧/⟦3⟧ for the attacker and defender, respectively
v6hb7a.zh: 补给不足：进攻方和防守方的攻击/防御惩罚最高分别可达 ⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧/⟦3⟧

y8ol3p.en: Encirclement: penalty for defender ⟦0⟧ if all surrounding land provinces are enemy-controlled (excluding islands)
y8ol3p.zh: 包围：若周围所有陆地省份均被敌方控制（岛屿除外），防守方受到 ⟦0⟧ 惩罚

x3wtzj.en: Intel advantage: up to ⟦0⟧ from army intel advantage (starting at 5⟦1⟧ and maxing out at 50⟦2⟧ intel advantage)
x3wtzj.zh: 情报优势：来自陆军情报优势，最高 ⟦0⟧（从 5⟦1⟧ 情报优势开始，在 50⟦2⟧ 情报优势时达到上限）

wboaeg.en: In multiple combats: ⟦0⟧ for a division that is in multiple combats (e.g. attacking while being attacked)
wboaeg.zh: 在多重战斗中：对于同时处于多重战斗的师（例如一边进攻一边被进攻），⟦0⟧

8ryx93.en: River crossing: penalty of ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ for attacker attack and breakthrough depending on the river size
8ryx93.zh: 渡河：根据河流大小，进攻方的攻击和突破受到 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 的惩罚

10tj91e.en: Planning bonus: up to ⟦0⟧ for the attacker, which can be further improved by a doctrine to ⟦1⟧ or more
10tj91e.zh: 计划加成：进攻方最高 ⟦0⟧，还可通过学说进一步提升至 ⟦1⟧ 或更高

1xm1rec.en: The armored division is damaged to slightly less than 100% HP and so has a 90% damage scaling factor.

138zkz1.en: With 6 carriers, the carrier overstacking penalty prevents -100399500% of all carrier wings from targeting enemy ships, rounded down. For this penalty, the first four carriers count as having only 1 air wing each. The 5th carrier counts as having 2 air wings and the 6th carrier counts as having 3 air wings. This gives a total of 9 carrier air wings. -100399500% of 9 is 9035964 air wings, and which rounds down to 9035964 air wings that can target enemy ships. These wings are counted from those based on the first carrier in the list going downward. This means that the naval bombers on the first 5 carriers will operate as normal, while the naval bombers and CAS on carrier number 6 will not launch attacks at enemy ships, but they will still take off and be vulnerable to enemy fighters. The carrier fighters on carriers number 5 and 6 are unaffected by the penalty, and so will fly and can target enemy aircraft regardless.
138zkz1.zh: 当拥有 6 艘航空母舰时，航母堆叠惩罚会阻止 -100399500% 的舰载航空队以敌方舰船为目标，并向下取整。在计算该惩罚时，前 4 艘航母每艘只算作拥有 1 个航空队。第 5 艘航母算作拥有 2 个航空队，第 6 艘航母算作拥有 3 个航空队。这样合计为 9 个舰载航空队。-100399500% 的 9 为 9035964 个航空队，向下取整后即 9035964 个航空队可以以敌方舰船为目标。这些航空队从列表中的第一艘航母开始向下依次计算。这意味着前 5 艘航母上的海军轰炸机将正常作战，而第 6 艘航母上的海军轰炸机和近距空中支援将不会对敌方舰船发起攻击，但它们仍会起飞并容易被敌方战斗机击落。第 5 艘和第 6 艘航母上的舰载战斗机不受该惩罚影响，因此仍会起飞并可照常以敌方飞机为目标。

cr4fy8.en: Once it has been pressed, it will bring up a column of information on either side of the summary naval combat results window, showing the impact of each unit or air wing (both carrier or land-based) on the battle - see the example to the right. In this case, the battle didn't include an air component, but the player can see from the sample results screen shown below that, for the Italians, the heavy cruiser Marco Polo delivered the final hits to the British destroyers Wishart and Wrestler, but it was assisted in sinking them by a number of other Italian ships, including Giuseppe La Masa, Giacinto Carini and Castelfidardo. On the British side, the heavy cruiser Effingham finished off two enemy destroyers (Curtatone and Castelfidardo) but the light cruiser Caledon did almost as much damage (only delivering the final hit on one enemy ship).
cr4fy8.zh: 按下后，它会在海军战斗结果摘要窗口的两侧各显示一列信息，展示每个单位或航空队（无论舰载还是陆基）对战斗的影响——参见右侧示例。在此例中，战斗并不包含空中部分，但玩家可以从下方所示的示例结果界面看到，对意大利一方而言，重巡洋舰 Marco Polo 对英国驱逐舰 Wishart 和 Wrestler 造成了最后的命中，但协助其击沉这两艘舰的还有许多其他意大利舰船，包括 Giuseppe La Masa、Giacinto Carini 和 Castelfidardo。在英国一方，重巡洋舰 Effingham 击沉了两艘敌方驱逐舰（Curtatone 和 Castelfidardo），但轻巡洋舰 Caledon 造成的伤害几乎相当（只对一艘敌舰造成了最后命中）。

6ia23p.en: Due to what is likely a mistake in the game's code, the chances of this happening are very small even when using dedicated anti-submarine ships against outdated submarines. For example, with an average sub detection of 45, which is near the theoretical maximum for a task force of only dedicated anti-submarine destroyers, against 25 sub visibility (for unupgraded, outdated Early Submarines), the chance to reveal a hidden submarine every hour is 0.457%. This means it will take on average 152 hours, or about 6.333 days, before a given outdated Early Submarine is passively revealed in combat for the standard 16 hours. Similarly, due to what is probably a mistake, aerial sub detection contributes 0%⟦0⟧ to the chance of passively revealing a submarine in battle, meaning only the sub detection of ships is considered.
6ia23p.zh: 由于游戏代码中很可能存在的错误，即使使用专门的反潜舰船对付过时的潜艇，这种情况发生的几率也非常小。例如，平均水下探测为 45（这几乎是仅由专业反潜驱逐舰组成的特遣舰队理论上的最大值），面对 25 的潜艇可见度（未升级的过时早期潜艇），每小时发现隐藏潜艇的几率为 0.457%。这意味着平均需要 152 小时，约 6.333 天，才能让一艘特定的过时早期潜艇在战斗中被被动发现，并持续标准的 16 小时。同样，由于很可能是错误，空中水下探测对战斗中被动发现潜艇的几率贡献为 0%⟦0⟧，这意味着只考虑舰船的水下探测。

1i97q8i.en: Each carrier exceeding ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ per side causes ⟦2⟧ of that side's carrier wings to be unable to target enemy ships in naval battles. This scales up to ⟦3⟧ of that side's carrier wings being unable to target ships. The number of wings that are able to target enemy ships is always rounded down, and unlike other penalties affecting carrier wings, each carrier plane type counts as a single wing for this penalty. The penalty is different from sortie efficiency, which affects the mission efficiency of carrier-based planes based on how many planes there are stationed on a single carrier. Aircraft that are unable to target enemy ships will still fly, allowing them to get shot down by enemy fighters.
1i97q8i.zh: 每方超出 ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ 的每艘航母，都会导致该方 ⟦2⟧ 的舰载航空队无法在海战中以敌方舰船为目标。该效果最高可扩大至该方 ⟦3⟧ 的舰载航空队无法以舰船为目标。能够以敌方舰船为目标的航空队数量始终向下取整，且与其他影响舰载航空队的惩罚不同，在计算该惩罚时每种舰载机机型都算作一个航空队。该惩罚不同于出击效率，后者会根据单艘航母上驻扎的飞机数量影响舰载机的任务效率。无法以敌方舰船为目标的飞机仍会起飞，从而可能被敌方战斗机击落。

7l4ga7.en: If you want to use ⟦0⟧ and use the air wings to operate standard air missions, then they will no longer operate automatically as a Carrier Air Group and if the carrier fleet is engaged by the enemy, it may not have air cover. The player should be careful to make sure that it is properly protected. One might place a fighter wing on an interception mission in the region where the carrier fleet is located, but send a bomber wing to target an adjoining region, for example, to support an amphibious landing. In order to send carrier-based air wings on standard air missions, including ⟦1⟧ to help train them up for battle, their carrier(s) must be at sea (not in a port) and must not be on any ⟦2⟧.
7l4ga7.zh: 如果你想让 ⟦0⟧ 并使用航空队执行标准空中任务，那么它们将不再作为舰载机航空群自动运作；如果航母舰队被敌人交战，可能就没有空中掩护。玩家应小心确保其得到妥善保护。例如，可以在航母舰队所在地区放置一个战斗机航空队执行拦截任务，同时派出一个轰炸机航空队以相邻地区为目标，以支援两栖登陆。要让舰载航空队执行标准空中任务（包括用 ⟦1⟧ 帮助它们为战斗进行训练），其所属航母必须位于海上（不在港口中），且不能处于任何 ⟦2⟧。

6xl8h1.en: ⟦0⟧ dictates what percentage of the aircraft on a given carrier can actually fly in both air missions and during naval battles. Carriers have a base sortie efficiency of ⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧ with doctrines like ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ being the main source of increases to it. ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ doctrines are able to provide up to ⟦7⟧ additional sortie efficiency, while ⟦8⟧ doctrines can provide a full ⟦9⟧. Political advisors, national spirits, ⟦10⟧, admiral ⟦11⟧, and admiral traits like ⟦12⟧ and ⟦13⟧ can all provide additional sortie efficiency, as can having full ⟦14⟧. Sortie efficiency of over 100% does not make existing planes more effective, so it does nothing unless the carrier is overcrowded.
6xl8h1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 决定了某艘航母上的飞机有多大比例能真正在空中任务和海战中起飞。航母的基础出击效率为 ⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧，而像 ⟦3⟧ 和 ⟦4⟧ 这样的学说是提升它的主要来源。⟦5⟧ 和 ⟦6⟧ 学说最多可提供 ⟦7⟧ 的额外出击效率，而 ⟦8⟧ 学说可提供整整 ⟦9⟧。政治顾问、国家精神、⟦10⟧、海军将领 ⟦11⟧，以及像 ⟦12⟧ 和 ⟦13⟧ 这样的海军将领特质，都能提供额外的出击效率，拥有满额的 ⟦14⟧ 也可以。超过 100% 的出击效率不会让已有飞机更有效，因此除非航母过度拥挤，否则它不起作用。

kh4stg.en: In order to be able to base aircraft on an aircraft carrier, carrier capable models must be produced. When playing without ⟦0⟧ and its ⟦1⟧, the land-based version of an aircraft must first be researched, then the carrier-capable version is researched separately. This is done by clicking the aircraft carrier button on the aircraft type in the air research tab. This can only be done for Fighters, Close Air Support, and Naval Bombers. The carrier-capable version has a different model name than the land-based version, as well as different artwork and different stats. If you don't intend to use aircraft carriers, you do not need to research carrier-capable planes.
kh4stg.zh: 为了能在航空母舰上驻扎飞机，必须生产舰载型机型。在没有 ⟦0⟧ 及其 ⟦1⟧ 的情况下游玩时，必须先研究飞机的陆基版本，然后单独研究其舰载版本。方法是点击空军科研标签页中飞机类型上的航空母舰按钮。只有战斗机、近距空中支援和海军轰炸机可以这样做。舰载版本的型号名称与陆基版本不同，美术图和属性也不同。如果你不打算使用航空母舰，就不需要研究舰载型飞机。

1su6r7r.en: For example, a 1936 light cruiser with 15 surface visibility and a speed of 32.0 kn has a ship hit profile of ca. 41.7. When fired upon by another 1936 light cruiser with its light cruiser batteries with no other hit chance modifiers besides a basic fire control system, the base hit chance will be 102.5% and the weapon hit profile will be 45, making the final hit chance of the attack ca. 87.9%. If the light cruiser had a ⟦0⟧ surface visibility bonus from, e.g., the ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ spirit, resulting in a surface visibility of 14.25, it would have a ship hit profile of 39.6, and so the hit chance of this attack from an enemy light cruiser would instead be ca. 79.3%.
1su6r7r.zh: 例如，一艘 1936 年轻巡洋舰拥有 15 的水面可见度和 32.0 节的速度，其舰船命中轮廓约为 41.7。当被另一艘 1936 年轻巡洋舰用其轻巡洋舰炮组射击时，若除基础火控系统外没有其他命中率修正，基础命中率将为 102.5%，武器命中轮廓为 45，使该次攻击的最终命中率约为 87.9%。如果该轻巡洋舰拥有 ⟦0⟧ 的水面可见度加成（例如来自 ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 精神），使水面可见度变为 14.25，其舰船命中轮廓将为 39.6，于是敌方轻巡洋舰该次攻击的命中率将变为约 79.3%。

1lvcyp.en: The ratio of screen ships to ⟦0⟧ and convoys is the ⟦1⟧. With good positioning, 100% screening efficiency is reached when the ratio is 3⟦2⟧ screen(s) per capital ship and/or carrier and an additional 0.5⟦3⟧ screen(s) per convoy. For example, if you have 4 carriers and 4 battleships, you need 24 screen ships in order to reach 100% screening efficiency, or if you have 16 convoys under attack from submarines, you need 8 screen ships to reach 100% screening efficiency. High screening efficiency prevents enemy torpedo attacks against the battle-line and carrier groups, and confers the following bonuses to those groups:
1lvcyp.zh: 屏卫舰与 ⟦0⟧ 及运输船队的比例就是 ⟦1⟧。在定位良好的情况下，当每艘主力舰和/或航空母舰配备 3⟦2⟧ 艘屏卫舰，且每支运输船队额外配备 0.5⟦3⟧ 艘屏卫舰时，即可达到 100% 屏卫效率。例如，如果你有 4 艘航母和 4 艘战列舰，就需要 24 艘屏卫舰才能达到 100% 屏卫效率；或者如果你有 16 支运输船队正遭受潜艇攻击，则需要 8 艘屏卫舰才能达到 100% 屏卫效率。高屏卫效率可阻止敌方对战列线和航母群的鱼雷攻击，并给予这些编组以下加成：

1ya7gc3.en: For example, if a carrier has deck space for 80 aircraft, but is hosting 10 air wings of 10 aircraft each for a total of 100 aircraft, it would normally be exceeding its capacity by ⟦0⟧, thus reducing the amount of aircraft that can sortie from it by ⟦1⟧. With ⟦2⟧ total sortie efficiency, only ⟦3⟧ of its 100 aircraft = ⟦4⟧ aircraft could fly. However, if the carrier has ⟦5⟧ total sortie efficiency through various sources, it is able to sortie ⟦6⟧ more aircraft than normal. The two effects counteract each other, allowing ⟦7⟧ of the carrier's 100 aircraft = ⟦8⟧ aircraft to fly.
1ya7gc3.zh: 例如，如果一艘航母的甲板容量可搭载 80 架飞机，却搭载了 10 个各 10 架飞机的航空队，总计 100 架飞机，那么它通常超出容量 ⟦0⟧，从而使能够从其起飞的飞机数量减少 ⟦1⟧。在总出击效率为 ⟦2⟧ 时，其 100 架飞机中只有 ⟦3⟧ = ⟦4⟧ 架飞机能够起飞。然而，如果该航母通过各种来源获得 ⟦5⟧ 的总出击效率，它就能比正常情况多起飞 ⟦6⟧ 架飞机。两种效果相互抵消，使该航母 100 架飞机中的 ⟦7⟧ = ⟦8⟧ 架能够起飞。

w2ly6s.en: If the submarine starts the battle on the defending side, it will be initially revealed for 16⟦0⟧ hours. This typically happens when its task force gets ⟦1⟧ by enemy patrols. Due to how low reveal chances are for submarines once they are already in battle, this is the main way that anti-submarine ships, especially anti-submarine carriers using naval bombers, can be effective against submarines. Importantly, ships ⟦2⟧ can never reveal submarines in this way, counterintuitively making anti-submarine ships bad at killing raiding submarines when they are escorting convoys.
w2ly6s.zh: 如果潜艇在战斗开始时处于防守方，它最初会被发现 16⟦0⟧ 小时。这通常发生在其特遣舰队被敌方巡逻队 ⟦1⟧ 时。由于潜艇一旦进入战斗后被发现几率极低，这是反潜舰船（尤其是使用海军轰炸机的反潜航母）能够有效对付潜艇的主要方式。重要的是，⟦2⟧ 的舰船永远无法以这种方式发现潜艇，这反直觉地使得反潜舰船在护航运输船队时难以击杀执行袭击任务的潜艇。

1rsfnhh.en: The penalty is applied to carriers from the bottom of the ship list upwards, meaning air wings from carriers near or at the top of the list are more likely to be able to target enemy ships than those at or near the bottom. Fighter air wings on any carrier will always operate as though the penalty does not exist, so when expecting to have more than ⟦0⟧ carriers in a single naval battle, it is better to put fighter air wings on the carriers listed lower in the task force and naval bomber air wings on the carriers listed at the top of the task force's ship list.
1rsfnhh.zh: 该惩罚从舰船列表底部向上施加于航母，这意味着位于列表顶部或附近的航母上的航空队比位于底部或附近的更有可能以敌方舰船为目标。任何航母上的战斗机航空队始终按该惩罚不存在的方式运作，因此当预计单场海战中会有超过 ⟦0⟧ 艘航母时，最好把战斗机航空队放在特遣舰队中排序靠下的航母上，而把海军轰炸机航空队放在特遣舰队舰船列表中排在最上面的航母上。

1glz193.en: It is possible to get detailed and valuable information on the impact of various elements of the player's fleet during a naval combat, once that combat has finished. After bringing up the naval combat results screen, access the detailed information by pressing the detailed naval combat results button, indicated in the picture on the left. This button acts like a toggle, so once it has been pressed in the current session, the naval combat results will automatically display the detailed results unless the detailed naval combat results button is pressed again.
1glz193.zh: 在一场海战结束后，玩家可以获取关于舰队各要素在战斗中影响的详细而有价值的信息。打开海军战斗结果界面后，按下左侧图片所示的详细海军战斗结果按钮即可查看详细信息。该按钮相当于一个开关，因此在当前会话中按下一次后，海军战斗结果将自动显示详细结果，除非再次按下详细海军战斗结果按钮。

11z09dk.en: For a fleet with a far more significant carrier force compared to the enemy fleet, these opening, carrier-only combat stages can produce a devastating alpha strike that can start a snowball effect of the enemy fleet dealing less damage as a result of reduced organization, which then causes their organization to fall faster than the allied fleets', reducing their damage even further. However, if the battle starts at night or in a ⟦0⟧, this initial stage can be wasted because carrier traffic will be severely reduced or non-existent during the stage.
11z09dk.zh: 对于航母力量远超敌舰队的舰队而言，这些开局时仅由航母参与的战斗阶段能产生毁灭性的先手打击，进而引发滚雪球效应：敌方舰队因组织度下降而输出更少伤害，这又使其组织度比友方舰队下降得更快，从而进一步降低其伤害。然而，如果战斗在夜间或 ⟦0⟧ 中开始，这一初始阶段可能会被浪费，因为在此阶段航母出动会大幅减少甚至完全无法出动。

1ipisg5.en: When a new carrier is produced, the planes that will be based on it by default can be customized as part of the carrier production line in the naval section using dockyards. Once finished, the carrier will be filled by the most up-to-date models that are available in the country's stockpile. Replacements and reinforcements to these wings will need to be produced using ⟦0⟧ and can otherwise be manipulated by first selecting the carrier(s) and then clicking the little airplane button next to their location on the map, similar to a land-based ⟦1⟧.
1ipisg5.zh: 当一艘新航母建成时，可以像在海军栏中用船坞建造航母生产线那样，自定义默认将驻扎在其上的飞机。建成后，该航母会装满该国库存中可用的最新型号。这些航空队的补充和增援需要用 ⟦0⟧ 生产，否则可以先选中航母，然后点击地图上其位置旁边的小飞机按钮来操作，类似陆基 ⟦1⟧。

1001oie.en: Instead, it is the carrier air wings stationed on carriers whose ⟦0⟧ levels and veterancy can affect the damage by carriers. Especially as newly deployed air wings start at ⟦1⟧ veterancy, and because carrier-based air wings can lose veterancy in naval battles very quickly because of how much bigger losses are relative to their wing size, it can be very important to train air wings stationed on carriers before sending them into engagements. Aces can also be assigned to carrier air wings and affect their combat performance.
1001oie.zh: 相反，影响航母伤害的是驻扎在航母上的舰载航空队的 ⟦0⟧ 等级和老练度。尤其是新部署的航空队老练度从 ⟦1⟧ 开始，而且由于舰载航空队相对于其航空队规模损失大得多，在海战中老练度会迅速下降，因此在把驻扎在航母上的航空队投入交战前进行训练可能非常重要。王牌飞行员也可以分配到舰载航空队并影响其战斗表现。

8o8o2j.en: When a naval battle starts, screens can only attack after ⟦0⟧ hours, and capital ships can only attack after ⟦1⟧ hours, but carriers can attack from hour ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧ This coincides with the 6⟦4⟧ hours referred to as the 'Initial Stage' by modifiers like the ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ spirit. It also lines up with carrier aircraft being able to sortie every 6⟦7⟧ hours (OBSOLETE, it is currently 8 hours, starting close to high noon), though they are unable to sortie at night without something like the ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ spirit.
8o8o2j.zh: 海战开始时，屏卫舰只能在 ⟦0⟧ 小时后攻击，主力舰只能在 ⟦1⟧ 小时后攻击，但航母可以从第 ⟦2⟧ 小时起攻击。⟦3⟧ 这与被称为「初始阶段」的 6⟦4⟧ 小时相吻合，该称呼来自像 ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ 精神这样的修正。它也与舰载机每 6⟦7⟧ 小时可出击一次相符（已过时，目前为 8 小时，从接近正午时开始），不过在没有类似 ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ 精神的情况下，它们无法在夜间出击。

1a1iijr.en: A ⟦0⟧ gets initiated on a specific province between two task forces, one of them being the attacker. This usually happens after a ⟦1⟧ process is complete or opposing fleets move onto the same province. Naval and port strikes by air wings trigger a naval battle that resolves instantly. Otherwise the battle lasts until one side is fully escaped or destroyed. The defender always joins the battle with full efficiency while the attacker may have a reduced efficiency depending on circumstances.
1a1iijr.zh: 一场 ⟦0⟧ 会在两支特遣舰队之间针对某个特定省份发起，其中一方是攻击方。这通常发生在 ⟦1⟧ 过程完成之后，或者敌对舰队移动到同一省份时。航空队的海上打击和港口打击会触发一场立即结算的海战。否则，战斗会持续到一方完全逃脱或被摧毁为止。防守方总是以满效率加入战斗，而攻击方的效率可能会根据情况降低。

lwe4bv.en: If the enemy task force has any ships with sub detection greater than zero, there is a 3.5%⟦0⟧ chance of the submarine revealing itself every time it attacks. The submarine's visibility affects this chance, and bad positioning increases the visibility effect by up to 200%.⟦1⟧ It can be reduced with torpedo reveal chance modifiers, e.g., from the ⟦2⟧ technology, the ⟦3⟧ admiral trait, and submarine naval doctrines like ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧. The combined formula is:⟦6⟧
lwe4bv.zh: 如果敌方特遣舰队中有任何舰船的水下探测大于零，那么潜艇每次攻击时都有 3.5%⟦0⟧ 的几率暴露自己。潜艇的可见度会影响该几率，而糟糕的定位最多会使可见度效果增加 200%。⟦1⟧ 可以通过鱼雷暴露几率修正来降低它，例如来自 ⟦2⟧ 科技、⟦3⟧ 海军将领特质，以及像 ⟦4⟧ 或 ⟦5⟧ 这样的潜艇海军学说。合并后的公式为：⟦6⟧

lmf2z3.en: It is important to note that the AA of the targeted ship counts ⟦0⟧ more for AA damage reduction purposes than ships in the rest of the fleet, and that the damage reduction effect increases very slowly with additional AA thanks to the exponent in the formula. This makes AA far less valuable on ships that are not expected to be targeted by enemy aircraft, e.g., screening ships in a battle fleet composed of larger capital ships and/or carriers.
lmf2z3.zh: 需要注意的是，在计算防空伤害减免时，被瞄准舰船的防空火力比舰队中其他舰船的权重高 ⟦0⟧，而且由于公式中的指数，伤害减免效果随防空火力增加而增长得非常缓慢。这使得防空火力在预计不会被敌方飞机瞄准的舰船上价值低得多，例如由较大主力舰和/或航母组成的战斗舰队中的屏卫舰。

1qsy9wf.en: It is important to note that while carriers can have light attack from equipping ⟦0⟧, carriers will not use their light attack to fire at ships in the enemy carrier group/line. This includes enemy carriers, but also enemy convoys. Among other things, this makes 'battlecarrier' designs (heavily armored carrier designs bristling with light attack, sacrificing deck space) even less effective than what one might expect, especially at ⟦1⟧.
1qsy9wf.zh: 需要注意的是，虽然航母可以通过装备 ⟦0⟧ 获得轻攻击，但航母不会用其轻攻击射击敌方航母群/战线中的舰船。这包括敌方航母，也包括敌方运输船队。除此之外，这使得「战列航母」设计（堆满轻攻击、牺牲甲板容量的重装甲航母设计）比人们预期的还要低效，在 ⟦1⟧ 时尤其如此。

usmgpj.en: This means that a weapon will suffer penalties to hit chance against a ship whose hit profile is smaller than that of the weapon. The hit chance can be modified by bad weather, night, ⟦0⟧, fire control and/or radar ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ traits and policies (with ⟦3⟧), ⟦4⟧ spirits (with ⟦5⟧), and the ship's admiral's skill level and traits such as ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧. If the hit chance of an attack does not result in a hit, the target remains unaffected.
usmgpj.zh: 这意味着，当舰船的命中轮廓小于武器自身的命中轮廓时，武器对其命中率会受到惩罚。命中率可以被恶劣天气、夜间、⟦0⟧、火控和/或雷达 ⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ 特质和政策（配合 ⟦3⟧）、⟦4⟧ 精神（配合 ⟦5⟧），以及舰船所属海军将领的技能等级和诸如 ⟦6⟧ 和 ⟦7⟧ 这样的特质所修正。如果一次攻击的命中率未能命中，目标不受影响。

njrl25.en: The ratio of capital ships to carriers and convoys is the ⟦0⟧. With good positioning, 100% carrier screening efficiency is reached when the ratio is 1⟦1⟧ capital ship(s) per carrier and an additional 0.25⟦2⟧ capital ship(s) per convoy. High carrier screening efficiency further prevents enemy torpedo attacks against the carrier group (stacking diminishingly). It also provides confers the following bonuses to carriers and convoys:
njrl25.zh: 主力舰与航母及运输船队的比例就是 ⟦0⟧。在定位良好的情况下，当每艘航母配备 1⟦1⟧ 艘主力舰，且每支运输船队额外配备 0.25⟦2⟧ 艘主力舰时，即可达到 100% 航母屏卫效率。高航母屏卫效率还能进一步阻止敌方对航母群的鱼雷攻击（效果递减叠加）。它还会给予航母和运输船队以下加成：

x5ijlz.en: Damage is applied against both the target's HP (by 60%⟦0⟧) and organization (by 100%⟦1⟧). Additionally ships start out immune against organization damage, scaling up to the nominal value as the ship's HP level goes down. As an example, assume a ship with 100/50 HP/Org receives multiple hits of 50 damage each. The consecutive hits will do 30/0, 30/15, 30/30, and 30/45 HP/Org damage, with the fourth hit sinking the ship.
x5ijlz.zh: 伤害会同时作用于目标的 HP（按 60%⟦0⟧）和组织度（按 100%⟦1⟧）。此外，舰船一开始对组织度伤害免疫，随着舰船 HP 水平下降而逐步提升至标称值。举例来说，假设一艘舰船拥有 100/50 的 HP/组织度，并多次受到每次 50 点伤害的命中。连续的命中将分别造成 30/0、30/15、30/30 和 30/45 的 HP/组织度伤害，第四次命中将击沉该舰。

1a8atn4.en: It can potentially be a viable strategy to deliberately have low amounts of AA on certain ships, potentially even no AA. When operating alongside more valuable ships that have a high weight of being selected for naval attack, e.g., fleet carriers, less valuable ships with low to no AA can potentially draw attention away from these valuable ships, thus increasing those ships' survivability at the cost of their own.
1a8atn4.zh: 有意让某些舰船配备低量防空火力、甚至完全没有防空火力，可能是一种可行的策略。当与更贵重、被选为海军攻击目标的权重更高的舰船（例如舰队航母）一起行动时，防空火力低或没有防空火力的较廉价舰船可以吸引对这些贵重舰船的注意力，从而提高它们的生存能力，代价是牺牲自己。

1mpkz0m.en: Carriers have a maximum capacity for aircraft and, similar to land-based ⟦0⟧, this capacity can be exceeded at the cost of a ⟦1⟧ penalty to how many aircraft can actually fly from the carrier for every ⟦2⟧ that its deck space is exceeded. Overcrowding penalties can be reduced directly by the ⟦3⟧ naval doctrine, but they can also be mitigated and even outright negated by having a sortie efficiency of over 100%.
1mpkz0m.zh: 航母对飞机有最大容量，与陆基 ⟦0⟧ 类似，该容量可以被超出，代价是承受 ⟦1⟧ 的惩罚，即甲板容量每超出 ⟦2⟧，能够真正从航母起飞的飞机数量就会相应减少。超载惩罚可以通过 ⟦3⟧ 海军学说直接降低，但也可以通过拥有超过 100% 的出击效率来缓解甚至完全抵消。

3mgase.en: In practical terms, a speed increase of 4% is roughly equivalent to increasing your ship's effective HP against other ships by about 1%. This increase applies across the board regardless of your ship's sub/surface visibility or what weapon is being used against it. Similarly, a visibility decrease of 1% is roughly equivalent to increasing your ship's effective HP against other ships by about 1.1%.
3mgase.zh: 实际上，4% 的速度提升大致相当于将舰船对其他舰船的有效 HP 提高约 1%。无论舰船的潜艇/水面可见度如何，也无论对其使用何种武器，这一提升都普遍适用。同样，1% 的可见度降低大致相当于将舰船对其他舰船的有效 HP 提高约 1.1%。

cj8250.en: In general, this penalty also generally discourages fielding lots of cheaper escort carriers (carriers with just one or two hangar spaces, usually converted from outdated cruisers), as -998 or more escort carriers will suffer the same penalties as the same number of full carriers, even though the escort carriers have far less deck space than the full carriers.
cj8250.zh: 总的来说，这一惩罚通常也会阻止大量部署较廉价的护航航母（只有一两个机库空间、通常由过时巡洋舰改装的航母），因为 -998 艘或更多护航航母会遭受与同样数量正规航母相同的惩罚，尽管护航航母的甲板容量远小于正规航母。

pjgp2l.en: If a critical hit does occur, it potentially affects one of the critical parts on the ship. The chance for this is 10%⟦0⟧ for attacks from other ships and 10%⟦1⟧ for aerial attacks, both inversely scaled by reliability (e.g., at 25% reliability the chance increases to 10%÷25%=40%). The effect depends on the specific part being damaged (see the table below).
pjgp2l.zh: 如果确实发生了暴击，它可能会影响舰船上的一个关键部位。来自其他舰船的攻击触发该效果的几率为 10%⟦0⟧，空袭为 10%⟦1⟧，两者都与可靠性成反比（例如在 25% 可靠性时，几率增加到 10%÷25%=40%）。效果取决于被损坏的具体部位（见下表）。

b0gjq6.en: When an aircraft carrier is part of a fleet that is on patrol in one or more regions, then the wings based on it are shown as on a carrier mission. They will operate as a Carrier Air Group and automatically take part in any naval combat that the fleet engages in. There is no need to give them any specific orders if they are intended to be used in this way.
b0gjq6.zh: 当一艘航空母舰属于一支在一个或多个地区巡逻的舰队时，驻扎在其上的航空队会显示为执行航母任务。它们将作为舰载机航空群运作，并自动参与该舰队加入的任何海战。如果打算这样使用它们，就无需给它们下达任何具体命令。

sflg59.en: As will often be the case, in this example there is more information available in the detailed results than can fit on-screen in the columns. To view the performance of the rest of the vessels involved in an encounter where the detailed results won't all fit on screen at one time, use the scrollbars on the side of the detailed naval results column.
sflg59.zh: 如常见情况那样，在此例中详细结果里的信息比屏幕上各列能容纳的更多。要查看一场交战中其余舰船的表现（而详细结果无法一次全部显示在屏幕上），请使用详细海军结果列侧边的滚动条。

1jq8oer.en: If any planes remain after the ship shoots at them, they perform the naval strike. If they are based on a carrier that is taking part in a naval battle with the target, their damage is increased by ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ The ratio of planes that actually hit the ship is ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ (capped between 0% and 100%). The ship's speed and armor do not matter in this case.
1jq8oer.zh: 如果舰船向飞机射击后仍有飞机存活，它们就会执行海上打击。如果它们驻扎在参与对目标海战的航母上，其伤害会提高 ⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧ 真正命中舰船的飞机比例为 ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧（上限为 0% 至 100%）。在这种情况下，舰船的速度和装甲无关紧要。

u2flzj.en: Each ship with offensive weapons (i.e. not carriers and convoys) and whose weapons are on cooldown can target three enemy ships, independently, per combat hour; one with its depth charges/light weapons, one with torpedoes, and one with heavy guns. Depending on weapon type and enemy screening, only certain enemy groups can be targeted.
u2flzj.zh: 每艘拥有攻击性武器（即不是航母和运输船队）且武器处于冷却中的舰船，每个战斗小时可以各自独立地以三艘敌方舰船为目标：一艘用深水炸弹/轻型武器，一艘用鱼雷，一艘用重型火炮。根据武器类型和敌方屏卫情况，只能以某些敌方编组为目标。

n36lzd.en: Like other ships, carriers can gain (or lose) ⟦0⟧, leading to them gaining or losing veterancy levels that can give various bonuses and penalties. Unlike other ships, however, carriers do not receive any benefits to their damage from veterancy levels, receiving sortie efficiency penalties and bonuses instead.
n36lzd.zh: 与其他舰船一样，航母可以获得（或失去）⟦0⟧，从而提升或降低老练度等级，带来各种加成和惩罚。然而与其他舰船不同，航母的伤害不会从老练度等级中获得任何好处，而是获得出击效率方面的惩罚和加成。

b8xtd.en: It is important to note that only the ship that is being targeted can fire back with its AA against enemy aircraft. This makes AA far less valuable on ships that are not expected to be targeted by enemy aircraft, e.g., screening ships in a battle fleet composed of larger capital ships and/or carriers.
b8xtd.zh: 需要注意的是，只有被瞄准的那艘舰船才能用其防空火力对敌方飞机还击。这使得防空火力在预计不会被敌方飞机瞄准的舰船上价值低得多，例如由较大主力舰和/或航母组成的战斗舰队中的屏卫舰。

g0a6rg.en: The respective weapon type damage of the ship can be modified by doctrines, the ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧, pride of the fleet (if present), and the admiral's skills and traits. Bad positioning can cause a penalty of up to 50%⟦2⟧. The Defense modifier of the enemy admiral's skill level will also reduce the damage.
g0a6rg.zh: 舰船相应武器类型的伤害可以被学说、⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、舰队之傲（若存在），以及海军将领的技能和特质修正。糟糕的定位最多可造成 50%⟦2⟧ 的惩罚。敌方海军将领技能等级的防御修正也会降低伤害。

1g1xj5z.en: The number of external planes is limited to: <sum of all enemy ships' current HP> * 0.05⟦0⟧ * (1 + 0.2⟦1⟧ * <combat days>). But at least 20⟦2⟧ planes can always join. The number of planes eligible for joining naval combat is the total planes assigned on ⟦3⟧ mission multiplied by ⟦4⟧.
1g1xj5z.zh: 外部飞机数量限制为：<所有敌方舰船当前 HP 之和> * 0.05⟦0⟧ * (1 + 0.2⟦1⟧ * <战斗天数>)。但至少有 20⟦2⟧ 架飞机总能加入。有资格加入海战的飞机数量，是分配到 ⟦3⟧ 任务上的飞机总数乘以 ⟦4⟧。

1kv5yaj.en: Submarines are completely immune to being targeted while they are hidden. This is indicated by a crossed-out eye symbol over the submarine. Revealing a submarine starts a cooldown of 20⟦0⟧ hours, after which the submarine will hide again (unless the cooldown gets refreshed).
1kv5yaj.zh: 潜艇在隐藏时完全免疫被瞄准。这由潜艇上方一个带叉的眼睛符号表示。发现一艘潜艇会开始 20⟦0⟧ 小时的冷却，之后潜艇会再次隐藏（除非冷却被刷新）。

1uzb5jr.en: The both the target ship's AA attack (unless it is a convoy) and the combined AA of all ships in the battle reduces the damage dealt. The total amount of damage reduction is:⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ For convoys, ⟦2⟧ , but convoy AA is included in ⟦3⟧ . Note that ⟦4⟧ is also included in ⟦5⟧ .
1uzb5jr.zh: 被瞄准舰船的防空攻击（除非它是运输船队）以及战斗中所有舰船的合计防空火力都会降低造成的伤害。总伤害减免量为：⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 对于运输船队，为 ⟦2⟧ ，但运输船队防空已包含在 ⟦3⟧ 中。注意 ⟦4⟧ 也包含在 ⟦5⟧ 中。

1gc6fjb.en: Bad positioning applies a penalty to how much ships contribute to both screening efficiency and carrier screening efficiency. The penalty increases linearly up to ⟦0⟧ at 0% positioning. This may increase the screening ratio required to achieve 100% efficiency by up to ⟦1⟧.
1gc6fjb.zh: 糟糕的定位会惩罚舰船对屏卫效率和航母屏卫效率的贡献。该惩罚随定位降至 0% 而线性增加到 ⟦0⟧。这可能使达到 100% 效率所需的屏卫比例最多提高 ⟦1⟧。

nq446b.en: If there are enemy fighters present in the air zone where the naval strike or port strike is taking place, they can engage in ⟦0⟧ and potentially disrupt the bombers before they even reach their ship targets. See the dedicated article on ⟦1⟧ for more information.
nq446b.zh: 如果海上打击或港口打击发生的空域中有敌方战斗机存在，它们可以参与 ⟦0⟧，并可能在轰炸机到达其舰船目标之前就将其扰乱。更多信息请参见关于 ⟦1⟧ 的专门条目。

1dh8ndj.en: Otherwise a regular critical occurs without damaging a particular part. The damage bonus ranges from ⟦0⟧ (at 100% reliability) up to ⟦1⟧ (at 0% reliability), scaling linearly. For torpedoes, the bonus does not depend on reliability and is always ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧
1dh8ndj.zh: 否则会发生普通暴击，而不损坏特定部位。伤害加成范围从 ⟦0⟧（100% 可靠性时）到 ⟦1⟧（0% 可靠性时），线性缩放。对于鱼雷，该加成不取决于可靠性，始终为 ⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧

852n3z.en: The weight of damaged ships gets increased by up to ⟦0⟧ as they approach 0% HP. If a ship's anti-air (AA) attack is below 5,⟦1⟧ the weight is increased by ⟦2⟧. For example, convoys have only 0.2 AA attack, increasing their score by 5 * (5 - 0.2) = ⟦3⟧.
852n3z.zh: 受损舰船的权重在其接近 0% HP 时会最多提高 ⟦0⟧。如果一艘舰船的防空（AA）攻击低于 5，⟦1⟧ 权重会增加 ⟦2⟧。例如，运输船队只有 0.2 的防空攻击，其分值增加 5 * (5 - 0.2) = ⟦3⟧。

1kn4cuv.en: ⟦0⟧ the probability that a torpedo can target capital ships (bypassing the screening group) is 100%, minus the enemy ⟦1⟧. To target ships in the carrier group (including convoys), it needs to pass an additional check of 100% minus the enemy ⟦2⟧.
1kn4cuv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 鱼雷以主力舰为目标（绕过屏卫编组）的概率为 100% 减去敌方 ⟦1⟧。要以航母群中的舰船（包括运输船队）为目标，还需要额外通过一次 100% 减去敌方 ⟦2⟧ 的检定。

yydc1u.en: Every 8⟦0⟧ hours (04:00, 12:00, 20:00), planes can sortie in the battle. For carrier-based planes, this is every 6⟦1⟧ hours, though note that carriers get ⟦2⟧ carrier traffic at night by default unless something like the ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ spirit is used.
yydc1u.zh: 每 8⟦0⟧ 小时（04:00、12:00、20:00），飞机可以在战斗中出击。对于舰载机，则是每 6⟦1⟧ 小时，不过要注意，航母在夜间默认会获得 ⟦2⟧ 的航母出动，除非使用类似 ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ 精神的东西。

xlxhmz.en: The chance for a torpedo to score a critical hit is 10%.⟦0⟧ For other weapon types the base chance is 5%,⟦1⟧ but also depends on whether the armor can be pierced (see ⟦2⟧) and the target's reliability (scaling down to 0% at 100% reliability).
xlxhmz.zh: 鱼雷造成暴击的几率为 10%。⟦0⟧ 其他武器类型的基础几率为 5%，⟦1⟧ 但也取决于装甲是否能被穿透（见 ⟦2⟧）以及目标的可靠性（在 100% 可靠性时降至 0%）。

ri2z87.en: The naval strike target of an undisrupted bomber wing is randomly selected from a weighted distribution of all enemy ships. The base weight is each ship's maximum HP, excluding hidden submarines. This gets scaled depending on ship type:
ri2z87.zh: 未受扰乱的轰炸机航空队的海上打击目标，是从所有敌方舰船的加权分布中随机选择的。基础权重是每艘舰船的最大 HP，不包括隐藏的潜艇。该权重会根据舰船类型进行缩放：

1x0bm2s.en: The base hit chance for guns and torpedoes is 10%,⟦0⟧ and the base hit chance for depth charges is 11%.⟦1⟧ If the firing ship lacks manpower or organization, their hit chances are reduced by up to ⟦2⟧ and by up to ⟦3⟧, respectively.
1x0bm2s.zh: 火炮和鱼雷的基础命中率为 10%，⟦0⟧ 深水炸弹的基础命中率为 11%。⟦1⟧ 如果开火舰船缺乏人力或组织度，其命中率分别最多降低 ⟦2⟧ 和最多降低 ⟦3⟧。

12qpdkr.en: When a ship gets targeted by an air wing, that ship and that ship alone will try to defend itself by shooting back preemptively. Against non-kamikaze air wings, the ship's chance to successfully preemptively retaliate is:⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧
12qpdkr.zh: 当一艘舰船被航空队瞄准时，只有该舰船会尝试通过先发制人地还击来自卫。对于非神风航空队，舰船成功先发制人还击的几率为：⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧

1enact5.en: If the target is less than full strength, up to +100% bonus are applied to the weight. If the target is escaping, the weight is reduced by 50%. If the target is actively fighting (i.e. not waiting), a +50% bonus is applied.
1enact5.zh: 如果目标兵力不满，权重最多获得 +100% 加成。如果目标正在逃跑，权重降低 50%。如果目标正在积极作战（即不在等待），则获得 +50% 加成。

5h4o8w.en: Out of the remaining valid targets one is chosen by weighted random selection. If the firing ship is not currently running away, the enemies are weighted as follows (numbers in parenthesis for light guns):⟦0⟧
5h4o8w.zh: 在剩余的有效目标中，通过加权随机选择挑出一个。如果开火舰船当前没有逃跑，敌方目标的权重如下（括号内为轻型火炮的数值）：⟦0⟧

t1pa54.en: This is further modified by the hit profile of both the firing weapon and the target ship. Ships with lower hit profiles are harder to hit, and weapons with lower hit profiles are better at targeting.
t1pa54.zh: 这还会进一步受到开火武器和目标舰船双方命中轮廓的影响。命中轮廓较低的舰船更难被命中，而命中轮廓较低的武器更善于瞄准。

hbzow6.en: If the ship succeeds in its preemptive defense, it destroys <AA> * 1%⟦0⟧ of them, rounded stochastically to a full number of planes. The planes' speed and air defense stats do not matter in this case.
hbzow6.zh: 如果舰船的先发制人防御成功，它会摧毁其中 <AA> * 1%⟦0⟧ 的飞机，并以随机方式取整为整数架飞机。在这种情况下，飞机的速度和防空属性无关紧要。

v2x0fo.en: This is the primary way that submarines are revealed during naval battles, e.g., against convoy escorts. Reducing torpedo reveal chance is therefore very important when using submarines in this role.
v2x0fo.zh: 这是海战中潜艇被发现的主要方式，例如面对护航运输船队时。因此，在让潜艇担任这一角色时，降低鱼雷暴露几率非常重要。

qmvx6b.en: Heavy attack guns and light attack guns can fire every 1⟦0⟧ hour(s) and 1⟦1⟧ hour(s), respectively. Torpedoes normally fire every 4⟦2⟧ hours. When This can be reduced by ⟦3⟧ with the ⟦4⟧ trait.
qmvx6b.zh: 重型攻击火炮和轻型攻击火炮分别每 1⟦0⟧ 小时和每 1⟦1⟧ 小时可以开火一次。鱼雷通常每 4⟦2⟧ 小时开火一次。这可以由 ⟦3⟧ 通过 ⟦4⟧ 特质来降低。

lski50.en: If the planes are performing kamikaze attacks, the ship will always successfully preemptively retaliate,⟦0⟧ its AA attack gets increased by ⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧ and the losses are increased by ⟦3⟧.⟦4⟧
lski50.zh: 如果飞机执行神风攻击，舰船将始终成功进行先发制人还击，⟦0⟧ 其防空攻击提高 ⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧，损失增加 ⟦3⟧。⟦4⟧

nyse2r.en: ⟦0⟧ in ⟦1⟧, multiplied by a random number between ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧, per function ⟦4⟧ in ⟦5⟧ as of version ⟦6⟧. The define comment is wrong about randomness subtracting from max (base) damage.
nyse2r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在 ⟦1⟧ 中，乘以 ⟦2⟧ 与 ⟦3⟧ 之间的随机数，按照函数 ⟦4⟧ 在 ⟦5⟧ 中的规则，截至版本 ⟦6⟧。该 define 注释关于随机性从最大（基础）伤害中减去的说法是错误的。

1w5po7e.en: Aircraft use entirely different math to figure out their hit chances when naval bombing that ignores the visibility and speed of their targets. See the ⟦0⟧ section for more information.
1w5po7e.zh: 飞机在进行海军轰炸时使用完全不同的算法来计算命中率，忽略目标的可见度和速度。更多信息请参见 ⟦0⟧ 章节。

lbaeij.en: A critical hit is a particularly devastating hit against the target which can also damage some of its critical parts. The resulting penalties can only be removed by repairing the ship.
lbaeij.zh: 暴击是对目标的一次特别具有破坏性的命中，它还可能损坏目标的一些关键部位。由此产生的惩罚只能通过修理该舰来移除。

jc62a0.en: The weighting is similar when the firing ship is escaping but only considers targets that are actively fighting and always chooses the highest scoring target, without randomization.
jc62a0.zh: 当开火舰船正在逃跑时，加权方式类似，但只考虑正在积极作战的目标，并且总是选择得分最高的目标，不进行随机化。

11pfx70.en: With ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧, researching any light airframe also grants access to its carrier-capable version, from which a buildable variant (fighter, naval bomber, or CAS) may be created.
11pfx70.zh: 借助 ⟦0⟧ 的 ⟦1⟧，研究任何轻型机体也会解锁其舰载版本，从而可以创建可建造的变体（战斗机、海军轰炸机或近距空中支援）。

1tdx9rn.en: If the enemy has any amount of sub detection, then every combat hour, there is a chance for the submarine to get revealed passively by the enemy's sub detection:⟦0⟧
1tdx9rn.zh: 如果敌方有任何数量的水下探测，那么每个战斗小时，潜艇都有几率被敌方水下探测被动发现：⟦0⟧

fwdeuq.en: Subs use their sub visibility, even when revealed, while all other ships use their surface visibility. The hit profile of convoys is always 85.⟦0⟧
fwdeuq.zh: 潜艇使用其潜艇可见度，即使已被发现也是如此，而所有其他舰船使用其水面可见度。运输船队的命中轮廓始终为 85。⟦0⟧

1r9ixu6.en: Submarines will only target screens when set to High risk engagement rule. They will only target capitals when set to Medium risk or higher.
1r9ixu6.zh: 潜艇只有在交战规则设为高风险时才会以屏卫舰为目标。只有在设为中风险或更高时才会以主力舰为目标。

p96exx.en: Torpedoes ignore armor entirely, though some heavier armor modules do reduce incoming ⟦0⟧ from torpedoes and the ⟦1⟧ chance of torpedoes.
p96exx.zh: 鱼雷完全无视装甲，不过一些较重的装甲模块确实会减少来自鱼雷的 ⟦0⟧ 以及鱼雷的 ⟦1⟧ 几率。

1lv3rhp.en: ⟦0⟧: Consists of ⟦1⟧ except for carriers. In addition to providing heavy firepower, these ships screen the carrier group from torpedoes.
1lv3rhp.zh: ⟦0⟧：由 ⟦1⟧ 组成，航母除外。除了提供强大火力外，这些舰船还屏卫航母群免受鱼雷攻击。

15qdgpd.zh: ⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧ 位于 ⟦3⟧ 中，函数 ⟦4⟧ 位于 ⟦5⟧ 中，截至版本 ⟦6⟧。这些 define 注释关于探测如何纳入其中的说法是错误的。

1i1ndhf.en: ⟦0⟧: Consists of ⟦1⟧, which may threaten the enemy battle-line and carrier group if they are insufficiently screened from torpedoes.
1i1ndhf.zh: ⟦0⟧：由 ⟦1⟧ 组成，如果它们没有获得足够的鱼雷屏卫，可能会威胁敌方战列线和航母群。

p6n4h0.zh: 装甲和穿透可以同时影响重型攻击火炮和轻型攻击火炮的 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 几率。
