rym8mf.zh: 非潜艇 vs 运输船队：60 (4)

1ewppi1.en: ⟦0⟧: Represents how many aircraft on the aircraft carrier can participate in the attack during the battle (sorties are air missions launched from an aircraft carrier). A higher sortie efficiency rating results in greater numbers of carrier based planes (not land based) joining in a fight. Sortie efficiency typically starts at 50%,⟦1⟧ meaning that only half of a carrier's planes may fly at the same time. See sortie efficiency for more details.
1ewppi1.zh: ⟦0⟧：表示战斗中航空母舰上可参与攻击的飞机数量（出击是从航空母舰上发起的空中任务）。出击效率越高，参与战斗的舰载机（非岸基飞机）就越多。出击效率通常起始为 50%，⟦1⟧这意味着同一时间只有一半的舰载机能够起飞。详见出击效率。

5tchre.en: Tracks are split into four categories: Submarines, Screens, Capital Ships, and Carriers. Each has a set of subdoctrines shared among each grand doctrine. Mastery is used to unlock milestones within the subdoctrine, granting further bonuses. Each track gains Mastery when certain units engage in action, or at a reduced rate while training. If a subdoctrine is not selected, up to 200 Mastery is held in reserve.
5tchre.zh: 路线分为四个类别：潜艇、屏卫舰、大型军舰和航空母舰。每条路线都有一套在各总体学说之间共享的子学说。精通度用于解锁子学说内的里程碑，提供进一步的加成。当特定单位参与行动时，每条路线都会获得精通度，训练时则以降低的速率获得。如果未选择子学说，最多可保留 200 点精通度。

iilen7.en: Subdoctrines allow a navy to specialize in different types of combat. Subdoctrines provide some bonuses when picked and additional bonuses are unlocked when enough Mastery is accumulated in each Doctrine Track. Only one Subdoctrine can be enabled from each Doctrine Track at a time. Grand Doctrines do not effect which Subdoctrines are available.
iilen7.zh: 子学说使海军能够专精于不同类型的战斗。子学说在被选中时提供一些加成，当每条学说路线中积累足够的精通度后，还会解锁额外加成。每条学说路线同时只能启用一个子学说。总体学说不会影响哪些子学说可用。

d0jqkc.en: ⟦0⟧ allows a nation to specialize the way its navy conducts ⟦1⟧. Naval doctrines are split into Grand Doctrines and Subdoctrines. Naval doctrines can be reviewed and unlocked from the ⟦2⟧ using ⟦3⟧. There are three mutually exclusive grand doctrines which have unique milestones for each track when a subdoctrine is mastered.
d0jqkc.zh: ⟦0⟧允许一个国家专精其海军进行⟦1⟧的方式。海军学说分为总体学说和子学说。海军学说可以在⟦2⟧中使用⟦3⟧查看和解锁。共有三种互斥的总体学说，当子学说达到精通时，每条路线都有独特的里程碑。

1wp636k.en: ⟦0⟧: How likely submarines are to reveal themselves when they fire at an enemy equipped with sub detection. Submarines have a base score of 3.5%,⟦1⟧ modified by visibility and positioning. While destroyers and light cruisers can also be equipped with torpedoes, as surface ships, they use different concealment mechanics.
1wp636k.zh: ⟦0⟧：潜艇向装备有潜艇探测的敌人开火时暴露自身的概率。潜艇的基础值为 3.5%，⟦1⟧受可见度和站位修正。虽然驱逐舰和轻巡洋舰也可以装备鱼雷，但作为水面舰船，它们使用不同的隐蔽机制。

18tg9na.en: ⟦0⟧: Indicator of a ship's combat readiness. The higher the organization rating of a ship, the longer it can stay in a fight, and the less its effectiveness drops from enemy attacks. A ship with low or no organization cannot fight or move effectively. See ⟦1⟧.
18tg9na.zh: ⟦0⟧：舰船战备状态的指标。舰船的组织度越高，在战斗中坚持的时间越长，其效能因敌方攻击而下降的幅度也越小。组织度过低或为零的舰船无法有效战斗或移动。见⟦1⟧。

5kthsc.en: ⟦0⟧: Value that represents a ship's steel decking thickness, belt thickness, bulkheads, etc. The purpose of armor is to help protect a ship from attack. Having armor that is equal to or greater than the opponent's piercing value makes you take less damage.
5kthsc.zh: ⟦0⟧：表示舰船钢制甲板厚度、装甲带厚度、舱壁等的数值。装甲的作用是帮助舰船抵御攻击。装甲值等于或大于对手的穿透值时，你受到的伤害会更少。

ndgf90.en: ⟦0⟧: Value that represents a capital ship's firepower or damage capability due to its gun size, quantity, rate of fire, etc. This value adds a positive modifier to the "to hit" dice of a large friendly ship. The higher the number, the better. See ⟦1⟧.
ndgf90.zh: ⟦0⟧：表示大型军舰因火炮口径、数量、射速等而具有的火力或伤害能力的数值。该数值为己方大型舰船的「命中」判定骰子提供正向修正。数值越高越好。见⟦1⟧。

1n9aj4p.en: Some nations start the game with a naval doctrine pre-selected and unlocked. They can still change doctrines as normal, though sticking with their starting doctrine can cost them less ⟦0⟧ in the long run.
1n9aj4p.zh: 有些国家在游戏开始时已预选并解锁了一项海军学说。它们仍可照常更换学说，不过从长远来看，坚持其初始学说可以让它们少花费⟦0⟧。

1d5y05t.en: Grand Doctrines represent the overall doctrine of a navy. They provide bonuses when unlocked, as well as unique milestones for each track once mastered. Only one Grand Doctrine can be enabled at a time.
1d5y05t.zh: 总体学说代表一支海军的整体学说。解锁时提供加成，并在达到精通后为每条路线提供独特的里程碑。同时只能启用一个总体学说。

ljl8cx.en: ⟦0⟧: How hard a submarine is to hit with depth charges, how well a hidden submarine can remain hidden in combat, and how well a submarine can remain hidden from detection outside of combat.
ljl8cx.zh: ⟦0⟧：潜艇被深水炸弹命中的难度、隐蔽的潜艇在战斗中保持隐蔽的能力，以及潜艇在战斗之外不被探测到的能力。

11v5w00.en: Each individual grand doctrine and subdoctrine has a base cost of 100 or 50 ⟦0⟧ This cost may be modified by spirits, advisors, and special bonuses from focuses, events, or decisions.
11v5w00.zh: 每个单独的总体学说和子学说的基础花费为 100 或 50 ⟦0⟧。该花费可能被精神、顾问以及来自国策、事件或决议的特殊加成所修正。

12f5t5v.en: ⟦0⟧: Abbreviation for "hit points" or "health points" and is the ability to absorb damage. It represents strength, which is how much damage a ship can sustain before being destroyed.
12f5t5v.zh: ⟦0⟧：「hit points」（命中点）或「health points」（生命值）的缩写，指承受伤害的能力。它代表兵力，即舰船在被摧毁前能承受多少伤害。

s2vxbf.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the amount of planes shot down when successfully intercepting enemy aircraft, reduces the damage and effectiveness of incoming ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. See ⟦3⟧ for more details.
s2vxbf.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高成功拦截敌机时击落飞机的数量，降低来袭的⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧的伤害与效能。更多细节见⟦3⟧。

vv3rs3.en: ⟦0⟧: How quickly ships assigned to Convoy Escort missions can come to the defense of convoys. At 100%, escorts will immediately enter combat upon a convoy coming under attack.
vv3rs3.zh: ⟦0⟧：执行护航运输船队任务的舰船前来保护运输船队的快慢。达到 100% 时，一旦运输船队遭到攻击，护航舰船就会立即进入战斗。

k3eyku.en: ⟦0⟧: How well ships can detect enemy vessels on the surface, both when finding enemy surface fleets and when trying to avoid them.
k3eyku.zh: ⟦0⟧：舰船探测水面敌方船只的能力，既包括发现敌方水面舰队，也包括设法避开它们。

1548vzy.en: ⟦0⟧: How hard a ship is to hit in combat by other ships, and how well a ship is hidden from detection outside of combat.
1548vzy.zh: ⟦0⟧：舰船在战斗中被其他舰船命中的难度，以及舰船在战斗之外不被探测到的能力。

1szl67m.en: ⟦0⟧: How much organization is lost by ships moving to engage a spotted fleet while assigned to Strike Force missions.
1szl67m.zh: ⟦0⟧：舰船在执行打击舰队任务时，移动去迎击已发现的舰队会损失多少组织度。

1acd1j8.en: ⟦0⟧: Reduces the penalty for having too many planes based in a carrier. See sortie efficiency for more details.
1acd1j8.zh: ⟦0⟧：降低航空母舰上搭载飞机过多的惩罚。详见出击效率。

lrgvqa.en: ⟦0⟧: How quickly ships assigned to Convoy Raiding missions can gather upon spotting a target.
lrgvqa.zh: ⟦0⟧：执行破交任务的舰船在发现目标后集结的快慢。

gw72cq.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases the penalty the enemy gets when they have too many ships in combat.
gw72cq.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高敌方在战斗中拥有过多舰船时受到的惩罚。

3202iq.en: ⟦0⟧: Modifies the agility of planes executing naval strike missions from carriers.
3202iq.zh: ⟦0⟧：修正从航空母舰执行对海打击任务的飞机的机动性。

1fo7407.en: ⟦0⟧: How likely planes assigned to ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ missions can hit enemy ships.
1fo7407.zh: ⟦0⟧：执行⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧任务的飞机命中敌方舰船的概率。

1jhryuf.en: ⟦0⟧: How well ships can detect enemy submarines, both in and out of combat.
1jhryuf.zh: ⟦0⟧：舰船探测敌方潜艇的能力，无论战斗内外。

1h6e7lm.en: ⟦0⟧ Increases damage when performing ⟦1⟧ missions against fleets in port.
1h6e7lm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 提高对港口内舰队执行⟦1⟧任务时的伤害。

1ga1j1o.en: ⟦0⟧: Affects overall efficiency of naval minelaying performed by fleets.
1ga1j1o.zh: ⟦0⟧：影响舰队执行海上布雷的整体效率。

1my0j8a.en: Attack when in combat alongside the Pride of the Fleet: ⟦0⟧
1my0j8a.zh: 与舰队之傲并肩作战时的攻击：⟦0⟧

slbe3f.en: Requires Special projects: Escort Carrier or Support Ships
slbe3f.zh: 需要特殊项目：护航航空母舰或支援舰船

gjolyj.zh: 支援舰船 - 最大支援效果：⟦0⟧

bgrbrn.zh: 需要特殊项目：微型潜艇

w4jkke.en: Screen bonus when using capital ships: ⟦0⟧
w4jkke.zh: 使用大型军舰时的屏卫加成：⟦0⟧

hwh5e1.en: Number of ships in the first contact: ⟦0⟧
hwh5e1.zh: 首次接触时的舰船数量：⟦0⟧

k9fs65.zh: 维修舰船 - 最大维修效果：⟦0⟧

1rhrv2a.zh: 航空母舰航空队出击延迟（小时）⟦0⟧

w9fcdl.zh: 需要特殊项目：护航航空母舰

2opwg7.zh: 需要特殊项目：支援舰船

1a04ymq.zh: 添加科技：近岸防御舰船。

1jxa6tw.zh: 400 护航航空母舰自给自足

kwm847.zh: 运输船队撤退时的速度：⟦0⟧

16usyd8.zh: 500 运输船队-航空母舰支援群

138q4u2.en: In tank designer you can specify the role of a design. This allows it to be used in certain armored combat support battalions or specialized support companies instead of in ordinary armored battalions. Changing the role of a design also inherently changes some of its stats, even if nothing else about the design changes. For example, a player can have two completely identical armored vehicle designs where one is designated a ⟦0⟧ and the other a ⟦1⟧, and the medium tank destroyer version of the identical design will have more hard attack and piercing just from the fact that it has been designated as such.
138q4u2.zh: 在坦克设计器中，你可以为设计指定角色。这使其能够被用于特定的装甲战斗支援营或专门的支援连，而不是普通的装甲营。改变设计的角色本身也会改变其部分属性，即使设计的其他内容完全不变。例如，玩家可以拥有两个完全相同的装甲车辆设计，其中一个被指定为⟦0⟧，另一个被指定为⟦1⟧，而这个完全相同设计的中型坦克歼击车版本仅仅因为被如此指定，就会拥有更高的硬攻和穿透。

q5mi22.en: There are three main types of tank chassis: light, medium, and heavy. These correspond to ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ tanks, respectively, as well as their armor variants, such as ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧, and armored support companies. New versions of these chassis can be unlocked through research. Research can also unlock some more specialized tank chassis types. Among other limitations, a chassis' type determines the largest size of turret the tank can handle, thus limiting the armaments the tank can use. This can be bypassed only by switching a design's main turret for a fixed superstructure.
q5mi22.zh: 坦克底盘有三种主要类型：轻型、中型和重型。它们分别对应⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧坦克，以及它们的装甲变体，例如⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧，还有装甲支援连。这些底盘的新版本可以通过科研解锁。科研还可以解锁一些更专业的坦克底盘类型。在其他限制之外，底盘类型决定了坦克能够安装的最大炮塔尺寸，从而限制了坦克可使用的武器。只有将设计的主炮塔换成固定战斗室才能绕过这一限制。

1ifnnex.en: Turrets are the main source of breakthrough, representing visibility from vehicle, size of crew workspace and their workload. Type of chassis determine maximus size of turret. Size of turret determines size of the weapon it can mount. Smaller weapons can be always mounted. Fixed super-structure allows mounting of larger sized guns and provides a higher reliability rate though it comes at the cost of breakthrough. Fixed super-structure cannot mount AA guns as it cannot track the target or elevate the gun far enough to hit planes.
1ifnnex.zh: 炮塔是突破的主要来源，代表着车内的视野、乘员工作空间的大小及其工作负荷。底盘类型决定炮塔的最大尺寸。炮塔尺寸决定其可安装武器的尺寸。较小的武器总是可以安装。固定战斗室允许安装更大尺寸的火炮，并提供更高的可靠性，但代价是突破。固定战斗室无法安装防空炮，因为它无法跟踪目标，也无法将火炮抬升到足以击中飞机的高度。

mxbyhc.en: Suspension modules represent the type of suspension system used to support the weight of the tank and its crew while making sure the tank remains stable enough while moving to use its weapons reliably. A tank design must have a suspension module selected to be valid. Bogie Suspension is the default suspension module for tanks.
mxbyhc.zh: 悬挂模块代表用于支撑坦克及其乘员重量的悬挂系统类型，同时确保坦克在移动时足够稳定，以便可靠地使用武器。坦克设计必须选择悬挂模块才有效。转向架悬挂是坦克的默认悬挂模块。

z80r93.en: Choosing a role other than tank drastically reduces the breakthrough of the battalion. Other than that, there are only minor differences in the base stats depending on the chosen role. It is important to note that different may receive different bonuses depending on researched technologies, doctrines or leaders.
z80r93.zh: 选择坦克以外的角色会大幅降低该营的突破。除此之外，根据所选角色的不同，基础属性只有细微差异。需要注意的是，不同的角色可能会因已研究的科技、学说或将领而获得不同的加成。

1ng64ws.en: A tank's weapon is one of its most distinguishing features. In addition to providing most, if not all, of the firepower of the vehicle, the main gun also determines which roles the design can fill. For example, mounting an anti-air gun will prevent the tank design from being used as a "tank".
1ng64ws.zh: 坦克的武器是其最显著的特征之一。除了提供车辆大部分乃至全部火力之外，主炮还决定了该设计能够担任哪些角色。例如，安装防空炮会使该坦克设计无法被用作「坦克」。

13fbkd3.en: Tank equipment modules are being unlocked through the ⟦0⟧ tree for the base chassis, engine and armor modules. The main weapon modules are unlocked through the ⟦1⟧. Additional supporting or special modules become available via the common tech trees (such as radios from the ⟦2⟧).
13fbkd3.zh: 坦克装备模块通过⟦0⟧科技树解锁基础底盘、发动机和装甲模块。主武器模块通过⟦1⟧解锁。额外的支援或特殊模块则通过通用科技树解锁（例如⟦2⟧中的无线电）。

fnso07.en: Non-tracked suspensions are only available for light chassis. They decrease production cost, decrease reliability, and lower hardness.
fnso07.zh: 非履带悬挂仅适用于轻型底盘。它们降低生产成本、降低可靠性，并降低硬度。

8q94ga.en: Engine modules represent the type of propulsion system used to drive the tank, as well as how powerful that propulsion system is.
8q94ga.zh: 发动机模块代表用于驱动坦克的推进系统类型，以及该推进系统的功率大小。

a2a63p.en: A tank design must have an engine type module selected to be valid. Gasoline Engine is the default engine type module for tanks.
a2a63p.zh: 坦克设计必须选择发动机类型模块才有效。汽油发动机是坦克的默认发动机类型模块。

upqpzf.en: Secondary turrets increase the attack power of the vehicle. The number of additional mountable turrets depend on chassis type:
upqpzf.zh: 副炮塔提高车辆的攻击力。可额外安装的炮塔数量取决于底盘类型：

1ov2yba.en: All tank chassis have four slots for special modules that can either be filled with the following modules or be left empty.
1ov2yba.zh: 所有坦克底盘都有四个特殊模块槽位，可以安装下列模块，也可以留空。

8sh4v5.en: These chassis correspond to the ⟦0⟧ support company. They use unique modules that are different from those used by tanks.
8sh4v5.zh: 这些底盘对应⟦0⟧支援连。它们使用与坦克不同的独特模块。

1q07o8m.en: It is possible to improve the stats of the engine by upgrading its level. Each level provides the same stacking effects.
1q07o8m.zh: 可以通过升级等级来提升发动机的属性。每一级提供的叠加效果都相同。

t2n0b.en: A tank design must have an armor type module selected to be valid. Riveted Armor is the default armor type for tanks.
t2n0b.zh: 坦克设计必须选择装甲类型模块才有效。铆接装甲是坦克的默认装甲类型。

ngwxsb.en: It is possible to improve the armor stats by upgrading its level. Each level provides the same stacking effects.
ngwxsb.zh: 可以通过升级等级来提升装甲属性。每一级提供的叠加效果都相同。

zw9kt4.en: Radios increase the breakthrough and defense of vehicles. Only one radio module can be equipped on a chassis.
zw9kt4.zh: 无线电提高车辆的突破和防御。一个底盘只能装备一个无线电模块。

93hm7n.en: Armor modules represent the processes used during the construction of the tank's chassis and its armor.
93hm7n.zh: 装甲模块代表在建造坦克底盘及其装甲时所采用的工艺。

k1v4n0.en: These modules can be equipped in the auxiliary, or special, module slots of a chassis.
k1v4n0.zh: 这些模块可以装备在底盘的辅助（或特殊）模块槽位中。

jtrqcy.en: The chassis is the frame of the vehicle on top of which all other modules are built.
jtrqcy.zh: 底盘是车辆的框架，所有其他模块都构建在其之上。

lauqko.en: These weapons can be mounted on any tank chassis with an appropriately-sized turret.
lauqko.zh: 这些武器可以安装在任何拥有合适尺寸炮塔的坦克底盘上。

1oj30d8.en: These are the weapon modules that can only be mounted on a Land Cruiser Chassis.
1oj30d8.zh: 这些是只能安装在陆地巡洋舰底盘上的武器模块。

1gf7poq.en: These weapons can only be mounted on light, medium, or heavy chassis.
1gf7poq.zh: 这些武器只能安装在轻型、中型或重型底盘上。

jf22mv.en: Amphibious and modern chassis cannot mount secondary turrets at all.
jf22mv.zh: 两栖和现代底盘完全无法安装副炮塔。

1h05lgy.en: Heavy and super-heavy chassis can mount up to 4 secondary turrets.
1h05lgy.zh: 重型与超重型底盘最多可以安装 4 个副炮塔。

xczily.en: Any number of the following modules can be equipped on a chassis.
xczily.zh: 下列模块可以任意数量装备在底盘上。

1noywiu.en: These modules can only be mounted on a Land Cruiser Chassis.
1noywiu.zh: 这些模块只能安装在陆地巡洋舰底盘上。

bvn0p1.en: Only up to one of each module can be equipped on a chassis.
bvn0p1.zh: 每种模块最多只能装备一个在底盘上。

czygp8.en: Medium chassis can only mount up to 2 secondary turrets.

staarz.en: Tracks are split into four categories: Infantry, Artillery & Combat Support, Armor, and Operations. Each has a set of subdoctrines shared among each grand doctrine. Mastery is used to unlock milestones within the subdoctrine, granting further bonuses. Each track gains Mastery when certain units engage in action, or at a reduced rate (10%) while training. If a subdoctrine is not selected, up to 200 Mastery is held in reserve (banked at a rate of 25% of further gain).
staarz.zh: 学说轨道分为四个类别：步兵、炮兵与战斗支援、装甲、作战。每个类别都有一套在各大学说之间共享的子学说。精通用于解锁子学说内的里程碑，从而提供更多加成。当特定单位参与行动时，每条轨道都会获得精通，训练时则以较低速率（10%）获得。如果未选择子学说，最多可储备 200 点精通（按后续获取量的 25% 存入储备）。

wjei1z.en: Subdoctrines allow an army to specialize in different types of combat. Subdoctrines provide some bonuses when picked, and additional bonuses are unlocked when enough Mastery is accumulated in each Doctrine Track. Only one Subdoctrine can be enabled from each Doctrine Track at a time. Grand Doctrines do not affect which Subdoctrines are available. Each milestone within a subdoctrine requires 100 Mastery (cumulative), unless otherwise noted.
wjei1z.zh: 子学说让军队能够专精于不同类型的战斗。选择子学说时会提供一些加成，当每条学说轨道积累足够的精通后还会解锁额外加成。每条学说轨道同时只能启用一个子学说。大学说不影响哪些子学说可用。除非另有说明，子学说内的每个里程碑都需要 100 点精通（累计）。

1yha4rm.en: It is possible to change doctrines at any point, but all bonuses from previously unlocked doctrines are lost when unlocking a different doctrine and changing grand doctrines resets all tracks. 1nw4n11.en: Incorrect path – This is commonly the cause if the game displays the filesize of the mod, but doesn't load it. The mod doesn't route to the file directly. This can sometimes be a cause of further subfoldering, such as if the mod is located in mod/my_mod/cool_mod, yet the user-specific .mod file contains path = "mod/my_mod". In this case, the files still exist and get loaded. However, the game, for example, expects focus trees in the /Hearts of Iron IV/common/national_focus/ folder. mod/my_mod/cool_mod/common/national_focus/ gets taken to be /Hearts of Iron IV/cool_mod/common/national_focus/ instead, as path = "mod/my_mod" doesn't knock off the /cool_mod/ folder. This is corrected simply by adjusting the path to be to the correct folder. Invalid path – The intended folder is correct, yet it's stated in a way that the game can't recognise. One of the ways of doing so is using backslashes for folder separations, such as path = "mod\my_mod". This is incorrect, as a single backlash gets taken to be an escape character instead. Using forward slashes as in path = "mod/my_mod" is correct. Another way of doing so is using special characters in the name, such as path = "C:/Users/Пример кириллицы/Documents/Paradox Interactive/Hearts of Iron IV/mod/my_mod". In this case, a special character is defined as one that takes more than 1 byte to write with UTF-8, not being present in ASCII's printable characters. This is commonly non-English language folder names, such as diacritics or non-Latin alphabets. In this case, it can be rerouted to a folder that does not contain special characters in the name, such as path = "D:/Hearts of Iron IV modding/my_mod". If the path to the user directory itself contains special characters, it's better to re-route the entire directory to another folder. To do so, edit the base game's /Hearts of Iron IV/launcher-settings.json file and change the folder specified under gameDataPath. After doing so, move the user directory's contents to that folder as to not lose save games and other information. The mod's path also needs to be adjusted properly. If the user directory has non-ASCII characters in the path to it, then all local mods stored there (as the default place to store them) will fail to be loaded and the in-game means will fail to open the error log, with a pop-up saying that the system cannot get access to the file. The default Steam installation folder has a path that will only have ASCII characters in it, making the Steam mods work as intended even if the user directory has non-ASCII characters in it.
1nw4n11.zh: 路径错误——如果游戏显示了模组的文件大小却无法加载它，通常就是这一原因。模组并没有直接指向该文件。有时这是多层子文件夹造成的，例如模组位于 mod/my_mod/cool_mod，而用户专属的 .mod 文件里写的是 path = "mod/my_mod"。这种情况下文件仍然存在并会被加载。然而，游戏（例如）期望国策树位于 /Hearts of Iron IV/common/national_focus/ 文件夹中。于是 mod/my_mod/cool_mod/common/national_focus/ 会被当成 /Hearts of Iron IV/cool_mod/common/national_focus/，因为 path = "mod/my_mod" 并不会去掉 /cool_mod/ 这一层文件夹。只要把路径改为正确的文件夹即可修正。路径无效——目标文件夹本身没错，但写法让游戏无法识别。其中一种做法是用反斜杠分隔文件夹，例如 path = "mod\my_mod"。这是错误的，因为单个反斜杠会被当作转义字符。使用正斜杠写作 path = "mod/my_mod" 才是正确的。另一种做法是在名称中使用特殊字符，例如 path = "C:/Users/Пример кириллицы/Documents/Paradox Interactive/Hearts of Iron IV/mod/my_mod"。这里的特殊字符定义为用 UTF-8 写入时需要超过 1 个字节、不属于 ASCII 可打印字符的字符。这通常是非英语语言的文件夹名，例如变音符号或非拉丁字母。这种情况下，可以把路径改到名称不含特殊字符的文件夹，例如 path = "D:/Hearts of Iron IV modding/my_mod"。如果用户目录本身的路径就包含特殊字符，最好把整个目录改到另一个文件夹。做法是编辑基础游戏的 /Hearts of Iron IV/launcher-settings.json 文件，修改 gameDataPath 下指定的文件夹。之后把用户目录的内容移动到该文件夹，以免丢失存档和其他信息。模组的路径也需要相应调整。如果用户目录的路径中包含非 ASCII 字符，那么存放在那里（作为默认存放位置）的所有本地模组都会加载失败，游戏内的方式也无法打开错误日志，并弹出提示说系统无法访问该文件。默认的 Steam 安装文件夹路径只包含 ASCII 字符，因此即使用户目录的路径含有非 ASCII 字符，Steam 模组仍能正常工作。

1prsfs.en: ⟦0⟧ is used in order to unload every previously-loaded file during the main menu loading within the specified folder. This only applies to files directly within that folder, any sub-folders will left untouched. ⟦1⟧: anything higher in the load order than the mod will be loaded in the exact same way, anything lower than the mod will first get loaded before getting unloaded (e.g. the error where a file will get loaded twice if there's one with a filename differing only by capitalisation will still be present even if one of the files is intended to be replaced with replace_path), anything loaded after the main menu will still get loaded from "replaced" folders. ⟦2⟧: if a file fails to overwrite another mod's file, it will still not do so with this attribute used; instead, ⟦3⟧ is used in the mod's attributes to change the load order. In case the mod fails to overwrite base game's files, this will never solve the problem: ensure that the folder you're writing to is indeed the mod's folder rather than, for example, the user directory or a backup of the mod; in case of flags, the game may occassionally fail to make the mod's ⟦4⟧ folder overwrite the base game which can be solved by creating another mod and moving the files there.
1prsfs.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于在主菜单加载期间卸载指定文件夹内所有先前已加载的文件。这只对该文件夹直接包含的文件生效，任何子文件夹都不会被触动。⟦1⟧：加载顺序高于该模组的内容会以完全相同的方式加载，低于该模组的内容会先被加载然后被卸载（例如，如果存在仅大小写不同的同名文件，就会出现文件被加载两次的错误，即使其中一个文件本打算用 replace_path 替换掉另一个，该错误依然存在）；主菜单之后加载的内容仍会从“被替换”的文件夹中加载。⟦2⟧：如果某个文件无法覆盖另一个模组的文件，使用该属性也依然无法覆盖；此时要在模组的属性中使用 ⟦3⟧ 来改变加载顺序。如果模组无法覆盖基础游戏的文件，这永远解决不了问题：请确认你写入的确实是模组的文件夹，而不是例如用户目录或模组的备份；至于旗帜，游戏有时无法让模组的 ⟦4⟧ 文件夹覆盖基础游戏，此时可以通过创建另一个模组并把文件移过去来解决。

n3rxfe.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The only exception that gets treated as a regular error is ⟦2⟧, caused by the palette in the file having a non-zero amount of colours, typically a product of saving over it in GIMP. Unlike other entries in error.log marked with MAP_ERROR, this allows the game to be opened without the debug mode and doesn't place a warning when trying to go into singleplayer. ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ In dynamic modifiers and only them, the order of modifiers in the tooltip isn't hard-coded. Instead, the game places them in the same order that they were written in the code of the dynamic modifier. However, the order of modifiers inside of dynamic modifiers cannot result in any difference in how they will get interpreted. ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ In rare cases, there is no image set to be placeholder, making it so that using a non-existing sprite also results in nothing appearing. An example of this happening is in ⟦7⟧, where specifying a non-existing sprite to represent a side will result in the side having no icon. This is particularly rare since there is a default fallback image of ⟦8⟧, showing the error dog in the base game.
n3rxfe.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 唯一被当作普通错误处理的例外是 ⟦2⟧，它由文件中调色板的颜色数量不为零引起，通常是使用 GIMP 另存覆盖所致。与 error.log 中其他标记为 MAP_ERROR 的条目不同，它允许在不开启调试模式的情况下打开游戏，并且尝试进入单人游戏时不会出现警告。⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ 在动态修正中（且仅在动态修正中），提示框里修正的顺序不是硬编码的。游戏会按照动态修正代码中的书写顺序来排列它们。不过，动态修正内部修正的顺序不会导致解释结果出现任何差异。⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ 在少数情况下没有设置用作占位符的图像，因此使用不存在的精灵也会导致什么都不显示。一个例子出现在 ⟦7⟧ 中：为某一方指定不存在的精灵会导致该方没有图标。这种情况相当罕见，因为基础游戏中有默认的备用图像 ⟦8⟧，显示的是那只错误狗。

uoxh9p.en: ⟦0⟧: leaving it out from the mod-specific descriptor will cause the launcher to remove it from the user-specific one, while leaving it out from the user-specific descriptor will cause it to not take effect instead of being copied from the mod-specific descriptor as most other attributes do. ⟦1⟧. In some folders, the game isn't built for there being no database entries, such as ⟦2⟧, resulting in a crash; in others, such as Scripted triggers, there are several usages for entries besides the obvious, which can cause unintuitive errors such as the resistance system being triggered when unintended. Therefore, the ⟦3⟧ attribute shouldn't be used recklessly: there should always be at least one file with content within the replaced folder in the mod files, and the base game's contents in the folder should be checked manually to see if anything useful is better left as remaining in the mod.
uoxh9p.zh: ⟦0⟧：从模组专属描述文件中省略它会导致启动器把它从用户专属描述文件中移除，而从用户专属描述文件中省略它则会导致它不生效，而不会像大多数其他属性那样从模组专属描述文件复制过来。⟦1⟧。在某些文件夹中，游戏并未考虑数据库条目为空的情况，例如 ⟦2⟧，从而导致崩溃；而在另一些文件夹中，例如脚本化触发器，条目的用途除了显而易见的那一种之外还有好几种，可能引发难以预料的错误，比如抵抗度系统在意料之外被触发。因此，⟦3⟧ 属性不应随意使用：模组文件中被替换的文件夹里始终应至少有一个有内容的文件，并且应手动检查该文件夹中基础游戏的内容，看看是否有有用的东西最好留在模组中。

iizk1r.en: Since this only unloads indexed files, a direct link to a file will not change regardless of the replace_path being present. For example, ⟦0⟧ will not change anything, since the files in that folder aren't checked during the main menu loading but rather get loaded with a direct link to the filename, such as ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧. Similarly, a ⟦3⟧ will not change anything since the country-identifying flags are only loaded when the country changes the ruling ideology group. This is particularly obvious with the loading screens: ⟦4⟧ will prevent any base game or DLC loading screen from appearing during the loading, however the main menu background will remain the same as if the replace_path wasn't present. This is since the main menu background is defined as a sprite with a direct link to the image, by default in ⟦5⟧.
iizk1r.zh: 由于这只会卸载被索引的文件，对文件的直接链接无论是否存在 replace_path 都不会改变。例如 ⟦0⟧ 不会带来任何变化，因为该文件夹中的文件不会在主菜单加载期间被检查，而是通过指向文件名的直接链接来加载，例如 ⟦1⟧ 中的 ⟦2⟧。同样，⟦3⟧ 也不会带来任何变化，因为用于标识国家的旗帜只在该国改变执政意识形态组时才会加载。这在加载界面上尤其明显：⟦4⟧ 会阻止加载期间出现任何基础游戏或 DLC 加载界面，但主菜单背景仍会和没有 replace_path 时一样。这是因为主菜单背景被定义为带有图像直接链接的精灵，默认位于 ⟦5⟧。

gngtcb.en: ⟦0⟧ - Edits to files done inside the mod folder will show up in-game without the need to use the 'reload' console command. This will also automatically add the errors in the files to the error log. ⟦1⟧, with an exception: if a file's direct path gets mentioned elsewhere within the mod, then it can still get loaded for that use in particular. Examples of that include ⟦2⟧, as ⟦3⟧ functions as a direct link to ⟦4⟧; or GFX, as ⟦5⟧ directly reference the position of the image. Although, notably, the loading of images in-game does not uncompress them properly, leading to visible distortion or black backgrounds which get fixed on a restart. Although edits to most files work, this doesn't work with ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, and ⟦8⟧, although the nudge partially can be used for the latter two.
gngtcb.zh: ⟦0⟧——在模组文件夹内对文件所做的修改无需使用「reload」控制台指令即可在游戏中生效。这还会自动把文件中的错误加入错误日志。⟦1⟧，但有一个例外：如果某个文件的直接路径在模组中的其他地方被提到，那么它仍会因那种特定用途而被加载。这方面的例子包括 ⟦2⟧，因为 ⟦3⟧ 相当于指向 ⟦4⟧ 的直接链接；或者 GFX，因为 ⟦5⟧ 直接引用了图像的位置。不过要注意，游戏内加载图像时不会正确解压它们，导致可见的变形或黑色背景，重启后即可恢复。虽然对大多数文件的修改都能生效，但对 ⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧ 和 ⟦8⟧ 不起作用，不过后两者可以部分使用微调器（nudge）。

1733j93.en: ⟦0⟧: if there is overlap in entries between different files, the game typically uses the order of evaluation in order to determine which one should get priority. For example, if the base game contains a state with the ID of 123 in ⟦1⟧ and the mod contains its information for state 123 in the file of ⟦2⟧, the game will prioritise the state created first, which is the base game's definition. On the converse, between ⟦3⟧ in the base game and ⟦4⟧ in the mod files, the mod's ⟦5⟧ will be chosen. How exactly duplicates are handled depends on the exact file: some don't handle them well and should be avoided (e.g. national focus duplicates break prerequisite line generation), some prefer the first-created entry, some prefer the last-created entry.
1733j93.zh: ⟦0⟧：如果不同文件的条目之间存在重叠，游戏通常使用求值顺序来决定哪一个优先。例如，如果基础游戏在 ⟦1⟧ 中有一个 ID 为 123 的州，而模组在 ⟦2⟧ 这个文件中包含州 123 的信息，游戏会优先采用先创建的州，也就是基础游戏的定义。反过来说，在基础游戏的 ⟦3⟧ 与模组文件中的 ⟦4⟧ 之间，则会选用模组的 ⟦5⟧。重复条目的具体处理方式取决于具体文件：有些文件处理得不好，应当避免（例如国策重复会破坏前置条件连线的生成），有些优先采用最先创建的条目，有些则优先采用最后创建的条目。

i3m8sd.en: ⟦0⟧ files that create sprites assigning information to images, such as attaching a singular name. If there are multiple definitions of the same sprite, only the later-evaluated sprite is used, with the earlier one being ignored. The base game notably uses this for DLCs: if a character only has a portrait within a DLC, then they will be set to use a sprite as the portrait. Within the base game, the sprite is set to lead to a generic portrait, as otherwise the character may appear broken, which is plausible in multiplayer. However, within the DLC files, the sprite that's used for the portrait is defined once again in a separate file later in the evaluation order to ensure that the DLC-added portrait will be used for the DLC owners.
i3m8sd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 文件会创建精灵，为图像赋予信息，例如附加一个单独的名称。如果同一个精灵有多个定义，只有较晚求值的精灵会被使用，较早的那个会被忽略。基础游戏特别将其用于 DLC：如果某个角色只在某个 DLC 中有立绘，那么他们会被设为使用某个精灵作为立绘。在基础游戏中，该精灵被设为指向通用立绘，否则该角色可能会显示异常，这在多人游戏中是可能发生的。然而在 DLC 文件中，用于立绘的精灵会在求值顺序更靠后的另一个文件中再次定义，以确保 DLC 拥有者会使用 DLC 添加的立绘。

8in7cb.en: ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ is a SQLite database that is used to generate the mod information and playsets within the launcher. Occassionally, the launcher may fail to update existing mods (e.g. an "invalid path" error may remain eternally even after the path is fixed or a new user-specific mod descriptor may fail to get detected), and a deletion of this file allows to re-generate the playsets. After the file is deleted, the game will pick up every user-specific mod descriptor and recreate the list of mods using each one. Mods hosted on Steam workshop and Paradox mods will be automatically added to the default playset; local mods will remain in the "All installed mods" list but not be assigned to any playset by default.
8in7cb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 是一个 SQLite 数据库，用于在启动器中生成模组信息和游玩组合。启动器有时会无法更新已有的模组（例如，即使路径已修正，「invalid path」错误仍可能永久存在，或者新的用户专属模组描述文件无法被检测到），删除该文件可以重新生成游玩组合。文件删除后，游戏会读取每一个用户专属模组描述文件，并据此重建模组列表。托管在 Steam 创意工坊和 Paradox Mods 上的模组会被自动加入默认游玩组合；本地模组会保留在「All installed mods」列表中，但默认不会被分配到任何游玩组合。

1q63bid.en: ⟦0⟧ - As long as there are any errors in the log, the log will automatically open when loading the game or after selecting a country. The log will also be able to get accessed by clicking on the error dog in the bottom-right corner after loading into a country, which appears each time a new error appears in the log (since files get automatically loaded-in). If the full path to the user directory, after expanding the ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧, contains any non-ASCII characters, such as non-Latin script or diacritics, then it will fail to open with "The system cannot find the path specified", which can be fixed by changing the folder used for the game data, moving the files if needed.
1q63bid.zh: ⟦0⟧——只要日志中存在任何错误，加载游戏时或选择国家后日志就会自动打开。载入某个国家后，也可以点击右下角的错误狗来访问日志，每当日志中出现新错误时它都会出现（因为文件会被自动加载）。如果在展开 ⟦1⟧ 后的 ⟦2⟧ 中得到的用户目录完整路径包含任何非 ASCII 字符，例如非拉丁文字或变音符号，那么日志将无法打开，并提示「The system cannot find the path specified」，可以通过更改游戏数据所用的文件夹（必要时移动文件）来解决。

12st4fy.en: Strings are marked with quotation marks (only ⟦0⟧) on both sides. A space will not interrupt the string, but a direct newline will. If there aren't any whitespace characters inside, omitting the quotation marks will not change the result (such as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧). There are two special characters allowed to use in strings: ⟦3⟧ is used to write a quotation mark and ⟦4⟧ is used to write a backslash, a backslash may not be used in any other way. It's impossible to include a newline directly inside of a string. Occassionally the attribute itself may be enclosed in quotation marks, such as ⟦5⟧. A string can include at most 255 characters, not including the null terminator.
12st4fy.zh: 字符串两侧用引号标记（只用 ⟦0⟧）。空格不会中断字符串，但直接换行会。如果内部没有任何空白字符，省略引号不会改变结果（例如 ⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧）。字符串中允许使用两个特殊字符：⟦3⟧ 用于写入引号，⟦4⟧ 用于写入反斜杠，反斜杠不得以任何其他方式使用。无法在字符串内部直接包含换行。有时属性本身也会被引号包起来，例如 ⟦5⟧。字符串最多可包含 255 个字符，不包括终止空字符。

43uqol.en: ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) – If a mod is intended to be a sub-mod to a larger mod or several, it is, in most cases, mandatory to include ⟦2⟧, which will place it higher in the load order. In this case, the name of the mod must be the exact same as in the .mod file of the mod, also showing up in the launcher. This can include special characters (e.g. ⟦3⟧ in the main mod will require ⟦4⟧ in the sub-mod with an en dash rather than a hyphen). For this reason, it's preferable to copy over the name from the .mod file of the main mod rather than manually retyping it from the launcher: some special charactes may be difficult to notice or to distinguish from other characters.
43uqol.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧）——如果某个模组打算作为更大模组或多个模组的子模组，多数情况下必须包含 ⟦2⟧，这会把它在加载顺序中排得更靠后（即更晚加载）。此时模组的名称必须与该模组 .mod 文件中的名称完全一致，启动器中显示的也是这个名称。名称中可以包含特殊字符（例如主模组中的 ⟦3⟧ 会要求子模组中使用带短破折号而不是连字符的 ⟦4⟧）。因此，最好从主模组的 .mod 文件中复制名称，而不要在启动器中手动重新输入：有些特殊字符可能难以察觉，也难以与其他字符区分。

wuz3lk.en: The ⟦0⟧, the 4-character alphanumeric code that can be seen next to the version in the main menu, such as a2b4, decides multiplayer and achievement compatibility: servers can be joined only if the checksum is identical to the host's, while achievements are only enabled if the checksum is identical to the base game's, which can be seen in the launcher. The list of what changes it can be seen in the base game's ⟦1⟧ file, which includes entire ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧ folders, as well as most of the ⟦5⟧ folder, other than ⟦6⟧. Any change to the files in that folder will change the checksum, while any mod that doesn't change them will not.
wuz3lk.zh: ⟦0⟧，即在主菜单中版本号旁边可见的 4 位字母数字代码，例如 a2b4，决定多人游戏和成就兼容性：只有当校验和与主机一致时才能加入服务器，而只有当校验和与基础游戏一致时才会启用成就，基础游戏的校验和可在启动器中查看。会改变它的内容清单可在基础游戏的 ⟦1⟧ 文件中看到，其中包含整个 ⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧ 和 ⟦4⟧ 文件夹，以及 ⟦5⟧ 文件夹的大部分内容（⟦6⟧ 除外）。对该文件夹中文件的任何改动都会改变校验和，而不改动它们的模组则不会。

1h5e3d0.en: In Windows it's possible to apply a launch option through a shortcut to the hoi4.exe or dowser.exe file in the game's directory. After creating the shortcut, right-clicking it, and going to properties, the shortcut's properties menu will open. In the "Shortcut" section of properties (opened by default), the "Target" section contains the path to the file. Launch options are inserted after the closing quote located after the filename. There must be at least one space between the quotation mark and the beginning of the launch option, and further launch options are also separated by spaces. An example "target" section is ⟦0⟧.
1h5e3d0.zh: 在 Windows 中，可以通过游戏目录里 hoi4.exe 或 dowser.exe 文件的快捷方式来应用启动选项。创建快捷方式后，右键点击它并进入属性，就会打开快捷方式的属性菜单。在属性的「Shortcut」部分（默认打开）中，「Target」部分包含文件的路径。启动选项插入在文件名之后那个右引号的后面。引号与启动选项开头之间必须至少有一个空格，后续的启动选项也用空格分隔。一个「target」部分的示例如 ⟦0⟧。

1he1qcz.en: It is common for the same attribute to intentionally be duplicated with different arguments. The handling of duplicated attributes varies and isn't intended everywhere. For example, each instance of ⟦0⟧ inside of a national focus tree is treated as a separate national focus. Usually if an effect block is duplicated (such as an event's ⟦1⟧), each one gets executed in order that they are placed. Occassionally, the name of the attribute is arbitrary. For example, in ⟦2⟧, each idea (placed inside of an idea category) the attribute's name will be treated as the name of the idea.
1he1qcz.zh: 同一个属性被故意用不同参数重复书写是很常见的。重复属性的处理方式各不相同，而且并非处处都有意如此。例如，国策树内部的每一个 ⟦0⟧ 都会被当作一个独立的国策。通常如果效果块被重复（例如某个事件的 ⟦1⟧），每一个都会按放置顺序执行。有时属性的名称是任意的。例如在 ⟦2⟧ 中，每一个理念（放置在某个理念类别内）的属性名都会被当作该理念的名称。

e4qk1m.en: For the vast majority of folders, such as ⟦0⟧ files, the ASCII character IDs are used to sort them by filename for the interpretation. This is different from the alphabetic sorting used by the file explorer as uppercase letters are considered to come before lowercase letters and there are multiple characters inbetween (such as underscores) that lie inbetween. In order to place a file particularly high in the evaluation order, a prefix using late character IDs such as ⟦1⟧ can be used and a reverse for the other way around, with the base game commonly using ⟦2⟧ for this.
e4qk1m.zh: 对于绝大多数文件夹，例如 ⟦0⟧ 文件，解释时会使用 ASCII 字符 ID 按文件名排序。这与文件资源管理器使用的字母排序不同，因为大写字母被视为排在小写字母之前，而且中间还夹着多个字符（例如下划线）。为了让某个文件在求值顺序中特别靠前，可以使用靠后的字符 ID 作为前缀，例如 ⟦1⟧；反过来则相反，基础游戏常用 ⟦2⟧ 来实现。

1b5zaj3.en: A localisation entry is structured as ⟦0⟧. In here, the first part before the colon is referred to as the localisation key, the ending part in quotes is referred to as the localisation key's value, and the number in-between is the version number. The version number is purely a comment and isn't read by the game, and it can be omitted entirely. ⟦1⟧, and it's better to use new files rather than copying over base game files. While it is theoretically possible to avoid using localisation in many cases, localisation has advantages over using strings directly:
1b5zaj3.zh: 一条本地化条目的结构为 ⟦0⟧。其中冒号之前的第一部分称为本地化键，引号中的结尾部分称为该本地化键的值，中间的数字是版本号。版本号纯粹是注释，游戏不会读取，完全可以省略。⟦1⟧，而且最好使用新文件，而不是直接复制覆盖基础游戏的文件。虽然在许多情况下理论上可以避免使用本地化，但本地化相比直接使用字符串有若干优势：

1c5sgj8.en: ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) – If, while interpreting a file, the game encounters a closing bracket that doesn't match up with any other opening bracket, the file will stop interpretation prematurely at the point of the closing bracket. This will lead to nothing else after that closing bracket being executed. This is most commonly an issue in files that do not force a root-level block, such as ⟦2⟧, as a single extra closing bracket there will usually be enough to instantly end interpretation, instead of creating unexpected token entries in ⟦3⟧ until the end of the file.
1c5sgj8.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧）——如果在解释文件时，游戏遇到一个与其他任何开括号都不匹配的闭括号，文件会在该闭括号处提前停止解释。这会导致该闭括号之后的所有内容都不被执行。这在不强制要求根级块的文件中最常见，例如 ⟦2⟧，因为那里多出的一个闭括号通常就足以立刻结束解释，而不是在 ⟦3⟧ 中直到文件末尾都生成意料之外的标记条目。

14h2opy.en: ⟦0⟧ logs what the game developers have foreseen as potential errors that may occur when modding the game. As such, it usually omits crash-causing errors, detailing potential unexpected behaviour instead. However, it can be useful for ⟦1⟧ crashes either way, since that unexpected behaviour may sometimes lead to crashes (e.g. an "⟦2⟧" error may lead to an uncontrolled state being transferred, causing a crash). ⟦3⟧, otherwise the game will fail to open.⟦4⟧ Some of the MAP_ERROR errors only appear after selecting a country and starting a playthrough.
14h2opy.zh: ⟦0⟧ 记录的是游戏开发者预见到的、在模组制作时可能出现的潜在错误。因此，它通常不包含导致崩溃的错误，而是详细记录潜在的意外行为。不过，它对 ⟦1⟧ 崩溃无论如何都有用，因为那种意外行为有时会导致崩溃（例如「⟦2⟧」错误可能导致一个不受控的州被转移，从而引发崩溃）。⟦3⟧，否则游戏将无法打开。⟦4⟧ 部分 MAP_ERROR 错误只有在选择国家并开始游玩之后才会出现。

p48xa1.en: ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) – The game keeps the mod's ⟦2⟧ file as the information for the mod in general and ⟦3⟧ as the information for the mod that gets read for the machine. While the launcher typically attempts to keep the machine-specific file up to date with the general mod information file, it sometimes fails to do so, such as for replace_paths where it succeeds at deleting unneeded entries but not at copying needed ones. In this case, both files must be edited manually for a replace_path to apply. This also may be needed for other entries in the file.
p48xa1.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧）——游戏把模组的 ⟦2⟧ 文件保留为模组总体信息，把 ⟦3⟧ 保留为供机器读取的模组信息。虽然启动器通常会尝试让机器专属文件与模组总体信息文件保持同步，但有时会失败，例如对于 replace_paths，它能成功删除不需要的条目，却无法复制需要的条目。这种情况下，必须手动编辑两个文件，replace_path 才会生效。文件中其他条目也可能需要这样处理。

14r8jou.en: ⟦0⟧ files: the order in which country tags are defined matters. While the base game places the evaluation order mostly in the order inside of the files here, it is still relevant. This decides on such things as the order in which ⟦1⟧ files are evaluated, which may result in subjects having broken popularities otherwise, the order in which events/decisions/focuses/etc are evaluated (whether it's the triggers for firing it or the AI selecting it), or the order when a scope selects several countries: both evaluated and in the tooltip.
14r8jou.zh: ⟦0⟧ 文件：国家标签的定义顺序很重要。虽然基础游戏在此处主要按文件内部的顺序安排求值顺序，但它仍然有意义。它决定的事情包括：⟦1⟧ 文件的求值顺序（否则可能导致附庸国的支持率出现异常）、事件/决议/焦点等的求值顺序（无论是触发它们的触发器还是 AI 选择它们），以及某个作用域选定多个国家时的顺序：既包括求值顺序，也包括提示框中的顺序。

p0k54e.en: Multiple language support. Even if the mod is only intended to only be within English or a different language, it is better to allow the option to be open for potential sub-mods. While it is still possible to make translation sub-mods to mods that don't use localisation, it becomes much harder to keep it up-to-date (As more than just localisation files need to be changed in this case) and changes the checksum (Making it impossible to have a multiplayer session between those that have the translation sub-mod and those that don't).
p0k54e.zh: 多语言支持。即使模组只打算使用英语或另一种语言，最好也保留这个选项，以便将来可能出现的子模组使用。虽然对不使用本地化的模组制作翻译子模组仍然可行，但要保持其同步更新会困难得多（因为这种情况下需要修改的不只是本地化文件），而且会改变校验和（导致装了翻译子模组的玩家与没装的玩家之间无法进行多人游戏）。

qh3te7.en: Aside from replace_path, there is no way to completely unload a file, though it can be overwritten if there is one with the same filename.⟦0⟧ For example, if the only file in a mod is ⟦1⟧, then it will only overwrite the base game's generic national focus tree, but other national focus trees will remain the same as they are in the base game. If another mod that only edits a different focus tree (e.g. a new ⟦2⟧), then the game will read the edit to the generic national focus tree, read ⟦3⟧, and have the rest as in the base game.
qh3te7.zh: 除了 replace_path 之外，没有办法完全卸载一个文件，不过如果有同名文件，它可以被覆盖。⟦0⟧ 例如，如果模组中唯一的文件是 ⟦1⟧，那么它只会覆盖基础游戏的通用国策树，其他国策树仍与基础游戏中一样。如果另一个模组只编辑了一棵不同的国策树（例如新增一个 ⟦2⟧），那么游戏会读取对通用国策树的修改、读取 ⟦3⟧，其余部分保持与基础游戏一致。

13bzw6p.en: If the attribute doesn't support grouping together attributes, then using the opening bracket will be interpreted as the argument itself. For example, the game would interpret ⟦0⟧ as trying to transfer the state with the ID of ⟦1⟧. Afterwards, the game encounters ⟦2⟧ which'd get interpreted as ⟦3⟧, which'd get interrupted prematurely by the closing bracket. As a result, there's one more closing bracket which doesn't have a proper opening bracket, which will likely lead to a scoping error, breaking the rest of the file.
13bzw6p.zh: 如果该属性不支持把多个属性归组在一起，那么使用开括号会被解释为参数本身。例如，游戏会把 ⟦0⟧ 解释为试图转移 ID 为 ⟦1⟧ 的州。之后游戏遇到 ⟦2⟧，它会被解释为 ⟦3⟧，并会被那个闭括号提前中断。结果就多出了一个没有对应开括号的闭括号，这很可能导致作用域错误，破坏文件其余部分。

1gkd0wq.en: In ⟦0⟧, this is in the menu triggered with the 'Toggle Search Details' button, represented with an ellipsis. This menu has separate "Files to include" and "Files to exclude" menus, used accordingly. Additionally, this allows representing folder names within the menus, with the doubled ⟦1⟧ (as in ⟦2⟧) used to represent an arbitrary folder name. For example, ⟦3⟧ in the "Files to include" and ⟦4⟧ in "Files to exclude" will search every single file with the .gfx extension with the exception of those in the dlc folder.
1gkd0wq.zh: 在 ⟦0⟧ 中，它位于由「Toggle Search Details」按钮触发的菜单里，该按钮用省略号表示。这个菜单有分开的「Files to include」和「Files to exclude」两项，分别使用。此外，它还允许在这些菜单中表示文件夹名，用双写的 ⟦1⟧（如 ⟦2⟧ 中那样）来表示任意文件夹名。例如，在「Files to include」中填 ⟦3⟧、在「Files to exclude」中填 ⟦4⟧，就会搜索所有扩展名为 .gfx 的文件，但 dlc 文件夹中的文件除外。

lmcbqq.en: For example, ⟦0⟧ will ensure that no state files from the base game or the user directory will be loaded when the game is launched with the mod. This can be used within major map overhauls to ensure that no base game contents will be read with unexpected results. Since the user directory is earlier in the load order than the mod files, this will also seemingly prevent the ⟦1⟧ from having any impact on the states, however the files will still be outputted in the folder even if immediately unloaded upon saving.
lmcbqq.zh: 例如，⟦0⟧ 可确保用该模组启动游戏时不会加载基础游戏或用户目录中的任何州文件。这可以用于大型地图改版，以确保不会读到基础游戏的内容而产生意外结果。由于用户目录在加载顺序中早于模组文件，这看起来也会阻止 ⟦1⟧ 对州产生任何影响，不过即使保存时立即被卸载，文件仍会输出到该文件夹中。

akumpk.en: ⟦0⟧ - If the map is edited, there's a possibility for errors to appear. Any map-related errors will crash the game when loading with a message saying 'Some errors are present in the map defition⟦1⟧ and have been logged to error.log'. If debug mode is on, the game will continue to load properly. The map definition occurs when there is any error containing MAP_ERROR within the error log ⟦2⟧, as certain map errors do not get logged yet when the debug launch option opens the log during the main menu loading.⟦3⟧
akumpk.zh: ⟦0⟧——如果编辑了地图，就有可能出现错误。任何与地图相关的错误都会在加载时使游戏崩溃，并提示「Some errors are present in the map defition⟦1⟧ and have been logged to error.log」。如果开启了调试模式，游戏会继续正常加载。当错误日志中出现任何包含 MAP_ERROR 的错误时，就说明存在地图定义错误 ⟦2⟧，因为在主菜单加载期间调试启动选项打开日志时，某些地图错误还没有被记录。⟦3⟧

1dvx70r.en: For the same type of attribute in a database entry, the interpretation varies. If multiple are supported, the position in code decides the order (e.g. every ⟦0⟧ in a national focus must be met for it to be possible to complete, or every ⟦1⟧ in an event will be executed when the event is fired). Otherwise, it may pick the earliest or the latest definition of the attribute, disregarding the other ones (For example, in scripted localisation, the first valid ⟦2⟧ where the trigger is met will be used).
1dvx70r.zh: 对于数据库条目中同一类型的属性，解释方式各不相同。如果支持多个，代码中的位置决定顺序（例如，国策中的每一个 ⟦0⟧ 都必须满足才能完成该焦点，或者事件中的每一个 ⟦1⟧ 都会在事件触发时执行）。否则，它可能会选取该属性最早或最晚的定义，而忽略其他定义（例如在脚本化本地化中，会使用第一个触发器得到满足的有效 ⟦2⟧）。

17ve9w4.en: Has a fan-made CWTools extension with Paradox syntax highlighting, validation and tooltips for triggers and effects. To install it, go to Extensions on the left panel of VS and search for CWTools. (Note: validation rules are incomplete and will show many false errors in gui and localization files). Recent versions with automatic highlighting of {} pairs in different colours and flagging opened/closing ones that are missing a partner red is worth it's weight in gold.
17ve9w4.zh: 有玩家制作的 CWTools 扩展，提供 Paradox 语法高亮、校验以及触发器和效果的提示框。要安装它，请打开 VS 左侧面板的 Extensions 并搜索 CWTools。（注意：校验规则并不完整，会在 gui 和本地化文件中显示大量误报错误）。较新版本能以不同颜色自动高亮成对的 {}，并把缺少配对的已打开/已闭合括号标红，其价值无可估量。

fpbzd3.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to defined the location of the mod folder. For local mods, entering ⟦1⟧ as a shortened location will automatically prepend the user directory's location after opening the launcher. Any folder can be used to store a mod, however ⟦2⟧. If the path contains non-ASCII characters, such as diacritics or non-Latin scripts, the mod will fail to be loaded. The folder separator is strictly a forward slash "/". This should only be present in the user-specific file.
fpbzd3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于定义模组文件夹的位置。对于本地模组，填入 ⟦1⟧ 作为缩写位置后，启动器打开时会自动在前面补上用户目录的位置。任何文件夹都可以用来存放模组，不过 ⟦2⟧。如果路径包含非 ASCII 字符，例如变音符号或非拉丁文字，模组将加载失败。文件夹分隔符严格使用正斜杠「/」。它只应出现在用户专属文件中。

1do0lck.en: ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) – In this case, "similar" is defined as a pair of files within the same folder that have names made up of different characters, but would be considered as having the same name with case-insensitive checking, such as ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. If the mod files contain a file that has a similar name to a base game file, the mod file will get loaded twice. Adjusting the filename to be the exact same as the base game file or entirely distinct will fix this issue. ⟦4⟧.
1do0lck.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧）——在这里，「相似」定义为同一文件夹内的一对文件，它们的名称由不同字符组成，但在不区分大小写的检查下会被视为同名，例如 ⟦2⟧ 和 ⟦3⟧。如果模组文件中存在与基础游戏文件名称相似的文件，该模组文件会被加载两次。把文件名调整为与基础游戏文件完全相同或完全不同即可解决该问题。⟦4⟧。

15d0fm.en: The user-specific descriptor file, that assigns the information used for loading the mod. In particular, the path to the folder storing the mod must be defined only here, since it can differ depending on the user. They are stored within the user directory's ⟦0⟧ folder, where the filename decides the order in which they will be loaded (unless overwritten by dependencies). The filename can't contain spaces. For example, ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ are user-specific descriptors.
15d0fm.zh: 用户专属描述文件，用于赋予加载模组所需的信息。尤其是存储模组的文件夹路径只能在这里定义，因为它可能因用户而异。它们存放在用户目录的 ⟦0⟧ 文件夹中，文件名决定它们的加载顺序（除非被依赖关系覆盖）。文件名中不能包含空格。例如 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧ 都是用户专属描述文件。

1tzlzl9.en: ⟦0⟧ provides a list of enabled mods (in the form of a list of shortened paths to the .mod files, as in ⟦1⟧) and disabled DLCs while opening the game. While this gets automatically changed by the launcher before the game's launch, this allows toggling off and on different mods without using the launcher. If there are multiple ⟦2⟧ definitions, the game will use the first-defined definition, allowing a set of playlists without using the launcher.
1tzlzl9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在打开游戏时提供已启用模组的列表（形式为 .mod 文件缩写路径的列表，如 ⟦1⟧ 中那样）以及已禁用的 DLC 列表。虽然启动器会在游戏启动前自动修改它，但它让你无需使用启动器就能开关不同的模组。如果存在多个 ⟦2⟧ 定义，游戏会使用最先定义的那个，从而无需启动器即可实现多套游玩列表。

bz3mzg.en: Most of the time, images are stored in the DDS format, typically ARGB8 (or A8R8G8B8. depending on the image editor) without mipmaps. The exact format doesn't strictly matter, however: most image files can be saved in either DDS, TGA, PNG, or BMP; as long as information in the sprite is correct. Main exceptions to this include the ⟦0⟧ that must be 32-bit TGA files without RLE encoding and bottom-left origin point, and files in the map folder.
bz3mzg.zh: 大多数情况下，图像以 DDS 格式存储，通常是不含 mipmap 的 ARGB8（视图像编辑器不同也可能是 A8R8G8B8）。不过确切格式并不严格要求：大多数图像文件都可以保存为 DDS、TGA、PNG 或 BMP，只要精灵中的信息正确即可。主要的例外包括 ⟦0⟧，它必须是 32 位 TGA 文件，不能使用 RLE 编码，且原点在左下角，另外还有 map 文件夹中的文件。

178ycro.en: The launcher can be used to create a pair of descriptors: the menu accessed via "All installed mods" -> "Upload mod" -> "Create a mod" is used for this purpose. This doesn't allow freedom in the location of the folder used as the mod folder and doesn't provide all arguments possible to include within a mod descriptor, so manually editing the descriptors in the output may be necessary to add other mod attributes or change the folder location.
178ycro.zh: 可以用启动器创建一对描述文件：通过「All installed mods」->「Upload mod」->「Create a mod」进入的菜单就是用于此目的的。它不允许自由选择用作模组文件夹的位置，也不提供模组描述文件中可以包含的全部参数，因此可能需要在输出结果中手动编辑描述文件，以添加其他模组属性或更改文件夹位置。

13ikjww.en: The order of effects and triggers matters the most: they are executed in the order that they are placed and this decides the placing of them in the tooltip shown to the player. For example, if an effect block first contains ⟦0⟧ and then ⟦1⟧ checking for the annexed country owning a state, the if statement will always be false since the country is already annexed. In triggers, the order of execution matters for temporary variables.
13ikjww.zh: 效果和触发器的顺序最重要：它们按放置顺序执行，这也决定了它们在玩家所见提示框中的排列顺序。例如，如果一个效果块先包含 ⟦0⟧，然后包含检查被吞并国家是否拥有某个州的 ⟦1⟧，那么该 if 语句将永远为假，因为该国已被吞并。在触发器中，执行顺序对临时变量有影响。

1h3wo4k.en: ⟦0⟧ - As long as the debug mode is turned on, hitting the ` button (Typically in the top left corner of QWERTY keyboards, used to open the console by default) in the main menu will provide information about the graphical interface used, giving the names of elements, their positions, and the sprites used by them. This is equivalent to using the "gui" console command, but the debug mode makes it possible to do in the main menu.
1h3wo4k.zh: ⟦0⟧——只要开启调试模式，在主菜单中按下 ` 键（通常位于 QWERTY 键盘左上角，默认用于打开控制台）就会提供所用图形界面的信息，给出元素名称、它们的位置以及它们使用的精灵。这相当于使用「gui」控制台指令，但调试模式让这一操作可以在主菜单中完成。

1vb729t.en: The script language in which the code is built always has a common structure: ⟦0⟧ (sometimes using inequality signs in case of triggers), such as ⟦1⟧, with few exceptions where the argument can be dropped. Each attribute and argument is a single word (A word character includes the ⟦2⟧ group), with whitespace characters serving as delimiters. There are two types of arguments that may include more than a single word, however:
1vb729t.zh: 构建代码所用的脚本语言始终具有共同结构：⟦0⟧（在触发器的情况下有时使用不等号），例如 ⟦1⟧，只有少数例外可以省略参数。每个属性和参数都是一个单词（单词字符包含 ⟦2⟧ 组），以空白字符作为分隔符。不过有两类参数可能包含不止一个单词：

a0mdkx.en: In case of files with the same name in the same location, the load order decides which one gets used. For example, if a mod and the base game edit ⟦0⟧, the game will read the mod's version. This applies only to individual files and not entire folders. It is never possible for several files with the same name in the same location to each get loaded: it will only pick the later-loaded one and disregard the older ones.
a0mdkx.zh: 对于同一位置同名文件的情况，加载顺序决定使用哪一个。例如，如果某个模组和基础游戏都编辑了 ⟦0⟧，游戏会读取模组的版本。这只适用于单个文件，不适用于整个文件夹。同一位置多个同名文件不可能都被加载：游戏只会选取较晚加载的那个，而忽略较早的那些。

3dlqev.en: In certain types of attributes, figure brackets are used to attach an entire block of code as the argument, which usually consists of other code in the same ⟦0⟧ format. As an example, ⟦1⟧ (as an ⟦2⟧) is an attribute of ⟦3⟧ with the argument of ⟦4⟧; that argument itself consists of an attribute of ⟦5⟧ with an argument of ⟦6⟧. In particular, this will scope into a random existing country and add 10% Stability.
3dlqev.zh: 在某些类型的属性中，使用花括号把整块代码作为参数附加进去，该参数通常由具有相同 ⟦0⟧ 格式的其他代码组成。举例来说，⟦1⟧（作为 ⟦2⟧）是 ⟦3⟧ 的一个属性，其参数为 ⟦4⟧；该参数本身又由 ⟦5⟧ 的一个属性组成，其参数为 ⟦6⟧。具体而言，这会进入一个随机存在的国家的作用域，并增加 10% 稳定度。

enwuu2.en: ⟦0⟧ effectively by enabling ⟦1⟧. Do this by adding ⟦2⟧ to your launch options in Steam. The launch options are accessed in the menu opened by right-clicking the game and choosing 'Properties..'. Alternatively, in Windows it's possible to create a shortcut to the hoi4.exe or dowser.exe file, and then to open the shortcut's properties and append -debug (separated by a space) after the path's end, such as ⟦3⟧.
enwuu2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 通过启用 ⟦1⟧ 即可有效实现。方法是在 Steam 的启动选项中添加 ⟦2⟧。启动选项可以在右键点击游戏并选择「Properties..」打开的菜单中找到。另外，在 Windows 中也可以创建 hoi4.exe 或 dowser.exe 文件的快捷方式，然后打开快捷方式的属性，在路径末尾之后追加 -debug（用空格分隔），例如 ⟦3⟧。

1oybklp.en: The two descriptors are intended to have mostly identical information, aside from the fact that only the user-specific file should have a ⟦0⟧ entry within its definition, since this isn't shared across different users and can vary significantly. The launcher enforces this for arguments that can be defined in the launcher, however other arguments such as ⟦1⟧ will not get automatically ported over.
1oybklp.zh: 这两个描述文件本应包含大体相同的信息，只是只有用户专属文件才应在其定义中包含 ⟦0⟧ 条目，因为它不在不同用户之间共享，且可能有很大差异。对于可以在启动器中定义的参数，启动器会强制这一点，但诸如 ⟦1⟧ 之类的其他参数不会被自动迁移过去。

1kfpmjg.en: ⟦0⟧ - With debug mode turned on, there will be additional information when hovering over the province, including its and the state it's in's IDs, tags of owner and controller, et cetera. This debug information is also given for entire countries when hovering over their flag in the country politics/diplomacy view, such as the tag, the original tag (for dynamic countries), and the cosmetic tag.
1kfpmjg.zh: ⟦0⟧——开启调试模式后，将鼠标悬停在省份上会显示额外信息，包括该省份及其所属州的 ID、所有者与控制者的标签等等。在国家政治/外交视图中将鼠标悬停在其旗帜上时，也会为整个国家显示这类调试信息，例如标签、原始标签（用于动态国家）以及外观标签。

1uf7gpv.en: ⟦0⟧ is the filename of the picture that's assigned to the mod. This will appear in the launcher for mods of the Steam and Paradox nature, and also as the thumbnail in Steam Workshop and Paradox Mods. The image must be contained within the root directory of the mod (defined via ⟦1⟧) and must be less than 1MB in size. This must be defined after the name of the mod. ⟦2⟧ even with this defined.
1uf7gpv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是指派给该模组的图片文件名。它会为 Steam 和 Paradox 类型的模组显示在启动器中，也会作为 Steam 创意工坊和 Paradox Mods 中的缩略图。该图像必须位于模组的根目录内（通过 ⟦1⟧ 定义），且大小必须小于 1MB。它必须定义在模组名称之后。即使定义了它也 ⟦2⟧。

1obio54.en: ⟦0⟧ - With debug mode turned on, an option to open the nudge will appear in the main menu. This can be useful to save time or to be able to open the nudge if the game crashes when you're trying to load into a country (This can happen if the ⟦1⟧ file references invalid states, if that file doesn't contain at least one ⟦2⟧ even if not containing anything, if ⟦3⟧, or for other reasons).
1obio54.zh: ⟦0⟧——开启调试模式后，主菜单中会出现打开微调器（nudge）的选项。这有助于节省时间，或者在尝试载入某个国家时游戏崩溃的情况下仍能打开微调器（如果 ⟦1⟧ 文件引用了无效的州、如果该文件即使不含任何内容也没有至少一个 ⟦2⟧、如果 ⟦3⟧，或者由于其他原因，都可能发生这种情况）。

e4ooql.en: A sprite is replaced with the default image: This is an indication that there is something wrong with the sprite itself rather than the image: the game links to a non-existing sprite somewhere. This is typically a typo within the sprite's name or a failure to follow a name format (Such as omitting _shine from the end of a ⟦0⟧). Ensure that the sprite exists and has the right name.⟦1⟧
e4ooql.zh: 精灵被替换为默认图像：这表明问题出在精灵本身而不是图像上：游戏在某处链接到了不存在的精灵。这通常是精灵名称中有拼写错误，或者没有遵循命名格式（例如在 ⟦0⟧ 末尾漏掉了 _shine）。请确保该精灵存在且名称正确。⟦1⟧

bkuk7a.en: ⟦0⟧ changes the ⟦1⟧, in particular forcing this mod to be loaded after every mod listed in this attribute. This doesn't make this mod require the listed mods to work. Changing the load order will ensure that any ⟦2⟧ within the dependency mod will leave this mod's files untouched and that this mod's files will overwrite the dependency mod's files in case of overlapping filenames. ⟦3⟧.
bkuk7a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 会改变 ⟦1⟧，尤其是强制该模组在该属性中列出的每一个模组之后加载。这并不会让该模组依赖于所列模组才能运行。改变加载顺序可确保依赖模组中的任何 ⟦2⟧ 都不会触动该模组的文件，并且在文件名重叠时该模组的文件会覆盖依赖模组的文件。⟦3⟧。

1qgy02x.en: Bracket and syntax highlighting. Bracket highlighting makes it easier to detect any missing or unnecessary files by allowing to select a bracket and see where it opens or closes, as to know what's inside of that block. Syntax highlighting can make code more easily readable by highlighting more important parts, as well as excluding brackets within comments from being considered such.
1qgy02x.zh: 括号与语法高亮。括号高亮让你可以选中一个括号并查看它在哪里打开或闭合，从而知道该块内包含什么，更容易发现缺失或多出的文件。语法高亮通过突出显示更重要的部分让代码更易读，同时还能把注释内部的括号排除在外、不被当作括号处理。

1c17fpx.en: Sprites are defined within the ⟦0⟧ block and have different definitions, such as a simple ⟦1⟧, a ⟦2⟧ that can be used with an arbitrary size, stretching to fit taking corners into consideration, a ⟦3⟧ that allows creating an animation sequence rather than being limited to scripted ones that can be done in ⟦4⟧s, and so on. A simplest possible sprite file consists of the following:
1c17fpx.zh: 精灵定义在 ⟦0⟧ 块中，并有多种不同的定义，例如简单的 ⟦1⟧、可用于任意尺寸并在拉伸时考虑四角的 ⟦2⟧、一个 ⟦3⟧，它允许创建动画序列，而不局限于只能在 ⟦4⟧ 中完成的脚本化动画，等等。最简单的精灵文件由以下内容组成：

1szp6er.en: ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) – This commonly happens when subscribing to one's own mod on Steam Workshop. If there are two mods with the same name that may be selected from the launcher, only the one that is loaded earlier will have its files detected; the other mod will appear as changing nothing in-game. This is corrected by changing the ⟦2⟧ attribute in the descriptors of either one of the mods.
1szp6er.zh: ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧）——这通常发生在 Steam 创意工坊中订阅自己的模组时。如果有两个同名模组可以在启动器中被选中，只有较早加载的那个其文件会被检测到；另一个模组在游戏中看起来什么也没改变。通过修改其中任一模组描述文件中的 ⟦2⟧ 属性即可修正。

s26s1y.en: ⟦0⟧: This folder primary decides on starting historical information: which states are owned by which countries, the starting political and diplomatic situations, the army positions, starting buildings, and so on. Typically, if something happens before any country gets selected, it's decided here. However, starting railways and supply nodes are instead defined in the ⟦1⟧ folder.
s26s1y.zh: ⟦0⟧：该文件夹主要决定起始的历史信息：哪些州由哪些国家拥有、起始的政治与外交局势、军队位置、起始建筑等等。通常，任何在国家被选中之前发生的事情都由这里决定。不过，起始铁路和补给节点反而定义在 ⟦1⟧ 文件夹中。

15rvym2.en: ⟦0⟧: This folder is used to store images. However, most of the time, ⟦1⟧. Commonly-edited exceptions include ⟦2⟧ where every single file is always loaded, ⟦3⟧ and subfolders where the country tries to load the flag upon ideology or cosmetic tag change, and ⟦4⟧ files that assign sprites to the pools of images shown in the equipment designer. Everything else requires a sprite.
15rvym2.zh: ⟦0⟧：该文件夹用于存放图像。不过大多数情况下 ⟦1⟧。经常被编辑的例外包括 ⟦2⟧（其中每一个文件都会被加载）、⟦3⟧ 及其子文件夹（国家在意识形态或外观标签改变时会尝试加载旗帜），以及 ⟦4⟧ 文件（为装备设计器中显示的图像池指派精灵）。其他所有内容都需要精灵。

1ryd7x0.en: DLCs, in the order of their internal ID (follows release date). For example, if the base game, DLC018, and DLC20 each contain ⟦0⟧, the game will only read the version in DLC020 and ignore the rest. Due to checksum constraints, DLC folders usually only contain graphics and audio related to the DLC, while the code is always kept in the base game itself, locked behind a ⟦1⟧.
1ryd7x0.zh: DLC，按其内部 ID 的顺序（与发行日期一致）。例如，如果基础游戏、DLC018 和 DLC20 都包含 ⟦0⟧，游戏只会读取 DLC020 中的版本，忽略其余版本。由于校验和的限制，DLC 文件夹通常只包含与该 DLC 相关的图形和音频，而代码始终保留在基础游戏本体中，被 ⟦1⟧ 锁定。

5k68lz.en: The Steam properties of the game include launch options. Right-clicking on the game's entry in the list of owned games provides a menu. In the bottom of the menu is "Properties...", which'll show a separate window. In the bottom of the "General" section (opened by default) are launch options. Each launch option is entered separated with spaces, such as ⟦0⟧
5k68lz.zh: 游戏的 Steam 属性中包含启动选项。在已拥有游戏列表中右键点击该游戏条目会弹出一个菜单。菜单底部是「Properties...」，点击后会显示一个单独的窗口。「General」部分（默认打开）的底部就是启动选项。每个启动选项之间用空格分隔输入，例如 ⟦0⟧

fdty28.en: Non-ASCII characters, such as umlauts and other diacritics are unsupported by strings in multiple files, such as country leader traits or adjacency rules. Non-ASCII support is usually marked by the file having the byte order mark (usually noted as a separate encoding with UTF-8-BOM), which causes the game to fail to load the file if not directly supported.
fdty28.zh: 非 ASCII 字符，例如元音变音和其他变音符号，在多个文件中不被字符串支持，例如国家领袖特质或相邻规则。非 ASCII 支持通常以文件带有字节顺序标记（通常记为一种单独的编码 UTF-8-BOM）为标志，如果文件并非直接支持却带有该标记，会导致游戏加载该文件失败。

satabr.en: A sprite is entirely transparent: This is an indication that the sprite exists, but the image within can't be loaded. This occurs if the ⟦0⟧ is defined to a file that doesn't exist (The folder path or the filename may not correspond with the file itself) or if the image itself is corrupted. This is usually accompanied with a ⟦1⟧ error.
satabr.zh: 精灵完全透明：这表明精灵存在，但其中的图像无法被加载。当 ⟦0⟧ 被定义到一个不存在的文件（文件夹路径或文件名可能与文件本身不对应），或者图像本身已损坏时，就会出现这种情况。这通常会伴随一个 ⟦1⟧ 错误。

zpyrcm.en: Doing mass replacements in multiple files at the same time, usually used together with regular expression. This can be used to automate monotonous tasks, such as adding a log to every event, or most simply to change the owner in multiple states (such as by ⟦0⟧ the previous owner and inserting another one by replacing ⟦1⟧ with ⟦2⟧).
zpyrcm.zh: 同时跨多个文件进行批量替换，通常与正则表达式一起使用。它可以用来自动完成单调重复的任务，例如为每个事件添加一条日志，或者最简单的——修改多个州的拥有者（例如通过 ⟦0⟧ 原拥有者，并把 ⟦1⟧ 替换为 ⟦2⟧ 来插入另一个拥有者）。

rmk4tk.en: The mod-specific descriptor file, that assigns the information that the mod has that should be shared regardless of the user. This file must be called ⟦0⟧ and is located within the primary folder of the path, i.e. the folder specified in the path within the file above. For example, ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ are mod-specific descriptors.
rmk4tk.zh: 模组专属描述文件，用于赋予该模组所拥有的、无论用户是谁都应共享的信息。该文件必须命名为 ⟦0⟧，并位于路径所指向的主文件夹内，也就是上面文件中 path 所指定的那个文件夹。例如 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧ 都是模组专属描述文件。

kih1gs.en: ⟦0⟧. In particular, the game will be unable to open error.log (but will change it regardless) or mods stored there. To circumvent this, either just mods may be moved to a different folder by modifying the ⟦1⟧ in the ⟦2⟧ or it's possible to move the entire user directory by editing ⟦3⟧ and moving the files accordingly.
kih1gs.zh: ⟦0⟧。尤其是游戏将无法打开 error.log（但仍会修改它）或存放在那里的模组。要绕开这一点，可以只把模组移到别的文件夹，方法是在 ⟦1⟧ 中修改 ⟦2⟧；也可以把整个用户目录移走，方法是编辑 ⟦3⟧ 并相应移动文件。

1usd4yb.en: Finding out where the database entry of a certain type is defined where it is not immediately intuitive. For example, by searching for an equipment ID within the folder that stores equipment (or even ⟦0⟧ in general) can be used to find the exact file, which isn't immediately obvious for some equipment types.
1usd4yb.zh: 当某种类型的数据库条目定义在哪里并不直观时找出它的位置。例如，在存放装备的文件夹中搜索某个装备 ID（或者一般来说搜索 ⟦0⟧），可以用来找到确切文件，而这对某些装备类型来说并不那么显而易见。

12saf0v.en: The user-specific mod descriptors are located inside of the ⟦0⟧ folder. This is used for assigning the mod information, such as the path to the folder that contains the mod. The same folder contains the default location of local mods after being created in the launcher, though any folder can be used for it.
12saf0v.zh: 用户专属模组描述文件位于 ⟦0⟧ 文件夹内。它用于赋予模组信息，例如包含模组的文件夹路径。同一个文件夹也包含本地模组在启动器中创建后的默认位置，不过也可以使用任何文件夹。

awfjo0.en: ⟦0⟧ - Certain errors do not get logged in the log unless the debug mode is turned on. An example would be the map definition errors mentioned above, as the game crashes before getting a chance to log them. Enabling debug mode will ensure that all errors that can be logged in the error log will get logged.
awfjo0.zh: ⟦0⟧——某些错误除非开启调试模式，否则不会被记录到日志中。一个例子就是上面提到的地图定义错误，因为游戏在有机会记录它们之前就崩溃了。启用调试模式可确保所有能记录到错误日志中的错误都会被记录下来。

1ltax14.en: ⟦0⟧ by adding separate files and loading from folders whenever possible, to improve mod compatibility and maintenance. (Your files can have any name, all files in the folder will be loaded by the game. So choose a name, no one else will ever use, like the name of your mod. Ex: coolmod_countries)
1ltax14.zh: 通过添加单独的文件并尽可能从文件夹加载来实现 ⟦0⟧，以提高模组兼容性和可维护性。（你的文件可以取任何名称，文件夹中的所有文件都会被游戏加载。所以要选一个别人绝不会用的名字，比如你的模组名。例如：coolmod_countries）

1jjm2iv.en: The user directory is used for storing the information related to Hearts of Iron IV that's not built into the game, but instead created by the user. The location is decided by ⟦0⟧ in the base game's ⟦1⟧. By default, the user directory for Hearts of Iron IV is located in the following folders:
1jjm2iv.zh: 用户目录用于存放与《钢铁雄心 IV》相关、并非内置于游戏中而是由用户创建的信息。位置由 ⟦0⟧ 在基础游戏的 ⟦1⟧ 中决定。默认情况下，《钢铁雄心 IV》的用户目录位于以下文件夹中：

rmd6fd.en: Notepad++. Choose Perl as your language, as it will provide good highlighting and allow to fold blocks of code and comments. To set it as default, go to Settings, Style Configurator, find Perl in the list on the left and add "gui txt" (without quotes) to the "User ext." field at the bottom.
rmd6fd.zh: Notepad++。把语言选为 Perl，因为它能提供良好的高亮效果并允许折叠代码块和注释。要将其设为默认，请打开 Settings、Style Configurator，在左侧列表中找到 Perl，并在底部的「User ext.」字段中添加「gui txt」（不含引号）。

1yhis6o.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to determine for which version of the game the mod is meant for, granting the 'out of date' marker in the launcher otherwise. The last number of the version can be replaced with an asterisk, which will signify that the mod will work on any minor update within that major update.
1yhis6o.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于确定该模组面向哪个游戏版本，否则会在启动器中显示「out of date」标记。版本号的最后一位数字可以替换为星号，表示该模组可在该大版本内的任何小更新上工作。

1x7i0dh.en: If the 'debug' console command is used, ⟦0⟧ will be available to use. If debug is turned on via ⟦1⟧, be that ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ (doesn't enable automatic loading), all benefits will be granted. However, multiplayer will be disabled and the game's performance will drop compared to not enabling it.
1x7i0dh.zh: 如果使用了「debug」控制台指令，就可以使用 ⟦0⟧。如果通过 ⟦1⟧ 开启调试，无论是 ⟦2⟧ 还是 ⟦3⟧（不会启用自动加载），所有好处都会获得。不过多人游戏将被禁用，并且与不开启相比游戏性能会下降。

12honss.en: In case the launcher shows that the mod has an invalid path even after correcting the issue, make sure that the user-specific mod descriptor file directly within the user directory's ⟦0⟧ exists and try forcing an update of mod information by deleting the ⟦1⟧, located at either ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧.
12honss.zh: 如果启动器在问题修正之后仍显示该模组路径无效，请确认用户目录 ⟦0⟧ 中直接包含用户专属模组描述文件，并尝试通过删除 ⟦1⟧（位于 ⟦2⟧ 或 ⟦3⟧）来强制更新模组信息。

14zdo8o.en: This order of creation may matter in other references. For example, in ⟦0⟧, an equipment type must be assigned an existing archetype. If the archetype doesn't exist when the equipment type is created, the game will crash to desktop, even if there is a definition later in the file.
14zdo8o.zh: 这种创建顺序在其他引用中也可能有意义。例如在 ⟦0⟧ 中，装备类型必须被指派一个已存在的原型。如果在装备类型创建时该原型尚不存在，游戏会直接崩溃到桌面，即使文件后面有该原型定义也一样。

18k57eh.en: ⟦0⟧, if using Windows. File extensions are considered a part of the filename, and hiding them can cause files to not work due to wrong filenames (Such as accidentally saving localisation files as .txt files, saving an image in the wrong format and not realising it, et cetera).
18k57eh.zh: 如果使用 Windows，请 ⟦0⟧。文件扩展名被视为文件名的一部分，隐藏它们可能导致文件因文件名错误而无法工作（例如不小心把本地化文件保存为 .txt 文件、以错误格式保存图像却没有察觉等等）。

1b023wx.en: ⟦0⟧: This folder is used to edit the appearance of the map, such as provinces, the shown terrain, the heightmap, and so on. This also includes the strategic regions and starting supply nodes and railways. However, the boundaries of states are instead defined in the ⟦1⟧ folder.
1b023wx.zh: ⟦0⟧：该文件夹用于编辑地图的外观，例如省份、显示的地形、高度图等等。它还包括战略区域以及起始的补给节点和铁路。不过，州的边界反而定义在 ⟦1⟧ 文件夹中。

qk67qg.en: Where applicable, ⟦0⟧, with the order inside of the files being secondary. As the ASCII order is used for this, the filename beginning with ⟦1⟧ is usually used to ensure that it's to be evaluated near the beginning, while beginning with ⟦2⟧ is used in the opposite manner.
qk67qg.zh: 在适用的情况下使用 ⟦0⟧，文件内部的顺序则是次要的。由于这里使用 ASCII 顺序，以 ⟦1⟧ 开头的文件名通常用于确保它被安排在接近开头处求值，而以 ⟦2⟧ 开头则用于相反的情形。

1a7t0i6.en: Large English-speaking modding communities include the HOI4 Modding Coop and the HOI4 Modding Den, which can be joined on Discord. It's useful to join one or multiple of them, as they contain links to modding resources and you can ask questions regarding modding in them.
1a7t0i6.zh: 大型英语模组制作社区包括 HOI4 Modding Coop 和 HOI4 Modding Den，可以在 Discord 上加入。加入其中一个或多个社区很有用，因为其中有模组制作资源的链接，你也可以在其中提问关于模组制作的问题。

1274o32.en: Mods are stored within the ⟦0⟧ folder within the ⟦1⟧. Alongside mods, the game will load any files stored in the user directory. The game's internal map editor, the Nudger, stores its output within that folder. ⟦2⟧, such as letters with diacritics or non-Latin script.
1274o32.zh: 模组存放在 ⟦0⟧ 文件夹中，该文件夹位于 ⟦1⟧ 内。除了模组之外，游戏还会加载存放在用户目录中的任何文件。游戏内置的地图编辑器微调器（Nudger）会把其输出存放在该文件夹中。⟦2⟧，例如带变音符号的字母或非拉丁文字。

1odzo89.en: The game will read any ⟦0⟧ within the ⟦1⟧ folder, and a local mod can be created via the launcher: "All installed mods" -> "Upload mod" -> "Create a mod". This is limited in the path and allowed mod structure options, so manually editing the output may be necessary.
1odzo89.zh: 游戏会读取 ⟦0⟧，也就是 ⟦1⟧ 文件夹中的任何内容，并且可以通过启动器创建本地模组：「All installed mods」->「Upload mod」->「Create a mod」。它在路径和允许的模组结构选项上有限制，因此可能需要手动编辑输出结果。

htyhdu.en: Each line is numbered on its side. Since error log typically points to the line where an error is present, this makes finding the line in question much faster compared to how the Microsoft Notepad only tells the number of the currently-selected line in the below.
htyhdu.zh: 每一行都在侧面标有行号。由于错误日志通常会指出出错所在的行，这使得定位问题行比 Microsoft Notepad 只能在下方显示当前选中行的行号要快得多。

1t4fipz.en: ⟦0⟧. For example, it is always mandatory where effects or ⟦1⟧ are expected, making this incorrect: ⟦2⟧. Instead, where there is no expected argument, ⟦3⟧ is commonly used as ⟦4⟧. There are few exceptions where an argument should be omitted, such as inside of ⟦5⟧.
1t4fipz.zh: ⟦0⟧。例如，在期望效果或 ⟦1⟧ 的地方它始终是必需的，因此这样写是错误的：⟦2⟧。相反，在不期望参数的地方，通常用 ⟦3⟧ 作为 ⟦4⟧。只有少数例外应当省略参数，例如在 ⟦5⟧ 内部。

1u9800h.en: Opens an entire folder within the editor as to be able to open files within more easily, without changing to the file explorer, as well as simplifying using the 'Find in files...' command to check every file within a folder without opening each one individually.
1u9800h.zh: 在编辑器中打开整个文件夹，以便更轻松地打开其中的文件而无需切换到文件资源管理器，同时也简化了「Find in files...」指令的使用，让你无需逐个打开文件就能检查文件夹内的每一个文件。

1wa6b52.en: Generally, there is no reason to subscribe to your own mod in the Steam Workshop: it will almost never function any differently from the local mod and this may also occassionally break updating the mod due to duplicate ⟦0⟧ attributes in different mods.
1wa6b52.zh: 一般来说，没有理由在 Steam 创意工坊订阅自己的模组：它的行为几乎永远不会与本地模组有任何不同，而且还可能因为不同模组中出现重复的 ⟦0⟧ 属性而偶尔破坏模组更新。

10cqs6y.en: ⟦0⟧ changes the folder where the game stores saves. This prevents loading a save made in base game and mods with a different ⟦1⟧ entry and, vise-versa, prevents saves made in this mod to be loaded in the base game or mods with a different ⟦2⟧ entry.
10cqs6y.zh: ⟦0⟧ 会更改游戏存放存档的文件夹。这会阻止加载使用基础游戏以及具有不同 ⟦1⟧ 条目的模组所创建的存档；反过来，也会阻止在该模组中创建的存档被基础游戏或具有不同 ⟦2⟧ 条目的模组加载。

6atejv.en: ⟦0⟧ details the system-generated information, usually to do with graphics. With the ⟦1⟧ launch option, it also generates an output for the checksum, which may be compared with a different user's checksum to find out where exactly the difference is.
6atejv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 详细记录了系统生成的信息，通常与图形有关。使用 ⟦1⟧ 启动选项时，它还会生成校验和的输出，可以与其他用户的校验和进行比较，从而找出差异究竟在哪里。

1dtv1ng.en: In ⟦0⟧, this is done with the 'filter' menu. Filters are separated with spaces, and an exclamation point in the beginning marks it as an exclude filter. For example, ⟦1⟧ will result in searching every localisation file aside from the French ones.
1dtv1ng.zh: 在 ⟦0⟧ 中，这是通过「filter」菜单完成的。多个过滤器用空格分隔，开头加感叹号表示它是排除过滤器。例如，⟦1⟧ 会搜索除法语文件之外的每一个本地化文件。

p55ni9.en: The Modding Git Guide is a community made guide for using Git, GitHub/GitLab, and related tools such as KDiff3. It can be a useful stop for questions beyond this wiki, and contains step by step guides for much of what is talked about here.
p55ni9.zh: 《Modding Git Guide》是一份社区制作的指南，介绍如何使用 Git、GitHub/GitLab 以及 KDiff3 等相关工具。对于本 wiki 之外的问题，它可能是个有用的去处，并且为这里谈到的许多内容提供了分步指南。

1wpkfij.en: The order of different attributes of the same entry doesn't change the interpretation. For example, if a national focus' reward is defined before its position instead of the opposite as normally done, it won't be treated any differently.
1wpkfij.zh: 同一入口不同属性之间的顺序不会改变解释结果。例如，如果某个国策的奖励被定义在其位置之前，而不是通常的反过来，也不会被区别对待。

e19wug.en: This assigns the ⟦0⟧ file to have the ⟦1⟧ sprite in-game. This sprite can then be used in the graphical user interface, such as a decision or a focus icon (⟦2⟧). The only images that do not have any definition within interface files are:
e19wug.zh: 这会把 ⟦0⟧ 文件指派为在游戏中使用 ⟦1⟧ 精灵。该精灵随后可用于图形用户界面，例如决议或焦点图标（⟦2⟧）。唯一在界面文件中没有任何定义的图像是：

1jw8j3y.en: The game's screenshots are stored in ⟦0⟧. This includes both the regular ⟦1⟧ screenshots and the map generated with ⟦2⟧, which is a pixel-perfect representation of the entire world map taking the province borders from ⟦3⟧.
1jw8j3y.zh: 游戏的截图存放在 ⟦0⟧ 中。这既包括普通的 ⟦1⟧ 截图，也包括用 ⟦2⟧ 生成的地图，后者是整个世界地图的像素级精确呈现，采用 ⟦3⟧ 中的省份边界。

1igi8dn.en: ⟦0⟧ are used in circumstances such as focus and decision availability checks, event triggers, or ⟦1⟧. They return a strictly boolean value of either true or false, without actually changing anything in the game's state.
1igi8dn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于焦点和决议可用性检查、事件触发器或 ⟦1⟧ 等场合。它们返回严格的布尔值 true 或 false，而不会实际改变游戏状态的任何内容。

14j2n4s.en: Unnecessarily removing an indentation level. This can usually be detected by detecting any interruptions in the indent guide–generated line from the line with the opening opening bracket drawn to the closing bracket:
14j2n4s.zh: 不必要地减少了一层缩进。这通常可以通过缩进参考线——从含开括号的那一行画向闭括号的线——出现中断来发现：

nw564k.en: Due to DLCs being their own source of loaded files, the ⟦0⟧ folder and its subfolders will have no effect. Instead, the file has to follow the actual load location: e.g. to edit ⟦1⟧, the mod will have to contain ⟦2⟧.
nw564k.zh: 由于 DLC 是各自独立的已加载文件来源，⟦0⟧ 文件夹及其子文件夹不会产生任何效果。文件必须遵循实际的加载位置：例如要编辑 ⟦1⟧，模组中就必须包含 ⟦2⟧。

1a225so.en: A variety of items within gfx such as ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. This does not include ⟦2⟧ (every file within there is loaded regardless of filename) or most font/image files (as they're loaded by a link within a different file).
1a225so.zh: gfx 中的多种项目，例如 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧。这不包括 ⟦2⟧（其中的每个文件无论文件名如何都会被加载）以及大多数字体/图像文件（它们通过另一个文件中的链接加载）。

fxqu9s.en: Effects are used in circumstances such as focus completion rewards, event options, decision effects, ⟦0⟧, country history files, and so on. They are used in order to enact a one-time change to the game's state.
fxqu9s.zh: 效果用于焦点完成奖励、事件选项、决议效果、⟦0⟧、国家历史文件等场合。它们用于对游戏状态实施一次性的改变。

14rs66e.en: ⟦0⟧, or creating ⟦1⟧, is the act of modifying the behavior of the base game (often referred to as ⟦2⟧), either for personal use, or to release publicly for other players, for instance - via the Steam Workshop.
14rs66e.zh: ⟦0⟧，或创建 ⟦1⟧，是指修改基础游戏（常被称为 ⟦2⟧）行为的行为，既可用于个人用途，也可公开发布给其他玩家，例如通过 Steam 创意工坊。

za1771.en: As for all Paradox games, ⟦0⟧ is moddable to a great extent. Motivations of modders may vary widely: a better translation to their native language, more events or decisions, better maps, a major overhaul, etc.
za1771.zh: 与所有 Paradox 游戏一样，⟦0⟧ 具有很大程度的可模组性。模组制作者的动机可能千差万别：更好的母语翻译、更多事件或决议、更好的地图、大型改版等等。

1opbm29.en: The character uses a randomly-generated portrait: This is an indication of either of the previous two problems: a character with an invalid sprite or a missing file will have their portrait randomised.
1opbm29.zh: 角色使用随机生成的立绘：这表明出现了上述两个问题之一：立绘精灵无效或文件缺失的角色，其立绘会被随机化。

5xrtes.en: ⟦0⟧ starting with # character, to remember reasons for writing tricky stuff. A single sharp sign will make the rest of the line completely ignored. There is no multi-line comment notation in the code.
5xrtes.zh: 以 # 字符开头的 ⟦0⟧，用于记下书写棘手内容的原因。单个井号会让该行其余部分被完全忽略。代码中没有多行注释写法。

98ge0b.en: The .mod file extension doesn't show up in the Windows File Explorer by default, which can make finding the files mentioned here more difficult. Ensure that file extensions are set to show up.
98ge0b.zh: Windows 文件资源管理器默认不显示 .mod 文件扩展名，这会让查找这里提到的文件更加困难。请确保已设置为显示文件扩展名。

qav321.en: ⟦0⟧. They ⟦1⟧ use a sprite as a definition, but they're the only place in the game which doesn't have it as a mandatory requirement, accepting direct links to the file as an alternative.
qav321.zh: ⟦0⟧。它们 ⟦1⟧ 使用精灵作为定义，但它们是游戏中唯一不把这一点作为强制要求的地方，允许改为直接链接到文件。

1fmd49d.en: If a line introduces an unclosed opening bracket, then everything until the proper closing bracket must be one indent level to the right compared to the line with the opening bracket.
1fmd49d.zh: 如果某一行引入了一个未闭合的开括号，那么直到相应闭括号之前的所有内容，都必须比含开括号的那一行多一个缩进层级。

tmmiy9.en: In this case, the focus' icon attribute is set with ⟦0⟧, and next the game has no idea how to interpret ⟦1⟧. In practice, this'll lead to the focus not being at the expected position.
tmmiy9.zh: 在这种情况下，焦点的图标属性被设为 ⟦0⟧，接下来游戏完全不知道该如何解释 ⟦1⟧。实际上，这会导致该焦点不出现在预期的位置。

z835hp.en: ⟦0⟧ are a particular subset of triggers and effects that can be used to change for which country/state/character/division the effects are executed or triggers are checked for.
z835hp.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是触发器和效果中的一个特殊子集，可用于改变效果为哪个国家/州/角色/师执行，或为哪个对象检查触发器。

ld4jv9.en: ⟦0⟧ is the name of the mod, as it appears in the launcher. This also gets used within the ⟦1⟧ attribute of mods. The name must be unique in comparison to other installed mods.
ld4jv9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是模组的名称，即在启动器中显示的名称。它也会被用在模组的 ⟦1⟧ 属性中。该名称相对于其他已安装的模组必须是唯一的。

1dt0o7x.en: ⟦0⟧ - Certain console commands are locked for developers only and debug mode allows the player to use them. However, note that not all console commands will become available.
1dt0o7x.zh: ⟦0⟧——某些控制台指令仅限开发者使用，而调试模式允许玩家使用它们。不过要注意，并非所有控制台指令都会变为可用。

1kjyu89.en: Mods, ordered by using ⟦0⟧. For example, if mods with descriptors of ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ both overwrite ⟦3⟧, only the version in the mod with the descriptor of ⟦4⟧ will be read.
1kjyu89.zh: 模组，使用 ⟦0⟧ 排序。例如，如果描述文件为 ⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧ 的两个模组都覆盖了 ⟦3⟧，那么只有描述文件为 ⟦4⟧ 的那个模组中的版本会被读取。

1m1e8n1.en: Finding out an internal ID by searching the localisation folder for the localised name. For example, searching for an event's title can be used to determine the ID.
1m1e8n1.zh: 通过在本地化文件夹中搜索本地化名称来找出内部 ID。例如，搜索某个事件的标题就可以用来确定它的 ID。

w7446b.en: If a line includes a closing bracket without including an opening bracket, then it shouldn't have anything other than the closing bracket and indentation before it.
w7446b.zh: 如果某一行包含闭括号却不包含开括号，那么它之前除了缩进不应该有任何其他内容。

s5sit2.en: It's easy to find what falls within a block by following the indent guide's line from the line with the open bracket to the point where it hits the closing bracket.
s5sit2.zh: 沿着缩进参考线从含开括号的那一行追踪到它触及闭括号的位置，就能轻松看出一个块内包含哪些内容。

1o7cyzw.en: ⟦0⟧: This folder is used to define sounds that play elsewhere, usually tied to an element of the GUI. This also includes such entries as the division voicelines.
1o7cyzw.zh: ⟦0⟧：该文件夹用于定义在其他地方播放的声音，通常与 GUI 的某个元素绑定。它还包括诸如师语音台词之类的条目。

bqc3px.en: The logs are located in the ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧ folder and may be used for ⟦2⟧ the game. In particular, these are especially useful when dealing with unexpected behaviour:
bqc3px.zh: 日志位于 ⟦0⟧ 的 ⟦1⟧ 文件夹中，可用于 ⟦2⟧ 游戏。尤其是在处理意外行为时，它们特别有用：

6chxs1.en: ⟦0⟧: use a mod even for small changes, and never modify directly game files in Steam Hearts of Iron 4 folder, as your changes may be undone without warning.
6chxs1.zh: ⟦0⟧：即使改动很小也要使用模组，绝不要直接修改 Steam 版 Hearts of Iron 4 文件夹中的游戏文件，因为你的改动可能在毫无预警的情况下被还原。

pe1tnr.en: Draws lines every 4 spaces or a single tab symbol making it easier to keep track of indentation. This makes missing brackets easier to see by default.
pe1tnr.zh: 每 4 个空格或一个制表符就画一条线，让缩进的追踪更容易。这默认使缺失的括号更容易被发现。

1tgbsl.en: Static modifiers also include modifiers applied in hard-coded cases, such as non-core state malus or the political power cost when a ⟦0⟧ is selected.
1tgbsl.zh: 静态修正还包括在硬编码情形下施加的修正，例如非核心州的惩罚，或选中某个 ⟦0⟧ 时的政治点数花费。

1d05ohn.en: It's easy to where an argument is contained by moving one indenting level to the left and then following the indent guide's line until it hits code.
1d05ohn.zh: 要找出某个参数包含在哪里，只需向左移动一个缩进层级，然后沿缩进参考线追踪，直到碰到代码为止。

1tk5vdz.en: Dealing with unintuitive errors where the location is not specified, such as ⟦0⟧, where this can be used to locate ⟦1⟧ file is throwing the error.
1tk5vdz.zh: 处理未指明位置的难以理解的错误，例如 ⟦0⟧，此时可以用它来定位是哪个 ⟦1⟧ 文件在抛出该错误。

iwww19.en: In case of replace_path being used inside of a mod descriptor, the load order decides which files will be unloaded inside of the specified folder.
iwww19.zh: 如果在模组描述文件中使用了 replace_path，则由加载顺序决定指定文件夹内的哪些文件会被卸载。

1jnzjql.en: ⟦0⟧ - When hovering over a GUI element, ⟦1⟧ can be used to open a debug menu, which will allow going to the GUI file where the element is defined.
