1jnzjql.zh: ⟦0⟧——将鼠标悬停在某个 GUI 元素上时，可以用 ⟦1⟧ 打开调试菜单，从而跳转到定义该元素的 GUI 文件。

s11g88.en: Comments are marked with the ⟦0⟧ character: everything after that character until the newline will be entirely ignored by the game. For example:
s11g88.zh: 注释用 ⟦0⟧ 字符标记：该字符之后直到换行之前的所有内容都会被游戏完全忽略。例如：

ssdz8j.en: Following the indenting rules and checking for these indenting errors will ensure that there will be no bracket-related errors within the code.
ssdz8j.zh: 遵循缩进规则并检查这些缩进错误，就能确保代码中不会出现与括号相关的错误。

jxx9y1.en: ⟦0⟧ is information that's logged in the middle of the game. In particular, "log" (either as an ⟦1⟧ or a ⟦2⟧) outputs its logs into this file.
jxx9y1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是在游戏运行过程中记录的信息。尤其是，「log」（无论是作为 ⟦1⟧ 还是 ⟦2⟧）会把它的日志输出到这个文件中。

1blr5rs.en: This can be overwritten using ⟦0⟧ in the ⟦1⟧. ⟦2⟧, but it is used to completely unload everything previously-loaded from a certain folder.
1blr5rs.zh: 这可以通过用 ⟦0⟧ 在 ⟦1⟧ 中来覆盖。⟦2⟧，但它用于完全卸载先前从某个文件夹加载的一切内容。

1yc3hrm.en: ⟦0⟧ are used to apply a constant numeric change, such as the daily political power gain. Commonly, ⟦1⟧ are used to apply it to countries.
1yc3hrm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于施加恒定的数值变化，例如每日政治点数获取。通常使用 ⟦1⟧ 把它施加到国家上。

1puxt6a.en: The ⟦0⟧'s outputs are stored in this folder. In particular, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ may be created by the user as outputs of the nudger. ⟦4⟧
1puxt6a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 的输出存放在该文件夹中。具体而言，用户可以把 ⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ 和 ⟦3⟧ 作为微调器的输出创建出来。⟦4⟧

1v80m1k.en: ⟦0⟧, in which case only the first-loaded mod as decided by the filename of the user-specific descriptor will have any effect in-game.
1v80m1k.zh: ⟦0⟧，此时只有由用户专属描述文件文件名决定的最先加载的那个模组会在游戏内产生效果。

ivwqm0.en: ⟦0⟧ is a string that's shown near the mod's name in the launcher as the mod's version. Any string is accepted and grants no change.
ivwqm0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是一个字符串，会作为模组版本显示在启动器中模组名称的旁边。任何字符串都被接受，且不会带来任何改变。

1idjbkp.en: The base game is loaded first, while mods are loaded later. The order of loading files is primarily used to determine two things:
1idjbkp.zh: 基础游戏最先加载，模组稍后加载。文件加载顺序主要用于决定两件事：

1889bl3.en: Loading screens within ⟦0⟧. Note that, however, the main menu background usually stored in that folder ⟦1⟧ defined as a sprite.
1889bl3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 中的加载界面。不过要注意，通常存放在该文件夹中的主菜单背景 ⟦1⟧ 被定义为精灵。

1f4fnop.en: Finding out what can cause a certain occurance to happen, such what fires a certain event or what sets a certain cosmetic tag.
1f4fnop.zh: 找出可能导致某种情况发生的原因，例如什么会触发某个事件，或者什么会设置某个外观标签。

f76osk.en: ⟦0⟧: This is the primary folder in which nearly every database entry is defined: countries, technologies, focuses, et cetera.
f76osk.zh: ⟦0⟧：这是最主要的文件夹，几乎所有数据库条目都在其中定义：国家、科技、焦点等等。

1q6kgt5.en: ⟦0⟧: This folder is used to define songs that play within the radio stations, and the possibilities in the weighted shuffle.
1q6kgt5.zh: ⟦0⟧：该文件夹用于定义在广播电台中播放的歌曲，以及加权随机播放中的可能性。

jghmdb.en: ⟦0⟧ and its subfolders, where the name must follow a strict formatting in order to be automatically loaded for a country.
jghmdb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 及其子文件夹，其中名称必须遵循严格的格式，才能被自动加载给某个国家。

ugnna1.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to attach a Steam Workshop or a Paradox Mods item to the mod, as to enable updating it within the launcher.
ugnna1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于把某个 Steam 创意工坊或 Paradox Mods 项目附加到模组上，以便能在启动器中更新它。

pmr598.en: Before 1.12 / By Blood Alone: Go down the communist focus tree towards Pan-Balkan Initiative and instigate an uprising in ⟦0⟧. When the communists win the civil war, justify on them and declare war (they will not be guaranteed by anyone). Puppet Transylvania in the peace conference and give them all Romanian territory. Starting with 1.12, this doesn't work because of the rework of the peace conference system. You have two choices. Either go down Western focus branch, release Transylvania as a puppet using Autonomy for Slavic Transylvania, and then defeat Romania; or go Communist and defeat Romania ⟦1⟧ (first to create the Transylvania puppet, then to give them the rest of Romanian cores). The second route is extra-hard (on historical, anyway), because you need to do it all before the Soviet Union demands Bessarabia in mid-1940.
pmr598.zh: 1.12 / 《唯有鲜血》之前：沿共产主义国策树一路走向「泛巴尔干倡议」，并在⟦0⟧煽动一场起义。当共产主义者赢得内战后，对其制造战争目标并宣战（它们不会得到任何国家的保障）。在和平会议上把特兰西瓦尼亚收为傀儡国，并把所有罗马尼亚领土都给它。从 1.12 起，由于和平会议系统重做，这一做法不再可行。你有两个选择：要么走西方分支，通过「斯拉夫特兰西瓦尼亚自治」把特兰西瓦尼亚释放为傀儡国，然后再击败罗马尼亚；要么转为共产主义并击败罗马尼亚⟦1⟧（先用它创建特兰西瓦尼亚傀儡国，再把罗马尼亚其余核心领土给它）。第二条路线极其困难（至少在历史模式下如此），因为你必须在 1940 年中期苏联索取比萨拉比亚之前全部完成。

11ly0e8.en: It can be done quickly as ⟦0⟧. The Japanese fleet is immediately capable of sinking not just the HMS Hood, but the entire Royal Navy if played properly. Choose Purge the Kodoha Faction and justify on the ⟦1⟧ (or ⟦2⟧) as soon as possible. Ask Germany for docking rights, and move your entire fleet to their port nearest to the UK. Use the bulk of your fleet as a strike force, with three groups of destroyers patrolling the naval areas around the UK. If possible, you can also use naval bombers as well for added firepower. When the justification has finished, declare war on them. If Germany invites you to the Axis you should accept in order to use their airfields. From there just keep beating the Brits and building new ships and bombers (importing Oil for fuel if needed) until your fleet sinks the Hood and unlocks the achievement.
11ly0e8.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局可以很快完成。日本舰队从一开始就有能力击沉「胡德号」，如果操作得当，甚至能全歼整个皇家海军。选择「清洗皇道派」，并尽快对⟦1⟧（或⟦2⟧）制造战争目标。向德国索要停靠权，把整支舰队调到其最靠近英国的港口。把舰队主力编成打击舰队，另派三支驱逐舰编队在英国周边海域巡逻。如有可能，也可以动用海军轰炸机来增强火力。战争目标制造完成后，对其宣战。如果德国邀请你加入轴心国，应当接受，以便使用其机场。此后只需持续击败英国人并建造新舰船与轰炸机（必要时进口石油以获取燃料），直到你的舰队击沉「胡德号」并解锁成就。

ypqdz8.en: Take the focus Revise the Constitution then take Balkans Dominance. Build an army to at least 500k manpower and take the Align Hungary and Split Czechoslovakia focuses. If Hungary refuses, win the war and puppet them. Germany should also agree to split ⟦0⟧ giving ⟦1⟧ a ⟦2⟧ puppet. Take the Appoint Pro-Axis Government, take the Fascist Demagogue and flip to fascism. Then head to Force Abdication. Remove the Fascist Demagogue once Romania flips to fascism. Wait until Germany declares war against ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ joins the Axis. Join the war but do not let Hungary and Slovakia into the war. Place the army on the Bulgarian Border. Take King Michael's Coup to flip to democratic and wait until Poland capitulates and the ⟦5⟧ takes Eastern Poland. Take the "Join the Allies" decision and capitulate Bulgaria.
ypqdz8.zh: 先完成「修订宪法」焦点，再完成「巴尔干霸权」。把军队扩充到至少 50 万人力，并完成「拉拢匈牙利」和「瓜分捷克斯洛伐克」焦点。如果匈牙利拒绝，就打赢战争并把它收为傀儡国。德国也应同意瓜分⟦0⟧，给⟦1⟧一个⟦2⟧傀儡国。完成「任命亲轴心政府」，招募「法西斯煽动家」并转为法西斯主义。随后走向「强制退位」。当罗马尼亚转为法西斯主义后，撤掉「法西斯煽动家」。等到德国对⟦3⟧宣战、⟦4⟧加入轴心国。加入战争，但不要让匈牙利和斯洛伐克参战。把军队部署在保加利亚边境。完成「米哈伊国王政变」转为民主主义，并等到波兰投降、⟦5⟧占领东波兰。采取「加入同盟国」决议并使保加利亚投降。

f2tsvh.en: Rush down the ⟦0⟧ route and take the Hispanic Alliance focus to invite all fascist or non-aligned Hispanic American countries. There is an 80% chance for them to accept your invitation (independent of opinion or diplomatic pressure). In 1936, these countries are ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧, with ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧ potentially flipping later. NOTE: make sure to take the focus when as many of them as possible are eligible, because it's a one-time thing; once the focus event fires, short of conquering them, it becomes extremely difficult to add anyone who refused or was ineligible at the time. Unless they are in a war, they'll need 30% fascist support, fascist government, +100 opinion, 100% diplomatic pressure, ⟦11⟧ some special factor like having a border with you, to make them accept.
f2tsvh.zh: 沿⟦0⟧路线速通，完成「西班牙裔联盟」焦点，以邀请所有法西斯或中立主义的西语美洲国家。它们有 80% 的概率接受你的邀请（与好感度或外交压力无关）。1936 年时，这些国家是⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧、⟦6⟧、⟦7⟧和⟦8⟧，而⟦9⟧和⟦10⟧可能在之后转投。注意：务必在尽可能多的国家都符合条件时再完成该焦点，因为这是一次性的；焦点事件一旦触发，除非征服它们，否则之后再想把当时拒绝或不符合条件的国家拉进来会极其困难。除非它们处于战争状态，否则需要 30% 法西斯支持度、法西斯政府、+100 好感度、100% 外交压力，⟦11⟧某些特殊因素（例如与你接壤），才能让它们接受。

xd5ky5.en: ⟦0⟧ Go the ⟦1⟧ path down to "Union Nacional Fascista" and build up your industry and a capable army. Get military access from ⟦2⟧ or even join the Axis via focus. Either way naval invade ⟦3⟧ when their civil war is over and your army is ready. They'll have very few equipment but will try to conquer any bridgehead you establish. This will cause them to have a massive equipment deficit quickly so you can overrun them easily. (Naval invading from countries you only have military access to works when you first set up a naval invasion from your country to the point from where you want to naval invade your actual target. For example set up from Buenos Aires to Sardinia and then you should be able to plan from Sardinia).
xd5ky5.zh: ⟦0⟧走⟦1⟧路线直到「民族法西斯联盟」，并发展工业、组建一支可用的军队。向⟦2⟧索取军事通行权，或者干脆通过焦点加入轴心国。无论哪种方式，都要在他们的内战结束、你的军队准备就绪后海军登陆⟦3⟧。他们的装备会非常少，却会试图夺回你建立的任何滩头阵地。这会让他们迅速陷入巨大的装备缺口，于是你可以轻松击溃他们。（从仅有军事通行权的国家发动海军登陆是可以的：先从你自己的国家向你想发动海军登陆的出发点制定登陆计划即可。例如先从布宜诺斯艾利斯规划到撒丁岛，之后就能从撒丁岛进行规划。）

1aedmlt.en: Play on non-historical and ensure ⟦0⟧ goes for Support the Kodoha Faction. Take Subjugate the Warlords. If they do not accept peacefully, use your war goals to puppet them by force. Complete the series of ⟦1⟧ decisions which appear after ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ are puppetted. Alternatively, defeat them the old-fashioned way (possibly after taking One China Policy focus) and then reduce their autonomy by building stuff (including border-to-border level 5 forts and supply depots) on their territories and/or lend-leasing supplies to them. The achievement can even be done by annexing them in a war, releasing them as puppets, and then reintegrating them (in case "puppet" is not an available option in the peace conference.)
1aedmlt.zh: 在非历史模式下游玩，并确保⟦0⟧走「支持皇道派」。完成「征服军阀」。如果他们不肯和平接受，就用战争目标以武力把他们收为傀儡国。完成⟦1⟧决议系列，这些决议会在⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧成为傀儡国后出现。或者用老办法击败他们（可以在完成「一个中国政策」焦点之后），然后通过在他们领土上建造东西（包括边境到边境的 5 级要塞和补给站）和/或向他们租借补给来降低其自治度。这个成就甚至可以通过在战争中吞并他们、将其释放为傀儡国、再重新整合来完成（以防和平会议中没有「傀儡国」这一选项）。

kesifs.en: Before the civil war fires delete all land units and make a single cavalry division in training. Deploy it in Athens after the war starts and take all victory points to quickly end the civil war. Naval invade Crete ⟦0⟧ if necessary. With ⟦1⟧, civil war can be triggered by not arresting the King and going down the The Right to Rule path. Without ⟦2⟧, you have to manually trigger a civil war using party popularity mechanics. Since you have a timer for when the civil war starts, you can time the Reorganize the Royal Guard focus to complete one day after the civil war starts. If you have deleted all units previously, the two units granted by the focus will be enough to immideately win the war.
kesifs.zh: 在内战爆发前解散所有陆军单位，并训练一个骑兵师。战争开始后把它部署到雅典，占领所有胜利点以迅速结束内战。必要时海军登陆克里特⟦0⟧。有⟦1⟧时，可以通过不逮捕国王并走「统治权」路线来触发内战。没有⟦2⟧时，就必须利用党派支持度机制手动触发内战。由于内战开始的时间是确定的，你可以把「整编皇家卫队」焦点安排在内战开始后一天完成。如果你之前已解散所有单位，该焦点给予的两个单位就足以立刻赢下战争。

133rzn7.en: Easiest as the ⟦0⟧ since it already controls all the territory needed, except ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. Take The King's Party focus route, justify and annex the 3 independent nations of the peninsula. Make a camel template and train 30 of them. You start the game with camels unlocked, but you have to make the template yourself. NOTE: Territory needs to be owned directly (not through puppets and not merely occupied), you'll need to reduce autonomy and annex Oman (which is easy), and, if the British Raj failed to hand over Aden back in 1936, you'll have to annex the Raj too (which is trickier, since The King's Party sets it on the path for independence and gives it a large daily autonomy boost).
133rzn7.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局最容易，因为它已经控制了所需的所有领土，只有⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧除外。走「国王党」焦点路线，制造战争目标并吞并半岛上的 3 个独立国家。制作一个骆驼师编制并训练 30 个。开局时骆驼已解锁，但编制需要你自己创建。注意：领土必须是直接拥有（不能通过傀儡国，也不能仅仅是占领），你需要降低自治度并吞并阿曼（这很容易）；另外，如果英属印度在 1936 年没有交出亚丁，你还得吞并英属印度（这更棘手，因为「国王党」会让它走上独立道路，并给予其大量的每日自治度加成）。

vqamzq.en: You only need to occupy the states, not own them. Switch to communist and get as many Balkan countries as possible in your faction. The country will flip above 60% communist support ( ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are particularly important to get on your side). Any Balkan country in your faction can be annexed through the The Unification of the Balkans focus. Once you have established the Federation, attack whoever still controls land in the Balkans and capitulate ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ needs to be in a faction when they capitulate to satisfy the "at war" and "has capitulated" requirements. Otherwise when they capitulate, they are no longer at war and the achievement doesn't fire.
vqamzq.zh: 你只需要占领这些州，而不必拥有它们。转为共产主义，并尽可能把更多巴尔干国家拉进你的阵营。当共产主义支持度超过 60% 时国家就会转变（把⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧拉到你这边尤其重要）。你阵营中的任何巴尔干国家都可以通过「巴尔干统一」焦点被吞并。建立联邦后，攻击任何仍控制巴尔干土地的国家，并使⟦2⟧投降。⟦3⟧⟦4⟧在投降时必须处于某个阵营中，才能满足「交战中」和「已投降」的条件。否则它们投降后就不再处于战争状态，成就也不会触发。

fy4mki.en: Follow the "Oppose Hitler" branch of the focus tree. An event will pop up as the focus is in progress. Select the "ensure loyalty of the Kreigsmarine". Fail the timed event in the decisions tab that asks for the progression towards certain naval focuses. Once the timed event has failed another event will pop, choose the decision that puts Erich Raeder in power. Justify or obtain war goal on the United Kingdom and have them capitulate to you ⟦0⟧ Achievement requires the United Kingdom to capitulate, but does not check whether Germany triggered the capitulation. Will be granted even by the end of a civil war in the United Kingdom.
fy4mki.zh: 沿国策树的「反对希特勒」分支前进。焦点进行中会弹出一个事件。选择「确保海军忠诚」。在决议标签页中，让那个要求推进特定海军焦点的限时事件失败。限时事件失败后会再弹出另一个事件，选择让埃里希·雷德尔上台的决议。对英国制造或取得战争目标，并让它向你投降⟦0⟧成就要求英国投降，但不检查是否是德国导致的投降。即使英国是在内战结束时投降，也会解锁。

1oiy6nr.en: After completing The Fate of the Balkans you get the ability to peacefully puppet any nation with a Balkan capital who is in your faction, as well as the capacity to force them into your faction if they are not already in one. A puppeted ⟦0⟧ can be integrated with its constituent states released as puppets for this achievement, or you can seize 803 ⟦1⟧ from them via decision. These states can make the puppets Macedonia and Serbia. In order to get states to join your faction via decision it is important to have more manpower deployed to the field, and puppet expeditionary forces contribute to this number.
1oiy6nr.zh: 完成「巴尔干的命运」后，你就能和平地把任何首都位于巴尔干、且在你阵营中的国家收为傀儡国；如果它们还不在任何阵营中，你也有能力把它们强行拉进你的阵营。对于这个成就，可以把已成为傀儡国的⟦0⟧整合，并将其下属各州作为傀儡国释放；也可以通过决议从它们手中夺取 803 ⟦1⟧。这些州可以组成马其顿和塞尔维亚两个傀儡国。要想通过决议让各州加入你的阵营，关键是在战场上投入更多人力，而傀儡国派出的远征军也会计入这个数字。

4emuru.en: As ⟦0⟧, play on non-historical in order to prevent the Sino-Japanese war ( ⟦1⟧ going communist is ideal). Make a fallback line on your capital and declare an early war on ⟦2⟧ while holding your capital with 9-12 divisions. Research infantry equipment and artillery only (at some point some of your divisions may run out of organization and die, so deploy a few extra divisions before it happens). If the AI stops attacking you, bait it to attack by training your divisions. If a General becomes level 9 before your field marshal, you may promote the General to field marshal and you will get the achievement.
4emuru.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，在非历史模式下游玩以避免中日战争（⟦1⟧转为共产主义最为理想）。在首都布置撤退线，用 9-12 个师守住首都的同时提前对⟦2⟧宣战。只研究步兵装备和火炮（某些时候部分师可能会因组织度耗尽而崩溃，所以提前多部署几个师）。如果 AI 停止进攻，就通过训练师来引诱它进攻。如果某位将领比你的元帅先升到 9 级，你可以把这位将领晋升为元帅，就能获得该成就。

fqc3r5.en: The event chain starts once Germany gains the Sudetenland via their Demand Sudetenland focus, after Czechoslovakia has been betrayed by their allies. 6 days after the initial event the second event will trigger and immediately change your name. If you select the "We need radical change" option in that event your name will also change to "Czecho-Slovak Republic", which is redundant due to the immediate effect of the event. Furthermore, 14 days after the second event a third event will demand you release Slovakia as a puppet. Releasing Slovakia will again also change your name (which is also redundant).
fqc3r5.zh: 当德国通过「索取苏台德」焦点获得苏台德、且捷克斯洛伐克已被其盟友背弃后，事件链便会启动。初始事件发生 6 天后，第二个事件会触发并立即更改你的国名。如果你在该事件中选择「我们需要激进变革」选项，你的国名也会变为「捷克-斯洛伐克共和国（Czecho-Slovak Republic）」，但由于该事件的即时效果，这是多余的。此外，第二个事件发生 14 天后，第三个事件会要求你释放斯洛伐克作为傀儡国。释放斯洛伐克同样会再次更改你的国名（这同样是多余的）。

zlw99.en: When the civil war fires, chose the option for divisions, rather than territory and do the Mobilize the Veteran Legionaries focus ASAP. When you attack ⟦0⟧ DO NOT finish the war, but try to push a bit in the south and cause some casualties. When WW2 starts, attack ⟦1⟧ and join Axis. If Germany doesn't let you join, reload the save and they will let you. Once ⟦2⟧ capitulates, just ask Germany for control of Paris. (You should have enough war score from the war against ⟦3⟧). If it still is not enough, try giving Germany some of the occupied territories in Argentina.
zlw99.zh: 内战爆发时，选择给予师的选项，而不是领土，并尽快完成「动员老兵军团」焦点。当你进攻⟦0⟧时，不要结束战争，而是尝试在南方推进一点并造成一些伤亡。二战爆发后，进攻⟦1⟧并加入轴心国。如果德国不允许你加入，就重新载入存档，它们就会允许。一旦⟦2⟧投降，直接向德国索要巴黎的控制权。（你从对⟦3⟧的战争中应该已经积累了足够的战争贡献。）如果还不够，可以试着把阿根廷境内的一些占领区让给德国。

1sacntv.en: Uncheck ⟦0⟧ Go into Custom Game Rules and into the AI behavior tab. Changing a country's path from ⟦1⟧ to a defined path makes the game non-iron man, but not if you specifically select the historical route, e.g. changing Germany's path from ⟦2⟧ to ⟦3⟧. Now change every country you want to stay historical from ⟦4⟧ to their ironman-compatible set path, with every country you want to possibly go a-historical still set on ⟦5⟧. This way, the game will only have countries with Default set as their path possibly go non-historical, though it is not guaranteed.
1sacntv.zh: 取消勾选⟦0⟧进入自定义游戏规则，再进入 AI 行为标签页。把一个国家的路线从⟦1⟧改为某条已定义的路线会使游戏变为非铁人模式，但如果你明确选择的是历史路线，则不会——例如把德国的路线从⟦2⟧改为⟦3⟧。现在，把你希望保持历史走向的每个国家从⟦4⟧改为它们兼容铁人模式的固定路线，而把你希望可能走非历史路线的每个国家仍设为⟦5⟧。这样，游戏中只有路线设为「默认值」的国家才可能走非历史路线，尽管这并不保证。

13dtvd5.en: Rush towards Proclaim the Third Empire focus to get ⟦0⟧. Wait until Germany declares war on ⟦1⟧ and then declare war on the ⟦2⟧. Accept the invitation to join Germany's faction. Your starting army and fleet will be enough to destroy the ⟦3⟧. Annex them in the peace conference. Guarantee ⟦4⟧ when the USSR starts justifying a war goal on them. Accept the call to arms and invite the rest of the Axis. This will make the war easier as the ⟦5⟧ will not receive the "Great Patriotic War" buff. Earn enough warscore and ask your allies for control of Moscow ⟦6⟧.
13dtvd5.zh: 速通「宣告第三帝国」焦点以获得⟦0⟧。等到德国对⟦1⟧宣战，然后对⟦2⟧宣战。接受邀请，加入德国的阵营。你的开局陆军和舰队足以摧毁⟦3⟧。在和平会议上吞并它们。当苏联开始对⟦4⟧制造战争目标时保障其独立。接受参战号召，并邀请轴心国其余成员。这会让战争更轻松，因为⟦5⟧不会获得「伟大卫国战争」加成。积累足够的战争贡献，然后向盟友索要莫斯科的控制权⟦6⟧。

ui0cbb.en: This is achievement requires a lot of grinding. Go ⟦0⟧ and keep the empire from falling apart. Take out the ⟦1⟧ early and give their territory to Canada to form the Dominion of North America. Later forming the Imperial Federation will then also include the US, giving one of the highest core population possible in the game, especially after also integrating Europe by forming the European Federation. Make sure to justify on as many smaller countries as possible while at war with a major power to speed up the process. Pairs well with ⟦2⟧.
ui0cbb.zh: 这个成就需要大量反复操作。走⟦0⟧，并维持帝国不四分五裂。尽早解决⟦1⟧，把它们的领土交给加拿大，以成立北美自治领。之后再成立帝国联邦时就能把美国也纳入其中，从而获得游戏中数一数二的核心人口——尤其是在通过成立欧洲联邦整合欧洲之后。务必在与主要国家交战期间尽可能多地对小国制造战争目标，以加快进度。与⟦2⟧搭配完成效果很好。

8o8rtb.en: Easiest as the East India Company. Here is how to get a state in all continents: Using Just Good Business, you can get ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ (Australia), ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ (South America) and any state in the ⟦4⟧ (Europe), via a naval invasion from Britain to the Netherlands, using the British navy. Then you can purchase ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ (North America), ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ or ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧ (Africa), and ⟦11⟧ ⟦12⟧ (Middle East). Alternatively, you can purchase ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧ and ⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧ for the Middle East and South America requirements, if you want to also get the ⟦17⟧ achievement.
8o8rtb.zh: 以东印度公司开局最容易。以下是在各大洲都取得一个州的方法：使用「只是生意（Just Good Business）」，你可以通过从英国海军登陆荷兰，取得⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧（澳大利亚）、⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧（南美洲）以及⟦4⟧（欧洲）中的任意一个州。之后你可以购买⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧（北美洲）、⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧或⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧（非洲）以及⟦11⟧ ⟦12⟧（中东）。另外，你也可以购买⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧和⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧来满足中东和南美洲的要求，如果你想顺便拿到⟦17⟧成就的话。

7sm4ji.en: Make your way to Realpolitik and create a "Bastion of Liberty" faction. Use your first initiative point to allow your faction to host governments in exile. Guarantee Finland. Wait for the Winter War to start and accept the Call to Arms. Improve relations and send an attache to Finland. You should have enough relations to invite them to your faction despite the distance. It's important to invite them quickly, as they will white peace the Soviets if they aren't in a faction. Once they capitulate you will get the achievement.
7sm4ji.zh: 一路走到「现实政治」，并创建一个「自由堡垒」阵营。用你的第一个主动性点数让阵营可以接纳流亡政府。保障芬兰独立。等待冬季战争爆发并接受参战号召。改善关系，并向芬兰派遣武官。尽管距离遥远，你的关系值也应该足以邀请他们加入你的阵营。务必尽快邀请，因为如果他们不在任何阵营中，就会与苏联白和。等他们投降，你就能获得该成就。

w3xfvb.en: Simply play as ⟦0⟧ on Historical, and go down the Continue the War in Batavia branch. There is no point in trying to defend your European lands (as Continue the War in Batavia requires you to have capitulated), so build up your Asian possessions. Once Germany is defeated, you will have control of your homeland back, and you can complete Liberation and earn the achievement. ⟦1⟧ You will need to have removed the "Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War" spirit, so make sure you complete War on Pacifism as soon as possible.
w3xfvb.zh: 直接在历史模式下以⟦0⟧开局，并走「继续在巴达维亚作战」分支。试图防守你在欧洲的领土毫无意义（因为「继续在巴达维亚作战」要求你已投降），所以应发展你在亚洲的属地。德国被击败后，你将重新控制本土，此时完成「解放」即可获得该成就。⟦1⟧你需要先移除「一战中受惊的旁观者」国家精神，所以务必尽快完成「向和平主义宣战」。

1o3s8mf.en: Start as ⟦0⟧ and get to 5 ⟦1⟧, either by training or hiring military advisor. Create a 1 width division and rush train as many as possible (make sure to set it to the highest priority in the recruiting tab so it gets guns first). Deploy them as soon as they reach the minimum training level and just switch them to the normal template. ⟦2⟧: You can only train 75% of the manpower currently on the field with a minimum of 100.00K. So that means you must have at least 1,333,334 manpower on the field to do this achievement.
1o3s8mf.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，把⟦1⟧提升到 5，可以通过训练或聘请军事顾问实现。创建一个宽度为 1 的师，并尽可能多地快速训练（务必在招募标签页中把它设为最高优先级，以便优先获得枪支）。一旦达到最低训练水平就立即部署，然后直接把它们切换为普通编制。⟦2⟧：你只能训练当前战场上人力的 75%，且最低为 100.00K。因此，要完成这个成就，战场上必须至少有 1,333,334 人力。

v0ar78.en: Simply play historical and join the Allies. You need 50% more factories and fielded manpower than the ⟦0⟧, which shouldn't be a problem after a few years of buildup. Once you become faction leader, create an invasion order and press the button below the army to request 51 expeditionary forces and earn the achievement. ⟦1⟧ The UK will accept to send the 51 divisions you need if they have ~160 divisions, you can send them some of your own troops as expeditionary forces to get them past that number.
v0ar78.zh: 直接在历史模式下游玩并加入同盟国。你需要比⟦0⟧多出 50% 的工厂和已部署人力，经过几年发展后这应该不成问题。成为阵营领袖后，创建一个入侵命令，并按下军队下方的按钮请求 51 支远征军，即可获得该成就。⟦1⟧如果英国拥有约 160 个师，他们就会同意派出你需要的 51 个师；你也可以把自己的一些部队作为远征军派给他们，帮他们超过这个数字。

z5fn0z.en: It is recommended to play as a ⟦0⟧ nation to avoid the diplomatic penalty from different ideology which may block the “Request License Production” option. Improve relations with five of the seven major powers then license the basic infantry weapons. (Researching the next level of infantry equipment also works, as even major nations have few problems with licensing outdated equipment). With La Résistance, you can use an agent and assign him to put diplomatic pressure on majors as well.
z5fn0z.zh: 建议以⟦0⟧国家开局，以避免因意识形态不同而产生的外交惩罚——该惩罚可能会挡住「申请许可生产」选项。与七大主要国家中的五个改善关系，然后获得基础步兵武器的生产许可。（研究下一级步兵装备也可以，因为即便是主要国家，通常也不介意授权过时装备。）启用《抵抗运动》后，你还可以派出一名特工，指派他对主要国家施加外交压力。

1a0j600.en: Play as ⟦0⟧ on historical. Go down the ⟦1⟧ side of the focus tree and pick the focus Establishing a Foothold to get a wargoal on ⟦2⟧. Simply defeat and puppet them in the peace deal that follows. Once you reach 60% ⟦3⟧ popularity, continue down the focus tree and either create your own faction (Argentina First) or join the Axis. Near the bottom of the ⟦4⟧ tree you'll find the focus The Old Enemy giving you a war goal on ⟦5⟧. Once you declare your war the achievement will unlock.
1a0j600.zh: 在历史模式下以⟦0⟧开局。走国策树的⟦1⟧一侧，选择「建立立足点」焦点以获得对⟦2⟧的战争目标。击败他们并在随后的和平协议中把他们收为傀儡国即可。当⟦3⟧支持度达到 60% 后，继续沿国策树前进，可以创建自己的阵营（「阿根廷优先」）或加入轴心国。在⟦4⟧国策树接近底部的位置，你会找到「宿敌」焦点，它给予你对⟦5⟧的战争目标。一旦宣战，成就就会解锁。

10rpxqi.en: Choose to invite Trotsky in the "Trotsky seeks refuge" event. Follow the rightmost side of the focus tree to become communist and put Trotsky in charge. Join Germany's war against the ⟦0⟧ via the Smash the Bureaucrats focus. To gain warscore, ask Germany for military access and put your troops on their front line. Alternatively, try to naval invade the Soviets' far east front and capture a few victory point provinces. During the peace conference, puppet the Soviet Union.
10rpxqi.zh: 在「托洛茨基寻求庇护」事件中选择邀请托洛茨基。沿国策树最右侧前进，转为共产主义并让托洛茨基掌权。通过「粉碎官僚」焦点加入德国对⟦0⟧的战争。为了获得战争贡献，向德国索取军事通行权并把部队部署在他们的前线。或者尝试海军登陆苏联的远东前线，占领几个胜利点省份。在和平会议上把苏联收为傀儡国。

sszdcv.en: ⟦0⟧ The Mughal Empire ⟦1⟧ tag can only be gained by completing Unite the Subcontinent national focus ⟦2⟧ completing Expand the Silk Road. This achievement can be combined with ⟦3⟧. An easy way to do it is to simply guarantee the independence of Greece and/or Yugoslavia, so that you will find yourself in a defensive war against the Axis on the same side as the Allies. The UK will let you join the allies and you can easily become the spymaster once you are in.
sszdcv.zh: ⟦0⟧莫卧儿帝国⟦1⟧标签只能通过完成「统一次大陆」国策⟦2⟧完成「拓展丝绸之路」来获得。这个成就可与⟦3⟧一起完成。一个简单的做法是直接保障希腊和/或南斯拉夫的独立，这样你就会发现自己与同盟国站在同一方，对轴心国进行防御战。英国会让你加入同盟国，加入后你很容易成为情报首脑。

pzw8gx.en: At the start of the game focus on building military factories in Valencia. As long as you control Valencia when the Anarchist uprising fires, you will be given control of it. Easier if the ⟦0⟧ are weakened by the Carlist rebellion. This can be done by keeping control of the northern states (Asturias & Pais Vasco) for as long as possible. On non-historical, they may also simply not take the focuses in the right order to prevent the uprising from happening.
pzw8gx.zh: 游戏开始时集中力量在瓦伦西亚建造军用工厂。只要无政府主义起义爆发时你控制着瓦伦西亚，它就会交给你控制。如果⟦0⟧因卡洛斯派叛乱而被削弱，会更容易。要做到这一点，可以尽可能长时间地控制北部各州（阿斯图里亚斯和巴斯克地区）。在非历史模式下，它们也可能干脆不按正确顺序完成焦点，从而避免起义发生。

1vy56ui.en: You need to move your fleet into the Black Sea before Turkey remilitarises the Bosphorus Strait. You can increase its range by basing it in Cyprus. Go down the Empower the Workers path towards Join Comintern. Justify a wargoal on ⟦0⟧ and attack from the ⟦1⟧. Turkey will guard Istanbul, but leave Erdine undefended. Call them into the war and naval invade ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧. The achievement only requires control of the state, so it can be gained while at war.
1vy56ui.zh: 你需要在土耳其重新军事化博斯普鲁斯海峡之前，把舰队开进黑海。把舰队基地设在塞浦路斯可以增加其航程。沿「赋予工人权力」路线走向「加入共产国际」。对⟦0⟧制造战争目标，并从⟦1⟧发动进攻。土耳其会防守伊斯坦布尔，但会放任埃迪尔内不设防。把他们拉入战争并海军登陆⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧。该成就只要求控制该州，因此在战争期间也能获得。

ly67lb.en: Boost fascism in ⟦0⟧ from the start of the game, then complete Danzig for Slovakia to gain control of Danzig ⟦1⟧ without going to war with ⟦2⟧. If France hasn't flipped by the time you get Danzig ⟦3⟧, start a fascist coup in France. As soon as the coup fires, you'll get the achievement. ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ flag fires when Germany declares war on ⟦6⟧. However, you should be able to ⟦7⟧ a war against them, e.g. if ⟦8⟧ declares war and asks you to join.
ly67lb.zh: 从游戏一开始就在⟦0⟧提升法西斯主义支持度，然后完成「但泽换斯洛伐克」焦点，取得但泽⟦1⟧的控制权，且不必与⟦2⟧开战。如果你拿到但泽⟦3⟧时法国还没有转变，就在法国发动法西斯政变。政变一爆发，你就能获得成就。⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧旗标会在德国对⟦6⟧宣战时触发。不过，你应该能够⟦7⟧一场对它们的战争，例如当⟦8⟧宣战并邀你加入时。

iknltm.en: The Megali Idea involves you, UK, and ⟦0⟧ agreeing to attack and split up ⟦1⟧ so you are guaranteed the land required in the peace deal. Do note that the UK and France can individually bail on the war when you complete the focus to attack Turkey even if they agreed at the convention, but it is still easy to beat Turkey with just one of them and is possible to beat them by yourself. (See also notes for "Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.")
iknltm.zh: 「伟大理想」需要你、英国以及⟦0⟧三方同意进攻并瓜分⟦1⟧，这样你就能确保在和谈中获得所需的土地。请注意，即使英国和法国在会议上同意了，当你完成进攻土耳其的焦点时，它们仍可能各自退出战争；不过只靠其中一方仍能轻松击败土耳其，你独自击败他们也是可行的。（另见「伊斯坦布尔就是君士坦丁堡。再一次。」的说明。）

dgia8k.en: The Regency Council is formed through Form a Regency Council focus. Go for Plot Against Boris focus and pick the decisions to kill him, then choose a pro-Axis regent and join the Axis. Going down "The democratic principle" seems easier than "The Tsars regime". Prince Paul will be replaced by Peter II in February 1941, and Germany will attack Yugoslavia soon after. Join the war to get the achievement.
dgia8k.zh: 摄政会议通过「组建摄政会议」焦点成立。走「密谋对付鲍里斯」焦点并选择杀死他的决议，然后选择一位亲轴心的摄政者并加入轴心国。走「民主原则」似乎比「沙皇政权」更容易。保罗亲王将在 1941 年 2 月被彼得二世取代，德国随后不久就会进攻南斯拉夫。加入战争即可获得该成就。

1k7gq50.en: You can start this by either subjugating ⟦0⟧ with the monarchist path, or by going down ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧, getting a foothold in Iberia by declaring on one (or more) of the Spanish Civil War factions, and taking land when they capitulate that borders Portugal. If you subjugate them, it's easier if you take ⟦3⟧ and give it to your Portugese puppet so you can build on the land and lower their autonomy easier.
1k7gq50.zh: 你可以通过君主主义路线征服⟦0⟧来开始，也可以走⟦1⟧或⟦2⟧，通过对西班牙内战中的一方（或多方）宣战在伊比利亚取得立足点，并在它们投降时夺取与葡萄牙接壤的土地。如果你选择征服它们，先夺取⟦3⟧并交给你的葡萄牙傀儡国会更容易，这样你就能在那片土地上建造，并更轻松地降低其自治度。

1uw669q.en: ⟦0⟧ To get the ⟦1⟧ country flag, you must annex ⟦2⟧ without being in a faction. The "not in a faction" check is done when Japan gets annexed, so theoretically you are free to join factions during the game if you want to, as long as you leave before you annex Japan. Remember that if you call your faction members to war, you will not be able to leave until after the peace conference.
1uw669q.zh: ⟦0⟧要获得⟦1⟧国家旗标，你必须在不在任何阵营的情况下吞并⟦2⟧。「不在阵营中」的判定在吞并日本时进行，所以理论上你可以在游戏中随意加入阵营，只要在吞并日本之前退出即可。请记住，如果你召集阵营成员参战，那么在和谈结束之前你都无法退出。

114xnsi.en: Play historical. Go down the ⟦0⟧ route, build fascist support until you can take Guardia Nacional, then wait until Germany has capitulated. The event will fire soon after. No other condition is necessary, you can be at war with Germany yourself, and as getting Señor Hilter in power is the first option in the event, it should select itself if you prefer to be afk the entire time.
114xnsi.zh: 在历史模式下游玩。走⟦0⟧路线，不断积累法西斯主义支持度直到能完成「国民卫队」，然后等待德国投降。事件随后不久就会触发。不需要其他条件，你甚至可以自己与德国交战；由于让希尔特先生上台是事件中的第一个选项，如果你想全程挂机，它也会自动选中。

1j5lgi6.en: Turn historical AI off, since the ⟦0⟧ may take the Revisit Colonial Policy branch of its focus tree containing the focus Withdraw from Contested Territories which will give Gibraltar ⟦1⟧ to ⟦2⟧ for free along with it becoming a core state. If this occurs during the civil war, Gibraltar ⟦3⟧ may not be given to the player's Spain but will be transferred once the civil war is won.
1j5lgi6.zh: 关闭历史 AI，因为⟦0⟧可能会走国策树中的「重新审视殖民政策」分支，其中包含「撤出争议领土」焦点，该焦点会免费把直布罗陀⟦1⟧交给⟦2⟧，并使其成为核心州。如果这发生在内战期间，直布罗陀⟦3⟧可能不会交给玩家控制的西班牙，但内战获胜后会转移过去。

vgij4z.en: With Götterdämmerung, you must complete the End the Regency to get Horthy as an advisor. Otherwise, you must complete Invite the Habsburg Prince. After that, you can go for any path under Reinstate the Pragmatic Sanction of 1713 to get wargoals on ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. Build up your industry and army, conquer either one, research and deploy a battleship and assign Horthy to that fleet.
vgij4z.zh: 启用《诸神黄昏》时，你必须完成「终结摄政」才能让霍尔蒂成为顾问。否则，你必须完成「邀请哈布斯堡王子」。之后，你可以走「恢复 1713 年国事诏书」下的任意路线，以获得对⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧的战争目标。发展工业和军队，征服其中一方，研究并部署一艘战列舰，然后把霍尔蒂分配到那支舰队。

gc4jy.en: Simply follow the guide for ⟦0⟧ which will put Western Europe under your control. At this point, it should be easy to launch an invasion on ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧. Get intel on the ⟦5⟧ or call ⟦6⟧ into the war to help with gaining naval superiority. The British Isles will be weakly defended, and once you have a stable port beachhead, it should be trivial to conquer them.
gc4jy.zh: 直接按⟦0⟧的攻略来做，就能把西欧置于你的控制之下。到这时，对⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧发动入侵应该很容易。获取⟦5⟧的情报，或者把⟦6⟧拉入战争以帮助取得制海权。不列颠群岛的防御会很薄弱，一旦你建立起稳固的港口滩头阵地，征服它们就轻而易举。

t637b0.en: At game start, establish an agency and set your operatives on "Establish Spy Network" mission in ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. The achievement will trigger once the network strength is over 50%. You can do this as soon as you have recruited your first operative but the more operatives you assign to establish a network in the same region, the faster the network will be at full strength.
t637b0.zh: 游戏开始时建立情报机构，并让特工在⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧执行「建立特工网络」任务。网络强度超过 50% 后成就就会触发。你一招募到第一名特工就可以着手进行，但同一地区内派去建立网络的特工越多，网络达到满强度就越快。

1ttdf3y.en: As of 1.16.9, likely due to a bug, this achievement calls for the control of ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, which is only a claim, but not for ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, which is one of Kurdistan's cores. As such, if you seize all the required states and attempt to release Kurdistan, the achievement won't fire. You'll have to go to war with Turkey and seize control of Malatya to get the achievement.
1ttdf3y.zh: 在 1.16.9 版本中，可能由于一个 bug，该成就要求控制⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧——而这只是一块主张领土——却不要求控制⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧，而后者是库尔德斯坦的核心州之一。因此，即使你夺取了所有必需的州并尝试释放库尔德斯坦，成就也不会触发。你必须与土耳其开战并夺取马拉蒂亚的控制权才能获得该成就。

qiq4sf.en: As a democratic nation, build a lot of planes, namely strategic bombers and fighters, and rush nuclear technology. Germany will control Paris. When in the Allies, move your planes to the airfield on the ⟦0⟧ Isles and set them on mission to Northern ⟦1⟧ when the nuclear tech is ready and one nuke is available. Achieve air superiority and nuke Paris when ready.
qiq4sf.zh: 作为民主主义国家，大量建造飞机，尤其是战略轰炸机和战斗机，并速研核技术。德国会控制巴黎。加入同盟国后，在核技术就绪且有一枚核弹可用时，把你的飞机转移到⟦0⟧群岛上的机场，并让它们执行前往北⟦1⟧的任务。取得制空权，准备好后就对巴黎投核弹。

1mik9g7.en: Start the game as the ⟦0⟧, justify and declare war on ⟦1⟧ and call ⟦2⟧ into the war. After capitulating Poland, give them all Polish states. Kick them from your faction and justify a war goal on them. Declare war but ⟦3⟧ capitulate them. Since they don't have the means to properly suppress resistance, you can just wait until the resistance in ⟦4⟧ hits 90.
1mik9g7.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，对⟦1⟧制造战争目标并宣战，同时把⟦2⟧拉入战争。在使波兰投降后，把所有波兰的州都给它。然后把它踢出你的阵营，并对其制造战争目标。宣战，但⟦3⟧使其投降。由于它没有能力妥善镇压抵抗，你只需等到⟦4⟧的抵抗度达到 90 即可。

90xlpp.en: Picking a country that already starts with an authoritarian government like ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ can speed things up. Spam 2-width divisions to reach the threshold for sending volunteers (30) and when Germany attacks ⟦2⟧ on historical, simply send a few volunteers. If world tension is too low justify a war goal on the USA to spike it.
90xlpp.zh: 选择一个开局就拥有威权政府的国家，比如⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧，可以加快进度。大量生产宽度为 2 的师以达到派遣志愿军的门槛（30 个），当德国在历史模式下进攻⟦2⟧时，直接派出几支志愿军即可。如果世界紧张度过低，就对美国制造战争目标来把它拉高。

1ifwiys.en: On historical mode, start as ⟦0⟧ and do absolutely nothing. Save up 750+ political power. When Germany declares war on you, make sure to join the Allies. Since you have no divisions, the Germans will capitulate you almost immediately. Once capitulated, change your conscription law to ⟦1⟧, and the achievement should fire.
1ifwiys.zh: 在历史模式下以⟦0⟧开局，什么都不要做。积攒 750 以上政治点数。当德国对你宣战时，务必加入同盟国。由于你没有任何师，德国人会几乎立刻让你投降。投降后，把你的征兵法令改为⟦1⟧，成就就应该会触发。

18i0ok2.en: Concede territory to avoid wars and just research. Even when you get overrun and conquered by Germany and/or the ⟦0⟧, you will continue the game as a government-in-exile hosted by the ⟦1⟧ and remain eligible for the achievement. As long as the Allies survive, you can continue doing research to get the achievement.
18i0ok2.zh: 割让领土以避免战争，专心搞科研。即使你被德国和/或⟦0⟧攻占并征服，你也会作为由⟦1⟧收留的流亡政府继续游戏，并仍然有资格获得该成就。只要同盟国还在，你就可以继续进行研究以取得该成就。

809mhd.en: To host a government in exile you need to be the leader of a faction which has the rule "allows hosting exiled governments". This is set by default on only a small handful of base factions, and the easiest ways to get this achievement (one of which is outlined in the next paragraph) require ⟦0⟧ to be enabled.
809mhd.zh: 要收留流亡政府，你需要是一个拥有「允许收留流亡政府」规则的阵营的领袖。默认情况下只有少数几个基础阵营具备该规则，而获得这个成就最简单的几种方法（其中一种在下一段中说明）都需要启用⟦0⟧。

1a18fdz.en: Not clear how (or if!) this is doable as Yugoslavia: the problem is that the only possible Yugoslavian underage monarch, Peter II, loses his 'underage monarch' trait in September 1941 when he turns 18, but Tsar Boris III of Bulgaria only dies in 1943 under historical AI, and you have no way to influence that.
1a18fdz.zh: 目前不清楚以南斯拉夫的身份如何（或者是否！）能做到这一点：问题在于，唯一可能的南斯拉夫未成年君主彼得二世会在 1941 年 9 月年满 18 岁并失去「未成年君主」特质，而保加利亚的沙皇鲍里斯三世在历史 AI 下要到 1943 年才会去世，你无法影响这一点。

1m8z936.en: Can be done as any ideology. Make sure to improve relations and save up a few hundred ⟦0⟧ before starting Hold the Imperial Conference. 300-400 political power is a good number to have saved before starting but if you can spare the time and effort, having around 600-700 political power will ensure success.
1m8z936.zh: 任何意识形态都可以完成。务必在开始「召开帝国会议」之前改善关系并积攒几百⟦0⟧。开始前存下 300-400 政治点数是个不错的数目，但如果你有时间和精力，攒到 600-700 政治点数左右就能确保成功。

7094ws.en: Either go ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧, focus on getting manpower to build a small army and some cheap submarines. If the USA gets Newfoundland through the focus they do normally garrison the port with 1 division. Regardless, plan your naval invasion. Declare your war and simply wait. At some point the invasion will launch.
7094ws.zh: 走⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧，重点获取人力以组建一支小型陆军和一些廉价潜艇。如果美国通过焦点获得纽芬兰，它们通常会派 1 个师驻守港口。无论如何，都要规划好你的海军登陆。宣战，然后耐心等待。登陆总会在某个时候发动。

mhriye.en: Turn fascist by going down the National Regeneration path. Join the Axis '⟦0⟧, and rush research towards ⟦1⟧. Make sure to also build as many naval dockyards as possible. Take focuses that help with research, construction speed and dockyard output. Assign all available dockyards to producing destroyers.
mhriye.zh: 走「民族复兴」路线转为法西斯主义。加入轴心国「⟦0⟧，并速研⟦1⟧。同时务必尽可能多地建造海军船坞。完成有助于科研、建造速度和船坞产出的焦点。把所有可用船坞都分配去生产驱逐舰。

1ouagty.en: Assign whatever Scientists to ⟦0⟧, but you MUST choose Oppenheimer for ⟦1⟧. Make sure to check out iterations and decisions during the research. If an event comes up asking you to decide whether to keep or dismiss Oppenheimer from the project, keep him. Once the project completes, the achievement pops.
1ouagty.zh: 把随便哪位科学家分配给⟦0⟧，但⟦1⟧必须选择奥本海默。研究过程中务必查看各项迭代与决议。如果出现事件要你决定是否将奥本海默留在项目中，就留下他。项目完成后，成就就会弹出。

j1jk1g.en: ⟦0⟧ Do ⟦1⟧ take the focus Reconcile Japan since North Sakhalin is your core! Turn off historical German focuses, leaving everything else on historical. Alternatively, declare war on ⟦2⟧ early, releasing Belarus and Ukraine as puppets ⟦3⟧ and leave them outside of the war for an easier defensive line.
j1jk1g.zh: ⟦0⟧做⟦1⟧完成「与日本和解」焦点，因为北萨哈林是你的核心领土！关闭德国的历史焦点，其余全部保持历史。或者，提前对⟦2⟧宣战，把白俄罗斯和乌克兰释放为傀儡国⟦3⟧，并让它们置身战争之外，以获得更容易防守的防线。

1yaxuor.en: Avoid the civil war and flip ⟦0⟧. Use your first ~70 ⟦1⟧ to justify a War goal on ⟦2⟧ which should take almost a year. Take the focus Beneath the Shadow of the Triple Alliance to get the other two war goals around the same date. Simply declare war on all three countries when you have all war goals.
1yaxuor.zh: 避免内战并转变⟦0⟧。用你最初的约 70 ⟦1⟧对⟦2⟧制造战争目标，这大约需要将近一年。完成「在三国同盟的阴影之下」焦点，以便在同一时间前后获得另外两个战争目标。等三个战争目标都到手后，直接对这三个国家宣战。

jjqtws.en: The earlier the war, the better your odds. Go down the Collective Security branch and pick Eradicate Western Fascism (mid-1939 to optimize the attack bonus). Refuse the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact, and attack the German when they close in on Paris. Collaboration Government in Germany could be helpful.
jjqtws.zh: 战争越早开始，你的胜算越大。走「集体安全」分支并选择「根除西方法西斯主义」（1939 年中期完成可最大化进攻加成）。拒绝《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》，并在德国人逼近巴黎时进攻他们。在德国建立「合作政府」可能会有所帮助。

1t76nk8.en: Build an intelligence agency and make sure to get the Suicide Pills upgrade. Keep sending your operatives on missions, or just have them perform various activities like 'Build Intel Network' in other countries (preferably the ⟦0⟧). Eventually one of them will die and the achievement will trigger.
1t76nk8.zh: 建立情报机构，并确保取得「自杀药丸」升级。不断派特工执行任务，或者干脆让他们在其他国家（最好是⟦0⟧）进行「建立情报网络」等各种活动。最终其中一人会死亡，成就就会触发。

1v9bxfr.en: Start as the ⟦0⟧ and build up Egypt as much as possible. Once completely full of military factories, release Egypt as a puppet (check "Play as" when the checkbox appears). Increase your autonomy in any way possible: lend lease (trains and convoys are excellent), continuous focus and attaché.
1v9bxfr.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，尽可能发展埃及。等它完全塞满军用工厂后，把埃及释放为傀儡国（出现复选框时勾选「以该国身份游玩」）。用一切可能的方式提高你的自治度：租借（列车和运输船队效果极佳）、持续焦点以及武官。

s2pebo.en: ⟦0⟧ count toward total factories. Simply go ⟦1⟧ and conquer ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. If you end up at war with the Allies, don't worry. Simply join the Axis. When Germany punches into ⟦4⟧ through your territory and capitulates them, you will occupy all of ⟦5⟧, thus giving you the necessary factories.
s2pebo.zh: ⟦0⟧会计入工厂总数。直接走⟦1⟧并征服⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧。如果你最终与同盟国开战，不用担心，直接加入轴心国即可。当德国借道你的领土突入⟦4⟧并使其投降时，你将占领整个⟦5⟧，从而获得所需的工厂。

24gdta.en: Make sure to select the "Police Chief Eisenhower steps in" option in the assassination event. The achievement will fire after Macarthur seizes power. Since all events in the chain have a MTTH, it can take a while after taking the assassination focus before you get your achievement.
24gdta.zh: 在暗杀事件中务必选择「警察总长艾森豪威尔介入」选项。麦克阿瑟夺取政权后成就就会触发。由于该事件链中所有事件都有平均触发时间，完成暗杀焦点后可能还要等上一段时间才能拿到成就。

7vz7yd.en: This achievement is ideally tackled as a nation that can receive more than just the standard nuclear research bonus in the generic focus tree. Germany is an ideal choice if one goes ⟦0⟧, given that on top of a bonus to nuclear weapons, it can get an ahead of time bonus on nukes.
7vz7yd.zh: 完成这个成就最理想的是一个能在通用国策树中获得不止标准核研究加成的国家。如果走⟦0⟧，德国是理想选择，因为它除了核武器加成之外，还能获得核弹的提前研究加成。

6tz7oq.en: Easy and quick with ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. Use the research bonuses from the military branch of the focus tree to get nuclear weapons early. As ⟦2⟧ you need some fighters to guarantee air superiority. As ⟦3⟧ just release Y Wladychfa Gymreig as a free country and then justify a war goal.
6tz7oq.zh: 用⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧可以又快又轻松地完成。利用国策树军事分支的科研加成尽早获得核武器。作为⟦2⟧，你需要一些战斗机来确保制空权。作为⟦3⟧，只需把威尔士亲王国释放为自由国家，然后制造战争目标即可。

xp8p0a.en: If Germany is the last major in its faction then capitulating it will end the war and the achievement will not fire. Capitulating it before ⟦0⟧ is recommended, unless one of the Balkan Axis countries becomes a major. Any faction that includes the ⟦1⟧ counts as 'the Allies'.
xp8p0a.zh: 如果德国是其阵营中最后一个主要国家，那么让它投降就会结束战争，成就也就不会触发。建议在⟦0⟧之前先让它投降，除非某个巴尔干轴心国成为了主要国家。任何包含⟦1⟧的阵营都算作「同盟国」。

d0qa4b.en: The decision to form Greater Greece is unlocked either by the focus Nenikikamen while your leader is not ⟦0⟧, by completing the focus The Modern Movement and choosing to have ⟦1⟧ as your country leader, or by completing the focus Prepare for the Great Anti-Fascist War.
d0qa4b.zh: 组建大希腊的决议可通过以下任一方式解锁：在你的领袖不是⟦0⟧时完成「Nenikikamen（我们胜利了）」焦点；完成「现代主义运动」焦点并选择让⟦1⟧作为你的国家领袖；或完成「筹备伟大的反法西斯战争」焦点。

6p4yr6.en: The easiest way to earn this achievement is to simply play on historical as the ⟦0⟧ and build as many ⟦1⟧ as possible. The Arsenal of Democracy branch of the focus tree gives ⟦2⟧ for free, so make sure you complete it, along with the WPA branch to boost your industry.
6p4yr6.zh: 获得这个成就最简单的办法就是在历史模式下以⟦0⟧开局，并尽可能多地建造⟦1⟧。国策树的「民主兵工厂（Arsenal of Democracy）」分支会免费给予⟦2⟧，所以务必完成它，同时完成 WPA 分支来提升工业。

vqj3hm.en: Follow the focus tree to Alliance with Germany. Justify against ⟦0⟧ and launch a naval invasion of Normandy. It is not necessary to call Germany into the war. If France is puppeted, the achievement will not fire. Annex all cores, territories, and colonies to be sure.
vqj3hm.zh: 沿国策树走到「与德国结盟」。对⟦0⟧制造战争目标，并对诺曼底发动海军登陆。不必把德国拉入战争。如果法国成为傀儡国，成就就不会触发。为确保成功，吞并所有核心领土、领地和殖民地。

1jmti7q.en: Play as ⟦0⟧ and go down the Balkan Dominance branch. Increase your power as much as possible, by focusing on army, industry and by taking out Hungary and ⟦1⟧. Join the Axis, but ⟦2⟧. When they are defeated, you will become the leader, earning you the achievement.
1jmti7q.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局并走「巴尔干霸权」分支。尽可能增强实力：专注陆军和工业，并解决匈牙利和⟦1⟧。加入轴心国，但要⟦2⟧。当它们被击败后，你就会成为领袖，从而获得该成就。

zddg9d.en: On historical mode, play as ⟦0⟧. Wait for world tension to reach 50% so you can do the Northern Defense Front national focus, which makes a faction and invites the other Scandinavian countries to it. The AI should join if it is not already in a faction.
zddg9d.zh: 在历史模式下以⟦0⟧开局。等世界紧张度达到 50%，这样你就能完成「北方防线」国策，它会创建一个阵营并邀请其他斯堪的纳维亚国家加入。只要 AI 还没有加入其他阵营，它们就会同意。

1iheu4w.en: As ⟦0⟧, remove your divisions from ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧(keeping your ports for maximum efficiency). Lay mines on the Ethiopian shore with your starting navy until you reach 1000 mines. However, if you lose all your territory you will white peace with ⟦5⟧.
1iheu4w.zh: 作为⟦0⟧，把师从⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧撤走（保留港口以获得最高效率）。用你的开局舰队在埃塞俄比亚沿岸布雷，直到布雷数达到 1000。不过，如果你失去全部领土，就会与⟦5⟧白和。

a1fpze.en: The ⟦0⟧ has the highest chance of capturing operatives, so expand your operative slots and send them all to the ⟦1⟧. After an operative gets captured, rescue them and send them to the ⟦2⟧ again. Once they get captured again, the achievement will fire.
a1fpze.zh: ⟦0⟧抓获特工的概率最高，所以扩充你的特工槽位，把他们全都派往⟦1⟧。有特工被抓后，把他营救出来，再派往⟦2⟧。等他再次被抓，成就就会触发。

bn8f62.en: With ⟦0⟧ disabled, head for Quit India Movement and develop, build and deploy a nuclear bomb (remember to get some strategic bombers and fighters for air superiority). Potential targets include ⟦1⟧ once ⟦2⟧ joins the Allies or ⟦3⟧ once they join ⟦4⟧.
bn8f62.zh: 禁用⟦0⟧后，走向「退出印度运动」，并研发、制造和投掷一枚核弹（记得准备一些战略轰炸机和战斗机以取得制空权）。潜在目标包括⟦1⟧（一旦⟦2⟧加入同盟国）或⟦3⟧（一旦它们加入⟦4⟧）。

1equx21.en: Progress towards the next stages (funds) is gained by either researching with the according MIO assigned to the research and/or by producing equipment with the MIO assigned. Best done with the USA as they have a strong economy and research abilities.
1equx21.zh: 推进到下一阶段（资金）的方式是：把相应的军工产业组织指派到科研中进行研究，和/或把该军工产业组织指派到装备生产上。用美国完成效果最好，因为它拥有强大的经济与科研能力。

hel8dn.en: Can be done without ⟦0⟧ . Simply take the decisions to improve worker conditions and do anti-fascist raids for more stability. Build max infrastructure in all your states. Take Construction Effort and Infrastructure Effort focuses to speed things up.
hel8dn.zh: 不启用⟦0⟧也能完成。只需采取改善工人条件的决议，并发动反法西斯突袭来提高稳定度。在所有州建造满级基础设施。完成「建造努力」和「基础设施努力」焦点以加快进度。

1wqlamj.en: It is not possible to gain achievements if the checksum has been changed - either by tampering with game files, or by running the game using mods that affect gameplay mechanics (graphical mods do not affect checksum), or a corrupted installation.
1wqlamj.zh: 如果校验和被改动，就无法获得成就——无论是通过篡改游戏文件、使用会影响游戏机制的模组运行游戏（图形模组不影响校验和），还是安装损坏。

1l25kf4.en: Collaborating with the Axis is the simplest route to achieving this. Help the Axis capitulate the Allies and the Comintern, and grab South Georgia ⟦0⟧ and Georgia ⟦1⟧. South Georgia ⟦2⟧ can also be obtained via the Reaffirm Monroe Doctrine focus.
1l25kf4.zh: 与轴心国合作是完成该成就最简单的途径。帮助轴心国使同盟国和共产国际投降，并夺取南佐治亚⟦0⟧和佐治亚⟦1⟧。南佐治亚⟦2⟧也可以通过「重申门罗主义」焦点获得。

125kokw.en: Battlecruisers are built with "Heavy Ship Hulls" and "Battlecruiser armor". Make the cheapest battlecruisers you can and build 6 at the same time ( ⟦0⟧ start with 3) with all your dockyards assigned, build more dockyards to speed up construction.
125kokw.zh: 战列巡洋舰需要用「重型舰船船体」和「战列巡洋舰装甲」来建造。造出你能造的最廉价战列巡洋舰，并同时建造 6 艘（⟦0⟧开局有 3 艘）；把所有船坞都分配上去，并建造更多船坞以加快建造速度。

194y4we.en: Go fascist and justify on ⟦0⟧ once you flip. Since ⟦1⟧ is guaranteeing Albania they will join ⟦2⟧ once you declare war on them. Make sure to rush for the port so that the ⟦3⟧ cannot bring over their troops. Capitulate ⟦4⟧ and take all their land.
194y4we.zh: 转为法西斯主义，并在转变后对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。由于⟦1⟧保障着阿尔巴尼亚的独立，你一旦对其宣战，它们就会加入⟦2⟧。务必迅速夺取港口，这样⟦3⟧就无法把部队运过来。使⟦4⟧投降并夺取其全部土地。

n457tg.en: Rush fascist and justify a war goal on the ⟦0⟧, drawing in the ⟦1⟧. Train a lot of cavalry divisions and try to poke holes in the US line and encircle their troops. They should not have enough divisions to cover the entire border sufficiently.
n457tg.zh: 速转法西斯主义，并对⟦0⟧制造战争目标，从而把⟦1⟧也卷进来。训练大量骑兵师，尝试在美军防线上打开缺口并包围其部队。他们的师应该不足以充分覆盖整条边境。

2pd5q0.en: Then, take the "Reino de Filipinas" focus and unify with the faction member countries, in that specific case, with Spain. Because of the civil war, you need to core half of Spain manually when you reach the necessary compliance level.
2pd5q0.zh: 接着完成「菲律宾王国（Reino de Filipinas）」焦点，并与阵营成员国统一——在那种情况下，就是与西班牙统一。由于内战，你需要在达到所需顺从度水平后手动把西班牙的一半核心化。

1y4dy6w.en: You only need to occupy the state. Turn fascist and justify on ⟦0⟧. Build ~10 submarines and declare war. Capture a port in Greenland and then invade ⟦1⟧. Note that you ⟦2⟧ be in a faction with countries outside South America.
1y4dy6w.zh: 你只需要占领该州。转为法西斯主义并对⟦0⟧制造战争目标。建造约 10 艘潜艇并宣战。夺取格陵兰的一个港口，然后入侵⟦1⟧。注意，你⟦2⟧与南美洲以外的国家处于同一阵营。

m0cgu6.en: ⟦0⟧ Kurdistan cannot be released by ⟦1⟧, Syria, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ if ⟦4⟧ is enabled. This achievement is now possible (patch 1.16.5) through the Iraq focus tree with ⟦5⟧ enabled if you go down the Promote Kurdish Identity path.
m0cgu6.zh: ⟦0⟧库尔德斯坦无法由⟦1⟧、叙利亚、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧释放，前提是启用了⟦4⟧。现在（补丁 1.16.5）启用⟦5⟧后，只要走「推动库尔德认同」路线，就能通过伊拉克国策树完成这个成就。

1q39v25.en: ⟦0⟧: Generals or field marshals directly commanding divisions gain experience much faster than field marshals commanding armies. Can be done together with ⟦1⟧ while doing ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧. Alternatively done together with ⟦4⟧.
1q39v25.zh: ⟦0⟧：直接指挥师的将领或元帅获得经验的速度远快于指挥集团军的元帅。可以与⟦1⟧一起完成，同时进行⟦2⟧或⟦3⟧。也可以与⟦4⟧一起完成。

6mvwbu.en: Choose the fascist demagogue as your first advisor and turn fascist. Avoid civil war if possible. Join the Axis and help them in their wars. Germany has to survive until they research Tiger tank - at least late 1943.
6mvwbu.zh: 选择法西斯煽动家作为你的第一位顾问并转为法西斯主义。尽可能避免内战。加入轴心国并在其战争中提供帮助。德国必须存活到研究出虎式坦克为止——至少要撑到 1943 年末。

1a2yyzh.en: Completing either Full Desegregation or Union Representation Act will trigger a civil war with the Confederacy. To help the ⟦0⟧ win the war, complete the WPA branch and Guarantee the American Dream beforehand.
1a2yyzh.zh: 完成「全面废除种族隔离」或「工会代表法」都会引发与南方邦联的内战。为了帮助⟦0⟧赢得战争，请提前完成 WPA 分支和「保障美国梦」。

bv8oqe.en: Go down the Unify the Nationalist Front path, win the civil war, and head for Join the Axis. Join the war once Germany attacks the Benelux and gain enough war score for Germany to give you control of ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧.
bv8oqe.zh: 走「统一民族阵线」路线，赢得内战，然后走向「加入轴心国」。等德国进攻比荷卢时加入战争，并积累足够的战争贡献，让德国把⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧的控制权交给你。

1jg6pci.en: Flip ⟦0⟧ and join the ⟦1⟧ to stay safe from German aggression. Repeatedly take Balance of Power decisions to push towards the Welfare side. Also hire and/or fire advisors to influence the Balance of Power.
1jg6pci.zh: 转变⟦0⟧并加入⟦1⟧，以避开德国的侵略。反复采取「力量平衡」决议，把天平推向福利一侧。也可以通过聘用和/或解雇顾问来影响力量平衡。

e6fddh.en: Start as any non-aligned country and get a spy with the seducer trait. ⟦0⟧ is the easiest target as they have a high non-aligned popularity at the start and won't be building a spy agency until later.
e6fddh.zh: 以任意中立主义国家开局，并获得一名拥有「诱惑者」特质的特工。⟦0⟧是最容易的目标，因为他们开局时中立主义支持度很高，而且在之后一段时间内都不会建立特工机构。

uvbyry.en: Note: If you are adamant on getting this achievement without disabling La Résistance for whatever reason, try rolling back to Patch 1.13.7 to stop the UK from investing so heavily in counterespionage.
uvbyry.zh: 注意：如果你出于某种原因坚持不关闭《抵抗运动》也要拿到这个成就，可以尝试回滚到补丁 1.13.7，以阻止英国在反特工上投入过多。

5ubwwr.en: Invent and build fighters, strategic bombers and nukes. Wait for ⟦0⟧ and let them conquer one state, which you should nuke. Use your own fighters or wait for the Allies to help with air superiority.
5ubwwr.zh: 研发并建造战斗机、战略轰炸机和核弹。等待⟦0⟧，让他们占领一个州，然后你对该州投掷核弹。使用你自己的战斗机，或者等同盟国来协助取得制空权。

uieud2.en: Easiest as the ⟦0⟧. ⟦1⟧ 2 special projects require certain research to be completed - Intercontinental Bomber requires Improved Large Airframe, and Land Cruiser requires Super-Heavy Tank Chassis.
uieud2.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局最容易。⟦1⟧的 2 个特殊项目需要先完成特定研究——洲际轰炸机需要「改进型大型机体」，陆地巡洋舰需要「超重型坦克底盘」。

acct7.en: Rush down the monarchist path. Going ahistorical makes this achievement easier. If you complete Fight for Silesia you get the option for a limit war with Germany after conquering Upper Silesia.
acct7.zh: 速通君主主义路线。走非历史路线会让这个成就更容易。如果你完成「争夺西里西亚」，就能在征服上西里西亚后获得对德国发动有限战争的选项。

hifg6s.en: Can be done in a historical playthrough, but it's easiest to achieve when Germany goes for Oppose Hitler. Attack the Monarchist (or both sides) before they can recover from the civil war.
hifg6s.zh: 在历史模式的一局中也能完成，但当德国选择「反对希特勒」时最容易达成。在君主派（或双方）从内战中恢复过来之前进攻他们。

cbbjh0.en: Choose fascist demagogue as your first ⟦0⟧ spending, turn fascist (skip civil war option), complete Invite German Military Mission and join the Axis. Justify and declare war on the ⟦1⟧.
cbbjh0.zh: 把法西斯煽动家作为你的第一笔⟦0⟧支出，转为法西斯主义（跳过内战选项），完成「邀请德国军事顾问团」并加入轴心国。对⟦1⟧制造战争目标并宣战。

5j4gvt.en: Play as ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ and declare war on ⟦2⟧. Puppet as many of their colonies as possible. Then, go down the Revisit Colonial Policy branch of your focus tree, releasing a lot of subjects.
5j4gvt.zh: 以⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧开局，并对⟦2⟧宣战。尽可能多地把他们殖民地收为傀儡国。然后走国策树的「重新审视殖民政策」分支，释放大量附属国。

trndgr.en: You must have the highest war score of all participants. It may be easier to annex a single state, release it, justify a second war against the Soviets, and capitulate them alone.
trndgr.zh: 你必须在所有参战方中拥有最高的战争贡献。把单个州吞并、再释放它、对苏联制造第二次战争目标并独自使其投降，可能会更容易。

ndb2w4.en: Elect the Fascist king, join the Axis, and help them in the Africa campaign. As you only need to ⟦0⟧ Jerusalem, simply gain enough war score and ask for the control of Palestine.
ndb2w4.zh: 选出法西斯主义国王，加入轴心国，并在非洲战役中协助他们。由于你只需要⟦0⟧耶路撒冷，只要积累足够的战争贡献并索要巴勒斯坦的控制权即可。

rh2eih.en: Something to note is that this number only applies to casualties taken from Germany; you can take as many casualties as you like from other countries you are at war with.
rh2eih.zh: 需要注意的一点是，这个数字只针对从德国一方承受的伤亡；与你交战的其他国家造成的伤亡再多也没有关系。

1j3n30l.en: After securing the Mediterranean, it can easily be done with a small 1944 strategic bomber fleet (without any escort) by taking control of ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧.
1j3n30l.zh: 控制地中海之后，用一支 1944 年的小型战略轰炸机队（无需任何护航）就能轻松完成：夺取⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧的控制权。

ignd0t.en: Pick Patriation and Swastika Clubs as your first focuses. Go for Support a Synarchist Baja when you switch, get ⟦0⟧ in your faction and attack the ⟦1⟧ on the East Coast.
ignd0t.zh: 把「归国宪法」和「纳粹俱乐部」作为你的首批焦点。转变后走「支持锡那基主义下加利福尼亚」，把⟦0⟧拉进你的阵营，并进攻东海岸的⟦1⟧。

xkx419.en: ⟦0⟧ Due to a bug, this achievement cannot be obtained with the ⟦1⟧ enabled, because Germany never progresses beyond "Basic Heavy Tank", no matter how long you wait.
xkx419.zh: ⟦0⟧由于一个 bug，启用⟦1⟧时无法获得这个成就，因为无论等多久，德国都不会研究到「基础重型坦克」之后。

1pce0u8.en: ⟦0⟧ Losing control of a state means losing control of a majority of its victory points. It is possible to lose a few provinces without invalidating the achievement.
1pce0u8.zh: ⟦0⟧失去对一个州的控制，意味着失去其大部分胜利点的控制。失去几个省份并不会让成就失效。

5fin2t.en: Alternatively, play historical Democratic and annex one of the Chinese states that Japan or Manchukuo controlled in the peace deal when the Japanese faction loses.
5fin2t.zh: 或者，在历史模式下以民主主义国家游玩，并在日本阵营战败后的和平协议中，吞并一个原本由日本或满洲国控制的中国州。

71p51o.en: If ⟦0⟧/ Hungary refuse to become your puppet, simply attack and puppet manually. The national spirit can be given to them via decision once they are your subject.
71p51o.zh: 如果⟦0⟧/匈牙利拒绝成为你的傀儡国，直接进攻并手动将其变为傀儡国即可。等他们成为你的附属国后，可以通过决议把该国家精神给予他们。

1upcx03.en: ⟦0⟧: You do ⟦1⟧ need to conquer ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧ for this achievement. Therefore, this can be achieved without ever going to war against the Allies.
1upcx03.zh: ⟦0⟧：要完成这个成就，你⟦1⟧需要征服⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧。因此，你可以完全不必对同盟国开战就达成它。

171odrj.en: Requires Germany to follow the Return of the Kaiser branch. Taking Curacao from the ⟦0⟧ will not earn the achievement, as it is counted as part of South America.
171odrj.zh: 需要德国走「皇帝归来」分支。从⟦0⟧手中夺取库拉索不会获得该成就，因为它被算作南美洲的一部分。

7gvw1p.en: Can be very easily and quickly completed by playing as Czechoslovakia and completing the focus An Entente of Our Own, the faction will start with 100% manifest.
7gvw1p.zh: 以捷克斯洛伐克开局并完成「我们自己的协约」焦点即可非常轻松快速地完成；该阵营开局时就有 100% 的 manifest。

1mb9sri.en: You don't actually have to release Slovakia to gain this achievement, but it could prove useful to use them as a buffer state by not calling them into the war.
1mb9sri.zh: 其实你不必释放斯洛伐克也能获得这个成就，不过不把它拉入战争、让它充当缓冲国可能会很有用。

6vf6fw.en: Check happens upon operation completion. At least 1 participating operative requires ⟦0⟧, and at least 1 participating operative requires British nationality.
6vf6fw.zh: 判定在行动完成时进行。至少 1 名参与行动的特工需要⟦0⟧，并且至少 1 名参与行动的特工需要英国国籍。

14fy6hz.en: ⟦0⟧ You don't need to own all core states of ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧, but you do need to control all core states of ⟦5⟧. Ensure you also control Dodecaneso ⟦6⟧.
14fy6hz.zh: ⟦0⟧你不必拥有⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧的所有核心州，但你必须控制⟦5⟧的所有核心州。还要确保你控制多德卡尼斯⟦6⟧。

1elmw1d.en: ⟦0⟧ The time requirement is not necessary to complete the achievement, it automatically unlocks when you occupy the island by force or take it in a peace.
1elmw1d.zh: ⟦0⟧完成该成就并不需要满足时间要求；当你以武力占领该岛或在和谈中获得它时，成就会自动解锁。

1q0o63w.en: On historical, rush the ⟦0⟧ path and join the Axis. As soon as possible, justify and declare war on ⟦1⟧. Islands counts as non-contiguous states.
1q0o63w.zh: 在历史模式下，速通⟦0⟧路线并加入轴心国。尽快对⟦1⟧制造战争目标并宣战。岛屿会被算作不相连的州。

i48yo9.en: Follow the strategy for ⟦0⟧. When you have nukes, release the ⟦1⟧ and go to war with them. The US must control the state you drop the nuke in.
i48yo9.zh: 按照⟦0⟧的攻略进行。拥有核弹后，释放⟦1⟧并与其开战。投掷核弹所在的那个州必须由美国控制。

dh7cs6.en: You only need to have had more than 30% surrender progress after 1941.06.22 once, and not necessarily when at war with the required countries.
dh7cs6.zh: 你只需要在 1941.06.22 之后有过一次超过 30% 的投降进度即可，而且不一定得是在与所需国家交战时。

rnzxh5.en: Simply go fascist and join Germany in attacking the ⟦0⟧. Mongolia should be in their faction, and you shouldn't need much war score at all.
rnzxh5.zh: 直接转为法西斯主义，并加入德国进攻⟦0⟧。蒙古应该会在他们的阵营中，你几乎不需要多少战争贡献。

1v1wime.en: Can be done together with ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧: The Middle East in this achievement encompasses the continent, not the strategic region (air zone). ⟦2⟧:
1v1wime.zh: 可以与⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧一起完成：该成就中的中东指的是整个大陆，而不是战略地区（空域）。⟦2⟧：

15c81jn.en: With some luck, you can even annex a state in a peace deal after joining the 2nd Russian Civil War via Intervene in the Soviet Civil War
15c81jn.zh: 运气好的话，你甚至可以在通过「干预苏联内战」加入第二次俄罗斯内战后，在和谈中吞并一个州。

1x56qn3.en: Alternatively help Germany kill the Allies by naval invading the UK after the fall of France then kill Germany. It is safer but harder.
1x56qn3.zh: 或者，在法国陷落后海军登陆英国，帮德国消灭同盟国，然后再消灭德国。这样更安全，但难度更大。

1lyem0h.en: For this you need to complete the Assassination of Quezon focus after the focus Police Chief Eisenhower has been completed previously.
1lyem0h.zh: 为此，你需要在先前完成「警察总长艾森豪威尔」焦点之后，完成「暗杀奎松」焦点。

1qy3cxp.en: Play historical and rush down economic focuses. When Germany declares war on ⟦0⟧, join the war and rush down to Send in the Zombies.
1qy3cxp.zh: 在历史模式下游玩并速通经济类焦点。当德国对⟦0⟧宣战时，加入战争并一路速通到「派遣僵尸」。

113t0st.en: Simply follow the guide for ⟦0⟧ and build a lot of military factories in your territory. ⟦1⟧ Offmap military factories do not count.
113t0st.zh: 直接按⟦0⟧的攻略进行，并在你的领土上大量建造军用工厂。⟦1⟧地图外的军用工厂不计入。

1ky7jhr.en: If playing on historical, signing the Tripartite pact will cause a civil war. So just flip via decision and join the axis manually.
1ky7jhr.zh: 如果在历史模式下游玩，签署三国同盟条约会引发内战。所以直接通过决议完成转变，并手动加入轴心国。

rhu7qn.en: When Germany capitulates, all their core states have to fall under your control. France must be in the Allies and have capitulated.
rhu7qn.zh: 当德国投降时，其所有核心州都必须落入你的控制之下。法国必须加入同盟国并且已经投降。

1rrk5j1.en: Annex Hungary and ⟦0⟧. Create Austria-Hungary. Release Hungary and ⟦1⟧. You will have decisions to set Habsburgs on their thrones.
1rrk5j1.zh: 吞并匈牙利和⟦0⟧。创建奥匈帝国。释放匈牙利和⟦1⟧。你将获得把哈布斯堡家族扶上其王位的决议。

fhfqda.en: Germany must capitulate to you. If it capitulates to another faction and you don't see the popup, you won't get the achievement.
fhfqda.zh: 德国必须向你投降。如果它向另一个阵营投降，而你没有看到弹窗，就不会获得该成就。

srz2wf.en: Continuing on from ⟦0⟧, simply justify on ⟦1⟧ and conquer them. Your army should be more than powerful and big enough to do so.
srz2wf.zh: 接着⟦0⟧继续，直接对⟦1⟧制造战争目标并征服他们。你的军队应该足够强大且规模足够完成这件事。

1sv1ysv.en: ⟦0⟧ The East India Company ⟦1⟧ tag can be only gained by completing Incorporation of the East-India Company national focus.
1sv1ysv.zh: ⟦0⟧东印度公司⟦1⟧标签只能通过完成「并入东印度公司」国策获得。

1owua6c.en: Another viable strategy is to play as the ⟦0⟧ on historical, immediately justify on Poland then Germany and rush them down.
1owua6c.zh: 另一个可行的策略是在历史模式下以⟦0⟧开局，立即对波兰、随后对德国制造战争目标，并速攻击溃他们。

uz7ikp.en: Can be done relatively easily by defeating the Axis together with the Allies and simply taking ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ in the peace deal.
uz7ikp.zh: 与同盟国一起击败轴心国，然后在和平协议中直接取得⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧，就能相对轻松地完成。

1offx4d.en: ⟦0⟧ The Hashemite Arab Federation ⟦1⟧ tag can be only gained by completing Hashemite Arab Federation national focus.
1offx4d.zh: ⟦0⟧哈希姆阿拉伯联邦⟦1⟧标签只能通过完成「哈希姆阿拉伯联邦」国策获得。

1n5pfir.en: On historical, ⟦0⟧ also at one point deploys their field marshal and will leave him in the field at least till 1945.
1n5pfir.zh: 在历史模式下，⟦0⟧也会在某个时点部署其元帅，并至少会让他在战场上待到 1945 年。

5s4k9n.en: Play as ⟦0⟧, join the Comintern, and justify and declare war on a warlord once the Chinese United Front is formed.
5s4k9n.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，加入共产国际，并在中国统一战线成立后对某个军阀制造战争目标并宣战。

1f14vkg.en: Georg von Trapp can join Austria via event, between 15 and 20 days after completing the Promote Admirals focus.
1f14vkg.zh: 格奥尔格·冯·特拉普可以在完成「提拔海军上将」焦点后 15 到 20 天之间通过事件加入奥地利。

a8h6rf.en: Just play as the ⟦0⟧ and go down the Revisit Colonial Policy branch to release all occupied land as puppets.
a8h6rf.zh: 直接以⟦0⟧开局，走「重新审视殖民政策」分支，把所有占领的土地作为傀儡国释放。

1oof4ns.en: ⟦0⟧ The achievements description is misleading because it suggests ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ when in fact it requires ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧.
1oof4ns.zh: ⟦0⟧成就说明容易误导人，因为它暗示的是⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧，而实际要求的是⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧。

1sbnjdj.en: Anarchist Spain is created from either Masters of Our Own Fate focus or the Government Crackdown event.
1sbnjdj.zh: 无政府主义西班牙可以通过「主宰自身命运」焦点或「政府镇压」事件成立。

1uvqpuh.en: The countries need to be released via event, not manually through the occupied territories screen.
1uvqpuh.zh: 这些国家必须通过事件释放，而不能在占领区界面中手动释放。

jfqxeb.en: Flip to fascism through an advisor or national foci, and join the Axis. ⟦0⟧ Just AFK until 1948.
jfqxeb.zh: 通过顾问或国策转为法西斯主义，并加入轴心国。⟦0⟧之后一直挂机到 1948 年即可。

2i3yix.en: Both nations need to be either capitulated or annexed. Neither of them can be a puppet.
2i3yix.zh: 这两个国家都必须处于已投降或已被吞并的状态，二者都不能是傀儡国。

wfvsnz.en: Easiest to follow the Byzantine path in the Greek focus tree introduced in ⟦0⟧, see ⟦1⟧
wfvsnz.zh: 最容易的做法是走⟦0⟧中加入的希腊国策树里的拜占庭路线，参见⟦1⟧

kh0vis.en: Easiest to do as ⟦0⟧ by completing Profit off the Spanish Civil War and selling to ⟦1⟧.
kh0vis.zh: 以⟦0⟧完成最容易：完成「从西班牙内战中获利」，并向⟦1⟧出售。

11ye3q8.en: ⟦0⟧: Unlocks with Desert Camel Corps and The Tuz Gölü Training Facility (⟦1⟧ required)
11ye3q8.zh: ⟦0⟧：需要「沙漠骆驼军团」和「图兹湖训练设施」才能解锁（需要⟦1⟧）

v0tux4.en: As the ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧, set all of your ⟦2⟧ to convoy production and stay out of any wars.
v0tux4.zh: 作为⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧，把你所有的⟦2⟧都设为生产运输船队，并避免卷入任何战争。

l6e99r.en: The achievement only requires control of the state, so it can be gained while at war.
l6e99r.zh: 该成就只要求控制该州，因此在战争期间也能获得。

9rntry.en: Follow the strategy for ⟦0⟧ achievement and simply research additional technologies.
9rntry.zh: 按照⟦0⟧成就的攻略进行，并额外研究一些科技即可。

1s1onix.en: Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia has ⟦0⟧ as the country leader and has not capitulated
1s1onix.zh: 伦巴底-威尼西亚王国以⟦0⟧为国家领袖，且尚未投降

1s9m56q.en: Follow the historical route, or immediately declare war on ⟦0⟧ and then Germany.
1s9m56q.zh: 走历史路线，或者立即对⟦0⟧宣战，随后再对德国宣战。

1lnmi9t.en: ⟦0⟧ This achievement requires ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ to be taken in a peace deal.
1lnmi9t.zh: ⟦0⟧这个成就要求在和平协议中取得⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧。

cckrt0.en: ⟦0⟧ Paradropping troops sets country flag ⟦1⟧ which prevents this achievement.
cckrt0.zh: ⟦0⟧空降部队会设置国家旗标⟦1⟧，从而使这个成就无法达成。

hjf1co.en: Hungary is a subject of ⟦0⟧ and has the "Integration efforts" national spirit
hjf1co.zh: 匈牙利是⟦0⟧的附属国，并拥有「一体化努力」国家精神

qq2bsv.en: Grand Duchy of Tuscany has ⟦0⟧ as the country leader and has not capitulated
qq2bsv.zh: 托斯卡纳大公国以⟦0⟧为国家领袖，且尚未投降

fzktl4.en: Has completed focus The Council of Europe ⟦0⟧ Support the European Project
fzktl4.zh: 已完成「欧洲委员会」焦点⟦0⟧「支持欧洲计划」

1jouz09.en: ⟦0⟧ The faction does not need be the Axis, but it must be led by Germany.
1jouz09.zh: ⟦0⟧该阵营不必是轴心国，但必须由德国领导。

6dj1or.en: ⟦0⟧ Requires the states of Rhineland ⟦1⟧ Moselland to be demilitarized.
6dj1or.zh: ⟦0⟧要求莱茵兰⟦1⟧摩泽尔兰各州实现非军事化。

rdch2h.en: As ⟦0⟧, rush down the Assertiveness path towards Independence War.
rdch2h.zh: 以⟦0⟧开局，速通「强硬姿态」路线直到「独立战争」。

kwfd1u.en: Simply rush the communist focus tree towards Il Sol dell'Avvenire.
kwfd1u.zh: 直接速通共产主义国策树，直到「Il Sol dell'Avvenire（未来之阳）」。

d0x7bt.en: Go down the ⟦0⟧ route up through Embrace the Workers' Revolution.
d0x7bt.zh: 走⟦0⟧路线，一路经过「拥抱工人革命」。

d5mcog.en: A coastal province must be acquired to build the naval facility.
d5mcog.zh: 必须取得一个沿海省份才能建造海军设施。

wj64q3.en: Has assumed faction leadership from the ⟦0⟧, Germany or the ⟦1⟧
wj64q3.zh: 已从⟦0⟧、德国或⟦1⟧手中接过阵营领袖之位

13of7zi.en: You can do this as any nation, as long as you have camel units.
13of7zi.zh: 只要拥有骆驼单位，任何国家都可以完成。

1r3ytae.en: If playing as ⟦0⟧: Has completed focus Unión Nacional Fascista
1r3ytae.zh: 若以⟦0⟧游玩：已完成「民族法西斯联盟」焦点

c7m6kf.en: If playing as ⟦0⟧: Has completed focus Restore the Old Kingdom
c7m6kf.zh: 若以⟦0⟧游玩：已完成「恢复旧王国」焦点

1awfd2e.en: Can be done as Germany by executing a raid on the dam from ⟦0⟧
1awfd2e.zh: 以德国游玩时，可以从⟦0⟧对该水坝执行突袭来完成。

1ywtwok.en: Hungary has ⟦0⟧ as the country leader and has not capitulated
1ywtwok.zh: 匈牙利以⟦0⟧为国家领袖，且尚未投降

1xj9ldn.en: Ukraine has ⟦0⟧ as the country leader and has not capitulated
1xj9ldn.zh: 乌克兰以⟦0⟧为国家领袖，且尚未投降

vga7nn.en: Croatia has ⟦0⟧ as the country leader and has not capitulated

nwkkap.zh: 作为荷属东印度（或印度尼西亚），研究高级计算机器并完全升级密码部（同时你的首都须位于爪哇岛）。

1ynxi8o.en: As Austria or Hungary led by a Habsburg Monarch, Control the Swiss Plateau and have at least three other countries be led by a member of the Habsburg family.
1ynxi8o.zh: 作为由哈布斯堡君主领导的奥地利或匈牙利，控制瑞士高原，并让至少另外三个国家由哈布斯堡家族成员领导。

60bv3j.en: As Germany, get over 30% surrender progress after 1941.6.22 while being at war with Soviet Union, France and England and controlling Moscow, Paris and London
60bv3j.zh: 作为德国，在 1941.6.22 之后投降进度超过 30%，同时与苏联、法国和英国交战，并控制莫斯科、巴黎和伦敦

1m3k6o4.en: As the Netherlands, do not cave to the Germans, continue the Zuiderzee works, and do not lose control of any of your continental European states until 1945.
1m3k6o4.zh: 作为荷兰，不向德国屈服，继续须德海工程，并在 1945 年前不失去任何欧洲大陆州的控制权。

g3y9bw.en: As any Allied Nation (in faction with a democratic Britain), enforce a peace deal on Germany that disarms the Rhineland and makes it a demilitarized zone.
g3y9bw.zh: 作为任一盟国（与民主制英国同阵营），对德国强制执行和平协议，解除莱茵兰的武装并使其成为非军事区。

pt7zne.en: As Yugoslavia, start the Second World War (i.e. be part of either the Axis or the Allies and at war with the other faction in a war you started).
pt7zne.zh: 作为南斯拉夫，引发第二次世界大战（即加入轴心国或同盟国之一，并在一场由你发起的战争中与另一方交战）。

yt455.en: As democratic Czechoslovakia, become the 2nd republic by losing the Sudetenland and then grant autonomy to Slovakia, and then capitulate Germany.
yt455.zh: 作为民主制捷克斯洛伐克，通过失去苏台德地区成为第二共和国，然后给予斯洛伐克自治，接着使德国投降。

1a6jbj2.en: As PRC, don't expand beyond Yan'an, and infiltrate at least 5 Chinese states and flip them to your control when attacking the rest of China.
1a6jbj2.zh: 作为中共，不要扩张到延安以外，并渗透至少 5 个中国州，在进攻中国其余地区时将其转为你的控制。

1fjykur.en: As the United Kingdom complete the Special Project for Medium Range Ballistic Missiles, have a rocket site, and be at war with Germany
1fjykur.zh: 作为英国，完成中程弹道导弹特殊项目，拥有一座火箭基地，并与德国交战

44nhhw.en: As the Netherlands, ensure the United Kingdom has no capital ships (carriers, battleships, battlecruisers, or heavy cruisers).
44nhhw.zh: 作为荷兰，确保英国没有任何主力舰（航空母舰、战列舰、战列巡洋舰或重巡洋舰）。

6wjub6.en: As Finland, have Hungary, Estonia, Sapmi, Karelia, Mari El, Udmurtia, Komi, Ostyak-Vogulia, Yamalia and Nenetsia as subjects
6wjub6.zh: 作为芬兰，让匈牙利、爱沙尼亚、萨米、卡累利阿、马里埃尔、乌德穆尔特、科米、奥斯佳克-沃古利亚、亚马尔和涅涅茨成为你的附庸

1eb7tap.en: As communist Italy, save Gramsci from the brink of death, make him the leader of Italy and form the Italian National Union.
1eb7tap.zh: 作为共产主义意大利，将葛兰西从死亡边缘救回，让他成为意大利的领袖并组建意大利民族联盟。

c0ksar.en: Occupy a coastal province in Europe as Mexico, and if in a faction have it contain only South American members or puppets.
c0ksar.zh: 作为墨西哥，占领一个欧洲沿海省份，且若加入阵营，该阵营只能包含南美成员或傀儡国。

z1vlsj.en: As South Africa, finish the Anti-Colonialist Crusade focus, release all European colonies via the focus, and take London.
z1vlsj.zh: 作为南非，完成反殖民主义十字军焦点，通过该焦点释放所有欧洲殖民地，并占领伦敦。

1akjiy4.en: As the U.S.A., assume faction leadership of the Allies, and have over 50 expeditionary divisions from the United Kingdom.
1akjiy4.zh: 作为美国，取得同盟国的阵营领袖地位，并拥有超过 50 个来自英国的远征师。

1i11xco.en: As non-aligned Finland, survive the Soviet Union until September 19th 1944 without losing control of a single core ever.
1i11xco.zh: 作为中立主义芬兰，在苏联的进攻下存活到 1944 年 9 月 19 日，且从未失去任何一块核心领土的控制权。

ju140e.en: As Yugoslavia, occupy all your neighbouring countries (Austria, Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, Albania, Italy and Greece).
ju140e.zh: 作为南斯拉夫，占领你所有的邻国（奥地利、匈牙利、罗马尼亚、保加利亚、阿尔巴尼亚、意大利和希腊）。

alhdtf.en: As the Mughal Empire, complete Agency Upgrade Psychological Warfare, become Spy Master and have at least 8 operatives
alhdtf.zh: 作为莫卧儿帝国，完成情报机构升级心理战，成为特工大师并拥有至少 8 名特工

1ai8zfc.en: As Ethiopia, found the African Union and have it encompass at least 13 different countries with capitals in Africa.
1ai8zfc.zh: 作为埃塞俄比亚，建立非洲联盟，并使其囊括至少 13 个首都位于非洲的不同国家。

1oa2k6f.en: As Norway, with Peder Jarlsberg as country leader, own Telemark, Glouchestershire, Normandy, Lombardia and Holland.
1oa2k6f.zh: 作为挪威，以佩德·亚尔斯贝格为国家领袖，拥有泰勒马克、格洛斯特郡、诺曼底、伦巴第和荷兰。

5o4vt7.en: As the Soviet union, capitulate Germany after the fall of France before the Allies control one German core state.
5o4vt7.zh: 作为苏联，在法国沦陷后使德国投降，且要在同盟国控制任何一个德国核心州之前完成。

u5elbg.en: As the UK, liberate Brabant, and have Bernard Montgomery liberate Friesland while maintaining a force in Arnhem.
u5elbg.zh: 作为英国，解放布拉班特，并让伯纳德·蒙哥马利解放弗里斯兰，同时在阿纳姆保持一支部队。

a9w798.en: As Germany, Bring back the Kaiser and ensure that Italy is controlled by Victor Emmanuel by killing Mussolini.
a9w798.zh: 作为德国，迎回德皇，并通过杀死墨索里尼确保意大利由维托里奥·埃马努埃莱控制。

qo4sj9.en: As the Netherlands, liberate the continental Netherlands after relocating the government to the East Indies.
qo4sj9.zh: 作为荷兰，在将政府迁往东印度后解放欧洲大陆上的荷兰。

1tl72be.en: As Australia or New Zealand, have an Army HQ in Greece and ensure that Greece doesn't capitulate until 1945.
1tl72be.zh: 作为澳大利亚或新西兰，在希腊设立一个集团军司令部，并确保希腊在 1945 年前不投降。

a25rh6.en: As France, have at least 150 Destroyers and research the maximum torpedo launcher technology, before 1945.
a25rh6.zh: 作为法国，在 1945 年前拥有至少 150 艘驱逐舰并研究最高等级的鱼雷发射器科技。

1m5lalm.en: As Democratic Japan, complete the focus Foreign Exchange Allocation Policy and capitulate Fascist Germany.
1m5lalm.zh: 作为民主制日本，完成外汇分配政策焦点并使法西斯德国投降。

1jkypjn.en: As Manchukuo, have max level infrastructure in every owned state and generate at least 15 units of oil.
1jkypjn.zh: 作为满洲国，让你拥有的每个州都拥有最高等级的基础设施，并产出至少 15 单位石油。

yzitlz.en: As the Soviet Union under Stalin, conquer Germany while suffering less than 1 million casualties total.
yzitlz.zh: 作为斯大林领导下的苏联，征服德国，同时总伤亡不超过 100 万。

1qj4irh.en: As Switzerland win a defensive war without ever losing Western Swiss Alps, Eastern Swiss Alps or Ticino
1qj4irh.zh: 作为瑞士，赢得一场防御战，且从未失去西瑞士阿尔卑斯、东瑞士阿尔卑斯或提契诺

15m67ce.en: As Denmark, get Maximum Welfare Spending after January 1st 1941 without being puppeted or capitulating.
15m67ce.zh: 作为丹麦，在 1941 年 1 月 1 日之后获得最高福利支出，同时未被傀儡化也未投降。

1n028wn.en: Complete the Special Projects for Intercontinental Bombers, Land Cruisers, and Super Heavy Battleships.
1n028wn.zh: 完成洲际轰炸机、陆上巡洋舰和超重型战列舰的特殊项目。

j1shzy.en: As Belgium, with Paul-Henri Spaak as country leader, research at least 10 different Special Projects.
j1shzy.zh: 作为比利时，以保罗-亨利·斯巴克为国家领袖，研究至少 10 个不同的特殊项目。

xxx7ka.en: As a Scandinavian country form your own faction, and have Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland in it.
xxx7ka.zh: 作为斯堪的纳维亚国家组建自己的阵营，并让丹麦、瑞典、挪威和芬兰加入其中。

lt2l8l.en: As communist Czechoslovakia, complete "Expand the Union" and have Austria and Hungary in that union.
lt2l8l.zh: 作为共产主义捷克斯洛伐克，完成“扩展联盟”并让奥地利和匈牙利加入该联盟。

yw51v.en: As Greece or Bulgaria, own both sides of the Bosporus. As Turkey, subjugate both Greece & Bulgaria.
yw51v.zh: 作为希腊或保加利亚，拥有博斯普鲁斯海峡两岸。作为土耳其，征服希腊和保加利亚两国。

123v7m4.en: As Yugoslavia, establish the autonomous region of Transylvania and have it own all Romanian cores.
123v7m4.zh: 作为南斯拉夫，建立特兰西瓦尼亚自治区并使其拥有罗马尼亚的全部核心领土。

vi8ekq.en: As communist Iceland, make Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland rise up against the United Kingdom
vi8ekq.zh: 作为共产主义冰岛，让威尔士、苏格兰和北爱尔兰起兵反抗英国

129d8pi.en: As Finland, form Greater Finland and own every core and claim without having ever joined a faction
129d8pi.zh: 作为芬兰，建立大芬兰并拥有其全部核心和宣称领土，且从未加入过任何阵营

aqj5kg.en: As Argentina or Chile, have a Conquistadors national spirit active while holding all Spanish Cores
aqj5kg.zh: 作为阿根廷或智利，在持有西班牙全部核心领土时激活征服者国家精神

1tdp0y1.en: As Afghanistan, Iran, Iraq or the Raj, control all of the other three nations' starting provinces
1tdp0y1.zh: 作为阿富汗、伊朗、伊拉克或英属印度，控制其他三国的全部初始省份

e14ibc.en: Starting as a minor power, assume faction leadership of the Allies, the Axis, or the Comintern.
e14ibc.zh: 以一个小国开局，取得同盟国、轴心国或共产国际的阵营领袖地位。

1gmpv3m.en: As Bulgaria capitulate Turkey while also controlling the rest of the Balkans, including Greece.
1gmpv3m.zh: 作为保加利亚，使土耳其投降，同时控制巴尔干其余地区，包括希腊。

o7qe6g.en: As Manchukuo, Break free from Japan and annex your former Overlord without being in a faction.
o7qe6g.zh: 作为满洲国，摆脱日本的控制并吞并你原先的宗主国，且不加入任何阵营。

1u24jyy.en: As Bulgaria, complete the focus The Fate of the Balkans while having 5 or more Balkan puppets.
1u24jyy.zh: 作为保加利亚，在拥有 5 个或更多巴尔干傀儡国的情况下完成巴尔干的命运焦点。

1l71xr7.en: As Either Brazil or Argentina, be in a faction with Uruguay while at war with Brazil/Argentina
1l71xr7.zh: 作为巴西或阿根廷，在与巴西/阿根廷交战期间与乌拉圭同处一个阵营

1ts6dfy.en: As Iraq, build the maximum infrastructure level in all core states and achieve 100% stability
1ts6dfy.zh: 作为伊拉克，在所有核心州建造最高等级的基础设施并达到 100% 稳定度

15ndxl5.en: Has completed the Special Projects Nuclear Fission Bomb, Rocket Interceptor and Jet Engines.
15ndxl5.zh: 已完成核裂变炸弹、火箭截击机和喷气发动机特殊项目。

1ywyeex.en: As Italy, take Austria before the Anschluss and never enter a faction with a fascist Germany
1ywyeex.zh: 作为意大利，在德奥合并之前夺取奥地利，并且绝不与法西斯德国加入同一阵营

orxqw0.en: As Finland, capitulate the Soviet Union while having a 2 country faction with another Nordic
orxqw0.zh: 作为芬兰，在与另一个北欧国家组成的两国阵营中使苏联投降

17qmdt8.en: Control all mainland states that border the pacific in South America, North America and Asia
17qmdt8.zh: 控制南美洲、北美洲和亚洲所有濒临太平洋的大陆州

1gjiaue.en: As India, develop and deploy a nuke. You must have the Quit India Movement national spirit.
1gjiaue.zh: 作为印度，研发并部署一枚核弹。你必须拥有退出印度运动国家精神。

28y10d.en: As Chile, form the Hispanic Alliance and have at least 8 "Hispanic" nations in your faction
28y10d.zh: 作为智利，组建西班牙裔联盟并让至少 8 个“西班牙裔”国家加入你的阵营

1c4nk3f.en: As Austria have a coastline, at least 10 Battleships and have Georg von Trapp as an Admiral
1c4nk3f.zh: 作为奥地利，拥有海岸线、至少 10 艘战列舰，并让格奥尔格·冯·特拉普担任海军上将

18fm63y.en: As Poland, install a Habsburg monarch and be in a faction with another Habsburg monarch.
18fm63y.zh: 作为波兰，拥立一位哈布斯堡君主，并与另一位哈布斯堡君主同处一个阵营。

1r6h8o1.en: As Germany, control Budweis, Tsingtao, and Guinness directly or through a faction member
1r6h8o1.zh: 作为德国，直接或通过阵营成员控制布德魏斯、青岛和吉尼斯

156qtgn.en: As the United Kingdom, put Edward VIII in power, ally Germany and fully control Paris.
156qtgn.zh: 作为英国，让爱德华八世掌权，与德国结盟并完全控制巴黎。

2ydcj6.en: As Switzerland annex 5 states that are not contiguous with each other or Switzerland.
2ydcj6.zh: 作为瑞士，吞并 5 个彼此不相邻、也不与瑞士相邻的州。

t58rzm.en: As Indonesia or the Philippines, form Maphilindo and control all Indian core states.
t58rzm.zh: 作为印度尼西亚或菲律宾，组建马菲印多并控制印度全部核心州。

18nn0ji.en: As Germany, turn France fascist and occupy Danzig without going to war with France.
18nn0ji.zh: 作为德国，将法国转变为法西斯国家，并在不与法国开战的情况下占领但泽。

4y4pl6.en: As Haile Selassie, declare yourself “King of Kings” and control Kenya and Tanzania.
4y4pl6.zh: 作为海尔·塞拉西，自称“王中之王”并控制肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚。

155uliu.en: As Argentina, hold the Falkland Islands and South Georgia for 73 days consecutively
155uliu.zh: 作为阿根廷，连续 73 天守住福克兰群岛和南乔治亚

11wpdke.en: As Sweden, acquire a production license for a Tiger or Tiger II tank from Germany.
11wpdke.zh: 作为瑞典，从德国获得虎式或虎王坦克的生产许可。

5vzk7v.en: As Soviet Union declare a war on Poland and Germany before Germany attacks Poland.
5vzk7v.zh: 作为苏联，在德国进攻波兰之前对波兰和德国宣战。

1oy6cbc.en: As Italy, continue holding onto the First Rome, and gain the second and third Rome
1oy6cbc.zh: 作为意大利，继续守住第一罗马，并夺得第二罗马和第三罗马

1gx1b57.en: As Japan, Nuke a core territory of the US before the US develops nuclear weapons.
1gx1b57.zh: 作为日本，在美国研发出核武器之前用核弹轰炸美国的一块核心领土。

izgl63.en: As Ethiopia, without being in a faction, force the Italians to make peace. Again.
izgl63.zh: 作为埃塞俄比亚，在不加入任何阵营的情况下迫使意大利人求和。又一次。

9n928z.en: As Yugoslavia or Bulgaria, be at war while both countries are ruled by a child.
9n928z.zh: 作为南斯拉夫或保加利亚，在两个国家都由孩童统治时处于战争状态。

1090fe8.en: As Paraguay, declare war on Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay within the same month
1090fe8.zh: 作为巴拉圭，在同一个月内对阿根廷、巴西和乌拉圭宣战

wwp29y.en: As any Chinese country or Manchukuo, own and control all Mongolian core states.
wwp29y.zh: 作为任一中国国家或满洲国，拥有并控制蒙古的全部核心州。

ah1shn.en: As monarchist Czechoslovakia, integrate both Austria and former Bohemian lands.
ah1shn.zh: 作为君主制捷克斯洛伐克，整合奥地利和原波希米亚地区。

7nzkpb.en: As the United Kingdom, accomplish the federation of the entire British Empire.
7nzkpb.zh: 作为英国，实现整个大英帝国的联邦化。

1mx9jgk.en: As Hungary proclaim Greater Hungary and control all of your historical state
1mx9jgk.zh: 作为匈牙利，宣告大匈牙利并控制你全部的历史州

1rlap9w.en: As South Africa, finish the A King for our People focus and take Jerusalem.
1rlap9w.zh: 作为南非，完成人民之王焦点并夺取耶路撒冷。

1i41pm9.en: As Hungary, have Miklos Horthy as a Naval commander and build a battleship.
1i41pm9.zh: 作为匈牙利，让米克洛什·霍尔蒂担任海军指挥官并建造一艘战列舰。

8tieh5.en: Get over 90% intel in each category on a major without using code cracking.
8tieh5.zh: 在不使用密码破译的情况下，在一个主要国家的每个类别上获得超过 90% 的情报。

4bxx5f.en: Successfully stage a coup in any nation using a spy with the Seducer trait.
4bxx5f.zh: 使用一名具有诱惑者特质的特工，在任一国家成功发动一场政变。

1uj9x5z.en: As any communist South or central American country, occupy Washington D.C.
1uj9x5z.zh: 作为任一共产主义南美或中美洲国家，占领华盛顿特区。

jfy7xr.en: As Ethiopia, go communist and take all the states that border the Red Sea
jfy7xr.zh: 作为埃塞俄比亚，转向共产主义并夺取所有濒临红海的州

13lqetv.en: As a Warlord, have at least 1,000,000 manpower queued up for deployment.
13lqetv.zh: 作为军阀，在部署队列中排入至少 1,000,000 人力。

xqcjml.en: As Colombia, form Gran Colombia and have 10 Carriers and 10 Battleships.
xqcjml.zh: 作为哥伦比亚，组建大哥伦比亚并拥有 10 艘航空母舰和 10 艘战列舰。

1rdtot0.en: As Spain, have at least 5 spies and stage 5 coups against other nations.
1rdtot0.zh: 作为西班牙，拥有至少 5 名特工并对其他国家发动 5 次政变。

37wyor.en: As Tsarist Russia complete the Special Project for Thermonuclear bombs.
37wyor.zh: 作为沙俄，完成热核炸弹特殊项目。

qawn7j.en: As the Soviet Union never lose 1 core territory to anyone before 1945.
qawn7j.zh: 作为苏联，在 1945 年前绝不把任何一块核心领土丢失给任何人。

13qmewm.en: As Brazil, in the allies, capitulate Germany while controlling Berlin.
13qmewm.zh: 作为加入同盟国的巴西，在控制柏林的情况下使德国投降。

j9ooqy.en: As Mapuche Chile liberate all native people in North and South America
j9ooqy.zh: 作为马普切智利，解放北美和南美的所有原住民

1cy91rx.en: As Nationalist Spain in Axis manage to take Paris before the Germans.
1cy91rx.zh: 作为加入轴心国的民族主义西班牙，设法赶在德国人之前夺取巴黎。

tmebs5.en: As Egypt, go from puppet to a free nation using the autonomy system.
tmebs5.zh: 作为埃及，利用自治度系统从一个傀儡国变成一个自由国家。

1748fe8.en: As Zhang Xueliang, reclaim Mukden and revive the Beiyang government.
1748fe8.zh: 作为张学良，收复奉天并复兴北洋政府。

ga0vpa.en: As Iraq, form the Hashemite Arab Federation and defeat Saudi Arabia
ga0vpa.zh: 作为伊拉克，组建哈希姆阿拉伯联邦并击败沙特阿拉伯

1utccgl.en: As South Africa, break free from the UK and puppet another nation.

1mmj73t.en: On historical, Finland deploys their general Aksel Airo in mid '37. The Finnish AI is highly inclined to promote him to field marshal, but once they do this they will un-deploy him as an HQ and deploy someone else. However, if you justify on them as the Soviets at game start and just encircle him immediately, the HQ will be unable to disband. From here, you just have to keep him encircled & make sure the HQ doesn't kill itself before ~1938 - at around this time, Finland should promote Airo despite being encircled, and then you can capture him. There's no way to tell whether he has been promoted or not, but waiting until around mid 1938 will make it more consistent. ⟦0⟧
1mmj73t.zh: 在历史模式下，芬兰会在 37 年中期部署他们的将领阿克塞尔·艾罗。芬兰 AI 极倾向于把他晋升为元帅，但一旦这么做，就会把他作为集团军司令部撤编并部署其他人。不过，如果你在开局时以苏联对他制造战争目标并立刻将他包围，该司令部将无法解散。此后你只需保持包围并确保该司令部在约 1938 年之前不会自我消灭——大约此时芬兰会在被包围的情况下晋升艾罗，然后你就可以俘获他。无法判断他是否已被晋升，但等到 1938 年中期左右会更稳定。⟦0⟧

1juuw1h.en: Experiences from the Great War and studies since show that bombing the enemy's military targets and major cities will win the next war. At the very least, we must have a bomber capable of delivering such destruction. It will need to fly high and at good speed, and it must carry a large payload. This will require a large airframe with multiple engines. It will also have some defensive capability.
1juuw1h.zh: 大战的经验以及此后的研究都表明，轰炸敌方的军事目标与主要城市将赢得下一场战争。至少，我们必须拥有能够造成此种破坏的轰炸机。它需要飞得高、速度好，并且必须携带大量载荷。这要求采用配备多台发动机的大型机体。它还将具备一定的自卫能力。
