chlwbu.en: The war has taught us that our heavy fighter design is vulnerable to more nimble fighters, but quite good at the interception of enemy bombers due to heavy armament. This next design will focus on increased attack capability against enemy aircraft and even ground targets. Its speed and range will be improved as well.
chlwbu.zh: 这场战争让我们认识到，我们的重型战斗机设计在面对更灵活的战斗机时十分脆弱，但凭借沉重的武器，在拦截敌方轰炸机方面相当出色。下一款设计将着重增强对敌方飞机乃至地面目标的攻击能力，其速度与航程也将得到提升。

15qruez.en: Our bomber force needs escort protection from enemy fighters all the way to their targets and back. In order to provide this escort, we must design fighter aircraft with bomber range. Out of necessity these aircraft are larger, slower and less agile than light fighters, though they can carry significant armament.
15qruez.zh: 我们的轰炸机部队需要战斗机全程护航，往返目标途中都要抵御敌方战斗机。为提供这种护航，我们必须设计具有轰炸机航程的战斗机。这些飞机必然比轻型战斗机更大、更慢、更笨拙，但能够携带相当可观的武器。

1guvvkb.en: Early war experiences have shown that increased speed, armor and maneuverability are necessary for CAS aircraft survivability against enemy fighters and ground fire. This next generation of ground attack aircraft will also utilize larger bombs, cannons and machineguns to inflict greater damage to their targets.
1guvvkb.zh: 战争初期的经验表明，近距空中支援机若要在敌方战斗机与地面火力下生存，就必须提高速度、装甲与机动性。下一代对地攻击机还将使用更大的炸弹、机炮与机枪，以对目标造成更大破坏。

1x7vvl2.en: The pace of fighter advancements is astounding, and as such, we must continue to incorporate the technology as well as improve upon existing concepts. Our new fighter design must be capable of high speed, high performance at altitude and the best range possible. Additionally, it must be very well armed.
1x7vvl2.zh: 战斗机技术的进步速度令人惊叹，因此我们必须持续吸收新技术并改进现有理念。我们的新战斗机设计必须能够高速飞行、在高空保持优异性能，并拥有尽可能大的航程。此外，它还必须装备精良。

1f1zm18.en: While our previous generations of fighter plane have proven worthy, any advantage gained by a better design should be taken. This aircraft will be the pinnacle platform of piston-engined fighter that will have excellent power, high agility, deadly weaponry and good range.
1f1zm18.zh: 我们此前几代战斗机已被证明堪当重任，但更好的设计所能带来的任何优势都应加以利用。这款飞机将成为活塞发动机战斗机的巅峰之作，拥有出色的动力、高度的灵活性、致命的武器与良好的航程。

15d2eum.en: The ever increasing capability of target AA and enemy interceptors require further evolution of our CAS aircraft. The new design incorporates increased engine power, airframe improvements for increased diving capability and protection, as well as even greater payloads.
15d2eum.zh: 目标防空与敌方截击机的能力不断增强，要求我们的近距空中支援机进一步进化。新设计提升了发动机功率，改进机体以增强俯冲能力与防护，并搭载更大的载荷。

jbi42i.en: Our CAS doctrine requires an aircraft capable of precision surface attack. While these aircraft carry a lesser payload compared to our larger Tactical Bombers, they are capable of attacking and destroying small targets of opportunity through strafing and dive bombing.
jbi42i.zh: 我们的近距空中支援学说需要一种能够实施精确对地攻击的飞机。与更大的战术轰炸机相比，这些飞机携带的载荷较少，但能够通过扫射与俯冲轰炸攻击并摧毁稍纵即逝的小型目标。

142yn98.en: Though our heavy fighter force has shown adeptness in various roles, we must consider a new design that will enhance its ability relative to enemy fighters, as well as allow it to continue intercepting increasingly faster and better defended enemy bombers.
142yn98.zh: 尽管我们的重型战斗机部队已在多种任务中表现出色，但我们必须考虑一种新设计，以增强其相对敌方战斗机的能力，并使其能够继续拦截速度越来越快、防护越来越好的敌方轰炸机。

pdak9s.en: Without their mothership, the fighters are essentially stranded in the air, severely limiting their operational effectiveness. Strengthening the mothership's air wings is the most cost-effective strategy to enhance the survivability of the entire squadron.
pdak9s.zh: 没有母机，这些战斗机基本上就会滞留空中，作战效能大打折扣。加强母机的航空队，是提高整个中队生存能力最具性价比的策略。

1r4vv2d.en: Bombing has proven effective at reducing the enemy's capacity to wage war. More defensive weaponry and increased speed will allow a new design to avoid destruction, while increasing the payload and range will make it more effective.
1r4vv2d.zh: 轰炸已被证明能有效削弱敌人的作战能力。更多的自卫武器与更高的速度将使新设计免遭摧毁，而提高载荷与航程则会使其更加有效。

snpmct.en: Naval aviation will be vital in the coming decade to confront new developments in naval warfare, such as the increased importance of submarines. Seaplanes with capacity to work as dive bombers and recon vehicles will be of use.
snpmct.zh: 在未来十年里，海军航空兵对于应对海战的新发展（例如潜艇日益重要）将至关重要。能够充当俯冲轰炸机与侦察载具的水上飞机将大有用处。

12l2buv.en: Gathering intelligence on enemy troop movements and providing reports of enemy naval deployments has been the original mission for airplanes since their first deployment in the Great War, and is still an important mission.
12l2buv.zh: 自飞机在大战中首次投入使用以来，搜集敌方部队调动情报并提供敌方海军部署报告就是飞机的原始任务，如今仍是一项重要任务。

19nipav.en: It is widely believed that the next war will be won entirely by bombing the enemy to extinction. It is imperative that we begin designing our own bomber plane that is capable of carrying heavy payloads at adequate speed.
19nipav.zh: 人们普遍认为，下一场战争将完全依靠把敌人炸到覆灭而取胜。我们必须着手设计自己的轰炸机，使其能够以足够的速度携带沉重载荷。

oypwyw.en: While fighter aircraft underwent many changes through the Great War, and since, the bi-plane design is becoming obsolete. We must begin to translate civilian technological advances into military applications.
oypwyw.zh: 尽管战斗机在大战期间及此后经历了诸多变化，双翼机设计仍正变得过时。我们必须开始把民用技术的进步转化为军事应用。

1m3b1lc.en: Previous increases in speed pale in comparison to the introduction of the first jet fighters. While we have yet to learn how to best construct planes for these engines, regular fighter planes cannot compete.
1m3b1lc.zh: 与首批喷气式战斗机的问世相比，此前速度的提升都黯然失色。虽然我们尚未掌握为这类发动机打造飞机的最佳方式，但常规战斗机已无法与之抗衡。

srf4ia.en: Light airframes have been revolutionized with the introduction of radial engines, monoplane designs and all metal skin construction. This design is our attempt at creating our first modern fighter plane.
srf4ia.zh: 星形发动机、单翼设计与全金属蒙皮结构的引入，使轻型机体发生了革命性变化。这一设计是我们打造首款现代战斗机的尝试。

55vtan.en: The advent of jet fighters necessitates bombers that can outrun or at least match their speed. First-generation medium bombers and bomber-fighters equipped with jet engines will fill this role.
55vtan.zh: 喷气式战斗机的出现，要求轰炸机能够甩开它们，或至少与其速度相当。装备喷气发动机的第一代中型轰炸机与战斗轰炸机将承担这一角色。

5e3idh.en: By developing dedicated planes for aerial surveillance and long-range reconnaissance, we ensure that we gain and maintain an accurate picture of our opponent's intentions and capabilities.
5e3idh.zh: 通过研制专用的空中监视与远程侦察飞机，我们确保能够获得并保持对敌方意图与能力的准确掌握。

1cyyh8w.en: Medium bombers need to be versatile and fast, capable of fulfilling a range of roles. A twin-engined design, remaining relatively light, can continue to be of use for many years to come.
1cyyh8w.zh: 中型轰炸机需要多用途且速度快，能够胜任一系列任务。一种保持相对轻巧的双发设计，将在未来许多年里继续发挥作用。

13yoe05.en: Taking a page from the advancements in fighter planes, unconventional materials and shapes can make new designs some of the fastest and best performing twin-engine planes ever built.
13yoe05.zh: 借鉴战斗机领域的进步，采用非常规材料与外形，可以让新设计跻身有史以来建造过的最快、性能最好的双发飞机之列。

1i1ciiu.en: To avoid losses to enemy fighters and ground fire, our next design will fly at great altitude. It will be larger to carry both an enormous payload and more fuel, to increase range.
1i1ciiu.zh: 为避免被敌方战斗机与地面火力击落，我们的下一款设计将在极高空飞行。它的体积会更大，以同时携带巨大的载荷与更多燃油，从而提高航程。

g8puri.en: All-metal designs and powerful airbrakes allow for more complex naval aeronautics. The planes of the future will demand a larger crew to operate these advanced systems, however.
g8puri.zh: 全金属设计与强力减速板使更复杂的海军航空技术成为可能。不过，未来的飞机将需要更多的机组人员来操作这些先进系统。

1bjl13v.en: Multiple jet engines allow new designs unprecedented speed while maintaining a large payload and long range. These planes are built for a new era of weapons of mass destruction.
1bjl13v.zh: 多台喷气发动机使新设计获得前所未有的速度，同时保持巨大载荷与远航程。这些飞机是为大规模杀伤性武器的新时代而建造的。

eojhp7.en: Centrifugal jets use a single stage compressor to compress the intake air, before blasting it out to create thrust. This results in smaller, more easily maintained engines.
eojhp7.zh: 离心式喷气发动机使用单级压气机压缩进气，然后将其喷出以产生推力。这带来了更小、更易维护的发动机。

pmbuke.en: Aerial Hangars attached to the mothership allows us to fit even more miniature fighters onto the top of the aircraft, allowing for increased firepower and further reach.
pmbuke.zh: 挂载于母机上的空中机库，让我们能在飞机顶部搭载更多微型战斗机，从而增强火力并延伸作战范围。

18um3vc.en: With smaller fighters we will be able to carry more of them into battle without sacrificing much firepower, as well as reducing the weight of the Motherships load
18um3vc.zh: 使用更小的战斗机，我们就能在不牺牲太多火力的情况下携带更多飞机投入战斗，同时减轻母机的载荷重量

tgv4e7.en: Not content with speed, future jet bombers will set altitude and range records, delivering payloads and performing reconnaissance on intercontinental missions.
tgv4e7.zh: 未来的喷气式轰炸机不满足于速度，还将创下高度与航程纪录，在洲际任务中投放载荷并执行侦察。

so808e.en: Heavier designs of tactical bombers can extend range, payload and speed while maintaining the planes' capacity to perform a wide variety of missions.
so808e.zh: 更重型的战术轰炸机设计可以延长航程、增大载荷并提高速度，同时保持飞机执行多种任务的能力。

1go0ey3.en: New swept wing designs and lighter material choices will allow us to extend the range and speed of the revolutionary jet fighters even further.
1go0ey3.zh: 新的后掠翼设计与更轻的材料选择，将使我们能够进一步提高这场革命性喷气战斗机的航程与速度。

vf94yd.en: New engine technology and aerodynamically refined designs will boost the speed and diving attack capability of naval planes significantly.
vf94yd.zh: 新的发动机技术与空气动力学上的精细设计，将显著提升海军飞机的速度与俯冲攻击能力。

i3d05g.en: An improved close air support plane modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
i3d05g.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的改进型近距空中支援机。

16urb4m.en: An advanced close air support plane modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
16urb4m.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的先进近距空中支援机。

wgzw7h.en: An early close air support plane modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
wgzw7h.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的早期近距空中支援机。

3nlbb2.en: An improved naval bomber modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
3nlbb2.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的改进型海军轰炸机。

1qb2ojo.en: An advanced naval bomber modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
1qb2ojo.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的先进海军轰炸机。

b6urzp.en: An early naval bomber modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
b6urzp.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的早期海军轰炸机。

24wzkk.en: An improved fighter modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
24wzkk.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的改进型战斗机。

7i7s2a.en: An advanced fighter modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
7i7s2a.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的先进战斗机。

1en0kwt.en: An early fighter modified to launch from and land on aircraft carriers.
1en0kwt.zh: 经过改装、可从航空母舰起飞并降落的早期战斗机。

h813s1.en: Planes used to transport troops on paradrop missions.
h813s1.zh: 用于在伞降任务中运送部队的飞机。

e8df8p.zh: 舰载近距空中支援 III

19xq196.zh: 舰载近距空中支援 II

156kzhz.zh: 舰载近距空中支援 I

uq0fjj.en: Mechanized infantry is infantry equipped with armored personnel carriers (APCs) or infantry fighting vehicles (IFVs) for transport and combat. Mechanized infantry is distinguished from motorized infantry in that its vehicles provide a degree of protection from hostile fire, as opposed to soft-skinned wheeled vehicles (trucks or jeeps) for motorized infantry.
uq0fjj.zh: 机械化步兵是配备装甲运兵车（APC）或步兵战车（IFV）用于运输与作战的步兵。机械化步兵与摩托化步兵的区别在于：其载具能提供一定防护以抵御敌方火力，而摩托化步兵使用的是无装甲的轮式载具（卡车或吉普车）。

1d3ze1a.en: Multiple rocket launchers such as these deliver explosives to a target area more quickly than conventional artillery, but with lower accuracy and requiring a longer time to reload. Being mounted on trucks, this version is able to launch attacks and change positions before the enemy can return fire.
1d3ze1a.zh: 此类多管火箭炮向目标区域投放炸药的速度比常规火炮更快，但精度更低，且重新装填所需时间更长。由于安装在卡车上，这种型号能够在敌人还击之前发动攻击并转移阵地。

hr0125.en: Motorizing infantry is the first stage to mechanizing an army. Civilian trucks are readily adapted to military uses of transporting soldiers, towing guns, and carrying equipment and supplies. This greatly increases the strategic mobility of infantry units, which would otherwise rely on marching.
hr0125.zh: 步兵摩托化是军队机械化的第一步。民用卡车很容易改装用于军事用途：运送士兵、牵引火炮以及载运装备与补给。这极大地提高了步兵单位的战略机动性，否则他们只能依靠徒步行军。

cwbvl.en: Personal and crew served weapons for infantry as well as the various other bits of kit a soldier needs. Further Modernized to include personal Assault Rifles and anti-tank rockets. Improved availability of weapons previously distributed to a limited extent.
cwbvl.zh: 步兵使用的单兵武器与班组武器，以及士兵所需的各种其他装备。进一步现代化，加入单兵突击步枪与反坦克火箭。此前仅有限配发的武器如今供应更加充足。

12kkuth.en: Troops specializing in amphibious warfare are growing ever more indispensable. Improvised methods and equipment become things of the past as our naval infantry is supported by specialized landing craft and training.
12kkuth.zh: 专精两栖作战的部队正变得愈发不可或缺。随着我们的海军步兵获得专用登陆艇与专门训练的支持，临时拼凑的方法与装备已成为过去。

e1erqf.en: Learning to adapt paradrop operations according to weather, standardizing equipment such as jump boots and extended specialized training will minimize the confusion and risks involved in these dangerous missions.
e1erqf.zh: 学会根据天气调整伞降作战、统一跳伞靴等装备，并延长专门训练，将把这些危险任务中的混乱与风险降到最低。

1w6qwtm.en: Special forces are able to perform missions that ordinary soldiers can not. We need to expand the training program to get more of our soldiers qualified. Mutually exclusive with Advanced Special Forces Training.
1w6qwtm.zh: 特种部队能够执行普通士兵无法完成的任务。我们需要扩大训练计划，让更多士兵达到合格标准。与「高级特种部队训练」互斥。

5au031.en: Early infra-red scopes, although initially intended for use by snipers, had a limited vision range. As both the portability and vision improves, these devices can be used by more troops operating at night.
5au031.zh: 早期的红外瞄准镜最初是为狙击手设计的，视距有限。随着便携性与观测距离的改善，这些装置可以被更多在夜间作战的部队使用。

nk6xcz.en: Penal battalions provide an opportunity for convicted soldiers and officers of the Red Army to bleed for the motherland and redeem themselves for the shameful or dishonorable actions committed in the past.
nk6xcz.zh: 惩罚营为被定罪的红军士兵与军官提供了为祖国流血、洗刷过去可耻或不光彩行为的机会。

lt0qxk.en: Transitioning from small operations with only a few paratroopers to larger airborne divisions paves way for massive airborne landings, taking these forces beyond a novelty to a natural part of warfare.
lt0qxk.zh: 从仅有少数伞兵的小规模行动过渡到更大的空降师，为大规模空降登陆铺平了道路，使这些部队不再只是新奇事物，而成为战争中自然而然的一部分。

adssho.en: Being able to see the enemy without being seen is key to night operations. With the invention of infra-red technology, we can outfit our army with devices which, though unwieldy, make this possible.
adssho.zh: 能在不被发现的情况下看到敌人，是夜间作战的关键。随着红外技术的发明，我们可以为军队配备这样的装置——尽管笨重，却让这一切成为可能。

39yx6t.en: Combat in mountain ranges exposes troops to many perils, but sometimes cannot be avoided. We can minimize these risks by providing our soldiers with specialized training for this environment.
39yx6t.zh: 在山脉中作战会让部队面临诸多危险，但有时无法避免。通过为士兵提供针对这种环境的专门训练，我们可以把这些风险降到最低。

w44k09.en: Going beyond survival, our forces can be trained to use mountains to their advantage. With light equipment and mule transports, they can maneuver in this terrain better than other infantry.
w44k09.zh: 不止于求生，我们的部队还可以接受训练，学会利用山地取得优势。凭借轻型装备与骡马运输，他们在这类地形中的机动能力胜过其他步兵。

e0db6e.en: Personal and crew served weapons for infantry as well as the various other bits of kit a soldier needs. Modernized to include a great number of sub-machineguns and anti-tank rifles.
e0db6e.zh: 步兵使用的单兵武器与班组武器，以及士兵所需的各种其他装备。经过现代化，加入大量冲锋枪与反坦克步枪。

l2qwu3.en: Amphibious warfare requires constant innovation. Improved logistical support and portable harbors can enable our marines to perform landings that may otherwise have been impossible.
l2qwu3.zh: 两栖作战需要不断创新。改进的后勤支援与可移动港口能让我们的海军陆战队实施原本可能无法完成的登陆。

12rxf3p.en: Personal and crew served weapons for infantry as well as the various other bits of kit a soldier needs. Further modernized to include personal Assault Rifles and anti-tank rockets.
12rxf3p.zh: 步兵使用的单兵武器与班组武器，以及士兵所需的各种其他装备。进一步现代化，加入单兵突击步枪与反坦克火箭。

11b490i.en: With extensive training, we can ensure that our special forces will be able to perform above and beyond that of normal men. Mutually exclusive with Expanded Special Forces Program.
11b490i.zh: 通过大量训练，我们可以确保特种部队的表现远超普通士兵。与「扩大特种部队计划」互斥。

p4c5t6.en: During the Great War the armies starting using basic civilian trucks for transporting supplies and hauling equipment. These have since become an integral part of most armies
p4c5t6.zh: 大战期间，各国军队开始使用基本的民用卡车运送补给与牵引装备。此后它们已成为大多数军队不可或缺的一部分

107zx6n.en: By incorporating airborne forces into our army, we can make forced entries and position key troops in previously inaccessible areas, allowing for new tactical opportunities.
107zx6n.zh: 通过将空降部队纳入我们的军队，我们可以实施强行突入，并把关键部队部署到此前无法到达的地区，从而带来新的战术机会。

tvhn03.en: Reducing the amount of supporting arms in our infantry divisions makes them more flexible and gives them an edge in combat in restricted terrain like Cities and forests.
tvhn03.zh: 减少步兵师中支援火力的数量，能让它们更加灵活，并在城市与森林等受限地形作战中占据优势。

1w9uzl5.en: Preparing for the most arduous mountain missions in high altitudes and low temperatures will require extraordinary training and discipline from our mountain troops.
1w9uzl5.zh: 为在高海拔与低温环境下执行最艰苦的山地任务做准备，需要我们的山地部队接受非凡的训练并具备严明的纪律。

gdu2dd.en: We need to be able to fight in the harshest of environments. With the right training and equipment, our troops will be able to fight in the most extreme conditions.
gdu2dd.zh: 我们需要有能力在最恶劣的环境中作战。有了合适的训练与装备，我们的部队将能够在最极端的条件下战斗。

pw0evq.en: While maintaining and improving reliability of machine guns, we can also experiment with higher firing rates to ensure lethality of the constant stream of bullets.
pw0evq.zh: 在保持并提高机枪可靠性的同时，我们还可以试验更高的射速，以确保持续不断的弹流具有杀伤力。

ok6ntp.en: Our light mechanized units will come into contact with enemy tank forces at some point. Developing a special anti-tank variant would give them a fighting chance.
ok6ntp.zh: 我们的轻型机械化单位终将在某个时候与敌方坦克部队接触。为其研制一种专门的反坦克型号，能让它们有一战之力。

duyglf.en: Only the best of the best will become special forces. The soldiers that make it through the training will be stronger. faster, and fight harder than anyone else.
duyglf.zh: 只有精英中的精英才能成为特种部队。通过训练的士兵将更加强壮、更加迅捷，并且比任何人都更加奋勇作战。

1cm9i4f.en: Where previous armored cars were simply commercial models with thin steel plating, this model was designed from the ground up to carry armor and light armament.
1cm9i4f.zh: 此前的装甲车不过是在商用车型上加装薄钢板，而这一型号则是从零开始设计，以承载装甲与轻型武器。

f54zj5.en: Personal and crew served weapons for infantry as well as the various other bits of kit a soldier needs. Improved weapon models and more specialized equipment.
f54zj5.zh: 步兵使用的单兵武器与班组武器，以及士兵所需的各种其他装备。改进的武器型号与更专门的装备。

1rjfawx.en: The development of automatic weapons which combine the aspects of light and heavy machine guns allows versatility in how our infantry employ their equipment.
1rjfawx.zh: 结合轻机枪与重机枪特点的自动武器的发展，让我们步兵在使用装备时拥有更多样的方式。

epxzrx.en: Automatic weapons are becoming more portable. Submachine guns have already proven effective and the development of hand-held support weapons must continue.
epxzrx.zh: 自动武器正变得更加便携。冲锋枪已被证明行之有效，手持支援武器的研发也必须继续下去。

1occbw8.en: With the increased use of assault rifles, developing automatic weapons that can be used in any environment by all soldiers is a priority for a modern army.
1occbw8.zh: 随着突击步枪的使用日益增多，研制可供所有士兵在任何环境中使用的自动武器，是现代化军队的首要任务。

1pwa6y7.en: Our special forces will often fight behind enemy lines and in short supply. We need to train them to endure harsh weather and fight with limited supplies.
1pwa6y7.zh: 我们的特种部队常常要在敌后且补给短缺的情况下作战。我们需要训练他们忍受恶劣天气，并在补给有限的情况下战斗。

19pvqdy.en: Amphibious Tractors, or Amtracs, allow Marines to be landed on a beach under armored protection. However, this comes at the cost of poor fuel efficiency.
19pvqdy.zh: 两栖牵引车（即 Amtrac）能让海军陆战队在装甲防护下登陆海滩。但代价是燃油效率低下。

c4syml.en: Marines can be more than just amphibious infantry. In the future, our marine corps will be among the most disciplined and organized special forces.
c4syml.zh: 海军陆战队不只是两栖步兵。未来，我们的陆战队将成为纪律最严明、组织最完善的特种部队之一。

vro9fi.en: Unconventional fighting requires specialist training. We need to ensure that our troops are prepared and able to adapt to harsh conditions.
vro9fi.zh: 非常规作战需要专门训练。我们需要确保部队做好准备，并能够适应恶劣条件。

ttnmpg.en: Changes on the battlefield require a much heavier armament and thicker armor to defeat enemy light untis and survive to report back.
ttnmpg.zh: 战场上的变化要求配备重得多的武器与更厚的装甲，以击败敌方轻型单位并存活到归来报信。

1gfcegv.en: For infantry to effectively engage heavier armored units, high-explosive anti-tank weapons need to be made smaller and lighter.
1gfcegv.zh: 要让步兵有效对付装甲更厚的单位，榴弹式反坦克武器必须做得更小、更轻。

1amnpiv.en: These Amtracs feature several improvements over the base version, such as rear loading ramp for easier unloading on the beach.
1amnpiv.zh: 这些两栖牵引车相比基础型号有多项改进，例如便于在海滩卸货的尾部装卸跳板。

1yzyi4a.en: Arming our infantry with anti-tank rifles will allow them to take out lighter armored vehicles while maintaining mobility.
1yzyi4a.zh: 为步兵配备反坦克步枪，能让他们在保持机动性的同时摧毁较轻型装甲车辆。

1dk2tkc.en: Regular infantry with bicycles are more mobile than their marching counterparts, for a very modest price.
1dk2tkc.zh: 配备自行车的普通步兵比徒步行军的步兵机动性更强，而代价非常低廉。

sdytvw.en: Personal and crew served weapons for infantry as well as the various other bits of kit a soldier needs.
sdytvw.zh: 步兵使用的单兵武器与班组武器，以及士兵所需的各种其他装备。

8hi8vv.en: An improved internal layout and additional ammunition storage creates a more effective armored car.
8hi8vv.zh: 改进的内部布局与额外的弹药储存空间，造就了更高效的装甲车。

6g0sw9.en: Special training will allow our troops to better defend in mountainous terrain.
6g0sw9.zh: 专门训练将使我们的部队能更好地在山地地形中防御。

im4sz1.en: Basic infantryman equipment developed before and during the Great War.
im4sz1.zh: 大战之前及期间研制的基本步兵装备。

1ngco3x.en: Elephant mounted Infantry. More Expensive, but good against Infantry
1ngco3x.zh: 骑象步兵。造价更高，但对付步兵效果出色

1qvo647.en: Special training to make our soldiers effective in mountain ranges.
1qvo647.zh: 专门训练，使我们的士兵在山脉中作战得力。

1aw2seq.en: Camel mounted infantry. More expensive, but with good versatility.
1aw2seq.zh: 骑驼步兵。造价更高，但用途广泛。

17wcdbq.en: Special training to make our soldiers effective in the jungle.
17wcdbq.zh: 专门训练，使我们的士兵在丛林中作战得力。

w9l4va.en: ⟦0⟧ via Desert Camel Corps, The Tuz Gölü Training Facility, or the following events: ⟦1⟧
w9l4va.zh: ⟦0⟧ 通过「沙漠骆驼军团」、「图兹湖训练设施」，或以下事件：⟦1⟧

1wxkoxd.en: These screen grabs show how state supply (the only source of supply in this example) changes as Italian forces advance across the state of Matrouh. In the first screen grab, we see total state supply in Mersa Matruh is 2.75 (note that level of rounding for state supply is to one decimal place, even though two are displayed), then in the second it shows that after the Italian forces have 2 provinces, they have access to 22% of the state supply from base, infrastructure and population, as they now control 2 of the 9 provinces in the state. In the third screen grab, the Italians now have four provinces and the victory point at Marsa Matruh, giving them 44% (4 as a proportion of the 9 provinces in the state) of the base, infrastructure and population supply, and all of the 0.25 state supply provided by the single VP at Marsa Matruh.
1wxkoxd.zh: 这些截图展示了意大利军队推进穿越马特鲁州时，州补给（本例中唯一的补给来源）如何变化。在第一张截图中，我们看到马特萨马特鲁的州补给总量为 2.75（注意州补给的取整位数为一位小数，尽管显示的是两位），随后第二张显示，意大利军队占领 2 个省份后，可以获得基础、基础设施和人口所提供的州补给的 22%，因为他们现在控制了该州 9 个省份中的 2 个。在第三张截图中，意大利人现在拥有四个省份以及马萨马特鲁的胜利点，这使他们获得基础、基础设施和人口补给的 44%（4 占该州 9 个省份的比例），以及马萨马特鲁单个胜利点提供的全部 0.25 州补给。

1t7geys.en: The screengrabs show a number of different situations for units in the “Northern Front” air region. Going from from left to right, in the first a division is in a province with access to some state supply, but no hub supply, and so is “topped up” by air supply. In the second, two divisions are fully covered by state and hub supply, and so don’t draw on any air supply. In the third, the province has nowhere near enough state supply (and no hub supply at all), and air supply is essential to these units being decently supplied. In the fourth, we see that the air wing flying the supply mission, that is flying from within the air zone, and drawing hub and state supply to provide the air supply elsewhere in the zone.
1t7geys.zh: 这些截图展示了「北方前线」空中区域内单位的多种不同情况。从左到右看，第一张中一个师所在的省份可以获得一些州补给，但没有补给中心补给，因此靠空运补给「补足」。第二张中，两个师完全由州补给和补给中心补给覆盖，因此不消耗任何空运补给。第三张中，该省份的州补给远远不够（而且完全没有补给中心补给），空运补给对这些单位获得像样的补给至关重要。第四张中，我们看到执行补给任务的航空队从该空中区域内起飞，并汲取补给中心补给和州补给，为该区域其他地方提供空运补给。

ya3j9y.en: On the left-hand side, the supply hub is still providing supply to allies. By clicking on the button with the blue flag on it, the situation changes to that on the right, where allies can no longer draw supply from the hub. Notice that there’s a small “do not enter” (red circle with a line through it) on the actual supply hub icon as well. Bear in mind that allied supply has to be turned off hub-by-hub – for Britain to completely deny allied supply in Dover, for example, supply needs to be turned off at the hubs in London, Portsmouth and the nearby port to the north.
ya3j9y.zh: 在左侧，补给中心仍在向盟国提供补给。点击带有蓝旗的按钮后，情况就变成右侧的样子，盟国无法再从该补给中心获取补给。请注意，补给中心图标本身也会出现一个小小的「禁止进入」标志（带斜杠的红色圆圈）。请记住，盟国补给必须逐个补给中心关闭——例如，英国要想在多佛完全禁止盟国补给，就需要关闭伦敦、朴茨茅斯以及北边附近港口的补给中心。

194l2cd.en: In the first screengrab, the logistics tooltip indicates there are only 58% of the trains required. In the second screengrab, of the Minsk supply hub tooltip, it shows that this results in only 6 of the 11 required trains being available. In the third screengrab, the divisions drawing on hub supply are only partially supplied because of this (note that their overall level of supply is higher than might be expected by the train shortfall because they are also drawing on state supply – more on that below).
194l2cd.zh: 在第一张截图中，后勤提示框显示列车数量仅为需求量的 58%。在第二张截图中，明斯克补给中心的提示框显示，这导致所需的 11 列列车中只有 6 列可用。在第三张截图中，依赖补给中心补给的师因此只能获得部分补给（注意，它们的总体补给水平高于列车短缺所预期的水平，因为它们还从州补给中获取补给——详见下文）。

1fazpmv.en: Here we see the 2 TrAD Air Wing, comprised of 40 transport aircraft, assigned to air supply in the Northern Front air region. While the range of the transport aircraft does not cover the whole region, the whole region will still receive access to the air supply from this air wing. However, because the transport aircraft cannot cover the whole region, they do receive a penalty to mission efficiency, which affects how much air supply they can provide (and how much supply they require as well).
1fazpmv.zh: 这里我们看到第 2 运输航空队，由 40 架运输机组成，被分配在北方前线空中区域执行空运补给。虽然运输机的航程无法覆盖整个区域，但整个区域仍可获得该航空队提供的空运补给。不过，由于运输机无法覆盖整个区域，它们会受到任务效率惩罚，这会影响它们能提供的空运补给量（以及它们所需的补给量）。

48ni4d.en: Around Moscow the well-supplied provinces are bright blue, while further away they become darker blue. Some border provinces are undersupplied, such as the one highlighted, which has no remaining supply in the province, and is not able to fully supply the units stationed there, as indicated by its bright orange color. The purple provinces have low or no available supply, but do not have units stationed on them.
48ni4d.zh: 在莫斯科周边，补给充足的省份呈亮蓝色，越远颜色越深。一些边境省份补给不足，例如高亮显示的那个，该省份已无剩余补给，无法为驻扎在那里的单位提供充足补给，其亮橙色即表示这一点。紫色省份的可用补给很低或为零，但没有单位驻扎。

1dncise.en: Look at the “Supply from hubs” value in this sequence of screen grabs to get an idea of the diminishing value of supply from the hub, as distance increases. Note that the state referred to in the tooltip is the state the province is in, not the state containing the hub where the supply is coming from (the furthest-right tooltip is still drawing its supply from the hub in Akhtubinsk).
1dncise.zh: 观察这组截图中「来自补给中心的补给」数值，可以了解随着距离增加，来自补给中心的补给如何递减。请注意，提示框中提到的州是该省份所在的州，而不是补给来源的补给中心所在的州（最右侧的提示框仍然是从阿赫图宾斯克的补给中心获取补给）。

quqh5h.en: This collection of screen grabs shows a number of units drawing supply from the state of Murmansk at the same point in time. Note that ships drawing from the port still consume state supply, as do aircraft on the airfield. Note that the armored division within range of the hub is drawing the same amount of state supply as the armored division outside of the hub’s range.
quqh5h.zh: 这组截图展示了同一时间点多个单位从摩尔曼斯克州获取补给的情况。请注意，从港口获取补给的舰船仍会消耗州补给，机场上的飞机也是如此。请注意，处于补给中心范围内的装甲师与处于补给中心范围外的装甲师消耗的州补给量相同。

1e3y02c.en: In this example, the troops at Tiraspol, to the north-west of Odessa, aren’t fully supplied. While the level of supply isn’t critical, one way to improve the level of supply would be to increase the level of motorization of the army (is currently set to “not motorized”, as indicated by the “horse” highlighted by a white ellipse and arrow in this screenshot).
1e3y02c.zh: 在本例中，位于敖德萨西北方蒂拉斯波尔的部队补给不足。虽然补给水平还不算危急，但改善补给水平的一个办法是提高该集团军的摩托化程度（当前设置为「未摩托化」，如本截图中白色椭圆和箭头高亮显示的「马」图标所示）。

fcnukl.en: If we now move in a sizeable force to protect against the border with Italian Libya, the same province that previously had 2.75 supply available now has very little (0.12), because the supply available in the state has been distributed between all of the divisions in that state, leaving only 32% of the division in that province’s requirements.
fcnukl.zh: 如果我们现在调动一支可观的部队去防守与意属利比亚的边境，那么之前有 2.75 可用补给的同一个省份现在只剩下很少（0.12），因为该州可用的补给已在州内所有师之间分配，该省份的师只能满足其需求的 32%。

1qwwxjh.en: Improving the level of infrastructure in the state of Arkhangelsk improves the level of hub supply provided at the airbase to the south of the hub. Note that the overall supply in the province increases by significantly more, because infrastructure has both a hub supply range and a state supply effect – more on state supply below.
1qwwxjh.zh: 提高阿尔汉格尔斯克州的基础设施等级，可以提升补给中心南侧空军基地所提供的补给中心补给水平。请注意，该省份的总体补给增加幅度要大得多，因为基础设施同时具有补给中心补给范围和州补给效果——州补给的详情见下文。

1lurold.en: In the top screenshot, 100 Polish CAS have been attacking the logistics of Belarus for a week, against a Soviet logistics network that only had unarmored trains. In the bottom screenshot, the same situation has taken place but the Soviet trains have been armored. Note the significant reduction in the number of trains destroyed.
1lurold.zh: 在上方截图中，100 架波兰近距空中支援飞机对白俄罗斯的后勤持续攻击了一周，而苏联后勤网络中只有非装甲列车。在下方截图中，情况相同，但苏联列车已加装装甲。请注意被摧毁列车数量的显著减少。

1vh0eo2.en: In the screengrab on the left, the 53⟦0⟧ (Welsh) Infantry Division is at a very low supply status, and it’s going to have to wait nearly a month to be brought back up to strength. In the screengrab on the right, the division has moved into a better-supplied province, and the replenishment is going to happen much sooner.
1vh0eo2.zh: 在左侧截图中，第 53⟦0⟧（威尔士）步兵师处于极低的补给状态，需要等待近一个月才能恢复到满编。在右侧截图中，该师已转移到补给更好的省份，补充将会快得多。

wgst2f.en: The “2” between Lipetsk and Tambov highlighted here, indicates that the level of rail connection between the two supply hubs is level 2. Click on this two with the “rail” tool in the production interface selected, and construction orders will be placed to increase the level of the rail connection between the two hubs.
wgst2f.zh: 这里高亮显示的利佩茨克与坦波夫之间的「2」，表示两个补给中心之间的铁路连接等级为 2 级。在生产界面选中「铁路」工具后点击这个 2，就会下达建造订单，提高两个补给中心之间的铁路连接等级。

r5kc3t.en: Here, Japan selects a supply hub for construction, which they then place it in a province where it will have a useful distribution. Bear in mind supply hub range is by province, not by area, so all else being equal supply will flow from a hub through two large provinces just as well as it will through two small ones.
r5kc3t.zh: 这里，日本选择建造一个补给中心，然后将其放置在能够有效分配补给的省份。请记住，补给中心的范围按省份计算，而不是按地区计算，因此在其他条件相同的情况下，补给从一个补给中心流经两个大省份与流经两个小省份的效果一样好。

hxmdgu.en: To see how much state supply is available, hover over a province in supply map mode to bring up the province supply tooltip. In this province, we can see there is 0.90 state supply from level 3 infrastructure, 0.14 supply from 831,140 population, and 0.25 from the level 1 victory point in Novgorod.
hxmdgu.zh: 要查看可用州补给有多少，在补给地图模式下将鼠标悬停在省份上，即可调出省份补给提示框。在这个省份中，我们可以看到有 0.90 州补给来自 3 级基础设施，0.14 补给来自 831,140 人口，0.25 来自诺夫哥罗德的 1 级胜利点。

11olc6h.en: In these two screengrabs, the situations are identical except that the British (green) fleet on the left-hand side is at 57% supply, and the British fleet on the right hand side is at 76% supply. Note (as highlighted) that the detection chance has increased with the greater level of supply.
11olc6h.zh: 在这两张截图中，情况完全相同，只是左侧的英国（绿色）舰队补给为 57%，右侧的英国舰队补给为 76%。请注意（如高亮所示），随着补给水平提高，被发现概率也随之增加。

1bfju2s.en: Be mindful that even after the stopwatch has been removed from the railroads, there may be a wait until the supply hub is available, as there is no indicator for the conversion of the railroad in the province containing the hub (but this still needs to convert before the hub can be used).
1bfju2s.zh: 请注意，即使铁路上的秒表图标已经消失，补给中心可能仍需等待一段时间才能使用，因为包含补给中心的省份中的铁路转换没有指示器（但该铁路仍必须先完成转换，补给中心才能使用）。

1mc6jb9.en: The stopwatch symbol above a grey railroad indicates a railroad being converted. If you hover over the stopwatch, a tooltip will indicate how long is remaining for the conversion. Note that this will reset back to 10 days if another province on the path towards a supply hub is captured.
1mc6jb9.zh: 灰色铁路上方的秒表符号表示铁路正在转换。如果将鼠标悬停在秒表上，提示框会显示转换剩余所需的时间。请注意，如果通往补给中心路径上的另一个省份被占领，时间会重置为 10 天。

734s4p.en: To find out the level of the rail connection between a hub and the capital, hover over the hub in the supply map mode, and see what the tooltip says about the bottleneck. In this case, Akhtubinsk is limited by its railway connection only being level 2, for the entire path from Moscow.
734s4p.zh: 要了解补给中心与首都之间的铁路连接等级，在补给地图模式下将鼠标悬停在补给中心上，查看提示框中关于瓶颈的说明。在本例中，阿赫图宾斯克受限于其铁路连接从莫斯科起整条线路都只有 2 级。

1pedyb.en: Observe the changing icons as the level of motorization of the Odessa supply hub (port) is increased. As per the far-right image, as long as a hub is motorized, it will have an icon of one or two trucks to indicate this (the number of trucks indicating the level of motorization).
1pedyb.zh: 观察随着敖德萨补给中心（港口）的摩托化等级提高，图标如何变化。如最右侧图片所示，只要补给中心已摩托化，其图标上就会显示一辆或两辆卡车来表示这一点（卡车数量表示摩托化等级）。

jplyga.en: This tooltip shows that there is 2.75 supply remaining in the province. Look closely, however, and notice that it’s all due to state supply – if that supply is used up elsewhere (e.g. once units have moved into the state), there will be a lot less actual supply in that province.
jplyga.zh: 这个提示框显示该省份还剩余 2.75 补给。但仔细观察会发现，这些全部来自州补给——如果这些补给在其他地方被用完（例如单位进入该州后），该省份的实际补给就会少得多。

1gjqppr.en: The army has now selected the first level of motorization, again highlighted by a white ellipse and arrow), and the supply situation for the troops at Tiraspol has improved considerably. Also note the small grey truck that is now part of the icon for the Odessa supply hub.
1gjqppr.zh: 该集团军现在选择了第一级摩托化（同样由白色椭圆和箭头高亮显示），蒂拉斯波尔部队的补给状况已大幅改善。另请注意，敖德萨补给中心的图标中现在多了一辆灰色小卡车。

1syr5vn.en: Here we see the supply footprint of the Soviet 72ya Div. Note that the base supply cost (0.77) is a product of its various battalions and support companies, but that it’s been modified up by a blizzard, and down by the supply skills of the army and army group commanders.
1syr5vn.zh: 这里我们看到苏联第 72 师的补给占用。请注意，基础补给消耗（0.77）由其各个营和支援连决定，但被暴风雪上调，又被集团军和集团军群指挥官的补给技能下调。

1kkny4e.en: Air supply is shown under the “Supply from State” heading in the province supply tooltip, but like state supply, the amount shown is the total available to the whole of the air region. In this case, air supply missions are providing 7.28 air supply to the whole region.
1kkny4e.zh: 空运补给显示在省份补给提示框的「来自州的补给」标题下，但与州补给一样，所示的量是整个空中区域可用的总量。在本例中，空运补给任务为整个区域提供 7.28 空运补给。

ziwloc.en: This series of screengrabs shows the impact on a province on the Soviet border with Finland of incrementally increasing the level of rail connection to the hub from 1 (far-left) through to five (far right) – note the weather is clear, and the hub is not motorized.
ziwloc.zh: 这组截图展示了将通往补给中心的铁路连接等级从 1 级（最左侧）逐步提高到 5 级（最右侧）对苏联与芬兰边境一个省份的影响——注意天气为晴朗，且补给中心未摩托化。

1x0xni2.en: The army has now selected the second level of motorization, again highlighted by a white ellipse and arrow), and troops at Tiraspol are now fully supplied. Also note that the grey “truck” icon that is part of the Odessa supply hub icon now has two trucks in it.
1x0xni2.zh: 该集团军现在选择了第二级摩托化（同样由白色椭圆和箭头高亮显示），蒂拉斯波尔的部队现在补给充足。另请注意，敖德萨补给中心图标中的灰色「卡车」图标现在显示两辆卡车。

1m7ka8u.en: Here, the “upgrade rail connection to capital” has been pressed for Akhtubinsk – see the construction orders in the construction build queue, as well as the “under construction” icon on the stretches of railway being upgraded in the supply map mode.
1m7ka8u.zh: 这里，已为阿赫图宾斯克按下「升级通往首都的铁路连接」——可以看到建造队列中的建造订单，以及补给地图模式下正在升级的铁路路段上的「建造中」图标。

b1xrs0.en: A general with the “Amphibious” trait can give marine divisions a very helpful extra 240 hours (more or less, depending on the division’s circumstances) of stored supply. Note that it can take some time to build up to this level of stored supply.
b1xrs0.zh: 拥有「两栖」特质的将领可以给海军陆战师额外 240 小时（大致如此，取决于该师的具体情况）的储备补给，非常有帮助。请注意，积累到这个储备补给水平需要一些时间。

1ljm33j.en: Two of the special force technologies can increase supply grace for special forces divisions. The final tech in the tree increases the stored supply in special forces divisions by roughly (it may vary depending on actual conditions) 48 hours.
1ljm33j.zh: 有两项特种部队科技可以提高特种部队师的补给宽限期。该科技树中的最后一项科技可将特种部队师的储备补给提高大约（实际条件下可能有所差异）48 小时。

bvlkl2.en: Here, Japan selects “railways” in the construction interface, and the clicks on the province to the south-west of where the new supply hub is building, and then clicks on the province containing the supply hub that’s being built.
bvlkl2.zh: 这里，日本在建造界面中选择「铁路」，然后点击新补给中心建造位置西南方的省份，再点击包含正在建造的补给中心的省份。

gg5sva.en: On the left, the US divisions in Dover only have access to hub supply, while on the right, the British divisions there have access to both hub supply and state supply, and so are able to maintain a higher supply state.
gg5sva.zh: 在左侧，多佛的美国师只能获得补给中心补给，而在右侧，那里的英国师既能获得补给中心补给，也能获得州补给，因此能够维持更高的补给状态。

pjk7nm.en: There is (understandably) no conversion time for rivers – so supply hubs that can connect to your supply network by a river that you control (to another hub, not just a railroad) will provide hub supply instantly.
pjk7nm.zh: 河流（可以理解地）没有转换时间——因此，能够通过你控制的河流接入你的补给网络（连接到另一个补给中心，而不仅仅是铁路）的补给中心，会立即提供补给中心补给。

nm4vi5.en: Here, the supply hub button has been pressed, bringing up the three icons – the one in the middle, highlighted by the arrow, will put in construction orders to upgrade the rail connection to the capital.
nm4vi5.zh: 这里，已按下补给中心按钮，弹出三个图标——箭头高亮的中间那个会下达建造订单，升级通往首都的铁路连接。

1xvyjlf.en: Here the 2 TrAD air wing finds itself in rainy weather (-10% mission efficiency) and with 15% of its aircraft disrupted, dropping the supplies provided through air supply from 7.28 down to 6.2.
1xvyjlf.zh: 这里，第 2 运输航空队遇上雨天天气（-10% 任务效率），且 15% 的飞机被扰乱，使通过空运补给提供的补给从 7.28 降至 6.2。

95n76h.en: Hovering over the port on the island to the South-East of the Arabian Peninsula also brings up arrows to ships supplied by that port, as well as a tooltip containing much useful information.
95n76h.zh: 将鼠标悬停在阿拉伯半岛东南方岛屿上的港口，也会显示指向由该港口补给的舰船的箭头，以及一个包含许多有用信息的提示框。

1xzotzo.en: Bringing up the tooltip for the supply hub of Velikiye Luki highlights in red the rail connection to the capital, while the tooltip provides a range of information on the nature of the hub.
1xzotzo.zh: 调出大卢基补给中心的提示框，会以红色高亮显示通往首都的铁路连接，同时提示框会提供关于该补给中心性质的一系列信息。

vog94a.en: Here, the 27ya Division is in a poor state, with just 10% supply status (and only 9% stored supply, which will increase to 10% as long as the province supply for the division doesn’t drop).
vog94a.zh: 这里，第 27 师状况很差，补给状态仅 10%（储备补给只有 9%，只要该师的省份补给不下降，就会增加到 10%）。

1khkmgv.en: The impact of the 27ya Division’s low supply state significantly reduces its movement speed – if it wasn’t for the base game speed of 1km/hr, the speed of the division would be even lower.
1khkmgv.zh: 第 27 师低补给状态的影响会显著降低其移动速度——如果不是游戏基础速度为 1 公里/小时，该师的速度还会更低。

4ykml7.en: Due to some rather questionable British army deployment orders, the supply to the airbase in South-West England is only sufficient to give 72% supply to the air wing operating from there.
4ykml7.zh: 由于英国陆军一些相当可疑的部署命令，英格兰西南部空军基地的补给仅足以为从那里运作的航空队提供 72% 的补给。

1vwno7b.en: Supply-049 – Here, the US task force and the US divisions in Dover draw supply from the British hub, as does the British task force there and a few other British divisions off-screen.
1vwno7b.zh: Supply-049——这里，美国特混舰队和多佛的美国师从英国补给中心获取补给，那里的英国特混舰队以及屏幕外的一些其他英国师也是如此。

283zzx.en: Here, the somewhat undersupplied British attack the very undersupplied Italians – note the impact on attack and breakthrough/defense of the units on both sides of the combat.
283zzx.zh: 这里，补给有些不足的英国进攻补给严重不足的意大利——注意这对战斗双方单位的攻击和突破/防御的影响。

wlz8jy.en: The research options for both the war austerity train, and the armored train, can be found at the bottom of the “Support Companies” tab, as highlighted in this screenshot.
wlz8jy.zh: 战时紧缩列车和装甲列车的研究选项都可以在「支援连」标签页的底部找到，如本截图高亮所示。

1gsb0g.en: While Rokossovky’s army has full motorization toggled, because of the shortage of trucks (note the tooltip), the troops at Tiraspol are not fully supplied.
1gsb0g.zh: 虽然罗科索夫斯基的集团军已切换为完全摩托化，但由于卡车短缺（见提示框），蒂拉斯波尔的部队补给并不充足。

180f2ed.en: Looking at the tooltip for the air unit from the example above, we can see that the impact of being at 72% supply is a 28% penalty on mission efficiency.
180f2ed.zh: 查看上述示例中空军单位的提示框，我们可以看到补给为 72% 带来的影响是 28% 的任务效率惩罚。

1kblnve.en: The two crates in the map mode selection area in the bottom-right of the screen indicate the supply map mode.
1kblnve.zh: 屏幕右下角地图模式选择区域中的两个板条箱图标表示补给地图模式。

11zdebw.en: Here the French 25⟦0⟧ Infantry Division has accumulated its full amount of stored supply.
11zdebw.zh: 这里，法国第 25⟦0⟧步兵师已积累满全部储备补给。

12nhctv.en: Note how the number of trains increases as the hub supply use goes up.
12nhctv.zh: 注意列车数量如何随着补给中心补给使用量的增加而增加。

11qj071.en: Combining anti-ship and anti-air guns in a single mount allows for more flexibility and saves weight. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. These modules also increase Anti-Air Attack. Mounting a Secondary Battery Module gives a Cruiser, Carrier, or Heavy Ship a small amount of Light Gun Attack and allows it to engage a second target.
11qj071.zh: 将反舰炮与防空炮整合到同一座炮架上，可提供更大的灵活性并减轻重量。安装此模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。这些模块还会提高防空攻击。安装副炮组模块可为巡洋舰、航空母舰或重型舰船提供少量轻型火炮攻击，并使其能够攻击第二个目标。

17vapo9.en: Powered fully enclosed Twin gun mounts greatly increase firepower and protection while saving weight. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. These modules also increase Anti-Air Attack. Mounting a Secondary Battery Module gives a Cruiser, Carrier, or Heavy Ship a small amount of Light Gun Attack and allows it to engage a second target.
17vapo9.zh: 动力驱动的全封闭双联装炮架在减轻重量的同时，大幅提升火力与防护。安装此模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。这些模块还会提高防空攻击。安装副炮组模块可为巡洋舰、航空母舰或重型舰船提供少量轻型火炮攻击，并使其能够攻击第二个目标。

6p8tt2.en: By integrating power loading and remote power control, modern cruisers can reach rates of fire and accuracy that was hitherto considered impossible. Mounting a Light Medium Battery module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. Mounting a Medium Battery module increases Heavy Gun Attack, which helps with engaging enemy Capital Ships.
6p8tt2.zh: 通过整合动力装填与远程动力控制，现代巡洋舰能够达到此前被认为不可能实现的射速与精度。安装轻型中型火炮组模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。安装中型火炮组模块可提高重型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方主力舰。

1wvhry8.en: Automated Rapid fire enclosed gun mounts greatly increase firepower. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. These modules also increase Anti-Air Attack. Mounting a Secondary Battery Module gives a Cruiser, Carrier, or Heavy Ship a small amount of Light Gun Attack and allows it to engage a second target.
1wvhry8.zh: 自动化速射封闭式炮架大幅提升火力。安装此模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。这些模块还会提高防空攻击。安装副炮组模块可为巡洋舰、航空母舰或重型舰船提供少量轻型火炮攻击，并使其能够攻击第二个目标。

tny4h3.en: An improved turret layout allows faster loading while better armor improves survivability. Mounting a Light Medium Battery module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. Mounting a Medium Battery module increases Heavy Gun Attack, which helps with engaging enemy Capital Ships.
tny4h3.zh: 改进的炮塔布局可加快装填速度，更好的装甲则提升生存能力。安装轻型中型火炮组模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。安装中型火炮组模块可提高重型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方主力舰。

rynp.en: A powered turret with two or three guns of medium caliber for use on cruisers. Mounting a Light Medium Battery module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. Mounting a Medium Battery module increases Heavy Gun Attack, which helps with engaging enemy Capital Ships.
rynp.zh: 用于巡洋舰的带动力炮塔，装有两到三门中口径火炮。安装轻型中型火炮组模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。安装中型火炮组模块可提高重型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方主力舰。

1eba4fi.en: Improved Recoil Reduction Mechanisms and delay coils reduce interference of shells in flight and dramatically increase accuracy. Mounting a Heavy Battery module increases a ship's Heavy Gun Attack, improving performance against enemy Capital Ships.
1eba4fi.zh: 改进的制退机构与延迟线圈可减少炮弹在飞行中的相互干扰，并大幅提高精度。安装重型火炮组模块可提高舰船的重型火炮攻击，提升对抗敌方主力舰的表现。

1coi1dx.en: A self-propelled weapon with an explosive warhead that runs on a pre-determined course until it hits the target below the waterline. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
1coi1dx.zh: 一种自带动力的武器，装有爆炸战斗部，沿预定航向航行，直至命中水线以下的目标。在轻型舰船或巡洋舰上安装此模块，可使其对敌方主力舰造成重大伤害。

15224n9.en: Automatic loading Rapid fire Medium enclosed gun Batteries greatly increase firepower. Mounting a Light Medium Battery increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. This module also increases Anti-Air Attack.
15224n9.zh: 自动装填的速射中型封闭式炮组大幅提升火力。安装轻型中型火炮组可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。此模块还会提高防空攻击。

7n36d4.en: A new detonator detects the shift in the earth's magnetic field when the torpedo passes under the target. An explosion directly under a ship causes much more damage and often breaks the keel of the target, sinking it instantly.
7n36d4.zh: 新型引信能在鱼雷从目标下方通过时侦测地球磁场的变化。在舰船正下方爆炸会造成大得多的伤害，常常直接折断目标龙骨，使其瞬间沉没。

1fn3o7a.en: Power Rammers increase the loading speed of heavy guns while automatic flash-tight doors improve safety. Mounting a Heavy Battery module increases a ship's Heavy Gun Attack, improving performance against enemy Capital Ships.
1fn3o7a.zh: 动力推弹机可提高重型火炮的装填速度，自动防焰门则提升安全性。安装重型火炮组模块可提高舰船的重型火炮攻击，提升对抗敌方主力舰的表现。

3zn4de.en: Instead of leaving an easily-detected trail of bubbles, a torpedo with an electrical engine remains practically invisible until it hits. This also means that there is no trail leading back to the launching submarine.
3zn4de.zh: 电动鱼雷不会留下容易被发现的气泡尾迹，在命中之前几乎无法被察觉。这也意味着没有尾迹会暴露发射它的潜艇。

1gbc78m.en: Instead of firing over the target and losing track of the impacts behind the enemy ship, shots are deliberately dropped short of the target and the distance between impact and target measured to determine the range.
1gbc78m.zh: 不再越过目标射击、以致看不清落在敌舰后方的弹着点，而是故意将炮弹打在目标前方，通过测量弹着点与目标之间的距离来确定距离。

hp333g.en: A closed, powered mount for a small-caliber gun gives the crew some protection from the elements and shell splinters. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships.
hp333g.zh: 小口径火炮的封闭式动力炮架可为炮组人员提供一定的防风防雨和防弹片保护。安装此模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。

6xotjz.en: Stronger motors allow more tubes to be installed in a single mount and be trained on target faster. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
6xotjz.zh: 更强的电动机允许在同一座炮架上安装更多发射管，并能更快地转向目标。在轻型舰船或巡洋舰上安装此模块，可使其对敌方主力舰造成重大伤害。

ovf5f8.en: Adding small color packages to the shells when they are fired colors the impacts around the target and allows multiple ships to engage the same target without being confused by each other's impacts.
ovf5f8.zh: 在发射时为炮弹加入少量染色剂，可使目标周围的弹着点带上颜色，让多艘舰船能够攻击同一目标而不会被彼此的弹着点弄混。

1aecqvd.en: Powerful compressed air charges allow heavier torpedoes to be launched at higher speeds. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
1aecqvd.zh: 强力的压缩空气装药使更重的鱼雷能以更高速度发射。在轻型舰船或巡洋舰上安装此模块，可使其对敌方主力舰造成重大伤害。

ib7czp.en: An advanced twin mount brings significantly more firepower to bear under armored protection. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships.
ib7czp.zh: 先进的双联装炮架能在装甲防护下发挥出显著更强的火力。安装此模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。

15xfz5e.en: Larger diameter tubes allow for bigger torpedoes with heavier warheads. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
15xfz5e.zh: 更大直径的发射管可容纳战斗部更重的更大鱼雷。在轻型舰船或巡洋舰上安装此模块，可使其对敌方主力舰造成重大伤害。

8vvd4q.en: A gigantic turret housing massive guns under heavy armor. Mounting a Heavy Battery module increases a ship's Heavy Gun Attack, improving performance against enemy Capital Ships.
8vvd4q.zh: 巨大的炮塔，在厚重装甲下容纳巨型火炮。安装重型火炮组模块可提高舰船的重型火炮攻击，提升对抗敌方主力舰的表现。

1oxg71s.en: An open, powered mount for a small-caliber gun for use on smaller ships. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships.
1oxg71s.zh: 用于较小舰船的小口径火炮敞开式动力炮架。安装此模块可提高轻型火炮攻击，有助于打击敌方屏卫舰。

kwdymc.en: A compromise between armor-piercing performance and explosive power, this shell does significantly more damage after punching through the weak armor of light ships.
kwdymc.zh: 这种炮弹在穿甲性能与爆炸威力之间取得折中，在击穿轻型舰船薄弱装甲后能造成显著更大的伤害。

13cgj8o.en: With heavy pumps usually dependent on the main engines for power, a single and fairly light hit in the engine room may render the ship unable to stay afloat.
13cgj8o.zh: 由于重型水泵通常依赖主机提供动力，轮机舱挨上哪怕一次相当轻的命中，就可能使舰船无法保持浮力。

nxw3o2.en: Standardized Tenshioned Replenishment Alongside Method or STREAM is a further evolution of ensuring a steady resupply of our long range naval operations
nxw3o2.zh: 标准化张力式海上并靠补给法（Standardized Tenshioned Replenishment Alongside Method，简称 STREAM）是确保我方远洋海军行动获得稳定补给的进一步演进。

czploc.en: By installing powerful electro-magnetic coils, a ship's magentic signature can be dramatically reduced, making it far less vulnerable to magnetic mines.
czploc.zh: 通过安装强力电磁线圈，可大幅降低舰船的磁信号特征，使其远不容易受到磁性水雷的威胁。

19xnhzb.en: By installing special equipment to hold and release mines, a specially-designed submarine can deploy mines while submerged and, hopefully, undetected.
19xnhzb.zh: 通过安装用于容纳和释放水雷的特殊设备，专门设计的潜艇可以在潜航状态下布雷，且有望不被发现。

1rrtupb.en: Every member of a ship's crew, from the Captain down to the simple sailor, must be able to help in containing and fighting fires onboard the ship.
1rrtupb.zh: 舰上每一名船员，从舰长到普通水兵，都必须能够协助控制和扑灭舰上火灾。

1ea1zk6.en: By separating the main water lines around the ship, the probability of a hit rendering the ship completely unable to fight fires is much reduced.
1ea1zk6.zh: 通过将舰上各主水管线路分开布置，一次命中就使舰船完全丧失灭火能力的概率大大降低。

1e404in.en: By fitting the mines with a small parachute, they can be safely dropped from airplanes, allowing quick and efficient creation of minefields.
1e404in.zh: 为水雷装上小型降落伞后，即可安全地从飞机上空投，从而快速高效地布设雷场。

kj2t9c.en: A proper armor-piercing shell for small caliber guns gives destroyers and other light ships a fighting chance against armored opponents.
kj2t9c.zh: 为小口径火炮配备真正的穿甲弹，使驱逐舰及其他轻型舰船面对有装甲的对手时也有了一战之力。

1ln7c9c.en: To hit the target, the first step is to straddle it by firing a few guns at a time until the impacts hit on both sides of the target.
1ln7c9c.zh: 要命中目标，第一步是夹叉目标——每次只用几门炮射击，直到弹着点落在目标两侧。

1e9r5bq.en: Redesigning mines to fit into torpedo tubes allows any submarine to become a minelayer, albeit at the expense of torpedoes carried.
1e9r5bq.zh: 重新设计水雷使其能装入鱼雷发射管，可让任何潜艇都变成布雷潜艇，代价是减少携带的鱼雷。

g3tioh.en: Weighing well over a ton, these massive shells strike with unprecedented power and pose a dire threat to even the heaviest armor.
g3tioh.zh: 这些巨型炮弹重达一吨以上，以空前的威力命中目标，即使对最厚重的装甲也构成严重威胁。

dmhdf9.en: Equipped with an accoustic detector, the torpedo can home in on the biggest source of noise ahead of it - usually the target.
dmhdf9.zh: 装上声学探测器后，鱼雷能够自动追踪其前方最大的噪声源——通常就是目标。

19hmu50.en: By fitting a ballistic hood, shells can be made more aerodynamic while still maintaining their armor-piercing performance.
19hmu50.zh: 加装风帽可使炮弹具有更好的气动外形，同时仍保持其穿甲性能。

1kbun1f.en: With the use of the newly produced supply ships, we can ensure smoother transfer of the fuel, ammunition and supplies.
1kbun1f.zh: 借助新生产的补给舰，我们可以确保燃料、弹药和补给品更顺畅地转运。

3pcmec.en: Advanced Landing craft means that our boys can get on the beach quicker and more effectively during an invasion.
3pcmec.zh: 先进的登陆艇意味着我们的士兵在登陆作战时能更快、更有效地登上滩头。

dnpm3q.en: A simple floating bomb, anchored to the sea floor. The mine explodes when it comes into contact with a ship.
dnpm3q.zh: 一种锚定在海底的简易漂浮炸弹。水雷在与舰船接触时爆炸。

1avl6u2.en: This sophisticated mine explodes when it detects changes in the magnetic field stemming from a passing ship.
1avl6u2.zh: 这种精密水雷在侦测到过往舰船引起的磁场变化时爆炸。

1gbns7s.en: Airplanes can be fitted with special equipment to detect and safely detonate naval mines from the air.
1gbns7s.zh: 飞机可加装特殊设备，从空中探测并安全引爆水雷。

16oy4j2.en: This highly advanced mine detects small changes in water pressure caused by a ship moving nearby.
16oy4j2.zh: 这种高度先进的水雷能侦测到附近舰船移动所引起的水压微小变化。

mq05i5.en: Dedicated invasion craft make landing in hostile territory slightly less of a headache.
mq05i5.zh: 专用登陆艇让在敌占区登陆这件事稍稍不那么令人头疼。

1bm0292.en: This type of naval mine detonates when its sensors detect the noise of a nearby ship.
1bm0292.zh: 这种水雷在其传感器侦测到附近舰船的噪声时起爆。

abjn8n.en: Ship designed solely for troop movement, without any defensive capabilities.
abjn8n.zh: 专为运送部队而设计的船只，不具备任何防御能力。

1i4qoqe.en: Basic design for the training and elevation mechanics of naval guns.
1i4qoqe.zh: 舰炮瞄准与俯仰机构的基础设计。

13c2dym.zh: 标准化张力式海上并靠补给法

gchu9s.en: A mortar on board the destroyer can throw an explosive charge much further, allowing the ship to maintain sonar contact with the submarine throughout the attack and dramatically increasing its accuracy. Mounting this module on Light Ships and Cruisers will allow them to attack enemy Submarines.
gchu9s.zh: 驱逐舰上搭载的臼炮能将爆炸装药投掷得更远，使舰船在整次攻击过程中都能保持对潜艇的声呐接触，并大幅提高命中精度。将此模块安装在轻型舰船与巡洋舰上，可使其攻击敌方潜艇。

1r1fvkf.en: This scheme focuses on only protecting the most vital areas of the ship, while ignoring the unimportant parts. Mounting this module on Heavy Ships improves their ability to withstand enemy damage. Battleships and Battlecruisers are defined by their different Armor Schemes.
1r1fvkf.zh: 这种方案只保护舰船最要害的部位，而忽略不重要的部分。将此模块安装在重型舰船上，可提高其承受敌方伤害的能力。战列舰与战列巡洋舰正是以各自不同的装甲方案来区分的。

1d04fpt.en: A simple mechanical device that tosses a depth charge a set distance away from the ship. This means that the destroyer no longer has to drive directly across the target to hit it. Mounting this module on Light Ships and Cruisers will allow them to attack enemy Submarines.
1d04fpt.zh: 一种简单的机械装置，可将深水炸弹抛投到距舰船一定距离之外。这意味着驱逐舰不必再直接从目标上方驶过才能命中。将此模块安装在轻型舰船与巡洋舰上，可使其攻击敌方潜艇。

ctqer7.en: By placing the belt armor at an angle, the same weight and thickness of armor are much harder to pierce. Mounting this module on Heavy Ships improves their ability to withstand enemy damage. Battleships and Battlecruisers are defined by their different Armor Schemes.
ctqer7.zh: 将舷侧装甲以一定角度倾斜布置，相同重量与厚度的装甲就难被击穿得多。将此模块安装在重型舰船上，可提高其承受敌方伤害的能力。战列舰与战列巡洋舰正是以各自不同的装甲方案来区分的。

3akblz.en: An armor scheme that copies the split between belt and deck armor seen in Capital Ships and offers some protection against splinters and small-caliber guns. Mounting this module on Cruisers improves their ability to withstand enemy damage, but also ⟦0⟧ their speed.
3akblz.zh: 一种仿照主力舰舷侧装甲与甲板装甲分离布置的装甲方案，能提供一定的抵御破片与小口径火炮的能力。将此模块安装在巡洋舰上可提高其承受敌方伤害的能力，但也会⟦0⟧其速度。

1wtw2wt.en: A simple airtube running from the engine room to the control tower. Extended, it allows the submarine to run its engines and charge its batteries while still submerged. Mounting this module on Submarines reduces their Visibility, making them harder to detect.
1wtw2wt.zh: 一根从机舱通到指挥塔的简单通气管。加长后，它能让潜艇在仍然潜航的状态下运转发动机并为电池充电。将此模块安装在潜艇上可降低其可见度，使其更难被发现。

sy27ss.en: Considered by some to be a relic of a bygone era of naval warfare, by others as the most impressive ships ever built, no one can deny that these remnants of the battleship arms race constitute some of the most heavily armed and armored vessels ever built.
sy27ss.zh: 有人认为它们是海战旧时代的遗物，也有人认为它们是有史以来最令人惊叹的舰船；但无人能否认，这些战列舰军备竞赛的遗存是有史以来武装最重、装甲最厚的舰船之一。

1rkamjc.en: An improved pneumatic mechanism allows much larger airplanes to be launched via catapult. This increases their search radius. Mounting this module on Cruisers, Heavy Ships or specialized Submarines improves their ability to detect enemy ships.
1rkamjc.zh: 改进的气动机构使弹射器能够弹射大得多的飞机，从而扩大其搜索半径。将此模块安装在巡洋舰、重型舰船或专用潜艇上，可提高其发现敌方舰船的能力。

xbcb5v.en: Thicker armor, stronger engines, a battery of high-caliber guns and improved anti-air capabilities can allow battleships to remain relevant, if correctly employed, in a world where naval warfare is increasingly dominated by aerial support.
xbcb5v.zh: 更厚的装甲、更强的发动机、一组大口径火炮以及改进的防空能力，可以让战列舰在海战日益由空中支援主导的世界中，只要运用得当，仍然保持其价值。

1tlknrm.en: Although bound by the stipulations of the Washington Naval Treaty, the cruiser is still the most flexible warship. This hull allows construction of a light cruiser for screening and scouting, or a heavy cruiser to support the battleline.
1tlknrm.zh: 尽管受到《华盛顿海军条约》条款的约束，巡洋舰仍是最灵活的军舰。这种舰体既可建造用于屏卫与侦察的轻巡洋舰，也可建造支援战列线的重巡洋舰。

1joomw4.en: Using modulated sound waves, this system can accurately measure bearing and distance to a submerged target. Mounting this module in an Electronics Slot on Light Ships or Cruisers will help them detect enemy Submarines.
1joomw4.zh: 该系统利用调制声波，能够精确测定与水下目标的方向和距离。将此模块安装在轻型舰船或巡洋舰的电子设备槽中，可帮助它们发现敌方潜艇。

acf0fq.en: Conversions of old hulls allow for cheap experiments with naval aviation to gain experience in building and operating carriers. These ships will be less capable than a purpose-built carrier, but far quicker to create.
acf0fq.zh: 改装旧舰体，可以低成本地试验海军航空技术，从而积累建造与运用航空母舰的经验。这些舰船的性能不如专门建造的航母，但建造速度快得多。

hxujvq.en: An improved design prevents any water from being sucked into the engines and also reduces the radar echo of the snorkel head. Mounting this module on Submarines reduces their Visibility, making them harder to detect.
hxujvq.zh: 改进的设计可防止水被吸入发动机，并降低通气管头部的雷达回波。将此模块安装在潜艇上可降低其可见度，使其更难被发现。

7v4lxp.en: A basic set of hydrophones allows tracking of underwater targets through detecting the sound they make. Mounting this module in an Electronics Slot on Light Ships or Cruisers will help them detect enemy Submarines.
7v4lxp.zh: 一套基本的水听器通过探测水下目标发出的声音来追踪它们。将此模块安装在轻型舰船或巡洋舰的电子设备槽中，可帮助它们发现敌方潜艇。

14lfb8t.en: A larger propellant charge throws a proper depth charge set to a specific depth at a submarine from quite a distance. Mounting this module on Light Ships and Cruisers will allow them to attack enemy Submarines.
14lfb8t.zh: 更大的发射装药能将一枚设定到特定深度的正规深水炸弹从相当远的距离投向潜艇。将此模块安装在轻型舰船与巡洋舰上，可使其攻击敌方潜艇。

1wpf2p1.en: Influenced by wartime experiences, the latest generation of cruisers have a rearranged superstructure to allow wider fields of fire for anti-air armaments and new internal layouts to support the use of radar.
1wpf2p1.zh: 受战时经验的影响，最新一代巡洋舰重新安排了上层建筑，使防空武器拥有更宽的射界，并采用新的内部布局以支持雷达的使用。

3qz4v.en: A simple explosive container with a pressure-sensitive trigger explodes when it hits a pre-set depth. Mounting this module on Light Ships and Cruisers will allow them to attack enemy Submarines.
3qz4v.zh: 一个装有压敏引信的简易爆炸容器，在到达预设深度时爆炸。将此模块安装在轻型舰船与巡洋舰上，可使其攻击敌方潜艇。

178xcat.en: As work begins on the first keel-up carrier designs, we must ensure that these ships have the range and speed to keep up with the rest of our navy, while respecting the post-war naval treaties.
178xcat.zh: 随着首批从龙骨开始设计的航母方案着手进行，我们必须确保这些舰船拥有足以跟上海军其余部队的航程与航速，同时遵守战后的海军条约。

tave7m.en: Many military theorists believe that naval aviation is the future. Converting old capital ships and ocean liners to carry aircraft will be the first step towards utilizing these new doctrines.
tave7m.zh: 许多军事理论家认为海军航空兵代表着未来。把旧的主力舰与远洋邮轮改装为搭载飞机，将是运用这些新学说的第一步。

1g8i2ox.en: The role of the submarine in the fleet outside of convoy attacks is still under debate. Achieving a balance between combination of speed, range and weaponry will be key to the necessary model.
1g8i2ox.zh: 潜艇在舰队中除袭击运输船队之外的作用仍有争议。在速度、航程与武器之间取得平衡，将是研制所需型号的关键。

150xgpi.en: The modern destroyer must be fitted with a variety of different detection technologies, new depth charge deployment systems and be built at a larger scale than their predecessors.
150xgpi.zh: 现代驱逐舰必须配备各种不同的探测技术、新的深水炸弹投放系统，并且建造规模要比其前型更大。

1d8ny2w.en: Better armed and more stable, new submarine designs are made to take advantage of advancements in naval tactics and have longer range, being able to attack distant convoy routes.
1d8ny2w.zh: 新式潜艇设计武装更强、更加稳定，旨在利用海军战术的进步，并拥有更大的航程，能够袭击遥远的运输船队航线。

1qi06ir.en: To ensure the safety of convoys, the destroyers of the Great War must be repurposed and developed. Arming vessels with more torpedoes will allow more opportunities to engage.
1qi06ir.zh: 为确保运输船队的安全，大战时期的驱逐舰必须加以改造和发展。为舰船装备更多鱼雷将带来更多交战机会。

chyf0c.en: Longer torpedo range and faster reload speeds, along with new types of armaments such as anti-air turrets, will allow our destroyers to remain efficient and versatile.
chyf0c.zh: 更远的鱼雷射程与更快的装填速度，以及防空炮塔等新型武器，将使我们的驱逐舰继续保持高效与多用途。

12jb96n.en: With the continued development of the Ice Composites we are looking for the best materials and construction techniques to provide protection for our carrier and planes
12jb96n.zh: 随着冰复合材料的持续研发，我们正在寻找最佳的材料与建造工艺，为我们的航母与飞机提供防护

1p721ah.en: Increased test depth and efficient layouts will be features of the modern submarines, taking advantage of field experience to select appropriate armaments and engines.
1p721ah.zh: 更大的测试深度与高效的布局将成为现代潜艇的特点，并利用实战经验来选择适当的武器与发动机。

1i4ebjy.en: Some minor modifications to the engines and smokestacks of light and medium ships allow them to make a lot of smoke to avoid or break contact with the enemy.
1i4ebjy.zh: 对轻型与中型舰船的发动机和烟囱进行一些小的改装，就能让它们制造大量烟雾，以避开敌人或与敌人脱离接触。

1kd7wea.en: With further refinement of the AIP technology, we are seeing improvement both in terms of performance as well as the material consumption used by the engines
1kd7wea.zh: 随着 AIP 技术的进一步改良，我们看到发动机在性能与材料消耗两方面都有所改善

1wk951y.en: With improved stability and range, a new generation of battleships improve upon previous designs while remaining within limits stipulated by naval treaties.
1wk951y.zh: 凭借更好的稳定性与航程，新一代战列舰在改进此前设计的同时，仍遵守海军条约规定的限制。

1iltlmx.en: Submarines are stealthy vessels designed to take out undefended convoys. The early models from the Great War pave the way for new methods of naval warfare.
1iltlmx.zh: 潜艇是专为消灭无防护的运输船队而设计的隐蔽舰艇。大战时期的早期型号为新的海战方式铺平了道路。

hk7lo3.en: Our experience and understanding of the Air-Independent Propulsion System have allowed us to develop state of the art engines. Silent, fast and deadly.
hk7lo3.zh: 我们对不依赖空气推进系统的经验与理解，使我们得以研制出最先进的发动机。静音、快速且致命。

sobnoy.en: As the world sees what may be the last major battleship confrontations, the importance of heavy armaments and anti-air turrets is greater than ever.
sobnoy.zh: 当世界目睹可能是最后的大规模战列舰对决时，重型武器与防空炮塔的重要性比以往任何时候都更高。

1p9wtpl.en: Improved construction methods and more specialized systems like deck edge elevators allow these carriers to transport more planes more efficiently.
1p9wtpl.zh: 改进的建造方法与舷侧升降机等更专门的系统，使这些航母能够更高效地运送更多飞机。

1az6dwt.en: The next generation of cruisers features new engine arrangements that improve survivability, as well as space for dedicated aircraft facilities.
1az6dwt.zh: 下一代巡洋舰采用新的发动机布局以提高生存能力，并为专用航空设施留出空间。

12i4uwj.en: With the further refinement of the Pykrete, we are now able to have much better insulation and protection for our aircraft about the Ice Carrier
12i4uwj.zh: 随着派克瑞特冰的进一步改良，我们现在能够为冰航母上的飞机提供更好的隔热与防护

1294ynh.en: To better face threats from above and below, new destroyers must be outfitted with radar and modern anti-air and anti-submarine weaponry.
1294ynh.zh: 为更好地应对来自空中与水下的威胁，新式驱逐舰必须配备雷达以及现代防空与反潜武器。

1vm17kb.en: As cruisers around the world get more powerful and capable, new and larger hulls are needed to hold all the extra equipment needed.
1vm17kb.zh: 随着世界各地的巡洋舰变得更强、能力更全面，需要更新、更大的舰体来容纳所有必需的额外设备。

mwczaj.en: The Kuomintang's Whampoa Military Academy holds the power over new recruits and promotions within the army. Though not entirely inefficient, it does contain a large amount of institutionalized corruption.
mwczaj.zh: 国民党的黄埔军校掌握着军中新兵招募与晋升的权力。它虽然并非全无效率，却包含着大量制度化的腐败。

bcnu4k.en: The history and accomplishments of our regiments stands testament to the heroism of our soldiers. By habitually recognizing great deeds, every man might aspire to that same greatness.
bcnu4k.zh: 我们各团的历史与功绩，是士兵英雄气概的明证。通过惯常地表彰伟大功绩，每个人都可能向往同样的伟大。

zzwf32.en: This new generation of officers will lead the Norwegian armies into victory, because they can learn from more than just dusty books and ancient peacetime professors.
zzwf32.zh: 新一代军官将引领挪威军队走向胜利，因为他们能学到的远不止积灰的书籍和古板的和平时期教授所讲的内容。

1e308w9.en: Destruction of equipment and disruption of the enemy's lines of communication shall seal victory faster than any number of inflicted casualties.
1e308w9.zh: 摧毁装备并扰乱敌人的交通线，比造成再多伤亡都能更快地锁定胜局。

n1jvza.en: Rapid logistical replenishment and efficient damage control don't win battles on their own, but they keep the guns of victory firing.
n1jvza.zh: 快速的后勤补给与高效的损管本身并不能赢得战斗，但它们能让胜利的炮火持续轰鸣。

m3acdf.en: The purpose of the state is to wage war against other states. Anything else is either in support of that or a useless distraction.
m3acdf.zh: 国家的目的就是对他国发动战争。其他一切要么是为战争服务，要么就是无用的干扰。

nxrsox.en: While replacing the horse with the tank is desirable in the long term, it cannot be done at the cost of national economic ruin.
nxrsox.zh: 虽然从长远来看，用坦克取代马匹是可取的，但不能以国民经济崩溃为代价。

1k2y1jz.en: Like an ancient shield wall, every ship in a battle fleet is not only responsible for its own defense, but to aid its neighbor.
1k2y1jz.zh: 如同古代的盾墙，战列舰队中的每艘舰船不仅要负责自身防御，还要支援相邻的舰船。

srae8x.en: Converge swiftly on the foe like a swarm of locusts, firing every weapon at your disposal: the quickest path to victory.
srae8x.zh: 如蝗群般迅速向敌人集结，用尽你手中的每一件武器开火：这是通往胜利的最快途径。

1tcg7ut.en: No land-based artillery can hope to match the firepower tens of thousands of tons of navy steel can bring to the dance.
1tcg7ut.zh: 任何陆基火炮都无法与数万吨海军钢铁所能带来的火力相提并论。

adkf33.en: A fool stands still in front of a superior enemy and allows themselves to be destroyed. Decline fights you cannot win.
adkf33.zh: 傻瓜才会在强敌面前原地不动，任其将自己消灭。拒绝打你赢不了的仗。

106bllh.en: Only frictionless cooperation between the aircraft industry, military, and government will ensure the highest quality.
106bllh.zh: 只有航空工业、军方与政府之间毫无摩擦的合作，才能确保最高的质量。

1qgwu9u.en: Combat air patrol and light ships exist to allow our heavy hitters to do their jobs without being rudely interrupted.
1qgwu9u.zh: 战斗空中巡逻与轻型舰船的存在，就是为了让我们的主力能够不受粗暴干扰地完成任务。

gyd8c4.en: The best judge of a man's ability and character is to give him a shovel and a day to do something useful with it.
gyd8c4.zh: 判断一个人的能力与品格，最好的办法就是给他一把铁锹和一天时间，看他能用它做出什么有用的事。

1j6g11o.en: The sea is vast. Victory in battle usually goes to the side who detects and decisively strikes the other first.
1j6g11o.zh: 海洋辽阔。战斗的胜利通常属于先发现对方并果断出手的一方。

trp359.en: Few people have what it takes to lead soldiers into battle. Fewer still have what it takes to win that battle.
trp359.zh: 很少有人具备带领士兵上战场的能力。具备赢得这场战斗能力的人则更少。

zvc3p8.en: A proper, civilized war is more like a chess match than a brawl. Why fight an enemy you can maneuver around?
zvc3p8.zh: 一场体面、文明的战争更像下棋，而不是打架斗殴。既然能绕过敌人，何必与他硬拼？

1lth7jn.en: Someone who does not have the correct ideology can not be expected to achieve the correct result in battle.
1lth7jn.zh: 不能指望一个没有正确意识形态的人在战斗中取得正确的结果。

1dhy6xu.en: It is good to destroy the enemy with your own weapons, but even better to destroy him with his own weapons.
1dhy6xu.zh: 用自己的武器消灭敌人固然好，但用敌人自己的武器消灭他更好。

9fl9xu.en: Throughout history to the modern day, soldiers and citizens alike honor the sacrifices of their comrades.
9fl9xu.zh: 从古至今，士兵与平民都会缅怀同胞的牺牲。

1xf0l9l.en: You think just flying in the dark is hard? Try landing on an aircraft carrier in the middle of the night!
1xf0l9l.zh: 你觉得在黑暗中飞行就已经很难了？试试半夜在航空母舰上降落吧！

g96wyy.en: Effective management of resources ensures that planes reach the locations where they are needed the most.
g96wyy.zh: 有效的资源管理能确保飞机抵达最需要它们的地方。

1eyp959.en: Armored breakthroughs can happen at any time, anywhere. The God of War helps those who help themselves.
1eyp959.zh: 装甲突破随时可能在任何地方发生。战争之神只帮助那些自助的人。

1cczx75.en: Not everyone needs to make the military their profession. But in times of war, they can still serve.
1cczx75.zh: 并非每个人都需要以军人为职业。但在战争时期，他们仍然可以报效国家。

jslctq.en: There is no such thing as too much trench work. There is only 'insufficient' and 'barely adequate'.
jslctq.zh: 战壕作业从来没有「过多」这回事。只有「不足」和「勉强够用」。

15v1fxc.en: As long as one prop is turning and one gun remains above the waterline, we are still in the fight.
15v1fxc.zh: 只要还有一个螺旋桨在转、还有一门炮在水线以上，我们就仍在战斗。

u9lrkq.en: A rolling barrage of shells is surprisingly effective at keeping the enemy from shooting back.
u9lrkq.zh: 移动弹幕射击在压制敌人还击方面出奇地有效。

1qb469z.en: Some officers may 'go native', but natives are very good at fighting on their chosen terrain.
1qb469z.zh: 有些军官可能会「入乡随俗」，但本地人非常擅长在自己熟悉的地形上作战。

hk2529.en: Massive strategic strikes at the heart of the enemy's core will break their ability to fight.
hk2529.zh: 对敌人核心地带发动大规模战略打击，将摧毁其作战能力。

2t0fem.en: A good General may be trained, but a great General must be bred. Like horses, in a way.
2t0fem.zh: 优秀的将领可以培养，但伟大的将领必须天生。某种意义上，就像马一样。

xbwq82.en: If you want to know what the other side is up to, go over there and ask them directly!
xbwq82.zh: 如果你想知道对方在干什么，就直接过去问他们！

1cf5ldl.en: The Air Force is an independent branch, and just as important as the Army or the Navy.
1cf5ldl.zh: 空军是一个独立军种，与陆军或海军同等重要。

h0vwcw.en: No one should be prevented from serving their nation due to a simple lack of money.
h0vwcw.zh: 任何人都不应仅仅因为缺钱而无法报效国家。

140oycm.en: All the firepower in the world doesn't mean anything when it's in the wrong place.
140oycm.zh: 再强的火力，如果放在错误的地方也毫无意义。

8l9qt6.en: The vast expanse of the sky holds untold promise for those in search of a legacy.
8l9qt6.zh: 广袤的天空对于寻求功业的人来说蕴含着无限的希望。

wc5vi.en: Wherever future battles are fought, armored troops will play the decisive role.
wc5vi.zh: 无论未来的战斗在哪里打响，装甲部队都将发挥决定性作用。

1akqoxz.en: The dagger in the night is often more effective than the longsword in the day.
1akqoxz.zh: 夜里的匕首往往比白天的长剑更有效。

1xrfe8d.en: When all is said and done, a tank or airplane can't hold a patch of ground.
1xrfe8d.zh: 说到底，坦克或飞机守不住一寸土地。

10hp9cj.en: Infantry is the Queen of Battle, and the Queen goes wherever she pleases.
10hp9cj.zh: 步兵是战场上的女王，而女王想去哪儿就去哪儿。

bweaor.en: Understand faster, think faster, act faster - that is the key to victory.
bweaor.zh: 更快理解、更快思考、更快行动——这就是胜利的关键。

sr5zsy.en: What counts is getting the job done, not following orders to the letter.
sr5zsy.zh: 重要的是把事情办成，而不是一字不差地执行命令。

lcrhr2.en: An unreliable military is a threat to the state it is meant to protect.
lcrhr2.zh: 一支不可靠的军队，对它本应保卫的国家本身就是一个威胁。

1f99qo3.en: Crank it down to zero elevation and engage the enemy over open sights!
1f99qo3.zh: 把炮口摇到零仰角，用直接瞄准具向敌人开火！

1rcq5xy.en: After all, they are the ones using the equipment, so why not ask them?
1rcq5xy.zh: 毕竟，装备是他们在用，为什么不问问他们呢？

1p1auz7.en: In order for every man to do his duty, he must know what his duty is.
1p1auz7.zh: 要让每个人都尽到自己的职责，他就必须知道自己的职责是什么。

q9ch23.en: Minimizing time in the dock, maximizes the time a ship can be at sea.
q9ch23.zh: 尽量缩短在船坞中的时间，就能让舰船在海上停留的时间最大化。

k6rb14.en: If artillery doesn't win you battles, you're not using enough of it.
k6rb14.zh: 如果火炮没能帮你赢得战斗，那说明你用得还不够多。

mxciey.en: It is better to die with glory than to live in the shame of defeat.
mxciey.zh: 光荣地死去，胜过在战败的耻辱中苟活。

fswv6w.en: Tough competition and strict selection breeds the captains we want.
fswv6w.zh: 激烈的竞争与严格的选拔，才能培养出我们想要的舰长。

1oxu3wo.en: Disrupting the enemy ground forces is the best way to defeat them.
1oxu3wo.zh: 扰乱敌方地面部队是击败他们的最佳方式。

1o8frfk.en: A people cannot be conquered until they admit they are conquered.
1o8frfk.zh: 一个民族除非自己承认被征服，否则就不会被征服。

1gq36ei.en: 1000 bombers can change the course of the war in a single strike.
1gq36ei.zh: 1000 架轰炸机只需一次出击就能改变战争走向。

18uvex5.en: Going all in for the battle will always give you the initiative.
18uvex5.zh: 全力投入战斗，永远能让你掌握主动权。

6zu6a5.en: No army or navy guy can order us around. We do things our way.
6zu6a5.zh: 陆军或海军的人别想对我们指手画脚。我们按自己的方式来。

1fpbbe9.en: It takes a certain type of courage to wage war at 10,000 feet.
1fpbbe9.zh: 在一万英尺高空作战，需要一种特别的勇气。

1i3nye2.en: There is a lot of science involved in digging a proper ditch.
1i3nye2.zh: 挖一条像样的战壕涉及大量科学。

1pctq8u.en: The troops can eat their belts but the tanks got to have gas.
1pctq8u.zh: 部队可以勒紧裤腰带，但坦克必须有油。

1w8e0ny.en: Being used to fighting in the dark gives distinct advantages.
1w8e0ny.zh: 习惯在黑暗中作战能带来明显的优势。

1s0es4r.en: It's all about giving the right people the chance to shine.
1s0es4r.zh: 关键就在于给合适的人发光的机会。

rdpolg.en: A special daring is necessary when fighting away from home.
rdpolg.zh: 远离本土作战时，需要一种特别的胆识。

9d9ubw.en: As the saying goes: a strong offense is the best defense.
9d9ubw.zh: 俗话说得好：最好的防守就是进攻。

5dk615.en: The army does not exist to feed the ego of its Generals.
5dk615.zh: 军队的存在不是为了满足将领的自尊心。

hll1mk.en: The Bureau of Ordnance influences any ship design made.
hll1mk.zh: 军械局会影响每一项舰船设计的制定。

1k312mm.en: Merchant convoys require special tactics and training.
1k312mm.zh: 商船船队需要特殊的战术与训练。

1dvrfkf.en: Close co-operation between air and sea units is vital!
1dvrfkf.zh: 空中与海上单位之间的密切合作至关重要！

lws37r.en: Our ships shall patrol the oceans around the globe.
lws37r.zh: 我们的舰船将巡逻全球各大洋。

1ysc0t1.en: Hitting the enemy before he is aware of the threat.
1ysc0t1.zh: 在敌人意识到威胁之前就打击他。

s6hqg8.en: We are professionals, and war is our profession.
s6hqg8.zh: 我们是职业军人，而战争就是我们的职业。

1yu6xnp.en: The best contract is one that can be terminated.
1yu6xnp.zh: 最好的合同就是可以终止的合同。

14p51yg.en: Constantly adapting our designs is top priority.
14p51yg.zh: 不断改进我们的设计是首要任务。

1pikeqa.en: Close cooperation between air and ground forces.
1pikeqa.zh: 空中与地面部队之间的密切合作。

56njfh.en: Without supplies, a country cannot fight a war.
56njfh.zh: 没有补给，国家就无法进行战争。

1bi7gah.en: Always have something up your sleeve. Always.

xzkchd.en: War is chaos, but chaos can be prepared for.
xzkchd.zh: 战争就是混乱，但混乱是可以预先准备的。

15cdbb0.en: A predictable General is a defeated General.
15cdbb0.zh: 能被预测的将领就是被击败的将领。

1b9jkn3.en: Destruction of key enemy equipment is vital.
1b9jkn3.zh: 摧毁敌人关键装备至关重要。

szyl3h.zh: 轻型/中型/重型/现代自行火炮：⟦0⟧

11vs7xa.en: Nothing eats a sea urchin, for good reason.
11vs7xa.zh: 没有谁吃海胆，这是有充分理由的。

9m6ahk.en: Why just let the subs do all the raiding?
9m6ahk.zh: 为什么只让潜艇包揽所有的破交任务？

1xvew37.zh: 牵引式火炮/防空/反坦克：⟦0⟧

167i07h.en: Being able to strike anywhere, anytime.
167i07h.zh: 能够随时随地发动打击。

hvqa1x.en: Getting in close is the key to victory.
hvqa1x.zh: 拉近距离是胜利的关键。

nzopv2.en: There's no such thing as bad weather...

sdm4g3.en: Strike faster, go further, win harder!
sdm4g3.zh: 打击更快，推进更远，赢得更彻底！

6l4fcd.en: Damn the torpedoes, full speed ahead!

1cdcmet.en: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
1cdcmet.zh: 敌人的敌人就是我的朋友。

ke8lp0.en: Letting the best train the rest.
ke8lp0.zh: 让最优秀的人来训练其余的人。

1olruef.zh: 什么都比不上一场良好的教育。

1j8467t.en: Modern planes are capable of withstanding significantly more punishment than older models, while also offering fewer opportunities to score hits. Each hit must therefore do the maximum amount of damage, requiring a bigger cartridge.
1j8467t.zh: 现代飞机比旧式机型能承受多得多的打击，同时也更难被命中。因此每一次命中都必须造成最大限度的损伤，这就需要更大的弹药。

8xbhxv.en: This very large airframe has plenty of space to carry bombs or fluel tanks. However, it is clear that its development potential is severely limited. New generations of strategic bombers are already on the horizon.
8xbhxv.zh: 这一极为庞大的机体有充足的空间携带炸弹或油箱。然而，显而易见的是，它的开发潜力十分有限。新一代战略轰炸机已初现端倪。

1r3w390.en: Since the early days of the Great War, airplanes have been increasingly used to drop explosives onto enemy targets. Over time, this has developed more and more into a fundamental aspect of aerial warfare.
1r3w390.zh: 自大战初期以来，飞机越来越多地被用于向敌方目标投掷炸药。随着时间推移，这已日益发展成为空战的一个基本方面。

196vz2e.en: While it seems obvious that adding more fuel capacity will increase the range of an airplane, actually adding that capacity to a plane without impacting flight performance too much is far from trivial.
196vz2e.zh: 增加燃料容量会提升飞机航程，这看似理所当然，但要在不太影响飞行性能的前提下真正为飞机增加这一容量，绝非易事。

6gdvdd.en: Since the early days of the Great War, aviation has advanced in leaps and bounds. This airframe represents the culmination of these developments, but it is clear that its growth potential is limited.
6gdvdd.zh: 自大战初期以来，航空技术突飞猛进。这一机体代表了这些发展的顶点，但显然它的成长潜力有限。

1q9x8rj.en: The development of lightweight fittings designed to be shed upon entering the water gives aerial torpedos significantly greater accuracy as well as enhanced safety for the aircraft performing a drop.
1q9x8rj.zh: 研制出入水时即可脱落的轻质挂具，使航空鱼雷的精度大幅提高，也让执行投雷的飞机更加安全。

1tqqjw1.en: The first clear military purpose of the aeroplane was to find the enemy and report their location to the Generals on the ground. This still remains one of the most common tasks of military aviation.
1tqqjw1.zh: 飞机最初明确的军事用途，就是搜寻敌人并向地面上的将军们报告其位置。这至今仍是军用航空最常见的任务之一。

ezzf3v.en: Airplane engines must be powerful, but lightweight and reliable. This engine type provides enough power to get a plane in the air, but somewhat limits it from reaching its full potential.
ezzf3v.zh: 飞机发动机必须强劲，同时又要轻便可靠。这一型号的发动机能提供足够的动力让飞机升空，但在一定程度上限制了它发挥全部潜力。

q96n6x.en: In recent years, a number of new technologies has emerged, allowing for the construction of very capable, yet small, planes. This airframe represents just the first step on that road.
q96n6x.zh: 近年来涌现出许多新技术，使人们能够造出性能优异却体型小巧的飞机。这一机体只是这条道路上的第一步。

1lf9bz2.en: This airframe is designed to take advantage of the great speeds offered by modern engines and solve some of the structural problems that come with flying at high sub-sonic speeds.
1lf9bz2.zh: 这一机体旨在充分利用现代发动机带来的高速度，并解决在高亚音速飞行时出现的一些结构问题。

bdnt02.en: Modern Warfare requires airplanes increasingly used larger bombs on enemy targets. Over time, this has developed more and more into a fundamental aspect of aerial warfare.
bdnt02.zh: 现代战争要求飞机越来越多地向敌方目标投掷更大的炸弹。随着时间推移，这已日益发展成为空战的一个基本方面。

yde4pp.en: This airframe was designed to test the potential of a true strategic bomber, able to attack industrial targets deep inside enemy territory, and bring its crew back alive.
yde4pp.zh: 这一机体旨在验证真正的战略轰炸机的潜力：既能打击敌方腹地的工业目标，又能把机组人员活着带回来。

19xefs1.en: With the concept of a strategic bomber now well proven, this airframe was designed to improve payload and range, while having sufficent potential for future growth.
19xefs1.zh: 在战略轰炸机的概念已得到充分验证之后，这一机体旨在提升载弹量与航程，同时保留足够的未来成长潜力。

cqhm28.en: We have come a long way since the days of plywood and fabric in aircraft manufacture. New technologies allow for planes that are better suited for specific roles.
cqhm28.zh: 从胶合板加蒙布制造飞机的年代至今，我们已经走了很远。新技术使飞机制造能够更好地适应特定任务的需求。

mw7ukq.en: With extensive engineering to capitalize on every possible performance boost, this engine represents the absolute pinnacle of piston-driven engine technology.
mw7ukq.zh: 经过大量工程设计以榨取每一分可能的性能提升，这一发动机代表了活塞发动机技术的绝对巅峰。

101zdna.en: Optimized for very long range flying at very high altitude, this airframe is capable of carrying a sizable payload deep into the heart of enemy territory.
101zdna.zh: 这一机体针对极高高度上的超远程飞行进行了优化，能够携带可观的载荷深入敌方腹地。

rh735x.en: Incorporating a number of new technologies developed recently, this airframe is significantly more capable than previous planes of similar size.
rh735x.zh: 这一机体融合了近期研发的多项新技术，性能明显优于此前同尺寸的飞机。

w8nltr.en: A cannon shell can punch through even the toughest airplane, while potentially carrying enough explosives to do crippling damage when it hits.
w8nltr.zh: 炮弹能够击穿哪怕最坚固的飞机，同时还可能携带足够的炸药，一旦命中便造成毁灭性损伤。

1irz1a1.en: With jet-powered planes likely to become dominant, engineers are starting to figure out how to build airframes with jet propulsion in mind.
1irz1a1.zh: 随着喷气动力飞机很可能成为主流，工程师们正开始摸索如何以喷气推进为前提来设计机体。

1ywt8xm.en: Incorporating advanced features such as methanol-injection and automatic mixture, this engine is able to put out significantly more power.
1ywt8xm.zh: 这一发动机采用甲醇喷射与自动混合比控制等先进技术，能够输出显著更大的功率。

tgydrt.en: Thoroughly optimized for performance, this airframe represents the absolute maximum of what can be done with a piston-driven airplane.
tgydrt.zh: 这一机体经过彻底的性能优化，代表了活塞动力飞机所能达到的绝对极限。

1jz5wa3.en: Standardized mounts and ratings allow the development of larger, more powerful torpedoes as well as increasing their general utility.
1jz5wa3.zh: 标准化的挂架与规格，使更大型、更强劲的鱼雷得以研制，同时也提升了它们的通用性。

qynqv.en: Taking advantage of modern production technologies, this airframe allows the plane to carry a bigger payload over a longer distance.
qynqv.zh: 利用现代生产技术，这一机体使飞机能够以更远的航程携带更大的载荷。

1rkic23.en: With improved aerodynamics and more robust construction, this airframe represents a clear step forward compared to the basic model.
1rkic23.zh: 凭借改进的空气动力学设计与更坚固的结构，这一机体相比基础型号是明显的进步。

1n4j2b6.en: By carefully analyzing the battle damage on returning planes, we can accurately determine which parts of a plane are really vital.
