1n4j2b6.zh: 通过仔细分析返航飞机上的战斗损伤，我们能够准确判断飞机上哪些部位才是真正要害。

1t0lc9d.en: Warships have steadily increased their deck armor to defeat this specialist bombs must be developed to penetrate this armor.
1t0lc9d.zh: 军舰不断加厚甲板装甲以抵御攻击，必须研制专门的炸弹来穿透这种装甲。

iekkx7.en: While able to carry a significant payload over a long distance, the growth potential of this airframe is severely limited.
iekkx7.zh: 这一机体虽然能够长距离携带可观的载荷，但其成长潜力十分有限。

w06iti.en: Engineered to maximize performance and payload, this airframe represents the pinnacle of conventionally-powered airplanes.
w06iti.zh: 这一机体经过精心设计以最大化性能与载荷，代表了常规动力飞机的巅峰。

19nw7nb.en: Lightweight torpedoes can be carried by any capable aircraft in order to extend our ability to strike at sea.
19nw7nb.zh: 轻型鱼雷可由任何有能力的飞机携带，从而拓展我们打击海上目标的能力。

1e6fjk0.en: Rifle-caliber machine guns have formed the mainstay of air-to-air weaponry since the days of the Great War.
1e6fjk0.zh: 自大战年代起，步枪口径机枪一直是空对空武器的主力。

124xttc.en: Jet propulsion offers a quantum leap in performance. This airframe was designed to take advantage of this.
124xttc.zh: 喷气推进带来了性能上的飞跃。这一机体正是为利用这一点而设计的。

1g7gg05.en: With a higher caliber and a bigger shell, these cannons can bring down even large planes in a single hit.
1g7gg05.zh: 凭借更大的口径与更大的弹丸，这些机炮只需一发就能击落哪怕大型飞机。

1d5xyqn.en: With A modern cannon firing a large shell at high velocity, we can bring down even the toughest aircraft.
1d5xyqn.zh: 有了以高初速发射大弹丸的现代机炮，我们就能击落哪怕最坚固的飞机。

5m7la0.en: The rapid growth of airplanes requires a corresponding growth of engine power.
5m7la0.zh: 飞机的快速进步要求发动机功率相应提升。

170n7km.en: ⟦0⟧ Changes the ideology of the ⟦1⟧ country, if set. Optional. ⟦2⟧ The size of the breakaway country and the fraction of the original stockpile and military units it will receive by default. Optional, defaults to 0.5. ⟦3⟧ The size of the land army that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. ⟦4⟧ The size of the naval forces that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. ⟦5⟧ The size of the airforce that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. ⟦6⟧ The capital state of the breakaway country. Optional. ⟦7⟧ The states included in the breakway country. Optional, defaults to random states based off size. ⟦8⟧ will result in all states that meet the filter going to the breakaway. ⟦9⟧ A trigger block checked for the state that must be met to be transferred to the breakaway. Optional. ⟦10⟧ List of unit leaders to be kept by their legacy_id. Optional. ⟦11⟧ Trigger block checked for every unit leader that forces them to be kept if they meet the triggers. The default scope is the unit leader, ROOT is the country receiving the unit leader, while FROM is the original owner of the unit leader. Optional. ⟦12⟧ Trigger for scientist to remain with the original country. ⟦13⟧ Controls if the promoted party leader (i.e. the one that'd take power if the country were to be switched to that ideology group) of the revolting ideology group will be kept by the country or join the revolt, yes resulting in the former. Optional, defaults to false. ⟦14⟧ Controls if non-promoted party leaders of the revolting ideology group will be kept by the country or join the revolt, yes resulting in the former. Optional, defaults to false. ⟦15⟧ If true, the revolter will have no characters from the original country transferred to them. Optional, defaults to false. ⟦16⟧ An effect block executed for the breakaway country.
170n7km.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若已设置，则改变 ⟦1⟧ 国家的意识形态。可选。⟦2⟧ 分离国家的规模，以及默认情况下它将获得的原库存与军事单位的比例。可选，默认为 0.5。⟦3⟧ 分离国家获得的陆军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。⟦4⟧ 分离国家获得的海军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。⟦5⟧ 分离国家获得的空军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。⟦6⟧ 分离国家的首都州。可选。⟦7⟧ 分离国家所包含的州。可选，默认根据 size 随机选取州。⟦8⟧ 会使所有符合筛选条件的州都归属分离国家。⟦9⟧ 针对州的触发器块，必须满足该条件才会被移交给分离国家。可选。⟦10⟧ 要保留的单位将领列表，按其 legacy_id 指定。可选。⟦11⟧ 针对每个单位将领检查的触发器块，若满足触发器则强制保留他们。默认作用域为单位将领，ROOT 为接收该单位将领的国家，FROM 为该单位将领的原属国。可选。⟦12⟧ 科学家留在原属国的触发器。⟦13⟧ 控制叛乱意识形态集团的被提升党魁（即若该国切换到该意识形态集团时会掌权者）是被该国保留还是加入叛乱，yes 表示前者。可选，默认为 false。⟦14⟧ 控制叛乱意识形态集团中未被提升的党魁是被该国保留还是加入叛乱，yes 表示前者。可选，默认为 false。⟦15⟧ 若为 true，叛乱方不会接收原属国的任何人物。可选，默认为 false。⟦16⟧ 为分离国家执行的效果块。

1m71sin.en: ⟦0⟧ Dynamic equipment version numbering. If disabled removes the suffix from the equipment name. Numbering linked to ⟦1⟧. Optional, yes by default. ⟦2⟧ Whether the equipment variant is flagged as obsolete within the GUI and for AI. Optional, no by default. ⟦3⟧ Marks all older (non-chassis) equipment variants as obsolete as long as the following matches: Archetype, niche, mission set (for planes). Optional, defaults to false. ⟦4⟧ The name group used for equipment. Stored in ⟦5⟧. Optional, can only be defined for ships. ⟦6⟧ Index of the role icon that will be used, as an integer. If set to "auto", will pick automatically. If set to 0, will be unset. Optional, only can be defined for ships. ⟦7⟧ Model that will be used by the equipment on the world map. Optional. ⟦8⟧ The icon that will be used by equipment. Stored as a spriteType within ⟦9⟧. Optional. ⟦10⟧ The military industrial organisation that should be set as the designer of the equipment. Optional. ⟦11⟧ If set, bypasses the requirement that the equipment that the variant is for must be unlocked through research. Optional, defaults to false. ⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧ The upgrades configuration for the variant. ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧ The modules configuration for the variant.
1m71sin.zh: ⟦0⟧ 动态装备版本编号。若禁用，则从装备名称中移除后缀。编号与 ⟦1⟧ 关联。可选，默认为 yes。⟦2⟧ 该装备变体是否在界面中以及对于 AI 被标记为过时。可选，默认为 no。⟦3⟧ 只要满足以下匹配条件，就把所有较旧的（非底盘）装备变体标记为过时：原型、定位、任务集（针对飞机）。可选，默认为 false。⟦4⟧ 用于装备的名称组。存储于 ⟦5⟧。可选，只能为舰船定义。⟦6⟧ 将使用的角色图标索引，为整数。若设为 "auto"，将自动选取。若设为 0，将取消设置。可选，只能为舰船定义。⟦7⟧ 装备在世界地图上使用的模型。可选。⟦8⟧ 装备将使用的图标。以 spriteType 形式存储于 ⟦9⟧ 中。可选。⟦10⟧ 应被设为该装备设计商的军事工业组织。可选。⟦11⟧ 若设置，则绕过该变体所属装备必须通过科研解锁的要求。可选，默认为 false。⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧ 该变体的升级配置。⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧ 该变体的模块配置。

1fhx653.en: ⟦0⟧ The level to set the building to. ⟦1⟧ Defines whether the buildings are instantly built. ⟦2⟧ Defines the exact province to add provincal buildings in. Can be used as a scope. ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ Affect all provinces within the state that meet each limit. Used in the province scope. ⟦5⟧ Affect the specified province ID. Used in the province scope, will apply for each province if inserted multiple times. ⟦6⟧ Affect only coastal provinces within the selection. Used in the province scope. ⟦7⟧ Affect only provinces that have naval bases built. Used in the province scope. ⟦8⟧ Affect only provinces that lie on a border between countries. Used in the province scope. ⟦9⟧ Affect only provinces that border a specific other country. Used in the province scope. ⟦10⟧ Affect only provinces that meet the victory point amount prerequisite. If ⟦11⟧ is used in place of a number, any amount of victory points works. Used in the province scope. ⟦12⟧ Affect only provinces that have a supply node. Used in the province scope. ⟦13⟧ Affect only provinces with buildings level below, at or above the specified level. Used in the province scope.
1fhx653.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将建筑设置到的等级。⟦1⟧ 定义建筑是否立即建成。⟦2⟧ 定义要添加省级建筑的确切省份。可用作作用域。⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ 影响州内满足每个限制条件的所有省份。在省份作用域中使用。⟦5⟧ 影响指定的省份 ID。在省份作用域中使用，若多次插入则会对每个省份生效。⟦6⟧ 仅影响选定范围内的沿海省份。在省份作用域中使用。⟦7⟧ 仅影响已建有海军基地的省份。在省份作用域中使用。⟦8⟧ 仅影响位于国家之间边界的省份。在省份作用域中使用。⟦9⟧ 仅影响与某个特定其他国家接壤的省份。在省份作用域中使用。⟦10⟧ 仅影响满足胜利点数量前提的省份。若用 ⟦11⟧ 代替数字，则任意数量的胜利点都可用。在省份作用域中使用。⟦12⟧ 仅影响拥有补给节点的省份。在省份作用域中使用。⟦13⟧ 仅影响建筑等级低于、等于或高于指定等级的省份。在省份作用域中使用。

or4sz6.en: The composition of the division. Sub-units are defined in ⟦0⟧ files. ⟦1⟧ The division names group that the template will use, deciding on the automatically-generated names of any new divisions built using that template. Optional, assigns one automatically if omitted. These are defined within ⟦2⟧ files. ⟦3⟧ Whether the division is locked to modification and deletion. Optional. ⟦4⟧ Whether the locked template can have units deployed using it without allowing editing. Optional, only has an effect in locked templates. ⟦5⟧ The maximum amount of divisions that this template may have; requires the template to be locked. Optional. ⟦6⟧ The priority the template receives in receiving supplies. Goes from 0 to 2. Optional, 1 by default. ⟦7⟧ The icon used by the division as an integer. Optional, defaults to the icon of the most common sub-unit within. The icons are defined as sprites within any ⟦8⟧ file (By default ⟦9⟧) with the pattern of ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧. ⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧. Optional.
or4sz6.zh: 该师的编制。子单位在 ⟦0⟧ 文件中定义。⟦1⟧ 该模板将使用的师名称组，决定用该模板新建的所有师的自动生成名称。可选，若省略则自动分配一个。这些在 ⟦2⟧ 文件中定义。⟦3⟧ 该师是否被锁定，无法修改和删除。可选。⟦4⟧ 被锁定的模板是否允许在不允许编辑的情况下使用它部署单位。可选，仅对已锁定模板有效。⟦5⟧ 该模板可拥有的师数量上限；要求模板已锁定。可选。⟦6⟧ 该模板在获得补给时的优先级。取值从 0 到 2。可选，默认为 1。⟦7⟧ 该师使用的图标，为整数。可选，默认为其中最常见子单位的图标。图标以 sprite 形式定义在任意 ⟦8⟧ 文件中（默认为 ⟦9⟧），命名模式为 ⟦10⟧ 和 ⟦11⟧。⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧。可选。

806r79.en: ⟦0⟧ The size of the breakaway country and the fraction of the original stockpile and military units it will receive by default. Optional, defaults to 0.5. ⟦1⟧ The size of the land army that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. ⟦2⟧ The size of the naval forces that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. ⟦3⟧ The size of the airforce that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size. ⟦4⟧ List of unit leaders to be kept by their legacy_id. Optional. ⟦5⟧ Trigger block checked for every unit leader that forces them to be kept if they meet the triggers. The default scope is the unit leader, ROOT is the country receiving the unit leader, while FROM is the original owner of the unit leader. Optional.
806r79.zh: ⟦0⟧ 分离国家的规模，以及默认情况下它将获得的原库存与军事单位的比例。可选，默认为 0.5。⟦1⟧ 分离国家获得的陆军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。⟦2⟧ 分离国家获得的海军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。⟦3⟧ 分离国家获得的空军规模。可选，默认与 size 相同。⟦4⟧ 要保留的单位将领列表，按其 legacy_id 指定。可选。⟦5⟧ 针对每个单位将领检查的触发器块，若满足触发器则强制保留他们。默认作用域为单位将领，ROOT 为接收该单位将领的国家，FROM 为该单位将领的原属国。可选。

ikmdrd.en: ⟦0⟧ Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional. ⟦1⟧ Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Adds a random number (between ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧, inclusive) of ⟦5⟧ to the scheduled fire time. Optional. ⟦6⟧ Adds a random number (between ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧, inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional. ⟦9⟧ The originator of the event. Optional, defaults to owner of operative. ⟦10⟧ The recipient of the event. Optional, defaults to owner of operative. ⟦11⟧ Sets the scope of FROM in scripted localization. Optional. ⟦12⟧ Sets the scope of FROM.FROM in scripted localization. Optional. ⟦13⟧ Sets the scope of ROOT in scripted localization. Optional.
ikmdrd.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在指定的天数后触发该事件。可选。⟦1⟧ 在指定的小时数后触发该事件。可选。⟦2⟧ 向预定触发时间添加一个随机数量（介于 ⟦3⟧ 与 ⟦4⟧ 之间，含两端）的 ⟦5⟧。可选。⟦6⟧ 向预定触发时间添加一个随机数量（介于 ⟦7⟧ 与 ⟦8⟧ 之间，含两端）的天数。可选。⟦9⟧ 该事件的发起方。可选，默认为特工的所有者。⟦10⟧ 该事件的接收方。可选，默认为特工的所有者。⟦11⟧ 设置脚本本地化中 FROM 的作用域。可选。⟦12⟧ 设置脚本本地化中 FROM.FROM 的作用域。可选。⟦13⟧ 设置脚本本地化中 ROOT 的作用域。可选。

1ofzssr.en: ⟦0⟧ The owner of the division. ⟦1⟧ If possible, this province within the state gets used. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Allows the units to be created on provinces owned by the division owner's enemy. Defaults to false. ⟦3⟧ The amount of units to create. Defaults to 1. ⟦4⟧ The ID to identify the unit. Only used in ⟦5⟧. ⟦6⟧ A MTTH block deciding the province in the state where the division should spawn, evaluates in the scope of the controller. Defaults to prioritising owner's controlled provinces first and then owner's allies. ⟦7⟧ give the division commander experience on unit creation The following arguments go within ⟦8⟧:
1ofzssr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该师的所有者。⟦1⟧ 若可行，则使用州内的该省份。可选。⟦2⟧ 允许在师所有者敌国拥有的省份上创建单位。默认为 false。⟦3⟧ 要创建的单位数量。默认为 1。⟦4⟧ 用于标识该单位的 ID。仅在 ⟦5⟧ 中使用。⟦6⟧ 决定该师应在州内哪个省份生成的 MTTH 块，在控制者作用域中求值。默认优先考虑所有者控制的省份，其次是所有者的盟国。⟦7⟧ 在创建单位时给予该师指挥官经验。以下参数位于 ⟦8⟧ 之内：

ayu9ry.en: ⟦0⟧ A number ID which can be referred to by other effects. Optional. ⟦1⟧ If provided, the id of the entity will be stored using this variable. Optional. ⟦2⟧ The X position of the entity. ⟦3⟧ The Y position of the entity. ⟦4⟧ The Z position of the entity. ⟦5⟧ The province the middle of which to use as the entity's position. ⟦6⟧ The state the middle of which to use as the entity's position. ⟦7⟧ The rotation of the entity in radians. ⟦8⟧ The size of the entity. ⟦9⟧ Minimum zoom level needed to be able to see the entity. ⟦10⟧ The scripted trigger that must be met for a country for it to see the entity.
ayu9ry.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可供其他效果引用的数字 ID。可选。⟦1⟧ 若提供，实体的 id 将使用该变量存储。可选。⟦2⟧ 实体的 X 坐标。⟦3⟧ 实体的 Y 坐标。⟦4⟧ 实体的 Z 坐标。⟦5⟧ 以其中心作为实体位置的省份。⟦6⟧ 以其中心作为实体位置的州。⟦7⟧ 实体的旋转角度，以弧度为单位。⟦8⟧ 实体的大小。⟦9⟧ 能看到该实体所需的最低缩放级别。⟦10⟧ 某个国家能看到该实体所必须满足的脚本触发器。

19ldvo0.en: As you can see, we have created a meta_effect that takes two arguments. These arguments will be used replacing the parameters [EQ_TYPE] and [EQ_LEVEL] inside the meta effect. EQ_LEVEL will be replaced by [?eq_level|.0] which is the integer value of eq_level (in this case 2.000 becomes 2). EQ_TYPE is a bit more complicated, it is being replaced by a scripted localization. This scripted localization will check eq_type variable and depending on its value it will return the key token for the equipment. If it is 0, it will return "infantry_equipment". If it is 1, it will return "artillery_equipment".
19ldvo0.zh: 如你所见，我们创建了一个接受两个参数的 meta_effect。这些参数将用于替换元效果内部的 [EQ_TYPE] 和 [EQ_LEVEL]。EQ_LEVEL 将被替换为 [?eq_level|.0]，即 eq_level 的整数值（在此情况下 2.000 变为 2）。EQ_TYPE 稍复杂一些，它被替换为一段脚本本地化。该脚本本地化会检查 eq_type 变量，并根据其值返回装备的键标记。若为 0，将返回 "infantry_equipment"。若为 1，将返回 "artillery_equipment"。

14xqjue.en: ⟦0⟧ State where to damage units. ⟦1⟧ Strategic region where to damage units. ⟦2⟧ Will only delete units if the triggers within are met for the country that owns the units. ⟦3⟧ The percentage of damage done to units. ⟦4⟧ The percentage of damage done to units to organisation in particular. ⟦5⟧ The percentage of damage done to units to strength in particular. ⟦6⟧ Will damage a ratio damage to total organisation/strength of unit if set. ⟦7⟧ If specified, requires the template name to match. ⟦8⟧ Will damage the army units. ⟦9⟧ Will damage the navy units.
14xqjue.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要对其单位造成伤害的州。⟦1⟧ 要对其单位造成伤害的战略区域。⟦2⟧ 仅当拥有单位的国家满足其中触发器时才会删除单位。⟦3⟧ 对单位造成伤害的百分比。⟦4⟧ 专门对单位组织度造成伤害的百分比。⟦5⟧ 专门对单位兵力造成伤害的百分比。⟦6⟧ 若设置，将按比例对单位的总组织度/兵力造成伤害。⟦7⟧ 若指定，则要求模板名称匹配。⟦8⟧ 将对陆军单位造成伤害。⟦9⟧ 将对海军单位造成伤害。

1uyhx3m.en: Optionally, ⟦0⟧ (with ⟦1⟧ serving in a similar fashion) and ⟦2⟧ can be added. If the initial limit within ⟦3⟧ is false, it moves on to the next ⟦4⟧, checking the limit there. If the limit there is false, then it moves on to the next one, until hitting an end or an ⟦5⟧. Two variants exist: nested and unnested. In the first case, the ⟦6⟧ or ⟦7⟧ is put directly inside of the preceding ⟦8⟧ or ⟦9⟧, while in the second case it's put ⟦10⟧. In case of overlap, unnested if statements are preferred. Here is an example using unnested if statements:
1uyhx3m.zh: 可选地，可以添加 ⟦0⟧（⟦1⟧ 的作用类似）和 ⟦2⟧。若 ⟦3⟧ 中的初始限制为 false，则继续检查下一个 ⟦4⟧ 的限制。若那里的限制为 false，则继续下一个，直到遇到结尾或 ⟦5⟧。存在两种变体：嵌套与非嵌套。在第一种情况下，⟦6⟧ 或 ⟦7⟧ 直接放在前面的 ⟦8⟧ 或 ⟦9⟧ 内部，而在第二种情况下它被放在 ⟦10⟧。若出现重叠，优先使用非嵌套的 if 语句。以下是使用非嵌套 if 语句的示例：

186cwgt.en: To create a custom console command, the scripted effect's name should begin with ⟦0⟧. The console command itself does not include ⟦1⟧, so ⟦2⟧ would be run in console as ⟦3⟧ In custom console commands, the country running the command is FROM, while ROOT is the selected country, state, or character. Anything entered after the console command, separated by spaces like ⟦4⟧ is added to the 'args' temp array. An example of a scripted effect which will transfer every state entered as an argument to the country that runs the console command is
186cwgt.zh: 要创建自定义控制台指令，脚本效果名称应以 ⟦0⟧ 开头。控制台指令本身不包含 ⟦1⟧，因此 ⟦2⟧ 在控制台中将作为 ⟦3⟧ 运行。在自定义控制台指令中，运行该指令的国家为 FROM，而 ROOT 为选定的国家、州或人物。在控制台指令之后输入的、以空格分隔的内容（如 ⟦4⟧）会被添加到 'args' 临时数组中。以下是一个脚本效果示例，它会把作为参数输入的每个州转交给运行该控制台指令的国家

1kag7rt.en: ⟦0⟧ The number of factories to assigned initially. Optional. ⟦1⟧ The initial production progress. Optional. ⟦2⟧ The initial production efficiency. Optional. ⟦3⟧ The name that'll be used for the equipment, such as with ships. Optional. ⟦4⟧ The military industrial organisation that's set as the equipment's designer. ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ The name of the equipment to produce. ⟦7⟧ The country which is producing the equipment. Used if root scope isn't producer. Optional. ⟦8⟧The name of the variant to produce. Optional.
1kag7rt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 初始分配的工厂数量。可选。⟦1⟧ 初始生产进度。可选。⟦2⟧ 初始生产效率。可选。⟦3⟧ 将用于该装备的名称，例如舰船。可选。⟦4⟧ 被设为该装备设计商的军事工业组织。⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ 要生产的装备名称。⟦7⟧ 正在生产该装备的国家。若根作用域不是生产方则使用。可选。⟦8⟧要生产的变体名称。可选。

1bt5ixt.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Subdoctrine id. ⟦2⟧ Optional, in case you need to specify the folder. ⟦3⟧ Optional, in case you need to specify the track index within the folder. Note that this is the track index (starting with 0) among ALL the tracks in the folder, not just the ones that match the subdoctrine. So in a case where a grand doctrine has the tracks: 'infantry - armor - armor - operations', you would use track = 1 to refer to the first armor track, and track = 2 to refer to the second armor track.
1bt5ixt.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 子学说 id。⟦2⟧ 可选，在你需要指定文件夹时使用。⟦3⟧ 可选，在你需要指定文件夹内路线索引时使用。请注意，这是该文件夹内所有路线的索引（从 0 开始），而不仅仅是匹配该子学说的那些。因此，若某个大学说拥有路线：'infantry - armor - armor - operations'，则你要用 track = 1 指代第一条装甲路线，用 track = 2 指代第二条装甲路线。

yxi7bl.en: ⟦0⟧ Number of days to apply the daily mastery gain for. ⟦1⟧ Loc key - will be used in descriptions to show the source of the mastery gain. ⟦2⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder. ⟦3⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine. ⟦4⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine. ⟦5⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks of the specified type. ⟦6⟧ Optional - will filter by the track index within the folder (0-indexed).
yxi7bl.zh: ⟦0⟧ 应用每日精通度增长的天数。⟦1⟧ 本地化键 - 将用于描述中，以显示精通度增长的来源。⟦2⟧ 可选 - 将按指定文件夹中的路线筛选。⟦3⟧ 可选 - 将按具有指定大学说的文件夹中的路线筛选。⟦4⟧ 可选 - 将按具有指定子学说的路线筛选。⟦5⟧ 可选 - 将按指定类型的路线筛选。⟦6⟧ 可选 - 将按文件夹内的路线索引筛选（从 0 开始索引）。

1f72ca3.en: ⟦0⟧ Number of days to apply the bonus mastery gain for. ⟦1⟧ Loc key - will be used in descriptions to show the source of the mastery gain. ⟦2⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder. ⟦3⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine. ⟦4⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine. ⟦5⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks of the specified type. ⟦6⟧ Optional - will filter by the track index within the folder (0-indexed).
1f72ca3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 应用奖励精通度增长的天数。⟦1⟧ 本地化键 - 将用于描述中，以显示精通度增长的来源。⟦2⟧ 可选 - 将按指定文件夹中的路线筛选。⟦3⟧ 可选 - 将按具有指定大学说的文件夹中的路线筛选。⟦4⟧ 可选 - 将按具有指定子学说的路线筛选。⟦5⟧ 可选 - 将按指定类型的路线筛选。⟦6⟧ 可选 - 将按文件夹内的路线索引筛选（从 0 开始索引）。

1bnfv2c.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether the operative can be recruited by the spy master. bypass_recruitment should be set to no. ⟦1⟧ If selecting a random portrait, create one that is from the specified country rather than the current country. ⟦2⟧ The name of the operative. ⟦3⟧ The graphical reference of the picture of the leader, defined as a sprite within any ⟦4⟧ file. ⟦5⟧ The nationalities of the operative. ⟦6⟧ The traits the leader spawns with. ⟦7⟧ The gender of the operative. Defaults to random.
1bnfv2c.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该特工是否能被特工大师招募。bypass_recruitment 应设为 no。⟦1⟧ 若选择随机肖像，则创建一张来自指定国家而非当前国家的肖像。⟦2⟧ 该特工的姓名。⟦3⟧ 该领袖图片的图形引用，以 sprite 形式定义在任意 ⟦4⟧ 文件中。⟦5⟧ 该特工的国籍。⟦6⟧ 该领袖生成时拥有的特质。⟦7⟧ 该特工的性别。默认为随机。

1w3gqp8.en: Targets the current scope where it's used. For example, when used in ⟦0⟧, it will refer to the state that's currently being evaluated. Primarily useful for variables (as in the example, where omitting it wouldn't work) or for ⟦1⟧, where some scope must be specified. More rarely, this may help with scope manipulation when using ⟦2⟧. Since omitting it makes no difference in how the code gets interpreted, there is little to no usage outside of these cases.
1w3gqp8.zh: 以使用它的当前位置为目标作用域。例如，在 ⟦0⟧ 中使用时，它将指代当前正在求值的州。主要用于变量（如示例中所示，省略它将无法工作）或用于 ⟦1⟧，此时必须指定某个作用域。更少见地，在使用 ⟦2⟧ 时，这可能有助于作用域操作。由于省略它不会改变代码的解释方式，因此在这些情况之外几乎没有用处。

1dchk59.en: ⟦0⟧ The fraction of the total score awarded to the winners compared to regular victory. ⟦1⟧ The reason for peace showing up in the pop-up. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Which countries should be present in the conference on the winner side alongside the current scope. Optional, defaults to LIMITED_FACTION. ⟦3⟧ Which countries should be present in the conference on the loser side alongside the target country. Optional, defaults to LIMITED_FACTION.
1dchk59.zh: ⟦0⟧ 相比常规胜利，授予胜利方的总分数比例。⟦1⟧ 在弹出窗口中显示的和平理由。可选。⟦2⟧ 除当前作用域外，哪些国家应作为胜利方出席和平会议。可选，默认为 LIMITED_FACTION。⟦3⟧ 除目标国家外，哪些国家应作为失败方出席和平会议。可选，默认为 LIMITED_FACTION。

1eg5g2v.en: ⟦0⟧ The folder to steal from. See ⟦1⟧ for list. ⟦2⟧ The reduction to the ahead of time penalty. ⟦3⟧ The bonus to research speed. ⟦4⟧ The backup bonus if no tech is available. ⟦5⟧ Whether to instantly give a tech instead of a bonus or not. No by default. ⟦6⟧ Changes between instant and non-instant based on type. No by default. ⟦7⟧ The name of the bonus. ⟦8⟧ The country to steal from. ⟦9⟧ How many times the bonus can be used.
1eg5g2v.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要窃取来源的文件夹。列表见 ⟦1⟧。⟦2⟧ 对超前时间惩罚的削减。⟦3⟧ 对科研速度的加成。⟦4⟧ 若无可用科技时的备用加成。⟦5⟧ 是直接给予一项科技还是给予加成。默认为 no。⟦6⟧ 根据类型在即时与非即时之间切换。默认为 no。⟦7⟧ 该加成的名称。⟦8⟧ 要窃取来源的国家。⟦9⟧ 该加成可使用的次数。

1ru4zt9.en: ⟦0⟧ No by default, if yes and in a country scope, it will only build on allied territories for the country scoped. ⟦1⟧ Defaults to no, if yes each option will try to fallback to the next available one. ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ If using start state/target state, the game will pick the provinces with the best supply available. If using state province/target province, the game will link those two provinces.
1ru4zt9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 默认为 no，若为 yes 且处于国家作用域，则仅在该作用域国家的盟友领土上建造。⟦1⟧ 默认为 no，若为 yes，每个选项都会尝试回退到下一个可用选项。⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ 若使用起始州/目标州，游戏将选取补给最佳的省份。若使用起始省份/目标省份，游戏将连接这两个省份。

tqfu6a.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The state the side is fighting on. ⟦2⟧ The number of provinces used in the state. ⟦3⟧ The event to fire for the side on a win. ⟦4⟧ The event to fire for the side on a loss. ⟦5⟧ The event to fire for the side on a draw. ⟦6⟧ The modifier on combat. Defaults to 0. ⟦7⟧ The modifier applied to dig-in bonuses. Defaults to 1. ⟦8⟧ The modifier applied to terrain bonuses. Defaults to 1.
tqfu6a.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 该方作战所在的州。⟦2⟧ 该州内使用的省份数量。⟦3⟧ 该方胜利时触发的事件。⟦4⟧ 该方失败时触发的事件。⟦5⟧ 该方平局时触发的事件。⟦6⟧ 战斗上的修正。默认为 0。⟦7⟧ 应用于构筑工事加成的修正。默认为 1。⟦8⟧ 应用于地形加成的修正。默认为 1。

xb5p1i.en: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ The graphical reference of the picture of the leader. ⟦5⟧ The skill of the leader. ⟦6⟧The attack skill of the leader. ⟦7⟧The defense skill of the leader. ⟦8⟧The maneuvering skill of the leader. ⟦9⟧The coordination skill of the leader. ⟦10⟧ The traits the leader spawns with. ⟦11⟧ The gender of the leader. ⟦12⟧ The legacy ID used for the unit leader. Optional.
xb5p1i.zh: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ 该领袖图片的图形引用。⟦5⟧ 该领袖的技能。⟦6⟧该领袖的攻击技能。⟦7⟧该领袖的防御技能。⟦8⟧该领袖的机动技能。⟦9⟧该领袖的协调技能。⟦10⟧ 该领袖生成时拥有的特质。⟦11⟧ 该领袖的性别。⟦12⟧ 该单位将领使用的传承 ID。可选。

1wmgwzs.en: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ The graphical reference of the picture of the leader. ⟦5⟧ The skill of the leader. ⟦6⟧ The attack skill of the leader. ⟦7⟧ The defense skill of the leader. ⟦8⟧ The planning skill of the leader. ⟦9⟧ The logistics skill of the leader. ⟦10⟧ The traits the leader spawns with. ⟦11⟧ The gender of the leader. ⟦12⟧ The legacy ID used for the unit leader. Optional.
1wmgwzs.zh: ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ 该领袖图片的图形引用。⟦5⟧ 该领袖的技能。⟦6⟧ 该领袖的攻击技能。⟦7⟧ 该领袖的防御技能。⟦8⟧ 该领袖的计划技能。⟦9⟧ 该领袖的后勤技能。⟦10⟧ 该领袖生成时拥有的特质。⟦11⟧ 该领袖的性别。⟦12⟧ 该单位将领使用的传承 ID。可选。

i3xn02.en: An if statement allows an execution of effects to only be done if certain ⟦0⟧ are met. Conditional statements are represented with the ⟦1⟧ effect. ⟦2⟧ inside of the if statement serves as a ⟦3⟧ that defines the conditions when it should be executed, and everything else directly inside of ⟦4⟧ is interpreted as the effects that should be executed if the condition is true.
i3xn02.zh: if 语句允许仅在满足某些 ⟦0⟧ 时才执行效果。条件语句用 ⟦1⟧ 效果表示。if 语句内部的 ⟦2⟧ 充当 ⟦3⟧，定义何时应执行，而 ⟦4⟧ 内直接包含的其他所有内容都会被解释为条件为真时应执行的效果。

yeke0m.en: ⟦0⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦1⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦2⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦3⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦4⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦5⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦6⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦7⟧ The bonus to grant. Optional. ⟦8⟧ The duration of the buff. Optional. ⟦9⟧ The tooltip to display for the buff.
yeke0m.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦1⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦2⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦3⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦4⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦5⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦6⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦7⟧ 要授予的加成。可选。⟦8⟧ 该增益效果的持续时间。可选。⟦9⟧ 该增益效果要显示的提示框。

wop93o.en: The number is not the chance, but the weight for each option, as they don't have to add up to 100 or any number. An option with the weight of 20 is twice as likely to be picked as the option with the chance of 10, for instance. In total, the probability for an option to be picked is equal to the weight of the option divided by the sum of all weights.
wop93o.zh: 该数字不是概率，而是每个选项的权重，因为它们不必总和为 100 或任何数字。例如，权重为 20 的选项被选中的可能性是权重为 10 的选项的两倍。总体而言，某个选项被选中的概率等于该选项的权重除以所有权重之和。

1f6xhks.en: ⟦0⟧ will be the country for whom the occupation law will be changed. If PREV is not a country, nothing changes. If PREV is the same country, changes the default occupation law. If PREV is different, default_law resets the country-specific law to the global default, otherwise it resets the default law to the occupation law with ⟦1⟧ in definition. ⟦2⟧
1f6xhks.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将是更改占领法令所针对的国家。若 PREV 不是国家，则不发生任何改变。若 PREV 是同一国家，则更改默认占领法令。若 PREV 不同，default_law 会把该国家专属法令重置为全局默认值，否则会把默认法令重置为定义中带有 ⟦1⟧ 的占领法令。⟦2⟧

fa0vh3.en: ⟦0⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder. ⟦1⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine. ⟦2⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine. ⟦3⟧ Optional - will filter by tracks of the specified type. ⟦4⟧ Optional - will filter by the track index within the folder (0-indexed).
fa0vh3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可选 - 将按指定文件夹中的路线筛选。⟦1⟧ 可选 - 将按具有指定大学说的文件夹中的路线筛选。⟦2⟧ 可选 - 将按具有指定子学说的路线筛选。⟦3⟧ 可选 - 将按指定类型的路线筛选。⟦4⟧ 可选 - 将按文件夹内的路线索引筛选（从 0 开始索引）。

9cw6h8.en: A value of 1 sets the technology. A value of 0 removes the technology, but if it is a researchable technology, the duration it takes to research isn't reset, meaning it can be researched in 1 day. Technologies that are mutually exclusive with other technologies can not be removed by this effect. Technologies are defined in ⟦0⟧ files. ⟦1⟧
9cw6h8.zh: 值为 1 时设置该科技。值为 0 时移除该科技，但若它是可研究的科技，其研究所需时长不会被重置，意味着它可以在 1 天内研究完成。与其他科技互斥的科技无法通过此效果移除。科技在 ⟦0⟧ 文件中定义。⟦1⟧

1s4lyy3.en: ⟦0⟧ Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional. ⟦1⟧ Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Adds a random number (between ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧, inclusive) of ⟦5⟧ to the scheduled fire time. Optional. ⟦6⟧ Adds a random number (between ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧, inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional.
1s4lyy3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 在指定的天数后触发该事件。可选。⟦1⟧ 在指定的小时数后触发该事件。可选。⟦2⟧ 向预定触发时间添加一个随机数量（介于 ⟦3⟧ 与 ⟦4⟧ 之间，含两端）的 ⟦5⟧。可选。⟦6⟧ 向预定触发时间添加一个随机数量（介于 ⟦7⟧ 与 ⟦8⟧ 之间，含两端）的天数。可选。

4le7ep.en: A civil war started via this effect cannot have more than two sides and the effect cannot be used in ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. For adding more sides or starting one before the game's start, this can be simulated by setting an existing war (typically originating from a dynamic country created via ⟦2⟧) as a civil war via ⟦3⟧.
4le7ep.zh: 通过此效果发起的内战不能超过两方，且该效果不能在 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 中使用。要添加更多方或在游戏开始前发起内战，可以通过把一场已有的战争（通常源自通过 ⟦2⟧ 创建的动态国家）用 ⟦3⟧ 设置为内战来模拟。

17nz1bx.en: Within the tooltip, only effects that would be executed are shown. The effects within an unfulfilled if statement (or an ⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧ that's not read due to the if statement being met) will be hidden from the player, and so will the trigger. In order to avoid player confusion, ⟦2⟧, such as being used within an ⟦3⟧.
17nz1bx.zh: 在提示框中，只显示将会执行的效果。未满足的 if 语句内的效果（或因 if 语句已满足而未被读取的 ⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧）将对玩家隐藏，触发器也会被隐藏。为避免玩家困惑，⟦2⟧，例如在 ⟦3⟧ 中使用时。

1m9nv6.en: Targets the scope that the current scope is contained in. Can have additional applications where the assumed default scope differs from the ROOT, such as in state events or some on_actions. Can be chained indefinitely as PREV.PREV. ⟦0⟧: what's shown to the player doesn't always correlate with reality. ⟦1⟧
1m9nv6.zh: 以当前作用域所隶属的作用域为目标。在假定默认作用域与 ROOT 不同的情况下可以有更多用途，例如在州事件或某些 on_action 中。可以无限链接为 PREV.PREV。⟦0⟧：向玩家显示的内容并不总是与现实相符。⟦1⟧

i1dwly.en: Scripted effects serve a similar purpose to functions in that they can be defined in ⟦0⟧ and then used elsewhere as a shortened version. ⟦1⟧ and requires being used as an effect elsewhere to be executed. Alongside that, the game allows the creation of custom console commands, which are scripted effects.
i1dwly.zh: 脚本效果的作用与函数类似，它们可以在 ⟦0⟧ 中定义，然后在其他地方作为简写形式使用。⟦1⟧ 并且需要在其他地方作为效果使用才能执行。此外，游戏允许创建自定义控制台指令，它们也是脚本效果。

19kqa0n.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether elections are allowed. Optional. ⟦1⟧ When the last election was. Optional. ⟦2⟧ How often in months an election occurs. Optional. ⟦3⟧ The long name of the country's new ruling party, appearing when hovering over it. Optional. ⟦4⟧ The name of the country's new ruling party. Optional.
19kqa0n.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是否允许选举。可选。⟦1⟧ 上次选举的时间。可选。⟦2⟧ 选举每隔多少个月举行一次。可选。⟦3⟧ 该国新执政党的长名称，悬停于其上时显示。可选。⟦4⟧ 该国新执政党的名称。可选。

12v5fi9.en: The ⟦0⟧ effect can be used if the dynamic country does not yet exist in order to ensure that it does not get overwritten by other creations of dynamic countries. If this is not done, the dynamic country will immediately stop existing if no states are transferred in the same scope. ⟦1⟧
12v5fi9.zh: 若动态国家尚不存在，可以使用 ⟦0⟧ 效果来确保它不会被其他动态国家的创建所覆盖。若不这样做，且在同一作用域内没有移交任何州，该动态国家将立即停止存在。⟦1⟧

24z50r.en: ⟦0⟧ Optional, accepts variable and keyword, only relevant if using random portrait, by default use country in scope. ⟦1⟧ Optional, by default random gender. ⟦2⟧ Optional array, same format as in scientist role in character DB, by default all skills are at 1. ⟦3⟧ Optional array.
24z50r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可选，接受变量和关键字，仅在使用随机肖像时相关，默认使用作用域中的国家。⟦1⟧ 可选，默认为随机性别。⟦2⟧ 可选数组，格式与人物数据库中的科学家角色相同，默认所有技能均为 1。⟦3⟧ 可选数组。

17xg548.en: ⟦0⟧ The description of the leader. ⟦1⟧ The graphical reference to the leader portrait. ⟦2⟧ When the leader dies in history. ⟦3⟧ The sub-ideology of the country leader. Does not accept regular ideologies. ⟦4⟧ The gender of the leader. ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ The trait to add. Can add multiple.
17xg548.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该领袖的描述。⟦1⟧ 该领袖肖像的图形引用。⟦2⟧ 该领袖在历史上的死亡时间。⟦3⟧ 该国领袖的子意识形态。不接受常规意识形态。⟦4⟧ 该领袖的性别。⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ 要添加的特质。可添加多个。

1200br2.en: Elections will always be disallowed for the breakaway. If the ⟦0⟧ attribute is used, the original country will have its elections disallowed. In the base game files, an on action is set up to ensure that elections get allowed if the democratic side wins the civil war.
1200br2.zh: 分离国家将始终被禁止选举。若使用了 ⟦0⟧ 属性，原属国也将被禁止选举。在基础游戏文件中，设置了一个 on action，以确保若民主方赢得内战则允许选举。

1k30fdc.en: Note that if you want to create a repeatable decision including a random list, by default the same decision will pick the same random result every time it is triggered in a game. You can reverse this behaviour by including the following line in the decision block:
1k30fdc.zh: 请注意，如果你想创建一个包含随机列表的可重复决议，默认情况下同一决议在游戏中每次被触发时都会选取相同的随机结果。你可以通过在决议块中包含以下行来反转此行为：

16bzmmj.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to target. ⟦1⟧ The buildings with this tag to damage. ⟦2⟧ The buildings with these tags to damage. ⟦3⟧ Repair will be x% slower until building is fully repaired ⟦4⟧ The amount of damage to inflict. ⟦5⟧ The province to target for provincal buildings.
16bzmmj.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要作为目标的州。⟦1⟧ 要损坏的拥有此标签的建筑。⟦2⟧ 要损坏的拥有这些标签的建筑。⟦3⟧ 在建筑完全修复前，修复速度将慢 x% ⟦4⟧ 要造成的损坏量。⟦5⟧ 省级建筑要作为目标的省份。

p68d4k.en: Noticably, the effect that fires the country event gets hidden from the tooltip. After completing the focus, the only thing that happens is that every subject country receives an event with the ID of ⟦0⟧, the country does not immediately gain 100 political power.
p68d4k.zh: 值得注意的是，触发国家事件的效果会从提示框中隐藏。完成该焦点后，唯一发生的事情是每个附属国都会收到一个 ID 为 ⟦0⟧ 的事件，该国不会立即获得 100 政治点数。

w44ypk.en: Shared buildings slots being the ones used for multiple building types, such as military or civilian factories. This is in contrast to non-shared slots, such as those used by radio stations or air bases, which only can be changed globally with technologies. ⟦0⟧
w44ypk.zh: 共享建筑槽位指的是用于多种建筑类型的槽位，例如军用或民用工厂。这与非共享槽位形成对比，例如无线电台或空军基地所使用的槽位，它们只能通过科技在全球范围内更改。⟦0⟧

14vgc5t.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The target country. ⟦2⟧ Whether the target country will peace out in all of its non-civil wars it's participating in. Defaults to true. ⟦3⟧ Whether the target country will peace out in all of its civil wars it's participating in. Defaults to true.
14vgc5t.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 目标国家。⟦2⟧ 目标国家是否将退出其参与的所有非内战战争。默认为 true。⟦3⟧ 目标国家是否将退出其参与的所有内战。默认为 true。

twap4d.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of times the bonus can be used, default 1. ⟦1⟧ The cost reduction if ahead of time, default 0. ⟦2⟧ Which technology category the bonus applies to. Multiple can be defined. ⟦3⟧ Which technology the bonus applies to. Multiple can be defined.
twap4d.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该加成可使用的次数，默认为 1。⟦1⟧ 若处于超前时间时的成本削减，默认为 0。⟦2⟧ 该加成适用的科技类别。可定义多个。⟦3⟧ 该加成适用的科技。可定义多个。

1t7o1zw.en: In the effect shown above, amount of equipment added is dynamic and can be set using the variable "eq_amount". However, this effect does not let you use a variable as equipment type. You can not store "infantry_equipment_2" in a variable and use it here.
1t7o1zw.zh: 在上面显示的效果中，添加的装备数量是动态的，可以使用变量 "eq_amount" 设置。然而，此效果不允许你把变量用作装备类型。你不能把 "infantry_equipment_2" 存入变量并在此处使用。

3ahyap.en: ⟦0⟧ will be the country for whom the occupation law will be changed. If PREV is not a country, nothing changes. If PREV doesn't occupy the state, nothing happens until it does. If using ⟦1⟧, resets to the law set by the country's occupation. ⟦2⟧
3ahyap.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将是更改占领法令所针对的国家。若 PREV 不是国家，则不发生任何改变。若 PREV 未占领该州，则在它占领前不会有任何变化。若使用 ⟦1⟧，则重置为该国的占领所设定的法令。⟦2⟧

paeu57.en: ⟦0⟧ The buildings with this tag to damage. ⟦1⟧ The buildings with these tags to damage. ⟦2⟧ Repair will be x% slower until building is fully repaired ⟦3⟧ The amount of damage to inflict. ⟦4⟧ The province to target for provincal buildings.
paeu57.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要损坏的拥有此标签的建筑。⟦1⟧ 要损坏的拥有这些标签的建筑。⟦2⟧ 在建筑完全修复前，修复速度将慢 x% ⟦3⟧ 要造成的损坏量。⟦4⟧ 省级建筑要作为目标的省份。

7g8fu0.en: ⟦0⟧ The state to nuke. ⟦1⟧ Prioritises provinces controlled by this country. ⟦2⟧ Whether a nuke should be deducted from the country's stockpile. Defaults to false. ⟦3⟧ type of nuke to use (e.g. nuclear_bomb, thermonuclear_bomb etc.)
7g8fu0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要核击的州。⟦1⟧ 优先选择该国控制的省份。⟦2⟧ 是否应从该国的库存中扣除一枚核弹。默认为 false。⟦3⟧ 要使用的核弹类型（例如 nuclear_bomb、thermonuclear_bomb 等）

1apf2oo.en: ⟦0⟧ Modifies the production cost. ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ The equipment the country is licensed to produce. Must be an non-archetype equipment. ⟦3⟧ The version indicates which variant should be licensed. The default is 0, meaning the base variant.
1apf2oo.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修改生产成本。⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 该国获许可生产的装备。必须是非原型装备。⟦3⟧ 版本表示应许可哪个变体。默认为 0，即基础变体。

1nhkhm1.en: This can be bypassed by putting an effect within a hidden event fired immediately within the focus or by reloading the same focus tree with ⟦0⟧ set to keep completed focuses, marking the focus as complete, before using the effect.
1nhkhm1.zh: 可以通过在焦点内立即触发的隐藏事件中放入一个效果，或在把 ⟦0⟧ 设为保留已完成焦点、将该焦点标记为完成后重新加载同一国策树来绕过这一点，然后再使用该效果。

mkenke.en: If the country flag inward_perfect_flag is set, it'll multiply the above chance of 30 by 1.3 to get 39. Meanwhile, ⟦0⟧ will take the value of the according temp variable or the current scope's variable as the weight of the option.
mkenke.zh: 若设置了国家标记 inward_perfect_flag，它会将上述 30 的概率乘以 1.3 得到 39。同时，⟦0⟧ 将取相应临时变量的值或当前作用域的变量作为该选项的权重。

84xjdv.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Project to complete. ⟦2⟧ Optional, default to current scientists on the project. ⟦3⟧ Optional, default to current state of the project. ⟦4⟧ Optional, can be a single reward or reward = option. ⟦5⟧ Optional, default = yes.
84xjdv.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 要完成的项目。⟦2⟧ 可选，默认为该项目当前的科学家。⟦3⟧ 可选，默认为该项目的当前状态。⟦4⟧ 可选，可以是单个奖励或 reward = option。⟦5⟧ 可选，默认 = yes。

eczvd6.en: ⟦0⟧ The left side of the BoP. ⟦1⟧ The right side of the BoP. ⟦2⟧ Resets the BoP to the initial state defined in the file. Optional, defaults to false. ⟦3⟧ The new value of the BoP. Optional, defaults to not changing the value.
eczvd6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 权力平衡（BoP）的左侧。⟦1⟧ 权力平衡的右侧。⟦2⟧ 将权力平衡重置为文件中定义的初始状态。可选，默认为 false。⟦3⟧ 权力平衡的新数值。可选，默认为不改变数值。

z4vl4n.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount to add. ⟦1⟧ Defines who produced the equipment. Optional, defaults to the current scope. ⟦2⟧ The equipment variant to add. Mandatory if a variant needs to be created to produce the equipment, optional otherwise.

4ba8zz.en: Current scope is the winner, target and its subjects are the losers. Can only be used if at war with the target. A score_factor of 0.0 is equivalent to a whitepeace. ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ have the following possible values: ⟦2⟧

v7emwg.en: In ⟦0⟧, this refers to the country that sent the event (i.e. if the event was fired ⟦1⟧, then it's the ROOT scope where it was fired). In ⟦2⟧ or diplomacy scripted triggers, this refers to the scope that is targeted.
v7emwg.zh: 在 ⟦0⟧ 中，这指代发送该事件的国家（即若该事件是 ⟦1⟧ 触发的，则它是当时触发所在的 ROOT 作用域）。在 ⟦2⟧ 或外交脚本触发器中，这指代被作为目标的作用域。

asfx91.en: If put within a focus' completion reward, the focus will not be marked as complete at the time the effect is executed, leading to ⟦0⟧ checks specifying that focus in particular to be marked as false. ⟦1⟧

1g06tbe.en: ⟦0⟧ The target country. ⟦1⟧ Name of ship in origin navy that will preferably be transferred to target navy. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Determines whether ships that are being refitted will be transferred. Optional.
1g06tbe.zh: ⟦0⟧ 目标国家。⟦1⟧ 原海军中优先移交给目标海军的舰船名称。可选。⟦2⟧ 决定正在改装中的舰船是否会被移交。可选。

1nbaduk.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The amount of strength and organization damage taken. ⟦2⟧ The amount of organization damage taken. ⟦3⟧ The amount of strength damage taken ⟦4⟧ The amount of planes lost ⟦5⟧ optional, default no
1nbaduk.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 承受的兵力和组织度伤害量。⟦2⟧ 承受的组织度伤害量。⟦3⟧ 承受的兵力伤害量 ⟦4⟧ 损失的飞机数量 ⟦5⟧ 可选，默认为 no

s00u8z.en: ⟦0⟧ The wargoal to generate. ⟦1⟧ The states to supply the wargoal (i.e. take_state_focus). ⟦2⟧ The amount of days that the wargoal will last before expiring. If unset or set to 0, will never expire.

ga5c9a.en: ⟦0⟧ The number of days to modify the idea by. ⟦1⟧ The number of months to modify the idea by. A month is equal to 30 days. ⟦2⟧ The number of years to modify the idea by. A year is equal to 365 days.
ga5c9a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 修改该理念的天数。⟦1⟧ 修改该理念的月数。一个月等于 30 天。⟦2⟧ 修改该理念的年数。一年等于 365 天。

alidye.en: ⟦0⟧ A description used as the reason for the rule applying. Optional. ⟦1⟧ A scripted trigger deciding when the override should be active. Optional, defaults to always true. ⟦2⟧ Rule's new value.
alidye.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用作规则适用理由的描述。可选。⟦1⟧ 决定该覆盖何时生效的脚本触发器。可选，默认为始终为 true。⟦2⟧ 规则的新数值。

1yikkbb.en: ⟦0⟧ The number of days to add the idea for. ⟦1⟧ The number of months to add the idea for. A month is equal to 30 days. ⟦2⟧ The number of years to add the idea for. A year is equal to 365 days.
1yikkbb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 添加该理念的天数。⟦1⟧ 添加该理念的月数。一个月等于 30 天。⟦2⟧ 添加该理念的年数。一年等于 365 天。

152f0ze.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The national focus tree to load. ⟦2⟧ Whether focuses shared between the old and new trees should stay completed. Defaults to false. ⟦3⟧ Copy completed focus from an existing country.
152f0ze.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 要加载的国策树。⟦2⟧ 新旧国策树之间共享的焦点是否应保持已完成。默认为 false。⟦3⟧ 从现有国家复制已完成的焦点。

abifgm.en: These scripted effects are defined in base game and might be useful to keep in the mod to cut down on the amount of code. As scripted effects, all of these use a boolean value as argument.
abifgm.zh: 这些脚本效果在基础游戏中定义，保留在模组中可能有助于减少代码量。作为脚本效果，它们全都使用布尔值作为参数。

1m3f4fn.en: ⟦0⟧ The type of autonomy state to set. ⟦1⟧ The new freedom level value. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Will end any wars the subject is involved in. ⟦3⟧ Will end any civil wars the subject is subject to
1m3f4fn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要设置的自治度状态类型。⟦1⟧ 新的自由等级数值。可选。⟦2⟧ 将结束该附属国参与的任何战争。⟦3⟧ 将结束该附属国所涉的任何内战

je545g.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若数组当前大小小于该规模，则要添加到数组中的变量。可选，默认为 0。⟦1⟧ 调整大小后数组内的元素数量。

1ovmc2p.zh: 元效果允许你把非动态效果（不接受修正、只能使用静态标记或常量值的效果）当作接受变量来使用。

ygff9t.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The flag to set. ⟦2⟧ Sets the flag to last for the specified amount of days. Optional. ⟦3⟧ The new value of the flag on the scale from -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647.
ygff9t.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 要设置的标记。⟦2⟧ 将标记设置为持续指定的天数。可选。⟦3⟧ 标记的新数值，标度为 -2 147 483 648 到 2 147 483 647。

q8btpu.en: ⟦0⟧ The equipment variant to use. ⟦1⟧ The country that created this ship. Optional. ⟦2⟧ Name of the ship. Optional. ⟦3⟧ The amount of ships to create. Optional, defaults to 1.

7wu70q.zh: ⟦0⟧ 陆军将被传送到的州数组。⟦1⟧ 陆军将被传送到的省份。⟦2⟧ 陆军将被传送到的州。

b69q95.zh: 升级在 ⟦0⟧ 中定义。装备类型（包括其模块槽位）在 ⟦1⟧ 中定义。装备模块在 ⟦2⟧ 中定义。

1238com.en: Has no effect on small islands, megalopolises, or ⟦0⟧ (Dense Urban Region). ⟦1⟧ (Urban Region) gets upgraded straight to Metropolis, skipping ⟦2⟧.
1238com.zh: 对小岛屿、特大城市或 ⟦0⟧（密集城区）没有效果。⟦1⟧（城区）会直接升级为都会，跳过 ⟦2⟧。

yvfwbz.en: All prepared Port Strike and Strategic Bombing in the target region will execute multiple times without air defence being able to intercept them.
yvfwbz.zh: 目标区域内所有已准备的港口打击和战略轰炸将执行多次，且防空无法拦截它们。

faxmjp.en: If you want an effect to have a random chance to be done or have nothing happen otherwise, the ⟦0⟧ block is the simplest way to accomplish that:
faxmjp.zh: 如果你希望某个效果有随机概率被执行，否则什么也不发生，⟦0⟧ 块是实现这一点的最简单方式：

m6xdg0.en: ⟦0⟧ Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ⟦1⟧ Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. ⟦2⟧ The trait to remove.
m6xdg0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该人物的槽位。顾问必填。⟦1⟧ 该人物的意识形态类型。国家领袖必填。⟦2⟧ 要移除的特质。

oh8bnv.en: It is also possible to use modifiers (akin to MTTH blocks) to affect the weight of each possible random effect or to use variables as chances.
oh8bnv.zh: 也可以使用修正（类似 MTTH 块）来影响每个可能随机效果的权重，或使用变量作为概率。

3tgpjr.en: debug = yes can be added to meta effects. Which will print the final effect to game.log when the effect is executed and make debugging easier.
3tgpjr.zh: 可以向元效果添加 debug = yes。这将在效果执行时把最终效果打印到 game.log，使调试更容易。

1ib9471.en: ⟦0⟧ Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ⟦1⟧ Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. ⟦2⟧ The trait to add.
1ib9471.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该人物的槽位。顾问必填。⟦1⟧ 该人物的意识形态类型。国家领袖必填。⟦2⟧ 要添加的特质。

1tswg9r.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ Will activate the advisor (add them directly when the command is run to the countries government). Optional, defaults to false.
1tswg9r.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 将激活该顾问（在指令运行时直接把他们加入该国政府）。可选，默认为 false。

e6cgz0.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ The template of the faction. ⟦2⟧ The name of the faction. ⟦3⟧ The icon of the faction. ⟦4⟧ The color of the faction in RGB format.
e6cgz0.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 阵营的模板。⟦2⟧ 阵营的名称。⟦3⟧ 阵营的图标。⟦4⟧ 阵营的颜色，RGB 格式。

bo1k9i.en: If the capacity is reduced to below the amount of assigned tasks, they'll be turned allowed. Cannot be negative. Doesn't instantly apply.
bo1k9i.zh: 若容量被削减到低于已分配任务的数量，这些任务将被转为允许状态。不能为负数。不会立即生效。

phtvm5.en: ⟦0⟧ If specified, copies stuff from this tag rather than the original tag. ⟦1⟧ Effects that will be executed on the new dynamic country.
phtvm5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若指定，则从此标签而非原标签复制内容。⟦1⟧ 将在新的动态国家上执行的效果。

1450g58.en: ⟦0⟧ How much civilian intel to add. ⟦1⟧ How much army intel to add. ⟦2⟧ How much navy intel to add. ⟦3⟧ How much airforce intel to add.
1450g58.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加多少民用情报。⟦1⟧ 要添加多少陆军情报。⟦2⟧ 要添加多少海军情报。⟦3⟧ 要添加多少空军情报。

1psplm4.en: ⟦0⟧# Changes USA's occupation law for GER where possible. ⟦1⟧# Changes the USA's default occupation law to the default where possible.
1psplm4.zh: ⟦0⟧# 在可能的地方更改美国对德国的占领法令。⟦1⟧# 在可能的地方把美国的默认占领法令更改为默认值。

3affys.en: ⟦0⟧ When using a variable and a ⟦1⟧, must be used as "saved_event.var_name" because "event_target:saved_event.var_name" will not work.
3affys.zh: ⟦0⟧ 当使用变量和 ⟦1⟧ 时，必须写作 "saved_event.var_name"，因为 "event_target:saved_event.var_name" 将无法工作。

x0s4b4.en: If the amount goes above the "Size Up" limit, the MIO will automatically gains sizes. The amount of funds is capped at 0 from below.
x0s4b4.zh: 若该数量超过「扩大规模」上限，军事工业组织将自动获得规模。资金数量的下限封顶为 0。

1d3098b.en: For example, the following will add 10% Stability to the country this is executed on if it has positive ⟦0⟧ and below 90% stability:
1d3098b.zh: 例如，若该国拥有正向 ⟦0⟧ 且稳定度低于 90%，以下内容将为其增加 10% 稳定度：

1l1s3mg.en: ⟦0⟧ The state where the resource rights are located. ⟦1⟧ The resources to which give resource rights to. Optional, defaults to all.
1l1s3mg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 资源权所在的州。⟦1⟧ 要授予资源权的资源。可选，默认为全部。

x91mq4.en: ⟦0⟧ Will activate the advisor (add them directly when the command is run to the countries government). Optional, defaults to false.
x91mq4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 将激活该顾问（在指令运行时直接把他们加入该国政府）。可选，默认为 false。

li28cg.en: The base amount is capped at 0 from below. Rounded down, e.g. ⟦0⟧ with a cost of ⟦1⟧ should result in ⟦2⟧, but becomes ⟦3⟧ instead.
li28cg.zh: 基础数值下限封顶为 0。向下取整，例如 ⟦0⟧ 成本为 ⟦1⟧ 时结果应为 ⟦2⟧，但实际上变为 ⟦3⟧。

1pji857.en: The effects here must be used within a ⟦0⟧ scope. Special projects must always be pre-pended with ⟦1⟧ when used a a scope or value.
1pji857.zh: 此处的效果必须在 ⟦0⟧ 作用域内使用。特殊项目在用作作用域或数值时必须始终在前面加上 ⟦1⟧。

ua0qwd.en: This counts as the operative dying and will trigger the corresponding On action. Logs an error if used against your own operative.
ua0qwd.zh: 这算作该特工死亡，并将触发相应的 On action。若用于你自己的特工，会记录一条错误。

1q543rt.en: Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked ⟦0⟧ can be a performance light alternative to ⟦1⟧ for scheduling events. ⟦2⟧
1q543rt.zh: 在不需要反复检查触发器的情况下，⟦0⟧ 可以成为用于安排事件的 ⟦1⟧ 的性能轻量替代方案。⟦2⟧

upk3nm.en: ⟦0⟧ The name used by the railway gun. Optional. ⟦1⟧ Location where the railway gun is created. Assumes the capital by default.
upk3nm.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该列车炮使用的名称。可选。⟦1⟧ 创建列车炮的位置。默认为首都。

abtlkd.en: The division string ⟦0⟧. A linebreak in the middle of ⟦1⟧ will break the effect and result in no units being spawned. ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧
abtlkd.zh: 师字符串 ⟦0⟧。在 ⟦1⟧ 中间换行会破坏该效果，导致不生成任何单位。⟦2⟧⟦3⟧

sqynfo.en: Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked ⟦0⟧ can be a performance light alternative to ⟦1⟧ for scheduling events.
sqynfo.zh: 在无需反复检查触发器的情况下，⟦0⟧ 可以成为用于安排事件的 ⟦1⟧ 的性能轻量替代方案。

1e2qj6v.en: The song will start playing for every country if the effect is executed. See ⟦0⟧ if only one country should have the song.
1e2qj6v.zh: 若执行该效果，该歌曲将开始为每个国家播放。若只应让一个国家拥有该歌曲，请参见 ⟦0⟧。

1u0qq1r.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to add. ⟦1⟧ The index to place the variable on in the array. Optional, defaults to the end of the array.
1u0qq1r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的变量。⟦1⟧ 在数组中放置该变量的索引。可选，默认为数组末尾。

1qtym0b.en: If the ideas have the same name in the localisation, it will show up as modifying the idea rather than swapping them. ⟦0⟧
1qtym0b.zh: 若这些理念在本地化中同名，它将显示为修改该理念，而非将它们互换。⟦0⟧

449qho.en: These are the MIO-related effects in the country scope. For effects in military industrial organisation scope, see ⟦0⟧.
449qho.zh: 这些是国家作用域中与军事工业组织相关的效果。关于军事工业组织作用域中的效果，请参见 ⟦0⟧。

1yk1vf0.en: ⟦0⟧ Logged entry. Never shown to the player. ⟦1⟧ Whether a medal can be awarded to the division over the history entry.
1yk1vf0.zh: ⟦0⟧ 记录的条目。从不向玩家显示。⟦1⟧ 是否可以在此历史条目上向该师授予勋章。

1adxp5d.en: ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧ The sprite used as an advisor. ⟦2⟧ The sprite used as a general. ⟦3⟧:⟦4⟧ The sprite used as a country leader.
1adxp5d.zh: ⟦0⟧：⟦1⟧ 用作顾问的 sprite。⟦2⟧ 用作将领的 sprite。⟦3⟧：⟦4⟧ 用作国家领袖的 sprite。

3lns4m.en: The value defines the progress towards the max level, e.g. 0.2 = gain 20% of the experience needed to reach max level.
3lns4m.zh: 该数值定义了向最高等级推进的进度，例如 0.2 = 获得达到最高等级所需经验的 20%。

31fman.en: ⟦0⟧ is used in order to hide the effects within from the tooltip, making their execution not get shown to the player.
31fman.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于把其中的效果从提示框中隐藏，使其执行不会向玩家显示。

1epi618.en: ⟦0⟧ This effect is extremely buggy. It does not properly replace traits and is crash prone. Use ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ instead.
1epi618.zh: ⟦0⟧ 此效果有严重缺陷。它无法正确替换特质，且容易导致崩溃。请改用 ⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧。

1wblzmt.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether the old capital gets "remembered", making the country change to it in case the current capital is lost.
1wblzmt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 原首都是否会被「记住」，使该国在当前首都失守时迁回该地。

3w24d4.en: ⟦0⟧ The buildings with this tag to remove. ⟦1⟧ The buildings with these tags to remove. ⟦2⟧ The levels to remove.
3w24d4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除的拥有此标签的建筑。⟦1⟧ 要移除的拥有这些标签的建筑。⟦2⟧ 要移除的等级。

1jh5eyz.en: For units, damage can be defined through one value 'damage' or separately through 'org_damage' and 'str_damage'
1jh5eyz.zh: 对于单位，伤害可以通过一个值 'damage' 定义，或分别通过 'org_damage' 和 'str_damage' 定义

wrrzzn.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Policy to display. ⟦2⟧ Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.
wrrzzn.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 要显示的政策。⟦2⟧ 是否应在提示框中显示该特质的修正。默认为 true。

1sd2468.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Trait to complete. ⟦2⟧ Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.
1sd2468.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 要完成的特质。⟦2⟧ 是否应在提示框中显示该特质的修正。默认为 true。

5c03ts.en: ⟦0⟧ The minimum value of the variable after the clamp. ⟦1⟧ The maximum value of the variable after the clamp.
5c03ts.zh: ⟦0⟧ 限制后变量的最小值。⟦1⟧ 限制后变量的最大值。

nhpma6.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether the operative is directly added to the list of available operatives or needs to be recruited. ⟦1⟧
nhpma6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该特工是被直接加入可用特工列表，还是需要被招募。⟦1⟧

1fqktsv.en: ⟦0⟧ If set to zero, it will be treated as a 1. Created equipment will be the latest available to the country.
1fqktsv.zh: ⟦0⟧ 若设为零，将被视为 1。创建的装备将是该国可获得的最新装备。

2oc9pl.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ Trait to display. ⟦2⟧ Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.
2oc9pl.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 要显示的特质。⟦2⟧ 是否应在提示框中显示该特质的修正。默认为 true。

1c8486.en: The sound will play for every country if the effect is executed. See ⟦0⟧ if only one country should hear it.
1c8486.zh: 若执行该效果，该音效将为每个国家播放。若只应让一个国家听到，请参见 ⟦0⟧。

14oqojq.en: Cannot be negative. Rounded down, e.g. ⟦0⟧ with a cost of ⟦1⟧ should result in ⟦2⟧, but becomes ⟦3⟧ instead.
14oqojq.zh: 不能为负数。向下取整，例如 ⟦0⟧ 成本为 ⟦1⟧ 时结果应为 ⟦2⟧，但实际上变为 ⟦3⟧。

1ygxci5.en: ⟦0⟧ A description used for the rule. Optional, defaults to being the same as default. ⟦1⟧ Rule's new value.
1ygxci5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于该规则的描述。可选，默认为与 default 相同。⟦1⟧ 规则的新数值。

78bkae.en: ⟦0⟧ Optional, special project scope for using special project name. If not set, the name will be used. ⟦1⟧
78bkae.zh: ⟦0⟧ 可选，用于使用特殊项目名称的特殊项目作用域。若未设置，将使用该名称。⟦1⟧

smhweb.en: ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧ The sub-ideology of the country leader role to which the trait is added. ⟦2⟧ The trait to remove.
smhweb.zh: ⟦0⟧：⟦1⟧ 要添加该特质的国家领袖角色的子意识形态。⟦2⟧ 要移除的特质。

1hh9zkk.en: If the amount goes above the "Size Up" limit, the MIO will automatically gains sizes. Cannot be negative.
1hh9zkk.zh: 若该数量超过「扩大规模」上限，军事工业组织将自动获得规模。不能为负数。

ssino2.en: ⟦0⟧# Changes USA's occupation law for GER. ⟦1⟧# Changes the USA's default occupation law to the default.
ssino2.zh: ⟦0⟧# 更改美国对德国的占领法令。⟦1⟧# 把美国的默认占领法令更改为默认值。

ww7mqz.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of times the discount can be used. ⟦1⟧ Discount. ⟦2⟧ Can be equipment type and archetype.
ww7mqz.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该折扣可使用的次数。⟦1⟧ 折扣。⟦2⟧ 可以是装备类型和原型。

yc8zfh.en: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ Will promote the leader to be the leader of the assigned party. Optional, defaults to false.
yc8zfh.zh: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ 将把该领袖提升为所属党派的领袖。可选，默认为 false。

m5tykw.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to remove. Optional. ⟦1⟧ The index to remove the variable from in the array. Optional.
m5tykw.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要移除的变量。可选。⟦1⟧ 在数组中移除该变量的索引。可选。

1cf2xl4.en: ⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧ The sub-ideology of the country leader role to which the trait is added. ⟦2⟧ The trait to add.
1cf2xl4.zh: ⟦0⟧：⟦1⟧ 要添加该特质的国家领袖角色的子意识形态。⟦2⟧ 要添加的特质。

1qh0t0i.en: ⟦0⟧ The surname of the ace. ⟦1⟧ The callsign of the ace. ⟦2⟧ The ace type. ⟦3⟧ The gender of the ace.
1qh0t0i.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该王牌的姓氏。⟦1⟧ 该王牌的代号。⟦2⟧ 该王牌的类型。⟦3⟧ 该王牌的性别。

mw8pvg.en: ⟦0⟧. Elsewhere, random seed is unfixed by default, making this argument unnecessary to set to "no".
mw8pvg.zh: ⟦0⟧。在其他地方，随机种子默认是不固定的，因此无需把此参数设为 "no"。

1b6favc.en: ⟦0⟧ is, instead, used in order to put the effects into the tooltip without actually executing them.
1b6favc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 则用于把效果放入提示框中而不实际执行它们。

1lacevy.en: Turns the current operative against their own country, transferring them to the specified country.
1lacevy.zh: 使当前特工转而对抗自己的国家，将其转交给指定的国家。

1u9e9qp.en: Damage is applied to ground units while damage to plane is defined as the amount of planes lost.
1u9e9qp.zh: 伤害会施加于地面单位，而对飞机的伤害则定义为损失的飞机数量。

2rsm7q.en: If 'ratio = yes', then all damage / losses are applied as a fraction of the current amount. ⟦0⟧
2rsm7q.zh: 若 'ratio = yes'，则所有伤害/损失都按当前数量的比例施加。⟦0⟧

1j160fy.en: These can only be used as effects; trying to use them as ⟦0⟧ will result in nothing happening.
1j160fy.zh: 这些只能作为效果使用；把它们当作 ⟦0⟧ 使用将不会产生任何效果。

2cilgn.en: ⟦0⟧ The wargoal to declare with. ⟦1⟧ The states to supply the wargoal (i.e. take_state_focus).
2cilgn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于宣战的战争目标。⟦1⟧ 为战争目标提供依据的州（即 take_state_focus）。

y6yow4.en: ⟦0⟧ The defender state. ⟦1⟧ Makes the attacker the winner. ⟦2⟧ Makes the defender the winner.
y6yow4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 防御方州。⟦1⟧ 使进攻方成为胜利方。⟦2⟧ 使防御方成为胜利方。

utw70c.en: ⟦0⟧ The value to subtract from the variable. ⟦1⟧Localisation used by the operation. Optional.
utw70c.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要从变量中减去的数值。⟦1⟧该行动使用的本地化。可选。

1n4h33a.en: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ are stored as ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ temp variables. ⟦6⟧ is clamped between 0 and 1.

k5t9ui.en: Sub-ideologies are defined in ⟦0⟧. Deprecated. Recommended to use ⟦1⟧ instead when possible.
k5t9ui.zh: 子意识形态在 ⟦0⟧ 中定义。已弃用。在可能的情况下建议改用 ⟦1⟧。

1r6g7ij.en: ⟦0⟧ The value to multiply the variable by. ⟦1⟧Localisation used by the operation. Optional.
1r6g7ij.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要与变量相乘的数值。⟦1⟧该行动使用的本地化。可选。

92ffat.en: Using days = <event> / <variable> or hours may still be bugged and will not fire the event.
92ffat.zh: 使用 days = <event> / <variable> 或 hours 可能仍有缺陷，且不会触发该事件。

1bm5pbb.en: ⟦0⟧ Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. ⟦1⟧ The trait to remove.
1bm5pbb.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该人物的意识形态类型。国家领袖必填。⟦1⟧ 要移除的特质。

1te7iv0.en: May also refer to a scripted localisation definition, which'll be evaluated in MIO's scope.
1te7iv0.zh: 也可以指代一段脚本本地化定义，它将在军事工业组织的作用域中求值。

1a7eehf.en: Will give experience to any type of unit assigned to the raid, e.g. divisions or air wings.
1a7eehf.zh: 将给予分配给该突袭的任意类型单位经验，例如师或航空队。

19n176g.en: ⟦0⟧ The country attacking the ally. ⟦1⟧ Localization for the reason for joining. Optional.
19n176g.zh: ⟦0⟧ 攻击该盟友的国家。⟦1⟧ 用于加入理由的本地化。可选。

1fmwrk2.en: ⟦0⟧ The value to divide the variable by. ⟦1⟧Localisation used by the operation. Optional.
1fmwrk2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要除以变量的数值。⟦1⟧该行动使用的本地化。可选。

1hor9o9.en: ⟦0⟧ The value to modulo the variable by. ⟦1⟧Localisation used by the operation. Optional.
