1i77m35.en: The role of military engineers is to build bridges and lay mines, as well as destroy similar works of the enemy. With the right equipment, training, and a willingness to spill sweat to spare blood, we can dominate the modern battlefield.
1i77m35.zh: 军事工程兵的职责是架设桥梁、布设地雷，以及摧毁敌方的同类工事。有了合适的装备与训练，再加上甘愿多流汗以减少流血的决心，我们便能主宰现代战场。

1f01r4u.en: Building upon hard-earned lessons from the First World War, we shall adopt a deliberate and methodical approach to pre-battle planning. Then, when every advantage has been leveraged, we fall upon the enemy like an avalanche.
1f01r4u.zh: 汲取第一次世界大战中用鲜血换来的教训，我们将在战前筹划中采取审慎而有条不紊的方式。待到一切优势都被充分利用，我们便如雪崩般扑向敌人。

zyyuwh.en: Our leaders should not be automatons. They must interpret their orders intelligently, and diverge from strict adherence to them if it accomplishes the mission. Victory is more important than blind obedience.
zyyuwh.zh: 我们的指挥官不应是机械执行命令的傀儡。他们必须灵活理解所受领的任务，如果严格执行命令反而不利于达成目标，就应当有所变通。胜利比盲目服从更重要。

h3x45z.en: When the skies belong to the enemy, our armies must refuse to present an easy target. Dispersed formations, hardened logistics, and dense anti-aircraft fire let us fight on where we cannot contest the air.
h3x45z.zh: 当天空属于敌人时，我们的军队绝不能轻易成为靶子。疏散的队形、强化的后勤以及密集的防空火力，让我们在无法争夺制空权的地方依然能继续作战。

1rae50x.en: Rather than bashing against enemy lines at their strongest point, we shall flow around them like water, maintaining offensive momentum and forcing the enemy to withdraw through threat of encirclement.
1rae50x.zh: 与其在敌军防线最强的地段硬碰硬，我们应如水般绕过它们，保持进攻势头，并以包围的威胁迫使敌人撤退。

lfrdfd.en: Every Man An Emperor: Our troops need to be able to individually undertake difficult and demanding tasks, and carry their weight at all times. How we train them is vital for our success on the front.
lfrdfd.zh: 人人皆皇帝：我们的士兵必须能够独立承担艰巨而严苛的任务，并始终扛起自己的那份重担。如何训练他们，对我们在前线能否取胜至关重要。

1ec5epk.en: The helicopter offers the radical possibility of introducing the third, vertical dimension into land warfare. We can configure the army to exploit this new approach for maximum mobility and surprise.
1ec5epk.zh: 直升机为陆战带来了引入第三个维度——垂直维度的革命性可能。我们可以调整陆军编制以利用这一新途径，获得最大的机动性与突然性。

17zvad7.en: When our backs are to the wall, and national survival is at stake, the only option is bitter, fanatical resistance by the entire population, turning every field, street and town into a battleground.
17zvad7.zh: 当我们退无可退、国家存亡悬于一线时，唯一的选择就是全体民众进行艰苦而狂热的抵抗，把每一片田野、每一条街道和每一座城镇都变成战场。

11wmt56.en: Wear down a superior enemy through constant low-level attacks on his lines of communication, eroding his will to continue the fight. Avoid major set-piece battles to preserve our own limited forces.
11wmt56.zh: 通过对敌军交通线不断发动低强度袭击来消耗优势之敌，消磨其继续作战的意志。避免大规模正规会战，以保全我们自身有限的兵力。

1rfztyd.en: An asymmetric approach to infantry warfare in which direct combat with superior forces is avoided, using the guerilla tactics of ambush, misdirection, and harassment to wear down enemy resolve.
1rfztyd.zh: 一种非对称的步兵作战方式，避免与优势兵力正面交锋，转而运用伏击、误导和袭扰等游击战术来消磨敌人的决心。

rztsnn.en: The tank offers the opportunity to create a war of movement rather than mere attrition. Our doctrine should emphasize rapid exploitation of breakthroughs to surround and destroy the enemy.
rztsnn.zh: 坦克提供了创造运动战而非单纯消耗战的机会。我们的学说应强调迅速扩张突破口，以包围并歼灭敌人。

1b6hghi.en: All the combat power in the world means little if it cannot get to the fight. We shall create an organizational emphasis on force projection capability in service of our strategic aims.
1b6hghi.zh: 若无法投入战斗，再强大的战斗力也毫无意义。我们应在组织上强调力量投射能力，以服务于我们的战略目标。

2yt8pb.en: With their firepower and protection, tanks can rapidly knock out machine guns and other weapons that hinder the advance of the infantry. Tank-Infantry cooperation must be seamless.
2yt8pb.zh: 凭借火力与防护，坦克能够迅速摧毁机枪以及其他妨碍步兵前进的武器。坦克与步兵的协同必须天衣无缝。

sgla6n.en: Armored forces are useful in defense as well as attack. With their mobility they can rapidly occupy strong defensive terrain, or move in to position to counter enemy breakthroughs.
sgla6n.zh: 装甲部队不仅在进攻中有用，在防御中同样如此。凭借其机动性，它们可以迅速占领有利的防御地形，或前出至阵位以反制敌军突破。

16c71o7.en: A unified approach to anti-tank defense at all tactical echelons, defending the flanks of friendly breakthroughs and channeling enemy armored attacks into pre-planned kill zones.
16c71o7.zh: 在各战术层级统一反坦克防御方式，掩护友军突破的侧翼，并将敌军装甲攻势引入预先规划好的杀伤区。

523g7y.en: Hit them where they don't expect - mobile warfare doctrine seeks to break the trench deadlock of the First World War via aggressive maneuvers to pre-empt and disrupt the enemy.
523g7y.zh: 打他们一个措手不及——机动战学说力图通过积极主动的机动来抢占先机、扰乱敌军，从而打破第一次世界大战式的堑壕僵局。

3x89es.en: The range and striking power of modern arms allows an enemy defense system to be overcome by striking it to its whole depth, simultaneously, with every weapon at our disposal.
3x89es.zh: 现代武器的射程与打击力，使我们能够动用手中一切武器同时打击敌军防御体系的整个纵深，从而将其击破。

ky8rs7.en: When faced with major enemy armored threats, we cannot count on our first line defenses always stopping the foe. Defense in depth by ambushing anti-tank units is essential.
ky8rs7.zh: 面对敌军大规模的装甲威胁时，我们不能指望第一线防御总能挡住敌人。以反坦克部队实施伏击的纵深防御至关重要。

11qm40q.en: With sufficient preparation, no obstacle is insurmountable - Grand Battleplan is characterized by patient, meticulous preparation of all arms, in both attack and defense.
11qm40q.zh: 只要有充分准备，没有障碍不可逾越——大军团作战计划的特点是各兵种无论进攻还是防御都进行耐心而细致的准备。

rp98y3.en: If we can master concentrated operations on a narrow front, we can create local superiority to overwhelm the enemy at the point of main effort and create a breakthrough.
rp98y3.zh: 如果我们能掌握在狭窄正面上集中用兵的本领，就能在主攻方向上形成局部优势，压垮敌人并打开突破口。

uj2nj5.en: To update our cavalry for the 20th century, we need cross-country operational mobility while mounted, and to fight dismounted with fast, modern heavy weapons in support.
uj2nj5.zh: 要让我们的骑兵跟上 20 世纪，就需要在乘马状态下具备越野作战机动能力，并在下马作战时得到快速、现代的重武器支援。

plizvm.en: Our willingness to sacrifice guarantees our victory - Mass Assault focuses on concentrating numerical superiority to force a breakthrough at the chosen time and place.
plizvm.zh: 我们甘愿牺牲的决心保证了胜利——大规模突击着眼于集中数量优势，在选定的时间与地点强行打开突破口。

hskdzo.en: With a combined arms approach backed up by extensive motorization, we can use reconnaissance units to find the enemy, and mobile heavy weapons to rapidly smash them.
hskdzo.zh: 在广泛摩托化支撑下的合成兵种作战方式，让我们能用侦察部队搜寻敌人，再用机动重武器迅速将其摧毁。

5hvxga.en: Offensive results on the strategic scale can only be achieved when all arms, including tanks, are massed to concentrate their striking power at the decisive point.
5hvxga.zh: 只有当包括坦克在内的所有兵种集中起来，把打击力汇聚于决定性地点时，才能取得战略层面的进攻成果。

16hhwai.en: An army-wide initiative to increase the mobility of supporting arms so they can keep pace with rapid motorized advances, and go into action quickly in support.
16hhwai.zh: 全军上下共同努力提高支援兵种的机动性，使其能够跟上摩托化部队的快速推进，并迅速投入战斗提供支援。

1p69rhx.en: Send shells, not men - Superior Firepower emphasizes employing crushing masses of fire to pave the way for maneuver units to advance and capture territory.
1p69rhx.zh: 送炮弹，不送人——优势火力强调以铺天盖地的密集火力为机动部队开辟道路，使其得以推进并夺取领土。

wph300.en: By centralizing control of fire support assets, our army can concentrate firepower at the critical point rather than frittering it away in small packets.
wph300.zh: 通过集中统辖火力支援力量，我军可以把火力汇聚于关键地点，而不是零敲碎打地分散消耗掉。

7s15js.en: A methodical approach to infantry fighting, featuring attacks with limited objectives followed by rapid entrenchment to tenaciously hold the won ground.
7s15js.zh: 一种有条不紊的步兵作战方式，特点是发动目标有限的进攻，随后迅速构筑工事，顽强守住已夺占的阵地。

zcjltn.en: A training and doctrinal emphasis on defensive tactics designed to stubbornly hold ground, inflicting casualties and delay upon the attacker.
zcjltn.zh: 在训练与学说上强调防御战术，旨在顽固据守阵地，给进攻方造成伤亡并迟滞其行动。

dr5ds3.en: The will of the people to resist, mobilized and guided by the state, guarantees our eventual victory over imperialism and counter-revolution.
dr5ds3.zh: 人民抵抗的意志一旦由国家动员并加以引导，就必将保证我们最终战胜帝国主义与反革命。

1ramrpv.en: Mechanized forces backed up by fast light tanks and armored cars can probe for weak spots and hit the enemy where they are most vulnerable.
1ramrpv.zh: 由快速轻型坦克和装甲车支援的机械化部队，可以试探敌军薄弱之处，打击其最脆弱的地方。

y89vuo.en: Organize the army with a combined arms approach to battle, with organic fire support assets integrated down to the smallest tactical unit.
y89vuo.zh: 以合成兵种的方式组织陆军作战，将建制内火力支援力量一直整合到最小的战术单位。

t7prju.en: Focus our infantry on mobility to keep up the pace of advances and avoid getting bogged down in costly positional fighting.
t7prju.zh: 让我们的步兵着眼于机动性，以保持推进速度，避免陷入代价高昂的阵地消耗战。

1t3e79b.en: Asserting full-spectrum dominance over the enemy makes their further resistance physically and psychologically impossible.
1t3e79b.zh: 对敌人确立全频谱优势，使其进一步抵抗在生理上和心理上都成为不可能。

vw5px7.en: Securing tracked mobility and protection for as much the army's heavy support weapons as possible: the way of the future.
vw5px7.zh: 尽可能为陆军的重型支援武器提供履带式机动能力与防护：这就是未来的方向。

ue7xtj.en: Truck-drawn Rocket Artillery / Motorized Rocket Artillery / Motorized Artillery battalions: ⟦0⟧
ue7xtj.zh: 卡车牵引火箭炮 / 摩托化火箭炮 / 摩托化炮兵营：⟦0⟧

oalu1y.en: No fixed fortification can stand for long against a steel rain of battleship-caliber shells.
oalu1y.zh: 没有任何固定工事能长期抵挡战列舰口径炮弹的钢铁之雨。

2jabi3.en: Field Hospital Support / Helicopter Brigade / Helicopter Field Hospital: ⟦0⟧
2jabi3.zh: 野战医院支援连 / 直升机旅 / 直升机野战医院：⟦0⟧

1jv3nod.en: Self-Propelled Artillery / Self-Propelled Anti-Air / Tank Destroyers: ⟦0⟧
1jv3nod.zh: 自行火炮 / 自行防空炮 / 坦克歼击车：⟦0⟧

o2cbef.zh: 超重型火炮 / 自行超重型火炮：⟦0⟧

nrb1i2.en: This Subdoctrine gains Mastery from a specific set of units: ⟦0⟧
nrb1i2.zh: 该子学说从一组特定的单位获得精通：⟦0⟧

24cj5h.en: Cavalry Recon / Motorized Recon / Armored Recon Companies: ⟦0⟧
24cj5h.zh: 骑兵侦察连 / 摩托化侦察连 / 装甲侦察连：⟦0⟧

1ja1sj5.en: Engineer / Assault Engineer / Pioneer Support Companies: ⟦0⟧
1ja1sj5.zh: 工兵 / 突击工兵 / 先锋支援连：⟦0⟧

1ka1oa5.zh: 火炮 / 反坦克 / 防空 / 火箭炮：⟦0⟧

19j63ec.zh: 自行火炮 / 自行防空炮：⟦0⟧

oosp9y.en: Cavalry Recon Detachment/ Motorized Recon Company: ⟦0⟧
oosp9y.zh: 骑兵侦察支队 / 摩托化侦察连：⟦0⟧

191bvez.en: Recon / Motorized Recon / Armored Recon Companies: ⟦0⟧
191bvez.zh: 侦察连 / 摩托化侦察连 / 装甲侦察连：⟦0⟧

1urufne.en: Light Armored Recon / Armored Recon Companies: ⟦0⟧
1urufne.zh: 轻型装甲侦察连 / 装甲侦察连：⟦0⟧

86qrow.zh: 铁道炮 / 超重型铁道炮：⟦0⟧

1u0pckj.zh: 摩托化与机械化步兵营：⟦0⟧

1vmjb70.zh: 轻型/中型/重型喷火坦克连：⟦0⟧

149w9qs.zh: 铁道炮 / 超重型铁道炮：⟦0⟧

82j4qg.zh: 沙漠 / 丛林 / 丘陵中的步兵：⟦0⟧

14p9sjt.zh: 所有步兵与摩托化/机械化营：⟦0⟧

1vhnph4.zh: 机动营与战斗支援部队：⟦0⟧

1jfihij.zh: 机械化 / 摩托化步兵 ⟦0⟧

vuwuvu.zh: 所有步兵与摩托化/机械化部队：⟦0⟧

1rmfcjd.en: Equipped with military motorbikes, these units are tasked with maintaining order behind the lines, escorting convoys, and conducting patrols. Their speed and mobility allow them to quickly respond to disruptions and, if needed, perform reconnaissance in active combat zones.
1rmfcjd.zh: 这些部队配备军用摩托车，任务是在后方维持秩序、护送运输队并进行巡逻。其速度与机动性使它们能够迅速应对骚乱，必要时还能在交战区执行侦察任务。

1qck872.en: Regular troops may be able to manage occupation for a shorter period of time, but they are first and foremost soldiers. Integrating military police into our forces will ensure we have people on the ground to respond to resistance and investigate sabotage.
1qck872.zh: 正规部队或许能在较短时间内应付占领任务，但他们首先是士兵。把军事警察编入我军，能确保我们有人在当地应对抵抗活动并调查破坏行为。

ebzny8.en: Although many improvements have been made in field medicine, many advances are improvised and we lack an established doctrine. With more experience, we can explain the role of these units more clearly and make improvised innovations permanent fixtures.
ebzny8.zh: 尽管战地医疗已取得许多改进，但不少进步仍是临时性的，我们缺乏成体系的学说。有了更多经验，我们就能更清楚地阐明这些部队的职责，并把临时的创新固定下来。

1n5vnuc.en: Maintaining local mobility while constructing what would previously have been considered permanent fortifications and supply systems, combat engineers of the future will ensure that no matter where our troops are attacked, they will be prepared.
1n5vnuc.zh: 在保持当地机动能力的同时修建以往会被视为永久性的工事与补给体系，未来的战斗工兵将确保无论我军在哪里遭到攻击，都能做好准备。

btx2z8.en: Safely policing occupied territory is as much about returning to normalcy as it is about ruthlessly eliminating opposition. Our military police must ensure that this process starts early, to ensure safety for soldiers and civilians alike.
btx2z8.zh: 安全地管控占领区，既在于无情地清除反对势力，也同样在于恢复正常秩序。我们的军事警察必须让这一进程尽早启动，以确保士兵与平民的安全。

1qzu6n9.en: Reconnaissance missions are often dangerous and casualties are high. Preparing our patrols to move and withdraw rapidly and equipping them to clear obstacles placed by the enemy will increase their chances of coming back alive.
1qzu6n9.zh: 侦察任务往往十分危险，伤亡率很高。让我们的巡逻队做好快速机动与撤离的准备，并为它们配备清除敌军障碍物的装备，将提高它们活着回来的机会。

11unfjp.en: Surgery is among the most common emergency procedures needed in the field. Procedures and tools for this must be available closer to the front, and we must ensure that skilled surgeons are part of the military medical units.
11unfjp.zh: 外科手术是战地最常见的急救处置之一。相关的手术流程与工具必须能在更靠近前线的地方获得，我们还必须确保技术娴熟的外科医生编入军队医疗单位。

iu975d.en: Establishing and maintaining communications in the field has always required special skills. With the advent of new communications and detection technology in the Great War, new possibilities for the practice lie ahead.
iu975d.zh: 在战场上建立并维持通信一向需要专门的技能。随着大战中新型通信与侦测技术的出现，这一行当面临着新的可能。

123ph1y.en: Signal companies focusing on communication between the different branches of the military can ensure that ground forces are able to coordinate efforts with sea and air operations and plan their movements more rapidly.
123ph1y.zh: 专注于军种间通信的通信连，可以确保地面部队能够与海上和空中行动协调一致，并更迅速地规划自身行动。

1wg0jio.en: By engaging in regular police duties in occupied territories, such as traffic control and maintaining public order, our military police can minimize the chaos and confusion in which partisan movements can thrive in.
1wg0jio.zh: 通过在占领区执行常规警务，例如交通管制和维持公共秩序，我们的军事警察可以把游击队得以滋生的混乱与动荡压到最低。

2kuek.en: Among our signal specialists are people with unparalleled first-hand knowledge of field use of this equipment. By involving them in the research of new communication technologies, we can make use of their expertise.
2kuek.zh: 我们的通信专家中，有些人对这些装备的战场使用有着无人能及的亲身经验。让他们参与新型通信技术的研究，就能发挥他们的专长。

12pnthr.en: Construction of fortifications and breaching obstacles make combat engineers vital in the field. Giving our engineers a versatile role enables us to deploy them in the diverse situations where they will be needed.
12pnthr.zh: 构筑工事与破除障碍让战斗工兵在战场上不可或缺。赋予工兵多面手的角色，使我们能够把他们部署到各种需要他们的不同情境中。

iuvdw5.en: A simplified design that ommits many features commonly found on regular freight trains for the sake of cheaper production. It is still every bit as vulnerable as a regular train, but can more easily be replaced.
iuvdw5.zh: 一种简化设计，为降低生产成本而省略了普通货运列车常见的许多功能。它的脆弱程度与普通列车无异，但更容易被替换。

6nezz4.en: Taken over by the military from regular civilian freight duty, this train engine is well-suited to move a large amount of supplies over long distances. However, its civilian construction makes it vulnerable.
6nezz4.zh: 这台机车由军方从普通民用货运中征用而来，非常适合长距离运输大量补给。然而，它的民用结构使它十分脆弱。

1r4wmx4.en: Helicopters equipped with transport pods or towing goods beneath them on a line can move supplies and equipment quickly and without regard for terrain. Getting stuck in the mud is a thing of the past!
1r4wmx4.zh: 装有运输吊舱或用绳索在下方拖曳货物的直升机，能够快速运送补给与装备，且不受地形限制。陷在泥里已成过去！

1m95kiq.en: Military engineering projects are approaching a larger scale. The construction of advanced infrastructural aid enables operations requiring supplies beyond what is normally available in the field.
1m95kiq.zh: 军事工程项目正迈向更大的规模。修建先进的基础设施辅助设施，使那些需要超出战场常规可得补给的行动成为可能。

qqum4a.en: Helicopters are able get a good vantage point of the battlefield regardless of the actual terrain, and thus make excellent forward scouts to provide accurate feedback to artillery barrages.
qqum4a.zh: 直升机无论实际地形如何都能获得良好的战场视野，因此是极佳的前沿侦察手段，可为炮兵火力打击提供准确的情报反馈。

1qt8h4x.en: Maintenance, repair and overhaul are important to keep military equipment reliable and safe to use. Having companies dedicated to this will ensure that it's given appropriate attention.
1qt8h4x.zh: 维护、修理与大修对于保持军事装备可靠、使用安全十分重要。设立专门负责此事的连队，可以确保装备得到应有的照料。

jhwha6.en: The use of armored recovery vehicles enables our maintenance personnel to recover and repair all kinds of equipment, ensuring maximum operational readiness on the battlefield.
jhwha6.zh: 使用装甲抢修车，使我方维修人员能够回收并修复各类装备，确保战场上保持最高的战备状态。

18m03v4.en: A casualty doesn't need to mean a dead soldier. Having immediate medical attention available for our wounded brought back to the rear is the first step towards ensuring this.
18m03v4.zh: 伤员未必就是阵亡的士兵。让后送的伤员能立即获得医疗救治，是实现这一点的第一步。

yynnbd.en: Deep reconnaissance operations, mixing espionage, guerilla operations and commando training, will aid our tactical choices and allow us to adapt our decision-making rapidly.
yynnbd.zh: 把间谍活动、游击作战与突击队训练融为一体的纵深侦察行动，将有助于我们的战术抉择，并让我们能够迅速调整决策。

kpy9n1.en: Combining engineering expertise with armored protection, armored engineer units are specialized on clearing obstacles and supporting front-line advances under heavy fire.
kpy9n1.zh: 装甲工兵部队把工程专长与装甲防护结合起来，专门负责在猛烈火力下清除障碍并支援前线推进。

ixpqos.en: Cooperating with local spy networks and informers established before occupation, our military police can proactively prepare for where resistance is likely to arise.
ixpqos.zh: 与占领前就已布建的当地特工网络和线人合作，我们的军事警察可以主动预判抵抗可能出现的地点并预先准备。

13hyn74.en: Making sure that our troops always have the basic materials in the field to perform common repairs will prevent the continued use of equipment known to be damaged.
13hyn74.zh: 确保我军在战场上始终备有进行常规修理所需的基本材料，可以防止已知损坏的装备继续被使用。

xmourf.en: A train engine encased in heavy armor to make it less vulnerable to enemy attack. It can carry as much cargo as any other design, but is more expensive to produce.
xmourf.zh: 一种外面包裹厚重装甲、以降低遭敌攻击风险的机车。它的载货量与任何其他设计相当，但生产成本更高。

182nj0i.en: Increasingly portable communications technology is more viable to be personally carried as a backpack. This increased mobility of signal corps must be utilized.
182nj0i.zh: 日益便携的通信技术更有可能让人以背包形式随身携带。通信部队这种机动性的提升必须加以利用。

19wf3o6.en: With modern equipment and high explosives, our engineers can go beyond their traditional tasks and surprise the enemy with their ingenuity, at land and sea.
19wf3o6.zh: 凭借现代装备与高爆炸药，我们的工兵可以超越传统职责，在陆地与海上以巧思令敌人吃惊。

70hdym.en: Sending smaller groups to scout ahead before moving in the main force allows us to gather intelligence about where the enemy is and how many we are facing.
70hdym.zh: 在主力部队开进之前先派出小股部队向前侦察，使我们能够搜集关于敌军位置与兵力的情报。

q1asc5.en: By establishing the use of portable hospitals, bringing the medical care to where it is needed, we can stop many unnecessary deaths and permanent injuries.
q1asc5.zh: 通过确立便携式医院的使用，把医疗救治带到需要的地方，我们可以避免许多不必要的死亡与永久性伤残。

r7doio.en: Improvements in radio technology change the way reconnaissance missions can be executed, enabling rapid communication of the gathered intelligence.
r7doio.zh: 无线电技术的进步改变了侦察任务的执行方式，使所获情报能够迅速传递。

x71vg5.en: Experiences with designing for active redundancy in the Great War can be renewed to work with more modern equipment to make maintenance easier.
x71vg5.zh: 大战期间在设计中运用主动冗余的经验可以重新加以发挥，与更现代的装备相结合，使维护保养更为简便。

190sv02.en: Equipping our units with command vehicles will ensure secure and reliable battlefield communications and coordination under armored protection.
190sv02.zh: 为部队配备指挥车辆，可确保在装甲防护下实现安全可靠的战场通信与协调。

1ikfbsb.en: Routine operational maintenance procedures minimize the risks of equipment breaking down and alerts troops to replace it before it does.
1ikfbsb.zh: 例行的运行维护程序能把装备故障的风险降到最低，并在装备损坏之前提醒部队予以更换。

1e4yyeu.en: Incoming wounded! We have incoming wounded! Helicopters provide even faster casualty evacuation than regular ambulances.
1e4yyeu.zh: 伤员来了！有伤员送来！直升机比普通救护车能更快地后送伤员。

cu3uax.en: Having specialized Logistics Officers among our ranks will ensure that support networks are leveraged to minimize waste.
cu3uax.zh: 队伍中有专业的后勤军官，可确保支援网络得到充分利用，把浪费降至最低。

s1h80o.en: Developing standardized classifications for supplies will minimize confusion and make planning more efficient.
s1h80o.zh: 为补给制定标准化的分类，可以减少混乱并让规划更加高效。

12b2zd7.en: Adapting our risk analyses to the new circumstances of war will improve the safety of our logistical support.
12b2zd7.zh: 让我们的风险分析适应新的战争形势，将提高后勤支援的安全性。

16cjeqw.en: Continued statistical evaluation of troop supply needs contribute to maximizing the utility of our resources.
16cjeqw.zh: 对部队补给需求持续进行统计评估，有助于最大限度地发挥我们资源的效用。

1kznlxs.en: Radios, Jeeps, Pontoons & other equipment used to support troops.
1kznlxs.zh: 无线电、吉普车、浮桥以及其他用于支援部队的装备。

1f4zfcu.en: A heavy cannon mounted on a railway carriage for transportation.
1f4zfcu.zh: 一种安装在铁路车架上以便运输的重型火炮。

gcqhpg.en: Trying to strike point targets from 30,000 feet is generally a waste of bombs. Flying in line abreast and creating a wide lane of destruction is a more reliable way to hit...something.
gcqhpg.zh: 试图从三万英尺高空打击点状目标通常只是浪费炸弹。以并列队形飞行、撕开一条宽阔的毁灭走廊，才是更可靠地命中……某些东西的办法。

1c6siah.en: Air strikes on front line targets during an active land battle exposes aircraft to ground fire and can be risky for friendly troops, but the effects at the sharp end are dramatic.
1c6siah.zh: 在陆战进行期间对前线目标实施空袭，会使飞机暴露于地面火力之下，对友军部队也有风险，但其在最前沿产生的效果极为显著。

50771q.en: Traditional sea-level means of coastal defense are manpower-intensive and inefficient. Aerial mobility means we can keep an eye on friendly shores and punish any would-be invader.
50771q.zh: 传统的海平面沿岸防御方式耗费人力且效率低下。空中机动意味着我们可以监视友方海岸，并惩罚任何来犯之敌。

101vtkg.en: Unescorted daylight bombing of the enemy homeland will incur ruinous losses. We need fighters with the range to accompany our bombers all the way there, and all the way back.
101vtkg.zh: 对敌方本土进行无护航的昼间轰炸将造成灾难性的损失。我们需要航程足以全程伴随轰炸机往返的战斗机。

mqrk9a.en: Carrier aircraft must run a gauntlet of enemy fighters and AA to deliver their payloads. Our training will emphasize survivability and tenacity in pressing home the attack.
mqrk9a.zh: 舰载机必须穿越敌方战斗机与防空炮火的重重阻拦才能投下弹药。我们的训练将强调生存能力与坚持完成攻击的韧性。

152dglq.en: With the right equipment and training, there is no target too deep in the enemy's hinterland to be struck. The enemy will come to know that no place is safe from our bombs.
152dglq.zh: 有了合适的装备与训练，敌方腹地再深的目标也不在话下。敌人终将明白，没有哪个地方能躲过我们的炸弹。

1xpuhwb.en: Contrary to Douhet, the bomber does not, in fact, always get through. Flying at night reduces our accuracy, but vastly improves the survival rate of our planes and crews.
1xpuhwb.zh: 与杜黑的主张相反，轰炸机其实并不能总能突入。夜间飞行会降低我们的命中精度，但大幅提高飞机与机组的存活率。

1e3qv94.en: Freed from the risk of hitting friendly troops, our bomber fleet can range unhindered in the enemy's rear areas, sowing havoc and aiding the fighting fronts indirectly.
1e3qv94.zh: 摆脱了误伤友军的风险，我们的轰炸机群便能在敌军后方畅通无阻地活动，制造混乱并间接支援各个作战前线。

btpx1k.en: The oldest form of military aviation is reconnaissance. In this, as in every age, knowing where the enemy is and what he is up to can be more powerful than any weapon.
btpx1k.zh: 最古老的军用航空形式就是侦察。在这方面，如同在每一个时代一样，了解敌人在哪里、在做什么，可能比任何武器都更有威力。

4uc5d1.en: The size and carrying capacity of large airframes gives them an unparalleled ability to carry a wide variety of mission-specific equipment for any military situation.
4uc5d1.zh: 大型机体的尺寸与承载能力，使其拥有无可比拟的能力，可为任何军事情况携带种类繁多的专用装备。

124tiwq.en: Large groups of bombers, flying in close formation and with heavy defensive armament, can force any attacking fighter to brave the fire of dozens of guns at once.
124tiwq.zh: 大批轰炸机以密集编队飞行并装备重型自卫武器，可迫使任何来袭战斗机一次面对数十门机炮的火力。

wm2olb.en: Gaining and maintaining air superiority, as a prerequisite for domination of the battlespace by general purpose medium bombers carrying out operational strikes.
wm2olb.zh: 夺取并保持制空权，以此作为由执行战役打击的通用中型轰炸机主宰战场的前提。

1qtvtu6.en: Techniques and training for close army-air force cooperation, with air strikes acting as flying artillery to blast a path for fast-moving ground operations.
1qtvtu6.zh: 开展陆空密切协同的技术与训练，让空中打击充当飞行炮兵，为快速推进的地面作战炸开道路。

1hkaqf.en: Almost all the world's industry and warmaking potential is within airstrike range of a coastline. Our carriers can put air power in the enemy's backyard.
1hkaqf.zh: 世界上几乎所有的工业与战争潜力都处于海岸线附近空中打击范围之内。我们的航空母舰可以把空中力量送到敌人的后院。

1u9t6mu.en: Mass bombing of factories, refineries, and transport infrastructure deep in the enemy's hinterland, to cut off his warmaking potential at the source.
1u9t6mu.zh: 对敌方腹地的工厂、炼油厂与运输基础设施实施大规模轰炸，从其源头切断其战争潜力。

1kjbs94.en: For our strike aircraft to operate with impunity, it is necessary that they be closely supported by fighters to sweep the skies of hostile aircraft.
1kjbs94.zh: 为了让我们的攻击机能够畅行无阻地作战，必须有战斗机密切护航，扫清天空中的敌机。

dm1b0l.en: With their speed and range, our strike craft can perform versatile double-duty supporting the army on land, or attacking enemy vessels at sea.
dm1b0l.zh: 凭借速度与航程，我们的攻击机可以身兼两职，既能支援陆上作战的陆军，也能攻击海上的敌方舰船。

1njagzx.en: A generalist approach to strike prioritization, engaging targets of opportunity from the front line all the way out to operational depth.
1njagzx.zh: 在打击目标优先级上采取通用化方针，从最前线一直到战役纵深，打击一切出现的机会目标。

oxiumh.en: Air power is the dominant weapon of the age, and the aircraft carrier allows its devastating striking potential to have a global reach.
oxiumh.zh: 空中力量是这个时代的主导武器，而航空母舰使其毁灭性的打击潜力具备了全球到达能力。

5p4m5y.en: A fleet of light bombers raining devastation from the sky upon hostile strong points, paving the way for the advance of our own troops.
5p4m5y.zh: 一支轻型轰炸机队从天而降，把毁灭倾泻在敌方据点之上，为我军部队的推进铺平道路。

1l5bdbq.en: Although their lack of agility can be a drawback against lighter aircraft, heavy fighters can carry destructive anti-bomber firepower.
1l5bdbq.zh: 尽管灵活性不足可能使其在面对更轻型的飞机时处于劣势，重型战斗机却能携带足以摧毁轰炸机的强大火力。

16yiy0h.en: In order to prosecute the war effectively, our industry and infrastructure must be shielded from strategic bombardment at any cost.
16yiy0h.zh: 为了有效地进行战争，我们的工业与基础设施必须不惜一切代价免遭战略轰炸。

1a90hl5.en: The range of modern aircraft allows for naval search and strike missions against enemy assets well before they threaten our coasts.
1a90hl5.zh: 现代飞机的航程使我们能够在敌方力量威胁我国海岸之前很久就对其实施海上搜索与打击任务。

hjxhx8.en: Almost uniquely in modern warfare, a fighter pilot fights alone. We must ensure the individual excellence of every pilot.
hjxhx8.zh: 在现代战争中几乎独一无二的是，战斗机飞行员是独自作战的。我们必须确保每一名飞行员都出类拔萃。

1p20pt8.en: A doctrine focused on dominating the operational battle area via persistent attacks by highly survivable medium aircraft.
1p20pt8.zh: 一种着眼于通过高生存性中型飞机持续不断的攻击来主宰战役战区的学说。

2xxgs.en: When not needed to combat enemy aircraft, our fighters can switch focus to strikes on ground targets to assist the army.
2xxgs.zh: 当无需与敌机交战时，我们的战斗机可以转而打击地面目标以协助陆军。

1bjqu8f.en: A few torpedos can be evaded. Dozens of them all at once can lay the most hardened target low through sheer volume.
1bjqu8f.zh: 几枚鱼雷可以被规避。但数十枚同时袭来，仅凭数量就能击垮最坚固的目标。

1lsg862.en: A focus on offensive air-to-air combat tactics designed to seize control of the skies.
1lsg862.zh: 专注于进攻性空对空作战战术，旨在夺取制空权。

cjolst.en: There's a lot of variance in the civil war, as the AI can defend certain mountain tiles very well. Try for encirclements on the most well-defended tiles. Make sure to promote your high level General with Organizer into a Field Marshal and take the max planning bonus trait; it will help. ⟦0⟧
cjolst.zh: 这场内战的变数很大，因为 AI 能把某些山地格子防守得非常好。尽量在最难攻打的格子上制造包围。务必把带有组织者特质的高级将领晋升为元帅，并点出最大计划加成特质；这会很有帮助。⟦0⟧

144cfej.en: You should have five full armies now - four using puppeted manpower (either Brazilian or Argentinian) and one made up of mountaineers with SPGs. Ideally you use your own manpower for this last army, but if you're low, just use Brazil's manpower, as they will never run out. ⟦0⟧
144cfej.zh: 此时你应当拥有五个满编集团军——四个使用傀儡国的人力（巴西或阿根廷皆可），另一个由山地兵加自行火炮组成。理想情况下这最后一个集团军使用你自己的人力，但如果你人力不足，就直接用巴西的人力，因为他们永远不会耗尽。⟦0⟧

zb4frs.en: It's generally worth it to do most focuses in this civil war section, as they are all locked out afterwards and almost all of them give permanent buffs. However, if you skip 2 focuses here, you'll bypass the timed event where Ibáñez sells your northernmost core to ⟦0⟧. ⟦1⟧
zb4frs.zh: 这一内战章节中的大多数焦点通常都值得点，因为它们之后都会锁定，而且几乎全都提供永久增益。不过，如果你在这里跳过 2 个焦点，就能绕过伊瓦涅斯把你最北端的核心州卖给⟦0⟧的限时事件。⟦1⟧

vdpagf.en: When you take the coastal city of Recife, the war should immediately end, before Brazil has a chance to join the Allies. Annex them fully (don't puppet this time) and take their navy. Then choose the decision to Reorganize the Brazilian Government. ⟦0⟧
vdpagf.zh: 当你拿下沿海城市累西腓时，战争应当会立即结束，赶在巴西有机会加入盟国之前。将其完全吞并（这次不要设为傀儡），并接管其海军。然后选择「重组巴西政府」决议。⟦0⟧

16sn4q8.en: Train your navy, and use your initial Navy Experience to design either an Early Destroyer or Basic Submarine variant with all the modules maxed out with your current technology. Put all but one of your ⟦0⟧ on these and the last one on convoys. ⟦1⟧
16sn4q8.zh: 训练你的海军，并用初始的海军经验设计一款早期驱逐舰或基础潜艇变体，把现有科技允许的模块全部拉满。除一座之外，把你的所有⟦0⟧都投入这些舰船，最后一座用来建造运输船队。⟦1⟧

s5tnlm.en: Optional (but recommended): rush first towards Devalue the Peso. You desperately need a third research slot just to keep up in regular technologies. Nevermind the fact that we will need at minimum a navy and tanks for later. ⟦0⟧
s5tnlm.zh: 可选（但推荐）：优先速出「让比索贬值」。你迫切需要第三个科研槽，才能在常规科技上不掉队——更别提我们之后至少还需要海军和坦克。⟦0⟧

1dyr1vw.en: Begin building Self-Propelled Artillery of your preferred tank size. Your goal will be to fill out an entire army with a new template that is 8x Mountaineers, 2-3x Medium SP Artillery or 2x Heavy SP Artillery. ⟦0⟧
1dyr1vw.zh: 开始建造你所偏好坦克尺寸的自行火炮。你的目标是让一个完整集团军换装新模板：8 个山地兵营、2-3 个中型自行火炮营或 2 个重型自行火炮营。⟦0⟧

a03tl2.en: Work your way north up through Central America. You will have to justify and declare on every Central American nation, and possibly Mexico and the US as well (depending on if they have joined the Allies). ⟦0⟧
a03tl2.zh: 一路向北推进，穿越中美洲。你必须对每个中美洲国家制造战争目标并宣战，可能还包括墨西哥和美国（取决于它们是否已加入盟国）。⟦0⟧

15v8wuq.en: Put your troops on the border of British Guyana (or as close as you can get). I recommend leaving the border between French Guyana and Amapa open and letting the Allies take it, if they haven't already. ⟦0⟧
15v8wuq.zh: 把你的部队部署到英属圭亚那边境（或尽可能靠近之处）。我建议让法属圭亚那与阿马帕之间的边境留空，如果盟国尚未夺取那里，就让它去占。⟦0⟧

1dm6b1d.en: At this point, it may be anywhere from 1940 to 1943, depending on your speed, skill, and luck. Even if ⟦0⟧ has joined the Allies, you still have a good shot, as long as you're fast from now on. ⟦1⟧
1dm6b1d.zh: 此时时间可能已在 1940 到 1943 年之间，取决于你的推进速度、技巧和运气。即使⟦0⟧已经加入盟国，只要你从现在起动作够快，仍然很有机会。⟦1⟧

165duwt.en: Justify a wargoal and declare war on the Allies. It's slightly more optimal to pick one of the weaker members to generate less world tension, but this doesn't matter much. ⟦0⟧
165duwt.zh: 制造一个战争目标并向盟国宣战。选择较弱的成员国之一能产生更少的世界紧张度，略微更优，但影响不大。⟦0⟧

st5ifo.en: When you have a high Collaboration Government % on ⟦0⟧, justify a war goal and declare war on them. You'll need to call in your puppets along the border with them. ⟦1⟧
st5ifo.zh: 当你在⟦0⟧拥有高比例的协作政府时，制造一个战争目标并向其宣战。你需要召唤与它接壤的傀儡国参战。⟦1⟧

1e8kdxd.en: Take Crusade Against Imperialism. This will allow you to release native nations. Take the "Liberation" decisions as soon as they are possible from now on. ⟦0⟧
1e8kdxd.zh: 选择「十字军东征帝国主义」。这将允许你释放原住民族国家。从现在起，「解放」决议一旦可用就立刻执行。⟦0⟧

rw7sv0.en: Afterwards, focus on getting Lessons From the Great War, War Planning Office, A Land of Mountains, and Invest in Mountain Guns, in that order. ⟦0⟧
rw7sv0.zh: 之后按此顺序专注于获取：从一战中吸取教训、战争规划办公室、山之地、投资山地炮。⟦0⟧

1bu0383.en: The US should have joined the Allies by the time you reach them. Don't stop at the American border, just keep going, full speed ahead. ⟦0⟧
1bu0383.zh: 等你打到美国时，它应当已经加入了盟国。不要在美国边境停下，只管继续全速推进。⟦0⟧

1rgyx55.en: When you declare war, pin the Argentinian divisions with attacks while your cavalry divisions encircle them and rush victory points. ⟦0⟧
1rgyx55.zh: 宣战时，用进攻牵制阿根廷师，同时让你的骑兵师包围它们并直冲胜利点。⟦0⟧

hszwy3.en: There's two more easy countries: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Puppet them both and reorganize Bolivia via decision. Don't forget to take ⟦2⟧'s navy! ⟦3⟧
hszwy3.zh: 还有两个好对付的国家：⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧。把两国都设为傀儡，并通过决议重组玻利维亚。别忘了接管⟦2⟧的海军！⟦3⟧

8v71u7.en: Use your two spies to start a Collaboration Government on ⟦0⟧. If you were unlucky, you may have to first rescue your original spy. ⟦1⟧
8v71u7.zh: 用你的两名特工对⟦0⟧启动协作政府。如果运气不好，你可能得先营救你原来的那名特工。⟦1⟧

1e3ge0i.en: At this point, build up a Navy or Air Force in order to either naval invade or paradrop the UK to capitulate the Allies. ⟦0⟧
1e3ge0i.zh: 此时开始建设海军或空军，以便通过海军登陆或空降英国来迫使盟国投降。⟦0⟧

3yjuph.en: Have an offensive line order against the two islands with the forces set on "Aggressive" so they keep pushing. ⟦0⟧
3yjuph.zh: 对这两座岛屿设置一条进攻线命令，并将部队设为「激进」，让它们持续推进。⟦0⟧

brutk1.en: Put them both on the ⟦0⟧ border as individual general frontlines, not as a field marshal order. ⟦1⟧
brutk1.zh: 把二者都部署到⟦0⟧边境上，作为各自独立的将领前线，而不是元帅命令。⟦1⟧

1ccwnfo.en: While fighting here, you must take the capital last to avoid ⟦0⟧ joining the Allies. ⟦1⟧
1ccwnfo.zh: 在此作战期间，你必须最后再攻占首都，以免⟦0⟧加入盟国。⟦1⟧

1d5yyv7.en: For your navy, base your entire fleet together at the port of Guayaquil in Ecuador. ⟦0⟧
1d5yyv7.zh: 至于海军，把你整支舰队一起驻扎在厄瓜多尔的瓜亚基尔港。⟦0⟧

c8jjf0.en: While building up, justify a war goal and declare war on ⟦0⟧. ⟦1⟧
c8jjf0.zh: 在扩军备战的同时，制造一个战争目标并对⟦0⟧宣战。⟦1⟧

1dc0haq.en: Justify a war goal, declare war on, and puppet ⟦0⟧ then ⟦1⟧. ⟦2⟧
1dc0haq.zh: 依次对⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧制造战争目标、宣战并将其设为傀儡国。⟦2⟧

1i6x1ph.en: Cooperate with the ⟦0⟧ in the First Congress event. ⟦1⟧
1i6x1ph.zh: 在第一次代表大会事件中与⟦0⟧合作。⟦1⟧

k656c1.en: During the war, the threats faced by tanks have multiplied, from enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, dedicated tank destroyers, all the way to modern infantry weapons firing shaped charges that can penetrate even heavy armor. We must develop new protection methods to keep our own tanks alive in the face of these threats.
k656c1.zh: 在战争期间，坦克面临的威胁成倍增加，从敌方坦克、反坦克炮、专用坦克歼击车，一直到发射空心装药、能击穿重型装甲的现代步兵武器。我们必须研制新的防护手段，让我们的坦克在这些威胁面前生存下来。

1ielova.en: A modernized chassis that borrows heavily from previous medium tanks, but puts a much bigger emphasis on speed and maneuverability, while also allowing for more armor and bigger guns than usually carried on medium tanks. The result is a vehicle that can fill a wide variety of roles.
1ielova.zh: 一种现代化的底盘，大量借鉴了此前的中型坦克，但更加强调速度与机动性，同时还能搭载比中型坦克通常更多的装甲和更大的火炮。其成果是一种能够胜任多种角色的车辆。

1h6vc40.en: Mechanized warfare is a form of combat that requires fast decision making and fast movement of troops and supplies. If our tanks are to carry modern weapons and enough armor to survive on the battlefield, they require powerful engines to keep up with the motorized infantry.
1h6vc40.zh: 机械化战争是一种需要快速决策、部队与补给快速机动的作战形式。如果我们的坦克要携带现代武器和足以在战场上存活的装甲，就需要强劲的发动机来跟上摩托化步兵。

1worf7s.en: Tanks during the Great War only had to contend with enemy small arms. As such, they got away with fairly thin armor. A new generation of anti-tank weaponry has made the battlefield a much more dangerous place for a tank, and much heavier protection is needed.
1worf7s.zh: 大战期间的坦克只需应对敌方轻武器，因此它们的装甲相当薄也无妨。新一代反坦克武器让战场对坦克而言危险得多，需要厚重得多的防护。

fs15vf.en: Utilizing naval engineering techniques such as reinforced crankshafts, high-torque transmissions and specialized cooling systems can enhance the power output and durability of Land Cruiser engines, allowing them to better manage the immense weight and stress.
fs15vf.zh: 运用强化曲轴、高扭矩变速箱和专用冷却系统等舰船工程技术，可以提升陆地巡洋舰发动机的输出功率与耐用性，使其能更好地承受巨大的重量与应力。

u56l96.en: Implementing advanced targeting optics, rangefinders, and gyroscopic stabilizers to enhance weapon accuracy and firing coordination, ensuring the guns can effectively engage targets despite their massive recoil and slow maneuverability.
u56l96.zh: 采用先进的瞄准光学设备、测距仪和陀螺稳定器来提升武器精度与射击协调性，确保这些火炮尽管后坐力巨大、转向缓慢，仍能有效打击目标。

1l4mr6.en: Refined gear ratios, clutch mechanisms and torque converters to create more efficient transmissions capable of handling the extreme power and weight of Land Cruisers, improving overall mobility and reducing mechanical strain.
1l4mr6.zh: 改进齿轮比、离合器机构与液力变矩器，造出能承受陆地巡洋舰极端功率与重量的更高效传动系统，提升整体机动性并减少机械损耗。

psj41b.en: Developing detailed training manuals tailored for Land Cruiser crews, covering unique operational procedures, maintenance protocols, and complex battlefield tactics required to effectively command these giant war machines.
psj41b.zh: 为陆地巡洋舰车组编写详尽的训练手册，涵盖有效指挥这些巨型战争机器所需的独特操作程序、维护规程与复杂战场战术。

1rw53et.en: The numerous new additions to tanks made necessary by modern warfare have increased the weight of the vehicle substantially. To move all that mass around, we require engines that have a lot of power behind them.
1rw53et.zh: 现代战争迫使坦克增加了众多新部件，使车辆重量大幅上升。要让这么大的质量动起来，我们需要动力十分强劲的发动机。

kddscr.en: Technological advances have made the designs of the immediate post-war period effectively obsolete. The modern battlefield requires a new, clean design incorporating advances in metallurgy and interior layout.
kddscr.zh: 技术进步已使战后初期的设计实际上变得过时。现代战场需要一种全新的、简洁的设计，融入冶金与内部布局方面的进步。

1caecaa.en: With medium tanks increasingly taking center stage in the fight, light tanks have largely been relegated to supporting roles. A new chassis design is needed that takes the needs of these roles into account.
1caecaa.zh: 随着中型坦克日益占据战斗的核心地位，轻型坦克大多退居支援角色。需要一种考虑到这些角色需求的新底盘设计。

1m7z1ti.en: While the limit of deployed anti-tank guns has likely been reached, a new generation of tanks will carry more advanced weaponry, which is able to pierce any current level of protection at long range.
1m7z1ti.zh: 已部署反坦克炮的极限或许已经达到，而新一代坦克将携带更先进的武器，能够在远距离击穿目前任何级别的防护。

cehsev.en: The tank has proven itself a powerful weapon in the Great War. While development has slowed in the intervening years, it is no doubt going to play a major role in the wars to come.
cehsev.zh: 坦克在大战中已证明自己是一种强大的武器。尽管在此后数年间发展有所放缓，它无疑将在未来的战争中扮演重要角色。

6fnw39.en: A small tank hull specifically designed to float. To achieve this, strict limits have to be set on the size of the weapon and the thickness of the armor the vehicle carries.
6fnw39.zh: 一种专为浮渡而设计的小型坦克车体。为实现这一点，必须严格限制武器的尺寸和车辆所载装甲的厚度。

1wi9y4a.en: Specifically designed to penetrate extremely thick armor, this weapon’s high kinetic energy makes it a formidable counter against other super-heavy tanks.
1wi9y4a.zh: 这种武器专为击穿极厚的装甲而设计，其高动能使其成为对抗其他超重型坦克的强大手段。

mb7bxv.en: A set of floatation devices and a small screw allow this tank to quickly be rigged to traverse water, either from ship to shore or across a river.
mb7bxv.zh: 一套浮渡装置加一个小型螺旋桨，使这种坦克能够迅速加装以渡水，既可舰到岸，也可跨越河流。

1by2ifm.en: With heavier and heavier anti-tank weapons being fielded around the world, the next generation of tanks will require even better protection.
1by2ifm.zh: 随着世界各地装备越来越重的反坦克武器，下一代坦克将需要更好的防护。

14lbem4.en: A further iteration based on the experiences gained with previous light tanks, this chassis allows for better reliability and maintenance.
14lbem4.zh: 在以往轻型坦克经验基础上进一步改进的型号，这一底盘具有更好的可靠性与维护性。

15pizpt.en: Where the tanks of the Great War were slow, lumbering beasts, the modern tank relies very much on speed and mobility to achieve victory.
15pizpt.zh: 大战时期的坦克是缓慢笨重的巨兽，而现代坦克在很大程度上依靠速度与机动性来取胜。

1isjuzm.en: Enhanced flamethrower systems, ideal for clearing fortified positions and inflicting devastating damage in close-quarters combat.
1isjuzm.zh: 增强型喷火系统，非常适合清除防御工事，并在近距离战斗中造成毁灭性杀伤。

9wvaa3.en: A gigantic vehicle, capable of mounting the heaviest armor and the biggest gun, but consequently fairly slow and unreliable.
9wvaa3.zh: 一种巨型车辆，能够安装最重的装甲和最大的火炮，但因此相当缓慢且可靠性不高。

9q8nty.en: With bigger guns and heavier armor, the new generation of tanks requires a more powerful engine to remain mobile.
9q8nty.zh: 随着火炮更大、装甲更重，新一代坦克需要更强劲的发动机才能保持机动。

183ymyy.en: A balanced, mid-sized chassis that offers a lot flexibility for building a wide variety of vehicles.
183ymyy.zh: 一种均衡的中型底盘，为打造各种类型的车辆提供了很大的灵活性。

1tttro7.en: A large chassis that can mount a heavy gun, thick armor, or both.
1tttro7.zh: 一种大型底盘，可以安装重型火炮、厚装甲，或两者兼而有之。

mthn7f.en: Tanks in World War I were developed separately and simultaneously by the United Kingdom and France as a means to break the deadlock of trench warfare on the Western Front. The name Tank was adopted by the British during the early stages of their development, as a security measure to conceal their purpose. Early tanks were armed with machine guns and small cannons, moved slowly, and were armored only enough to stop small arms fire.
mthn7f.zh: 第一次世界大战中的坦克由英国和法国分别同时研发，用来打破西线堑壕战的僵局。「Tank」这一名称是英国人在研发初期采用的，作为掩盖其用途的保密措施。早期坦克装备机枪和小型火炮，行驶缓慢，装甲仅够抵挡轻武器火力。

14pn9we.en: Tank Destroyers are tanks with a larger than normal gun in a fixed mounting in place of a turret. Light Tank Destroyers are based on the chassis of Light Tanks, which means they are fairly mobile but do not carry particularly powerful guns compared to heavier TDs.
14pn9we.zh: 坦克歼击车是取消炮塔、以固定炮架安装比常规更大火炮的坦克。轻型坦克歼击车以轻型坦克的底盘为基础，因此相当机动，但相比更重的坦克歼击车，其火炮威力并不突出。

1a6ji55.en: Tank Destroyers are tanks with a larger than normal gun in a fixed mounting in place of a turret. Medium Tank Destroyers are based on the chassis of Medium Tanks, meaning they are fairly mobile and carry respectable firepower.
1a6ji55.zh: 坦克歼击车是取消炮塔、以固定炮架安装比常规更大火炮的坦克。中型坦克歼击车以中型坦克的底盘为基础，因此相当机动，且火力相当可观。

mmhde5.en: Super heavy tanks are an evolution of the Heavy tank concept. Bigger, better armed, with more armor, they are also slower and have severe problems with soft ground and few bridges can hope to handle their weight.
mmhde5.zh: 超重型坦克是重型坦克概念的演进。它们更大、武装更好、装甲更厚，但也更慢，在松软地面上问题严重，而且少有桥梁能承受它们的重量。

1edul70.en: Modern tanks are agile multi-purpose tanks which are able to take on many roles such as scouting, support, and most importantly, front-line tanks.
1edul70.zh: 现代坦克是灵活的多用途坦克，能够承担侦察、支援等多种角色，最重要的是充当一线坦克。

1pqwnuf.en: Medium tanks are reasonably agile multi-purpose tanks which are able to take on many roles such as scouts, support, or even front-line tanks.
1pqwnuf.zh: 中型坦克是相当灵活的多用途坦克，能够承担侦察、支援甚至一线坦克等多种角色。

po1bka.en: Modern Tank Destroyers are an evolution of earlier light and medium TDs, providing mobility and stealth to heavy armor.
po1bka.zh: 现代坦克歼击车是早期轻型和中型坦克歼击车的演进，为重型装甲赋予了机动性与隐蔽性。

1gnjm9l.en: A medium tank modified to move through water. The added versatility and mobility comes at the cost of fuel efficiency.
1gnjm9l.zh: 一种经过改装、可在水中行进的中型坦克。额外的多用途性与机动性以燃油效率为代价。

1h4e5gn.en: A super heavy tank chassis with more frontal armour and an even larger gun in a fixed mount instead of a turret.
1h4e5gn.zh: 一种超重型坦克底盘，正面装甲更厚，并以固定炮架而非炮塔搭载更大的火炮。

6tf58i.en: Essentially a light tank modified to float, this vehicle offers fire support to units establishing a beachhead.
6tf58i.zh: 本质上是一种改装为可浮渡的轻型坦克，能为建立滩头阵地的部队提供火力支援。

ru88mm.en: Heavy tanks are large, armored monsters which are designed to destroy enemy tanks and fortifications.
ru88mm.zh: 重型坦克是体型庞大、披挂重甲的战车，专为摧毁敌方坦克和工事而设计。

k1vg0v.en: Light tanks are small, agile tanks which are able to both scout and fight lightly armored opponents.
k1vg0v.zh: 轻型坦克是体型小、机动灵活的坦克，既能侦察，也能与轻装甲对手交战。

zm8y9r.en: A heavy tank with the turret removed to carry an even larger gun in a fixed mounting.
zm8y9r.zh: 一种拆除炮塔、以固定炮架搭载更大火炮的重型坦克。

1epmuo7.en: Rocket artillery is less accurate and has a much lower sustained rate of fire than batteries of traditional artillery guns. However, they have the capability of simultaneously hitting a target with multiple rockets with devastating effect.
1epmuo7.zh: 与传统的管式火炮炮组相比，火箭炮精度更低，持续射速也慢得多。不过，它们能够用多枚火箭同时命中同一目标，造成毁灭性效果。

ctzs1i.en: As radar systems improve, employing radar direction of anti-aircraft guns becomes more viable. Keeping up with this technology will allow us to make some of the most accurate anti-air systems available.
ctzs1i.zh: 随着雷达系统不断改进，用雷达为高射炮指示方向变得越来越可行。跟上这项科技，我们就能造出一些最精准的防空系统。

1xyrbaa.en: By using various Shock-Hardening Techniques, and utilizing stress equalizers for our components, we lowered the rate of premature detonations, making our projectiles more reliable and effective
1xyrbaa.zh: 通过采用各种冲击硬化工艺，并为部件配备应力均衡器，我们降低了过早引爆的概率，让炮弹更加可靠、更具威力

5k6wf5.en: With adapting Variable Time Fuze Shells - we have made our field artillery devastating against our opponents. Shells explode before reaching the ground, thus creating much bigger kill-zone.
5k6wf5.zh: 借助改良的可变定时引信炮弹，我们让野战火炮对敌人具有毁灭性威力。炮弹在触地前便爆炸，从而形成大得多的杀伤区域。

8tlaz8.en: Artillery refers to large-caliber weapons, such as cannons and howitzers that are operated by crews, which can project munitions far beyond the effective range of personal weapons.
8tlaz8.zh: 火炮指由炮组操作的大口径武器，例如加农炮和榴弹炮，这类武器能把弹药投射到远超单兵武器有效射程之外。

unpbln.en: Combining different kinds of new ammunition technology with guns with higher muzzle velocities, these anti-tank guns are prepared for whatever new armor our enemies may develop.
unpbln.zh: 把各类新型弹药技术与更高炮口初速的火炮结合起来，这些反坦克炮已准备好应对敌人可能研发的任何新式装甲。

1ptzdul.en: The importance of effective anti-tank weapons was established in the Great War. Introducing a new generation of these weapons will be necessary to combat modern tank designs.
1ptzdul.zh: 有效反坦克武器的重要性在第一次世界大战中就已确立。要对抗现代坦克设计，就必须推出新一代此类武器。

18uo2j0.en: Sacrificing range for impact, we can mount heavier rockets on larger vehicles. Operating in teams, these artillery batteries can cooperate to reload and relocate quickly.
18uo2j0.zh: 牺牲射程换取威力，我们就能在更大的载具上安装更重的火箭。这些炮组可编队协同作战，快速重新装填并转移阵地。

5hvqbh.en: The mountainous terrain of Northern India led to the development of an artillery piece that could be dismantled and carried on muleback to wherever it was needed.
5hvqbh.zh: 北印度多山的地形催生了一种可拆卸、由骡队驮运到任何需要之处的火炮。

pmo29f.en: Self-propelled artillery utilizing multiple rockets will be able to cause large-scale destruction rapidly, while maintaining mobility to avoid counter-fire.
pmo29f.zh: 使用多枚火箭的自行火炮将能迅速造成大规模破坏，同时保持机动性以躲避反击火力。

5xsxpn.en: Light-weight artillery capable of being broken down for transport, making it possible to bring artillery support to areas previously difficult to reach.
5xsxpn.zh: 轻型火炮可拆解后运输，从而能把火炮支援送到以往难以抵达的地区。

yra6az.en: Upgrading old pieces can only get us so far. New howitzer designs will be needed, taking advantage of new hydraulic recoil devices and longer barrels.
yra6az.zh: 升级旧炮能带给我们的提升终归有限。我们需要全新的榴弹炮设计，利用新的液压驻退装置和更长的炮管。

p89co1.en: Anti-air artillery is primarily designed to shoot down hostile planes, although the rapid fire cannons can also be effective against ground targets.
p89co1.zh: 防空火炮主要用于击落敌方飞机，不过其速射炮对地面目标同样有效。

1kkm7is.en: Specialized vehicles designed to transport and support super-heavy howitzers, ensuring mobility and easiness of battlefield deployment.
1kkm7is.zh: 专为运输和支援超重型榴弹炮而设计的车辆，确保其机动性并便于在战场上部署。

1jlo552.en: An advanced mobile flak gun with greater reach and firing capacity, to combat even the fastest and highest-flying enemy aircraft.
1jlo552.zh: 一款射程更远、火力更强的先进机动高射炮，足以对抗最快、飞得最高的敌机。

lgmlvy.en: Combining modern systems of radar, computerization and autoloaders will be necessary to react quickly against faster aircraft.
lgmlvy.zh: 要快速应对更快的飞机，就必须结合现代雷达、计算机化与自动装填系统。

1hejh9s.en: New versatile anti-tank guns employing armored-piercing discarding sabot shots can penetrate the armor of nearly any tank.
1hejh9s.zh: 采用脱壳穿甲弹的新型多用途反坦克炮，能够击穿几乎任何坦克的装甲。

edzvof.en: Lessons learned in the development of different types of artillery can be cross-applied to the design of other pieces.
edzvof.zh: 在研发各类火炮过程中获得的经验，可以交叉应用到其他火炮的设计上。

18haqpc.en: Enhanced projectiles for super-heavy howitzers, designed to extend range and improve impact through rocket propulsion.
18haqpc.zh: 为超重型榴弹炮研制的改进型弹药，通过火箭助推来延长射程并增强威力。

1flfnpj.en: HEAT (high-explosive anti-tank) rounds can be used in anti-tank artillery to make up for limited muzzle velocity.
1flfnpj.zh: 反坦克火炮可以使用 HEAT（高爆反坦克）弹，以弥补炮口初速的不足。

7nyld4.en: With faster reloading mechanisms, anti-air guns carrying large rounds can still maintain necessary firing rates.
7nyld4.zh: 有了更快的装填机构，使用大口径弹药的防空炮仍能维持必要的射速。

g1gzqo.en: Artillery specialized in defeating armored targets like Tanks, it generally fires armor piercing shells.
g1gzqo.zh: 专精于击毁坦克等装甲目标的火炮，通常发射穿甲弹。

zx9sut.en: To enable heavier guns on lighter carriages, muzzle brakes can be included in howitzer designs.
zx9sut.zh: 为了让较轻的炮架承载更重的火炮，可以在榴弹炮设计中加入炮口制退器。

47rqwl.en: New howitzer designs, taking advantage of new hydraulic recoil devices and longer barrels.
47rqwl.zh: 采用新型液压驻退装置和更长炮管的新型榴弹炮设计。

8pwh00.en: Artillery designs with lower silhouettes will be more difficult for the enemy to target.
8pwh00.zh: 轮廓更低的火炮设计会让敌人更难瞄准。

g5abty.en: Anti-air guns with longer cartridges and barrels, able to target high-flying aircraft.
g5abty.zh: 采用更长弹药和炮管的防空炮，能够打击高空飞行的飞机。

320f5e.en: Spin-stabilized rockets, increasing the range of lighter artillery batteries.
320f5e.zh: 旋转稳定火箭弹，可提升较轻火炮炮组的射程。

xjd0xs.zh: 超重型榴弹炮、自行超重型榴弹炮：⟦0⟧

gl4d51.en: Larger caliber guns to combat heavier tanks with sloped armor.
gl4d51.zh: 更大口径的火炮，用于对抗带倾斜装甲的重型坦克。

1ca99xw.en: Video display button - Clicking the gear icon opens the video display menu. This menu has 3 dropdown menus; Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. The Display Mode allows three choices: Fullscreen, Windowed, and Borderless. Fullscreen is recommended because Windowed and Borderless modes on some systems have been known to cause launch issues such as blackscreens and failure to launch the game (reference ⟦0⟧). The Resolution allows a multitude of choices such as 1600x1024, 1680x1050, etc. Matching the game's resolution to the monitor's native resolution usually gives the optimum viewing experience. The Refresh Rate should also be set to match the monitor, if possible. The 60 Hz selection is recommended because it is quite common and the 50 Hz selection has been known to cause launch issues such as blackscreens and failure to launch the game. ⟦1⟧
1ca99xw.zh: 视频显示按钮——点击齿轮图标会打开视频显示菜单。该菜单有三个下拉菜单：显示模式、分辨率和刷新率。显示模式提供三种选择：全屏、窗口和窗口化全屏。推荐使用全屏，因为在某些系统上，窗口和窗口化全屏模式已知会导致启动问题，例如黑屏和无法启动游戏（参见⟦0⟧）。分辨率提供多种选择，例如 1600x1024、1680x1050 等。把游戏分辨率匹配到显示器的原生分辨率通常能获得最佳观看体验。刷新率也应尽可能设置为与显示器一致。推荐选择 60 Hz，因为它相当常见，而 50 Hz 选项已知会导致黑屏和无法启动游戏等启动问题。⟦1⟧

qpka4t.en: Mods tab - Clicking on the Mods tab will show a pulldown menu capable of revealing all of the mods that have been downloaded for the game. Clicking an item will place a green check mark next to the item indicating that it has been selected for inclusion in the game. No check mark indicates that the item was not selected for the game. The graphic shows that the mods "Coloured Buttons" and "More Division Icons" have been selected. Mods can be downloaded from the Steam Workshop. Be aware that some mods will deactivate the ability to get achievements during gameplay and that some mods are not updated for the latest version of the game which can lead to a system crash. Reading the author's information about their mod will usually indicate if the mod is compatible with achievements and what version of HOI4 that their mod has been updated to. ⟦0⟧
qpka4t.zh: 模组标签页——点击模组标签页会显示一个下拉菜单，可展开所有已为游戏下载的模组。点击某一项会在该项旁打上绿色对勾，表示它已被选中加入游戏。没有对勾表示该项未被选入游戏。图中显示「Coloured Buttons」和「More Division Icons」两个模组已被选中。模组可从 Steam 创意工坊下载。请注意，有些模组会禁用游戏过程中获得成就的能力，还有些模组尚未针对最新版本更新，可能导致系统崩溃。阅读作者关于其模组的说明，通常能看出该模组是否兼容成就，以及它已更新到《钢铁雄心4》的哪个版本。⟦0⟧

qs8gyd.en: This graphic has a vertical arrow pointing to the video display button represented by the gear icon. Clicking the "gear icon" will open the video display menu (see horizontal arrow) revealing 3 dropdown menus; one menu each for Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. Clicking on each small, inverted, green triangle will open a menu for choosing your video preference. The graphic shows that Fullscreen, 1920x1080, and 60 Hz have been selected.
qs8gyd.zh: 此图有一个垂直箭头指向齿轮图标所代表的视频显示按钮。点击「齿轮图标」会打开视频显示菜单（见水平箭头），其中显示 3 个下拉菜单：显示模式、分辨率和刷新率各一个。点击每个小型倒置绿色三角形都会打开一个菜单，用于选择你的视频偏好。图中显示已选中全屏、1920x1080 和 60 Hz。

ow2cnf.en: ⟦0⟧: research better infantry weapons and equipment and unlock specialized types of infantry divisions. This is where mobile infantry (motorized infantry and mechanized infantry), paratroopers, marines, mountain troops, trucks, motorized rocket artillery (MRA), amphibious vehicles, and armored cars (requires La Résistance DLC) will be unlocked. ⟦1⟧
ow2cnf.zh: ⟦0⟧：研究更好的步兵武器与装备，并解锁特种步兵师类型。这里会解锁摩托化步兵与机械化步兵等机动步兵、伞兵、海军陆战队、山地部队、卡车、摩托化火箭炮（MRA）、两栖车辆和装甲车（需要「抵抗运动」DLC）。⟦1⟧

1wcm79u.en: The Launcher for Hoi4. Items 1 through 7 are as follows: 1) game version and checksum 2) video display button 3) clear user directory button 4) game play button 5) create account button 6) downloadable content (DLC) tab 7) mods tab. Note that the DLC tab is currently open.
1wcm79u.zh: 《钢铁雄心4》的启动器。1 到 7 项如下：1) 游戏版本与校验和 2) 视频显示按钮 3) 清空用户目录按钮 4) 开始游戏按钮 5) 创建账户按钮 6) 可下载内容（DLC）标签页 7) 模组标签页。注意，DLC 标签页当前处于打开状态。

17adosd.en: Clear user directory button - Clicking on this button will clear your HOI4 user directory. Only click on this button if you are experiencing game crashes. Reference the Tooltip in the graphic. ⟦0⟧
17adosd.zh: 清空用户目录按钮——点击此按钮会清空你的《钢铁雄心4》用户目录。只有在遇到游戏崩溃时才点击此按钮。参见图中的提示框。⟦0⟧

1kb5bam.en: Infantry technology screen - outdated (doctrines removed from research and added to officer corps with patch 1.11.0 Barbarossa).
1kb5bam.zh: 步兵科技界面——已过时（1.11.0 Barbarossa 补丁把学说从科研中移除并加入军官团）。

1dc4qqe.en: A graphic with an arrow pointing to the "Mods" tab. The "Coloured Buttons" and "More Division Icons" mods have been selected.
1dc4qqe.zh: 一张用箭头指向「模组」标签页的图。图中已选中「Coloured Buttons」和「More Division Icons」两个模组。

h6j7br.en: A graphic with arrows pointing to the "Clear user directory" button and its associated Tooltip.
h6j7br.zh: 一张用箭头分别指向「清空用户目录」按钮及其对应提示框的图。

bagl7y.en: Corrupt game files: Try a clean reinstallation of the game. ⟦0⟧
bagl7y.zh: 游戏文件损坏：尝试干净地重新安装游戏。⟦0⟧

1ix0uw1.en: As Congo break free from the shackles of your old overlord and take control of all of their starting states.
1ix0uw1.zh: 作为刚果，挣脱旧日宗主的枷锁，并夺取其全部初始州份的控制权。

yzcxw1.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to create an entry for a country among the interesting countries. Using the tag of ⟦1⟧ will be taken as the "other countries" menu, allowing the player to enter the country selection without any selected. The same country may have several definitions. In particular, these are used as arguments inside: ⟦2⟧
yzcxw1.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于在「有趣的国家」中为一个国家创建条目。使用 ⟦1⟧ 的 tag 将被视为「其他国家」菜单，允许玩家在未选中任何国家的情况下进入国家选择界面。同一个国家可以有多个定义。具体来说，以下内容被用作其中的参数：⟦2⟧

pq9h0t.en: There are 3 ⟦0⟧ gridboxes in the file used for positioning the interesting countries. The one inside of the ⟦1⟧ container window is used for major countries, while the ones inside ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ are for minor countries, changing from one to the other after a 9th minor country is added. ⟦4⟧
pq9h0t.zh: 文件中有 3 个 ⟦0⟧ gridbox 用于定位「有趣的国家」。⟦1⟧ 容器窗口内的那个用于主要国家，而 ⟦2⟧ 和 ⟦3⟧ 内的那些用于次要国家，在加入第 9 个次要国家后从一个切换到另一个。⟦4⟧

1j0u7te.en: The ⟦0⟧ gridbox is used for positioning the bookmarks for the player to select, and the ⟦1⟧ container windows are the individual elements of that gridbox. If the amount of bookmarks doesn't match the ones in the base game, this is necessary to edit: ⟦2⟧
1j0u7te.zh: ⟦0⟧ gridbox 用于定位供玩家选择的书签，而 ⟦1⟧ 容器窗口是该 gridbox 的各个独立元素。如果书签数量与基础游戏中的不一致，则需要编辑以下内容：⟦2⟧

yaq5qe.en: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are used to define options of the game rule, with the latter being automatically selected by default. These can be replicated multiple times. In particular, these have the following attributes: ⟦2⟧
yaq5qe.zh: ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 用于定义游戏规则的选项，其中后者默认会被自动选中。这些可以被重复多次。具体来说，它们具有以下属性：⟦2⟧

1b8ra2.en: If you didn't get it, don't worry too much. Due to the way the game combines similar wars between factions, sometimes your "Iceland-UK" war is automatically combined into the much larger "Germany-Poland" war. This depends on a few different factors that you can't control, including who the AI actually decides to call in to each war and whether or not the "Italy-Ethiopia" war was already combined with the "Germany-Poland" war. ⟦0⟧
1b8ra2.zh: 如果你没能成功，也不必太担心。由于游戏会把阵营之间的类似战争合并，有时你的「冰岛-英国」战争会自动并入规模大得多的「德国-波兰」战争。这取决于几个你无法控制的因素，包括 AI 实际决定把谁拉进每场战争，以及「意大利-埃塞俄比亚」战争是否已经与「德国-波兰」战争合并。⟦0⟧

16k1abs.en: For your first researches, get them in the following order: Electronic Mechanical Engineering, Basic Machine Tools, Early Cruiser, Concentrated Industry I, Radio, and Concentrated Industry II. Just proceed like normal with research afterwards, focusing on Computing (at least the first 2-3 techs; the rest aren't worth it), Radio, Industry, Infantry Equipment, Trucks/Trains, Artillery, and Anti-Air (in roughly that order). ⟦0⟧
16k1abs.zh: 你的头几项科研按以下顺序进行：电子机械工程、基础机床、早期巡洋舰、集中工业 I、无线电、集中工业 II。之后照常推进科研，重点放在计算（至少前 2-3 项科技；其余不值得）、无线电、工业、步兵装备、卡车／列车、火炮和防空（大致按此顺序）。⟦0⟧

18qr7yg.en: For future focuses, prioritize getting your third research slot from Industrial Research School, the free spy agency from Infiltration, and then the buff from Professionalize the Army (go down the Naval side and pick up Emergency Conversions while you are there). ⟦0⟧
18qr7yg.zh: 接下来的焦点优先选择：通过工业研究学校获得第三个科研槽、通过渗透获得免费特工机构，然后是「军队专业化」带来的增益（顺路走海军分支并点出「紧急改装」）。⟦0⟧

tr556v.en: However, because you made plans that are split between 2 regions and because your fleet can provide upwards of 2000 Naval Dominance in a single region, the UK AI physically cannot get enough Naval Dominance to block all 4 naval invasions simultaneously. ⟦0⟧
tr556v.zh: 不过，由于你的登陆计划分散在两个地区，而且你的舰队能在单个地区提供高达 2000 的海军主导权，英国 AI 实际上无法获得足够的海军主导权来同时阻止全部 4 次海军登陆。⟦0⟧

1xv57gg.en: As the date of your justification approaches (check on the ⟦0⟧ diplomacy screen), slow down the game time. You need to declare war on the ⟦1⟧ on the exact hour that the justification finishes. Don't invite your allies or accept their requests to join. ⟦2⟧
1xv57gg.zh: 当你的战争目标制造日期临近时（在⟦0⟧外交界面查看），放慢游戏时间。你需要在制造完成的那一小时准时对⟦1⟧宣战。不要邀请你的盟友，也不要接受他们的参战请求。⟦2⟧

hxpm42.en: In January 1939, join the ⟦0⟧. Set up a Naval invasion plan from the port of Wilhelmshaven in Germany to the port one tile north of Amsterdam in the Netherlands (west of Leeuwarden). Assign your units to it so they move to Wilhelmshaven. ⟦1⟧
hxpm42.zh: 1939 年 1 月，加入⟦0⟧。制定一项海军登陆计划，从德国的威廉港出发，登陆荷兰阿姆斯特丹以北一格的那个港口（吕伐登以西）。把部队分配到该计划，让它们移动到威廉港。⟦1⟧

1r9mk12.en: Afterwards, release all of the puppets possible from the UK's land that are -not- the UK ( Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, and all the various overseas ones). Then release the UK but as an independent country, not a puppet. ⟦0⟧
1r9mk12.zh: 之后，从英国领土上释放所有能释放、但并非英国本身的傀儡国（苏格兰、威尔士、北爱尔兰以及各个海外领地）。然后把英国作为独立国家释放，而不是傀儡国。⟦0⟧

1u8qrh.en: With the ⟦0⟧ you gained from the first focus, start buying equipment from the Market and continue doing so for the next couple of years. You want to focus on Infantry Equipment with Towed Artillery as a second priority. ⟦1⟧
1u8qrh.zh: 用第一项焦点获得的⟦0⟧，开始从市场购买装备，并在接下来几年里持续这样做。你要以步兵装备为重点，牵引式火炮为第二优先。⟦1⟧

k718z4.en: Make sure you're continuing your Collaboration Governments on the UK and doing your "Refit ships to Cruisers" decision every time you can. (The destroyers one is nice but ultimately less impactful.) ⟦0⟧
k718z4.zh: 确保继续在英国推进协作政府，并尽可能每次都执行「将舰船改装为巡洋舰」决议。（驱逐舰那个也不错，但最终影响较小。）⟦0⟧

k02425.en: At this point, pick one of the two sets of naval invasions to commit to. Assign divisions to that set of naval invasions and put your main fleet on Patrol in the needed sea area. ⟦0⟧
k02425.zh: 此时从两组海军登陆中选择一组全力执行。把师分配到该组海军登陆任务，并让你的主力舰队在所需海域执行巡逻。⟦0⟧

lxtwd7.en: You can do an exploit here as well to increase the power of your Navy substantially if you want, but it doesn't make a huge difference. In case you do though: ⟦0⟧
lxtwd7.zh: 如果你想的话，这里也可以利用一个漏洞大幅提升海军实力，但它带来的差别并不大。不过如果你确实要用：⟦0⟧

1d587wh.en: As soon as you've got a port, set up a Field Marshal frontline and assign all of your forces to it (minus like 4 divisions left at home to guard Iceland). ⟦0⟧
1d587wh.zh: 一旦你拿到一个港口，就建立一条元帅前线并把所有部队分配给它（留下大约 4 个师守家，防卫冰岛）。⟦0⟧

16ohqlh.en: Now that your destroyer is done, go ahead and add a single line of your starting division template to your Recruitment queue. Set the quantity to 5. ⟦0⟧
16ohqlh.zh: 现在你的驱逐舰已经完工，继续把一条初始师模板加入招募队列。数量设为 5。⟦0⟧

ezazm.en: Queue up a couple ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ in Iceland on your capital; you probably won't finish them but that's fine. If you do, build ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧
ezazm.zh: 在冰岛你的首都排入几个⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧；你多半完不成它们，但那没关系。如果完成了，就建造⟦2⟧。⟦3⟧

7vow5b.en: If you're lucky and fast, you will capitulate the ⟦0⟧ immediately. ⟦1⟧
7vow5b.zh: 如果你运气好、动作快，就会立刻迫使⟦0⟧投降。⟦1⟧

w25lmv.en: There is still a lot of slack in our construction industry. By focusing our attention on it, we can achieve a significant improvement in construction speed. Unfortunately, the production of machine tools has proven a major bottleneck in the expansion of our heavy industry, so they won't benefit from efforts in this area.
w25lmv.zh: 我们的建筑业仍有很大的闲置产能。只要把注意力集中于此，我们就能大幅提升建造速度。遗憾的是，机床生产已被证明是重工业扩张的主要瓶颈，因此它们无法从这一领域的努力中受益。

1avoegy.en: The task of preparing the Swiss population is never-ending. We cannot rest until the threat of invasion is gone, and might never be. We must orient our nation towards defensive preparations without delay.
1avoegy.zh: 让瑞士民众做好准备的工作永无止境。在入侵威胁消失之前我们无法安歇，也许永远都无法安歇。我们必须立即让国家转向防御准备。

as6yth.en: Although we have lost land to the enemy, the fight must go on. The Black Lions are offering a great deal of resistance to the Italian's and we should therefore support them in any way we can.
as6yth.zh: 尽管我们已把土地丢给了敌人，战斗仍须继续。黑狮们正在对意大利人进行顽强的抵抗，因此我们应当以一切可能的方式支援他们。

1nsw1zn.en: Across Ethiopia there are patriots willing to take up arms against the Italian invaders. We must do everything we can to support these brave men and women in crippling the Italian war machine
1nsw1zn.zh: 在埃塞俄比亚各地，都有爱国者愿意拿起武器对抗意大利入侵者。我们必须竭尽所能支持这些勇敢的男女，去瘫痪意大利的战争机器

451ix4.en: Our citizens are armed and deployed into their local militias, it is everyone else's duty to support them however they can so we can keep the enemies of the confederation at bay
451ix4.zh: 我们的公民已经武装起来并被编入当地民兵，其他人都有义务尽其所能支持他们，以便我们能够抵挡联邦的敌人

1dq6sk3.en: ⟦0⟧ - The trigger block which the primary country must fulfill for the target to work. In here, ROOT (default scope) is the country running the scorer. ⟦1⟧
1dq6sk3.zh: ⟦0⟧ - 主要国家为使目标生效而必须满足的触发器块。在这里，ROOT（默认作用域）是运行评分器的国家。⟦1⟧

1rm191t.en: Amount of buildings of a certain type that have been constructed after the game's start by the country. The following options exist: ⟦0⟧
1rm191t.zh: 游戏开始后该国已建造的某一类型建筑的数量。存在以下选项：⟦0⟧

yaccdr.en: ⟦0⟧ decides the way the number will show up in the tooltip. There are the following values this argument can be set to: ⟦1⟧
yaccdr.zh: ⟦0⟧ 决定该数字在提示框中显示的方式。此参数可以设置为以下值：⟦1⟧

2vfa1t.en: The total amount of produced equipment with the specified type of equipment archetypes. The following options exist: ⟦0⟧
2vfa1t.zh: 指定装备原型类型所生产的装备总量。存在以下选项：⟦0⟧

s0eq0q.en: ⟦0⟧ The name of the file, not counting the file extension. Defaults to "variable_dump". ⟦1⟧
s0eq0q.zh: ⟦0⟧ 文件名，不包含文件扩展名。默认为 "variable_dump"。⟦1⟧

om68s6.en: ⟦0⟧ An AND trigger block deciding when the effect would repeat. ⟦1⟧
om68s6.zh: ⟦0⟧ 一个 AND 触发器块，决定该效果何时会重复。⟦1⟧

1v1ipb2.en: ⟦0⟧ The value at which the evaluation starts. Default to 0. ⟦1⟧
1v1ipb2.zh: ⟦0⟧ 求值开始时的数值。默认为 0。⟦1⟧

2c6ps5.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to modify or create. ⟦1⟧

10lbg3r.en: ⟦0⟧ The variable to get the value of. ⟦1⟧

f9upta.zh: 本地化 § 格式化变量

166721u.en: Not cancellable without having a common border or within the first 12 months of the pact.⟦0⟧ After 12 months, the ability to break a NAP will depend on the relative size of armies along the common border.⟦1⟧ Up to 18 months past the NAP, the country will require a 2:1 ratio of troops compared to its opponent on the common border.⟦2⟧ Between 18 and 24 months, a 1:1 ratio is required.⟦3⟧ Past 24 months after the NAP, a 1:2 ratio is required to break the pact.⟦4⟧ NAPs dissolve after 48 months.⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧⟦7⟧
166721u.zh: 在没有共同边界或未处于条约签订后头 12 个月的情况下不可取消。⟦0⟧ 12 个月后，能否废除互不侵犯条约将取决于共同边界两侧军队的相对规模。⟦1⟧ 在互不侵犯条约签订后 18 个月内，该国需要相对于共同边界上的对手拥有 2:1 的兵力比例。⟦2⟧ 在 18 至 24 个月之间，需要 1:1 的比例。⟦3⟧ 在互不侵犯条约签订 24 个月之后，废除条约需要 1:2 的比例。⟦4⟧ 互不侵犯条约会在 48 个月后失效。⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧⟦7⟧

16s85bj.en: Guarantee the independence of another country. If anyone declares war on a guaranteed nation, that guaranteed nation will automatically join the ⟦0⟧ of the guarantor. ⟦1⟧
16s85bj.zh: 保障另一国的独立。若有人向被保障国宣战，该被保障国将自动加入保障国的⟦0⟧。 ⟦1⟧

z1p4vk.en: ⟦0⟧# Changes GER's occupation law for every controlled state.
z1p4vk.zh: ⟦0⟧# 更改德国对每个受控州的占领法令。

17i2iwy.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the character flag with. ⟦1⟧
17i2iwy.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该人物标记的唯一字符串。⟦1⟧

b70jmq.en: This example can be used as an effect in regular code as ⟦0⟧.
b70jmq.zh: 此示例可以在常规代码中作为 ⟦0⟧ 效果使用。

avrqb9.en: Only results in an agency being created if one doesn't exist.
avrqb9.zh: 仅当情报机构不存在时才会创建一个。

z0osuo.en: ⟦0⟧ The amount of specialization breakthrough points to add.
z0osuo.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的专业化突破点数。

dv67wj.en: Funds will not be changed by the effect. Cannot be negative.
dv67wj.zh: 资金不会因此效果而改变。不能为负数。

1xps99t.en: There are 3 ways to edit the tooltip within an effect block:
1xps99t.zh: 在效果块内有 3 种编辑提示框的方式：

ax8rd9.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the country flag with. ⟦1⟧
ax8rd9.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该国家标记的唯一字符串。⟦1⟧

12g0q3.en: ⟦0⟧ The resource to add. ⟦1⟧ The amount of resource to add.
12g0q3.zh: ⟦0⟧ 要添加的资源。⟦1⟧ 要添加的资源数量。

rv0e5g.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether to free all operatives or not (Defaults to no).
rv0e5g.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是否释放所有特工（默认为 no）。

1kctwcf.en: command to call them up. Only necessary in 1.11 and beyond.
1kctwcf.zh: 用于召集他们的指令。仅在 1.11 及以后的版本中需要。

1wj2i4o.en: ⟦0⟧ The character name. Optional if in character scope. ⟦1⟧
1wj2i4o.zh: ⟦0⟧ 该人物名称。若处于人物作用域中则可选。⟦1⟧

m5s1gk.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the project flag with. ⟦1⟧
m5s1gk.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该项目标记的唯一字符串。⟦1⟧

b0u66h.en: Complete a prototype reward option for the project in scope
b0u66h.zh: 为作用域中的项目完成一个原型奖励选项

lp8jxg.en: ⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the global flag with. ⟦1⟧
lp8jxg.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于标识该全局标记的唯一字符串。⟦1⟧

t243hc.en: ⟦0⟧ Whether to transfer the troops of the annexed country.
t243hc.zh: ⟦0⟧ 是否转交被吞并国家的部队。

1gihlqv.en: ⟦0⟧ The wargoal to remove. "all" will remove all wargoals.

ep9cyl.en: The increased computation power that improved our cryptanalysis so far threatens to create nearly unbreakable ciphers in the future. To stay ahead, we must be prepared to work more aggressively on gaining inside information on the technology.
ep9cyl.zh: 此前使我们的密码分析得以改进的算力提升，如今也预示着未来将出现几乎无法破解的密码。要想保持领先，我们必须做好准备，更积极地设法获取有关该技术的内幕情报。

1fviylj.en: By learning from past mistakes and reinforcing not only the structure itself, but also its base foundations, we will be able to construct much larger fortifications, that will be able to hold off even the most seasoned enemies.
1fviylj.zh: 通过吸取以往的教训，不仅加固工事本身，也加固其地基，我们将能够修建大得多的工事，足以挡住最老练的敌人。

1y96d5y.en: A project to construct an atomic bomb will be one of the most secretive and difficult tasks a nation can undertake, but, if successful, may change not only the course of today's wars but of the future of the world.
1y96d5y.zh: 建造原子弹的计划将是一个国家所能承担的最机密、最艰难的任务之一，但一旦成功，可能不仅改变当今战争的走向，也改变世界的未来。

6nceio.en: The development of more sophisticated computers allows for new applications of cryptanalysis methods like differencing, which can be used to break advanced cyphers when combined with new hand codebreaking methods.
6nceio.zh: 更精密计算机的研制，使差分法等密码分析方法有了新的应用；这些方法若与新的手工破译手段相结合，便可用来破译先进的密码。

1q1wnhj.en: The development of RADAR, Radio Detection and Ranging, allows using radio waves to detect physical objects. Research is highly secretive, considering the impact these inventions could have on locating units.
1q1wnhj.zh: 雷达（无线电探测与测距）的研制，使我们能够利用无线电波探测实体目标。考虑到这些发明在定位部队方面可能产生的影响，相关研究高度保密。

h3i9hs.en: Advancing the science of rocketry by improving the range and reliability of liquid-fuel rockets will teach us enough about the technology to allow the construction of launch sites for more advanced models.
h3i9hs.zh: 通过提高液体燃料火箭的射程与可靠性来推进火箭科学，将使我们对该技术有足够的了解，从而能够为更先进的型号建造发射场。

19jxau9.en: Unlike traditional radar that relies on mechanical rotation phased arrays use electronics to steer the beam, allowing it to perform multiple functions simultaneously, such as tracking multiple targets.
19jxau9.zh: 与依赖机械旋转的传统雷达不同，相控阵利用电子方式操纵波束，使其能够同时执行多项功能，例如跟踪多个目标。

1clfoji.en: Limitation in the randomization of cipher machines can be exploited to break the ciphers. By improving the randomness of the rotor mechanics, we can make this kind of cryptanalysis more difficult.
1clfoji.zh: 密码机随机化的不足可以被利用来破解密码。通过改进转子的随机性，我们可以让这类密码分析变得更加困难。

1sosvw7.en: By building our bunkers and fortifications further into the cliff-sides and hills, we can construct even larger complexes that have the ability to repel even the greatest of naval invasion forces.
1sosvw7.zh: 把我们的掩体与工事更深地修入崖壁和山丘之中，我们就能修建规模更大的综合工事群，甚至有能力击退最强大的海军登陆部队。

ixgfw5.en: Developing a theoretical groundwork for modern computers and constructing electromechanical machines to start putting them into practice will be the first steps into this realm of possibilities.
ixgfw5.zh: 为现代计算机奠定理论基础，并制造机电式机器开始付诸实践，将是迈入这一充满可能性的领域的第一步。

cx2j9r.en: Beginning to work on computers capable of storing programs and making use of transistors will put us on the path to a Digital Revolution where these machines may be used in nearly any field.
cx2j9r.zh: 着手研制能够存储程序并使用晶体管的计算机，将使我们踏上数字革命之路，届时这类机器几乎可以用于任何领域。

l6j17j.en: We live in an age when electrical machines can no longer only warm and light us, but help us think and communicate. Electronics will be key to military intelligence in the coming century.
l6j17j.zh: 我们身处的时代，电气机器不再只能为我们供暖和照明，还能帮助我们思考和通信。在下个世纪，电子学将成为军事情报的关键。

eoo6yf.en: By making better use of the land surrounding our coastal fortifications, and incorporating new technology to boot, we can strengthen our existing structures and expand them even further.
eoo6yf.zh: 更好地利用沿海工事周围的土地，并引入新技术，我们就能加固现有工事并将其进一步扩建。

pnk91p.en: Electronic digital computers can now be made which are programmable. Although still expensive and large, these machines allow for intelligence analysis far beyond human capacity.
pnk91p.zh: 如今已能制造可编程的电子数字计算机。尽管仍然昂贵而笨重，这些机器却能进行远超人类能力的情报分析。

1sqqwys.en: By making better use of the land surrounding our fortifications, and incorporating new technology to boot, we can strengthen our existing structures and expand them even further.
1sqqwys.zh: 更好地利用工事周围的土地，并引入新技术，我们就能加固现有工事并将其进一步扩建。

1kmipfk.en: Using a tube that generates microwaves called a Cavity Magnatron we can dramatically improve existing radar systems ability to detect objects by bouncing waves off of them.
1kmipfk.zh: 利用一种名为空腔磁控管的产生微波的电子管，我们可以大幅提升现有雷达系统通过反射波探测目标的能力。

ji6xl0.en: Adopting the inventions of amateur radio operators and extending the use of FM radio will reduce radio interference and allow us to find new uses for radio technology.
ji6xl0.zh: 采纳业余无线电爱好者的发明并推广调频无线电的使用，将减少无线电干扰，并让我们为无线电技术找到新的用途。

bfx1oo.en: By using stronger materials and metal reinforcements within the structures, we can construct larger fortifications without having to worry about them collapsing.
bfx1oo.zh: 在结构中使用更坚固的材料与金属加固件，我们就能修建更大的工事而不必担心它们坍塌。

tkm56v.en: By entering course, speed and distance of a target, a mechanical computer can accurately predict where the target will be when the next salvo is ready to fire.
tkm56v.zh: 输入目标的航向、航速与距离，机械计算机就能准确预测出下一轮齐射准备就绪时目标所在的位置。

1d0tryx.en: Cryptanalysis is increasingly becoming an advanced mathematical science. Systems like card catalogs and devices like cyclometers can aid the necessary work.
1d0tryx.zh: 密码分析正日益成为一门高深的数学科学。卡片目录之类的系统与密码计数器之类的装置都能为这项必要工作提供帮助。

4olo5r.en: Advancements in Radio technology has increased the range of radios, and even made some of them small enough to be carried. Some call it the Walkie-Talkie
4olo5r.zh: 无线电技术的进步提升了电台的通信距离，甚至使其中一些小巧到可以随身携带。有人称之为步话机。

cpsryw.en: Constructing machines capable of advanced differential analysis will radically change what sort of machine-assisted calculations can be made.
cpsryw.zh: 制造能够进行高级差分分析的机器，将彻底改变机器辅助计算所能完成的工作。

1fhokph.en: With new methods of communication comes new risks for interception. Rotor cipher machines can be used to allow for rapid, complex encryption.
1fhokph.zh: 新的通信方式带来了新的被截获风险。转子密码机可用于实现快速而复杂的加密。

1pv3b1o.en: Technological improvements and hard-earned experience allows us to implement more traffic flow security measures in our communication.
1pv3b1o.zh: 技术的进步与来之不易的经验，使我们能够在通信中实施更多的通信流量保密措施。

nxjh7h.en: All fire of the ship's guns is controlled from a central position, ensuring a tighter grouping of shots and increases accuracy.
nxjh7h.zh: 舰炮的全部射击由中央位置统一控制，确保弹着更加密集并提高命中精度。

1czny7j.en: Even larger rocket propelled unguided bombs, carrying a heavier payload, able to penetrate their targets even more effectively.
1czny7j.zh: 更大的火箭推进无制导炸弹，携带更重的战斗部，能够更有效地穿透目标。

oth44.en: With monopulse radar we can determine the direction of a target by comparing signals from sevel antennas, improving detection.
oth44.zh: 借助单脉冲雷达，我们可以通过比较多个天线的信号来确定目标方向，从而改进探测效果。

1g8smt7.en: By adding a second combustion chamber to the engine, we can improve flight time and effectiveness of our rocket engines.
1g8smt7.zh: 为发动机增加第二个燃烧室，我们就能延长火箭发动机的工作时间并提升其效能。

17tj1kr.en: Further refinements of the dual combustion engine may lead to even greater improvements in the design's effectiveness.
17tj1kr.zh: 对双燃烧室发动机的进一步改良，可能使该设计的效能得到更大的提升。

106udyt.en: New radar operating in the microwave bands enable us to detect objects too small for previous radars to pick up.
106udyt.zh: 在微波波段工作的新型雷达，使我们能够探测到以往雷达无法捕捉的过小目标。

g7oo0i.en: In nuclear fission, splitting the atom yields enormous amounts of energy and limitless destructive capability.
g7oo0i.zh: 在核裂变中，分裂原子能释放出巨大的能量与无限的破坏力。

csa8j9.en: Rocket propelled unguided bombs can inflict considerable damage on ships and similar armoured larger targets.
csa8j9.zh: 火箭推进的无制导炸弹能对舰船以及类似的大型装甲目标造成相当大的破坏。

s1hfbq.en: Improvements in signal strength has allowed Radios to be broadcasted further than ever before.
s1hfbq.zh: 信号强度的改进使无线电能够比以往传播得更远。
