6tdjt4.zh: 战争摘要界面会显示冲突中每个参战国家向投降上限推进的进度。

1mhy52v.en: Aussa and the Horn of Africa countries ⟦0⟧

1ej7ekw.en: Put your division on a Front Line order on the German-Hungarian Border (Anschluss should have happened by now). When your war goal is ready, pause the game, order your divisions to walk into Hungary, click force attack and then declare on Hungary. Your Units should now be attacking into Hungary without having to call in the Germans. Once you have taken your first tiles you can keep attacking from there. They should capitulate once you have taken Sopron, Győr, Pécs and Budapest. Depending on how long the civil war takes, how early you start justifying and how long it takes to beat Hungary you should be done by late 1938 to mid 1939. You can also save time by not upgrading your Economy Law and instead get the ⟦0⟧ during the civil war so you can justify immediately. Just make sure to finish the civil war before World Tension reaches 50%, otherwise ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ will be able to call the ⟦3⟧ into the civil war.
1ej7ekw.zh: 将你的师部署到德匈边境并下达「前线」命令（此时德奥合并应已完成）。当你的战争目标准备就绪后，暂停游戏，命令你的师步行进入匈牙利，点击强制攻击，然后对匈牙利宣战。你的部队此时应当能在不召唤德国的情况下攻入匈牙利。一旦夺取了第一批地块，你就可以从那里继续进攻。占领肖普朗、杰尔、佩奇和布达佩斯后，他们应当会投降。根据内战持续多久、你多早开始正当化以及击败匈牙利需要多长时间，你应当在 1938 年末至 1939 年中期之间完成。你也可以不升级经济法案，改为在内战期间取得⟦0⟧来节省时间，这样就能立即开始正当化。只是要确保在世界紧张度达到 50% 之前结束内战，否则⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧将能够把⟦3⟧拉入内战。

wofv96.en: When your justification finishes, declare war on ⟦0⟧. Give your Field Marshal and General good traits using your Command power (Offensive Doctrine and Thorough Planner for the Field Marshal and Infantry Expert for the General). Call in your allies within a month or two (whenever you feel ready) and start pushing ⟦1⟧. You can just battle plan this. After ⟦2⟧ captitulates, take as much of the land bordering Hungary as possible. You should at least get 2 states, maybe 3 if the Soviets aren't being jerks. It should be no later than July 1939 (probably much earlier). Begin to justify a War goal on ⟦3⟧. Throw a front line on the Soviet-Turkish border now and battle plan an offensive line deep in ⟦4⟧ and send it. This is to have your forces help the Soviets capture ⟦5⟧ while your second justification is ongoing. Take Edirne in the peace deal for the achievement ⟦6⟧.
wofv96.zh: 当你的正当化完成后，对⟦0⟧宣战。用你的指挥点数为你的元帅和将军赋予良好特质（元帅选择「攻势学说」和「周密策划者」，将军选择「步兵专家」）。在一两个月内召唤你的盟友（你觉得准备好了就召唤），并开始推进⟦1⟧。你完全可以直接用作战计划来完成。在⟦2⟧投降后，尽可能多地夺取与匈牙利接壤的土地。你至少应当得到 2 个州，如果苏联人不刁难的话也许能拿到 3 个。这不应晚于 1939 年 7 月（很可能早得多）。开始对⟦3⟧正当化一个战争目标。此时在苏土边境布置一条前线，并在⟦4⟧纵深规划一条进攻线并派遣部队。这样做是为了让你的部队在第二次正当化进行期间协助苏联夺取⟦5⟧。在和谈中夺取埃迪尔内以取得成就⟦6⟧。

1pxawf7.en: Take focuses to become independent, hire a ⟦0⟧ advisor, change your ideology to ⟦1⟧, and take the Join Comintern focus. This will allow you to join the ⟦2⟧ without worrying about the distance penalty. As soon as you turn ⟦3⟧, justify on ⟦4⟧ in order to bump the world tension past 20%. This lets you start on Establish Advisory War Council. (Once the World Tension is raised, cancel the justification. You don't ⟦5⟧ want to attack ⟦6⟧, and you don't want the Stability/War support penalty that would hit you if you let a justification expire.) Optionally, create an intelligence agency, get the ⟦7⟧, put two spies in ⟦8⟧ and keep one building the spy network, the other promoting ideology. This is so that ⟦9⟧ stays below 30% ⟦10⟧ support and does not join the ⟦11⟧ when attacked.
1pxawf7.zh: 通过国策取得独立，聘请一位⟦0⟧顾问，将你的意识形态改为⟦1⟧，并选取「加入共产国际」国策。这将使你能够加入⟦2⟧而不必担心距离惩罚。你一旦转为⟦3⟧，就对⟦4⟧进行正当化，以便将世界紧张度推高到 20% 以上。这样你就能开始「建立咨政战争委员会」。 （世界紧张度提高后，取消该正当化。你并不⟦5⟧想进攻⟦6⟧，也不希望因正当化过期而遭受稳定度/战争支持度惩罚。）可选做法是：建立情报机构，取得⟦7⟧，在⟦8⟧安插两名特工，让一名继续建立特工网络，另一名提升意识形态。这样做是为了让⟦9⟧的⟦10⟧支持度保持在 30% 以下，从而在遭到进攻时不会加入⟦11⟧。

133s1ju.en: Click the Prepare for Civil War decision followed by Expand Civil Support once, save up 100 ⟦0⟧, and then wait for your Stability to drop below 60%. Then click Anti-Fascist Raids to reduce your Stability even further so you can ignite the civil war. Once in the civil war make sure to pick the Desperate Defense Subdoctrine and don't finish the civil war until after you have completed Establish Advisory War Council and Invest in Victory. You should also have enough ⟦1⟧ to switch to ⟦2⟧, but beware that your War support will drop once the civil war is over, so make sure you have enough ⟦3⟧ to send an attache to ⟦4⟧. From now on the exact foci you pick don't really matter, just prioritize research slots and industry.
133s1ju.zh: 点击「准备内战」决议，随后点击一次「扩大民间支持」，攒够 100 ⟦0⟧，然后等待你的稳定度降到 60% 以下。接着点击「反法西斯突袭」以进一步降低稳定度，从而点燃内战。进入内战后，务必选择「绝望防御」子学说，并且在完成「建立咨政战争委员会」和「投资于胜利」之前不要结束内战。你还应当拥有足够的⟦1⟧来切换到⟦2⟧，但要注意内战结束后你的战争支持度会下降，所以要确保你有足够的⟦3⟧向⟦4⟧派遣武官。从此以后，你具体选哪些国策并不太重要，只需优先考虑科研槽和工业。

1879mrb.en: One major complication you have to deal with is that Australia has severely restricted manpower. You start the game with the conscription law capped at ⟦0⟧, which only gives you a maximum of 105K manpower. Unlocking higher conscription laws requires completing a long chain of focuses (you need to finish 3 70-day focuses - 210 days total - to unlock ⟦1⟧ and another 350 days to unlock ⟦2⟧). You want to finish Citizen Military Forces and switch to ⟦3⟧ at least a month before attacking {{flag|Romania, and you want to finish Fight Work or Perish and switch to ⟦4⟧ at least a month before attacking ⟦5⟧. If you rush everything and employ the justification on ⟦6⟧ trick, you should be able to declare on ⟦7⟧ in late 1939.
1879mrb.zh: 你必须应对的一个主要麻烦是澳大利亚的人力受到严重限制。开局时你的征兵法案上限被锁定在⟦0⟧，这最多只能给你 105K 人力。解锁更高的征兵法案需要完成一长串国策（你需要完成 3 个 70 天的国策——共 210 天——才能解锁⟦1⟧，再花 350 天解锁⟦2⟧）。你需要在进攻 {{flag|Romania 之前至少一个月完成「公民军事力量」并切换到⟦3⟧，并且需要在发动进攻前至少一个月完成「战斗、工作或灭亡」并切换到⟦4⟧，这场进攻针对的是⟦5⟧。如果你速通一切并使用对⟦6⟧进行正当化的技巧，你应当能够在 1939 年末对⟦7⟧宣战。

9ba1rq.en: The initial Focus order is Never Another Gallipoli > Abandon the Westminster System > Industries Assistance Corporation > Standard Gauge Railway > [Wait 11 Days for autonomy to reach 550] >Support the Centre Party > Additional Militia Training. This sets us up for the civil war. In the meantime, spend your Political Power on hiring the ⟦0⟧, the Ban Communism decision after Abandon the Westminster System finishes and the ⟦1⟧ after Support the Centre Party is done. Use the ⟦2⟧ for the Proper Heritage ⟦3⟧. The freely editable cavalry templates are useful during the civil war and the invasion of Hungary. For your production put one ⟦4⟧ on trains, one on Artillery and the remaining ones on Infantry Equipment.
9ba1rq.zh: 最初的国策顺序是「绝不再有加里波利」>「废除威斯敏斯特体系」>「产业援助公司」>「标准轨距铁路」> [等待 11 天让自治度达到 550] >「支持中间党」>「额外民兵训练」。这为我们打内战做好了准备。在此期间，把你的政治点数用于聘请⟦0⟧、在「废除威斯敏斯特体系」完成后执行「禁止共产主义」决议，以及在「支持中间党」完成后聘请⟦1⟧。把⟦2⟧用于「正统传承」⟦3⟧。可自由编辑的骑兵师编制在内战和入侵匈牙利期间很有用。在生产方面，把一座⟦4⟧用于火车，一座用于火炮，其余用于步兵装备。

16g306j.en: As soon as ⟦0⟧ finishes, justify a War goal on ⟦1⟧. If the justification is going to take ~700 days, you should restart. You need pretty horrid luck for Atatürk to die this early (it should be between December 1937 and February 1938 right now), so it shouldn't happen again. After you join the ⟦2⟧, put your forces on the border with ⟦3⟧. Ideally, you should have ~15 divisions by now, with another ~6 or so on the way. Use your ⟦4⟧ to first grab the ⟦5⟧ for your Military Staff. Afterwards, focus on upgrading your conscription law and economy law when you can. Your next two focus goals should be first ⟦6⟧ in the army section of the focus tree and then ⟦7⟧ in the population section of the focus tree.
16g306j.zh: ⟦0⟧一完成，就对⟦1⟧正当化一个战争目标。如果正当化需要约 700 天，你就应该重开。阿塔图尔克这么早去世需要相当糟糕的运气（现在应该在 1937 年 12 月到 1938 年 2 月之间），所以不太可能再发生。加入⟦2⟧后，把你的部队部署到与⟦3⟧的边境。理想情况下，你现在应当拥有约 15 个师，另有约 6 个正在组建中。用你的⟦4⟧先为你的军事参谋部取得⟦5⟧。之后，在可能时专注于升级你的征兵法案和经济法案。接下来的两个国策目标应当是：先取国策树陆军部分的⟦6⟧，再取国策树人口部分的⟦7⟧。

qu2zpe.en: Next do ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Grab the Bradmill Denim Factory Industrial Concern and then do ⟦2⟧ followed by ⟦3⟧. Take the decision to "Seize Local Leadership in New South Wales" and do the focus ⟦4⟧. You should be able to do the focus for ⟦5⟧ immediately afterwards, though you might have to wait a couple days. When it finishes, pick up Ideological Loyalty for your Spirit of the Army. Use any remaining ⟦6⟧ to add in Support Artillery and Infantry Guns, along with one more Infantry battalion to even out the regiments. Use your Command power to promote John Northcott to a Field Marshal and assign him as your Field Marshal with Leslie Morshead as your General.
qu2zpe.zh: 接下来执行⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧。取得「布拉德米尔牛仔布工厂」工业集团，然后执行⟦2⟧，接着执行⟦3⟧。执行「夺取新南威尔士地方领导权」决议并完成国策⟦4⟧。之后你应当能够立即完成⟦5⟧的国策，不过可能需要等几天。完成后，为你的「陆军精神」选取「意识形态忠诚」。用剩余的⟦6⟧加入支援火炮和步兵炮，再加一个步兵营以凑齐各团。用你的指挥点数将约翰·诺斯科特晋升为元帅，并任命他为你的元帅，由莱斯利·莫斯黑德担任你的将军。

mzv8e5.en: During and after the civil war train 20 2-width cavalry divisions, get military access from ⟦0⟧ and Hungary and send them to Venezia. Once they are in Europe convert them to a 20-width cavalry template with Support Artillery and start exercising them until the are fully trained. During this hire the ⟦1⟧ and start justifying on ⟦2⟧ and/or the USA to increase World Tension. Keep canceling the justifications a couple of days before they finish, so you can keep doing them and avoid the penalties for expiring war goals. You won't be able to join the ⟦3⟧ until tension is at 100%. As soon as you are in the ⟦4⟧, start justifying on Hungary.
mzv8e5.zh: 在内战期间及之后训练 20 个 2 宽度骑兵师，从⟦0⟧和匈牙利取得军事通行权，并将它们派往威尼斯。它们抵达欧洲后，将其转换为带有支援火炮的 20 宽度骑兵师编制，并开始操练直到完全训练完毕。在此期间聘请⟦1⟧，并开始对⟦2⟧和/或美国进行正当化以提高世界紧张度。在正当化即将完成前几天不断取消，这样你就能反复进行并避免战争目标过期的惩罚。在世界紧张度达到 100% 之前，你无法加入⟦3⟧。一旦你加入⟦4⟧，就开始对匈牙利进行正当化。

1ol2atn.en: As an aside, none of the strategies on this page work with ⟦0⟧ enabled. With it enabled, all of the countries in the region will just join the ⟦1⟧ when you attack them and pull Germany into the conflict. You can still complete this achievement this way, but if you do, the game will be very long because ⟦2⟧ gets additional cores via their focus tree after they carve up ⟦3⟧. This means you'll have to invade ⟦4⟧ after the ⟦5⟧ has been defeated usually (because those cores are starting states of ⟦6⟧), which probably mean dealing with the ⟦7⟧. Basically, disable ⟦8⟧ or this achievement's difficulty goes from "Easy" to "Hard".
1ol2atn.zh: 顺便说一句，本页的所有策略在启用⟦0⟧时都无法奏效。启用它后，该地区所有国家在你进攻时都会直接加入⟦1⟧，并把德国拖入冲突。你仍然可以用这种方式完成该成就，但这样一来游戏会非常漫长，因为⟦2⟧在瓜分⟦3⟧之后会通过其国策树获得额外的核心领土。这意味着你通常必须入侵⟦4⟧，而且一般要等到⟦5⟧被击败之后（因为这些核心是⟦6⟧的开局州），这很可能意味着要对付⟦7⟧。总之，禁用⟦8⟧，否则这个成就的难度会从「简单」变成「困难」。

4zgzbu.en: If you do everything quickly, you can invade ⟦0⟧/ ⟦1⟧ first (this is preferable to invading ⟦2⟧, because the war ends up shorter - on account of the ⟦3⟧ having a border with ⟦4⟧ - and you get a shot at ⟦5⟧.) But this only works if you start justifying before Atatürk retires or dies (usually sometime in mid- to late 1938, sometimes as early as January), because his replacement in historical AI, İsmet İnönü, has a trait "Justify war goal time on us +200.0%" (it will take you 600 days to justify), and if you declare before ~Feb 1939 (on historical, ⟦6⟧ drops its guarantee around that time).
4zgzbu.zh: 如果你一切速通，你可以先入侵⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧（这比入侵⟦2⟧更可取，因为战争会更短——由于⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧接壤——而且你有机会取得⟦5⟧）。但这只有在你于阿塔图尔克退休或去世之前开始正当化时才可行（通常在 1938 年中后期，有时早至 1 月），因为他在史实 AI 下的继任者伊斯梅特·伊纳尼拥有特质「对我们的战争目标正当化时间 +200.0%」（你需要 600 天才能正当化），而且如果你在约 1939 年 2 月之前宣战（在史实模式下，⟦6⟧大约在那时放弃其保障）。

f8hy2w.en: If the USSR manages to take everything, you can still use the paratrooper trick from the above strategy. You'll have to prepare in advance, though. Paradrop requires 70% air superiority, and you'll somehow need to amass enough fighters to counter Hungarian air force. 200 fighters might be enough. With zero beginning air tech except for transports and only 2 research slots, the best option is probably to license a fighter design from the ⟦0⟧ shortly after you join the ⟦1⟧ and start producing them ASAP. You'll also want to build an ⟦2⟧ next to the Hungarian border.
f8hy2w.zh: 如果苏联把一切都拿下了，你仍然可以使用上文策略中的伞兵技巧。不过你必须提前准备。空降需要 70% 的制空权，而且你还得设法集结足够的战斗机来对抗匈牙利空军。200 架战斗机也许就够了。由于开局除运输机外没有任何空军科技，且只有 2 个科研槽，最好的选择可能是从⟦0⟧那里许可生产一种战斗机设计（在你加入⟦1⟧后不久），并尽快开始生产。你还需要在匈牙利边境旁建造一座⟦2⟧。

10r3f7b.en: Justify war on ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧, as they are both guaranteed only by ⟦2⟧. If you decide to invade Turkey, you can also get the ⟦3⟧ achievement if you occupy Edirne or take it in the peace deal. When you finish justifying, declare war and call in the USSR, but also send in your own troops in to gain war score. When ⟦4⟧ is called in, attack them with your divisions, and you should be able to defeat them together with the USSR easily. In the peace deal, try to take provinces bordering Hungary, so you will be able to invade without calling the Soviets.
10r3f7b.zh: 对⟦0⟧或⟦1⟧正当化战争，因为它们都只由⟦2⟧保障。如果你决定入侵土耳其，只要占领埃迪尔内或是在和谈中夺取它，你也能拿到⟦3⟧成就。正当化完成后，宣战并召唤苏联，但也要派自己的部队参战以获取战争分数。当⟦4⟧被召唤进来时，用你的师进攻他们，你应当能与苏联一起轻松击败他们。在和谈中，尽量夺取与匈牙利接壤的省份，这样你就能在不召唤苏联的情况下入侵。

4zfeo2.en: Send your forces to the Hungarian border but limit the frontline's size so that it is contained entirely in the states you control. Throw up an offensive line on the opposite side of Hungary, and when the justification finishes, declare war and send it. Make sure not to call in your allies this time. You should have ~24 divisions at this point, and you can just put your forces on Aggressive behavior even while they execute the battle plan. You'll win inside a month and get the achievement when you annex everything in the peace deal.
4zfeo2.zh: 把你的部队派往匈牙利边境，但限制前线的规模，使其完全位于你控制的州内。在匈牙利对侧规划一条进攻线，当正当化完成时宣战并发动它。这次务必不要召唤你的盟友。此时你应当拥有约 24 个师，你完全可以在部队执行作战计划时把他们的行为设为「激进」。你将在一个月内获胜，并在和谈中吞并一切时获得该成就。

maqo7c.en: Doing all of this lets you convert to ⟦0⟧ by the end of 1936 without triggering the civil war, and you get a free bypass on ⟦1⟧, which was blocking off your economic path focuses. Speaking of which, that should be your next order of business. Do the three required economic focuses and then ⟦2⟧. Afterwards, you should have enough ⟦3⟧ support to beeline straight down to ⟦4⟧. Start training additional Infantry divisions. Upgrade your economy law to when you can afford it.
maqo7c.zh: 完成这一切能让你在 1936 年底前转为⟦0⟧而不触发内战，并且你会免费跳过⟦1⟧，而它此前一直挡着你的经济路线国策。说到这个，那应当是你的下一项事务。完成三个必需的经济国策，然后执行⟦2⟧。之后，你应当拥有足够的⟦3⟧支持度，可以直奔⟦4⟧。开始训练更多步兵师。在负担得起时升级你的经济法案。

d3wami.en: This strategy gets early access to manpower by flipping to ⟦0⟧ via a civil war in order to get the Desperate Defense Subdoctrine. After that, we raise World Tension to 100% with repeated justifications on ⟦1⟧ and the USA to enable us to join the Axis. We then use a small exploit to attack Hungary from German territory without calling in Germany to ensure that we get all of the Hungarian territory in the peace deal.
d3wami.zh: 该策略通过发动内战转为⟦0⟧，从而提前获得人力，以取得「绝望防御」子学说。此后，我们通过对⟦1⟧和美国反复进行正当化，将世界紧张度提升到 100%，以便加入轴心国。接着我们利用一个小漏洞，从德国领土进攻匈牙利而不召唤德国，以确保在和谈中获得全部匈牙利领土。

xdykbl.en: Now is a good time prepare any additional cheese you might want to use to make the civil war easier (e.g. deleting your starting army, creating a template containing one line anti-air battalion, putting as many as possible into training and then adding another anti-air battalion to the template to ensure that your opponent in the civil can't deploy any divisions by binding all of their manpower).
xdykbl.zh: 现在是准备任何其他可以使内战更轻松的技巧的好时机（例如：删除你的开局军队，创建一个包含一个线列防空营的师编制，把尽可能多的人力投入训练，然后往编制中再加一个防空营，通过占满对手的全部人力来确保内战中的对手无法部署任何师）。

1v0kaz1.en: Strip your infantry template down to 6 or 7 infantry battalions, build 15 of them, and put them on the border of ⟦0⟧ as soon as you're in the ⟦1⟧ (you can't have larger divisions at this point because of your manpower issues, and it's much easier to update the template on the spot than to build and ship newly trained divisions from Sydney to Odessa).
1v0kaz1.zh: 把你的步兵师编制精简到 6 或 7 个步兵营，组建 15 个这样的师，并把它们部署到⟦0⟧的边境——你一加入⟦1⟧就立刻动手（由于人力问题，此时你无法拥有更大的师，而且在当地更新编制要比从悉尼建造并运送新训练的师到敖德萨容易得多）。

pbsmjc.en: Change your occupation law to Civilian Oversight. Convert all your starting forces to the Infantry division template and add a naval queue for Convoys. Do ⟦0⟧ followed by ⟦1⟧. Afterwards, hire the following three advisors in order: ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧. Build 2 ⟦5⟧ and 5 ⟦6⟧ in Queensland and pump out ⟦7⟧ for the rest of the game after that.
pbsmjc.zh: 把你的占领法令改为「文官监督」。将你所有开局部队转换为步兵师编制，并在海军生产队列中加入运输船队。执行⟦0⟧，接着执行⟦1⟧。之后，按顺序聘请以下三位顾问：⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧。在昆士兰建造 2 座⟦5⟧和 5 座⟦6⟧，此后在游戏余下时间里大量生产⟦7⟧。

1tu1x56.en: This method is significantly easier than the other methods, as Australia's starting position is substantially improved in ⟦0⟧. They get a third research slot from the beginning, their focuses are much more powerful, and increasing your conscription laws is much easier. This strategy also ensures you will get ⟦1⟧ along the way.
1tu1x56.zh: 这种方法比其他方法容易得多，因为澳大利亚的开局处境在⟦0⟧中得到了大幅改善。他们从一开始就拥有第三个科研槽，其国策强大得多，而且提升征兵法案也容易得多。该策略还能确保你在过程中取得⟦1⟧。

1t7dsej.en: Try to finish ⟦0⟧ before they take the Join the Axis focus (on historical AI, in mid-1940; you should be able to see their focuses thanks your spy network), or you'll have a protracted fight against Germany instead of a quick and easy achievement.
1t7dsej.zh: 尽量在他们选取「加入轴心国」国策之前完成⟦0⟧（在史实 AI 下是 1940 年中期；借助你的特工网络你应当能看到他们的国策），否则你将与德国陷入持久战，而不是轻松快速地拿到成就。

1fcyfir.en: After the By Blood Alone update, it is not possible to join the ⟦0⟧ easily due to the distance penalty. However, it's still possible to get the achievement by joining the ⟦1⟧ through a focus.
1fcyfir.zh: 在「唯有鲜血」更新之后，由于距离惩罚，轻松加入⟦0⟧已不可能。不过，仍然可以通过国策加入⟦1⟧来获得该成就。

1jdx7tq.en: ⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work. Additionally, Götterdämmerung is assumed to be enabled for this strategy, as it changes the Hungarian focus tree.
1jdx7tq.zh: 该策略要奏效必须禁用⟦0⟧。此外，该策略假定已启用「诸神黄昏」，因为它会改变匈牙利国策树。

16onxmk.en: From here it is also relatively easy to wait for ⟦0⟧ to join the ⟦1⟧ and then justify on ⟦2⟧ for an attempt at ⟦3⟧.
16onxmk.zh: 从这里出发，也相对容易做到：等待⟦0⟧加入⟦1⟧，然后对⟦2⟧进行正当化，以尝试取得⟦3⟧。

twm89d.en: ⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work. ⟦1⟧ must be enabled, since we're using its focus tree.
twm89d.zh: 该策略要奏效必须禁用⟦0⟧。必须启用⟦1⟧，因为我们要使用其国策树。

1fhc6ck.en: ⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work.
1fhc6ck.zh: 该策略要奏效必须禁用⟦0⟧。

hmabjx.en: All for One, One for All

ue3jpf.en: Along with Niceto Alcalá-Zamora as a leader, the Republicans will now, after the 1936 elections, receive a National Spirit reducing their political power income. Along with Zamora's trait and various tweaks and adjustments made to the political power gained through events and Republican focuses, this should make the flow of Garrison Control fighting before the SCW much more natural. Now, Nationalists get an initial advantage and a 'head start', but if the Republicans correctly focus on delaying the civil war initially, they will be rewarded and eventually be able to take more states back from the Nationalists than if they focus on taking states from the very start. Delaying the civil war should therefore be more enticing as a strategy.
ue3jpf.zh: 随着尼塞托·阿尔卡拉-萨莫拉作为领袖登场，共和派现在会在 1936 年选举之后获得一个降低其政治点数收入的国家精神。配合萨莫拉的特质，以及对通过事件和共和派国策获得的政治点数所做的各种调整，这应能让西班牙内战爆发前「驻军控制」阶段的争夺节奏自然得多。如今民族派在开局获得优势和一个「先手」，但如果共和派在初期正确地专注于拖延内战，他们将得到回报，并最终能从民族派手中夺回比一开始就急于夺取州更多的州。因此，拖延内战作为一项策略应当更具吸引力。

le33ji.en: It is now no longer possible to avoid the Carlist/Anarchist uprisings by ending the Spanish Civil War before their timers expire. The timers will now continue until expiring, and, if the opposing faction (Republicans or Nationalists) has been defeated already, a new civil war will begin with the Carlists or the Anarchists (Franco can avoid this by taking the Fuse the Parties focus, as normal). New news events and descriptions for existing events have been added for these situations. The Civil War will now only be considered 'ended' when all factions have been defeated, or Franco takes the Fuse the Parties focus.
le33ji.zh: 如今已无法再通过在其计时器到期前结束西班牙内战来规避卡洛斯派/无政府主义者的起义。计时器现在会继续走完直到到期；如果敌对阵营（共和派或民族派）已被击败，就会与卡洛斯派或无政府主义者爆发一场新的内战（佛朗哥照常可以通过点出「融合各党派」国策来避免这一点）。针对这些情况新增了新闻事件，并为现有事件补充了描述。现在只有当所有阵营都被击败，或佛朗哥点出「融合各党派」国策时，内战才会被视为「已结束」。

1bgaq7t.en: Fixed an issue where Spanish Civil War factions did not have their cores initialized correctly, resulting in erroneous minimum surrender limit calculation. This resulted in Republican Spain having a surrender limit or 40%, rather than the intended limit of 15%. Together with the adjustment to the minimum surrender limit in the Death Before Surrender spirit for the Republicans, this should mean Republican Spain is much more difficult to capitulate now.
1bgaq7t.zh: 修复了西班牙内战各阵营的核心未能正确初始化、导致最低投降阈值计算错误的问题。这曾使共和派西班牙的投降阈值为 40%，而非预期的 15%。结合对共和派「宁死不降」国家精神中最低投降阈值的调整，这意味着如今要让共和派西班牙投降要困难得多。

14kihgx.en: If Republican Spain declares independence after having Expanded Soviet Aid, the Soviet Union can now choose to grant it, instead of being forced to fight them over it. If the Soviet Union elected to annex Spanish land in preparation for the Independence War, via the event, this land will be returned and spawned divisions are once again removed. The AI is unlikely to choose this course of action unless they are in a large war.
14kihgx.zh: 如果共和派西班牙在拥有「扩大苏联援助」之后宣布独立，苏联现在可以选择予以承认，而不必被迫为此与其开战。如果苏联此前通过事件选择吞并西班牙土地以备战独立战争，这些土地将被归还，且其生成的师会再次被移除。除非身陷大规模战争，AI 不太可能选择这条路线。

13s2o1n.en: added dirty = var_name for scripted windows. if this variable name is set, the game will check if the value of that variable is changed before updating scripted windows to see if it needs to update the gui. by default guis are updated every hour/with every command. now if a change has been made that would affect the scripted gui, you can just change/increase a variable to force an update and improve performance
13s2o1n.zh: 为脚本窗口新增了 dirty = var_name。如果设置了这个变量名，游戏在更新脚本窗口之前会检查该变量的值是否发生变化，以判断是否需要更新 gui。默认情况下 gui 每小时/每条命令都会更新。现在，如果发生了会影响脚本 gui 的变动，你只需修改/增加一个变量来强制更新，从而提升性能。

kbfqa5.en: Increased the cost of Concessions to the Anarchists decision to 150 PP to bring it more in line with its intended purpose as an 'emergency' delay rather than a permanent one, and also made it require either of the Nationalist factions to exist. This means that once those are defeated, there is no stopping the Anarchist uprising anymore.
kbfqa5.zh: 将「向无政府主义者让步」决议的花费提高到 150 政治点数，使其更符合其作为「应急」拖延手段而非永久解决方案的本来用途，同时还要求必须存在任一个民族派阵营。这意味着一旦这些阵营被击败，就再也无法阻止无政府主义者的起义了。

rbvj0p.en: Spain will not get resistance from the states until the SCW is completely over, meaning that the second uprising has been triggered/avoided. This is also applied if a Spanish faction defeats the other Spanish tags before her second uprising happens, since the SCW will not end until the second uprising has been dealt with.
rbvj0p.zh: 在西班牙内战彻底结束（即第二次起义已被触发/规避）之前，西班牙不会从各州获得抵抗度。如果某个西班牙阵营在其第二次起义发生之前就击败了其他西班牙标签，这一规则同样适用，因为只有当第二次起义被处理完毕，内战才会结束。

12q18nt.en: Updated Portuguese Anarchism and Regional Defense Council of Iberia bypass and available triggers. Portuguese Anarchism should now bypass if you own their European states, ensuring you cannot get stuck on this focus as long as you do. Regional Defense Council of Iberia requires ownership of these same states.
12q18nt.zh: 更新了「葡萄牙无政府主义」与「伊比利亚地区防卫委员会」的跳过条件与可用触发器。「葡萄牙无政府主义」现在应会在你拥有其欧洲各州时跳过，从而确保只要你拥有这些州就不会卡在该国策上。「伊比利亚地区防卫委员会」则要求拥有这些相同的州。

nubwt7.en: Fixed issue with Portuguese cosmetic tag colors: United Kingdom of Portugal and Brazil loosing its blue color when loading save game. The Fifth Empire will now be green for all ideologies (previously the color was only applied to non-aligned and democratic, and it was almost the same blue as for monarchists)
nubwt7.zh: 修复了葡萄牙外观标签配色的问题：葡萄牙-巴西联合王国在读取存档时会丢失其蓝色。第五帝国现在对所有意识形态都会显示为绿色（此前该颜色只应用于中立主义与民主主义，而且几乎与君主派的蓝色相同）。

1yn32r9.en: Death Before Surrender now is a timed spirit that lasts for 900 days. This means that, if the Civil War starts the earliest it can start, the spirit will be removed at the beginning of 1939, thus simulating a collapse of morale and speeding up the conclusion of the Civil War if it is still in progress.
1yn32r9.zh: 「宁死不降」现在是一个持续 900 天的限时国家精神。这意味着如果内战以其最早可能的时点爆发，该精神将在 1939 年初被移除，从而模拟士气崩溃，并在内战仍未结束时加速其收场。

1dys5ov.en: Improved cleanup of unneeded leaders in script, and added a failsafe in the Temporal Continuum Matrix, both of which are aimed to prevent Franco or Mola from entering into our world from an alternate dimension and wage a war against themselves. Also prevented Primo de Rivera from rising from the dead.
1dys5ov.zh: 改进了脚本中对多余领袖的清理，并在时间连续体矩阵中加入了一道保险，两者都旨在防止佛朗哥或莫拉从平行维度闯入我们的世界并对他们自己开战。同时也防止了普里莫·德里维拉死而复生。

9wwf4h.en: 1939 Spain start will now correctly have cores on historically Nationalist territory, and resistance will be correctly initialized on Republican states, allowing for re-coring via the decision system, as intended. Also removed cores of a superfluous Nationalist Spain tag.
9wwf4h.zh: 1939 年开局的西班牙现在会正确地拥有历史上民族派领土的核心，且共和派各州的抵抗度会被正确初始化，从而可以按设计通过决议系统重新建立核心。此外还移除了一个多余民族派西班牙标签的核心。

1bzycjk.en: Added a cooldown timer after naval transfers are engaged at sea and escape to avoid stun-locking issues with many small fleets. The cooldown depends on the screening efficiency of the defenders so a defended convoy will have a longer cooldown the better defended it is
1bzycjk.zh: 为海上遭遇交战并逃脱后的海军运输增加了冷却计时器，以避免大量小型舰队造成的「锁死」问题。冷却时间取决于防守方的屏卫效率，因此受护航的运输船队防守得越好，冷却时间就越长。

1h6hku0.en: Chinese decision to move the capital to Beijing/Nanjing will no longer be available for subjects. This change fixes the issue with Portuguese China moving their capital and making the achievement "Go ahead, Macau my Day" impossible to complete.
1h6hku0.zh: 中国迁都北京/南京的决议将不再对附庸国开放。这一改动修复了葡属中国迁都、致使成就 "Go ahead, Macau my Day" 无法完成的问题。

1v5f735.en: added support for random female army leaders & admirals (controlled by define NCountry::FEMALE_UNIT_LEADER_BASE_CHANCE & modifiers female_random_operative_chance female_random_army_leader_chance female_random_admiral_chance)
1v5f735.zh: 新增了对随机女性陆军领袖与海军上将的支持（由 define NCountry::FEMALE_UNIT_LEADER_BASE_CHANCE 以及修正 female_random_operative_chance、female_random_army_leader_chance、female_random_admiral_chance 控制）。

1d6swdj.en: Fixed an issue where, when the SCW starts, the other side did not have any cores on any of the Spanish states.Now both sides (Nationalists and Republicans) should have cores on all Spanish states upon the start of the SCW.
1d6swdj.zh: 修复了西班牙内战爆发时另一方在任何一个西班牙州上都没有核心的问题。现在内战爆发时，双方（民族派与共和派）都应拥有全部西班牙州的核心。

dobmwd.en: Added an additional 5% neutrality support to both Safeguard the Freedom of Worship and Integrate the Requetés, making it easier for Francoist Spain to remain below 40% fascism support, in case they want to join the Allies.
dobmwd.zh: 为「保障信仰自由」和「整合雷克特派」都额外增加了 5% 中立主义支持度，使佛朗哥派西班牙更容易将法西斯主义支持度保持在 40% 以下，以备其想要加入同盟国。

1tfweri.en: Added error logging for defines that have invalid values. They are still fixed up to be valid, but now the automatic change is reported, alerting designers and modders to adjustments that will not have the expected effect.
1tfweri.zh: 为取值无效的 define 增加了错误日志。它们仍会被修正为有效值，但现在会报告这一自动更改，以提醒设计师与模组作者注意那些不会产生预期效果的调整。

1xcsnrc.en: Patrol convoy raiding and convoy escort missions now rely on local navy position for air superiority rather than average of air zones to stop high air superiority in a zone from saving the ships from spotting in another.
1xcsnrc.zh: 巡逻、破交与护航任务现在依据当地海军位置来判定制空权，而不再取各空域的均值，以免某一空域的高制空权让舰船在另一空域免于被发现。

1os7imu.en: Taking any focus that removes or reduces 'autonomy' in Galicia, Pais Vasco, or Catalunya, while not controlling some of these states, will now remove or reduce 'autonomy' of these states when you take control of them.
1os7imu.zh: 在未控制加利西亚、巴斯克或加泰罗尼亚的部分州时，点出任何移除或降低这些地区「自治度」的国策，现在会在你取得这些州的控制权时移除或降低它们的「自治度」。

1tgb8hs.en: AI Spanish Factions will now surrender if they do not control any state in the Iberian Peninsula, but own other territories outside of it (preventing the player from needing to execute naval invasions to win the SCW)
1tgb8hs.zh: AI 西班牙阵营现在如果不再控制伊比利亚半岛上的任何州、却拥有半岛之外的其他领土，就会投降（从而让玩家不必为了赢下西班牙内战而实施海军登陆）。

15pz1le.en: All Must Bear the Torch now also requires Collectivization and Workers' Control to be completed, thereby preventing situations in which the former's 5% recruitable population bonus was erroneously not being applied.
15pz1le.zh: 「人人皆须高举火炬」现在还要求完成「集体化」与「工人控制」，从而避免前者 5% 可征召人口加成被错误地不生效的情况。

3u3k65.en: Rearranged the order of dynamic tag colors, making it less likely that Nationalist Spain or Vichy France will end up neighboring dynamically-generated tags (civil war factions) that have the same color as them.
3u3k65.zh: 重新排列了动态标签颜色的顺序，降低了民族派西班牙或维希法国与颜色相同的动态生成标签（内战阵营）相邻的可能性。

31jhqh.en: Made the distribution of states for the Carlist and Anarchist uprisings more reasonable, especially when finishing the SCW early and therefore owning a lot of states before rising up as the Anarchists.
31jhqh.zh: 使卡洛斯派与无政府主义者起义的州分配更为合理，尤其是在提前结束西班牙内战、因而在以无政府主义者身份起义之前就拥有大量州的情况下。

1igbh20.en: The UK will now prioritize giving Gibraltar, if possible, to SPD, then SPA, then SPB and, only if no other Spanish tag exists, to SPC when they complete "Withdraw from Contested Territories" focus.
1igbh20.zh: 英国在完成「撤出争议领土」国策时，现在会优先把直布罗陀交给 SPD，其次是 SPA，再次是 SPB，只有在不存在其他西班牙标签时才会交给 SPC。

haypys.en: If Portugal joins the SCW, but their allied Spanish faction is defeated, this faction will now be recreated when Portugal wins, rather than result in a peace conference upon conclusion of the SCW.
haypys.zh: 如果葡萄牙加入西班牙内战，但其结盟的西班牙阵营被击败，那么当葡萄牙获胜时该阵营现在会被重新创建，而不会在内战结束时引发和平会议。

1y66p9h.en: Join the Comintern, Join the Allies, Honor Anglo-Portuguese Alliance, Join the Axis and The Royal Iberian Alliance focuses now require Portugal to not be in a faction and will get canceled if so.
1y66p9h.zh: 「加入共产国际」「加入同盟国」「尊重英葡同盟」「加入轴心国」和「伊比利亚王室同盟」国策现在要求葡萄牙不在任何阵营之中，若在阵营中则会被取消。

1jr5z08.en: Fixed bug where staging a coup in Brazil lead to a second Civil War when Portugal completed The Empire of Brazil focus, even if stability and non-aligned support requirements in Brazil were met.
1jr5z08.zh: 修复了在巴西策划政变后，当葡萄牙完成「巴西帝国」国策时会引发第二次内战的 bug，即便巴西的稳定度与中立主义支持度要求已满足。

1f8zq7l.en: José Antonio Primo de Rivera and Francisco Franco advisors now have icons that are direct copies of their country leader portraits. In Franco's case this has resulted in miraculous rejuvenation!
1f8zq7l.zh: 何塞·安东尼奥·普里莫·德里维拉与弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥顾问现在拥有的图标直接照搬了他们的国家领袖肖像。就佛朗哥而言，这带来了奇迹般的返老还童！

n77ga0.en: Reduce heavy gun target signature from 90 to 80 and increased light gun target signature from 40 to 45 to make heavy guns a bit more versatile and light guns a bit slower at picking off screens
n77ga0.zh: 将重型火炮的目标特征从 90 降至 80，并将轻型火炮的目标特征从 40 提升至 45，使重型火炮用途更广一些，而轻型火炮清理屏卫舰船的速度稍慢一些。

1ylx4y6.en: Fixed bug with Purchase Ships decision, checking for the wrong DD technologies if MTG was active (which could lead to Portugal getting Basic Destroyers regardless of ITA/ENG DD hull research).
1ylx4y6.zh: 修复了「购买舰船」决议的 bug：当启用 MTG 时会检查错误的驱逐舰科技（这可能导致葡萄牙不论 ITA/ENG 的驱逐舰舰体科研如何都获得基础驱逐舰）。

jaq3wa.en: Several new Spanish advisors are now at the service of the different Spanish factions. POUM will also receive a field marshal and two generals upon completion of Masters of Our Own Fate focus.
jaq3wa.zh: 若干新的西班牙顾问现在为不同的西班牙阵营效力。POUM 在完成「主宰我们自己的命运」国策后还将获得一名元帅和两名将领。

d8el1p.en: added country_resource_steel & country_resource_cost_steel (and others) which can be used in country scope to add/remove resources to country (added ones are affected by production modifiers)
d8el1p.zh: 新增了 country_resource_steel 与 country_resource_cost_steel（以及其他同类），可在国家作用域中使用，以为国家增加/移除资源（增加的部分会受生产修正影响）。

eyo8ik.en: added support for highlight_state_targets for decisions which is a script target that can be used for highlighting states. should give improved performance if used instead of highlight_states
eyo8ik.zh: 为决议新增了对 highlight_state_targets 的支持，这是一个可用于高亮州的脚本目标。若用它替代 highlight_states，应能提升性能。

1amyqj4.en: Fixed issue with Spanish cores at the end of the SCW. Now the SCW winner will get resistance in the initial states of the "major" (SPD/SPA) Spanish enemy, until they get cored via decisions.
1amyqj4.zh: 修复了西班牙内战结束时西班牙核心的问题。现在内战获胜方会在「主要」（SPD/SPA）西班牙敌方的初始各州中获得抵抗度，直到这些州通过决议被建立核心为止。

d8hm2m.en: Removed tooltip in News Events showing up after defeating the other faction/s in the SCW before the second uprising. Added tooltip in News Events showing up after actually wining the SCW.
d8hm2m.zh: 移除了在第二次起义之前击败内战中其他阵营后出现的新闻事件中的提示框。新增了在真正赢下西班牙内战之后出现的新闻事件提示框。

11fq6bh.en: Fixed upper bound of define for min legitimacy of government in exile to allow equipment transfer, which has the practical effect of increasing this min required legitimacy from 1 to 5.
11fq6bh.zh: 修复了流亡政府可进行装备转让所需最低合法性的 define 上限，其实际效果是将这一所需最低合法性从 1 提高到 5。

qzas5w.en: Fixed misspelling in a variable used for calculating size of Civil Wars in Portugal. Civil Wars in Portugal will be potentially harder but WAD now that the appropriate variable is used.
qzas5w.zh: 修复了用于计算葡萄牙内战规模的变量中的拼写错误。如今使用了正确的变量，葡萄牙的内战可能会更难，但这符合设计。

1tt3ps2.en: Increased the strength of the focuses contained within the Expand Soviet Aid branch, to make these more useful and worth the repercussions. Also made them impact Communism support more.
1tt3ps2.zh: 增强了「扩大苏联援助」分支中所含各国策的效果，使其更有用、更值得承受随之而来的后果。同时也让它们对共产主义支持度的影响更大。

1oublh8.en: Vichy France reuniting with Free France after Germany refuses to hand over the occupied territories will no longer result in a game over for a player Vichy France (Singleplayer only)
1oublh8.zh: 在德国拒绝移交被占领土之后，维希法国与自由法国重新统一，将不再导致玩家操控的维希法国游戏结束（仅单人游戏）。

14ku6kv.en: Fixed the Fascist Referendum decision incorrectly being available for the Carlists. Also made requirements more stringent for the Referendum decisions for all other Spanish factions.
14ku6kv.zh: 修复了「法西斯主义公投」决议错误地对卡洛斯派可用的问题。同时提高了其他所有西班牙阵营公投决议的要求。

11qvms9.en: The Republican tree for Spain (POUM, Stalinists, and Democrats) has received various balancing tweaks and additional industry focuses, to make post-Civil War gameplay more enjoyable.
11qvms9.zh: 西班牙的共和派国策树（POUM、斯大林派与民主派）获得了多项平衡性调整和额外的工业国策，使内战后的游戏体验更为愉快。

5elh3l.en: Fixed operative on Boost Ideology and Propaganda being re-assigned to Counter Intelligence on save load when no operative is assigned to Build Intel Network in their intel network
5elh3l.zh: 修复了在读取存档时，负责「提升意识形态」与「宣传」的特工会在其情报网中没有特工被指派到「建立情报网络」的情况下被重新指派到「反特工」的问题。

1hqkqpi.en: Anarchist divisions now spawn with only 25% equipment (unless the player/AI went down the Anarchists branch). This should make Anarchist Spain's starting position much weaker.
1hqkqpi.zh: 无政府主义者的师现在生成时仅有 25% 的装备（除非玩家/AI 走了无政府主义者分支）。这应会让无政府主义西班牙的开局处境弱得多。

1kvkge.en: added state modifiers for building & repair speed for specific building types (example state_production_speed_infrastructure_factor state_repair_speed_infrastructure_factor)
1kvkge.zh: 为特定建筑类型新增了建造与修复速度的州修正（例如 state_production_speed_infrastructure_factor、state_repair_speed_infrastructure_factor）。

1dqnz1i.en: Fixed bounds of define for daily legitimacy change of liberated government in exile, which has the practical effect of changing the rate from -1 to -1.5 legitimacy per day.
1dqnz1i.zh: 修复了被解放的流亡政府每日合法性变化的 define 边界，其实际效果是将该速率从每天 -1 合法性改为 -1.5。

1a8t66q.en: added state_resource_cost_steel (and others) modifier that will add a resource cost for state (they can reduce state resources below zero and unaffected by transfer ratio)
1a8t66q.zh: 新增了 state_resource_cost_steel（以及其他同类）修正，会为州增加一项资源消耗（它们可以把州资源降到零以下，且不受转移比率影响）。

u5zolg.en: The EU should now correctly gain cores on Belgium and the Netherlands, Byzanthium and Imperium Romanum now also both gain cores on new states that were previously missing
u5zolg.zh: 欧盟现在应能正确地获得比利时与荷兰的核心，拜占庭与罗马帝国现在也都能获得此前缺失的新州的核心。

qs2jxn.en: France should no longer abandon all bonds of fellowship by leaving their faction if they decide to support the Czechs together with Britain, because IT IS NOT THIS DAY
qs2jxn.zh: 如果法国决定与英国一同支持捷克人，它不应再背弃一切情谊而退出其阵营，因为「绝非今日」。

871u9p.en: Fixed OOS caused by differing name of the airbase airwings participating in naval combat are coming from when a client has a different language setting than the host
871u9p.zh: 修复了当客户端与主机的语言设置不同时，因参与海战的航空队所属空军基地名称不同而导致的失同步（OOS）。

ud3ms8.en: The Stalinist Doctrine and Anti-Fascist Unity are now only 35 days, making it possible for the Stalinists to reach Anti-Fascist Unity before the Anarchists rise up.
ud3ms8.zh: 「斯大林主义学说」与「反法西斯团结」现在只需 35 天，使斯大林派有可能在无政府主义者起义之前点出「反法西斯团结」。

2tjabt.en: Reduced the hourly tick cost of checking for out-of-syncs by calculating checksum only for existing countries, and only for technologies actively being researched.
2tjabt.zh: 通过仅对现存国家、且仅对正在积极研发的科技计算校验和，降低了每小时检查失同步的开销。

18ak03b.en: If Britain or France decide to abandon Czechoslovakia or Yugoslavia in their respective event chains, any guarantees they have made to those countries are revoked
18ak03b.zh: 如果英国或法国在各自的事件链中决定抛弃捷克斯洛伐克或南斯拉夫，它们对这些国家作出的任何保障独立都会被撤销。

1u8819c.en: Communists in the Government now also completes Increase Arms Production, allowing them to move down the Stalinist branch even if they started out as Republicans.
1u8819c.zh: 「政府中的共产党人」现在也会完成「增加武器生产」，使他们即便最初是共和派也能沿斯大林派分支推进。

cfvich.en: scripted effects with names that start with "d_" (example d_test_effect) now will be available as a console command) example usages are in zzz_debug_effects.txt
cfvich.zh: 名称以 "d_" 开头的脚本效果（例如 d_test_effect）现在可作为控制台指令使用，用法示例见 zzz_debug_effects.txt。

1deuuw.en: unless producer tag is specified, add_equipment_to_stockpile will now remove equipment from all tags until it removes all required amount if amount is negative
1deuuw.zh: 除非指定了生产方标签，否则当数量为负数时，add_equipment_to_stockpile 现在会从所有标签处移除装备，直到移除完所需总量为止。

klwqcd.en: Fixed an earlier fix for Expand Soviet Aid. It should now only bypass when having taken The Stalinist Doctrine and the civil war has ended, instead of always.
klwqcd.zh: 修复了此前对「扩大苏联援助」的一次修复。现在它应只在已点出「斯大林主义学说」且内战已结束时跳过，而不再是总是跳过。

1ktgg57.en: dismantling the Maginot Line now removes the "Protected by the Maginot Line" national spirit. The Extending the Maginot Line Focus now requires this spirit.
1ktgg57.zh: 拆除马奇诺防线现在会移除「受马奇诺防线保护」国家精神。「延长马奇诺防线」国策现在要求拥有该精神。

hwer0v.en: the bonuses for collaboration governments are no longer reversed so the special outcome ends up worse, also adjusted levels according to actual old default
hwer0v.zh: 合作政府的加成不再被颠倒，以致特殊结果反而更差；同时按实际的旧默认值调整了等级。

n14csk.en: Fixed Portuguese Anarchism focus to give Anarchist Spain a war goal against all Portuguese tags if Portugal is in a Civil War when the focus is completed.
n14csk.zh: 修复了「葡萄牙无政府主义」国策，使其在该国策完成时若葡萄牙正处于内战中，会给予无政府主义西班牙对所有葡萄牙标签的战争目标。

1awxgiz.en: Reworked AI weights on Limited Self-Rule and Lusotropicalism. Portugal AI will not choose Limited Self-Rule while ruling party is non-aligned or fascist.
1awxgiz.zh: 重做了「有限自治」与「卢索热带主义」的 AI 权重。当执政党为中立主义或法西斯主义时，葡萄牙 AI 不会选择「有限自治」。

1ynbfv.en: AI japan will no longer make Marianas a collaboration regime, similarly with Czechoslovakia which is a bit too complex to represent well with the AI here
1ynbfv.zh: AI 日本不会再让马里亚纳成为合作政权，捷克斯洛伐克同理，因为它对这里的 AI 来说过于复杂，难以良好呈现。

54b5b7.en: Fixed OOS caused by a client that has been kicked from or lost connection to their last game when the client has different DLC settings than the new host
54b5b7.zh: 修复了当客户端与新主机的 DLC 设置不同时，因该客户端在此前游戏中被踢出或断线而导致的失同步（OOS）。

1al5e3i.en: Hinder NKVD Interference focus will be canceled if The Stalinist Doctrine is completed, fixing an edge case where player could unlock both sub-branches.
1al5e3i.zh: 若「斯大林主义学说」已完成，「阻碍内务人民委员部干预」国策将被取消，修复了玩家可以同时解锁两个子分支的边界情况。

12dsyw5.en: Fixed edge case where Spain could unlock two mutually exclusive faction branches (aka Anarchist and Communist) while the SCW starting event was active.
12dsyw5.zh: 修复了在西班牙内战爆发事件处于激活状态时，西班牙可以解锁两个互斥阵营分支（即无政府主义者与共产主义者）的边界情况。

zbnfk0.en: Reduced surrender limit offset (mninimum surrender limit) for Republican and Anarchist Spain in the Death Before Surrender spirit to 5%, down from 15%.
zbnfk0.zh: 将「宁死不降」国家精神中共和派与无政府主义西班牙的投降阈值偏移（最低投降阈值）从 15% 降至 5%。

1e9g2h9.en: operations will now higher cost as you execute same operation on same targets (default is 15%. rescue operation is still 0%. Some exceptions are 25%)
1e9g2h9.zh: 现在对相同目标反复执行同一行动会提高花费（默认 15%。营救行动仍为 0%。某些例外为 25%）。

1e6rwha.en: Improved logging of event errors to specify file, line number, and id, and logged when the event window times out but no option is allowed by script.
1e6rwha.zh: 改进了事件错误日志，可指明文件、行号与 id，并会在事件窗口超时但脚本未允许任何选项时记录日志。

19edfoj.en: fixed a rare case where Italy would not correctly join the Allies if France was already part of the Allies and Italy agreed to join the Stresa Front
19edfoj.zh: 修复了一种罕见情况：当法国已是同盟国成员、且意大利同意加入斯特雷萨阵线时，意大利未能正确加入同盟国。

1f6lw9c.en: Fixed an issue in the Romanian focus tree where the 'All Parties Must End' focus incorrectly added a democratic drift instead of non-aligned drift.
1f6lw9c.zh: 修复了罗马尼亚国策树中「一切党派必须终结」国策错误地增加民主主义倾向而非中立主义倾向的问题。

1t056em.en: Spanish POUM will no longer share the same game rules as Anarchist Spain. They will be able to join factions, boost ideology and puppet nations.
1t056em.zh: 西班牙 POUM 将不再与无政府主义西班牙共用相同的游戏规则。它们将能够加入阵营、提升意识形态并傀儡他国。

14q49go.en: Fixed lack of initial pause when starting a new game after exiting to menu from in game when the application was started with -start_speed=N.
14q49go.zh: 修复了在以 -start_speed=N 启动程序时，从游戏内退回菜单后开始新游戏缺少初始暂停的问题。

2sxcnn.en: Added Niceto Niceto Alcalá-Zamora as the initial leader of Spain in 1936, along with an event to replace him with Manuel Azaña in April 1936.
2sxcnn.zh: 新增尼塞托·尼塞托·阿尔卡拉-萨莫拉作为 1936 年西班牙的初始领袖，并加入一个在 1936 年 4 月以曼努埃尔·阿萨尼亚取代他的事件。

13y13h5.en: 20% Reduction to Strengthen the Regime focus requirements (80k MP instead of 100k, 800 infantry eq. and 800 support eq. instead of 1k each)
13y13h5.zh: 「巩固政权」国策的要求降低 20%（人力从 10 万降至 8 万，步兵装备与支援装备从各 1 千降至各 800）。

15iz947.en: The Chinese "Communist threat defeated" event is now suppressed after firing once until a new Communist infiltration is detected (WtT only)
15iz947.zh: 中国的「共产主义威胁被击败」事件现在在触发一次后会被抑制，直到检测到新的共产主义渗透为止（仅 WtT）。

1aheakj.en: Tech stealing can no longer unlock mutually exclusive techs and will let you unlock techs with less than 50% progress on them directly also
1aheakj.zh: 窃取科技不再能解锁互斥科技，并且也会让你直接解锁进度不足 50% 的科技。

o0ppf3.en: France now has engineer companies attached to leg and motorized infantry divisions as well as light mechanized divisions in the 1936 start
o0ppf3.zh: 在 1936 年开局中，法国的徒步与摩托化步兵师以及轻型机械化师现在都配有工兵连。

1ncc1cr.en: destroying the counter-revolution now prevents France from descending into another civil war against the fascists from low stability again
1ncc1cr.zh: 摧毁反革命现在能防止法国再次因低稳定度而陷入对抗法西斯主义者的又一场内战。

h9tnyb.en: Fixed handling of -start_speed=N startup option so that the game will immediately begin running even when combined with -start_save=SAVE.
h9tnyb.zh: 修复了 -start_speed=N 启动选项的处理，使游戏即便与 -start_save=SAVE 组合使用也会立即开始运行。

1lxaaiu.en: if France backs down during the Sudeten Crisis, French guarantees on Yugoslavia will also be removed (no one believes you anymore France)
1lxaaiu.zh: 如果法国在苏台德危机中退让，法国对南斯拉夫的保障独立也会被移除（法国，再也没人相信你了）。

mcu4cq.en: Anarchist Spain is no longer allowed to call into being nation-states from liberated communal territory, much less puppet these as well.
mcu4cq.zh: 无政府主义西班牙不再被允许从解放的公社领土中催生民族国家，更不用说将其一并傀儡化。

m5mbdk.en: Allow Portugal to remove the Unstable Republic national spirit when taking focuses 'Join the Axis' and 'Honor Anglo-Portuguese Alliance'
m5mbdk.zh: 允许葡萄牙在点出「加入轴心国」与「尊重英葡同盟」国策时移除「不稳定的共和国」国家精神。

10jc5xn.en: Portugal AI will be more inclined to build the required dockyards for Naval Research Institute focus after completing Fuzileiros focus.
10jc5xn.zh: 葡萄牙 AI 在完成 Fuzileiros 国策后，会更倾向于为「海军研究所」国策建造所需的船坞。

o1wz2.en: Fixed scope so that Navarra, if owned by the Carlists, will become their capital during Fascist Crackdown and Carlist Uprising events.
o1wz2.zh: 修复了作用域问题，使纳瓦拉在被卡洛斯派拥有时，会在「法西斯镇压」与「卡洛斯派起义」事件中成为其首都。

12cl3vq.en: Our Chief Weapon is Surprise will no longer check how many operatives you have and will correctly only check if you have done 5 coups.
12cl3vq.zh: 「Our Chief Weapon is Surprise」将不再检查你拥有多少特工，而会正确地只检查你是否完成过 5 次政变。

1vbl4gz.en: New Zealand will now gain access to a decision to request control of Pacific Islands upon completion of the "Maori Volunteers" focus.
1vbl4gz.zh: 新西兰现在在完成「毛利志愿兵」国策后可获得一项请求控制太平洋岛屿的决议。

knqj29.en: Why Die for Danzig achievement should now require players to turn France fascist and occupy Danzig without going to war with France.
knqj29.zh: 「Why Die for Danzig」成就现在应要求玩家让法国转为法西斯主义，并在不与法国开战的情况下占领但泽。

1nzy9lb.en: Fixed OOS when joining a MP that has not LaR with a client that has LaR enable while comming back from a game with active operatives
1nzy9lb.zh: 修复了从有活跃特工的游戏返回后，以启用了 LaR 的客户端加入未启用 LaR 的多人游戏时出现的失同步（OOS）。

m9k480.en: Tech stealing can now unlock techs, uses weights on tech picking to prefer more up to date and equipment for a more rewarding bonus
m9k480.zh: 窃取科技现在可以解锁科技，并在挑选科技时使用权重，以偏向更新的科技与装备，从而给出更丰厚的奖励。

xr0iib.en: Republican Spain will now never join the allies in search of aid in their independence war, and thereby cause an Allied-Soviet war.
xr0iib.zh: 共和派西班牙现在绝不会为在独立战争中寻求援助而加入同盟国，从而引发同盟国与苏联之间的战争。

cx8316.en: researching modern spaa now correctly shows modern spaa subunit as unlock (it always unlocked it, but showed wrong subunit instead)
cx8316.zh: 研发现代自行防空炮现在会正确显示现代自行防空炮子单位为解锁项（它一直都会解锁该单位，只是显示成了错误的子单位）。

1ry7cfr.en: technology tokens can now be accessed as variables. added num_researched_technologies trigger. added researched_techs country array
1ry7cfr.zh: 科技标记现在可以当作变量访问。新增了 num_researched_technologies 触发器。新增了 researched_techs 国家数组。

z0i0g.en: Specified Cyrillic script fallback fonts for an old fonts used in a limited number of places, most notably the Autosaving message.
z0i0g.zh: 为少数地方使用的旧字体指定了西里尔字母后备字体，其中最突出的是「自动保存中」提示。

1svb4zp.en: release release_puppet release_autonomy effects no longer changes the controller if the state is controlled by a non-ally country.
1svb4zp.zh: release、release_puppet、release_autonomy 效果在该州由非盟国控制时，不再改变其控制者。

kur8ip.en: Toggle between build network and quiet network on right click. Improve tooltip, and fix map mode for CounterIntelligence mission.
kur8ip.zh: 右键可在建立网络与静默网络之间切换。改进了提示框，并修复了反特工任务的地图模式。

1afzu8.en: Brazilian Fascist party will become an Anti-Monarchist Coalition when Portugal completes the focus Monarchist Uprising in Brazil.
1afzu8.zh: 当葡萄牙完成「巴西君主主义起义」国策时，巴西法西斯主义政党将变为反君主主义联盟。

1ag00fk.en: fixed an issue where the British Raj could end up with no recruitable manpower if they went down the swaraj focus path (TfV only)
1ag00fk.zh: 修复了英属印度在走「斯瓦拉吉」国策路线时可能最终没有可征召人力的问题（仅 TfV）。

5x26y9.en: Fixes to historical AI strategy plan, preventing Portugal to take any undesired focuses that will make it abort historical plan.
5x26y9.zh: 修复了历史 AI 战略计划，防止葡萄牙点出会导致其中止历史计划的任何非预期国策。

ya99mn.en: fixed a number of edge cases in the Munich conference logic (and probably introduced a number of new edge cases, happy hunting!)
ya99mn.zh: 修复了慕尼黑会议逻辑中的若干边界情况（很可能也引入了一些新的边界情况，祝狩猎愉快！）。

1ep28i4.en: Improved French intervention in SCW so that now France, if fighting in the SCW, will be at war with any new Spanish tag spawned.
1ep28i4.zh: 改进了法国对西班牙内战的干预，现在若法国参战于西班牙内战，它将与任何新生成的西班牙标签处于战争状态。

q3cy3c.en: Against Fascism was impossible due to the combination of requirements. It no longer requires Expand Soviet Aid to be completed.
q3cy3c.zh: 由于各项要求的组合，「反对法西斯主义」原本无法完成。它不再要求完成「扩大苏联援助」。

u3ctxb.en: Fixed CTD when trying to assign a front line to a selection of units where some belong to an army group and some are unassigned
u3ctxb.zh: 修复了在尝试为一部分属于某集团军、另一部分未分配的所选单位指派前线时发生的崩溃（CTD）。

1w8o2no.en: Improvements to the form Polynesia decision: New Zealand can now request control of Pacific islands from their faction members
1w8o2no.zh: 改进了「组建波利尼西亚」决议：新西兰现在可以向其阵营成员请求控制太平洋岛屿。

5e1brp.en: Units now correctly divide units into fallback orders that originate in friendly territory and pass through neutral territory.
5e1brp.zh: 对于起始于友方领土并穿越中立领土的撤退线命令，单位现在能正确地分配部队。

1x7eh27.en: Portugal will not be able to complete "Intervention in Spain" or "Nationalist Intervention" if it is in a faction with Spain.
1x7eh27.zh: 如果葡萄牙与西班牙同属一个阵营，它将无法完成「干预西班牙」或「民族派干预」。

1vxamzw.en: If an operation somehow gets too much equipment (like if modifiers improve) it will now give that back on start of operation
1vxamzw.zh: 如果某项行动不知何故获得了过多装备（例如修正得到提升），它现在会在行动开始时归还多余部分。

9q3jvu.en: Unified achievements tooltips during game setup and in-game so that the in-game button shows the same details as game setup.
9q3jvu.zh: 统一了游戏设置与游戏内成就的提示框，使游戏内按钮显示与游戏设置相同的细节。

1lbsriq.en: fixed activate_targeted_decision & remove_targeted_decision not working properly for some cases of state targeted decisions
1lbsriq.zh: 修复了 activate_targeted_decision 与 remove_targeted_decision 在某些州定向决议情形下无法正常工作的问题。

1r6aa2f.en: Free French coup in territory operations should now only be available against the country actually occupying that territory
1r6aa2f.zh: 自由法国在领土内策划政变的行动现在应只对实际占领该领土的国家可用。

1uxu9v1.en: Former Warlords are now able to use the "Integrate the Warlords" decision given they have completed the appropriate focus.
1uxu9v1.zh: 前军阀现在只要完成了相应的国策，就能使用「整合军阀」决议。

1m3s0rb.en: Fixed being able to start the operation Orchestrate Coup against a country with the same ideology or already in a civilwar
1m3s0rb.zh: 修复了可以对意识形态相同或已处于内战中的国家发动「策划政变」行动的问题。

1sald7p.en: fixed a crash that happens while loading/saving game rules if you enabled a difficulty setting that was on a disabled mod
1sald7p.zh: 修复了当你启用了某个位于已禁用模组上的难度设置时，加载/保存游戏规则会发生的崩溃。

v8fx4s.en: fixed "Expand Influence in state" decisions increasing the influence over max and causing ui to show wrong decision icons
v8fx4s.zh: 修复了「扩大在州内的影响力」决议使影响力超出上限并导致 ui 显示错误决议图标的问题。

5qh03h.en: Fixed OOS in naval combat when convoys are sunk in a MP with at least one client using a different language than the host
5qh03h.zh: 修复了在至少有一名客户端使用与主机不同语言的多人游戏中，运输船队被击沉时海战出现的失同步（OOS）。

41mvy4.en: Fixed air base capacity not updating properly when the controller of the state differ from the controller of the airbase
41mvy4.zh: 修复了当州的控制者与空军基地的控制者不同时，空军基地容量未能正确更新的问题。

1o7elwk.en: Ensured the Independence War news event for Spain shows the correct localization (it was referring to the wrong nation).
1o7elwk.zh: 确保西班牙独立战争的新闻事件显示正确的本地化文本（此前它引用了错误的国家）。

1v06myu.en: Fixed an issue where Canadian focus "Skewer the Eagle" was automatically bypassed if Britain failed to enforce loyalty.
1v06myu.zh: 修复了若英国未能强制效忠，加拿大国策「Skewer the Eagle」被自动跳过的问题。

a1xfd.en: Corrected achievement UI to be disabled when not logged in with necessary accounts, with explanation added to tooltip.
a1xfd.zh: 修正了成就 ui，使其在未使用必要账户登录时处于禁用状态，并在提示框中加入了说明。

15niyqz.en: Any Spanish tag revived by a foreign ally will now declare war on any foreign country allied to any other Spanish tag.
15niyqz.zh: 任何被外国盟友复活的西班牙标签，现在都会对与任何其他西班牙标签结盟的任何外国宣战。

1oxt1c4.en: The game now displays a pop up when reaching the main menu if it detected invalid map data when launched in debug mode
1oxt1c4.zh: 现在若游戏在调试模式下启动时检测到无效地图数据，进入主菜单时会显示一个弹窗。

1nobt9k.en: you can specify a list of effects under spawn_civil_war effect now, which will be executed under new civil war country
1nobt9k.zh: 现在你可以在 spawn_civil_war 效果下指定一个效果列表，这些效果将在新的内战国家下执行。

1qh7qis.en: Portuguese Anarchism focus now bypasses if Portugal no longer exists (for example if it has been Anarchized already).
1qh7qis.zh: 如果葡萄牙已不复存在（例如已被无政府主义化），「葡萄牙无政府主义」国策现在会跳过。

12uzkoh.en: Decreased compliance from collab regime operation to 20% from 30% on normal result and 50% to 40% on excelent result
12uzkoh.zh: 将合作政权行动带来的顺从度从普通结果的 30% 降至 20%，从优秀结果的 50% 降至 40%。

1p7pzwr.en: Republican Spain should no longer incorrectly load the wrong strategy plan and expand Soviet aid in Historical Mode.
1p7pzwr.zh: 在历史模式下，共和派西班牙不应再错误地加载错误的战略计划并扩大苏联援助。

yweakk.en: Fixed OOS related to asking an operative to resume their mission after the operation they are assigned to completes
yweakk.zh: 修复了在特工被指派参与的行动完成之后要求其恢复任务所导致的失同步（OOS）。

lrdt6n.en: Fixed Guarda and Porto population being the other way around. Renamed state files to match the actual state names.
lrdt6n.zh: 修复了瓜达与波尔图人口数据被弄反的问题。重命名了州文件，使其与实际州名相符。

vveown.en: War propaganda mission can now always be taken as long as there is intelligence network strength on targeted state
vveown.zh: 只要目标州上存在情报网络强度，战争宣传任务现在随时都可以执行。

1r839uk.en: Korea should now correctly be released if Manchukuo breaks free from japan and forces a peace settlement with them
1r839uk.zh: 如果满洲国摆脱日本独立并迫使其达成和平解决，朝鲜现在应能被正确地释放。

jmj465.en: Ensured the Abdication Crisis timed mission will now appear at the top of its decision category, for convenience.
jmj465.zh: 确保「退位危机」限时任务现在会显示在其决议类别的最上方，以便查看。

18oqk0d.en: Fixed an exploit that allows you to control another country that was being controlled Back in the previous Game
18oqk0d.zh: 修复了可以控制你在上一局游戏中曾控制过的另一个国家的漏洞。

1cliasf.en: Fixed error in log about invalid nationality when running triggers for operative trait of a captured operative
1cliasf.zh: 修复了为被俘特工的特工特质运行触发器时，日志中出现无效国籍报错的问题。

1b0oiuc.en: Nationalist Spain will no longer be offered to move their capital to Madrid if their capital is already Madrid
1b0oiuc.zh: 如果民族派西班牙的首都已经是马德里，将不再向其提供迁都马德里的选项。

1gsk300.en: Made targeting weights for air-to-ship in naval combat moddable. See NAVAL_COMBAT_AIR_*_TARGET_SCORE defines.
1gsk300.zh: 使海战中空对舰的目标选择权重可被模组修改。参见 NAVAL_COMBAT_AIR_*_TARGET_SCORE 系列 define。

1c07qgx.en: Ensured Reassert Dominance decisions can no longer target Denmark, if its capital has moved to the Americas.
1c07qgx.zh: 确保「重申主导地位」决议在其首都已迁至美洲时不再以丹麦为目标。

1vjlw2b.en: Fixed CTD when accessing the airwings of a carrier that has been acquired through the annexation of a puppet
1vjlw2b.zh: 修复了访问通过吞并傀儡国而获得的航空母舰的航空队时发生的崩溃（CTD）。

17hg7s7.en: Fixed operative resuming their mission after an operation being able to run their mission in a quiet network
17hg7s7.zh: 修复了特工在行动结束后恢复任务时能在静默网络中执行任务的问题。

8jeyn7.en: Fixed an issue where, under specific circumstances in some edge cases, Gibraltar cores/claims could be lost.
8jeyn7.zh: 修复了在某些边界情况的特定条件下，直布罗陀的核心/宣称可能丢失的问题。

1knkt12.en: Fixed the Paradox account initialization to detect the active session passed to the game from the launcher.
1knkt12.zh: 修复了 Paradox 账户的初始化，使其能检测到从启动器传递给游戏的活跃会话。

1x2y80.en: Pakistani independence war units will now be deleted when the two nations make peace in any circumstances.
1x2y80.zh: 无论在任何情况下，只要两国缔结和平，巴基斯坦独立战争的单位现在都会被删除。

2slhi8.en: fixed some bugs that was changing resistance country (by cancelling and recreating resistance) not working
2slhi8.zh: 修复了通过取消并重建抵抗度来更换抵抗度所属国家这一做法无法生效的若干 bug。

100sq9p.en: France can no longer start border wars over her colonies if at war with the controller of those colonies
100sq9p.zh: 如果法国正与这些殖民地的控制者交战，它就不能再为殖民地发动边境战争。

1qfkp4k.en: Portuguese puppets will not get opinion penalty with Portugal upon completion of The Fifth Empire focus.
1qfkp4k.zh: 在「第五帝国」国策完成后，葡萄牙的傀儡国将不会受到与葡萄牙之间的好感度惩罚。

xgavtc.en: Increased tech stealing extra bonus outcomes to also give either 1 or 2 year ahead of time bonuses also
xgavtc.zh: 增强了窃取科技的额外奖励结果，使其还会额外给予 1 年或 2 年的超前科技加成。

ecj4oe.en: Effective carrier plane advantage in naval combat now gives penalties to positioning for the other side
ecj4oe.zh: 海战中有效的航母舰载机优势现在会给对方带来阵位惩罚。

1ql67fe.en: The French "Invest in..." focuses should now pick the correct states and not pick the same state twice
1ql67fe.zh: 法国的「投资……」系列国策现在应会选择正确的州，且不会两次选中同一个州。

14iyc3a.en: A Portuguese puppet will not be able to complete focuses that will make it join a war upon completion.
14iyc3a.zh: 葡萄牙的傀儡国将无法完成那些在完成后会使其参战的国策。

10zejub.en: Fixed Metropolitan Army focus not actually giving technology boost for infantry and support equipment.
10zejub.zh: 修复了「本土陆军」国策实际上未给予步兵与支援装备科技加成的问题。

1stnyh7.en: Fixed an issue with tech stealing operation where players with MTG could be stealing old useless techs
1stnyh7.zh: 修复了窃取科技行动的一个问题：拥有 MTG 的玩家可能会窃取到无用的旧科技。

4n84bc.en: Fixed "Expand Garrison Control in Burgos" decision not increasing garrison control for the Republicans
4n84bc.zh: 修复了「扩大布尔戈斯的驻军控制」决议不会为共和派提高驻军控制度的问题。

1jz6tcg.en: Added general Jose Asensio Torrado to the Spanish roster, so he can finally show up his cool portrait.
1jz6tcg.zh: 将何塞·阿森西奥·托拉多将领加入西班牙名册，让他终于可以亮出自己帅气的肖像。

it9szk.en: Fix dynamic countries not being able to research variants and having all land doctrine paths unlocked
it9szk.zh: 修复了动态国家无法研发改型、且所有陆军学说路线都被解锁的问题。

qf0tje.en: Added a tooltip to explain that you need an operative working on the network to prepare an operation.
qf0tje.zh: 新增了一个提示框，说明你需要一名在情报网上工作的特工才能筹备行动。

1a5j49r.en: Blocked execution of white_peace before game start, along with error log explanation, instead of CTD.
1a5j49r.zh: 阻止了在游戏开始之前执行 white_peace，并附带错误日志说明，而不再是崩溃（CTD）。

16na0rc.en: fixed an issue that prevented Vichy Produce Airplane Parts spirit from correctly applying to Germany
16na0rc.zh: 修复了「维希生产飞机零件」国家精神无法正确对德国生效的问题。

16a680f.en: During peace conference, collaboration events are delayed until after and non-news events are hidden
16a680f.zh: 在和平会议期间，合作事件会被推迟到会议之后，非新闻类事件则会被隐藏。

kbajp0.en: ai is now less reluctant to accept other ai countries' access requests if other country is too small
kbajp0.zh: 如果对方国家过小，AI 现在不那么不愿意接受其他 AI 国家的通行请求了。

1gdnlr1.en: fixed some tooltip issues with for_each_scope_loop effect and all_of_scopes & any_of_scopes triggers
1gdnlr1.zh: 修复了 for_each_scope_loop 效果以及 all_of_scopes 与 any_of_scopes 触发器的一些提示框问题。

2r2wz8.en: The game no longer aborts due to map errors if launched in debug mode, to allow access to the Nudger
2r2wz8.zh: 若以调试模式启动，游戏不再因地图错误而中止，以便能够使用 Nudger。

j01x8n.en: Fixed CTD due to stack overflow when trying to set a tooltip handler to a window that had no guitype
j01x8n.zh: 修复了尝试为没有 guitype 的窗口设置提示框处理器时因栈溢出导致的崩溃（CTD）。

1snnjz3.en: Prevent CTD when attempting to display the airwings of an airbase the player does not have access to
1snnjz3.zh: 防止在尝试显示玩家无权访问的空军基地的航空队时发生崩溃（CTD）。

xo60b1.en: Expand Soviet Aid now requires the Soviets to actually have sent volunteers before it is available.
xo60b1.zh: 「扩大苏联援助」现在要求苏联实际派出过志愿军才可用。

2vyfvo.en: "Give up Baleares" and "Refuse to Give up Baleares" events are now fired to Italy instead of Spain.
2vyfvo.zh: 「放弃巴利阿里」与「拒绝放弃巴利阿里」事件现在会向意大利而非西班牙触发。

cfwhz4.en: Added a few new Carlist focuses to slightly improve their industrial situation after the civil war.
cfwhz4.zh: 新增了若干卡洛斯派国策，以略微改善其在内战后的工业状况。

1qrwfe2.en: fixed an issue where France would start out with too low war support if Man The Guns was not active
1qrwfe2.zh: 修复了未启用 Man The Guns 时法国开局战争支持度过低的问题。

lfwruc.en: added mtth database that allows mean_time_to_happen/ai_will_do structure as if they were variables
lfwruc.zh: 新增了 mtth 数据库，使 mean_time_to_happen/ai_will_do 结构可以像变量一样使用。

13bop19.en: Gibraltar will not generate resistance to any Spanish nation if it is transferred during the SCW.
13bop19.zh: 如果在西班牙内战期间被移交，直布罗陀不会对任何西班牙国家产生抵抗度。

13m8zqf.en: fixed an issue with Yugoslavian Fighter/Bomber competition event chain having unlocalized strings
13m8zqf.zh: 修复了南斯拉夫战斗机/轰炸机竞标事件链存在未本地化字符串的问题。

8wxp53.en: Prevented Monarchist France from being able to join the Spanish Civil War on the Anarchist side.
8wxp53.zh: 阻止了君主主义法国以无政府主义者一方加入西班牙内战。

yt3pru.en: French guarantees on Yugoslavia and Czechoslovakia are now cancelled if France goes with Britain
yt3pru.zh: 如果法国与英国站在一起，法国对南斯拉夫与捷克斯洛伐克的保障独立现在会被取消。

h7yrmx.en: fixed two game rules not working (Volunteers freely available and Hungary set to go Communist)
h7yrmx.zh: 修复了两条游戏规则失效的问题（志愿军自由可用、匈牙利设定为走向共产主义）。

1drejql.en: Spanish Election of 1936 events will now get the current Spanish leader, Niceto Alcala-Zamora.
1drejql.zh: 1936 年西班牙选举事件现在会取用当前的西班牙领袖尼塞托·阿尔卡拉-萨莫拉。

ujob6h.en: Decreased fielded manpower requirement from German "Demand Sudetenland" to 725000 from 750000
ujob6h.zh: 将德国「索取苏台德」的现役人力要求从 750000 降至 725000。

586ukf.en: Reduced the Compliance requirements for the Anarchist coring decisions to 50%, down from 60%.
586ukf.zh: 将无政府主义者建立核心决议的顺从度要求从 60% 降至 50%。

tq55pe.en: The "Join the French" focus in the Dutch focus tree now takes new French focuses into account
tq55pe.zh: 荷兰国策树中的「加入法国」国策现在会把法国的新国策纳入考虑。

j8qlj.en: Releasing puppet no longer creates a new operative slot that disappears again after unpausing
j8qlj.zh: 释放傀儡国不再会创建一个在取消暂停后又消失的新特工槽位。

12nqbmg.en: Fix units when retreating towards a tile while in multiple combats has a wrong arrow visually
12nqbmg.zh: 修复了单位在同时参与多场战斗时向某格撤退会显示错误箭头的问题。

yjt802.en: neutral ai countries won't create collaborations unless it is past 1944 and they are at peace
yjt802.zh: 中立 AI 国家不会建立合作政权，除非时间已过 1944 年且它们处于和平状态。

aetmuf.en: Fixed "Catalonian Occupation Zone" to properly refer to a "Catalan Occupation Zone", instead.
aetmuf.zh: 已将「Catalonian Occupation Zone」修正为正确表述「Catalan Occupation Zone」。

45416g.en: Enabled the abort on map error for when game files are modified in the installation directory
45416g.zh: 为安装目录中的游戏文件被修改的情况重新启用了地图错误中止。

y8dfs2.en: Prevented crash when trying to respond to faction invite from a faction that no longer exists
y8dfs2.zh: 防止了在尝试回应来自已不复存在的阵营的邀请时发生崩溃。

16n4tvf.en: the Iberian Pact Invoked event should now only fire if Spain or Portugal is not in a faction
16n4tvf.zh: 「伊比利亚条约被援引」事件现在应只在西班牙或葡萄牙不在阵营中时触发。

zf9lw2.en: Added "name = X" too all technology bonuses missing it in Portuguese FT, X being focus name.
zf9lw2.zh: 为葡萄牙国策树中所有缺少该字段的科技加成添加了 "name = X"，其中 X 为国策名称。

4cg1dv.en: Airwing duplication now also copies missions as well as the "auto turn off" training setting
4cg1dv.zh: 复制航空队现在也会一并复制任务以及「自动关闭」训练设置。

1m9px8y.en: French Focuses bypassed by not having an inefficient economy now correctly display that fact
1m9px8y.zh: 因不具备低效经济而被跳过的法国国策现在会正确显示这一情况。

11m94s9.en: Luis Maria Martinez should now use the correct portrait even if he is spawned via civil war
11m94s9.zh: 路易斯·玛丽亚·马丁内斯现在即使是通过内战生成，也会使用正确的肖像。

1um0mwi.en: French Disunite Germany focus will now only create a faction if France isn't in one already
1um0mwi.zh: 法国的「分裂德国」国策现在只会在法国尚未加入任何阵营时创建一个阵营。

dvh7fr.en: France should now only be able to invite a country once into the non-intervention committee
dvh7fr.zh: 法国现在对每个国家只能邀请一次加入不干涉委员会。

gpl5hg.en: capture cypher operation now gives between 30-50% decrypt and requires a bit lower network.
gpl5hg.zh: 捕获密码行动现在会给予 30% 至 50% 的解密进度，且所需的情报网络要求略有降低。

1b4um9a.en: The coordinated strike operation now has proper effect descriptions explaining what it does
1b4um9a.zh: 「协同打击」行动现在有了恰当的效果描述，说明其具体作用。

16f7so1.en: France now has the correct heavy battery and secondary battery unlocked in 1936 (MtG only)
16f7so1.zh: 在 1936 年，法国现在会正确解锁正确的重型主炮与副炮（仅 MtG）。

s83m37.en: fixed accessing variables using other variables not working ( such as var_name:var_name2 )
s83m37.zh: 修复了使用其他变量访问变量（例如 var_name:var_name2）无法生效的问题。

1vdhnlm.en: Reaffirm the Popular Front Strategy now bypasses if the Anarchists have already rebelled.
1vdhnlm.zh: 如果无政府主义者已经起义，「重申人民阵线战略」现在会跳过。

ki8qyk.en: SS divisions recruited through decisions now have motorized recon units instead of horses
ki8qyk.zh: 通过决议招募的党卫军师现在配备摩托化侦察单位，而非马匹。

18oivmt.en: Slightly adjusted A Great Spain and The Popular Front focus placement to be more central.
18oivmt.zh: 略微调整了「伟大的西班牙」与「人民阵线」国策的位置，使其更居中。

p1qoao.en: The French "Economic Devolution" focus now displays the correct effects after it is taken
p1qoao.zh: 法国的「经济权力下放」国策现在在点出后会显示正确的效果。

10rfm92.en: compliance is now halved (instead of factored by 75%) when a state controller is changed
10rfm92.zh: 当州的控制者发生变更时，顺从度现在会减半（而非按 75% 折算）。

wbiy1o.en: Updated Romanian focus Handle The King to give democratic support instead of non-aligned
wbiy1o.zh: 更新了罗马尼亚「处理国王」国策，使其给予民主主义支持度而非中立主义。

4xb0af.en: Renamed Franco's old portrait to prevent it from being used unintentionally by the game.
4xb0af.zh: 重命名了佛朗哥的旧肖像，以防游戏无意中调用它。

zafayt.en: Fix Missing localization tag for synthetic refineries when hovering over state resources
zafayt.zh: 修复了将鼠标悬停在州资源上时合成炼油厂缺少本地化标签的问题。

sy9fb5.en: Portugal AI will accept to Restore the Iberian Union if it is a puppet of Carlist Spain.
sy9fb5.zh: 如果葡萄牙是卡洛斯派西班牙的傀儡国，葡萄牙 AI 将接受「恢复伊比利亚联盟」。

18ov508.en: Portuguese "Volunteers in the War" National Spirits will be removed when the SCW is over
18ov508.zh: 西班牙内战结束后，葡萄牙的「战争中的志愿军」国家精神将被移除。

10jkmak.en: improved performance slightly by making some adjustments to triggers (courtesy of Yard1)
10jkmak.zh: 通过对触发器做一些调整略微提升了性能（由 Yard1 提供）。

zzlduz.en: Fixed issues with resource requirements in operations differing between UI and gameplay
zzlduz.zh: 修复了行动的资源需求在界面与游戏实际表现之间不一致的问题。

50gf9.en: Fixed an issue where territory wasn't assigned properly in the Japan surrender to China
50gf9.zh: 修复了日本向中国投降时领土未能正确分配的问题。

1qigytp.en: invalid operations (target is now ally etc) are now cancelled even if they are prepared
1qigytp.zh: 无效的行动（目标现已成为盟友等）现在即使已经筹备完毕也会被取消。

1m9lne9.en: The list of aces to pick from is now sorted to have compatible and free aces at the top
1m9lne9.zh: 可供选择的王牌列表现在会排序，将兼容且空闲的王牌置于顶部。

tedquu.en: Operatives can be disbanded to free up operative slots and recruit different operatives
tedquu.zh: 特工可以被解散，以腾出特工槽位并招募不同的特工。

1cmd5vd.en: Added new 3D models for the various Spanish sides and Portuguese units in La Résistance
1cmd5vd.zh: 在 La Résistance 中为西班牙各方与葡萄牙单位新增了新的 3D 模型。

ma0l86.en: you can now set the French Ai to become monarchist through custom game rules (LaR only)
ma0l86.zh: 现在你可以通过自定义游戏规则将法国 AI 设定为走向君主主义（仅 LaR）。

ho4iez.en: Fixed CTD on Windows caused by the assumption of the presence of the popcnt instruction
ho4iez.zh: 修复了因假定存在 popcnt 指令而在 Windows 上导致的崩溃（CTD）。

42ivez.en: Carrier planes no longer take area coverage penalties on their targeted/ground missions
42ivez.zh: 航母舰载机在执行指定目标/对地任务时不再承受区域覆盖惩罚。

1i68k8o.en: Expand Soviet Aid focus now bypasses if you are Stalinist Spain and the SCW has ended.
1i68k8o.zh: 如果你是斯大林派西班牙且西班牙内战已结束，「扩大苏联援助」国策现在会跳过。

m795gs.en: Wilno will now become a core when forming the United Baltic States or Poland Lithuania
m795gs.zh: 在组建波罗的海联合国家或波兰-立陶宛时，维尔诺现在会成为核心。

1yagdbo.en: Relocate Government to Batavia focus now also adds 70 compliance to Indonesian states.
1yagdbo.zh: 「将政府迁往巴达维亚」国策现在还会为印度尼西亚各州增加 70 顺从度。

96xrwy.en: Renamed Elastic Defense focus to Rebuild the Lines of Torres Vedras for better flavor.
96xrwy.zh: 将「弹性防御」国策更名为「重建托里什韦德拉什防线」，以增添风味。

1qs81aq.en: Fixed Soviet Union seizing Spanish gold reserves even if the gold was never relocated.
1qs81aq.zh: 修复了即便黄金从未被转移，苏联也会夺取西班牙黄金储备的问题。

15plc64.en: Vichy France is now informed if any colonial territories are taken over by Free France
15plc64.zh: 如果任何殖民领土被自由法国接管，维希法国现在会得到通知。

silfxb.en: Enabled 3D mesh lookup based on a country's cosmetic tag before checking its true tag.
silfxb.zh: 启用了先依据国家的外观标签、再检查其真实标签来查找 3D 模型。

18xwcxi.en: Fixed an issue where formable nations decisions category was using an incorrect asset
18xwcxi.zh: 修复了可组建国家决议类别使用了错误素材的问题。

1d9vuh9.en: Fixed CTD that may happen when confirming the replacement of a technology to research
1d9vuh9.zh: 修复了在确认替换待研发科技时可能发生的崩溃（CTD）。

jwrrsh.en: fixed an issue with Carlist spain losing its 3d models after reinstating the monarchy
jwrrsh.zh: 修复了卡洛斯派西班牙在恢复君主制后丢失其 3D 模型的问题。

1kbkovc.en: Fix end of civil war events no longer firing (initially reported on German Civil war)
1kbkovc.zh: 修复了内战结束事件不再触发的问题（最初是在德国内战中被报告的）。

1rlrshi.en: Carrier planes no longer suffer the range coverage penalty during coordinated strikes
1rlrshi.zh: 航母舰载机在协同打击期间不再承受航程覆盖惩罚。

53nr6r.en: Prevent some UI to be visible on the loading screen when loading a save from in-game
53nr6r.zh: 防止从游戏内读取存档时部分界面元素显示在加载画面上。

lbwyf1.en: Fixed annexation effects not being triggered after defeating non-anarchist Portugal.
lbwyf1.zh: 修复了击败非无政府主义的葡萄牙后吞并效果未被触发的问题。

1ao2c5g.en: Fixed CTD caused by event that would kill country leaders or a country that had none
1ao2c5g.zh: 修复了由会杀死国家领袖的事件、或针对没有任何领袖的国家的事件所导致的崩溃（CTD）。

z5ywpa.en: It will no longer be possible for Wang Ming or Zhang Lan to rule multiple countries
z5ywpa.zh: 王明或张澜将不再可能统治多个国家。

1ki3slg.en: Fixed Bulgarian Ships using generic Portuguese names for Submarines and Destroyers.
1ki3slg.zh: 修复了保加利亚舰船的潜艇与驱逐舰使用葡萄牙通用名称的问题。

1bkr4dp.en: assigned f10 to faction map mode (you can take screen shot of map using ctrl + f10)
1bkr4dp.zh: 将 f10 分配给阵营地图模式（你可以用 ctrl + f10 对地图截图）。

s0n6uz.en: Delayed UK AI strategy for piling in to save benelux to avoid awkward timing issues
s0n6uz.zh: 推迟了英国 AI 蜂拥救援比荷卢的战略，以避免尴尬的时机问题。

6dcqhs.en: Changed the country names for Galicia and added party names for Spanish releasables
6dcqhs.zh: 更改了加利西亚的国家名称，并为西班牙可释放国家添加了政党名称。

7j7n3z.en: Added trigger network_national_coverage to test for Intel Network National Coverage
7j7n3z.zh: 新增了触发器 network_national_coverage，用于检测情报网络全国覆盖率。

jx2zfv.en: 1.9.1 is a bugfix patch which was released on 2020-04-08⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.
jx2zfv.zh: 1.9.1 是一个错误修复补丁，于 2020-04-08⟦0⟧发布，校验和为 ⟦1⟧。

pkwgov.en: French focuses should now be correctly positioned when La Resistance is not active
pkwgov.zh: 当 La Resistance 未启用时，法国国策现在应能正确排布。

o2av5o.en: Evade Blockade decisions will now be properly removed after a country capitulates.
o2av5o.zh: 一个国家投降之后，「规避封锁」决议现在会被正确移除。

yjax23.en: Fixed originator property of operative_leader_event effect not working as intended
yjax23.zh: 修复了 operative_leader_event 效果的 originator 属性未按预期生效的问题。

rjn3aj.en: 1.9.2 is a bugfix patch which was released on 2020-05-06⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.
rjn3aj.zh: 1.9.2 是一个错误修复补丁，于 2020-05-06⟦0⟧发布，校验和为 ⟦1⟧。

dywnq7.en: 1.9.3 is a bugfix patch which was released on 2020-06-04⟦0⟧ with the checksum ⟦1⟧.
dywnq7.zh: 1.9.3 是一个错误修复补丁，于 2020-06-04⟦0⟧发布，校验和为 ⟦1⟧。

cplonl.en: mitigated the effects of deleting your whole army to get more XP training exploit
cplonl.zh: 减轻了通过删除整支军队来获取更多经验的训练漏洞所造成的影响。

4z927b.en: Fixed faction members joining wars via one's puppets, overriding master's consent
4z927b.zh: 修复了阵营成员通过他国的傀儡国参战、越过宗主国同意权的问题。

1lo6zpg.en: Unplanned Offensive now also reduces air mission effectiveness in affected areas.
1lo6zpg.zh: 「无计划的攻势」现在还会降低受影响地区的空中任务效率。

1xi9qec.en: French Reorganize the Aviation Industry decisions can now only be taken once each
1xi9qec.zh: 法国的「重组航空工业」决议现在每项只能执行一次。

18a3x4q.en: added 'lack of fuel' icon for combat view for the divisions that are lacking fuel
18a3x4q.zh: 为缺乏燃料的师在战斗视图中新增了「燃料不足」图标。

1bhlgb1.en: lowered intel required for approximate army count & fielded manpower count to 5%
1bhlgb1.zh: 将获取陆军规模概略与现役人力概略所需的情报要求降至 5%。

q648q7.en: Nationalist Spain will no longer complete Iberian Pact focus in historical mode.
q648q7.zh: 在历史模式下，民族派西班牙将不再完成「伊比利亚条约」国策。

f74y3k.en: Fix steal naval blueprint removing civilian instead of a navy infiltration token
f74y3k.zh: 修复了窃取海军蓝图会移除民用渗透标记而非海军渗透标记的问题。

vvsyfv.en: Added large font support and visual message notification to the multiplayer chat
vvsyfv.zh: 为多人聊天新增了大字体支持与视觉消息通知。

1fa7mb2.en: German AI should now research 1940 fighters (after 1940 due to balance concerns)
1fa7mb2.zh: 德国 AI 现在应会研发 1940 年型战斗机（出于平衡性考虑，1940 年之后才会进行）。

zrkw2.en: The Bell Tolls for Us achievement should now trigger when winning the civil war.
zrkw2.zh: 「The Bell Tolls for Us」成就现在应在赢得内战时触发。

rx4che.en: Allow operative to be re-assigned to their mission when the operation completes
rx4che.zh: 允许在行动完成后将特工重新指派回其任务。

1p5vf4s.en: Ratifying the Stresa front will now maintain the Franco-Soviet mutual guarantee
1p5vf4s.zh: 批准斯特雷萨阵线现在会维持法苏互相保障。

7gpykm.en: Fixed Portuguese and Brazilian infantry division name to Divisão de Infantaria.
7gpykm.zh: 将葡萄牙与巴西步兵师的名称修正为 Divisão de Infantaria。

fnnuny.en: fixed a rare edge case where Communist China could attempt to infiltrate itself
fnnuny.zh: 修复了中国共产党可能尝试渗透自身这一罕见的边界情况。

e1ssrc.en: Prevented AI from attempting to refit ships to their current equipment variant.
e1ssrc.zh: 阻止 AI 尝试将舰船改装为其当前的装备改型。

pzmuez.en: enabled Jacques Duclos as a French operative in the communist branch (LaR only)
pzmuez.zh: 在共产主义分支中启用了雅克·杜克洛作为法国特工（仅 LaR）。

c9wlp7.en: Fix a CTD on related to clearing strategic air data and processing air activity
c9wlp7.zh: 修复了与清除战略空军数据和处理空中活动相关的崩溃（CTD）。

2nlk68.en: increased the cost of initial radar tech, lowered cost on all other radar techs
2nlk68.zh: 提高了初始雷达科技的花费，降低了其他所有雷达科技的花费。

102tqhl.en: Improved Resistance Suppression when using "Brutal Oppression" from 65% to 75%
102tqhl.zh: 将使用「残酷镇压」时的抵抗度压制从 65% 提升至 75%。

1mh6wp8.en: Portuguese dynamic tags will get Portuguese Focus Tree after wining civil war.
1mh6wp8.zh: 葡萄牙动态标签在赢得内战后将获得葡萄牙国策树。

1d38k0p.en: Completing Estado Novo focus will now lock Alvaro Cunhal as political advisor.
1d38k0p.zh: 完成「新国家体制」国策现在会锁定阿尔瓦罗·库尼亚尔作为政治顾问。

19z6dl1.en: it is possible to specify name & icon in create_intelligence_agency effect now
19z6dl1.zh: 现在可以在 create_intelligence_agency 效果中指定名称与图标。

pekvwi.en: Fixed CTD when the game files do not specify a strategic region for a province
pekvwi.zh: 修复了游戏文件未为某省份指定战略区域时发生的崩溃（CTD）。

ygab5o.en: Added mitigation when loading a save that has invalid access rules for carrier
ygab5o.zh: 为读取航母访问规则无效的存档新增了缓解措施。

58850y.en: Anti-Fascist Unity is no longer available after the Anarchists have risen up.
58850y.zh: 无政府主义者起义之后，「反法西斯团结」不再可用。

cdkqb1.en: Portugal cannot send volunteers to a Spanish faction they are not supporting.
cdkqb1.zh: 葡萄牙不能向其未支持的西班牙阵营派遣志愿军。

10oplow.en: Mexico should no longer be able to send shipments to Spain if the war is over
10oplow.zh: 如果战争已经结束，墨西哥不应再能向西班牙运送物资。

slez9y.en: Fix saving and reloading remove research bonus already applied to a research.
slez9y.zh: 修复了保存并重新读取后，已应用于某项研究的科研加成被移除的问题。

1qlig8p.en: Ai now able to send volunteer airwings again (optimization broke it in 1.8.1)
1qlig8p.zh: AI 现在又能派遣志愿航空队了（某项优化在 1.8.1 中破坏了该功能）。

zdjk5i.en: Errors that cause the invalid map data error are now preffixed with MAP_ERROR
zdjk5i.zh: 导致无效地图数据错误的报错现在会加上 MAP_ERROR 前缀。

5pjj79.en: Increased compliance decay to give cap of 90% compliance to non democracies.
5pjj79.zh: 提高了顺从度衰减，使非民主国家的顺从度上限为 90%。

1r8kd2l.en: French Coup operations should now correctly display their potential outcomes
1r8kd2l.zh: 法国的政变行动现在应能正确显示其可能结果。

11idwaz.en: GER now will try to put more armor to low countries instead of france border
