uv6n35.en: Modifiers are factors multiplied against the state value to either increase or decrease the total cost. Factors less than 1.0 will decrease the cost, while factors greater than 1.0 will increase the cost. Thus, a modifier of 1.2 represents a 20% increase while a modifier of 0.8 represents a 20% decrease. The ⟦0⟧ displayed in the demand tooltip (i.e., the 'Multiplied by' value) is computed by multiplying all active modifiers by each other. This product is then multiplied by the ⟦1⟧ to arrive at the war score cost for the state. The breakdown of constituent cost modifiers is displayed in the demand tooltip when hovering over a demand in the peace conference by holding the ⟦2⟧ key.
uv6n35.zh: 修正值是乘以州价值以增加或减少总花费的系数。小于 1.0 的系数会降低花费，而大于 1.0 的系数会提高花费。因此，1.2 的修正值代表增加 20%，而 0.8 的修正值代表减少 20%。要求提示框中显示的⟦0⟧（即「乘以」值）是通过把所有生效的修正值彼此相乘计算得出的。然后用该乘积乘以⟦1⟧，得出该州的战争贡献花费。在和平会议中按住⟦2⟧键并将鼠标悬停在一项要求上时，要求提示框中会显示各项构成花费修正值的明细。

19eax6z.en: ⟦0⟧ = ⟦1⟧, where: s is the peace score scale factor, a constant in the Defines LUA file, currently defined as 1.35.[1] v is the combined state value of all states controlled by the enemy at the start of the war. p is the war participation of each victor, a percentage calculated by dividing the total of each participant’s war participation points into the total of all participants’ war participation points of the same side. c is a conditional surrender factor (only active if the loser conditionally surrenders) equal to the loser's surrender progress (represented by the red/blue bar at the top of the war summary window) at the time that they conditionally surrender.
19eax6z.zh: ⟦0⟧ = ⟦1⟧，其中：s 是和平贡献缩放系数，是 Defines LUA 文件中的一个常量，目前定义为 1.35。[1] v 是战争开始时敌方控制的所有州的合并州价值。p 是每个胜利者的战争参与度，即以某一方所有参与者的战争参与点数总和为分母、以每位参与者的战争参与点数为分子计算出的百分比。c 是有条件投降系数（仅当失败方有条件投降时生效），等于失败方有条件投降时的投降进度（以战争概要窗口顶部的红/蓝条表示）。

2z97j4.en: The button labelled "Submit Demands", located at the bottom of the panel displaying the player's current demands, serves to submit all un-submitted demands and conclude the current turn. In the event that the player is unable to meet the financial obligations associated with the selected demands, this button will become inoperable. In the event that demands are contested, the Submit Demands button will change to the Contested Demands button. This will remain in effect until the player has determined an appropriate course of action within the Contested Demands window.
2z97j4.zh: 标有「提交要求」的按钮位于显示玩家当前要求的面板底部，用于提交所有未提交的要求并结束当前回合。如果玩家无法满足所选要求相关的财政义务，该按钮将变得不可用。如果要求存在争议，「提交要求」按钮会变成「有争议的要求」按钮。在玩家于「有争议的要求」窗口中确定适当的行动方案之前，这一状态会一直保持。

1jyd9zp.en: Players should generally prioritize deciding the fate of states before selecting naval vessels and other demands. This is because the total war score distribution computed at the beginning of the conference is based on state value and does not account for naval vessels or the value of additional demands such as DMZs, war reparations, and resources. Even in a single-victor conference where there is no AI to contend with, the player may not have sufficient war score to disposition all states and take all naval vessels, particularly if the loser has a large navy.
1jyd9zp.zh: 玩家通常应优先决定各州的归属，然后再选择海军舰船和其他要求。这是因为会议开始时计算出的战争贡献总量是基于州价值的，并不计入海军舰船或非军事区、战争赔款、资源等额外要求的价值。即使在只有一位胜利者、无需与 AI 争夺的会议中，玩家也可能没有足够的战争贡献来处置所有州并取得所有海军舰船，尤其是当失败方拥有庞大海军时。

1jzcy3g.en: At the center of the interface, the map graphically represents the current status of different states during the conference, provides information based on selected demand types, and allows the player to select or deselect demands on states similar to the Make Demands and Current Demands panel. Hovering over a state displays a tooltip with demand information based on the currently selected demand type. This includes a breakdown of the costs. Holding the ⟦0⟧ key during this hover will display expanded details on the cost modifiers of the demand.
1jzcy3g.zh: 在界面中央，地图以图形方式表示会议期间各州的当前状态，根据所选要求类型提供信息，并允许玩家像在「提出要求」和「当前要求」面板中那样选择或取消选择各州上的要求。将鼠标悬停在一个州上会显示提示框，其中包含基于当前所选要求类型的要求信息，包括花费明细。悬停期间按住⟦0⟧键会显示该要求的花费修正值的详细展开信息。

1pqyaqt.en: The map updates based on the currently selected demand type from the Make Demands panel. States that are eligible for the selected demand type and affordable to the player will be highlighted green. If the state is not affordable with the current war score, it loses its green highlighting. On selecting a demand, the associated state is highlighted blue. On subsequent turns, if the state has been successfully demanded without contest, it changes its base color to that of the new owner. If a state is contested, it is highlighted red.
1pqyaqt.zh: 地图会根据「提出要求」面板中当前选中的要求类型更新。符合所选要求类型且玩家支付得起的州会以绿色高亮显示。如果以当前战争贡献支付不起该州，它就会失去绿色高亮。选择一项要求后，相关州会以蓝色高亮显示。在后续回合中，如果该州在无争议的情况下被成功要求，其基础颜色会变为新所有者的颜色。如果某个州存在争议，它会以红色高亮显示。

10schp0.en: It is possible for defeated countries to survive the conference. This typically occurs if the victors collectively fail to demand all states of the losers. Annexed states will be in an occupied status unless they are a core of their new owners; compliance gained during long-term occupation or through collaboration missions will remain in effect after the conference. Countries that have been forced to change government will tend to have poor opinion of the winners, while liberated countries will tend to have a good opinion.
10schp0.zh: 战败国是有可能在会议中存续下来的。这通常发生在胜利者集体未能索取失败方全部州的情况下。被吞并的州将处于被占领状态，除非它们是新所有者的核心领土；在长期占领期间或通过合作任务获得的顺从度将在会议结束后继续生效。被迫更换政府的国家往往会对获胜方持较差看法，而被解放的国家则往往持较好看法。

11y8pwd.en: If multiple contests erupt with the AI, it is worth sticking to demands for only one or two turns. This is because the player will start permanently losing some war score after the first turn of the contest and will incur opportunity costs on demanding other states. When there are multiple states contested, the AI will start forfeiting some of their demands at a rate of 1 or 2 per turn, but eventually the AI will stubbornly stick to a few demands and the player will face diminishing returns fighting for them.
11y8pwd.zh: 如果与 AI 之间爆发了多场争夺，那么最好只在一到两个回合内坚持要求。这是因为玩家会在争夺的第一个回合之后开始永久损失部分战争贡献，并且会因为索取其他州而承担机会成本。当有多个州陷入争夺时，AI 会以每回合 1 到 2 项的速度开始放弃部分要求，但最终 AI 会顽固地坚持少数几项要求，玩家为争夺它们将面临收益递减。

1jmxzh0.en: Ranges from 0.7 to 1.0 depending on pixel distance from the nearest of three different types of your states, with varying contribution factored from negotiator’s ⟦0⟧ (20%), nearest core (30%), and nearest controlled state (50%, including peace conference bids). For cases where one or more controlled states are directly adjacent, each adjacent state decreases the cost modifier by 0.05, which may bring the cost modifier below 0.7. Minor countries will get 35% less discount from this computation.
1jmxzh0.zh: 范围从 0.7 到 1.0，取决于到你三种不同类型州中最近者的像素距离，其贡献权重分别来自谈判方的⟦0⟧（20%）、最近的核心领土（30%）和最近的控制州（50%，包括和平会议中的投标）。如果有一个或多个控制州直接相邻，每个相邻州会使花费修正值降低 0.05，这可能使花费修正值降到 0.7 以下。小国从此计算中获得的折扣要少 35%。

1ofbwwd.en: Selecting a tile expands the list of demands available under the country. Hovering over each demand displays a tooltip with more details of the demand, including its costs, beneficiary country, puppet type that will be created, other countries contesting, world tension effects, etc. Holding the ⟦0⟧ key during this hover will display expanded details on the cost modifiers of the demand. Once bidding starts, small country flags on each demand indicate which countries are bidding on it.
1ofbwwd.zh: 选择一个地块会展开该国名下可用的要求列表。将鼠标悬停在每项要求上会显示提示框，其中包含该要求的更多细节，包括其花费、受益国、将创建的傀儡类型、其他正在争夺的国家、世界紧张度影响等。悬停期间按住⟦0⟧键会显示该要求的花费修正值的详细展开信息。一旦开始投标，每项要求上出现的小国旗表示哪些国家正在对它投标。

10ae152.en: The Victors list is displayed by default and lists selected demands, grouping them under country tiles. Each country tile displays the country’s name, available war score, number of uncontested and contested demands, and war participation percentage. Selecting a country tile makes it the beneficiary of take state demands. By default, the player’s country tile is selected until another tile is selected. The current beneficiary is indicated with horizontal yellow bars.
10ae152.zh: 「胜利者」列表默认显示，列出已选的要求，并将它们按国家地块分组。每个国家地块显示该国名称、可用战争贡献、无争议与有争议要求的数量，以及战争参与度百分比。选择某个国家地块会使其成为取得州要求的受益方。默认情况下，玩家所属国家的地块处于选中状态，直到选择另一个地块为止。当前受益方以黄色横条标示。

kl73wo.en: Selecting the yellow arrow on the right side of each tile expands the list of current demands made by or for that country. Within the list, un-submitted demands are bracketed with yellow chevrons prior to the end of turn submission. Clicking an un-submitted demand will cancel it and refund any points that were deducted from the player’s war score. After the turn, if the demands go uncontested, the chevrons are removed, indicating that the demands are now submitted.
kl73wo.zh: 选择每个地块右侧的黄色箭头会展开该国提出或为其提出的当前要求列表。在该列表中，未提交的要求会在回合结束提交之前用黄色尖括号括起。点击某项未提交的要求会取消它，并退还从玩家战争贡献中扣除的点数。回合结束后，如果这些要求无争议，尖括号会被移除，表示这些要求现已提交。

cqxygr.en: The cost of each demand is influenced by a variety of factors, including the type of demand, the value of the demanded state, the negotiator’s ⟦0⟧, whether the beneficiary has a ⟦1⟧ or claim on the demand, proximity of the demand to states owned by the negotiator, and whether another victor is already making a demand or contest on it. War score is a finite resource, so the player will often be forced to prioritize those demands that are most valuable to them.
cqxygr.zh: 每项要求的花费受多种因素影响，包括要求类型、被要求州的价值、谈判方的⟦0⟧、受益方对该要求是否拥有⟦1⟧或宣称、该要求与谈判方拥有的州的邻近程度，以及是否有另一位胜利者已对它提出要求或争夺。战争贡献是有限的资源，因此玩家常常不得不优先考虑对自己最有价值的要求。

10kemhu.en: Selecting a demand type lists the demands available for the selected type, grouping them under ⟦0⟧. Country tiles represent either the defeated countries when take state or take navy types are selected, or subject/breakaway countries that will result when puppet, liberate, or change government types are selected. Green flag and red flag icons on each country tile provide an at-a-glance number of uncontested and contested demands for the associated country.
10kemhu.zh: 选择一种要求类型会列出该类型可用的要求，并按⟦0⟧分组。当选择「取得州」或「取得海军」类型时，国家地块代表战败国；当选择「傀儡」「解放」或「更换政府」类型时，它们代表将由此产生的附属国/分离国。每个国家地块上的绿旗和红旗图标可让人一眼看出该国家无争议和有争议要求的数量。

1d5ysgi.en: ⟦0⟧ = 2⟦1⟧ * ln(3⟦2⟧ + 5⟦3⟧ + ⟦4⟧ + 2) ÷ 20, where: f = tension factor, depending on demand type 2 if annexing a state with no core or claim[19] 0.5 if annexing a claim[20] 0 if annexing a core[21] 1.25 if puppeting a state[22] 0.75 if changing government of a state[23] b = total number of civilian factories, military factories, docks, and rocket sites in the state v = total number of victory points in the state r = total base resources in the state
1d5ysgi.zh: ⟦0⟧ = 2⟦1⟧ * ln(3⟦2⟧ + 5⟦3⟧ + ⟦4⟧ + 2) ÷ 20，其中：f = 紧张度系数，取决于要求类型 2 如果吞并一个没有核心或宣称的州[19] 0.5 如果吞并一个宣称[20] 0 如果吞并一个核心[21] 1.25 如果对某个州建立傀儡[22] 0.75 如果更换某个州的政府[23] b = 该州内民用工厂、军用工厂、船坞和火箭基地的总数 v = 该州内胜利点的总数 r = 该州内基础资源的总数

1am9p6k.en: Land combat damage and occupation tend to be the largest factors in war participation gain. Becoming proficient in combat will have a second-order effect of increasing war score in these areas. Naval and air combat are also excellent contributors for countries that can field an adequate navy and air force. Lend lease tends give the least return on investment and should be avoided when the materiel could be put to better use in the player’s military.
1am9p6k.zh: 陆战伤害和占领往往是战争参与度增长中最大的因素。精通战斗会产生提高这些方面战争贡献的次生效果。对于能够投入足够海军和空军的国家来说，海战和空战也是极佳的贡献来源。租借往往投资回报最低，当物资能在玩家军队中得到更好利用时，就应避免租借。

13g2o8q.en: The conference takes place over a series of ⟦0⟧. War score is distributed at the beginning of the conference if there is just one victor, or over the first five turns if there are multiple victors. During each turn, all victors may simultaneously select and submit demands for states or ships. If multiple victors submit conflicting demands, a ⟦1⟧ results and the victors may continue contesting it on subsequent turns until all but one have forfeited.
13g2o8q.zh: 会议在一系列⟦0⟧中进行。如果只有一位胜利者，战争贡献会在会议开始时分配；如果有多个胜利者，则在最初五个回合内分配。在每个回合中，所有胜利者可以同时为州或舰船选择并提交要求。如果多个胜利者提交了相互冲突的要求，就会产生⟦1⟧，胜利者可以在后续回合中继续争夺，直到除一方之外全部放弃。

1fsrx3a.en: The Confirm and Exit button signifies the conclusion of the conference for the player and the closure of the peace conference interface. The button is only available when there are no longer any unsubmitted demands in the Current Demands list. Upon selecting the Confirm and Exit button, a warning is displayed, urging the player to ascertain that all requisite actions pertaining to the peace conference have been completed prior to exiting.
1fsrx3a.zh: 「确认并退出」按钮表示玩家方面会议的结束以及和平会议界面的关闭。只有当「当前要求」列表中没有未提交的要求时，该按钮才可用。选择「确认并退出」按钮后会显示警告，敦促玩家在退出前确认与和平会议相关的所有必要操作均已完成。

1iok82t.en: The turn ends when each participant submits their demands; in the player’s case, this occurs upon selecting the Submit Demands button. At the end of each turn, the game evaluates all demands to determine if there are any contests. Demands submitted by only one victor are considered uncontested and are essentially granted to that victor until another victor decides to select that demand in a future turn or until the conference ends.
1iok82t.zh: 当每位参与者提交其要求后，本回合结束；对玩家而言，这发生在选择「提交要求」按钮时。在每个回合结束时，游戏会评估所有要求以判定是否存在争夺。仅由一位胜利者提交的要求被视为无争议，并实质上授予该胜利者，直到另一位胜利者在未来回合决定选择该要求，或者直到会议结束。

146hfbx.en: Selecting the Beneficiaries button switches to the Beneficiaries list, displaying puppets and liberated countries that receive states from puppet and liberate demands made by the victors. This list is read-only and these countries cannot be directly selected in this panel as beneficiaries. Rather, their beneficiary status for a given state is determined by the available demands under their country tile in the Make Demands panel.
146hfbx.zh: 选择「受益方」按钮会切换到「受益方」列表，显示从胜利者提出的「傀儡」和「解放」要求中获得州的傀儡国和被解放国家。该列表为只读，这些国家不能在此面板中被直接选为受益方。相反，它们在某个州上的受益方身份由「提出要求」面板中其国家地块下可用的要求决定。

1u6wgyu.en: The minimum score per turn rate is 1.35 * 1000 * 0.2 * 0.05 = 13.5. Germany and the Soviet Union’s war score will be distributed to them in 20% increments for the first five turns. Because Lithuania has less than 5% of the war participation, it will be given its score at the minimum war score per turn rate of 13.5 until it has all 54 of its points. The distribution to these three countries is depicted in the below table.
1u6wgyu.zh: 每回合最低贡献率为 1.35 * 1000 * 0.2 * 0.05 = 13.5。德国和苏联的战争贡献将在最初五个回合以 20% 的增量分配给他们。由于立陶宛的战争参与度低于 5%，它将按每回合最低贡献率 13.5 获得其贡献，直到其全部 54 点分配完毕。这三个国家的分配情况见下表。

zef0p1.en: The information displayed for each demand includes the new cost to contest it, the type of demand and name of the state or ship, and the countries involved in the contest. Hovering over a contested demand displays a tooltip with additional information, including details on other victors' demands. The player can individually select demands from the list to take action on or use the Select All button.
zef0p1.zh: 每项要求显示的信息包括争夺它的新花费、要求类型以及州或舰船的名称，还有参与争夺的国家。将鼠标悬停在有争议的要求上会显示提示框，其中包含额外信息，包括其他胜利者要求的详情。玩家可以从列表中单独选择要求以采取行动，也可以使用「全选」按钮。

ehxx2u.en: An ⟦0⟧ of a multi-victor conference: Germany, the ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ declare war on Poland and win. The combined value of Poland’s states is 1000 points. Germany has 60% war participation, Soviet Union has 36% war participation, and Lithuania has 4%. The war score computed for each victor is: Germany: 1.35 * 1000 * 0.6 = 810 Soviet Union: 1.35 * 1000 * 0.36 = 486 Lithuania: 1.35 * 1000 * 0.04 = 54
ehxx2u.zh: 多胜利者会议的一个⟦0⟧：德国、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧对波兰宣战并获胜。波兰各州的合并价值为 1000 点。德国拥有 60% 战争参与度，苏联拥有 36% 战争参与度，立陶宛拥有 4%。为每位胜利者计算出的战争贡献为：德国：1.35 * 1000 * 0.6 = 810 苏联：1.35 * 1000 * 0.36 = 486 立陶宛：1.35 * 1000 * 0.04 = 54

1sbae1n.en: If multiple participants make demands on the same state (regardless of demand type) or ship, such demands become contested. The player is refunded the war score spent on any contested demands and presented with the Contested Demands window. The player can decide to continue contesting selected demands at an increased cost, at which point the refunded war score goes back into the contest.
1sbae1n.zh: 如果多个参与者对同一个州（无论要求类型如何）或同一艘舰船提出要求，这些要求就会变为有争议。玩家会获得对任何有争议要求所花费的战争贡献的退款，并看到「有争议的要求」窗口。玩家可以决定以更高的花费继续争夺选定的要求，此时退款的战争贡献会重新投入争夺。

hscy4m.en: The top part of the peace conference interface displays world tension effects resulting from selected demands and the player’s currently available war score. Below the current war score is the current conference turn. To the right of this value is the war score that will be issued to the player at the start of the next turn and how many turns remain to issue the remaining war score.
hscy4m.zh: 和平会议界面的顶部显示所选要求带来的世界紧张度影响以及玩家当前可用的战争贡献。当前战争贡献下方是当前会议回合。该数值右侧是将于下一回合开始时发放给玩家的战争贡献，以及用于发放剩余战争贡献所剩的回合数。

1jahc9x.en: For single-victor conferences, these techniques will free up more war score for other demands (take navy, reparations, etc.). With no pressure from other victors, the player can use influence from annexations over a number of turns to work their way around the country, from cheapest to most expensive states, with significant cumulative savings by the time the last state is annexed.
1jahc9x.zh: 对于只有一位胜利者的会议，这些技巧能腾出更多战争贡献用于其他要求（取得海军、赔款等）。在没有其他胜利者压力的情况下，玩家可以利用多个回合中吞并带来的影响力，从最便宜的州到最昂贵的州逐步处理整个国家，到最后一个州被吞并时已累计节省了大量花费。

1v5w17c.en: As an ⟦0⟧, at the start of 1936, the German state of Rhineland has a state value of 205.5, based on the following: Base value: 10 Manpower: 6,150,000 ÷ 100,000 = 61.5 Base resources: 35 steel Buildings: 99 State category (Megalopolis): 48 Military factories: 3 * 8 = 24 Civilian factories: 4 * 5 = 20 Infrastructure: 4 * 1 = 4 Air bases: 3 * 1 = 3 Total: 10 + 61.5 + 35 + 99 = 205.5

jdd66h.en: The effects of both modifiers are stackable for puppeting/forcing government actions. The player may, for example, annex a cheap state and puppet another cheap state on turn one, and then puppet additional states on subsequent turns with both modifiers multiplied by each other for a larger discount (the annexed state may be transferred to the puppet after the conference).
jdd66h.zh: 对于建立傀儡/强制更换政府的行动，两种修正值的效果可以叠加。例如，玩家可以在第一回合吞并一个便宜的州并对另一个便宜的州建立傀儡，然后在后续回合建立更多傀儡，此时两种修正值彼此相乘会带来更大折扣（被吞并的州可以在会议后转交给该傀儡国）。

1inrj6m.en: Influence – Demands on a state are cheaper when the player has control of states nearby, especially if they are on the border; this includes states the player successfully annexes during the conference regardless of how much they cost. This allows a player to annex a cheap state on one turn, and get a discount on more expensive states nearby on subsequent turns.
1inrj6m.zh: 影响力——当玩家控制附近的州时，对某个州的要求会更便宜，尤其是当这些州位于边境时；这包括玩家在会议期间成功吞并的州，无论其花费多少。这使玩家能够在一个回合吞并一个便宜的州，并在后续回合对附近更昂贵的州获得折扣。

q3ojzk.en: The following information is provided to give players a much more in depth understanding of how the conference mechanics work and how various values are calculated. This information is subject to change in future patches, so the reader is encouraged to check the most recent patch change logs in case recent updates have outpaced the management of this article.
q3ojzk.zh: 以下信息旨在让玩家更深入地理解会议机制如何运作以及各种数值如何计算。这些信息可能会在未来补丁中发生变化，因此鼓励读者查看最新的补丁更新日志，以防最近的更新已使本文的管理工作落后于版本。

14u2au9.en: Taking ships increases tension by 0.25 per capital ship.⟦0⟧ DMZ, resource rights, reparations, and dismantle military industry demands are calculated as 0.25 times the base threat associated with the state.⟦1⟧ All tension resulting from the peace conference, whether a net increase or decrease, is credited to the country that the enemy faction capitulated to.
14u2au9.zh: 取得舰船会每艘主力舰提高 0.25 紧张度。⟦0⟧非军事区、资源权、赔款和拆除军事工业要求按与该州相关的基础威胁乘以 0.25 计算。⟦1⟧和平会议产生的所有紧张度变化，无论是净增加还是净减少，都记在敌方阵营向其投降的那个国家名下。

loi6jh.en: Continuous political action – Once the player makes a puppet or force government demand on a loser, all puppet and force government demands on the same loser will be 15% cheaper on subsequent turns. This allows the player to puppet or force one cheap state on one turn, and then get discounts on more expensive states of the losing country on subsequent turns.
loi6jh.zh: 持续政治行动——一旦玩家对某个失败方提出建立傀儡或强制更换政府的要求，在后续回合中对同一个失败方的所有建立傀儡和强制更换政府要求都会便宜 15%。这使玩家能够在一个回合对某个便宜州建立傀儡或强制更换政府，然后在后续回合对失败国更昂贵的州获得折扣。

1hdh27o.en: For take navy demands, the game lists each capital ship (carriers, battleships, and heavy cruisers) and then allots a share of the country’s screen ships (light cruisers, destroyers, and submarines) to each. The cost of each demand is the sum of the capital ship’s IC (i.e., ⟦0⟧) multiplied by 0.005⟦1⟧ and the screening ships’ IC multiplied by 0.005.⟦2⟧
1hdh27o.zh: 对于取得海军要求，游戏会列出每艘主力舰（航空母舰、战列舰和重型巡洋舰），然后为该舰分配该国屏卫舰（轻型巡洋舰、驱逐舰和潜艇）中的一份。每项要求的花费等于该主力舰的IC（即⟦0⟧）乘以 0.005⟦1⟧再加上屏卫舰的IC乘以 0.005。⟦2⟧

b6od83.en: There is a ⟦0⟧ rate, calculated as 5% of the total war score awarded to all countries per turn. This goes into effect for any country with less than 5% war participation (assuming game rules do not redistribute their score), awarding them the minimum value until all of their score is distributed to them, potentially before the fifth turn.⟦1⟧
b6od83.zh: 存在一个⟦0⟧速率，按每回合授予所有国家的战争贡献总量的 5% 计算。它会对比战争参与度低于 5% 的任何国家生效（假设游戏规则不重新分配其贡献），向它们发放这一最低值，直到其全部贡献都分配完毕，有可能在第五回合之前就完成。⟦1⟧

16iil3d.en: In the event a contest between AI negotiators extends beyond two turns, a tie breaker function compares each negotiator's remaining war score, influence distance to the demanded state, and country score. As these factors are weighed evenly, the negotiator with the greater average of these factors is more likely to win the tie breaker.⟦0⟧
16iil3d.zh: 如果 AI 谈判方之间的争夺持续超过两个回合，就会启动平局裁决功能，比较各谈判方剩余的战争贡献、到被要求州的影响力距离以及国家得分。由于这些因素权重相同，这些因素平均值更高的谈判方更有可能赢得平局裁决。⟦0⟧

42p8nm.en: During a war, belligerents on both sides accumulate war participation, a percentage that represents the relative contribution they make to their side of the war. The capitulation or conditional surrender of one side ends the war, computes the ⟦0⟧ of each victor based on their war participation, and opens the peace conference interface.
42p8nm.zh: 在战争期间，双方的交战国都会积累战争参与度，这是一个表示它们对自己一方所做相对贡献的百分比。一方的投降或有条件投降会结束战争，根据各胜利者的战争参与度计算其⟦0⟧，并打开和平会议界面。

1agrxqh.en: In all cases, if the AI has a net 0 or less desire on a state, it will not make demands on it, even if it has the war score to do so. Puppets will generally not make demands at all unless it is on their own cores and claims, or on behalf of their overlord/allies for their cores and claims. The AI has not been observed demanding ships.
1agrxqh.zh: 在所有情况下，如果 AI 对某个州的净欲望为 0 或更低，它就不会对该州提出要求，即使它有足够的战争贡献这样做。傀儡国通常根本不会提出要求，除非是针对它们自己的核心和宣称，或是代表其宗主国/盟友针对他们的核心和宣称。尚未观察到 AI 索取舰船。

1861k7w.en: AI victors can be unpredictable in contests and AI puppets are particularly wasteful of war score. If an AI ally is not essential for defeating an enemy, keeping them out of the war will go a long way toward giving the player more control of the conference and ensure all states are properly dispositioned (i.e., taken, puppeted, etc.).
1861k7w.zh: AI 胜利者在争夺中可能难以预测，而 AI 傀儡国尤其会浪费战争贡献。如果 AI 盟友对于击败敌人并非必不可少，让它们不参战将大大有助于让玩家更好地掌控会议，并确保所有州都得到妥善处置（即被取得、建立傀儡等）。

1gd4tey.en: Liberate demands – Liberates the selected state to the country that has a core or claim on it based on game scripting. If the receiving country does not exist, it will be created. Its ideology will be the ideology of its original tag, unless it changes during the game, in which case it will be its last ideology before becoming ⟦0⟧.
1gd4tey.zh: 解放要求——根据游戏脚本，把选定的州解放给对其拥有核心或宣称的国家。如果接收国不存在，它将被创建。其意识形态将是其原始 tag 的意识形态，除非它在游戏过程中发生了改变，这种情况下将是它变成⟦0⟧之前的最后一个意识形态。

6c1uvv.en: The remainder of each country’s demands list shows submitted demands from previous turns organized by loser and demand type. Victors cannot cancel their submitted demands from a previous turn unless another victor decides to contest it. When a victor leaves the conference, a green checkmark appears in its country tile.
6c1uvv.zh: 每个国家要求列表的其余部分显示前几个回合已提交的要求，按失败方和要求类型排列。胜利者无法取消前几个回合已提交的要求，除非另一位胜利者决定争夺它。当某位胜利者离开会议时，其国家地块中会出现一个绿色对勾。

poiid8.en: Demand costs for each state are computed by multiplying the state’s value by various modifiers. Costs will vary between victors for a particular demand due to the victor's characteristics, the defeated state's characteristics, and demands already made on the state. The cost cap for any single demand is 9999 points.⟦0⟧
poiid8.zh: 每个州的要求花费通过将该州的价值乘以各种修正值计算得出。由于胜利者的特征、战败州的特征以及已对该州提出的要求不同，同一项要求在不同胜利者之间的花费会有所差异。任何单项要求的花费上限为 9999 点。⟦0⟧

14o3qjg.en: The Reset button, located at the bottom of the Make Demands panel, enables the player to cancel all unsubmitted demands within the current turn, thereby returning the war score to its original value. It should be noted that this button has no effect on any demands that have already been submitted in a previous turn.
14o3qjg.zh: 位于「提出要求」面板底部的「重置」按钮使玩家能够取消当前回合内所有未提交的要求，从而将战争贡献恢复到原值。应当注意，该按钮对前几个回合已经提交的任何要求都没有影响。

85119q.en: During each turn, all victors in the conference get to make demands simultaneously. Players make demands either on their own behalf or on another victor’s behalf by selecting the victor’s country tile from the Current Demands panel. If making demands on another’s behalf, only the take states type may be selected.
85119q.zh: 在每个回合中，会议中的所有胜利者都可以同时提出要求。玩家可以代表自己提出要求，也可以通过从「当前要求」面板中选择某位胜利者的国家地块来代表另一位胜利者提出要求。如果代表他人提出要求，则只能选择「取得州」类型。

brto9h.en: Additional cost modifiers exist based on country-specific scripting, often categorized as ⟦0⟧. A major example is the Yalta Conference event which, if agreed to by both the western and Soviet leaders, results in the following cost modifiers in the eventual peace conference between the Allies, Axis, and Comintern:
brto9h.zh: 还存在基于特定国家脚本的额外花费修正值，通常归类为⟦0⟧。一个主要例子是雅尔塔会议事件，如果西方领导人和苏联领导人都同意，就会在随后同盟国、轴心国和共产国际之间的和平会议中产生以下花费修正值：

ik3taq.en: The computed state value is displayed in a tooltip when hovering over a demand in the peace conference; holding the ⟦0⟧ key during this hover displays a breakdown of the four constituent values. In non-⟦1⟧ games, the player can also view the state value by enabling tdebug in the ⟦2⟧ and hovering over any state.
ik3taq.zh: 计算出的州价值会在和平会议中把鼠标悬停在一项要求上时显示在提示框中；悬停期间按住⟦0⟧键会显示四个构成数值的明细。在非⟦1⟧游戏中，玩家还可以在⟦2⟧中启用 tdebug 并将鼠标悬停在任意州上来查看州价值。

z4y2di.en: As an ⟦0⟧: Rhineland has a state value of 205.5 and the player, as democratic ⟦1⟧, has captured it and wants to annex it. Assuming the cost modifiers in effect are Ideology (1.3), Influence (0.77), and Occupation (0.8): Combined cost modifier is: 1.3 * 0.77 * 0.8 = 0.8 Cost to take state is: 0.8 * 205.5 = 164.4
z4y2di.zh: 作为一个⟦0⟧：莱茵兰州的价值为 205.5，玩家作为民主制⟦1⟧占领了它并想吞并它。假设生效的花费修正值为意识形态（1.3）、影响力（0.77）和占领（0.8）：合并花费修正值为：1.3 * 0.77 * 0.8 = 0.8 取得该州的花费为：0.8 * 205.5 = 164.4

11edwzv.en: If another victor submits the same demand as the player, on the next turn the war score spent on the demand is refunded and the Contested Demands window will display. The Contested Demands window displays the total number of contested demands, the total war score refunded, and a list of the contested demands.
11edwzv.zh: 如果另一位胜利者提交了与玩家相同的要求，那么下一回合用于该要求的战争贡献会被退还，并会显示「有争议的要求」窗口。「有争议的要求」窗口显示有争议要求的总数、退还的战争贡献总量，以及有争议要求的列表。

1j0ai23.en: Take Navy demands – Acquires the defeated country’s ⟦0⟧ (carriers, battleships, heavy cruisers). Individual screening ships (light cruisers, destroyers, submarines) are not listed; instead, a proportional number of the loser’s screening ships are automatically included with the demand for each capital ship.
1j0ai23.zh: 取得海军要求——获取战败国的⟦0⟧（航空母舰、战列舰、重型巡洋舰）。单独的屏卫舰（轻型巡洋舰、驱逐舰、潜艇）不会列出；而是会在对每艘主力舰的要求中自动按比例附带失败方的一部分屏卫舰。

1q1rqpr.en: Multiple countries if they are in a faction and the majors of that faction were all capitulated. Any non-major countries in the faction that were participating in the war will automatically be capitulated. Countries in a losing faction that were not involved in the war are omitted from the peace conference.
1q1rqpr.zh: 多个国家，如果它们同属一个阵营且该阵营的主要国家全部投降。该阵营中参与战争的所有非主要国家将自动投降。失败阵营中未参战的国家会被排除在和平会议之外。

1pmhfmk.en: If a faction leader requests a conditional surrender via ⟦0⟧ and it is accepted, they along with their fellow faction members will comprise the losing side, and the winning side will consist of the faction leader that received the surrender along with their faction members. Other factions will be excluded.
1pmhfmk.zh: 如果阵营领袖通过⟦0⟧请求有条件投降并被接受，那么该领袖及其阵营成员将构成失败方，而获胜方将由接受投降的阵营领袖及其阵营成员组成。其他阵营将被排除在外。

mdageh.en: The peace conference ends when all participants exit the conference; for the player this occurs upon selecting the Confirm and Exit button. The player will be pulled back into the conference if other victors contest their demands (unlikely when playing against the AI, but possible in multiplayer games).
mdageh.zh: 当所有参与者退出会议时，和平会议结束；对玩家而言，这发生在选择「确认并退出」按钮时。如果其他胜利者争夺玩家的要求，玩家会被拉回会议中（在与 AI 对战时不太可能，但在多人游戏中可能发生）。

sg07ba.en: If the player decides to forfeit, they keep the refunded war score. The amount of war score refunded depends on how many turns the demand has been contested, with the score fully refunded on the first turn of contesting, but on each subsequent turn, this refund is reduced by 8% down to a low of 76%.⟦0⟧
sg07ba.zh: 如果玩家决定放弃，他们可以保留退还的战争贡献。退还的战争贡献数量取决于该要求已被争夺的回合数：在争夺的第一个回合全额退还，但在之后的每个回合中，退款会减少 8%，最低降至 76%。⟦0⟧

1we9gt4.en: An ⟦0⟧ of a single-victor conference: the USA declares war on ⟦1⟧ and easily wins. The combined value of Cuba’s states is 120 points. USA is the only victor. The war score computed for the USA is: 1.35 * 120 * 1.0 = 162. All 162 points are distributed to the USA at the beginning of the conference.
1we9gt4.zh: 单胜利者会议的一个⟦0⟧：美国对⟦1⟧宣战并轻松获胜。古巴各州的合并价值为 120 点。美国是唯一的胜利者。为美国计算出的战争贡献为：1.35 * 120 * 1.0 = 162。全部 162 点在会议开始时分配给美国。

hizrnf.en: Countries that are members of the winning faction, had been earlier occupied by the losing faction, and subsequently had half or more of their victory points occupied by a third-party faction fighting the losing faction (a common example is ⟦0⟧ at the end of the war in historic gameplay).
hizrnf.zh: 属于获胜阵营、此前曾被失败阵营占领，随后其半数或更多胜利点被与失败阵营作战的第三方阵营占领的国家（一个常见例子是史实游戏后期⟦0⟧）。

17ge13y.en: Add Resource Rights demands – Makes the state’s ⟦0⟧ available to the negotiator for five years. The resources depicted for each state on the map reflect the potential resources after upgrades and may appear higher than what will initially be received upon conclusion of the conference.
17ge13y.zh: 添加资源权要求——使该州的⟦0⟧在五年内可供谈判方使用。地图上为每个州显示的资源反映的是升级后的潜在资源，可能看起来高于会议结束时实际获得的资源。

1fihel.en: For non-democratic nations, collaboration governments created through the espionage mechanics allow the player to take advantage of the Compliance cost modifier. This often requires performing two collaboration missions, so the player must weigh their cost versus benefit.
1fihel.zh: 对于非民主国家，通过间谍活动机制建立的合作政府使玩家能够利用顺从度花费修正值。这通常需要执行两次合作任务，因此玩家必须权衡其成本与收益。

ow9ale.en: As an ⟦0⟧, Germany demands a converted battleship hull carrier in the conference from the UK, which comes with 13 destroyers. The carrier has an IC cost of about 9000 while each destroyer has an IC cost of 1000. The total cost is 9000 * 0.005 + 13 * 1000 * 0.005 = 110.
ow9ale.zh: 作为一个⟦0⟧，德国在会议中向英国索要一艘由战列舰舰体改装而成的航空母舰，该舰附带 13 艘驱逐舰。该航空母舰的IC花费约为 9000，而每艘驱逐舰的IC花费为 1000。总花费为 9000 * 0.005 + 13 * 1000 * 0.005 = 110。

1fjokpa.en: Selecting Close will close the Contested Demands window without making a decision. The Submit Demands button will be relabeled Contested Bids, and selecting it will prompt the player with the Contested Demands window to make a decision before ending the turn.
1fjokpa.zh: 选择「关闭」会关闭「有争议的要求」窗口而不做决定。「提交要求」按钮将被重新标记为「有争议的投标」，选择它会提示玩家打开「有争议的要求」窗口，在结束回合前做出决定。

uxoeaw.en: Each state’s value is used to compute ⟦0⟧ distributed to victors as well as ⟦1⟧ and is the sum of the state’s base value, resources, ⟦2⟧, and buildings. These values may change before and after the conference, but remain static during the peace conference.
uxoeaw.zh: 每个州的价值用于计算分配给胜利者的⟦0⟧以及⟦1⟧，它是该州基础价值、资源、⟦2⟧和建筑的总和。这些数值在会议前后可能会变化，但在和平会议期间保持固定。

1tmpahc.en: ⟦0⟧ – The country that will end up as the new owner of the demand. This is often the same as the negotiator, unless the demand is on behalf of another victor or is a demand type that results in a ⟦1⟧, liberated country, or forced change of government.
1tmpahc.zh: ⟦0⟧——最终将成为该要求新所有者的国家。这通常与谈判方相同，除非该要求是代表另一位胜利者提出的，或者属于会产生⟦1⟧、被解放国家或被迫更换政府的类型。

ghpll6.en: Selecting a demand will add it as an ⟦0⟧ in the Current Demands panel and will deduct the associated demand costs from the available war score. Clicking the demand again will cancel the un-submitted demand, refunding the war score.
ghpll6.zh: 选择一项要求会把它作为⟦0⟧加入「当前要求」面板，并从可用战争贡献中扣除相关的要求花费。再次点击该要求会取消未提交的要求，退还战争贡献。

1diens2.en: Take State demands – Annexes the selected state to the negotiator’s country. The player also has the option to select a different victor as beneficiary of the annexation by selecting its country tile in the Current Demands panel.
1diens2.zh: 取得州要求——把选定的州吞并给谈判方所属国家。玩家还可以通过在「当前要求」面板中选择另一位胜利者的国家地块，将其指定为这次吞并的受益方。

157eies.en: The winning side will consist of all countries, whether allied or not, that were at war with the losing country or faction. It is possible for victorious countries in a conference to be in separate wars against each other.
157eies.zh: 获胜方将包括所有与失败国或失败阵营交战的国家，无论是否为盟国。会议中的获胜国家之间有可能彼此处于不同的战争中。

1o3wn2l.en: Liberating states will decrease tension by an amount that varies depending on the characteristics of the negotiator and the losing country (primarily number of production buildings)⟦0⟧ multiplied by a factor of -1.0.⟦1⟧
1o3wn2l.zh: 解放州会降低紧张度，降低量因谈判方和失败国的特征（主要是生产建筑数量）而异⟦0⟧，再乘以 -1.0 的系数。⟦1⟧

12tsjw6.en: The peace conference’s complex mechanics make it impossible to provide comprehensive guidelines for every scenario; however, the following techniques may prove useful depending on the makeup of the conference.
12tsjw6.zh: 和平会议复杂的机制使得无法为每种情形提供全面的指导；不过，根据会议的构成，以下技巧可能会有所帮助。

uql8t8.en: The AI employs a complex set of generic and country-specific rules when weighing its desire to make demands on states. A high-level summary of generic AI behavior in the peace conference is provided below.⟦0⟧
uql8t8.zh: AI 在权衡对各个州提出要求的欲望时会采用一套复杂的通用规则和特定国家规则。下面提供了和平会议中 AI 通用行为的高层次概述。⟦0⟧

l1iav7.en: For multi-victor conferences, the player can still benefit from these techniques but must balance the number of turns required to take advantage of it with the pressure that will come from competing victors.
l1iav7.zh: 对于多胜利者会议，玩家仍然可以从这些技巧中受益，但必须在使用它所需要消耗的回合数与来自竞争胜利者的压力之间取得平衡。

1bg5m4l.en: Puppet demands – Creates a puppet with the selected state or adds it to an existing puppet subject to the negotiator, if applicable. Democratic negotiators can only create ⟦0⟧ puppets from these demands.
1bg5m4l.zh: 傀儡要求——用选定的州创建一个傀儡国，或在适用时将其加入谈判方名下现有的傀儡附属国。民主制谈判方通过这些要求只能创建⟦0⟧傀儡国。

orpaoo.en: Starts at 1.15 once a negotiator demands a state, increasing each turn while state is uncontested by multiplying 1.15 by itself plus 0.15 each turn up to 1.6, until contested or until capped at 15.
orpaoo.zh: 从 1.15 开始，一旦谈判方索要某个州，在该州无争议期间每回合按「1.15 乘以自身再加 0.15」的方式递增，最高到 1.6，直到该州陷入争议或达到 15 的上限。

s3qnc5.en: Hovering over the war score values provides a tooltip summarizing the total war score the player is entitled to, including what is currently available and what they will receive in future turns.
s3qnc5.zh: 将鼠标悬停在战争贡献数值上会显示提示框，概述玩家有权获得的战争贡献总量，包括当前可用量和未来回合将获得的量。

gjnx43.en: Buildings – Sum of point values for the state's category plus points for each ⟦0⟧ type and level. The below table lists the values associated with state categories⟦1⟧ and buildings.⟦2⟧
gjnx43.zh: 建筑——州类别的点数价值加上每种⟦0⟧类型和等级的点数之和。下表列出了与州类别⟦1⟧和建筑相关的数值。⟦2⟧

cam0bw.en: The decisions made in this window do not prevent the player from subsequently selecting or deselecting the same demands from the conference interface prior to ending the turn.
cam0bw.zh: 在此窗口中做出的决定不会阻止玩家在结束回合前从会议界面中随后选择或取消选择相同的要求。

1umrcb4.en: Selecting Forfeit will give up on the selected demands, allowing the player to keep the refunded war score. Selecting Demand will continue contesting the selected demands.
1umrcb4.zh: 选择「放弃」会放弃选定的要求，使玩家保留退还的战争贡献。选择「要求」将继续争夺选定的要求。

uvdjtc.en: The peace conference begins with distribution of ⟦0⟧, a political currency used to bid on available demands. The war score awarded to each victor is calculated as follows:
uvdjtc.zh: 和平会议从分配⟦0⟧开始，这是一种用于对可用要求投标的政治货币。授予每位胜利者的战争贡献计算如下：

1enyr78.en: Selections in the Make Demands panel are added in the Current Demands panel on the right side of the interface, which consists of the Victors list and Beneficiaries list.
1enyr78.zh: 在「提出要求」面板中的选择会加入界面右侧的「当前要求」面板，该面板由「胜利者」列表和「受益方」列表组成。

b734t0.en: Starts at 1.2 once a state is contested, increasing each turn while state is contested by multiplying 1.2 by itself until no longer contested or until capped at 15.
b734t0.zh: 一旦某个州陷入争议就从 1.2 开始，在该州存在争议期间每回合将 1.2 乘以自身递增，直到不再有争议或达到 15 的上限。

16ikujh.en: These types of cost modifiers may persist after the peace conference, which may result in undesirable demand costs if conflict re-ignites over the same territory.
16ikujh.zh: 这些类型的花费修正值可能在和平会议之后仍然存在，如果围绕同一片领土再次爆发冲突，可能会导致不理想的要求花费。

1qiq7q4.en: The DMZ, Resource Rights, Reparation, and Dismantle Military Industry options are available only in conjunction with puppet or change government demands.
1qiq7q4.zh: 非军事区、资源权、赔款和拆除军事工业选项只能与建立傀儡或更换政府要求结合使用。

1uwzel2.en: Change Government demands – Creates an independent country from the selected state, but its government will have the same ideology as the negotiator’s.
1uwzel2.zh: 更换政府要求——用选定的州创建一个独立国家，但其政府将拥有与谈判方相同的意识形态。

1vzfnum.en: Resources – Sum of all base resources in the state.⟦0⟧ Resources generated by buildings (e.g., oil refineries) are not included in this calculation.

1c1mzv0.en: Götterdämmerung introduced the Assault Engineer Company and Armored Engineer Company as a variants of the engineer support company. They are made available after completing the Military Engineering Vehicles special project, though the Armored Engineer Company also requires having completed the 1938 Armored Engineer Company technology. These use armored support vehicle equipment in place of some support equipment and infantry equipment. The equipment differences mean they have increased production cost and add fuel usage to the division, increase its supply use, and reduce its Defense, but they can also provide some additional Armor, Piercing, Soft Attack, Hard Attack, and Breakthrough to the division depending on the equipment variant(s) used. Assault engineers trade most of the engineers' terrain defense and movement bonuses for terrain attack bonuses, and they also provide significant attack and movement bonuses in urban terrain. Instead of providing additional entrenchment to leg infantry battalions, they provide addition breakthrough to those battalions. Armored engineers lose defense bonuses in jungle, marsh, and river terrain compared to regular engineers, but give greater movement bonuses in more terrain types, and provide additional attack bonuses in rivers, forts, and urban terrain as well as in amphibious environments (naval invasions). Armored engineers also provide additional Breakthrough to armor battalions. Tech upgrades to engineers also provide these two support companies with similar bonuses, with assault engineers receiving greater attack bonuses but no defense bonuses and armored engineers receiving greater defense bonuses but no attack bonuses. Due to these differences, assault engineers are best used in offensive divisions, while armored engineers are more niche and best used for defensive divisions that are meant to guard key provinces important enough to justify the increased production costs, especially urban provinces.
1c1mzv0.zh: 「诸神黄昏」引入了突击工兵连和装甲工兵连，作为工兵支援连的变体。它们在完成「军用工程车辆」特殊项目后可用，不过装甲工兵连还要求已完成 1938 年的装甲工兵连科技。它们使用装甲支援车辆装备来替代部分支援装备和步兵装备。装备上的差别意味着它们的生产成本更高，并会给师增加燃料消耗、提高其补给消耗、降低其防御，但根据所使用的装备变体，它们也能为所属师提供一些额外的装甲、穿透、软攻、硬攻和突破。突击工兵用大部分工兵的地形防御和移动加成换来地形进攻加成，并且它们在城市地形中还能提供可观的进攻和移动加成。它们不为徒步步兵营提供额外工事，而是为这些营提供额外突破。与普通工兵相比，装甲工兵失去了丛林、沼泽和河流地形中的防御加成，但在更多地形类型中提供更高的移动加成，并在河流、要塞和城市地形以及两栖环境（海军登陆）中提供额外的进攻加成。装甲工兵还为装甲营提供额外突破。工兵的科技升级也会为这两个支援连提供类似的加成：突击工兵获得更高的进攻加成但没有防御加成，装甲工兵获得更高的防御加成但没有进攻加成。由于这些差异，突击工兵最适合用于进攻型师，而装甲工兵则更为小众，最适合用于防守型师——这些师负责守卫重要到足以证明其更高生产成本合理的重点省份，尤其是城市省份。

jb12fz.en: Armored Signal Company is a variant of the signal company made available after completing the 1938 technology of the same name that requires having completed the Military Engineering Vehicles special project. It uses armored support vehicle equipment in place of some support equipment and truck equipment. The equipment differences mean it has increased production cost and adds fuel usage to any division it is added to, but it can also provides some additional Armor, Piercing, Soft Attack, Hard Attack, Defense, and Breakthrough to the division depending on the equipment variant(s) used. Compared to a signal company, it also provides additional Breakthrough to armor battalions. Without any upgrades, it gives more Initiative than a regular signal company, but from the 1939 signal company upgrade onwards, it provides less Initiative than a regular signal company. Upgrades to armored signal companies do increase the bonus Initiative they give (albeit at a much lower rate than for regular signal companies), and they also increase the additional Breakthrough they provide to armor battalions. Because dedicated tank-heavy divisions tend to have fairly high Breakthrough already and the main benefit of using armored or regular signal companies would be the bonus Initiative where armored signal companies provide an inferior bonus, armored signal companies are only better than regular signal companies in under niche circumstances, probably involving an offensive division that has just a few tank battalions that could benefit from the additional Breakthrough more.
jb12fz.zh: 装甲通讯连是通讯连的变体，在完成同名的 1938 年科技后可用，而该科技要求已完成「军用工程车辆」特殊项目。它使用装甲支援车辆装备来替代部分支援装备和卡车装备。装备上的差别意味着它的生产成本更高，并会给任何加入它的师增加燃料消耗，但根据所使用的装备变体，它也能为所属师提供一些额外的装甲、穿透、软攻、硬攻、防御和突破。与通讯连相比，它还为装甲营提供额外突破。在没有任何升级时，它提供的主动性高于普通通讯连，但从 1939 年的通讯连升级开始，它提供的主动性就低于普通通讯连。装甲通讯连的升级确实会提高其提供的主动性加成（尽管提升幅度远低于普通通讯连），同时也会提高它们为装甲营提供的额外突破。由于以坦克为主的专门师往往已经拥有相当高的突破，而使用装甲或普通通讯连的主要好处在于主动性加成——在这方面装甲通讯连提供的是较差的加成——因此装甲通讯连只在少数小众情况下才优于普通通讯连，很可能涉及一个只编有少量坦克营、能更多受益于额外突破的进攻型师。

1jdtffm.en: Additionally, recon companies can help to counter enemy tactics, should their tactics have counters available. The side with more reconnaissance points receives a flat bonus equivalent to ⟦0⟧ leader skill points. This is added to the ⟦1⟧'s skill level when determining which side picks their tactics second; the side that picks first has a disadvantage because the other side then knows which available tactics would counter the first side's tactic. It only matters that one side has more points than another, the magnitude of the difference does not matter. Each recon upgrade increases reconnaissance points, and the ⟦2⟧ options ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ increase reconnaissance points from recon companies as well. Helicopter brigade and motorized military police support companies also increase reconnaissance points and can be used in tandem with any recon company. Factors to consider in evaluating recon companies include the relative range of tactics available to each side, potential importance of counterable tactics to an army's warfighting (e.g., the Blitz and Breakthrough tactics can be very useful for tank divisions, but they are countered by the Elastic Defense and Backhand Blow tactics, respectively), and opposing commander skill levels. When multiple divisions in combat on the same side have multiple, different reconnaissance point values, only the highest value is used for that side.
1jdtffm.zh: 此外，如果敌方战术存在可用的克制战术，侦察连还能帮助克制敌方战术。侦察点数更多的一方会获得相当于⟦0⟧将领技能点的固定加成。在判定哪一方后选择战术时，该加成会计入⟦1⟧的技能等级；先选择的一方处于劣势，因为另一方随后就知道哪些可用战术能克制先选方的战术。重要的只是一方点数比另一方多，差距大小无关紧要。每次侦察升级都会提高侦察点数，⟦2⟧选项中的⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧也会提高侦察连提供的侦察点数。直升机旅和摩托化军事警察支援连同样会提高侦察点数，并可与任何侦察连搭配使用。评估侦察连时需要考虑的因素包括：双方可用战术的相对范围、可被克制的战术对一支军队作战的潜在重要性（例如「闪电战」和「突破」战术对坦克师非常有用，但它们分别会被「弹性防御」和「反手一击」战术克制），以及双方指挥官的技能等级。当同一方参战的多个师拥有多个不同的侦察点数值时，该方只采用其中最高的数值。

17ir0fc.en: Helicopter Transports are a variant of the logistics company made available after completing the 1938 Helicopter Transport Company technology that requires having completed the Helicopters special project. It requires additional helicopter equipment in addition to the normal equipment required by a logistics company. This means it has increased production cost, but it also provides some additional Armor, Piercing, Defense, and Breakthrough to the division. Unlike other helicopter support company variants, it does not add fuel usage to a division that does not have any to begin with, but it does increase fuel usage percentage-wise for any division that already has it instead of decreasing it the way a regular logistics company would. Otherwise, compared to a logistics company, helicopter transports provide additional movement speed in most terrain types. Upgrading helicopter tranports also provides bigger supply usage reductions compared to upgrading logistics companies, though their percentage-wise increase to fuel usage remains. As their only downsides compared to logistics companies come from them increasing fuel usage instead of decreasing it, they are straight upgrades to regular logistics companies for divisions that would not otherwise use fuel, such as infantry or special forces divisions without any armored or motorized support companies.
17ir0fc.zh: 直升机运输队是后勤连的变体，在完成 1938 年的直升机运输连科技后可用，而该科技要求已完成「直升机」特殊项目。除后勤连通常所需的装备外，它还需要额外的直升机装备。这意味着它的生产成本更高，但它也能为所属师提供一些额外的装甲、穿透、防御和突破。与其他直升机支援连变体不同，它不会给原本不消耗燃料的师增加燃料消耗，但对于已经消耗燃料的师，它会按百分比提高燃料消耗，而不是像普通后勤连那样降低消耗。除此之外，与后勤连相比，直升机运输队在大多数地形类型中提供额外的移动速度。升级直升机运输队所获得的补给消耗削减也比升级后勤连更大，不过其按百分比提高燃料消耗的效果依然存在。由于它们相对后勤连的唯一缺点在于提高而非降低燃料消耗，对于原本不会消耗燃料的师（例如没有任何装甲或摩托化支援连的步兵或特种部队师）来说，它们就是后勤连的纯粹升级版。

1kqb4ml.en: Götterdämmerung introduced the Helicopter Brigade support company, which is unlocked by completing the Helicopters special project. Where other helicopter support companies like helicopter recon, helicopter med-evac, and helicopter tranports are specialized alternatives to non-helicopter-based support companies, the helicopter brigade functions as something standalone that can be added to a division regardless of what other support companies it is using. On top of the extra Armor, Piercing, Defense, and Breakthrough that the company provides from its use of helicopter equipment, the helicopter brigade provides a mix of bonuses that the other three, more specialized companies would give: extra Reconnaissance, reduced Supply Use, extra manpower trickleback, extra war support protection, reduced XP loss from taking losses, and extra HP for infantry, motorized, and mechanized battalions. These bonuses, however, are only upgraded by the 1942 technology upgrades for recon companies, logistics companies, and field hospitals, which can make fully upgrading helicopter brigades more difficult compared to one of the specialized helicopter support companies. Unlike the more specialized companies though, helicopter brigades neither add fuel usage nor increase existing fuel usage.
1kqb4ml.zh: 「诸神黄昏」引入了直升机旅支援连，它通过完成「直升机」特殊项目解锁。直升机侦察、直升机医疗后送和直升机运输队等其他直升机支援连是非直升机支援连的专门替代品，而直升机旅则是一个独立存在的东西，无论师使用了其他哪些支援连都可以加入。除了该连因使用直升机装备而提供的额外装甲、穿透、防御和突破之外，直升机旅还提供其他三个更专门的连队所给加成的混合：额外侦察、降低补给消耗、额外人力回流、额外战争支持度保护、减少因伤亡而损失的经验值，以及为步兵、摩托化和机械化营提供额外HP。不过，这些加成只能通过 1942 年针对侦察连、后勤连和野战医院的科技升级来提升，这使得与某个专门的直升机支援连相比，把直升机旅完全升级更为困难。不过与那些更专门的连队不同，直升机旅既不会增加燃料消耗，也不会提高现有燃料消耗。

1aumiv2.en: Pioneers are a variant of the engineer support company available to all countries who have unlocked the ⟦0⟧ special forces doctrine. These give less entrenchment, remove their amphibious (naval invasions) attack bonus, do not give terrain bonuses in forest, hills, or jungle terrain, and give worse defense bonuses in marsh, rivers, and forts, but give more breakthrough (especially to marine battalions) and better attack bonuses in marsh, rivers, and forts. They can gain additional bonuses through special forces doctrine upgrades. Crucially, ⟦1⟧ restores some of their jungle terrain defense bonus and also has them provide attack and movement bonuses in jungle terrain, while ⟦2⟧ makes them provide amphibious (naval invasions) attack, defense, and movement bonuses that exceed engineer companies', but only one of these doctrinal bonuses can be active at a time. Pioneers are best used for offensive divisions fighting either across rivers in otherwise flat terrain or in terrain that matches their chosen special forces doctrine bonus. They are otherwise either on par with or inferior to regular engineer companies.
1aumiv2.zh: 先锋队是工兵支援连的变体，所有已解锁⟦0⟧特种部队学说的国家都可以使用。它们提供的工事更少，取消了其两栖（海军登陆）进攻加成，不在森林、丘陵或丛林地形中提供地形加成，在沼泽、河流和要塞中提供的防御加成也更差，但提供更多突破（尤其是对海军陆战营），并在沼泽、河流和要塞中提供更好的进攻加成。它们可以通过特种部队学说升级获得额外加成。关键在于，⟦1⟧会恢复其部分丛林地形防御加成，并让它们在丛林地形中提供进攻和移动加成，而⟦2⟧则让它们提供超过工兵连的两栖（海军登陆）进攻、防御和移动加成，但同一时间只能有一个这类学说加成生效。先锋队最适合用于在其他方面平坦的地形中渡河作战的进攻型师，或用于与其所选特种部队学说加成相匹配的地形。在其他情况下，它们要么与普通工兵连相当，要么不如普通工兵连。

1pajh8c.en: Armored Maintenance Company is a variant of the maintenance company made available after completing the 1938 technology of the same name that requires having completed the Military Engineering Vehicles special project. It uses armored support vehicle equipment in place of some support equipment and infantry equipment. The equipment differences mean it has increased production cost and adds fuel usage to any division it is added to, but it also provides some additional Armor, Piercing, Soft Attack, Hard Attack, Defense, and Breakthrough to the division depending on the equipment variant(s) used. Compared to maintenance companies, they also provide additional HP to armor battalions and add equipment recovery to attached divisions. Upgrades to armored maintenance companies provide lower reliability bonuses compared to upgrades to maintenance companies, but increased equipment capture ratios and equipment recovery rates, making them more useful in tank divisions, especially compared to regular maintenance companies.
1pajh8c.zh: 装甲维修连是维修连的变体，在完成同名的 1938 年科技后可用，而该科技要求已完成「军用工程车辆」特殊项目。它使用装甲支援车辆装备来替代部分支援装备和步兵装备。装备上的差别意味着它的生产成本更高，并会给任何加入它的师增加燃料消耗，但根据所使用的装备变体，它也能为所属师提供一些额外的装甲、穿透、软攻、硬攻、防御和突破。与维修连相比，它们还为装甲营提供额外HP，并为所属师增加装备回收。装甲维修连的升级相比维修连的升级提供的可靠性加成更低，但装备缴获率和装备回收率更高，这使它们在坦克师中更有用，尤其是与普通维修连相比。

sco8sa.en: Motorized Military Police is a variant of military police made available after completing the 1938 technology of the same name that requires having completed the Military Engineering Vehicles special project. It requires military motorcycle equipment in place of some support equipment and infantry equipment. The equipment differences mean it has increased production cost and adds fuel usage to any division it is added to, though this fuel usage is not applied to garrisons that use division templates containing motorized military police. Compared to military police, they have increased supply use, but provide additional Suppression as well as Reconnaissance that stacks with recon companies', and they gain the same benefits with improved technology as regular military police. However, as of 1.15.1, they do not benefit from the large suppression bonus granted by ⟦0⟧ to cavalry battalions, making them potentially give less Suppression to cavalry-heavy garrison templates compared to military police.
sco8sa.zh: 摩托化军事警察是军事警察的变体，在完成同名的 1938 年科技后可用，而该科技要求已完成「军用工程车辆」特殊项目。它需要军用摩托车装备来替代部分支援装备和步兵装备。装备上的差别意味着它的生产成本更高，并会给任何加入它的师增加燃料消耗，不过对于使用含摩托化军事警察的师编制的驻军，这一燃料消耗不会生效。与军事警察相比，它们的补给消耗更高，但提供额外镇压以及可与侦察连叠加的侦察。它们随科技进步获得与普通军事警察相同的收益。然而，截至 1.15.1，它们无法享受⟦0⟧授予骑兵营的高额镇压加成，这使得在以骑兵为主的驻军编制中，它们提供的镇压可能少于军事警察。

1nu72e.en: Helicopter Med-Evac is a variant of the field hospital company made available after completing the 1938 Helicopter Med-Evac Company technology that requires having completed the Helicopters special project. It requires helicopter equipment in place of some truck equipment. The equipment differences mean it has increased production cost and adds fuel usage to any division it is added to, but it also provides some additional Armor, Piercing, Defense, and Breakthrough to the division. Compared to field hospitals, helicopter med-evacs have greater supply use and provide less XP loss reduction and bonus HP, but they provide greater manpower trickleback and war support protection and provide additional Recovery Rate to all infantry, motorized, and mechanized battalions. Upgrading helicoptier med-evacs provides smaller bonuses to XP loss reduction compared to upgrading field hospitals, but instead provices greater bonuses to manpower trickleback, war support protection, and bonus Recovery Rate.
1nu72e.zh: 直升机医疗后送是野战医院连的变体，在完成 1938 年的直升机医疗后送连科技后可用，而该科技要求已完成「直升机」特殊项目。它需要直升机装备来替代部分卡车装备。装备上的差别意味着它的生产成本更高，并会给任何加入它的师增加燃料消耗，但它也能为所属师提供一些额外的装甲、穿透、防御和突破。与野战医院相比，直升机医疗后送的补给消耗更高，提供的经验值损失削减和额外HP更少，但提供更高的人力回流和战争支持度保护，并为所有步兵、摩托化和机械化营提供额外恢复率。升级直升机医疗后送相比升级野战医院提供的经验值损失削减加成更小，但反而提供更高的人力回流、战争支持度保护和额外恢复率加成。

raqstk.en: One example is if a division at the top of the reserves has a Signal Company, the division will be more likely to fill the hole in the front line faster. Without a Signal Company, the base chance to reinforce a battle (assuming that there is available width in the battlefield) is 2% every hour. This means there is a 50% chance that a division will have reinforced the battle within 35 hours. If the Radio technology has been researched, this increases to 4% chance to reinforce every hour, and there is then a 50% chance that the division will have reinforced the battle within 17 hours. The 1936 Signal Company increase Initiative by 10%, and every following upgrade adds 12% Initiative. Each 1% extra Initiative increases reinforce rate by 0.25%, meaning that 10% Initiative adds 2.5% to the reinforcement chance - thus, there is a 6.5% chance for the division to reinforce every hour. So a division with a 1936 Signal Company will have a 50% chance to reinforce a battle within 11 hours.
raqstk.zh: 一个例子是：如果预备队最上方的师编有通讯连，该师就更有可能更快填补前线的缺口。没有通讯连时，增援一场战斗的基础几率（假设战场上有可用宽度）是每小时 2%。这意味着一个师有 50% 的几率在 35 小时内增援该战斗。如果已研究无线电科技，则提高到每小时 4% 的增援几率，此时该师有 50% 的几率在 17 小时内增援该战斗。1936 年的通讯连提高 10% 主动性，此后每次升级再增加 12% 主动性。每 1% 的额外主动性使增援率提高 0.25%，也就是说 10% 主动性会让增援几率提高 2.5%——因此该师每小时有 6.5% 的增援几率。所以一个编有 1936 年通讯连的师有 50% 的几率在 11 小时内增援一场战斗。

4vmhbb.en: These provide a flat 10% reduction in supply consumption and a 5% reduction in fuel usage, which improves with upgrades. Since it's percentage based, they will provide the most benefit in the most supply-hungry divisions. Since artillery uses a lot of supplies, divisions with multiple artillery of any type (line/support/self-propelled) are the first place to look. Just open the division designer and compare the Supply Use stat before and after adding the company, then decide if it's worth it. Most large divisions are potential candidates. For infantry, keep in mind that when fighting in places with high infrastructure, where months of fighting can go by without units running low on supply, a logistics company provides no benefit. Creating a separate infantry division template specifically for low-supply areas is an option. Other divisions can use that support slot for more combat-related purposes.
4vmhbb.zh: 它们提供固定 10% 的补给消耗削减和 5% 的燃料消耗削减，并会随升级而提高。由于是按百分比计算，它们在补给需求最迫切的师中收益最大。由于火炮消耗大量补给，编有多个任何类型火炮（线列/支援/自行）的师是首先应该考虑的对象。只要打开师编制设计器，比较加入该连前后的补给消耗属性，然后决定是否值得。大多数大型师都是潜在候选。对于步兵，要记住在高基础设施地区作战时，可能连续数月战斗都不会出现部队补给不足，此时后勤连毫无收益。可以专门为低补给地区创建一个独立的步兵师编制。其他师则可以把那个支援连槽位用于更多与战斗相关的用途。

1ns9tmk.en: From an XP perspective, however, each soldier is worth more XP in a smaller division. So, it can be worth adding them to a small number of elite divisions. These could be things like marine or paratroop divisions, etc. Another possibility might be a regular infantry division that has already gained a high experience level on its own. By creating a duplicate template, a field hospital can be added to some divisions but not to otherwise identical ones, to help those high XP divisions keep their XP. The higher a division's XP gets, the more the average will be reduced by casualties (since replacements are always green). Deploying new divisions that have a field hospital while they are still green is a complete waste from the XP perspective. Therefore, you have more incentive to train new divisions up to regular before deployment when using field hospitals.
1ns9tmk.zh: 不过从经验值的角度来看，在较小的师中每名士兵所值的经验值更多。因此，把它们加入少量精锐师可能是值得的。这些师可以是海军陆战队或伞兵师等。另一种可能是已经自行积累了高经验等级的普通步兵师。通过创建一份重复的师编制，可以给某些师加上野战医院，而不给其他原本完全相同的师加上，以帮助那些高经验值师保持其经验值。一个师的经验值越高，伤亡对平均经验值的削减就越大（因为补充兵员永远是新手）。在师还是新手状态时部署带有野战医院的新师，从经验值角度看完全是浪费。因此，使用野战医院时，你更有动力在部署前把新师训练到「正规」水平。

1h87ubt.en: These provide three bonuses. First, with the 1936 hospital, 20% of the losses in combat get returned to the manpower pool rather than being lost forever, also removing the impact of those losses on War Support. Second, 10% less XP is lost from combat losses. Third, all infantry, motorized, and mechanized battalions provide 10% more HP, leading to fewer equipment losses from battle, especially on the attack. Upgrading field hospitals increases the first two of these bonuses. The more combat a division sees over time, the greater the overall benefit from a field hospital, especially when attacking in poorly supplied conditions. Conversely, they are a waste in a division unlikely to see sustained combat or likely to be eliminated if engaged in combat, such as some security, garrison, or coastal defense divisions.
1h87ubt.zh: 它们提供三项加成。第一，使用 1936 年医院时，战斗损失的 20% 会返回人力池而不是永久损失，同时也消除了这些损失对战争支持度的影响。第二，因战斗损失而损失的经验值减少 10%。第三，所有步兵、摩托化和机械化营提供 10% 更多HP，从而减少战斗中的装备损失，尤其是在进攻时。升级野战医院会提高前两项加成。一个师随着时间经历的战斗越多，野战医院带来的总体收益就越大，尤其是在补给不良的条件下进攻时。反过来，对于不太可能经历持续战斗、或者在交战时很可能被歼灭的师（例如某些安保、驻军或海岸防御师），它们就是浪费。

1k8pcj6.en: They provide roughly a 10% speed boost on most terrain, varies depending on cavalry, motorized, armored car, or light tank. This speed bonus does not increase with upgrades. Consider the value of increasing the infantry speed from 4 km/h to 4.4 km/h, or motorized/light tanks from 12 km/h to 13.2 km/h, and consider how this may combine with vehicle variants to achieve specific speed targets to outpace or overrun the enemy. The answers will vary from player to player and likely from division to division. For example, exploitation and envelopment divisions may find the extra speed valuable while assault and breakthrough divisions may not, although they may find the combat tactics bonus valuable in intense battles. The exact speed boost can be seen in this table:
1k8pcj6.zh: 它们在大多数地形上提供大约 10% 的速度加成，具体数值因骑兵、摩托化、装甲车或轻型坦克而异。该速度加成不会因升级而提高。请考虑把步兵速度从 4 km/h 提高到 4.4 km/h，或把摩托化/轻型坦克从 12 km/h 提高到 13.2 km/h 的价值，并考虑这可能如何与车辆变体结合以达到特定速度目标，从而超越或击溃敌人。答案会因玩家而异，也很可能因师而异。例如，扩张和包围型师可能会觉得额外速度很有价值，而突击和突破型师则未必，尽管它们可能在激烈战斗中发现战斗战术加成很有价值。确切的速度加成见下表：

nrjrag.en: Because of their diluted bonuses spread across so many things, helicopter brigades are most effective when they are paired up with one or two dedicated support companies for its roles while also acting as a minor replacement for a different dedicated support company. For example, if a division would previously have had both a logistics company and a field hospital and the player has decided to use it in a theater where supply usage is a huge concern but still wants to minimize manpower losses, it can be beneficial to swap out the field hospital for a helicopter brigade to get that extra bit of supply usage reduction without completely losing all of the field hospital's bonuses.
nrjrag.zh: 由于其加成被分散到如此多的方面而被稀释，直升机旅在与一到两个专门支援连搭配以承担其角色、同时又作为另一个专门支援连的次要替代品时最为有效。例如，如果一个师原本既有后勤连又有野战医院，而玩家决定把它用在一个补给消耗极为关键的战区，但仍想尽量减少人力损失，那么把野战医院换成直升机旅可能是有益的，这样就能在不完全失去野战医院所有加成的情况下获得一点额外的补给消耗削减。

r1658s.en: The effect is initially rather weak, as it only provides a 5% bonus. This means that (land) equipment with 80% reliability will get boosted to 84% (80 × 1.05). However, this bonus increases by an additional 5% per level (for 10%, 15%, and 20%, respectively). This allows reliability improvements to equipment that normally cannot be upgraded. Mechanized are the most significant, but also motorized, all of the towed weapons, and support equipment. It benefits infantry equipment too, but infantry equipment is easy to produce and starts at 90% reliability, rather than the usual 80%. Waiting until Maintenance Company II before considering using it isn't a bad idea.
r1658s.zh: 该效果起初相当弱，因为它只提供 5% 的加成。这意味着可靠性为 80% 的（陆军）装备会被提升到 84%（80 × 1.05）。不过，该加成每级再增加 5%（分别为 10%、15% 和 20%）。这使那些通常无法升级的装备也能获得可靠性改善。机械化装备最为重要，但摩托化装备、所有牵引式武器以及支援装备同样受益。步兵装备也受益，但步兵装备容易生产，且初始可靠性为 90%，而非通常的 80%。等到「维修连 II」再考虑使用它并不是个坏主意。

1gl75mv.en: Engineers provide a movement bonus in forest, jungle, marsh, and rivers. They provide a constant defense bonus in forest, jungle, hills, marsh, rivers, and forts. They also provide an entrenchment bonus on top of that. Upgrading engineers increases the entrenchment bonus and adds additional attack and defense bonuses in forts (II), rivers (III) and urban environments (IV). Lastly, they provide a constant attack bonus to amphibious (naval invasions), which stacks with Marines bonuses. Engineers also increase division defense and soft attack, but not as much as an infantry battalion.
1gl75mv.zh: 工兵在森林、丛林、沼泽和河流中提供移动加成。它们在森林、丛林、丘陵、沼泽、河流和要塞中提供恒定的防御加成。此外它们还在此之上提供工事加成。升级工兵会提高工事加成，并在要塞（II）、河流（III）和城市环境（IV）中增加额外的进攻和防御加成。最后，它们对两栖（海军登陆）提供恒定进攻加成，该加成可与海军陆战队的加成叠加。工兵也会提高师的防御和软攻，但不如一个步兵营那么多。

1wtdjx0.en: Military police or motorized military police can be used as an extra infantry battalion if the need arises, though they give a large hit to organization and it is better to use Support Artillery, Support Rocket Artillery, or Engineers to increase division statistics. While the additional reconnaissance on motorized military police can be useful to eek out a defensive advantage, the fact that divisions with it use fuel when they otherwise wouldn't compounds with the increased production requirements to the point that it can outweight this advantage.
1wtdjx0.zh: 如果有需要，军事警察或摩托化军事警察可以作为额外的步兵营使用，不过它们会大幅降低组织度，而使用支援火炮、支援火箭炮或工兵来提高师属性会更好。虽然摩托化军事警察的额外侦察在争取防御优势时可能有用，但编有它的师会在原本不消耗燃料时消耗燃料，这一点与更高的生产需求叠加起来，可能反而超过这一优势。

dzxgyc.en: † Note that support companies do not affect a division's speed and do not affect combat width as they are forces that remain behind the fighting front while the "front line" combat battalions engage. Therefore a towed antitank support company does not affect the 12 kph speed of a fast division but adding a towed antitank combat battalion to the regiment lines would slow that same division to the towed anti-tank's base speed of 4 KPH. So support Artillery, Anti-Air or Anti-Tank support units can add valuable capabilities to fast divisions.
dzxgyc.zh: † 请注意，支援连不影响师的速度，也不影响战斗宽度，因为它们是留在战斗前线后方、由「前线」战斗营交战的力量。因此，一个牵引式反坦克支援连不会影响一个快速师 12 kph 的速度，但在团级序列中加入一个牵引式反坦克战斗营会使同一个师减速到牵引式反坦克的 4 KPH 基础速度。所以，支援火炮、防空或反坦克支援单位可以为快速师增添宝贵的能力。

3fx4q4.en: This support company is not intended for the front lines, or any combat really. It provides a percentage increase to the division's Suppression statistic. Suppression counters partisans operating in a region, preventing them from damaging industry. Best when combined with cavalry, motorized, armored cars, and light tanks, which have better suppression than infantry battalions. While they can simply be added to a garrison division, most prefer to create a division template specifically for MPs.
3fx4q4.zh: 该支援连并非用于前线，实际上也不用于任何战斗。它按百分比提高师的镇压属性。镇压可以对抗在地区内活动的游击队，阻止他们破坏工业。最好与骑兵、摩托化、装甲车和轻型坦克搭配，它们的镇压能力优于步兵营。虽然可以简单地把它们加入驻军师，但大多数人更倾向于专门为军事警察创建一个师编制。

168ikrm.en: A recon company provides a speed bonus on most terrain and a reconnaissance points bonus to the ⟦0⟧ that increases the chance to counter the tactic chosen by the enemy. They also slightly increase division defense and attack. There are different types of recon company with varying abilities and ⟦1⟧: cavalry (1 reconnaissance point), motorized (1.5), armored car (2; requires La Résistance), light tank (1), recon rangers (1; requires ⟦2⟧), or helicopter recon (2; requires Götterdämmerung).
168ikrm.zh: 侦察连在大多数地形上提供速度加成，并为⟦0⟧提供侦察点数加成，从而提高克制敌方所选战术的几率。它们还会略微提高师的防御和进攻。侦察连有不同的类型，能力和⟦1⟧各不相同：骑兵（1 侦察点）、摩托化（1.5）、装甲车（2；需要「抵抗运动」）、轻型坦克（1）、侦察游骑兵（1；需要⟦2⟧）或直升机侦察（2；需要「诸神黄昏」）。

3k0tn3.en: For equipment that can be upgraded, such as aircraft, it means putting upgrade points into reliability is less necessary, unless it drops below 80% (or let it drop lower and focus on maintaining 80% reliability after the bonus). That can potentially save a lot of XP. With ⟦0⟧, vehicle designs with low reliability, such as using petrol-electric engines, become more feasible. Of course, that would require all divisions using tanks of that design to have a maintenance company.
3k0tn3.zh: 对于可升级的装备，例如飞机，这意味着不必把升级点投入可靠性，除非它降到 80% 以下（或者让它降得更低，专注于在获得加成后维持 80% 可靠性）。这有可能节省大量经验值。有了⟦0⟧，低可靠性的车辆设计（例如使用汽油-电动引擎）变得更可行。当然，这要求所有使用该设计坦克的师都编有维修连。

sny578.en: From the manpower, war support, and HP perspectives, bigger is better. Each field hospital, being percentage-based, will simply save more lives and equipment in a large division than in a small one. This applies doubly so for helicopter med-evacs, as their bonus recovery rate is also percentage-based, and their fuel usage relative to the entire division goes down as the number of fuel-using battalions in the division increases.
sny578.zh: 从人力、战争支持度和HP的角度看，越大越好。每个野战医院都是按百分比计算，在大型师中拯救的生命和装备自然比在小型师中更多。对于直升机医疗后送来说这一点加倍成立，因为它们的加成恢复率同样按百分比计算，而且随着师中消耗燃料的营数量增加，其相对整个师的燃料消耗会下降。

121uabz.en: Maintenance companies increase the Reliability statistic of all equipment in a division, thus significantly reducing the amount of equipment lost due to ⟦0⟧. The reliability bonus is shown as a "Reliability Bonus" in the division view, rather than being calculated for each division and then recalculated; as a result, all calculations for this company must be done outside the game.
121uabz.zh: 维修连提高师中所有装备的可靠性属性，从而大幅减少因⟦0⟧而损失的装备数量。可靠性加成在师视图中显示为「可靠性加成」，而不是为每个师单独计算再重算；因此，该连的所有计算都必须在游戏之外完成。

6u7j7v.en: Planning speed is increased by 1% for every 1% of a division's Initiative. Given that the base planning speed is 2% per day, a 1936 Signal Company will add an additional 0.2% planning bonus per day, and thus save 3 days to reach the standard 50 % bonus (II:4 days; III: 6 days; IV: 7 days). Whether bonus Initiative expedites preparation of invasions or paradrops is unconfirmed.
6u7j7v.zh: 师的主动性每有 1%，计划速度就提高 1%。鉴于基础计划速度是每天 2%，1936 年的通讯连将每天额外增加 0.2% 的计划加成，从而节省 3 天达到标准的 50% 加成（II：4 天；III：6 天；IV：7 天）。额外主动性是否会加快登陆或空降的准备尚未确认。

1jx2qqy.en: Unlike battalions, support companies are optional. A division may have up to 5⟦0⟧ support companies, but no more than one of each type. Support companies can alter and improve the stats and fighting capabilities of the division. They generally are cheaper in manpower cost than battalions and do not affect a division's combat width or max speed.
1jx2qqy.zh: 与营不同，支援连是可选的。一个师最多可以有 5⟦0⟧个支援连，但每种类型不能超过一个。支援连可以改变并提升师的属性和作战能力。它们的人力成本通常比营更低，并且不影响师的战斗宽度或最大速度。

1jewgey.en: Towed AA units also have half-decent anti-armor capability. For example, the tier 2 towed AA has enough piercing to negate the armor value of tier 1 medium tanks. However, self-propelled AA doesn't have anywhere near as much anti-armor capability. AA does not require tungsten to make, so it may be a budget AT option for minor countries.
1jewgey.zh: 牵引式防空单位也有还算不错的反装甲能力。例如，二级牵引式防空炮的穿透足以抵消一级中型坦克的装甲值。然而，自行防空炮的反装甲能力远没有这么强。防空炮不需要钨来制造，因此对小国来说可能是一种预算型反坦克选择。

1gwprod.en: AA will primarily help protect against tactical bombers and CAS attacking a battle that the division is participating in, allowing multiple divisions in the same battle to pool their AA fire. Towed and self-propelled Anti-Air will only fire at enemy planes attacking that division or other divisions that take part in the same battle.
1gwprod.zh: 防空主要有助于防御对师所参与战斗进行攻击的战术轰炸机和近距空中支援，同一场战斗中的多个师可以汇集它们的防空火力。牵引式和自行防空只会向攻击该师或参与同一战斗的其他师的敌机开火。

1eze00s.en: Signal companies provide the Initiative stat, which speeds up joining combat in progress from reserves, as well as planning speed. In general these are most useful for troops in frequent front-line combat, or for reserves in critical positions where rapid reinforcement is needed. Used in the right place, these can be great.
1eze00s.zh: 通讯连提供主动性属性，它能加快从预备队加入进行中的战斗的速度，以及计划速度。总的来说，这些对经常在前线作战的部队最有用，或者对位于关键位置、需要快速增援的预备队最有用。用在正确的地方，它们会非常出色。

v853sj.en: At least as of version 1.3, the Devs have reported⟦0⟧ that attached AA can shoot down fighters, but it takes a lot of it (the example in the video showed multiple line battalions, not just a lone support company). Of course, if you have no fighters, putting AA in every division on the front line may be your only option.
v853sj.zh: 至少截至 1.3 版本，开发者曾表示⟦0⟧附属防空可以击落战斗机，但需要大量防空（视频中的例子展示了多个线列营，而不只是一个孤零零的支援连）。当然，如果你没有战斗机，在前线每个师里都放防空可能是你唯一的选择。

10efmbc.en: As of 1.5, Maintenance companies can also capture equipment from enemy divisions (equal to their reliability boost) that would otherwise be destroyed.
10efmbc.zh: 自 1.5 起，维修连还能从敌方师那里缴获原本会被摧毁的装备（数量等于其可靠性加成）。

19dlc4p.en: AA are more efficient than fighters at shooting down planes (version 1.10). AA with 1936 equipment can shoot down up to 5% attack planes per 8 hours.
19dlc4p.zh: 在击落飞机方面，防空比战斗机更高效（1.10 版本）。使用 1936 年装备的防空每 8 小时最多可击落 5% 的攻击机。

wqp1jv.en: ⟦0⟧: Increases speed in difficult terrain and the division's Reconnaissance stat, making it easier to counter enemy combat tactics in battle.
wqp1jv.zh: ⟦0⟧：提高在困难地形中的速度以及师的侦察属性，使战斗中更容易克制敌方战斗战术。

amh833.en: They do nothing against strategic bombers (they fly too high), so adding AA to garrisons will not help protect industry.
amh833.zh: 它们对战略轰炸机毫无作用（它们飞得太高），所以在驻军中加防空无助于保护工业。

8a0qc9.en: Having towed or self-propelled AA in a division reduces the malus that enemy air superiority inflicts.
8a0qc9.zh: 在师中编有牵引式或自行防空可以减轻敌方制空权造成的惩罚。

1o346cj.en: In the ⟦0⟧, support companies are represented vertically under the Support section.
1o346cj.zh: 在⟦0⟧中，支援连以纵向方式显示在「支援」部分下。

10wgzar.en: Each support company costs ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ to add, replace, or remove from a template.
10wgzar.zh: 每个支援连在师编制中添加、替换或移除需要花费⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧。

1psvve8.en: In-game, a support company is a fundamental component of a ⟦0⟧.
1psvve8.zh: 在游戏中，支援连是⟦0⟧的基本组成部分。

1nz9opl.en: Main article: Division designer § Support companies
1nz9opl.zh: 主条目：师编制设计器 § 支援连

1eqbjpc.en: "Together for Victory feature stream" on YouTube.
1eqbjpc.zh: YouTube 上的「共赴胜利」特色直播。

ney8v.zh: 地形与侦察单位（速度加成）对照

q1m8ij.en: Major Nation Buffs allow the player to increase the strength of HOIV's major nations, which include: Germany, ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ (along with Mengkukuo and ⟦6⟧), and China (both the ⟦7⟧ and Communist China). These buffs are implemented via sliders, which confer powerful bonuses on the selected country (countries) when the slider is maxed out, with the buffs being weaker if the slider is less than max (if slider is halfway, 50% of buffs get applied).
q1m8ij.zh: 「主要国家增强」允许玩家提升 HOIV 主要国家的实力，这些国家包括：德国、⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧（以及蒙疆联合自治政府和⟦6⟧），还有中国（⟦7⟧和中国共产党）。这些增强通过滑块实现，滑块拉满时会为所选国家赋予强大的加成；如果滑块未拉满，加成会更弱（如果滑块处于中间位置，则只应用 50% 的加成）。

1o998zc.en: Players can set the highest level of ⟦0⟧ (both land and coastal) that can be built manually. The setting may be left alone (allowing for forts up to Level 10), or set anywhere between Level 1 and Level 9. However, pre-existing forts, and relevant national focuses, decisions, and events are not constrained by this setting.
1o998zc.zh: 玩家可以设置可手动建造的⟦0⟧（陆地和海岸）的最高等级。该设置可以保持不变（允许建造最高 10 级的要塞），也可以设为 1 级到 9 级之间的任意值。不过，已有的要塞以及相关的国策、决议和事件不受此设置限制。

kkqxeo.en: The Finnish Right, led by the Patriotic People's Movement, will overthrow the former conservative democracy, attempting to strengthen ties with Germany and relying on organizations like the Mustapaidat and Suojeluskunta to develop a powerful military and expand the country's borders according to the Greater Finland idea.
kkqxeo.zh: 由爱国人民运动领导的芬兰右翼将推翻此前的保守民主政权，试图加强与德国的关系，并依靠「黑衫队」和「白卫队」等组织来发展强大的军队，并按「大芬兰」理念扩张国家边界。

n6hj8v.en: Seeking help from the Soviet Union, communists will organize the Finnish left movement, uniting socialists, social-democrats and other left-wing elements in order to coup the government and lead the country towards a new revolution against the capitalist and fascist threats abroad.
n6hj8v.zh: 共产党人将向苏联寻求帮助，组织芬兰左翼运动，团结社会主义者、社会民主党人和其他左翼力量，以政变推翻政府，并领导国家发动一场新的革命，对抗国外的资本主义和法西斯主义威胁。

1yrsiew.en: Finnish Social-Democrats will appeal to the Finnish people and lead a drastic but bloodless change in the course of Finnish politics. Finland will then attempt to join other western major democracies in order to preserve the country's sovereignty and its conservative-left society.
1yrsiew.zh: 芬兰社会民主党人将呼吁芬兰人民，引领一场剧烈但无血的芬兰政治路线变革。芬兰随后将尝试加入其他西方主要民主国家，以维护国家主权及其保守-左翼社会。

1nl2ip9.en: The Soviet AI will try to re-instate the Left Opposition and include other opposition groups in the party as well as re-start the permanent revolution, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree. The goal for the AI is to form the Supreme Soviet.
1nl2ip9.zh: 苏联 AI 将试图让左翼反对派重新掌权，并把其他反对派团体也纳入党内，同时通过国策树中的相关分支重启不断革命。AI 的目标是组建最高苏维埃。

1amto0h.en: The German AI will attempt to overthrow the Nazis, and bring the communist revolution to Germany. They will then attempt to install a more democratic socialist regime under the new Spartacus League, and spread the communist revolutionary wildfire throughout Europe.
1amto0h.zh: 德国 AI 将试图推翻纳粹，把共产主义革命带到德国。随后它会试图在新的斯巴达克同盟领导下建立一个更民主的社会主义政权，并把共产主义革命的野火传遍欧洲。

16v6bvk.en: The Chilean AI will look to tradition and thus oust Alessandri from power, instating Ibáñez in his place. It will then go into a civil war, in which Antoine III will restore the old Kingdom of Araucanía and Patagonia, declaring himself a successor to Napoleon.
16v6bvk.zh: 智利 AI 将向传统靠拢，从而把亚历山德里赶下台，让伊瓦涅斯取而代之。随后它将陷入内战，在内战中安托万三世将恢复旧日的阿劳卡尼亚和巴塔哥尼亚王国，并自称为拿破仑的继承者。

1eav10b.en: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Emir Sayyid Mir Muhammad Alim Khan who will then attempt to unify the Afghan tribes. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders eventually forming a new Afghan Empire.
1eav10b.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将试图推翻查希尔沙阿国王，代之以埃米尔赛义德·米尔·穆罕默德·阿利姆汗，后者随后将试图统一阿富汗各部族。阿富汗然后将寻求扩张边界，最终建立一个新的阿富汗帝国。

1fdxeui.en: Brazil will resurrect the ANL and attempt to overthrow the democratic government. It will be replaced by the ANL council who will then implement communist reforms before ultimately attempting to liberate the continent from fascism and imperialism.
1fdxeui.zh: 巴西将复兴 ANL，并试图推翻民主政府。它将被 ANL 委员会取代，该委员会随后将实施共产主义改革，最终试图把大陆从法西斯主义和帝国主义中解放出来。

1gsfm1g.en: The Chilean AI will choose to support the various Mapuche organizations, eventually having them take control of the country. It will later go on a crusade against Imperialism, outing the European controlled states from South and Central America.
1gsfm1g.zh: 智利 AI 将选择支持各个马普切组织，最终让他们掌控国家。它随后将发起一场反帝国主义的征讨，把欧洲控制的国家逐出南美和中美洲。

1jgznmc.en: The AI will largely follow the Historical path, but will attempt to stave of Anschluss by any means possible, fighting tooth and claw for their independence until the bitter end. This might present a challenge or delay to the outbreak of the war
1jgznmc.zh: AI 将大体遵循历史路线，但会设法以一切手段阻止德奥合并，为独立拼死抵抗到底。这可能会给战争的爆发带来挑战或延迟

szqwch.en: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with the Faqir of Ipi who will then attempt to reverse the modernization of the country. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders eventually forming a new Caliphate.
szqwch.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将试图推翻查希尔沙阿国王，代之以伊皮的法基尔，后者随后将试图逆转国家的现代化。阿富汗然后将寻求扩张边界，最终建立一个新的哈里发国。

11v3xwz.en: The Danish AI will attempt to stay out of any conflicts and follow the historical events as much as possible. If it becomes a subject, it will try to slowly build support with foreign powers to eventually reassert its independence once again.
11v3xwz.zh: 丹麦 AI 将试图不卷入任何冲突，并尽可能遵循历史事件。如果它成为附属国，它将尝试慢慢争取外国列强的支持，以便最终重新确立独立。

19oat5w.en: Countries may only build up land and coastal forts to the selected level. Fortifications present at the start of the game are not affected by this. Buildings granted from national focuses, decisions and events may exceed the selected level.
19oat5w.zh: 国家只能把陆地和海岸要塞建造到所选等级。游戏开始时已存在的工事不受此影响。由国策、决议和事件提供的建筑可以超过所选等级。

oxoijg.en: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Mirza Khurshid Jah Bahadur who will then attempt to recreate the Mughal Empire. They will then look to expanding their borders eventually forming a new Timurid Empire.
oxoijg.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将试图推翻查希尔沙阿国王，代之以米尔扎·胡尔希德·贾·巴哈杜尔，后者随后将试图重建莫卧儿帝国。他们然后将寻求扩张边界，最终建立一个新的帖木儿帝国。

1mu7hto.en: Communists will overturn the government and fight against the Spanish Nationalists during the Spanish Civil War, unifying the Iberian Peninsula as the United European Socialist Republics, the last European bastion against fascism.
1mu7hto.zh: 共产党人将推翻政府，并在西班牙内战中对抗西班牙民族主义者，把伊比利亚半岛统一为欧洲联合社会主义共和国——欧洲对抗法西斯主义的最后堡垒。

yvcj06.en: The AI will attempt to build up the Swedish military while remaining neutral and democratic. It will carefully avoid getting into conflict with the Axis and Comintern, but may offer limited support to the Allies later in the war.
yvcj06.zh: AI 将试图在保持中立和民主的同时建设瑞典军队。它会小心避免与轴心国和共产国际发生冲突，但可能在战争后期向同盟国提供有限支持。

nkpw29.en: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Amanullah Khan who will then attempt to rapidly modernize the country. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders with the aid of the Axis powers.
nkpw29.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将试图推翻查希尔沙阿国王，代之以阿曼努拉汗，后者随后将试图迅速实现国家现代化。阿富汗然后将寻求在轴心国列强援助下扩张边界。

upmy0y.en: The Soviet AI will try to put the Right Opposition into power and include other opposition groups in the party, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree. The goal for the AI is to form the Supreme Soviet.
upmy0y.zh: 苏联 AI 将试图让右翼反对派掌权，并把其他反对派团体纳入党内，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。AI 的目标是组建最高苏维埃。

8z7m6j.en: The Portuguese government will embrace Fascism, fighting against the Republicans during the Spanish Civil War and attempting to recover its lost territories in Africa, Asia and America, rising as a major power once again.
8z7m6j.zh: 葡萄牙政府将拥抱法西斯主义，在西班牙内战中与共和派作战，并试图收复其在非洲、亚洲和美洲失去的领土，再次崛起为列强。

ubuwz6.en: Brazil will attempt to overthrow Vargas by ending the state of emergency. It will then attempt to reform the nation, increasing democratic participation before ultimately cooperating with the USA against the Axis powers.
ubuwz6.zh: 巴西将试图通过结束紧急状态来推翻瓦加斯。随后它将试图改革国家，扩大民主参与，最终与美国合作对抗轴心国。

18bqhsf.en: The true Communists, taking their orders from Moscow, will resist the Anarchists and Fascists, curb the influence of the Independent Communists, and usher in a new age for the Second Republic under Stalinist guidance.
18bqhsf.zh: 真正的共产党人听从莫斯科的命令，将抵抗无政府主义者和法西斯主义者，遏制独立共产党人的影响，并在斯大林主义指引下为第二共和国开创一个新时代。

1x7o4aq.en: Influenced by the United Kingdom, a democratic government will overthrow the authoritarian regime of Salazar and, with the help of the British, focus on developing the national industry before joining the Allies.
1x7o4aq.zh: 在英国影响下，一个民主政府将推翻萨拉查的威权政权，并在英国帮助下专注于发展国家工业，随后加入同盟国。

1gf77s2.en: Tsar Boris III will lead the country towards the Axis, relying on German arbitration to expand Bulgarian borders peacefully, eventually signing the Tripartite Pact and delaying Bulgarian participation in the war.
1gf77s2.zh: 沙皇鲍里斯三世将带领国家走向轴心国，依靠德国仲裁以和平方式扩张保加利亚边界，最终签署三国同盟条约并推迟保加利亚参战。

1w97xs.en: India will attempt to gain in dependence via the communist focus tree. If successful, India will focus on urbanization and rapid industrialization of society, and will attempt to seek aid from the Soviet Union.
1w97xs.zh: 印度将试图通过共产主义国策树争取独立。如果成功，印度将专注于城市化和社会的快速工业化，并试图寻求苏联的援助。

1uw2plf.en: The government led by Nikola Mushanov will follow socialist policies, seeking to improve its relations with neighboring nations to form a Balkan Confederation and defend the Balkans against foreign aggressors.
1uw2plf.zh: 由尼古拉·穆沙诺夫领导的政府将奉行社会主义政策，寻求改善与邻国的关系，以组建巴尔干联邦并保卫巴尔干免受外国侵略者侵犯。

bxkt1k.en: Players may allow or block the ability of ⟦0⟧ divisions to use their ability to be dropped into provinces via aircraft. However, this does not disable the ability to recruit and deploy paratrooper divisions.
bxkt1k.zh: 玩家可以允许或阻止⟦0⟧师使用其通过飞机空降到省份的能力。不过，这不会禁用招募和部署伞兵师的能力。

1ye4tce.en: Brazil will attempt to overthrow the democratic government and replace it with a Soviet aligned, communist government headed by Luís Carlos Prestes. It will then join the Comintern and aide the Soviet Union.
1ye4tce.zh: 巴西将试图推翻民主政府，代之以由路易斯·卡洛斯·普列斯特斯领导的、与苏联结盟的共产主义政府。它随后将加入共产国际并援助苏联。
