1nytjzv.en: The Chilean AI will go down the path of fascism, eventually choosing to not side with any of the great world powers. They will later go on to either conquer the Hispanic world, or unite it diplomatically.
1nytjzv.zh: 智利 AI 将走上法西斯主义道路，最终选择不站在任何世界列强一边。它们随后要么征服西班牙语世界，要么以外交方式将其统一。

abbp43.en: The Congolese AI will attempt to break free from their colonial overlords through a violent revolution and subsequent civil war, and will then attempt to spread communism throughout the African continent.
abbp43.zh: 刚果 AI 将试图通过暴力革命和随后的内战摆脱其殖民宗主，随后将试图把共产主义传遍非洲大陆。

7ctkp7.en: The AI will attempt to reform the Empire of Brazil by gaining support for Pedro de Alcântara as the rightful heir to the throne. It will then attempt to reunify with Portugal through diplomacy or force.
7ctkp7.zh: AI 将试图通过为佩德罗·德·阿尔坎塔拉争取支持，以他为王位的合法继承人，来重建巴西帝国。它随后将试图通过外交或武力与葡萄牙重新统一。

1om5hr9.en: Players wishing to have a different HOIV experience can modify the behavior of several AI nations. These options include ensuring historical accuracy or prompting countries to pursue alternative paths.
1om5hr9.zh: 希望获得不同 HOIV 体验的玩家可以修改若干 AI 国家的行为。这些选项包括确保历史准确性，或促使各国走上替代路径。

uj2jcw.en: Turkey will appoint Fevzi Çakmak to follow in Mustafa Kemal Atatürk’s footsteps as President, and will pursue neutrality for as long as possible before attempting to join either the Axis or the Allies.
uj2jcw.zh: 土耳其将任命费夫齐·恰克马克作为总统继承穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克的事业，并将尽可能长久地保持中立，之后才试图加入轴心国或同盟国。

1k5grgn.en: The Afghan AI will cozy up to the Soviet Union and implement radical reforms to transform the nation into a Communist state. It will then join the Comintern and attempt to take control of central Asia.
1k5grgn.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将向苏联靠拢，并实施激进改革，把国家转变为共产主义国家。它随后将加入共产国际并试图控制中亚。

1jv01nn.en: King Vittorio Emanuele will depose Mussolini, attempt to form an independent faction and lead Italy towards a constitutional monarchy favoring the Christian Democratic party, led by Alcide de Gasperi.
1jv01nn.zh: 国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱将废黜墨索里尼，试图组建一个独立阵营，并带领意大利走向君主立宪制，偏向由阿尔契德·德·加斯佩里领导的基督教民主党。

11zctcb.en: The Philippines will have its election overturned, having Partido Sakdalista take over until eventually having an independence war with support from friendly Hispanic nations and becoming a monarchy.
11zctcb.zh: 菲律宾的选举将被推翻，由萨达尔党接管，最终在友好的西班牙语国家支持下发动独立战争并成为一个君主国。

imwij5.en: The AI will stab Haile Selassie in the back and side with the Italians, causing Ethiopia to become a fascist puppet. However, it will attempt to break free and become an independent fascist nation.
imwij5.zh: AI 将背刺海尔·塞拉西并站在意大利一边，使埃塞俄比亚成为法西斯傀儡国。不过，它会试图挣脱并成为一个独立的法西斯国家。

1ov5u7s.en: The AI will try to keep Lev Trotskij in Norway, and follow his principles of Communism, going against the Soviet Union if it remains Stalinist, and allying with it if Trotskij becomes its leader.
1ov5u7s.zh: AI 将试图把列夫·托洛茨基留在挪威，并遵循他的共产主义原则：如果苏联仍保持斯大林主义，就与之为敌；如果托洛茨基成为其领导人，就与它结盟。

1a57xzj.en: Wargoal generation is disabled below 100% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
1a57xzj.zh: 世界紧张度低于 100% 时禁用战争目标生成，此后对所有国家开放。这会覆盖任何意识形态限制，但仍允许通过国策获得战争目标。

h6uy3y.en: The AI will make decisions based on other gameplay settings, such as the option to force historical focuses and other gameplay scenarios. This is the same behavior as in version 1.5 and earlier.
h6uy3y.zh: AI 将根据其他游戏设置做出决策，例如强制历史国策选项和其他游戏情景。这与 1.5 及更早版本的行为相同。

1jy9b81.en: The Ethiopian AI will attempt to defeat Italy using the Legaue of nations ⟦0⟧, and if that fails try to go into exile. Thereafter it will try to recover its home territory, and rebuild Ethiopia.
1jy9b81.zh: 埃塞俄比亚 AI 将试图利用国际联盟的⟦0⟧击败意大利，如果失败则尝试流亡。此后它将试图收复本土，并重建埃塞俄比亚。

th7wiz.en: Wargoal generation is disabled below 25% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
th7wiz.zh: 世界紧张度低于 25% 时禁用战争目标生成，此后对所有国家开放。这会覆盖任何意识形态限制，但仍允许通过国策获得战争目标。

xrdj3z.en: Wargoal generation is disabled below 50% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
xrdj3z.zh: 世界紧张度低于 50% 时禁用战争目标生成，此后对所有国家开放。这会覆盖任何意识形态限制，但仍允许通过国策获得战争目标。

8y3lwm.en: Wargoal generation is disabled below 75% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
8y3lwm.zh: 世界紧张度低于 75% 时禁用战争目标生成，此后对所有国家开放。这会覆盖任何意识形态限制，但仍允许通过国策获得战争目标。

1ogk09q.en: The Hungarian AI will attempt to restore the Austro-Hungarian Empire by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree, selecting Otto von Habsburg as their ruler if available to them.
1ogk09q.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来恢复奥匈帝国，如果可选则选择奥托·冯·哈布斯堡作为其统治者。

1wyjnz1.en: The Chilean AI will reinforce the democratic system and choose to support social-democratic policies whilst maintaining the power balance, and will join the global struggle only if it drags on.
1wyjnz1.zh: 智利 AI 将强化民主制度，选择支持社会民主政策，同时维持权力平衡，只有当全球斗争拖长时才会加入。

43facf.en: The AI will attempt to remain loyal to the UK while building up its power in the region, gradually taking over administration of territory and ultimately forming the Hashemite Arab Federation.
43facf.zh: AI 将试图在建设本地区势力的同时继续效忠英国，逐步接管领土的行政管理，最终组建哈希姆阿拉伯联邦。

1ag9khg.en: The South African AI will attempt to remain democratic and take a more assertive role in the relationship with the mother country, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1ag9khg.zh: 南非 AI 将试图保持民主，并在与宗主国的关系中采取更强势的姿态，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

3zdo44.en: The Chilean AI will go down the path of fascism, choosing to side with the German Reich if they get the chance, eventually going to war and attempting to restore the Kingdom of Chile of old.
3zdo44.zh: 智利 AI 将走上法西斯主义道路，如果有机会就选择站在德意志国一边，最终开战并试图恢复旧日的智利王国。

vdimqm.en: The Japanese AI will attempt to turn communist and install a Ronoha-led government, leading a crusade against imperialism in Asia by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
vdimqm.zh: 日本 AI 将试图转向共产主义，建立由劳农派领导的政府，并沿国策树中的相关路径在亚洲发起一场反帝国主义的征讨。

1wvsmqo.en: The AI will will try to convince states around Switzerland to join the confederation, and will arm the country in preparation for owner of those states refusing to let their states be free.
1wvsmqo.zh: AI 将试图说服瑞士周边的州加入联邦，并将国家武装起来，为这些州的所有者拒绝让其州获得自由做准备。

ih6zl8.en: The AI will attempt to reform the Empire of Brazil by gaining support for Pedro Henrique as the rightful heir to the throne. It will then attempt to conquer or integrate Brazil's neighbors.
ih6zl8.zh: AI 将试图通过为佩德罗·恩里克争取支持，以他为王位的合法继承人，来重建巴西帝国。它随后将试图征服或整合巴西的邻国。

1xjostp.en: Italian anti-fascists will join forces to overthrow the fascist regime by force, forming a social-democratic government and seeking to form a Confederation with former colonies in Africa.
1xjostp.zh: 意大利反法西斯主义者将联合起来以武力推翻法西斯政权，组建社会民主政府，并寻求与前非洲殖民地组建联邦。

1vjt954.en: India will attempt to gain independence via the communist focus tree. If successful, India will focus on agricultural economic growth and establishing its own unqique socialist ideology.
1vjt954.zh: 印度将试图通过共产主义国策树争取独立。如果成功，印度将专注于农业经济增长，并建立其自身独特的社会主义意识形态。

1xh7f67.en: The Chilean AI will utilize the instability caused by the fascist to demands Arturo Alessandri's resignation, and increase presidential powers so that they can instate a communist state.
1xh7f67.zh: 智利 AI 将利用法西斯分子造成的不稳定，要求阿图罗·亚历山德里辞职，并扩大总统权力，以便建立一个共产主义国家。

1yidjn8.en: The Afghan AI will push King Zahir Shah to oust his uncles before continuing on a path of radical reforms. This will culminate in Afghanistan becoming a democracy and joining the Allies.
1yidjn8.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将推动查希尔沙阿国王罢黜其叔父，然后继续推行激进改革。这最终将使阿富汗成为民主国家并加入同盟国。

jrxcqa.en: The Romanian AI will attempt to reform the country into a functioning democracy and ally with other major democratic powers by going down the relevant paths in the national focus trees.
jrxcqa.zh: 罗马尼亚 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，把国家改革为运作良好的民主国家，并与其他主要民主列强结盟。

18c88a8.en: Franco will take control of the nationalist front and merge the Falangist and Carlist ideologies in a new and unified Spain, attempting to stay neutral in the World War unless attacked.
18c88a8.zh: 佛朗哥将掌控民族主义阵线，并在一个新的统一西班牙中融合长枪党和卡洛斯主义意识形态，试图在世界大战中保持中立，除非遭到进攻。

1l6qk55.en: Switzerland will remain neutral, while building up their militias and fortifications in preparation for any attack. They will give some support to the allies towards the end of the war.
1l6qk55.zh: 瑞士将保持中立，同时发展民兵和工事以备任何进攻。他们将在战争末期向同盟国提供一些支持。

1hk0bmh.en: Winners with less than 5% of war participation give all their score to other winners. Does not apply if no winner has at least 10% of war participation. Does not apply to Human Players.
1hk0bmh.zh: 战争参与度低于 5% 的胜利者将其全部贡献交给其他胜利者。如果没有胜利者拥有至少 10% 的战争参与度，则不适用。不适用于人类玩家。

18vlg5q.en: The AI will flip-flop between historical coups, culminating in the Golden Square seizing control and going to war with the UK before ultimately restoring the monarchy and surrendering.
18vlg5q.zh: AI 将在历次历史政变之间反复摇摆，最终由金方阵夺取控制权并对英国开战，最后又恢复君主制并投降。

1es1xoo.en: The Australian AI will attempt to gain full independence from the United Kingdom and become a major force in their region, by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
1es1xoo.zh: 澳大利亚 AI 将试图从英国获得完全独立，并成为本地区的一支主要力量，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1evh4r4.en: The AI will attempt to increase the popularity of Communism, while aligning Norway to Stalin's Soviet Union, or the biggest Non-Trostkyist Communist country if Stalin has been ousted.
1evh4r4.zh: AI 将试图提高共产主义支持度，同时把挪威与斯大林的苏联结盟，如果斯大林已被推翻，则与最大的非托洛茨基主义共产主义国家结盟。

qe21cd.en: Moderate reformers within the Catholic Church will create a new concordat within Mexico, bringing an end to the social strife of totalitarianism and aligning Mexico towards Britain.
qe21cd.zh: 天主教内部的温和改革派将在墨西哥建立新的政教协定，终结极权主义带来的社会冲突，并使墨西哥向英国靠拢。

1ozmszk.en: The AI will unite the country's nationalists and form SUMKA, bringing a fascist regime to the country. It will attempt to join a fascist faction and declare war on their neighbors.
1ozmszk.zh: AI 将统一该国的民族主义者并组建 SUMKA，把法西斯政权带到该国。它将试图加入法西斯阵营并对其邻国宣战。

1c8of2b.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to remain democratic and lead Europe's minor democracies in the creation of a European Union, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1c8of2b.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图保持民主，并带领欧洲的小型民主国家创建欧洲联盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

j90zbv.en: The Hungarian AI will attempt to become a constitutional monarchy by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree, electing Carl V Wilhelm as it's new Apostolic King.
j90zbv.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进成为君主立宪制国家，选举卡尔·V·威廉为其新的使徒国王。

ansy3b.en: The AI will attempt to put the Golden Square in power as soon as possible before joining the Axis to fight the UK. They will then attempt to annex neighbouring Arab territories.
ansy3b.zh: AI 将试图尽快让金方阵掌权，然后加入轴心国对抗英国。他们随后将试图吞并邻近的阿拉伯领土。

1av4389.en: The AI will go down the path of the Unwilling Diarchy, with Mao and Guotao attempting to co-operate against the warlords. The AI will not seek to join the Second United Front.
1av4389.zh: AI 将走上「不情愿的双头政治」路径，毛泽东和张国焘试图合作对抗军阀。AI 不会寻求加入第二次统一战线。

w0pdzb.en: The British AI will attempt to support King Edward VIII's marriage to Wallis Simpson and empower the King's Party, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
w0pdzb.zh: 英国 AI 将试图支持国王爱德华八世与沃利斯·辛普森的婚姻并壮大国王党，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

6vcos4.en: The AI will go down the 28 1/2 Bolshevik path, trying to align with the Soviet Union. If in the Second United Front, the AI will try to influence the faction diplomatically.
6vcos4.zh: AI 将走上「二十八又二分之一布尔什维克」路径，试图与苏联结盟。如果处于第二次统一战线中，AI 将试图以外交手段影响该阵营。

1lquptf.en: The AI will attempt to keep out of world affairs and focus on internal industrialization, putting the Colorado party in power. Only joining the allies at the end of the war.
1lquptf.zh: AI 将试图置身世界事务之外，专注于国内工业化，让科罗拉多党掌权。只在战争末期加入同盟国。

1at9age.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to join the Allies once invaded, but not relocate their government to the East Indies, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1at9age.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图在被入侵后加入同盟国，但不会把政府迁往东印度，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

84kbin.en: The Swedish AI will go down the democratic tree but will be more likely to become actively involved in the war by rearming faster, leaning more into right-leaning policies.
84kbin.zh: 瑞典 AI 将走民主路线，但会通过更快重整军备而更有可能积极参战，并更倾向于右翼政策。

1j4sn1j.en: The AI will attempt to keep out of world affairs and focus on internal industrialization, putting the Blanco party in power. Only joining the allies at the end of the war.
1j4sn1j.zh: AI 将试图置身世界事务之外，专注于国内工业化，让白党掌权。只在战争末期加入同盟国。

67vqpi.en: Italian anti-fascists will join forces to overthrow the fascist regime by force, forming a communist government, abolishing the colonies and seeking to join the Comintern
67vqpi.zh: 意大利反法西斯主义者将联合起来以武力推翻法西斯政权，组建共产主义政府，废除殖民地，并寻求加入共产国际

7x4jqd.en: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to form a faction of its own to defend itself while remaining democratic, by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
7x4jqd.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克 AI 将试图在保持民主的同时组建自己的阵营以自保，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

ld8rnw.en: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to remain democratic and focus predominantly on its internal development by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
ld8rnw.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克 AI 将试图保持民主，并主要专注于内部发展，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

at04fh.en: The British AI will attempt to protect Poland and lead the allies in their defensive war against the Germans, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
at04fh.zh: 英国 AI 将试图保护波兰并带领同盟国对德国展开防御战争，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

41n8cq.en: The British AI will attempt to stop its policy of Appeasement and replace it with democratic interventionism, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
41n8cq.zh: 英国 AI 将试图停止其绥靖政策，代之以民主干预主义，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

s3kyn.en: Vargas will attempt to stay in power by carefully eliminating the political opposition in Brazil before eventually joining the Allies and working with the United States.
s3kyn.zh: 瓦加斯将试图通过在巴西小心清除政治反对派来保住权力，最终加入同盟国并与美国合作。

t3xu4a.en: The German AI will attempt to overthrow the Nazis, and bring the communist revolution to Germany. They will then attempt to establish a dictatorship of the proletariat.
t3xu4a.zh: 德国 AI 将试图推翻纳粹，把共产主义革命带到德国。随后它会试图建立无产阶级专政。

1opqkyl.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to remain democratic, but focus on continental build-up instead of their colonies, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1opqkyl.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图保持民主，但专注于本土建设而非殖民地，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1pp7472.en: The Anarchist communes in Aragon and Catalonia will band together to vanquish the Fascists and Communists alike and resist the very notion of a nation-state altogether.
1pp7472.zh: 阿拉贡和加泰罗尼亚的无政府主义公社将联合起来，同时击溃法西斯主义者和共产党人，并彻底抵制民族国家这一概念本身。

103evd7.en: Rafael Pereira will take control of Portugal as a Fascist dictator, supporting the Nationalists during the Spanish Civil War and attempting to join the Axis afterwords.
103evd7.zh: 拉斐尔·佩雷拉将作为法西斯独裁者控制葡萄牙，在西班牙内战期间支持民族主义者，并在战后试图加入轴心国。

t8svjk.en: The Polish AI will attempt to come to an understanding with the USSR to protect itself against aggression, by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
t8svjk.zh: 波兰 AI 将试图与苏联达成谅解以保护自身免受侵略，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

jtrobv.en: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to turn the country fascist and enter into an arrangement with Germany by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
jtrobv.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克 AI 将试图把国家转变为法西斯国家，并与德国达成安排，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

j0i6x9.en: The South African AI will attempt to turn communist and liberate the peoples of Africa from colonial rule, by going down the relevant path of the national focus tree.
j0i6x9.zh: 南非 AI 将试图转向共产主义，把非洲各族人民从殖民统治中解放出来，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

12d9t8s.en: The Japanese AI will attempt to strike north against the Soviet Union and make common cause with the Axis by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
12d9t8s.zh: 日本 AI 将试图向北进攻苏联，并与轴心国携手，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1lks4vb.en: As fascism rises in the country, right-wing leader Hristo Lukov will attempt to join the Axis, eventually overthrowing the Tsar and imposing a military dictatorship.
1lks4vb.zh: 随着法西斯主义在该国抬头，右翼领袖赫里斯托·卢科夫将试图加入轴心国，最终推翻沙皇并实行军事独裁。

q1vds.en: The Afghan AI will attempt to stay neutral throughout the time period while also attempting to gain economic concessions from the Allies, Comintern and Axis powers.
q1vds.zh: 阿富汗 AI 将试图在整个时期保持中立，同时试图从同盟国、共产国际和轴心国列强那里获取经济让步。

1r00ynh.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to cave to the Germans in the trade war, and ally them once becoming fascist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1r00ynh.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图在贸易战中向德国屈服，并在转为法西斯主义后与之结盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

11f0w9b.en: King Christian X will try to secure natural resources and strengthen Denmark's military capabilities by controlling the rest of the Nordics by any means necessary.
11f0w9b.zh: 国王克里斯蒂安十世将试图通过以一切必要手段控制其余北欧国家，来确保自然资源并加强丹麦的军事能力。

82azoh.en: Countries may not execute parachute drops under any circumstances. Paratrooper divisions may still be recruited, but will not be able to execute airborne attacks.
82azoh.zh: 国家在任何情况下都不能执行伞降。伞兵师仍可被招募，但无法执行空降攻击。

d67jrm.en: The Japanese AI will pursue its historical path and attempt to strike south against the western allies by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
d67jrm.zh: 日本 AI 将遵循其历史路线，并试图向南进攻西方盟国，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1c1pal6.en: The Hungarian AI will attempt to become a communist nation and ally with other major communist nations by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1c1pal6.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将试图成为共产主义国家，并与其他主要共产主义国家结盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1xv7y5l.en: The AI will arm Switzerland and prepare for war, aligning Switzerland to the democratic powers of the world, eventually breaking neutrality in favor of the Allies
1xv7y5l.zh: AI 将武装瑞士并准备战争，使瑞士与世界的民主列强结盟，最终打破中立转而支持同盟国

bydmf3.en: The AI will attempt to reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire by rebuilding their military and demanding subjugation of the countries that now occupy their old lands.
bydmf3.zh: AI 将试图通过重建军队并要求现占据其旧有领土的国家臣服，来重建奥匈帝国。

16q0ndd.en: The Canadian AI will attempt to turn communist and support the workers of the world in their struggle by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
16q0ndd.zh: 加拿大 AI 将试图转向共产主义，并支持世界工人们的斗争，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1qsruuc.en: The Canadian AI will attempt to gain full independence and create an alliance with the United States, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1qsruuc.zh: 加拿大 AI 将试图获得完全独立并与美国建立同盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1djyvw2.en: After the restoration of the monarchy in Portugal, King Duarte will appeal to the Brazilian monarchists and attempt to restore the Empire of Portugal and Brazil.
1djyvw2.zh: 在葡萄牙君主制复辟之后，杜阿尔特国王将呼吁巴西的君主主义者，并试图恢复葡萄牙与巴西帝国。

egjuqc.en: The Bulgarian Democratic Party will attempt to join the Allies as it conspires against Tsar Boris to remove him from power and form a pro-Allies regency council.
egjuqc.zh: 保加利亚民主党将试图加入同盟国，同时密谋反对沙皇鲍里斯以将其赶下台，并组建一个亲同盟国的摄政委员会。

1t4rwmu.en: The Integralist movement will betray Vargas and install one of their own as leader. They will then attempt to dominate South America through diplomacy and force.
1t4rwmu.zh: 整合主义运动将背叛瓦加斯，并安插他们自己的一员为领导人。他们随后将试图通过外交和武力主宰南美洲。

1epz82l.en: Countries can never guarantee other countries. This does not affect guarantees that exist at the start of the game or which are issued through national focuses.
1epz82l.zh: 国家永远不能保障其他国家。这不影响游戏开始时就存在的保障或通过国策发出的保障。

1gxm0wl.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to revive the legacy of the "De Zeven Provinciën" mutiny and go communist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1gxm0wl.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图复兴「七省号」兵变的遗产并转向共产主义，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

661lvc.en: The AI will make Switzerland align itself with Germany and slowly turn the country fascist, eventually either allying with the Axis or becoming a German Puppet.
661lvc.zh: AI 将使瑞士与德国结盟，并慢慢把该国转变为法西斯国家，最终要么与轴心国结盟，要么成为德国的傀儡国。

snyl2i.en: The Soviet AI will try to re-instate the Left Opposition and re-start the permanent revolution, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
snyl2i.zh: 苏联 AI 将试图让左翼反对派重新掌权并重启不断革命，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

1swqibh.en: The Soviet AI will expell the Communists through civil war, and establish a fascist government, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
1swqibh.zh: 苏联 AI 将通过内战驱逐共产党人，并建立法西斯政府，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

1mjahoo.en: The Indian AI will attempt to gain its independence through an alliance with with fascist countries by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1mjahoo.zh: 印度 AI 将试图通过与法西斯国家结盟来获得独立，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

15whga5.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to remain democratic, but move their capital to Batavia once capitulated, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
15whga5.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图保持民主，但在投降后把首都迁往巴达维亚，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

vbgu6g.en: The German AI will attempt to replace Hitler with one the members of the Inner Circle, heed von Neurath's concerns and attempt to enforce its New World Order.
vbgu6g.zh: 德国 AI 将试图用「核心圈」成员之一取代希特勒，听取冯·牛赖特的担忧，并试图推行其「新世界秩序」。

1mm6osv.en: The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Bonapartist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
1mm6osv.zh: 法国 AI 将试图恢复法国君主制，并把波拿巴派王位觊觎者扶上王座，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1n5bxq5.en: Bakr Sidqi will launch his historical coup but will not be assassinated. Instead, the government will work with Iran and Turkey to form a regional power bloc.
1n5bxq5.zh: 贝克尔·西德基将发动其历史性的政变，但不会被刺杀。相反，政府将与伊朗和土耳其合作，组建一个地区性强权集团。

1r9sgy5.en: The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Legitimist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
1r9sgy5.zh: 法国 AI 将试图恢复法国君主制，并把正统派王位觊觎者扶上王座，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

eany7r.en: The Ethiopian AI will attempt to defeat Italy on its own, without getting the help of the League of Nations. Thereafter it will attempt to expand its empire.
eany7r.zh: 埃塞俄比亚 AI 将试图在没有国际联盟帮助的情况下独自击败意大利。此后它将试图扩张其帝国。

jregj8.en: The Kurds of Northern Iraq will launch a revolt against the Iraqi government. If they succeed, they will attempt to unify their lands across Turkey and Iran.
jregj8.zh: 伊拉克北部的库尔德人将发动反对伊拉克政府的起义。如果他们成功，他们将试图统一横跨土耳其和伊朗的库尔德人土地。

qy680t.en: The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Orléanist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
qy680t.zh: 法国 AI 将试图恢复法国君主制，并把奥尔良派王位觊觎者扶上王座，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1v9pfo6.en: India will go down the path of resistance and pick Savarkar as its leader, taking a more militant stance towards independence and try and form Akhand Bharat
1v9pfo6.zh: 印度将走上抵抗之路，选择萨瓦尔卡为其领导人，对独立采取更激进的立场，并试图建立「大印度」

ucdk9n.en: Following the death of Tsar Boris III, his father Ferdinand I will sit on the throne once again, seeking revenge against those who wronged him decades ago.
ucdk9n.zh: 在沙皇鲍里斯三世去世后，其父斐迪南一世将再次坐上王座，寻求向数十年前错待他的人复仇。

tjvz9b.en: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to reform the country to communism and enter into an alliance with the Soviet Union or another major communist nation.
tjvz9b.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克 AI 将试图把国家改革为共产主义国家，并与苏联或其他主要共产主义国家结盟。

7jdk6o.en: The Congolese AI will attempt to gain it's independence as soon as it can through peaceful means, and later attempt to spread communism throughout Africa.
7jdk6o.zh: 刚果 AI 将试图尽快通过和平手段获得独立，随后试图把共产主义传遍非洲。

qf37jz.en: The Soviet AI will expell the Communists through civil war, and reinstate Tsarist Russia, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
qf37jz.zh: 苏联 AI 将通过内战驱逐共产党人，并恢复沙皇俄国，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

1enb4m1.en: The Hungarian AI will oppose Horthy, and bring democracy to Hungary, eventually embracing the Dragon Movement and attempting to restore Greater Hungary.
1enb4m1.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将反对霍尔蒂，把民主带到匈牙利，最终拥抱「龙之运动」并试图恢复大匈牙利。

betlgp.en: The Congolese AI will stay with Belgium and utilize its relationship with the nation to its fullest potential, eventually looking for increased autonomy
betlgp.zh: 刚果 AI 将留在比利时一方，并充分利用其与该国的关系，最终寻求更大的自治权

bbt1vx.en: The AI will engage in a revolution that will leave the Soviet aligned Tudeh party in power. The communist regime will attempt to destabilize the region.
bbt1vx.zh: AI 将发动一场革命，使与苏联结盟的图德党掌权。该共产主义政权将试图破坏该地区的稳定。

b8i991.en: Some nations are only available for modification upon purchase of certain DLC. These requirements are marked by an icon next to the name of the nation.
b8i991.zh: 某些国家只有在购买特定 DLC 后才可修改。这些要求在国家名称旁以图标标出。

dhy4ot.en: The Japanese AI will attempt to turn communist and support other communist regimes in Asia by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
dhy4ot.zh: 日本 AI 将试图转向共产主义，并支持亚洲其他共产主义政权，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1n96wpf.en: The South African AI will attempt to turn fascist and come to an arrangement with Germany, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1n96wpf.zh: 南非 AI 将试图转向法西斯主义并与德国达成安排，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

wfi3lv.en: The British AI will attempt to make concessions to the Trade Unions and become communist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
wfi3lv.zh: 英国 AI 将试图向工会做出让步并转向共产主义，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

nx532p.en: Norway will attempt to remain democratic and resist the German invasion before continuing to fight on as a government in exile, alongside the Allies.
nx532p.zh: 挪威将试图保持民主并抵抗德国入侵，随后作为流亡政府与同盟国一起继续战斗。

1jxwcz9.en: The Congolese AI will attempt to gain it's independence as soon as it can through peaceful means, and later campaign for democracy throughout Africa.
1jxwcz9.zh: 刚果 AI 将试图尽快通过和平手段获得独立，随后在非洲各地为民主而奔走。

1ch634s.en: The French AI will attempt to turn fascist and make common cause with a fascist Germany, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1ch634s.zh: 法国 AI 将试图转向法西斯主义，并与法西斯德国携手，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1c2aob0.en: The Australian AI will attempt to turn the country communist and ally with the Comintern by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1c2aob0.zh: 澳大利亚 AI 将试图把国家转变为共产主义国家并与共产国际结盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

15m40i6.en: The AI will let Fascism's influence grow over time, and will eventually align with The Third Reich, or go it alone if Germany is no longer Fascist.
15m40i6.zh: AI 将任由法西斯主义的影响力随时间增长，最终与第三帝国结盟，或者在德国不再是法西斯主义时独自行动。

m3hfy5.en: The AI will attempt to go communist and overthrow the government. Adhering to a strict Austromarxist agenda they will create a faction of their own
m3hfy5.zh: AI 将试图转向共产主义并推翻政府。遵循严格的奥地利马克思主义纲领，他们将建立自己的阵营

1aazsfl.en: The red sun will rise over the Philippines, as maritime communism takes hold and seeks to spread the spirit of equality across the world's oceans.
1aazsfl.zh: 红日将在菲律宾升起，海上共产主义扎根并寻求把平等精神传遍世界各大洋。

9vrpmb.en: The Indian AI will attempt to gain its independence by allying with the Soviet Union, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
9vrpmb.zh: 印度 AI 将试图通过与苏联结盟来获得独立，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1q9sr7h.en: Plutarco Calles, Saturnino Cedillo, and the other military strongmen will abort Mexico's nascent attempts at democracy, aligning towards Germany.
1q9sr7h.zh: 普卢塔科·卡列斯、萨图尼诺·塞迪略和其他军事强人将扼杀墨西哥初生的民主尝试，转而向德国靠拢。

8qno1d.en: The Carlists under Manuel Fal Conde will reject Falangism and ensure a return to the absolutist monarchy of old, under its rightful Carlist king.
8qno1d.zh: 曼努埃尔·法尔·孔德领导下的卡洛斯派将拒绝长枪主义，并确保恢复旧日的专制君主制，由合法的卡洛斯派国王继位。

vxr50t.en: The French AI will attempt to form the Little Entente to contain Germany. Should Czechoslovakia create that faction, they will join it instead.
vxr50t.zh: 法国 AI 将试图组建小协约国以遏制德国。如果捷克斯洛伐克创建了该阵营，他们将转而加入它。

1vnnrlk.en: The Hungarian AI will attempt to establish absolute rule under the Arrow Cross Party, eventually joining the Axis as a faithful ally of theirs.
1vnnrlk.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将试图在箭十字党领导下建立绝对统治，最终作为其忠实盟友加入轴心国。

vf731m.en: The Dutch AI will attempt to support monarchism and put Queen Wilhelmina in power, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
vf731m.zh: 荷兰 AI 将试图支持君主主义并把威廉明娜女王推上台，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

95oiz6.en: The AI will attempt to turn Ethiopia into an anarcho-communist federation with the support of communists and anarchists from across the world.
95oiz6.zh: AI 将试图在世界各地共产党人和无政府主义者的支持下，把埃塞俄比亚变成一个无政府共产主义联邦。

1crgdmn.en: The AI will attempt to form the Alpine Protectorate by abandoning neutrality and democracy in favor of a militaristic and expansionist regime.
1crgdmn.zh: AI 将试图通过放弃中立和民主、转而建立军国主义和扩张主义政权，来组建阿尔卑斯保护国。

ihbwhb.en: The Soviet Union will have all SSRs released from game start, and will look like it did just after its dissolution at the end of the Cold War.
ihbwhb.zh: 苏联将在游戏开始时释放所有加盟共和国，其版图将看起来像冷战结束解体后不久的样子。

1kikm0r.en: The AI will force constitutional limits on the Shah and follow a path of democracy before eventually attempting to join a democratic faction.
1kikm0r.zh: AI 将把宪法限制强加于沙阿，并走上民主道路，最终试图加入一个民主阵营。

i09shg.en: When setting up a game of HOIIV, players are able to modify specific elements of the game's difficulty settings by clicking the ⟦0⟧ button.
i09shg.zh: 在设置 HOIIV 游戏时，玩家可以通过点击⟦0⟧按钮来修改游戏难度设置中的特定内容。

1nebh01.en: The Romanian AI will attempt to establish supremacy over their Balkan neighbors by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1nebh01.zh: 罗马尼亚 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，确立对巴尔干邻国的霸权。

17pqouw.en: The Yugoslavian AI will attempt to reform the country into a communist republic by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
17pqouw.zh: 南斯拉夫 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，把国家改革为共产主义共和国。

t2lcx6.en: The trend towards moderate secularism and the rule of law will be strengthened in Mexico, with the country aligning itself towards America.
t2lcx6.zh: 墨西哥将强化温和世俗主义与法治的趋势，并使该国向美国靠拢。

mqa95b.en: The POUM and their Anarchist allies will cast off the Stalinist yoke and seek their own independent communist ideology after the Civil War.
mqa95b.zh: POUM 及其无政府主义盟友将在内战结束后摆脱斯大林主义的枷锁，寻求他们自己独立的共产主义意识形态。

1rnz4a6.en: The Hungarian AI will progress down the path of the national focus tree that most closely resembles history, and attempt to join the Axis.
1rnz4a6.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将沿国策树中最接近历史的路径推进，并试图加入轴心国。

rq39yo.en: The AI will attempt to reform the Austrian Empire by rebuilding their military and then expanding and annexing their old lost territories.
rq39yo.zh: AI 将试图通过重建军队、随后扩张并吞并其旧日失去的领土，来重建奥地利帝国。

z46x7p.en: All releasable Republics, Okrugs and Territories comprising the Soviet Union are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
z46x7p.zh: 构成苏联的所有可释放共和国、自治区和领土都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

tsnvk5.en: Bulgaria will attempt to form a Balkan alliance, influencing its neighbors to embrace the revolution and ultimately unifying the Balkans.
tsnvk5.zh: 保加利亚将试图组建巴尔干同盟，影响其邻国拥抱革命，最终统一巴尔干。

1846j24.en: India will endeavour to become independent, remain Democratic and join the Allies, but stand united as one country and avoid Partition.
1846j24.zh: 印度将努力争取独立、保持民主并加入同盟国，但会作为一个统一国家保持团结，避免分治。

1dvtzgu.en: The Yugoslavian AI will attempt to grow closer to the fascist nations of Europe, aiming to eventually enter into an alliance with them.
1dvtzgu.zh: 南斯拉夫 AI 将试图向欧洲的法西斯国家靠拢，目标是最终与它们结成同盟。

1b3wpso.en: The British AI will attempt to organize the blackshirts and become fascist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1b3wpso.zh: 英国 AI 将试图组织黑衫队并转向法西斯主义，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1cid3e2.en: The Italian AI will attempt to oust Mussolini from power, and install Dino Grandi instead to seek to strengthen ties with the allies.
1cid3e2.zh: 意大利 AI 将试图把墨索里尼赶下台，代之以迪诺·格兰迪，以寻求加强与同盟国的关系。

172l8g4.en: The Hungarian AI will crown either Miklos Horthy or his son as king of Hungary, and attempt to establish a Greater Hungarian Kingdom.
172l8g4.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将加冕米克洛什·霍尔蒂或其子为匈牙利国王，并试图建立大匈牙利王国。

epm93a.en: Turkey will commit itself to maintaining security in the Balkans and attempt to form a faction with Greece, Romania, and Yugoslavia.
epm93a.zh: 土耳其将致力于维护巴尔干的安全，并试图与希腊、罗马尼亚和南斯拉夫组建阵营。

13c4gsx.en: The AI will attempt to turn the country communist and will join the Comintern to focus on spreading their ideology in South America.
13c4gsx.zh: AI 将试图把国家转变为共产主义国家，并加入共产国际，专注于在南美洲传播其意识形态。

1dlqope.en: King Vittorio Emanuele will lead Italy towards an absolute monarchy, trying to achieve Mare Nostrum and reforming the Roman Empire.
1dlqope.zh: 国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱将带领意大利走向绝对君主制，试图实现「我们的海」并重建罗马帝国。

gk6d08.en: The French AI will attempt to turn communist and join the Comintern by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
gk6d08.zh: 法国 AI 将试图转向共产主义并加入共产国际，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

7ncdbv.en: The AI will attempt to remain democratic and establish full sovereignty by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
7ncdbv.zh: AI 将试图保持民主，并通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来建立完全主权。

1ajhkrz.en: The Romanian AI will attempt to forge an alliance with a major communist power by going down the relevant paths in the focus tree.
1ajhkrz.zh: 罗马尼亚 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，与一个主要共产主义强国结成同盟。

1u6sxxx.en: The Polish AI will attempt to reconcile with Germany for protection, by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
1u6sxxx.zh: 波兰 AI 将试图为求保护而与德国和解，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

o2u6nd.en: India will go down the path of resistance and pick Chandra Bose as its leader, taking a more militant stance towards independence
o2u6nd.zh: 印度将走上抵抗之路，选择钱德拉·鲍斯为其领导人，对独立采取更激进的立场

fllfvl.en: The Manchu AI will attempt to break free and take over all of China by going down the relevant branch of the national focus tree.
fllfvl.zh: 满洲 AI 将试图挣脱束缚并夺取整个中国，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

1pgghyj.en: Bulgaria will attempt to join the Comintern and fight together with its Soviet comrades against fascism and capitalism in Europe.
1pgghyj.zh: 保加利亚将试图加入共产国际，与其苏联同志并肩在欧洲对抗法西斯主义和资本主义。

k1p9jt.en: The Yugoslavian AI will attempt to maintain a democratic government by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
k1p9jt.zh: 南斯拉夫 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来维持民主政府。

1d4jva3.en: The Synarchists and Cristeros will take power in Mexico, creating a new Latin American order to purge the continent of heretics.
1d4jva3.zh: 协同主义者和基督军将在墨西哥掌权，建立新的拉丁美洲秩序以清除大陆上的异端。

1h4zdqs.en: The AI will attempt to adhere to historical events by avoiding entry into the war and gradually cooperating with the UK and USA.
1h4zdqs.zh: AI 将试图遵循历史事件，避免参战，并逐步与英国和美国合作。

1fecely.en: The Hungarian AI will attempt to form its own faction with Italy and Austria by going down the relevant path in the focus tree.
1fecely.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，与意大利和奥地利组建自己的阵营。

19st744.en: Turkey will pursue neutrality for as long as possible under the leadership of İsmet Inönü, and then attempt to join the Allies.
19st744.zh: 土耳其将在伊斯梅特·伊纳尼领导下尽可能长久地保持中立，然后试图加入同盟国。

n1rbto.en: The Soviet AI will try to put the Right Opposition into power, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
n1rbto.zh: 苏联 AI 将试图让右翼反对派掌权，其方式是沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

1hmv9yy.en: The Italian AI will attempt to oust Mussolini from power, and install Italo Balbo instead to seek an independent path forward.
1hmv9yy.zh: 意大利 AI 将试图把墨索里尼赶下台，代之以伊塔洛·巴尔博，以寻求一条独立的前进道路。

16plnyx.en: The Australian AI will attempt to turn fascist and ally with Japan by going down the relevant path of the national focus tree.
16plnyx.zh: 澳大利亚 AI 将试图转向法西斯主义并与日本结盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

dhpc8z.en: The Canadian AI will attempt to turn fascist and ally with Germany by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
dhpc8z.zh: 加拿大 AI 将试图转向法西斯主义并与德国结盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

940w3p.en: The Hungarian AI will attempt to restore the old Socialist Federative Republic, and bring about a Red Greater Hungarian State.
940w3p.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将试图恢复旧日的社会主义联邦共和国，并建立一个红色的「大匈牙利国」。

av5t7a.en: The US AI will attempt to take a more active role in world affairs by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
av5t7a.zh: 美国 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，在世界事务中发挥更积极的作用。

19p6o89.en: Under the regime of Salazar, Portugal will strengthen the Estado Novo and will attempt to remain neutral during the World War.
19p6o89.zh: 在萨拉查政权下，葡萄牙将强化「新国家」体制，并试图在世界大战期间保持中立。

egiobe.en: The AI will attempt to turn Ethiopia communist and garner the support of the Soviet Union, turning it into a Stalinist puppet.
egiobe.zh: AI 将试图把埃塞俄比亚转变为共产主义国家并争取苏联的支持，使其成为斯大林主义傀儡国。

14fory7.en: All releasable constituent nations comprising the United Kingdom are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
14fory7.zh: 构成英国的所有可释放组成国家都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

1kj2ebf.en: The German AI will remain fascist and attempt to take over Europe by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1kj2ebf.zh: 德国 AI 将保持法西斯主义，并试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来接管欧洲。

dd0w24.en: The Romanian AI will attempt to follow history and join the Axis by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
dd0w24.zh: 罗马尼亚 AI 将试图遵循历史并加入轴心国，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1n7n3u.en: Fevzi Çakmak shall transition Turkey into a conservative quasi-fascist dictatorship and attempt to form a faction with Italy.
1n7n3u.zh: 费夫齐·恰克马克将使土耳其转变为一个保守的准法西斯独裁政权，并试图与意大利组建阵营。

1htde19.en: The Lithuanian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1htde19.zh: 立陶宛 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来建立法西斯政府。

1tc1hij.en: The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, become subservient to Germany and break free from them when the time is right.
1tc1hij.zh: 瑞典 AI 将走上法西斯道路，屈从于德国，并在时机成熟时挣脱它们。

he6l5u.en: The AI will keep out of global politics and focus on internal issues, going through instabilities keeping it out of the war.
he6l5u.zh: AI 将置身全球政治之外，专注于内部问题，经历种种动荡而置身战争之外。

150vvgd.en: After the fall of the Philippine government, a military figure will rise and lead the nation against any and all aggressors.
150vvgd.zh: 在菲律宾政府垮台后，一位军人将崛起并带领国家对抗一切侵略者。

x3kbd5.en: The German AI will attempt to create a constitutional monarchy by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
x3kbd5.zh: 德国 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来建立君主立宪制。

3y9aa6.en: Portugal will align itself towards the Soviet Union, supporting the Spanish Republic, and attempting to join the Comintern.
3y9aa6.zh: 葡萄牙将向苏联靠拢，支持西班牙共和国，并试图加入共产国际。

1pss31g.en: The AI will go with the Rexist Fascists, and establish a tall highly industrial state, then assist the fascists in the war.
1pss31g.zh: AI 将站在雷克斯主义法西斯一边，建立一个高度工业化的小而强国家，然后在战争中协助法西斯分子。

1srhcub.en: The AI will establish an absolute monarchy as Reza Shah Pahlavi and work towards a campaign of conquest in the Middle East.
1srhcub.zh: AI 将以礼萨·沙阿·巴列维的身份建立绝对君主制，并致力于在中东发动一场征服战争。

1twl6pr.en: All releasable constituent nations comprising the British Raj are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
1twl6pr.zh: 构成英属印度的所有可释放组成国家都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

sytww1.en: The Estonian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
sytww1.zh: 爱沙尼亚 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来建立法西斯政府。

1uklgf5.en: The AI will go with the Flemish Nationalist Fascists, and aggressively try to unite the low countries then turn on France.
1uklgf5.zh: AI 将站在弗拉芒民族主义法西斯一边，积极尝试统一低地国家，然后转而对付法国。

1lykfh9.en: The AI will allow the Labour party to win the election, and then slowly begin to align themselves with the Communist bloc.
1lykfh9.zh: AI 将让工党赢得选举，然后慢慢开始向共产主义阵营靠拢。

b5ro98.en: The German AI will attempt to return the Kaiser to the throne by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
b5ro98.zh: 德国 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，让德皇重登王位。

xbaxg9.en: The Manchu AI will attempt to remain loyal as much as possible and follow the relevant branch in the national focus tree.
xbaxg9.zh: 满洲 AI 将试图尽可能保持忠诚，并沿国策树中的相关分支推进。

1nsogri.en: Greece will become democratic, suffer a collapse in government, and then go on to aspire for the grandest of ambitions...
1nsogri.zh: 希腊将转为民主国家，遭遇政府崩溃，随后继续怀抱最宏大的野心……

kc03wd.en: The Latvian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
kc03wd.zh: 拉脱维亚 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来建立法西斯政府。

1655fwn.en: The AI will work through political reforms and bolster their military, before being invaded and immediately capitulating.
1655fwn.zh: AI 将推进政治改革并加强军备，然后遭到入侵并立即投降。

2ejv7x.en: The AI will attempt to turn communist and join the Comintern by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
2ejv7x.zh: AI 将试图转向共产主义并加入共产国际，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

wk2zgb.en: The Hungarian AI will oppose Horthy, and attempt to bring democracy to the nation, establishing the Danubian Federation.
wk2zgb.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将反对霍尔蒂，并试图把民主带给国家，建立多瑙河联邦。

pw5w6p.en: Turkey will adopt a communist government that maintains its Kemalist qualities and attempt to form a faction of its own.
pw5w6p.zh: 土耳其将采用一个保持其凯末尔主义特质的共产主义政府，并试图组建自己的阵营。

h6653j.en: The AI will attempt to form the Danubian Federation by inviting other nations along the Danube under a non-aligned rule.
h6653j.zh: AI 将试图通过邀请多瑙河沿岸其他国家，在一个不结盟的统治下组建多瑙河联邦。

tpj8u7.en: The AI will attempt to go communist and overthrow the government before aligning with the USSR and joining the Comintern
tpj8u7.zh: AI 将试图转向共产主义并推翻政府，然后与苏联结盟并加入共产国际

m30rv4.en: Mexico will align itself towards the Soviet Union, spreading the Revolution into Latin America at the tip of a bayonet.
m30rv4.zh: 墨西哥将向苏联靠拢，以刺刀之尖把革命传播到拉丁美洲。

ki911w.en: The AI will attempt to form the Danubian Federation by inviting other nations along the Danube under a democratic rule.
ki911w.zh: AI 将试图通过邀请多瑙河沿岸其他国家，在民主统治下组建多瑙河联邦。

1fn2hbu.en: The AI will attempt to turn the country fascist and will join the Axis powers to open up a new front in South America.
1fn2hbu.zh: AI 将试图把国家转变为法西斯国家，并加入轴心国列强，以在南美洲开辟一条新战线。

10rgv4y.en: The AI will fight against Rafael Franco's coup and enter a civil war to try and keep its democratic government intact.
10rgv4y.zh: AI 将对抗拉斐尔·佛朗哥的政变并陷入内战，以设法保全其民主政府。

r5z841.en: Belgium will initially try to stave off attacks, but will then fall back to the Congo and continue the war from there.
r5z841.zh: 比利时最初将试图抵挡进攻，但随后会退往刚果并从那里继续战争。

1qqu706.en: All releasable constituent nations comprising Yugoslavia are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
1qqu706.zh: 构成南斯拉夫的所有可释放组成国家都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

dd62mz.en: Lázaro Cárdenas and his left-wing successors will create a Bolivarian Alliance and strike at the Yanqui imperialists.
dd62mz.zh: 拉萨罗·卡德纳斯及其左翼继任者将创建玻利瓦尔联盟，并向扬基帝国主义者发起打击。

1je3vyv.en: The AI will attempt to turn democratic and will join the Allies to safe guard democracy and freedom in South America.
1je3vyv.zh: AI 将试图转向民主，并加入同盟国以捍卫南美洲的民主与自由。

b38po7.en: Certain obsolete branches will be hidden under the appropriate circumstances for easier navigation of the Focus Tree.
b38po7.zh: 某些过时的分支将在适当情况下被隐藏，以便更轻松地浏览国策树。

1ql1hjt.en: The Republic of Turkey will collapse and from its ashes the Ottoman Sultanate shall be restored to power once again.
1ql1hjt.zh: 土耳其共和国将崩溃，奥斯曼苏丹国将从其灰烬中再次掌权。

108lse8.en: The AI will stab Haile Selassie in the back and side with the Italians, causing Ethiopia to become a fascist puppet.
108lse8.zh: AI 将背刺海尔·塞拉西并站在意大利一边，使埃塞俄比亚成为法西斯傀儡国。

x27ab3.en: The AI will attempt to turn fascist and ally with Japan by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
x27ab3.zh: AI 将试图转向法西斯主义并与日本结盟，其方式是沿国策树中的相关路径推进。

1x9wz4j.en: The AI will start pressuring King Haakon VII to dismantle the Storting and turn Norway into an Oligarchic Monarchy.
1x9wz4j.zh: AI 将开始向哈康七世国王施压，要求解散议会，把挪威变成寡头君主制。

vc42jr.en: The Falangists under José Antonio Primo de Rivera will reject the Carlism and seek to restore Spanish imperialism.
vc42jr.zh: 何塞·安东尼奥·普里莫·德里维拉领导下的长枪党人将拒绝卡洛斯主义，并寻求恢复西班牙帝国主义。

jn0xvi.en: The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, become subservient to Germany and remain obedient to their overlord.
jn0xvi.zh: 瑞典 AI 将走上法西斯道路，屈从于德国并对他们的宗主国保持顺从。

18h1skn.en: All releasable constituent nations comprising France are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
18h1skn.zh: 构成法国的所有可释放组成国家都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

1iqc5nv.en: The Australian AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events and decisions in the national focus tree.
1iqc5nv.zh: 澳大利亚 AI 将试图遵循国策树中的历史事件与决议链条。

1pb5k4j.en: The Swedish AI will go down the unaligned path, return the king to power and try to form the Great Nordic Kingdom
1pb5k4j.zh: 瑞典 AI 将走上不结盟道路，让国王重掌权力，并尝试建立大北欧王国

16pjsir.en: The AI will keep Rafael Franco's communist government and seek to take revenge against Bolivia for the Chaco War.
16pjsir.zh: AI 将保留拉斐尔·佛朗哥的共产主义政府，并寻求为查科战争向玻利维亚复仇。

1yfzwil.en: The Polish AI will crown Friedrich Christian as king and attempt to restore the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
1yfzwil.zh: 波兰 AI 将加冕弗里德里希·克里斯蒂安为国王，并试图恢复波兰-立陶宛联邦。

15z3rk.en: The Canadian AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events and decisions in the national focus tree.
15z3rk.zh: 加拿大 AI 将试图遵循国策树中的历史事件与决议链条。

1k7681m.en: The AI will attempt to establish a communist regime by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
1k7681m.zh: AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进来建立共产主义政权。

lh1bze.en: The Polish AI will crown Karl Albrecht von Habsburg as king and attempt to form a union with Czechoslovakia.
lh1bze.zh: 波兰 AI 将加冕卡尔·阿尔布雷希特·冯·哈布斯堡为国王，并试图与捷克斯洛伐克组成联合。

1okam01.en: The Hungarian AI will elect Joseph August as its king, and restore Greater Hungary, but under Habsburg rule.
1okam01.zh: 匈牙利 AI 将选举约瑟夫·奥古斯特为其国王，并恢复大匈牙利，但在哈布斯堡统治之下。

uisprs.en: Greece will become an absolute monarchy and seek to join the Central Powers with Germany or Austria-Hungary.
uisprs.zh: 希腊将成为绝对君主制国家，并寻求与德国或奥匈帝国一起加入中央列强。

qyb9x8.en: The Lithuanian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
qyb9x8.zh: 立陶宛 AI 将在战役的大部分时间里保持中立，但会在 1940 年代成为苏联的傀儡国。

1n29p0p.en: The democratic government of Spain will maintain the Second Republic, rejecting both Fascism and Communism.
1n29p0p.zh: 西班牙民主政府将维持第二共和国，同时拒绝法西斯主义和共产主义。

1n6h7hw.en: The Japanese AI will attempt to reform into a democracy by going down the relevant path in the focus tree.
1n6h7hw.zh: 日本 AI 将试图通过沿国策树中的相关路径推进，改革为民主国家。

1x7qb0w.en: The Estonian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
1x7qb0w.zh: 爱沙尼亚 AI 将在战役的大部分时间里保持中立，但会在 1940 年代成为苏联的傀儡国。

vexr0k.en: The AI will turn fascist and attempt to stave off the Anschluss with the Vaterländische Front at the helm.
vexr0k.zh: AI 将转向法西斯主义，并试图在祖国阵线主导下阻止德奥合并。

1wadmh6.en: Countries can gain military access and docking rights from countries that share the same ruling ideology.
1wadmh6.zh: 国家可以从拥有相同执政意识形态的国家获得军事通行权和停泊权。

1lm0p4c.en: The Latvian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
1lm0p4c.zh: 拉脱维亚 AI 将在战役的大部分时间里保持中立，但会在 1940 年代成为苏联的傀儡国。

1n2tde9.en: The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, remain independent and try to form the Great Nordic Kingdom
1n2tde9.zh: 瑞典 AI 将走上法西斯道路，保持独立，并尝试建立大北欧王国

tp2zga.en: The AI will throw off the shackles of their weak-willed king, and attempt to defend Belgium at all costs.
tp2zga.zh: AI 将挣脱其懦弱国王的枷锁，并试图不惜一切代价保卫比利时。

1sokd6t.en: All releasable colonized nations in Oceania are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
1sokd6t.zh: 大洋洲所有可释放的殖民地国家都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

e8ps2r.en: Countries can never gain military access and docking rights from any other country outside of a faction.
e8ps2r.zh: 国家永远不能从阵营之外的任何其他国家获得军事通行权和停泊权。

b9qa7z.en: The Philippines will align themselves with the Japanese, potentially falling foul of fascism themselves.
b9qa7z.zh: 菲律宾将向日本靠拢，有可能自己也陷入法西斯主义。

176exej.en: All releasable colonized nations in Africa are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
176exej.zh: 非洲所有可释放的殖民地国家都会在游戏开始时作为自由独立国家被释放。

tkj6o4.en: The Philippines will play the USA and the Japanese off against each other, to maximize their potential.
tkj6o4.zh: 菲律宾将让美国和日本相互牵制，以最大化自身的潜力。

15z7zwj.en: Players can determine whether countries can take control of a faction when certain conditions are met.
