1c34w6o.en: Sápmi will be released from Finland, Sweden and Norway.
1c34w6o.zh: 萨米将从芬兰、瑞典和挪威被释放。

3bq1lq.en: Countries may never send volunteers to any country.
3bq1lq.zh: 国家永远不能向任何国家派遣志愿军。

pyogsp.en: Countries may only release nations while at peace.
pyogsp.zh: 国家只能在和平时释放国家。

1uuxp2p.en: Countries may not take over faction leadership.
1uuxp2p.zh: 国家不能接管阵营领导权。

8bjrwc.en: Countries may prepare and execute coups freely.
8bjrwc.zh: 国家可以自由策划和执行政变。

1u1o2m0.en: Disallows use of Scorched Earth in State Menus.
1u1o2m0.zh: 禁止在州菜单中使用焦土。

4ktt67.en: Countries may execute parachute drops freely.
4ktt67.zh: 国家可以自由执行伞降。

1strs4i.en: Guarantees of Independence can be revoked.

1djy3zy.en: Legacy of the "De Zeven Provinciën" mutiny

19n49.en: India will try and form the Mughal Empire
19n49.zh: 印度将尝试建立莫卧儿帝国

k77pr0.en: The full list of buffs is available ⟦0⟧.
k77pr0.zh: 完整加成列表可在⟦0⟧查看。

v3q9il.zh: 共产主义 - 民族解放联盟

pfpdlb.zh: 无政府共产主义：向世界宣告

1kzyn9i.zh: 奥地利民主制 - 阿尔卑斯联邦

1qzxlaw.en: Countries may use Scorch Earth freely.
1qzxlaw.zh: 国家可以自由使用焦土。

5pbers.zh: 背刺者 帝国专员辖区 法西斯主义

1i47h2e.en: The Kingdom of Araucanía and Patagonia
1i47h2e.zh: 阿劳卡尼亚和巴塔哥尼亚王国

14ei9ui.zh: GOE - 共产主义（城市工业主义）

1o97a7d.en: The world is colonized as historical.

1kiqtr2.zh: 国家永远不能释放国家。

15uokzt.en: Event Loyalties to Britain: Added triggers to hide old options if the Dominion is on the same ideological path as ENG, making it unavailable to leave the Commonwealth through event; Added new option with triggers to show if the Dominion is on the same ideological path as ENG.
15uokzt.zh: 事件「对不列颠的忠诚」：新增触发器，在自治领与 ENG 处于相同意识形态路线时隐藏旧选项，使其无法通过事件退出英联邦；新增带触发器的选项，在自治领与 ENG 处于相同意识形态路线时显示。

6lgyzh.en: SIA: Added a new focus in the Pan-Thaiism branch that allows you to end the factionalism of the Khana Ratsadon if both the Civil and Military wing approve of you for 270 days. This focus shuts off the Khana Ratsadon system and merges the civilian and military wing spirits.
6lgyzh.zh: SIA：泛泰主义分支中新增了一个国策，若文官派与军人派都连续 270 天认可你，就能终结人民党（Khana Ratsadon）的派系斗争。该国会策会关闭人民党体系，并合并文官派与军人派的国家精神。

1hk9bf6.en: INS/HOL: The focus 'The Republic of Indonesia' no longer requires a minimum number of civs, mils, and dockyards, and instead only checks your factory count, regardless of which type. Also reduced the factories required to take the focus.
1hk9bf6.zh: INS/HOL：国策「印度尼西亚共和国」不再要求民用工厂、军用工厂与船坞的最低数量，而只检查你的工厂总数，不论类型。同时降低了点出该国策所需的工厂数。

1tkviqk.en: AST: Upgraded the focus 'Coastwatchers' with Air Wing Experience Loss When Killed reduction, and Naval Auxiliary Patrol with Casualties on Sink reduction to represent the many airmen and sailors saved by these two organisations.
1tkviqk.zh: AST：强化了国策「海岸监视者」，使其降低航空队阵亡时的经验损失；并强化「海军辅助巡逻队」，使其降低沉没时的伤亡，以体现这两个组织所挽救的众多飞行员与水兵。

khgiws.en: INS: Made it so that Indonesia cannot side with Japanese invaders if the Focus 'The Industrialized Colony' has been completed, making it no longer possible to gain 7 research slots as Indonesia.
khgiws.zh: INS：已完成「工业化殖民地」国策后，印度尼西亚不再能与日本入侵者站在一边，从而使印度尼西亚不再可能获得 7 个科研槽。

1t7psmz.en: Fixed a case where Romania could snatch Bulgarian territory from a third party occupying them totally via the 'Puppet Romania' focus. Now Bulgaria is required to be at peace for this focus.
1t7psmz.zh: 修复了罗马尼亚可通过「傀儡罗马尼亚」国策从完全占领保加利亚的第三方手中夺走保加利亚领土的情况。现在该国策要求保加利亚处于和平状态。

11d5qod.en: AST: The Focus 'Defying American Interference': Added event chain asking JAP to guarantee AST if they're not in the same faction, and updated tooltips for the focus and its event chains.
11d5qod.zh: AST：国策「抗拒美国干涉」：新增事件链，在 JAP 与 AST 不同属一个阵营时请其保障 AST，并更新了该国策及其事件链的提示框。

1l38xeu.en: SIA: Reduced Research speed, Production efficiency cap, Defense, Organization, Entrenchment and Output by on average ~1% gained from Asian Democratic Compact per faction member.
1l38xeu.zh: SIA：将「亚洲民主协定」按每个阵营成员所提供的科研速度、生产效率上限、防御、组织度、构筑工事与产出加成平均降低约 1%。

1nrfcu6.en: SIA: the Royal Palace Directive focus now unlocks a decision to increase the Military/Civil wing opinion of you, without pissing the other party off. This has a 365 day timeout.
1nrfcu6.zh: SIA：「王室指令」国策现在会解锁一项决议，可在不惹恼另一方的情况下提高军人派/文官派对你的好感。该决议有 365 天的超时限制。

p9losr.en: AST: The Focus 'Join the Comintern' has a better tooltip explaining what is going on. Australia's faction will only merge into the Comintern, if Australia is the faction leader.
p9losr.zh: AST：国策「加入共产国际」有了更好的提示框来说明具体情况。只有当澳大利亚是阵营领袖时，澳大利亚的阵营才会并入共产国际。

1mqj5zk.en: AST: Phosphate Commission spirit is now being removed by completing the Focus ‘Nauru's Return to German Hands’, instead of being removed by the event, making the effect clearer.
1mqj5zk.zh: AST：「磷酸盐委员会」国家精神现在通过完成国策「瑙鲁回归德国之手」来移除，而不再由事件移除，使效果更加清晰。

1q7xtm8.en: Indonesian AI will be heavily encouraged to switch to a different leader after completing the focus 'A Democratic Indonesia', if Indonesia's leader is still a governor general.
1q7xtm8.zh: 如果印度尼西亚的领袖仍是总督，印度尼西亚 AI 在完成「民主的印度尼西亚」国策后会被强烈鼓励更换为其他领袖。

apdzef.en: SIA: Fixed an issue which caused a limited war to white peace without transfer instead of correctly transferring states if France capitulated while the limited war was ongoing.
apdzef.zh: SIA：修复了若法国在有限战争进行期间投降，有限战争会以不转移领土的白和告终、而非正确转移各州的问题。

1raw2wx.en: AST: Refunding UAP/ALP advisors when they're removed; Counting completed Castle Crumbling mission as election win; Adding party votes modifier to Castle Crumbling mission fail
1raw2wx.zh: AST：在 UAP/ALP 顾问被移除时退还花费；将已完成的「摇摇欲坠的堡垒」任务计为选举胜利；为「摇摇欲坠的堡垒」任务失败添加政党得票修正。

1kmh6cm.en: AST: Australia now has a level 2 rail connection all the way from Canberra to Alice Springs if they complete both 'Standard Gauge Line to Darwin' and 'Alice Springs' focuses.
1kmh6cm.zh: AST：如果澳大利亚同时完成「通往达尔文的标准轨距铁路」与「爱丽斯泉」国策，它现在就会拥有一条从堪培拉一直到爱丽斯泉的 2 级铁路连接。

qwlzj0.en: Give Control of State action should now display why you can't give control of a state in a specific condition, instead of allowing it to be done, but failing to properly act.
qwlzj0.zh: 「移交州控制权」操作现在应会显示在特定条件下你为何无法移交某州控制权，而不再允许执行却无法正常生效。

1qb4d1y.en: Tuned down the "Spirit of St. Bernard" spirit, which in combination with other things could give 105% casualty trickleback and unending armies of resurrected zombie Swiss.
1qb4d1y.zh: 下调了「圣伯纳德精神」国家精神，它与其它因素叠加时可提供 105% 伤亡回流，造就源源不断复活的僵尸瑞士军队。

15wobsk.en: Add 'always_show_on_actions_tooltip' bool field on Advisors to avoid 'on_add and on_remove' effect tooltips being lost when the advisor has a trait with a custom tooltip.
15wobsk.zh: 为顾问新增 always_show_on_actions_tooltip 布尔字段，以避免当顾问拥有带自定义提示框的特质时，on_add 与 on_remove 的效果提示框丢失。

6i6v52.en: AST: Added fallbacks for effects of event Nauru's Return to German Hands to cover if Australia is subject to the UK but not in the same faction or if not subject at all.
6i6v52.zh: AST：为事件「瑙鲁回归德国之手」的效果新增了后备方案，以涵盖澳大利亚是英国附庸但与之不同属一个阵营、或根本就不是附庸的情况。

1cfrvvf.en: ENG: Fixed an issue where the United Kingdom wouldn't Bypass the focuses Secure Iraq and Secure Iran when they already had them as their puppets or were at war with them
1cfrvvf.zh: ENG：修复了英国在其已将伊拉克与伊朗作为傀儡国、或正与其交战时，不会跳过「确保伊拉克」与「确保伊朗」国策的问题。

smpcgj.en: Fixed a bug where the AI could be over-eager with their lendlease offers, they will now keep in mind the amount of available convoys you have in their offer.
smpcgj.zh: 修复了 AI 在租借提议上可能过于热心的 bug，它们现在会在提议中考虑你所拥有的可用运输船队数量。

yulxqw.en: Updated tooltip for "Establish the ABDACOM" shared focus to make it more clear that only faction members are eligible to receive invites to join the ABDACOM.
yulxqw.zh: 更新了共享国策「建立美英荷澳司令部」的提示框，更清楚地说明只有阵营成员才有资格收到加入美英荷澳司令部的邀请。

56b09h.en: SIA: The Seri Thai civil war can now be avoided if the combined civil war strength for the player is over 80% (5%/general swayed + total democratic support).
56b09h.zh: SIA：如果玩家一方的内战实力合计超过 80%（每拉拢一名将领 5% + 民主主义支持度总和），自由泰人运动的内战现在可以被避免。

qgyxqq.en: Add impassable_ignored_links for impassable states, a list of state IDs that will be ignored when computing the owner and controller of an impassable state
qgyxqq.zh: 为不可通行州新增 impassable_ignored_links，即在计算不可通行州的拥有者与控制者时会被忽略的州 ID 列表。

11mdm2m.en: Fixed the description for the focus "Reestablish the Guominjun" to not make the rather bold claim that Sinkiang was led by Moustache Man in the 1939 start.
11mdm2m.zh: 修复了国策「重建国民军」的描述，使其不再做出相当大胆的断言，称新疆在 1939 年开局由「小胡子」领导。

12rdbcl.en: AST: The 'Governor General' Advisor Trait has had a balance tweak lowering the Democracy drift from 0.10 to 0.05 and adding -5% consumer goods factor.
12rdbcl.zh: AST：「总督」顾问特质进行了平衡性调整，将民主主义倾向从 0.10 降至 0.05，并新增 -5% 消费品系数。

y6d5h2.en: SIA: Added a decision to increase the Civil/Military wings approval of you if they are rebellious at the cost of a temporary negative National Spirit.
y6d5h2.zh: SIA：新增了一项决议，可在文官派/军人派心怀不满时提高他们对你的认可度，代价是暂时承受一个负面国家精神。

1vcoueb.en: AST: Australian Communists no longer need to deal with the Cabinet Trust following the Canberra Air Disaster. Their government has already changed.
1vcoueb.zh: AST：在堪培拉空难之后，澳大利亚共产党人不再需要应对内阁信任问题。他们的政府已经改变了。

6agwfz.en: AST: Removing effect for focus Under the Rule of Canberra that gave puppet to puppet; instead it annexes the states that are owned by an AI player
6agwfz.zh: AST：移除了国策「在堪培拉的统治下」中让傀儡国再获得傀儡国的效果；现在它会吞并由 AI 玩家所拥有的州。

nqryg6.en: SIA: A civil war triggered through the Khana Ratsadon only happens once now. If they become rebellious again a negative spirit is applied instead.
nqryg6.zh: SIA：由人民党触发的内战现在只会发生一次。若他们再次心怀不满，则会改为施加一个负面国家精神。

oi7bys.en: SIA: Added options to sway individuals via decisions for the Seri Thai. Each general increases the strength of the civil war for your side by 5%.
oi7bys.zh: SIA：为自由泰人运动新增了通过决议拉拢个人的选项。每名将领都会使你一方在内战中的实力提高 5%。

1dk8meq.en: Bougainville has now been included in effects that target the state for GER, JAP, PHI (i.e.: focuses that take control of pacific islands etc.).
1dk8meq.zh: 布干维尔现在已被纳入 GER、JAP、PHI 针对该州的效果中（例如夺取太平洋岛屿控制权的国策等）。

qptt3m.en: Fixed a CTD when Army HQ units were destroyed in combat under specific conditions (risks happening in, for example, a 4-way Spanish civil war).
qptt3m.zh: 修复了在特定条件下陆军司令部单位于战斗中被摧毁时发生的崩溃（CTD）（例如在四方西班牙内战中就有发生风险）。

muaybt.en: AST: The Focus 'Lang is Right' shows the right tooltip (it is -0.05 Political Power Cost instead of -0.05%). Colour is also now green for good.
muaybt.zh: AST：国策「朗是对的」显示了正确的提示框（是 -0.05 政治点数花费，而非 -0.05%）。颜色现在也正确地显示为绿色。

dpbe5w.en: AST: Failsafes for mission 'Organize a Strike' and spirit 'Strike Ongoing' to cancel both when completing the Focus 'All for One, One for All'.
dpbe5w.zh: AST：为任务「组织罢工」与「罢工进行中」国家精神加入保险机制，使其在完成国策「人人为我，我为人人」时都被取消。

gohnuv.en: ETH: Fixes Ethiopia being able to annex colonial powers through the Horn of Africa decisions if the colonial powers moved their capitals there.
gohnuv.zh: ETH：修复了若殖民列强将其首都迁至非洲之角，埃塞俄比亚就能通过非洲之角决议吞并这些殖民列强的问题。

1bcg372.en: OOS: Fixed an OOS that happened if a client had previously played an ahistorical game in the same session before joining a historical MP game.
1bcg372.zh: OOS：修复了客户端在同一会话中先玩过一局非历史游戏、随后加入历史向多人游戏时会发生的失同步。

1qgi4y.en: INS: Fixed a bug where Indonesia could start a new volksraad decision before clearing the event, allowing the same decision to be taken twice.
1qgi4y.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚可以在事件尚未清除前就启动新的 Volksraad 决议，从而重复执行同一决议的 bug。

epcf3u.en: Fixed some missing idea icons - for Design Companies and others, amongst them AST_kirov, BEL_kirov, smb_organization_of_american_states_member
epcf3u.zh: 修复了一些缺失的理念图标——包括设计商及其他类型，其中有 AST_kirov、BEL_kirov、smb_organization_of_american_states_member。

226v9s.en: INS/HOL: The focus 'Economic Integration' now requires a minimum of 50 factories of any type, instead of 45 civilian factories specifically
226v9s.zh: INS/HOL：国策「经济一体化」现在要求任意类型的工厂总数至少为 50，而不再特指 45 座民用工厂。

kicx17.en: AST: Edited advisor Richard Dixon available check, added leader trait to focus Eastern Focus, and tweaked prereqs of focus The Pacific Pact
kicx17.zh: AST：修改了顾问理查德·迪克森的可用性检查，为国策「东方焦点」添加了领袖特质，并调整了国策「太平洋公约」的前置条件。

1k6r4ys.en: HOL: Fixed bug where the Netherlands would not get the 'Obtain Foreign Colonial Investments' decisions after completing the required focus.
1k6r4ys.zh: HOL：修复了荷兰在完成所需国策后无法获得「获取外国殖民投资」决议的 bug。

n0w2zq.en: SIA: Fixed a bug where the Asian democratic compact wasn't updating correctly. It will now always be updated once at the end of each month.
n0w2zq.zh: SIA：修复了亚洲民主协定未能正确更新的 bug。现在它会在每月月末固定更新一次。

1b8hfr.en: INS: The Indonesian AI will no longer wait before establishing a revolutionary HQ, and will be far less likely to build the HQ in Papua.
1b8hfr.zh: INS：印度尼西亚 AI 不再拖延建立革命司令部，并且远不那么可能在巴布亚建立该司令部。

1gx3rf5.en: SIA: Fixed a bug where you could get a wargoal against yourself if you controlled parts of Indochina while asking France to return it.
1gx3rf5.zh: SIA：修复了在你控制中南半岛部分地区并要求法国归还时，可能获得针对自己的战争目标的 bug。

10tva9c.en: INS: Fixed a bug where Indonesia would suddenly become the Republic of Indonesia again after forming the Netherlands-Indonesia Union.
10tva9c.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚在组建荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦后会突然又变回印度尼西亚共和国的 bug。

l5nt30.en: INS: The focus 'A Democratic Indonesia' will no longer reset the country leader to Cornelis even if Tjarda was chosen to replace him
l5nt30.zh: INS：即便已选择 Tjarda 取代 Cornelis，国策「民主的印度尼西亚」也不再会把国家领袖重置为 Cornelis。

f992vf.en: AST: Renamed the Bristol Blenheim to the Bristol Blenheim Mk IF (this variant replaced the bomb bay for extra under-carriage guns).
f992vf.zh: AST：将 Bristol Blenheim 更名为 Bristol Blenheim Mk IF（该改型去掉了弹舱，以在机腹增设机枪）。

a6dofm.en: AST: Focus completion time increase/decrease in event Halfway to Federal Election & decision Final Reforms has been edited to match
a6dofm.zh: AST：事件「联邦选举之路过半」与决议「最终改革」中的国策完成时间增减已被修改为彼此一致。

mheq0r.en: Shift + Clicking a Commander while assigning to an Army will now also automatically start deploying them in the field with an HQ.
mheq0r.zh: 在为集团军指派指挥官时按住 Shift 点击，现在也会自动开始将其随一个司令部部署到战场上。

1k3qp0g.en: AST: The National Spirit 'Nauru Pact' tooltip has been edited so its effects alter depending on GER being in the faction or not.
1k3qp0g.zh: AST：「瑙鲁公约」国家精神的提示框已被修改，使其效果会根据 GER 是否在该阵营中而变化。

109j56g.en: AST: The Focus 'The Irish Anti-Britain Pact' now correctly grants Australia military access and docking rights through Ireland.
109j56g.zh: AST：国策「爱尔兰反不列颠公约」现在会正确给予澳大利亚经由爱尔兰的军事通行权与停泊权。

1sy98v2.en: AST: Fixed missing localisation in Smuggle Arms decisions, and made the Irish and Northern Irish smuggling use the same timer.
1sy98v2.zh: AST：修复了走私武器决议中缺失的本地化文本，并使爱尔兰与北爱尔兰的走私共用同一计时器。

s71d8y.en: AST: Fixed so advisors Milford, Northcott, Jeffrey, Goble & Burnett get discount from Relief of Command/Independent Air Force,
s71d8y.zh: AST：修复了顾问 Milford、Northcott、Jeffrey、Goble 与 Burnett 无法从「解除指挥」/「独立空军」获得折扣的问题。

b6ldnr.en: INS: The mission 'Moestopo demands promotion for his efforts' no longer gives +2 levels without the relevant skill increases.
b6ldnr.zh: INS：任务「Moestopo 要求因其功绩获得晋升」不再在没有相应技能提升的情况下给予 +2 等级。

1omviel.en: ICE: Fixed 'Reclaiming the Empire' focus for Iceland to be doable again after a war with the owner of Greenland is concluded.
1omviel.zh: ICE：修复了冰岛在与格陵兰拥有者的战争结束之后无法再完成「重夺帝国」国策的问题。

1b56sah.en: AST: The Focus 'World Peace' will now actually allow sending Volunteers to the Spanish Republicans rather than Nationalists.
1b56sah.zh: AST：国策「世界和平」现在确实会允许向西班牙共和派而非民族派派遣志愿军。

1u9fkk6.en: AST: Event Nauru's Return to German Hands either gives a German Guarantee or adds Australia to the German faction, not both.
1u9fkk6.zh: AST：事件「瑙鲁回归德国之手」要么给予德国保障独立，要么将澳大利亚加入德国阵营，而不会两者兼施。

19rprqc.en: HOL: The Netherlands will now be invited to the Allies despite being at war with Indonesia after getting invaded by Germany.
19rprqc.zh: HOL：在遭德国入侵后，荷兰尽管正与印度尼西亚交战，现在仍会被邀请加入同盟国。

dgwhdo.en: SIA: Advisors when playing without Thunder at Our Gates enabled should no longer be displayed as question mark placeholder.
dgwhdo.zh: SIA：在未启用「雷霆临门」时游玩，顾问不应再显示为问号占位符。

3jhqw4.en: Fixed the Treaty of Saadabad focus branch overlapping the Kurdish focus tree as Iraq when obsolete focus branches are shown
3jhqw4.zh: 修复了在显示已作废国策分支时，作为伊拉克游玩时《萨阿达巴德条约》国策分支与库尔德国策树重叠的问题。

14tvpe2.en: Fixed a bug where Special Forces doctrines were shown to everyone, even if you didn't own the relevant DLC. (AAT or NCNS).
14tvpe2.zh: 修复了特种部队学说会向所有人显示、即便你并未拥有相关 DLC（AAT 或 NCNS）的 bug。

t6ei8q.en: The new releasable nations in Indonesia now also have access to the Nusantara/Greater Indonesia formable decision category
t6ei8q.zh: 印度尼西亚新增的可释放国家现在也可以使用「努山塔拉/大印度尼西亚」可组建国家决议类别。

1xshl2d.en: INS: Fixed an issue where the Indonesian National Revolution ending would sometimes not whitepeace the rest of the Allies.
1xshl2d.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚民族革命结束时有时不会与同盟国其余成员白和的问题。

gcuhdm.en: INS: Indonesia can no longer take the 'Purge the Opportunists' Focus, which creates a faction, if Indonesia is puppeted.
gcuhdm.zh: INS：如果印度尼西亚已被傀儡化，它不再能点出会创建阵营的「清洗投机分子」国策。

1vsk32p.en: INS: Indonesia can no longer use democratic elections (which don't work) after forming the Netherlands-Indonesia Union.
1vsk32p.zh: INS：在组建荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦之后，印度尼西亚不再能使用民主选举（原本就无法生效）。

1mp0flo.en: Fixes Czechoslovakia not puppeting Hungary after taking the Neutralize Hungarian Threat Focus and capitulating Hungary.
1mp0flo.zh: 修复了捷克斯洛伐克在点出「消除匈牙利威胁」国策并迫使匈牙利投降后却未将其傀儡化的问题。

mcl3c6.en: SIA: Unconventional Tank Construction now grants -15% build cost instead of -20% and -10% reliability instead of -15%.
mcl3c6.zh: SIA：「非常规坦克建造」现在给予 -15% 建造成本（原为 -20%）与 -10% 可靠性（原为 -15%）。

qz0vc2.en: AST: The Focus 'Defying American Interference': Added fallbacks if the Philippines are no longer a subject of the USA.
qz0vc2.zh: AST：国策「抗拒美国干涉」：新增后备方案，以应对菲律宾不再是美国附庸的情况。

fhso2.en: AST: Added MILS to fascist focuses 'Walls Like Uluru' and 'Crush the Gates' + spirit National Defense modifier tweaks
fhso2.zh: AST：为法西斯主义国策「如乌鲁鲁般的城墙」与「粉碎城门」添加了军用工厂，并调整了国防国家精神修正。

5mgl0g.en: AST: Added mission to Australia First Movement decisions to visualize and keep track of the insufficient funds timer.
5mgl0g.zh: AST：为澳大利亚优先运动决议新增了任务，以直观显示并追踪资金不足的计时器。

a9nsov.en: AST: Decreased Non-Core Attack / Defence values by roughly half on the 'Australian Military Forces' National Spirit .
a9nsov.zh: AST：将「澳大利亚军事力量」国家精神的非核心攻击/防御数值降低约一半。

1rf2ttl.en: SIA: Fixed a bug that caused players without La Resistance DLC to not get a proper bonus from the Seri Thai OSS Focus
1rf2ttl.zh: SIA：修复了未拥有抵抗运动 DLC 的玩家无法从自由泰人 OSS 国策获得正确加成的 bug。

t0tw8o.en: INS: Allow an Indonesian-formed Netherlands-Indonesia union to take most Dutch economic focuses from the joint tree.
t0tw8o.zh: INS：允许由印度尼西亚组建的荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦从联合国策树中点出大部分荷兰经济国策。

x891ud.en: AST: Added tooltip for Planned Extraction to show this focus will give access to the endless Pilbara steel decision.
x891ud.zh: AST：为「有计划的开采」添加了提示框，说明该国策将解锁无尽的皮尔巴拉钢铁决议。

jbuh5q.en: Fixed the crash that could happen due to the spy operative mastering ability to be in two countries at the same time
jbuh5q.zh: 修复了因特工特工掌握同时身处两个国家的能力而可能发生的崩溃。

1gqr8m2.en: INS: The Indonesian communist branch will no longer create a generic faction with the 'Strength in Unity' manifest.
1gqr8m2.zh: INS：印度尼西亚共产主义分支不再会以「团结即力量」宣言创建一个通用阵营。

11o325a.en: AST: The Focus 'Singapore Strategy' is now available if either ENG or AST controls Singapore, instead of only ENG.
11o325a.zh: AST：现在只要 ENG 或 AST 任一控制新加坡，国策「新加坡战略」就可用，而不再仅限于 ENG。

1q74o6n.en: INS: Indonesia no longer needs to control impassable states such as Interior Borneo in order to win the revolution
1q74o6n.zh: INS：印度尼西亚不再需要控制如内陆婆罗洲这样的不可通行州才能赢得革命。

1doe2sb.en: SIA: Finishing the 'Triangular Defense network' now gives a flat +10% Compliance boost to any occupied territory.
1doe2sb.zh: SIA：完成「三角防御网络」现在会为任何被占领土提供固定的 +10% 顺从度加成。

uq2bt3.en: Fixed bug where clients could join the lobby directly, instead of hot-joining once the host loaded into the map.
uq2bt3.zh: 修复了客户端可以直接加入大厅、而非在主机载入地图后中途加入的 bug。

1uxigls.en: AST: Fixed an issue so the Focuses 'Done Meddling’ & 'The Ultimate Overseas Duty' don't reset war participation.
1uxigls.zh: AST：修复了国策「不再插手」与「终极海外使命」会重置战争贡献的问题。

16rngbw.en: AST: Tooltip for locked Air Crash advisor to show he's available only if Canberra Air Disaster hasn't happened.
16rngbw.zh: AST：为锁定的空难顾问添加提示框，说明只有在堪培拉空难尚未发生时才可用。

1wop5zk.en: SIA: Removed Reliability penalty for 'Unconventional Tank Designs' and added a -5% Soft attack penalty instead.
1wop5zk.zh: SIA：移除了「非常规坦克设计」的可靠性惩罚，改为 -5% 软攻惩罚。

1hiic8w.en: Fixed an issue where Army HQs became the default garrison garrison template if all other templates were locked.
1hiic8w.zh: 修复了当其他所有师编制都被锁定时，陆军司令部会成为默认驻军师编制的问题。

s6p6wj.en: AST: Hidden Australia's prospect decision which were TAOG only (they never worked, but showed up in the list).
s6p6wj.zh: AST：隐藏了仅限于 TAOG 的澳大利亚前景决议（它们从未生效，却会出现在列表中）。

9ejcd7.en: Fixed a bug where Commander Ability cost was determined by number of divisions instead of number of battalions
9ejcd7.zh: 修复了指挥官能力花费取决于师的数量、而非营的数量的 bug。

17g6qi5.en: Fix Army Leaders cloned for a Civil War still thinking they are deployed with the Army of the original Leader.
17g6qi5.zh: 修复了为内战克隆的陆军领袖仍以为自己随原领袖的集团军部署的问题。

10cn6b1.en: SIA: King of the White Elephant propaganda poster tooltip and its effect on Weekly Stability have been fixed.
10cn6b1.zh: SIA：「白象之王」宣传海报的提示框及其对每周稳定度的影响已被修复。

gmc5bt.en: Blockade Runner admiral trait requirement reduced from 37 to 32 knots to allow for support and repair ships.
gmc5bt.zh: 「封锁突破者」海军上将特质的要求从 37 节降至 32 节，以便纳入支援舰与维修舰。

1iniujy.en: INS: The Indonesian focus 'The Timor Issue' will now dynamically switch icons & loc if Timor is independent.
1iniujy.zh: INS：如果帝汶已独立，印度尼西亚国策「帝汶问题」现在会动态切换图标与本地化文本。

1l75ud3.en: AST: Decision 'Scorch the North' gives effect when specific states are naval invaded instead of when at war.
1l75ud3.zh: AST：决议「焦土北方」现在会在特定州遭海军登陆时产生效果，而不再是在开战时。

bwefck.en: INS: Indonesia’s AI will have a higher risk tolerance for raids if the only alternative is cancelling them.
bwefck.zh: INS：如果唯一的替代方案是取消突袭，印度尼西亚 AI 对突袭的风险容忍度会更高。

rrw6ml.en: AST: Added TAOG/Non-TAOG DLC checks for Custom Game Rules / AI Behavior to prevent displaying a double set
rrw6ml.zh: AST：为自定义游戏规则/AI 行为添加了 TAOG/非 TAOG 的 DLC 检测，以避免显示重复的一套选项。

18ul2gm.en: INS: Added a small naval branch for the Dutch East Indies joint tree, which is available during peacetime.
18ul2gm.zh: INS：为荷属东印度联合国策树新增了一个小型海军分支，在和平时期可用。

pekhc8.en: SIA: Added option to pick a new leader when the Seri Thai Takes over, Phin Choonhavan or Khuang Aphaiwong.
pekhc8.zh: SIA：在自由泰人运动接管时新增了选择新领袖的选项：Phin Choonhavan 或 Khuang Aphaiwong。

dpgrcn.en: Fixed a bug where lobbies with more than 20 players would struggle with more people connecting to the game
dpgrcn.zh: 修复了玩家超过 20 人的大厅在更多人连接游戏时会出问题的 bug。

1nenfwo.en: Fixed an issue where dynamic countries could be created without valid Army HQ templates, causing a crash.
1nenfwo.zh: 修复了动态国家可能在没有有效陆军司令部师编制的情况下被创建、从而导致崩溃的问题。

y3k7dr.en: SIA: American Tank Studies now only grants its attack bonus instead of -5% build cost reduction as well.
y3k7dr.zh: SIA：「美国坦克研究」现在只给予其攻击加成，而不再同时给予 -5% 建造成本减免。

1llupxu.en: AST: The Focus 'Reclaim the Lost Territory' now transfers all land, naval, and air forces to Australia.
1llupxu.zh: AST：国策「收复失地」现在会将所有陆军、海军与空军部队移交给澳大利亚。

137exic.en: ENG: The UK will build more synthetic refineries to safeguard their supply of rubber. (autarky is king)
137exic.zh: ENG：英国会建造更多合成炼油厂以保障其橡胶供应。（自给自足才是王道）

6m7hfq.en: AST: Toned down the tech rushing capability through 'Lee-Enfield No.1 Mk III*' and 'Owen Gun' focuses.
6m7hfq.zh: AST：下调了通过「Lee-Enfield No.1 Mk III*」与「Owen Gun」国策冲科技的能力。

1hvot4u.en: SIA: Fixed a bug that would cause Yellow Dossier events to fire after 'Spring the Trap' was completed.
1hvot4u.zh: SIA：修复了在「收网」完成之后仍会触发黄色档案事件的 bug。

18okxhu.en: INS: Added a decision for the Netherlands-Indonesia Union to move its capital to Amsterdam or Batavia.
18okxhu.zh: INS：为荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦新增了一项决议，可将首都迁至阿姆斯特丹或巴达维亚。

29t5ne.en: AST: The Focuses 'Liberate the Colonies' and 'Red Solidarity' now have a tooltip to show what they do.
29t5ne.zh: AST：国策「解放殖民地」与「红色团结」现在有了提示框来说明其作用。

x8i7wh.en: AST: Mount Isa Industrial Concern will now display correctly when upgraded through Planned Extraction.
x8i7wh.zh: AST：艾萨山工业集团在通过「有计划的开采」升级之后，现在会正确显示。

jl8qj9.en: AST: Decisions Vichy Out of Africa is now removed by the Focus 'Undeniably Ours', not 'Done Meddling'.
jl8qj9.zh: AST：决议「将维希逐出非洲」现在由国策「无可争议地属于我们」移除，而非「不再插手」。

wbmwnp.en: SIA: Slightly increased the probability that asking for the return of territories goes in Siams favor
wbmwnp.zh: SIA：略微提高了索还领土的请求有利于暹罗的几率。

3i9iy8.en: INS: Feint uprisings now cost more manpower (2500 > 5000), but less infantry equipment (2500 > 1500).
3i9iy8.zh: INS：佯动起义现在消耗更多人力（2500 > 5000），但消耗更少步兵装备（2500 > 1500）。

1pxha7.en: GER: Decision Reichskommissariat Australasian required states has been adjusted to match map changes.
1pxha7.zh: GER：决议「澳大利亚总督辖区」所需的州已调整，以匹配地图改动。

17q38eu.en: The Grand Assault milestone 'Forward Command Posts' supply reduction was reduced from -0.05 to -0.01
17q38eu.zh: 大突击里程碑「前沿指挥所」的补给削减从 -0.05 降至 -0.01。

11u5gw8.en: SIA: In the Seri Thai branch the Focus 'Prepare to Drop' now gives a special forces National Spirit.
11u5gw8.zh: SIA：在自由泰人分支中，国策「准备空投」现在会给予一个特种部队国家精神。

r8lxud.en: SIA: You now need to be a faction leader to get updated bonuses from the 'Asian Democratic Compact'.
r8lxud.zh: SIA：现在你需要成为阵营领袖，才能获得「亚洲民主协定」更新后的加成。

1orck3y.en: A subject owning a single state no longer creates a 'new war participant' popup when joining a war.
1orck3y.zh: 仅拥有一个州的附庸国在参战时不再会产生「新的参战方」弹窗。

xuysys.en: Fix issue where militia raid unit models were in an idle pose while displayed above the raid arrow.
xuysys.zh: 修复了民兵突袭单位模型在突袭箭头上方显示时摆出待机姿势的问题。

grsyr8.en: SIA: 'Army of Siam' is now a dynamic modifier instead of a National Spirit to reduce spirit bloat.
grsyr8.zh: SIA：「暹罗军队」现在是一个动态修正而非国家精神，以减少国家精神泛滥。

1qhyz4t.en: SIA: Rising up as the Seri Thai against Japan now seizes some valuables, giving a temporary bonus.
1qhyz4t.zh: SIA：作为自由泰人运动反抗日本起义时，现在会夺取一些贵重物品，给予临时加成。

uc8a4u.en: Divisions with an active ability that is being nerfed because of late joiners show that reduction.
uc8a4u.zh: 因有人中途加入而被削弱的、拥有主动能力的师会显示该削减。

ez0qw0.en: HOL: The Netherlands will no longer sometimes cave to the British when going communist or fascist.
ez0qw0.zh: HOL：荷兰在走向共产主义或法西斯主义时，不再有时会屈服于英国。

1b4laiu.en: HOL: The Focus 'Continue the War in Batavia' now moves the capital to Batavia instead of Bandung.
1b4laiu.zh: HOL：国策「在巴达维亚继续抗战」现在会将首都迁至巴达维亚，而非万隆。

ndte6z.en: AST: Event The Prime Minister Succumbs localization has been fixed to reference correct character
ndte6z.zh: AST：事件「首相辞世」的本地化文本已被修复，以引用正确的角色。

guhv4c.en: ETH: The Focus 'Freedom at Gunpoint' now will only take African states and leaves the rest alone.
guhv4c.zh: ETH：国策「枪口下的自由」现在只会夺取非洲的州，其余州则不予触碰。

oxwxjv.en: Fixes issue where division templates used in a garrison could be edited to have zero suppression.
oxwxjv.zh: 修复了用于驻军的师编制可以被编辑为零镇压值的问题。

cvlsgv.en: INS/HOL: Significantly reduced the factories required for the focus 'The Industrialized Colony'.
cvlsgv.zh: INS/HOL：大幅降低了国策「工业化殖民地」所需的工厂数。

110s0gv.en: SIA: When agricultural tax reduction is removed you now gain a one time tech bonus for industry.
110s0gv.zh: SIA：农业税减免被移除时，你现在会获得一次性的工业科技加成。

3uvu7l.en: JAP: Fixed Japan's 'Strike the Southern Road' Focus being unreachable if Siam no longer existed.
3uvu7l.zh: JAP：修复了若暹罗已不复存在，日本的「出击南方道路」国策无法点出的问题。

s9hga4.en: Heavy Armor HQ Security is now capable of exercising instead of relaxing all day in their Tanks.
s9hga4.zh: 重装甲司令部警卫部队现在能够进行操练，而不再整天待在坦克里休息。

1spe9y2.en: GER: German focus 'Around Maginot' now targets an Indonesian-formed Netherlands-Indonesia Union.
1spe9y2.zh: GER：德国国策「绕开马奇诺」现在会以由印度尼西亚组建的荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦为目标。

ajixlb.en: SIA: Removed a redundant requirement in the Focus 'Spread Democratic Sentiment In Universities'.
ajixlb.zh: SIA：移除了国策「在大学传播民主情绪」中的一项多余要求。

1dyvhmy.en: INS: Indonesia will no longer lose Dutch generals when having completed ‘Volksraad Compromises’.
1dyvhmy.zh: INS：在完成「Volksraad 妥协」之后，印度尼西亚不再会失去荷兰将领。

ftt244.en: SIA: Recover Indochina and Demand the return of lost territory are no longer mutually exclusive
ftt244.zh: SIA：「收复中南半岛」与「索还失地」不再互斥。

4lzs2y.en: SIA: German Tank Studies now grants +5% piercing bonus instead of a -10% build cost reduction.
4lzs2y.zh: SIA：「德国坦克研究」现在给予 +5% 穿透加成，而不再给予 -10% 建造成本减免。

9mqksd.en: Added a new event sound tickbox to disable/enable scripted event sounds. For example speeches.
9mqksd.zh: 新增了一个事件音效勾选框，用于禁用/启用脚本事件音效。例如演讲。

9px62o.en: SIA: Added the king of the white elephant as a Movie poster decision, giving weekly stability.
9px62o.zh: SIA：新增了「白象之王」作为电影海报决议，可提供每周稳定度。

ufu6je.en: CTD: Fixed a crash that occurred when calling 'gain_xp' command on a fleet without an Admiral.
ufu6je.zh: CTD：修复了对没有海军上将的舰队调用 gain_xp 指令时发生的崩溃。

11t6mj5.en: HOL: the National Spirit 'Profitable Colony' is no longer removed immediately upon being added
11t6mj5.zh: HOL：「有利可图的殖民地」国家精神不再在添加后立即被移除。

1iu259b.en: AST: Setting and clearing flag in Vichy territory requests for decisions Vichy Out of Africa.
1iu259b.zh: AST：在「将维希逐出非洲」决议的维希领土请求中设置并清除标记。

15l8nbe.en: Fixed wrong interactions and tooltips for Generals while assigning a leader to an Army Group.
15l8nbe.zh: 修复了在为集团军指派领袖时将领的错误交互与提示框。

pvxy9t.en: Pending Commander now shows up as a smaller portrait when re-assigning them to another army.
pvxy9t.zh: 待命指挥官在重新指派到另一支集团军时，现在会以小号肖像显示。

1yxl02b.en: SIA: Reduced compliance gain from the Focus 'Built to Withstand Every Flame' from 10% to 5%.
1yxl02b.zh: SIA：将国策「为承受一切烈焰而建」的顺从度增长从 10% 降至 5%。

o87s4e.en: Fixed a bug where a spearhead or offensive line order was not advancing to destination tiles
o87s4e.zh: 修复了突击或进攻线命令不会向目标格推进的 bug。

384tfb.en: AST: Removed misplaced trigger on 'Strike Ongoing' which made it cancel if not owning Nauru.
384tfb.zh: AST：移除了「罢工进行中」上放错位置的触发器——它会在不拥有瑙鲁时取消该精神。

6o17w3.en: SIA: The 'Artillery Enthusiast' trait now no longer applies to the Self-Propelled Artillery.
6o17w3.zh: SIA：「火炮爱好者」特质现在不再对自行火炮生效。

6fgjp5.en: Armies with deployed HQ can now change Commander, who will wait for the HQ to be withdrawn.
6fgjp5.zh: 拥有已部署司令部的集团军现在可以更换指挥官，新指挥官会等待该司令部撤回。

15wzf4m.en: USA: Added home guard defense logic to protect the continent once the Axis become a threat.
15wzf4m.zh: USA：新增了国民卫队防御逻辑，以便在轴心国构成威胁后保护本土大陆。

dzjte2.en: SIA: Fixed an issue where limited wars would cause France to not be able to join a faction.
dzjte2.zh: SIA：修复了有限战争会导致法国无法加入阵营的问题。

1ijibwe.en: INS: The Netherlands-Indonesia Union will now transfer all characters, including advisors.
1ijibwe.zh: INS：荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦现在会移交所有角色，包括顾问。

1qanx2.en: AST: Rebalanced the Australian Air Branch, decreasing especially their mission efficiency.
1qanx2.zh: AST：重新平衡了澳大利亚空军分支，尤其降低了其任务效率。

hlktq.en: Fixed an issue where Division Designer dropdown items buttons did not have the right size.
hlktq.zh: 修复了师编制设计器下拉菜单项按钮尺寸不正确的问题。

1x2cll9.en: INS: Fixed a broken command power modifier given by the Indonesian 'Laskar Rakyat' focus.
1x2cll9.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚「Laskar Rakyat」国策所给予的失效指挥点数修正。

1esmljw.en: Divisions with multiple active commander abilities now show them all instead of just one.
1esmljw.zh: 拥有多项已激活指挥官能力的师现在会全部显示，而不再只显示一项。

1yi48hk.en: ENG: The UK will be more likely to take 'Gateway to Europe' decisions on Historical mode.
1yi48hk.zh: ENG：在历史模式下，英国会更倾向于执行「通往欧洲的门户」决议。

y91ovc.en: When writing a file, it's now guarded by a try/catch and will error when unable to write.
y91ovc.zh: 写入文件现在由 try/catch 保护，无法写入时会报错。

10t11u1.en: INS/HOL: Significantly reduced the factories required for the focus 'The Soetardjo Act'.
10t11u1.zh: INS/HOL：大幅降低了国策「苏塔佐法案」所需的工厂数。

1ltju9l.en: INS: Fixed several incorrect equipment names for Indonesian mechanized and armored cars.
1ltju9l.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚机械化与装甲车的若干错误装备名称。

54sf0g.en: SIA: Pridi now gets his Civilian Wing Leader correctly when completing Secure the state.
54sf0g.zh: SIA：Pridi 在完成「确保国家」之后现在会正确获得其文官派领袖身份。

11rmxjb.en: SIA: Fixed a bug where the Allies could decline Siam's offer to join from the Seri Thai.
11rmxjb.zh: SIA：修复了同盟国可以拒绝暹罗由自由泰人运动提出的加入请求的 bug。

912me0.en: Fixes the conflicting available tooltip for 'The Between the Seas Concept' to be clearer
912me0.zh: 修复了「两海之间构想」相互冲突的可用提示框，使其更加清晰。

1py2702.en: Sir Mohammed Iqbal and Agha Khan III will now be unhired when Pakistan starts existing.
1py2702.zh: 当巴基斯坦开始存在时，穆罕默德·伊克巴尔爵士与阿迦汗三世现在会被解聘。

1ann8hz.en: CTD: Fix a crash that occurred when assigning a deployed Field Marshal to an Army Group
1ann8hz.zh: CTD：修复了将已部署的元帅指派给集团军时发生的崩溃。

htwn4y.en: Now showing all manpower modifiers in tooltips even if they sum up to a neutral number.
htwn4y.zh: 现在提示框中会显示所有人力修正，即便它们合计为零。

hq3eo6.en: INS: Fixed an issue where the Indonesian Volksraad would be inaccessible after a veto.
hq3eo6.zh: INS：修复了在否决之后印度尼西亚的 Volksraad 无法访问的问题。

w1um7e.en: AST: Changed focus length from 70 to 35 for several focuses, and swapped a few icons.
w1um7e.zh: AST：将若干国策的时长从 70 天改为 35 天，并调换了几个图标。

16i7mbg.en: AST: Fixed a bug with the small portrait of John Lavarack showing the wrong portrait.
16i7mbg.zh: AST：修复了约翰·拉瓦拉克的小肖像显示错误肖像的 bug。

14vfpck.en: SIA: 'Asian Democratic Compact' now only counts non-puppets that are in your faction.
14vfpck.zh: SIA：「亚洲民主协定」现在只计算你阵营中的非傀儡国。

1r0hl7y.en: Added missing spriteType entry for event picture and switched out two event pictures.
1r0hl7y.zh: 为事件图片补充了缺失的 spriteType 条目，并替换了两张事件图片。

1q238xn.en: Fixed a bug where Commander Abilities cost was affected by a general's planning skill
1q238xn.zh: 修复了指挥官能力花费会受将领计划技能影响的 bug。

yyjhyo.en: AST: Decreased Citizen Army penalty to non-core Attack and Defence from -25% to -15%.
yyjhyo.zh: AST：将「公民军」对非核心攻击与防御的惩罚从 -25% 降至 -15%。

4d4bzb.en: JAP: After being defeated in the war, Japan is now discouraged from joining the Axis.
4d4bzb.zh: JAP：在战争中被击败之后，日本现在会被劝阻不要加入轴心国。

yy0j9d.en: SIA: Fixed an issue where changing laws would not properly adjust the Khana Ratsadon.
yy0j9d.zh: SIA：修复了更改法令时未能正确调整人民党的问题。

10hwn9r.en: AST: Applying A Sound Voice trait which failed earlier in the decision A Sound Voice
10hwn9r.zh: AST：应用了此前在决议「可靠的声音」中失败未生效的「可靠的声音」特质。

mosy4g.en: Fixed an issue where Volunteers would not come back when Air Base Access is enabled.
mosy4g.zh: 修复了启用空军基地通行权时志愿军不会返回的问题。

1pj69st.en: AST: Australia now gains the 'Liverpool Dockworker' uprising from 'Out of the Den'.
1pj69st.zh: AST：澳大利亚现在会通过「走出巢穴」获得「利物浦码头工人」起义。

au5qbg.en: INS: Indonesia's leader will no longer reset after peacefully gaining independence.
au5qbg.zh: INS：印度尼西亚在和平获得独立之后不再会重置领袖。

1ghzh2i.en: AST: Communist Civil War should no longer happen if Australia is already Communist.
1ghzh2i.zh: AST：如果澳大利亚已经是共产主义，共产主义内战不应再发生。

knkw2c.en: SIA: Fixed an issue where invite country to Asian Democratic Compact wasn't showing
knkw2c.zh: SIA：修复了「邀请国家加入亚洲民主协定」不显示的问题。

dvranz.en: AST: Tweaked the values of Decisions and National Spirits for the Fascist branch.
dvranz.zh: AST：调整了法西斯分支决议与国家精神的数值。

pny5vn.en: Expeditionary Leader trait Non-Core Attack and Defence reduced from +15% to +10%.
pny5vn.zh: 「远征军领袖」特质的非核心攻击与防御从 +15% 降至 +10%。

k1u08f.en: GER: Introduced some intermediate plane variants for the improved_small_airframe.
k1u08f.zh: GER：为 improved_small_airframe 引入了一些中间型飞机改型。

aaft44.en: RAJ: Loc typo for displaying current resistance in string currentStateResistance.
aaft44.zh: RAJ：字符串 currentStateResistance 中显示当前抵抗度的本地化拼写错误。

lyr3qj.en: PHI: Added Sergio Osmena as a country leader option after Manuel Quezon's death.
lyr3qj.zh: PHI：新增塞尔吉奥·奥斯梅尼亚作为曼努埃尔·奎松去世后的国家领袖选项。

3hvs2v.en: INS: Fixed certain characters not appearing for the Netherlands-Indonesia Union.
3hvs2v.zh: INS：修复了某些角色不会为荷兰-印度尼西亚联邦出现的问题。

8occqz.en: AST: Changed event images for AST_diplomatic_events.73, AST_diplomatic_events.76
8occqz.zh: AST：更改了 AST_diplomatic_events.73 与 AST_diplomatic_events.76 的事件图片。

6733e5.en: AST: Added TAOG check to event The 1938 Sesquicentenary (AST_political_events.6)
6733e5.zh: AST：为事件「1938 年一百五十周年纪念」（AST_political_events.6）添加了 TAOG 检测。

36h2kn.en: Anzac Achievement is now correctly only triggered by generals and field marshals
36h2kn.zh: Anzac 成就现在正确地只由将领与元帅触发。

14e3937.en: AST: Now has access to their second Special Forces branch via the Marines focus.
14e3937.zh: AST：现在可通过海军陆战队国策使用其第二个特种部队分支。

kbt4e3.en: INS: Militia unit upgrades now increase the success chance of Indonesian raids.
kbt4e3.zh: INS：民兵单位升级现在会提高印度尼西亚突袭的成功率。

11ahtbz.en: Tooltip for maximum command power now correctly shows the name of the advisors.
11ahtbz.zh: 指挥点数上限的提示框现在会正确显示顾问的名称。

ylb53g.en: SIA: Reduced Build cost IC for 'Unconventional Tank Designs' from -15% to -10%.
ylb53g.zh: SIA：将「非常规坦克设计」的建造成本工业产能减免从 -15% 降至 -10%。

18d91db.en: SIA: Starting a limited war now requires the territory to be adjacent to yours.
18d91db.zh: SIA：发动有限战争现在要求目标领土与你方领土相邻。

10byuln.en: AST: 'The Phosphate Commission' now requires both owning and controlling Nauru.
10byuln.zh: AST：「磷酸盐委员会」现在要求同时拥有并控制瑙鲁。

ydmp17.en: INS: Clarified an Indonesian tooltip in the declaration of independence focus.
ydmp17.zh: INS：澄清了印度尼西亚独立宣言国策中的一处提示框。

v2d853.en: INS: Fixed a broken modifier added by the Indonesian 'Arm the Students' focus.
v2d853.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚「武装学生」国策所添加的失效修正。

wlaztb.en: INS: Conrad Helfrich is no longer unavailable as a Chief of Navy for Indonesia
wlaztb.zh: INS：康拉德·赫尔弗里希不再会作为印度尼西亚的海军总司令而不可用。

7c8ilb.en: AST: Fixed a bug where communist Australia had a hard time ending civil wars.
7c8ilb.zh: AST：修复了共产主义澳大利亚难以结束内战的 bug。

7vea9x.en: Fix a bug where deployed Generals were able to be deployed as Field Marshals.
7vea9x.zh: 修复了已部署的将领还能被部署为元帅的 bug。

13j2ul6.en: INS: Fixed several Focuses occasionally attempting to target Interior Borneo.
13j2ul6.zh: INS：修复了若干国策偶尔会尝试以内陆婆罗洲为目标的问题。

1s6up7j.en: Load and continue buttons in main menu now correctly displays cosmetic flags
1s6up7j.zh: 主菜单中的「载入」与「继续」按钮现在会正确显示外观旗帜。

1n4vzof.en: AST: A. Ruthven set as leader if monarchist UK starts uprising in Australia.
1n4vzof.zh: AST：若君主主义英国在澳大利亚发动起义，A. Ruthven 会被设为领袖。

oipq9s.en: Fixed a bug where pending hot-joins didn't show up in the UI to be accepted.
oipq9s.zh: 修复了待处理的中途加入请求不会显示在界面中以待接受的 bug。

1uwyyrh.en: AST: Focus Done Meddling will no longer flood error log on hovering over it.
1uwyyrh.zh: AST：将鼠标悬停在国策「不再插手」上时，不再会刷爆错误日志。

1on1xz3.en: Remove incorrect tooltip which falsely claimed an advisor would be unlocked.
1on1xz3.zh: 移除了错误地声称会解锁某位顾问的提示框。

1ews9hf.en: AST: Set to correct Fascist cosmetic tag when becoming independent manually.
1ews9hf.zh: AST：手动独立时会设置为正确的法西斯主义外观标签。

df916f.en: HOL: The achievement 'Bevrijding' is no longer impossible with TAOG enabled.
df916f.zh: HOL：在启用 TAOG 时，成就「Bevrijding」不再是不可能完成的。

10g28qr.en: INS: Indonesia will now core all of their starting states in the revolution
10g28qr.zh: INS：印度尼西亚现在会在革命中为其全部初始州建立核心。

mmzdmi.en: INS: Clarified the effect of the Focus 'Privately Owned Military Industry'.
mmzdmi.zh: INS：澄清了国策「私营军事工业」的效果。

276q3.en: INS: Hollandia will now be renamed to Jayapura if Indonesia is independent.
276q3.zh: INS：如果印度尼西亚已独立，荷兰迪亚现在会被更名为查亚普拉。

hgq2z2.en: AST: Changed incorrect value in the tooltip of the mission 'Final Reforms'.
hgq2z2.zh: AST：更改了任务「最终改革」提示框中的错误数值。

obvp4t.en: SIA: Fixed an issue where you could demand to release your own territories.
obvp4t.zh: SIA：修复了你可以要求释放自己领土的问题。

miljtf.en: ABDACOM: Vichy France no longer has access to the ABDACOM joint focus tree.
miljtf.zh: ABDACOM：维希法国不再能使用美英荷澳司令部联合国策树。

117xstj.en: SIA: Thailand is now evil red instead of blue when Siam turns to Thailand.
117xstj.zh: SIA：当暹罗转变为泰国时，泰国现在会是邪恶的红色而非蓝色。

1dsb0ae.en: INS: Indonesia can now core East Timor using Unity in Diversity decisions.
1dsb0ae.zh: INS：印度尼西亚现在可以通过「多元统一」决议为东帝汶建立核心。

ip73ul.en: Updated script documentation following the addition of new math functions.
ip73ul.zh: 在新增数学函数之后更新了脚本文档。

e6rof9.en: INS: Fixed a typo in the Focus description 'Continue the Hybrid Politics'.
e6rof9.zh: INS：修复了国策描述「继续混合政治」中的一处拼写错误。

1rnuaz4.en: SIA: Fixed a bug that caused the Seri Thai to not add intel bonus properly
1rnuaz4.zh: SIA：修复了导致自由泰人运动无法正确添加情报加成的 bug。

is0r0l.en: Fix AI constantly deploying and withdrawing Army HQs under Field Marshals.
is0r0l.zh: 修复了 AI 不断在元帅麾下部署又撤回陆军司令部的问题。

jsy8fm.en: Sync HQ deploy template and CP reservation when retemplating a deployed HQ
jsy8fm.zh: 在重新编制已部署司令部时同步司令部部署编制与指挥点数预留。

1cfk3yd.en: INS: Fixed unlocalized string in Indonesian democratic elections tooltip.
1cfk3yd.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚民主选举提示框中未本地化的字符串。

dm4szd.en: AST: Adding a is_coastal check to several focuses that gave coastal forts
dm4szd.zh: AST：为若干给予海岸炮台的国策添加了 is_coastal 检测。

2hposj.en: SIA: Made the requirement for forming the Greater Thai empire more clear.
2hposj.zh: SIA：使组建大泰帝国的要求更加清晰。

b8mdtq.en: GER: Bougainville added to focus Break the Anglo-French Colonial Hegemony
b8mdtq.zh: GER：将布干维尔加入国策「打破英法殖民霸权」。

bsvpbs.en: AST: Democratic branch autonomy gain has been increased from 0.1 to 0.3.
bsvpbs.zh: AST：民主主义分支的自治度增长从 0.1 提高到 0.3。

1ailhqv.en: INS: Indonesia now gets events after finishing a militia base decision.
1ailhqv.zh: INS：印度尼西亚在完成民兵基地决议之后现在会获得事件。

1l2pija.en: Added a few common math functions pow, sqrt, cos, sin, tan, exp and log
1l2pija.zh: 新增了几个常用数学函数：pow、sqrt、cos、sin、tan、exp 与 log。

1eu44b0.en: AST: Changed Naval Engineer (Percival McNeil) icon to be more relevant.
1eu44b0.zh: AST：更改了海军工程师（珀西瓦尔·麦克尼尔）的图标，使其更为贴切。

5zrs8e.en: Fix an issue where Czechs puppets would trigger the Sudetenland Crisis.
5zrs8e.zh: 修复了捷克傀儡国会触发苏台德危机的问题。

qpfywu.en: SIA: Reduced compliance gain from full Civilian support from 10% to 5%.
qpfywu.zh: SIA：将文官派全力支持的顺从度增长从 10% 降至 5%。

1r7a8a7.en: INS: Indonesian decision "Order a Ceasefire" now requires escalation 2+
1r7a8a7.zh: INS：印度尼西亚决议「下令停火」现在要求升级等级为 2 或以上。

l81xm3.en: ITA: Introduced historical Italian fighter designs for the AI to build.
l81xm3.zh: ITA：引入了历史性的意大利战斗机设计供 AI 建造。

ocd8r0.en: The Regimental Support Rocket Battery no longer affects division speed.
ocd8r0.zh: 团级支援火箭炮连不再影响师的速度。

6tjebq.en: Division Designer should now save correctly restricted equipment types
6tjebq.zh: 师编制设计器现在应能正确保存受限的装备类型。

10vlrtd.en: AST: Updated Expéditionnaire Français en Extrême-Orient name to CEFEO.
10vlrtd.zh: AST：将 Expéditionnaire Français en Extrême-Orient 的名称更新为 CEFEO。

7tlnyk.en: AST: Australia now must own Nauru for The Phosphate Commission focus.
7tlnyk.zh: AST：澳大利亚现在必须拥有瑙鲁才能点出「磷酸盐委员会」国策。

1vhf0xf.en: AST: Australian Infantry Divisions now have the proper division icon.
1vhf0xf.zh: AST：澳大利亚步兵师现在拥有正确的师图标。

mvop7g.en: The Division Designer click-shortcuts now also apply to HQ templates.
mvop7g.zh: 师编制设计器的点击快捷键现在也适用于司令部编制。

ehf5ke.en: ABDACOM focuses are now mostly 35 days (first and last are 70 day).
ehf5ke.zh: 美英荷澳司令部国策现在大多为 35 天（首个与末个为 70 天）。

1f0t26v.en: INS: Indonesia can no longer access the Volksraad when independent.
1f0t26v.zh: INS：印度尼西亚独立之后不再能使用 Volksraad。

ks1tx7.en: INS/HOL: Fixed a missing icon in Dutch spirit 'Agricultural Taxes'.
ks1tx7.zh: INS/HOL：修复了荷兰「农业税」国家精神中缺失的一个图标。

z6hqsp.en: INS: Fixed a typo in the Focus description 'Women in the Military'.
z6hqsp.zh: INS：修复了国策描述「军队中的女性」中的一处拼写错误。

1awegnv.en: Fixed a bug where infiltration tokens disappear when loading saves.
1awegnv.zh: 修复了读取存档时渗透标记会消失的 bug。

vgw5yc.en: SIA: Added decisions to Develop Northern Malaya and Eastern Burma.
vgw5yc.zh: SIA：新增了开发北马来亚与东缅甸的决议。

1r524yi.en: Fix the commander skill bonus modifier not being properly applied
1r524yi.zh: 修复了指挥官技能加成修正未能正确生效的问题。

n3mjew.en: Block disbanding armies with a deployed HQ, preventing an exploit
n3mjew.zh: 阻止解散拥有已部署司令部的集团军，以防堵一个漏洞。

r0wtkz.en: INS: Fixed a bug where Indonesia could have two resource trades.
r0wtkz.zh: INS：修复了印度尼西亚可以有两笔资源贸易的 bug。

1j70767.en: SIA: Fixed 2 planes not showing up in the tech tree without BBA.
1j70767.zh: SIA：修复了在没有 BBA 时 2 种飞机不显示在科技树中的问题。

1j2u35t.zh: AST：重新平衡了澳大利亚的各项人口增长修正。

1189j9a.zh: AST：调整民主主义与共产主义志愿军国策的效果。

14x9cgo.en: AST: Fascist autonomy gain has been increased from 0.1 to 0.3.
14x9cgo.zh: AST：法西斯主义分支的自治度增长从 0.1 提高到 0.3。

w0xvq7.zh: AST：加入后备方案，以应对未启用 NCNS 时给予阵营效果的国策。

15l7wqi.zh: INS：修复了国策「Overallwagen」的拼写错误——应为「Overvalwagen」。

1mkykll.zh: 修复了 Shift+点击会使西班牙能够部署已锁定的司令部编制的问题。

1pdwamm.zh: AST：「爱丽斯泉」国策的时长已缩短至 35 天。

199c1mn.zh: SIA：将暹罗的开局稳定度从 19% 提高到 29%。

7gnj2s.zh: AST：重新平衡了 AI 权重，使其略多地侧重空军。

7i3xty.en: SIA: Fixed an incorrect tooltip in the Seri Thai Branch.

xc2ib8.zh: AST：锁定在空难事件中必定身亡的默认顾问。

vg8e90.en: Allow queuing the HQ deployment of en-route Commanders.
vg8e90.zh: 允许将为在途指挥官部署司令部排入队列。

7gj2zb.en: Forum: Thunder at our Gates | Patch 1.19.1, 2026-06-17.

b894dh.en: Forum: Thunder at our Gates | Patch 1.19.2, 2026-06-30.

1b1vvs8.en: Main menu icon for TaoG now correctly shows ownership.
1b1vvs8.zh: TaoG 的主菜单图标现在会正确显示拥有状态。

1ektyc1.en: INS: Fixed a missing loc string in an Indonesian event
1ektyc1.zh: INS：修复了某个印度尼西亚事件中缺失的本地化字符串。

1a5im28.en: AST: Decision Call On Fascist now has a dynamic cost.
1a5im28.zh: AST：决议「召唤法西斯主义者」现在具有动态花费。

sydb1j.en: SIA: Kedah is now renamed to Syburi if cored by Siam.
sydb1j.zh: SIA：如果吉打被暹罗建立核心，现在会被更名为 Syburi。

ouek8c.en: JAP: Japan is more likely to naval invade Borneo now.
ouek8c.zh: JAP：日本现在更有可能对婆罗洲实施海军登陆。

1u7i8ps.en: Fixed a missing localisation string (Mt. Isa Mines).
1u7i8ps.zh: 修复了缺失的本地化字符串（Mt. Isa Mines）。

h1a4su.en: OOS: Fixed a late-game gamestate OOS caused by MIOs.
h1a4su.zh: OOS：修复了由军工组织导致的后期游戏状态失同步。

1005qui.en: SIA: Replaced an inappropriately themed focus icon.
1005qui.zh: SIA：替换了一个主题不当的国策图标。

1596h6z.en: SIA: Removed increasing cost for theater decisions.
1596h6z.zh: SIA：移除了战区决议的递增花费。

dcem9j.en: Fixed Assign Commander tooltips with TAOG disabled.
dcem9j.zh: 修复了在未启用 TAOG 时「指派指挥官」的提示框。

sd29vs.en: INS: Fixed a typo in the Focus 'Women's Sufferage'.
sd29vs.zh: INS：修复了国策「Women's Sufferage」中的拼写错误。

1le8gpy.en: SIA: Fixed tooltip for 'Asian Democratic compact'.
1le8gpy.zh: SIA：修复了「亚洲民主协定」的提示框。

bqrnc7.en: Added dams to the States & Construction mapmodes.
bqrnc7.zh: 在州与建造地图模式中新增了水坝。

gz5nio.en: Fixed the tooltip for the Maphilindia achievement
gz5nio.zh: 修复了 Maphilindia 成就的提示框。

f9h2of.en: Added joint focus tree icons to ABDACOM focuses.
f9h2of.zh: 为美英荷澳司令部国策新增了联合国策树图标。

p8almk.en: SIA: Fixed missing tech names for tech bonuses.
p8almk.zh: SIA：修复了科技加成缺失的科技名称。

1u00s7w.en: Added a lerp function to the math expressions.
1u00s7w.zh: 为数学表达式新增了 lerp 函数。

g84mk5.zh: ⟦0⟧ 均为以 1.19 开头的补丁。

1w7nsow.en: INS: Fixed typo in Murk Boerstra's name.
1w7nsow.zh: INS：修复了 Murk Boerstra 名字中的拼写错误。

1g4k9fo.zh: AST：新增了可组建国家「澳大拉西亚」。

1t1h16j.en: Added atan and atan2 math functions
1t1h16j.zh: 新增了 atan 与 atan2 数学函数。

15rteuv.en: Fixed various issues where Syria and Lebanon could escape from war and territorial losses when Vichy France was created by siding with them or declaring independence, and made it so they properly peace out enemies or not depending on their choices in the event chain. The now also gain historical flags and leaders when becoming Vichy puppets.
15rteuv.zh: 修复了叙利亚与黎巴嫩在维希法国因与其站在一起或宣布独立而成立时得以摆脱战争与领土损失的多种问题，并使它们能依据其在事件链中的选择正确地与敌人媾和或不予媾和。它们在成为维希傀儡国时现在也会获得符合历史的旗帜与领袖。

72xt2q.en: Shoot and Scoot: All three SP categories had max organisation reduced from +10 to +5 and recovery rate from +20% to +15%. SP artillery additionally gains +5% soft attack; SP anti-air additionally gains +5% anti-air; tank destroyers' hard attack reduced from +15% to +5%.
72xt2q.zh: 「射击与转移」：全部三个自行装备类别的最大组织度加成从 +10 降至 +5，恢复速度从 +20% 降至 +15%。自行火炮额外获得 +5% 软攻；自行防空炮额外获得 +5% 防空；坦克歼击车的硬攻从 +15% 降至 +5%。

1537o2y.en: Raj: Fixed an issue where the Mughals could puppet existing countries when having the Princes Revolt against British India if they held a core of theirs. Also fixed a few characters not being correctly recruited, who are now available for the path.
1537o2y.zh: Raj：修复了莫卧儿在让土邦王公反抗英属印度时，若对方拥有其核心，就能傀儡现有国家的问题。还修复了若干角色未能被正确招募的问题，他们现在可在该路线中使用。

aaavct.en: Torpedo Mountings and Anti-Ship Guided Missile - they are considered one family, and as such Upgrade Option in the Plane Designer will upgrade them Torpedo Mounting I -> Torpedo Mounting II -> Torpedo Mounting III -> Anti-Ship Guided Missile
aaavct.zh: 鱼雷挂架与反舰导弹被视为同一系列，因此在飞机设计器中的「升级选项」会按 Torpedo Mounting I -> Torpedo Mounting II -> Torpedo Mounting III -> Anti-Ship Guided Missile 的顺序升级它们。

1afao2i.en: Integrated Support Batteries: Support artillery soft attack nerfed from +10% to +5%; anti-tank and anti-air support companies now also benefit (+20 max organisation, +5% AP and +5% hard attack for anti-tank, +5% air attack for anti-air).
1afao2i.zh: 「整合支援炮兵连」：支援火炮的软攻从 +10% 削弱至 +5%；反坦克与防空支援连现在也能受益（+20 最大组织度，反坦克获得 +5% 穿甲与 +5% 硬攻，防空获得 +5% 对空攻击）。

1bxulzo.en: Added in more critical states for ships: Leaking Pressure Hull, Leaking Battery, Jammed Torpedo Tube, Broken Diesel Engines, Broken Bilge Pump, Shortcircuited Radar, Leaking Fuel Tanks, Reactor Coolant Loss, and Fire Direction Breakdown.
1bxulzo.zh: 为舰船新增了更多严重状态：耐压壳渗漏、电池渗漏、鱼雷发射管卡死、柴油机损坏、舱底泵损坏、雷达短路、燃油舱渗漏、反应堆冷却剂流失与射击指挥故障。

a9av0q.en: Fixed an issue where Iraq could become permanently locked out of their decisions to invite nation to the Hashemite Arab Federation if they ended up at war with them or they disappeared while the targeted decision was still ongoing.
a9av0q.zh: 修复了伊拉克在与受邀加入哈希姆阿拉伯联邦的国家开战、或该国在定向决议仍在进行期间消失时，会永久无法再使用这些邀请决议的问题。

1fj4f6y.en: Poland: The focus 'Institute Royal Guards' now creates a valid division template. Also it is now slightly buffed (instead of 2 Division 7 Infantry 2 Artillery it is now creating 2 Divisions of 8 Infantry 2 Artillery, Polska Gurom)
1fj4f6y.zh: 波兰：「设立皇家卫队」国策现在会创建一个有效的师编制。它还得到了小幅增强（现在创建 2 个由 8 个步兵营与 2 个炮兵营组成的师，而非此前的 2 个师各 7 步兵 2 炮兵，Polska Gurom）。

1d181oj.en: Commercial Nuclear Reactor will now contribute 0.01% Daily Breakthrough towards 'Physics/Nuclear' category. (As it already contributed to the production of the Nuclear Bombs, it will now also be listed in the respective tooltip).
1d181oj.zh: 商用核反应堆现在会为「物理学/核」类别贡献 0.01% 的每日突破进度。（由于它本就对核弹的生产有所贡献，现在它也会被列在相应的提示框中。）

5ndi5l.en: Italy will use its airforce more in Africa and keep a strong presence in North-Africa, even when its attacking Yugoslavia, and Greece. They also no longer will reinforce mindlessly in the Sub-Saharan region.
5ndi5l.zh: 意大利会在非洲更多地使用其空军，并在北非保持强大存在，即便它正在进攻南斯拉夫与希腊。它们也不会再在撒哈拉以南地区盲目增兵。

fqwl4.en: Added a small optimization for borderwars where the AI tried and failed interacting with it while technically not allowed to do so. (AKA: Made the AI stop trying (and failing) to cheat in border wars).
fqwl4.zh: 为边境战争加入了一项小幅优化：此前 AI 会在技术上不被允许的情况下尝试与之交互并失败。（也就是说：让 AI 不再试图（并失败地）在边境战争中作弊。）

hf1x2l.en: The two Japanese focuses locked behind having Yamakawa Kikue as the country leader can now also be taken if she is hired as an advisor, which she can be if her husband is the country leader.
hf1x2l.zh: 那两个需要山川菊荣担任国家领袖才能解锁的日本国策，现在在她被聘为顾问时也可以点出；如果她的丈夫是国家领袖，她就能被聘为顾问。

52jgus.en: Re-added an airbase that had been accidentally removed for the 1939 scenario and fixed an issue where the Warlord focuses 'An Autonomous Tibet' and 'Conquer Tibet' wouldn't properly bypass.
52jgus.zh: 重新加入了在 1939 年剧本中被意外移除的一个空军基地，并修复了军阀国策「自治的西藏」与「征服西藏」无法正确跳过的问题。

1ur2fr.en: Fixed an issue where Afghanistan would be forced into a faction with Germany despite being in its own one when completing either 'Into the Plains of the British Raj' or 'The Red Threat'.
1ur2fr.zh: 修复了阿富汗在完成「挺进英属印度平原」或「红色威胁」时，尽管已身处自己的阵营，仍会被强行拉入与德国的阵营的问题。

1j2bcnz.en: Iran no longer gains redundant research bonuses when going down the Negotiate with America / Establish the Iranian Nuclear Program focuses, instead getting breakthrough points.
1j2bcnz.zh: 伊朗在走「与美国谈判」/「建立伊朗核计划」国策时不再获得多余的科研加成，而是获得突破点数。

18gmapn.en: Warships of the Pacific: Fixed so only Commonwealth and ENG get Commonwealth ship icons, not all faction members of ENG which led to France getting defaulted to British ships.
18gmapn.zh: 「太平洋战舰」：已修复为只有英联邦国家与 ENG 获得英联邦舰船图标，而不再是 ENG 的所有阵营成员都能获得——这曾导致法国被默认使用英国舰船。

1otmpqy.en: The Iranian focuses 'The Iranian Socialist Revolution' and 'Force Abdication' now properly inform the player that a civil war can be avoided if certain conditions are met.
1otmpqy.zh: 伊朗国策「伊朗社会主义革命」与「强制退位」现在会正确告知玩家：若满足某些条件，可以避免内战。

12ec5i0.en: The Indian focus 'Princely States Policy' now shows the effects of the unlocked laws upfront, and if taken by an ai the Independent Rule law is now automatically applied.
12ec5i0.zh: 印度国策「土邦政策」现在会预先显示所解锁法令的效果；若由 AI 点出，独立统治法令现在会自动应用。

to3v83.en: Fixed an issue where Japan and Germany could be unable to send volunteers to Afghanistan or the Soviet Union despite promising to do so due to ideology and world tension.
to3v83.zh: 修复了日本与德国尽管承诺派遣志愿军，却因意识形态与世界紧张度而无法向阿富汗或苏联派遣的问题。

15t4z6z.en: Afghanistan: The 'Eliminate dissent' in a state decisions under 'Shadows of the King' are available again if the decision got canceled without completing the decision.
15t4z6z.zh: 阿富汗：「国王的阴影」下的各州「消除异议」决议在未完成即被取消后，现在可以再次使用。

18hc5q2.en: The British Raj will now drop their 'Raj' cosmetic tag at the end of a peace conference if they are either independent or a subject of a different nation than the UK.
18hc5q2.zh: 如果英属印度在和平会议结束时已独立、或成为英国以外其他国家的附庸，它现在会丢弃其「Raj」外观标签。

17j49i3.en: Belgium will no longer get a puppet war goal on Congo if they handover Congo through the German focus "Carve up Congo" and is then released as a puppet of Germany.
17j49i3.zh: 如果比利时通过德国国策「瓜分刚果」移交刚果、随后又作为德国的傀儡国被释放，它将不再获得针对刚果的傀儡战争目标。

94pofq.en: Fixed an issue where in the Swedish focus, 'The Åland Issu', Finland would refuse to cede Åland if Sweden was much stronger, contrary to what the focus describes.
94pofq.zh: 修复了瑞典国策「奥兰问题」中的一个问题：当瑞典强大得多时，芬兰会拒绝割让奥兰，与该国策的描述相悖。

bn9tw9.en: Add allow_in_multiple_tracks property for subdoctrines, which determines whether one subdoctrine can be added to multiple tracks simultaneously (default is no).
bn9tw9.zh: 为子学说新增了 allow_in_multiple_tracks 属性，用于决定一个子学说能否被同时加入多条路线（默认为否）。

1m0yd8j.en: Fire Concentration Subdoctrine will now properly provide +5% Defense Bonus as well as +5 Organization to the Line Artillery Unit Category in the Initial unlock.
1m0yd8j.zh: 「火力集中」子学说现在会在初始解锁中正确地为一线炮兵单位类别提供 +5% 防御加成以及 +5 组织度。

12q6ea.en: The negative effects of failing the 'People's Trust' mission as the PRC are now better displayed in the tooltip, and have been merged into one National Spirit.
12q6ea.zh: PRC 未能完成「人民的信任」任务的负面效果现在会在提示框中更好地显示，并已合并为一个国家精神。

798lnx.en: Axel Pehrsson Bramstorp and Gösta Bagge no longer keep the trait 'Minority opposition party in power' after being re-elected in the 1936 general election.
798lnx.zh: 阿克塞尔·佩尔松·布拉姆斯托普与约斯塔·巴格在 1936 年大选中再次当选后，不再保留「少数派反对党执政」特质。

1874ifb.en: Fixed 'The Fall of Cairo' events targeting the wrong state, and allowed them to also be triggered if Egypt owns the state but is in a faction with the UK.
1874ifb.zh: 修复了「开罗陷落」事件指向错误州的问题，并允许它们在埃及拥有该州但与英国同属一个阵营时也能触发。

1v40aat.en: Removes support for 'add_temporary_buff_to_units' and adds new 'unit_modifiers' to cover these use cases. All Army HQ abilities now use 'unit_modifiers'.
1v40aat.zh: 移除了对 add_temporary_buff_to_units 的支持，并新增 unit_modifiers 来覆盖这些用途。所有陆军司令部能力现在都使用 unit_modifiers。

cku6l.en: Added the ability for all releasable nations within the British Raj as well as Nepal and Bhutan to unite the Indian subcontinent into a formable nation.
cku6l.zh: 新增了让英属印度境内所有可释放国家以及尼泊尔与不丹将印度次大陆统一为一个可组建国家的能力。

eghkzy.en: Fixed an issue where the Iranian focus 'Reach Out to Separatists' did not properly apply the opposition-control state modifiers to the western regions.
eghkzy.zh: 修复了伊朗国策「接触分离主义者」未能正确对西部各地区应用反对派控制州修正的问题。

1rpk7cz.en: Combined Arms Integration: Removed +4 max organisation for tanks; removed +10% air attack for anti-air support company (migrated to anti-air battery).
1rpk7cz.zh: 「合成兵种整合」：移除了坦克的 +4 最大组织度；移除了防空支援连的 +10% 对空攻击（已迁移至防空炮连）。

17td0c2.en: Added the ability to Shift+Click on a template icon to open the division designer for that template from the Army List view and Unit Details view.
17td0c2.zh: 新增了在陆军列表视图与单位详情视图中按住 Shift 点击师编制图标以打开该编制师编制设计器的功能。

wr84zn.en: Game is now literally playable after fixing Typo in the Belgian Focus about Re-establishing Belgian Navy. Navy and game is now literally playable.
wr84zn.zh: 在修复了比利时关于重建比利时海军的国策中的拼写错误后，游戏现在真的可以游玩了。海军与游戏现在真的可以游玩了。

l32rtn.en: Fixed a bug where ships unable to escape the harbor as the province gets captured would get stuck in limbo. They either flee or scuttle the ships.
l32rtn.zh: 修复了在省份被占领时无法逃离港口的舰船会陷入停滞状态的 bug。它们现在要么逃走，要么自沉。

1v6wkca.en: Fixed an issue where the 'Manchuko People's Army' and 'People's Liberation Army' National Spirits didn't give any Recruitable Population Factor.
1v6wkca.zh: 修复了「满洲人民军」与「人民解放军」国家精神不提供任何可征召人口系数的问题。

gzfzu0.en: Fixed an issue where the decision 'Diversify Elite Forces' checked for an implicit 'and' instead of 'or', causing it to not show up correctly.
gzfzu0.zh: 修复了「精锐部队多样化」决议检查的是隐含的「and」而非「or」，导致其无法正确显示的问题。

1co4ufq.en: Supervised States can now decline being called into a war, to represent the difference between regular puppets and democratized governments.
1co4ufq.zh: 受监管国家现在可以拒绝被召入战争，以体现普通傀儡国与民主化政府之间的差异。

rh0xnn.en: Rejigged the Mexican AI strategy plans so that they build up and prepare more before they eventually go to war with the USA and the Allies.
rh0xnn.zh: 重新调整了墨西哥 AI 的战略计划，使其在与美国及同盟国开战之前会更多地积蓄力量与做准备。

5durun.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese AI would sometimes puppet or liberate states out of its own core territory at the end of their Civil War.
5durun.zh: 修复了日本 AI 有时会在其内战结束时从自身核心领土中傀儡或释放国家的问题。

14ijjop.en: The UK is now less likely to select a faction rule that reduces the tension needed to guarantee other nations when playing on historical.
14ijjop.zh: 在历史模式下，英国现在较不可能选择那条降低保障他国所需世界紧张度的阵营规则。

179yq2q.en: Fixed an issue where fascist Norway would be locked out of the focus Norwegian Reichsprotektorate if the democratic side ceased to exist.
179yq2q.zh: 修复了若民主派一方不复存在，法西斯主义挪威就无法点出「挪威帝国总督辖区」国策的问题。

lflokq.en: Fixed an issue where the available tooltip would appear twice for the Radio Propaganda decision if not playing as Brazil or Afghanistan.
lflokq.zh: 修复了在不以巴西或阿富汗游玩时，广播宣传决议的可用提示框会显示两次的问题。

1ly4x1i.en: Japan: If the pressure Siam focus isn't available due to them being in another faction, Japan will now pivot to their focus Occupy Siam.
1ly4x1i.zh: 日本：如果因暹罗身处其他阵营而无法使用施压暹罗国策，日本现在会转而点出其「占领暹罗」国策。

vut15r.en: An AI hosting governments in exile no longer stops upgrading its own division templates as a side effect of refreshing exile templates.
vut15r.zh: 收容流亡政府的 AI 不再会因刷新流亡政府师编制而附带地停止升级自己的师编制。

yudzq5.en: Fixed an issue where Germany would fail to go down their democratic path when it was randomly chosen when historical AI was turned off.
yudzq5.zh: 修复了在关闭历史 AI 后，德国在被随机选中走民主路线时却无法走该路线的问题。

inm4uy.en: Added Dispersed Operations doctrine for Thunder at our Gates, focusing on hardening logistics & reduce the effect of enemy air power.
inm4uy.zh: 为「雷霆临门」新增了「分散作战」学说，侧重于强化后勤并降低敌方空中力量的影响。

1ar9ag2.en: 'And the Snake Smoked' achievement now requires you to be in the Allies, and requires germany to be capitulated or no longer exist.
1ar9ag2.zh: 「And the Snake Smoked」成就现在要求你身处同盟国，并要求德国已投降或不再存在。

1cb1ttg.en: 'Improve Cross Border Rail Connections' focus will now also include subject nations when adding connections to bordering countries.
1cb1ttg.zh: 「改善跨境铁路连接」国策在向接壤国家添加连接时，现在也会把附庸国计算在内。

1gaavk5.en: Fixed an issue where the PRC could repeatedly demand Manchuria from Japan and leave their faction despite being a puppet of theirs.
1gaavk5.zh: 修复了 PRC 尽管是日本的傀儡国，却可以反复向日本索要满洲并退出其阵营的问题。

1f6146d.en: UK: Changed 'Blackshirt replace dominion government' decisions to send event instead of changing dominion ideology unilaterally.
1f6146d.zh: UK：将「黑衫党替换自治领政府」决议改为发送事件，而不再单方面改变自治领的意识形态。

1ngnyq.en: Soviets and Germans have updated AT and armored templates. The AI will also more likely prioritize templates that need updating.
1ngnyq.zh: 苏联与德国已更新其反坦克与装甲师编制。AI 也会更倾向于优先处理需要更新的师编制。

1ifwk06.en: UK: Fixed Dominions getting event to leave Commonwealth when UK goes fascist/communist even if a dominion has the same ideology.
1ifwk06.zh: UK：修复了即便某自治领拥有相同意识形态，在英国转为法西斯主义/共产主义时该自治领仍会收到退出英联邦事件的问题。

1gk29fd.en: Raj: Added correct focus filters to 'Royal Indian Navy Mutiny', 'Quality Training', and 'Soviet Indian Industrial Cooperation'.
1gk29fd.zh: Raj：为「皇家印度海军哗变」「优质训练」与「苏印工业合作」添加了正确的国策筛选标签。

1azol14.en: If Sweden joins the Winter War as a result of the Finnish focus 'A Cry for Help', it is no longer considered an offensive war.
1azol14.zh: 如果瑞典因芬兰国策「呼救」而加入冬季战争，这不再被视为一场进攻性战争。

dfmocf.en: India is now more likely to annex Princely States that try and break free from them, rather than puppeting or liberating them.
dfmocf.zh: 印度现在更倾向于吞并试图脱离它的土邦，而不是将其傀儡化或释放。

bbqtvz.en: Iranian events from the focuses Demand Iraqi Territory and Demand Afghan Territory will now properly mention the name of Iran.
bbqtvz.zh: 来自「索取伊拉克领土」与「索取阿富汗领土」国策的伊朗事件现在会正确提及伊朗的名称。

1kwti01.en: Introducing Army HQs which allows for the deployment of generals into the field to provide additional support to their army.
1kwti01.zh: 推出陆军司令部，允许将将领部署到战场上，为其军队提供额外支援。

k2pep.en: Fixed an issue where Reza Shah Pahlavi would show up incorrectly in multiplayer if one player had GOE and the other didn't.
k2pep.zh: 修复了在一名玩家拥有 GOE 而另一名没有时，礼萨·沙阿·巴列维在多人游戏中错误显示的问题。

b8p2hr.en: The Pearl Harbor raid now has a lower base success chance, but it is improved by taking the focus 'Form the Kido Butai'.
b8p2hr.zh: 珍珠港突袭现在的基础成功几率更低，但点出「组建机动部队」国策可以提升该几率。

lqjccl.en: Self-Sufficient Battalion: Armored signal battalion_mult on tank destroyers nerfed: AP attack reduced from +20% to +10%.
lqjccl.zh: 「自给自足营」：坦克歼击车上装甲通信营的 battalion_mult 被削弱：穿甲攻击从 +20% 降至 +10%。

1g4g4ot.en: AI is better at filling their carriers with airplanes, even if they can't field the best, they will reuse old equipment.
1g4g4ot.zh: AI 更擅长为航母配备飞机了，即便无法装备最好的机型，它们也会重复使用旧装备。

ggkngn.en: The Achievement 'The Juannines' now only requires the Philippines to control and have cores on Spain's European states.
ggkngn.zh: 成就「The Juannines」现在只要求菲律宾控制西班牙的欧洲各州并在其上拥有核心。

b7elvz.en: Iraq forming the Hashemite Arab Federation will now annex any subject included in their newly gained core territories.
b7elvz.zh: 伊拉克组建哈希姆阿拉伯联邦时，现在会吞并任何包含在其新获得核心领土之内的附庸国。

e4poj.en: Fixed various issues and inconsistencies with the decolonization game rule for Asia, Africa, Oceania and the Americas.
e4poj.zh: 修复了针对亚洲、非洲、大洋洲与美洲的非殖民化游戏规则的多种问题与不一致之处。

hnrcna.en: Fixed an issue where the New Zealand decisions to demand Polynesian states wouldn't give all those that were demanded.
hnrcna.zh: 修复了新西兰索要波利尼西亚各州的决议不会给予所索要全部州的问题。

zf30u1.en: Pakfront: Anti-tank brigade +20% defense moved to Emplacement Rotation & +20% soft attack moved to Weakpoint Studies
zf30u1.zh: 「反坦克阵线」：反坦克旅的 +20% 防御移至「阵地轮换」，+20% 软攻移至「弱点研究」。

8icfjb.en: Fixed an issue where Iranian decisions to Plant Resistance Cells granted effects upon completion instead of removal.
8icfjb.zh: 修复了伊朗「安插抵抗小组」决议在完成时给予效果、而非将其移除的问题。

94kjjs.en: Made the AI verify that they don't have access to special research facilities before building another one of them.
94kjjs.zh: 让 AI 在再建造一座特殊研究设施之前，先确认自己尚未拥有该类设施的访问权。

ebjex.en: Fixed an issue where France had 3D models for TDs and SPGs assigned incorrectly when playing without No Step Back.
ebjex.zh: 修复了在不启用「绝不后退」游玩时，法国坦克歼击车与自行火炮的 3D 模型被错误分配的问题。

1or4zb5.en: Fixed an issue where a few states were missing from the decisions unlocked by the Afghan focus Kabul Conference.
1or4zb5.zh: 修复了阿富汗国策「喀布尔会议」所解锁的决议中缺少少数几个州的问题。

13nn7uv.en: Raj: Fixed an issue where Shubhas Chandra Bose was still available as an advisor and general while hiding away.
13nn7uv.zh: Raj：修复了苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯在躲藏期间仍可作为顾问与将领使用的问题。

7edis2.en: Fixed a bug where the Union of Soviet Workers could get the world to help them and 6000 divisions would arrive.
7edis2.zh: 修复了苏联工人联盟可以召来全世界的援助、结果 6000 个师蜂拥而至的 bug。

gdgyzf.en: Added Ship Captains to Naval vessels and the ability to grant them medals and promote them to become Admirals.
gdgyzf.zh: 为海军舰船新增了舰长，以及授予他们勋章并将其晋升为海军上将的能力。

vshn15.en: Chile: Fixed an issue where taking the focus 'Treading the Straight Line' would break Ibanez' small portrait.
vshn15.zh: 智利：修复了点出「循规蹈矩」国策会破坏伊巴涅斯小肖像的问题。

ue0jt6.en: Fixed an issue where the event chain from the Iranian focus 'Push for Negotiations' was missing descriptions.
ue0jt6.zh: 修复了伊朗国策「推动谈判」的事件链缺少描述的问题。

vc98dq.en: Fixed a bug where Heavy Fighters were not correctly filtered as aircrafts when requesting license production.
vc98dq.zh: 修复了在申请许可生产时，重型战斗机未被正确归类为飞机的 bug。

1sayvmw.en: Added 12 Regimental support companies that are unlocked through techs and synergise with the doctrine system
1sayvmw.zh: 新增了 12 个团级支援连，它们通过科技解锁，并与学说系统相互配合。

qnbo03.en: Fascist China now has access to the Sino-German Technical Mission tank MIO after approaching Western Powers.
qnbo03.zh: 法西斯主义中国在接近西方列强之后，现在可以使用中德技术使团的坦克军工组织。

1unga8h.en: Implement xor property for subdoctrines which makes subdoctrines mutually exclusive between separate tracks.
1unga8h.zh: 为子学说实现了 xor 属性，使子学说在不同路线之间互斥。

mm18r1.en: Fixed an issue where the Soviet Union would sometimes reject communist Iran's request to join their faction.
mm18r1.zh: 修复了苏联有时会拒绝共产主义伊朗加入其阵营请求的问题。

1ers3an.en: Fixed an issue where you could switch country by being able to click on the map on ironman save file screen.
1ers3an.zh: 修复了在铁人模式存档界面上可以点击地图从而切换国家的问题。

1y2pfuq.en: Updated the Japanese AI to be more willing to attack islands to their south when they are going historical.
1y2pfuq.zh: 更新了日本 AI，使其在走历史路线时更愿意进攻其南方的岛屿。

1vbflkn.en: Fixed two instances where the Stresa Front could be ratified while Italy was a subject of a foreign power.
1vbflkn.zh: 修复了意大利为外国附庸时仍可批准斯特雷萨阵线的两处情况。

vla0k6.en: The Famine state modifiers will now be removed if the owner of the state is not RAJ or a puppet of theirs.
vla0k6.zh: 如果州的拥有者不是 RAJ 或其傀儡国，饥荒州修正现在会被移除。

12ye04k.en: Added arrows to the Italian BoP decision names to indicate which direction they will push the Balance in.
12ye04k.zh: 为意大利权力平衡决议的名称添加了箭头，以指示它们会把平衡推向哪个方向。

1cpg61l.en: Fixed an instance where the Brazilian monarchist civil war triggered by Portugal would cease 1 day after.
1cpg61l.zh: 修复了由葡萄牙触发的巴西君主主义内战在 1 天之后即停止的情况。

12jblhs.en: Fixed an issue where the visual representation of the Naval HQ range did not match the range of the buff.
12jblhs.zh: 修复了海军司令部范围的视觉表示与增益实际范围不符的问题。

1b02fyh.en: Fixed an issue where Navy leaders could be assigned to multiple Naval Headquarters after saving the game.
1b02fyh.zh: 修复了保存游戏后海军领袖可被指派到多个海军司令部的问题。

iec8r4.en: Raid auto launch success probability dropdown is now properly clickable even when running at high speed.
iec8r4.zh: 突袭自动发动成功几率的下拉框现在即便在高速运行下也能正常点击。

1rplp63.en: Fixed a few bugs in sub doctrines where a modifier was shown as a multiplication instead of an addition.
1rplp63.zh: 修复了子学说中若干把修正显示为乘法而非加法的 bug。

1vjtn65.en: Manchukuo: Improved the trait the leader gains when completing the focus 'Claim the Mandate of Heaven'.
1vjtn65.zh: 满洲国：改进了领袖在完成「承继天命」国策时所获得的特质。

oigv59.en: focus_count command now also shows you a summary of the focuses and the days it takes to complete them.
oigv59.zh: focus_count 指令现在还会显示各国策及其完成所需天数的汇总。

bpxtu9.en: Sweden can now bypass the focus 'Narvik Crisis' if Narvik and surrounding area is controlled by Sweden.
bpxtu9.zh: 如果纳尔维克及周边地区由瑞典控制，瑞典现在可以跳过「纳尔维克危机」国策。

l3i8r4.en: PRC: The MIO Dalian Shipbuilding Company now properly requires control of Dalian rather than Liaoning.
l3i8r4.zh: PRC：军工组织大连造船公司现在正确要求控制大连，而非辽宁。

1ryg6m8.en: Afghan focuses granting foreign ideological influence now mention that the ideas will last for 1 year.
1ryg6m8.zh: 给予外国意识形态影响力的阿富汗国策现在会说明这些理念将持续 1 年。

1xdfvnj.en: Sir Mohammed Iqbal and Agha Khan III will now be unavailable if Pakistan has broken free from the Raj.
1xdfvnj.zh: 如果巴基斯坦已从 Raj 中挣脱，穆罕默德·伊克巴尔爵士与阿迦汗三世现在将不可用。

ffref7.en: Fixed an issue where some Indian design companies would become invisible when their civil war started.
ffref7.zh: 修复了印度内战爆发时某些印度设计商会变为不可见的问题。

oct4wr.en: Artillery Groups: Support artillery now also benefits, gaining +5% soft attack and +10% breakthrough.
oct4wr.zh: 「炮兵集群」：支援火炮现在也能受益，获得 +5% 软攻与 +10% 突破。

19sy6kt.en: Fixed an issue where some warlord leaders wouldn't be promoted through the Personal Leadership focus.
19sy6kt.zh: 修复了某些军阀领袖无法通过「个人领导」国策获得晋升的问题。

76zu8h.en: Fixed an issue where the Unruly Tribes in southern Iraq were referred to as Shia despite being Sunni.
76zu8h.zh: 修复了伊拉克南部的桀骜部族虽属逊尼派却被称作什叶派的问题。

1p9z3dx.en: Fixed an issue where you could not assign Commanders to an army when having multiple armies selected.
1p9z3dx.zh: 修复了在选中多个集团军时无法为某一集团军指派指挥官的问题。

4h7s30.en: Hovering a province will now show the information about the province control instead of the state's.
4h7s30.zh: 将鼠标悬停在省份上时，现在会显示关于省份控制情况的信息，而非该州的信息。

gb1t65.en: Romania: Fixed a broken AI weight in the event King Carol's Lifestyle - 'King bans critical book'.
gb1t65.zh: 罗马尼亚：修复了事件「卡罗尔国王的生活方式——国王查禁批评书籍」中失效的 AI 权重。

snvcfd.en: 'The Juannines' Achievement won't instantly be completed if Nationalist Spain loses the Civil War.
snvcfd.zh: 如果民族派西班牙在内战中失败，成就「The Juannines」不会被立即完成。

qsgt9w.en: Nordic support collaboration tech now correctly reduces experience loss instead of increasing it.
qsgt9w.zh: 北欧支援合作科技现在会正确减少经验损失，而不再增加它。

1cqppfk.en: When sending multiple armies as volunteers, they will be preserved instead of combined into one.
1cqppfk.zh: 在派遣多个集团军作为志愿军时，它们会被保留下来，而不再合并为一个。

1k8o66p.en: Added filters to the Country Selection Screen for unplayed countries and the various continents.
1k8o66p.zh: 为国家选择界面新增了用于筛选未游玩国家与各大洲的过滤器。

1jdumyi.en: Fixed an issue where the Indian focus 'Kingmaker' would grant two non-functioning rules changes.
1jdumyi.zh: 修复了印度国策「国王制造者」会给予两项无效规则变动的问题。

fa9ll0.en: Wargoals gained from 'Return To Delhi' and 'Reclaim Transoxiana' do not show the correct states.
fa9ll0.zh: 从「重返德里」与「收复河中地区」获得的战争目标未显示正确的州。

xu5foe.en: Tweaked the Ship Details window: moved manpower, display fuel consumption, removed Terrain tab.
xu5foe.zh: 调整了舰船详情窗口：移动了人力显示位置，显示燃料消耗，移除了地形标签页。

xsn35d.en: Fixed an issue where the achievement 'En Svensk Tiger' did not work if No Step Back is enabled.
xsn35d.zh: 修复了在启用「绝不后退」时成就「En Svensk Tiger」不生效的问题。

1dycocw.en: Add is_leader_visible trigger to check whether the given unit leader is visible for its owner.
1dycocw.zh: 新增 is_leader_visible 触发器，用于检查给定单位领袖对其拥有者是否可见。

1fqxxzk.en: Transport Plane 3 Technology - now has the same 1945 Year for both BBA and non-BBA technology.
1fqxxzk.zh: 运输机 3 科技——现在在 BBA 与非 BBA 科技中都具有相同的 1945 年份。

xvve78.en: Fix 'Enemy Raids' alert shown when an ally raid is executed and gains control of the province.
xvve78.zh: 修复了在盟友发动突袭并取得该省份控制权时仍显示「敌方突袭」警报的问题。

1ivq1iq.en: Fixed an issue where multiple Pacific releasable tags were missing generic military advisors.
1ivq1iq.zh: 修复了多个太平洋可释放标签缺少通用军事顾问的问题。

5wjk59.en: Fixed an issue where the Japanese focus 'Hasten the Integration of Taiwan' wasn't bypassable.
5wjk59.zh: 修复了日本国策「加速台湾整合」无法跳过的问题。

1pu9jgh.en: Added 8 Historical Ship Captains in both bookmarks for all Major countries (and Australia!).
1pu9jgh.zh: 为所有主要国家（以及澳大利亚！）在两个书签中都新增了 8 名历史舰长。

sblo2r.en: Stop AI creating Frontlines they cannot reach (because of a demilitarized zone for example).
sblo2r.zh: 阻止 AI 创建它们无法抵达的前线（例如因非军事区而无法抵达）。

74z80h.en: Only bordering states will be transferred if taking the 'Swear Fealty to the Invaders focus'
74z80h.zh: 如果点出「向入侵者宣誓效忠」国策，现在只会移交接壤的州。

5awkxo.en: Added 11 unique HQ support companies that allows for tailoring Army HQs to different needs.
5awkxo.zh: 新增了 11 个独特的司令部支援连，可用于按不同需求定制陆军司令部。

osv6id.en: Multirole Support Vehicles: Moved all SP-vehicle bonuses to regimental-support equivalents.
osv6id.zh: 「多用途支援车辆」：将所有自行车辆加成移至对应的团级支援单位。

dx91q5.en: Fixed an issue where Commanders gained through focuses would not gain XP for their traits.
dx91q5.zh: 修复了通过国策获得的指挥官无法为其特质获得经验的问题。

1t284h7.en: Remove incorrect focus filter in the Raj focus 'Stop the Japanese Threat in Central Asia'.
1t284h7.zh: 移除了 Raj 国策「阻止日本在中亚的威胁」中错误的国策筛选标签。

cnqa81.en: Saadabad: 'Expand Road and Rail Connections' - Focus tooltip displays empty Bypass Effect.
cnqa81.zh: 萨阿达巴德：「扩建公路与铁路连接」——国策提示框显示空的跳过效果。

9j57g7.en: Add support for subdoctrines being assignable to multiple different doctrine track types.
9j57g7.zh: 新增支持，使子学说可被指派到多种不同的学说路线类型。

kytgpi.en: Fixed a bug where Canadian & Italian focus tree still referred to 'medium gun batteries'.
kytgpi.zh: 修复了加拿大与意大利国策树仍引用「中型火炮组」的 bug。

45c3lt.en: Fixed exploit where you could gain more manpower from leaving and rejoining your faction.
45c3lt.zh: 修复了通过退出并重新加入阵营来获取更多人力资源的漏洞。

nb92v1.en: Raj: 'The Peoples Liberation Army' national spirit was missing an apostrophe in its name.
nb92v1.zh: Raj：「The Peoples Liberation Army」国家精神的名称中缺少一个撇号。

1vz3ftp.en: Afghanistan: Fixed 'Unify the Islamic World' - Faction name is missing in focus' effects.
1vz3ftp.zh: 阿富汗：修复了「统一伊斯兰世界」——国策效果中缺少阵营名称。

8zpk87.en: Fixed getting effects from recompleting goals by dismantling and recreating your faction.
8zpk87.zh: 修复了通过解散并重建阵营来重复完成目标以获取效果的问题。

ecyrkw.en: Afghanistan: Fixed 'Extend a Hand to Tokyo' - Faction name is missing in focus' effects.
ecyrkw.zh: 阿富汗：修复了「向东京伸出援手」——国策效果中缺少阵营名称。

eyj796.en: "Quick Decision Offensive Warfare" Militia now gets 1.5% Initiative bonus instead of 1%
eyj796.zh: 「速决进攻战」民兵现在获得 1.5% 主动性加成，而非此前的 1%。

1bq60xe.en: Fixed Balance Of Power transferring to new country after reusing a dynamic country tag.
1bq60xe.zh: 修复了复用动态国家标签后权力平衡被转移到新国家的问题。

1lpb514.en: Kurdish uprising instigated by Iran will no longer have the UK automatically join Iraq.
1lpb514.zh: 由伊朗煽动的库尔德起义不再会让英国自动加入伊拉克一方。

15j8ogk.en: Made United Kingdom more competent at defending egypt and attacking Tripoli, and Iraq.
15j8ogk.zh: 使英国在防守埃及以及进攻的黎波里与伊拉克时更为得力。

urcztv.en: Fixed an issue where the Republic of Congo focus would not bypass if Congo was at war.
urcztv.zh: 修复了刚果处于战争状态时「刚果共和国」国策不会跳过的问题。

1ihpiz8.en: Fixed a crash that could occur during peace conferences when co-oping in multiplayer.
1ihpiz8.zh: 修复了在多人合作中和平会议期间可能发生的崩溃。

th0wqr.en: Stop AI continuously exchanging Army Groups Field Marshals while they are in combat.
th0wqr.zh: 阻止 AI 在集团军元帅处于战斗中时不断地调换他们。

k9ygjl.en: Fixed fascist Latvia decision to incite civil war in Estonia, Lithuania, and Poland.
k9ygjl.zh: 修复了法西斯主义拉脱维亚煽动爱沙尼亚、立陶宛与波兰内战的决议。

n5482n.en: Take Control of the Executive Yaum now properly updates autonomy of Warlord Puppets.
n5482n.zh: 「Take Control of the Executive Yaum」现在会正确更新军阀傀儡国的自治度。

nob1m0.en: The Indian focus 'Varunas Armor' now has a name assigned to the tech bonus it gives.
nob1m0.zh: 印度国策「Varunas Armor」现在为其给予的科技加成指定了名称。

hpnhyy.en: Split the Japanese Home Islands airzone into Northern, Central, and Southern Japan.
hpnhyy.zh: 将日本本土诸岛空域拆分为北日本、中日本与南日本。

16qcobz.en: Nuclear Production Tooltip now counts all the buildings with nuclear_reactor = yes.
16qcobz.zh: 核生产提示框现在会统计所有带有 nuclear_reactor = yes 的建筑。

oq7ywz.en: Fixed multiple issues of mismatches between small/medium/large flags for countries.
oq7ywz.zh: 修复了各国小/中/大型旗帜之间不匹配的多处问题。

6u0ewm.en: Fixed an issue where several Indian events had pictures not relevant to the region.
6u0ewm.zh: 修复了若干印度事件使用了与该地区无关的图片的问题。

nbj4uh.en: Invite to Hashemite Arab Federation decisions will now highlight the whole country.
nbj4uh.zh: 「邀请加入哈希姆阿拉伯联邦」决议现在会高亮显示整个国家。

n1zatv.en: Deployed Army HQs can be assigned to specific orders and buff troops accordingly.
