This path revolves around turning neighboring states communinst through instigating civil wars across Europe, and eventually puppet them once they've become communist. The player gets the option to turn puppeted nations into Volkskommissariats and the ability to puppet them through decisions.
iem7wj.zh: 德意志社会主义人民联盟是一个可通过德国的⟦0⟧焦点分支成立的国家。在共产主义焦点分支中，玩家需要沿以焦点「斯巴达克同盟的遗产」开头的互斥路线推进。该路线围绕通过在欧洲各地煽动内战把邻国变为共产主义国家，并在它们成为共产主义国家后最终将其傀儡化。玩家可以选择把被傀儡化的国家变为人民委员辖区，并获得通过决议傀儡化它们的能力。

1j7bhmx.en: The Slavic Union is a formable nation, that can be formed by choosing Anastasia Romanov as the king and going down the subpath of The Romanov in the ⟦0⟧ branch as ⟦1⟧. This path gives focuses to annex ⟦2⟧ and "Annex" war goals against ⟦3⟧ and the ⟦4⟧. ⟦5⟧ can still form ⟦6⟧ and has access to the relevant focus, allowing it to get cores on Lithuania and Latvia. It is advised to finish the Restore the Commonwealth focus before Proclaim Slavic Unity, otherwise the cores on Ermland-Masuren and Königsberg will be lost.
1j7bhmx.zh: 斯拉夫联盟是一个可成立国家，可以在⟦0⟧分支中选择阿纳斯塔西娅·罗曼诺娃为国王，并走罗曼诺夫子路线，以⟦1⟧的身份来成立。该路线提供吞并⟦2⟧的焦点，以及对⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧的“吞并”战争目标。⟦5⟧仍然可以成立⟦6⟧，并可使用相关焦点，从而获得立陶宛和拉脱维亚的核心领土。建议在「宣告斯拉夫统一」之前先完成「恢复联邦」焦点，否则埃尔姆兰-马祖里和柯尼斯堡的核心领土将会丢失。

1llnotl.en: Throughout this entire process, the United Kingdom must ensure that it maintains control over all of its dominions ( Canada, ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧) as they are all required for the final focus. It doesn't matter if some dominions break away before the Imperial Conference begins, as they can be reconquered and re-puppeted (although losing South Africa can cause complications in getting their cores - see Note 2 below). The UK simply needs to control all of the dominions while the two final focuses are carried out.
1llnotl.zh: 在整个过程中，联合王国必须确保维持对所有自治领（加拿大、⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧和⟦3⟧）的控制，因为最后那个焦点需要它们全部。有些自治领在帝国会议开始前脱离也无妨，因为它们可以被重新征服并重新傀儡化（不过失去南非可能会给获取其核心领土带来麻烦——见下方注 2）。英国只需在最后两个焦点执行期间控制所有自治领即可。

1qkjy6r.en: If the Baltic state opted to stay independent and enter opposition, then Belarus must be acquired through adversarial means. The Baltic state must propagandise support for unification in Belarus similar to the Spanish Civil War garrison control system. This starts a countdown timer and when that time runs out, Belarus will be released and a civil war will ignite in it; the victor will be annexed into either the victorious Baltic nation or the USSR. The rest of Belarus must be conquered from Poland by force.
1qkjy6r.zh: 如果该波罗的海国家选择保持独立并加入反对派，那么就必须通过对抗手段取得白俄罗斯。该波罗的海国家必须像西班牙内战中的驻军控制机制那样，在白俄罗斯宣传对统一的支持。这会启动一个倒计时，时间耗尽后白俄罗斯将被释放并在其中爆发内战；胜者会被并入获胜的波罗的海国家或苏联。白俄罗斯的其余部分则必须通过武力从波兰手中征服。

16q7ez2.en: The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth is a formable nation that represents the Commonwealth that existed from 1569 until 1795 when it was partitioned by Russia, Prussia, and the Austrian Empire. Only ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ can form the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Poland may form the Bermontian Commonwealth or the Congressional Commonwealth if it follows the The Cossack-King or The Romanov paths respectively. It uses the same decision as the regular "Re-form the Commonwealth" decision but Poland keeps its white color.
16q7ez2.zh: 波兰-立陶宛联邦是一个可成立国家，代表着 1569 年至 1795 年间存在的联邦，它在 1795 年被俄罗斯、普鲁士和奥地利帝国瓜分。只有⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧可以成立波兰-立陶宛联邦。若波兰分别走哥萨克国王路线或罗曼诺夫路线，它可以成立别尔蒙德特联邦或国会联邦。它使用与常规的“重建联邦”决议相同的决议，但波兰会保留其白色。

71zzhg.en: Once all of the dominions have been reduced to the Integrated Puppet autonomy level, the player can take the final national focus Imperial Federation. Once that focus completes, the UK will annex all of its dominions, adopt a new name and flag, change its color to a deep red color, and will gain cores on all of the dominion territories apart from the whole of India, and Transvaal in South Africa. The UK will also inherit all military units and military leaders from its former dominions.
71zzhg.zh: 一旦所有自治领都被降到一体化傀儡国自治度等级，玩家就可以选取最后一个国策「帝国联邦」。该焦点完成后，英国将吞并其所有自治领，采用新名称和国旗，把颜色改为深红色，并获得除整个印度和南非德兰士瓦之外所有自治领领土的核心领土。英国还会继承其前自治领的所有军事单位和军事领袖。

1k5sif9.en: In order to form the Imperial Federation, the national focus Reinforce the Empire must be taken to start down the path to founding the Imperial Federation. After that, the national focus Commonwealth Ties opens up the branch that ultimately leads to the Imperial Federation. This branch contains a series of national focuses that develop the UK's dominions by adding industry and building slots, along with slightly reducing the dominion's autonomy level due to the investment.
1k5sif9.zh: 要成立帝国联邦，必须选取国策「加强帝国」，以开启通往创建帝国联邦的道路。此后，国策「英联邦纽带」会打开最终通往帝国联邦的分支。该分支包含一系列国策，通过增加工业和建筑位来发展英国的自治领，同时因投资而略微降低自治领的自治度。

1ndcr6r.en: The Baltic Sea Dominion is a formable nation that consists of mainland ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and the three Baltic states ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧. It can be formed by ⟦6⟧. The easiest way to do so is by unifying the Right. Now you can either decide to follow the monarchist or the fascist path and in the end gain Conquer (Focus) war goals against ⟦7⟧ and the Baltic nations via the focus Dominium Maris Baltici. If chosen, the Nordic League, and the North Sea Federation cannot be formed.
1ndcr6r.zh: 波罗的海自治领是一个可成立国家，由⟦0⟧本土、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧以及三个波罗的海国家⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧和⟦5⟧组成。它可以由⟦6⟧成立。最简单的做法是统一右翼。此后你可以选择走君主主义路线或法西斯主义路线，最终通过焦点「Dominium Maris Baltici」获得对⟦7⟧和波罗的海诸国的征服（焦点）战争目标。若作此选择，则无法成立北欧联盟和北海联邦。

4drsn0.en: The Third Bulgarian Empire is the greater state that ⟦0⟧ tried to form during WWI and WWII. Historically, it represents a restoration of the Bulgarian Empire, which existed in 681-1018 and 1185-1396/1422. These two "Bulgarian Empires" are usually not treated as separate entities but rather as the one and same state restored after a period of foreign rule, so that technically means that the Third Bulgarian Empire is indeed a restoration of the Bulgarian Empire of old.
4drsn0.zh: 第三保加利亚帝国是⟦0⟧在第一次和第二次世界大战期间试图建立的更大国家。从历史上看，它代表保加利亚帝国的复辟，该帝国存在于 681—1018 年和 1185—1396／1422 年。这两个“保加利亚帝国”通常不被视为彼此独立的实体，而是同一个国家在外国统治时期结束后得到恢复，因此严格说来，第三保加利亚帝国确实就是昔日保加利亚帝国的复辟。

5xddsa.en: Greater Italy is one of the two major formable nations available for ⟦0⟧ - the other one being the Roman Empire. Only one of those two can be done unless you go down the papal states path where both decisions can be taken. Forming Greater Italy was the country's goal since the First World War and now requires orienting towards Italian irredentism. The formation seems to be just available to facist, neutral and democratic Italy, but can also be done by communism.
5xddsa.zh: 大意大利是⟦0⟧可用的两个主要可成立国家之一——另一个是罗马帝国。除非你走教宗国路线（那样两个决议都可以选取），否则这两者只能完成其中一个。成立大意大利是该国自第一次世界大战以来的目标，如今则需要转向意大利民族收复主义。该成立条件似乎只对法西斯、中立和民主的意大利可用，但共产主义意大利也可以完成。

1tdbb6m.en: ⟦0⟧ can form this nation by banning foreign Nazi propaganda and going down the path towards supporting the Gotthardbund. With less and less democratic support, the confederation presses for Vorarlberg and expands its holdings via referendum in the neighbor regions. ⟦1⟧ eventually empowers the council and expands the current president's term period via the focus President For Life. This unlocks the decision "dismiss council", forming The Helvetic Republic.
1tdbb6m.zh: ⟦0⟧可以通过禁止外国纳粹宣传并走上支持戈特哈德联盟的路线来成立该国。随着民主支持度不断下降，该联邦索要福拉尔贝格，并通过在邻近地区的全民公投扩张其领地。⟦1⟧最终会通过焦点「终身总统」强化委员会并延长现任总统的任期。这会解锁“解散委员会”决议，从而成立海尔维希亚共和国。

18dhwbo.en: Due to Petorkata enabling both the A Balkan Confederation Sub-branch and the Liberalization of Trade Policies Sub-branch, it is possible to form the United Balkan Federation as every ideology. However, neither the decisions to boost ideology nor the focus Bury the Grudges of the Past will account for this and still treat Bulgaria as if it were Democratic. Furthermore, neither the name nor the flag will change as they are the same for every ideology.
18dhwbo.zh: 由于 Petorkata 同时启用了巴尔干联邦子分支和贸易政策自由化子分支，因此任何意识形态都可以成立联合巴尔干联邦。然而，无论是提升意识形态的决议还是焦点「埋葬昔日恩怨」都不会考虑到这一点，仍会把保加利亚当作民主主义来对待。此外，名称和国旗也不会改变，因为它们对所有意识形态都相同。

e5a9m8.en: Should the ⟦0⟧ be dismantled for whatever reason, then one of the releasable successor states in the historical Idel-Ural region can decide to pick up the pieces of the fallen union and save what still can be saved by forming a united state in the south Urals. In order to form Idel-Ural, the constituent republics of the region must be united. Historically there was a short-lived Tatar state during the Russian Revolution in the region by this name.
e5a9m8.zh: 若⟦0⟧因故解体，那么历史上伊德尔-乌拉尔地区的某个可释放继承国便可决定收拾这个陨落联盟的残局，通过在南乌拉尔成立一个统一国家来挽救尚可挽救之物。要成立伊德尔-乌拉尔，必须统一该地区的各构成共和国。历史上，俄罗斯革命期间该地区确实存在过一个以此为名的短命鞑靼国家。

1lkviod.en: As of 1.19.2, because Canada will be the leader of the Commonwealth of Nations faction, another solution is to manually justify a war goal on one of the Commonwealth of Nations members, declare war, and capitulate Canada, and all of the faction members will surrender. If they are annexed (NOT puppeted) the problem focuses can be bypassed. After bypassing the two focuses, you can release as puppet Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and South Africa.
1lkviod.zh: 截至 1.19.2，由于加拿大将成为英联邦阵营的领袖，另一个解决办法是手动对英联邦成员之一制造战争目标、宣战，并迫使加拿大投降，这样所有阵营成员都会投降。如果他们被吞并（而非被傀儡化），那两个有问题的焦点就可以被跳过。跳过这两个焦点后，你可以把澳大利亚、新西兰、加拿大和南非作为傀儡国释放。

4p72km.en: However, the dream of a Greater Finland would still remain alive and well within Finnish culture and society throughout the interwar era and into World War II, especially within right-wing circles such as the Academic Karelia Society and the fascist Lapua Movement and its successor the People's Patriotic Movement political party. Marshall C. G. E. Mannerheim's Sword Scabbard Declarations of 1918 and 1941 would add further fervor to the idea.
4p72km.zh: 然而，大芬兰的梦想在两次大战之间的整个时期乃至第二次世界大战期间，仍在芬兰文化与社会中生生不息，尤其是在右翼圈子中，例如学术卡累利阿协会、法西斯拉普阿运动及其后继政党人民爱国运动党。曼纳海姆元帅 1918 年和 1941 年的“拔剑宣言”会进一步助长这一理念。

30rw7h.en: The United Kingdoms of Sweden and Hungary is a nation formed when ⟦0⟧ decides to Elect a Democratic King and place the ⟦1⟧ King Carl V Wilhelm on the throne. If Hungary is a ⟦2⟧ nation, either at war or if the World Tension is above 85%, is fully independent and has 50 ⟦3⟧, the King may decide to directly rule the country. When all of the ⟦4⟧ starting cores are owned by Hungary, or a puppet, it may decide to form the nation.
30rw7h.zh: 瑞典与匈牙利联合王国是在⟦0⟧决定「选举一位民主国王」并把⟦1⟧国王卡尔五世·威廉扶上王位时成立的国家。如果匈牙利是⟦2⟧国家、处于战争状态或世界紧张度高于 85%、完全独立且拥有 50 ⟦3⟧，国王便可以直接统治该国。当⟦4⟧所有开局核心领土都由匈牙利或其傀儡国拥有时，它便可决定成立该国。

u16hp6.en: When the conference starts, each dominion gets -100 opinion with the UK for the duration of the conference, effectively canceling out the +50 from being in faction and +50 from being a puppet. Only one decision can be debated at a time. The player will have two months (60 days) to carry out all five decisions; each decision resolves quickly. The decisions, including Discuss Imperial Federation, can be taken in any order.
u16hp6.zh: 会议开始时，每个自治领都会在会议期间与英国的好感度 -100，恰好抵消同处阵营带来的 +50 与身为傀儡国带来的 +50。同一时间只能辩论一项决议。玩家将有两个月（60 天）来完成全部五项决议；每项决议都很快解决。这些决议，包括「讨论帝国联邦」，可以按任意顺序选取。

1ump8jj.en: The Franco-British Union is a union that ⟦0⟧ and The ⟦1⟧ can form if France is capitulated by the Germans while allied to the UK, if both countries agree to the union, the United Kingdom will annex France and gain cores of all French cores. All French military units and leaders will be transferred to the UK. While the UK can get the decision regardless of ideology, France can only propose the union if it is Democratic.
1ump8jj.zh: 法英联盟是一个联盟，若法国在与英国结盟时被德国迫降，⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧便可成立它；若两国都同意该联盟，联合王国将吞并法国并获得法国全部核心领土的核心。法国所有军事单位和领袖都会转移给英国。虽然英国无论意识形态如何都能获得该决议，但法国只有是民主主义时才能提出该联盟。

17y9mqb.en: This nation is formable through the communist focus branch of ⟦0⟧. In history, Leon Trostsky spent over a year in exile in Norway until his deportation to Mexico in December in 1936. Instead of deporting Trotsky as happened historically, or following the ⟦1⟧ ideology of communism, the Northern Revolutionary Front represents a nation that has fully embraced Trotskys ideals and establishes a new communist international.
17y9mqb.zh: 该国可通过⟦0⟧的共产主义焦点分支成立。历史上，列夫·托洛茨基在挪威流亡了一年多，直到 1936 年 12 月被驱逐到墨西哥。北方革命阵线代表的不是像历史上那样驱逐托洛茨基、也不是遵循⟦1⟧的共产主义意识形态，而是一个彻底拥抱托洛茨基理念并建立新共产主义国际的国家。

9qhjnd.en: To form Iberia as Regional Defense Council of Aragón, complete the focus Portuguese Anarchism to start a civil war in ⟦0⟧ where Anarchist Spain joins the ⟦1⟧. If ⟦2⟧ is already in a civil war, Anarchist Spain will get a War goal instead. Once ⟦3⟧ is under Spanish control, they will become a puppet. Completing the focus Regional Defense Council of Iberia will annex ⟦4⟧ and become Regional Defense Council of Iberia.
9qhjnd.zh: 要以阿拉贡地区防卫委员会的身份成立伊比利亚，请完成焦点「葡萄牙无政府主义」，在⟦0⟧挑起内战，使无政府主义西班牙加入⟦1⟧。若⟦2⟧已处于内战中，无政府主义西班牙将改为获得一个战争目标。一旦⟦3⟧处于西班牙控制之下，它就会成为傀儡国。完成焦点「伊比利亚地区防卫委员会」将吞并⟦4⟧并变为伊比利亚地区防卫委员会。

ajxwlf.en: The Hungarian national focus tree allows Kingdom of Hungary to become this new country, swapping colors with ⟦0⟧, if following the monarchist branch. It requires the Kingdom of Hungary to own all the states originally owned by ⟦1⟧. The Kingdom of Hungary gets a decision to core the remaining Austro-Hungarian territories once all of them are conquered. The flag will change to the civil ensign of Austria-Hungary.
ajxwlf.zh: 若走君主主义分支，匈牙利国策树允许匈牙利王国变为这个新国家，并与⟦0⟧互换颜色。它要求匈牙利王国拥有原属⟦1⟧的所有州。一旦征服全部奥匈领土，匈牙利王国便会获得一项决议，把其余奥匈领土转为核心领土。国旗将改为奥匈帝国的民用船旗。

dbxw51.en: If the player wishes to declare independence and form The New Order, they need to complete the focus The New Order at the end of this focus branch. This will make the player independent, add heavy tank technologies to the nation and white peace them out of all of their overlords current wars if the focus Towards a Swedish Rike was completed. Germany also gets a wargoal against The New Order for rebelling.
dbxw51.zh: 如果玩家希望宣布独立并成立新秩序，就需要在该焦点分支末端完成焦点「新秩序」。这会使玩家独立，为国家添加重型坦克科技，并且若已完成焦点「迈向瑞典帝国」，还会让他们从其宗主国当前参与的所有战争中白和退出。德国也会因这场叛乱获得对新秩序的战争目标。

1g8sggv.en: To form Iberia as Carlist Spain, win the Spanish Civil War and complete the focus Restore the Iberian Union. ⟦0⟧ will then get an event where if it accepts, Spain will annex and gain cores on ⟦1⟧. If it refuses, Spain will get a War goal. Chances of acceptance increase significantly if ⟦2⟧ has completed the focus The Royal Iberian Alliance. Portugal will always say yes if it is a puppet of Spain.
1g8sggv.zh: 要以卡洛斯派西班牙的身份成立伊比利亚，请赢得西班牙内战并完成焦点「恢复伊比利亚联盟」。⟦0⟧随后会收到一个事件，若它接受，西班牙将吞并⟦1⟧并获得其核心领土。若它拒绝，西班牙将获得一个战争目标。若⟦2⟧已完成焦点「皇家伊比利亚联盟」，接受的概率会大幅提高。如果葡萄牙是西班牙的傀儡国，它将总是同意。

h27bav.en: As fascist Britain: Store up enough political power beforehand and use the national focus Move to Secure the Dominions to enforce the loyalty of all dominions and stop any of them from breaking away. With proper play in terms of political power and troop placement, it is possible to retain all dominions in the fold and stop any of them from breaking away. If not, see the monarchist section below.
h27bav.zh: 作为法西斯英国：事先积攒足够的政治点数，并使用国策「行动确保自治领」来强制所有自治领保持忠诚，阻止其中任何一个脱离。只要在政治点数和部队部署方面处理得当，就有可能把所有自治领都留在怀抱之中，阻止其中任何一个脱离。若无法做到，请参阅下方君主主义部分。

17k5rqu.en: The "Global Defense Council" part of this "nation" simply exists because the anarchist communes have decided to band together for security and defense and the Global Defense Council itself is merely an organization formed for the purpose of coordinating the collective military actions of the anarchists - to protect itself from other nations, and to build their vision of united world (dis)order.
17k5rqu.zh: 这个“国家”中的“全球防卫委员会”之所以存在，只是因为各无政府主义公社决定为安全与防卫而联合起来，而全球防卫委员会本身不过是一个为协调无政府主义者的集体军事行动而成立的组织——既为了保护自己免受其他国家侵害，也是为了建设他们心目中统一的世界（无）秩序。

w52n6e.en: The Dutch focus tree contains several focuses that assist in forming a united Netherlands, though the DLC does not unlock the above decision. The focus Revive the Buffer State Proposal can transfer all required territory to the Netherlands without conflict. Bring Socialism South grants puppet war goals on Belgium and Luxembourg, while The United Netherlands grants annexation war goals.
w52n6e.zh: 荷兰国策树中包含若干有助于成立统一尼德兰的焦点，尽管该 DLC 并未解锁上述决议。焦点「重振缓冲国提案」可以在不发生冲突的情况下把所有必需领土移交给尼德兰。「把社会主义带到南方」会给予对比利时和卢森堡的傀儡战争目标，而「联合尼德兰」则给予吞并战争目标。

vmr51k.en: If the player wishes to stay loyal to their overlord as a puppet nation, they need to complete the focus Reichsprotectorate Nordland at the end of this focus branch. This focus will give the newly established Reichsprotektorat Nordland claims on land in northeastern Europe. Additionally, if this land is controlled by their overlord it will be transferred to Reichsprotektorat Nordland.
vmr51k.zh: 如果玩家希望作为傀儡国继续忠于其宗主国，就需要在该焦点分支末端完成焦点「北方之地帝国保护国」。该焦点将给予新成立的北方之地帝国保护国对北欧东北部土地的宣称。此外，若这片土地由其宗主国控制，它将被移交给北方之地帝国保护国。

yft308.en: In order to form this nation, each of the Baltic States must progress down the communist branch of their national focus tree to overthrow the government through a civil war, which then opens up the option to convert the rest of the Baltic States to communism through a propaganda war (which allows one to form the Baltic Federation) as well as acquiring Belarus for even more territory.
yft308.zh: 要成立该国，三个波罗的海国家都必须沿其国策树的共产主义分支推进，通过内战推翻政府，此后便会开启通过宣传战把其余波罗的海国家转变为共产主义国家的选项（从而得以成立波罗的海联邦），同时还能取得白俄罗斯以获得更多领土。

iyn54o.en: The ability to dynamically core any state comes at the expense of all other countries becoming hostile towards the GDC and will actively take steps to destroy it. The GDC cannot form or join factions and other nations will be hostile toward it. The GDC essentially stands alone against the entire world. A bug however allows other nations to form factions with Global Defense Council.
iyn54o.zh: 动态地把任何州转为核心领土的能力，代价是所有其他国家都会对全球防卫委员会产生敌意，并会积极采取行动摧毁它。全球防卫委员会无法组建或加入阵营，其他国家都会对它抱有敌意。全球防卫委员会实际上是独自对抗整个世界。不过有一个漏洞，允许其他国家与全球防卫委员会组建阵营。

1nt6rsd.en: The Macedonian Empire is the recreation of Alexander the Great's Empire spanning from Greece to India which formed during his reign of 336-323 BC and fell apart almost immediately after Alexander's death. As ⟦0⟧ it may be formed with the ⟦1⟧ leader George Mercouris and the Molding the New World Order Focus or with the ⟦2⟧ leader ⟦3⟧ and the Protectors of the Mediterranean focus.
1nt6rsd.zh: 马其顿帝国是亚历山大大帝帝国的重建，其疆域从希腊一直延伸到印度，形成于他公元前 336—323 年的统治时期，并在亚历山大死后几乎立刻分崩离析。作为⟦0⟧，它可以由⟦1⟧领袖乔治·梅尔库里斯通过焦点「塑造世界新秩序」成立，也可以由⟦2⟧领袖⟦3⟧通过焦点「地中海守护者」成立。

14h7ld0.en: To form Iberia as ⟦0⟧, you have to go Communist by doing the focus Workers of Iberia, Unite!, which will cause a civil war in ⟦1⟧ and join ⟦2⟧ in the Spanish Civil War. Once the Spanish Civil War has ended, completing the focus The Iberian Socialist Union will allow ⟦3⟧ to become Iberia and gain cores all Spanish cored states. ⟦4⟧ will get an event to choose to be annexed.
14h7ld0.zh: 要以⟦0⟧的身份成立伊比利亚，你必须转为共产主义，方法是完成焦点「伊比利亚的工人们，联合起来！」，这会在⟦1⟧引发内战，并让⟦2⟧加入西班牙内战。西班牙内战结束后，完成焦点「伊比利亚社会主义联盟」将使⟦3⟧变为伊比利亚，并获得所有西班牙核心州的核心领土。⟦4⟧将收到一个事件，供其选择是否被吞并。

10c463u.en: The Baltic Federation represents the proposed federation of the Baltic states known as the United Baltic Duchy that was proposed in 1918 in the aftermath of the collapse of the Russian Empire. Ultimately, it never actually came into being but the Baltic states would continue to pursue a close relationship afterwards, something which is true even today.
10c463u.zh: 波罗的海联邦代表着 1918 年俄罗斯帝国崩溃后提出的波罗的海诸国联邦方案，即所谓的联合波罗的海公国。它最终从未真正成立，但波罗的海诸国此后仍继续保持密切关系，这一点至今依然如此。

13gi1b5.en: This country represents the pluri-ethnic empire created from the Austrian Empire through a Compromise by the Austrian King and Emperor Francis Joseph I in 1867 with the Hungarians which then existed until its collapse in 1918. Up until its collapse, the Austro-Hungarian Empire was the second-largest empire in Europe, second only to the Russian Empire.
13gi1b5.zh: 该国代表着奥地利帝国经奥地利国王兼皇帝弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世于 1867 年与匈牙利人达成妥协后所创建的多民族帝国，它此后一直存在到 1918 年崩溃。在崩溃之前，奥匈帝国是欧洲第二大帝国，仅次于俄罗斯帝国。

14rd1g4.en: Greater Denmark represents a return of Danish territories in Scandinavia before the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658 which cedes Skåne (Scania) to ⟦0⟧ and Treaty of Vienna in 1864 which cedes Holsten (Holstein) to Prussia. In-game, instead of formed through a decision, this formable nation formed when an event is triggered between 7 and 365 days as follows:
14rd1g4.zh: 大丹麦代表着丹麦在 1658 年《罗斯基勒条约》（将斯科讷割让给⟦0⟧）和 1864 年《维也纳条约》（将荷尔斯泰因割让给普鲁士）之前在斯堪的纳维亚的领土回归。在游戏中，该可成立国家不是通过决议成立，而是在 7 至 365 天之间触发如下事件时成立：

1vs192m.en: Communist Germany can create this formable via decision after rallying the Wehrmacht and defeating the Nazis in the German civil war, then starting the Proletarian Revolution and becoming the ⟦0⟧ following the people's victory. Rooting out imperialism leads to the focus Hegemony over Europe, which finally unlocks the decision to proclaim the ⟦1⟧.
1vs192m.zh: 共产主义德国可以在重整国防军并赢得德国内战击败纳粹之后，通过决议创建这个可成立国家，随后发动无产阶级革命，并在人民胜利后成为⟦0⟧。铲除帝国主义会通向焦点「称霸欧洲」，它最终解锁宣告成立⟦1⟧的决议。

1qgq6e8.en: Note that if Spain managed to form the Iberian Union with ⟦0⟧ after the latter formed the United Kingdom of Portugal and Brazil, France will also gain cores on all Portuguese and Brazilian States as well, creating an empire comparable to the European Union or the Imperial Federation in terms of population, industry and potential military power.
1qgq6e8.zh: 请注意，如果西班牙在⟦0⟧成立葡萄牙-巴西联合王国之后与其组建了伊比利亚联盟，法国也将获得所有葡萄牙与巴西州的核心领土，从而造就一个在人口、工业和潜在军事实力上可与欧洲联盟或帝国联邦相媲美的帝国。

mxr41a.en: In order to form either of these nations, player first needs to go down the fascist sub-branch starting with the focus Delegation to Berlin. This focus starts a civil war and turns the player into a puppet of Germany, called Reichsprotectorate Sweden. At the end of this path the player has a mutually exclusive choice for the future of Sweden.
mxr41a.zh: 要成立这两个国家中的任何一个，玩家首先需要沿法西斯子分支推进，从焦点「派代表团前往柏林」开始。该焦点会引发内战，并把玩家变为德国的傀儡国，称为瑞典帝国保护国。在这条路线的末端，玩家将面临一个关于瑞典未来的互斥选择。

qbn3fy.en: Variations of Poland that can't form Commonwealth through their respective focus branches (for example, Kingdom of Poland-Romania), if holding ⟦0⟧ states with more than 80% compliance, can do it through the "Re-form the Commonwealth" decision, changing name, flag and colors to Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and gaining all of its cores.
qbn3fy.zh: 无法通过各自焦点分支成立联邦的波兰变体（例如波兰-罗马尼亚王国），若拥有顺从度超过 80% 的⟦0⟧各州，就可以通过“重建联邦”决议来成立，将名称、国旗和颜色改为波兰-立陶宛联邦，并获得其全部核心领土。

zjxsk0.en: Hellas, or Greater Greece, is a proposed idea to unite all Greek peoples around the Aegean in one nation-state. The realisation of the idea was attempted during the Greco-Turkish War after WWI but failed and never tried again, but a sufficiently belligerent ⟦0⟧ can decide to revive the idea and realise it by defeating ⟦1⟧ decisively.
zjxsk0.zh: 希腊，或称大希腊，是一个旨在把爱琴海周边所有希腊民族统一为一个民族国家的构想。一战后希腊-土耳其战争期间曾尝试实现这一构想，但以失败告终，此后未再尝试；不过，一个足够好战的⟦0⟧可以决定重拾这一构想，通过决定性地击败⟦1⟧来实现它。

cf2y0x.en: Formable by ⟦0⟧ as part of the fascist branch of their national focus tree, Greater Lithuania represents a restoration of the old Grand Duchy of Lithuania, which existed as early as the early 11th century (consolidated during the 12th century) until its demise during the final partition of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1795.
cf2y0x.zh: 大立陶宛可由⟦0⟧作为其国策树法西斯分支的一部分成立，代表着旧立陶宛大公国的复辟——该公国早在 11 世纪初便已存在（12 世纪完成整合），直至 1795 年波兰-立陶宛联邦最终被瓜分时灭亡。

aornay.en: The forming nation must be one of the Nordic countries ( ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, or ⟦4⟧), and requires all aforementioned nations to be united under one banner. Additionally, should Estonia complete the focus Estonia is Scandinavia, the decision will be available to Estonia as well, although it does not require any additional cores.
aornay.zh: 成立国必须是北欧国家之一（⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧或⟦4⟧），并要求上述所有国家统一在同一面旗帜下。此外，若爱沙尼亚完成焦点「爱沙尼亚即斯堪的纳维亚」，该决议也会对爱沙尼亚开放，尽管它不需要任何额外核心领土。

1xm1ybr.en: She can opt to lean into her Scandinavian side and seek to unite the Nordic countries of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ under one flag by military force through the rest of the national focuses in that branch. If Estonia then completes the national focus Estonia is Scandinavia, she will gain access to the decision to form the Nordic League.
1xm1ybr.zh: 她可以选择倾向其斯堪的纳维亚一面，通过该分支余下的国策以武力把⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧这些北欧国家统一在同一面旗帜下。若爱沙尼亚随后完成国策「爱沙尼亚即斯堪的纳维亚」，她将获得成立北欧联盟的决议。

1m7d8pc.en: These formable nation are both available through ⟦0⟧'s path, wherein Sweden voluntarily becomes a puppet of ⟦1⟧. At the end of this path, the player has the choice to either rebel and break free to become the independent fascist nation The New Order, or stay loyal to their overlord and become Reichsprotektorat Nordland.
1m7d8pc.zh: 这两个可成立国家都可以通过⟦0⟧的路线获得，在这条路线中瑞典自愿成为⟦1⟧的傀儡国。在这条路线的末端，玩家可以选择反叛并挣脱束缚，成为独立的法西斯国家新秩序，或者忠于其宗主国并成为北方之地帝国保护国。

1u57q3n.en: The United Netherlands is a formable nation that represents the Kingdom of the United Netherlands that existed in 1819-1839. Its historical capitals were Amsterdam, The Hague and Brussels. The ⟦0⟧ is the legitimate successor state and has a branch of national focuses devoted to the reunification of the Low Countries.
1u57q3n.zh: 联合尼德兰是一个可成立国家，代表着 1819—1839 年间存在的联合尼德兰王国。其历史首都为阿姆斯特丹、海牙和布鲁塞尔。⟦0⟧是其合法继承国，并拥有一支专门致力于低地国家重新统一的国策分支。

vottpt.en: ⟦0⟧ is a variation of the Commonwealth formable only by Communist Poland by the Organize the Peasant's Strike focus tree, through Assemble a Leftist Cabinet down to the Commonwealth of Socialist Republics focus. In addition to standard Commonwealth cores, Commonwealth of Socialist Republics also cores ⟦1⟧ states.
vottpt.zh: ⟦0⟧是联邦的一个变体，只能由共产主义波兰通过「组织农民罢工」国策树，经由「组建左翼内阁」一路向下到焦点「社会主义共和国联邦」来成立。除标准的联邦核心领土外，社会主义共和国联邦还会把⟦1⟧各州转为核心领土。

11a15hv.en: ⟦0⟧ can form the Union of Pannonian Socialist Republics through its communist focus branch, by going down the path Restore the Socialist Federative Republic. Upon completion of the focus A Pannonian Socialist Union the nations color and name will change, and the player gains cores on all Pannonian lands.
11a15hv.zh: ⟦0⟧可以通过其共产主义焦点分支，走「恢复社会主义联邦共和国」路线来成立潘诺尼亚社会主义共和国联盟。完成焦点「潘诺尼亚社会主义联盟」后，该国的颜色和名称将会改变，玩家还会获得所有潘诺尼亚土地的核心领土。

k80uyj.en: Alternately, the Imperial Conference and Imperial Federation can be done where some of the dominions don't exist, provided their core states are all owned by the UK; a Monarchist or Fascist Britain can thus conquer their dominions outright and puppet at least one of them, and still form the Federation.
k80uyj.zh: 另外，也可以在某些自治领不存在的情况下召开帝国会议并成立帝国联邦，只要它们的核心州全部由英国拥有即可；因此，君主主义或法西斯英国可以直接征服其自治领并傀儡化其中至少一个，同时仍能成立联邦。

7ewi7s.en: ⟦0⟧ is the historical founding nation, as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ were subjects of Denmark (in personal union) during the era of the Kalmar Union, as seen most notably in Europa Universalis 4. The Nordic League, The North Sea Federation and the Baltic Sea Dominion may still be formed after forming Scandinavia.
7ewi7s.zh: ⟦0⟧是历史上的创始国，因为在卡尔马联盟时代，⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧都是丹麦的附庸（共主邦联），这一点在《欧陆风云 4》中体现得尤为明显。成立斯堪的纳维亚之后，仍可成立北欧联盟、北海联邦和波罗的海自治领。

1ofn9g7.en: Despite unlocking Decisions and National Spirits to boost either Democracy or Communism in Turkey, Turkey will not get any events towards changing their ideology, and Kemalist Neutrality as well as a big AI modifier forbid them from joining Bulgaria's own faction in any situation but same-side war.
1ofn9g7.zh: 尽管解锁了在土耳其提升民主主义或共产主义的决议和国家精神，土耳其也不会获得任何改变其意识形态的事件，而凯末尔主义中立以及一个强大的 AI 修正会禁止他们在任何情况下加入保加利亚自己的阵营，除非是同一方的战争。

ducy02.en: The second decision requires the additional requirements of the states of ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧ from the ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧. This creates the Eternal Nordic Empire, makes Gustavus Adolphus II "the Eternal" and cores the required states from the Germans, ⟦11⟧, ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧ and ⟦14⟧.
ducy02.zh: 第二项决议还额外需要⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧和⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧各州，且这些州须来自⟦8⟧、⟦9⟧和⟦10⟧。这会创建永恒北欧帝国，使古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫获得“永恒者”称号，并把来自德国、⟦11⟧、⟦12⟧、⟦13⟧和⟦14⟧的所需各州转为核心领土。

xobbo8.en: All German splinter states, the Polish releasable of ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧ releasable of Volga Germany, the historical post World War II nations of ⟦2⟧ and West Germany and the German puppet ⟦3⟧ can form this nation. ⟦4⟧ can also form this nation, but only if the Germany Fragmented game rule is active.
xobbo8.zh: 所有德国分裂小国、波兰的可释放国家⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧的可释放国家伏尔加德意志、历史上二战后建立的⟦2⟧和西德，以及德国傀儡国⟦3⟧都可以成立该国。⟦4⟧也可以成立该国，但仅在“德国分裂”游戏规则启用时才能做到。

vuj0mp.en: Upon completion of the final focus Integrate Volkskommissariats, the player will unlock the decisions to integrate puppeted ⟦0⟧. Upon the annexation of the first puppet Volkskommissariat, the German Socialist Volksunion will be formed and the nations name and colour will change.
vuj0mp.zh: 完成最后一个焦点「整合人民委员辖区」后，玩家将解锁整合被傀儡化的⟦0⟧的决议。吞并第一个傀儡人民委员辖区后，德意志社会主义人民联盟便会成立，该国的名称和颜色也会改变。

2iqkxj.en: With the ⟦0⟧ DLC, the Commonwealth can also be formed via national focus as either Poland or Lithuania, if the appropriate monarchist path is chosen. Forming it this way only requires you to have the other nation as a subject, which is much easier than gaining 80% compliance.
2iqkxj.zh: 启用⟦0⟧ DLC 后，联邦也可以通过国策由波兰或立陶宛成立，只要选择了相应的君主主义路线。以这种方式成立只需要让另一国成为你的附庸国，这比获得 80% 顺从度容易得多。

435g6l.en: To form Iberia as Communist Spain, win the Spanish Civil War and complete the focus A Red Iberia. If ⟦0⟧ is Communist then it will get an event where if it accepts Communist Spain will annex and gain cores on ⟦1⟧. If it refuses, Communist Spain will get a War goal.
435g6l.zh: 要以共产主义西班牙的身份成立伊比利亚，请赢得西班牙内战并完成焦点「红色伊比利亚」。若⟦0⟧是共产主义，它将收到一个事件，若它接受，共产主义西班牙将吞并⟦1⟧并获得其核心领土。若它拒绝，共产主义西班牙将获得一个战争目标。

1whbvmb.en: There are some states that initially don't have cores by any country, but they can eventually gain cores and, then, be cored by the GDC. However, most of this events are very hard to combine with a normal game with the Global Defense Council. See the list below.
1whbvmb.zh: 有些州最初不属于任何国家的核心领土，但它们最终可以获得核心，然后再被全球防卫委员会转为核心领土。不过，这些事件大多很难与全球防卫委员会的常规游戏进程配合起来。见下方列表。

1scvk5u.en: In 1.10, the focus Press the Austro-Hungarian Claim will give ⟦0⟧, the Kingdom of Hungary, and ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧. However, unlike Germany, this focus will not give ⟦3⟧, the Kingdom of Hungary, nor ⟦4⟧ the above decision nor will they be able to become Austria-Hungary.
1scvk5u.zh: 在 1.10 中，焦点「施压奥匈宣称」会给予⟦0⟧、匈牙利王国和⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧。然而与德国不同，该焦点不会给予⟦3⟧、匈牙利王国或⟦4⟧上述决议，他们也无法变为奥匈帝国。

1vxkh13.en: For The Unification of the Balkans to send out annexation events, Bulgaria needs not be the faction leader. As long as a Balkan Country with the same ideology as Bulgaria is in a faction with Bulgaria, the focus is unlocked and all events will fire.
1vxkh13.zh: 要让「巴尔干统一」发出吞并事件，保加利亚不必是阵营领袖。只要有一个与保加利亚意识形态相同的巴尔干国家与保加利亚同处一个阵营，该焦点就会被解锁，所有事件也都会触发。

16px73.en: The Central Europe Federation is formed by ⟦0⟧ when the focus Forming a Federation is completed. Furthermore, this unlocks decisions to core Central Europe and demand both ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ to join your federation, doing so they will become your puppets.
16px73.zh: 中欧联邦由⟦0⟧在完成焦点「组建联邦」时成立。此外，这还会解锁把中欧转为核心领土、以及要求⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧加入你联邦的决议，这样做它们将成为你的傀儡国。

mfu96v.en: The Holy Roman Empire is a formable nation that represents the original H.R.E which was formed as a successor nation of the West Roman Empire in 800 and existed from 962 to 1806. It can be formed by the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ (including Liechtenstein), and ⟦2⟧.
mfu96v.zh: 神圣罗马帝国是一个可成立国家，代表着最初的神圣罗马帝国——它于 800 年作为西罗马帝国的继承国形成，并从 962 年存在到 1806 年。它可以由⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧（包括列支敦士登）和⟦2⟧成立。

17w34mh.en: The United Kingdom of Portugal and Brazil is a formable nation introduced in the ⟦0⟧ DLC that represents the short-lived United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves that existed from 1815 - 1825, although it had de facto dissolved by 1822.
17w34mh.zh: 葡萄牙-巴西联合王国是⟦0⟧ DLC 中引入的一个可成立国家，代表着 1815—1825 年间存在的短命的葡萄牙、巴西和阿尔加维联合王国，尽管它实际上到 1822 年就已解体。

1rxgj1t.en: UK: Trade relation with dominion +50 Dominion: +10 opinion of UK; change Trade Law to Free Trade (construction +15%, research +10%, factory/dockyard output +15%, resources to market 80%, civilian intel to others +40%, navy intel to others +20%)
1rxgj1t.zh: 英国：与自治领的贸易关系 +50　自治领：对英国好感度 +10；将贸易法案改为自由贸易（建造 +15%、科研 +10%、工厂／船坞产出 +15%、投放市场的资源 80%、对他人提供的民用情报 +40%、对他人提供的海军情报 +20%）

63gmzl.en: If the Baltic state opted to align themselves with the ⟦0⟧, the Soviets will cede their half of Belarus to the Baltic state, with the rest being acquired through either war or through the Molotov-Ribbentrop-pact and the partition of ⟦1⟧.
63gmzl.zh: 如果该波罗的海国家选择与⟦0⟧站在一起，苏联将把其白俄罗斯的那一半割让给该波罗的海国家，其余部分则通过战争或通过《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》以及瓜分⟦1⟧来取得。

1jugws1.en: The other incarnations are formed when the nations are ⟦0⟧. The left side of the focus tree allows you to Join France and then complete the focus The Second Helvetic Republic, which forms the République Helvétique as a puppet of France.
1jugws1.zh: 其他化身是在这些国家成为⟦0⟧时成立的。国策树的左侧允许你「加入法国」，然后完成焦点「第二海尔维希亚共和国」，从而成立海尔维希亚共和国作为法国的傀儡国。

1di0a3a.en: ⟦0⟧ ENG will not receive cores from the British Raj or British Malaya to illustrate cultural differences (also done to counteract the OPness of gaining full access to all Indian manpower, which even British Raj/India doesn’t get).
1di0a3a.zh: ⟦0⟧ ENG 不会从英属印度或英属马来亚获得核心领土，以体现文化差异（这样做也是为了抵消获得全部印度人力所带来的过强效果，即使是英属印度／印度自己也得不到这些人力）。

5xf81p.en: The Kingdom of Livonia is a formable nation that can be created by ⟦0⟧ as part of the monarchist branch of the national focus tree and is effectively an alternative version of the Baltic Federation, albeit exclusive to Lithuania.
5xf81p.zh: 利沃尼亚王国是一个可成立国家，可以由⟦0⟧作为国策树君主主义分支的一部分创建，实际上是波罗的海联邦的替代版本，只是立陶宛专属。

uviu4p.en: The Nordic League is an extended version of Scandinavia, representing a greater union of all the Nordic nations, including also ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. If chosen, the North Sea Federation and the Baltic Sea Dominion cannot be formed.
uviu4p.zh: 北欧联盟是斯堪的纳维亚的扩展版本，代表着所有北欧国家的更大联合，其中还包括⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧。若作此选择，则无法成立北海联邦和波罗的海自治领。

1i3dpv6.en: The European Federation is a formable nation that initially represents a union between the original 6 countries that started the European Coal and Steel Community in 1952, the predecessor to the modern day European Union.
1i3dpv6.zh: 欧罗巴联邦是一个可成立国家，最初代表 1952 年发起欧洲煤钢共同体的最初 6 个国家之间的联盟，即现代欧洲联盟的前身。

1hg48s7.en: Once forming the union it will only remain whilst Britain is at war. Whenever Britain becomes at peace there will be an event to release France, or keep them. Whichever option is chosen the UK will lose its French cores.
1hg48s7.zh: 这个联盟成立后，只在英国处于战争状态时维持。每当英国进入和平状态，都会出现一个事件，供你释放法国或保留法国。无论选择哪个选项，英国都会失去其法国核心领土。

1s44wzi.en: Once the nation has been formed, ⟦0⟧ will annex ⟦1⟧ and give ⟦2⟧ its cores. This can be obtained alongside the cores obtained through the Luso-Tropicalism focus, giving the country a total of 52 million core population.
1s44wzi.zh: 该国成立后，⟦0⟧将吞并⟦1⟧并把其核心领土给予⟦2⟧。这可以与通过「葡热带主义」焦点获得的核心领土一并取得，使该国核心人口总数达到 5200 万。

mn0uuy.en: Available as part of ⟦0⟧'s fascist path, Ostland is an oddball case when it comes to formable nations, as it is an artifical state invented by Germany and can be established by Latvia for personal benefit and profit.
mn0uuy.zh: 东方总督辖区可作为⟦0⟧法西斯路线的一部分使用；就可成立国家而言，它是个异类，因为它是德国发明的一个人为国家，拉脱维亚可以为一己私利与好处而建立它。

ww8haj.en: ⟦0⟧ can form Greater Hungary with the focus Proclaim Greater Hungary, representing a restoration of their Pre-World War I borders and a forceful elimination of the dishonorable humiliation of the Treaty of Trianon.
ww8haj.zh: ⟦0⟧可以通过焦点「宣告大匈牙利」成立大匈牙利，代表着其第一次世界大战前边界的复辟，以及对《特里亚农条约》这一不光彩屈辱的强力消除。

1fxzukp.en: It can be formed by ⟦0⟧ through the focus The Kingdom Reunited after restoring monarchies to both ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ via the Estado Novo focus path. Both countries must be Non-Aligned and at peace to be able to form it.
1fxzukp.zh: 它可以由⟦0⟧通过「新国家」焦点路线恢复⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧的君主制之后，完成焦点「重新统一的王国」来成立。两国都必须是不结盟且处于和平状态才能成立它。

1i3cip2.en: Naturally, the formation of Greater Finland is possible through Finland's national focus tree. There are a total of five different versions of Greater Finland that can be formed, depending of the ideology:
1i3cip2.zh: 大芬兰自然可以通过芬兰的国策树成立。共有五个不同版本的大芬兰可以成立，取决于意识形态：

keffxa.en: Once the decision is selected, ⟦0⟧ will be renamed as the Byzantine Empire and change color to a purple color. The Byzantine capital will be moved to Istanbul, which is renamed back to Constantinople.
keffxa.zh: 选取该决议后，⟦0⟧将被改名为拜占庭帝国，颜色变为紫色。拜占庭首都将迁至伊斯坦布尔，后者被重新改名为君士坦丁堡。

15jh8px.en: Representing a realization (in name) of Adolf Hitler's plans to forge a German nation spanning from the Low Countries to the Ural Mountains, Hearts of Iron 4 has far lower requirements for forming it.
15jh8px.zh: 它代表着阿道夫·希特勒建立一个从低地国家延伸到乌拉尔山脉的德意志国家之计划在名义上的实现，而《钢铁雄心 4》对成立它的要求要低得多。

fm9rq1.en: Germany can form Greater Hungary for ⟦0⟧ using the focus The Austrian Question, Hungary gets an event to align with Germany and if they accept, they form ⟦1⟧ and get claims in former Hungarian states.
fm9rq1.zh: 德国可以通过焦点「奥地利问题」为⟦0⟧成立大匈牙利；匈牙利会收到一个事件，选择与德国结盟，若他们接受，就会成立⟦1⟧并获得对前匈牙利各州的宣称。

npcabx.en: The Global Defense Council is a formable "nation", that can be created by the Regional Defense Council of Aragón through a National focus of the same name in the Anarchist path for Republican Spain.
npcabx.zh: 全球防卫委员会是一个可成立的“国家”，可以由阿拉贡地区防卫委员会通过共和派西班牙无政府主义路线中同名的国策创建。

1utjy9p.en: Uniting with any Balkan Nation will merge any wars, but will not transfer any wargoals. Focuses that generate wargoals on any annexed nation that is not Bulgaria such as War with Greece will cancel.
1utjy9p.zh: 与任何巴尔干国家统一都会合并所有战争，但不会转移任何战争目标。对任何非保加利亚的被吞并国家产生战争目标的焦点，例如「与希腊的战争」，将会取消。

15eyclv.en: This section covers all of the ⟦0⟧ formables that require you to be a puppet of a certain nation. The nations you are a puppet to in these formables are as follows: ⟦1⟧, Germany, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧.
15eyclv.zh: 本节涵盖所有需要你成为某一特定国家傀儡国的⟦0⟧可成立国家。这些可成立国家中你所傀儡依附的国家如下：⟦1⟧、德国、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧和⟦4⟧。

fkvwa0.en: The United Balkan Federation is a formable nation that can be formed by either ⟦0⟧ through the focus The Unification of the Balkans or (since the ⟦1⟧ DLC) by ⟦2⟧ through the focus Balkan Ambitions.
fkvwa0.zh: 联合巴尔干联邦是一个可成立国家，可以由⟦0⟧通过焦点「巴尔干统一」成立，或（自⟦1⟧ DLC 起）由⟦2⟧通过焦点「巴尔干野心」成立。

1ux34j4.en: In addition, Germany may use the following decisions to core Luxembourg and the former European territories of the German Empire (excluding Eupen-Malmedy, which is not represented in the game):
1ux34j4.zh: 此外，德国可以使用以下决议把卢森堡以及德意志帝国昔日的欧洲领土转为核心领土（欧本-马尔梅迪除外，游戏未表现该地）：

10so8e2.en: After the Roman Empire has been formed, the following decisions become available. The decisions will give the Roman Empire cores on the required states, however it will cost ⟦0⟧ and Stability.
10so8e2.zh: 罗马帝国成立后，以下决议将变为可用。这些决议会给予罗马帝国所需各州的核心领土，但会消耗⟦0⟧和稳定度。

xf59z2.en: The Kingdom of Franco-Spain is a monarchic union between ⟦0⟧ and Spain that can be formed by ⟦1⟧ if they go monarchist under the Legitimists and completes the national focus Unite the Crowns.
xf59z2.zh: 法兰克-西班牙王国是⟦0⟧与西班牙之间的君主制联合，可由⟦1⟧在走正统派君主主义路线并完成国策「合并王冠」后成立。

my7ngb.en: Germany has decisions that allows them to form a Transcaucasian satellite state under Georgia. These decisions are unlocked when Germany completes the focus Establish Eastern Grand Duchies.
my7ngb.zh: 德国拥有若干决议，可以让他们在格鲁吉亚之下建立一个外高加索卫星国。当德国完成焦点「建立东方大公国」时，这些决议便会解锁。

3i6y18.en: But in contrast to the Bulgarian way you don't get any further decisions to rally support, puppet the other Balkan nations or integrate them. You simply have to conquer them completely.
