18mepcl.en: One relatively easy way to deal with the Germany problem as the Soviet Union is to strike early and to strike hard. You start with nearly triple the manpower of Germany, though you have various debuffs and equipment shortages. Use your first political power to justify on Poland. Build military factories, run exercises to generate Army Experience, hire Chief of Army, switch to War Economy when your war support is over 50%. Update your infantry template to 9 infantry / 1 artillery + support artillery, engineers, recon, logistics. (You'll need to produce lots of artillery and supply equipment.) Disband units as necessary (in particularly, get rid of all NKVD Pogranichnaya Diviziya ASAP) to put 80-ish fully equipped infantry divisions on the Polish border. Likewise, disband some of your mechanized divisions. Declare on Poland, then start justifying on Germany. If all goes well, you'll capitulate Germany by early 1938, earning you "We don't really like statistics", "The Revolution Triumphant" (if you puppet some part of Germany instead of annexing it), a good shot at "Not a Step Back". (NOTE: you won't get "One Step Forward" unless you declare on Germany ⟦0⟧ you're still fighting Poland, which is risky.) Everyone will hate you (you'll generate 100% world tension all by yourself), and the UK will guarantee any Democratic country you attempt to justify on after Germany, but you'll be out of immediate danger. You can immediately follow by justifying on Austria (which, being unaligned/fascist, is fair game, as far as the UK is concerned), and then either justifying or using the "Eradicate Western Fascism" focus to attack Italy for "The Pope? How many Divisions does he have?". (Don't dawdle: with Germany gone and the Axis dismantled, the Allies may decide to invade and take Rome as early as 1940.)
18mepcl.zh: 作为苏联处理德国问题相对容易的一种办法，就是趁早出手、全力出击。开局时你的人力几乎是德国的三倍，但你身上带着各种减益和装备短缺。用你最初的政治点数去制造对波兰的战争目标。建造军用工厂，通过演习积累陆军经验，聘请陆军总司令，在战争支持度超过 50% 后切换到战争经济。把步兵师编制更新为 9 步兵 / 1 火炮 + 支援火炮、工兵、侦察、后勤。（你需要生产大量火炮和补给装备。）必要时解散部队（尤其是尽快解散所有 NKVD 边防师（Pogranichnaya Diviziya）），以便在波兰边境上摆出约 80 个满编步兵师。同样，解散一些机械化师。对波兰宣战，然后开始制造对德国的战争目标。如果一切顺利，你会在 1938 年初迫使德国投降，从而拿到「我们其实不太喜欢统计数字」、「革命胜利」（如果你把德国的一部分变成傀儡国而非吞并），以及很有机会拿到「寸步不退」。（注意：除非你对德国宣战 ⟦0⟧ 你还在与波兰作战，否则你拿不到「向前一步」，这样做风险很大。）所有人都会恨你（你会独自制造出 100% 的世界紧张度），而英国会保障你在德国之后试图制造战争目标的任何民主国家的独立，但你会摆脱眼前的危险。你可以紧接着制造对奥地利的战争目标（就英国而言，奥地利属于不结盟/法西斯，是合法目标），然后要么制造战争目标，要么使用「根除西方法西斯主义」国策来进攻意大利，以取得「教皇？他有多少个师？」。（别磨蹭：德国一消失、轴心国一解体，同盟国最早可能在 1940 年就决定入侵并攻占罗马。）

1kk4kov.en: First, one should decide one thing: if they want to be cooperative with the Left Opposition, or if they wish to save the generals Stalin historically purges. This will determine focus order. Regardless, the first 3 focuses one should take are ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ - for the political power you get, either hire Mikhail Kalinin or take Improved Worker Conditions for a much needed stability boost (note that until Bukharin is in charge, you will not be able to earn much political power - although you can somewhat offset this by infiltrating the civilian governments of other countries; if playing on ahistorical, there's a chance Turkey might back down when you mobilize the armed forces in response to them remilitarizing the Bosporus, thus giving you some stability and political power). After that, take ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧, then go up to Partial Mobilization, and round it off with ⟦5⟧ - while you might think that ⟦6⟧ is a good idea if not working with the Left Opposition, doing so will boost Paranoia, so it's best avoided. However, if you want to attack another country, consider holding off to see if you can go for War Economy instead of Partial Mobilization after justifying.
1kk4kov.zh: 首先，你得决定一件事：是想与左翼反对派合作，还是想救下那些历史上被斯大林清洗的将领。这将决定国策顺序。无论如何，你该最先点的 3 个国策是 ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧ —— 就拿到的政治点数而言，要么聘请米哈伊尔·加里宁，要么选择「改善工人条件」以获得急需的稳定度提升（注意，在布哈林上台之前，你无法获得多少政治点数 —— 不过你可以通过渗透其他国家的文官政府在一定程度上弥补；如果玩非历史线，当你为回应土耳其重新军事化博斯普鲁斯而动员武装力量时，土耳其有可能会退让，从而给你一些稳定度和政治点数）。之后，点 ⟦3⟧ 和 ⟦4⟧，然后升到部分动员，最后以 ⟦5⟧ 收尾 —— 你可能会觉得在不与左翼反对派合作的情况下 ⟦6⟧ 是个好主意，但这么做会提升偏执度，所以最好避免。不过，如果你想进攻另一个国家，可以考虑先缓一缓，看看能否在制造战争目标后选择战争经济而不是部分动员。

i4kpz.en: While this may seem like you will not finish the latter before the ⟦0⟧ finishes, the game will prioritize the player's focus as long as it completes on the same day (and both of the latter focuses will bypass the Terror Center). Additionally, if we take the focus that bypasses the aforementioned Center focus before, Stalin will merely speed up his focuses, whereas if we let it play out but not finish, he'll be on the same track but we'll be closer. While it might seem ideal to purge army officers because of how many you have, if you need to lower paranoia, focus on purging the navy - while you have more generals, the navy is not as important to the Soviet Union as it is to the British or Japanese. Generate new admirals as needed, and also forge production reports if you don't have the option to purge an admiral. Only purge officers if you have no other choice.
i4kpz.zh: 虽然看起来你无法在 ⟦0⟧ 完成之前完成后者，但只要在同一天完成，游戏就会优先处理玩家的国策（而且后两个国策都会绕过恐怖中心）。此外，如果我们先点那个绕过前述中心国策的国策，斯大林只会加快他自己的国策，而如果我们让它推进但不完成，他会处在同样的轨道上，而我们则更接近目标。虽然鉴于你手下的军官数量，清洗陆军军官看似理想，但如果你需要降低偏执度，就集中清洗海军 —— 你的将领数量更多，而海军对苏联的重要性不如对英国或日本。按需生成新的海军上将，如果没有可清洗的海军上将，也可以伪造生产报告。只有在别无选择时才清洗军官。

1x009bw.en: Regardless, as soon as Plan for the Coup is finished, immediately click the decision to sway the head of the NKVD to your cause, and take ⟦0⟧. It should finish before the NKVD head is swayed to your cause, so go straight for ⟦1⟧, and clicking the decision to eliminate Stalin. You have an 80% chance of Stalin dying this way - consider disbanding the entire army beforehand if he survives, since you'll likely get a civil war afterwards. However, if he does die, congrats! But you're not out of the woods just yet - Lavrentiy Beria, who will replace Stalin, will continue down the Centre path, and should he finish ⟦2⟧, the Bloodless coup option will be locked out, in which case, all your work will have been for naught. Afterwards, all that's left is to take either ⟦3⟧ or ⟦4⟧ to remove the Trotskyite Plot debuff.
1x009bw.zh: 无论如何，只要「策划政变」一完成，立刻点击决议把 NKVD 首脑拉拢到你这边，并点 ⟦0⟧。它应该在 NKVD 首脑被拉拢之前完成，所以直接去点 ⟦1⟧，并点击消灭斯大林的决议。这样有 80% 的几率让斯大林死亡 —— 如果他活下来，考虑事先解散整支军队，因为你之后很可能会遭遇内战。不过，如果他真的死了，恭喜！但你还没脱离险境 —— 将接替斯大林的拉夫连季·贝利亚会继续走中间路线，而一旦他完成 ⟦2⟧，不流血政变的选项就会被锁死，那样的话你的一切努力都将白费。之后，剩下的就是点 ⟦3⟧ 或 ⟦4⟧ 来移除托洛茨基阴谋的减益。

399cmg.en: This uneasy arrangement with Germany ended abruptly on 22 June 1941, when the Wehrmacht launched Operation Barbarossa, the largest invasion in history. The Soviet Union, caught off guard, suffered devastating early losses but gradually halted the German advance through immense sacrifice and the mobilization of its vast resources. The turning points at Moscow, Stalingrad, and Kursk shifted the momentum, and by 1945 the Red Army had pushed deep into Eastern Europe, capturing Berlin in May. Victorious yet scarred by immense human and material losses, the Soviet Union emerged from the war as a superpower, dominating Eastern Europe and entering into a global rivalry with the ⟦0⟧ that would define the Cold War.
399cmg.zh: 与德国这种不安的安排在 1941 年 6 月 22 日骤然终结，国防军发动了历史上规模最大的入侵——巴巴罗萨行动。苏联措手不及，在初期遭受了毁灭性的损失，但通过巨大的牺牲和对其庞大资源的动员，逐渐阻止了德军的推进。莫斯科、斯大林格勒和库尔斯克的转折点扭转了势头，到 1945 年红军已深入东欧，并于 5 月攻占柏林。苏联虽赢得胜利，却因巨大的人员与物资损失而满目疮痍，战后以超级大国的姿态出现，主宰东欧，并与 ⟦0⟧ 展开了一场定义冷战的全球对抗。

fa1xq5.en: This is a guide about Stalins great purges, which happens when the appropriate focuses (The Zinovyevite Terrorist Center, The Anti-Soviet Trotskyist Center, The Military Conspiracy, The Bloc of Rights and Trotskyites) finish (and it assumes you follow the centre path, some of the other paths might change who gets purged). After each one you get an unavoidable purge of several characters. The characters purged are always the same, unless a random purge already purged one of those characters earlier via the paranoia system, or if they are exiled. If the character was already purged, a random character will be picked. So the amount of people purged cannot be reduced.
fa1xq5.zh: 这是一篇关于斯大林大清洗的指南，大清洗会在相应国策（「齐诺维耶夫恐怖中心」、「反苏托洛茨基中心」、「军事阴谋」、「权利与托洛茨基分子联盟」）完成时发生（本指南假设你走中间路线，其他路线可能会改变被清洗的人选）。每完成一个，你就会不可避免地失去若干人物。被清洗的人物通常总是相同的，除非他们此前已因偏执度系统被随机清洗，或已被流放。如果该人物已被清洗，则会随机挑选一位人物。因此被清洗的人数无法减少。

18d94ro.en: It should be noted that while Beria will be the one who can lock off the bloodless coup, if Yagoda is purged, he will be replaced with Nikolay Yezhov - this is both good and bad, since while doing so will significantly lower paranoia, Yezhov will generate more paranoia on a weekly basis than Yagoda does (and he also lowers Stability more). The best case scenario would be Yagoda getting purged late (if he gets purged at all), but as long as you can attempt to eliminate Stalin before Yezhov is purged, you're in the clear. Note that you can decline to purge Yezhov, but doing so will boost paranoia and cost you some political power.
18d94ro.zh: 应当注意，虽然贝利亚才是能够锁死不流血政变的人，但如果亚戈达被清洗，他将由尼古拉·叶若夫接替 —— 这既好也坏，因为这样做会显著降低偏执度，但叶若夫每周产生的偏执度比亚戈达更多（而且他降低的稳定度也更多）。最好的情况是亚戈达较晚才被清洗（如果他真被清洗的话），但只要你能在叶若夫被清洗之前尝试消灭斯大林，你就安全了。注意，你可以选择不清洗叶若夫，但这样做会提升偏执度并让你损失一些政治点数。

9asjpq.en: It's possible to drag Soviet Union into Sino-Japanese war, by guaranteeing Communist China and ⟦0⟧. As such, when ⟦1⟧ invades China, Soviet Union ends up dragged in it. Don't forget to move divisions to ⟦2⟧ front beforehand in this case. Since you have more divisions (both if directly comparing USSR and Japan - and if factoring in puppets, China, and Volunteers from ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧), and other Axis factions don't participate in this - defeating ⟦5⟧ should be rather easy. The only tricky part may be invasion of ⟦6⟧ mainland - as USSR's navy is small, and starts on opposite side of the globe.
9asjpq.zh: 通过保障中国共产党和 ⟦0⟧ 的独立，有可能把苏联拖入中日战争。这样一来，当 ⟦1⟧ 入侵中国时，苏联最终会被拖进去。在这种情况下，别忘了事先把师调到 ⟦2⟧ 前线。由于你的师更多（无论是直接比较苏联与日本 —— 还是把傀儡国、中国以及来自 ⟦3⟧ 和 ⟦4⟧ 的志愿军算进去），而且其他轴心国阵营不参与其中 —— 击败 ⟦5⟧ 应该相当容易。唯一棘手的部分可能是入侵 ⟦6⟧ 本土 —— 因为苏联海军规模小，而且开局在地球的另一端。

h9htf.en: In foreign affairs, the Soviet Union initially sought collective security against the rise of fascism, engaging in negotiations with the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. However, Western reluctance to commit to firm guarantees led Moscow to sign the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact with the ⟦2⟧ in August 1939, a non-aggression treaty that secretly divided Eastern Europe into spheres of influence. Following the pact, the USSR annexed eastern ⟦3⟧, the Baltic states, and Bessarabia, and fought the Winter War against ⟦4⟧, gaining territory but revealing serious deficiencies in its armed forces.
h9htf.zh: 在外交上，苏联最初寻求针对法西斯主义崛起的集体安全，与 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 进行谈判。然而，西方不愿做出坚定保障，使莫斯科于 1939 年 8 月与 ⟦2⟧ 签署了《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》，这是一项互不侵犯条约，秘密地把东欧划分为势力范围。该条约签订后，苏联吞并了 ⟦3⟧ 东部、波罗的海国家和比萨拉比亚，并与 ⟦4⟧ 打了冬季战争，获得了领土，却也暴露出其武装力量的严重缺陷。

18z4h35.en: Following Lenin’s death in 1924, Joseph Stalin gradually consolidated power, outmaneuvering rivals within the party. By the early 1930s, the ⟦0⟧ had embarked on a program of rapid industrialization and forced collectivization of agriculture, transforming the nation’s economic base at the cost of widespread famine, suffering, and political repression. The Great Purge of 1936–1938 further tightened Stalin’s grip, eliminating perceived enemies within the military, party, and intelligentsia, but leaving the Red Army weakened on the eve of global conflict.
18z4h35.zh: 1924 年列宁逝世后，约瑟夫·斯大林逐步巩固权力，在党内斗倒对手。到 1930 年代初，⟦0⟧ 已开始推行快速工业化和农业强制集体化，以普遍的饥荒、苦难和政治镇压为代价，改变了国家的经济基础。1936–1938 年的大清洗进一步收紧了斯大林的掌控，清除了军队、党和知识分子中被视为敌人的人，却让红军在全球冲突前夕变得虚弱。

t4q27z.en: Despite its large amount of manpower and natural resources, the country's stability is torn apart as a result of old power struggles and paranoia, with purges on a regular basis intended to root out all conspirators with often detrimental side effects to the efficiency of management, production and command. Their military is in need of rapid modernization in multiple aspects to keep up with their European neighbors. And the Five Year Plan has only just started recently and would still require effort and time to reap the fruits.
t4q27z.zh: 尽管拥有大量人力和自然资源，但国家稳定度因旧有的权力斗争和偏执而支离破碎，定期的清洗旨在铲除所有阴谋者，却往往对管理、生产和指挥的效率产生有害的副作用。其军队在多个方面都需要迅速现代化，才能跟上欧洲邻国的步伐。而五年计划才刚刚开始不久，仍需投入努力和时间才能收获成果。

1fprvi5.en: The Russian Empire's collapse in the chaos of the 1917 revolutions and the ensuing civil war gave rise to the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics in 1922. Born from the Bolshevik victory over the White forces and foreign intervention, the new Soviet state emerged under the leadership of Vladimir Lenin and the Communist Party, committed to building a socialist society and spreading revolutionary ideology abroad. The early years were marked by economic hardship, reconstruction, and the suppression of political dissent.
1fprvi5.zh: 俄罗斯帝国在 1917 年革命的混乱和随之而来的内战中崩溃，1922 年苏联由此诞生。新生的苏维埃国家诞生于布尔什维克对白军和外国干涉的胜利，在弗拉基米尔·列宁和共产党的领导下登上舞台，致力于建设社会主义社会并在海外传播革命意识形态。早年充满了经济困苦、重建以及对政治异见的压制。

bdzlwn.en: That can allow to remove debuffs sooner, protect Communist China, and defeat ⟦0⟧ if played correctly. ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, Mengkukuo, Korea, Federated States of Micronesia, Mariana Federation can be turned into ⟦3⟧ - don't forget to take their industry and resources - though, China countries would also try to get parts of Japan during peace conference. You must also consider the time needed to move divisions to China and back - in case you're planning to bum-rush elsewhere, or otherwise go to war with someone.
bdzlwn.zh: 这能让你更早移除减益、保护中国共产党，并且在操作得当时击败 ⟦0⟧。⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、蒙疆联合自治政府、朝鲜、密克罗尼西亚联邦、马里亚纳联邦都可以变成 ⟦3⟧ —— 别忘了拿走它们的工业和资源 —— 不过中国各方也会试图在和平会议上分得日本的一部分。你还必须考虑把师调到中国再调回来所需的时间 —— 以防你打算突袭别处，或者要跟其他人开战。

11qufjb.en: Unlike every option above — which asks a foreign government to agree — the Permanent Revolution branch is purely ⟦0⟧: the target gets no accept/refuse choice. It is available only on the Left Opposition path, with the USSR led by ⟦1⟧, and requires the ⟦2⟧ content (Trotsky must be alive in exile in ⟦3⟧). After winning the Left Opposition civil war, completing ⟦4⟧ upgrades Trotsky's leader trait from ⟦5⟧ to ⟦6⟧ and unlocks two repeatable targeted decisions used to export the revolution by force.
11qufjb.zh: 与上面每个选项（都要求外国政府同意）不同，「不断革命」分支是纯粹的 ⟦0⟧：目标没有接受/拒绝的选择。它仅在左翼反对派路线可用，此时苏联由 ⟦1⟧ 领导，并且需要 ⟦2⟧ 内容（托洛茨基必须还活着并流亡在 ⟦3⟧）。赢得左翼反对派内战后，完成 ⟦4⟧ 会把托洛茨基的领袖特质从 ⟦5⟧ 升级为 ⟦6⟧，并解锁两个可重复的定向决议，用于以武力输出革命。

1fzffzm.en: It's also possible to end Sino-Japanese war before 1941 by using volunteers. If Guanxi clique is at peace with Japan, it's unable to take *Demand Tonkinese Bases* focus, therefore Pearl Harbor never happens and USA doesn't join Allies, which will make further war with Allies easier. Japan will sign white peace with China if China controls all core states, Manchuria is capitulated and Korea isn't controlled by Japan.
1fzffzm.zh: 也可以通过志愿军让中日战争在 1941 年前结束。如果桂系与日本处于和平状态，它就无法点「索取东京湾基地」国策，因此珍珠港事件永远不会发生，美国也不会加入同盟国，这将使之后与同盟国的战争更容易。如果中国控制所有核心州、满洲投降且朝鲜不受日本控制，日本就会与中国签订白色和平。

oz6ddp.en: With No Step Back released, one notable option available to players who stay communist is the ability to get rid of Stalin without a civil war if they go down the Right Opposition Path. However, this is very risky, since you need to assassinate Stalin before Beria becomes head of the NKVD, and should Paranoia get above 90, the civil war will fire. But if you want Russia to avoid another civil war, read on.
oz6ddp.zh: 随着《绝不后退》发布，坚持共产主义路线的玩家有一个显著选项：走右翼反对派路线可以在不发生内战的情况下除掉斯大林。然而这非常冒险，因为你必须在贝利亚成为 NKVD 首脑之前刺杀斯大林，而一旦偏执度超过 90，内战就会爆发。但如果你想让俄罗斯避免另一场内战，请继续读下去。

149kklk.en: To do this, support Guomintang and send 3 light tank, 3 mountaineer, a wing of fighters and a wing of tactical bombers early. Japanese divisions shouldn't be able to pierce even the basic Soviet light tank template. Prioritize clearing plains, landings, then supply hubs. Once Manchuria is reached, try to rush Mukden - it can be particularly difficult to take once China eats all the supply on that front.
149kklk.zh: 要做到这一点，支持国民党，并尽早派出 3 个轻型坦克师、3 个山地师、一个战斗机航空队和一个战术轰炸机航空队。日本的师应该连苏联的基础轻型坦克编制都打不穿。优先清理平原、登陆点，然后是补给中心。一旦抵达满洲，就设法突袭奉天 —— 当中国吃光那条战线上的全部补给后，攻取它会特别困难。

18py579.en: The post-civil war sub-branch allows the coronation of Vladimir III as ⟦0⟧, thus reinstalling the Romanovs to the throne of ⟦1⟧. It may also install a ⟦2⟧ government with Konstantin Rodzayevsky as leader and relegating the Tsar to a figurehead. There is also the path in which ⟦3⟧ may become a ⟦4⟧, creating the Third Rome with Arch-Patriarch Meletius as the head of state, forcing Vladimir III to resign.
18py579.zh: 内战后的子分支允许加冕弗拉基米尔三世为 ⟦0⟧，从而让罗曼诺夫家族重登 ⟦1⟧ 的王位。它也可能建立一个由康斯坦丁·罗扎耶夫斯基领导的 ⟦2⟧ 政府，并把沙皇降为傀儡。还有一条路径是 ⟦3⟧ 可能成为 ⟦4⟧，以大主教梅勒提乌斯为国家元首建立第三罗马，迫使弗拉基米尔三世退位。

1fdet7r.en: ⟦0⟧ targets a non-communist country that is ⟦1⟧ at war with or allied to the USSR, has ⟦2⟧ support and borders Soviet-controlled land. It costs 50 , once per country, and applies the ⟦3⟧ spirit for 120 days ( drift ⟦4⟧/month, ⟦5⟧, ideology drift defence ⟦6⟧; a weakened version — ⟦7⟧ drift, ⟦8⟧ stability — if the target has banned communism), while handing the USSR a 90-day ⟦9⟧ war goal.
1fdet7r.zh: ⟦0⟧ 以某个非共产主义国家为目标，该国需与苏联处于 ⟦1⟧ 状态或与苏联结盟、拥有 ⟦2⟧ 支持度，并与苏联控制的土地接壤。它花费 50 ，每个国家一次，并施加 ⟦3⟧ 国家精神 120 天（每月 ⟦4⟧ 偏移、⟦5⟧、意识形态偏移防御 ⟦6⟧；如果目标禁止共产主义，则为削弱版 —— ⟦7⟧ 偏移、⟦8⟧ 稳定度），同时给苏联一个为期 90 天的 ⟦9⟧ 战争目标。

14xjczj.en: The Soviet Union is a massive country, stretching from the barren wastelands of Kamchatka to the warm, fertile fields of Ukraine. Much of the north and east is forest, with polar regions of Siberia marshlands and plains. There is little mountains or hills besides the Caucasus and Ural ranges. The south is primarily plains, with a few urban provinces dispersed throughout the country.
14xjczj.zh: 苏联是一个庞大的国家，从堪察加荒芜的废土延伸到乌克兰温暖肥沃的田野。北部和东部大部分是森林，西伯利亚的极地地区则是沼泽和平原。除高加索和乌拉尔山脉外，几乎没有山地或丘陵。南部主要是平原，全国各地散布着一些城市省份。

az20fz.en: While led by ⟦0⟧ (the Centre path), the ⟦1⟧ runs a hidden ⟦2⟧ meter from 0 to 100, shown in its own interface. It represents Stalin's distrust of the party and the armed forces and drives the purges that periodically remove the country's characters (generals, admirals, advisors and theorists). The meter starts at 0 and is tied to the ⟦3⟧ national spirit ( gain ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧).
az20fz.zh: 在 ⟦0⟧ 领导期间（中间路线），⟦1⟧ 会运行一个从 0 到 100 的隐藏 ⟦2⟧ 计量条，显示在其独立界面中。它代表斯大林对党和武装力量的不信任，并驱动定期清除国家人物（将领、海军上将、顾问和理论家）的清洗。该计量条从 0 开始，并与 ⟦3⟧ 国家精神挂钩（获得 ⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧）。

lpqg31.en: The Soviet Civil War is fired by the political focus tree when an Opposition faction moves against Stalin. The player always leads the rebels; Stalin's loyalists break away as a new country, the ⟦0⟧ (tag SOS), keeping Moscow as their capital. Stalin leads SOS (or Lavrenty Beriya if Stalin is already dead), and the Stalinist side instantly completes the ⟦1⟧ focuses.
lpqg31.zh: 苏联内战的爆发源于政治国策树中某个反对派派系对斯大林发难。玩家总是领导叛军；斯大林的效忠者会分离出去，成为一个新国家 ⟦0⟧（tag SOS），以莫斯科为首都。斯大林领导 SOS（如果斯大林已死，则由拉夫连季·贝利亚领导），并且斯大林主义一方会瞬间完成 ⟦1⟧ 国策。

shrrgh.en: The Exiles path in particular destabilises the union: from the third month onward a monthly check can spawn breakaway nations — Ukraine, Belarus, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Crimea, Karelia and the Central Asian republics — with the odds rising the longer the war drags on (Ukraine and the Caucasus republics are the likeliest). A Karelian revolt also drags in ⟦0⟧.
shrrgh.zh: 尤其是流亡者路线会动摇联盟：从第三个月起，每月的一次检查可能催生分离国家 —— 乌克兰、白俄罗斯、格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆、克里米亚、卡累利阿以及中亚各共和国 —— 战争拖得越久，几率越高（乌克兰和高加索各共和国最有可能）。卡累利阿的叛乱还会把 ⟦0⟧ 拖进来。

a2bsmy.en: Through its focus tree (mainly the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ branches), the ⟦2⟧ gains a series of decisions and focuses that put a proposal - a pact, an ideological push, an ultimatum, or a territorial demand - to a foreign AI, which then accepts or refuses. The odds below are the base AI weights on the default historical AI; listed modifiers multiply those weights.
a2bsmy.zh: 通过其国策树（主要是 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 分支），⟦2⟧ 获得一系列决议和国策，向外国 AI 提出一项提议 —— 一份条约、一次意识形态推动、一份最后通牒或一项领土要求 —— 然后由对方接受或拒绝。下面的几率是默认历史 AI 下的基础 AI 权重；列出的修正会乘算这些权重。

1mu782f.en: If the player is following an Opposition path to depose Stalin and Paranoia climbs above 89, each day carries a ⟦0⟧ to immediately ignite the Soviet Civil War (the AI is exempt from this check). Keeping Paranoia low — or finishing the coup quickly — is therefore essential on the Right and Left Opposition routes. The war itself is covered in ⟦1⟧ below.
1mu782f.zh: 如果玩家正走反对派路线以推翻斯大林，而偏执度升到 89 以上，那么每天都有 ⟦0⟧ 立刻点燃苏联内战（AI 不受此检查影响）。因此，在右翼和左翼反对派路线上，保持低偏执度 —— 或迅速完成政变 —— 至关重要。战争本身将在下文 ⟦1⟧ 中介绍。

1vj4mvq.en: ⟦0⟧ is used against a country the USSR is ⟦1⟧ whose home territory borders Soviet-controlled land. It costs a flat ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ from the stockpile, once per target, and after a delay spawns Soviet-controlled "Trotskyist Revolutionary Militias" (three-battalion militia divisions) as a fifth-column uprising inside the enemy's territory.
1vj4mvq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 用于针对一个苏联正与其处于 ⟦1⟧ 状态、且其本土与苏联控制的土地接壤的国家。它每次针对一个目标，从库存中固定花费 ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧，并在延迟后生成由苏联控制的“托洛茨基革命民兵”（三营民兵师），作为敌方领土内的第五纵队起义。

8z30y.en: Each branch — army, navy and air — has its own "opposition support" value, raised by the focuses that align commanders and units to your cause. With no preparation it bottoms out at a 20% floor for that branch and is capped at 90%; the Stalinist SOS keeps the remainder. (An AI-led Opposition gets +25% to any branch below 55%.)
8z30y.zh: 每个分支 —— 陆军、海军和空军 —— 都有自己的“反对派支持度”数值，由那些让指挥官和部队倒向你事业的国策提升。若毫无准备，该分支的支持度会触底在 20% 的下限，上限为 90%；斯大林主义的 SOS 保留其余部分。（AI 领导的反对派在任何低于 55% 的分支上获得 +25%。）

1mrw5c5.en: Independently of the random meter, four focuses on the Centre path (⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧) each trigger an unavoidable Great Purge — detailed under ⟦4⟧. Characters already killed by the random Paranoia system are skipped and replaced, so the total number purged cannot be reduced; only ⟦5⟧ characters die changes.
1mrw5c5.zh: 独立于随机计量条之外，中间路线上的四个国策（⟦0⟧、⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧ 和 ⟦3⟧）各自触发一次不可避免的大清洗 —— 详见 ⟦4⟧。已被随机偏执度系统杀死的人物会被跳过并替换，因此被清洗的总人数无法减少；唯一会变的是 ⟦5⟧ 人物会死。

1a0io93.en: ⟦0⟧ keep monarchist-sympathizer commanders and additionally raise unique White formations from their focuses: "Ruki" (Hands) NKVD infantry from ⟦1⟧, "Rebyata" youth units, "Stariki" (Old Guard) cavalry, returning Cossack/Manchurian cavalry, and Ataman Grigory Semyonov transferred from the Far East.
1a0io93.zh: ⟦0⟧ 保留同情君主制的指挥官，并额外通过其国策组建独特的白军部队：来自 ⟦1⟧ 的“Ruki”（手）NKVD 步兵、“Rebyata”青年部队、“Stariki”（老近卫）骑兵、回归的哥萨克/满洲骑兵，以及从远东调来的阿塔曼格里戈里·谢苗诺夫。

nhjtvw.en: ⟦0⟧ — Paranoia rises every week from active modifiers, chiefly Stalin's own ⟦1⟧ trait and the current head of the NKVD. The base weekly increase is small (+1 per active modifier), but replacing Genrikh Yagoda with Nikolai Yezhov raises the weekly gain (and lowers stability further).
nhjtvw.zh: ⟦0⟧ —— 偏执度每周因生效的修正而上升，主要是斯大林自己的 ⟦1⟧ 特质和现任 NKVD 首脑。每周基础增幅很小（每个生效修正 +1），但用尼古拉·叶若夫替换亨里希·亚戈达会提高每周增幅（并进一步降低稳定度）。

ltvh7v.en: ⟦0⟧ keeps Trotskyist-aligned commanders — notably ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, won over by the ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ focuses (plus a few randomly converted generals). Because this path protects them instead of purging them, Tukhachevsky and Primakov — historically shot in 1937 — survive and fight for you.
ltvh7v.zh: ⟦0⟧ 保留与托洛茨基结盟的指挥官 —— 尤其是 ⟦1⟧ 和 ⟦2⟧，他们是被 ⟦3⟧ 和 ⟦4⟧ 国策争取过来的（再加上少数被随机转化来的将领）。因为这条路线保护他们而非清洗他们，历史上于 1937 年被枪决的图哈切夫斯基和普里马科夫得以幸存并为你而战。

4ww8j8.en: A weak, friendly, unguaranteed minor therefore folds roughly two times in three; a strong or major-backed one (e.g. an armed neutral ⟦0⟧) usually refuses. ⟦1⟧ is low-stakes - it only nudges communist popularity, changing no government or alliance - and is almost always accepted.
4ww8j8.zh: 因此，一个弱小、友好且未受保障的小国有约三分之二的概率屈服；而一个强大或有主要国家撑腰的小国（例如武装中立的 ⟦0⟧）通常会拒绝。⟦1⟧ 风险很低 —— 它只会小幅推动共产主义支持度，不会改变任何政府或同盟 —— 而且几乎总会被接受。

izbum6.en: The officer corps is not divided evenly. The rebels keep only the commanders they have aligned to their faction; every other general and admiral — including all unaligned officers — defects to Stalin's SOS, which additionally receives every Stalinist-aligned officer.
izbum6.zh: 军官团并非平均分配。叛军只保留他们已拉拢到己方派系的指挥官；其他所有将领和海军上将 —— 包括所有未结盟的军官 —— 都倒向斯大林的 SOS，后者还额外获得所有与斯大林结盟的军官。

18l6vsn.en: Each week the game rolls for a purge, weighted by how many days that week were spent at medium versus high Paranoia — the more days at high Paranoia, the likelier a Great Purge over a Regular one. After any purge there is a ⟦0⟧ before another can occur.
18l6vsn.zh: 每周游戏都会进行一次清洗判定，权重取决于那一周处于中等偏执度与高偏执度的天数 —— 高偏执度的天数越多，越可能发生大清洗而非普通清洗。任何清洗之后都会有一段 ⟦0⟧，之后才可能再次发生。

kthtqh.en: In many ways, the USSR is the epicenter of Communist ideology, which finds itself at odds with many of their neighbors. With various territorial disputes with ⟦0⟧, the Baltic States and ⟦1⟧ to the west, and frequent border clashes with ⟦2⟧ to the east.
kthtqh.zh: 在许多方面，苏联是共产主义意识形态的中心，而它与许多邻国关系不睦。它在西面与 ⟦0⟧、波罗的海国家和 ⟦1⟧ 存在各种领土争端，在东面则与 ⟦2⟧ 频繁发生边境冲突。

117lj3l.en: ⟦0⟧ Base puppet 2 vs refuse 10 (≈17% accept), but the puppet weight is ×2 below 0.8 strength ratio, ×4 below 0.5 and ×6 below 0.2 (stacking). A Balkan minor far weaker than the USSR puppets ≈90% of the time; a comparable or faction-backed one refuses.
117lj3l.zh: ⟦0⟧ 基础傀儡权重 2 对拒绝 10（约 17% 接受），但当实力比低于 0.8 时傀儡权重 ×2，低于 0.5 时 ×4，低于 0.2 时 ×6（可叠加）。一个远弱于苏联的巴尔干小国有约 90% 的概率被傀儡化；实力相当或有阵营支持的小国则会拒绝。

xan6q4.en: The ⟦0⟧ has the largest army in the world in 1936, with over a million men deployed in 138 divisions. Its navy is thinly spread across multiple naval theaters with a strong focus on submarines, while its air force is among the strongest on the globe.
xan6q4.zh: 1936 年 ⟦0⟧ 拥有世界上最大的陆军，138 个师共部署了超过一百万兵力。其海军稀薄地分散在多个海战战区，并以潜艇为重点，而其空军则是全球最强的空军之一。

10bysdf.en: If you are planning on saving the advisors, take ⟦0⟧, and either ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ - you hypothetically have time for both, but the more time you waste, the more chance you risk of Stalin purging advisors who you otherwise would save. Afterwards, rush ⟦3⟧.
10bysdf.zh: 如果你打算救下那些顾问，就点 ⟦0⟧，然后点 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧ —— 理论上你有时间把两个都点完，但你浪费的时间越多，斯大林清洗掉你本可救下的顾问的机会就越大。之后，赶紧点 ⟦3⟧。

ocdlcl.en: This sub-branch handles external politics and alliances with the development of the ⟦0⟧ other allies in the east, political maneuvering with the other major European countries, on other eastern European nations, The Middle East, and Far East Asia.
ocdlcl.zh: 该子分支处理对外政治与同盟，包括在东部发展 ⟦0⟧ 的其他盟友、与其他欧洲主要国家展开政治运作，以及涉及其他东欧国家、中东和远东亚洲的事务。

1tpgzyp.en: The ⟦0⟧, also known as the ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ is a major country stretching across Eastern Europe and the northern parts of Asia with a population of ⟦3⟧. The USSR is the leader of the Comintern faction, consisting of ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧.
1tpgzyp.zh: ⟦0⟧，又称 ⟦1⟧ 或 ⟦2⟧，是一个横跨东欧和亚洲北部的大国，人口为 ⟦3⟧。苏联是共产国际阵营的领袖，该阵营由 ⟦4⟧ 和 ⟦5⟧ 组成。

q0jrm2.en: The focus ⟦0⟧ offers a mutual non-aggression pact and guarantee. The target is ⟦1⟧ by default, otherwise ⟦2⟧ if it leads a faction, otherwise any non-fascist European faction leader. A fascist France is not a valid target.
q0jrm2.zh: 国策 ⟦0⟧ 提供互不侵犯条约和保障独立。默认目标是 ⟦1⟧，否则若其领导阵营则为 ⟦2⟧，再否则为任意非法西斯欧洲阵营领袖。法西斯法国不是有效目标。

15vbl5p.en: As the premier communist nation in 1936, the Soviet Union is the head of the Comintern, consisting of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Meanwhile, Communist China, and ⟦2⟧ are the only other countries that have a favorable view of the USSR.
15vbl5p.zh: 作为 1936 年首屈一指的共产主义国家，苏联是共产国际的首脑，该阵营由 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 组成。与此同时，中国共产党和 ⟦2⟧ 是仅有的另外两个对苏联持好感的国家。

r3n1d1.en: Separately, the Opposition's popular support feeds a dynamic modifier (⟦0⟧), active for the whole war, that shifts the surrender surrender limit in the rebels' favour and against Stalin in proportion to that support.
r3n1d1.zh: 此外，反对派的民众支持度会驱动一个动态修正（⟦0⟧），该修正在整场战争期间生效，会按支持度比例把投降上限朝有利于叛军、不利于斯大林的方向调整。

5m549h.en: A normal civil war splits forces roughly government alignment. The Soviet war instead splits them by how much of the state and armed forces the Opposition has won over in advance through its focuses:
5m549h.zh: 普通内战大致按政府阵营划分部队。而苏联内战则按反对派事先通过其国策争取到的国家与武装力量的比例来划分：

1ydizpi.en: This sub-branch places ⟦0⟧ as leader of the ⟦1⟧ via civil war. Afterwards, it allows the fomentation of ⟦2⟧ uprisings in foreign nations and allows the releasing of countries from within the ⟦3⟧.
1ydizpi.zh: 该子分支通过内战让 ⟦0⟧ 成为 ⟦1⟧ 的领袖。之后，它允许在外国煽动 ⟦2⟧ 起义，并允许从 ⟦3⟧ 内部释放国家。

1rpx09h.en: This branch prepares the Second Russian Civil War, allowing the end of ⟦0⟧ rule in ⟦1⟧. It also allows the donation of Sakhalin or Vladivostok to ⟦2⟧ for help in the civil war.
1rpx09h.zh: 该分支为第二次俄罗斯内战做准备，允许终结 ⟦0⟧ 在 ⟦1⟧ 的统治。它还允许把萨哈林或符拉迪沃斯托克赠予 ⟦2⟧ 以换取内战中的援助。

1rajtq.en: ⟦0⟧ accept / 60% refuse. Accept drops to ⟦1⟧ if Poland is already guaranteed by Germany (via ⟦2⟧) or holds the anti-Soviet pact, so it must be secured before Germany acts.
1rajtq.zh: ⟦0⟧ 接受 / 60% 拒绝。接受率会降至 ⟦1⟧，前提是波兰已被德国保障独立（通过 ⟦2⟧）或持有反苏条约，因此必须在德国行动之前确保达成。

1unqfz5.en: This sub-branch allows the ⟦0⟧ to follow the historical ⟦1⟧ path. It balances Stalin's Political Paranoia, starts the Great Purge and modifies the ⟦2⟧ national spirit.
1unqfz5.zh: 该子分支允许 ⟦0⟧ 走上历史性的 ⟦1⟧ 路线。它平衡斯大林的政治偏执度，启动大清洗并修改 ⟦2⟧ 国家精神。

de0cgh.en: During the war, a monthly event lets Stalinist generals who were merely ⟦0⟧ into loyalty defect to the Opposition (≈25% chance each), slowly evening the rosters.
de0cgh.zh: 战争期间，每月一次事件会让那些仅仅是 ⟦0⟧ 的斯大林主义将领倒向反对派（每个约 25% 几率），逐渐使双方的名册趋于平衡。

dnne0c.en: ⟦0⟧ accept / 67% refuse at parity (base 5 vs 10); the accept chance rises with how badly Japan is outmatched on land ⟦1⟧ at sea (army and naval strength ratios).
dnne0c.zh: ⟦0⟧ 接受 / 在势均力敌时 67% 拒绝（基础 5 对 10）；接受几率随日本在陆地 ⟦1⟧ 海上被压制的程度而上升（陆军和海军实力比）。

1vyk2iz.en: Effectively ⟦0⟧, almost always with the ⟦1⟧ option (raises the Poland question before signing). ⟦2⟧ is ×4 on historical AI; ⟦3⟧ is ×0.1 under the Popular Front.
1vyk2iz.zh: 实际上就是 ⟦0⟧，几乎总是选择 ⟦1⟧ 选项（在签署前提出波兰问题）。在历史 AI 下 ⟦2⟧ 为 ×4；在人民阵线下 ⟦3⟧ 为 ×0.1。

1js42y5.en: This half of the army branch gives the national spirit ⟦0⟧ and gives bonuses to artillery and armor as it gets modified when the player goes down the branch.
1js42y5.zh: 陆军分支的这一半给予国家精神 ⟦0⟧，并在玩家沿该分支推进、其被修改时给予火炮和装甲加成。

1swrdj7.en: ⟦0⟧: Without ⟦1⟧, Medium Tank I and II are unlocked one year later. Amphibious tanks are then unlocked in 1940 and 1942, the second one is called PT-76.
1swrdj7.zh: ⟦0⟧：若没有 ⟦1⟧，中型坦克 I 和 II 会晚一年解锁。两栖坦克则在 1940 年和 1942 年解锁，第二种名为 PT-76。

14udh9s.en: ⟦0⟧ (accept 10 vs refuse 0). They only resist if protected by a major's faction or guarantee, or guaranteed by Germany via a Baltic-safeguard focus.
14udh9s.zh: ⟦0⟧（接受 10 对拒绝 0）。只有当它们受到主要国家阵营或保障独立的保护，或经由波罗的海保障国策被德国保障独立时，它们才会抵抗。

1dy78de.en: This sub-branch places ⟦0⟧ as leader of the ⟦1⟧ via civil war or a coup via Stalin's assassination. It allows the ⟦2⟧ as a new economic law.
1dy78de.zh: 该子分支通过内战或刺杀斯大林后的政变，让 ⟦0⟧ 成为 ⟦1⟧ 的领袖。它允许将 ⟦2⟧ 作为新的经济法令。

10jhlqm.en: ⟦0⟧ on historical AI (accept is forced to 0; refuse 75) — triggers the Winter War. Off-historical it folds ≈25% of the time if unguaranteed.
10jhlqm.zh: 在历史 AI 下 ⟦0⟧（接受被强制为 0；拒绝 75）—— 触发冬季战争。非历史情况下，若未受保障，它约有 25% 的概率屈服。

bejdw.en: ×5 if the country already leans that ideology (>50% popularity); ×2 on high opinion. Unavailable if it already shares the USSR's ideology.
bejdw.zh: 若该国已倾向该意识形态（支持度 >50%）则 ×5；高好感度则 ×2。若它已与苏联共享同一意识形态则不可用。

867lio.en: This sub-branch is shared with the ⟦0⟧ and the ⟦1⟧. It allows gaining of support from advisors from the other sub-branch.
867lio.zh: 该子分支与 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 共用。它允许从另一个子分支的顾问那里获得支持。

mydeqr.en: This sub-branch is shared with the ⟦0⟧ and the ⟦1⟧. It allows the the Supreme Soviet to become the head of the ⟦2⟧ party.
mydeqr.zh: 该子分支与 ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧ 共用。它允许最高苏维埃成为 ⟦2⟧ 党的首脑。

19i3b9n.en: ×2 if much weaker than the USSR, ×4 if far weaker; ×2 if opinion of the USSR > 75. Unavailable if already in a faction.
19i3b9n.zh: 若远比苏联弱小则 ×2，若远为弱小则 ×4；若对苏联的好感度 > 75 则 ×2。若已在某个阵营中则不可用。

1490wvn.en: ⟦0⟧ cede / 70% refuse, and accept is forced to ⟦1⟧ once a major guarantees or allies Poland — historically it refuses.
1490wvn.zh: ⟦0⟧ 割让 / 70% 拒绝，而一旦有主要国家保障或与波兰结盟，接受就会被强制为 ⟦1⟧ —— 历史上它会拒绝。

1bhx7yt.en: ⟦0⟧ kills: Karl Radek, Ivar Smilga, Yevgeny Preobrazhensky, Martemyan Ryutin, and if you own ⟦1⟧, Nikolay Ustryalov
1bhx7yt.zh: ⟦0⟧ 杀死：卡尔·拉狄克、伊瓦尔·斯米尔加、叶夫根尼·普列奥布拉任斯基、马尔捷米扬·留京，以及如果你拥有 ⟦1⟧，则还有尼古拉·乌斯特里亚洛夫

n77qmj.en: This sub-branch creates forts on strategically defensive locations and moves the industry to the Ural mountains.
n77qmj.zh: 该子分支在具有战略防御价值的地点修建要塞，并把工业迁往乌拉尔山脉。

5k5sfr.en: By selecting this ⟦0⟧ it will permanently affect capabilities on all equipment researched while they are hired.
5k5sfr.zh: 选择这个 ⟦0⟧ 会在其受聘期间永久影响所有已研究装备的能力。

h6y68f.en: The following commanders are only available to the Provisional Russian Government, formed when the ⟦0⟧ starts.
h6y68f.zh: 以下指挥官仅对临时俄罗斯政府可用，该政府在 ⟦0⟧ 开始时成立。

wkr4ry.en: Should ⟦0⟧ prevail in the Spanish Civil War, it may be amenable to joining, as would a communist-aligned ⟦1⟧.
wkr4ry.zh: 如果 ⟦0⟧ 在西班牙内战中胜出，它可能愿意加入，而与共产主义结盟的 ⟦1⟧ 也同样。

1nsz5vr.en: The Head of the NKVD cannot be manually replaced or removed from post until the Great Purge has concluded.
1nsz5vr.zh: 在大清洗结束之前，NKVD 首脑无法被手动替换或免职。

1muv6b8.en: The ⟦0⟧ begins with 3 research slots available; 3 more can be unlocked through the national focus tree.
1muv6b8.zh: ⟦0⟧ 开局有 3 个可用科研槽；另可通过国策树解锁 3 个。

fkaakz.en: The player can push Paranoia back down through purges, forged production reports and certain decisions.
fkaakz.zh: 玩家可以通过清洗、伪造生产报告以及某些决议把偏执度重新压低。

7oi84z.en: ⟦0⟧ apply one-off changes in discrete steps: ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧. The value is clamped to 0–100.
7oi84z.zh: ⟦0⟧ 以离散步骤施加一次性变化：⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧、⟦5⟧。数值被限制在 0–100 之间。

qqcbr2.en: The cooperation focuses unlock two repeatable decisions per region - ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Targets by branch:
qqcbr2.zh: 合作协议国策每个地区解锁两个可重复决议 —— ⟦0⟧ 和 ⟦1⟧。按分支的目标：

1hftyix.en: ⟦0⟧ kills: Grigory Zinovyev, Lev Kamenev, Ivan Smirnov, Grigory Sokolnikov, Aleksandr Shlyapnikov
1hftyix.zh: ⟦0⟧ 杀死：格里戈里·季诺维也夫、列夫·加米涅夫、伊万·斯米尔诺夫、格里戈里·索柯里尼柯夫、亚历山大·施略普尼柯夫

m6kwug.en: can come to power via event ⟦0⟧ if focus The Left Opposition is complete and Trotsky isn't dead.
m6kwug.zh: 如果国策「左翼反对派」已完成且托洛茨基未死，可通过事件 ⟦0⟧ 上台。

1ep085k.en: Soviet Union starts with 50% and 30% base. These are changed to 28.2% and 40% after modifiers.
1ep085k.zh: 苏联开局基础值为 50% 和 30%。经修正后变为 28.2% 和 40%。

730g48.en: can come to power via event ⟦0⟧ if the player has completed the focus Align the Zinovyevites
730g48.zh: 如果玩家完成了国策「拉拢齐诺维耶夫派」，可通过事件 ⟦0⟧ 上台

ijhqoj.en: 2x Light Cruiser Battery I, Anti-Air I, Fire Control 0, Torpedo Launcher I, Minelaying Rails
ijhqoj.zh: 2x 轻型巡洋舰主炮 I、防空 I、火控 0、鱼雷发射器 I、布雷轨

6u1jgc.en: The industrial branch gives bonuses to infrastructure and modifies the ⟦0⟧ national spirit.
6u1jgc.zh: 工业分支给予基础设施加成并修改 ⟦0⟧ 国家精神。

1juy5sf.en: Both decisions are unlocked continent by continent — a target's ⟦0⟧ must be unlocked first:
1juy5sf.zh: 两个决议按大洲逐个解锁 —— 必须先解锁目标的 ⟦0⟧：

qlgk7f.en: This half of the army branch modifies the ⟦0⟧ whilst giving bonuses to infantry divisions.
qlgk7f.zh: 陆军分支的这一半修改 ⟦0⟧，同时给予步兵师加成。

i1zuvv.en: 2x Medium Battery I, 2x Anti-Air I, Fire Control 0, Cruiser Armor I, Floatplane Catapult I
i1zuvv.zh: 2x 中型主炮 I、2x 防空 I、火控 0、巡洋舰装甲 I、水上飞机弹射器 I

1p7ma4x.en: Same base weights and scaling - realistically only conceded when Japan is already crushed.
1p7ma4x.zh: 基础权重和缩放与上面相同 —— 现实中只有在日本已被击溃时才会让出。

1upwwjo.en: Main articles: Soviet events, Soviet events WtT, Soviet events NSB, Soviet events NSB 2
1upwwjo.zh: 主条目：Soviet events、Soviet events WtT、Soviet events NSB、Soviet events NSB 2

1a0xs6x.en: 2x Heavy Battery I, Secondary Battery I, Anti-Air I, Fire Control 0, Battleship Armor I
1a0xs6x.zh: 2x 重型主炮 I、副炮 I、防空 I、火控 0、战列舰装甲 I

1ntzljl.en: The naval branch modifies the ⟦0⟧ national spirit and gives bonuses to coastal states.
1ntzljl.zh: 海军分支修改 ⟦0⟧ 国家精神并给予沿海州加成。

1hdxhi4.en: ⟦0⟧ kills: Mikhail Tukhachevsky, Aleksandr Yegorov, Vasily Blyukher, Vitaly Primakov
1hdxhi4.zh: ⟦0⟧ 杀死：米哈伊尔·图哈切夫斯基、亚历山大·叶戈罗夫、瓦西里·布柳赫尔、维塔利·普里马科夫

ji22z.en: Light Battery II, 2x Anti-Air I, Fire Control 0, Torpedo Launcher I, Depth Charge I
ji22z.zh: 轻型主炮 II、2x 防空 I、火控 0、鱼雷发射器 I、深水炸弹 I

13dp74i.en: Once the harder focuses are taken, the USSR can issue annexation/puppet ultimatums.
13dp74i.zh: 一旦点完较难的国策，苏联就可以发出吞并/傀儡化最后通牒。

1ybxot2.en: The Soviet national focus tree can be divided into 7 branches and 9 sub-branches:
1ybxot2.zh: 苏联国策树可分为 7 个分支和 9 个子分支：

1snl28i.en: can come to power via event ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ if focus The Right Opposition is complete.
1snl28i.zh: 如果国策「右翼反对派」已完成，可通过事件 ⟦0⟧ 或 ⟦1⟧ 上台。

15chdj3.en: This handles internal politics with an increased number of propaganda campaigns.
15chdj3.zh: 这部分处理内部政治，增加宣传运动的数量。

1uae6cn.en: After a great purge event fires, a random purge event cannot happen for 15 days.
1uae6cn.zh: 大清洗事件触发后，15 天内不会发生随机清洗事件。

nlv7nt.en: can come to power via event ⟦0⟧ if focus Integrate Smirnov's Bloc is complete.
nlv7nt.zh: 如果国策「整合斯米尔诺夫集团」已完成，可通过事件 ⟦0⟧ 上台。

l4bics.en: This Designer can be upgraded to add new bonuses and improve existent ones.
l4bics.zh: 该设计商可以升级，以增加新加成并改善现有加成。

1o1v3a.en: ⟦0⟧ kills: Nikolay Bukharin, Aleksey Rykov, Mikhail Tomsky, Maksim Litvinov
1o1v3a.zh: ⟦0⟧ 杀死：尼古拉·布哈林、阿列克谢·李可夫、米哈伊尔·托姆斯基、马克西姆·李维诺夫

13xxw43.en: If you are going to save the generals who get purged, rush towards ⟦0⟧.
13xxw43.zh: 如果你打算救下那些被清洗的将领，就赶紧冲向 ⟦0⟧。

unvku4.en: Light Battery I, Fire Control 0, 2x Torpedo Launcher I, Depth Charge I
unvku4.zh: 轻型主炮 I、火控 0、2x 鱼雷发射器 I、深水炸弹 I

17wb8lx.en: Light Cruiser Battery I, Anti-Air I, Fire Control 0, Minelaying Rails
17wb8lx.zh: 轻型巡洋舰主炮 I、防空 I、火控 0、布雷轨

73ve7j.en: The airforce branch allows the ⟦0⟧ national spirit to be modified.
73ve7j.zh: 空军分支允许修改 ⟦0⟧ 国家精神。

1g5yu73.en: ⟦0⟧ (accept forced to 0 on historical; refuse 100, ×2 historical).
1g5yu73.zh: ⟦0⟧（历史上接受被强制为 0；拒绝 100，历史上 ×2）。

p37sz8.en: High alert. ⟦0⟧ can fire, removing a larger batch of characters.
p37sz8.zh: 高度警戒。⟦0⟧ 可能触发，清除更大一批人物。

1l9n633.en: Anyways, what happens next also depends on who you want to save.
1l9n633.zh: 总之，接下来会发生什么也取决于你想救谁。

1patj9j.en: Resistance Decay Speed in our states occupied by the enemy: ⟦0⟧
1patj9j.zh: 我方被敌方占领的州中的抵抗度衰减速度：⟦0⟧

1ksg5ih.en: Intelligence gained from Operatives and Infiltrated Assets: ⟦0⟧
1ksg5ih.zh: 从特工和被渗透资产获得的情报：⟦0⟧

wpkn07.en: can come to power via coup or focus Dismantle the Zemsky Sobor
wpkn07.zh: 可通过政变或国策「解散缙绅会议」上台

c8iefa.en: Has completed focus Approach Semyonov and the ⟦0⟧ has started.
c8iefa.zh: 已完成国策「接近谢苗诺夫」且 ⟦0⟧ 已开始。

1ksbek4.en: The focus ⟦0⟧ lets the USSR demand land from ⟦1⟧ short of war.
1ksbek4.zh: 国策 ⟦0⟧ 让苏联可以在不诉诸战争的情况下向 ⟦1⟧ 索取土地。

2d02ve.en: Armor technology, Support Equipment, Train, Railway Artillery
2d02ve.zh: 装甲科技、支援装备、列车、铁道炮

b0xtbu.en: Defier of the Sun God Supreme Representative of God on Earth
b0xtbu.zh: 太阳神的挑战者 神在地上的最高代表

1b5etyb.en: 2x Light Cruiser Battery I, Fire Control 0, Minelaying Rails
1b5etyb.zh: 2x 轻型巡洋舰主炮 I、火控 0、布雷轨

nodc1z.en: Light Battery II, Anti-Air I, Fire Control 0, Depth Charge I
nodc1z.zh: 轻型主炮 II、防空 I、火控 0、深水炸弹 I

ae251z.en: Basic Radio, 2x Heavy Machine Gun, Secondary Cannon Turret
ae251z.zh: 基础无线电、2x 重机枪、副炮塔

1eb8d8v.en: Occasional ⟦0⟧ — one or a few random characters are lost.
1eb8d8v.zh: 偶发的 ⟦0⟧ —— 一个或几个随机人物会损失。

1s1xaqr.en: ( The Empire of Japan)Defense bonus against country: ⟦0⟧
1s1xaqr.zh: （ 日本帝国）对该国的防御加成：⟦0⟧

186ghex.en: The focus ⟦0⟧ proposes an alliance and Soviet guarantee.
186ghex.zh: 国策 ⟦0⟧ 提议结盟并提供苏联保障。

4o0br3.en: Returns with completed focus Reconvene the Zemsky Sobor.
4o0br3.zh: 在完成国策「重新召集缙绅会议」后回归。

dpppe3.en: ( The Empire of Japan)Attack bonus against country: ⟦0⟧
dpppe3.zh: （ 日本帝国）对该国的进攻加成：⟦0⟧

18e7zqj.en: The ⟦0⟧ branch opens up to the following sub-branches.

1sunp0y.en: Completing the focus '⟦0⟧' will improve this designer.
1sunp0y.zh: 完成国策「⟦0⟧」将改进该设计商。

1vveapo.en: Light Battery I, Fire Control 0, 2x Torpedo Launcher I
1vveapo.zh: 轻型主炮 I、火控 0、2x 鱼雷发射器 I
